e123ab27dbbbf343f56b88e7100df21f74de9bee.open_work: Neural architecture search for minimal MCP representations across large-sample catchments in different hydroclimatic regimes, and information-theoretic training metrics.
e123ab27dbbbf343f56b88e7100df21f74de9bee.issues: Single-catchment study, so findings on architecture may not generalize; predictive skill relative to LSTM benchmarks is not the focus.

1a47c282d505654c8dfa0e5e5901432d06349136.goal: Disentangles separate and confounding effects of temperature and precipitation on global maize yield and quantifies uncertainty across crop model types.
1a47c282d505654c8dfa0e5e5901432d06349136.architecture: Comparison of polynomial regression, a long short-term memory (LSTM) network and process-based crop models within a consistent framework under controlled climate perturbations.
1a47c282d505654c8dfa0e5e5901432d06349136.data: Global maize yield and climate data under 25 climate scenarios combining temperature and precipitation changes; specific yield products not named in the abstract.
1a47c282d505654c8dfa0e5e5901432d06349136.result: With precipitation fixed, +1 °C causes global yield loss of 6.88%, 4.86% or 5.61% (regression, LSTM, process models); +10% precipitation mitigates this by 3.98%, 1.05% or 3.10%; uncertainty is larger under drier conditions.
1a47c282d505654c8dfa0e5e5901432d06349136.open_work: Using multiple model types consistently in impact assessments and exploring other crops and adaptation.
1a47c282d505654c8dfa0e5e5901432d06349136.issues: Simple uniform climate perturbations; statistical and LSTM models may extrapolate poorly outside observed climates; large cross-model discrepancies remain for temperature effects.

26838cb2ea69f8a47978403e0d4f52f43d98d9e5.goal: Tests whether traditional calibrated hydrological models are adequate for climate change impact studies compared with LSTM models, given concerns about extrapolation under strong warming.
26838cb2ea69f8a47978403e0d4f52f43d98d9e5.architecture: Two long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, one regional and one continental, compared with four traditional conceptual hydrological models calibrated per catchment.
26838cb2ea69f8a47978403e0d4f52f43d98d9e5.data: 148 catchments for the regional LSTM plus about 1000 additional continental catchments, many in climates analogous to the future study domain; climate forcing from four simple scenarios and 22 CMIP6 GCMs under SSP5-8.5.
26838cb2ea69f8a47978403e0d4f52f43d98d9e5.result: LSTM models show different climate sensitivity than traditional models; precipitation elasticity and analogue-catchment tests suggest the continental LSTM is best suited for climate change impact studies.
26838cb2ea69f8a47978403e0d4f52f43d98d9e5.open_work: Further verification of LSTM climate sensitivity with more analogue catchments and physically grounded tests of extrapolation.
26838cb2ea69f8a47978403e0d4f52f43d98d9e5.issues: Future streamflow truth is unavailable, so adequacy is inferred indirectly; results may depend on catchment selection and on the specific traditional models compared.

fd79bf89f72aa67ba4b02f2515bc5200cd7df276.goal: Explains why graph neural networks underuse river network topology in flood forecasting and proposes a fix to improve forecasts, especially for extreme floods.
fd79bf89f72aa67ba4b02f2515bc5200cd7df276.architecture: Graph neural network (GNN) applied to a transformed dense, reachability-based graph that reduces resistance distances and over-squashing, compared with an EA-LSTM baseline.
fd79bf89f72aa67ba4b02f2515bc5200cd7df276.data: Water level records and forcing for a river network; specific basins and data products not reported in the abstract.
fd79bf89f72aa67ba4b02f2515bc5200cd7df276.result: GNNs on the dense graph outperform EA-LSTM, particularly for rare extreme floods; 24 h GNN water-level forecasts match EA-LSTM 14 h accuracy, about 10 h earlier warning.
fd79bf89f72aa67ba4b02f2515bc5200cd7df276.open_work: Testing on more river networks and combining with weather forecast inputs for operational early warning.
fd79bf89f72aa67ba4b02f2515bc5200cd7df276.issues: Study region details and generality across networks are unclear from the abstract; dense graphs may lose some physical meaning of flow routing.

e0b6b03dce98b01de6580c898cc349e3cd73e3d0.goal: Improves estimates of snow water equivalent (SWE) and snow density across the western United States by combining physical modelling with machine learning.
e0b6b03dce98b01de6580c898cc349e3cd73e3d0.architecture: Hybrid model in which a neural network is informed by outputs of a physical snow model, compared with a plain LSTM, the physical model and a statistical snow density model.
e0b6b03dce98b01de6580c898cc349e3cd73e3d0.data: Nine years of daily data at 49 SNOTEL sites spanning western US snow climates, with regional and westwide training configurations.
e0b6b03dce98b01de6580c898cc349e3cd73e3d0.result: The hybrid model reduces SWE RMSE by 35% relative to the physical model and 51% relative to the LSTM; regional training gives only minimal benefit over a westwide model.
e0b6b03dce98b01de6580c898cc349e3cd73e3d0.open_work: Extending to spatially distributed SWE mapping and to sites without in situ observations.
e0b6b03dce98b01de6580c898cc349e3cd73e3d0.issues: Point-scale evaluation at SNOTEL stations, which under-sample high elevations and complex terrain; relies on availability of physical model output.

9aff017ab310419aba2f7a987fe50ff0f6c28232.goal: Diagnoses process deficiencies in large-scale operational hydrologic models by identifying catchment attributes that control their performance.
9aff017ab310419aba2f7a987fe50ff0f6c28232.architecture: Random forest predicting Kling-Gupta efficiency of streamflow simulations, explained with SHAP (Shapley value) interpretable machine learning.
9aff017ab310419aba2f7a987fe50ff0f6c28232.data: National Water Model (NWM) and National Hydrologic Model (NHM) streamflow simulations at 4383 stream gauges in the conterminous US, with 48 catchment attributes.
9aff017ab310419aba2f7a987fe50ff0f6c28232.result: Soil water content is the most influential feature; KGE drops for soil water below 210 mm, precipitation below 900 mm/yr, road density above 5 km/km² and lake area above 10%.
9aff017ab310419aba2f7a987fe50ff0f6c28232.open_work: Improving representation of soil water storage, arid processes, reservoirs and human influences in NWM and NHM.
9aff017ab310419aba2f7a987fe50ff0f6c28232.issues: Proof of concept; explains correlations with attributes rather than causal process errors; attribute data quality affects conclusions.

7e50b815ff40143a038377edb64a70a65d832bc7.goal: Improves LSTM simulation of peak streamflow for flood frequency analysis in ungauged catchments, since annual maxima are under-represented in training data.
7e50b815ff40143a038377edb64a70a65d832bc7.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) networks with six enhancements: extra meteorological variables, hybrid inputs from the HYDROTEL distributed model, oversampling of peaks, multi-head attention, donor catchments and combinations.
7e50b815ff40143a038377edb64a70a65d832bc7.data: 88 catchments in Quebec with leave-one-out cross-validation; flood frequency analysis applied to observations and simulations; HYDROTEL as benchmark.
7e50b815ff40143a038377edb64a70a65d832bc7.result: Simple LSTM models simulate peak streamflow as well as HYDROTEL, and hybrid LSTM-hydrological model versions perform better for flood frequency analysis.
7e50b815ff40143a038377edb64a70a65d832bc7.open_work: The authors discuss several pathways to further improve LSTM peak-flow prediction.
7e50b815ff40143a038377edb64a70a65d832bc7.issues: Regional study in Quebec; limited number of annual maxima makes flood quantile evaluation uncertain.

dc0fcad0d6a0a11200ef4a0983e216666b562a53.goal: Reconciles process understanding with state-of-the-art predictive accuracy in deep learning hydrological models.
dc0fcad0d6a0a11200ef4a0983e216666b562a53.architecture: Deep process learning (DPL): a neural network with intuitive physical structure embedded as a structural prior so information flows along hydrologically meaningful paths.
dc0fcad0d6a0a11200ef4a0983e216666b562a53.data: Precipitation-runoff data for catchments across the USA; internal states validated against independent snow water equivalent and evapotranspiration datasets.
dc0fcad0d6a0a11200ef4a0983e216666b562a53.result: Ensemble median NSE 0.758 and KGE 0.778 versus 0.762 and 0.751 for a state-of-the-art deep learning model, with robust transferability and good water budget closure.
dc0fcad0d6a0a11200ef4a0983e216666b562a53.open_work: Applying the approach to other geoscientific domains that need process clarity.
dc0fcad0d6a0a11200ef4a0983e216666b562a53.issues: Gains in accuracy are marginal; process insights depend on chosen priors and on the quality of the independent validation datasets.

f106e37af71ed6bfa7bd94f450cb59951665c5c4.goal: Forecasts drought via the SPEI index while exploiting spatial coherence across neighbouring regions, which benchmark deep learning models ignore.
f106e37af71ed6bfa7bd94f450cb59951665c5c4.architecture: SQUARE-Mamba: a spatially aware neural network with a Mamba state space model for temporal features and quantum neural networks to entangle spatial features across time.
f106e37af71ed6bfa7bd94f450cb59951665c5c4.data: Seven meteorological variables and SPEI for multiple regions; validation over El Niño, La Niña and normal years; specific data products not reported in the abstract.
f106e37af71ed6bfa7bd94f450cb59951665c5c4.result: Average R² improvement above 9.8% over baselines; the quantum component adds over 2.7% R² to the plain Mamba baseline.
f106e37af71ed6bfa7bd94f450cb59951665c5c4.open_work: Longer lead times and wider regional evaluation; code is released.
f106e37af71ed6bfa7bd94f450cb59951665c5c4.issues: Quantum layers are simulated and their practical benefit is modest; study domain and lead times unclear from the abstract.

57761e62e181b8737949b0e703a6a220d608e829.goal: Predicts and explains winter wheat yield anomalies in Germany from non-linear weather and soil moisture effects to support adaptation decisions.
57761e62e181b8737949b0e703a6a220d608e829.architecture: Random forest with monthly features, clustering of districts and average marginal effects for interpretation.
57761e62e181b8737949b0e703a6a220d608e829.data: District-level winter wheat yields in Germany with monthly meteorological extremes and soil moisture features (soil moisture from a hydrological model such as mHM, given the authors).
57761e62e181b8737949b0e703a6a220d608e829.result: Test R² about 0.68; March soil moisture is the most important variable with high moisture harmful; soil moisture explains more variance than meteorology; captures 2003, 2018 losses and 2014 gains.
57761e62e181b8737949b0e703a6a220d608e829.open_work: Developing targeted decision support and extending to other crops and climate projections.
57761e62e181b8737949b0e703a6a220d608e829.issues: Heat effects are missed if clusters are poorly defined; district aggregation and modelled soil moisture introduce uncertainty.

a73b71e6c1b11c4610ee42078a3aedfac24e9960.goal: Reconstructs spatially contiguous daily runoff across all of Switzerland from 1962 to 2023, including ungauged locations, to study long-term water resource changes.
a73b71e6c1b11c4610ee42078a3aedfac24e9960.architecture: Sequential deep learning models: an LSTM recurrent neural network and a 1D temporal convolutional network, driven by temperature, precipitation and static catchment attributes.
a73b71e6c1b11c4610ee42078a3aedfac24e9960.data: Swiss gauged catchment runoff with gridded temperature and precipitation available since the 1960s; spatiotemporal cross-validation and comparison with an operational distributed hydrological model.
a73b71e6c1b11c4610ee42078a3aedfac24e9960.result: Competitive or better performance than the operational model in daily runoff, interannual variability and trends; reveals more frequent dry years and a negative summer runoff trend.
a73b71e6c1b11c4610ee42078a3aedfac24e9960.open_work: Using the efficient model for scenario simulation and climate attribution studies; the product is released online.
a73b71e6c1b11c4610ee42078a3aedfac24e9960.issues: Reconstruction quality in the early period depends on gridded forcing quality; glacier and human regulation effects may be imperfectly learned.

3d39377653a0f427a103889acbe4681c4a8bab2a.goal: Estimates river discharge from medium-resolution satellite imagery, including narrow ungauged rivers where width-based methods fail.
3d39377653a0f427a103889acbe4681c4a8bab2a.architecture: Transformer architecture mapping time series of river surface reflectance imagery directly to discharge.
3d39377653a0f427a103889acbe4681c4a8bab2a.data: Medium-resolution satellite reflectance time series paired with quality-checked records from 2036 discharge gauges.
3d39377653a0f427a103889acbe4681c4a8bab2a.result: Positive KGE in 68.6% of ungauged rivers versus 28.4% for BAM and 33.1% for geoBAM, despite two-thirds of rivers being narrower than 100 m; braided rivers show no degradation.
3d39377653a0f427a103889acbe4681c4a8bab2a.open_work: Scaling to global space-based discharge monitoring and combining with other sensors.
3d39377653a0f427a103889acbe4681c4a8bab2a.issues: Performance in ungauged regions with different optical conditions (clouds, sediment) and climates outside the gauge sample is uncertain.

1991bdc2369c9d05eddf4fca92a03aefd5573bdc.goal: Forecasts seasonal groundwater levels across Germany with a single global machine learning model to support national groundwater management.
1991bdc2369c9d05eddf4fca92a03aefd5573bdc.architecture: Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and N-HiTS (MLP-based neural hierarchical forecasting) global time series models.
1991bdc2369c9d05eddf4fca92a03aefd5573bdc.data: Historical groundwater levels at 5288 monitoring wells in Germany, meteorological inputs and static hydrogeological and soil features; forecasts up to 12 weeks.
1991bdc2369c9d05eddf4fca92a03aefd5573bdc.result: N-HiTS beats TFT with median NSE 0.5 at 12 weeks; 25% of wells exceed NSE 0.68 while 15% are below 0; better in data-dense lowland porous aquifers.
1991bdc2369c9d05eddf4fca92a03aefd5573bdc.open_work: Improving performance at poorly predicted wells and using meteorological forecasts as inputs.
1991bdc2369c9d05eddf4fca92a03aefd5573bdc.issues: Wide performance spread with many poor wells; uses observed meteorology, so operational skill with forecast inputs is untested.

8b22d51b31ef13ad4390bab854efdc2de255287f.goal: Exploits spatial information within watersheds for rainfall-runoff modelling, which watershed-lumped LSTM models ignore.
8b22d51b31ef13ad4390bab854efdc2de255287f.architecture: GNRRM (Graph Neural Rainfall-Runoff Model), a graph neural network using high-resolution precipitation, flow direction and geographic information.
8b22d51b31ef13ad4390bab854efdc2de255287f.data: High-resolution gridded precipitation and streamflow for study watersheds; specific products not reported in the abstract.
8b22d51b31ef13ad4390bab854efdc2de255287f.result: GNRRM overfits less and significantly improves performance compared with baseline models.
8b22d51b31ef13ad4390bab854efdc2de255287f.open_work: Incorporating more domain knowledge into deep learning rainfall-runoff models.
8b22d51b31ef13ad4390bab854efdc2de255287f.issues: No quantitative results or study area details in the abstract; limited evaluation scope likely.

e9e2bf09d83cfceebcea12a2a5d638edf73bc098.goal: Develops a hydrologic data assimilation method that avoids restrictive error-distribution assumptions and better represents posterior distributions.
e9e2bf09d83cfceebcea12a2a5d638edf73bc098.architecture: HydroGEnDA: autoencoders map states to a latent space, a deep generative model learns the state distribution and is conditioned on observations, followed by resampling in physical space.
e9e2bf09d83cfceebcea12a2a5d638edf73bc098.data: Synthetic experiments with the Lorenz-63 model at varying observation noise and real case studies with coupled SNOW-17 and SAC-SMA models across diverse watersheds.
e9e2bf09d83cfceebcea12a2a5d638edf73bc098.result: HydroGEnDA outperforms previous data assimilation methods in both synthetic and real experiments.
e9e2bf09d83cfceebcea12a2a5d638edf73bc098.open_work: Application to higher-dimensional distributed models and more observation types.
e9e2bf09d83cfceebcea12a2a5d638edf73bc098.issues: Trained offline on hydrologic model outputs, so it inherits model biases; tested on low-dimensional lumped models.

d51826bf92e38b2353c2975305f92cd32952b073.goal: Tests whether incorporating river network topology into neural models improves discharge forecasting across gauging stations.
d51826bf92e38b2353c2975305f92cd32952b073.architecture: Graph neural networks (GNNs) with different adjacency definitions, including learned edge weights.
d51826bf92e38b2353c2975305f92cd32952b073.data: River discharge records from a network of gauging stations; specific dataset not reported in the abstract.
d51826bf92e38b2353c2975305f92cd32952b073.result: Models fail to benefit from river network topology on the full network or subgraphs; learned edge weights show no regular pattern; GNNs struggle with sudden discharge spikes.
d51826bf92e38b2353c2975305f92cd32952b073.open_work: Systematic study of when neural prediction benefits from graph structure.
d51826bf92e38b2353c2975305f92cd32952b073.issues: Negative result on a single river network; the cause of the missing benefit is not resolved.

1332ec61b844df34d4d4059914b2b0d8986eb253.goal: Forecasts soil moisture, evapotranspiration and runoff jointly while satisfying water balance, which independent deep learning models violate.
1332ec61b844df34d4d4059914b2b0d8986eb253.architecture: Multitask deep learning model with soft, hard and hybrid physical constraints enforcing water balance.
1332ec61b844df34d4d4059914b2b0d8986eb253.data: ERA5-Land data, which close the water budget, for training and evaluation over gridded domains.
1332ec61b844df34d4d4059914b2b0d8986eb253.result: Multitask models match or beat single-task models; the best multitask model outperforms single-task over 70.5% of grids; the hybrid constrained model is best overall and under reduced data and extrapolation.
1332ec61b844df34d4d4059914b2b0d8986eb253.open_work: Applying the constraints with observational data and other hydrological variables.
1332ec61b844df34d4d4059914b2b0d8986eb253.issues: Trained and evaluated on ERA5-Land, so it inherits reanalysis biases and its water closure by design.

8ae624bc2af3ff909c82384945c6a812cf192151.goal: Corrects orographic quantitative precipitation estimate (QPE) errors in headwater basins to improve flood simulation and nowcasting.
8ae624bc2af3ff909c82384945c6a812cf192151.architecture: Physics-guided AI framework: precipitation regime identification from inverse rainfall correction, then a multilayer perceptron (MLP) error model per regime.
8ae624bc2af3ff909c82384945c6a812cf192151.data: Merged radar and rain gauge QPE products and 57 largest floods in Southern Appalachian headwater basins, 2008–2017.
8ae624bc2af3ff909c82384945c6a812cf192151.result: Hourly KGE improves on average from −0.5 to 0.4 and peak flood error drops 70%, with better results for cold-season events.
8ae624bc2af3ff909c82384945c6a812cf192151.open_work: Generalizing to other mountainous regions and integrating corrected QPE into operational flood nowcasting.
8ae624bc2af3ff909c82384945c6a812cf192151.issues: Limited number of flood events; error climatology depends on the hydrologic inverse correction method.

c7d6e69281912ff7b73f36aade7b2bbd4d68bbbe.goal: Short-term solar irradiance forecasting from sky image sequences for solar energy.
c7d6e69281912ff7b73f36aade7b2bbd4d68bbbe.architecture: Anticipative transformer: vision transformer encoder of consecutive sky images with a transformer decoder predicting future irradiance.
c7d6e69281912ff7b73f36aade7b2bbd4d68bbbe.data: A newly introduced all-sky image dataset with irradiance measurements.
c7d6e69281912ff7b73f36aade7b2bbd4d68bbbe.result: Forecast skill of 21.45% versus smart persistence at 15 minutes ahead; attention focuses on relevant image features.
c7d6e69281912ff7b73f36aade7b2bbd4d68bbbe.open_work: Testing longer horizons and other sites and sky imagers.
c7d6e69281912ff7b73f36aade7b2bbd4d68bbbe.issues: Single dataset and site; short horizon only.

e35f6ca4a56b85ddd1f97d1bc7def271996c7f1a.goal: Tests whether satellite fractional snow-covered area improves operational seasonal water supply forecasts in the western US.
e35f6ca4a56b85ddd1f97d1bc7def271996c7f1a.architecture: Statistical and AI-based models of the NRCS operational water supply forecast system, with genetic algorithm predictor selection.
e35f6ca4a56b85ddd1f97d1bc7def271996c7f1a.data: STC MODSCAG fractional snow-covered area from MODIS with SNOTEL predictors in four watersheds (Walker, Wind, Piedra, Gila Rivers); over 200 forecast models.
e35f6ca4a56b85ddd1f97d1bc7def271996c7f1a.result: fSCA gives roughly 10–25% accuracy gains for short-lead late-season forecasts and helps long-lead forecasts but not at peak accumulation; AI model generally beats statistical.
e35f6ca4a56b85ddd1f97d1bc7def271996c7f1a.open_work: Using fSCA alone in sparsely monitored regions and guiding new SNOTEL site selection.
e35f6ca4a56b85ddd1f97d1bc7def271996c7f1a.issues: Only four watersheds; benefits vary with snowmelt dominance and monitoring density.

33b355c9a41c592ff51e304e2c1bbfea18fd49c5.goal: Review of artificial intelligence applications for predicting crop performance and enhancing food security under drought-induced water stress.
33b355c9a41c592ff51e304e2c1bbfea18fd49c5.architecture: Review of AI and machine learning methods applied to crop yield and drought stress prediction; specific method coverage not reported since the abstract is unavailable.
33b355c9a41c592ff51e304e2c1bbfea18fd49c5.data: Not reported in the abstract; reviewed studies likely draw on remote sensing, weather and field data.
33b355c9a41c592ff51e304e2c1bbfea18fd49c5.open_work: Not reported in the abstract; likely includes data availability, interpretability and transferability of AI crop models.
33b355c9a41c592ff51e304e2c1bbfea18fd49c5.issues: Abstract unavailable; scope and conclusions cannot be verified.

240efb2e8b4f6f5f931b98a32323628e40dd903f.goal: Challenges LSTM's dominance in rainfall-runoff simulation by introducing a deep state space model.
240efb2e8b4f6f5f931b98a32323628e40dd903f.architecture: S4D-FT, a frequency tuned diagonal state space sequence model, benchmarked against LSTM and the physically based SAC-SMA model.
240efb2e8b4f6f5f931b98a32323628e40dd903f.data: 531 CONUS watersheds (the standard CAMELS subset) under in-sample and out-of-sample setups.
240efb2e8b4f6f5f931b98a32323628e40dd903f.result: S4D-FT outperforms LSTM across diverse regions in both setups, especially snowmelt-driven and intermittent regimes, but underperforms in flashy high-magnitude regimes.
240efb2e8b4f6f5f931b98a32323628e40dd903f.open_work: Improving short-burst flow representation and exploring other state space variants.
240efb2e8b4f6f5f931b98a32323628e40dd903f.issues: Weaker on flashy floods due to global convolution emphasizing slow dynamics.

aa17729f8029919998dda402e2e76e0afedebe38.goal: Bias-corrects CMIP6 global ensemble precipitation without paired supervision, improving extremes.
aa17729f8029919998dda402e2e76e0afedebe38.architecture: Unsupervised CycleGAN (cycle-consistent generative adversarial network) compared with a supervised CNN and quantile mapping.
aa17729f8029919998dda402e2e76e0afedebe38.data: CMIP6 ensemble mean precipitation and observational reference; reference product not specified in the abstract.
aa17729f8029919998dda402e2e76e0afedebe38.result: CycleGAN outperforms CNN and quantile mapping for ensemble mean bias correction and better predicts extreme precipitation.
aa17729f8029919998dda402e2e76e0afedebe38.open_work: Extending to individual models, other variables and future projections.
aa17729f8029919998dda402e2e76e0afedebe38.issues: Only ensemble mean corrected; no quantitative metrics in abstract; stationarity of correction under future climate uncertain.

95f9c35e25f3d04fd05a6a6d83ac01c7dc261673.goal: Forecasts total water storage anomaly up to one year ahead and assimilates it to improve land model reanalysis and hydrological forecasts.
95f9c35e25f3d04fd05a6a6d83ac01c7dc261673.architecture: Machine learning forecasts of GRACE TWSA (model type not specified in the abstract) assimilated into the Community Land Model (CLM) via data assimilation.
95f9c35e25f3d04fd05a6a6d83ac01c7dc261673.data: GRACE TWSA over Europe with near-real-time meteorological observations as predictors; validation with observations and reanalysis; five hindcast experiments.
95f9c35e25f3d04fd05a6a6d83ac01c7dc261673.result: ML forecast TWSA correlates 0.91–0.94 with GRACE in Iberia, Danube and Volga basins; assimilation improves CLM forecasts of hydrological states and droughts.
95f9c35e25f3d04fd05a6a6d83ac01c7dc261673.open_work: Integrating into seasonal drought services and future satellite gravity missions.
95f9c35e25f3d04fd05a6a6d83ac01c7dc261673.issues: GRACE coarse resolution and short record; ML architecture details unclear from abstract.

97a649731ecb1079ddc492bbc0ffe3b283c2aac2.goal: Calibrates spatially distributed parameters of a land surface hydrologic model, avoiding the uneven spatial performance caused by single-value objective functions.
97a649731ecb1079ddc492bbc0ffe3b283c2aac2.architecture: Generative adversarial network (GAN-PO): a generator produces spatially coherent parameter fields while a discriminator detects spatial model biases; neural-network surrogates make the VIC model differentiable.
97a649731ecb1079ddc492bbc0ffe3b283c2aac2.data: Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC) model calibrated against evapotranspiration (ET) observations over the Huaihe basin, China.
97a649731ecb1079ddc492bbc0ffe3b283c2aac2.result: GAN-PO reduces ET errors from default parameters in nearly all grid cells, beats parameter regionalization and outperforms differentiable parameter learning (dPL) in spatial performance; ablation shows the discriminator is essential.
97a649731ecb1079ddc492bbc0ffe3b283c2aac2.open_work: Extend to multi-variable calibration (streamflow, soil moisture), other basins and other land surface models.
97a649731ecb1079ddc492bbc0ffe3b283c2aac2.issues: Single basin and single target variable (ET); relies on surrogate fidelity; calibrated parameters may compensate for structural model errors.

8d06385ff8e1886abf4a4a8a12c041c3cf347798.goal: Makes deep learning flood simulation physically interpretable by embedding conceptual hydrological principles into the network.
8d06385ff8e1886abf4a4a8a12c041c3cf347798.architecture: Hybrid recurrent neural network: a physics-based XAJRNN layer encoding Xinanjiang (XAJ) runoff generation and flow routing, fused with LSTM layers.
8d06385ff8e1886abf4a4a8a12c041c3cf347798.data: Streamflow and flood events in the Lushui River and Qingjiang River basins, China; compared with benchmark models.
8d06385ff8e1886abf4a4a8a12c041c3cf347798.result: Average Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency of 0.98 and 0.94 in the two basins, with flood peak relative errors and peak timing errors close to zero.
8d06385ff8e1886abf4a4a8a12c041c3cf347798.open_work: Test transfer to more and more diverse basins, ungauged settings and operational forecasting with forecast forcings.
8d06385ff8e1886abf4a4a8a12c041c3cf347798.issues: Only two basins; very high NSE values suggest testing in simulation mode with observed forcing; interpretability claims rest on the embedded XAJ structure.

5bfd004fbf8e3d6b483973acddb1e252d0d7fb7e.goal: Projects global changes in bivariate flood risk (peak and volume) and their socioeconomic exposure under climate change, and identifies drivers of streamflow change.
5bfd004fbf8e3d6b483973acddb1e252d0d7fb7e.architecture: Supervised machine learning to rank drivers of daily streamflow, plus a physics-constrained cascade with a hybrid deep-learning-hydrological model; copula-style joint return periods.
5bfd004fbf8e3d6b483973acddb1e252d0d7fb7e.data: Bias-corrected outputs of 20 CMIP6 global climate models under four SSPs; global catchment streamflow; population and GDP exposure data.
5bfd004fbf8e3d6b483973acddb1e252d0d7fb7e.result: Under SSP3-7.0 the median joint return period of a 50-year flood falls to about 27.6 years, exposing 186 trillion USD and 4 billion people; downwelling shortwave radiation is the dominant driver of daily streamflow changes.
5bfd004fbf8e3d6b483973acddb1e252d0d7fb7e.open_work: Refine attribution of drivers, include human regulation such as reservoirs and adaptation, and narrow cascade uncertainty.
5bfd004fbf8e3d6b483973acddb1e252d0d7fb7e.issues: Long model chain propagates GCM, bias-correction and hydrological model uncertainty; ML model extrapolates beyond training climate; exposure estimates are scenario-dependent.

fc4fa2c6fd3938c9939094cfd2df68ebb251191f.goal: Projects future bivariate hydrological drought risk (duration and severity) and its GDP and population exposure across China under climate change.
fc4fa2c6fd3938c9939094cfd2df68ebb251191f.architecture: Cascade model chain: random forest for variable importance, five hydrological models coupled with a deep-learning model (hybrid hydrological-deep-learning), copula functions and most-likely-realization method.
fc4fa2c6fd3938c9939094cfd2df68ebb251191f.data: 179 catchments in China; five bias-corrected CMIP6 GCMs under three SSPs; terrestrial water storage anomalies (GRACE-type) and standardized runoff index; GDP and population data.
fc4fa2c6fd3938c9939094cfd2df68ebb251191f.result: The hybrid model reaches KGE above 0.8 in 161 of 179 catchments; by late century bivariate drought risk doubles over 60% of catchments, mainly in southwestern China under SSP5-8.5.
fc4fa2c6fd3938c9939094cfd2df68ebb251191f.open_work: Account for human water use and reservoirs, and quantify uncertainty contributions along the chain.
fc4fa2c6fd3938c9939094cfd2df68ebb251191f.issues: Few GCMs; learned streamflow relationships are extrapolated to future climates; exposure depends on socioeconomic scenarios.

12b108118b5035f6364fc769afb04b6a32f240f7.goal: Produces field-scale (30 m) daily evapotranspiration estimates and diagnoses their error sources across the contiguous United States.
12b108118b5035f6364fc769afb04b6a32f240f7.architecture: Physically based PT-JPL model driven by satellite and reanalysis inputs, followed by a deep neural network (MLP-type) postprocessor; random forest with partial dependence plots for error diagnosis.
12b108118b5035f6364fc769afb04b6a32f240f7.data: ECOSTRESS, MODIS, Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS), ERA5-Land radiation and meteorology; eddy covariance ET at 145 flux sites in CONUS, with held-out test sites.
12b108118b5035f6364fc769afb04b6a32f240f7.result: 30 m ET reaches r = 0.8, RMSE 1.736, KGE 0.466 versus r = 0.485, KGE -0.841 for 70 m ECOSTRESS ET; DNN postprocessing raises test-site performance to r = 0.842, KGE 0.792. Radiation input biases drive most errors.
12b108118b5035f6364fc769afb04b6a32f240f7.open_work: Improve radiation inputs and extend the approach beyond flux-site footprints and to other regions.
12b108118b5035f6364fc769afb04b6a32f240f7.issues: Postprocessor is trained on flux towers, which have energy-balance closure issues and limited land-cover coverage; larger biases in humid, densely vegetated, high-radiation conditions.

504fd6177878b7ae46a6cc33e05647c86aeb2de8.goal: Reduces the cost of large-scale physics-based flood simulation by learning coarse terrain representations that preserve fine-grid flood behavior.
504fd6177878b7ae46a6cc33e05647c86aeb2de8.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network trained to downsample digital elevation maps in a physics-aware way, optimized through a differentiable shallow-water flood simulator so coarse-grid solutions match fine-grid ones.
504fd6177878b7ae46a6cc33e05647c86aeb2de8.data: Purpose-built dataset of terrain elevation maps and fine-grid flood simulations; released with code for reproduction.
504fd6177878b7ae46a6cc33e05647c86aeb2de8.result: Achieves a significant reduction in computational cost while maintaining an accurate flood solution compared with naive coarse-graining.
504fd6177878b7ae46a6cc33e05647c86aeb2de8.open_work: Validate against observed flood extents and integrate into operational flood forecasting at larger scales.
504fd6177878b7ae46a6cc33e05647c86aeb2de8.issues: Evaluated against simulations rather than observed floods; quantitative gains not reported in the abstract; tied to a specific hydraulic solver.

e16a02ea664db71dc79edcbc12949903b9195bf5.goal: Provides a reliable hourly precipitation product for the arid, data-sparse Arabian Peninsula to support hydrology, flood management and climate research.
e16a02ea664db71dc79edcbc12949903b9195bf5.architecture: Stacked machine learning models (18 model stacks) fusing satellite and (re)analysis precipitation with static predictors; the specific learners are not named in the abstract.
e16a02ea664db71dc79edcbc12949903b9195bf5.data: Gauge observations in Saudi Arabia (113) and globally (14,256) as targets; inputs include IMERG, GSMaP, ERA5 and other products; evaluated on 119 independent Saudi gauges; hourly 0.1°, 1979-present.
e16a02ea664db71dc79edcbc12949903b9195bf5.result: SaRa ranks first among 20 products on all metrics, with median KGE 0.36 versus 0.21 for ERA5, -0.39 for IMERG-L V07, 0.29 for IMERG-F V07 and 0.20 for MSWEP V2.8.
e16a02ea664db71dc79edcbc12949903b9195bf5.open_work: Extend to the wider region and evaluate for extremes and hydrological modeling applications.
e16a02ea664db71dc79edcbc12949903b9195bf5.issues: Absolute skill remains modest (median KGE 0.36); sparse gauges limit evaluation of hourly extremes; quality depends on input products in early decades.

737f3ff2d628a27178a60ba620375de3d77915cd.goal: Improves predictions of nitrous oxide emissions from fertilized US croplands, a major and uncertain greenhouse gas source.
737f3ff2d628a27178a60ba620375de3d77915cd.architecture: Ensemble modeling system coupling several process-based ecosystem models with several machine learning models; specific learners not reported in the abstract.
737f3ff2d628a27178a60ba620375de3d77915cd.data: Cropland N2O flux measurements from US food and bioenergy cropping systems across diverse soils and climates; details not reported in the abstract.
737f3ff2d628a27178a60ba620375de3d77915cd.result: The coupled ensemble substantially improves cropland N2O flux predictions and yields insights for improving ecosystem models and guiding field measurements.
737f3ff2d628a27178a60ba620375de3d77915cd.open_work: Use the system to refine ecosystem model processes, target measurements and evaluate N2O mitigation strategies.
737f3ff2d628a27178a60ba620375de3d77915cd.issues: Only the significance statement is available, so data, metrics and skill gains are unspecified; flux observations are sparse and highly episodic.

6c323dc2287b552b7ffae646fc2fc9b89fd367d1.goal: Provides probabilistic extended-range (up to 32 days) forecasts of daily maximum stream water temperature for operational use.
6c323dc2287b552b7ffae646fc2fc9b89fd367d1.architecture: Temporal fusion transformer compared with RNN encoder-decoder, N-HiTS, random forest, MLP and an autoregressive linear model.
6c323dc2287b552b7ffae646fc2fc9b89fd367d1.data: 10 years of data from 54 stations in Switzerland: static catchment features, 64 days of past meteorological observations and 32-day meteorological ensemble forecasts.
6c323dc2287b552b7ffae646fc2fc9b89fd367d1.result: TFT is best with CRPS 0.70 °C averaged over leads (0.38 °C at 1 day to 0.90 °C at 32 days), ahead of RNN (0.74), N-HiTS (0.75), random forest (0.80), MLP (0.81) and linear (0.96); TFT also performs best at ungauged stations.
6c323dc2287b552b7ffae646fc2fc9b89fd367d1.open_work: Reduce error from meteorological ensemble uncertainty at long leads and extend to other regions; forecasts already run operationally twice weekly.
6c323dc2287b552b7ffae646fc2fc9b89fd367d1.issues: Skill at long leads is limited by meteorological forecast uncertainty; evaluation covers 90 forecasts over one year; single country.

e43fce4999bb22f5d36ea622415add25e5a5b211.goal: Forecasts global river discharge and floods while exploiting spatial connections across river networks, beyond local-scale deep learning models.
e43fce4999bb22f5d36ea622415add25e5a5b211.architecture: State space model (Mamba blocks) capturing spatio-temporal relations over large river networks, pretrained on long-term reanalysis, with forecast blocks that ingest meteorological forecasts.
e43fce4999bb22f5d36ea622415add25e5a5b211.data: Long-term reanalysis data for pretraining (GloFAS-type discharge reanalysis), ECMWF HRES meteorological forecasts; global 0.05° grid, up to 7-day lead time.
e43fce4999bb22f5d36ea622415add25e5a5b211.result: Provides reliable discharge predictions across flood return periods, including extreme floods, and lead times, surpassing both AI- and physics-based models.
e43fce4999bb22f5d36ea622415add25e5a5b211.open_work: Extend lead times, add uncertainty quantification and evaluate operationally against gauged observations worldwide.
e43fce4999bb22f5d36ea622415add25e5a5b211.issues: Training on reanalysis targets inherits its biases; deterministic forecasts; quantitative gains not given in the abstract.

907874b1314ea8a8cd8ca0f8471618069998ee66.goal: Improves seasonal prediction of summer drought, measured by consecutive dry days (CDD), over China.
907874b1314ea8a8cd8ca0f8471618069998ee66.architecture: Convolutional neural network predicting principal components of the six leading EOF modes of CDD anomalies, projected back onto observed patterns.
907874b1314ea8a8cd8ca0f8471618069998ee66.data: Previous-winter precipitation, 2-m temperature and 500 hPa geopotential height as predictors; observed CDD over China; independent hindcast period 2007-2018.
907874b1314ea8a8cd8ca0f8471618069998ee66.result: The six PCs are significantly predicted and summer CDD patterns reach anomaly correlation generally above 0.2 three months ahead, with skill over the Yangtze valley, northwestern and northern China.
907874b1314ea8a8cd8ca0f8471618069998ee66.open_work: Add other predictors such as SST and soil moisture and compare with dynamical seasonal forecasts.
907874b1314ea8a8cd8ca0f8471618069998ee66.issues: Short hindcast period (12 years) and modest skill; EOF truncation limits spatial detail; small sample for training CNN.

211c6f5b7ad3689d8caf7e9beddcdf63f1ba17d1.goal: Tests whether accurate LSTM rainfall-runoff models rely on hydrologically plausible internal mechanisms (functional realism).
211c6f5b7ad3689d8caf7e9beddcdf63f1ba17d1.architecture: Hydrology-specific explainable AI framework that extracts nonlinear, lag-dependent, time-varying impulse response functions from LSTM networks for precipitation, temperature and PET.
211c6f5b7ad3689d8caf7e9beddcdf63f1ba17d1.data: 672 North American catchments with strong LSTM predictive skill; forcings of precipitation, temperature and potential evapotranspiration.
211c6f5b7ad3689d8caf7e9beddcdf63f1ba17d1.result: High accuracy often masks implausible reasoning: in over 70% of rain-dominated basins temperature rises increase simulated streamflow without rain, and in snow basins PET is misattributed as a snowmelt driver.
211c6f5b7ad3689d8caf7e9beddcdf63f1ba17d1.open_work: Use the diagnostic to constrain or regularize LSTM training and test robustness under climate shifts and extremes.
211c6f5b7ad3689d8caf7e9beddcdf63f1ba17d1.issues: Diagnosis only, no remedy proposed; IRF extraction depends on perturbation design; limited to North America.

58ba037b74ad9b61f84dba007a4865c8ea96c934.goal: Improves streamflow prediction in data-scarce basins by transferring LSTM knowledge from data-rich regions.
58ba037b74ad9b61f84dba007a4865c8ea96c934.architecture: Transfer learning with LSTM networks pre-trained on donor basins and fine-tuned locally; K-Means clustering of catchment attributes to select donor groups.
58ba037b74ad9b61f84dba007a4865c8ea96c934.data: 441 donor basins from Scotland, Switzerland and British Columbia; 36 target basins in data-poor region (CA); ERA5 climate data and lagged streamflow.
58ba037b74ad9b61f84dba007a4865c8ea96c934.result: TL-LSTM pre-trained on clusters beats locally trained models (NSE 0.85, KGE 0.80); the cluster most similar to the target region gives the best results, and short local records improve fine-tuning.
58ba037b74ad9b61f84dba007a4865c8ea96c934.open_work: Test transfer to more climates and fully ungauged basins without lagged streamflow.
58ba037b74ad9b61f84dba007a4865c8ea96c934.issues: Uses lagged observed streamflow as input, limiting use in truly ungauged basins; small target set; ambiguity in target region definition in the abstract.

fd9ae50a8b2442c0aebb811f1d78f957e4748f71.goal: Produces streamflow forecasts that are consistent across timescales (daily and weekly) for decision-making.
fd9ae50a8b2442c0aebb811f1d78f957e4748f71.architecture: Hierarchical deep learning model based on LSTM networks with temporal hierarchical reconciliation implemented as a differentiable output layer.
fd9ae50a8b2442c0aebb811f1d78f957e4748f71.data: Over 400 catchments in the contiguous United States (CAMELS-type data); seven-day-ahead daily and weekly forecasts.
fd9ae50a8b2442c0aebb811f1d78f957e4748f71.result: Improves median daily NSE (3.01% at lead one) over a multi-timescale LSTM and is more accurate than aggregated daily forecasts in over 65% of catchments weekly; 9.45% median NSE gain for the worst decile.
fd9ae50a8b2442c0aebb811f1d78f957e4748f71.open_work: Extend to more timescales, probabilistic reconciliation and other water resources variables.
fd9ae50a8b2442c0aebb811f1d78f957e4748f71.issues: Modest gains for typical catchments; deterministic forecasts; performance depends on reconciliation formulation.

ed2370a1ea411ac47f227574be22063ba6d77d40.goal: Predicts crop yield under drought with machine learning across scales and examines predictive drivers and transferability between European and Asian climates.
ed2370a1ea411ac47f227574be22063ba6d77d40.architecture: Machine learning models at multiple scales; specific algorithms are not known from the title (abstract not available).
ed2370a1ea411ac47f227574be22063ba6d77d40.data: Not reported; presumably drought indices, climate and remote sensing predictors with crop yield records in Europe and Asia.
ed2370a1ea411ac47f227574be22063ba6d77d40.result: Not available; the title implies an analysis of key drivers and of how well models transfer between climates.
ed2370a1ea411ac47f227574be22063ba6d77d40.open_work: Likely improving cross-region transferability of yield models under drought.
ed2370a1ea411ac47f227574be22063ba6d77d40.issues: Abstract missing; content inferred from the title only.

aab53f5b55172a7d12e60e9f0c5bc764ddbabdb0.goal: Estimates global partitioning of runoff into baseflow and quickflow by combining a physical framework with machine learning.
aab53f5b55172a7d12e60e9f0c5bc764ddbabdb0.architecture: Hybrid Budyko-constrained machine learning: boosted regression trees predict parameters of the Budyko curve and a new baseflow coefficient curve from 13 climatic and physiographic properties.
aab53f5b55172a7d12e60e9f0c5bc764ddbabdb0.data: 1,461 catchments worldwide for training and testing; applied globally at 0.25° grid.
aab53f5b55172a7d12e60e9f0c5bc764ddbabdb0.result: Test R2 of 0.96 for runoff and 0.91 for baseflow; globally 35.3% of precipitation becomes runoff (19.6% baseflow, 15.7% quickflow); vegetation controls Budyko alpha and soil controls baseflow parameters.
aab53f5b55172a7d12e60e9f0c5bc764ddbabdb0.open_work: Extend to temporal variability and changing climate, and evaluate in poorly gauged regions.
aab53f5b55172a7d12e60e9f0c5bc764ddbabdb0.issues: Long-term mean water balance only; catchment sample biased to gauged regions; baseflow separation method uncertainty affects targets.

c42f00d7af5762b7d8acfeeb9ca4312ccd409f4d.goal: Improves large-sample streamflow prediction where detailed basin attributes are hard to obtain.
c42f00d7af5762b7d8acfeeb9ca4312ccd409f4d.architecture: Geo-ViT-LSTM: vision transformer encoding remote sensing basin imagery into attributes combined with a global LSTM network.
c42f00d7af5762b7d8acfeeb9ca4312ccd409f4d.data: 531 basins across the contiguous United States (CAMELS-type); remote sensing imagery for basin attributes.
c42f00d7af5762b7d8acfeeb9ca4312ccd409f4d.result: Shows superior accuracy over baselines in both temporal and spatiotemporal extrapolation scenarios; numbers not reported in the abstract.
c42f00d7af5762b7d8acfeeb9ca4312ccd409f4d.open_work: Apply to regions lacking attribute data and other land surface variables.
c42f00d7af5762b7d8acfeeb9ca4312ccd409f4d.issues: Quantitative improvements not given; CONUS only; interpretability of learned attributes unclear.

ae2920be47b1d2d8af3c0c9dd1f86f476baedb05.goal: Develops a knowledge-guided ML system for operational catchment flood forecasting that efficiently integrates real-time data.
ae2920be47b1d2d8af3c0c9dd1f86f476baedb05.architecture: Factorized Hierarchical Neural Network with an inverse model inferring catchment state from observations and a forward model predicting streamflow; inference-based data integration instead of optimization-based data assimilation; compared with autoregressive LSTM.
ae2920be47b1d2d8af3c0c9dd1f86f476baedb05.data: CAMELS-US large-sample dataset and US National Weather Service operational flood forecasts.
ae2920be47b1d2d8af3c0c9dd1f86f476baedb05.result: Human NWS forecasters are more accurate in the first 12-18 hours, but FHNN is significantly better at later lead times.
ae2920be47b1d2d8af3c0c9dd1f86f476baedb05.open_work: Combine AI models with forecaster expertise in operational river forecasting.
ae2920be47b1d2d8af3c0c9dd1f86f476baedb05.issues: Comparison with NWS depends on forcing used; early-lead skill below human forecasts; limited to evaluated basins.

83037785153c44d6c3f9b6052b4dc0293a3ef99a.goal: Predicts rapidly developing flash droughts, addressing imbalanced and limited data for ML.
83037785153c44d6c3f9b6052b4dc0293a3ef99a.data: Flash drought events in Eastern Australia, 2001-2022; training 2001-2015, validation 2016-2017, test 2018-2022; predictor datasets not named in the abstract.
83037785153c44d6c3f9b6052b4dc0293a3ef99a.result: Balanced accuracy of 80% and AUC of 93% on the test period.
83037785153c44d6c3f9b6052b4dc0293a3ef99a.open_work: Reduce overestimation of drought extent and extend to longer leads and other regions.
83037785153c44d6c3f9b6052b4dc0293a3ef99a.issues: Overestimates the spatial extent of droughts; lead time unclear in abstract; rare events limit training data.

d74132aa940a62a2e9c23e2765297a967dc97e95.goal: Improves subseasonal (15-28 day) forecasts of soil moisture and the Evaporative Stress Index for flash drought prediction.
d74132aa940a62a2e9c23e2765297a967dc97e95.architecture: Statistical-dynamical forecasts enhanced with nonlinear machine learning methods compared with linear regression.
d74132aa940a62a2e9c23e2765297a967dc97e95.data: Current and past land surface states and S2S Prediction Project dynamical hindcasts; soil moisture at 0-10 and 0-100 cm and ESI.
d74132aa940a62a2e9c23e2765297a967dc97e95.result: Skill gains come almost entirely from initial land state predictors, not dynamical model output; nonlinear ML helps soil moisture but not ESI; gains mainly in soil moistening rather than drying.
d74132aa940a62a2e9c23e2765297a967dc97e95.open_work: Optimize use of current land state information in operational S2S flash drought forecasts.
d74132aa940a62a2e9c23e2765297a967dc97e95.issues: Little improvement for drought onset (drying); limited value from dynamical forecasts at present.

a353776126a5dffaf1a4c8af8ef5d125ddae9a16.goal: Infills missing radar rainfall data, such as during radar outages, while accounting for spatiotemporal variability of precipitation.
a353776126a5dffaf1a4c8af8ef5d125ddae9a16.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network with a memory component (recurrent) using sequences before and after the gap.
a353776126a5dffaf1a4c8af8ef5d125ddae9a16.data: Hourly RADKLIM 1 km radar-gauge precipitation over Germany; artificial and real gaps; events including May 2012 and July 2021 (Ahrtal flood).
a353776126a5dffaf1a4c8af8ef5d125ddae9a16.result: Effectively infills artificial and actual gaps, including during significant rainfall events; quantitative metrics not given in the abstract.
a353776126a5dffaf1a4c8af8ef5d125ddae9a16.open_work: Use in nowcasting and hydrological applications and transfer to other radar networks.
a353776126a5dffaf1a4c8af8ef5d125ddae9a16.issues: Single dataset and country; skill for large gaps during extremes may be limited; numbers not reported in abstract.

1d1512bd87ec22d80af66d6a26c78bf4d1279a5a.goal: Reviews and experimentally compares deep learning techniques for solar irradiance forecasting and prediction.
1d1512bd87ec22d80af66d6a26c78bf4d1279a5a.architecture: Review with experimental comparison of deep learning models for solar irradiance; the models compared are not available in the metadata.
1d1512bd87ec22d80af66d6a26c78bf4d1279a5a.data: Not reported; presumably public irradiance datasets.
1d1512bd87ec22d80af66d6a26c78bf4d1279a5a.open_work: Likely identifies directions such as hybrid physics-ML and multimodal inputs.
1d1512bd87ec22d80af66d6a26c78bf4d1279a5a.issues: Abstract missing; content inferred from the title only.

04bfcf970c6f4c847bddee774a30eeaba23b0eb2.goal: Provides a benchmark and model for subseasonal-to-seasonal drought prediction and understanding over CONUS.
04bfcf970c6f4c847bddee774a30eeaba23b0eb2.architecture: Benchmark dataset DroughtSet plus a spatial-temporal deep learning model (SPDrought) predicting three drought indices with feature-importance analysis.
04bfcf970c6f4c847bddee774a30eeaba23b0eb2.data: Predictive features and three drought indices from multiple remote sensing and reanalysis datasets across the contiguous United States.
04bfcf970c6f4c847bddee774a30eeaba23b0eb2.result: SPDrought predicts three drought types simultaneously and offers insights into sensitivity of drought to physical and biological drivers; numbers not given in abstract.
04bfcf970c6f4c847bddee774a30eeaba23b0eb2.open_work: Use DroughtSet to benchmark more time-series and spatio-temporal forecasting methods.
04bfcf970c6f4c847bddee774a30eeaba23b0eb2.issues: CONUS only; quantitative skill not reported in the abstract; reanalysis inputs carry biases.

a7cf32d122bfcc0247bb361d6e432e08be5b856f.goal: Provides a reproducible workflow for probabilistic seasonal streamflow volume forecasts in snow-fed basins across North America.
a7cf32d122bfcc0247bb361d6e432e08be5b856f.architecture: Non-deep statistical workflow: quantile mapping for gap-filling SWE, principal component analysis and regression for ensemble hindcasts.
a7cf32d122bfcc0247bb361d6e432e08be5b856f.data: Snow water equivalent and precipitation station data, streamflow observations for 75 nival basins in Canada and the USA, 1979-2021.
a7cf32d122bfcc0247bb361d6e432e08be5b856f.result: Predicts lower and higher than normal spring-early summer flows up to 5 months ahead in some basins; late-season snowpack is key, while target-period precipitation reduces skill.
a7cf32d122bfcc0247bb361d6e432e08be5b856f.open_work: Include climate forecasts and other predictors and assess changing predictability.
a7cf32d122bfcc0247bb361d6e432e08be5b856f.issues: Linear regression on SWE misses precipitation during the target period; limited to unregulated basins.

15c8a1442e428282ae3bb4f965d5ccb87a64d830.goal: Bias-corrects CMIP6 solar radiation over Africa using physics-constrained deep learning to inform solar power planning under climate change.
15c8a1442e428282ae3bb4f965d5ccb87a64d830.architecture: Physics-constrained deep learning bias correction model; architecture not known (abstract not available).
15c8a1442e428282ae3bb4f965d5ccb87a64d830.data: CMIP6 surface solar radiation over Africa, presumably corrected against reanalysis or satellite products.
15c8a1442e428282ae3bb4f965d5ccb87a64d830.open_work: Likely implications for photovoltaic potential and planning under future scenarios.
15c8a1442e428282ae3bb4f965d5ccb87a64d830.issues: Abstract missing; content inferred from the title only.

77ac6c4a39392af32e38ced4a550459caf8e64a6.goal: Assesses future changes in atmospheric circulation types linked to compound coastal flooding in Europe.
77ac6c4a39392af32e38ced4a550459caf8e64a6.architecture: Deep learning ensemble (neural network classifiers) for automatic classification of Hess-Brezowsky Grosswetterlagen.
77ac6c4a39392af32e38ced4a550459caf8e64a6.data: 31 realisations of CMIP6 simulations under SSP1-2.6, SSP3-7.0 and SSP5-8.5.
77ac6c4a39392af32e38ced4a550459caf8e64a6.result: Robust increase in winter frequency of the Cyclonic Westerly pattern by 2100 across models and scenarios, implying increasing compound flood risk.
77ac6c4a39392af32e38ced4a550459caf8e64a6.open_work: Link circulation changes directly to surge and discharge modeling.
77ac6c4a39392af32e38ced4a550459caf8e64a6.issues: Classification inherits subjectivity of the original catalog; circulation types are an indirect proxy for flood risk.

40201772894f08b5a80082e13a7aaea7e2554a80.goal: Improves streamflow prediction in ungauged basins using foundation-model embeddings of basin characteristics.
40201772894f08b5a80082e13a7aaea7e2554a80.architecture: Deep learning hydrological models using AlphaEarth Foundation satellite embeddings in place of or alongside traditional catchment attributes; embedding similarity for donor basin selection.
40201772894f08b5a80082e13a7aaea7e2554a80.data: AlphaEarth satellite embeddings and streamflow records; specific basin dataset not named in the abstract.
40201772894f08b5a80082e13a7aaea7e2554a80.result: Embedding-based models achieve higher accuracy in basins not used for training; similarity-selected donors improve performance, while many dissimilar donors reduce accuracy.
40201772894f08b5a80082e13a7aaea7e2554a80.open_work: Interpret what embeddings encode physically and test across regions.
40201772894f08b5a80082e13a7aaea7e2554a80.issues: Quantitative gains and dataset not reported; embeddings are opaque.

3f316e910cd7f72cd43c29494df05665b2bc343a.goal: Discovers governing equations for soil water flow in heterogeneous soils from data.
3f316e910cd7f72cd43c29494df05665b2bc343a.architecture: Extended-DeepGS: deep learning framework with group sparse regression for equation discovery; not a forecasting network.
3f316e910cd7f72cd43c29494df05665b2bc343a.data: Time series of volumetric soil water content from numerical experiments.
3f316e910cd7f72cd43c29494df05665b2bc343a.result: Simultaneously reconstructs soil moisture dynamics and governing equations robustly in numerical experiments.
3f316e910cd7f72cd43c29494df05665b2bc343a.open_work: Apply to field observations and address limitations discussed.
3f316e910cd7f72cd43c29494df05665b2bc343a.issues: Tested on synthetic numerical experiments only; relies on assumed generalized equation form.

ec18f7ac707713939f969960523c5d52ab7c0ee4.goal: Develops a hybrid subseasonal-to-seasonal forecasting system for UK flood risk months ahead.
ec18f7ac707713939f969960523c5d52ab7c0ee4.architecture: Quantile regression forest (random forest) trained on dynamical forecasts plus static catchment attributes in a large-sample multi-site setup.
ec18f7ac707713939f969960523c5d52ab7c0ee4.data: C3S multimodel ensemble of 196 members from eight seasonal forecast models; 579 UK stations, 2004-2016.
ec18f7ac707713939f969960523c5d52ab7c0ee4.result: Large-sample model slightly but significantly beats single-site models; positive CRPSS in 60% of stations in month 1, falling to 33% in month 4.
ec18f7ac707713939f969960523c5d52ab7c0ee4.issues: Skill declines rapidly; short hindcast period.

8adac2484e4a871ffe4ecfe0fcca6817ec05708d.goal: Improves day-ahead solar irradiance forecasting resolution for PV grid integration.
8adac2484e4a871ffe4ecfe0fcca6817ec05708d.architecture: SolarCrossFormer: graph neural network transformer combining satellite images and ground station time series.
8adac2484e4a871ffe4ecfe0fcca6817ec05708d.data: Satellite imagery and ground meteorological station network across Switzerland, one year, 127 locations.
8adac2484e4a871ffe4ecfe0fcca6817ec05708d.result: Normalized MAE of 6.1% over the horizon, competitive with a commercial numerical weather prediction service.
8adac2484e4a871ffe4ecfe0fcca6817ec05708d.open_work: Extend to other regions and longer test periods.

fd35c70534e8715caa47bde0d62a6817af535646.goal: Forecasts country-scale daily solar and wind power production in France for grid stability and price prediction, using spatially resolved weather data instead of bottom-up plant-level forecasts.
fd35c70534e8715caa47bde0d62a6817af535646.architecture: Benchmark of machine learning models (tree-based gradient boosting, MLP-type neural networks and a convolutional computer vision architecture) with three ways of handling gridded weather: spatial averaging, principal component analysis and CNN input.
fd35c70534e8715caa47bde0d62a6817af535646.data: New dataset 2012–2023: daily RTE national solar and wind production as target; ERA5 daily weather, production-site capacity and location, and electricity prices as inputs.
fd35c70534e8715caa47bde0d62a6817af535646.result: Time-series-aware cross-validation gives the lowest errors; neural networks beat tree-based models, which fail to extrapolate under growing capacity. Normalized RMSE is 4–10% at midterm horizon, comparable to single-plant models.
fd35c70534e8715caa47bde0d62a6817af535646.open_work: Extend to sub-daily resolution and operational forecast inputs rather than reanalysis, and test transfer to other countries.
fd35c70534e8715caa47bde0d62a6817af535646.issues: Uses ERA5 reanalysis as input, so skill with real NWP forecasts is untested; daily resolution only; capacity growth makes the target non-stationary.

68a3ea159bfdfcc72ece99868d6087237cc406af.goal: Improves estimation of rice phenological dates, since satellite-only methods miss interannual variation driven by climate.
68a3ea159bfdfcc72ece99868d6087237cc406af.architecture: Hybrid random forest model combining growth-stage-specific climate predictors with satellite-derived phenology metrics.
68a3ea159bfdfcc72ece99868d6087237cc406af.data: Satellite vegetation proxies (CSIF solar-induced fluorescence and LAI) plus climate predictors such as temperature indicators; ground phenology observations as reference. Region and period not reported in the abstract.
68a3ea159bfdfcc72ece99868d6087237cc406af.result: The hybrid model cuts errors by over 60% versus satellite-only methods; climate data add about 13% in R2 on average, with temperature indicators most important; CSIF outperforms LAI.
68a3ea159bfdfcc72ece99868d6087237cc406af.open_work: Extend to other crops and regions and use the model to study climate-change effects on phenology.
68a3ea159bfdfcc72ece99868d6087237cc406af.issues: Random forest may not extrapolate to unprecedented climate; relies on quality of ground phenology records; study domain details not given in the abstract.

f4cd57614e6ca241476bd9056bec1ee8a9082020.goal: Predicts pixel-level vineyard yield by jointly modeling weather, remote sensing and management practices.
f4cd57614e6ca241476bd9056bec1ee8a9082020.architecture: Climate-Management Aware Vision Transformer (CMAViT), a multimodal transformer with cross-attention encoding text-form management practices against time-series weather and imagery.
f4cd57614e6ca241476bd9056bec1ee8a9082020.data: Remote sensing imagery and short-term meteorological data over 2,200 ha of vineyards with eight grape cultivars and over 5 million vines, 2016–2019.
f4cd57614e6ca241476bd9056bec1ee8a9082020.result: R2 of 0.84 and MAPE 8.22% on unseen test data, beating UNet-ConvLSTM especially for extreme yields; removing management, climate or both drops R2 to 0.73, 0.70 and 0.72.
f4cd57614e6ca241476bd9056bec1ee8a9082020.open_work: Test on longer records, other crops and regions, and with seasonal climate forecasts for prospective prediction.
f4cd57614e6ca241476bd9056bec1ee8a9082020.issues: Only four seasons from one vineyard operation, limiting interannual climate variability sampled; generalization to other sites is untested.

25c7e774537093f77f8b206c5694a6f5a213ae5b.goal: Quantifies future meteorological drought risk over New Zealand, which needs large, high-resolution ensembles too costly to produce with regional climate models.
25c7e774537093f77f8b206c5694a6f5a213ae5b.architecture: Generative AI downscaling emulator (deep generative model; exact family not stated in the abstract) trained to emulate a physics-based regional climate model, applied to many GCM large ensembles.
25c7e774537093f77f8b206c5694a6f5a213ae5b.data: 20 CMIP6 GCMs, including two single-model initial-condition large ensembles, downscaled to 12 km; training target is the dynamical RCM; SSP3-7.0 scenario.
25c7e774537093f77f8b206c5694a6f5a213ae5b.result: The emulator adds value similar to the RCM for precipitation and drought metrics. Droughts intensify over most of the country; current-climate extreme droughts up to twice as long as in small ensembles, reaching about 30 months in some places under SSP3-7.0.
25c7e774537093f77f8b206c5694a6f5a213ae5b.open_work: Apply to other hazards and regions and further assess emulator fidelity for extremes outside the training distribution.
25c7e774537093f77f8b206c5694a6f5a213ae5b.issues: Emulator inherits RCM and GCM biases and may not extrapolate under strong warming; drought duration and frequency changes remain highly uncertain.

0de2078138812d976ad0832cf88504a3c353b71e.goal: Determines which variational data assimilation strategy works best for differentiable (physics-informed ML) hydrologic models in short-term streamflow forecasting.
0de2078138812d976ad0832cf88504a3c353b71e.architecture: Differentiable hydrologic model with neural network parameterization, plus variational DA that optimizes adjusters on precipitation forcing, internal hydrological states, or both; compared with LSTM with DA.
0de2078138812d976ad0832cf88504a3c353b71e.data: CAMELS basins across the conterminous United States.
0de2078138812d976ad0832cf88504a3c353b71e.result: Variational DA raises one-day-lead median NSE from 0.75 to 0.82, matching or beating LSTM with DA in eastern, northwestern and central Great Plains regions; state adjusters matter most, precipitation adjusters help high flows.
0de2078138812d976ad0832cf88504a3c353b71e.open_work: Apply the framework to whole river networks and longer lead times operationally.
0de2078138812d976ad0832cf88504a3c353b71e.issues: Evaluated mainly at one-day lead on CAMELS basins; benefits vary regionally; uses observed rather than forecast forcings in hindcast.

376e9b77e3d4e9386b59cbc8f0a585ee02441fe6.goal: Short-term (1–6 h) national-level wind power forecasting to support grid balancing with growing wind capacity.
376e9b77e3d4e9386b59cbc8f0a585ee02441fe6.architecture: Automated deep learning (neural architecture search over deep networks, including convolutional models) applied to NWP wind speed maps.
376e9b77e3d4e9386b59cbc8f0a585ee02441fe6.data: Numerical weather prediction wind speed maps and national wind power production; country, period and NWP product not reported in the abstract.
376e9b77e3d4e9386b59cbc8f0a585ee02441fe6.result: Abstract claims accurate national short-term forecasts; quantitative gains not reported in the abstract.
376e9b77e3d4e9386b59cbc8f0a585ee02441fe6.open_work: Extend to probabilistic forecasts and longer horizons; compare against operational benchmarks in more detail.
376e9b77e3d4e9386b59cbc8f0a585ee02441fe6.issues: Abstract is brief and gives no metrics; AutoDL search cost and robustness to capacity changes not discussed.

ac55221564370bfe933626a5085aaeac9d771d01.goal: Produces probabilistic wind power forecasts for offshore wind farms to support grid integration.
ac55221564370bfe933626a5085aaeac9d771d01.architecture: Gradient boosting trees combined with three probabilistic methods: conformalized quantile regression, natural gradient boosting and conditional diffusion models; baselines are power curve, wake model and variational Gaussian process regression.
ac55221564370bfe933626a5085aaeac9d771d01.data: Four years of production data for all Belgian offshore wind farms with an ensemble of weather forecasts from multiple providers.
ac55221564370bfe933626a5085aaeac9d771d01.result: Tree-based models clearly reduce MAE over deterministic baselines; the conditional diffusion model is best, improving MAE by 5% and CRPS by 12% over the GP baseline; using multiple weather forecasts improves point accuracy by 17% on average.
ac55221564370bfe933626a5085aaeac9d771d01.open_work: Extend to longer horizons, other farm types and spatio-temporal dependence across farms.
ac55221564370bfe933626a5085aaeac9d771d01.issues: Single region; four years of data; performance depends on the available weather providers.

44c1f57445286b90b99e5e44bd12cc0317aae7ff.goal: Builds a global daily streamflow forecasting model that closes the performance gap when moving from reanalysis forcing to operational forecasts.
44c1f57445286b90b99e5e44bd12cc0317aae7ff.architecture: AIFL, a deterministic LSTM with two-stage transfer learning: pre-training on reanalysis then fine-tuning on operational forecast forcing.
44c1f57445286b90b99e5e44bd12cc0317aae7ff.data: 18,588 Caravan basins; ERA5-Land 1980–2019 pre-training; ECMWF IFS forecasts 2016–2019 fine-tuning; independent test 2021–2024.
44c1f57445286b90b99e5e44bd12cc0317aae7ff.result: Median KGE' 0.66 and NSE 0.53 on the test period, comparable to state-of-the-art global systems; two-stage training beats IFS-only and mixed-forcing alternatives.
44c1f57445286b90b99e5e44bd12cc0317aae7ff.open_work: Add probabilistic output, longer lead times and data assimilation of recent discharge.
44c1f57445286b90b99e5e44bd12cc0317aae7ff.issues: Deterministic only; short IFS fine-tuning period; Caravan gauge coverage is uneven across regions.

8161d36277d58649276ff3bf288e5c3419af85f6.goal: Quantifies historical and future surface soil moisture drying, which is debated and linked to droughts, heatwaves and wildfires.
8161d36277d58649276ff3bf288e5c3419af85f6.architecture: Deep learning gap-filling of satellite soil moisture records, then observational constraint applied to Earth System Model projections. Network family not reported in the abstract.
8161d36277d58649276ff3bf288e5c3419af85f6.data: Remote sensing surface soil moisture 1983–2020 and 23 CMIP6 ESMs over 1901–2100.
8161d36277d58649276ff3bf288e5c3419af85f6.result: About half of global land dried over the past four decades; observation-constrained projections show weaker drying in dry–wet transition zones and monsoon margins than raw ESMs.
8161d36277d58649276ff3bf288e5c3419af85f6.open_work: Integrate remote sensing and AI into ESMs to improve soil moisture–atmosphere feedbacks and drought projections.
8161d36277d58649276ff3bf288e5c3419af85f6.issues: Gap-filled data may carry retrieval and ML errors into the constraint; constraint method assumes stationarity of observed relationships.

566b5e5d3ed89f050ca6a5b2f6e5ac0cdb58aadc.goal: Provides probabilistic hourly streamflow prediction for flood warning, since hourly peaks exceed daily values and LSTM schemes handle uncertainty and observations poorly.
566b5e5d3ed89f050ca6a5b2f6e5ac0cdb58aadc.architecture: h-Diffusion, a denoising diffusion probabilistic model conditioned on observed or simulated daily discharge to generate hourly hydrographs, with inpainting for data assimilation.
566b5e5d3ed89f050ca6a5b2f6e5ac0cdb58aadc.data: CAMELS hourly dataset (US basins); baselines MTS-LSTM and MF-LSTM.
566b5e5d3ed89f050ca6a5b2f6e5ac0cdb58aadc.result: Outperforms the LSTM baselines on general and extreme metrics; inpainting with recent observations greatly improves flood forecasts and can inversely estimate rainfall.
566b5e5d3ed89f050ca6a5b2f6e5ac0cdb58aadc.open_work: Operational testing with forecast forcing and extension to ungauged basins.
566b5e5d3ed89f050ca6a5b2f6e5ac0cdb58aadc.issues: Depends on daily discharge input quality; diffusion sampling is costly; evaluated on CAMELS only.

46048718cfeeaab9466a2021dd713ec3ae7829c2.goal: Mitigates skill loss in deep learning runoff forecasts when switching from reanalysis to biased meteorological forecast inputs.
46048718cfeeaab9466a2021dd713ec3ae7829c2.architecture: LSTM variants including Encoder–Decoder LSTM and Sequential Forecast LSTM, with transfer learning, input embeddings and assimilation of past discharge.
46048718cfeeaab9466a2021dd713ec3ae7829c2.data: Extended LamaH-CE dataset, 451 Central European basins; reanalysis and meteorological forecast forcings; maximum daily discharge targets.
46048718cfeeaab9466a2021dd713ec3ae7829c2.result: Domain shift drops median NSE from 0.58 to 0.33; Sequential Forecast LSTM reaches 0.63 and adding recent discharge gives 0.71, above the reanalysis baseline; biggest gains in arid catchments.
46048718cfeeaab9466a2021dd713ec3ae7829c2.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and probabilistic forecasts; exploit catchment attributes to target bias correction.
46048718cfeeaab9466a2021dd713ec3ae7829c2.issues: Archived forecasts and complex embeddings sometimes destabilize training; gains are smaller in alpine and snow catchments; regional dataset only.

9890bd5c4e8eb91b2cb24c9dbf53c0bfe69196c3.goal: Provides a fully spatially resolved dataset so neural rainfall–streamflow models can go beyond lumped catchments.
9890bd5c4e8eb91b2cb24c9dbf53c0bfe69196c3.architecture: Benchmark dataset of gridded meteorological forcings and ancillary data (soil, rock, land cover, orography), with code to combine it with discharge data; neural network modeling demonstrated.
9890bd5c4e8eb91b2cb24c9dbf53c0bfe69196c3.data: Five central European basins (upper Danube, Elbe, Oder, Rhine, Weser) on a 9 km grid, daily 1980–2024; source of the meteorological forcings not reported in the abstract.
9890bd5c4e8eb91b2cb24c9dbf53c0bfe69196c3.result: Harmonized, openly available dataset enabling direct comparison of distributed and lumped model types.
9890bd5c4e8eb91b2cb24c9dbf53c0bfe69196c3.open_work: Use the dataset to benchmark distributed neural hydrological models against lumped and process-based models.
9890bd5c4e8eb91b2cb24c9dbf53c0bfe69196c3.issues: Limited to five basins; 9 km grid may be coarse for small catchments; discharge data must be added by users.

c86c68277cc3e26a701d3660ab0be6fb5fc3dcfc.goal: Lets national forecasters adapt globally trained ML flood models using local data they own, lowering barriers to operational deployment.
c86c68277cc3e26a701d3660ab0be6fb5fc3dcfc.architecture: Pre-train a global deep learning streamflow model (network family not stated in the abstract) on a large diverse dataset, then fine-tune on individual basins.
c86c68277cc3e26a701d3660ab0be6fb5fc3dcfc.data: Large global streamflow dataset for pre-training and per-basin data for fine-tuning; specific products not reported in the abstract.
c86c68277cc3e26a701d3660ab0be6fb5fc3dcfc.result: Fine-tuning improves performance, most strongly in watersheds that underperform under global training.
c86c68277cc3e26a701d3660ab0be6fb5fc3dcfc.open_work: Operational roadmap for national agencies; test with truly private local data and forecast forcings.
c86c68277cc3e26a701d3660ab0be6fb5fc3dcfc.issues: Risk of overfitting small local records; magnitude of gains not quantified in the abstract.

8bb7ebc36b40d688dee80f36350bea57edb8d397.goal: Produces spatially explicit irrigation water withdrawal estimates for China, which are scarce and uncertain in process models and remote sensing.
8bb7ebc36b40d688dee80f36350bea57edb8d397.architecture: Knowledge-informed explainable random forest with SHAP, plus temporal downscaling to monthly values.
8bb7ebc36b40d688dee80f36350bea57edb8d397.data: Irrigated cropland maps, socioeconomic, hydroclimatic and auxiliary predictors; prefecture-level IWW reports for training; independent observations in 150+ basins and counties.
8bb7ebc36b40d688dee80f36350bea57edb8d397.result: Cross-validated R2 above 0.85 and RMSE below 0.45 km3/yr; the resulting CIWW1km product (monthly, 1 km, 2000–2020) explains over 85% of variance in independent data and shows rapid IWW growth in arid China.
8bb7ebc36b40d688dee80f36350bea57edb8d397.open_work: Use CIWW1km in hydrological, climate and water–food nexus studies; extend in time and to other countries.
8bb7ebc36b40d688dee80f36350bea57edb8d397.issues: Training relies on reported statistics of uneven quality; temporal downscaling adds uncertainty; RF limited in extrapolation.

ba46bbb69dd0923cc28eca96e04453b93c023008.goal: Improves crop yield forecasts in anomalous years, where models fail due to lack of physically grounded weather–yield data.
ba46bbb69dd0923cc28eca96e04453b93c023008.architecture: VITA, a variational pretraining framework for transformers that predicts latent atmospheric states with a seasonality-aware sinusoidal prior, then fine-tunes on limited weather statistics.
ba46bbb69dd0923cc28eca96e04453b93c023008.data: Large satellite-based weather datasets for pretraining; corn and soybean yields for 763 US Corn Belt counties.
ba46bbb69dd0923cc28eca96e04453b93c023008.result: State-of-the-art yields across all scenarios, especially extreme years (p < 0.0001), outperforming GNN-RNN without soil data and Chronos-Bolt with less compute.
ba46bbb69dd0923cc28eca96e04453b93c023008.open_work: Apply to data-scarce regions and other crops.
ba46bbb69dd0923cc28eca96e04453b93c023008.issues: Single region; county-level yields; evaluation of climate robustness limited to historical extremes.

dea648aac0ff6d9619a9687d84a45d002739baa0.goal: Enables fast operational flood modeling, since physics-based hydrodynamic models are too slow for rapid prediction.
dea648aac0ff6d9619a9687d84a45d002739baa0.architecture: DUALFloodGNN, a physics-informed graph neural network with message passing that jointly predicts node water volume and edge flow, with global and local physics loss terms and multi-step curriculum training.
dea648aac0ff6d9619a9687d84a45d002739baa0.data: Hydrodynamic simulation dataset (open-sourced); specific sites not reported in the abstract.
dea648aac0ff6d9619a9687d84a45d002739baa0.result: Substantial improvements over standard and state-of-the-art GNN flood models for water volume, flow and depth while remaining computationally efficient.
dea648aac0ff6d9619a9687d84a45d002739baa0.open_work: Test generalization to unseen catchments and real events.
dea648aac0ff6d9619a9687d84a45d002739baa0.issues: Trained on simulated data, so inherits numerical model assumptions; autoregressive error accumulation remains possible.

c3760ba6a4dc78768655b54ced4d31c2e12eecec.goal: Develops satellite precipitation retrieval for regions lacking radar, evaluating the benefit of commercial Tomorrow.io microwave sounders.
c3760ba6a4dc78768655b54ced4d31c2e12eecec.architecture: Convolutional neural network ingesting sequences of geostationary imagery and sparse polar-orbiting passive microwave swaths over the preceding hour.
c3760ba6a4dc78768655b54ced4d31c2e12eecec.data: Geostationary imagers, public passive microwave sensors and two Tomorrow.io microwave sounders; verified against radar networks (USA, Europe, Japan), US gauges, and IMERG-Early.
c3760ba6a4dc78768655b54ced4d31c2e12eecec.result: 10-min, 0.04° precipitation over 60°S–72°N; 5–10% gains over earlier versions and 30–50% skill gains over IMERG-Early; data denial for 2024 hurricanes shows microwave benefit.
c3760ba6a4dc78768655b54ced4d31c2e12eecec.open_work: Add more sounders and extend validation to data-poor regions.
c3760ba6a4dc78768655b54ced4d31c2e12eecec.issues: Depends on commercial satellite data; validation mostly over radar-rich regions.

3557e687a79b8af485a679333c2c264dc273907e.goal: Assesses climate change impacts on solar energy generation across the continental United States using deep learning, as implied by the title.
3557e687a79b8af485a679333c2c264dc273907e.architecture: Deep learning model (family not known) used to project solar generation; abstract not available.
3557e687a79b8af485a679333c2c264dc273907e.data: Not reported (abstract missing); likely climate model projections over the continental US.
3557e687a79b8af485a679333c2c264dc273907e.open_work: Likely needs multi-model uncertainty quantification and validation against observed generation.
3557e687a79b8af485a679333c2c264dc273907e.issues: Abstract missing; projections depend on climate model biases and the learned mapping's validity under future climate.

72fd920d5898be96a56207efd9fb3bd2519e29a4.goal: Quantifies future climate change impacts on streamflow intermittence across Europe at high resolution, including headwater streams.
72fd920d5898be96a56207efd9fb3bd2519e29a4.architecture: Hybrid approach: random forest trained on observed streamflow intermittence using predictors from a global hydrological model (WaterGAP).
72fd920d5898be96a56207efd9fb3bd2519e29a4.data: WaterGAP at 50 km driven by five global climate models, historical gauge observations; predictions for 1.5 million reaches at 500 m; SSP1-RCP2.6 and SSP5-RCP8.5.
72fd920d5898be96a56207efd9fb3bd2519e29a4.result: Non-perennial reach-months rise under both scenarios; no-flow share goes from 3.5% (1985–2014) to 3.8% (SSP1-2.6) or 4.8% (SSP5-8.5) in 2071–2100; 2.8% of reaches shift to non-perennial.
72fd920d5898be96a56207efd9fb3bd2519e29a4.open_work: Link to ecological impacts and include water use and management changes.
72fd920d5898be96a56207efd9fb3bd2519e29a4.issues: Coarse driving model; only five GCMs; RF may not extrapolate to new climate; human water use projections uncertain.

eef31f9a7373549e63d73db43633978a373dc27c.goal: Provides fast 24-hour solar irradiance forecasting across CONUS without the cost of NWP data assimilation and PDE solving.
eef31f9a7373549e63d73db43633978a373dc27c.architecture: SolarSeer, an end-to-end large deep learning model mapping historical satellite observations to future cloud cover and irradiance. Network family not reported in the abstract.
eef31f9a7373549e63d73db43633978a373dc27c.data: Historical satellite observations over CONUS; evaluation against HRRR, reanalysis data and 1,800 ground stations.
eef31f9a7373549e63d73db43633978a373dc27c.result: Over 1,500 times faster than NWP, producing 5 km 24-hour forecasts in under 3 s; RMSE reduced by 27.28% vs HRRR on reanalysis and 15.35% across stations.
eef31f9a7373549e63d73db43633978a373dc27c.open_work: Extend to probabilistic forecasts and longer horizons and other regions.
eef31f9a7373549e63d73db43633978a373dc27c.issues: Satellite-only inputs may miss synoptic evolution beyond 24 h; deterministic.

3b9debf0338b31a85fd697e5bdfa79970616add3.goal: Infers the dynamically active root zone storage that ecosystems use for evapotranspiration, which cannot be measured directly.
3b9debf0338b31a85fd697e5bdfa79970616add3.architecture: Hybrid machine learning model combining a parsimonious ecohydrological structure with neural networks, treating active storage as a latent state.
3b9debf0338b31a85fd697e5bdfa79970616add3.data: Multi-source observations of ET, runoff, snow and terrestrial water storage for hundreds of US catchments, 2001–2020.
3b9debf0338b31a85fd697e5bdfa79970616add3.result: Active storage peaks in transitional regions where atmospheric demand and supply balance; realized capacity reflects long-term hydroclimate and substrate constraints.
3b9debf0338b31a85fd697e5bdfa79970616add3.open_work: Extend globally and link to vegetation and carbon fluxes.
