3b9debf0338b31a85fd697e5bdfa79970616add3.issues: Latent state is not directly verifiable; depends on observational product uncertainties.

9b71715269bcb172226dd551e46dcd48268beb51.goal: Systematically compares how static catchment or site features are integrated into global deep learning models for groundwater level prediction, a choice seldom evaluated.
9b71715269bcb172226dd551e46dcd48268beb51.architecture: Global deep learning groundwater model comparing four static-feature strategies: repetition, concatenation, attention and conditional initialization.
9b71715269bcb172226dd551e46dcd48268beb51.data: Large-scale groundwater level dataset from Germany with environmental and time-series-derived static features.
9b71715269bcb172226dd551e46dcd48268beb51.result: All methods perform similarly on average; repetition slightly best but computationally inefficient; feature informativeness matters more than integration method.
9b71715269bcb172226dd551e46dcd48268beb51.open_work: Explore efficient integration methods and better static feature selection.
9b71715269bcb172226dd551e46dcd48268beb51.issues: Single-country groundwater dataset; results may differ for streamflow or other variables.

f288204bb6cf05fb250a8fe28cbc49c1c31655e8.goal: Estimates long-term weather-driven variability of Australian energy demand, since demand records are short.
f288204bb6cf05fb250a8fe28cbc49c1c31655e8.architecture: Machine learning regression models (type not specified in the abstract) using reanalysis weather predictors.
f288204bb6cf05fb250a8fe28cbc49c1c31655e8.data: Daily demand 2010–2019 for Australian National Electricity Market states; reanalysis weather variables as predictors (product not named in the abstract); demand reconstructed for 1959–2022.
f288204bb6cf05fb250a8fe28cbc49c1c31655e8.result: Median errors 2–4% on held-out years; extreme-demand probability varies from half to twice across decades and up to 7 times when conditioned on ENSO phase.
f288204bb6cf05fb250a8fe28cbc49c1c31655e8.open_work: Include future climate projections and demand trends.
f288204bb6cf05fb250a8fe28cbc49c1c31655e8.issues: Assumes the 2010s weather–demand relationship holds across 1959–2022, ignoring changes in technology, population and rooftop solar; inherits reanalysis biases.

bb65e9e9b986907f6ac8d93e1c9ef27f9276f400.goal: Tests whether large language model agents can replace human experts in calibrating distributed hydrologic models, a bottleneck for operational water management.
bb65e9e9b986907f6ac8d93e1c9ef27f9276f400.architecture: Benchmark of nine frontier LLM agents and HydroAgent, a Qwen3-4B fine-tuned with supervised learning and Group-Relative Policy Optimization reinforcement learning from simulator feedback.
bb65e9e9b986907f6ac8d93e1c9ef27f9276f400.data: CREST distributed hydrologic model used by the US National Weather Service; four held-out gauges (329–40,792 km2); 2,576 expert calibration trajectories.
bb65e9e9b986907f6ac8d93e1c9ef27f9276f400.result: Frontier LLM best NSE ranges from -0.16 to 0.75, mostly 0.65–0.75, rarely reaching human experts; the authors argue domain grounding, not model size, is the gap.
bb65e9e9b986907f6ac8d93e1c9ef27f9276f400.open_work: Scale to more basins and modalities including remote sensing and forecaster narratives.
bb65e9e9b986907f6ac8d93e1c9ef27f9276f400.issues: Few test gauges; HydroAgent quantitative results not given in the abstract; single hydrologic model.

bf9d52eecc2ecbaaf6ac16a25148e8f0132f47ba.goal: Forecasts soil moisture at sub-seasonal to seasonal scales to anticipate flash droughts and explain their drivers, where NWP has limited skill.
bf9d52eecc2ecbaaf6ac16a25148e8f0132f47ba.architecture: Spatiotemporal deep learning models (ConvLSTM, U-Net) with a Bayesian model averaging ensemble, interpreted with occlusion maps and SHAP.
bf9d52eecc2ecbaaf6ac16a25148e8f0132f47ba.data: Drought-related precursors (compound drought–heatwave, evaporative stress, VPD, vegetation conditions) over basins with varied climates; NWP comparison. Data products not reported in the abstract.
bf9d52eecc2ecbaaf6ac16a25148e8f0132f47ba.result: Deep learning improves pentad SSI forecasts over NWP; BMA ensemble is reliable up to 12 pentads (~60 days); three driver patterns: water-, energy-dominated and composite.
bf9d52eecc2ecbaaf6ac16a25148e8f0132f47ba.open_work: Use for operational early warning systems.
bf9d52eecc2ecbaaf6ac16a25148e8f0132f47ba.issues: Limited to selected basins; interpretability methods are post hoc.

2b90ec1d78ebee1a4f59d4f239d48b87f38a60a3.goal: Provides regional climate information for renewable energy planning by emulating CORDEX regional climate models with machine learning, focusing on wind and solar energy droughts.
2b90ec1d78ebee1a4f59d4f239d48b87f38a60a3.architecture: Machine learning emulators (two models; families not stated in the abstract) mapping GCM to RCM fields.
2b90ec1d78ebee1a4f59d4f239d48b87f38a60a3.data: CMIP5 and CORDEX for training; CMIP6 for application; Central Europe.
2b90ec1d78ebee1a4f59d4f239d48b87f38a60a3.result: The emulator reproduces RCM data with sufficient accuracy and gives plausible results for unseen CMIP6 simulations; the number of low-wind, low-solar energy drought days in Central Europe is likely to decrease.
2b90ec1d78ebee1a4f59d4f239d48b87f38a60a3.open_work: Extend to other regions, variables and impact metrics, and use emulators to enlarge downscaled ensembles.
2b90ec1d78ebee1a4f59d4f239d48b87f38a60a3.issues: Transfer to CMIP6 cannot be verified directly; emulator inherits RCM biases.

6b1545666e5c4d059f251e44a047bd372201ea89.goal: Estimates evapotranspiration in near real time at 5-min resolution for both day and night, since most satellite ET products are daily and daytime-only.
6b1545666e5c4d059f251e44a047bd372201ea89.architecture: ALIVEET framework comparing Gradient Boosting Regression and LSTM models.
6b1545666e5c4d059f251e44a047bd372201ea89.data: GOES-R ABI observations including land surface temperature; ground ET reference not named in the abstract; comparison with daily ALEXI ET.
6b1545666e5c4d059f251e44a047bd372201ea89.result: GBR daytime R2 0.74 (nRMSE 0.91); LSTM nighttime R2 0.24 (nRMSE 1.29).
6b1545666e5c4d059f251e44a047bd372201ea89.open_work: Improve nighttime estimates and agreement with ALEXI.
6b1545666e5c4d059f251e44a047bd372201ea89.issues: Nighttime skill is weak (R2 0.24) and nRMSE values are high; coverage limited to the GOES-R domain; cloudy-sky retrievals are harder to validate.

6ce3b558b76fcf22491949ff01e67ae0213a25cd.goal: Produces near-real-time quasi-global precipitation estimates from infrared data alone, avoiding dependence on infrequent passive microwave overpasses.
6ce3b558b76fcf22491949ff01e67ae0213a25cd.architecture: PERSIANN-Unet, a U-Net convolutional neural network using IR data and monthly climatology.
6ce3b558b76fcf22491949ff01e67ae0213a25cd.data: Geostationary IR; IMERG V07 Final 2016–2021 training; evaluated 2022–2023 against HE, IMERG, PDIR-Now and Stage IV over CONUS.
6ce3b558b76fcf22491949ff01e67ae0213a25cd.result: Closely matches IMERG Final globally; produces spatially consistent fields without tile seams at 0.04°, half-hourly over 60°N–60°S.
6ce3b558b76fcf22491949ff01e67ae0213a25cd.open_work: Further evaluation in data-poor regions and extremes.
6ce3b558b76fcf22491949ff01e67ae0213a25cd.issues: Trained on IMERG so inherits its biases; IR-only limits physical sensitivity.

89d049c3dd20fea9d1f42c49a0988c0f0c0ea029.goal: Reduces the cost of Monte Carlo ray-traced surface solar irradiance in cloud-resolving models, which needs large sampling budgets to converge.
89d049c3dd20fea9d1f42c49a0988c0f0c0ea029.architecture: Denoising autoencoder (convolutional) mapping noisy to well-converged irradiance fields.
89d049c3dd20fea9d1f42c49a0988c0f0c0ea029.data: Pairs of noisy and well-converged Monte Carlo ray-traced irradiance fields for an ensemble of simulated cumulus cloud fields and solar angles.
89d049c3dd20fea9d1f42c49a0988c0f0c0ea029.result: Denoising diffuse irradiance from 1 sample per pixel is ten times faster and twice as accurate as 128 samples; adding liquid water path and solar angles halves errors.
89d049c3dd20fea9d1f42c49a0988c0f0c0ea029.open_work: Improve generalization across resolutions and cloud types; couple online.
89d049c3dd20fea9d1f42c49a0988c0f0c0ea029.issues: Errors at cloud shadow edges for direct irradiance; trained on cumulus only.

8c1c169657563455ee8738193c16c54d80295d29.goal: Identifies the climate drivers and mechanisms of hydrological drought across the contiguous United States to support drought forecasting and water management.
8c1c169657563455ee8738193c16c54d80295d29.architecture: Attention-augmented LSTM with Expected Gradients attribution.
8c1c169657563455ee8738193c16c54d80295d29.data: ERA5 1940–2022 monthly variables plus Niño-3.4; 547 GAGES-II catchments.
8c1c169657563455ee8738193c16c54d80295d29.result: Three mechanisms: rapid-onset, gradually evolving and climatically reinforced droughts, with spatial patterns by aridity.
8c1c169657563455ee8738193c16c54d80295d29.open_work: Use for seasonal drought forecasting and water management.
8c1c169657563455ee8738193c16c54d80295d29.issues: Inputs come from ERA5 so inherit reanalysis biases; attribution by Expected Gradients is model-dependent and not causal; restricted to minimally disturbed catchments.

b824bd1552b9224a3659af266fa7eb70c92875f3.goal: Classifies flood-generating processes and predicts extreme river-flood magnitudes across peninsular India to understand how rainfall, antecedent wetness and reservoir storage jointly control floods.
b824bd1552b9224a3659af266fa7eb70c92875f3.architecture: Cluster-specific TabNet deep-learning models (attention-based tabular network) predict flood magnitude; SHAP values attribute predictions to drivers and their interactions; events are first classified by rainfall–soil-moisture thresholds.
b824bd1552b9224a3659af266fa7eb70c92875f3.data: Flood events 1980–2020 at 206 catchments in peninsular India, with daily hydro-meteorological forcings, soil moisture and basin-averaged static attributes; strict spatial cross-validation.
b824bd1552b9224a3659af266fa7eb70c92875f3.result: Humid, low-storage basins are dominated by excess-rain floods while drier, storage-influenced basins show more long-rain floods; about 67% of basins reach KGE above 0.3 with physically consistent driver combinations.
b824bd1552b9224a3659af266fa7eb70c92875f3.open_work: Extend toward climate-adaptive flood forecasting in monsoon regions and improve skill in basins where models remain weak.
b824bd1552b9224a3659af266fa7eb70c92875f3.issues: Predictive skill is only moderate (KGE threshold of 0.3); reservoir operations are represented coarsely; SHAP attributions are correlational rather than causal.

c388dc84c9b38f89606d471c3b976f89a2713923.goal: Predicts soil moisture simultaneously at multiple depths with interpretable deep learning, addressing nonlinear soil water transport and variable boundary conditions.
c388dc84c9b38f89606d471c3b976f89a2713923.architecture: Non-local neural networks: a self-attention variant (SA-NLNN, embedded Gaussian) and a knowledge-guided variant (KG-NLNN) that decomposes depth influences into four physically motivated components; physics-guided deep learning.
c388dc84c9b38f89606d471c3b976f89a2713923.data: In-situ multi-depth soil moisture observations; specific sites and periods are not reported in the abstract.
c388dc84c9b38f89606d471c3b976f89a2713923.result: Both models perform satisfactorily; knowledge-guided non-local operations significantly improve accuracy, reliability, noise robustness and interpretability of learned inter-layer weights, at high computational efficiency.
c388dc84c9b38f89606d471c3b976f89a2713923.open_work: Test at more sites and soil types, and couple with land surface models or remote sensing for spatial prediction.
c388dc84c9b38f89606d471c3b976f89a2713923.issues: Evaluation limited to in-situ stations; interpretability is qualitative; quantitative gains and generalization to unseen sites are not reported in the abstract.

68b855dcdd1898595fecb51e761596c6d9efd6d2.goal: Tests whether large ML weather-model frameworks retain skill for drought and flash drought prediction over Africa at subseasonal-to-seasonal scales.
68b855dcdd1898595fecb51e761596c6d9efd6d2.architecture: DroughtFormer, a CrossFormer transformer built on NSF NCAR's CREDIT framework, with dry air mass and moisture conservation constraints, predicting soil moisture, vegetation health and other drought variables.
68b855dcdd1898595fecb51e761596c6d9efd6d2.data: ERA5 and GLDAS2 reanalyses plus IMERG precipitation and MODIS satellite observations over Africa.
68b855dcdd1898595fecb51e761596c6d9efd6d2.result: Stable, skillful forecasts to 90-day leads for soil moisture and vegetation variables, beating or matching climatology; lower accuracy for precipitation and flash-drought indices and underestimated anomaly magnitudes.
68b855dcdd1898595fecb51e761596c6d9efd6d2.open_work: Improve precipitation and flash-drought index skill and the representation of anomaly magnitudes.
68b855dcdd1898595fecb51e761596c6d9efd6d2.issues: Benchmarked mainly against climatology; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases over data-sparse Africa; flash-drought onset remains poorly predicted.

d033a18e7d4a6e953a1f1186ec4726aa10e83170.goal: Estimates global groundwater recharge, which is hard to measure directly, to assess sustainability of aquifer use.
d033a18e7d4a6e953a1f1186ec4726aa10e83170.architecture: Gaussian Process Regression emulator trained on Hydrus-1D Richards-equation simulations of unsaturated-zone fluxes, then driven by satellite and reanalysis inputs.
d033a18e7d4a6e953a1f1186ec4726aa10e83170.data: Hydrus-1D runs at 235 points spanning climates and soils; inputs from SMAP soil moisture, GPM precipitation, ERA5 reanalysis and soil hydraulic properties; GRACE storage changes for validation.
d033a18e7d4a6e953a1f1186ec4726aa10e83170.result: Captures global recharge patterns, especially in high-rainfall regions; rainfall, unsaturated conductivity and soil moisture are the main predictors; estimates consistent with GRACE storage trends.
d033a18e7d4a6e953a1f1186ec4726aa10e83170.open_work: Improve performance in arid and heavily irrigated regions and add lateral and anthropogenic processes.
d033a18e7d4a6e953a1f1186ec4726aa10e83170.issues: 1-D vertical model ignores lateral flow and irrigation; weaker in arid areas; GRACE comparison is indirect validation; emulator inherits Hydrus-1D assumptions.

27b4d50675ff250e8f61a454a860669090eee9b5.goal: Adapts frozen time series foundation models to regional drought forecasting when weights are proprietary, local data are short and compute is limited.
27b4d50675ff250e8f61a454a860669090eee9b5.architecture: Black-box inference-time wrappers around frozen time series foundation models (transformer backbones): SMR2 multi-resolution residual corrections with adaptive ensembling, and Moving Block Bootstrap ensembling; no fine-tuning.
27b4d50675ff250e8f61a454a860669090eee9b5.data: One-month-ahead SPEI at multiple sites in South Australia; period and SPEI source not reported in the abstract.
27b4d50675ff250e8f61a454a860669090eee9b5.result: Consistently improves several backbone models, with up to 26% MSE reduction over the frozen backbone.
27b4d50675ff250e8f61a454a860669090eee9b5.open_work: Extend to longer leads, other drought indices and regions, and probabilistic outputs.
27b4d50675ff250e8f61a454a860669090eee9b5.issues: Single region and one-month lead; point forecasts only; gains depend on backbone; compared mainly with the frozen backbone rather than domain models.

8f8d79c3d140fd68b1975a8819a6be45b8563e3c.goal: Argues about the scientific role of machine learning in hydrology and the persistent fragmentation of hydrological science.
8f8d79c3d140fd68b1975a8819a6be45b8563e3c.architecture: Commentary/perspective; no new model. Discusses integrating data-driven ML and process-based approaches for the terrestrial hydrosphere.
8f8d79c3d140fd68b1975a8819a6be45b8563e3c.data: No new data; cites examples such as divergent estimates of groundwater–streamflow interactions and water-balance storage changes.
8f8d79c3d140fd68b1975a8819a6be45b8563e3c.result: Argues ML's outperformance in streamflow prediction reflects fragmentation of hydrology, and that the future lies in integrating ML and physics rather than choosing between them.
8f8d79c3d140fd68b1975a8819a6be45b8563e3c.open_work: Develop coherent, scale-relevant, integrated understanding of the terrestrial hydrosphere combining data-driven and process-based methods.
8f8d79c3d140fd68b1975a8819a6be45b8563e3c.issues: Opinion piece without quantitative demonstration; concrete integration methods are not specified.

74832aaff5a7441ac493867d47d0a873151d268c.goal: Tests whether assimilating deep-learning-enhanced satellite soil moisture improves a European land reanalysis, given sensor gaps, retrieval noise and biases.
74832aaff5a7441ac493867d47d0a873151d268c.architecture: Ensemble land data assimilation into the encore Community Land Model (eCLM) of a deep-learning-enhanced AMSR-E/2 soil moisture product, with climatological bias correction and Triple Collocation uncertainty estimates.
74832aaff5a7441ac493867d47d0a873151d268c.data: DL-enhanced AMSR-E/AMSR2 soil moisture, daily 2003–2023 over Europe; independent in situ soil moisture networks for evaluation.
74832aaff5a7441ac493867d47d0a873151d268c.result: Against open loop, PBIAS drops from 28.68% to 3.28% and RMSE from 0.100 to 0.082 m3/m3, beating assimilation of original AMSR-E/2; spatial uncertainty improves correlation at 66% of stations.
74832aaff5a7441ac493867d47d0a873151d268c.open_work: Extend to other variables and observation types, and to global or coupled Earth system reanalyses.
74832aaff5a7441ac493867d47d0a873151d268c.issues: The deep learning enhancement itself is described elsewhere; gains vary by climate zone and season; evaluation at point stations has representativeness issues.

09b7172fb9d7a75ff328b36634610c4b34663f80.goal: Assesses crop yield sensitivity to climate change in Northeast China while accounting for vegetation and groundwater memory that is only observed in the satellite era.
09b7172fb9d7a75ff328b36634610c4b34663f80.architecture: ReGen-Net reconstruction module extends NDVI and groundwater anomaly records back to 1981; a GATAE-TFT model (graph attention plus Temporal Fusion Transformer) predicts yields, with YieldTransformer baseline and SHAP attribution.
09b7172fb9d7a75ff328b36634610c4b34663f80.data: Crop yield records since 1981 in Northeast China, NDVI, groundwater storage anomalies (GRACE-era), drought indices; bias-adjusted ISIMIP projections 2017–2060 under SSP1-2.6 and SSP5-8.5.
09b7172fb9d7a75ff328b36634610c4b34663f80.result: Test R2 of 0.857, 0.777, 0.798 and 0.837 for maize, rice, soybean and wheat; projections show gradual declines in maize, rice and wheat and stable soybean.
09b7172fb9d7a75ff328b36634610c4b34663f80.open_work: Incorporate management and CO2 effects and extend to other regions.
09b7172fb9d7a75ff328b36634610c4b34663f80.issues: Reconstructed predictors add uncertainty; statistical projections assume stationary relationships under future climate; adaptation and CO2 fertilization are not explicitly represented.

9fb31e512e2b1fa9a98942a2f1e350a9ecd24f59.goal: Improves crop yield projections under climate change by combining process-based global gridded crop models with machine learning that generalizes out of distribution.
9fb31e512e2b1fa9a98942a2f1e350a9ecd24f59.architecture: NeuralCrop, a differentiable hybrid global gridded crop model combining an advanced process-based GGCM with neural network components; first trained to emulate a GGCM, then fine-tuned on observations.
9fb31e512e2b1fa9a98942a2f1e350a9ecd24f59.data: Emulation of a process-based GGCM, then fine-tuning on observed yields; site-level and large-scale simulations including European wheat regions and the US Corn Belt.
9fb31e512e2b1fa9a98942a2f1e350a9ecd24f59.result: Accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art GGCMs, better reproduction of yield anomalies especially under drought extremes, and orders of magnitude faster for large-scale long-term runs.
9fb31e512e2b1fa9a98942a2f1e350a9ecd24f59.open_work: Extend to more crops and regions and use for climate-impact risk assessment.
9fb31e512e2b1fa9a98942a2f1e350a9ecd24f59.issues: Out-of-distribution reliability under future climates remains to be demonstrated; inherits parent GGCM structure; observational yield data quality limits fine-tuning.

7887057feceac434bdd40657221281ec2751f0bc.goal: Simulates spatiotemporally correlated flood risk at interannual-to-decadal horizons relevant to insurance contracts.
7887057feceac434bdd40657221281ec2751f0bc.architecture: Attention-based analog retrieval combined with stochastic generation of multivariate flood frequency, intensity and duration sequences; explainable AI attribution and wavelet analysis.
7887057feceac434bdd40657221281ec2751f0bc.data: Flood records at over 100 sites in the Mississippi River Basin conditioned on large-scale climate variability indices.
7887057feceac434bdd40657221281ec2751f0bc.result: Produces spatiotemporally coherent, out-of-sample flood portfolios and links simulated clustering to large-scale climate drivers, giving interpretable flood clusters for loss simulation.
7887057feceac434bdd40657221281ec2751f0bc.open_work: Apply to other basins and portfolios and couple with loss and financial models.
7887057feceac434bdd40657221281ec2751f0bc.issues: Single basin; limited by length of observed records for rare clustered events; no quantitative skill reported in the abstract.

461ce6ea8f2d86452a7e53c1cd99f350472a23ad.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting by combining turbine SCADA data with gridded numerical weather prediction forecasts.
461ce6ea8f2d86452a7e53c1cd99f350472a23ad.architecture: Multimodal network with scalar/vector feature decomposition, a geometric encoder giving rotation-invariant wind vector features, and a Fourier Neural Operator for global frequency-domain convolutions.
461ce6ea8f2d86452a7e53c1cd99f350472a23ad.data: Historical SCADA data and gridded NWP forecasts for three real-world wind farms; NWP source and period not reported in the abstract.
461ce6ea8f2d86452a7e53c1cd99f350472a23ad.result: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on all three wind farms; code released.
461ce6ea8f2d86452a7e53c1cd99f350472a23ad.open_work: Extend to more farms, probabilistic forecasts and longer horizons.
461ce6ea8f2d86452a7e53c1cd99f350472a23ad.issues: Only three farms; quantitative gains not stated in the abstract; dependence on NWP quality.

4da50f01d520beb45b6c287d9f39f0bb255b86fa.goal: Quantifies historical drought impacts on global hydropower generation at plant level.
4da50f01d520beb45b6c287d9f39f0bb255b86fa.architecture: Hybrid framework coupling physically based hydropower potential simulations with machine learning trained on observed generation, for run-of-river and storage plants; ML family not specified in the abstract.
4da50f01d520beb45b6c287d9f39f0bb255b86fa.data: Physically based hydropower potential simulations and observed plant-level generation, monthly, global, 1982–2022.
4da50f01d520beb45b6c287d9f39f0bb255b86fa.result: Drought reduces global hydropower generation by about 11% relative to the long-term average, with larger declines in western and eastern North America, southeastern South America, the Mediterranean and East Asia.
4da50f01d520beb45b6c287d9f39f0bb255b86fa.open_work: Develop monitoring tools for climate-extreme impacts on hydropower and support water–energy nexus policy.
4da50f01d520beb45b6c287d9f39f0bb255b86fa.issues: Described as an initial step; observed generation data are uneven across regions; reservoir operations are inferred rather than modeled explicitly.

abd7b4d67e377dbb134bd65dd462b844339e3b97.goal: Provides day-ahead, kilometer-scale solar irradiance forecasts for grid integration, which NWP lacks in resolution and satellite extrapolation in lead time.
abd7b4d67e377dbb134bd65dd462b844339e3b97.architecture: Baguan-solar, a two-stage multimodal deep learning framework fusing forecasts from the Baguan weather foundation model (transformer) with geostationary satellite imagery; first forecasts cloud cover, then irradiance.
abd7b4d67e377dbb134bd65dd462b844339e3b97.data: Baguan forecasts and high-resolution geostationary satellite imagery over East Asia; CLDAS used as ground truth.
abd7b4d67e377dbb134bd65dd462b844339e3b97.result: Reduces RMSE by 16.08% versus strong baselines including ECMWF IFS, vanilla Baguan and SolarSeer, better resolving cloud transients; operational in an eastern Chinese province since July 2025.
abd7b4d67e377dbb134bd65dd462b844339e3b97.open_work: Extend to other regions and probabilistic irradiance forecasts.
abd7b4d67e377dbb134bd65dd462b844339e3b97.issues: Evaluated against CLDAS analysis rather than ground pyranometers; regional; deterministic only.

192b217460cd2431042c61b86902ce55f085bbed.goal: Forecasts standardized crop yields in India before planting from drought indices to support impact-based early warning.
192b217460cd2431042c61b86902ce55f085bbed.architecture: Random Forest, XGBoost (gradient boosting) and artificial neural networks (MLP) linking observed and forecast drought indices to yields, at district and cluster levels.
192b217460cd2431042c61b86902ce55f085bbed.data: District-level historical paddy rice and wheat yields in India, observed drought indices at multiple accumulation periods, and ECMWF SEAS5 seasonal forecasts.
192b217460cd2431042c61b86902ce55f085bbed.result: District models beat cluster models with Random Forest best; over 80% of wheat and 70% of rice districts reach RMSE below 0.2; SEAS5 enables rice predictions up to 6 months ahead; CRPS confirms skill including for extremely low yields.
192b217460cd2431042c61b86902ce55f085bbed.open_work: Operationalize for anticipatory action and include non-climatic drivers such as irrigation and management.
192b217460cd2431042c61b86902ce55f085bbed.issues: Short yield records per district; standardized yields remove trends; skill varies with yield variability and lead time.

112933663cd88f89544ae01047b851b891705222.goal: Predicts streamflow drought across the conterminous US and identifies its meteorological drivers and sensitive basin characteristics.
112933663cd88f89544ae01047b851b891705222.architecture: 3198 at-site random forest models plus a dynamic regionalization donor-gage approach for pseudo-ungaged prediction.
112933663cd88f89544ae01047b851b891705222.data: USGS streamgages across CONUS, 1982–2020, with meteorological drivers including teleconnections, temperature, evaporative demand, snow water equivalent, precipitation and soil moisture.
112933663cd88f89544ae01047b851b891705222.result: Teleconnections, temperature, evaporative demand and SWE dominate in western regions, precipitation and soil moisture in the east and northwest; donor-gage regionalization performs comparably to at-site models.
112933663cd88f89544ae01047b851b891705222.open_work: Apply the donor-gage approach to other hydrologic prediction problems requiring transfer to ungaged locations.
112933663cd88f89544ae01047b851b891705222.issues: Pseudo-ungaged tests may overstate transfer skill; driver importance from random forests is correlational; human regulation of flows not explicitly addressed.

56165908d9a3146ee0655cf2ae0e70fe1998fef4.goal: Produces fast, high-resolution medium-range hydrological and flood forecasts across the contiguous US.
56165908d9a3146ee0655cf2ae0e70fe1998fef4.architecture: Hapi, a U-Net Swin Transformer with 3-D patches and hierarchical shifted-window attention, multi-task with adaptive task weighting.
56165908d9a3146ee0655cf2ae0e70fe1998fef4.data: ERA5-Land inputs at 0.05° over CONUS; held-out 2024 evaluation against GloFAS return-period flood thresholds and 3,881 USGS gauges.
56165908d9a3146ee0655cf2ae0e70fe1998fef4.result: Highest flood F1 in 20 of 21 comparisons and highest median NSE at every lead (24–72 h); a four-variable 72-h forecast takes 0.11 s on one A100 GPU.
56165908d9a3146ee0655cf2ae0e70fe1998fef4.open_work: Run with actual weather forecast forcings rather than prescribed ERA5-Land, and extend lead times.
56165908d9a3146ee0655cf2ae0e70fe1998fef4.issues: Potential-skill setting with ERA5-Land prescribed over the horizon overstates operational skill; single test year; ERA5-Land biases inherited.

63c0d78a89fc4204d138957a1cf88607dec59dc8.goal: Emulates Noah-MP snow water equivalent cheaply for hydrologic forecasting in the Colorado Rocky Mountains.
63c0d78a89fc4204d138957a1cf88607dec59dc8.architecture: ConvLSTM spatiotemporal deep learning emulator, compared with a pixel-wise LSTM baseline.
63c0d78a89fc4204d138957a1cf88607dec59dc8.data: WRF meteorological forcings, static physiographic variables, remotely sensed snow cover and leaf area index; Noah-MP SWE targets; evaluation against SNODAS and SNOTEL.
63c0d78a89fc4204d138957a1cf88607dec59dc8.result: Spatial coupling raises the fraction of cells with non-negative NSE by 15–27%; reproduces Noah-MP and SNODAS patterns, competitive against SNOTEL, R2 up to 0.96 in accumulation and 0.97 in melt.
63c0d78a89fc4204d138957a1cf88607dec59dc8.open_work: Use for real-time monitoring and ensemble forecasting, and extend to other regions.
63c0d78a89fc4204d138957a1cf88607dec59dc8.issues: Emulates a model rather than observations, so inherits Noah-MP and WRF biases; regional study; some cells still have negative NSE.

5643f404a49d70c1099e7e97545f0b595af8d632.goal: Evaluates crop-yield forecasting models under the extreme 2012 US Corn Belt drought, when conditions lie outside the training distribution.
5643f404a49d70c1099e7e97545f0b595af8d632.architecture: Comparison of non-deep ML models with sample weighting and feature selection against the VITA deep learning model.
5643f404a49d70c1099e7e97545f0b595af8d632.data: County-level US corn yields with 16 meteorological drivers; 2012 drought year as test.
5643f404a49d70c1099e7e97545f0b595af8d632.result: Sample weighting and feature selection improve the ML models, VITA gains little from them but still outperforms the ML models.
5643f404a49d70c1099e7e97545f0b595af8d632.open_work: Develop methods robust to distribution shift and spatial/temporal sparsity for extreme years.
5643f404a49d70c1099e7e97545f0b595af8d632.issues: Single extreme year and single crop; limited predictors; quantitative skill not reported in the abstract.

36c932f5e7f68ac604f43d8e3dcfed6b32d05e74.goal: Improves European drought forecasting by treating internal climate variability as structured, usable information.
36c932f5e7f68ac604f43d8e3dcfed6b32d05e74.architecture: Deep learning drought forecasting framework extended with an uncertainty-aware lower drought bound derived from a large climate model ensemble; network family not specified in the abstract.
36c932f5e7f68ac604f43d8e3dcfed6b32d05e74.data: Large climate model ensemble for internal variability and reanalysis data over Europe; specific products not named in the abstract.
36c932f5e7f68ac604f43d8e3dcfed6b32d05e74.result: The ensemble-informed bound is better calibrated than a reanalysis-only bound across most regions and seasons, especially in anomalously dry conditions.
36c932f5e7f68ac604f43d8e3dcfed6b32d05e74.open_work: Use large ensembles more broadly to inject physically plausible variability into ML forecasts.
36c932f5e7f68ac604f43d8e3dcfed6b32d05e74.issues: Relies on the climate model ensemble realistically representing internal variability; the bound is a conservative lower tail rather than a full predictive distribution.

58c52b6f98e922095c13c144f19f2af6dc6544b6.goal: Improves post-processing of global horizontal irradiance forecasts by selecting the most informative predictors.
58c52b6f98e922095c13c144f19f2af6dc6544b6.architecture: Stepwise machine learning regression for predictor selection in GHI forecast post-processing; specific models not available (abstract missing).
58c52b6f98e922095c13c144f19f2af6dc6544b6.data: Not reported; likely NWP-based GHI forecasts with ground measurements, but details unknown.
58c52b6f98e922095c13c144f19f2af6dc6544b6.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
58c52b6f98e922095c13c144f19f2af6dc6544b6.open_work: Not reported; testing predictor selection across sites and NWP models follows naturally.
58c52b6f98e922095c13c144f19f2af6dc6544b6.issues: Abstract unavailable, so data, methods and results cannot be verified.

c7e38d8a8a98f38890002d136c5dfe08db4175b6.goal: Accelerates development of seasonal snowmelt runoff forecasts for Sierra Nevada watersheds as hydroclimatic change erodes statistical forecast skill.
c7e38d8a8a98f38890002d136c5dfe08db4175b6.architecture: Agentic large language model workflow plus LLM code-mutation with Monte Carlo Tree Search, producing an adaptive ensemble of three XGBoost quantile regression models with physics-informed features.
c7e38d8a8a98f38890002d136c5dfe08db4175b6.data: Monthly Full Natural Flow for 23 Sierra Nevada watersheds; agent-discovered datasets; evaluation 2021–2025 against California's Bulletin 120 forecasts.
c7e38d8a8a98f38890002d136c5dfe08db4175b6.result: Better early-season April–July runoff skill than Bulletin 120, reducing watershed-averaged quantile forecast error by up to 29%.
c7e38d8a8a98f38890002d136c5dfe08db4175b6.open_work: Extend agent-driven model development to other geoscience forecasting tasks.
c7e38d8a8a98f38890002d136c5dfe08db4175b6.issues: Short 5-year evaluation; risk of overfitting through automated search; reproducibility of LLM-driven workflow.

87aefa8b9e84f0858934eba35e134973cfa959b0.goal: Characterizes national-scale solar power ramp events and evaluates how well forecasting models predict them.
87aefa8b9e84f0858934eba35e134973cfa959b0.architecture: Statistical ramp metrics plus evaluation of deep learning and physics-based nowcasts: SolarSTEPS, SHADECast (diffusion-based), IrradianceNet (ConvLSTM) and IFS-ENS.
87aefa8b9e84f0858934eba35e134973cfa959b0.data: Two years of 15-min PV production from 6434 stations at national scale; IFS-ENS forecasts as physics-based baseline; nowcast inputs not detailed in the abstract.
87aefa8b9e84f0858934eba35e134973cfa959b0.result: SHADECast is most reliable, with CRPS 10.8% lower than SolarSTEPS at 2-h lead, but forecast RMSE rises by up to 50% during ramps.
87aefa8b9e84f0858934eba35e134973cfa959b0.open_work: Develop improved high-resolution spatiotemporal models targeting ramp prediction.
87aefa8b9e84f0858934eba35e134973cfa959b0.issues: Two years only; single country; models struggle on ramp dynamics.

002e2a4273718ecd91b110884b1ccf1776239bdc.goal: Forecasts subseasonal root-zone soil moisture over Europe and assesses prospects for flash drought prediction.
002e2a4273718ecd91b110884b1ccf1776239bdc.architecture: Vision Transformer with dual-pathway temporal and spatial attention, residual learning, and quantile-head fine-tuning for probabilistic output.
002e2a4273718ecd91b110884b1ccf1776239bdc.data: European root-zone soil moisture; evaluation 2021–2022 against deep learning baselines and ECMWF S2S forecasts; training source not named in the abstract.
002e2a4273718ecd91b110884b1ccf1776239bdc.result: Highest deterministic and probabilistic skill at all leads, reliably detecting dry states below the 20th percentile; residual learning in physical units is essential to beat persistence.
002e2a4273718ecd91b110884b1ccf1776239bdc.open_work: Improve prediction of flash drought onset, which remains a challenge for all S2S systems.
002e2a4273718ecd91b110884b1ccf1776239bdc.issues: Short two-year test; flash drought onset poorly predicted; skill depends strongly on target formulation.

6a9fca4b856343ea83a0f96113285db458abf192.goal: Provides hourly flood simulation across the US river network that resolves extreme peaks better than operational and AI models.
6a9fca4b856343ea83a0f96113285db458abf192.architecture: dHBV2.0MTS-MC, a multi-timescale differentiable physics-embedded learning model (neural networks parameterizing an HBV-style hydrologic model) with infiltration excess.
6a9fca4b856343ea83a0f96113285db458abf192.data: More than 800,000 CONUS river reaches, evaluated at 2,831 gauges against NWM v3.0, an operational LSTM and recent AI models.
6a9fca4b856343ea83a0f96113285db458abf192.result: Median hourly NSE 0.683 versus 0.461 for NWM3.0; peak timing errors reduced to 4.5–6 h; captures 33% more 50-year floods than NWM3.0 and cuts peak error by 34% for 100-year floods.
6a9fca4b856343ea83a0f96113285db458abf192.open_work: Candidate for the next-generation National Water Model; operational forecasting tests with forecast forcings.
6a9fca4b856343ea83a0f96113285db458abf192.issues: Evaluated in simulation mode with observed forcings; ungauged-reach accuracy only indirectly verified.

5a84c6ab581cda98d4a51d286bf681c7ca9b7d67.goal: Improves seasonal summer rainfall forecasts for the East Asian flood season, limited by the spring predictability barrier.
5a84c6ab581cda98d4a51d286bf681c7ca9b7d67.architecture: CAPES, a hybrid ensemble combining a kilometer-resolution coupled regional atmosphere–land–ocean model with a data-driven AI seasonal forecasting system, run on exascale computing.
5a84c6ab581cda98d4a51d286bf681c7ca9b7d67.data: Ten annual 1,774-member hindcasts for 2016–2025 at 15 km (174 numerical plus 1,600 AI members); training data of the AI system not reported in the abstract.
5a84c6ab581cda98d4a51d286bf681c7ca9b7d67.result: Hindcasts complete in 14.6 hours, improving mean prediction score from ECMWF's 71.8 to 75.9; 1-km configuration enables fine-scale typhoon simulation.
5a84c6ab581cda98d4a51d286bf681c7ca9b7d67.open_work: Operationalize the 1-km fused ensemble and extend beyond one-week fine-scale runs.
5a84c6ab581cda98d4a51d286bf681c7ca9b7d67.issues: Prediction score metric is specific to Chinese operations; ten-year hindcast is short; AI component details not given.

0dd318767c0e26100b3c07d3efb2c21e8f4168d0.goal: Introduces the multilayer perceptron to atmospheric scientists and surveys how it had been applied to atmospheric problems up to the late 1990s.
0dd318767c0e26100b3c07d3efb2c21e8f4168d0.architecture: Review of multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks trained by backpropagation, covering their theory, training and practical use in the atmospheric sciences.
0dd318767c0e26100b3c07d3efb2c21e8f4168d0.data: No new data; surveys published applications such as air-quality and pollutant prediction, weather and rainfall forecasting and other atmospheric variables.
0dd318767c0e26100b3c07d3efb2c21e8f4168d0.result: Concludes that MLPs can model nonlinear atmospheric relationships and often match or beat linear statistical methods, given careful training and validation.
0dd318767c0e26100b3c07d3efb2c21e8f4168d0.open_work: Calls for more systematic guidance on network design, training and comparison with conventional statistical methods.
0dd318767c0e26100b3c07d3efb2c21e8f4168d0.issues: Predates deep learning; covers only feedforward MLPs. Abstract not available, so the card relies on general knowledge of the paper.

4087e84fc695bb6433d0104ee94f9d7e9f4b7da5.goal: Reviews how machine learning can extract knowledge from large fluid-mechanics datasets and support modelling, optimization and control of flows.
4087e84fc695bb6433d0104ee94f9d7e9f4b7da5.architecture: Review of ML methods for fluid mechanics, spanning supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning, including neural networks, dimensionality reduction and data-driven modelling of flows.
4087e84fc695bb6433d0104ee94f9d7e9f4b7da5.data: No new data; draws on experimental, field and large-scale simulation data used in the reviewed fluid-mechanics studies.
4087e84fc695bb6433d0104ee94f9d7e9f4b7da5.result: Argues that ML offers a powerful information-processing framework that can augment and possibly transform fluid-mechanics research and industrial applications.
4087e84fc695bb6433d0104ee94f9d7e9f4b7da5.open_work: Identifies emerging opportunities in combining domain knowledge with ML for understanding, modelling and controlling flows.
4087e84fc695bb6433d0104ee94f9d7e9f4b7da5.issues: Broad review not specific to geophysical flows; discusses strengths and limitations qualitatively rather than benchmarking methods.

4aa5d73c67c915b62cb3843b67031c249dc5e82f.goal: Reviews how artificial neural networks were developed for predicting and forecasting water resource variables, to identify good modelling practice.
4aa5d73c67c915b62cb3843b67031c249dc5e82f.architecture: Review of feedforward neural network (mostly MLP with backpropagation) modelling practice: input selection, data division, preprocessing, architecture choice, training and validation.
4aa5d73c67c915b62cb3843b67031c249dc5e82f.data: No new data; examines 43 published papers on ANN prediction of water resource variables, mainly river flow and water quality.
4aa5d73c67c915b62cb3843b67031c249dc5e82f.result: Finds that the modelling process is often poorly described and suboptimal, especially input determination, data division and validation, and proposes a structured modelling protocol.
4aa5d73c67c915b62cb3843b67031c249dc5e82f.open_work: Calls for systematic methods for input selection, data division and architecture determination, and for consistent reporting of model development.
4aa5d73c67c915b62cb3843b67031c249dc5e82f.issues: Abstract not available; relies on knowledge of the paper. Covers pre-2000 feedforward networks only.

441fbfdcc77187c9f9c41166b5fd42de04de1427.goal: Assesses the challenges and opportunities of deep learning for remote sensing data analysis and lowers the barrier for remote sensing scientists to adopt it.
441fbfdcc77187c9f9c41166b5fd42de04de1427.architecture: Review of deep learning for remote sensing, mainly convolutional neural networks (CNN) and related deep architectures for classification, detection, fusion and retrieval tasks.
441fbfdcc77187c9f9c41166b5fd42de04de1427.data: No new data; surveys remote sensing applications across hyperspectral, SAR, optical and other imagery, and lists datasets and resources.
441fbfdcc77187c9f9c41166b5fd42de04de1427.result: Argues that deep learning is a powerful but not universal tool, and that domain expertise must be combined with it to tackle large-scale problems.
441fbfdcc77187c9f9c41166b5fd42de04de1427.open_work: Advocates applying deep learning to large-scale challenges such as climate change and urbanization, with remote sensing knowledge built in.
441fbfdcc77187c9f9c41166b5fd42de04de1427.issues: Survey of a fast-moving field as of 2017; little coverage of atmospheric or oceanic applications specifically.

0acd117521ef5aafb09fed02ab415523b330b058.goal: Discovers the governing partial differential equations of spatiotemporal systems directly from measurement data, where first-principles derivations are intractable.
0acd117521ef5aafb09fed02ab415523b330b058.architecture: Sparse regression (PDE-FIND) over a library of candidate nonlinear and partial derivative terms, with Pareto analysis to select parsimonious models; not a neural network.
0acd117521ef5aafb09fed02ab415523b330b058.data: Simulated time series from canonical systems including Navier-Stokes, the quantum harmonic oscillator, diffusion, Burgers and Korteweg-de Vries equations, in Eulerian and Lagrangian frames.
0acd117521ef5aafb09fed02ab415523b330b058.result: Correctly recovers the governing equations of a range of canonical PDEs and can disambiguate non-unique dynamics, such as distinguishing linear wave from Korteweg-de Vries, using multiple initial conditions.
0acd117521ef5aafb09fed02ab415523b330b058.open_work: Extension to parameterized systems, noisy real-world measurements and systems where the candidate library is unknown.
0acd117521ef5aafb09fed02ab415523b330b058.issues: Relies on accurate numerical derivatives, so it is sensitive to noise; requires the true terms to be present in the candidate library.

6adeda1af8abc6bc3c17c0b39f635a845476cd9f.goal: Finds coordinate transformations that make strongly nonlinear dynamics approximately linear, enabling prediction and control with linear theory via Koopman eigenfunctions.
6adeda1af8abc6bc3c17c0b39f635a845476cd9f.architecture: Modified autoencoder neural network that learns Koopman eigenfunctions, with an auxiliary network parameterizing continuous eigenvalue frequencies.
6adeda1af8abc6bc3c17c0b39f635a845476cd9f.data: Simulated low-dimensional dynamical systems; specific test systems are not reported in the abstract.
6adeda1af8abc6bc3c17c0b39f635a845476cd9f.result: Learns parsimonious, interpretable embeddings on which dynamics are globally linear, including systems with continuous spectra.
6adeda1af8abc6bc3c17c0b39f635a845476cd9f.open_work: Scaling the approach to high-dimensional systems and using the embeddings for estimation and control.
6adeda1af8abc6bc3c17c0b39f635a845476cd9f.issues: Demonstrated on low-dimensional toy systems; not tested on realistic geophysical flows.

f3c546e922a85839c1f19cd0a96a25c4986dbce8.goal: Generalizes neural networks to learn operators between infinite-dimensional function spaces, providing fast surrogates for PDE solution operators.
f3c546e922a85839c1f19cd0a96a25c4986dbce8.architecture: Neural operator framework built from linear integral operators and nonlinear activations, with graph neural operator, multipole, low-rank and Fourier neural operator (FNO) parameterizations.
f3c546e922a85839c1f19cd0a96a25c4986dbce8.data: Synthetic PDE datasets including Burgers, Darcy flow and Navier-Stokes equations.
f3c546e922a85839c1f19cd0a96a25c4986dbce8.result: Proves universal approximation and discretization invariance, and shows neural operators outperform prior ML baselines while being orders of magnitude faster than conventional solvers.
f3c546e922a85839c1f19cd0a96a25c4986dbce8.open_work: Applying neural operators to larger, more complex physical systems such as weather and climate, and improving data efficiency.
f3c546e922a85839c1f19cd0a96a25c4986dbce8.issues: Abstract not available; card relies on knowledge of the paper and its 2021 arXiv version. Benchmarks are idealized PDEs.

f6d918d1c9b7bb1e45b9ca750bd9618bf8ef4ad7.goal: Systematically reviews which machine learning algorithms and input features are used for crop yield prediction.
f6d918d1c9b7bb1e45b9ca750bd9618bf8ef4ad7.architecture: Systematic literature review of machine learning and deep learning for crop yield prediction, covering artificial neural networks, CNN, LSTM, deep neural networks and others.
f6d918d1c9b7bb1e45b9ca750bd9618bf8ef4ad7.data: 567 studies retrieved from six databases, 50 ML studies selected, plus 30 deep learning studies from an additional search.
f6d918d1c9b7bb1e45b9ca750bd9618bf8ef4ad7.result: Temperature, rainfall and soil type are the most used features; artificial neural networks are the most applied ML method, and CNN is the most used deep learning algorithm, followed by LSTM and DNN.
f6d918d1c9b7bb1e45b9ca750bd9618bf8ef4ad7.open_work: Provides suggestions for further research on algorithms and features for crop yield prediction.
f6d918d1c9b7bb1e45b9ca750bd9618bf8ef4ad7.issues: Review based on a limited sample of studies; does not quantitatively compare model performance across studies.

ae55ab0f9310b647854f3144cdd43c7d4d004683.goal: Tests whether artificial neural networks can model the nonlinear rainfall-runoff process as well as conventional time-series and conceptual hydrological models.
ae55ab0f9310b647854f3144cdd43c7d4d004683.architecture: Three-layer feedforward neural network (MLP) trained with a procedure combining linear least squares and simplex search, compared with ARMAX time-series models and the SAC-SMA conceptual model.
ae55ab0f9310b647854f3144cdd43c7d4d004683.data: Daily rainfall and streamflow data from the Leaf River basin, Mississippi.
ae55ab0f9310b647854f3144cdd43c7d4d004683.result: The ANN gives better streamflow simulations than the linear ARMAX model and performance comparable to or better than the conceptual SAC-SMA model.
ae55ab0f9310b647854f3144cdd43c7d4d004683.open_work: Need to improve physical interpretability and to test networks on other basins and with additional inputs.
ae55ab0f9310b647854f3144cdd43c7d4d004683.issues: Abstract not available; relies on knowledge of the paper. Single basin; black-box model with limited physical interpretation.

61f886cb763d35ae0146037f9210c3c38cdb85a5.goal: Introduces artificial neural network concepts to hydrologists, as the first part of an ASCE task committee report on ANNs in hydrology.
61f886cb763d35ae0146037f9210c3c38cdb85a5.architecture: Review and tutorial of artificial neural networks for hydrology, mainly feedforward MLP networks with backpropagation, plus other network types and training methods.
61f886cb763d35ae0146037f9210c3c38cdb85a5.data: No new data; conceptual overview with references to hydrological applications.
61f886cb763d35ae0146037f9210c3c38cdb85a5.result: Sets out the basic concepts, network types and training procedures relevant to hydrological modelling.
61f886cb763d35ae0146037f9210c3c38cdb85a5.open_work: Points to the applications review in Part II and to open questions on network design and physical interpretation.
61f886cb763d35ae0146037f9210c3c38cdb85a5.issues: Abstract not available and author list missing in metadata (ASCE Task Committee report); card relies on knowledge of the paper. Predates deep learning.

319d0aea3b8d5500ea01d722bf9deaf776915634.goal: Learns solution operators of parametric PDE families while overcoming both the optimization difficulty of PINNs and the data demands of purely data-driven neural operators.
319d0aea3b8d5500ea01d722bf9deaf776915634.architecture: Physics-informed neural operator (PINO): Fourier neural operator (FNO) trained with coarse-resolution data plus PDE residual constraints at higher resolution, with instance-wise fine-tuning using physics only.
319d0aea3b8d5500ea01d722bf9deaf776915634.data: Synthetic PDE problems including Burgers, Darcy flow, Navier-Stokes and Kolmogorov flows.
319d0aea3b8d5500ea01d722bf9deaf776915634.result: Accurately approximates solution operators with no degradation under zero-shot super-resolution, needs few or no data, and solves long transient and Kolmogorov flows where PINN and other baselines fail.
319d0aea3b8d5500ea01d722bf9deaf776915634.open_work: Authors point to applications such as weather forecasting, airfoil design and turbulence control.
319d0aea3b8d5500ea01d722bf9deaf776915634.issues: Tested on idealized PDE benchmarks only; requires known governing equations to impose constraints.

32e29041fa352a9df0889f42807ed6141bc0b5ff.goal: Highlights the role of machine learning as an effective approach for problems in geosciences and remote sensing.
32e29041fa352a9df0889f42807ed6141bc0b5ff.architecture: Review of ML methods including neural networks, support vector machines, self-organizing maps, decision trees, random forests and genetic programming, with emphasis on genetic programming.
32e29041fa352a9df0889f42807ed6141bc0b5ff.data: Illustrative nonparametric regression and classification examples from geoscience and remote sensing; specific datasets not reported in the abstract.
32e29041fa352a9df0889f42807ed6141bc0b5ff.result: Shows through examples that ML methods can efficiently handle nonlinear regression and classification problems in geosciences and remote sensing.
32e29041fa352a9df0889f42807ed6141bc0b5ff.open_work: Broader adoption of ML methods in geoscience workflows.
32e29041fa352a9df0889f42807ed6141bc0b5ff.issues: General introductory overview; little quantitative comparison and predates deep learning.

696b388ee6221c6dbcfd647a06883b2bfee773d9.goal: Reconciles mechanistic scientific models with data without requiring big data, by embedding learnable components into differential equations.
696b388ee6221c6dbcfd647a06883b2bfee773d9.architecture: Universal differential equations (UDEs): differential equation models augmented with neural networks or other universal approximators, trained with open-source differentiable solver software (Julia SciML).
696b388ee6221c6dbcfd647a06883b2bfee773d9.data: Diverse examples including biological systems, physics-informed neural network training and large-eddy simulation closures; specific datasets not reported in the abstract.
696b388ee6221c6dbcfd647a06883b2bfee773d9.result: UDEs discover unknown governing equations, extrapolate beyond training data and accelerate simulations in a time- and data-efficient manner.
696b388ee6221c6dbcfd647a06883b2bfee773d9.open_work: Applying UDEs to more complex scientific models, including climate and fluid closures.
696b388ee6221c6dbcfd647a06883b2bfee773d9.issues: Mostly demonstration examples; performance on large, noisy real-world systems is not established.

34e41a4af6da972bafaae192fc63574911c73241.goal: Predicts hourly solar irradiance for the next day using weather forecast data, to support solar power planning.
34e41a4af6da972bafaae192fc63574911c73241.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network mapping forecast weather variables to hourly irradiance.
34e41a4af6da972bafaae192fc63574911c73241.data: Weather forecast inputs and measured hourly solar irradiance; site and period not reported here.
34e41a4af6da972bafaae192fc63574911c73241.result: The LSTM is reported to outperform the baseline methods it is compared with; baselines and scores are not reported here.
34e41a4af6da972bafaae192fc63574911c73241.open_work: Testing at more sites and climates, and adding probabilistic forecasts.
34e41a4af6da972bafaae192fc63574911c73241.issues: Abstract not available; site, baselines and scores are not verified, and generalization across locations is untested here.

b0e4a2cba183bceaf514de1dc5633949e460c41b.goal: Reviews how neural networks for predicting water resource variables in river systems were developed, to assess progress and future directions.
b0e4a2cba183bceaf514de1dc5633949e460c41b.architecture: Review of neural network development methods (mostly MLP feedforward networks) covering input selection, data division, architecture, calibration and validation.
b0e4a2cba183bceaf514de1dc5633949e460c41b.data: No new data; reviews about 210 journal papers published 1999–2007 on river flow and water quality prediction.
b0e4a2cba183bceaf514de1dc5633949e460c41b.result: Finds most studies use MLPs, with ad hoc input selection and data division and little progress on validation and uncertainty, despite advances since 2000.
b0e4a2cba183bceaf514de1dc5633949e460c41b.open_work: Calls for better input selection methods, model validation, uncertainty quantification and a generic modelling protocol.
b0e4a2cba183bceaf514de1dc5633949e460c41b.issues: Abstract not available; relies on knowledge of the paper, and the paper count should be spot-checked.

98f9db6743bc1f781b10bf2a8fa72fafdaa85067.goal: Compares AI methods for monthly river discharge forecasting to support hydropower reservoir management and scheduling.
98f9db6743bc1f781b10bf2a8fa72fafdaa85067.architecture: Comparison of ARMA models, artificial neural networks, adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS), genetic programming and support vector machine (SVM) regression.
98f9db6743bc1f781b10bf2a8fa72fafdaa85067.data: Long-term monthly river flow discharge observations at two river sites in China.
98f9db6743bc1f781b10bf2a8fa72fafdaa85067.result: ANFIS, GP and SVM give the best performance across R, Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency, RMSE and MAPE during training and validation.
98f9db6743bc1f781b10bf2a8fa72fafdaa85067.open_work: Combining methods or hybrid models, and testing at other sites and lead times.
98f9db6743bc1f781b10bf2a8fa72fafdaa85067.issues: Only two sites and monthly scale; no single method dominates across all criteria.

580bc7029739004442b2b2aafc3fef763c1a3483.goal: Develops an LSTM model for flood forecasting in a transboundary basin where downstream flows can change suddenly.
580bc7029739004442b2b2aafc3fef763c1a3483.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network using daily discharge and rainfall as inputs.
580bc7029739004442b2b2aafc3fef763c1a3483.data: Daily discharge and rainfall from the Da River basin, Vietnam, before 1985 (pre Hoa Binh dam), forecasting flow at Hoa Binh station.
580bc7029739004442b2b2aafc3fef763c1a3483.result: Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency reaches 99%, 95% and 87% for one-, two- and three-day ahead forecasts.
580bc7029739004442b2b2aafc3fef763c1a3483.open_work: Extending to post-dam regulated conditions and longer lead times.
580bc7029739004442b2b2aafc3fef763c1a3483.issues: Single basin with pre-dam data; skill drops with lead time and regulation effects are not modelled.

7568e91b9b2d79f11250504166a99b799e99721c.goal: Estimates rainfall from satellite infrared imagery at high resolution by classifying cloud patches and assigning cloud-type-specific rain rates (PERSIANN-CCS).
7568e91b9b2d79f11250504166a99b799e99721c.architecture: Cloud classification system: segmentation of infrared cloud images into patches, feature extraction, a self-organizing map (SOM) neural network to cluster patches, and per-cluster temperature-rain rate curves.
7568e91b9b2d79f11250504166a99b799e99721c.data: Geostationary GOES infrared imagery, calibrated and validated against ground radar rainfall estimates.
7568e91b9b2d79f11250504166a99b799e99721c.result: Produces rainfall estimates at finer resolution than earlier PERSIANN, with better skill from distinguishing cloud types; exact scores not given here.
7568e91b9b2d79f11250504166a99b799e99721c.open_work: Adding multispectral and passive microwave information and extending coverage.
7568e91b9b2d79f11250504166a99b799e99721c.issues: Abstract not available; relies on knowledge of the paper. IR-only inputs relate cloud-top temperature to rainfall only indirectly.

cb238aedf9dc09be23c15329c54499d6ffcc07a2.goal: Investigates whether artificial neural networks can serve as rainfall-runoff models and learn catchment response.
cb238aedf9dc09be23c15329c54499d6ffcc07a2.architecture: Feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network trained by backpropagation mapping rainfall to runoff.
cb238aedf9dc09be23c15329c54499d6ffcc07a2.data: Mainly synthetic rainfall and runoff series generated from a conceptual storage model; details not reported here.
cb238aedf9dc09be23c15329c54499d6ffcc07a2.result: ANNs can emulate rainfall-runoff behaviour well, with performance sensitive to data scaling and the range of training data.
cb238aedf9dc09be23c15329c54499d6ffcc07a2.open_work: Testing on real catchment data and improving extrapolation to events outside the training range.
cb238aedf9dc09be23c15329c54499d6ffcc07a2.issues: Abstract not available; data details should be spot-checked. Synthetic data and poor extrapolation to extremes.

a8f5a688920214d5531a8b507d6f1206ee710f48.goal: Assesses flood hazard risk spatially using machine learning to identify high-risk areas and important risk factors.
a8f5a688920214d5531a8b507d6f1206ee710f48.architecture: Random forest model for flood hazard risk classification, with variable importance analysis and comparison to a support vector machine.
a8f5a688920214d5531a8b507d6f1206ee710f48.data: Historical flood records and geospatial risk indices (e.g. rainfall, terrain, river network) for a river basin in China; details not reported here.
a8f5a688920214d5531a8b507d6f1206ee710f48.result: Random forest is reported to outperform SVM for flood hazard risk assessment; exact scores not given here.
a8f5a688920214d5531a8b507d6f1206ee710f48.open_work: Applying to other basins and adding dynamic or climate-change drivers.
a8f5a688920214d5531a8b507d6f1206ee710f48.issues: Abstract not available; study area and indices should be spot-checked. Static assessment depends on historical flood inventory quality.

d8d3aa7eb79d0c9a1c46a6bea38a3c42a00c8964.goal: Predicts long-term water table depth in heterogeneous agricultural areas as a cheaper alternative to physical groundwater models.
d8d3aa7eb79d0c9a1c46a6bea38a3c42a00c8964.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) layer with dropout followed by a fully connected layer, compared with a feedforward neural network and a double-LSTM model.
d8d3aa7eb79d0c9a1c46a6bea38a3c42a00c8964.data: Monthly water diversion, evaporation, precipitation, temperature and time for five sub-areas of Hetao Irrigation District, China; 2000–2011 training, 2012–2013 validation.
d8d3aa7eb79d0c9a1c46a6bea38a3c42a00c8964.result: LSTM reaches R2 of 0.789–0.952 versus 0.004–0.495 for FFNN and 0.170–0.864 for double-LSTM; dropout significantly reduces overfitting.
d8d3aa7eb79d0c9a1c46a6bea38a3c42a00c8964.open_work: Applying to other regions and data-scarce areas, and longer prediction horizons.
d8d3aa7eb79d0c9a1c46a6bea38a3c42a00c8964.issues: Short 14-year record and a two-year validation period; single irrigation district.

f6cb47a3b5f27833cfc3f7b7cebffea1e0dfb91b.goal: Estimates Lyapunov exponents and reproduces the long-term climate of chaotic systems from data without a model.
f6cb47a3b5f27833cfc3f7b7cebffea1e0dfb91b.architecture: Reservoir computing (echo-state recurrent network) with linear regression for output weights, run autonomously to reproduce the attractor.
f6cb47a3b5f27833cfc3f7b7cebffea1e0dfb91b.data: Simulated time series from the Lorenz system and the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation.
f6cb47a3b5f27833cfc3f7b7cebffea1e0dfb91b.result: The autonomous reservoir reproduces the attractor's climate and gives accurate Lyapunov exponent estimates, including for the high-dimensional KS system.
f6cb47a3b5f27833cfc3f7b7cebffea1e0dfb91b.open_work: Applying to higher-dimensional and real-world systems such as weather and climate.
f6cb47a3b5f27833cfc3f7b7cebffea1e0dfb91b.issues: Idealized low-dimensional or 1D systems with clean data; success is not guaranteed for every training run.

aafa9bb3ba269fb0561c0b2165d27464840545d7.goal: Generalizes neural networks to learn operators between infinite-dimensional function spaces, providing fast surrogates for PDE solution operators.
aafa9bb3ba269fb0561c0b2165d27464840545d7.architecture: Neural operator: composition of linear integral operators and nonlinear activations, with graph neural operator, multipole graph, low-rank and Fourier neural operator (FNO) parameterizations.
aafa9bb3ba269fb0561c0b2165d27464840545d7.data: Synthetic PDE data for Burgers, Darcy subsurface flow and Navier-Stokes equations.
aafa9bb3ba269fb0561c0b2165d27464840545d7.result: Proves universal approximation and discretization invariance; outperforms prior ML methods and is orders of magnitude faster than conventional PDE solvers.
aafa9bb3ba269fb0561c0b2165d27464840545d7.open_work: Scaling to complex real-world systems and improving data efficiency.
aafa9bb3ba269fb0561c0b2165d27464840545d7.issues: Evaluated on idealized PDE benchmarks; needs solver-generated training data.

21a1eade787a5a49302533e7e28911581cca428e.goal: Reviews the use of support vector machines in hydrology to summarize applications and guide future work.
21a1eade787a5a49302533e7e28911581cca428e.architecture: Review of support vector machine (SVM) and support vector regression applications in hydrology, including hybrid variants.
21a1eade787a5a49302533e7e28911581cca428e.data: No new data; surveys hydrological studies on rainfall-runoff, streamflow, groundwater, evaporation and related variables.
21a1eade787a5a49302533e7e28911581cca428e.result: Finds SVMs perform well, often comparably to or better than ANNs, in many hydrological prediction problems.
21a1eade787a5a49302533e7e28911581cca428e.open_work: Calls for better kernel and parameter selection and more hybrid approaches.
21a1eade787a5a49302533e7e28911581cca428e.issues: Abstract not available; relies on general knowledge of the paper's scope.

7a0927c8d761667642675e7d0c4722ed47690ed9.goal: Produces probabilistic wind power forecasts to quantify uncertainty for power system operation.
7a0927c8d761667642675e7d0c4722ed47690ed9.architecture: Deep learning ensemble approach combining wavelet decomposition of wind power series with convolutional neural network (CNN) feature learning and an ensemble for uncertainty estimation.
7a0927c8d761667642675e7d0c4722ed47690ed9.data: Wind power data from wind farms; details not reported here.
7a0927c8d761667642675e7d0c4722ed47690ed9.result: Reported to improve probabilistic forecast accuracy over benchmark methods; exact scores not given here.
7a0927c8d761667642675e7d0c4722ed47690ed9.open_work: Extending to more sites, horizons and inclusion of numerical weather prediction inputs.
7a0927c8d761667642675e7d0c4722ed47690ed9.issues: Abstract not available; architecture details and data should be spot-checked.

9ec33f323bab1d39a674b0400c8ed3331a12beed.goal: Combines physics-based models with neural networks to improve generalization and physical consistency of lake temperature predictions.
9ec33f323bab1d39a674b0400c8ed3331a12beed.architecture: Physics-guided neural network (PGNN): a feedforward neural network taking physics-based model outputs plus observational features, trained with a loss penalizing violations of the temperature-density-depth relationship.
9ec33f323bab1d39a674b0400c8ed3331a12beed.data: Lake temperature observations and physics-based lake model (GLM) simulations; specific lakes not reported in the abstract.
9ec33f323bab1d39a674b0400c8ed3331a12beed.result: PGNN gives lower errors and physically consistent predictions with better generalizability than pure data-driven or physics-based models.
9ec33f323bab1d39a674b0400c8ed3331a12beed.open_work: Extending physics-guided learning to other physical constraints and environmental systems.
9ec33f323bab1d39a674b0400c8ed3331a12beed.issues: Physics constraint covers only density-depth monotonicity; tested on limited lakes.

eb5c651e7490d12ea286604561142223f8fb96c4.goal: Popularizes random forests and their variants for water scientists and assesses how they have been used in water resources.
eb5c651e7490d12ea286604561142223f8fb96c4.architecture: Review of random forest algorithms and variants (e.g. quantile regression forests), related concepts such as variable importance, and R implementations.
eb5c651e7490d12ea286604561142223f8fb96c4.data: No new data; reviews published random forest applications in water resources.
eb5c651e7490d12ea286604561142223f8fb96c4.result: Finds most applications use only Breiman's original algorithm, leaving useful variants underexploited.
eb5c651e7490d12ea286604561142223f8fb96c4.open_work: Encourages use of random forest variants for diverse practical problems in the water sector.
eb5c651e7490d12ea286604561142223f8fb96c4.issues: Descriptive review without quantitative benchmarking of methods.

c50795ab1f32c557db2b64e40b51e48cd8790d79.goal: Downscales GCM output to regional precipitation under climate change scenarios using a statistical learning method.
c50795ab1f32c557db2b64e40b51e48cd8790d79.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression for statistical downscaling of monthly precipitation, compared with a multilayer perceptron neural network.
c50795ab1f32c557db2b64e40b51e48cd8790d79.data: Reanalysis predictors (NCEP/NCAR) for training and GCM simulations for future scenarios, applied to meteorological subdivisions of India.
c50795ab1f32c557db2b64e40b51e48cd8790d79.result: SVM downscaling performs better than the MLP benchmark; projected precipitation changes are reported per subdivision.
c50795ab1f32c557db2b64e40b51e48cd8790d79.open_work: Considering uncertainty across GCMs and scenarios.
c50795ab1f32c557db2b64e40b51e48cd8790d79.issues: Abstract not available; data details should be spot-checked. Stationarity assumption of statistical downscaling.

cfe190d5cc9a7d63eb1962a912f9655540de9a94.goal: Predicts hourly runoff for the next 24 hours to improve short-term flood forecasting.
cfe190d5cc9a7d63eb1962a912f9655540de9a94.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) encoder-decoder sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) model, compared with linear, Lasso, Ridge, support vector, Gaussian process regression and plain LSTM.
cfe190d5cc9a7d63eb1962a912f9655540de9a94.data: Rainfall observations and forecasts, runoff observations and monthly evapotranspiration for Clear Creek and Upper Wapsipinicon River watersheds, Iowa.
cfe190d5cc9a7d63eb1962a912f9655540de9a94.result: LSTM-seq2seq outperforms all baselines at all stations in NSE, correlation, bias and normalized RMSE.
cfe190d5cc9a7d63eb1962a912f9655540de9a94.open_work: Use in operational short-term flood forecasting and other hydrological time-series tasks.
cfe190d5cc9a7d63eb1962a912f9655540de9a94.issues: Two watersheds only; quality depends on rainfall forecast inputs.

45f0e02b2508999368aeaff25ebb7056807509b7.goal: Forecasts long-term (monthly) river discharge for reservoir and hydropower planning.
45f0e02b2508999368aeaff25ebb7056807509b7.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression, compared with ARMA time-series models and artificial neural networks.
45f0e02b2508999368aeaff25ebb7056807509b7.data: Long-term monthly river discharge records; site details not reported here.
45f0e02b2508999368aeaff25ebb7056807509b7.result: SVM is reported to outperform ARMA and ANN for monthly discharge prediction.
45f0e02b2508999368aeaff25ebb7056807509b7.open_work: Improving SVM parameter selection and testing at more stations.
45f0e02b2508999368aeaff25ebb7056807509b7.issues: Abstract not available; data details should be spot-checked.

3452e69a8d574122a06e5939587ad4e96b7ac5a4.goal: Discovers the governing partial differential equation of a system directly from spatiotemporal data, aiming for interpretable models rather than black-box predictors.
3452e69a8d574122a06e5939587ad4e96b7ac5a4.architecture: Non-neural method: sparse regression over a dictionary of candidate derivative and nonlinear terms, solved with L1-type sparse optimization to select the few active terms.
3452e69a8d574122a06e5939587ad4e96b7ac5a4.data: Synthetic data generated from known canonical PDEs; exact test cases and noise levels are not given in the available metadata.
3452e69a8d574122a06e5939587ad4e96b7ac5a4.result: Recovers the correct terms and coefficients of the generating PDEs from data in the tested cases.
3452e69a8d574122a06e5939587ad4e96b7ac5a4.open_work: Robustness to strong noise, sparse or irregular observations, and extension to real geophysical data remain open.
3452e69a8d574122a06e5939587ad4e96b7ac5a4.issues: Requires the true terms to be in the candidate library and accurate numerical derivatives; demonstrated on idealized synthetic systems only.

05d20fda297c9afb347214bd1693bd049674e0c6.goal: Introduces machine learning researchers to the challenges and opportunities that geoscience problems pose, to foster collaboration between the two communities.
05d20fda297c9afb347214bd1693bd049674e0c6.architecture: Review/perspective of geoscience data properties, problem categories and cross-cutting ML research themes; no new model is proposed.
05d20fda297c9afb347214bd1693bd049674e0c6.data: Discusses typical geoscience data sources such as satellite remote sensing, in situ sensors and model simulations, described generically.
05d20fda297c9afb347214bd1693bd049674e0c6.result: Identifies geoscience-specific obstacles for ML (e.g. heterogeneity, multiscale structure, small labelled samples, rare events) and research themes to address them.
05d20fda297c9afb347214bd1693bd049674e0c6.open_work: Calls for deep ML–geoscience collaboration and new methods for the identified cross-cutting themes.
05d20fda297c9afb347214bd1693bd049674e0c6.issues: Perspective paper without quantitative benchmarks; predates the deep learning weather and climate boom.

f78065c75a1d0448fc0fee1dfef8cb93c607c1cd.goal: Compares training strategies for recurrent neural networks forecasting high-dimensional chaotic spatiotemporal dynamics, including reduced-order settings.
f78065c75a1d0448fc0fee1dfef8cb93c607c1cd.architecture: Recurrent neural networks: reservoir computing (echo state networks) versus gated RNNs (LSTM, GRU) trained with backpropagation through time, with parallel implementations.
f78065c75a1d0448fc0fee1dfef8cb93c607c1cd.data: Simulated Lorenz-96 and Kuramoto–Sivashinsky systems, using full-state and reduced-order observations.
f78065c75a1d0448fc0fee1dfef8cb93c607c1cd.result: With full-state data, reservoir computing beats BPTT in accuracy and long-term statistics at much lower training cost; with reduced-order data, BPTT RNNs are more stable and accurate. Lyapunov spectrum of KS is recovered with BPTT.
f78065c75a1d0448fc0fee1dfef8cb93c607c1cd.open_work: Scaling to real, partially observed geophysical systems and improving the stability of large reservoirs are natural next steps.
f78065c75a1d0448fc0fee1dfef8cb93c607c1cd.issues: Idealized chaotic test systems only; large reservoir models can diverge on reduced-order data.

70fc34f1075ccb06cfd6b3f3821bf093251efb66.goal: Simulates event-based rainfall–runoff for flood forecasting, testing whether deep learning improves on conventional neural networks and process models.
70fc34f1075ccb06cfd6b3f3821bf093251efb66.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network compared with a standard artificial neural network (ANN).
70fc34f1075ccb06cfd6b3f3821bf093251efb66.data: 98 rainfall–runoff flood events (1971–2013) in the Fen River basin, China, from 14 rain gauges and one hydrologic station; 86 events training, 12 test.
70fc34f1075ccb06cfd6b3f3821bf093251efb66.result: Both networks beat conceptual and physically based models; LSTM outperforms ANN with R2 and NSE above 0.9 and is more stable across lead times.
70fc34f1075ccb06cfd6b3f3821bf093251efb66.open_work: Testing on more basins and longer lead times for operational flood forecasting.
70fc34f1075ccb06cfd6b3f3821bf093251efb66.issues: Single basin and small test set of 12 events; no uncertainty quantification.

ba95ae1b56fa8450f4347e7d69ab84de70f1913b.goal: Compares deep learning models for day-ahead photovoltaic power forecasting, which is hard due to intermittent solar resource.
ba95ae1b56fa8450f4347e7d69ab84de70f1913b.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN), long short-term memory (LSTM) network and a hybrid CNN-LSTM model.
ba95ae1b56fa8450f4347e7d69ab84de70f1913b.data: Photovoltaic power data from the DKASC Alice Springs PV system, Australia; evaluated with MAPE, RMSE and MAE.
ba95ae1b56fa8450f4347e7d69ab84de70f1913b.result: The hybrid CNN-LSTM performs best, then CNN; LSTM is worst but fastest to train. Longer input sequences help up to a point.
ba95ae1b56fa8450f4347e7d69ab84de70f1913b.open_work: Determining optimal input sequence length and adding weather forecast inputs.
ba95ae1b56fa8450f4347e7d69ab84de70f1913b.issues: Single site; dependence on input length is not explained; no probabilistic forecasts.

9a222f519165011866b2caea12dcb78d47312398.goal: Reviews artificial intelligence methods used for streamflow forecasting between 2000 and 2015 to summarize progress and guide model choice.
9a222f519165011866b2caea12dcb78d47312398.architecture: Review of AI-based streamflow models such as artificial neural networks, fuzzy and neuro-fuzzy systems, support vector machines, genetic programming and wavelet-hybrid models.
9a222f519165011866b2caea12dcb78d47312398.data: Covers published streamflow studies from 2000–2015 across many catchments; no new data.
9a222f519165011866b2caea12dcb78d47312398.result: Summarizes the growth and relative performance of AI models for streamflow forecasting; detailed findings are not available in the provided metadata.
9a222f519165011866b2caea12dcb78d47312398.open_work: Hybrid models and better input selection are typical suggested directions.
9a222f519165011866b2caea12dcb78d47312398.issues: Abstract unavailable; predates deep learning models such as LSTM in hydrology.

6b96f4daa52f7fe7e6334bf2b2e3d8e245f652c7.goal: Estimates soil moisture from remote sensing data with machine learning as an alternative to physically based retrieval.
6b96f4daa52f7fe7e6334bf2b2e3d8e245f652c7.data: Satellite remote sensing inputs (radar backscatter and vegetation index) with modelled soil moisture as target; exact products and sites should be checked.
6b96f4daa52f7fe7e6334bf2b2e3d8e245f652c7.result: Reports that the machine learning approach estimates soil moisture with reasonable accuracy; specific scores are not available here.
6b96f4daa52f7fe7e6334bf2b2e3d8e245f652c7.open_work: Extending to other regions and sensors and comparing with in situ networks.
6b96f4daa52f7fe7e6334bf2b2e3d8e245f652c7.issues: Abstract unavailable; target data may come from a land surface model rather than observations, inheriting its biases.

989e681731eb27ac1e12b2d60c8612c6982fe8c7.goal: Predicts turbulent flow dynamics with deep learning while incorporating physical principles, relevant to turbulence and climate modelling.
989e681731eb27ac1e12b2d60c8612c6982fe8c7.architecture: Turbulent-Flow Net: trainable spectral filters inspired by a coupled RANS–LES decomposition, followed by a specialized U-Net for prediction.
989e681731eb27ac1e12b2d60c8612c6982fe8c7.data: Velocity fields from large-scale turbulent fluid flow simulations (two-dimensional Rayleigh–Bénard convection).
989e681731eb27ac1e12b2d60c8612c6982fe8c7.result: Significantly lower error than state-of-the-art baselines for predictions 60 frames ahead, with better mass conservation and turbulent kinetic energy spectra.
989e681731eb27ac1e12b2d60c8612c6982fe8c7.open_work: Extending to 3D turbulence, longer horizons and hard physical constraints.
989e681731eb27ac1e12b2d60c8612c6982fe8c7.issues: Trained and tested on a single simulated flow configuration; conservation is encouraged rather than guaranteed.

e2252b4a9ca2a552c37f528e3e1ef49dbb58575b.goal: Explains how neural network models can be adapted to prediction and data analysis in meteorology and oceanography, especially for large-scale low-frequency problems.
e2252b4a9ca2a552c37f528e3e1ef49dbb58575b.architecture: Review of feed-forward neural networks with hidden layers, combined with PCA prefiltering, ensemble averaging, and nonlinear extensions of PCA and canonical correlation analysis.
e2252b4a9ca2a552c37f528e3e1ef49dbb58575b.data: Illustrative meteorological and oceanographic applications such as tropical Pacific sea surface temperature and ENSO prediction; details not given in the abstract.
e2252b4a9ca2a552c37f528e3e1ef49dbb58575b.result: Shows that nonlinear instability with short records, large spatial fields and interpretability can be addressed via ensembles, PCA compression and phase-space interpretation of hidden layers.
e2252b4a9ca2a552c37f528e3e1ef49dbb58575b.open_work: Wider use of nonlinear multivariate NN methods in climate analysis and forecasting.
e2252b4a9ca2a552c37f528e3e1ef49dbb58575b.issues: Short data records limit nonlinear models; early-era methods predating deep learning.

6965bc6d26fc910a6387cd6d423b35fd9e1d358b.goal: Surveys methods that integrate physics-based modelling with machine learning to improve accuracy, consistency and data efficiency in scientific applications.
6965bc6d26fc910a6387cd6d423b35fd9e1d358b.architecture: Review/survey organized by objective (e.g. surrogates, downscaling, parameterization, inverse modelling) and by method (physics-guided loss, initialization, architecture design, residual and hybrid models).
6965bc6d26fc910a6387cd6d423b35fd9e1d358b.data: Covers studies across environmental and engineering sciences, including hydrology, climate and fluid dynamics; no new data.
6965bc6d26fc910a6387cd6d423b35fd9e1d358b.result: Provides a taxonomy of physics–ML integration strategies and catalogs applications for each.
6965bc6d26fc910a6387cd6d423b35fd9e1d358b.open_work: Open questions include uncertainty quantification, generalization, and principled combination of multiple integration strategies.
6965bc6d26fc910a6387cd6d423b35fd9e1d358b.issues: Survey without quantitative comparison; abstract unavailable in the metadata.
