ca4fe1e3e62d5e9ca10b635aa2c44899b0d660b0.goal: Forecasts long-term drought, expressed by the Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI), in the Awash River Basin, Ethiopia, to support drought preparedness.
ca4fe1e3e62d5e9ca10b635aa2c44899b0d660b0.architecture: Wavelet neural network (wavelet transform plus artificial neural network) and wavelet support vector regression, compared with ARIMA, ANN and SVR.
ca4fe1e3e62d5e9ca10b635aa2c44899b0d660b0.data: SPI time series (e.g. SPI 12 and SPI 24) derived from rain gauge records in the Awash River Basin.
ca4fe1e3e62d5e9ca10b635aa2c44899b0d660b0.result: Wavelet-coupled models, especially the wavelet neural network, forecast long-term SPI better than the non-wavelet models.
ca4fe1e3e62d5e9ca10b635aa2c44899b0d660b0.open_work: Testing other lead times, basins and drought indices.
ca4fe1e3e62d5e9ca10b635aa2c44899b0d660b0.issues: Abstract unavailable; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if applied to the whole series.

f28f413d1fdefc779a6522a186508abeff27a173.goal: Reviews deep learning in geophysics to summarize concepts, state of the art, difficulties and future trends.
f28f413d1fdefc779a6522a186508abeff27a173.architecture: Review of deep learning approaches (CNNs, RNNs, autoencoders, GANs etc.) with a coding tutorial and practical tips.
f28f413d1fdefc779a6522a186508abeff27a173.data: Covers exploration geophysics, earthquakes and remote sensing primarily, plus Earth structure, water resources, atmospheric and space science.
f28f413d1fdefc779a6522a186508abeff27a173.result: Synthesizes how deep learning predicts complex system states and eases the curse of dimensionality across geophysical applications.
f28f413d1fdefc779a6522a186508abeff27a173.open_work: Points to unsupervised, transfer, multimodal and federated learning, uncertainty estimation and active learning.
f28f413d1fdefc779a6522a186508abeff27a173.issues: Atmospheric and oceanic applications are a minor part; broad survey without benchmarks.

af3b8920be370b3fadb6d06b72d23f6c19b544eb.goal: Reviews deep learning for flood mapping to identify the state of the art, knowledge gaps and future directions.
af3b8920be370b3fadb6d06b72d23f6c19b544eb.architecture: Review of 45 publications on deep learning for flood susceptibility, inundation and hazard mapping.
af3b8920be370b3fadb6d06b72d23f6c19b544eb.data: Reviewed studies use varied data, including hydraulic model outputs, remote sensing and topography; no new data.
af3b8920be370b3fadb6d06b72d23f6c19b544eb.result: Convolutional models are usually more accurate; deep learning is more accurate than traditional methods and faster than numerical models, but all reviewed models are deterministic.
af3b8920be370b3fadb6d06b72d23f6c19b544eb.open_work: Graph neural networks and neural operators for generalization, real-time warning and flood risk, and Deep Gaussian Processes for probabilistic prediction.
af3b8920be370b3fadb6d06b72d23f6c19b544eb.issues: Generalization to unseen sites and uncertainty quantification are largely missing in the field.

1c3752586e7d746b13eb5b2784ac9fe53756b7fd.goal: Explains when reservoir computing can learn a model of a chaotic system that both forecasts short term and reproduces its long-term ergodic behaviour.
1c3752586e7d746b13eb5b2784ac9fe53756b7fd.architecture: Reservoir computing (echo state network) with a theoretical framework based on generalized synchronization.
1c3752586e7d746b13eb5b2784ac9fe53756b7fd.data: Numerical experiments on simulated chaotic dynamical systems, notably the Lorenz system.
1c3752586e7d746b13eb5b2784ac9fe53756b7fd.result: Derives conditions for skillful short-term prediction and accurate attractor reconstruction, and argues the theory extends to other ML time-series methods.
1c3752586e7d746b13eb5b2784ac9fe53756b7fd.open_work: Applying the framework to higher-dimensional and noisy real systems.
1c3752586e7d746b13eb5b2784ac9fe53756b7fd.issues: Low-dimensional idealized examples; conditions may be hard to verify in practice.

eadc2e781abf80e478e8301c4a56b86c90ff4694.goal: Reduces numerical errors of iterative PDE solvers by learning correction functions for effects missed by coarse discretization.
eadc2e781abf80e478e8301c4a56b86c90ff4694.architecture: Convolutional neural network corrections trained with a differentiable physics solver in the training loop (solver-in-the-loop), compared with purely supervised training.
eadc2e781abf80e478e8301c4a56b86c90ff4694.data: Simulated PDEs including nonlinear advection–diffusion, Burgers-type flows and three-dimensional Navier–Stokes flows.
eadc2e781abf80e478e8301c4a56b86c90ff4694.result: Solver-in-the-loop training significantly outperforms previous approaches, giving stable rollouts over several hundred steps.
eadc2e781abf80e478e8301c4a56b86c90ff4694.open_work: Extending to more complex solvers and real geophysical models.
eadc2e781abf80e478e8301c4a56b86c90ff4694.issues: Requires a differentiable solver; tested on idealized flows only.

ed9e35332d9fe5aa28fb42d1e24589a5b8701124.goal: Reviews deep learning models for solar irradiance forecasting, important for integrating solar energy into power grids.
ed9e35332d9fe5aa28fb42d1e24589a5b8701124.architecture: Review of deep learning approaches for solar irradiance forecasting, such as CNN, LSTM and hybrid models.
ed9e35332d9fe5aa28fb42d1e24589a5b8701124.data: Covers studies using ground measurements, satellite imagery and numerical weather prediction inputs; no new data.
ed9e35332d9fe5aa28fb42d1e24589a5b8701124.result: Summarizes the performance of deep learning versus conventional methods; specific findings are not available in the metadata.
ed9e35332d9fe5aa28fb42d1e24589a5b8701124.open_work: Likely directions include hybrid and probabilistic models and better input selection.
ed9e35332d9fe5aa28fb42d1e24589a5b8701124.issues: Abstract unavailable; content inferred from the title.

3b7cbdfc2d6227285fc773b7091ea11610120c45.goal: Provides quantile regression neural networks for estimating conditional quantiles of skewed variables such as precipitation, with an application to statistical downscaling.
3b7cbdfc2d6227285fc773b7091ea11610120c45.architecture: Quantile regression neural network (multilayer perceptron trained on the quantile loss), implemented as an R package, including handling of zero precipitation.
3b7cbdfc2d6227285fc773b7091ea11610120c45.data: Precipitation downscaling case study; specific stations and predictor datasets are not given in the metadata.
3b7cbdfc2d6227285fc773b7091ea11610120c45.result: Shows the QRNN gives a flexible nonlinear quantile regression suitable for downscaling mixed discrete–continuous precipitation.
3b7cbdfc2d6227285fc773b7091ea11610120c45.open_work: Extending to multisite and multivariate downscaling.
3b7cbdfc2d6227285fc773b7091ea11610120c45.issues: Abstract unavailable; independently fitted quantiles can cross.

b79127b48a3bf7ddcf7b5553889f35e4ed9a819e.goal: Reviews artificial intelligence methods for groundwater level modelling and forecasting to provide practical guidelines.
b79127b48a3bf7ddcf7b5553889f35e4ed9a819e.architecture: Review of 67 papers (2001–2018) on AI methods such as artificial neural networks, neuro-fuzzy, support vector machines and hybrid models for groundwater level.
b79127b48a3bf7ddcf7b5553889f35e4ed9a819e.data: Reviewed studies on groundwater level time series in various aquifers; no new data.
b79127b48a3bf7ddcf7b5553889f35e4ed9a819e.result: Properly developed AI methods can simulate and forecast groundwater level, though many modelling steps rely on trial and error.
b79127b48a3bf7ddcf7b5553889f35e4ed9a819e.open_work: Proposes new ideas for innovative methods and improved modelling quality.
b79127b48a3bf7ddcf7b5553889f35e4ed9a819e.issues: Qualitative synthesis; predates widespread deep learning use.

3f47ed0e11308f9c9bbb2fd070b24025430fb606.goal: Forecasts streamflow with artificial neural networks and compares different network training algorithms.
3f47ed0e11308f9c9bbb2fd070b24025430fb606.architecture: Artificial neural networks trained with different algorithms; the network family beyond ANN is not specified in the available metadata.
3f47ed0e11308f9c9bbb2fd070b24025430fb606.data: Streamflow time series; the river and period are not reported in the available metadata.
3f47ed0e11308f9c9bbb2fd070b24025430fb606.result: Compares forecast skill across training algorithms; specific results are not available here.
3f47ed0e11308f9c9bbb2fd070b24025430fb606.open_work: Testing on other basins and with additional inputs.
3f47ed0e11308f9c9bbb2fd070b24025430fb606.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-variable time series forecasting.

e0252e451d76cc8fe873890073a5ab3b665f8a48.goal: Builds an accurate and interpretable deep learning flood forecasting model, addressing low robustness of hydrological models and opacity of ML.
e0252e451d76cc8fe873890073a5ab3b665f8a48.architecture: Spatio-temporal attention long short-term memory (STA-LSTM) network with dynamic spatial and temporal attention, trained with Adam.
e0252e451d76cc8fe873890073a5ab3b665f8a48.data: Hydrological data from three small and medium basins in China.
e0252e451d76cc8fe873890073a5ab3b665f8a48.result: STA-LSTM outperforms HA, FCN, CNN, GCN, LSTM, SA-LSTM and TA-LSTM in most cases, and attention weights are physically reasonable.
e0252e451d76cc8fe873890073a5ab3b665f8a48.open_work: Testing on larger basins and more systematic interpretability evaluation.
e0252e451d76cc8fe873890073a5ab3b665f8a48.issues: Attention weights are a limited form of interpretation; only three basins.

ccfb9195def94bb9afe9036293892047dcc5cfc7.goal: Forecasts drought, measured by the Standardized Precipitation Index, at several lead times to aid drought planning.
ccfb9195def94bb9afe9036293892047dcc5cfc7.architecture: Feed-forward neural networks applied with recursive multistep and direct multistep forecasting strategies.
ccfb9195def94bb9afe9036293892047dcc5cfc7.data: SPI series from a river basin in India (Kansabati basin); details should be checked.
ccfb9195def94bb9afe9036293892047dcc5cfc7.result: Neural network approaches give useful drought forecasts, with differences between recursive and direct strategies by lead time; numbers not available here.
ccfb9195def94bb9afe9036293892047dcc5cfc7.open_work: Hybrid stochastic–neural models and longer lead times.

2581b3e44592b3b3741474c8d6f483a90c29f139.goal: Shows how physical background knowledge can guide deep learning design for natural processes, using sea surface temperature prediction as example.
2581b3e44592b3b3741474c8d6f483a90c29f139.architecture: Convolutional encoder–decoder network that estimates a motion (flow) field, then warps the current SST field via a scheme derived from the advection–diffusion equation.
2581b3e44592b3b3741474c8d6f483a90c29f139.data: SST fields from NEMO ocean model reanalysis data (Copernicus Marine) over Atlantic regions.
2581b3e44592b3b3741474c8d6f483a90c29f139.result: Outperforms baselines including a state-of-the-art numerical data assimilation-based approach, and is formally linked to solutions of advection–diffusion equations.
2581b3e44592b3b3741474c8d6f483a90c29f139.open_work: Incorporating other physical processes and additional variables.
2581b3e44592b3b3741474c8d6f483a90c29f139.issues: Assumes advection–diffusion dominates; SST-only predictions on model-generated data.

5834dd1c2f49f2d3e3df27786f288fd2138482fc.goal: Downscales general circulation model simulations to basin-scale streamflow to assess climate change impacts on hydrology.
5834dd1c2f49f2d3e3df27786f288fd2138482fc.architecture: Relevance vector machine (sparse Bayesian kernel regression), with PCA and fuzzy clustering of predictors, compared with a support vector machine.
5834dd1c2f49f2d3e3df27786f288fd2138482fc.data: Reanalysis predictors for training and CGCM2 GCM simulations, with observed streamflow of the Mahanadi River, India.
5834dd1c2f49f2d3e3df27786f288fd2138482fc.result: The relevance vector machine performs comparably or better than SVM with fewer relevance vectors and projects decreasing streamflow in the basin.
5834dd1c2f49f2d3e3df27786f288fd2138482fc.issues: Abstract unavailable; single GCM and basin, stationarity assumption of downscaling.

e0194ddb5a18391a67d3a5e2d896552b1791ecc8.goal: Produces in-season soybean yield forecasts in southern Brazil to support markets, policy and food security.
e0194ddb5a18391a67d3a5e2d896552b1791ecc8.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network compared with multivariate OLS linear regression and random forest.
e0194ddb5a18391a67d3a5e2d896552b1791ecc8.data: Satellite NDVI, EVI and land surface temperature plus precipitation, masked with Rural Environment Registry field boundaries, and municipality yield data.
e0194ddb5a18391a67d3a5e2d896552b1791ecc8.result: Municipality-scale MAE of 0.24 Mg/ha at DOY 64; LSTM beats other methods except at DOY 16, where OLS is best; MAE grows to 0.42 Mg/ha for earlier forecasts.
e0194ddb5a18391a67d3a5e2d896552b1791ecc8.open_work: Earlier accurate forecasts and crop-specific masks.
e0194ddb5a18391a67d3a5e2d896552b1791ecc8.issues: Non-crop-specific mask; accuracy degrades early in the season.

70dfd0c4849ad3c4b5e3ed5ec00f5b241db2db7d.goal: Reviews deep learning for mining information from big ocean remote sensing data archives.
70dfd0c4849ad3c4b5e3ed5ec00f5b241db2db7d.architecture: Review of two deep learning frameworks for ocean remote sensing image classification, with eight application examples.
70dfd0c4849ad3c4b5e3ed5ec00f5b241db2db7d.data: Ocean remote sensing imagery of various types (e.g. SAR and optical) for internal waves, eddies, oil spills, coastal inundation, sea ice, green algae, ships and coral reefs.
70dfd0c4849ad3c4b5e3ed5ec00f5b241db2db7d.result: Shows that the deep learning frameworks are effective across the eight applications.
70dfd0c4849ad3c4b5e3ed5ec00f5b241db2db7d.open_work: Adapting the frameworks to other kinds of remote sensing imagery.
70dfd0c4849ad3c4b5e3ed5ec00f5b241db2db7d.issues: Largely showcases the authors' own work; limited quantitative comparison.

f22050cbfdffd85070bf22ce9aab77f129fe2b54.goal: Forecasts half-hourly global solar radiation to support solar energy monitoring and grid integration.
f22050cbfdffd85070bf22ce9aab77f129fe2b54.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network and long short-term memory (CNN-LSTM) model, benchmarked against standalone deep learning, single hidden layer and tree-based models.
f22050cbfdffd85070bf22ce9aab77f129fe2b54.data: Half-hourly global solar radiation at Alice Springs, Australia, 1 January 2006 to 31 August 2018.
f22050cbfdffd85070bf22ce9aab77f129fe2b54.result: Hybrid model outperforms all benchmarks, with over 70% of errors within ±10 W/m2, RRMSE about 1.5% and MAPE about 4.7%.
f22050cbfdffd85070bf22ce9aab77f129fe2b54.open_work: Multi-site testing and integration into real power grid systems.

b1c9f0f96f0c73cc95e1dfeb022bea9321851db7.goal: Simulates lake water temperature profiles by combining physics-based modelling with machine learning to overcome limitations of each.
b1c9f0f96f0c73cc95e1dfeb022bea9321851db7.architecture: Physics-guided recurrent neural network (PGRNN) with LSTM cells, pretrained on General Lake Model outputs and trained with an energy-conservation physics loss.
b1c9f0f96f0c73cc95e1dfeb022bea9321851db7.data: General Lake Model (GLM) simulations and sparse observed temperature profiles from lakes (e.g. Lake Mendota).
b1c9f0f96f0c73cc95e1dfeb022bea9321851db7.result: Improves accuracy over physics-based models by over 20% even with little training data while respecting physical laws.
b1c9f0f96f0c73cc95e1dfeb022bea9321851db7.open_work: Applying to other lakes and other mechanistic models.
b1c9f0f96f0c73cc95e1dfeb022bea9321851db7.issues: Relies on a calibrated physics model for pretraining; few lakes tested.

acb6d219551c4390730a3a80799bff34ab16bbb4.goal: Forecasts monthly runoff with a deep learning model whose parameters are optimized automatically.
acb6d219551c4390730a3a80799bff34ab16bbb4.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network with parameters tuned by the ant lion optimizer (ALO).
acb6d219551c4390730a3a80799bff34ab16bbb4.data: Monthly runoff records; the basin and period are not reported in the available metadata.
acb6d219551c4390730a3a80799bff34ab16bbb4.result: Reports that LSTM-ALO improves monthly runoff forecasting over comparison models; numbers not available here.
acb6d219551c4390730a3a80799bff34ab16bbb4.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-variable monthly series, small data.

1d2e19040a9675ae978d85f09c4aca3ac3a5d2cd.goal: Provides rapid prediction of fluvial flood inundation because 2D hydraulic models are too slow for real-time use.
1d2e19040a9675ae978d85f09c4aca3ac3a5d2cd.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network (CNN) trained to predict water depths, benchmarked against support vector regression.
1d2e19040a9675ae978d85f09c4aca3ac3a5d2cd.data: LISFLOOD-FP 2D hydraulic model outputs for Carlisle, UK, evaluated on the January 2005 and December 2015 floods.
1d2e19040a9675ae978d85f09c4aca3ac3a5d2cd.result: CNN agrees well with LISFLOOD-FP and beats SVR; maximum-depth errors are 0–0.2 m (2005) and 0–0.5 m (2015) at over 99% of cells.
1d2e19040a9675ae978d85f09c4aca3ac3a5d2cd.open_work: Real-time flood forecasting deployment and other sites.
1d2e19040a9675ae978d85f09c4aca3ac3a5d2cd.issues: Trained on and evaluated against its own hydraulic model, inheriting its errors; single town.

f286ffb59d1a88e005cf3b36a79b5a555779e1ad.goal: Reviews deep learning concepts, methods and applications in hydrology and water resources and outlines research directions.
f286ffb59d1a88e005cf3b36a79b5a555779e1ad.architecture: Review of deep learning architectures such as LSTM, CNN, autoencoders and generative models applied to hydrology.
f286ffb59d1a88e005cf3b36a79b5a555779e1ad.data: Covers hydrological studies across streamflow, flood, drought, groundwater and water quality; no new data.
f286ffb59d1a88e005cf3b36a79b5a555779e1ad.result: Summarizes the growth of deep learning in hydrology; detailed findings are not available in the metadata.
f286ffb59d1a88e005cf3b36a79b5a555779e1ad.open_work: Likely directions include physics-informed models, interpretability and uncertainty quantification.
f286ffb59d1a88e005cf3b36a79b5a555779e1ad.issues: Abstract unavailable; content inferred from the title.

fb76df7b3e0fb9353b5d8aabb2a1e1468f6d2878.goal: Forecasts soil moisture several days ahead to support irrigation and water management decisions, using a data-driven alternative to physically based soil water models.
fb76df7b3e0fb9353b5d8aabb2a1e1468f6d2878.architecture: Support vector machine (support vector regression) using lagged soil moisture and meteorological inputs, compared with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) artificial neural network.
fb76df7b3e0fb9353b5d8aabb2a1e1468f6d2878.data: Point soil moisture and meteorological observations from monitoring sites in the western United States; exact sites and record lengths are not given here.
fb76df7b3e0fb9353b5d8aabb2a1e1468f6d2878.result: Support vector machines give soil moisture forecasts a few days ahead that are as good as or better than the neural network benchmark.
fb76df7b3e0fb9353b5d8aabb2a1e1468f6d2878.open_work: Testing other sites, soil types and longer lead times, and adding uncertainty estimates to the forecasts.
fb76df7b3e0fb9353b5d8aabb2a1e1468f6d2878.issues: Point-scale study with limited sites; no abstract available, so details of inputs and skill scores are not verified here.

dd42f6617cae7d4ee89e21e1b4a840da4573e559.goal: Compares statistical downscaling methods for daily and monthly surface temperature and precipitation, to judge whether artificial neural networks beat regression for local climate projections.
dd42f6617cae7d4ee89e21e1b4a840da4573e559.architecture: Multiple linear regression-based downscaling compared with feed-forward artificial neural networks (MLP), using large-scale circulation predictors, partly reduced by principal component analysis.
dd42f6617cae7d4ee89e21e1b4a840da4573e559.data: Large-scale predictors from NCEP/NCAR reanalysis and station observations at a single US site (Indianapolis, Indiana).
dd42f6617cae7d4ee89e21e1b4a840da4573e559.result: Temperature is downscaled with reasonable skill by both approaches, while precipitation is reproduced much less well; neither method clearly dominates for all variables and time scales.
dd42f6617cae7d4ee89e21e1b4a840da4573e559.open_work: Applying the downscaling models to GCM output and testing additional predictors and stations.
dd42f6617cae7d4ee89e21e1b4a840da4573e559.issues: Single-station study; precipitation skill is low; no abstract available, so details rely on recollection and should be checked.

0f44df746ec0939b2f4df0f976f0738d490c1495.goal: Predicts the monthly Effective Drought Index (EDI) in eastern Australia to support drought early warning and water resource planning.
0f44df746ec0939b2f4df0f976f0738d490c1495.architecture: Extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer feed-forward neural network with random input weights), compared with a conventional backpropagation artificial neural network (MLP).
0f44df746ec0939b2f4df0f976f0738d490c1495.data: Monthly hydrometeorological variables (e.g., rainfall, temperature, evaporation) and large-scale climate indices as predictors at stations in eastern Australia; exact stations and periods not given here.
0f44df746ec0939b2f4df0f976f0738d490c1495.result: The extreme learning machine predicts monthly EDI with accuracy better than or comparable to the ANN benchmark while training much faster.
0f44df746ec0939b2f4df0f976f0738d490c1495.open_work: Extending to longer lead times, more regions and hybrid or ensemble models, and quantifying predictive uncertainty.
0f44df746ec0939b2f4df0f976f0738d490c1495.issues: No abstract available; station-based and region-specific; numbers and predictor set are not verified here.

cee75e291d693e3ee4087f1aa74f0f7e223b3b6f.goal: Addresses the instability and error growth of neural PDE surrogates over long autoregressive rollouts, which limits their use for fluid dynamics simulation.
cee75e291d693e3ee4087f1aa74f0f7e223b3b6f.architecture: PDE-Refiner, a diffusion model-inspired multistep refinement method on top of a neural PDE solver (U-Net backbone) that iteratively denoises predictions to capture low-amplitude, high-frequency components.
cee75e291d693e3ee4087f1aa74f0f7e223b3b6f.data: Fluid dynamics benchmarks including the 1D Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation and 2D Kolmogorov flow; compared with neural, numerical and hybrid neural-numerical baselines.
cee75e291d693e3ee4087f1aa74f0f7e223b3b6f.result: Neglect of non-dominant spatial frequencies is identified as the main cause of rollout failure; PDE-Refiner gives longer stable, accurate rollouts than state-of-the-art baselines, better data efficiency, and an uncertainty estimate.
cee75e291d693e3ee4087f1aa74f0f7e223b3b6f.open_work: Scaling to 3D and larger systems such as weather and climate models, and reducing the cost of multiple refinement steps.
cee75e291d693e3ee4087f1aa74f0f7e223b3b6f.issues: Several refinement steps raise inference cost; tests are on idealized PDE benchmarks rather than real geophysical data.

94217b8944b6a373ad019134cc4528db352b3a13.goal: Reviews two decades of neural network rainfall-runoff and streamflow modelling ('river forecasting') to identify emerging themes and outstanding challenges.
94217b8944b6a373ad019134cc4528db352b3a13.architecture: Review of artificial neural network (mostly MLP) river forecasting, covering input selection, physical interpretation, modular designs, ensembles and hybridization with conventional hydrological models.
94217b8944b6a373ad019134cc4528db352b3a13.data: Literature review; no new data. Discusses the need for agreed benchmark data sets for intermodel comparison.
94217b8944b6a373ad019134cc4528db352b3a13.result: The field is established but fragmented; it needs consistent protocols for inputs, interpretation and benchmarking, and confidence intervals before operational use.
94217b8944b6a373ad019134cc4528db352b3a13.open_work: Agreed benchmark data sets, better diagnostics, uncertainty characterization and a coordinated international research effort instead of isolated incremental studies.
94217b8944b6a373ad019134cc4528db352b3a13.issues: Predates the deep learning era (e.g., LSTMs), so recent architectures are not covered; perspective-driven rather than a systematic quantitative review.

7c02adfc0bf7a96641acb744243be42ae5c94200.goal: Improves short-range weather forecasts of surface variables at station locations by learning from historical observations rather than running a full numerical weather prediction model.
7c02adfc0bf7a96641acb744243be42ae5c94200.architecture: Hybrid model combining discriminatively trained per-station predictors with a deep generative component that models joint spatial statistics across stations; the exact network family is not specified here.
7c02adfc0bf7a96641acb744243be42ae5c94200.data: Historical surface weather station observations over the United States (e.g., temperature, pressure, wind); exact network and period not given here.
7c02adfc0bf7a96641acb744243be42ae5c94200.result: The hybrid model improves forecasts over purely discriminative baselines and is reported to be competitive with operational forecasts at short leads.
7c02adfc0bf7a96641acb744243be42ae5c94200.open_work: Adding more variables, longer lead times and integration with NWP output.
7c02adfc0bf7a96641acb744243be42ae5c94200.issues: No abstract available; architecture details and benchmark comparisons rely on recollection and should be checked; station-only data.

99d34850330e7b7c9e2afbf16d06b92ac1226683.goal: Forecasts daily streamflow 1-7 days ahead in a small mountainous watershed to assess whether nonlinear machine learning beats linear regression when using weather and climate inputs.
99d34850330e7b7c9e2afbf16d06b92ac1226683.architecture: Bayesian neural network, support vector regression and Gaussian process regression, compared with multiple linear regression.
99d34850330e7b7c9e2afbf16d06b92ac1226683.data: Local meteorological observations, NWP (NCEP GFS reforecast) outputs and large-scale climate indices as predictors; streamflow in the Stave River basin, British Columbia, Canada.
99d34850330e7b7c9e2afbf16d06b92ac1226683.result: Nonlinear methods generally outperform linear regression at short lead times; GFS outputs help most at short leads and climate indices add some value at longer leads.
99d34850330e7b7c9e2afbf16d06b92ac1226683.open_work: Testing other basins and ensemble NWP inputs, and probabilistic forecasting.
99d34850330e7b7c9e2afbf16d06b92ac1226683.issues: Single basin; skill drops quickly with lead time; numbers not verified here because the abstract is unavailable.

c8f9a5a2f6da022a08b1b0c5b7c4d311fcb1ce34.goal: Forecasts crop yields on the Canadian Prairies before harvest using satellite vegetation indices, to support agricultural planning.
c8f9a5a2f6da022a08b1b0c5b7c4d311fcb1ce34.architecture: Bayesian neural network and model-based recursive partitioning (tree-based), compared with multiple linear regression.
c8f9a5a2f6da022a08b1b0c5b7c4d311fcb1ce34.data: MODIS vegetation indices (NDVI, EVI) and other satellite-derived variables, with census-region yields of barley, canola and spring wheat across the Canadian Prairies.
c8f9a5a2f6da022a08b1b0c5b7c4d311fcb1ce34.result: Nonlinear methods (Bayesian neural network and model-based recursive partitioning) outperform multiple linear regression; vegetation indices provide useful forecasts weeks to months before harvest.
c8f9a5a2f6da022a08b1b0c5b7c4d311fcb1ce34.open_work: Adding weather inputs and testing other crops, regions and earlier forecast dates.
c8f9a5a2f6da022a08b1b0c5b7c4d311fcb1ce34.issues: No abstract available; regional yield statistics only, and numbers are not verified here.

55e2cd86ad4d8d5269dcc68453d34f9f7b727e12.goal: Predicts soybean yields in data-poor developing countries from satellite imagery, as a cheaper and more scalable alternative to ground surveys.
55e2cd86ad4d8d5269dcc68453d34f9f7b727e12.architecture: Deep learning models with transfer learning (pre-training on Argentina, fine-tuning on Brazil); the network family is not specified in the abstract.
55e2cd86ad4d8d5269dcc68453d34f9f7b727e12.data: Remotely sensed satellite imagery with soybean yield data for Argentina (training) and Brazil (transfer target with less data); exact products not reported in the abstract.
55e2cd86ad4d8d5269dcc68453d34f9f7b727e12.result: Deep learning gives promising soybean yield predictions in Argentina, and transfer learning achieves satisfactory results in Brazil with less training data.
55e2cd86ad4d8d5269dcc68453d34f9f7b727e12.open_work: Applying the transfer approach to other crops and countries with scarce ground truth.
55e2cd86ad4d8d5269dcc68453d34f9f7b727e12.issues: Short student/workshop-style paper; quantitative results and baselines are not reported in the abstract.

5d5bbfdd12bf66ce6644e104cbdb5129a0a403c9.goal: Improves streamflow predictions of the physically based WRF-Hydro model, which carry systematic errors, by combining it with deep learning.
5d5bbfdd12bf66ce6644e104cbdb5129a0a403c9.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) networks combined with WRF-Hydro simulations, e.g., to correct or post-process simulated streamflow.
5d5bbfdd12bf66ce6644e104cbdb5129a0a403c9.data: WRF-Hydro simulations and observed streamflow for a study basin; basin and period are not given here.
5d5bbfdd12bf66ce6644e104cbdb5129a0a403c9.result: Combining LSTM with WRF-Hydro improves streamflow prediction relative to WRF-Hydro alone.
5d5bbfdd12bf66ce6644e104cbdb5129a0a403c9.open_work: Testing in more basins and coupling strategies, and adding uncertainty quantification.
5d5bbfdd12bf66ce6644e104cbdb5129a0a403c9.issues: No abstract available; coupling design, basin and skill numbers are not verified here.

e5482f1bd4cc1405f16a9f80028e48d61d191698.goal: Provides probabilistic monthly streamflow forecasts for water resource management, using a nonparametric Bayesian method that yields predictive uncertainty.
e5482f1bd4cc1405f16a9f80028e48d61d191698.architecture: Gaussian process regression, compared with other regression approaches such as linear regression and artificial neural networks.
e5482f1bd4cc1405f16a9f80028e48d61d191698.data: Monthly hydroclimatic predictors and streamflow for US basins (possibly MOPEX catchments); details not given here.
e5482f1bd4cc1405f16a9f80028e48d61d191698.result: Gaussian process regression gives competitive or better monthly forecasts than the benchmarks while also providing uncertainty estimates.
e5482f1bd4cc1405f16a9f80028e48d61d191698.open_work: Testing longer leads, more predictors (e.g., climate indices) and other regions.
e5482f1bd4cc1405f16a9f80028e48d61d191698.issues: No abstract available; data set, baselines and scores are not verified here.

f43507936dd71d7b91e473737de5fbee23c1b5c8.goal: Argues that deep learning can open a complementary route to knowledge discovery in hydrologic science and outlines how the community can foster it.
f43507936dd71d7b91e473737de5fbee23c1b5c8.architecture: Opinion/perspective paper on deep learning in hydrology: competing data-consistent hypotheses from DL, interpretation methods, and integration with process-based models.
f43507936dd71d7b91e473737de5fbee23c1b5c8.data: No new data; discusses data limitations, heterogeneity and the need to share data and baseline models.
f43507936dd71d7b91e473737de5fbee23c1b5c8.result: Hydrology is ripe for DL breakthroughs, but progress needs coordinated community effort, process-DL integration, shared data and baselines, and open competitions.
f43507936dd71d7b91e473737de5fbee23c1b5c8.open_work: Building shared datasets, baseline models and competitions, interpretable DL, and grassroots DL education in hydrology.
f43507936dd71d7b91e473737de5fbee23c1b5c8.issues: Perspective without quantitative evaluation; recommendations are not tested.

184cb4a2b6c21b9b817f5eb42c499d25b985e75f.goal: Assesses long lead-time daily and monthly streamflow forecasting with machine learning for water resources planning, where systematic short- versus long-term comparisons are scarce.
184cb4a2b6c21b9b817f5eb42c499d25b985e75f.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) and long short-term memory (LSTM) network, both run recursively by feeding one-step-ahead forecasts back as inputs.
184cb4a2b6c21b9b817f5eb42c499d25b985e75f.data: Rainfall and runoff data from the Nan and Ping River Basins, Thailand, 1974-2014.
184cb4a2b6c21b9b817f5eb42c499d25b985e75f.result: Both models give accurate daily forecasts up to 20 days ahead; LSTM is better at long-lead daily forecasts but worse for multi-monthly forecasts due to small monthly training sets; time lag and epoch count are key settings.
184cb4a2b6c21b9b817f5eb42c499d25b985e75f.open_work: Larger training sets for monthly forecasting, additional predictors and uncertainty quantification.
184cb4a2b6c21b9b817f5eb42c499d25b985e75f.issues: Recursive forecasting accumulates errors; two basins only; monthly data too short for LSTM; no probabilistic output.

55b81a1ad8f5893606bd97cf5f6664a2f75a0302.goal: Surveys Gaussian processes for Earth observation data analysis, motivated by their accuracy, uncertainty estimates and interpretability for retrieving biophysical parameters.
55b81a1ad8f5893606bd97cf5f6664a2f75a0302.architecture: Review and tutorial of Gaussian process regression for remote sensing, including kernel design, model inversion, emulation of radiative transfer models, and scalable/heteroscedastic variants.
55b81a1ad8f5893606bd97cf5f6664a2f75a0302.data: Illustrative examples on optical and other remote sensing data for biophysical parameter retrieval (e.g., vegetation variables); details not given here.
55b81a1ad8f5893606bd97cf5f6664a2f75a0302.result: Gaussian processes are shown to be accurate and flexible for EO parameter estimation, offering uncertainty and interpretable kernel hyperparameters.
55b81a1ad8f5893606bd97cf5f6664a2f75a0302.open_work: Scaling GPs to big EO data, multi-output and physically consistent GPs, and wider operational use.
55b81a1ad8f5893606bd97cf5f6664a2f75a0302.issues: Survey from 2016; GP computational cost limits large datasets; details not verified because the abstract is unavailable.

06ef256ecd0fa3ce7794f61b5535ac34f7319c5c.goal: Develops seasonal drought prediction models for Pakistan to support early warning for vulnerable communities.
06ef256ecd0fa3ce7794f61b5535ac34f7319c5c.architecture: Support vector machine, artificial neural network (MLP) and k-nearest neighbour models, with recursive feature elimination for predictor selection.
06ef256ecd0fa3ce7794f61b5535ac34f7319c5c.data: SPEI-based moderate, severe and extreme drought for the Rabi and Kharif seasons; predictors from NCEP/NCAR reanalysis.
06ef256ecd0fa3ce7794f61b5535ac34f7319c5c.result: SVM best captures temporal and spatial drought characteristics; KNN performs worst; relative humidity, temperature and wind over the Mediterranean, Caspian, Indian Ocean and Arabian Sea are key predictors.
06ef256ecd0fa3ce7794f61b5535ac34f7319c5c.open_work: Using climate model projections for future drought, and longer lead times.
06ef256ecd0fa3ce7794f61b5535ac34f7319c5c.issues: Trained on reanalysis predictors and inherits its biases; skill numbers not reported in the abstract; limited sample of drought events.

3307c819f60b6fbc0ac04d7ef2510f60a94eee5d.goal: Improves the geoscientific awareness of deep learning by integrating physical models into deep networks for modelling dynamic geophysical processes.
3307c819f60b6fbc0ac04d7ef2510f60a94eee5d.architecture: Physics-aware deep learning in which a conceptual hydrological model is embedded as special recurrent neural network layers within a deep learning architecture (hybrid physics-AI).
3307c819f60b6fbc0ac04d7ef2510f60a94eee5d.data: Runoff modelling across catchments of the conterminous United States; exact dataset not reported in the abstract.
3307c819f60b6fbc0ac04d7ef2510f60a94eee5d.result: The physics-aware model improves runoff prediction accuracy, transfers robustly, and infers unobserved processes better than pure DL.
3307c819f60b6fbc0ac04d7ef2510f60a94eee5d.open_work: Extending the approach to other geoscientific processes and models.
3307c819f60b6fbc0ac04d7ef2510f60a94eee5d.issues: Single application (runoff); specific skill numbers are not reported in the abstract.

afbc78381d62bec1dda243e3c2cd753663ed76a8.goal: Improves machine learning streamflow simulation from meteorological inputs alone, which struggles because of weak, lagged links between streamflow and weather.
afbc78381d62bec1dda243e3c2cd753663ed76a8.architecture: Support vector regression, artificial neural networks (MLP) and random forest coupled with a base flow separation method; both simulation (no antecedent flow) and forecasting (with antecedent flow) schemes.
afbc78381d62bec1dda243e3c2cd753663ed76a8.data: Precipitation, temperature and potential evapotranspiration with streamflow for four rivers in the United States.
afbc78381d62bec1dda243e3c2cd753663ed76a8.result: Base flow separation improves the simulation performance of all three models to a degree; performance depends on model type, input structure and catchment dynamics.
afbc78381d62bec1dda243e3c2cd753663ed76a8.open_work: Testing more catchments and other flow separation or hybrid approaches.
afbc78381d62bec1dda243e3c2cd753663ed76a8.issues: Only four catchments; improvements described as modest; numbers not reported in the abstract.

1b23e8c623713a3afb5f34b1729e4e135c2087d3.goal: Downscales daily precipitation from large-scale circulation for local hydrological impact studies.
1b23e8c623713a3afb5f34b1729e4e135c2087d3.architecture: Support vector machine (classification of wet/dry days and support vector regression of amounts) combined with multivariate analysis for predictor reduction.
1b23e8c623713a3afb5f34b1729e4e135c2087d3.data: Large-scale reanalysis predictors (NCEP/NCAR) and daily station precipitation, likely in Taiwan; details not given here.
1b23e8c623713a3afb5f34b1729e4e135c2087d3.result: The SVM-based approach reproduces daily precipitation statistics better than a multiple linear regression benchmark.
1b23e8c623713a3afb5f34b1729e4e135c2087d3.open_work: Applying the model to GCM scenarios for future precipitation projections.
1b23e8c623713a3afb5f34b1729e4e135c2087d3.issues: No abstract available; study region, predictors and scores are not verified here; extremes likely underestimated, as is typical for regression downscaling.

405c8896eb74a61ce14933e2f836376d209bcc47.goal: Predicts drought spatially while making the model's decisions interpretable, to increase trust in machine learning for drought management.
405c8896eb74a61ce14933e2f836376d209bcc47.architecture: Deep learning model with explainable AI (XAI) attribution, e.g., Shapley-value analysis, applied post hoc; the network family is not specified in the available metadata.
405c8896eb74a61ce14933e2f836376d209bcc47.data: Drought index and hydroclimatic predictors for a study region; data and period are not given here.
405c8896eb74a61ce14933e2f836376d209bcc47.result: The model predicts drought with good accuracy and the XAI analysis identifies the most influential predictors.
405c8896eb74a61ce14933e2f836376d209bcc47.open_work: Applying interpretable drought models to other regions and longer lead times.
405c8896eb74a61ce14933e2f836376d209bcc47.issues: No abstract available; region, architecture and numbers are not verified here.

2e256aad70f17275728565f378823dc28dccff23.goal: Compares a deep learning streamflow forecasting model against conventional machine learning to see whether LSTM gives a real advantage.
2e256aad70f17275728565f378823dc28dccff23.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network compared with conventional machine learning algorithms (specific baselines not given here).
2e256aad70f17275728565f378823dc28dccff23.data: Observed streamflow and hydrometeorological inputs at a study basin; details not given here.
2e256aad70f17275728565f378823dc28dccff23.result: The LSTM-based model outperforms the conventional machine learning algorithms for streamflow forecasting.
2e256aad70f17275728565f378823dc28dccff23.open_work: Testing longer lead times, more basins and uncertainty quantification.
2e256aad70f17275728565f378823dc28dccff23.issues: No abstract available; basin, baselines and skill numbers are not verified here.

d8020d1247699ae7578f2e17fd47771f4c326832.goal: Forecasts weather at thousands of worldwide stations with one unified deep model that captures spatiotemporal correlations among stations and remains interpretable.
d8020d1247699ae7578f2e17fd47771f4c326832.architecture: Corrformer, a transformer with a multi-correlation mechanism that replaces standard attention to model spatial and temporal correlations efficiently.
d8020d1247699ae7578f2e17fd47771f4c326832.data: Global station observations (temperature and wind) from several thousand weather stations (NCEI global surface data); exact counts not verified here.
d8020d1247699ae7578f2e17fd47771f4c326832.result: Corrformer outperforms state-of-the-art deep forecasting models and is reported to be competitive with operational numerical forecasts at the station level, with interpretable correlations.
d8020d1247699ae7578f2e17fd47771f4c326832.open_work: Adding more variables, longer leads and coupling with gridded NWP or reanalysis data.
d8020d1247699ae7578f2e17fd47771f4c326832.issues: No abstract available; station-only data, limited variables; numbers not verified here.

8398013ce2202572851890680f7af918af8a51ad.goal: Tests the common claim that particular machine learning models are superior for hourly solar irradiance forecasting, by comparing many off-the-shelf algorithms fairly.
8398013ce2202572851890680f7af918af8a51ad.architecture: Benchmark of 68 off-the-shelf machine learning algorithms (including tree-based methods such as random forest, neural networks and regression models) auto-tuned with the R caret package; no hybrid models.
8398013ce2202572851890680f7af918af8a51ad.data: Hourly solar irradiance at 7 locations in 5 climate zones of the continental United States (SURFRAD stations), split by 3 sky conditions; two years of evaluation.
8398013ce2202572851890680f7af918af8a51ad.result: Tree-based methods perform consistently well over two-year overall results but rarely stand out in daily evaluation; no universal best model, though preferred models per sky and climate condition are given.
8398013ce2202572851890680f7af918af8a51ad.open_work: Hybrid and ensemble approaches, and model selection strategies that adapt to conditions.
8398013ce2202572851890680f7af918af8a51ad.issues: Off-the-shelf implementations only; US sites only; hourly horizon only.

e9b9b26e1246593fcfdc751c43fd6bc32525a10a.goal: Improves monthly streamflow forecasting by combining a conceptual hydrological model with a data-driven model, to exploit both physical knowledge and statistical learning.
e9b9b26e1246593fcfdc751c43fd6bc32525a10a.architecture: Hybrid in which outputs of a conceptual rainfall-runoff model (GR4J) are used as inputs to a Bayesian artificial neural network (MLP) giving probabilistic forecasts.
e9b9b26e1246593fcfdc751c43fd6bc32525a10a.data: Monthly rainfall, evapotranspiration and streamflow for catchments in Australia; details not given here.
e9b9b26e1246593fcfdc751c43fd6bc32525a10a.result: The hybrid gives better monthly forecasts and uncertainty estimates than either the conceptual model or the Bayesian ANN alone.
e9b9b26e1246593fcfdc751c43fd6bc32525a10a.open_work: Testing in more catchments and with seasonal climate forecasts as inputs.
e9b9b26e1246593fcfdc751c43fd6bc32525a10a.issues: No abstract available; catchments and scores are not verified here.

5d1311d43086a9abc01e3faa94da9f126402079b.goal: Introduces machine learning to hydrologists new to the field, motivated by growing hydrologic data and ML success elsewhere.
5d1311d43086a9abc01e3faa94da9f126402079b.architecture: Review: non-technical overview of common machine learning algorithms and deep learning architectures in historical context, and their hydrologic applications including hybrid process-based modelling.
5d1311d43086a9abc01e3faa94da9f126402079b.result: Summarizes applications in pattern/event detection, approximation of hydrologic variables (e.g., rainfall-runoff), relationship mining, parameterization, surrogate modelling and bias correction.
5d1311d43086a9abc01e3faa94da9f126402079b.open_work: Improving extrapolation robustness, physical interpretability and learning from small samples in hydrology.

bc40984c7ab7b15603f132bd375a956a622d4903.goal: Compares statistical learning with physical modelling for photovoltaic power forecasting at short to day-ahead horizons.
bc40984c7ab7b15603f132bd375a956a622d4903.architecture: Support vector regression compared with a physical modelling approach, with combinations of inputs from measurements, NWP and cloud motion.
bc40984c7ab7b15603f132bd375a956a622d4903.data: PV power measurements, numerical weather prediction forecasts and satellite-based cloud motion vector forecasts for PV systems in Germany; details not given here.
bc40984c7ab7b15603f132bd375a956a622d4903.result: SVR performs well, particularly at short horizons using measurements, and is comparable to the physical approach; combining input sources improves forecasts.
bc40984c7ab7b15603f132bd375a956a622d4903.open_work: Combining statistical and physical approaches and scaling to regional forecasts.
bc40984c7ab7b15603f132bd375a956a622d4903.issues: No abstract available; horizons, sites and error numbers are not verified here.

256b7cc35bc110c3a34c50669c50ccec60474680.goal: Estimates ecosystem evapotranspiration (latent heat flux) while conserving the surface energy budget, to improve generalization of machine learning models.
256b7cc35bc110c3a34c50669c50ccec60474680.architecture: Physics-constrained hybrid model: a neural network (MLP) predicts surface resistance that is fed into the Penman-Monteith equation, compared with a pure ML model.
256b7cc35bc110c3a34c50669c50ccec60474680.data: Eddy covariance flux observations at 82 tower sites (FLUXNET).
256b7cc35bc110c3a34c50669c50ccec60474680.result: The hybrid model matches the pure ML model on mean metrics, conserves the energy balance, and extrapolates much better; vegetation height and soil moisture are main regulators of ET and surface resistance.
256b7cc35bc110c3a34c50669c50ccec60474680.open_work: Extending physics constraints to other fluxes and to global upscaling.
256b7cc35bc110c3a34c50669c50ccec60474680.issues: Site-level evaluation; relies on Penman-Monteith assumptions; energy balance closure issues in eddy covariance data.

4039e8c50d7c1e7e97817548b9aa6dec3fd6a9fd.goal: Statistically downscales precipitation to fine resolution with machine learning to support hydrological applications.
4039e8c50d7c1e7e97817548b9aa6dec3fd6a9fd.architecture: Prec-DWARF: random forest regression relating fine-resolution precipitation to coarse/fine covariates, in a single-RF and a double-RF (two independent random forests) version.
4039e8c50d7c1e7e97817548b9aa6dec3fd6a9fd.data: Hourly gauge-radar precipitation at 0.125 degrees from NLDAS-2, coarsened to 0.25, 0.5 and 1 degree for synthetic experiments.
4039e8c50d7c1e7e97817548b9aa6dec3fd6a9fd.result: Prec-DWARF outperforms bilinear interpolation and reproduces spatial and temporal patterns; the double RF better captures extremes, but spatial and temporal variability are still strongly underestimated.
4039e8c50d7c1e7e97817548b9aa6dec3fd6a9fd.open_work: Better representation of fine-scale variability and extremes, and application to real coarse model output.
4039e8c50d7c1e7e97817548b9aa6dec3fd6a9fd.issues: Single RF underestimates extremes; poor fine-scale structure at 1 degree; synthetic perfect-prognosis setup only.

057a518674aa54cc58cbb2ba545ef3be0ec936f5.goal: Provides fast real-time prediction of maximum water levels during urban flash floods, where physically based models are too slow.
057a518674aa54cc58cbb2ba545ef3be0ec936f5.architecture: Ensemble of artificial neural networks (MLP) whose structure is found with a new growing algorithm.
057a518674aa54cc58cbb2ba545ef3be0ec936f5.data: Synthetic spatially uniform rain events and hydrodynamic model simulations for two real but slightly modified urban catchments with different surface slopes.
057a518674aa54cc58cbb2ba545ef3be0ec936f5.result: The model predicts maximum water levels with convincing accuracy in seconds of computation, suggesting usefulness for real-time forecasting.
057a518674aa54cc58cbb2ba545ef3be0ec936f5.open_work: Testing with spatially variable and real observed rainfall and in operational settings.
057a518674aa54cc58cbb2ba545ef3be0ec936f5.issues: Trained and tested only on synthetic, spatially uniform rain events; modified catchments; no real flood validation.

3ce06754c82a8ee295032e8ed7c90d3c43db17b1.goal: Forecasts sea surface temperature evolution associated with tropical instability waves, as a data-driven alternative to physics-based ocean models.
3ce06754c82a8ee295032e8ed7c90d3c43db17b1.architecture: Deep learning model driven purely by satellite data; the network family is not specified in the abstract.
3ce06754c82a8ee295032e8ed7c90d3c43db17b1.data: Satellite remote sensing sea surface temperature time series of the tropical Pacific; testing period 2010-2019.
3ce06754c82a8ee295032e8ed7c90d3c43db17b1.result: Over the 9-year test period the model accurately and efficiently forecasts the SST field associated with tropical instability waves.
3ce06754c82a8ee295032e8ed7c90d3c43db17b1.open_work: Applying satellite-driven deep learning forecasts to other ocean phenomena and variables.
3ce06754c82a8ee295032e8ed7c90d3c43db17b1.issues: Quantitative skill and lead times are not reported in the abstract; SST only, without subsurface information.

5dc080e8738ea8d00dc918a11319650246b7eba9.goal: Estimates county-level corn yield in the US Corn Belt by fusing heterogeneous phenology, meteorology and remote sensing data, including under extreme weather.
5dc080e8738ea8d00dc918a11319650246b7eba9.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network, compared with LASSO regression and random forest.
5dc080e8738ea8d00dc918a11319650246b7eba9.data: County-level corn yields, crop phenology (growth phases), meteorological indices and satellite remote sensing indices over the US Corn Belt.
5dc080e8738ea8d00dc918a11319650246b7eba9.result: LSTM explains 76% of yield variation versus 39% from meteorological indices alone; in the 2012 drought RMSE is 1.47 Mg/ha versus 1.93 (LASSO) and 2.43 (RF); silking to dough is the most critical period.
5dc080e8738ea8d00dc918a11319650246b7eba9.open_work: Extending to in-season prediction, other crops and global regions.
5dc080e8738ea8d00dc918a11319650246b7eba9.issues: County-level aggregation; end-of-season estimation rather than early forecast; limited number of extreme years.

15de2cb6ab8dd22a1f19139812de503cf2042f9b.goal: Improves assessment of extreme climate event impacts (frost, drought, heat) on wheat yield, which process-based crop models represent poorly.
15de2cb6ab8dd22a1f19139812de503cf2042f9b.architecture: Hybrid model feeding APSIM crop model outputs and growth-stage-specific extreme-event indicators into a random forest; multiple linear regression hybrid used as benchmark.
15de2cb6ab8dd22a1f19139812de503cf2042f9b.data: Observed wheat yields and climate records in the New South Wales wheat belt, south-eastern Australia, plus APSIM simulations; future climate projections for impact assessment.
15de2cb6ab8dd22a1f19139812de503cf2042f9b.result: APSIM+RF explains 81% of observed yield variation, 33% better than APSIM alone and 19% better than APSIM+MLR; APSIM alone may overestimate future yields by 1–10%.
15de2cb6ab8dd22a1f19139812de503cf2042f9b.open_work: Apply the hybrid approach to other regions and crops and to further extreme-event types.
15de2cb6ab8dd22a1f19139812de503cf2042f9b.issues: Regional statistical correction may not transfer outside training conditions; future projections rely on extrapolating learned extreme-event effects.

f629a9be75bc256fb582890538588fe773749da9.goal: Tests whether LSTM rainfall–runoff models work across Great Britain and how they compare with conceptual hydrological models.
f629a9be75bc256fb582890538588fe773749da9.architecture: LSTM and Entity-Aware LSTM (EA-LSTM) recurrent neural networks trained across many catchments, benchmarked against four lumped conceptual models.
f629a9be75bc256fb582890538588fe773749da9.data: Hydro-meteorological forcings and discharge for 669 catchments in Great Britain (CAMELS-GB).
f629a9be75bc256fb582890538588fe773749da9.result: LSTM and EA-LSTM reach median NSE of 0.88 and 0.86, outperforming the conceptual models, with largest gains in north-east Scotland and south-east England.
f629a9be75bc256fb582890538588fe773749da9.open_work: Add inputs describing groundwater, abstractions and percolation; use spatial performance patterns to refine conceptual models.
f629a9be75bc256fb582890538588fe773749da9.issues: South-east England remains hard to model because the LSTMs cannot learn groundwater processes and human abstractions from standard meteorological inputs.

fda0812099547cd3b91031851f644e1929b4b77c.goal: Examines whether claims that machine learning beats numerical solvers for fluid-related PDEs are trustworthy.
fda0812099547cd3b91031851f644e1929b4b77c.architecture: Review and meta-analysis of the ML-for-PDE-solving literature, assessing baseline strength and evidence of reporting and publication biases.
fda0812099547cd3b91031851f644e1929b4b77c.data: 76 articles that use ML to solve fluid-related PDEs and claim to outperform a standard numerical method.
fda0812099547cd3b91031851f644e1929b4b77c.result: 79% (60/76) of articles compare against a weak baseline, and outcome-reporting and publication biases are widespread, making the field overoptimistic.
fda0812099547cd3b91031851f644e1929b4b77c.open_work: Cultural and structural reforms: strong baselines, reporting of negative results and reduced incentives for biased reporting.
fda0812099547cd3b91031851f644e1929b4b77c.issues: Focused on fluid-related PDEs; judgments of baseline weakness involve author criteria and may not cover all applications such as weather emulation.

d53cd4dc81a93f496c92864509de9c9c8ca4513e.goal: Provides a textbook introduction to machine learning methods for environmental scientists, especially in meteorology, oceanography and climate.
d53cd4dc81a93f496c92864509de9c9c8ca4513e.architecture: Textbook review covering multilayer perceptron neural networks, nonlinear PCA and related neural methods, and kernel methods such as support vector machines and Gaussian processes.
d53cd4dc81a93f496c92864509de9c9c8ca4513e.data: Illustrative environmental examples rather than a single dataset; abstract not available.
d53cd4dc81a93f496c92864509de9c9c8ca4513e.result: Not reported in the available metadata; serves as a reference text on neural network and kernel methods in environmental sciences.
d53cd4dc81a93f496c92864509de9c9c8ca4513e.open_work: Predates deep learning; later methods (CNNs, transformers, generative models) are outside its scope.
d53cd4dc81a93f496c92864509de9c9c8ca4513e.issues: Classical shallow methods only; abstract unavailable so contents summarized from knowledge of the book.

0d84d395e8b7c6974cbd36ab5d2d7c2c85afd9dd.goal: Predicts streamflow in ungauged basins, where no discharge records are available to calibrate models, using artificial neural networks.
0d84d395e8b7c6974cbd36ab5d2d7c2c85afd9dd.architecture: Artificial neural networks; the specific network types are not given in the available metadata.
0d84d395e8b7c6974cbd36ab5d2d7c2c85afd9dd.data: Not reported in the available metadata (abstract missing).
0d84d395e8b7c6974cbd36ab5d2d7c2c85afd9dd.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
0d84d395e8b7c6974cbd36ab5d2d7c2c85afd9dd.open_work: Transferability of trained networks to more diverse ungauged basins.
0d84d395e8b7c6974cbd36ab5d2d7c2c85afd9dd.issues: Abstract unavailable; regionalization from limited gauged basins may not generalize across climates and physiography.

ffd42963b10315d79fce48e8aa8e185e9a109152.goal: Upscales evapotranspiration from flux towers to the regional scale, where in situ measurements have limited coverage.
ffd42963b10315d79fce48e8aa8e185e9a109152.architecture: Comparison of five machine learning methods: artificial neural network (MLP-type ANN), Cubist, deep belief network, random forest and support vector machine.
ffd42963b10315d79fce48e8aa8e185e9a109152.data: Eddy covariance ET at 36 flux tower sites (65 site-years) in the Heihe River Basin; regional daily 1 km estimates for 2012–2016.
ffd42963b10315d79fce48e8aa8e185e9a109152.result: ANN, Cubist, RF and SVM perform almost identically and slightly better than the deep belief network; RF has the lowest regional relative uncertainty (three-cornered hat).

f854a6643c93cde78729443c573e48b748ec19ab.goal: Combines process-based hydrologic models with machine learning to reduce structural errors while retaining physical consistency for streamflow simulation.
