ebe35a0df7d4a502673da50bfdf7d094be14ddd9.issues: Single case study; the neural correction depends on the DA results it was trained on; validation details are limited in the abstract.

cd2694144f0ef40ef58c33189b98b254624acb13.goal: Enables reliable probabilistic forecasting with generative neural networks while avoiding unstable adversarial training.
cd2694144f0ef40ef58c33189b98b254624acb13.architecture: Generative neural networks trained by minimizing prequential proper scoring rules (adversarial-free), compared with GAN-based training; spatial scoring rules defined for gridded data.
cd2694144f0ef40ef58c33189b98b254624acb13.data: Two chaotic dynamical models (Lorenz-63 and Lorenz-96) and the WeatherBench global weather benchmark dataset.
cd2694144f0ef40ef58c33189b98b254624acb13.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art adversarial approaches, especially in probabilistic calibration, with less hyperparameter tuning; consistency of the minimizer is proven for dependent data.
cd2694144f0ef40ef58c33189b98b254624acb13.open_work: Scaling to higher-resolution weather data and other scoring rules for spatial fields.
cd2694144f0ef40ef58c33189b98b254624acb13.issues: Coarse-resolution weather benchmark; skill relative to operational ensembles is not established.

dc3e0b8ce89e1b4701b2bee561c38e13abec072e.goal: Emulates data assimilation with deep generative models to fuse multimodal observations without linear-Gaussian assumptions.
dc3e0b8ce89e1b4701b2bee561c38e13abec072e.architecture: SLAMS: score-based latent diffusion model for data assimilation, framing DA as observation-conditioned state generation.
dc3e0b8ce89e1b4701b2bee561c38e13abec072e.data: In-situ weather station data and satellite imagery assimilated to calibrate global vertical temperature profiles; specific products not named in the abstract.
dc3e0b8ce89e1b4701b2bee561c38e13abec072e.result: SLAMS is robust in low-resolution, noisy and sparse data settings in ablations; described as the first deep generative multimodal DA on real-world data.
dc3e0b8ce89e1b4701b2bee561c38e13abec072e.open_work: Coupling with forecast models in cycled assimilation and extension to more variables for Earth system models.
dc3e0b8ce89e1b4701b2bee561c38e13abec072e.issues: Workshop-scale study; comparison against operational DA systems and cycled forecast impact is not reported in the abstract.

1ff80b68db0a1c43d6f33675f4eec985e53cea25.goal: Improves extended-range (1–35 day) probabilistic forecasts of 2 m maximum temperature over East Asia through statistical post-processing.
1ff80b68db0a1c43d6f33675f4eec985e53cea25.architecture: Neural networks (family not specified in the abstract) trained with a CRPS loss and natural gradient boosting (NGBoost), benchmarked against EMOS.
1ff80b68db0a1c43d6f33675f4eec985e53cea25.data: EMC-GEFS reforecasts from the NCEP SubX project over East Asia, lead times 1–35 days.
1ff80b68db0a1c43d6f33675f4eec985e53cea25.result: Both ML methods reduce bias and uncertainty and beat EMOS by about 0.2 CRPS overall, being the best model in more than 90% of the area.
1ff80b68db0a1c43d6f33675f4eec985e53cea25.open_work: Adding more predictors and spatial information and extending to other variables.
1ff80b68db0a1c43d6f33675f4eec985e53cea25.issues: Gains concentrate in lead weeks 1–2; little skill at longer leads; single model ensemble.

2a56648f0befae947902d2df0feee37709726cbb.goal: Enables diffusion and flow-matching models to generate rare and extreme events from heavy-tailed distributions.
2a56648f0befae947902d2df0feee37709726cbb.architecture: Diffusion models and flow matching with multivariate Student-t priors (t-EDM and t-Flow), with tailored perturbation kernel and gamma-divergence-inspired training objective.
2a56648f0befae947902d2df0feee37709726cbb.data: High-resolution weather datasets (HRRR per knowledge; spot-check).
2a56648f0befae947902d2df0feee37709726cbb.result: t-EDM and t-Flow outperform standard Gaussian diffusion models in heavy-tail estimation, with tail heaviness controlled by a single hyperparameter.
2a56648f0befae947902d2df0feee37709726cbb.open_work: Conditional generation for downscaling and forecasting, and tuning tail parameters per variable.
2a56648f0befae947902d2df0feee37709726cbb.issues: Evaluation focuses on marginal tail statistics; physical consistency of generated extremes is not detailed in the abstract.

c7bcac787391efa40e457371b5c51763b8c69396.goal: Investigates how hydrologic regime information can be used to apply LSTM runoff models more effectively.
c7bcac787391efa40e457371b5c51763b8c69396.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) networks trained at local, regime and national levels, benchmarked against the GR4J conceptual model.
c7bcac787391efa40e457371b5c51763b8c69396.data: 361 gauged catchments across France with at least 30 years of data; regime classification from runoff, precipitation and temperature indices.
c7bcac787391efa40e457371b5c51763b8c69396.result: Sensitivity to input sequence length is highest in Uniform and Nival regimes; regime-level training slightly outperforms national training; local tuning of sequence length and hidden size with national training gives the best performance.
c7bcac787391efa40e457371b5c51763b8c69396.open_work: Further use of regime information as static attributes and testing in other regions.
c7bcac787391efa40e457371b5c51763b8c69396.issues: French catchments only; regime classification is one choice of homogeneity measure.

aec62f04f63d83b3125f27ccc96f4782ae6124c9.goal: Explores deep neural networks for flood (stream stage) forecasting at any location to support emergency management.
aec62f04f63d83b3125f27ccc96f4782ae6124c9.architecture: Deep neural networks for time-series forecasting; the specific network family is not specified in the abstract.
aec62f04f63d83b3125f27ccc96f4782ae6124c9.data: A dataset of stream stage observations organised by connectivity of points on river networks; region and period not reported in the abstract.
aec62f04f63d83b3125f27ccc96f4782ae6124c9.result: Neural networks are shown to be helpful for time-series forecasting of flood events and to support existing models through data assimilation; no numbers in the abstract.
aec62f04f63d83b3125f27ccc96f4782ae6124c9.open_work: Extending to network-wide forecasting and coupling with hydrological models.
aec62f04f63d83b3125f27ccc96f4782ae6124c9.issues: Abstract gives no quantitative skill or baselines; generalization to ungauged locations is unclear.

06f0d00d451a2b0297a62c04ddc75926fb94893f.goal: Assesses whether data-driven surrogates of hydrodynamic models for urban pluvial flood water depth transfer to new areas.
06f0d00d451a2b0297a62c04ddc75926fb94893f.architecture: U-Net convolutional neural network (CNN) and random forest (RF), with transfer learning.
06f0d00d451a2b0297a62c04ddc75926fb94893f.data: Three study areas in Berlin, Germany, for training, validation and testing; target water depths from hydrodynamic simulations.
06f0d00d451a2b0297a62c04ddc75926fb94893f.result: RF outperforms CNN inside the training domain (likely overfitting), while CNN generalizes better beyond it and benefits more from transfer learning.
06f0d00d451a2b0297a62c04ddc75926fb94893f.open_work: Testing in other cities and with more rainfall events.
06f0d00d451a2b0297a62c04ddc75926fb94893f.issues: Limited to Berlin; surrogate accuracy is bounded by the hydrodynamic model used for training.

217d365c88620dfbff666e151260e622a6229d36.goal: Examines how explainable AI is used in hydrology and water resources and argues for its responsible use, as the title implies.
217d365c88620dfbff666e151260e622a6229d36.architecture: Review/perspective on explainable AI (XAI) methods in hydrology and water resources; not a new model.
217d365c88620dfbff666e151260e622a6229d36.data: Not reported (no abstract available); a review of the literature is implied.
217d365c88620dfbff666e151260e622a6229d36.result: Not reported (no abstract available); the title suggests that XAI outputs are often over-interpreted as explanations.
217d365c88620dfbff666e151260e622a6229d36.open_work: Guidelines for interpreting XAI outputs and linking them to physical process understanding.
217d365c88620dfbff666e151260e622a6229d36.issues: Content inferred from the title only; specific recommendations unknown.

5ddf3838d170bda24b13b7f2095e58f009df04ee.goal: Tests whether neural networks can learn chaotic dynamics from incomplete training data and learn the effect of external forcing, as relevant to climate.
5ddf3838d170bda24b13b7f2095e58f009df04ee.architecture: Feed-forward neural networks (MLP-type) trained as one-step forecast models.
5ddf3838d170bda24b13b7f2095e58f009df04ee.data: Lorenz-63 and Lorenz-95 (Lorenz-96) systems, with parts of phase space or forcing ranges withheld.
5ddf3838d170bda24b13b7f2095e58f009df04ee.result: For Lorenz-63, networks fail in excluded phase-space regions because they learn localized mappings; for Lorenz-95 they generalize. Forcing influence is learned only with wide training ranges.
5ddf3838d170bda24b13b7f2095e58f009df04ee.open_work: Designing appropriate train-test splits for real-world, non-stationary applications.
5ddf3838d170bda24b13b7f2095e58f009df04ee.issues: Idealized low-dimensional systems; only feed-forward networks tested.

a2376e16555a6de9f9e8f8807577f6f342ab045b.goal: Provides probabilistic ENSO forecasts with direct estimates of predictive uncertainty from statistical models.
a2376e16555a6de9f9e8f8807577f6f342ab045b.architecture: Ensembles of Gaussian density neural networks and quantile regression neural networks; layer type not specified in the abstract.
a2376e16555a6de9f9e8f8807577f6f342ab045b.data: ENSO indices and predictors over 1963–2017 for evaluation; specific datasets not reported in the abstract.
a2376e16555a6de9f9e8f8807577f6f342ab045b.result: Mean/median forecasts reach correlation of 0.5 at 12-month lead (1963–2017); Gaussian density networks estimate uncertainty better than a standard method over 1982–2017.
a2376e16555a6de9f9e8f8807577f6f342ab045b.open_work: Combining with dynamical models and reducing the spring predictability barrier.
a2376e16555a6de9f9e8f8807577f6f342ab045b.issues: Short observational record limits training; skill at long leads remains modest.

ca05ef59d2e4994fff286811578e4e4766a67230.goal: Develops a temporal convolutional network for long-term streamflow projection in California under climate change.
ca05ef59d2e4994fff286811578e4e4766a67230.architecture: Temporal convolutional neural network (TCNN) with causal convolution blocks, compared with other machine learning models.
ca05ef59d2e4994fff286811578e4e4766a67230.data: CAMELS watersheds in California for training; LOCA downscaled climate projections for future streamflow.
ca05ef59d2e4994fff286811578e4e4766a67230.result: TCNN captures physically plausible input–streamflow relationships, remains stable under an idealized extreme test (4x precipitation, +5 °C), and produces future projections.
ca05ef59d2e4994fff286811578e4e4766a67230.open_work: Further evaluation of extrapolation under climate change and comparison with process-based projections.
ca05ef59d2e4994fff286811578e4e4766a67230.issues: Extrapolation beyond observed climate is inherently uncertain; inherits biases of the LOCA forcing.

c8c779a91f1c453a63bf9e4fc7c626fcfc63dd97.goal: Emulates physics-based inundation models for fast spatio-temporal flood prediction.
c8c779a91f1c453a63bf9e4fc7c626fcfc63dd97.architecture: FloodGNN-GRU: graph neural network (GNN) combined with gated recurrent unit (GRU), with velocities as vector features.
c8c779a91f1c453a63bf9e4fc7c626fcfc63dd97.data: LISFLOOD-FP simulation of Hurricane Harvey (2017) in Houston, Texas.
c8c779a91f1c453a63bf9e4fc7c626fcfc63dd97.result: Outperforms data-driven alternatives on several metrics; trains 100x faster and tests 1000x faster than a comparable simulation.
c8c779a91f1c453a63bf9e4fc7c626fcfc63dd97.open_work: Generalizing to other events and domains and longer lead times.
c8c779a91f1c453a63bf9e4fc7c626fcfc63dd97.issues: Single simulated event; skill degrades for longer predictions; trained on model output, not observations.

54b7d9c300aabb962df6216d2d4d4bdb726fd2ce.goal: Emulates and interprets high-dimensional climate model outputs to make expensive simulations tractable for analysis, as the title implies.
54b7d9c300aabb962df6216d2d4d4bdb726fd2ce.architecture: Statistical emulator for high-dimensional climate model output; the specific method is not stated here (no abstract available).
54b7d9c300aabb962df6216d2d4d4bdb726fd2ce.data: Not reported (no abstract available); climate model ensemble output is implied.
54b7d9c300aabb962df6216d2d4d4bdb726fd2ce.open_work: Not reported; extension to more complex models would follow naturally.

ce4d0a63a415a9e6a0e2275fc8f6a4b75f6408b4.goal: Produces probabilistic weather forecasts by predicting full probability density functions with neural networks.
ce4d0a63a415a9e6a0e2275fc8f6a4b75f6408b4.architecture: Neural networks predicting discretized probability distributions at each grid point, combined through a stacked neural network; base network family not specified in the abstract.
ce4d0a63a415a9e6a0e2275fc8f6a4b75f6408b4.data: WeatherBench (processed ERA5) for 3- and 5-day forecasts of geopotential and temperature.
ce4d0a63a415a9e6a0e2275fc8f6a4b75f6408b4.result: More accurate than some coarse NWP models and as accurate as more complex neural networks, while providing probabilistic information.
ce4d0a63a415a9e6a0e2275fc8f6a4b75f6408b4.open_work: Extending to more variables, leads and higher resolution.
ce4d0a63a415a9e6a0e2275fc8f6a4b75f6408b4.issues: Coarse WeatherBench resolution; calibration and comparison with operational ensembles limited.

f43952aaa7c1c4678beb576685169284f24821d4.goal: Assesses training frameworks for deep learning emulators of regional climate models to replace costly dynamical downscaling.
f43952aaa7c1c4678beb576685169284f24821d4.architecture: Deep learning RCM-emulator (network family not specified in the abstract) trained in perfect and imperfect model frameworks.
f43952aaa7c1c4678beb576685169284f24821d4.data: RCM and GCM simulations of surface mass balance over the Antarctic Peninsula; products not named in the abstract.
f43952aaa7c1c4678beb576685169284f24821d4.result: The perfect-framework emulator conserves RCM–GCM inconsistencies and underestimates SMB on GCM data; the imperfect-framework emulator predicts SMB close to the truth, with large computational gain.
f43952aaa7c1c4678beb576685169284f24821d4.open_work: Applying emulators to future scenarios and other GCMs and variables.
f43952aaa7c1c4678beb576685169284f24821d4.issues: Single region and variable; imperfect framework is tied to the specific GCM–RCM pair.

95450dc143f5cbe46b8b5a82ab3dbe5e908a08a1.goal: Downscales daily precipitation as an RCM emulator capturing extremes, which deterministic downscaling smooths.
95450dc143f5cbe46b8b5a82ab3dbe5e908a08a1.architecture: Conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) generating residuals on top of a deterministic deep learning prediction, with an intensity constraint in the loss.
95450dc143f5cbe46b8b5a82ab3dbe5e908a08a1.data: Regional climate model simulations of daily precipitation; region and products not named in the abstract.
95450dc143f5cbe46b8b5a82ab3dbe5e908a08a1.result: cGAN skill is highly sensitive to the adversarial loss weight, but the intensity constraint gives reliable results over two orders of magnitude; cGANs better capture climatological statistics and extremes.
95450dc143f5cbe46b8b5a82ab3dbe5e908a08a1.open_work: Transfer to other applications and future periods as a weather generator.
95450dc143f5cbe46b8b5a82ab3dbe5e908a08a1.issues: GAN training sensitivity; tested in a single emulation setting.

0edcd57b44d6c191b8224df583ca5d6b34981ec7.goal: Learns a generic parameterization of diapycnal mixing efficiency instead of the fixed 20% assumption in ocean models.
0edcd57b44d6c191b8224df583ca5d6b34981ec7.architecture: Deep neural network; the specific network family is not specified in the abstract.
0edcd57b44d6c191b8224df583ca5d6b34981ec7.data: Direct numerical simulation (DNS) of stratified shear flows with Kelvin–Helmholtz and Holmboe wave instabilities.
0edcd57b44d6c191b8224df583ca5d6b34981ec7.result: The network predicts mixing efficiency in unseen parameter regions well beyond training, and transfers from weakly to strongly stratified Holmboe cases; more universal than published parameterizations.
0edcd57b44d6c191b8224df583ca5d6b34981ec7.open_work: Implementing the parameterization in ocean models and testing with observations.
0edcd57b44d6c191b8224df583ca5d6b34981ec7.issues: Idealized DNS flows; no online ocean-model evaluation.

7e4a3115d26482b2d1fc75116b8e61a93e30c736.goal: Builds physically sound data-driven representations of geophysical dynamical systems for identification and forecasting.
7e4a3115d26482b2d1fc75116b8e61a93e30c736.architecture: Residual neural network (ResNet) inspired by Runge–Kutta schemes with bilinear layers.
7e4a3115d26482b2d1fc75116b8e61a93e30c736.data: Synthetic dynamical systems and a real geophysical dataset; specifics not reported in the abstract.
7e4a3115d26482b2d1fc75116b8e61a93e30c736.result: The architecture is relevant for both forecasting performance and model identification; no numbers in the abstract.
7e4a3115d26482b2d1fc75116b8e61a93e30c736.open_work: Scaling to high-dimensional systems and noisy, partial observations.
7e4a3115d26482b2d1fc75116b8e61a93e30c736.issues: Small numerical experiments; real-data evaluation limited.

cf3744e45be35294319563f182985a269e7dc44c.goal: Discovers dynamical system equations from time-averaged statistics when time derivatives are unavailable.
cf3744e45be35294319563f182985a269e7dc44c.architecture: Non-neural method: sparse learning via ensemble Kalman inversion (EKI) with sparsity constraints.
cf3744e45be35294319563f182985a269e7dc44c.data: Noisy Lorenz-63, Lorenz-96, coalescence equations and Kuramoto–Sivashinsky equation.
cf3744e45be35294319563f182985a269e7dc44c.result: Time-averaged statistics suffice to recover differential equations with sparse EKI.
cf3744e45be35294319563f182985a269e7dc44c.open_work: Application to climate model calibration and more complex systems.
cf3744e45be35294319563f182985a269e7dc44c.issues: Test problems are idealized; depends on a suitable candidate function library.

67a1c508b49cdac007de7ade318d6b6ed5ab8058.goal: Post-processes ensemble forecasts multivariately while modelling dependencies and including extra predictors.
67a1c508b49cdac007de7ade318d6b6ed5ab8058.architecture: Generative neural network producing samples of the multivariate forecast distribution, trained by minimizing a proper scoring rule (nonparametric distributional regression).
67a1c508b49cdac007de7ade318d6b6ed5ab8058.data: Ensemble forecasts and station observations of temperature and wind speed over Germany (ECMWF ensemble per knowledge; spot-check).
67a1c508b49cdac007de7ade318d6b6ed5ab8058.result: Significant improvements over state-of-the-art copula-based methods, particularly for spatial dependencies.

2ac84fdc860f58f8e1c521b51f7d70b799be872f.goal: Improves ENSO amplitude and type forecasts with limited training data.
2ac84fdc860f58f8e1c521b51f7d70b799be872f.architecture: Deep residual convolutional neural network (ResNet CNN) with dropout and homogeneous and heterogeneous transfer learning.
2ac84fdc860f58f8e1c521b51f7d70b799be872f.data: Evaluation 1984–2017; training datasets not named in the abstract.
2ac84fdc860f58f8e1c521b51f7d70b799be872f.result: Predicts Niño3.4 up to 20 months ahead, three more than the previous best; ONI up to 18 months; 83.3% accuracy for 12-month El Niño type.
2ac84fdc860f58f8e1c521b51f7d70b799be872f.open_work: Further improvement of ENSO diversity and probabilistic forecasts.
2ac84fdc860f58f8e1c521b51f7d70b799be872f.issues: Short observational record; small evaluation sample for El Niño type.

e61f99b7fdc5ca74765d0e3cb75c5ce822704fd0.goal: Builds an end-to-end data-driven forecast system trained and initialised directly from observations without reanalysis.
e61f99b7fdc5ca74765d0e3cb75c5ce822704fd0.architecture: GraphDOP: graph neural network learning a latent Earth system state from observations.
e61f99b7fdc5ca74765d0e3cb75c5ce822704fd0.data: Earth system observations such as satellite brightness temperatures from polar-orbiting and geostationary satellites and conventional observations; periods not reported in the abstract.
e61f99b7fdc5ca74765d0e3cb75c5ce822704fd0.result: Produces skilful predictions of relevant weather parameters up to five days ahead.
e61f99b7fdc5ca74765d0e3cb75c5ce822704fd0.open_work: Extending lead time and adding observation types.
e61f99b7fdc5ca74765d0e3cb75c5ce822704fd0.issues: Early-stage system with forecasts limited to five days; quantitative comparison with reanalysis-based models and NWP is not given in the abstract.

a13dde347fd42a6a13e2577559a13d3a92aef30d.goal: Predicts streamflow in a snow-dominated mountainous karst watershed, where physically based and conceptual models struggle with complex terrain, snowmelt and matrix-conduit flow duality.
a13dde347fd42a6a13e2577559a13d3a92aef30d.architecture: Hybrid model coupling a physically based, spatially distributed snow model with a ConvLSTM (convolutional long short-term memory) deep learning model that maps spatiotemporal recharge to outlet streamflow.
a13dde347fd42a6a13e2577559a13d3a92aef30d.data: Meteorological forcing and simulated snowmelt for a single watershed in northern Utah with seasonal snow and variably karstified carbonate bedrock; observed outlet streamflow. Exact periods not reported in the abstract.
a13dde347fd42a6a13e2577559a13d3a92aef30d.result: The hybrid ConvLSTM simulates outlet streamflow with high accuracy and outperforms reference models; learned spatial recharge and discharge patterns are consistent with known hydrogeology.
a13dde347fd42a6a13e2577559a13d3a92aef30d.open_work: Test transferability to other karst watersheds and extend interpretation of learned recharge and storage patterns.
a13dde347fd42a6a13e2577559a13d3a92aef30d.issues: Single-watershed study, so generalization is unproven; skill metrics are not quantified in the abstract and snow-model errors propagate into the deep learning component.

40f176e94b9002c32aee5cdb581765830a96a362.goal: Discusses how explainable AI can help meteorology and climate science fine-tune neural networks, calibrate trust in their predictions and extract new physical insight.
40f176e94b9002c32aee5cdb581765830a96a362.architecture: Review and perspective on post hoc explainable AI (attribution) methods applied to neural networks for weather and climate problems; specific network families are not specified in the available metadata.
40f176e94b9002c32aee5cdb581765830a96a362.data: Abstract not available; the work presumably illustrates methods on climate datasets, but the data used are not reported in the metadata.
40f176e94b9002c32aee5cdb581765830a96a362.result: Argues that XAI can reveal whether networks learn physically sensible strategies, help diagnose and fine-tune models, and occasionally reveal new science. No quantitative results available.
40f176e94b9002c32aee5cdb581765830a96a362.open_work: Develop benchmark tests to evaluate the fidelity of XAI methods and guidance on choosing among them for geoscience applications.
40f176e94b9002c32aee5cdb581765830a96a362.issues: Abstract missing; attribution methods can disagree and their fidelity is hard to verify without ground truth.

41408251101074311d085e6884c175e652fd6392.goal: Book chapter presenting neural networks as emulators of complex multidimensional mappings, such as physical parameterizations and retrieval algorithms, in Earth system science.
41408251101074311d085e6884c175e652fd6392.architecture: Review of neural network emulation techniques, chiefly shallow MLP (multilayer perceptron) emulators of model parameterizations and transfer functions; not a single new model.
41408251101074311d085e6884c175e652fd6392.data: Abstract not available; likely draws on examples from atmospheric and ocean models and satellite retrievals, but specific datasets are not reported in the metadata.
41408251101074311d085e6884c175e652fd6392.result: Not reported in the abstract; presents NN emulations as fast and accurate replacements for costly components of numerical environmental models.
41408251101074311d085e6884c175e652fd6392.open_work: Robustness of emulators outside the training domain and their long-term stability when coupled into models.
41408251101074311d085e6884c175e652fd6392.issues: Abstract missing; content summarized from the title and the author's known research line, so details are uncertain.

44c74b5a8dab90153dd81394d43a9de718478dbd.goal: Detects, segments and tracks extreme climate events such as tropical cyclones and atmospheric rivers in large climate datasets to support automated analysis of extremes.
44c74b5a8dab90153dd81394d43a9de718478dbd.architecture: Deep convolutional neural networks for semantic segmentation of extreme events, combined with a tracking step across time; the exact network design is not specified in the available metadata.
44c74b5a8dab90153dd81394d43a9de718478dbd.data: Abstract not available; presumably climate model simulation output with event labels from heuristic detection algorithms, but the dataset is not reported in the metadata.
44c74b5a8dab90153dd81394d43a9de718478dbd.open_work: Improve labels beyond heuristic detectors and evaluate tracking consistency across models and climates.
44c74b5a8dab90153dd81394d43a9de718478dbd.issues: Abstract missing; labels derived from heuristic algorithms would limit the network to reproducing those definitions.

0abe4b88574814440e93d183f8a7903144bbec52.goal: Fits stochastic differential equation (SDE) closure models to data, avoiding short-timescale inconsistencies between SDEs and data that break standard parameter estimation.
0abe4b88574814440e93d183f8a7903144bbec52.architecture: Ensemble Kalman inversion solving an inverse problem on time-averaged sufficient statistics, with non-parametric drift and diffusion learned via hierarchical refinable parameterizations using Gaussian process regression.
0abe4b88574814440e93d183f8a7903144bbec52.data: Synthetic data from a noisy Lorenz-63 model, deterministic chaotic systems from atmospheric science (dimension reduction), large-scale climate pattern modeling, and molecular dynamics observables.
0abe4b88574814440e93d183f8a7903144bbec52.result: The methodology robustly and systematically fits SDE models to data across all test problems, without requiring trajectory matching.
0abe4b88574814440e93d183f8a7903144bbec52.open_work: Scale the approach to higher-dimensional closures and apply it to closures within comprehensive climate models.
0abe4b88574814440e93d183f8a7903144bbec52.issues: Demonstrated on low-dimensional or simplified systems; relies on time averages being sufficient statistics and on many forward model runs.

17d6a2607529fc1eff36d1d5a6cd0588414748f3.goal: Forecasts Arctic sea ice at weather to sub-seasonal time scales cheaply, as numerical models are expensive and need consistent near-real-time inputs.
17d6a2607529fc1eff36d1d5a6cd0588414748f3.architecture: ConvLSTM (convolutional long short-term memory) network using spatial and temporal covariances between multiple climate fields to predict regional sea ice concentration.
17d6a2607529fc1eff36d1d5a6cd0588414748f3.data: Reanalysis input fields (product not named in the abstract) for the Barents Sea, with sensitivity tests on different climate predictors including surface energy budget components.
17d6a2607529fc1eff36d1d5a6cd0588414748f3.result: Forecasts sea ice concentration skillfully at weekly to monthly leads and generally outperforms climatology, persistence and a statistical model; surface energy budget terms strongly affect weather-scale predictability.
17d6a2607529fc1eff36d1d5a6cd0588414748f3.open_work: Move toward operational Arctic sea ice forecasting and extend beyond the Barents Sea.
17d6a2607529fc1eff36d1d5a6cd0588414748f3.issues: Regional study trained on reanalysis, inheriting its biases; skill numbers not given in the abstract and no probabilistic output.

2f4a99d7db49be030fe3e6afee26eebf66d663d3.goal: Brings machine learning ensemble post-processing into operational use at a national weather service to correct biased, underdispersed ensemble forecasts.
2f4a99d7db49be030fe3e6afee26eebf66d663d3.architecture: Quantile regression forests (random forest variant), including a forecast-anomaly-based QRF for temperature, combined with ensemble copula coupling (ECC) and a rainfall-specific ECC variant.
2f4a99d7db49be030fe3e6afee26eebf66d663d3.data: Météo-France ensemble systems: station-based surface temperature from a medium-resolution ensemble interpolated to a grid, and gridded hourly rainfall from a high-resolution ensemble prediction system.
2f4a99d7db49be030fe3e6afee26eebf66d663d3.result: Both forecast quality and forecast value improve over the raw ensemble; model size and computation time are discussed for operational feasibility.
2f4a99d7db49be030fe3e6afee26eebf66d663d3.open_work: Extend calibrated post-processing to more variables and improve multivariate and spatial coherence of calibrated outputs.
2f4a99d7db49be030fe3e6afee26eebf66d663d3.issues: Detailed skill numbers not in the abstract; QRF cannot extrapolate beyond observed values, which matters for record extremes.

0d3144f66a4770d0d91d0ac218c463838c00c3a2.goal: Assesses how robust process-based and data-driven rainfall-runoff models are when applied under climate conditions different from their calibration period.
0d3144f66a4770d0d91d0ac218c463838c00c3a2.architecture: Comparison of the ECMWF physically based land surface model, the conceptual Simple Water Balance Model and an LSTM (long short-term memory) runoff model, using differential split-sample tests.
0d3144f66a4770d0d91d0ac218c463838c00c3a2.data: Streamflow from 161 European catchments, with calibration in a reference period (e.g., wet years) and evaluation in a climatically contrasting period (e.g., dry years).
0d3144f66a4770d0d91d0ac218c463838c00c3a2.result: All models lose performance as conditions depart from the reference climate; the physically based model is the most robust, while the LSTM shows relatively low robustness in this setup.
0d3144f66a4770d0d91d0ac218c463838c00c3a2.open_work: Train data-driven models on diverse spatial and temporal variability to improve robustness, and improve physics-based parameterizations.
0d3144f66a4770d0d91d0ac218c463838c00c3a2.issues: The split-sample setup restricts LSTM training data, which disadvantages data-driven models; the authors note results may not generalize.

ea2c55e2573d9f6b9cda366a376a105faa17468a.goal: Tests deep learning as an alternative to numerical weather models for short-term daily precipitation prediction over the contiguous United States.
ea2c55e2573d9f6b9cda366a376a105faa17468a.architecture: 3D convolutional neural network (CNN) that maps a single frame of meteorological fields to the spatial distribution of daily precipitation.
ea2c55e2573d9f6b9cda366a376a105faa17468a.data: 39 years (1980–2018) of meteorological fields and daily precipitation over the contiguous US; specific products not named in the abstract.
ea2c55e2573d9f6b9cda366a376a105faa17468a.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art weather models for daily total precipitation up to 5-day leads; blending with NWP forecasts improves accuracy, especially for heavy precipitation, and millisecond inference enables large ensembles.
ea2c55e2573d9f6b9cda366a376a105faa17468a.open_work: Exploit cheap inference for large ensembles and integrate the network with operational NWP forecasting.
ea2c55e2573d9f6b9cda366a376a105faa17468a.issues: Skill at longer leads depends on input fields from forecasts; quantitative metrics and verification details are not given in the abstract.

8addf1765428f8f42467aded2b5d0c2bce52fbdf.goal: Reviews machine learning surrogate modeling at the intersection of geoscience dynamical systems, data assimilation and model error correction.
8addf1765428f8f42467aded2b5d0c2bce52fbdf.architecture: Review and perspective on neural network surrogate dynamics combined with data assimilation, covering subgrid parameterization, model error correction, model discovery and surrogate modeling.
8addf1765428f8f42467aded2b5d0c2bce52fbdf.data: Not applicable; perspective article surveying the literature, including low-order chaotic models and high-dimensional geophysical systems.
8addf1765428f8f42467aded2b5d0c2bce52fbdf.result: Identifies technical obstacles to deploying combined ML and data assimilation in high-dimensional operational systems and highlights advances in physical model error correction.
8addf1765428f8f42467aded2b5d0c2bce52fbdf.open_work: Short- versus long-term fidelity of surrogate dynamics, combined DA-ML methodology, and uncertainty quantification.
8addf1765428f8f42467aded2b5d0c2bce52fbdf.issues: Perspective rather than new results; reflects the author's own view of the field.

b6dd254ddf2b7b21f1665073ebc5556892a44f3f.goal: Improves and benchmarks seasonal forecasts, where large GCM ensembles are costly and limited observations hinder verification and diagnosis.
b6dd254ddf2b7b21f1665073ebc5556892a44f3f.architecture: Conditional Generative Forecasting (CGF): a probabilistic deep learning generative model that explicitly models internal variability and GCM formulation differences; the exact network family is not specified in the abstract.
b6dd254ddf2b7b21f1665073ebc5556892a44f3f.data: 52,201 years of climate model simulations (GCM output) for training; applied to real-world global seasonal forecasts of precipitation and 2 m air temperature.
b6dd254ddf2b7b21f1665073ebc5556892a44f3f.result: CGF faithfully represents GCM-encoded seasonal predictability and achieves performance competitive with dynamical forecasts; it reveals that insufficient ensemble spread sampling limits a dynamical system's skill.
b6dd254ddf2b7b21f1665073ebc5556892a44f3f.open_work: Combine multiple GCMs in CGF-based ensemble strategies to exploit their complementary strengths.
b6dd254ddf2b7b21f1665073ebc5556892a44f3f.issues: Learned relationships inherit GCM biases; skill in observation space is only competitive with, not clearly better than, dynamical forecasts.

bfdef46944bf2786a1dac74a5c0f827ffae89aef.goal: Argues that adoption of machine learning in Earth and environmental science needs reforms in education and research policy.
bfdef46944bf2786a1dac74a5c0f827ffae89aef.architecture: Commentary on training, curricula and research policy for machine learning in the geosciences; no model is proposed.
bfdef46944bf2786a1dac74a5c0f827ffae89aef.result: Not reported in the abstract; calls for reforms so that Earth scientists gain ML skills and collaborations are supported.
bfdef46944bf2786a1dac74a5c0f827ffae89aef.open_work: Concrete curriculum design and funding and incentive structures for interdisciplinary ML research.
bfdef46944bf2786a1dac74a5c0f827ffae89aef.issues: Abstract missing; position piece without empirical evaluation.

98e48a012728bae83ab4559dd4342eb6c4dbf05f.goal: Reduces the computational cost of 3D-Variational data assimilation without sacrificing accuracy.
98e48a012728bae83ab4559dd4342eb6c4dbf05f.architecture: Bi-Reduced Space 3D-Var using attention-based convolutional autoencoders to reduce both the state and the background covariance representation; proven equivalent to previous solutions.
98e48a012728bae83ab4559dd4342eb6c4dbf05f.data: Air pollution model of a site at Elephant and Castle, London, UK.
98e48a012728bae83ab4559dd4342eb6c4dbf05f.result: Reduces the background covariance matrix representation by about O(10^3) and increases assimilation accuracy relative to existing reduced-space methods.
98e48a012728bae83ab4559dd4342eb6c4dbf05f.open_work: Apply the approach to larger geophysical assimilation systems such as weather or ocean models.
98e48a012728bae83ab4559dd4342eb6c4dbf05f.issues: Tested on a single urban pollution application; generality to atmospheric or oceanic DA is not shown.

87554dc16354a40a846bc8f5f25df5645a018a6e.goal: Develops a nonlinear reduced-order model for climate predictability studies as an alternative to linear inverse modeling (LIM).
87554dc16354a40a846bc8f5f25df5645a018a6e.architecture: Reservoir computing (echo state network-type recurrent network) operating on retained EOF coefficients, compared with LIM.
87554dc16354a40a846bc8f5f25df5645a018a6e.data: Preindustrial control simulation of the Community Earth System Model (CESM), North Atlantic sea surface temperature; Lorenz-63 system for emulator tests.
87554dc16354a40a846bc8f5f25df5645a018a6e.result: Reservoir computing improves predictive skill over LIM across many settings, including more retained EOFs and limited-data regimes; climate emulation beyond the predictable horizon is shown only for Lorenz-63.
87554dc16354a40a846bc8f5f25df5645a018a6e.open_work: Develop reservoir computing into climate emulators for realistic predictability studies.
87554dc16354a40a846bc8f5f25df5645a018a6e.issues: Evaluated on model output rather than observations; emulator capability not demonstrated for the realistic climate case.

61e01ac6f143e35a624ac964457702551435ad5e.goal: Tests whether LSTM streamflow models trained with global datasets can support prediction in ungauged basins worldwide.
61e01ac6f143e35a624ac964457702551435ad5e.architecture: LSTM (long short-term memory) rainfall-runoff models, comparing global versus local forcing and catchment attributes.
61e01ac6f143e35a624ac964457702551435ad5e.data: Over 500 CAMELS-US catchments, ERA5 meteorological forcing and global catchment characteristics from the HydroMT tool, compared with local CAMELS forcing and attributes.
61e01ac6f143e35a624ac964457702551435ad5e.result: Local forcing gives better overall median daily NSE (0.71 vs 0.54), but ERA5 yields higher NSE in Western and North-Western US (0.83 vs 0.78); global attribute sources do not change performance.
61e01ac6f143e35a624ac964457702551435ad5e.open_work: Train with streamflow from other world regions and with higher-quality global meteorological forcing.
61e01ac6f143e35a624ac964457702551435ad5e.issues: Evaluated only in the US; ERA5 precipitation biases degrade performance in many regions.

b8dbfe061588dd3f374c75f06a9c0f4cbed10032.goal: Learns NWP precipitation parameterizations from basic model fields as a data-driven alternative to complex sub-grid schemes.
b8dbfe061588dd3f374c75f06a9c0f4cbed10032.architecture: Encoder-decoder convolutional neural networks (several image-processing architectures, including U-Net-style designs) compared with baseline ML methods, plus variable selection over geopotential levels.
b8dbfe061588dd3f374c75f06a9c0f4cbed10032.data: NWP reanalysis data (product not named in the abstract) with geopotential height at multiple levels as input and total precipitation as target.
b8dbfe061588dd3f374c75f06a9c0f4cbed10032.result: Encoder-decoder CNNs infer total precipitation from geopotential height with high accuracy and outperform baseline ML methods; identifies the most influential geopotential levels.
b8dbfe061588dd3f374c75f06a9c0f4cbed10032.open_work: Use additional input variables and test the learned parameterizations inside an NWP model.
b8dbfe061588dd3f374c75f06a9c0f4cbed10032.issues: Offline diagnostic mapping only; uses geopotential alone and reanalysis precipitation, which inherits model biases.

ab90cc9c56018959cbfa68c0d05c505b13fe2069.goal: Calibrates storm-scale probabilistic guidance for tornado, severe hail and severe wind hazards from the Warn-on-Forecast System for 0–3 h forecasts.
ab90cc9c56018959cbfa68c0d05c505b13fe2069.architecture: Random forests, gradient-boosted trees and logistic regression applied to predictors from a novel ensemble storm-track identification method.
ab90cc9c56018959cbfa68c0d05c505b13fe2069.data: WoFS ensemble forecasts every 5 min to 150 min lead from the 2017–19 NOAA Hazardous Weather Testbed Spring Forecasting Experiments (81 dates), verified against storm reports.
ab90cc9c56018959cbfa68c0d05c505b13fe2069.result: All three ML algorithms discriminate well for all hazards and give more reliable probabilities than tuned-threshold ensemble baselines.
ab90cc9c56018959cbfa68c0d05c505b13fe2069.open_work: Expand the dataset beyond 81 dates and test in real-time forecasting.
ab90cc9c56018959cbfa68c0d05c505b13fe2069.issues: Limited number of cases; storm reports are a noisy, biased verification target.

24d54fe51453a92a104dd56c8055a3d663fda220.goal: Tests whether differentiable, physics-informed hydrologic models are competitive for global-scale rainfall-runoff simulation.
24d54fe51453a92a104dd56c8055a3d663fda220.architecture: Differentiable HBV model (δHBV) with neural networks learning parameters, compared with a purely data-driven LSTM and traditional regionalization.
24d54fe51453a92a104dd56c8055a3d663fda220.data: Daily discharge for 3753 basins worldwide (subset of 1675 with long records); forcing products are not named in the abstract.
24d54fe51453a92a104dd56c8055a3d663fda220.result: Both δHBV and LSTM reach median KGE near or above 0.7 (0.78 for LSTM on long-record subset); regionalized δHBV generalizes better to ungauged regions (median KGE 0.64 vs 0.46 for traditional regionalization) and beats LSTM there.
24d54fe51453a92a104dd56c8055a3d663fda220.open_work: Fix structural deficiencies of the backbone for cold, polar, arid and human-impacted basins.
24d54fe51453a92a104dd56c8055a3d663fda220.issues: δHBV underperforms LSTM in cold, arid and human-impacted basins due to the simple HBV backbone.

ff6baf0db64da657cdb9882b84ff4e28377fa016.goal: Learns photosynthesis parameters at large scale for ecosystem models, overcoming site-by-site calibration problems such as overfitting and non-uniqueness.
ff6baf0db64da657cdb9882b84ff4e28377fa016.architecture: Differentiable physics-informed framework: a differentiable version of FATES photosynthesis coupled to neural networks that learn parameterizations from observations.
ff6baf0db64da657cdb9882b84ff4e28377fa016.data: Synthetic data for parameter recovery tests and a real-world dataset of photosynthesis rates across many plant functional types.
ff6baf0db64da657cdb9882b84ff4e28377fa016.result: Recovers multiple synthetic parameters concurrently; learned parameters substantially reduce biases relative to literature values, and Vc,max25 is more impactful than the water limitation factor.
ff6baf0db64da657cdb9882b84ff4e28377fa016.open_work: Learn additional processes and parameters and apply to full ecosystem simulations at large scales.
ff6baf0db64da657cdb9882b84ff4e28377fa016.issues: Focuses on the photosynthesis module only; quantitative skill not given in the abstract.

fdb40485f00e88997283b54787b2d3b1acc812c1.goal: Addresses the underestimation of uncertainty in climate projections caused by selecting a single tuned parameter configuration per climate model.
fdb40485f00e88997283b54787b2d3b1acc812c1.architecture: Machine-assisted tuning via history matching with statistical emulators of the climate model, used to explore free parameter space; the emulator type is not specified in the abstract.
fdb40485f00e88997283b54787b2d3b1acc812c1.data: Perturbed-parameter simulations of a climate model (IPSL model family) constrained by present-day observations of the climate system.
fdb40485f00e88997283b54787b2d3b1acc812c1.result: Automatic selection yields multiple parameter configurations all consistent with present-day observations but producing different warming worlds.
fdb40485f00e88997283b54787b2d3b1acc812c1.open_work: Integrate parametric uncertainty quantification into CMIP contributions and accelerate model improvement.
fdb40485f00e88997283b54787b2d3b1acc812c1.issues: Quantitative details not given in the abstract; results depend on chosen metrics and tolerance to observational error.

a1446470c6c516ed52c87491b651ef8c10f8627f.goal: Makes neural network emulations of physical parameterizations in numerical environmental models robust by detecting and handling occasional large emulation errors.
a1446470c6c516ed52c87491b651ef8c10f8627f.architecture: Compound parameterization: an MLP (multilayer perceptron) emulator of the physics, an additional neural network that predicts the emulation error for quality control, and fallback to the original parameterization when large errors are flagged.
a1446470c6c516ed52c87491b651ef8c10f8627f.data: Abstract not available; applied to parameterizations in atmospheric and ocean wave models, but specific datasets are not reported in the metadata.
a1446470c6c516ed52c87491b651ef8c10f8627f.result: Not reported in the abstract; the compound approach aims to keep emulation speed-ups while controlling the rare larger errors.
a1446470c6c516ed52c87491b651ef8c10f8627f.open_work: Extend quality-controlled emulation to other parameterizations and to long coupled simulations.
a1446470c6c516ed52c87491b651ef8c10f8627f.issues: Abstract missing; details summarized from the title and the authors' known research line.

5a3ba483b63333baceafbfc36800207623907ba2.goal: Makes neural network emulators of subgrid convection respect physical constraints and generalize to unseen climates.
5a3ba483b63333baceafbfc36800207623907ba2.architecture: Neural networks (MLP-type, as in the CBRAIN-CAM framework) with physical constraints enforced through the loss function or to machine precision via architecture, plus physical rescaling of inputs.
5a3ba483b63333baceafbfc36800207623907ba2.data: High-resolution (superparameterized) climate simulations; specific configuration not detailed in the abstract.
5a3ba483b63333baceafbfc36800207623907ba2.result: Physical constraints can be enforced approximately or exactly, and physically rescaled training data improve generalization to unseen climates.
5a3ba483b63333baceafbfc36800207623907ba2.open_work: Online coupled testing and further rescaling strategies for robust climate generalization.
5a3ba483b63333baceafbfc36800207623907ba2.issues: Short conference paper; constraints alone do not guarantee generalization and evaluation appears offline.

cb19274b9196ccb30c95014e41368f2d818eb3af.goal: Constrains the large spread in Earth system model projections of gross primary production (GPP) under CO2 fertilization.
cb19274b9196ccb30c95014e41368f2d818eb3af.architecture: Emergent constraint on CO2 fertilization combined with a machine learning regression trained on CMIP5 models; the ML model family is not specified in the abstract.
cb19274b9196ccb30c95014e41368f2d818eb3af.data: CMIP5 ESMs under RCP8.5, observed CO2 seasonal cycle changes at Cape Kumukahi, and observational diagnostics as ML inputs.
cb19274b9196ccb30c95014e41368f2d818eb3af.result: Constrains 2091–2100 global GPP to 171 ± 12 Gt C/yr versus an unconstrained 156–247; ML beats the CMIP5 mean in leave-one-model-out cross-validation and predicts larger GPP gains at high northern latitudes.
cb19274b9196ccb30c95014e41368f2d818eb3af.open_work: Apply to CMIP6 and to other carbon cycle variables.
cb19274b9196ccb30c95014e41368f2d818eb3af.issues: Relies on CMIP5 structural assumptions and the validity of the emergent constraint; cross-validation uses models, not observed futures.

ae9a5e43da72e5b3471cf786f5cc9c7e69df93e9.goal: Improves physical consistency and accuracy of data-driven weather prediction and integrates it with data assimilation.
ae9a5e43da72e5b3471cf786f5cc9c7e69df93e9.architecture: U-Net with a deep spatial transformer in the latent space (U-STN) preserving equivariance, coupled with a sigma-point ensemble Kalman filter for data assimilation and a multi-time-step scheme.
ae9a5e43da72e5b3471cf786f5cc9c7e69df93e9.data: ERA5 reanalysis geopotential height at 500 hPa (Z500), with synthetic noisy observations for DA experiments.
ae9a5e43da72e5b3471cf786f5cc9c7e69df93e9.result: U-STNs outperform U-Nets (e.g., 45% skill improvement); DA cycles are stable with high observation noise using O(1000) ensembles, and multi-time-step DA reduces errors by factors of 2–3.
ae9a5e43da72e5b3471cf786f5cc9c7e69df93e9.open_work: Apply the components to full multivariate DDWP and to ocean and land systems.
ae9a5e43da72e5b3471cf786f5cc9c7e69df93e9.issues: Single-variable Z500 setup at coarse resolution; short-term forecasts only, with idealized observations.

cfd01b026417e2572dfc35641ffdf55394bf6610.goal: Estimates the predictability limit of the June 2021 Pacific Northwest heatwave using gradient-based initial condition optimization in deep learning weather models.
cfd01b026417e2572dfc35641ffdf55394bf6610.architecture: Backpropagation and gradient descent through GraphCast (graph neural network) to optimize initial conditions, with tests in Pangu-Weather (transformer).
cfd01b026417e2572dfc35641ffdf55394bf6610.data: ERA5-based initial conditions for the June 2021 Pacific Northwest heatwave; GraphCast and Pangu-Weather forecasts.
cfd01b026417e2572dfc35641ffdf55394bf6610.result: Optimized initial conditions reduce 10-day forecast errors over the Pacific Northwest by over 90%; improvements transfer to Pangu-Weather and extend to about 23 days.
cfd01b026417e2572dfc35641ffdf55394bf6610.open_work: Apply to other extreme events and examine physical realism of optimal perturbations.
cfd01b026417e2572dfc35641ffdf55394bf6610.issues: Single case study; optimal perturbations may exploit ML model artifacts and are not constrained to observational uncertainty.

d4959945b50a1482ad3ed080142b7b244b24c769.goal: Interprets a black-box ConvLSTM soil moisture model to build trust and reveal drivers of spatiotemporal soil moisture variability in China.
d4959945b50a1482ad3ed080142b7b244b24c769.architecture: ConvLSTM (convolutional long short-term memory) network interpreted with permutation importance (global) and smooth gradient (local) methods.
d4959945b50a1482ad3ed080142b7b244b24c769.data: Gridded meteorological forcing, soil properties and soil moisture over China; specific products not named in the abstract.
d4959945b50a1482ad3ed080142b7b244b24c769.result: ConvLSTM reaches R2 = 0.92; precipitation and soil properties are most important, with stronger seasonality in high latitudes but larger effects in low latitudes.
d4959945b50a1482ad3ed080142b7b244b24c769.open_work: Extend interpretation to other Earth system variables and compare across XAI methods.
d4959945b50a1482ad3ed080142b7b244b24c769.issues: Interpretation methods are post hoc and can be unreliable; target soil moisture product not specified in the abstract.

923ff391502903da51e6924c7a112e59bc8b266d.goal: Tests whether generative deep learning can emulate kilometer-scale dynamical downscaling at much lower cost.
923ff391502903da51e6924c7a112e59bc8b266d.architecture: Latent diffusion model (LDM) applied as a residual on a reference U-Net, compared with interpolation, a U-Net and a GAN.
923ff391502903da51e6924c7a112e59bc8b266d.data: ERA5 predictors over Italy as input; targets are 2 m temperature and 10 m wind from COSMO-CLM dynamical downscaling at 2 km.
923ff391502903da51e6924c7a112e59bc8b266d.result: The LDM with residual approach outperforms all baselines in spatial error, frequency distributions and power spectra while preserving fine-scale realism.
923ff391502903da51e6924c7a112e59bc8b266d.open_work: Apply to downscaling of climate projections and exploit ensemble generation for uncertainty quantification.
923ff391502903da51e6924c7a112e59bc8b266d.issues: Limited to temperature and wind over Italy; target is a regional model, so it inherits COSMO-CLM biases.

4ed0f0dc8642a8f8ebfb5b9ed1de32494a3e51b2.goal: Combines forecasts from multiple NWP models and lead times into well-calibrated probabilistic forecasts for decision support.
4ed0f0dc8642a8f8ebfb5b9ed1de32494a3e51b2.architecture: Three-stage framework: quantile regression forests (random forest) learn each model's error profile, quantile averaging combines them, and interpolation yields a full predictive distribution.
4ed0f0dc8642a8f8ebfb5b9ed1de32494a3e51b2.data: Road surface temperature forecasts from several NWP models with corresponding observations (sources not detailed in the abstract).
4ed0f0dc8642a8f8ebfb5b9ed1de32494a3e51b2.result: Produces well-calibrated probabilistic outputs and is an effective and operationally viable framework across models and lead times.
4ed0f0dc8642a8f8ebfb5b9ed1de32494a3e51b2.open_work: Apply to other variables and test operational deployment.
4ed0f0dc8642a8f8ebfb5b9ed1de32494a3e51b2.issues: Single-variable demonstration; quantitative skill not given in the abstract.

2ef88f1ed661007caab20de2182533d5a2c50a42.goal: Accelerates radiative transfer computations by emulating gaseous optical properties with neural networks.
2ef88f1ed661007caab20de2182533d5a2c50a42.architecture: Neural networks (MLPs) emulating RRTMGP gas optics, using optimized BLAS for matrix computations.
2ef88f1ed661007caab20de2182533d5a2c50a42.data: Randomly perturbed atmospheric profiles with optical properties computed by RRTMGP; also a large-eddy simulation case.
2ef88f1ed661007caab20de2182533d5a2c50a42.result: Radiative flux errors average within 0.5 W/m2 compared with RRTMGP, and the scheme is up to four times faster.
2ef88f1ed661007caab20de2182533d5a2c50a42.open_work: Test in full model integrations and broader atmospheric conditions.
2ef88f1ed661007caab20de2182533d5a2c50a42.issues: Applicability is restricted to a reduced range of atmospheric conditions; speed-up is modest.

40978f70c1d6e4fb30de239e25e2b32bf57f0d07.goal: Predicts maize yield from weather and soil, comparing machine learning with a process-based crop model under climate variability.
40978f70c1d6e4fb30de239e25e2b32bf57f0d07.architecture: LSTM with attention (LSTMatt), compared with other ML models and LSTM variants and a process-based crop model.
40978f70c1d6e4fb30de239e25e2b32bf57f0d07.data: Maize yields in the US Corn Belt with meteorological variables and soil properties; leave-one-year-out validation including drought year 2012.
40978f70c1d6e4fb30de239e25e2b32bf57f0d07.result: LSTMatt explains 73% of spatiotemporal yield variance versus 16% for the regionally calibrated process-based model, with errors about one-third as large; skill drops but remains better in 2012.
40978f70c1d6e4fb30de239e25e2b32bf57f0d07.open_work: Apply to other crops and regions and to projections under climate change.
40978f70c1d6e4fb30de239e25e2b32bf57f0d07.issues: Performance drops for unprecedented extremes; regional US-only evaluation.

bab5883840ee07eb8c5fc73cceff2f9f82d06260.goal: Proposes neural network data assimilation that performs 3D-Var minimisation in a learned latent space, as an alternative to traditional variational and Kalman filter methods.
bab5883840ee07eb8c5fc73cceff2f9f82d06260.architecture: Variational autoencoder (VAE) whose reduced-order latent space hosts an autodifferentiable 3D-Var cost function fusing observations and an encoded persistence background.
bab5883840ee07eb8c5fc73cceff2f9f82d06260.data: Atmospheric fields with simulated observations and a short-range persistence forecast as background; specific reanalysis product and resolution not reported in the abstract.
bab5883840ee07eb8c5fc73cceff2f9f82d06260.result: The latent-space background-error covariance matrix is quasidiagonal while grid-point covariances are flow-dependent and seasonal; single-observation tests show B captures tropical and extratropical covariances simultaneously.
bab5883840ee07eb8c5fc73cceff2f9f82d06260.open_work: Extending to many real observations, cycled assimilation with a real forecast model background, and comparison against operational 3D-Var or EnKF systems.
bab5883840ee07eb8c5fc73cceff2f9f82d06260.issues: Demonstrated mainly with single temperature observation experiments and a persistence background; no full cycling or operational-scale evaluation is reported.

46090c810174da11df5b0019c80780d881c03b14.goal: Tracks typhoon eye positions from multichannel satellite imagery to support data-driven understanding of atmospheric dynamics.
46090c810174da11df5b0019c80780d881c03b14.architecture: Convolutional neural networks (multi-layer networks with different activation choices) trained as a regression model for the typhoon centre coordinates.
46090c810174da11df5b0019c80780d881c03b14.data: Multichannel satellite images of typhoons over the northern hemisphere east region; the specific satellite product and period are not reported in the abstract.
46090c810174da11df5b0019c80780d881c03b14.result: A particular combination of models and activation policies gives promising single-typhoon coordinate predictions; quantitative errors are not reported in the abstract.
46090c810174da11df5b0019c80780d881c03b14.open_work: Extending to track forecasting, intensity estimation and comparison with operational best-track centre-fixing methods.
46090c810174da11df5b0019c80780d881c03b14.issues: Early short arXiv study with vague evaluation; no quantitative baseline comparison or independent test set is described in the abstract.

1939340b6163c31d12f56f8bf8b81ce50ac7dbf2.goal: Provides a cheap emulator of Earth system model temperature fields with realistic internal variability so large ensembles and many scenarios can be explored.
1939340b6163c31d12f56f8bf8b81ce50ac7dbf2.architecture: Non-ML statistical emulator: a deterministic pattern-scaling mean response to global temperature plus stochastic residual variability fields with space-time correlation (EOF and Fourier phase randomization), released as an R package.
1939340b6163c31d12f56f8bf8b81ce50ac7dbf2.data: Gridded temperature output of Earth system models (CMIP5-era ESM runs) used to fit the mean response and residual variability.
1939340b6163c31d12f56f8bf8b81ce50ac7dbf2.result: Generated fields have spatially and temporally coherent variability and statistically reproduce the target ESM properties; arbitrarily many realisations can be produced.
1939340b6163c31d12f56f8bf8b81ce50ac7dbf2.open_work: Extending to other variables such as precipitation and joint multivariate fields, and coupling to human-Earth system models.
1939340b6163c31d12f56f8bf8b81ce50ac7dbf2.issues: Variability statistics are assumed stationary and tied to the mean-response relation; only temperature is emulated and fidelity is limited to properties the method is built to capture.

cdf3fb2670d0721eabcbaef9572be25324e6f44f.goal: Tests whether machine-learned moist-physics parameterizations trained on a global cloud-resolving model work offline and when coupled online in a coarse atmospheric model.
cdf3fb2670d0721eabcbaef9572be25324e6f44f.architecture: Random forest and neural network (MLP) parameterizations of the aggregate effect of moist physics, coupled to the FV3GFS atmospheric model.
cdf3fb2670d0721eabcbaef9572be25324e6f44f.data: Coarse-grained 3 km global cloud-resolving simulation for training and testing; online tests at about 200 km resolution.
cdf3fb2670d0721eabcbaef9572be25324e6f44f.result: The NN beats the RF offline, but the NN-coupled run crashes within 7 days while RF runs remain stable; both improve weather forecasts over baseline yet climate variables drift on longer timescales.
cdf3fb2670d0721eabcbaef9572be25324e6f44f.open_work: Methods to ensure online stability of neural parameterizations and reduce long-term climate drift.
cdf3fb2670d0721eabcbaef9572be25324e6f44f.issues: Offline skill does not predict online behaviour; instability of coupled NN and climate drift remain unsolved; training on a short cloud-resolving simulation.

0b074322b3c62cd0a0cf2e78f57514426f02089d.goal: Introduces climate informatics, the use of machine learning and data mining to accelerate discovery in climate science.
0b074322b3c62cd0a0cf2e78f57514426f02089d.architecture: Perspective and review of machine learning opportunities in climate science; no single new model is the focus.
0b074322b3c62cd0a0cf2e78f57514426f02089d.data: Not reported (abstract unavailable); discusses climate model ensembles, observations and paleoclimate data as typical sources.
0b074322b3c62cd0a0cf2e78f57514426f02089d.result: Argues that collaboration between machine learning and climate science can address open problems such as combining model ensembles and reconstructing past climate.
0b074322b3c62cd0a0cf2e78f57514426f02089d.open_work: Building the interdisciplinary community, shared datasets and challenge problems.
0b074322b3c62cd0a0cf2e78f57514426f02089d.issues: Early perspective without new quantitative results; content inferred from the title and venue since the abstract is missing.

25fab581afa6159150f81354d928333a937ee73a.goal: Provides a machine learning benchmark relating global air quality (tropospheric ozone) metrics to easily accessible station metadata.
25fab581afa6159150f81354d928333a937ee73a.architecture: Benchmark dataset with a defined task and evaluation metric; baselines from linear regression, a fully connected neural network (MLP) and random forest.
25fab581afa6159150f81354d928333a937ee73a.data: Aggregated 2010-2014 air quality data and metadata from more than 5500 monitoring stations worldwide from the first Tropospheric Ozone Assessment Report (TOAR) database.
25fab581afa6159150f81354d928333a937ee73a.result: Validated as a FAIR, low-threshold benchmark with reference baseline scores; data and introductory code are openly available.
25fab581afa6159150f81354d928333a937ee73a.open_work: Using the benchmark for ozone mapping, explainability studies and more advanced ML methods; blueprint for other environmental benchmarks.
25fab581afa6159150f81354d928333a937ee73a.issues: Static aggregated metrics rather than time series; predictors limited to metadata; station coverage is uneven globally.

1068928c1fe236d263b176b639b805639ad5924b.goal: Reduces the storage and transmission cost of reanalysis data so AI weather research is accessible to resource-limited researchers.
1068928c1fe236d263b176b639b805639ad5924b.architecture: Neural codec VAEformer: a low-complexity variational autoencoder transformer producing a quantized Gaussian latent for entropy coding.
1068928c1fe236d263b176b639b805639ad5924b.data: ERA5 reanalysis (226 TB) compressed to the CRA5 dataset (0.7 TB); downstream training of global weather forecasting models on CRA5.
1068928c1fe236d263b176b639b805639ad5924b.result: Compression ratio above 300 while outperforming prior compression methods; forecasting models trained on CRA5 match accuracy of models trained on original ERA5.
1068928c1fe236d263b176b639b805639ad5924b.open_work: Compressing other variables and datasets, and assessing impact on extremes and fine-scale analyses.
1068928c1fe236d263b176b639b805639ad5924b.issues: Lossy compression may degrade extremes or small-scale features; utility shown mainly through forecasting accuracy rather than all scientific uses.

66fac38adadda68f26e70908a3bf907dc8aedf90.goal: Predicts natural drought by combining deep learning with climate model information, as the title indicates.
66fac38adadda68f26e70908a3bf907dc8aedf90.architecture: Hybrid approach combining a long short-term memory (LSTM) network with climate model outputs (LSTM-CM); further details not available.
66fac38adadda68f26e70908a3bf907dc8aedf90.data: Not reported (abstract unavailable); presumably drought indices and climate model projections, region not known.
66fac38adadda68f26e70908a3bf907dc8aedf90.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title claims a hybrid LSTM and climate-model drought predictor.
66fac38adadda68f26e70908a3bf907dc8aedf90.open_work: Not reported; would naturally include longer lead times and other regions.
66fac38adadda68f26e70908a3bf907dc8aedf90.issues: Abstract missing, so data, region and skill cannot be verified from this record.

d784b958c0143ea0253497a3833677c5921f1e5b.goal: Downscales global reanalysis precipitation to km and sub-hourly scales to capture intense local rainfall relevant to hazards.
d784b958c0143ea0253497a3833677c5921f1e5b.architecture: spateGAN-ERA5, a spatio-temporal generative adversarial network (GAN) producing ensembles of high-resolution precipitation fields.
d784b958c0143ea0253497a3833677c5921f1e5b.data: ERA5 precipitation (24 km, 1 h) to 2 km, 10 min targets; trained on radar-based data from Germany, validated in the US and Australia.
d784b958c0143ea0253497a3833677c5921f1e5b.result: Produces realistic spatio-temporal rainfall patterns and accurate rain rate distributions including extremes, and generalises to US and Australian climates including tropical regimes.
d784b958c0143ea0253497a3833677c5921f1e5b.open_work: Global on-demand generation of high-resolution precipitation for hydrological applications and further validation in data-poor regions.
d784b958c0143ea0253497a3833677c5921f1e5b.issues: Trained only on German data; generalisation to all climates is not guaranteed; inherits ERA5 biases in timing and location of rain.

fa026e1a3e001074c40f7e18cf407a31b253ce6f.goal: Removes dependence of AI weather models on NWP analyses by building an AI data assimilation component for an end-to-end forecasting system.
fa026e1a3e001074c40f7e18cf407a31b253ce6f.architecture: Adas, a neural network data assimilation model trained cyclically to represent steady-state background error covariance with an observation confidence matrix, coupled to the FengWu transformer forecast model.
fa026e1a3e001074c40f7e18cf407a31b253ce6f.data: ERA5 reanalysis for training; global conventional observations assimilated; forecasts compared with ECMWF IFS.
fa026e1a3e001074c40f7e18cf407a31b253ce6f.result: FengWu-Adas assimilates conventional observations to produce good analyses, runs stably long term and gives end-to-end forecasts with skill comparable to IFS.
fa026e1a3e001074c40f7e18cf407a31b253ce6f.open_work: Assimilating satellite radiances and other observation types, and flow-dependent error covariances.
fa026e1a3e001074c40f7e18cf407a31b253ce6f.issues: Uses only conventional observations and a steady-state background error assumption; evaluation partly against reanalysis-type references.

a58ce76ab93b9d4bb979a57eaefa75f9c7f31c43.goal: Downscales tropical cyclone rainfall from coarse to hazard-relevant scales to support flood risk assessment under climate change.
a58ce76ab93b9d4bb979a57eaefa75f9c7f31c43.architecture: Three deep learning downscaling models compared, including a Wasserstein generative adversarial network (WGAN), which performs best.
a58ce76ab93b9d4bb979a57eaefa75f9c7f31c43.data: MSWEP (Multi-Source Weighted-Ensemble Precipitation) TC rainfall coarsened to about 100 km as input, original about 10 km as target; most extreme storms held out.
a58ce76ab93b9d4bb979a57eaefa75f9c7f31c43.result: The WGAN captures realistic spatial structure and power spectra with mean biases within 5% of observations, and extrapolates well to the most extreme unseen storms.
a58ce76ab93b9d4bb979a57eaefa75f9c7f31c43.open_work: Applying the downscaling to low-resolution climate model TC simulations to estimate future rainfall hazard.
a58ce76ab93b9d4bb979a57eaefa75f9c7f31c43.issues: Trained on coarsened observations (perfect-prognosis setting), so transfer to climate model biases is untested; extremes sampled by few storms.

03a2c79fc0bda6231cde3f1e8752aa9c75ee574d.goal: Learns both the system state and a surrogate dynamical model online, updating estimates as new partial noisy observations arrive.
03a2c79fc0bda6231cde3f1e8752aa9c75ee574d.architecture: Ensemble Kalman filter family (global, local and iterative EnKF) with state-parameter augmentation and a simple machine-learning surrogate representation of the dynamics.
03a2c79fc0bda6231cde3f1e8752aa9c75ee574d.data: Synthetic observations from one-scale and two-scale chaotic Lorenz models (Lorenz-96 type).
03a2c79fc0bda6231cde3f1e8752aa9c75ee574d.result: Online learning of dynamics and state is numerically efficient and accurate across the EnKF variants, with specific algorithmic issues identified and addressed for each.
03a2c79fc0bda6231cde3f1e8752aa9c75ee574d.open_work: Scaling to high-dimensional realistic models and richer surrogate representations.
03a2c79fc0bda6231cde3f1e8752aa9c75ee574d.issues: Idealized low-dimensional chaotic models only; simple surrogate representation; localization of model parameters raises design issues.

dd4a2ee6fcc17f0b1b88a7695670ded74953eea7.goal: Provides a general open-source workflow for emulating expensive Earth system models for uncertainty quantification and calibration.
dd4a2ee6fcc17f0b1b88a7695670ded74953eea7.architecture: ESEm software tool supporting Gaussian process, neural network and random forest emulators, with sampling routines (e.g. approximate Bayesian computation, MCMC) for calibration.
dd4a2ee6fcc17f0b1b88a7695670ded74953eea7.data: Case studies: perturbed-parameter ensemble of a general circulation model, cloud-resolving model precipitation sensitivity, and the CMIP6 multi-model ensemble.
dd4a2ee6fcc17f0b1b88a7695670ded74953eea7.result: Demonstrates flexible, scalable emulation and calibration across three diverse case studies, reducing parametric uncertainty in a GCM.
dd4a2ee6fcc17f0b1b88a7695670ded74953eea7.open_work: Extension to more emulator types and broader community use for model tuning.
dd4a2ee6fcc17f0b1b88a7695670ded74953eea7.issues: Tool paper; emulator accuracy depends on ensemble design and size; calibration results are case-specific.

68e8ec0f24fc0f0e2ccccfa7592f14083c110ee7.goal: Builds a fast coupled AI ocean-atmosphere model for large-ensemble seasonal forecasts.
68e8ec0f24fc0f0e2ccccfa7592f14083c110ee7.architecture: Ola: separate autoregressive Spherical Fourier Neural Operator (SFNO) models for ocean and atmosphere at 0.25 degree, coupled together.
68e8ec0f24fc0f0e2ccccfa7592f14083c110ee7.data: Atmospheric and ocean reanalysis fields at 0.25 degree; exact products and periods not reported in the abstract; ENSO skill compared with GFDL SPEAR.
68e8ec0f24fc0f0e2ccccfa7592f14083c110ee7.result: Learns coupled dynamics including tropical ocean waves with correct phase speeds and an internally generated ENSO with realistic amplitude and structure; ENSO forecast skill compares favourably to SPEAR.
68e8ec0f24fc0f0e2ccccfa7592f14083c110ee7.open_work: Fuller seasonal skill assessment, large ensembles and longer stable climate runs.
68e8ec0f24fc0f0e2ccccfa7592f14083c110ee7.issues: Initial evidence only; skill comparison limited; reanalysis training inherits biases and the ocean record is short.

90e77e189d79ef1154f9843efd901b12f395e6e8.goal: Improves statistical post-processing of global medium-range ensemble forecasts directly at the member level.
90e77e189d79ef1154f9843efd901b12f395e6e8.architecture: PoET, a hierarchical transformer post-processing model that calibrates each ensemble member and is ensemble-size agnostic.
90e77e189d79ef1154f9843efd901b12f395e6e8.data: ECMWF ensemble (ENS) forecasts and verifying analyses for 2 m temperature and precipitation; also the ENS10 benchmark dataset.
90e77e189d79ef1154f9843efd901b12f395e6e8.result: Up to 20% skill improvement globally for 2 m temperature and 2% for precipitation; outperforms member-by-member statistical method and other deep learning solutions on ENS10 for most parameters.
90e77e189d79ef1154f9843efd901b12f395e6e8.open_work: Extending to more variables, longer leads and downstream applications using calibrated members.
90e77e189d79ef1154f9843efd901b12f395e6e8.issues: Gains for precipitation are small; spatial and multivariate consistency of calibrated members needs further checking.

4c861748bc39607a64cc1994acd9827e12f61f2c.goal: Simultaneously bias-corrects and downscales Earth system model precipitation to improve extremes and spatial structure.
4c861748bc39607a64cc1994acd9827e12f61f2c.architecture: Conditional diffusion model trained to reverse a mapping of observational and ESM fields to a shared unbiased embedding space.
4c861748bc39607a64cc1994acd9827e12f61f2c.data: Observational precipitation data for training only; applied to ESM precipitation; specific products not reported in the abstract.
4c861748bc39607a64cc1994acd9827e12f61f2c.result: Preserves spatial patterns above a chosen scale with statistical fidelity and outperforms statistical and deep learning baselines, especially for extremes.
4c861748bc39607a64cc1994acd9827e12f61f2c.open_work: Applying to other ESMs, variables and regions without retraining; multivariate correction.
4c861748bc39607a64cc1994acd9827e12f61f2c.issues: Correction below the chosen spatial scale relies on the embedding assumption; evaluation against observations in historical period only.

172be0a14935e8767f142d6c2689674f3f923630.goal: Comments on the prospects of AI-based weather prediction in light of recent data-driven global models.
172be0a14935e8767f142d6c2689674f3f923630.architecture: Commentary (News and Views) on AI weather prediction, discussing transformer-based global models such as Pangu-Weather; no new model.
172be0a14935e8767f142d6c2689674f3f923630.data: Not reported (abstract unavailable); discusses models trained on ERA5 reanalysis.
172be0a14935e8767f142d6c2689674f3f923630.result: Argues AI models can rival operational NWP in accuracy at far lower cost, while open questions remain.
172be0a14935e8767f142d6c2689674f3f923630.open_work: Physical consistency, extremes, uncertainty quantification and independence from NWP analyses.
172be0a14935e8767f142d6c2689674f3f923630.issues: Abstract missing; summary based on knowledge of the commentary and the title.

5b3065906402f4624d712b90e07d9f02afe683b2.goal: Adds 3D cloud radiative effects to the ECMWF 1D radiation scheme ecRad at low cost.
5b3065906402f4624d712b90e07d9f02afe683b2.architecture: Neural networks predicting the difference between ecRad's 1D Tripleclouds solver and the 3D SPARTACUS solver; network family beyond feed-forward neural network not detailed in the abstract.
5b3065906402f4624d712b90e07d9f02afe683b2.data: Atmospheric profiles with ecRad Tripleclouds and SPARTACUS radiative calculations; specific source of profiles not reported in the abstract.
5b3065906402f4624d712b90e07d9f02afe683b2.result: Neural network corrections have typical errors of 20-30% of the 3D signal and improve Tripleclouds accuracy for about 1% runtime increase versus 5 times cost of SPARTACUS.
5b3065906402f4624d712b90e07d9f02afe683b2.open_work: Online testing of the 3D correction in IFS weather and climate runs.
5b3065906402f4624d712b90e07d9f02afe683b2.issues: Offline evaluation; residual errors of 20-30% of the 3D signal; trained on a specific solver whose own accuracy limits the target.

4b4b97aba4068ea715252db5b2f8b920ef787a32.goal: Short-term prediction of Arctic sea ice concentration, especially during rapid melt and freeze changes.
4b4b97aba4068ea715252db5b2f8b920ef787a32.architecture: Encoder-decoder with a gated recurrent unit (GRU) encoding sequential sea ice data and a feed-forward neural network decoder, applied per grid cell with added global statistics.
4b4b97aba4068ea715252db5b2f8b920ef787a32.data: Satellite-derived Arctic sea ice concentration time series; specific product and period not reported in the abstract.
4b4b97aba4068ea715252db5b2f8b920ef787a32.result: Adding global sea ice statistics to local information significantly improves prediction accuracy compared with local-only data schemes.
4b4b97aba4068ea715252db5b2f8b920ef787a32.open_work: Spatially aware architectures and longer lead times.
4b4b97aba4068ea715252db5b2f8b920ef787a32.issues: Per-cell predictions lack spatial context; quantitative skill and lead times not reported in the abstract.

1b4e6f93a7cce869c8b9361d6968a41be3850d31.goal: Assesses transferability and physical consistency of deep learning emulators of regional climate models across periods, scenarios and driving GCMs.
1b4e6f93a7cce869c8b9361d6968a41be3850d31.architecture: Deep learning RCM emulators under Perfect Prognosis and Model Output Statistics training setups, analysed with explainable AI (XAI); specific network family not specified in the abstract.
1b4e6f93a7cce869c8b9361d6968a41be3850d31.data: Short regional climate model simulations driven by global climate models for training; future periods, scenarios and other GCMs for transfer tests.
1b4e6f93a7cce869c8b9361d6968a41be3850d31.result: Both approaches reproduce some RCM climatological properties across periods and scenarios; PP learns physically meaningful patterns while MOS is GCM-dependent; both fail at transfer to other GCMs.
1b4e6f93a7cce869c8b9361d6968a41be3850d31.open_work: Strategies to handle GCM-dependent biases so emulators can build multi-GCM RCM ensembles.
1b4e6f93a7cce869c8b9361d6968a41be3850d31.issues: Hard transferability fails due to GCM biases; limited emulator applicability for ensemble generation.

fe974079a26242d659dac8afb6a4f42ad29e710e.goal: Predicts high-resolution urban flood water depth maps with calibrated uncertainty as a fast alternative to hydrodynamic models.
fe974079a26242d659dac8afb6a4f42ad29e710e.architecture: Probabilistic deep learning using deep ensembles to give per-pixel water depth uncertainty; base network family not specified in the abstract.
fe974079a26242d659dac8afb6a4f42ad29e710e.data: Simulated hydrodynamic flood data for catchments in Switzerland and Portugal with 18 rainfall patterns; inputs are rainfall forecasts and terrain (DEM).
fe974079a26242d659dac8afb6a4f42ad29e710e.result: Hazard maps at 1 m resolution with mean absolute errors as low as 21 cm for extreme cases with water above 1 m, plus well-calibrated uncertainty.
fe974079a26242d659dac8afb6a4f42ad29e710e.open_work: Testing on more catchments and real observed flood events.
fe974079a26242d659dac8afb6a4f42ad29e710e.issues: Trained and evaluated on simulated data only; few rainfall patterns and catchments.

4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.goal: Improves the eddy diffusivity component of ocean surface boundary layer vertical mixing parameterizations for climate models.
4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.architecture: Neural networks predicting eddy diffusivity profiles from forcing parameters, embedded online in the ocean model while preserving conservation.
4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.data: Training on output from a second moment closure turbulence scheme; online tests in an ocean general circulation model (MOM6).
4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.result: Stable online implementation reduces biases in mixed-layer depth and upper-ocean stratification compared with the predecessor scheme.
4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.open_work: Training on higher-fidelity data such as LES and testing in coupled climate models.
4756bc59632a28cee4060f38f196423a9391289b.issues: Trained on a closure scheme rather than observations or LES, so learns its assumptions; generalisation to unseen regimes uncertain.

adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.goal: Builds stable data-driven autoregressive surrogates of geophysical turbulence as a step towards data-driven climate models.
adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.architecture: Convolutional encoder-decoder with deep spatial transformer modules (equivariance preserving) predicting the upper-layer stream function autoregressively.
adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.data: Two-layer quasi-geostrophic turbulence simulations, upper-layer stream function only.
adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.result: Predicts up to about 9 days in the QG system, beating persistence and a standard convolutional encoder-decoder, and remains stable for multiple years.
adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.open_work: Extension to more complex climate models and real atmospheric data.
adfabcd28292e19b6dfaa043af328f821be8615c.issues: Idealized QG system; partial-state input only; long-run statistics not detailed in the abstract.

a60e4fddfb54ea0e0d17caccf2cbb5da4af944f5.goal: Forecasts rare sudden stratospheric warmings, computing event probability and lead time from short simulations instead of long integrations.
