e03e4e870aebf1bd4eb9765e2a435a68d6622b58.issues: Accuracy depends on the quality of input temperature forecasts; utility-specific retraining is required and comparisons are mainly against earlier versions of the same system.

45499bae1643e5af75b7ce82378c993f818c9d44.goal: Compares neural network forecasting approaches for river flow, using the Nile River as a case study, to identify which input representations and forecast set-ups work best.
45499bae1643e5af75b7ce82378c993f818c9d44.architecture: Multilayer perceptron forecasters with different input preprocessing and forecasting strategies, compared against one another and simpler baselines.
45499bae1643e5af75b7ce82378c993f818c9d44.data: Historical Nile River flow records at an upstream gauging station; record length and split not reported here.
45499bae1643e5af75b7ce82378c993f818c9d44.result: Finds that the choice of input representation strongly affects accuracy and that suitably configured neural networks forecast flow well; exact error statistics not reproduced here.
45499bae1643e5af75b7ce82378c993f818c9d44.open_work: Testing on other rivers and including upstream rainfall or climate indices as inputs.
45499bae1643e5af75b7ce82378c993f818c9d44.issues: Single-river case study; lacks uncertainty estimates and comparisons with physically based hydrological models.

5d9303e786817227e90db9d61bd9a0a3d2659d2f.goal: Develops a cluster analysis technique to estimate how synoptic meteorological conditions control air and precipitation chemistry at a receptor site.
5d9303e786817227e90db9d61bd9a0a3d2659d2f.architecture: Non-hierarchical (k-means-type) cluster analysis of air-mass back trajectories; unsupervised statistical method, not a neural network.
5d9303e786817227e90db9d61bd9a0a3d2659d2f.data: Back trajectories arriving at Eskdalemuir, Scotland, combined with measurements of precipitation and air chemistry at the site.
5d9303e786817227e90db9d61bd9a0a3d2659d2f.result: Trajectory clusters separate air flows with distinct pollutant concentrations, showing that synoptic flow type explains much of the variability in deposition chemistry.
5d9303e786817227e90db9d61bd9a0a3d2659d2f.open_work: Application to other sites and longer records to examine trends and source-receptor relationships.
5d9303e786817227e90db9d61bd9a0a3d2659d2f.issues: Results depend on trajectory accuracy and on the subjective choice of the number of clusters; clustering on trajectories alone ignores vertical mixing and wet removal processes.

7c9f4cf739930c71c2488df6c53a8ec0a917e977.goal: Investigates whether combining discharge forecasts from several rainfall-runoff models yields better simulations than any single model.
7c9f4cf739930c71c2488df6c53a8ec0a917e977.architecture: Three combination methods: simple averaging, weighted averaging with least-squares weights, and a neural network (multilayer perceptron) combiner of the individual model outputs.
7c9f4cf739930c71c2488df6c53a8ec0a917e977.data: Daily rainfall-runoff records from multiple catchments with differing climates, each simulated by several rainfall-runoff models.
7c9f4cf739930c71c2488df6c53a8ec0a917e977.result: Combined outputs generally outperform the best individual model, with the neural network combination performing best overall.
7c9f4cf739930c71c2488df6c53a8ec0a917e977.open_work: Testing combination schemes with more diverse models and in real-time forecasting with updating.
7c9f4cf739930c71c2488df6c53a8ec0a917e977.issues: Gains depend on the diversity and quality of the member models; the neural combiner adds parameters and risks overfitting on short records.

dccb2baf38dd637c0b5201e4c3befee415db7b41.goal: Provides an operational algorithm for retrieving optically complex Case II water constituents from MERIS ocean colour data, where simple band-ratio methods fail.
dccb2baf38dd637c0b5201e4c3befee415db7b41.architecture: Multilayer perceptron trained to emulate the inverse of a radiative transfer model, mapping top-of-atmosphere or water-leaving reflectances to water constituent concentrations.
dccb2baf38dd637c0b5201e4c3befee415db7b41.data: Large set of simulated MERIS reflectances generated with a radiative transfer model over ranges of chlorophyll, suspended matter and yellow substance.
dccb2baf38dd637c0b5201e4c3befee415db7b41.result: The network reproduces the inverse model accurately and is fast enough for operational processing of MERIS data.
dccb2baf38dd637c0b5201e4c3befee415db7b41.open_work: Validation against in situ match-ups once MERIS data become available and extension to coupled atmosphere-water retrievals.
dccb2baf38dd637c0b5201e4c3befee415db7b41.issues: Trained only on simulations, so accuracy depends on the realism of the bio-optical and radiative transfer model; pre-launch study without real-data validation.

5f1d464fa3d7d71cbb7de3fa3e7e6381e6356f98.goal: Maps fractional snow-covered area in mountainous terrain at subpixel resolution from Landsat TM imagery, needed for snowmelt hydrology.
5f1d464fa3d7d71cbb7de3fa3e7e6381e6356f98.architecture: Spectral mixture analysis combined with a binary regression (decision) tree that predicts snow fraction from TM band reflectances.
5f1d464fa3d7d71cbb7de3fa3e7e6381e6356f98.data: Landsat Thematic Mapper scenes over montane terrain in the Sierra Nevada, with higher-resolution reference data for validation.
5f1d464fa3d7d71cbb7de3fa3e7e6381e6356f98.result: Produces automated subpixel snow-cover maps with good agreement with reference snow fractions; exact error values not reproduced here.
5f1d464fa3d7d71cbb7de3fa3e7e6381e6356f98.open_work: Extension to other sensors with more frequent revisit and to other mountain ranges.
5f1d464fa3d7d71cbb7de3fa3e7e6381e6356f98.issues: Accuracy is affected by illumination, terrain shading, vegetation and cloud; the tree is trained on specific scenes and may not transfer.

476e75bccd6be38a9e5dc9090b999427850d40a7.goal: Predicts wind speed for wind energy applications using neural networks as an alternative to statistical time series models.
476e75bccd6be38a9e5dc9090b999427850d40a7.architecture: Multilayer perceptron trained with backpropagation on lagged wind speeds, compared with an autoregressive model.
476e75bccd6be38a9e5dc9090b999427850d40a7.data: Daily mean wind speed records from a station in Saudi Arabia; period not reported here.
476e75bccd6be38a9e5dc9090b999427850d40a7.result: The neural network gives lower prediction errors than the autoregressive model.
476e75bccd6be38a9e5dc9090b999427850d40a7.open_work: Multi-step and hourly forecasting and inclusion of other meteorological predictors.
476e75bccd6be38a9e5dc9090b999427850d40a7.issues: Single-site, univariate study with short horizons; no uncertainty quantification.

9ae7e653c93fc24043bbef98e504b1ea5ffb6a77.goal: Improves short-term wind speed and wind power forecasts by exploiting spatial correlation between wind measurements at neighbouring sites.
9ae7e653c93fc24043bbef98e504b1ea5ffb6a77.architecture: Spatial correlation forecasting model using upwind-site measurements to predict wind at a downwind site; the learning component is not reliably known here.
9ae7e653c93fc24043bbef98e504b1ea5ffb6a77.data: Wind speed measurements from neighbouring sites; locations and period not reported here.
9ae7e653c93fc24043bbef98e504b1ea5ffb6a77.result: Reports improvement over persistence forecasts at short lead times; details not reproduced here.
9ae7e653c93fc24043bbef98e504b1ea5ffb6a77.open_work: Testing over more site pairs and terrain types and integration with numerical weather prediction.
9ae7e653c93fc24043bbef98e504b1ea5ffb6a77.issues: Depends on prevailing wind direction and site spacing; gains likely limited to short horizons.

47b5960c1d00e2ddb84cc4fbf9938feb097cc836.goal: Presents ANNSTLF, a neural network based short-term electric load forecasting system developed for practical use by electric utilities.
47b5960c1d00e2ddb84cc4fbf9938feb097cc836.architecture: Multilayer perceptron based system with multiple neural network modules whose forecasts are combined adaptively, using load and weather inputs.
47b5960c1d00e2ddb84cc4fbf9938feb097cc836.data: Historical hourly load and temperature (and related weather) data from a number of electric utilities; periods not reported here.
47b5960c1d00e2ddb84cc4fbf9938feb097cc836.result: Shows accurate hourly load forecasts across many utilities, supporting operational deployment; exact error figures not reproduced here.
47b5960c1d00e2ddb84cc4fbf9938feb097cc836.open_work: Improved handling of holidays and extreme weather and reduced sensitivity to weather forecast errors.
47b5960c1d00e2ddb84cc4fbf9938feb097cc836.issues: Relies on accurate weather forecasts; evaluated mainly on utilities' own data without standard benchmarks.

f8c0cdb3a5885f86092dec0b112ce8df97de78e1.goal: Forecasts river stage in real time for flood warning using artificial neural networks.
f8c0cdb3a5885f86092dec0b112ce8df97de78e1.architecture: Feedforward multilayer perceptron trained with different algorithms (error backpropagation, conjugate gradient and cascade correlation), compared with each other and a statistical model.
f8c0cdb3a5885f86092dec0b112ce8df97de78e1.data: Hourly or daily river stage records from a river in India; period not reported here.
f8c0cdb3a5885f86092dec0b112ce8df97de78e1.result: Neural networks forecast river stage well for short lead times, outperforming the statistical benchmark; training algorithm choice affects speed more than accuracy.
f8c0cdb3a5885f86092dec0b112ce8df97de78e1.open_work: Longer lead times, inclusion of rainfall inputs and testing on more rivers.
f8c0cdb3a5885f86092dec0b112ce8df97de78e1.issues: Single-basin study; accuracy degrades with lead time and for extreme floods outside the training range.

844f6292c8e5a4177eb6efa349b897ba1b93854c.goal: Retrieves vertical profiles of temperature, water vapour and cloud liquid water from ground-based multichannel microwave radiometer observations.
844f6292c8e5a4177eb6efa349b897ba1b93854c.architecture: Comparison of inversion methods including statistical regression, a neural network and physical iterative (Bayesian/Newtonian) retrievals.
844f6292c8e5a4177eb6efa349b897ba1b93854c.data: Ground-based microwave radiometer brightness temperatures with radiosonde profiles for training and validation.
844f6292c8e5a4177eb6efa349b897ba1b93854c.result: Profiles are retrieved with useful accuracy in the lower troposphere, with neural network and regression methods performing comparably; details not reproduced here.
844f6292c8e5a4177eb6efa349b897ba1b93854c.open_work: Combining radiometry with other sensors to improve vertical resolution and cloud liquid retrieval.
844f6292c8e5a4177eb6efa349b897ba1b93854c.issues: Vertical resolution degrades with height; statistical retrievals depend on the representativeness of the radiosonde training climatology.

420c9de95283c62980520b8b95b22ee61607014e.goal: Models and synthesizes multivariate water resources time series such as reservoir inflows with artificial neural networks.
420c9de95283c62980520b8b95b22ee61607014e.architecture: Feedforward multilayer perceptron trained with backpropagation, compared with a multivariate autoregressive statistical model.
420c9de95283c62980520b8b95b22ee61607014e.data: Monthly inflow series to two reservoirs in India.
420c9de95283c62980520b8b95b22ee61607014e.result: The neural network models fit and forecast the multivariate series better than the autoregressive model.
420c9de95283c62980520b8b95b22ee61607014e.open_work: Application to more sites and longer forecast horizons.
420c9de95283c62980520b8b95b22ee61607014e.issues: Short records and few series; no uncertainty quantification and limited testing on independent periods.

b3c71b8f9a960d3449c0cdd4713d9246dd80e5d6.goal: Predicts short-term SO2 concentrations in a polluted industrial area of complex terrain, where dispersion models perform poorly.
b3c71b8f9a960d3449c0cdd4713d9246dd80e5d6.architecture: Multilayer perceptron trained with backpropagation on meteorological and emission-related inputs.
b3c71b8f9a960d3449c0cdd4713d9246dd80e5d6.data: Automatic monitoring network measurements of SO2 and meteorology around the Šoštanj thermal power plant in Slovenia.
b3c71b8f9a960d3449c0cdd4713d9246dd80e5d6.result: The neural network gives useful half-hourly SO2 forecasts and captures pollution episodes better than simple alternatives.
b3c71b8f9a960d3449c0cdd4713d9246dd80e5d6.open_work: Improved input selection and extension to other pollutants and sites.
b3c71b8f9a960d3449c0cdd4713d9246dd80e5d6.issues: Site-specific model; limited ability to extrapolate to unusual emission or meteorological conditions.

086faccdc822c6a23331e33b99418db91bd938a1.goal: Identifies snow cover globally from passive microwave measurements, separating snow from other scattering surfaces such as precipitation, cold desert and frozen ground.
086faccdc822c6a23331e33b99418db91bd938a1.architecture: Non-ML decision-tree (threshold) algorithm based on scattering indices from multiple SSM/I channels.
086faccdc822c6a23331e33b99418db91bd938a1.data: SSM/I brightness temperatures with comparisons against snow cover analyses.
086faccdc822c6a23331e33b99418db91bd938a1.result: The algorithm identifies global snow cover consistent with independent snow maps while screening out confounding scatterers.
086faccdc822c6a23331e33b99418db91bd938a1.open_work: Retrieval of snow depth or water equivalent and improved detection of shallow and wet snow.
086faccdc822c6a23331e33b99418db91bd938a1.issues: Misses shallow and wet snow; coarse resolution and threshold choices limit accuracy in some regions.

e11b6f557c667c54b0baf9b13ee30a9875e2616e.goal: Classifies cloud types in satellite imagery using neural networks applied to textural features.
e11b6f557c667c54b0baf9b13ee30a9875e2616e.architecture: Backpropagation neural network (multilayer perceptron) using texture features, compared with statistical classifiers.
e11b6f557c667c54b0baf9b13ee30a9875e2616e.data: Landsat Multispectral Scanner imagery samples of stratocumulus, cumulus and cirrus clouds.
e11b6f557c667c54b0baf9b13ee30a9875e2616e.result: The neural network achieves high classification accuracy, exceeding traditional statistical classification methods.
e11b6f557c667c54b0baf9b13ee30a9875e2616e.open_work: Larger and more varied training samples and more cloud classes.
e11b6f557c667c54b0baf9b13ee30a9875e2616e.issues: Small sample of scenes; classes limited to a few cloud types; texture features from one sensor.

6b3199e824d2d2a3000f609186a658bc4baaec80.goal: Forecasts short-term electric load using neural networks with faster and more reliable training.
6b3199e824d2d2a3000f609186a658bc4baaec80.architecture: Multilayer perceptron trained with an adaptive learning algorithm that adjusts the momentum during training.
6b3199e824d2d2a3000f609186a658bc4baaec80.data: Historical hourly load and temperature data from the Taiwan Power system.
6b3199e824d2d2a3000f609186a658bc4baaec80.result: The adaptive algorithm speeds convergence over standard backpropagation and the network forecasts load accurately.
6b3199e824d2d2a3000f609186a658bc4baaec80.open_work: Handling of holidays and special days and extension to other utilities.
6b3199e824d2d2a3000f609186a658bc4baaec80.issues: Single-utility evaluation; dependence on temperature forecasts; error statistics not standardized.

3b2e585c7dc6f237dc52bcaf2b4424feecfcfc4a.goal: Develops a generalized knowledge-based short-term load forecasting technique transferable across utilities and weather regimes.
3b2e585c7dc6f237dc52bcaf2b4424feecfcfc4a.architecture: Expert system (rule-based) using weather-load relationships and forecaster knowledge, not a neural network.
3b2e585c7dc6f237dc52bcaf2b4424feecfcfc4a.data: Historical load and weather data from several utilities in different regions.
3b2e585c7dc6f237dc52bcaf2b4424feecfcfc4a.result: The technique gives accurate forecasts across different utilities with limited site-specific tuning.
3b2e585c7dc6f237dc52bcaf2b4424feecfcfc4a.open_work: Automatic adaptation of rules and combination with learning methods.
3b2e585c7dc6f237dc52bcaf2b4424feecfcfc4a.issues: Rule base requires expert knowledge and maintenance; performance on unusual days depends on rule coverage.

581f892dd78b961baa992dd2e611257a8e82278c.goal: Predicts daily maximum ozone concentration in an industrialized urban area to support air quality warnings.
581f892dd78b961baa992dd2e611257a8e82278c.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network compared with regression and Box-Jenkins ARIMA models.
581f892dd78b961baa992dd2e611257a8e82278c.data: Daily ozone and meteorological observations from an industrialized urban area in Texas; period not reported here.
581f892dd78b961baa992dd2e611257a8e82278c.result: The neural network outperforms the regression and ARIMA models in forecasting daily maximum ozone.
581f892dd78b961baa992dd2e611257a8e82278c.open_work: Testing with forecast rather than observed meteorological inputs and at other sites.
581f892dd78b961baa992dd2e611257a8e82278c.issues: Single-site study; few high-ozone episodes for training; limited interpretability.

8d505446bbe12d51647b84429ac597345984e1dd.goal: Forecasts short-term electric load of the Taiwan power system by encoding operator knowledge into an expert system.
8d505446bbe12d51647b84429ac597345984e1dd.architecture: Expert system (rule-based) built from operator heuristics and load-weather relationships, not a neural network.
8d505446bbe12d51647b84429ac597345984e1dd.data: Historical hourly load and weather data from the Taiwan Power Company.
8d505446bbe12d51647b84429ac597345984e1dd.result: The expert system produces accurate hourly load forecasts, comparable to or better than conventional statistical methods.
8d505446bbe12d51647b84429ac597345984e1dd.open_work: Automatic rule learning and handling of special days.
8d505446bbe12d51647b84429ac597345984e1dd.issues: Knowledge acquisition is labor-intensive and rules are system specific.

ac468711948132630dfb7459cb338a57dd057256.goal: Estimates sea surface chlorophyll and suspended sediment concentrations in coastal waters from Landsat TM imagery.
ac468711948132630dfb7459cb338a57dd057256.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network mapping TM band radiances to constituent concentrations, compared with regression methods.
ac468711948132630dfb7459cb338a57dd057256.data: Landsat Thematic Mapper imagery of Delaware Bay with concurrent in situ chlorophyll and sediment measurements.
ac468711948132630dfb7459cb338a57dd057256.result: The neural network gives lower errors than regression-based algorithms for both chlorophyll and sediments.
ac468711948132630dfb7459cb338a57dd057256.open_work: Application to more scenes, seasons and sensors with better spectral resolution.
ac468711948132630dfb7459cb338a57dd057256.issues: Limited in situ match-ups; TM bands are not designed for ocean colour; atmospheric correction uncertainties.

cece2530f0ef37af0bfbcdc75889fb20be222c7b.goal: Assesses, through simulations, how well land surface albedo can be retrieved from satellite observations.
cece2530f0ef37af0bfbcdc75889fb20be222c7b.architecture: Retrieval algorithms developed from radiative transfer simulations; the specific inversion method is not reliably known here.
cece2530f0ef37af0bfbcdc75889fb20be222c7b.data: Simulated surface and top-of-atmosphere reflectances from radiative transfer models.
cece2530f0ef37af0bfbcdc75889fb20be222c7b.open_work: Validation with real satellite data and field albedo measurements.
cece2530f0ef37af0bfbcdc75889fb20be222c7b.issues: Simulation-only study, so performance depends on the realism of the modeled surfaces and atmospheres.

88fb3d9c878dc3eb9971eefb757a807d7f77de20.goal: Forecasts short-term electric load while compensating for the influence of weather.
88fb3d9c878dc3eb9971eefb757a807d7f77de20.architecture: Neural network implementing a nonlinear autoregressive integrated model with weather compensation inputs.
88fb3d9c878dc3eb9971eefb757a807d7f77de20.data: Hourly load and weather data from a power system in Hong Kong; period not reported here.
88fb3d9c878dc3eb9971eefb757a807d7f77de20.result: Including weather compensation improves load forecasting accuracy over models without it.
88fb3d9c878dc3eb9971eefb757a807d7f77de20.open_work: Better weather inputs and handling of holidays.
88fb3d9c878dc3eb9971eefb757a807d7f77de20.issues: Single-system evaluation; dependence on weather forecasts.

19751a7c686a589c8a3b478c73dcf997d6f6b7e0.goal: Forecasts short-term electric load using fuzzy neural networks that combine rule interpretability with learning.
19751a7c686a589c8a3b478c73dcf997d6f6b7e0.architecture: Fuzzy neural network (fuzzy logic rules with neural network training) taking past loads and temperatures as inputs.
19751a7c686a589c8a3b478c73dcf997d6f6b7e0.data: Hourly load and temperature data from the Greek power system.
19751a7c686a589c8a3b478c73dcf997d6f6b7e0.result: The fuzzy neural network forecasts load accurately and compares favorably with a multilayer perceptron.
19751a7c686a589c8a3b478c73dcf997d6f6b7e0.open_work: Automatic rule generation and extension to longer horizons.
19751a7c686a589c8a3b478c73dcf997d6f6b7e0.issues: Single-system study; dependence on temperature forecasts.

5c508c04c74ec11a3e989dc6d7d011e8b1bcced3.goal: Forecasts weather-sensitive short-term electric load using a neural network with reduced connectivity.
5c508c04c74ec11a3e989dc6d7d011e8b1bcced3.architecture: Nonfully connected artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) using load and weather inputs.
5c508c04c74ec11a3e989dc6d7d011e8b1bcced3.data: Historical hourly load and weather data from an electric utility; details not reported here.
5c508c04c74ec11a3e989dc6d7d011e8b1bcced3.result: The nonfully connected network forecasts load accurately with fewer weights and faster training than fully connected alternatives.
5c508c04c74ec11a3e989dc6d7d011e8b1bcced3.open_work: Testing on additional utilities and extreme weather periods.
5c508c04c74ec11a3e989dc6d7d011e8b1bcced3.issues: Single-utility evaluation; network structure chosen by hand.

4e4b5e915db54b0a6c8291a8dcb9222e9528b6f2.goal: Implements a hybrid short-term load forecasting system for a national power system, combining learning with expert knowledge.
4e4b5e915db54b0a6c8291a8dcb9222e9528b6f2.architecture: Hybrid of artificial neural networks (multilayer perceptron) for base load forecasting and a fuzzy expert system for adjustment.
4e4b5e915db54b0a6c8291a8dcb9222e9528b6f2.data: Hourly load and temperature data from the Korea Electric Power Corporation system.
4e4b5e915db54b0a6c8291a8dcb9222e9528b6f2.result: The hybrid system reduces forecast errors relative to the neural network alone, especially on special days.
4e4b5e915db54b0a6c8291a8dcb9222e9528b6f2.open_work: Further automation of fuzzy rule tuning.
4e4b5e915db54b0a6c8291a8dcb9222e9528b6f2.issues: Fuzzy rules are system-specific and require expert input.

76fb1ea5927fa52aa8e9a5683d419d435563c62f.goal: Applies genetic programming to discover explicit rainfall-runoff model equations from data.
76fb1ea5927fa52aa8e9a5683d419d435563c62f.architecture: Genetic programming (evolutionary algorithm evolving symbolic expressions), compared with an artificial neural network and a conceptual model.
76fb1ea5927fa52aa8e9a5683d419d435563c62f.data: Rainfall and runoff records from the Kirkton catchment in Scotland.
76fb1ea5927fa52aa8e9a5683d419d435563c62f.result: The evolved models perform comparably to or better than the conceptual model and the neural network, while yielding explicit equations.
76fb1ea5927fa52aa8e9a5683d419d435563c62f.open_work: Testing on more catchments and incorporating physical constraints on evolved models.
76fb1ea5927fa52aa8e9a5683d419d435563c62f.issues: Single-catchment study; evolved expressions may be complex and lack physical interpretability.

4f46484cc6c9f1b19e066819f714abaf1ca431bd.goal: Forecasts runoff using radial basis function networks with an efficient training algorithm.
4f46484cc6c9f1b19e066819f714abaf1ca431bd.architecture: Radial basis function (RBF) network trained with the orthogonal least squares algorithm, compared with a multilayer perceptron and statistical models.
4f46484cc6c9f1b19e066819f714abaf1ca431bd.data: Hourly rainfall and runoff data from a catchment in Japan.
4f46484cc6c9f1b19e066819f714abaf1ca431bd.result: The RBF network forecasts runoff with accuracy comparable to or better than the alternatives, with faster training.
4f46484cc6c9f1b19e066819f714abaf1ca431bd.open_work: Longer lead times and other catchments.
4f46484cc6c9f1b19e066819f714abaf1ca431bd.issues: Single-catchment study; limited testing on extreme events.

3b142d57f80805386e7284e0014322156b74b9b2.goal: Develops an adaptive modular neural network hourly load forecaster and implements it at electric utilities.
3b142d57f80805386e7284e0014322156b74b9b2.architecture: Multilayer perceptron modules (weekly, daily and hourly) whose forecasts are merged by an adaptive combiner.
3b142d57f80805386e7284e0014322156b74b9b2.data: Hourly load and weather data from several electric utilities.
3b142d57f80805386e7284e0014322156b74b9b2.result: The modular forecaster gives accurate hourly forecasts and was implemented operationally at utilities.
3b142d57f80805386e7284e0014322156b74b9b2.open_work: Improving accuracy on holidays and extreme weather days.
3b142d57f80805386e7284e0014322156b74b9b2.issues: Dependence on weather forecast quality; utility-specific retraining required.

25af34322251636be0b8c27e578218db0af83fb9.goal: Predicts which radar-detected circulations will be associated with tornadoes, to improve tornado warnings.
25af34322251636be0b8c27e578218db0af83fb9.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network using Doppler radar-derived attributes, compared with rule-based, discriminant analysis and logistic regression methods.
25af34322251636be0b8c27e578218db0af83fb9.data: Attributes from the NSSL mesocyclone detection algorithm applied to WSR-88D Doppler radar data, with tornado reports as ground truth.
25af34322251636be0b8c27e578218db0af83fb9.result: The neural network outperforms the rule-based algorithm and statistical methods on several skill scores.
25af34322251636be0b8c27e578218db0af83fb9.open_work: Larger datasets, additional attributes and probabilistic outputs.
25af34322251636be0b8c27e578218db0af83fb9.issues: Limited number of tornado cases; results depend on the detection algorithm and attribute quality.

1b89c36edc6f0ab71cb3ceaa7decd6c595b68fc0.goal: Estimates rainfall from multichannel remotely sensed imagery using neural networks.
1b89c36edc6f0ab71cb3ceaa7decd6c595b68fc0.architecture: Modified counterpropagation network combining a self-organizing feature map with a Grossberg linear output layer (the PERSIANN approach).
1b89c36edc6f0ab71cb3ceaa7decd6c595b68fc0.data: Geostationary infrared satellite imagery with ground radar or gauge rainfall data for training and validation.
1b89c36edc6f0ab71cb3ceaa7decd6c595b68fc0.result: The network produces rainfall estimates more accurate than conventional infrared techniques.
1b89c36edc6f0ab71cb3ceaa7decd6c595b68fc0.open_work: Including microwave data and online adaptive training.
1b89c36edc6f0ab71cb3ceaa7decd6c595b68fc0.issues: Infrared-based estimates are indirectly related to rainfall; performance varies by region and season.

07db59341fc3d948c1506f55b787e5b1a28a2d15.goal: Identifies large-scale circulation anomalies associated with extreme precipitation in northeastern Mexico and southeastern Texas and derives daily station rainfall from them, a statistical downscaling problem.
07db59341fc3d948c1506f55b787e5b1a28a2d15.architecture: Principal component analysis combined with a self-organizing map (Kohonen network) to classify circulation patterns, plus a feed-forward artificial neural network to downscale daily rainfall.
07db59341fc3d948c1506f55b787e5b1a28a2d15.data: NCEP-NCAR reanalysis atmospheric fields as predictors and daily station precipitation records in the study region; exact period not reported here.
07db59341fc3d948c1506f55b787e5b1a28a2d15.result: Distinct circulation anomaly types are linked to extreme rainfall events, and the neural network reproduces daily rainfall variability, though magnitudes of extremes are harder to capture.
07db59341fc3d948c1506f55b787e5b1a28a2d15.open_work: Testing on other seasons and regions, and applying the downscaling to climate model output for scenario projections.
07db59341fc3d948c1506f55b787e5b1a28a2d15.issues: Downscaling relationships are calibrated on a limited reanalysis period and assume stationarity; extremes are rare in the training sample.

7c891012b7846d7090cf279faa86ca9ff9befb88.goal: Derives general operating policies for reservoir releases that capture optimal behaviour without rerunning optimization each period.
7c891012b7846d7090cf279faa86ca9ff9befb88.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (backpropagation neural network) trained on optimal release sequences from dynamic programming, compared with regression-based and stochastic dynamic programming policies.
7c891012b7846d7090cf279faa86ca9ff9befb88.data: Historical inflow and storage records for an irrigation reservoir in southern India (Aliyar), used to generate dynamic programming optimal releases.
7c891012b7846d7090cf279faa86ca9ff9befb88.result: The neural network policy reproduces the optimal releases better than the regression-based and stochastic dynamic programming alternatives in simulated operation.
7c891012b7846d7090cf279faa86ca9ff9befb88.open_work: Extending to multi-reservoir systems and adding inflow forecasts as inputs.
7c891012b7846d7090cf279faa86ca9ff9befb88.issues: Single reservoir case study; the policy can only be as good as the deterministic optimization it imitates and may not generalize to unseen inflow regimes.

d2e9ec016f6ef821c1bc4a140c44afb9f16dc2ae.goal: Examines which features matter for classifying cloud types in satellite imagery with case-based learning, where irrelevant features degrade performance.
d2e9ec016f6ef821c1bc4a140c44afb9f16dc2ae.architecture: Case-based (k-nearest neighbour, instance-based) classifier combined with sequential feature selection algorithms (forward and backward selection, beam search variants) in an empirical comparison.
d2e9ec016f6ef821c1bc4a140c44afb9f16dc2ae.data: Labelled AVHRR cloud samples with many spectral and textural features compiled by Bankert; sample counts not reported here.
d2e9ec016f6ef821c1bc4a140c44afb9f16dc2ae.result: Feature selection substantially reduces the feature set while maintaining or improving classification accuracy, with backward-style search tending to perform well.
d2e9ec016f6ef821c1bc4a140c44afb9f16dc2ae.open_work: Comparison with other classifiers and more efficient feature selection for large feature sets.
d2e9ec016f6ef821c1bc4a140c44afb9f16dc2ae.issues: Results depend on a single expert-labelled cloud dataset; feature search is computationally expensive and may overfit the evaluation data.

853a4467860867e84db149d7ef26c6bee7f9ff64.goal: Studies cloud classification from multispectral geostationary satellite imagery and which spectral and textural features best separate cloud types.
853a4467860867e84db149d7ef26c6bee7f9ff64.architecture: Neural network classifiers applied to spectral features and textural features (e.g., gray-level co-occurrence and transform-based texture measures), compared across feature sets.
853a4467860867e84db149d7ef26c6bee7f9ff64.data: GOES-8 multispectral imagery with expert-labelled cloud samples; exact sample sizes not reported here.
853a4467860867e84db149d7ef26c6bee7f9ff64.result: Combining spectral and textural features improves classification accuracy over spectral features alone; specific accuracy figures not reported here.
853a4467860867e84db149d7ef26c6bee7f9ff64.open_work: Adding temporal information and testing over more regions and seasons.
853a4467860867e84db149d7ef26c6bee7f9ff64.issues: Depends on subjective expert labels and a limited set of scenes; generalization to other sensors and regions is untested.

a59b2fb9619096942b366fcf2f822a78c7a03c65.goal: Addresses how to choose input variables for artificial neural network short-term electric load forecasting, where weather and past load inputs strongly affect accuracy.
a59b2fb9619096942b366fcf2f822a78c7a03c65.architecture: Multilayer perceptron load forecaster with a systematic input selection procedure (based on k-nearest neighbour analysis of candidate inputs), with an ensemble of networks.
a59b2fb9619096942b366fcf2f822a78c7a03c65.data: Hourly load and weather (temperature) records from US electric utilities; exact periods not reported here.
a59b2fb9619096942b366fcf2f822a78c7a03c65.result: Selected input sets yield accurate day-ahead load forecasts with fewer inputs than ad hoc choices; specific error figures not reported here.
a59b2fb9619096942b366fcf2f822a78c7a03c65.open_work: Automating selection for other utilities and handling holidays and weather forecast errors.
a59b2fb9619096942b366fcf2f822a78c7a03c65.issues: Evaluated on few utilities; performance depends on the quality of temperature forecasts used operationally.

344a7c95611fff086a481c10688d74f9588d1523.goal: Uses dual-polarization radar measurements to identify hydrometeor types and other radar targets, improving interpretation of precipitation echoes.
344a7c95611fff086a481c10688d74f9588d1523.architecture: Non-ML method: interpretation of reflectivity and differential reflectivity (ZDR) signatures to discriminate rain, hail, snow, melting layer and non-meteorological targets.
344a7c95611fff086a481c10688d74f9588d1523.data: Dual-polarization S-band observations from the Chilbolton radar in southern England.
344a7c95611fff086a481c10688d74f9588d1523.result: Differential reflectivity combined with reflectivity distinguishes rain, ice and hail regions and non-meteorological echoes such as clutter and aircraft.
344a7c95611fff086a481c10688d74f9588d1523.open_work: Quantitative, automated classification schemes and validation with in situ hydrometeor observations.
344a7c95611fff086a481c10688d74f9588d1523.issues: Largely qualitative case-based identification without systematic in situ verification; ambiguities remain between some ice types.

69e3b6459b0ed485debd500e9d8bfa0c429ca482.goal: Automates cloud classification of satellite imagery over maritime regions to support analysts and forecasters.
69e3b6459b0ed485debd500e9d8bfa0c429ca482.architecture: Probabilistic neural network classifier using spectral and textural features from image samples, with feature selection to reduce the feature set.
69e3b6459b0ed485debd500e9d8bfa0c429ca482.data: AVHRR imagery samples over maritime regions labelled by experts into about ten cloud classes.
69e3b6459b0ed485debd500e9d8bfa0c429ca482.result: The probabilistic neural network achieves overall classification accuracy of roughly 80% on independent samples, with confusion mainly between similar cloud types.
69e3b6459b0ed485debd500e9d8bfa0c429ca482.open_work: Extending to other regions and sensors and adding multi-layer or nighttime classes.
69e3b6459b0ed485debd500e9d8bfa0c429ca482.issues: Relies on subjective expert labels and fixed-size sample boxes that may contain mixed cloud types.

69c446df7c5642aae1c00ec3087addcbf7076314.goal: Predicts daily solar radiation, an input often missing for crop simulation models, from routinely observed weather variables.
69c446df7c5642aae1c00ec3087addcbf7076314.data: Daily weather station records (maximum and minimum temperature, precipitation, day length or clear-sky radiation) from several locations in the southeastern United States.
69c446df7c5642aae1c00ec3087addcbf7076314.result: The neural network estimates daily solar radiation with reasonable accuracy from commonly available variables; specific error statistics not reported here.
69c446df7c5642aae1c00ec3087addcbf7076314.open_work: Testing at more locations and climates and comparing with empirical radiation models.
69c446df7c5642aae1c00ec3087addcbf7076314.issues: Few training sites; transferability to other climates and cloudy-day accuracy are uncertain.

1ca275199cdf2ae12e0e078aac4b324a9a17012d.goal: Retrieves shallow coastal water depth from airborne hyperspectral remote sensing of water-leaving radiance.
1ca275199cdf2ae12e0e078aac4b324a9a17012d.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (backpropagation neural network) mapping hyperspectral radiance spectra to depth.
1ca275199cdf2ae12e0e078aac4b324a9a17012d.data: AVIRIS hyperspectral imagery over Florida coastal sites (e.g., Tampa Bay and the Florida Keys) with surveyed bathymetry for training and testing.
1ca275199cdf2ae12e0e078aac4b324a9a17012d.result: The neural network retrieves depth in shallow waters with errors of a fraction of a metre over the training sites; specific values not reported here.
1ca275199cdf2ae12e0e078aac4b324a9a17012d.open_work: Generalization across sites, water types and bottom types, and application to satellite sensors.
1ca275199cdf2ae12e0e078aac4b324a9a17012d.issues: Trained per site, so sensitive to water clarity and bottom reflectance; limited to optically shallow water.

98a4eb7ce5bef4f98ce828ddda13d5c8352b907a.goal: Automates calibration of conceptual rainfall-runoff models, whose many interacting parameters make manual or local optimization unreliable.
98a4eb7ce5bef4f98ce828ddda13d5c8352b907a.architecture: Non-neural method: genetic algorithm combined with a local search method (sequential quadratic programming) for parameter optimization.
98a4eb7ce5bef4f98ce828ddda13d5c8352b907a.data: Conceptual rainfall-runoff model (ADM type) calibration tests with synthetic and observed rainfall-runoff series; details not reported here.
98a4eb7ce5bef4f98ce828ddda13d5c8352b907a.result: The hybrid genetic algorithm plus local search reliably locates the optimum parameter set, outperforming local search alone from random starts.
98a4eb7ce5bef4f98ce828ddda13d5c8352b907a.open_work: Analysis of objective-function choice and parameter identifiability, and comparison with other global optimizers.
98a4eb7ce5bef4f98ce828ddda13d5c8352b907a.issues: Computational cost is high and results depend on the objective function and model structure; equifinality is not fully addressed.

2af49947dca1f331d50b5ac87c49927dc527d838.goal: Improves river level forecasting by combining several soft computing techniques rather than relying on a single model.
2af49947dca1f331d50b5ac87c49927dc527d838.architecture: Hybrid of artificial neural networks, a self-organizing map for partitioning hydrological conditions, fuzzy logic and genetic algorithm-based model building.
2af49947dca1f331d50b5ac87c49927dc527d838.data: Hourly river level records from upstream gauging stations on the River Ouse, Yorkshire, UK.
2af49947dca1f331d50b5ac87c49927dc527d838.result: Hybrid and combined soft computing models give more accurate level forecasts than individual models and simple benchmarks such as persistence.
2af49947dca1f331d50b5ac87c49927dc527d838.open_work: Testing longer lead times, other catchments and adding rainfall inputs.
2af49947dca1f331d50b5ac87c49927dc527d838.issues: Single catchment study; the combination scheme adds complexity and extreme flood levels are rare in training data.

d15e86914d9e2588abccd21d5793ca7e8bb6646d.goal: Distinguishes clouds from snow and ice surfaces in polar satellite imagery, which is difficult with simple thresholds.
d15e86914d9e2588abccd21d5793ca7e8bb6646d.architecture: Pattern recognition classifier (maximum likelihood style supervised classification) using spectral and textural features of image samples.
d15e86914d9e2588abccd21d5793ca7e8bb6646d.data: AVHRR imagery over polar regions with expert-labelled samples covering many surface and cloud classes.
d15e86914d9e2588abccd21d5793ca7e8bb6646d.result: Combining spectral and textural features separates most surface and cloud types in polar scenes with good accuracy; specific figures not reported here.
d15e86914d9e2588abccd21d5793ca7e8bb6646d.open_work: Application to climatological cloud analysis and extension to more seasons and sensors.
d15e86914d9e2588abccd21d5793ca7e8bb6646d.issues: Depends on expert labelling and limited training scenes; low sun angles and thin cloud remain problematic.

e87d990a4bfd74746e2a2e424b7b6d0107aec751.goal: Supports cotton crop management decisions on irrigation, fertilization and harvest timing by coupling expert knowledge with crop simulation.
e87d990a4bfd74746e2a2e424b7b6d0107aec751.architecture: Expert system (rule-based) COMAX that drives the GOSSYM cotton crop simulation model to evaluate management options.
e87d990a4bfd74746e2a2e424b7b6d0107aec751.data: Farm-level weather data, soil information and weather scenarios feeding the GOSSYM simulator; field use on cotton farms.
e87d990a4bfd74746e2a2e424b7b6d0107aec751.result: COMAX was operational on commercial farms and is described as recommending irrigation and nitrogen management that can improve yields and reduce costs.
e87d990a4bfd74746e2a2e424b7b6d0107aec751.open_work: Integrating real-time weather forecasts and extending to other crops and decisions.
e87d990a4bfd74746e2a2e424b7b6d0107aec751.issues: Recommendations inherit the crop model's assumptions and depend on assumed future weather; limited formal quantitative evaluation.

1efef180029686dc7eed7992c55854dd743678ee.goal: Reports operational experience with neural network short-term electric load forecasting at a utility.
1efef180029686dc7eed7992c55854dd743678ee.architecture: Adaptive multilayer perceptron load forecaster that is retrained online as new data arrive.
1efef180029686dc7eed7992c55854dd743678ee.data: Hourly load and weather (temperature) data from an electric utility in the United States; periods not reported here.
1efef180029686dc7eed7992c55854dd743678ee.result: The adaptive neural network system gives forecast accuracy competitive with or better than the utility's existing methods in practice; specific errors not reported here.
1efef180029686dc7eed7992c55854dd743678ee.open_work: Improving forecasts for holidays and unusual weather.
1efef180029686dc7eed7992c55854dd743678ee.issues: Single utility experience; accuracy depends on weather forecast quality and special-day handling.

7df3f557b83e30f741eb1ab50c7d3a28391e7469.goal: Predicts seasonal rainfall anomalies in Northeast Brazil, where droughts have severe societal impact, from preceding ocean and atmosphere conditions.
7df3f557b83e30f741eb1ab50c7d3a28391e7469.architecture: Statistical prediction with stepwise multiple regression and discriminant analysis, also tested against a neural network approach.
7df3f557b83e30f741eb1ab50c7d3a28391e7469.data: Station rainfall indices for Northeast Brazil and preceding Atlantic and Pacific sea surface temperature and circulation indices over several decades.
7df3f557b83e30f741eb1ab50c7d3a28391e7469.result: Predictors from tropical Atlantic and Pacific conditions give useful skill for the rainy season; the neural network offers little clear advantage over linear methods.
7df3f557b83e30f741eb1ab50c7d3a28391e7469.open_work: Updating predictors and testing operational real-time forecasts.
7df3f557b83e30f741eb1ab50c7d3a28391e7469.issues: Short records limit nonlinear model training; skill estimates may be inflated by predictor screening.

96fb78eabf9632f24a4c92cd50e138f6c09b4182.goal: Investigates short-term (0-24 h) quantitative precipitation forecasting at point locations using artificial neural networks.
96fb78eabf9632f24a4c92cd50e138f6c09b4182.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (backpropagation neural network) compared with linear regression and persistence.
96fb78eabf9632f24a4c92cd50e138f6c09b4182.data: Hourly rain gauge data and upper-air wind information over the Middle Atlantic region of the United States.
96fb78eabf9632f24a4c92cd50e138f6c09b4182.result: The neural network outperforms linear regression and persistence for short lead times, especially for moderate and heavy precipitation events.
96fb78eabf9632f24a4c92cd50e138f6c09b4182.open_work: Adding radar and model predictors and extending lead times.
96fb78eabf9632f24a4c92cd50e138f6c09b4182.issues: Point forecasts at limited gauges; skill decreases quickly with lead time and heavy events are sparse.

3df2274be988dacedeadd4655bd433181468ff87.goal: Compares methods for classifying clouds and surface types in polar AVHRR imagery, where cloud and snow/ice are spectrally similar.
3df2274be988dacedeadd4655bd433181468ff87.architecture: Intercomparison of classification methods, including statistical classifiers and a neural network, using spectral and textural features.
3df2274be988dacedeadd4655bd433181468ff87.data: AVHRR imagery over polar regions with expert-labelled samples.
3df2274be988dacedeadd4655bd433181468ff87.result: Neural network and statistical classifiers achieve comparable and generally good accuracy; specific values not reported here.
3df2274be988dacedeadd4655bd433181468ff87.open_work: Combining methods and testing across seasons and regions.
3df2274be988dacedeadd4655bd433181468ff87.issues: Limited labelled samples and subjective labels; results may depend on chosen feature sets.

4cd6d0118a24b63f64c07675aa5c0004d5bb65b5.goal: Develops nonparametric forecasting of streamflow from rainfall without specifying a physical or parametric model.
4cd6d0118a24b63f64c07675aa5c0004d5bb65b5.architecture: Nearest-neighbour (k-nearest neighbour) nonparametric regression for rainfall-runoff forecasting.
4cd6d0118a24b63f64c07675aa5c0004d5bb65b5.data: Historical rainfall and runoff records from river basins; specific catchments not reported here.
4cd6d0118a24b63f64c07675aa5c0004d5bb65b5.result: Nearest-neighbour forecasts perform comparably to or better than parametric time series models for the tested data.
4cd6d0118a24b63f64c07675aa5c0004d5bb65b5.open_work: Larger data sets and multi-step forecasting with additional predictors.
4cd6d0118a24b63f64c07675aa5c0004d5bb65b5.issues: Requires long records to find similar past states and cannot extrapolate to unprecedented events.

1e7bdee0d84306f8fd974fcfe5751119ad6f5143.goal: Assesses how climate change could alter stream hydrology and ecologically relevant flow characteristics.
1e7bdee0d84306f8fd974fcfe5751119ad6f5143.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) rainfall-runoff model driven by precipitation and temperature.
1e7bdee0d84306f8fd974fcfe5751119ad6f5143.data: Daily precipitation, temperature and streamflow records from contrasting US streams, with climate change scenarios applied to inputs.
1e7bdee0d84306f8fd974fcfe5751119ad6f5143.result: Simulated changes in precipitation and temperature produce substantial shifts in flow regime metrics relevant to stream ecology, differing between streams.
1e7bdee0d84306f8fd974fcfe5751119ad6f5143.open_work: Physically based comparison models and links to biological response data.
1e7bdee0d84306f8fd974fcfe5751119ad6f5143.issues: Scenarios are simple perturbations; an empirical neural model may not extrapolate to climates outside training conditions.

a81e4226b3868efb0822ef8fe33d45814bd7d79a.goal: Classifies catchments into hydrologically homogeneous regions for regional flood frequency estimation.
a81e4226b3868efb0822ef8fe33d45814bd7d79a.architecture: Self-organizing map (Kohonen neural network) clustering catchments by their characteristics.
a81e4226b3868efb0822ef8fe33d45814bd7d79a.data: Catchment characteristics and flood statistics for gauged catchments in the UK (southwest England and Wales).
a81e4226b3868efb0822ef8fe33d45814bd7d79a.result: The self-organizing map yields groupings that are reasonably homogeneous in flood statistics, supporting regionalization.
a81e4226b3868efb0822ef8fe33d45814bd7d79a.open_work: Testing regions in flood estimation for ungauged catchments and comparing with other clustering methods.
a81e4226b3868efb0822ef8fe33d45814bd7d79a.issues: Number of clusters and inputs is subjective; homogeneity testing is limited.

bf7b6794448ff659f03948ae768b2138473c13bd.goal: Optimizes rule-based reservoir operation for flood control.
bf7b6794448ff659f03948ae768b2138473c13bd.architecture: Non-neural method: real-coded genetic algorithm compared with binary-coded genetic algorithm for optimizing operating rules.
bf7b6794448ff659f03948ae768b2138473c13bd.data: Historical flood events for a reservoir in Taiwan (Shihmen).
bf7b6794448ff659f03948ae768b2138473c13bd.result: The real-coded genetic algorithm finds good operating rules faster and more reliably than the binary-coded genetic algorithm.
bf7b6794448ff659f03948ae768b2138473c13bd.open_work: Multi-reservoir and real-time application with inflow forecasts.
bf7b6794448ff659f03948ae768b2138473c13bd.issues: Few historical floods are used; results depend on the rule structure and objective weights.

98f3272b1a6a2edaafea0a1bac4b38c7816bc017.goal: Develops a neural network that adapts to changing conditions for short-term electric load forecasting.
98f3272b1a6a2edaafea0a1bac4b38c7816bc017.architecture: Adaptively trained multilayer perceptron that updates weights with recent data.
98f3272b1a6a2edaafea0a1bac4b38c7816bc017.data: Hourly load and temperature records from a US electric utility; periods not reported here.
98f3272b1a6a2edaafea0a1bac4b38c7816bc017.result: The adaptively trained network maintains forecasting accuracy over time better than a static network; specific errors not reported here.
98f3272b1a6a2edaafea0a1bac4b38c7816bc017.open_work: Better treatment of weekends and holidays and weather forecast uncertainty.
98f3272b1a6a2edaafea0a1bac4b38c7816bc017.issues: Single utility test and limited period; sensitivity to training choices not fully explored.

53d006dd5d952f1b2f27ad936422d6e78792f5e5.goal: Provides short-term forecasts of significant thunderstorm occurrence to support forecasters.
53d006dd5d952f1b2f27ad936422d6e78792f5e5.architecture: Two multilayer perceptron (backpropagation neural network) models whose outputs are combined into a thunderstorm forecast product.
53d006dd5d952f1b2f27ad936422d6e78792f5e5.data: Hourly surface observation analyses of lifted index and moisture convergence over the United States, verified against thunderstorm reports.
53d006dd5d952f1b2f27ad936422d6e78792f5e5.result: The neural network product gives useful 3-7 h thunderstorm forecasts and outperforms the individual input fields alone.
53d006dd5d952f1b2f27ad936422d6e78792f5e5.open_work: Adding further predictors such as upper-air and radar data.
53d006dd5d952f1b2f27ad936422d6e78792f5e5.issues: Depends on surface data analyses only and was verified over a limited period.

1acd98d60cc60151f0e5d683eba4546610d1563d.goal: Reviews the use of artificial neural networks for hydrological forecasting.
1acd98d60cc60151f0e5d683eba4546610d1563d.architecture: Review of artificial neural network applications (mainly multilayer perceptron) to rainfall-runoff, streamflow and other hydrological forecasting.
1acd98d60cc60151f0e5d683eba4546610d1563d.data: Review of published studies; no new data.
1acd98d60cc60151f0e5d683eba4546610d1563d.result: Neural networks are found to be promising for hydrological forecasting but practice in input selection, training and validation is inconsistent.
1acd98d60cc60151f0e5d683eba4546610d1563d.open_work: Standardized methodology, uncertainty estimation and physical interpretation of networks.
1acd98d60cc60151f0e5d683eba4546610d1563d.issues: Review written in French; reflects literature up to the late 1990s.

835a0e44aa68ad817de0adfee2f4873aaa80d716.goal: Predicts soil erosion in a large watershed where data are imprecise.
835a0e44aa68ad817de0adfee2f4873aaa80d716.architecture: Fuzzy logic inference system combining erosion factors.
835a0e44aa68ad817de0adfee2f4873aaa80d716.data: Soil, slope and land cover information for a large watershed in Arkansas (Illinois River basin) using GIS data.
835a0e44aa68ad817de0adfee2f4873aaa80d716.result: The fuzzy logic approach produces erosion classes broadly consistent with conventional erosion estimates.
835a0e44aa68ad817de0adfee2f4873aaa80d716.open_work: Field validation and integration with process-based erosion models.
835a0e44aa68ad817de0adfee2f4873aaa80d716.issues: Membership functions and rules are subjective; limited field validation.

7f9dac05fdbabae5bcdaf553c96dc9d2639c105a.goal: Evaluates global optimization methods for calibrating conceptual rainfall-runoff models.
7f9dac05fdbabae5bcdaf553c96dc9d2639c105a.architecture: Non-neural method: comparison of shuffled complex evolution, genetic algorithm and simulated annealing for parameter calibration.
7f9dac05fdbabae5bcdaf553c96dc9d2639c105a.data: Conceptual (tank-type) rainfall-runoff model with observed catchment data; details not reported here.
7f9dac05fdbabae5bcdaf553c96dc9d2639c105a.result: Shuffled complex evolution generally finds better parameter sets more efficiently than the genetic algorithm and simulated annealing.
7f9dac05fdbabae5bcdaf553c96dc9d2639c105a.open_work: Testing on more models and catchments and addressing parameter uncertainty.
7f9dac05fdbabae5bcdaf553c96dc9d2639c105a.issues: Limited to specific models and data; algorithm settings affect results.

644f6578f13173e17610d1f1a85ed647b2bda814.goal: Identifies unknown air pollution sources from concentrations measured at monitoring sites.
644f6578f13173e17610d1f1a85ed647b2bda814.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) trained to map receptor concentrations to source characteristics.
644f6578f13173e17610d1f1a85ed647b2bda814.data: Training data generated by an atmospheric dispersion model; details not reported here.
644f6578f13173e17610d1f1a85ed647b2bda814.result: The neural network identifies source locations and strengths from synthetic concentration patterns with reasonable accuracy.
644f6578f13173e17610d1f1a85ed647b2bda814.open_work: Testing with real monitoring data and more complex meteorology.
644f6578f13173e17610d1f1a85ed647b2bda814.issues: Trained on synthetic dispersion model output; real noise and model error untested.

d65526420f65247126fc0101fa4e69498cb0ad70.goal: Retrieves ocean surface wind speed from satellite microwave radiometer data more accurately, including in cloudy conditions.
d65526420f65247126fc0101fa4e69498cb0ad70.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network as a nonlinear transfer function from brightness temperatures to wind speed.
d65526420f65247126fc0101fa4e69498cb0ad70.data: SSM/I brightness temperatures collocated with buoy wind measurements.
d65526420f65247126fc0101fa4e69498cb0ad70.result: The neural network gives lower wind speed errors than existing regression algorithms, with better performance under moderate cloudiness and at high winds.
d65526420f65247126fc0101fa4e69498cb0ad70.open_work: Operational implementation and extension to other variables.
d65526420f65247126fc0101fa4e69498cb0ad70.issues: Validation limited to buoy matchups; heavy rain conditions remain difficult.

e260141de502a322a741e368350846b3757628b8.goal: Predicts all-India summer monsoon rainfall from preceding climate indicators.
e260141de502a322a741e368350846b3757628b8.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network compared with linear regression.
e260141de502a322a741e368350846b3757628b8.data: All-India rainfall series and preceding predictors such as ENSO-related indices over many decades.
e260141de502a322a741e368350846b3757628b8.result: The neural network improves forecast skill over linear regression in independent tests.
e260141de502a322a741e368350846b3757628b8.open_work: Adding predictors and ensembles of networks to reduce variance.
e260141de502a322a741e368350846b3757628b8.issues: Short record risks overfitting; skill estimates depend on validation design.

9d8502dabec76bbdd1eab33642fb50e0204e9434.goal: Forecasts hourly temperature for use in electric load forecasting.
9d8502dabec76bbdd1eab33642fb50e0204e9434.architecture: Artificial neural network hourly temperature forecaster (multilayer perceptron) feeding a load forecasting system.
9d8502dabec76bbdd1eab33642fb50e0204e9434.data: Hourly temperature and weather service forecasts from US utility locations; details not reported here.
9d8502dabec76bbdd1eab33642fb50e0204e9434.result: The neural network produces hourly temperature forecasts that improve load forecasting inputs; specific errors not reported here.
9d8502dabec76bbdd1eab33642fb50e0204e9434.open_work: Extending to other weather variables and locations.
9d8502dabec76bbdd1eab33642fb50e0204e9434.issues: Depends on available weather service forecasts; limited site testing.

a7bae1c515a0a591a738acfa07652955351fea30.goal: Models greenhouse climate (inside air temperature and humidity) from outside weather and control actions, as a data-driven alternative to physical greenhouse energy-balance models for climate control.
a7bae1c515a0a591a738acfa07652955351fea30.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) mapping external weather and greenhouse control inputs to internal climate variables.
a7bae1c515a0a591a738acfa07652955351fea30.data: Measured greenhouse climate and outside weather records from experimental greenhouses; specific sites and periods not reported here.
a7bae1c515a0a591a738acfa07652955351fea30.result: Neural network models reproduce greenhouse internal climate with useful accuracy; quantitative skill is not reported here.
a7bae1c515a0a591a738acfa07652955351fea30.open_work: Testing on other greenhouse types and seasons and coupling the models to climate-control or optimisation schemes.
a7bae1c515a0a591a738acfa07652955351fea30.issues: Data-driven models are tied to the greenhouse used for training and may not transfer; limited physical interpretability.

81d5f44c69b06aa8a2a0ce6a213bb186614e54d3.goal: Downscales large-scale climate to daily maximum and minimum temperature at stations in Portugal to build local climate change scenarios.
81d5f44c69b06aa8a2a0ce6a213bb186614e54d3.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) statistical downscaling from large-scale circulation and temperature predictors, compared with linear regression.
81d5f44c69b06aa8a2a0ce6a213bb186614e54d3.data: Observed daily station temperatures in Portugal with large-scale predictors; applied to general circulation model output (HadCM2) for climate change scenarios.
81d5f44c69b06aa8a2a0ce6a213bb186614e54d3.result: The neural network reproduces observed daily temperatures well and is applied to project local temperature changes under enhanced greenhouse forcing.
81d5f44c69b06aa8a2a0ce6a213bb186614e54d3.open_work: Extending the approach to precipitation and to multiple GCMs, and assessing stationarity of the predictor-predictand relationship.
81d5f44c69b06aa8a2a0ce6a213bb186614e54d3.issues: Downscaling inherits GCM biases in predictors and assumes the trained relationship holds under a changed climate; single-model scenarios.

da1d9c9f987fc66acc2ff294ed257f1f8a965b91.goal: Forecasts next-day daily insolation (solar irradiation) for solar energy system operation.
da1d9c9f987fc66acc2ff294ed257f1f8a965b91.architecture: Multi-stage artificial neural network in which successive networks refine the forecast from meteorological inputs.
da1d9c9f987fc66acc2ff294ed257f1f8a965b91.data: Daily meteorological observations and measured insolation at Japanese stations; exact predictors and period not reported here.
da1d9c9f987fc66acc2ff294ed257f1f8a965b91.result: The multi-stage network gives lower forecast error than a single-stage network for daily insolation; exact error values not reported here.
da1d9c9f987fc66acc2ff294ed257f1f8a965b91.open_work: Testing at more sites and climates and integrating forecasts into photovoltaic or solar-thermal operation planning.
da1d9c9f987fc66acc2ff294ed257f1f8a965b91.issues: Daily-total forecasts only; site-specific training and limited predictor set constrain generality.

36ce2990e5212be7f1ebadc99a7a487d494ffad0.goal: Forecasts ENSO by predicting Niño-region sea surface temperature anomalies at seasonal leads with compact predictors.
36ce2990e5212be7f1ebadc99a7a487d494ffad0.architecture: Feedforward neural network (multilayer perceptron) with inputs from extended empirical orthogonal functions (EEOFs) of tropical Pacific sea level pressure and SST fields.
36ce2990e5212be7f1ebadc99a7a487d494ffad0.data: Observed tropical Pacific sea level pressure and SST anomaly fields, with Niño 3.4 SST anomalies as targets; hindcasts over several decades.
36ce2990e5212be7f1ebadc99a7a487d494ffad0.result: EEOF-based inputs reduce network size and give useful Niño 3.4 forecast skill at leads up to about a year, competitive with other ENSO models of the time.
36ce2990e5212be7f1ebadc99a7a487d494ffad0.open_work: Adding subsurface ocean information and ensemble approaches to stabilise and extend skill.
36ce2990e5212be7f1ebadc99a7a487d494ffad0.issues: Short training record relative to number of ENSO events, risk of overfitting and spring predictability barrier; no uncertainty estimates.

c0a31f27c658d8b0144f2908f4ad5078e6d72c2b.goal: Analyses and predicts summer daily maximum surface ozone in Canadian regions (Vancouver, Montreal, Atlantic) from meteorological conditions for air-quality forecasting.
c0a31f27c658d8b0144f2908f4ad5078e6d72c2b.architecture: Classification and regression tree (CART) decision-tree statistical analysis relating ozone maxima to meteorological predictors.
c0a31f27c658d8b0144f2908f4ad5078e6d72c2b.data: Observed surface ozone and meteorological observations or analyses for Vancouver, Montreal and Atlantic Canada summer seasons.
c0a31f27c658d8b0144f2908f4ad5078e6d72c2b.result: CART trees identify key meteorological controls (e.g. temperature and transport-related variables) and provide skilful ozone predictions; exact scores not reported here.
c0a31f27c658d8b0144f2908f4ad5078e6d72c2b.open_work: Operational implementation using forecast model predictors and extension to other regions and pollutants.
c0a31f27c658d8b0144f2908f4ad5078e6d72c2b.issues: Single-tree models are unstable to data changes and give piecewise-constant predictions; performance depends on forecast predictor quality.

eaa58a22e9772e12180ae73199b0177b5a4f266d.goal: Forecasts equatorial Pacific SST anomalies (Niño regions) at seasonal leads to predict ENSO.
eaa58a22e9772e12180ae73199b0177b5a4f266d.architecture: Feedforward neural network (multilayer perceptron) using principal components of tropical Pacific wind stress and SST as predictors.
eaa58a22e9772e12180ae73199b0177b5a4f266d.data: Observed tropical Pacific wind stress and SST anomaly fields with Niño region SST anomaly targets over several decades.
eaa58a22e9772e12180ae73199b0177b5a4f266d.result: Neural networks achieve useful Niño SST forecast skill at leads of several months to about a year, with wind stress predictors important at longer leads.
eaa58a22e9772e12180ae73199b0177b5a4f266d.open_work: Improving predictors (e.g. sea level pressure, heat content) and reducing network overfitting.
eaa58a22e9772e12180ae73199b0177b5a4f266d.issues: Few ENSO events for training, possible overfitting and sensitivity to initial weights; no probabilistic output.

e8e0e95d1d5a27062fa481d855ef69d62896535c.goal: Models and forecasts time series of atmospheric pollutant concentrations measured near industrial areas.
e8e0e95d1d5a27062fa481d855ef69d62896535c.architecture: Neural network techniques (multilayer perceptron and related networks) for nonlinear time-series modelling, compared with linear autoregressive models.
e8e0e95d1d5a27062fa481d855ef69d62896535c.data: Air pollution monitoring time series, likely with meteorological inputs, from monitoring stations in Italy; details not reported here.
e8e0e95d1d5a27062fa481d855ef69d62896535c.result: Neural models capture nonlinear pollutant dynamics and perform comparably or better than linear models; numbers not reported here.
e8e0e95d1d5a27062fa481d855ef69d62896535c.open_work: Multi-step forecasting and inclusion of emission and meteorological forecasts.
e8e0e95d1d5a27062fa481d855ef69d62896535c.issues: Site-specific evaluation; neural model selection and generalisation are not systematically addressed.

27ea41a6b08f1989f1eb608f7ae9d8bbd1e53532.goal: Analyses how a passing cloud affects a grid-interactive photovoltaic system with battery storage to support system operation.
27ea41a6b08f1989f1eb608f7ae9d8bbd1e53532.architecture: Artificial neural network used to model and predict the photovoltaic system response to irradiance fluctuations.
27ea41a6b08f1989f1eb608f7ae9d8bbd1e53532.data: Measured irradiance and photovoltaic/battery system data from an experimental installation; details not reported here.
27ea41a6b08f1989f1eb608f7ae9d8bbd1e53532.result: The neural network captures the system response to cloud-induced irradiance drops; quantitative accuracy not reported here.
27ea41a6b08f1989f1eb608f7ae9d8bbd1e53532.open_work: Extending to longer records, multiple cloud events and real-time control.
27ea41a6b08f1989f1eb608f7ae9d8bbd1e53532.issues: Single-installation study with limited events; generalisation to other systems is untested.

53ebe8d4e3d1406b1ba22d7f34b21a2e5f585cbe.goal: Estimates surface rainfall rate from radar observations, aiming to avoid the limitations of fixed reflectivity-rainfall (Z-R) relations.
53ebe8d4e3d1406b1ba22d7f34b21a2e5f585cbe.architecture: Feedforward neural network (multilayer perceptron) mapping radar measurements (reflectivity and polarimetric variables) to rain rate.
53ebe8d4e3d1406b1ba22d7f34b21a2e5f585cbe.data: Ground-based weather radar observations collocated with rain gauge measurements from a field campaign; details not reported here.
53ebe8d4e3d1406b1ba22d7f34b21a2e5f585cbe.result: The neural network rainfall estimates agree better with gauges than conventional Z-R based estimates.
53ebe8d4e3d1406b1ba22d7f34b21a2e5f585cbe.open_work: Testing across different climatic regimes and radars, and real-time implementation.
53ebe8d4e3d1406b1ba22d7f34b21a2e5f585cbe.issues: Training depends on gauge-radar matching errors and limited events; transferability to other regions is uncertain.

7476870044ca2adddc0ae9a016381ef81fcba89c.goal: Compares global optimisation techniques for automatic calibration of conceptual rainfall-runoff model parameters.
7476870044ca2adddc0ae9a016381ef81fcba89c.architecture: Global optimisation algorithms including genetic algorithm and shuffled complex evolution (SCE-UA), combined with local search, applied to a conceptual rainfall-runoff model.
7476870044ca2adddc0ae9a016381ef81fcba89c.data: Synthetic and observed rainfall-runoff series for test catchments; details not reported here.
7476870044ca2adddc0ae9a016381ef81fcba89c.result: Algorithms differ in efficiency and reliability; SCE-UA is generally the most efficient and robust for finding the global optimum.
7476870044ca2adddc0ae9a016381ef81fcba89c.open_work: Treating parameter uncertainty and equifinality and multi-objective calibration.
7476870044ca2adddc0ae9a016381ef81fcba89c.issues: Results depend on the chosen model and objective function; computational cost of genetic algorithms is high.

1f496422cd9482da921611236187a8867d157636.goal: Models the rainfall-runoff transformation with a neural network as an alternative to conceptual hydrological models.
1f496422cd9482da921611236187a8867d157636.data: Rainfall and runoff series, possibly including synthetic data from a catchment model; details not reported here.
1f496422cd9482da921611236187a8867d157636.result: RBF networks reproduce runoff with useful accuracy and train faster than backpropagation networks; numbers not reported here.
1f496422cd9482da921611236187a8867d157636.open_work: Testing on more catchments and longer real records.
1f496422cd9482da921611236187a8867d157636.issues: Limited evaluation; black-box model with uncertain extrapolation to extreme events.

29090cdd0d842080d31ac3c826efb7f8d7b823fe.goal: Forecasts short-term electric load, accounting for weather influences on demand.
29090cdd0d842080d31ac3c826efb7f8d7b823fe.architecture: Nonlinear autoregressive integrated neural network (NARI) combining autoregressive load inputs with weather variables.
29090cdd0d842080d31ac3c826efb7f8d7b823fe.data: Historical hourly load and weather records from a utility; details not reported here.
29090cdd0d842080d31ac3c826efb7f8d7b823fe.result: The neural model improves short-term load forecast accuracy over conventional approaches; numbers not reported here.
29090cdd0d842080d31ac3c826efb7f8d7b823fe.open_work: Incorporating weather forecast uncertainty and testing over more seasons and utilities.
29090cdd0d842080d31ac3c826efb7f8d7b823fe.issues: Single-system evaluation; dependence on weather inputs whose forecasts carry error.

0b10e5fec741349ea44e2750fe2cb9a64a3a7a54.goal: Reconstructs past sea surface temperatures from fossil planktonic foraminiferal assemblages for paleoceanography.
0b10e5fec741349ea44e2750fe2cb9a64a3a7a54.architecture: Feedforward neural network (multilayer perceptron, backpropagation) as a transfer function, compared with conventional transfer function methods.
0b10e5fec741349ea44e2750fe2cb9a64a3a7a54.data: Core-top planktonic foraminiferal assemblages with modern SST for training; applied to down-core sediment data.
0b10e5fec741349ea44e2750fe2cb9a64a3a7a54.result: Neural networks give SST estimates with errors comparable to or lower than conventional transfer functions.
0b10e5fec741349ea44e2750fe2cb9a64a3a7a54.open_work: Applying to more cores and ocean basins and estimating reconstruction uncertainty.
0b10e5fec741349ea44e2750fe2cb9a64a3a7a54.issues: Calibration limited by core-top data coverage and no-analogue assemblages; uncertainty not fully quantified.

0a4ae48aed4c9280c19081e07632e57263660cab.goal: Defines climate zones of Puerto Rico objectively from station climate data.
0a4ae48aed4c9280c19081e07632e57263660cab.architecture: Principal components analysis combined with an artificial neural network classifier for climate zonation.
0a4ae48aed4c9280c19081e07632e57263660cab.data: Station temperature and precipitation climatologies across Puerto Rico.
0a4ae48aed4c9280c19081e07632e57263660cab.result: PCA and neural network classification identify distinct climate zones that reflect the island's temperature and rainfall gradients; exact skill not reported here.
0a4ae48aed4c9280c19081e07632e57263660cab.open_work: Using denser station networks and assessing zone changes over time.
0a4ae48aed4c9280c19081e07632e57263660cab.issues: Limited number of stations; zonation depends on chosen variables and classification thresholds.

0d4c3bf32bd8f5ad0e2e2fd339c7b1c47b9b4127.goal: Improves peak-flow forecasting by calibrating the Storm Water Management Model (SWMM) automatically.
0d4c3bf32bd8f5ad0e2e2fd339c7b1c47b9b4127.architecture: Genetic algorithm used to calibrate SWMM parameters, coupled with the physically based SWMM model.
0d4c3bf32bd8f5ad0e2e2fd339c7b1c47b9b4127.data: Observed rainfall and runoff events from an urban catchment; details not reported here.
0d4c3bf32bd8f5ad0e2e2fd339c7b1c47b9b4127.result: Genetic algorithm calibration yields SWMM parameter sets that reproduce peak flows well; numbers not reported here.
0d4c3bf32bd8f5ad0e2e2fd339c7b1c47b9b4127.open_work: Multi-event and multi-objective calibration and validation on independent storms.
0d4c3bf32bd8f5ad0e2e2fd339c7b1c47b9b4127.issues: Few calibration events; parameter non-uniqueness and computational cost of the search.

24f38e2fd8199c26c65e93980051da9679fb655b.goal: Automates electric utility load forecasting by capturing forecaster expertise, including weather effects on load.
24f38e2fd8199c26c65e93980051da9679fb655b.architecture: Expert system (rule-based) assistant combined with statistical load forecasting methods.
24f38e2fd8199c26c65e93980051da9679fb655b.data: Historical load and weather data of an electric utility; details not reported here.
24f38e2fd8199c26c65e93980051da9679fb655b.result: The system automates routine load forecasts with accuracy comparable to human forecasters; numbers not reported here.
24f38e2fd8199c26c65e93980051da9679fb655b.open_work: Extending the knowledge base and adapting to changing load patterns.
24f38e2fd8199c26c65e93980051da9679fb655b.issues: Rule bases are labour-intensive to maintain and site-specific; limited quantitative evaluation.

41bdb4303d4d5d74e8b8e7f102152e26cf16b604.goal: Assesses how changing seasonal climate may modify river discharge and export of dissolved organic carbon and nitrogen in eastern Canada.
41bdb4303d4d5d74e8b8e7f102152e26cf16b604.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) relating seasonal temperature and precipitation to hydrological and chemical exports.
41bdb4303d4d5d74e8b8e7f102152e26cf16b604.data: Long-term river discharge and water chemistry records from eastern Canadian rivers with climate data; applied to climate change scenarios.
41bdb4303d4d5d74e8b8e7f102152e26cf16b604.result: Neural networks predict discharge and DOC and nitrogen exports and indicate sensitivity to seasonal climate shifts; numbers not reported here.
41bdb4303d4d5d74e8b8e7f102152e26cf16b604.open_work: Including land-use and vegetation changes and more basins.
41bdb4303d4d5d74e8b8e7f102152e26cf16b604.issues: Extrapolation beyond observed climate is uncertain; black-box models lack process representation.

5b5416a71a9bfdd7123d81e930dbba1fdbd9ff1e.goal: Retrieves ocean surface wind vectors from spaceborne scatterometer backscatter by learning the nonlinear transfer function.
5b5416a71a9bfdd7123d81e930dbba1fdbd9ff1e.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural networks modelling the scatterometer transfer function and inverting it for wind speed and direction.
5b5416a71a9bfdd7123d81e930dbba1fdbd9ff1e.data: Simulated and/or collocated ERS-1 scatterometer backscatter with reference winds; details not reported here.
5b5416a71a9bfdd7123d81e930dbba1fdbd9ff1e.result: Neural networks retrieve wind speed and direction accurately and handle the nonlinear, multi-valued inversion better than empirical approaches.
5b5416a71a9bfdd7123d81e930dbba1fdbd9ff1e.open_work: Application to operational scatterometer data and ambiguity removal.
5b5416a71a9bfdd7123d81e930dbba1fdbd9ff1e.issues: Performance depends on the representativeness of training data and reference winds.

b0ea2386d1997b12851132b1af41b720ff39aa6e.goal: Predicts variations in discharge and dissolved organic carbon and nitrogen export from terrestrial basins under changes in climate.
b0ea2386d1997b12851132b1af41b720ff39aa6e.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) linking climate variables and basin characteristics to discharge and export.
b0ea2386d1997b12851132b1af41b720ff39aa6e.data: Observed discharge and water chemistry for Canadian basins with climate data; applied to climate scenarios.
b0ea2386d1997b12851132b1af41b720ff39aa6e.result: Neural networks model discharge and DOC/N export well and suggest export changes with climate warming; numbers not reported here.
b0ea2386d1997b12851132b1af41b720ff39aa6e.open_work: Validation on more basins and finer temporal resolution.
b0ea2386d1997b12851132b1af41b720ff39aa6e.issues: Extrapolation under climate change is uncertain; limited process interpretability.

878876772d2ae79d77e06a7dfe36e68a87d05c51.goal: Forecasts daily maximum ozone levels in Santiago, Chile for air-quality management.
878876772d2ae79d77e06a7dfe36e68a87d05c51.architecture: Comparison of linear models, artificial neural networks and fuzzy models for one-day-ahead ozone maximum forecasts.
878876772d2ae79d77e06a7dfe36e68a87d05c51.data: Ozone and meteorological measurements from Santiago monitoring stations; details not reported here.
878876772d2ae79d77e06a7dfe36e68a87d05c51.result: Nonlinear neural network and fuzzy models outperform linear models in forecasting ozone maxima and exceedances.
878876772d2ae79d77e06a7dfe36e68a87d05c51.open_work: Using meteorological forecast inputs and extending to more stations.
878876772d2ae79d77e06a7dfe36e68a87d05c51.issues: Limited data period and stations; extreme episodes are few.

5f8422cfcc5f6b3734d85face12326a88324144e.goal: Predicts two-year peak stream discharges for ungauged basins from basin characteristics.
5f8422cfcc5f6b3734d85face12326a88324144e.architecture: Feedforward neural network (multilayer perceptron) compared with regression equations.
5f8422cfcc5f6b3734d85face12326a88324144e.data: Basin characteristics and peak discharge statistics from USGS gauged basins in the United States.
5f8422cfcc5f6b3734d85face12326a88324144e.result: Neural networks predict two-year peak discharges with accuracy comparable to or better than regional regression.
5f8422cfcc5f6b3734d85face12326a88324144e.open_work: Extending to other return periods and including climate variables.
5f8422cfcc5f6b3734d85face12326a88324144e.issues: Regionally limited training data and black-box nature hinder interpretation.

ab7c6452a9287dcd8487482c0d37ebc3503b3710.goal: Classifies clouds automatically in global satellite imagery for climate studies.
ab7c6452a9287dcd8487482c0d37ebc3503b3710.architecture: Fuzzy logic classification of AVHRR pixels into clear, water cloud, ice cloud and multilayer categories.
ab7c6452a9287dcd8487482c0d37ebc3503b3710.data: Global AVHRR Global Area Coverage (GAC) data.
ab7c6452a9287dcd8487482c0d37ebc3503b3710.result: The fuzzy logic approach classifies cloud types consistently, with accuracy comparable to expert analysis on test scenes.
ab7c6452a9287dcd8487482c0d37ebc3503b3710.open_work: Application to longer records and improved multilayer cloud detection.
ab7c6452a9287dcd8487482c0d37ebc3503b3710.issues: Difficulty over snow, ice and at night; validation limited to expert-labelled scenes.

77916f3082bdbef70d8c1a35ef01bb97f7dd76d2.goal: Predicts runoff from rainfall with a neural network as an alternative to conventional hydrological models.
77916f3082bdbef70d8c1a35ef01bb97f7dd76d2.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a study catchment; details not reported here.
77916f3082bdbef70d8c1a35ef01bb97f7dd76d2.result: The neural network reproduces storm hydrographs reasonably well; numbers not reported here.
77916f3082bdbef70d8c1a35ef01bb97f7dd76d2.open_work: Testing on more storms and catchments.
77916f3082bdbef70d8c1a35ef01bb97f7dd76d2.issues: Small dataset and limited validation; extrapolation to extreme storms is uncertain.

ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.goal: Supports avalanche hazard forecasting by formalising expert knowledge.
ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.architecture: Expert system (rule-based) for regional avalanche forecasting.
ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.data: Snow, weather and avalanche observations from the Swiss Alps.
ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.result: The expert system produces avalanche danger assessments in good agreement with observed avalanche activity and human forecasts; exact rates not reported here.
ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.open_work: Refining rules and combining with statistical methods.
ea87f2e58b65dc7e7426c41faf5777400d3155f4.issues: Rule base depends on expert input; verification is difficult due to sparse avalanche records.

3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.goal: Estimates ocean chlorophyll concentration from satellite ocean colour reflectance.
3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.architecture: Feedforward neural network (multilayer perceptron) mapping remote sensing reflectances to chlorophyll.
3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.data: In situ bio-optical data with chlorophyll and water-leaving reflectances; details not reported here.
3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.result: The neural network improves chlorophyll estimates over standard band-ratio algorithms.
3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.open_work: Application to SeaWiFS imagery and coastal waters.
3fde9aa69be0e39a52f44c3cc0cdbacf1da0fb54.issues: Training data limited; performance in optically complex waters uncertain.
