d18bb890c049cf0df13aca2d7f1c6aba857b17e6.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the paper presents the GRNN as a viable tool for monthly flow forecasting.
d18bb890c049cf0df13aca2d7f1c6aba857b17e6.open_work: Testing on more basins, adding climatic predictors and comparing with other neural network types would clarify generality.
d18bb890c049cf0df13aca2d7f1c6aba857b17e6.issues: Single-variable data-driven approach with limited record length typical of monthly series; extrapolation beyond observed flows is uncertain.

b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.goal: Generates synthetic streamflow sequences for water resources planning that reproduce observed statistics, including nonlinear dependence, while allowing values outside the historical record.
b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.architecture: Nonparametric stochastic method, not a neural network: a local polynomial regression fit combined with K-nearest neighbour (K-NN) resampling of residuals, extending the traditional K-NN bootstrap.
b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.data: Annual natural streamflow series of the Colorado River at Lees Ferry; observed historical records.
b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.result: The modified K-NN model reproduces distributional statistics and dependence of the observed flows and, unlike plain K-NN bootstrap, generates flow values not seen in the historical record.
b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.open_work: Extension to multisite and seasonal or monthly simulation and conditioning on climate information are natural next steps.
b57319017b7183506ced0637d07fe28a296e1db3.issues: Demonstrated mainly on one basin's annual flows; resampling-based methods depend on record length and stationarity.

53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.goal: Estimates global precipitation rates from the Aqua satellite microwave and infrared sounders (AIRS, AMSU, HSB), extending sounder-based retrievals to precipitation.
53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.architecture: MLP neural network estimator using opaque microwave channels and principal components of sounder radiances as inputs, with physically motivated preprocessing.
53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.data: AIRS/AMSU/HSB observations from the Aqua satellite; neural network trained and evaluated against NEXRAD radar precipitation estimates.
53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.result: The neural network retrievals agree reasonably with NEXRAD precipitation rates at sounder resolution, demonstrating useful precipitation estimates from sounding instruments; detailed scores not reproduced here.
53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.open_work: Global validation beyond radar-covered regions, snow and light-rain sensitivity, and adaptation to later sounders remain open.
53b54b6f86067c568ed2d61773392c74c64c6333.issues: Training against NEXRAD over limited regions may not transfer to other climates or ocean areas; HSB failed early in the Aqua mission, limiting data.

12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.goal: Forecasts wind speed and direction jointly for wind energy applications by treating the wind vector as a complex-valued signal.
12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.architecture: Complex-valued recurrent neural network forecasting models that process wind speed and direction together as a complex number, compared with real-valued counterparts.
12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.data: Measured wind profile time series; site and period not reported in the available metadata.
12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.result: Complex-valued modelling of the wind vector improves forecasts compared with real-valued approaches treating speed and direction separately, according to the authors.
12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.open_work: Longer horizons, multiple sites and integration into wind power forecasting systems would test practical value.
12b244b3ff66965268dbb9b86a4d1c64a0835f18.issues: Limited data and short-term horizons; no probabilistic forecasts. Details of the evaluation are not reported in the available metadata.

c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.goal: Retrieves soil moisture from remotely sensed radar data and compares a neural network inversion with a Bayesian retrieval approach.
c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network inversion compared against a Bayesian estimation method for inverting backscatter to soil moisture.
c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.data: Remotely sensed SAR backscatter data with ground measurements of soil moisture; exact sensors and sites not reported in the available metadata.
c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.result: Both methods retrieve soil moisture with comparable accuracy; the paper discusses their relative strengths, with specifics not reported in the available metadata.
c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.open_work: Combining the two approaches, accounting for vegetation and roughness, and testing on more sites remain open.
c755d3995abaa28a467934106fd5fe307da9d859.issues: Ground truth is sparse; retrieval performance depends on surface roughness and vegetation conditions represented in the training data.

1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.goal: Improves automatic measurement of convective boundary layer depth from radar wind profilers, where simple signal-to-noise peak methods fail with clouds, birds or other contamination.
1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.architecture: Fuzzy logic method combining radar reflectivity (signal-to-noise ratio) and vertical velocity spectral width information to identify the boundary layer top; not a neural network.
1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.data: 915-MHz Doppler radar wind profiler observations, verified against radiosonde-derived boundary layer depths.
1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.result: The fuzzy logic algorithm gives boundary layer depths in better agreement with radiosondes than the standard signal-to-noise peak method, reducing gross errors.
1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.open_work: Adding further input variables (e.g. RASS temperature) and operational real-time deployment are natural extensions.
1252221e44c13a603464ef9acd2f54783250f7a8.issues: Tuned membership functions are site- and instrument-specific; performance under stable or multi-layer conditions is limited.

ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.goal: Forecasts solar irradiance for solar energy applications by combining time-frequency decomposition with recurrent neural networks.
ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.architecture: Recurrent neural network combined with wavelet analysis: the irradiance series is decomposed by wavelet transform and recurrent networks model the components.
ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.data: Measured solar irradiance time series; station and period not reported in the available metadata.
ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.result: The wavelet-recurrent network combination improves forecast accuracy compared with networks without wavelet preprocessing, according to the authors.
ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.open_work: Testing on more sites and horizons and adding meteorological inputs such as cloud forecasts are natural next steps.
ad97628192956b2c960075b166bd47e7fef525a6.issues: Single-site evaluation; wavelet decomposition may use future information if not applied causally, a common pitfall.

836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.goal: Improves satellite precipitation estimation by using multispectral geostationary imagery rather than infrared alone in the PERSIANN framework.
836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.architecture: PERSIANN-MSA: self-organizing feature map (SOFM) clustering of multispectral cloud features, with principal component analysis of inputs, followed by mapping clusters to rain rates.
836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.data: GOES-12 multispectral channels (visible and infrared bands) over the United States, with radar-based precipitation for training and validation.
836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.result: Using multispectral information improves rain/no-rain detection and rain-rate estimates relative to infrared-only estimation.
836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.open_work: Extending to newer geostationary imagers with more channels and merging with passive microwave data.
836d825f14e95cd4d9b9d3af5b810fe081b728d9.issues: Visible channels are only available in daytime; evaluated over a limited region and period.

5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.goal: Provides an operational algorithm for retrieving atmospheric trace gas columns (CO, CH4, O3) from the Infrared Atmospheric Sounding Interferometer before the instrument's launch.
5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) retrieval mapping simulated IASI radiances to trace gas total columns, designed for fast near-real-time processing.
5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.data: Simulated IASI spectra computed with a radiative transfer model from chemistry-transport model and climatological atmospheric profiles.
5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.result: The neural network retrieves total columns of the target gases with useful accuracy at a speed suitable for operational processing of IASI data.
5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.open_work: Validation with real IASI observations after launch and extension to more species.
5fd3e638ce7a447fe191b2a1af28b15986999916.issues: Developed on simulated data, so performance on real spectra with instrument and cloud effects was untested; no vertical profile information.

30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.goal: Addresses multi-step-ahead flood forecasting, where errors accumulate with lead time, for real-time flood warning.
30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.architecture: Comparison of static feedforward neural networks and dynamic recurrent neural networks for multi-step-ahead streamflow prediction.
30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.data: Hourly rainfall and discharge records from flood events in a Taiwanese catchment; details not reported in the available metadata.
30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.result: The recurrent (dynamic) network gives more accurate and stable multi-step-ahead forecasts than static networks.
30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.open_work: Longer lead times, uncertainty quantification and use of rainfall forecasts as inputs remain open.
30d9f2bb7873bb1d42d9ff9dbfe742bfd094bc27.issues: Limited number of flood events for training and testing; deterministic forecasts only.

1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.goal: Disaggregates annual streamflows into monthly flows at multiple sites while preserving space-time statistics, for basin-scale water resources simulation.
1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.architecture: Nonparametric K-nearest neighbour (K-NN) resampling-based disaggregation; a stochastic method, not a neural network.
1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.data: Naturalized monthly streamflow records at multiple gauges in the Upper Colorado River Basin.
1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.result: The technique reproduces monthly and annual statistics and spatial and temporal correlation across sites, and summability of disaggregated flows.
1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.open_work: Combination with paleo-reconstructed or climate-conditioned annual flows for planning scenarios.
1cb07268e6acef2b67126c68fda148a6e302ed52.issues: Resampling cannot generate monthly patterns absent from the historical record; assumes stationarity.

b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels for groundwater management in a hard-rock aquifer setting in India using artificial neural networks.
b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) trained with backpropagation-type algorithms on groundwater level and related inputs.
b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.data: Observed groundwater levels and associated hydrometeorological data from an Indian watershed; details not reported in the available metadata.
b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.result: The neural network forecasts groundwater levels with acceptable accuracy, according to the authors.
b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.open_work: Including pumping and recharge information and testing at more wells and longer horizons.
b1c263108322a5fc3f305976851ed2bb8ff6d262.issues: Short records and site-specific training limit transferability; no uncertainty estimates.

aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.goal: Forecasts daily river flows and compares artificial neural networks with classical auto-regressive time-series models.
aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward MLP) compared with auto-regressive (AR) models using lagged flows as inputs.
aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.data: Daily streamflow records from a river in Turkey; period not reported in the available metadata.
aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.result: The neural network models perform better than the auto-regressive models for daily flow forecasting, according to the author.
aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.open_work: Adding precipitation inputs and testing on more rivers and longer lead times.
aff2b36e9d05853c31f146e0cf2083ba7bf62979.issues: Single-river, flow-only inputs; extrapolation to extreme flows is uncertain.

636512b5deed72bdb3d09583e26ddcf8da1e17ea.goal: Predicts streamflow and related hydrologic variables at multiple gauging stations in an agricultural watershed and compares different artificial neural network models.
636512b5deed72bdb3d09583e26ddcf8da1e17ea.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural network model types for multi-station hydrologic prediction; the specific network types are not specified in the available metadata.
636512b5deed72bdb3d09583e26ddcf8da1e17ea.data: Hydrologic observations at multiple gauging stations in an agricultural watershed in the United States; details not reported in the available metadata.
636512b5deed72bdb3d09583e26ddcf8da1e17ea.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the comparison identifies which network configuration predicts best across stations.
636512b5deed72bdb3d09583e26ddcf8da1e17ea.open_work: Extension to water quality variables and to ungauged locations is a natural next step.
636512b5deed72bdb3d09583e26ddcf8da1e17ea.issues: Watershed-specific training; limited data for extreme events.

4abeca5362cccb15f0c75f15cb64a51259378a3c.goal: Predicts power ramp rates of a wind farm, important for grid operation and balancing, using data-mining methods.
4abeca5362cccb15f0c75f15cb64a51259378a3c.architecture: Data-mining approach comparing several machine learning algorithms, including neural networks (MLP), for predicting wind farm power ramp rates at short horizons.
4abeca5362cccb15f0c75f15cb64a51259378a3c.data: Wind farm SCADA power and wind speed data; site and period not reported in the available metadata.
4abeca5362cccb15f0c75f15cb64a51259378a3c.result: Data-mining models predict ramp rates at short horizons with useful accuracy, with accuracy declining as the horizon increases.
4abeca5362cccb15f0c75f15cb64a51259378a3c.open_work: Incorporating numerical weather prediction inputs to extend the horizon and probabilistic ramp forecasting.
4abeca5362cccb15f0c75f15cb64a51259378a3c.issues: Single wind farm; short horizons only; ramp events are rare, which limits evaluation.

73f5839e5cf283e81c1afa6f6b24fcda82ce0aae.goal: Improves real-time flood forecasts from a deterministic lumped rainfall-runoff model by forecasting short-term rainfall and updating the predicted discharge.
73f5839e5cf283e81c1afa6f6b24fcda82ce0aae.architecture: Time-series techniques: linear stochastic ARMA and ARIMA models compared with nonlinear artificial neural networks (ANNs) and the nearest-neighbours non-parametric regression method, used for rainfall forecasting and discharge updating.
73f5839e5cf283e81c1afa6f6b24fcda82ce0aae.data: Rainfall and discharge records for a catchment with a conceptual rainfall-runoff model; catchment details not given in the abstract.
73f5839e5cf283e81c1afa6f6b24fcda82ce0aae.result: Rainfall forecasting, discharge updating, and both in cascade improve discharge forecasts; ANN-based techniques give a remarkable improvement over heuristic rainfall prediction and the non-updated model.
73f5839e5cf283e81c1afa6f6b24fcda82ce0aae.open_work: Testing on more catchments and longer lead times, and quantifying forecast uncertainty.
73f5839e5cf283e81c1afa6f6b24fcda82ce0aae.issues: Single conceptual model and catchment; rainfall forecasting from time series alone has limited skill beyond short horizons.

2d70c5ab00d70531cfba5edb22e8360fa720d318.goal: Predicts watershed runoff and compares artificial neural networks with empirical approaches commonly used in practice.
2d70c5ab00d70531cfba5edb22e8360fa720d318.architecture: Artificial neural networks (network type not specified in the available metadata) compared with empirical rainfall-runoff methods.
2d70c5ab00d70531cfba5edb22e8360fa720d318.data: Rainfall and runoff observations from watersheds in Kansas, United States; details not reported in the available metadata.
2d70c5ab00d70531cfba5edb22e8360fa720d318.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the comparison assesses where neural networks outperform empirical methods for runoff prediction.
2d70c5ab00d70531cfba5edb22e8360fa720d318.open_work: Incorporating physical watershed information into networks and testing on more basins.
2d70c5ab00d70531cfba5edb22e8360fa720d318.issues: Data-driven models trained on limited watersheds and events; transferability uncertain.

48d08b7d143abfa1d68d0fadde4c6b0cb9fbc129.goal: Examines uncertainties in real-time flood forecasting with neural networks, including how well they handle events outside the training range.
48d08b7d143abfa1d68d0fadde4c6b0cb9fbc129.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward) rainfall-runoff forecasting models analysed for sensitivity to training data and forecast uncertainty.
48d08b7d143abfa1d68d0fadde4c6b0cb9fbc129.data: Rainfall and flow records from a catchment; details not reported in the available metadata.
48d08b7d143abfa1d68d0fadde4c6b0cb9fbc129.result: Neural network flood forecasts carry substantial uncertainty, notably for high flows poorly represented in training data, and their reliability depends on the training data.
48d08b7d143abfa1d68d0fadde4c6b0cb9fbc129.open_work: Methods to quantify predictive uncertainty and improve extrapolation to extreme floods.
48d08b7d143abfa1d68d0fadde4c6b0cb9fbc129.issues: Single catchment study; findings on uncertainty are qualitative rather than a full probabilistic framework.

2184d9bb2e5ee49d1318ae3f5d3d9eb03e948cc3.goal: Forecasts next-day hourly maximum ozone and threshold exceedances in an urban area of central France for real-time air quality warnings.
2184d9bb2e5ee49d1318ae3f5d3d9eb03e948cc3.architecture: MultiLayer Perceptron (MLP) neural network with a BIC-like regularisation and confidence intervals, plus an MLP neural classifier with sigmoid output giving exceedance probability, compared with logistic regression.
2184d9bb2e5ee49d1318ae3f5d3d9eb03e948cc3.data: Model output statistics of weather predictions from the French National Weather Service and ozone measurements from an urban air quality network; validation in summer 2003.
2184d9bb2e5ee49d1318ae3f5d3d9eb03e948cc3.result: Ozone peaks are predicted with agreement index 92%; the neural classifier reaches a 78% success index versus 65–72% for classical MLPs and detected six of seven peaks in summer 2003.
2184d9bb2e5ee49d1318ae3f5d3d9eb03e948cc3.open_work: Yearly retraining with new data, deployed operationally as NEUROZONE, to address the low frequency of exceedances.
2184d9bb2e5ee49d1318ae3f5d3d9eb03e948cc3.issues: Few exceedance events for training; single urban site; comparison with the chemistry-transport model is limited to one region.

d5c2f2eddcfe993e2b90e9d7f52e0efd38b70641.goal: Models the rainfall-runoff relationship using an artificial intelligence technique as an alternative to conventional approaches.
d5c2f2eddcfe993e2b90e9d7f52e0efd38b70641.architecture: Artificial intelligence based rainfall-runoff model; the specific method type is not specified in the available metadata.
d5c2f2eddcfe993e2b90e9d7f52e0efd38b70641.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a river basin; details not reported in the available metadata.
d5c2f2eddcfe993e2b90e9d7f52e0efd38b70641.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the method is presented as a viable alternative for rainfall-runoff modelling.
d5c2f2eddcfe993e2b90e9d7f52e0efd38b70641.open_work: Comparison across more basins and with physically based models.
d5c2f2eddcfe993e2b90e9d7f52e0efd38b70641.issues: Card based on title only; data-driven model trained on limited records.

baf2e661cebe52ca532b195350245cc30d7a45cf.goal: Simulates runoff and sediment yield from a watershed, which are difficult to model physically, using support vector machines.
baf2e661cebe52ca532b195350245cc30d7a45cf.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression compared with artificial neural network models for runoff and sediment yield simulation.
baf2e661cebe52ca532b195350245cc30d7a45cf.data: Monsoon-season rainfall, runoff and sediment yield observations from a watershed in India; details not reported in the available metadata.
baf2e661cebe52ca532b195350245cc30d7a45cf.result: SVM models simulate runoff and sediment yield with performance comparable to or better than the neural network models, according to the authors.
baf2e661cebe52ca532b195350245cc30d7a45cf.open_work: Testing on more watersheds and including land-use and soil information.
baf2e661cebe52ca532b195350245cc30d7a45cf.issues: Small watershed dataset; sediment observations are sparse and noisy.

43f90f3cc3bbdaeb26889ef82371e4eaf8b4e6df.goal: Downscales monthly surface temperature to a river basin in India for IPCC SRES scenarios and examines how the choice of predictors affects projections.
43f90f3cc3bbdaeb26889ef82371e4eaf8b4e6df.architecture: Least-squares support vector machine (SVM) statistical downscaling model relating large-scale atmospheric predictors to station temperatures, tested with different predictor sets.
43f90f3cc3bbdaeb26889ef82371e4eaf8b4e6df.data: NCEP/NCAR reanalysis predictors for calibration and CGCM3 GCM output for SRES A1B, A2, B1 and COMMIT scenarios; observed temperatures for the Malaprabha basin, India.
43f90f3cc3bbdaeb26889ef82371e4eaf8b4e6df.result: Including additional predictors such as humidity-related variables changes and improves downscaled temperatures; projected maximum and minimum temperatures increase under the SRES scenarios.
43f90f3cc3bbdaeb26889ef82371e4eaf8b4e6df.open_work: Using multiple GCMs and quantifying downscaling uncertainty.
43f90f3cc3bbdaeb26889ef82371e4eaf8b4e6df.issues: Single GCM and basin; assumes stationarity of predictor-predictand relationships; reanalysis biases propagate.

d766a9aa826045573b31e09d40baadcec22a543d.goal: Retrieves atmospheric and oceanic properties over optically complex Case-2 coastal waters from MERIS imagery, where standard algorithms fail.
d766a9aa826045573b31e09d40baadcec22a543d.architecture: Neural network (MLP) inversion of radiative transfer simulations for atmospheric correction and retrieval of water constituents (chlorophyll, suspended matter, yellow substance), implemented in the BEAM toolbox.
d766a9aa826045573b31e09d40baadcec22a543d.data: Radiative transfer simulations of coupled atmosphere-ocean system for training; ENVISAT MERIS measurements and in-situ data for evaluation.
d766a9aa826045573b31e09d40baadcec22a543d.result: The processor provides atmospheric correction and Case-2 water constituent retrievals with reasonable agreement against in-situ measurements.
d766a9aa826045573b31e09d40baadcec22a543d.open_work: Further validation in diverse coastal waters and regional tuning of inherent optical properties.
d766a9aa826045573b31e09d40baadcec22a543d.issues: Trained on simulations, so performance depends on the representativeness of the bio-optical model; validation data are limited.

20bdf4729d6be6287d8e32bbab5f99c7105748b7.goal: Forecasts hourly reservoir inflow during typhoon-warning periods in Taiwan, when accurate inflow is critical for reservoir flood operation.
20bdf4729d6be6287d8e32bbab5f99c7105748b7.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression models with typhoon characteristics and rainfall as inputs, compared with backpropagation neural networks.
20bdf4729d6be6287d8e32bbab5f99c7105748b7.data: Hourly reservoir inflow, rainfall and typhoon data from typhoon events affecting a reservoir in Taiwan; details not reported in the available metadata.
20bdf4729d6be6287d8e32bbab5f99c7105748b7.result: SVM-based models give more accurate hourly inflow forecasts than the neural network benchmark, and adding typhoon characteristics improves longer-lead forecasts.
20bdf4729d6be6287d8e32bbab5f99c7105748b7.open_work: Extension to longer lead times and use of quantitative precipitation forecasts.
20bdf4729d6be6287d8e32bbab5f99c7105748b7.issues: Limited number of typhoon events; deterministic forecasts without uncertainty.

1390996b4000c9699d101fc3f4d421a4d2497988.goal: Estimates near-shore swell conditions economically by driving models from an offshore global wave model rather than running full nearshore simulations everywhere.
1390996b4000c9699d101fc3f4d421a4d2497988.architecture: Data-driven linear regression and artificial neural network (nonlinear) models compared with the spectral wave simulation model SWAN.
1390996b4000c9699d101fc3f4d421a4d2497988.data: NOAA WaveWatch3 global wind-wave model output offshore and near-shore wave observations at 17 locations around Australia over a 7-month period.
1390996b4000c9699d101fc3f4d421a4d2497988.result: The ANNs outperform SWAN and the nonlinear architecture consistently beats the linear method; performance variability is explained by local wave transformation complexity.
1390996b4000c9699d101fc3f4d421a4d2497988.open_work: Longer records, more sites and forecasting at longer horizons.
1390996b4000c9699d101fc3f4d421a4d2497988.issues: Only 7 months of data; site-specific empirical models need local observations for training.

72a69588cbc745fd22efd41078634a3ce284ca71.goal: Predicts sediment loss from an Indian watershed and compares artificial neural networks with regression models.
72a69588cbc745fd22efd41078634a3ce284ca71.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward MLP) compared with regression models for sediment loss prediction.
72a69588cbc745fd22efd41078634a3ce284ca71.data: Rainfall, runoff and sediment observations from the Banha watershed in India; period not reported in the available metadata.
72a69588cbc745fd22efd41078634a3ce284ca71.result: The neural network predicts sediment loss more accurately than the regression models, according to the authors.
72a69588cbc745fd22efd41078634a3ce284ca71.open_work: Including geomorphological and land-use inputs and testing on other watersheds.
72a69588cbc745fd22efd41078634a3ce284ca71.issues: Small single-watershed dataset; limited events for training and validation.

601e769f7eddc7c860c6dc265cac97723a518841.goal: Introduces the fuzzy lattice reasoning classifier and applies it to estimating ambient ozone levels for air quality management.
601e769f7eddc7c860c6dc265cac97723a518841.architecture: Fuzzy lattice reasoning (FLR) classifier, a rule-based fuzzy method operating on lattices of intervals, compared with other classifiers.
601e769f7eddc7c860c6dc265cac97723a518841.data: Ambient air quality and meteorological measurements from monitoring stations; details not reported in the available metadata.
601e769f7eddc7c860c6dc265cac97723a518841.result: The FLR classifier estimates ozone levels with accuracy competitive with established classifiers while producing interpretable rules.
601e769f7eddc7c860c6dc265cac97723a518841.open_work: Application to other pollutants and to forecasting rather than estimation.
601e769f7eddc7c860c6dc265cac97723a518841.issues: Classification into discrete ozone levels rather than continuous concentrations; limited dataset.

409391d7c6b62bb5ef00cfe25087bd8730ba5424.goal: Estimates direct runoff over watersheds by embedding geomorphologic information into neural network structure to make it more physically interpretable.
409391d7c6b62bb5ef00cfe25087bd8730ba5424.architecture: Geomorphology-based artificial neural networks (GANNs) whose structure follows the geomorphologic instantaneous unit hydrograph concept, linking network weights to flow paths.
409391d7c6b62bb5ef00cfe25087bd8730ba5424.data: Rainfall and runoff observations from watersheds in Kansas, United States; details not reported in the available metadata.
409391d7c6b62bb5ef00cfe25087bd8730ba5424.result: GANNs estimate direct runoff well and offer more physical interpretation than purely black-box networks.
409391d7c6b62bb5ef00cfe25087bd8730ba5424.open_work: Extension to larger and ungauged basins and to continuous simulation.
409391d7c6b62bb5ef00cfe25087bd8730ba5424.issues: Demonstrated on few watersheds; requires geomorphological characterization.

85a96da2aea4fb1c942efbf2d2efa40b8c9218cd.goal: Incorporates spatially distributed satellite precipitation into ANN river flow forecasting for a large basin without full distributed hydrological modelling.
85a96da2aea4fb1c942efbf2d2efa40b8c9218cd.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) models with rainfall preprocessed using flow length and travel time information, compared across different hydrological preprocessing schemes.
85a96da2aea4fb1c942efbf2d2efa40b8c9218cd.data: Satellite-observed (remotely sensed) precipitation and local streamflow measurements for the Ganges river basin.
85a96da2aea4fb1c942efbf2d2efa40b8c9218cd.result: ANN forecasts discharge 3 days ahead with acceptable accuracy, where pre-processed rainfall has marginal influence; at 7–10 days it adds noticeable value though overall performance deteriorates.
85a96da2aea4fb1c942efbf2d2efa40b8c9218cd.open_work: Improving longer-horizon forecasts and refining spatial preprocessing of satellite rainfall.
85a96da2aea4fb1c942efbf2d2efa40b8c9218cd.issues: Short-lead skill dominated by autocorrelated discharge inputs; performance deteriorates at longer horizons.

c84fa913534235efd5304f5352cae0adfdc714d4.goal: Predicts hourly mean surface air temperature in Saudi Arabia, useful for energy and solar applications.
c84fa913534235efd5304f5352cae0adfdc714d4.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) trained on past temperature data to predict hourly temperatures.
c84fa913534235efd5304f5352cae0adfdc714d4.data: Hourly surface temperature records from a station in Saudi Arabia; period not reported in the available metadata.
c84fa913534235efd5304f5352cae0adfdc714d4.result: The neural network predicts hourly temperatures with good agreement to observations, according to the authors.
c84fa913534235efd5304f5352cae0adfdc714d4.open_work: Including other meteorological variables and testing at more stations.
c84fa913534235efd5304f5352cae0adfdc714d4.issues: Single-station, single-variable approach; limited evaluation details.

e9af1a3dedfc8b34912ca46ceb85411806911f76.goal: Downscales daily precipitation at multiple sites probabilistically from synoptic-scale predictors, capturing occurrence, amounts and spatial relationships.
e9af1a3dedfc8b34912ca46ceb85411806911f76.architecture: Expanded Bernoulli-gamma density network (EBDN): an artificial neural network (MLP) whose outputs are Bernoulli-gamma parameters, with a covariance constraint in the cost function and an autoregressive noise model.
e9af1a3dedfc8b34912ca46ceb85411806911f76.data: Multisite daily precipitation dataset from coastal British Columbia, Canada, with synoptic-scale climate predictors.
e9af1a3dedfc8b34912ca46ceb85411806911f76.result: EBDN specifies the conditional precipitation distribution at each site, reproduces spatial relationships, generates realistic synthetic series, and predicts amounts beyond the observed record.
e9af1a3dedfc8b34912ca46ceb85411806911f76.open_work: Application to GCM scenarios and other regions and variables.
e9af1a3dedfc8b34912ca46ceb85411806911f76.issues: Demonstrated in one region; parametric Bernoulli-gamma form may misrepresent extremes; assumes stationarity of predictor relationships.

039e4c5434116a522d2473a5dcd888cf60e8f2b3.goal: Evaluates artificial neural networks for forecasting fine particulate pollution (PM10 and PM2.5), for air quality forecasting.
039e4c5434116a522d2473a5dcd888cf60e8f2b3.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks compared with multiple linear regression models.
039e4c5434116a522d2473a5dcd888cf60e8f2b3.data: Particulate matter and meteorological observations from monitoring sites in the Lower Fraser Valley, British Columbia.
039e4c5434116a522d2473a5dcd888cf60e8f2b3.result: MLP models offer only modest improvement over regression; persistence and meteorological inputs are important, and predicting high episodes remains difficult.
039e4c5434116a522d2473a5dcd888cf60e8f2b3.open_work: Hybrid approaches combining networks with other methods and better input selection.
039e4c5434116a522d2473a5dcd888cf60e8f2b3.issues: Limited improvement over linear models; small data and few high-concentration episodes.

7293f851b97f65037eec1fabf5b71bece9bb6670.goal: Generates flood hydrographs, including peak flow, time to peak and shape, from hydro-meteorological parameters for flood management.
7293f851b97f65037eec1fabf5b71bece9bb6670.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) trained with backpropagation, mapping hydro-meteorological inputs to hydrograph characteristics.
7293f851b97f65037eec1fabf5b71bece9bb6670.data: Hydro-meteorological and streamflow data for the Red River basin, Manitoba, Canada.
7293f851b97f65037eec1fabf5b71bece9bb6670.result: The neural network reproduces peak flow, timing and hydrograph shape with good accuracy, according to the authors.
7293f851b97f65037eec1fabf5b71bece9bb6670.open_work: Incorporating further hydrological processes and uncertainty; application to other basins.
7293f851b97f65037eec1fabf5b71bece9bb6670.issues: Snowmelt-driven single-basin application; limited flood events.

50d4fac891664234ed564ac2a009321227c0da7c.goal: Predicts average summer-monsoon rainfall over India, a key seasonal forecasting problem.
50d4fac891664234ed564ac2a009321227c0da7c.architecture: Three-layer feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) with sigmoid non-linearity, compared with persistence and multiple linear regression forecasts.
50d4fac891664234ed564ac2a009321227c0da7c.data: Monthly summer monsoon rainfall totals, tropical rainfall indices and sea surface temperature anomalies, 1950–1995.
50d4fac891664234ed564ac2a009321227c0da7c.result: The ANN outperforms persistence and multiple linear regression forecasts of average summer-monsoon rainfall.
50d4fac891664234ed564ac2a009321227c0da7c.open_work: Independent out-of-sample validation and additional predictors.
50d4fac891664234ed564ac2a009321227c0da7c.issues: Short record (46 years) for training and testing; risk of overfitting; no skill scores reported in the abstract.

5edd1005c964815dd33dc04d72952145357c7d97.goal: Predicts short-term storm surge at Taichung harbor, Taiwan, during typhoons for coastal hazard warning.
5edd1005c964815dd33dc04d72952145357c7d97.architecture: Back-propagation neural network (feedforward MLP) using meteorological and tidal inputs to predict storm surge.
5edd1005c964815dd33dc04d72952145357c7d97.data: Typhoon storm surge and meteorological observations at Taichung harbor, Taiwan; details not reported in the available metadata.
5edd1005c964815dd33dc04d72952145357c7d97.result: The back-propagation network predicts short-term storm surge with good accuracy, according to the author.
5edd1005c964815dd33dc04d72952145357c7d97.open_work: Longer lead times and inclusion of typhoon track forecasts.
5edd1005c964815dd33dc04d72952145357c7d97.issues: Limited number of typhoon events; single location.

4cf0e7e4f6abfee8af4cf77d0ecfc4ce76ab772d.goal: Forecasts hourly concentrations of urban air pollutants using neural networks with optimised temporal averaging of input variables.
4cf0e7e4f6abfee8af4cf77d0ecfc4ce76ab772d.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network with inputs formed from optimised temporal averages of meteorological variables and pollutant concentrations.
4cf0e7e4f6abfee8af4cf77d0ecfc4ce76ab772d.data: Hourly air pollutant (e.g. NO2, O3, CO, PM10) and meteorological measurements from an urban monitoring station in Zagreb, Croatia.
4cf0e7e4f6abfee8af4cf77d0ecfc4ce76ab772d.result: Optimised temporal averages of inputs improve neural network forecasts of hourly pollutant concentrations, according to the authors.
4cf0e7e4f6abfee8af4cf77d0ecfc4ce76ab772d.open_work: Testing at other stations and with forecast meteorology as input.
4cf0e7e4f6abfee8af4cf77d0ecfc4ce76ab772d.issues: Single station; uses observed rather than forecast meteorology.

7bd92c73f56ad4560de0ada9729b2e6e3c1186a7.goal: Forecasts next-day 24-hour photovoltaic generating power to support power system operation.
7bd92c73f56ad4560de0ada9729b2e6e3c1186a7.architecture: Neural network forecasting models (types not specified in the available metadata) using weather data to predict next-day PV output.
7bd92c73f56ad4560de0ada9729b2e6e3c1186a7.data: Measured photovoltaic power and meteorological data in Japan; details not reported in the available metadata.
7bd92c73f56ad4560de0ada9729b2e6e3c1186a7.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the neural network approach is presented as giving useful day-ahead PV forecasts.
7bd92c73f56ad4560de0ada9729b2e6e3c1186a7.open_work: Using numerical weather prediction inputs and probabilistic forecasts.
7bd92c73f56ad4560de0ada9729b2e6e3c1186a7.issues: Conference paper with limited evaluation; single system.

cb920c51e9fc5c3e3b2c6ae14e487a18e5872e62.goal: Predicts wind power output for grid integration using an artificial neural network.
cb920c51e9fc5c3e3b2c6ae14e487a18e5872e62.architecture: Artificial neural network forecasting model; the specific network type is not specified in the available metadata.
cb920c51e9fc5c3e3b2c6ae14e487a18e5872e62.data: Wind farm power and wind data; details not reported in the available metadata.
cb920c51e9fc5c3e3b2c6ae14e487a18e5872e62.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
cb920c51e9fc5c3e3b2c6ae14e487a18e5872e62.open_work: Comparison with physical and statistical benchmarks and longer horizons.
cb920c51e9fc5c3e3b2c6ae14e487a18e5872e62.issues: Card based on title only; evaluation details unknown.

a5a6d91db48a082f26a7eebadee682cb2272822a.goal: Forecasts streamflow in real time using a recurrent neural network that adapts online to new observations.
a5a6d91db48a082f26a7eebadee682cb2272822a.architecture: Real-time recurrent learning (RTRL) recurrent neural network trained online, compared with conventional approaches.
a5a6d91db48a082f26a7eebadee682cb2272822a.data: Hourly streamflow and rainfall data from a river in Taiwan; details not reported in the available metadata.
a5a6d91db48a082f26a7eebadee682cb2272822a.result: The RTRL network provides accurate real-time streamflow forecasts and adapts to changing conditions, according to the authors.
a5a6d91db48a082f26a7eebadee682cb2272822a.open_work: Multi-step-ahead forecasting and application to flood events at other basins.
a5a6d91db48a082f26a7eebadee682cb2272822a.issues: Single basin; one-step-ahead focus; online learning can be unstable.

602bb9485c7f0962939ae56ff4ccdfa6827ca561.goal: Forecasts wind-generated waves from wind and wave observations using machine learning methods as an alternative to physics-based wave models.
602bb9485c7f0962939ae56ff4ccdfa6827ca561.architecture: Data-driven learning methods, including artificial neural networks; other method types are not specified in the available metadata.
602bb9485c7f0962939ae56ff4ccdfa6827ca561.data: Buoy wind and wave observations; location and period not reported in the available metadata.
602bb9485c7f0962939ae56ff4ccdfa6827ca561.result: Data-driven models forecast significant wave height with useful accuracy at short horizons, according to the authors.
602bb9485c7f0962939ae56ff4ccdfa6827ca561.open_work: Longer lead times and use of forecast winds from numerical weather prediction.
602bb9485c7f0962939ae56ff4ccdfa6827ca561.issues: Site-specific training on limited buoy data; skill declines with lead time.

7916fc39d84edd3b160ea3c35d8f7e7e181e6467.goal: Moves from diagnosing to forecasting urban air pollution in Bilbao, Spain, to give hours-ahead warnings of pollutant concentrations at monitoring stations.
7916fc39d84edd3b160ea3c35d8f7e7e181e6467.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks, one per pollutant, station and lead time, using recent pollutant, meteorological and traffic inputs.
7916fc39d84edd3b160ea3c35d8f7e7e181e6467.data: Hourly records from the Bilbao air quality monitoring network (pollutants such as SO2, CO, NO, NO2 and O3) with co-located meteorology and traffic data.
7916fc39d84edd3b160ea3c35d8f7e7e181e6467.result: Neural networks give usable short-range forecasts, with skill degrading as the lead time grows over the several-hour horizon; exact scores are not given here.
7916fc39d84edd3b160ea3c35d8f7e7e181e6467.open_work: Extending to longer lead times by adding numerical weather prediction inputs and testing in operational warning settings.
7916fc39d84edd3b160ea3c35d8f7e7e181e6467.issues: Station-specific models with limited transferability; no uncertainty estimates; skill drops quickly beyond a few hours.

c24c630be842a2bc6d41ccf89b959b1c7bc7654e.goal: Estimates precipitation from passive microwave sounder observations near 54 and 183 GHz, exploiting opaque oxygen and water vapour channels that sense precipitation aloft.
c24c630be842a2bc6d41ccf89b959b1c7bc7654e.architecture: Physically guided retrieval that combines channel signatures with a neural network trained to estimate precipitation rate.
c24c630be842a2bc6d41ccf89b959b1c7bc7654e.data: NOAA-15 AMSU-A and AMSU-B brightness temperatures, evaluated against NEXRAD radar precipitation rates over the United States.
c24c630be842a2bc6d41ccf89b959b1c7bc7654e.result: Opaque-channel signatures detect and quantify precipitation, with neural network estimates agreeing reasonably with NEXRAD at about 15 km resolution; detailed scores are not reproduced here.
c24c630be842a2bc6d41ccf89b959b1c7bc7654e.open_work: Extending to more cases, seasons and regions and to later sounders such as AMSU on other satellites.
c24c630be842a2bc6d41ccf89b959b1c7bc7654e.issues: Training and evaluation tied to radar over limited U.S. cases; weak sensitivity to light or warm rain; radar itself carries errors.

217c9bff186d05f7a0b5d11692b803021305b166.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasts for wind farms and attaches an on-line measure of how risky each prediction is, to support grid operation and trading.
217c9bff186d05f7a0b5d11692b803021305b166.architecture: Fuzzy neural network for power prediction combined with an on-line prediction risk index derived from the spread of meteorological forecasts.
217c9bff186d05f7a0b5d11692b803021305b166.data: Numerical weather prediction forecasts and SCADA power measurements from operating wind farms.
217c9bff186d05f7a0b5d11692b803021305b166.result: The fuzzy neural network improves on persistence and the risk index correlates with the size of forecast errors, flagging situations of low predictability.
217c9bff186d05f7a0b5d11692b803021305b166.open_work: Turning the risk index into calibrated prediction intervals and testing across more sites and NWP systems.
217c9bff186d05f7a0b5d11692b803021305b166.issues: Few sites; the risk index is qualitative rather than a full probabilistic forecast.

627f80af729a0f54f3c9106c2e5df81888177f42.goal: Uses genetic programming to induce rainfall-runoff models directly from data as an alternative to conceptual and neural network models.
627f80af729a0f54f3c9106c2e5df81888177f42.architecture: Genetic programming (symbolic regression) evolving explicit rainfall-runoff expressions.
627f80af729a0f54f3c9106c2e5df81888177f42.data: Catchment rainfall and runoff records; the specific catchment is not reported here.
627f80af729a0f54f3c9106c2e5df81888177f42.result: Genetic programming yields compact runoff models with accuracy comparable to or better than the benchmarks used. Not reported in the abstract.
627f80af729a0f54f3c9106c2e5df81888177f42.open_work: Combining evolved expressions with physical knowledge and testing on more catchments.
627f80af729a0f54f3c9106c2e5df81888177f42.issues: Evolved formulas may overfit and lack physical interpretability; single-catchment evidence.

26548c855758400d2e00349e0b001101bd776ba4.goal: Predicts river flow at a downstream location from upstream flows, comparing two data-driven approaches for operational flow forecasting.
26548c855758400d2e00349e0b001101bd776ba4.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (ANN) compared with an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS).
26548c855758400d2e00349e0b001101bd776ba4.data: Daily flow records from gauging stations in the Mahanadi River system, India.
26548c855758400d2e00349e0b001101bd776ba4.result: ANFIS gives somewhat better flow predictions than the ANN, with both performing acceptably. Not reported in the abstract.
26548c855758400d2e00349e0b001101bd776ba4.open_work: Adding rainfall and catchment inputs and testing on extreme flood events.
26548c855758400d2e00349e0b001101bd776ba4.issues: Single river system; limited treatment of high flows and no uncertainty quantification.

b1dda6b4f58e9adca81d50a52ee77d1d00b446a6.goal: Provides one-day-ahead significant wave height forecasts at buoy locations as a cheap alternative to numerical wave models.
b1dda6b4f58e9adca81d50a52ee77d1d00b446a6.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural networks using past wave observations at the buoy.
b1dda6b4f58e9adca81d50a52ee77d1d00b446a6.data: Wave measurements from NOAA NDBC buoys.
b1dda6b4f58e9adca81d50a52ee77d1d00b446a6.result: Neural networks give useful forecasts out to 24 h, with accuracy decreasing as lead time increases.
b1dda6b4f58e9adca81d50a52ee77d1d00b446a6.open_work: Including wind forecasts as inputs and combining with numerical wave models.
b1dda6b4f58e9adca81d50a52ee77d1d00b446a6.issues: Point forecasts tied to individual buoys; accuracy degrades for longer leads and during rapidly changing storm conditions.

8237d358a6e17e7d69a8853380f4efb66986b870.goal: Replaces time-consuming Monte Carlo parameter uncertainty analysis of hydrological models with a fast emulator usable in real time.
8237d358a6e17e7d69a8853380f4efb66986b870.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) trained to map model inputs to uncertainty descriptors (prediction quantiles) derived from Monte Carlo realizations.
8237d358a6e17e7d69a8853380f4efb66986b870.data: Monte Carlo simulations of the lumped conceptual HBV model for the Brue catchment, United Kingdom.
8237d358a6e17e7d69a8853380f4efb66986b870.result: The ANN reproduces Monte Carlo prediction intervals reasonably accurately on verification data.
8237d358a6e17e7d69a8853380f4efb66986b870.open_work: Applying the emulator to complex distributed models and to real-time forecasting with short lead times.
8237d358a6e17e7d69a8853380f4efb66986b870.issues: Only parametric uncertainty is considered; single catchment and model; the emulator inherits the Monte Carlo setup assumptions.

aa7d2317d194f8261c8052229d73132d3a05a36b.goal: Predicts solar radiation series needed to size stand-alone photovoltaic systems at sites lacking measurements.
aa7d2317d194f8261c8052229d73132d3a05a36b.architecture: Artificial neural network; the specific network type is not specified here.
aa7d2317d194f8261c8052229d73132d3a05a36b.data: Measured solar radiation and meteorological data from sites in Algeria.
aa7d2317d194f8261c8052229d73132d3a05a36b.result: The neural network produces solar radiation data suitable for PV sizing. Not reported in the abstract.
aa7d2317d194f8261c8052229d73132d3a05a36b.open_work: Validation at more sites and climates and direct use of predicted data in sizing optimisation.
aa7d2317d194f8261c8052229d73132d3a05a36b.issues: Few sites; accuracy metrics and generalisation are not clear without the full text.

d6763bb4dcaec46d9ef307fe82f87bb7bfc1165a.goal: Forecasts seasonal spring runoff volumes in snowmelt-dominated basins where regression methods are unreliable.
d6763bb4dcaec46d9ef307fe82f87bb7bfc1165a.architecture: Fuzzy logic (rule-based fuzzy inference) model using snowpack, soil moisture and precipitation indices.
d6763bb4dcaec46d9ef307fe82f87bb7bfc1165a.data: Historical seasonal runoff and snow and climate indices for basins in Alberta, Canada.
d6763bb4dcaec46d9ef307fe82f87bb7bfc1165a.result: The fuzzy model categorises runoff (e.g. low, average, high) more reliably than regression-based forecasts.
d6763bb4dcaec46d9ef307fe82f87bb7bfc1165a.open_work: Extending to more basins and integrating climate signals into the rule base.
d6763bb4dcaec46d9ef307fe82f87bb7bfc1165a.issues: Coarse categorical output; rule base partly expert-defined; short records.

f55f8b150d541d6a2bc1f622b89688f43f7b592f.goal: Evaluates how well artificial neural networks predict runoff and how their performance should be assessed.
f55f8b150d541d6a2bc1f622b89688f43f7b592f.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural networks compared with regression-based alternatives.
f55f8b150d541d6a2bc1f622b89688f43f7b592f.data: Streamflow and hydrometeorological records from a Canadian basin (Red River, Manitoba).
f55f8b150d541d6a2bc1f622b89688f43f7b592f.result: ANNs predict runoff competitively, and the study highlights the need for multiple performance measures. Not reported in the abstract.
f55f8b150d541d6a2bc1f622b89688f43f7b592f.open_work: Better evaluation criteria for peak flows and longer lead times.
f55f8b150d541d6a2bc1f622b89688f43f7b592f.issues: Single basin; standard performance measures may hide poor peak-flow performance.

d2089c60c84560c7da84b64a79f79044a2871b9e.goal: Forecasts hydrologic time series with a kernel method that is faster to train than support vector regression.
d2089c60c84560c7da84b64a79f79044a2871b9e.architecture: Kernel ridge regression in feature space combined with phase-space (chaos-based) reconstruction of the time series.
d2089c60c84560c7da84b64a79f79044a2871b9e.data: Daily river flow series from benchmark catchments. Not reported in the abstract.
d2089c60c84560c7da84b64a79f79044a2871b9e.result: Ridge regression in feature space matches support vector machine accuracy at lower computational cost. Not reported in the abstract.
d2089c60c84560c7da84b64a79f79044a2871b9e.open_work: Automated selection of embedding and kernel parameters and tests on more catchments.
d2089c60c84560c7da84b64a79f79044a2871b9e.issues: Results depend on embedding and kernel choices; univariate inputs only.

0d4a53e79fce4905e5d7cb663c14e210e2316153.goal: Improves rainfall-runoff simulation by combining a conceptual model with neural networks applied to divided parts of the flow regime.
0d4a53e79fce4905e5d7cb663c14e210e2316153.architecture: Back-propagation (BP) neural networks combined with the Xinanjiang conceptual model in a division-based scheme.
0d4a53e79fce4905e5d7cb663c14e210e2316153.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a Chinese catchment. Not reported in the abstract.
0d4a53e79fce4905e5d7cb663c14e210e2316153.result: The division-based hybrid improves simulations over a single model. Not reported in the abstract.
0d4a53e79fce4905e5d7cb663c14e210e2316153.open_work: Testing other division criteria and catchments.
0d4a53e79fce4905e5d7cb663c14e210e2316153.issues: Single-catchment evidence; division thresholds are subjective.

ae9a1a4bcf50296135647cf93033ffb4c52ecedb.goal: Forecasts river flows in the Apalachicola River, Florida, with data-driven models to support water management.
ae9a1a4bcf50296135647cf93033ffb4c52ecedb.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural networks using upstream flows and antecedent observations.
ae9a1a4bcf50296135647cf93033ffb4c52ecedb.data: Daily streamflow records from gauging stations on the Apalachicola River system.
ae9a1a4bcf50296135647cf93033ffb4c52ecedb.result: Neural networks forecast flows accurately at short lead times. Not reported in the abstract.
ae9a1a4bcf50296135647cf93033ffb4c52ecedb.open_work: Including rainfall forecasts and extending lead times.
ae9a1a4bcf50296135647cf93033ffb4c52ecedb.issues: Single river; skill expected to decline at longer leads and for extreme flows.

6727f04a18cb00719999a900f17fd06312361601.goal: Derives monthly operating rules for an irrigation reservoir that approximate optimal release policies.
6727f04a18cb00719999a900f17fd06312361601.architecture: Artificial neural network trained on optimal releases from dynamic programming to form operating rules.
6727f04a18cb00719999a900f17fd06312361601.data: Inflow, storage and demand data for an irrigation reservoir in Sicily, Italy, with optimised releases as targets.
6727f04a18cb00719999a900f17fd06312361601.result: ANN-based rules reproduce optimal releases better than linear rules and reduce irrigation shortages in simulation.
6727f04a18cb00719999a900f17fd06312361601.open_work: Extending to multireservoir systems and including inflow forecasts.
6727f04a18cb00719999a900f17fd06312361601.issues: Depends on deterministic optimisation of historical inflows; single reservoir.

3a96e5da93201819c4835f068d536704f1515694.goal: Models groundwater levels in an urban coastal aquifer to support groundwater management under pumping and seawater intrusion risk.
3a96e5da93201819c4835f068d536704f1515694.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural networks trained with back-propagation variants (e.g. Levenberg-Marquardt).
3a96e5da93201819c4835f068d536704f1515694.data: Observed groundwater levels, rainfall and related records from wells in a coastal city aquifer in India.
3a96e5da93201819c4835f068d536704f1515694.result: Neural networks reproduce observed groundwater level fluctuations well. Not reported in the abstract.
3a96e5da93201819c4835f068d536704f1515694.open_work: Adding pumping data and longer forecasts for management scenarios.
3a96e5da93201819c4835f068d536704f1515694.issues: Few wells and short records; no physical constraints on groundwater dynamics.

71cfdfa81878425066f51405a15b6e93c0f5a7d7.goal: Speeds up and improves training of neural networks used for river stage forecasting.
71cfdfa81878425066f51405a15b6e93c0f5a7d7.architecture: Feed-forward neural network trained by a split-step particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO followed by Levenberg-Marquardt).
71cfdfa81878425066f51405a15b6e93c0f5a7d7.data: Water level records from the Shing Mun River, Hong Kong.
71cfdfa81878425066f51405a15b6e93c0f5a7d7.result: The split-step PSO trains faster and gives more accurate stage forecasts than standard back-propagation or PSO alone.
71cfdfa81878425066f51405a15b6e93c0f5a7d7.open_work: Applying the hybrid training to other hydrological problems and lead times.
71cfdfa81878425066f51405a15b6e93c0f5a7d7.issues: Single river; gains depend on optimiser settings.

52fe2c56fd6c2b87f2fd85cf96d8ed87d99a7e55.goal: Updates conceptual model river flow forecasts using recent errors to improve real-time accuracy.
52fe2c56fd6c2b87f2fd85cf96d8ed87d99a7e55.architecture: Non-linear auto-regressive exogenous-input (NARX) updating procedure built on a multilayer neural network, compared with linear ARX updating.
52fe2c56fd6c2b87f2fd85cf96d8ed87d99a7e55.data: Daily discharge forecasts from the SMAR conceptual model on five catchments with different climatic conditions.
52fe2c56fd6c2b87f2fd85cf96d8ed87d99a7e55.result: The NARX neural network updating procedure outperforms the linear ARX procedure.
52fe2c56fd6c2b87f2fd85cf96d8ed87d99a7e55.open_work: Testing at sub-daily time steps and with other conceptual models.
52fe2c56fd6c2b87f2fd85cf96d8ed87d99a7e55.issues: Daily data only; updating limited to output correction rather than model states.

3e8e2f69937c148cecf9fce463206aeec05c84c2.goal: Reviews methods and software for short-term wind power prediction to inform research and operational users.
3e8e2f69937c148cecf9fce463206aeec05c84c2.architecture: Review of physical, statistical and neural network based wind power forecasting approaches and operational software tools.
3e8e2f69937c148cecf9fce463206aeec05c84c2.data: Literature and operational tool descriptions; no new dataset.
3e8e2f69937c148cecf9fce463206aeec05c84c2.result: Summarises the state of the art, showing NWP-driven statistical and physical models outperform persistence beyond a few hours.
3e8e2f69937c148cecf9fce463206aeec05c84c2.open_work: Better uncertainty estimates, offshore forecasting and combining models.
3e8e2f69937c148cecf9fce463206aeec05c84c2.issues: Review based on reported results that use different sites and error measures, making direct comparison hard.

e8370e774da88727cc8dbcc641867282661a5dd2.goal: Uses data mining to extract patterns from air quality data that can support air pollution management policy.
e8370e774da88727cc8dbcc641867282661a5dd2.architecture: Data mining techniques; the specific methods are not specified here.
e8370e774da88727cc8dbcc641867282661a5dd2.data: Air quality monitoring records from Taiwan. Not reported in the abstract.
e8370e774da88727cc8dbcc641867282661a5dd2.result: Data mining reveals pollution patterns relevant to policy making. Not reported in the abstract.
e8370e774da88727cc8dbcc641867282661a5dd2.open_work: Linking mined patterns to emission sources and policy evaluation.
e8370e774da88727cc8dbcc641867282661a5dd2.issues: Descriptive analysis; details of methods and validation are unclear without the full text.

de2ab445a5cb07b3a3869ca4a2c10a77ff88343c.goal: Predicts streamflow with artificial neural networks as an alternative to conceptual and statistical models.
de2ab445a5cb07b3a3869ca4a2c10a77ff88343c.data: Streamflow and hydrometeorological records from a mountain basin. Not reported in the abstract.
de2ab445a5cb07b3a3869ca4a2c10a77ff88343c.result: Neural networks give accurate streamflow predictions. Not reported in the abstract.
de2ab445a5cb07b3a3869ca4a2c10a77ff88343c.open_work: Testing on more basins and longer lead times.

70131ffad768605ffcbac5acdcd95040847f19f7.goal: Evaluates neural networks for six-hourly flow forecasting on the River Yangtze and compares them with conventional statistical techniques.
70131ffad768605ffcbac5acdcd95040847f19f7.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) and radial basis function (RBF) networks with alternative RBF transfer functions.
70131ffad768605ffcbac5acdcd95040847f19f7.data: Six-hourly rainfall-runoff data for the River Yangtze at Yichang, upstream of the Three Gorges Dam, 1991-1993.
70131ffad768605ffcbac5acdcd95040847f19f7.result: Both networks simulate flows beyond the training range, and the Gaussian function is not necessarily the best RBF; comparisons are made with stepwise regression, ARMA and zero-order forecasts.
70131ffad768605ffcbac5acdcd95040847f19f7.open_work: Longer records and assessing other transfer functions and lead times.

6a807c416c9d6cb69730c2366f97159977ae4e15.goal: Reconstructs missing precipitation records from neighbouring gauges to complete hydrological datasets.
6a807c416c9d6cb69730c2366f97159977ae4e15.architecture: Adaptive fuzzy rule-based models compared with neural networks and linear regression.
6a807c416c9d6cb69730c2366f97159977ae4e15.data: Daily precipitation records from nearby rain gauges. Not reported in the abstract.
6a807c416c9d6cb69730c2366f97159977ae4e15.result: Fuzzy rule-based models reconstruct missing values with accuracy comparable to neural networks. Not reported in the abstract.
6a807c416c9d6cb69730c2366f97159977ae4e15.open_work: Applying to other gauge networks and handling extreme events.
6a807c416c9d6cb69730c2366f97159977ae4e15.issues: Performance depends on correlation between gauges; rule generation is data-hungry.

60fbe24a54282072cda5d866874bb537ca39fd5f.goal: Improves short-term air temperature prediction for agricultural decision support such as frost protection.
60fbe24a54282072cda5d866874bb537ca39fd5f.architecture: Ward-style artificial neural networks with multiple hidden slabs, using recent weather observations and seasonal terms.
60fbe24a54282072cda5d866874bb537ca39fd5f.data: Weather observations from the Georgia Automated Environmental Monitoring Network, USA.
60fbe24a54282072cda5d866874bb537ca39fd5f.result: Enhanced input sets and network design reduce errors for 1 to 12 hour air temperature forecasts. Not reported in the abstract.
60fbe24a54282072cda5d866874bb537ca39fd5f.open_work: Extending to other variables and more sites.
60fbe24a54282072cda5d866874bb537ca39fd5f.issues: Point forecasts; errors grow with lead time; no NWP inputs.

39349914470ee4ad8b399af0188e0793fb26e09e.goal: Forecasts maximum daily ozone levels for air quality warnings.
39349914470ee4ad8b399af0188e0793fb26e09e.architecture: Neural network combined with statistical characteristics of ozone series; the specific network type is not specified here.
39349914470ee4ad8b399af0188e0793fb26e09e.data: Ozone and meteorological observations from Hong Kong.
39349914470ee4ad8b399af0188e0793fb26e09e.result: The combined approach improves maximum daily ozone predictions over a standard network. Not reported in the abstract.
39349914470ee4ad8b399af0188e0793fb26e09e.open_work: Testing for high-ozone episodes and other sites.
39349914470ee4ad8b399af0188e0793fb26e09e.issues: Single region; extreme episodes are rare in training data.

1b20f9d15d9fb69767be1ac63a32c7c6428a19c5.goal: Produces real-time rainfall estimates over Africa where gauge networks are sparse.
1b20f9d15d9fb69767be1ac63a32c7c6428a19c5.architecture: Neural network combining satellite thermal infrared data with numerical weather prediction variables.
1b20f9d15d9fb69767be1ac63a32c7c6428a19c5.data: Meteosat thermal infrared imagery, ECMWF model variables and rain gauge data in Africa (e.g. Zambia).
1b20f9d15d9fb69767be1ac63a32c7c6428a19c5.result: Neural network estimates improve on infrared-only methods at daily scale. Not reported in the abstract.
1b20f9d15d9fb69767be1ac63a32c7c6428a19c5.open_work: Extending to other regions and operational implementation.
1b20f9d15d9fb69767be1ac63a32c7c6428a19c5.issues: Gauge validation is sparse; NWP-dependent inputs.

28acfad4e198cfa643657645d051d7990754a3c4.goal: Retrieves surface roughness and soil moisture from SAR backscatter for bare agricultural soils.
28acfad4e198cfa643657645d051d7990754a3c4.architecture: Neural network inversion of SAR backscatter trained on backscatter simulated by the integral equation model (IEM).
28acfad4e198cfa643657645d051d7990754a3c4.data: IEM-simulated backscatter for training and SAR data with field measurements over agricultural fields for testing.
28acfad4e198cfa643657645d051d7990754a3c4.result: Neural networks retrieve soil moisture and roughness with useful accuracy, especially with multi-angle or multi-polarisation data.
28acfad4e198cfa643657645d051d7990754a3c4.open_work: Using more SAR configurations and real data for training.
28acfad4e198cfa643657645d051d7990754a3c4.issues: Relies on IEM accuracy; bare soils only; limited field validation.

572f331e4613f04c553dda31d31426f75b0dc347.goal: Tests whether neural networks can model non-linear hydrological relationships, responding to claims that they offer no improvement over linear transfer functions.
572f331e4613f04c553dda31d31426f75b0dc347.architecture: Eight neural network models emulating a non-linear rainfall-runoff equation and a runoff coefficient relationship, compared with multiple linear regression.
572f331e4613f04c553dda31d31426f75b0dc347.data: Synthetic random inputs with uniform distribution generated from a recognised non-linear hydrological model; no temporal component.
572f331e4613f04c553dda31d31426f75b0dc347.result: Neural networks reproduce the non-linear relationships and outperform least squares multiple linear regression.
572f331e4613f04c553dda31d31426f75b0dc347.open_work: Testing on real catchment data with temporal dynamics.
572f331e4613f04c553dda31d31426f75b0dc347.issues: Controlled synthetic experiments with modest input ranges; no noise or real data.

8cd849beb1bd13c6f53c48b5f4d802c9f0eb3ac6.goal: Retrieves soil moisture and agricultural variables from microwave radiometry over vegetated fields.
8cd849beb1bd13c6f53c48b5f4d802c9f0eb3ac6.architecture: Neural network inversion trained on simulations from a discrete electromagnetic emission model.
8cd849beb1bd13c6f53c48b5f4d802c9f0eb3ac6.data: Simulated brightness temperatures for training and experimental radiometer measurements over agricultural fields for testing.
8cd849beb1bd13c6f53c48b5f4d802c9f0eb3ac6.result: Neural networks retrieve soil moisture and vegetation variables with good accuracy. Not reported in the abstract.
8cd849beb1bd13c6f53c48b5f4d802c9f0eb3ac6.open_work: Applying to satellite radiometers such as SMOS.
8cd849beb1bd13c6f53c48b5f4d802c9f0eb3ac6.issues: Depends on the forward model; experimental validation limited to few sites.

2ce91d120fb66d17c27090c4a616e2f62f7e3ee6.goal: Evaluates neural networks for spatial interpolation of surface air temperature as a tool for downscaling GCM output.
2ce91d120fb66d17c27090c4a616e2f62f7e3ee6.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural networks compared with conventional spatial interpolation methods.
2ce91d120fb66d17c27090c4a616e2f62f7e3ee6.data: Observed surface air temperature from station networks in the United States.
2ce91d120fb66d17c27090c4a616e2f62f7e3ee6.result: Neural networks interpolate temperatures more accurately than conventional methods. Not reported in the abstract.
2ce91d120fb66d17c27090c4a616e2f62f7e3ee6.open_work: Applying to GCM fields and other variables such as precipitation.
2ce91d120fb66d17c27090c4a616e2f62f7e3ee6.issues: Tested on observations rather than GCM output; stationarity of relationships assumed.

18035ab7bff8f6120647b43c71fec10ec36c877a.goal: Improves runoff prediction with a hybrid scheme combining input selection and data-driven models.
18035ab7bff8f6120647b43c71fec10ec36c877a.architecture: Integrated hybrid scheme using the Gamma Test for input selection with wavelet decomposition, neural network (NNARX) and neuro-fuzzy (ANFIS) models.
18035ab7bff8f6120647b43c71fec10ec36c877a.data: Rainfall and runoff records from the Brue catchment, United Kingdom.
18035ab7bff8f6120647b43c71fec10ec36c877a.result: The hybrid wavelet-based models outperform conventional neural network and ANFIS models. Not reported in the abstract.
18035ab7bff8f6120647b43c71fec10ec36c877a.open_work: Testing on more catchments and longer lead times.
18035ab7bff8f6120647b43c71fec10ec36c877a.issues: Single catchment; added complexity of the hybrid scheme.

fef2f523e3b849c49b4faf536c5015269a8ca34f.goal: Assesses how well neural networks can reconstruct North Atlantic surface pCO2 from satellite data given sparse ship sampling.
fef2f523e3b849c49b4faf536c5015269a8ca34f.architecture: Neural network mapping satellite-observable variables to pCO2; the network type is not specified here.
fef2f523e3b849c49b4faf536c5015269a8ca34f.data: Synthetic pCO2 and predictor fields from a North Atlantic biogeochemical model, sampled along ship tracks, with SST and chlorophyll as predictors.
fef2f523e3b849c49b4faf536c5015269a8ca34f.result: Neural networks reconstruct basin-scale pCO2 reasonably, with errors depending on sampling density and predictors.
fef2f523e3b849c49b4faf536c5015269a8ca34f.open_work: Applying to real observations and satellite products.
fef2f523e3b849c49b4faf536c5015269a8ca34f.issues: Methodological study on model data; real-world errors likely larger.

700f0151641073089062547d5f214e8523972b57.goal: Extracts non-linear modes of tropical Indo-Pacific SST and sea level pressure variability, including ENSO asymmetry.
700f0151641073089062547d5f214e8523972b57.architecture: Non-linear principal component analysis (NLPCA) with an autoassociative neural network.
700f0151641073089062547d5f214e8523972b57.data: Observed tropical Indo-Pacific sea surface temperature and sea level pressure analyses.
700f0151641073089062547d5f214e8523972b57.result: The leading non-linear mode captures ENSO asymmetry between El Nino and La Nina better than linear PCA.
700f0151641073089062547d5f214e8523972b57.open_work: Extending to other climate modes and coupled analysis.
700f0151641073089062547d5f214e8523972b57.issues: Risk of overfitting in NLPCA; short observational record.

e9615aad91c228ad8b5e47f93d0ab5bf4dccfa53.goal: Predicts extreme precipitation linked to summer floods in Moravia, Czech Republic.
e9615aad91c228ad8b5e47f93d0ab5bf4dccfa53.architecture: Feed-forward neural network; the specific architecture details are not specified here.
e9615aad91c228ad8b5e47f93d0ab5bf4dccfa53.data: Precipitation records from Moravian stations, including the 1997 flood period.
e9615aad91c228ad8b5e47f93d0ab5bf4dccfa53.result: The neural network gives reasonable predictions of extreme precipitation. Not reported in the abstract.
e9615aad91c228ad8b5e47f93d0ab5bf4dccfa53.open_work: Including atmospheric predictors and longer records.

bcfe6d9f1adceb38b8f85c638739648b37149882.goal: Forecasts total ozone time series and compares neural networks with linear regression.
bcfe6d9f1adceb38b8f85c638739648b37149882.architecture: Single hidden layer artificial neural networks (MLP) versus multiple linear regression.
bcfe6d9f1adceb38b8f85c638739648b37149882.data: Total ozone time series. Not reported in the abstract.
bcfe6d9f1adceb38b8f85c638739648b37149882.result: Single hidden layer networks outperform multiple linear regression. Not reported in the abstract.
bcfe6d9f1adceb38b8f85c638739648b37149882.open_work: Testing deeper networks and additional predictors.

dbf433c0a82057a5bf9d92e1a284712e9bdcf366.goal: Introduces genetic programming as a paradigm for rainfall-runoff modelling.
dbf433c0a82057a5bf9d92e1a284712e9bdcf366.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a catchment in Singapore. Not reported in the abstract.
dbf433c0a82057a5bf9d92e1a284712e9bdcf366.result: Genetic programming performs well and yields explicit models. Not reported in the abstract.
dbf433c0a82057a5bf9d92e1a284712e9bdcf366.open_work: Testing at longer lead times and other catchments.
dbf433c0a82057a5bf9d92e1a284712e9bdcf366.issues: Single catchment; risk of overfitting evolved expressions.

071b4b1db109930097b272255e0f653c3c82839a.goal: Predicts severe hail size from radar and environmental data to improve warnings.
071b4b1db109930097b272255e0f653c3c82839a.architecture: Bayesian neural network (MLP with Bayesian regularisation) for hail size classification.
071b4b1db109930097b272255e0f653c3c82839a.data: WSR-88D radar-derived attributes and near-storm environmental sounding data with hail reports.
071b4b1db109930097b272255e0f653c3c82839a.result: The Bayesian neural network outperforms the existing hail detection algorithm in predicting hail size classes.
071b4b1db109930097b272255e0f653c3c82839a.issues: Hail reports are biased; limited sample size.

48934289881325bb00ddbe737b43543b13012529.goal: Optimises operation of multireservoir systems under inflow uncertainty.
48934289881325bb00ddbe737b43543b13012529.architecture: Reinforcement learning (Q-learning) compared with stochastic dynamic programming.
48934289881325bb00ddbe737b43543b13012529.data: Inflow and operating data for a multireservoir system in Korea (Geum River basin).
48934289881325bb00ddbe737b43543b13012529.result: Q-learning produces operating policies competitive with or better than stochastic dynamic programming.
48934289881325bb00ddbe737b43543b13012529.open_work: Scaling to larger systems and continuous state spaces.

93d6c32dc74d541e4d73b5d5faf1ae04705c8bf8.goal: Predicts daily SO2 and particulate levels in Zonguldak, Turkey.
93d6c32dc74d541e4d73b5d5faf1ae04705c8bf8.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) using meteorological and pollutant inputs.
93d6c32dc74d541e4d73b5d5faf1ae04705c8bf8.data: Daily air pollution and meteorological data from Zonguldak, Turkey.
93d6c32dc74d541e4d73b5d5faf1ae04705c8bf8.result: ANFIS predicts daily pollutant levels well. Not reported in the abstract.
93d6c32dc74d541e4d73b5d5faf1ae04705c8bf8.open_work: Extending to other pollutants and cities.

05dc2f925bab41d0bbcb224be329daa85a33adc5.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction at a wind farm by exploiting diverse input data.
05dc2f925bab41d0bbcb224be329daa85a33adc5.architecture: Banks of multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks fed by mesoscale model runs with different physical parameterisations.
05dc2f925bab41d0bbcb224be329daa85a33adc5.data: MM5 mesoscale model forecasts with different physics options and observed wind speed at a wind farm in Spain.
05dc2f925bab41d0bbcb224be329daa85a33adc5.result: Banks of ANNs exploiting input diversity give more accurate wind speed predictions than single networks.
05dc2f925bab41d0bbcb224be329daa85a33adc5.open_work: Using ensembles of NWP models and extending to power prediction.
05dc2f925bab41d0bbcb224be329daa85a33adc5.issues: Single site; computational cost of multiple MM5 runs.

40945661e873978811be91382c64e30607918286.goal: Downscales GCM output to local wind speeds to assess climate change impacts on wind power.
40945661e873978811be91382c64e30607918286.architecture: Feed-forward neural network for local statistical downscaling of GCM fields.
40945661e873978811be91382c64e30607918286.data: GCM output and observed station wind speeds in the United States. Not reported in the abstract.
40945661e873978811be91382c64e30607918286.result: Downscaled winds suggest changes in wind power potential under climate change. Not reported in the abstract.
40945661e873978811be91382c64e30607918286.open_work: Using multiple GCMs and more sites.
40945661e873978811be91382c64e30607918286.issues: Single GCM; stationarity of downscaling relationships assumed.

15a16efa6a615deb5e07c02d8c42cad4f06e563e.goal: Quantifies uncertainty in artificial neural network predictions for water resources modelling, where deterministic training gives single weight sets and no prediction intervals.
15a16efa6a615deb5e07c02d8c42cad4f06e563e.architecture: Bayesian training of a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network, sampling the weight posterior with Markov chain Monte Carlo instead of point-estimate backpropagation.
15a16efa6a615deb5e07c02d8c42cad4f06e563e.data: Water resources case study; a River Murray (South Australia) salinity forecasting application is the known example. Details of periods and inputs not reported here.
15a16efa6a615deb5e07c02d8c42cad4f06e563e.result: Bayesian training yields weight distributions and prediction intervals with accuracy comparable to standard training, giving more informative and interpretable network outputs.
15a16efa6a615deb5e07c02d8c42cad4f06e563e.open_work: Extending Bayesian treatment to input and architecture uncertainty and reducing the computational cost of MCMC sampling.
15a16efa6a615deb5e07c02d8c42cad4f06e563e.issues: MCMC sampling is computationally demanding and convergence is hard to check for high-dimensional weight spaces; prior choice affects results.

dd20ebadf35c6657603348d64897ca884d8190d2.goal: Identifies and removes ground clutter and anomalous propagation echoes from weather radar data, which contaminate quantitative precipitation estimates.
dd20ebadf35c6657603348d64897ca884d8190d2.architecture: Classification of echoes from radar echo characteristics (texture and vertical structure features); the exact classifier type is not specified here.
dd20ebadf35c6657603348d64897ca884d8190d2.data: Weather radar volume scans; specific radar sites and periods not reported here.
dd20ebadf35c6657603348d64897ca884d8190d2.result: Echo characteristics separate ground and anomalous propagation echoes from precipitation; quantitative skill not reported here.
dd20ebadf35c6657603348d64897ca884d8190d2.open_work: Testing across more radars, seasons and mixed precipitation-clutter situations.
dd20ebadf35c6657603348d64897ca884d8190d2.issues: Evaluation details unknown; feature thresholds may be radar- and site-specific, and embedded clutter within precipitation remains difficult.

23e0d9449e105f0afbd0c5d4a27ccca59dd2e61c.goal: Forecasts airborne pollen concentration time series, which matter for allergy warnings, using nonlinear data-driven models.
23e0d9449e105f0afbd0c5d4a27ccca59dd2e61c.architecture: Neural network and neuro-fuzzy models (adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference) for time series forecasting, compared against each other.
23e0d9449e105f0afbd0c5d4a27ccca59dd2e61c.data: Airborne pollen concentration time series; taxon, site and periods not reported here.
23e0d9449e105f0afbd0c5d4a27ccca59dd2e61c.result: Neural and neuro-fuzzy models provide usable forecasts of pollen concentration; comparative numbers not reported here.
23e0d9449e105f0afbd0c5d4a27ccca59dd2e61c.open_work: Adding meteorological predictors and extending to other pollen types and stations.
23e0d9449e105f0afbd0c5d4a27ccca59dd2e61c.issues: Single-site, single-taxon time series limit generality; peak-season extremes are hard to capture.

be5eb363decaacc61c7f98f6e798a4da6a6df147.goal: Compares methods for reconstructing past sea surface temperatures from planktonic foraminifer census counts, a key paleoclimate proxy transfer problem.
be5eb363decaacc61c7f98f6e798a4da6a6df147.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward MLP) compared with statistical transfer techniques such as the modern analog technique and regression-based transfer functions.
be5eb363decaacc61c7f98f6e798a4da6a6df147.data: Core-top planktonic foraminifer census data with modern sea surface temperatures (Atlantic calibration set); exact datasets not reported here.
be5eb363decaacc61c7f98f6e798a4da6a6df147.result: The artificial neural network gives the lowest prediction errors among the compared techniques for past sea surface temperature estimation.
be5eb363decaacc61c7f98f6e798a4da6a6df147.open_work: Applying the calibrated networks to downcore records and assessing no-analog conditions.
be5eb363decaacc61c7f98f6e798a4da6a6df147.issues: Calibration set coverage limits reliability in no-analog past conditions; error estimates depend on cross-validation design.

17a8117a84ebb88e05fc55a02a396b8c413e30ee.goal: Improves the generalization of artificial neural networks in rainfall-runoff modelling, where overfitting to short calibration records degrades predictions.
17a8117a84ebb88e05fc55a02a396b8c413e30ee.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks trained with strategies to improve generalization; specific regularization variants are not detailed here.
17a8117a84ebb88e05fc55a02a396b8c413e30ee.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a catchment case study; catchment and periods not reported here.
17a8117a84ebb88e05fc55a02a396b8c413e30ee.result: Generalization-improving strategies yield more robust runoff predictions than plain training; quantitative gains not reported here.
17a8117a84ebb88e05fc55a02a396b8c413e30ee.open_work: Testing across more catchments and combining with input selection and uncertainty estimation.
17a8117a84ebb88e05fc55a02a396b8c413e30ee.issues: Single case study; behaviour for extreme floods outside the calibration range is untested.

c8f111f955964dd91aacf0875ac84eaca39a4520.goal: Forecasts daily river flow one step ahead in Portuguese watersheds to support water management.
c8f111f955964dd91aacf0875ac84eaca39a4520.architecture: Neural network approaches for one-step flow forecasting; the specific network types are not specified here.
