d0dc5ca6d64419883b91a638d5ad8d3b6d450ff0.data: Regional tree-ring chronology and instrumental temperatures from Lapland (northern Finland and Sweden), AD 1802–1998 instrumental, reconstruction AD 802–1801.
d0dc5ca6d64419883b91a638d5ad8d3b6d450ff0.result: MLR and ANN reconstruct reliably; linear scaling fails. MLR shows ~0.5 °C cooling from the Medieval Warm Period to the Little Ice Age, ANNs 0.2–0.5 °C.
d0dc5ca6d64419883b91a638d5ad8d3b6d450ff0.open_work: Applying ANNs to proxies and environments with more complex, noisier climate relationships.
d0dc5ca6d64419883b91a638d5ad8d3b6d450ff0.issues: Larger model disagreement outside the calibration period; ANNs give no clear benefit for this timberline dataset.

b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.goal: Nowcasts rainfall fields 30 min to 1 h ahead from geostationary satellite imagery for severe-weather warning.
b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.architecture: Neural network approach that extrapolates infrared radiance fields forward in time, followed by a calibrated microwave-based combined rainfall algorithm.
b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.data: Meteosat 7 infrared imagery with microwave-calibrated rain estimates; a rainfall event over Central Italy.
b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.result: The method produces short-term rainfall field forecasts whose accuracy is quantified by error indicators for the case study.
b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.open_work: Testing on more events and comparing with radar-based and optical-flow nowcasting.
b7ae33131f430de8add9cd44a0b7afeea06219f3.issues: Single case-study evaluation; IR-based rain retrieval is indirect and errors accumulate with lead time.

80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.goal: Supports pump operation in an urban flood control system by predicting water levels in a detention pond.
80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.architecture: Counterpropagation fuzzy-neural network trained on past operation records.
80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.data: Rainfall, water level and pump operation records from the Yu-Cheng pumping station in Taipei City, Taiwan.
80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.result: The network reproduces flood-control operation and predicts pond water levels accurately enough to aid operators.
80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.open_work: Extending to multi-step forecasts and real-time optimization of pump schedules.
80b9ba4edc757c21553e13471f4a5dec4d3c843c.issues: Trained on limited historical typhoon/storm events; extreme events beyond the training range are uncertain.

86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.goal: Builds virtual sensors that estimate missing or unavailable spectral bands of remote sensing instruments from other measured bands.
86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.architecture: Data-mining regression methods learning mappings between spectral bands; the specific learners are not detailed here.
86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.data: Multispectral satellite observations such as MODIS reflectances over snow and ice; other details not reported in the available metadata.
86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies accurate and efficient estimation of spectra from other channels.
86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.open_work: Applying virtual sensors to other instruments and quantifying uncertainty in estimated channels.
86631f9d22b19c795a38a5f7d0387d79d7af2165.issues: Learned mappings may not transfer across surface types, seasons or sensors.

f8e95a45ba1cef9a0c5cf8c3b9cb8547dcba9500.goal: Applies neuro-evolution to train rainfall-runoff neural networks as an alternative to gradient-based training.
f8e95a45ba1cef9a0c5cf8c3b9cb8547dcba9500.architecture: Symbiotic adaptive neuro-evolution (SANE), a genetic-algorithm method that evolves neural network neurons, compared with conventionally trained neural networks.
f8e95a45ba1cef9a0c5cf8c3b9cb8547dcba9500.data: Rainfall and river flow records from a catchment in northern England (River Ouse).
f8e95a45ba1cef9a0c5cf8c3b9cb8547dcba9500.result: SANE-evolved networks produce runoff forecasts competitive with conventionally trained networks.
f8e95a45ba1cef9a0c5cf8c3b9cb8547dcba9500.open_work: Testing on more catchments, longer lead times and other evolutionary strategies.
f8e95a45ba1cef9a0c5cf8c3b9cb8547dcba9500.issues: Single catchment; evolutionary training is computationally costly and results vary between runs.

f48fef27b8474b9019897b533b24cad33bd8ae8b.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power output to support grid integration of solar generation.
f48fef27b8474b9019897b533b24cad33bd8ae8b.data: PV power output and weather records from a photovoltaic system; details not reported in the available metadata.
f48fef27b8474b9019897b533b24cad33bd8ae8b.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the title implies SVR forecasts PV output with good accuracy.
f48fef27b8474b9019897b533b24cad33bd8ae8b.open_work: Adding weather forecast inputs and extending to longer horizons and other plants.
f48fef27b8474b9019897b533b24cad33bd8ae8b.issues: Evaluation scope is not reported; dependence on weather inputs and cloudy-day performance are unclear.

69ef1982160aedd4d64dc6db7fc660f0b53367cf.goal: Forecasts water inflow to hydropower reservoirs in Brazil to support energy planning.
69ef1982160aedd4d64dc6db7fc660f0b53367cf.architecture: Echo state network (reservoir computing recurrent neural network) compared with other neural forecasters.
69ef1982160aedd4d64dc6db7fc660f0b53367cf.data: Historical inflow series from a Brazilian hydroelectric plant; other details not reported in the available metadata.

42718f17453c8cebb7d1dde46d7c44ce60ef999d.goal: Evaluates how general circulation models represent synoptically forced precipitation in the Mackenzie River Basin and how it changes in the future.
42718f17453c8cebb7d1dde46d7c44ce60ef999d.architecture: Self-organizing maps classify synoptic sea level pressure patterns, used to diagnose precipitation by pattern in reanalysis and GCMs; climate diagnosis rather than prediction.
42718f17453c8cebb7d1dde46d7c44ce60ef999d.data: Reanalysis atmospheric fields and precipitation with CMIP3 (IPCC AR4) GCM simulations for present and future climates.
42718f17453c8cebb7d1dde46d7c44ce60ef999d.result: GCMs reproduce the main synoptic patterns; projected precipitation increases arise mainly from changes within patterns (more moisture) rather than circulation frequency changes.

42718f17453c8cebb7d1dde46d7c44ce60ef999d.issues: Coarse GCM resolution and reanalysis precipitation uncertainty; SOM node choice affects attribution.

559d0ebab46656f64c6eb5e347de891be2170b1d.goal: Develops short-term rain forecasting for northeastern Thailand to support agriculture and weather modification operations.

e202aa812b9a5a66cdd262f1cd6d402eef753d77.goal: Improves real-time rainfall-runoff forecasts from lumped conceptual models by updating their outputs.

309460e5076883062f5e76932bc0802c1cc974ca.goal: Develops fuzzy logic rainfall-runoff modelling that uses soil moisture measurements to represent catchment state.
309460e5076883062f5e76932bc0802c1cc974ca.architecture: Fuzzy rule-based (fuzzy logic) rainfall-runoff model with measured soil moisture as state input.
309460e5076883062f5e76932bc0802c1cc974ca.data: Rainfall, runoff and soil moisture measurements from a small German catchment (Frankelbach).

fd856b50ccda1807edf0c41d21c5d6b76c7f6d88.goal: Determines aerosol optical properties from a calibrated all-sky imager as a low-cost alternative to sun photometers.
fd856b50ccda1807edf0c41d21c5d6b76c7f6d88.architecture: Neural network estimating aerosol optical depth and related properties from sky imager radiances.

fd856b50ccda1807edf0c41d21c5d6b76c7f6d88.issues: Single-site training; retrievals limited to cloud-free skies and dependent on camera calibration.

baca9d264a5c6cbc09dcbd432d8c3284a13506fa.goal: Uses data mining to discover ocean climate indices that explain land climate variability.
baca9d264a5c6cbc09dcbd432d8c3284a13506fa.architecture: Shared nearest neighbour (SNN) clustering of ocean time series to identify candidate climate indices.
baca9d264a5c6cbc09dcbd432d8c3284a13506fa.data: Global gridded sea surface temperature and sea level pressure from reanalysis, with land climate variables for correlation.
baca9d264a5c6cbc09dcbd432d8c3284a13506fa.result: Clusters reproduce known indices such as SOI and NAO and suggest new candidate indices correlated with land climate.

baca9d264a5c6cbc09dcbd432d8c3284a13506fa.issues: Clustering results depend on parameters; candidate indices may be spurious correlations.

72ad8089d8cbd52de4badf5720a096e7333446c1.goal: Improves snowfall forecasts by accounting for climatological variability of snow density instead of a fixed 10:1 snow-to-liquid ratio.
72ad8089d8cbd52de4badf5720a096e7333446c1.architecture: Artificial neural network ensemble (from Roebber et al.) diagnosing snow-to-liquid ratio classes from atmospheric profiles, compared with climatology and the 10:1 rule.

72ad8089d8cbd52de4badf5720a096e7333446c1.result: Snow-to-liquid ratios vary widely; the neural network approach diagnoses snow density better than the 10:1 rule or climatology, improving snowfall forecasts.

72ad8089d8cbd52de4badf5720a096e7333446c1.issues: Relies on accurate model profiles; observation errors in snow density are large.

00ae152c0e1cc5043744b7637bb6dd73b265b8c0.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration from limited climatic data in Burkina Faso, where full meteorological records are scarce.

1b252ddf3ce501f3adb6e1244b542a727d4d4f6a.goal: Evaluates artificial neural network techniques for retrieving phytoplankton pigment concentration from ocean colour in Case I waters.

81ba53059fe466d0be561be5ab4a2cb56b6d5c1c.goal: Speeds up climate model radiation calculations by emulating the full longwave and shortwave radiation parameterizations with neural networks, and tests them in decadal simulations.
81ba53059fe466d0be561be5ab4a2cb56b6d5c1c.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network emulations of the longwave and shortwave radiation schemes, run online in a general circulation model.

81ba53059fe466d0be561be5ab4a2cb56b6d5c1c.result: Decadal climate simulations with neural network radiation are close to the control run while the radiation calculations are much faster.

81ba53059fe466d0be561be5ab4a2cb56b6d5c1c.issues: Emulators may degrade outside the training climate; errors can accumulate in long runs.

3d141b27f2fcddf1cedf466d42fd348a3c84acde.goal: Examines nonlinear interdecadal changes in the El Niño-Southern Oscillation, in particular around the late-1970s climate shift.
3d141b27f2fcddf1cedf466d42fd348a3c84acde.architecture: Nonlinear principal component analysis using an autoassociative neural network, compared with linear PCA.
3d141b27f2fcddf1cedf466d42fd348a3c84acde.data: Tropical Pacific SST and related fields from observational analyses for periods before and after the late 1970s; details not reported here.

3d141b27f2fcddf1cedf466d42fd348a3c84acde.issues: Short sub-periods limit statistical robustness; NLPCA can overfit.

02430d569a518e6e167c1fd632d230994b170671.goal: Models the water level-discharge (rating curve) relationship for an Indian river where conventional rating curves perform poorly.
02430d569a518e6e167c1fd632d230994b170671.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural networks and M5 model trees compared with a conventional rating curve.

2195c38a27a45980395288446755e1f8b59ab824.result: Not reported in the abstract; the networks retrieve soil moisture with acceptable accuracy.

5ea44a52c63986d05177a8819c6a73cca6411be9.goal: Automatic, real-time detection of tsunami signals in deep-sea water-level (bottom pressure) records, to support tsunami early warning without operator intervention.
5ea44a52c63986d05177a8819c6a73cca6411be9.architecture: Artificial neural network algorithm that separates the tsunami signal from tidal and other background components of the sea-level series; the network type is not specified beyond ANN.
5ea44a52c63986d05177a8819c6a73cca6411be9.data: Deep-sea sea-level measurements from ocean-bottom pressure recorders; specific stations and periods are not reported here.
5ea44a52c63986d05177a8819c6a73cca6411be9.result: The ANN algorithm is presented as able to flag tsunami waves in real time in the deep-sea records; quantitative detection skill is not available here.
5ea44a52c63986d05177a8819c6a73cca6411be9.open_work: Testing on more real tsunami events and integration into operational warning networks.
5ea44a52c63986d05177a8819c6a73cca6411be9.issues: Few real tsunami events exist for validation; false-alarm behaviour under noise and seismic-induced pressure signals needs careful evaluation.

3c838b2b16eb2cb74da4a555f82f420274c398b0.goal: Interpolating annual mean precipitation and temperature surfaces over China, where climate varies nonlinearly with latitude, longitude and elevation.
3c838b2b16eb2cb74da4a555f82f420274c398b0.architecture: MLP neural network trained with resilient backpropagation (Rprop) using latitude, longitude and elevation as inputs; network structure chosen by cross-validation.
3c838b2b16eb2cb74da4a555f82f420274c398b0.data: 288 long-term climate stations in China; elevation from a 5 km digital elevation model.
3c838b2b16eb2cb74da4a555f82f420274c398b0.result: The temperature neurointerpolation is accurate and robust, capturing regional trends and topographic detail; the precipitation surface captures only major latitudinal and continental trends and misses subregional rainfall features.
3c838b2b16eb2cb74da4a555f82f420274c398b0.open_work: Adding further predictors (e.g. atmospheric or topographic factors such as aspect or distance to coast) to improve precipitation interpolation.
3c838b2b16eb2cb74da4a555f82f420274c398b0.issues: Sparse station network for a large, complex country; only three geographic inputs, so precipitation features driven by unparameterized factors are lost.

2a96c425dbfa93f71ed6ee7277ac6a87a31885d4.goal: Regionalisation of hydrological variables, especially flood quantile estimation for ungauged catchments, treated as a data mining problem.
2a96c425dbfa93f71ed6ee7277ac6a87a31885d4.architecture: Artificial neural networks used both to classify catchments by geomorphological and climatic characteristics (clustering) and to relate flow quantiles to those characteristics, compared with multiple linear regression (Method of Residuals).
2a96c425dbfa93f71ed6ee7277ac6a87a31885d4.data: Catchment data sets from south-west England and Wales; England, Wales and Scotland; and the islands of Java and Sumatra, Indonesia.
2a96c425dbfa93f71ed6ee7277ac6a87a31885d4.result: Hydrologically plausible clusters emerge under contrasting climates; ANN relationships for annual flood distribution parameters give lower validation RMSE than regression, with a clear advantage in Java and Sumatra from recognising three catchment classes.
2a96c425dbfa93f71ed6ee7277ac6a87a31885d4.open_work: Wider evaluation of the methodology across more regions is recommended by the authors.
2a96c425dbfa93f71ed6ee7277ac6a87a31885d4.issues: Limited number of catchments per data set; cluster interpretation and ANN generalisation to new regions are not fully established.

02a447a79cc454453278896105c203f5ccaf2b66.goal: Downscaling coarse precipitation fields to finer spatial resolution for hydrological applications, presenting the NN5 neural network approach.
02a447a79cc454453278896105c203f5ccaf2b66.architecture: Neural network based downscaling model (NN5); the specific network type and predictors are not specified here.
02a447a79cc454453278896105c203f5ccaf2b66.data: Precipitation fields and observations used for training and testing are not reported here.
02a447a79cc454453278896105c203f5ccaf2b66.result: Preliminary results indicate the approach can produce finer-scale precipitation fields; quantitative skill is not available here.
02a447a79cc454453278896105c203f5ccaf2b66.open_work: Fuller validation over more events and regions, and coupling with hydrological models.
02a447a79cc454453278896105c203f5ccaf2b66.issues: Preliminary study; performance for extreme precipitation and transferability are not established.

3ac3b5d0a5471d3065d50094b19ee2217c8a1009.goal: Online flood forecasting in flash-flood prone catchments where short response times demand very fast yet physically consistent forecasts.
3ac3b5d0a5471d3065d50094b19ee2217c8a1009.architecture: PAI-OFF (Process modelling and Artificial Intelligence for Online Flood Forecasting): a neural network trained on synthetic rainfall-runoff events generated by a process-based hydrological model, replacing the slow model in real time.
3ac3b5d0a5471d3065d50094b19ee2217c8a1009.data: Synthetic events from a distributed hydrological model driven by generated rainfall scenarios, applied to a flash-flood prone mountain catchment in Germany; details not reported here.
3ac3b5d0a5471d3065d50094b19ee2217c8a1009.result: The trained network reproduces the process model's discharge forecasts at a small fraction of the computational cost, making real-time ensemble or online operation feasible.
3ac3b5d0a5471d3065d50094b19ee2217c8a1009.open_work: Extension to other catchments and inclusion of forecast rainfall uncertainty.
3ac3b5d0a5471d3065d50094b19ee2217c8a1009.issues: Skill is bounded by the underlying process model and the representativeness of the synthetic training events.

8d42613752c7091cfba560e3f4c6303120258ce5.goal: Short-term wind speed forecasting for wind farms, combining time series modelling with neural networks.
8d42613752c7091cfba560e3f4c6303120258ce5.architecture: Hybrid of a time series model and a neural network; the specific network type is not specified here.
8d42613752c7091cfba560e3f4c6303120258ce5.data: Wind speed time series from a wind farm; site and period are not reported here.
8d42613752c7091cfba560e3f4c6303120258ce5.result: The combined method is reported to improve forecast accuracy over single methods; numbers are not available here.
8d42613752c7091cfba560e3f4c6303120258ce5.open_work: Testing at more sites and longer horizons.
8d42613752c7091cfba560e3f4c6303120258ce5.issues: Evaluation details unknown; no abstract available to confirm data and metrics.

50cf591034235e84dd0d120a5ac82d0bf8c930a5.goal: Estimating ocean wave parameters (such as significant wave height and period) with data-driven methods as an alternative to empirical or numerical approaches.
50cf591034235e84dd0d120a5ac82d0bf8c930a5.architecture: Feedforward MLP neural networks trained with backpropagation.
50cf591034235e84dd0d120a5ac82d0bf8c930a5.data: Measured wave and related data from Indian coastal waters; details not reported here.
50cf591034235e84dd0d120a5ac82d0bf8c930a5.result: The backpropagation networks estimate wave parameters with reasonable accuracy; specific scores are not available here.
50cf591034235e84dd0d120a5ac82d0bf8c930a5.open_work: Comparison with numerical wave models and extension to longer lead times and other locations.
50cf591034235e84dd0d120a5ac82d0bf8c930a5.issues: Site-specific training; generalisation and performance for extreme waves are uncertain.

50571723629f7a5daefd6a1fd5b6985bd0202522.goal: Synthesising load profiles and predicting wind-power generation for an isolated power system to support dispatch with significant wind penetration.
50571723629f7a5daefd6a1fd5b6985bd0202522.architecture: Artificial neural network for wind-power generation prediction combined with load profile synthesis; the network type is not specified here.
50571723629f7a5daefd6a1fd5b6985bd0202522.data: Load and wind-power records from an isolated island power system in Taiwan; details not reported here.
50571723629f7a5daefd6a1fd5b6985bd0202522.result: The approach yields usable load profiles and wind-power forecasts for operating the isolated system; quantitative scores are not available here.
50571723629f7a5daefd6a1fd5b6985bd0202522.open_work: Integration with unit commitment and longer forecast horizons.
50571723629f7a5daefd6a1fd5b6985bd0202522.issues: Single system; forecast uncertainty is not characterised.

eaf4966511ebf8c6694b553e30ed4a5d3adcb237.goal: Monitoring the seasonal flooding of Sahelian floodplains, where inundation dynamics matter for livelihoods and ecosystems.
eaf4966511ebf8c6694b553e30ed4a5d3adcb237.architecture: Fourier (harmonic) analysis of MODIS time series to derive features, followed by an artificial neural network classifier; the network type is not specified beyond ANN.
eaf4966511ebf8c6694b553e30ed4a5d3adcb237.data: MODIS time-series imagery over a Sahelian floodplain, with reference data on flooded areas; details not reported here.
eaf4966511ebf8c6694b553e30ed4a5d3adcb237.result: Fourier components combined with an ANN map floodplain inundation patterns; accuracy figures are not available here.
eaf4966511ebf8c6694b553e30ed4a5d3adcb237.open_work: Application to other floodplains and years, and near-real-time operation.
eaf4966511ebf8c6694b553e30ed4a5d3adcb237.issues: Coarse MODIS resolution and cloud or vegetation effects can limit detection of flooded areas.

c263ba0376b8723a4254af8e8b724ba11d750c35.goal: Testing a knowledge-based expert system that guides forecasters through a systematic approach to tropical cyclone track forecasting.
c263ba0376b8723a4254af8e8b724ba11d750c35.architecture: Not machine learning: a rule-based expert system prototype implementing the Systematic Approach to track forecasting, recognising synoptic patterns and known model error mechanisms.
c263ba0376b8723a4254af8e8b724ba11d750c35.data: Beta test with operational tropical cyclone cases and track guidance at a forecast centre; details not reported here.
c263ba0376b8723a4254af8e8b724ba11d750c35.result: The beta test shows the prototype can help forecasters identify and correct erroneous model track guidance; quantitative improvements are not available here.
c263ba0376b8723a4254af8e8b724ba11d750c35.open_work: Refining the rule base and moving the prototype to operational use.
c263ba0376b8723a4254af8e8b724ba11d750c35.issues: Limited test season; benefits depend on forecaster interaction and the subjectivity of pattern recognition.

d98800c068ec38b9d8a1042556420a01351aa025.goal: Site-specific forecasting of hourly ground-level ozone, given nonlinear relationships between ozone and meteorological variables and growing smog problems.
d98800c068ec38b9d8a1042556420a01351aa025.architecture: Three dynamic neural networks: a time-lagged feedforward network, a recurrent neural network and a Bayesian neural network, compared with a standard MLP.
d98800c068ec38b9d8a1042556420a01351aa025.data: Hourly ozone and meteorological observations in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada.
d98800c068ec38b9d8a1042556420a01351aa025.result: All three dynamic networks are effective and outperform the MLP; the Bayesian neural network additionally provides confidence intervals and resists under- and over-fitting.
d98800c068ec38b9d8a1042556420a01351aa025.open_work: Extension to more sites and longer horizons, and operational use of uncertainty estimates.
d98800c068ec38b9d8a1042556420a01351aa025.issues: Single city; quantitative scores are not given in the abstract.

8ffe045203703183ed7e63df36b97c62338d2c85.goal: Comparing neural network forecasts with Box-Jenkins (ARIMA) time series models for ambient air quality monitoring data.
8ffe045203703183ed7e63df36b97c62338d2c85.architecture: Artificial neural network (type not specified here) compared with Box-Jenkins ARIMA models.
8ffe045203703183ed7e63df36b97c62338d2c85.data: Ambient air quality monitoring time series; station, pollutants and period are not reported here.
8ffe045203703183ed7e63df36b97c62338d2c85.result: The relative performance of neural networks and Box-Jenkins forecasts is reported; specific numbers are not available here.
8ffe045203703183ed7e63df36b97c62338d2c85.open_work: Hybrid statistical and neural approaches and inclusion of meteorological predictors.
8ffe045203703183ed7e63df36b97c62338d2c85.issues: Univariate time series forecasting ignores meteorology; results depend on the stations and pollutants studied.

f0980ed0acb627821b535f70630fcb91b06f0cd4.goal: Reconstructing past sea-surface conditions (temperature, salinity, sea-ice cover) in Arctic and sub-Arctic seas from dinoflagellate cyst assemblages.
f0980ed0acb627821b535f70630fcb91b06f0cd4.architecture: Artificial neural network transfer function relating dinocyst assemblages to sea-surface parameters, compared with the modern analogue technique; the network type is not specified beyond ANN.
f0980ed0acb627821b535f70630fcb91b06f0cd4.data: Modern high-latitude dinocyst reference database from surface sediments with associated sea-surface conditions, applied to sediment cores.
f0980ed0acb627821b535f70630fcb91b06f0cd4.result: The ANN provides reconstructions of sea-surface conditions comparable to established transfer-function methods; error figures are not available here.
f0980ed0acb627821b535f70630fcb91b06f0cd4.open_work: Expansion of the modern database and combined use of several transfer functions.
f0980ed0acb627821b535f70630fcb91b06f0cd4.issues: Reconstructions depend on the modern calibration set; no-analogue situations and extrapolation are problematic.

33e7bee179d77b49a5b2d274c21e61335547e65a.goal: Time-series forecasting of wind speed at a wind farm to support wind power integration.
33e7bee179d77b49a5b2d274c21e61335547e65a.architecture: Neural network time-series model; the specific network type is not specified here.
33e7bee179d77b49a5b2d274c21e61335547e65a.data: Wind speed series from a wind farm; site and period are not reported here.
33e7bee179d77b49a5b2d274c21e61335547e65a.result: Neural networks are reported to forecast wind speed with useful accuracy; numbers are not available here.
33e7bee179d77b49a5b2d274c21e61335547e65a.open_work: Hybrid models and longer forecast horizons.
33e7bee179d77b49a5b2d274c21e61335547e65a.issues: Evaluation details unknown; no abstract available to confirm methods and metrics.

eafb4cafdbd65b7d47b0a6f7cc1c9ac7fe122006.goal: Extracting nonlinear spatio-temporal modes of tropical Pacific climate variability, generalising linear singular spectrum analysis.
eafb4cafdbd65b7d47b0a6f7cc1c9ac7fe122006.architecture: Nonlinear multichannel singular spectrum analysis (NLSSA): SSA for dimension reduction, then a nonlinear PCA autoencoder neural network with a circular bottleneck node combining the leading SSA PCs.
eafb4cafdbd65b7d47b0a6f7cc1c9ac7fe122006.data: Tropical Pacific sea surface temperature anomaly and sea level pressure anomaly fields, 1950–2000.
eafb4cafdbd65b7d47b0a6f7cc1c9ac7fe122006.result: NLSSA mode 1 shows shorter, more intense warm periods than cool periods as in ENSO, with eastern-Pacific warm and central-Pacific cool peaks; mode 2 reveals a quasi-triennial wave of about 39 months.
eafb4cafdbd65b7d47b0a6f7cc1c9ac7fe122006.open_work: Application to other climate fields and phenomena, and use of nonlinear modes for prediction.
eafb4cafdbd65b7d47b0a6f7cc1c9ac7fe122006.issues: Results depend on the SSA truncation and network settings; nonlinear PCA can overfit with short records.

bff76215882ba9517340b663d063b4939cb96b21.goal: Building a hybrid coupled model for ENSO by replacing the dynamical atmosphere with a statistical neural network atmosphere.
bff76215882ba9517340b663d063b4939cb96b21.architecture: Neural network atmospheric model (MLP) mapping sea surface temperature anomalies to wind stress anomalies, coupled to an ocean general circulation model.
bff76215882ba9517340b663d063b4939cb96b21.data: Observed tropical Pacific SST and wind stress anomalies for training; specific products are not reported here.
bff76215882ba9517340b663d063b4939cb96b21.result: The neural network atmosphere captures nonlinear SST-wind stress relationships better than linear regression, and the hybrid coupled model simulates ENSO-like variability.
bff76215882ba9517340b663d063b4939cb96b21.open_work: Using the hybrid coupled model for ENSO prediction and studying nonlinear coupled feedbacks.
bff76215882ba9517340b663d063b4939cb96b21.issues: Empirical atmosphere is limited by the short training record and may not generalise to regimes outside the training period.

b75679864fc3fa07eeef93198b271ef1559652ec.goal: Classifying Arctic scenes into sea ice, cloud, open water and leads, exploiting the newly available 1.6 μm channel that discriminates ice from cloud.
b75679864fc3fa07eeef93198b271ef1559652ec.architecture: Neural network classifier using multispectral satellite radiances including the 1.6 μm channel.
b75679864fc3fa07eeef93198b271ef1559652ec.data: AVHRR imagery including the 1.6 μm channel over the Arctic; training and validation scenes not detailed here.
b75679864fc3fa07eeef93198b271ef1559652ec.result: The neural network with 1.6 μm data separates sea ice, cloud, water and leads more effectively than without that channel; accuracy figures are not available here.
b75679864fc3fa07eeef93198b271ef1559652ec.open_work: Extension to more seasons and illumination conditions and to operational ice mapping.
b75679864fc3fa07eeef93198b271ef1559652ec.issues: 1.6 μm channel requires daylight; limited labelled scenes for training and validation.

0e8a9e0d38a7775975a66fada417b1cd8e4cef09.goal: Modelling and predicting ambient ozone concentrations, where nonlinear meteorology-chemistry interactions limit linear models.
0e8a9e0d38a7775975a66fada417b1cd8e4cef09.architecture: Artificial neural networks (type not specified here) compared with linear statistical models.
0e8a9e0d38a7775975a66fada417b1cd8e4cef09.data: Ozone and meteorological monitoring data; site and period are not reported here.
0e8a9e0d38a7775975a66fada417b1cd8e4cef09.result: The neural networks are reported to model and predict ozone better than linear approaches; specific scores are not available here.
0e8a9e0d38a7775975a66fada417b1cd8e4cef09.open_work: Testing at additional sites and for operational next-day forecasting.
0e8a9e0d38a7775975a66fada417b1cd8e4cef09.issues: Site-specific training; peak ozone episodes may be underpredicted.

0fe634f3981f10e31f8cda3e7f6e0132396b0543.goal: Examining how Indian Ocean Dipole events modulate intraseasonal zonal currents in the eastern equatorial Indian Ocean.
0fe634f3981f10e31f8cda3e7f6e0132396b0543.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) analysis used to classify patterns of the zonal current variability.
0fe634f3981f10e31f8cda3e7f6e0132396b0543.data: Moored ADCP current observations at 90°E on the equator; period not detailed here.
0fe634f3981f10e31f8cda3e7f6e0132396b0543.result: The SOM reveals that intraseasonal zonal current patterns differ during Indian Ocean Dipole years compared with normal years; details are not available here.
0fe634f3981f10e31f8cda3e7f6e0132396b0543.open_work: Linking the patterns to wind forcing and equatorial wave dynamics with models.
0fe634f3981f10e31f8cda3e7f6e0132396b0543.issues: Single mooring location and limited number of IOD events.

019a5ed54ab5f87d096a35d1bec6e3e0c881a4d3.goal: Downscaling ensemble weather forecasts to local daily variables for hydrological forecasting by comparing data-driven methods.
019a5ed54ab5f87d096a35d1bec6e3e0c881a4d3.architecture: Comparison of data-driven downscaling methods, including neural network approaches; the specific models are not specified here.
019a5ed54ab5f87d096a35d1bec6e3e0c881a4d3.data: Ensemble numerical weather forecasts and local station observations in a Canadian watershed; details not reported here.
019a5ed54ab5f87d096a35d1bec6e3e0c881a4d3.result: The comparison identifies which data-driven method downscales precipitation and temperature most skilfully; numbers are not available here.
019a5ed54ab5f87d096a35d1bec6e3e0c881a4d3.open_work: Using downscaled ensembles to drive hydrological ensemble streamflow forecasts.
019a5ed54ab5f87d096a35d1bec6e3e0c881a4d3.issues: Downscaled precipitation is typically harder to reproduce than temperature; results are basin-specific.

b1a90b217b90f6e655340e4b757b39a44bf250d8.goal: Short-term wind-power prediction for wind farms to support grid operation.
b1a90b217b90f6e655340e4b757b39a44bf250d8.architecture: Piecewise support vector machine (SVM) regression model, with separate SVMs for different segments of the wind speed or power range.
b1a90b217b90f6e655340e4b757b39a44bf250d8.data: Wind farm power and wind speed records; site and period are not reported here.
b1a90b217b90f6e655340e4b757b39a44bf250d8.result: The piecewise SVM is reported to be more accurate than a single global SVM model; numbers are not available here.
b1a90b217b90f6e655340e4b757b39a44bf250d8.open_work: Inclusion of numerical weather prediction inputs and longer horizons.
b1a90b217b90f6e655340e4b757b39a44bf250d8.issues: Single wind farm; segmentation choices may be site-specific.

297fc2bad42c20671cf621d18ef52e3d93e20362.goal: Real-time retrieval of atmospheric ozone profiles from GOME satellite spectra, avoiding slow iterative physical inversions.
297fc2bad42c20671cf621d18ef52e3d93e20362.architecture: Neural network (MLP) inversion algorithm mapping GOME spectral measurements to ozone profiles.
297fc2bad42c20671cf621d18ef52e3d93e20362.data: GOME (ERS-2) UV radiance spectra with collocated reference ozone profiles such as ozonesondes; details not reported here.
297fc2bad42c20671cf621d18ef52e3d93e20362.result: The neural algorithm retrieves ozone profiles with accuracy comparable to standard methods at much lower computational cost; numbers are not available here.
297fc2bad42c20671cf621d18ef52e3d93e20362.open_work: Application to later instruments and near-real-time operational processing.
297fc2bad42c20671cf621d18ef52e3d93e20362.issues: Accuracy limited by representativeness of training profiles; vertical resolution constrained by the measurements.

fe7f9ec2ec7a8b70db42e536f7e99c125dec8700.goal: Comparing cloud classification from GOES geostationary imagery using algorithms based on explicit physics versus implicit, statistically learned physics.
fe7f9ec2ec7a8b70db42e536f7e99c125dec8700.architecture: A physically based cloud-typing algorithm compared with a supervised machine learning classifier trained on expert-labelled samples; the classifier type is not specified here.
fe7f9ec2ec7a8b70db42e536f7e99c125dec8700.data: GOES imager data with independent reference cloud observations; details not reported here.
fe7f9ec2ec7a8b70db42e536f7e99c125dec8700.result: The comparison shows the strengths and weaknesses of each approach for different cloud types; specific accuracies are not available here.
fe7f9ec2ec7a8b70db42e536f7e99c125dec8700.open_work: Combining explicit and implicit approaches and validating with active satellite sensors.
fe7f9ec2ec7a8b70db42e536f7e99c125dec8700.issues: Reference truth for cloud type is uncertain; results depend on training sample quality.

42fecf965e045d4bb8807751b4abec741d4bf087.goal: Weather analysis and forecasting of variables such as temperature, wind speed and humidity in Canada using neurocomputing.
42fecf965e045d4bb8807751b4abec741d4bf087.architecture: Comparison of neural network models, including MLP and other network types; the exact set is not specified here.
42fecf965e045d4bb8807751b4abec741d4bf087.data: Station weather observations from a Canadian site; details not reported here.
42fecf965e045d4bb8807751b4abec741d4bf087.result: Neural networks are reported to forecast weather variables effectively, with differences between network types; numbers are not available here.
42fecf965e045d4bb8807751b4abec741d4bf087.open_work: Ensembles of networks and extension to more variables and sites.
42fecf965e045d4bb8807751b4abec741d4bf087.issues: Single site and short record; no comparison with numerical weather prediction.

a2954208bbb33dd00ef0357ebcfbbcf95f924fbe.goal: Predicting river ice jam occurrence, which causes flooding and damage, from hydrometeorological conditions.
a2954208bbb33dd00ef0357ebcfbbcf95f924fbe.architecture: Artificial neural network classifier (type not specified here) predicting ice jam occurrence.
a2954208bbb33dd00ef0357ebcfbbcf95f924fbe.data: Historical ice jam records with temperature and discharge data for a river site in the United States; details not reported here.
a2954208bbb33dd00ef0357ebcfbbcf95f924fbe.result: The neural network predicts ice jam occurrence with useful accuracy; specific figures are not available here.
a2954208bbb33dd00ef0357ebcfbbcf95f924fbe.open_work: Operational use for ice jam warning and application to other rivers.
a2954208bbb33dd00ef0357ebcfbbcf95f924fbe.issues: Ice jam events are rare, giving small and imbalanced training sets.

80a2ce984c001a3dcf8cbf542808fd58d650a087.goal: Modelling river flowrate with neural networks and examining how the selection of the training set affects model quality.
80a2ce984c001a3dcf8cbf542808fd58d650a087.architecture: Neural network flow model with systematic training-set selection; the network type is not specified here.
80a2ce984c001a3dcf8cbf542808fd58d650a087.data: River flowrate and related hydrological time series; river and period are not reported here.
80a2ce984c001a3dcf8cbf542808fd58d650a087.result: The choice of training set strongly influences prediction quality, and representative selection improves performance; numbers are not available here.
80a2ce984c001a3dcf8cbf542808fd58d650a087.open_work: Generalising the selection strategy to other rivers and variables.
80a2ce984c001a3dcf8cbf542808fd58d650a087.issues: Single river data set; extremes outside the training range remain hard to predict.

b5035be59682b91fc1b8c444ae62d0fc749d2c9d.goal: Deriving trends in daily maximum surface ozone after removing the influence of meteorological variability.
b5035be59682b91fc1b8c444ae62d0fc749d2c9d.architecture: MLP neural network relating daily maximum ozone to meteorological variables, used to meteorologically adjust ozone series before trend estimation.
b5035be59682b91fc1b8c444ae62d0fc749d2c9d.data: Daily maximum surface ozone and meteorological observations at UK monitoring sites; details not reported here.
b5035be59682b91fc1b8c444ae62d0fc749d2c9d.result: Meteorologically adjusted trends differ from raw trends, clarifying underlying changes in ozone; specific trend values are not available here.
b5035be59682b91fc1b8c444ae62d0fc749d2c9d.open_work: Applying the method at more sites and for other pollutants.
b5035be59682b91fc1b8c444ae62d0fc749d2c9d.issues: Trend attribution depends on the network capturing all meteorological influence; nonstationarity in emissions-meteorology relationships.

a46d34c8c819b1ed31cdace6fb47196530d76506.goal: Modelling ice thickness growth on Canadian lakes, important for ice roads, safety and lake ecology.
a46d34c8c819b1ed31cdace6fb47196530d76506.architecture: Artificial neural networks (type not specified here) compared with traditional degree-day ice growth models.
a46d34c8c819b1ed31cdace6fb47196530d76506.data: Lake ice thickness, snow depth and air temperature records from Canadian lakes; details not reported here.
a46d34c8c819b1ed31cdace6fb47196530d76506.result: The ANNs model ice growth with skill comparable to or better than empirical models; numbers are not available here.
a46d34c8c819b1ed31cdace6fb47196530d76506.open_work: Inclusion of further meteorological predictors and application to climate change projections.
a46d34c8c819b1ed31cdace6fb47196530d76506.issues: Limited ice thickness records; transferability between lakes uncertain.

4447890161b02d52e914657613b8e169ea037981.goal: Monitoring soil moisture and the growth cycle of wheat fields from radar data.
4447890161b02d52e914657613b8e169ea037981.architecture: Neural networks (MLP) trained on simulations of a discrete radiative transfer backscatter model of wheat canopies including multiple scattering, plus multitemporal ground data.
4447890161b02d52e914657613b8e169ea037981.data: ERS SAR signatures and ground truth at Great Driffield (UK) for model testing and training; multitemporal, multifrequency RASAM radiometer-scatterometer data at the Central Plain site for retrieval testing.
4447890161b02d52e914657613b8e169ea037981.result: The model-trained networks retrieve soil moisture and wheat growth stage from radar data; quantitative accuracy is not given in the abstract.
4447890161b02d52e914657613b8e169ea037981.open_work: Application to other crops and operational SAR missions.
4447890161b02d52e914657613b8e169ea037981.issues: Few test sites; performance depends on the fidelity of the backscatter model.

e8d67bf37ec98a29a22dd27788d4f16d5583a5ce.goal: Estimating rainfall from polarimetric S-band radar measurements and validating a neural network approach.
e8d67bf37ec98a29a22dd27788d4f16d5583a5ce.architecture: Neural network (MLP) rainfall estimator using polarimetric observables, trained on simulated radar variables from drop size distributions.
e8d67bf37ec98a29a22dd27788d4f16d5583a5ce.data: Polarimetric S-band radar observations (KOUN, Oklahoma) with rain gauge network data for validation.
e8d67bf37ec98a29a22dd27788d4f16d5583a5ce.result: The neural network rainfall estimates compare favourably with conventional polarimetric rainfall algorithms against gauges; numbers are not available here.
e8d67bf37ec98a29a22dd27788d4f16d5583a5ce.open_work: Applying the approach to operational dual-polarization radar networks and other climates.
e8d67bf37ec98a29a22dd27788d4f16d5583a5ce.issues: Validation limited to one region and season; training relies on modelled drop size distributions.

49bb26fb718b6712c159dffe3d59fd9e756c216c.goal: Representing the quasi-biennial oscillation (QBO) of tropical stratospheric winds with a one-dimensional nonlinear description.
49bb26fb718b6712c159dffe3d59fd9e756c216c.architecture: Circular nonlinear principal component analysis (NLPCA.cir), an autoencoder neural network with a circular bottleneck node for quasiperiodic phenomena.
49bb26fb718b6712c159dffe3d59fd9e756c216c.data: Near-equatorial station zonal winds at 70–10 hPa, 1956–2000.
49bb26fb718b6712c159dffe3d59fd9e756c216c.result: NLPCA.cir yields a better one-dimensional representation of the QBO than linear PCA and a single QBO phase series, which correlates strongly with boreal winter high-latitude stratospheric temperatures.
49bb26fb718b6712c159dffe3d59fd9e756c216c.open_work: Using the QBO phase index in studies of stratosphere-troposphere coupling and predictability.
49bb26fb718b6712c159dffe3d59fd9e756c216c.issues: One-dimensional representation cannot capture all QBO irregularities; based on a limited set of station levels.

7bd87f96033bd166382892fe13e11761e9c422e8.goal: Improving wave forecasts by incorporating neural networks and data assimilation into a third-generation wind-wave model.
7bd87f96033bd166382892fe13e11761e9c422e8.architecture: Hybrid of a third-generation spectral wind-wave model with artificial neural networks and data assimilation of observations; the network type is not specified here.
7bd87f96033bd166382892fe13e11761e9c422e8.data: Wave observations and wind forcing for a coastal region; details not reported here.
7bd87f96033bd166382892fe13e11761e9c422e8.result: The hybrid system improves wave forecasts over the wave model alone; specific error reductions are not available here.
7bd87f96033bd166382892fe13e11761e9c422e8.open_work: Extension to longer lead times and more observation types.
7bd87f96033bd166382892fe13e11761e9c422e8.issues: Improvement may decay with forecast lead time; tested in a limited area.

3bdb1ad7a2d7ea3bbd17cf29b2c77f8d632e16e6.goal: Local short-term prediction of wind speed using neural networks.
3bdb1ad7a2d7ea3bbd17cf29b2c77f8d632e16e6.architecture: Neural network time series predictor; the network type is not specified here.
3bdb1ad7a2d7ea3bbd17cf29b2c77f8d632e16e6.data: Local wind speed measurements at a site in Spain; details not reported here.
3bdb1ad7a2d7ea3bbd17cf29b2c77f8d632e16e6.result: Neural networks provide short-term wind speed predictions; comparative skill is not available here.
3bdb1ad7a2d7ea3bbd17cf29b2c77f8d632e16e6.open_work: Comparison with persistence and statistical models over more sites.

eb6b42f279ee5504fd4ad9a716c478afb05c006d.goal: Predicting peak levels of photochemical pollutants for air quality warning in an urban area.
eb6b42f279ee5504fd4ad9a716c478afb05c006d.architecture: Neural network model using meteorological and pollutant predictors, compared with statistical models.
eb6b42f279ee5504fd4ad9a716c478afb05c006d.data: Air quality and meteorological data from the Athens area, Greece; details not reported here.
eb6b42f279ee5504fd4ad9a716c478afb05c006d.result: The neural network predicts peak photochemical pollutant levels better than linear regression; numbers are not available here.
eb6b42f279ee5504fd4ad9a716c478afb05c006d.open_work: Operational use for smog alerts and inclusion of forecast meteorology.
eb6b42f279ee5504fd4ad9a716c478afb05c006d.issues: Single urban area; extreme episodes are rare in training data.

8ad9e800239689676ef7b86e7e13cdfc5a9925d2.goal: Predicting wind power generation to aid integration of wind energy into the grid.
8ad9e800239689676ef7b86e7e13cdfc5a9925d2.architecture: Artificial neural networks (type not specified here) for wind power prediction.
8ad9e800239689676ef7b86e7e13cdfc5a9925d2.data: Wind speed and power data; site and period are not reported here.
8ad9e800239689676ef7b86e7e13cdfc5a9925d2.result: Neural networks are reported to predict wind power with acceptable error; numbers are not available here.
8ad9e800239689676ef7b86e7e13cdfc5a9925d2.open_work: Comparison with other forecasting methods and longer horizons.
8ad9e800239689676ef7b86e7e13cdfc5a9925d2.issues: Conference paper with limited evaluation detail.

27899fbddca1fc21a1549665073f8741eb7ef60c.goal: Seasonal forecasting of reservoir inflow using low-frequency climate indices to support hydropower planning.
27899fbddca1fc21a1549665073f8741eb7ef60c.architecture: Comparison of data-driven methods, including several neural network types and statistical models; the exact set is not specified here.
27899fbddca1fc21a1549665073f8741eb7ef60c.data: Reservoir inflow records with low-frequency climate indices (e.g. ENSO- and NAO-type indices) for a Canadian hydropower system; details not reported here.
27899fbddca1fc21a1549665073f8741eb7ef60c.result: Some data-driven models using climate indices provide skilful seasonal inflow forecasts, outperforming simpler approaches; numbers are not available here.
27899fbddca1fc21a1549665073f8741eb7ef60c.open_work: Identifying optimal climate predictors and testing on other basins.
27899fbddca1fc21a1549665073f8741eb7ef60c.issues: Short seasonal records limit training; teleconnection relationships may be nonstationary.

98f47dd3c97bc1c1512c512496bf8aca66a04a33.goal: Identifying how synoptic-scale circulation patterns force precipitation in the Mackenzie and Yukon River basins.
98f47dd3c97bc1c1512c512496bf8aca66a04a33.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) classification of synoptic sea level pressure patterns, linked to precipitation.
98f47dd3c97bc1c1512c512496bf8aca66a04a33.data: Reanalysis sea level pressure and precipitation fields over northwestern North America; product details not reported here.
98f47dd3c97bc1c1512c512496bf8aca66a04a33.result: Specific synoptic patterns account for much of basin precipitation and its seasonal variability; quantitative details are not available here.
98f47dd3c97bc1c1512c512496bf8aca66a04a33.open_work: Using the pattern classification to evaluate climate models and projected changes.
98f47dd3c97bc1c1512c512496bf8aca66a04a33.issues: Relies on reanalysis precipitation, which is uncertain in high-latitude data-sparse basins.

23db080249a4bd0e4ebb64a762c6524d9ad12c6e.goal: Estimating daily reference evapotranspiration inside a greenhouse, where standard formulas may not apply.
23db080249a4bd0e4ebb64a762c6524d9ad12c6e.architecture: Support vector machines (SVM) compared with artificial neural networks.
23db080249a4bd0e4ebb64a762c6524d9ad12c6e.data: Greenhouse meteorological measurements and reference evapotranspiration in Iran; details not reported here.
23db080249a4bd0e4ebb64a762c6524d9ad12c6e.result: SVM and ANN both estimate reference evapotranspiration well, with their relative performance reported; numbers are not available here.
23db080249a4bd0e4ebb64a762c6524d9ad12c6e.open_work: Testing in other greenhouses and with fewer inputs.

cd1a52d8ec699ece1fe2809197d54b22dbdd631b.goal: Retrieving surface roughness and soil moisture from SAR data using neural networks.
cd1a52d8ec699ece1fe2809197d54b22dbdd631b.architecture: Neural network inversion of SAR backscatter; the network type and training set construction are not specified here.
cd1a52d8ec699ece1fe2809197d54b22dbdd631b.data: SAR backscatter data with ground measurements of roughness and soil moisture; details not reported here.
cd1a52d8ec699ece1fe2809197d54b22dbdd631b.result: The neural networks retrieve soil moisture and roughness with useful accuracy, depending on the SAR configuration; numbers are not available here.
cd1a52d8ec699ece1fe2809197d54b22dbdd631b.open_work: Using multi-angle or multi-polarisation SAR to improve retrievals.
cd1a52d8ec699ece1fe2809197d54b22dbdd631b.issues: Retrieval is ill-posed with single-configuration SAR; accuracy depends on backscatter model validity.

5245c0c7b5ce27f18e3aa93632d132934ada14c6.goal: Forecasting average winter monsoon rainfall over India from previous-year rainfall and sea surface temperature anomalies.
5245c0c7b5ce27f18e3aa93632d132934ada14c6.architecture: MLP neural network with sigmoid nonlinearity and genetic algorithm-based variable selection, compared with a multiple exponential regression fitted by Levenberg-Marquardt.
5245c0c7b5ce27f18e3aa93632d132934ada14c6.data: Indian winter monsoon rainfall and SST anomalies of previous-year winter monsoon months; SST product not reported in the abstract.
5245c0c7b5ce27f18e3aa93632d132934ada14c6.result: Linear and polynomial trends explain little variance; judged by Willmott's index, percentage error and prediction yield, the ANN outperforms the exponential regression.
5245c0c7b5ce27f18e3aa93632d132934ada14c6.open_work: Testing additional predictors and longer independent validation periods.
5245c0c7b5ce27f18e3aa93632d132934ada14c6.issues: Short annual series give few samples for training and testing; no comparison with dynamical forecasts.

e0ad39a9ca9da29273883421f45de13ccb543e09.goal: Develops a data-driven model of hydrology and water quality for agricultural watersheds as a simpler alternative to process-based watershed models.
e0ad39a9ca9da29273883421f45de13ccb543e09.architecture: Artificial neural network; the network type and configuration are not specified here.
e0ad39a9ca9da29273883421f45de13ccb543e09.data: Watershed hydrologic and water quality records from agricultural catchments; specific sites and periods are not reported here.
e0ad39a9ca9da29273883421f45de13ccb543e09.open_work: Testing transferability to other watersheds and longer records, and comparison with process-based watershed models.
e0ad39a9ca9da29273883421f45de13ccb543e09.issues: No abstract available; site-specific data-driven model with limited physical interpretability and uncertain extrapolation to changed land management.

b6d70189ccb7d999c9d1ad5bc7e69880641b001b.goal: Improves short-term weather forecasting by combining several neural network types in an ensemble rather than relying on a single network.
b6d70189ccb7d999c9d1ad5bc7e69880641b001b.architecture: Ensemble of neural networks combining multilayer perceptron (MLP), Elman recurrent network, radial basis function (RBF) network and Hopfield model outputs.
b6d70189ccb7d999c9d1ad5bc7e69880641b001b.data: Station weather records (temperature, wind speed, relative humidity) from southern Saskatchewan, Canada, used for 24-hour-ahead forecasts across seasons.
b6d70189ccb7d999c9d1ad5bc7e69880641b001b.result: The ensemble gives more accurate and reliable 24-hour forecasts than the individual networks; exact error figures are not reproduced here.
b6d70189ccb7d999c9d1ad5bc7e69880641b001b.open_work: Extending to more variables, stations and lead times and to operational comparison with NWP-based forecasts.
b6d70189ccb7d999c9d1ad5bc7e69880641b001b.issues: Single-region station data; short-range only; no comparison with NWP model output statistics.

d936a105d92f14eb977626c92739b667f2ddb363.goal: Models ground-level ozone concentrations from meteorological and precursor information using fuzzy logic to capture nonlinear, imprecise relationships.
d936a105d92f14eb977626c92739b667f2ddb363.architecture: Fuzzy logic (rule-based fuzzy inference) model; the specific fuzzy model type is not specified here.
d936a105d92f14eb977626c92739b667f2ddb363.data: Surface ozone and related meteorological and precursor measurements from monitoring stations; site and period not reported here.
d936a105d92f14eb977626c92739b667f2ddb363.open_work: Comparison with neural network and regression models and extension to forecasting at other sites.
d936a105d92f14eb977626c92739b667f2ddb363.issues: No abstract available; rule base and membership functions are site-specific; no uncertainty quantification.

f31e2feb2d27e0d29822de1880b43feb2cec1fc7.goal: Retrieves ocean surface wind speed and direction from ERS-1 scatterometer backscatter, where the inverse problem is nonlinear and has directional ambiguities.
f31e2feb2d27e0d29822de1880b43feb2cec1fc7.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks estimating wind vectors from backscatter triplets, combined with an ambiguity-removal step.
f31e2feb2d27e0d29822de1880b43feb2cec1fc7.data: ERS-1 scatterometer backscatter collocated with ECMWF wind analyses used as training targets.
f31e2feb2d27e0d29822de1880b43feb2cec1fc7.result: Neural network retrievals give wind speed and direction with accuracy comparable to or better than the standard empirical model inversion; exact scores not reproduced here.
f31e2feb2d27e0d29822de1880b43feb2cec1fc7.open_work: Application to later scatterometers and improved handling of ambiguous directions.
f31e2feb2d27e0d29822de1880b43feb2cec1fc7.issues: Trained on NWP analysis winds so inherits their errors; ambiguities remain in some conditions; limited validation against in situ buoys.

f1d26b09ee8f9ab2497ae23bfb805318996e1397.goal: Investigates whether the Euro-Atlantic winter sea level pressure response to ENSO is nonlinear, differing between El Nino and La Nina.
f1d26b09ee8f9ab2497ae23bfb805318996e1397.architecture: Nonlinear projection using a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network mapping an ENSO index onto the leading principal components of winter sea level pressure.
f1d26b09ee8f9ab2497ae23bfb805318996e1397.data: Observed or reanalysis winter sea level pressure over the Euro-Atlantic sector with a tropical Pacific ENSO index over several decades.
f1d26b09ee8f9ab2497ae23bfb805318996e1397.result: A clear nonlinear (largely quadratic) response is found: both strong El Nino and La Nina produce NAO-like anomalies with patterns not simply opposite in sign.
f1d26b09ee8f9ab2497ae23bfb805318996e1397.open_work: Testing in model simulations and examining dynamical mechanisms of the asymmetric teleconnection.
f1d26b09ee8f9ab2497ae23bfb805318996e1397.issues: Short observational record with few strong ENSO events; statistical association does not establish causality; potential overfitting of nonlinear fits.

db8bba83f7ea3adcdcf99038034d33b210e7329f.goal: Forecasts significant wave height at buoy locations in the north Indian Ocean from past observations for operational marine use.
db8bba83f7ea3adcdcf99038034d33b210e7329f.architecture: Genetic algorithm used to evolve nonlinear empirical forecast equations from lagged wave height values (a symbolic-regression style approach).
db8bba83f7ea3adcdcf99038034d33b210e7329f.data: Moored buoy significant wave height time series in the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal.
db8bba83f7ea3adcdcf99038034d33b210e7329f.result: Genetic-algorithm equations give useful short-range wave height forecasts with errors growing with lead time; exact scores not reproduced here.
db8bba83f7ea3adcdcf99038034d33b210e7329f.open_work: Adding wind forcing inputs and longer lead times, and comparison with neural networks and numerical wave models.
db8bba83f7ea3adcdcf99038034d33b210e7329f.issues: Univariate time-series approach cannot anticipate storm-driven changes; limited buoy records; site-specific equations.

b159c2c052688a156975e26e36eda99d6b3a99a8.goal: Estimates multi-decadal changes in Arctic sea ice thickness, which is poorly observed, by learning from in situ measurements and empirical forcing variables.
b159c2c052688a156975e26e36eda99d6b3a99a8.architecture: Neural network model trained on in situ ice thickness observations and driven by empirical forcing inputs; the network type is not specified here.
b159c2c052688a156975e26e36eda99d6b3a99a8.data: In situ Arctic sea ice thickness observations with empirical forcing fields; specific products and periods are not reported here.
b159c2c052688a156975e26e36eda99d6b3a99a8.result: The model indicates fluctuating rather than monotonic Arctic ice thickness changes over the study period; exact magnitudes not reproduced here.
b159c2c052688a156975e26e36eda99d6b3a99a8.open_work: Validation against independent thickness data such as satellite altimetry and comparison with dynamic-thermodynamic ice models.
b159c2c052688a156975e26e36eda99d6b3a99a8.issues: No abstract available; sparse in situ training data; extrapolation to unobserved regions and periods is uncertain.

aa1a770deb96742bbc0a5b22901d82cd3de859a7.goal: Analyses wind-wave variability in a shallow tidal sea (the German Wadden Sea) where waves depend on wind, water level and currents.
aa1a770deb96742bbc0a5b22901d82cd3de859a7.architecture: Spectral wave model (SWAN) simulations combined with neural networks trained to reproduce wave parameters from forcing conditions; the network type is not specified here.
aa1a770deb96742bbc0a5b22901d82cd3de859a7.data: SWAN model output for the coastal tidal area driven by wind and water level scenarios, together with local observations.
aa1a770deb96742bbc0a5b22901d82cd3de859a7.result: Neural networks reproduce SWAN wave parameters efficiently, enabling analysis of long-term wave variability at low cost; exact errors not reproduced here.
aa1a770deb96742bbc0a5b22901d82cd3de859a7.open_work: Extending the emulator to climate-change scenarios and other coastal sites.
aa1a770deb96742bbc0a5b22901d82cd3de859a7.issues: Emulates a numerical model so inherits its errors; limited to forcing conditions in the training set.

5f4acd4333c85f2fe4d13f9483ec5cc4129a2a54.goal: Predicts short-term power output of a wind farm using wavelet decomposition to handle the nonstationary wind signal.
5f4acd4333c85f2fe4d13f9483ec5cc4129a2a54.architecture: Wavelet analysis decomposing the power series into components, each forecast by a data-driven predictor; the predictor type is not specified here.
5f4acd4333c85f2fe4d13f9483ec5cc4129a2a54.data: Wind farm power (and possibly wind speed) time series; site and period not reported here.
5f4acd4333c85f2fe4d13f9483ec5cc4129a2a54.open_work: Comparison with other hybrid methods and inclusion of NWP forecasts.
5f4acd4333c85f2fe4d13f9483ec5cc4129a2a54.issues: No abstract available; single-site study; wavelet boundary effects can contaminate real-time forecasts.

26a2fa475866e76a1f627754a357982aa0882351.goal: Automates cloud masking of AVHRR scenes, a prerequisite for retrieving surface parameters such as sea surface temperature.
26a2fa475866e76a1f627754a357982aa0882351.architecture: Backpropagation-trained multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks classifying pixels as cloudy or clear.
26a2fa475866e76a1f627754a357982aa0882351.data: NOAA AVHRR multispectral scenes with expert-labelled cloud and clear samples; region and period not reported here.
26a2fa475866e76a1f627754a357982aa0882351.open_work: Extension to other sensors, seasons and regions, and handling of thin cirrus and cloud edges.
26a2fa475866e76a1f627754a357982aa0882351.issues: No abstract available; performance depends on labelled training scenes; thin and broken clouds are typically hard to detect.

e9e81b75b1983491f2833f6f1fe5224112ba74f1.goal: Calibrates the EPIC crop model against irrigated water use so it can serve in decision support for sustainable groundwater use in the High Plains Aquifer.
e9e81b75b1983491f2833f6f1fe5224112ba74f1.architecture: Genetic algorithm with entropy maximization producing bootstrap distributions for ten EPIC crop model parameters; calibration of a process-based crop model rather than a learned predictor.
e9e81b75b1983491f2833f6f1fe5224112ba74f1.data: Geo-referenced crop (corn, sorghum, alfalfa, soybean), soil, weather and water-use data covering 4931 well-years, with 3.8 x 10^9 parallel model runs.
e9e81b75b1983491f2833f6f1fe5224112ba74f1.result: Calibrated parameter distributions are obtained per crop, and yield and water-use errors are analysed by crop, aggregation level (county vs well) and data independence.
e9e81b75b1983491f2833f6f1fe5224112ba74f1.open_work: Coupling the calibrated crop model with hydrologic and economic components in a stakeholder decision support system.
e9e81b75b1983491f2833f6f1fe5224112ba74f1.issues: Very high computational cost; errors depend on aggregation level; calibration specific to the High Plains region.

14f66c91cdca8ee940c2bbe543501949c8ba2e48.goal: Discusses the role of evolutionary computation in environmental and water resources systems analysis.
14f66c91cdca8ee940c2bbe543501949c8ba2e48.architecture: Review of evolutionary computation methods (genetic algorithms and related evolutionary algorithms) for optimisation and modelling in water and environmental systems.
14f66c91cdca8ee940c2bbe543501949c8ba2e48.result: Not reported in the abstract; the paper surveys applications and their benefits for complex, multi-objective problems.
14f66c91cdca8ee940c2bbe543501949c8ba2e48.open_work: Better handling of uncertainty, multi-objective trade-offs and computational cost in real-world applications.
14f66c91cdca8ee940c2bbe543501949c8ba2e48.issues: No abstract available; overview rather than a quantitative comparison of methods.

46ae61aed1ebb28ea9762eb77f7386c84fe9640d.goal: Forecasts damaging downslope windstorms in Boulder, Colorado, which are hard to predict with numerical models alone.
46ae61aed1ebb28ea9762eb77f7386c84fe9640d.architecture: Statistical models including support vector machines, artificial neural networks and linear regression trained on atmospheric predictors.
46ae61aed1ebb28ea9762eb77f7386c84fe9640d.data: Historical Boulder windstorm cases with sounding and numerical model derived predictors; exact products and periods are not reproduced here.
46ae61aed1ebb28ea9762eb77f7386c84fe9640d.result: Nonlinear methods such as support vector machines improve windstorm prediction skill over linear approaches; exact scores not reproduced here.
46ae61aed1ebb28ea9762eb77f7386c84fe9640d.open_work: Operational testing and adding more cases and predictors from high-resolution models.
46ae61aed1ebb28ea9762eb77f7386c84fe9640d.issues: Few windstorm events limit training and verification; site-specific models.

2fb46d07ddf43dc2978071210ec1825e9c95f901.goal: Improves wind power forecasting for a wind farm by combining complementary data-driven models.
2fb46d07ddf43dc2978071210ec1825e9c95f901.architecture: Combined neuro-fuzzy (adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference) and artificial neural network model; the exact combination scheme is not specified here.
2fb46d07ddf43dc2978071210ec1825e9c95f901.data: Wind farm wind speed and power records; site and period not reported here.
2fb46d07ddf43dc2978071210ec1825e9c95f901.open_work: Adding NWP inputs and testing at other wind farms and horizons.
2fb46d07ddf43dc2978071210ec1825e9c95f901.issues: No abstract available; single-site evaluation; no probabilistic forecasts.

3d63ca74e9c26e3b33776f2aec779f36696ee54a.goal: Forecasts hourly reservoir inflow during typhoons, when rapid inflow changes challenge reservoir operation.
3d63ca74e9c26e3b33776f2aec779f36696ee54a.architecture: Radial basis function (RBF) neural network coupled with an information processor that preprocesses typhoon and rainfall inputs.
3d63ca74e9c26e3b33776f2aec779f36696ee54a.data: Hourly typhoon-event rainfall and reservoir inflow records from a Taiwanese reservoir; exact site and events not reported here.
3d63ca74e9c26e3b33776f2aec779f36696ee54a.result: The RBF model with the information processor forecasts inflow more accurately than without it; exact scores not reproduced here.

72ba9e2b6f4902dafd837434426bac01fea4e2aa.goal: Predicts wind speed and wind power output one month ahead to support wind energy planning.

72ba9e2b6f4902dafd837434426bac01fea4e2aa.issues: No abstract available; monthly-ahead predictability of wind is limited; single-site evaluation.

d35d3c7aeb4b8ed7b4141e363f429abb5c32fe8c.goal: Assimilates observed contaminant concentrations into transport and dispersion modelling to recover source and wind information when the wind meanders.
d35d3c7aeb4b8ed7b4141e363f429abb5c32fe8c.architecture: Data-assimilation approach coupling a transport and dispersion model with concentration observations to estimate a time-varying wind field; the exact optimisation technique is not specified here.

64c7c7ff7640b92d0a2a279022c2149282256535.goal: Maps the spatial and temporal distribution of Arctic multiyear sea ice from passive microwave data over 1988-2001.

a6e27f31ab7eed35522d94b4aa927bcf97c57c6f.goal: Evaluates runoff generation in a tropical watershed where data are scarce and runoff controls are imprecise.

0fe5e9edcbccc793c0dab6924e0751ab911c4f03.goal: Forecasts wind speed and power generation at an experimental wind park in Brazil for grid integration.
0fe5e9edcbccc793c0dab6924e0751ab911c4f03.architecture: Wavelet decomposition combined with artificial neural networks; the network type is not specified here.
0fe5e9edcbccc793c0dab6924e0751ab911c4f03.data: Wind speed and power measurements from a Brazilian experimental wind park; period not reported here.

cf46dc474142ebcee7fac1c44ae3a867bdd5d4ba.goal: Describes how meteorological conditions affect urban air pollutant concentrations in Hong Kong.

cf46dc474142ebcee7fac1c44ae3a867bdd5d4ba.issues: No abstract available; case study for one city; fuzzy rules may not transfer.

ba2b986d92ed94b21f1c053e99ee23694ac73209.goal: Assesses how predictable Indian Ocean sea surface temperature anomalies are using nonlinear data-driven models.
ba2b986d92ed94b21f1c053e99ee23694ac73209.architecture: Artificial neural network forecasting SST anomalies from past values; the network type is not specified here.

ba2b986d92ed94b21f1c053e99ee23694ac73209.issues: No abstract available; short records limit training; univariate approach.

7239f82c676ed110d1904f44fee22fc7eabc8051.goal: Estimates wind speed-up over complex topography such as hills, needed for wind loading and siting, at lower cost than full simulations.
7239f82c676ed110d1904f44fee22fc7eabc8051.architecture: Combined approach using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations to train artificial neural networks that predict flow over topography; the network type is not specified here.
7239f82c676ed110d1904f44fee22fc7eabc8051.data: CFD simulations of wind over idealised and multiple hill configurations, compared with experimental or code-based data.
7239f82c676ed110d1904f44fee22fc7eabc8051.result: Neural networks reproduce CFD speed-up ratios over topography quickly and with reasonable accuracy; exact errors not reproduced here.
7239f82c676ed110d1904f44fee22fc7eabc8051.open_work: Application to real complex terrain and validation with field measurements.
7239f82c676ed110d1904f44fee22fc7eabc8051.issues: Trained on simulated idealised topographies; inherits CFD model errors; limited generalisation.

416501d93665761f1e43fc252f9494078c825f5e.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction at a wind farm by combining global and mesoscale weather forecasts with a statistical correction.
416501d93665761f1e43fc252f9494078c825f5e.architecture: Hybrid system feeding global model and mesoscale model (MM5) forecasts into artificial neural networks (multilayer perceptron) for site-specific prediction.
416501d93665761f1e43fc252f9494078c825f5e.data: Global forecast model output downscaled with MM5 and wind farm measurements in Spain.
416501d93665761f1e43fc252f9494078c825f5e.result: The hybrid neural network approach improves wind speed forecasts over the raw numerical models; exact scores not reproduced here.
416501d93665761f1e43fc252f9494078c825f5e.open_work: Ensembles of models and extension to power prediction and other farms.
416501d93665761f1e43fc252f9494078c825f5e.issues: Single-site evaluation; limited record; no probabilistic forecasts.

1ca191db6309e41f93529a4dabe07d37e0eeac0d.goal: Estimates wind turbine power curves, needed for monitoring and power prediction, comparing regression and neural network approaches.
1ca191db6309e41f93529a4dabe07d37e0eeac0d.architecture: Comparison of regression models and an artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) for mapping wind speed (and direction) to turbine power.
1ca191db6309e41f93529a4dabe07d37e0eeac0d.data: Measured wind speed and turbine power data from a wind farm.

1ca191db6309e41f93529a4dabe07d37e0eeac0d.open_work: Use for turbine performance monitoring and including more inputs such as air density.
1ca191db6309e41f93529a4dabe07d37e0eeac0d.issues: Data from few turbines; no uncertainty; site-specific behaviour.

8a2c51b2b3e26d9f32d5d59cdaed6a696005d4c9.goal: Explores reservoir computing for short-term hourly wind speed forecasting.
8a2c51b2b3e26d9f32d5d59cdaed6a696005d4c9.architecture: Reservoir computing (recurrent network with a fixed random reservoir and a trained linear readout).
8a2c51b2b3e26d9f32d5d59cdaed6a696005d4c9.data: Hourly wind speed measurements from a site in Brazil; details not reported here.
8a2c51b2b3e26d9f32d5d59cdaed6a696005d4c9.open_work: Optimising reservoir parameters and comparison with other recurrent models.
8a2c51b2b3e26d9f32d5d59cdaed6a696005d4c9.issues: No abstract available; single-site evaluation; reservoir hyperparameters strongly affect results.

4bcfe6823eae5d1fa7d28b537dcff8e4b4edf378.goal: Proposes a systematic way to choose input variables and lags for neural network rainfall-runoff models instead of trial and error.
4bcfe6823eae5d1fa7d28b537dcff8e4b4edf378.architecture: Systematic input determination procedure applied to neural network rainfall-runoff models; the network type is not specified here.

1e0cc029937de2ad52dd7c91f2fe127f959a2005.issues: No abstract available; limited data; site-specific model without physical constraints.

f0c18f2b586ea225093e4b9a0ed07cc35f422ea6.goal: Maps climatic variables such as temperature over complex terrain, where relationships with topography are nonlinear and scale-dependent.
f0c18f2b586ea225093e4b9a0ed07cc35f422ea6.architecture: Machine learning regression including support vector regression (support vector machines) using many multi-scale topographic features derived from a digital elevation model.
f0c18f2b586ea225093e4b9a0ed07cc35f422ea6.data: Meteorological station measurements (e.g. temperature) in Switzerland with DEM-derived terrain features.
f0c18f2b586ea225093e4b9a0ed07cc35f422ea6.result: Machine learning captures nonlinear terrain effects such as temperature inversions better than linear geostatistical approaches; exact scores not reproduced here.
f0c18f2b586ea225093e4b9a0ed07cc35f422ea6.open_work: Extension to other variables, operational mapping and uncertainty estimation.
f0c18f2b586ea225093e4b9a0ed07cc35f422ea6.issues: Sparse stations in high terrain; feature selection affects results; limited uncertainty quantification.

850a428eeb6d8b7cf83cfebcebb4297cff11b53d.goal: Improves forecasts of which tropical cloud clusters develop into tropical cyclones, building on a linear discriminant analysis genesis model.
850a428eeb6d8b7cf83cfebcebb4297cff11b53d.architecture: Neural network classifier (multilayer perceptron) producing genesis probabilities from large-scale predictors.
850a428eeb6d8b7cf83cfebcebb4297cff11b53d.data: Atlantic tropical cloud clusters identified in satellite imagery over several seasons, with large-scale predictors from global analyses.
850a428eeb6d8b7cf83cfebcebb4297cff11b53d.result: The neural network classifier improves genesis prediction skill over linear discriminant analysis at 6-48 h lead times; exact scores not reproduced here.
850a428eeb6d8b7cf83cfebcebb4297cff11b53d.open_work: Extending to other basins and to operational guidance with more seasons.
850a428eeb6d8b7cf83cfebcebb4297cff11b53d.issues: Few genesis events relative to non-developing clusters; predictors depend on analysis quality; Atlantic only.

922c8254982af183e4ba9c2bf006611fea687658.architecture: Artificial neural network rainfall-runoff model analysed through its weights in relation to deterministic hydrological concepts; the network type is not specified here.

922c8254982af183e4ba9c2bf006611fea687658.issues: No abstract available; limited events; interpretation may depend on network structure.

4b1f931fd955440c8511f8235b355ad2998928ae.architecture: Genetic algorithm searching for weather-system features matched to model templates in NWP fields.
4b1f931fd955440c8511f8235b355ad2998928ae.data: Numerical weather prediction model output; model and region not reported here.
4b1f931fd955440c8511f8235b355ad2998928ae.open_work: Extension to more system types and operational evaluation.
4b1f931fd955440c8511f8235b355ad2998928ae.issues: No abstract available; template definitions are subjective; computational cost of the search.

82f2c0e3fb30f8e23390f9496189209838217ab0.goal: Predicts crop yields from environmental and agronomic predictors using neural networks.

c404f7d57c417db4e678645de7f9296c13679bb4.issues: No abstract available; imbalanced developing/non-developing samples; single decision trees can be unstable.

5e977c3efcc2b498f33dac06f0e1e18ae60ce86b.goal: Forecasts visibility and fog, which affect aviation, using an objective statistical method.
5e977c3efcc2b498f33dac06f0e1e18ae60ce86b.architecture: Decision tree method classifying visibility and fog categories from meteorological predictors.
5e977c3efcc2b498f33dac06f0e1e18ae60ce86b.data: Surface observations and possibly model output for a Hungarian location; details not reported here.
5e977c3efcc2b498f33dac06f0e1e18ae60ce86b.open_work: Validation on more stations and seasons and combination with NWP output.
5e977c3efcc2b498f33dac06f0e1e18ae60ce86b.issues: No abstract available; site-specific; rare dense-fog events limit training.

c1c7a5b1a425a6497537b0e51e965037d1e47631.goal: Simulates and predicts ENSO with a hybrid coupled model and tests how data assimilation improves its initial conditions and forecasts.
c1c7a5b1a425a6497537b0e51e965037d1e47631.architecture: Hybrid coupled model: an intermediate-complexity dynamical ocean model coupled with a neural network (nonlinear statistical) atmospheric model, with a data assimilation scheme for initialisation.
c1c7a5b1a425a6497537b0e51e965037d1e47631.data: Observed tropical Pacific ocean data assimilated into the ocean model, with retrospective ENSO forecasts over several decades.
c1c7a5b1a425a6497537b0e51e965037d1e47631.result: The hybrid model simulates ENSO-like oscillations, and data assimilation improves its retrospective ENSO forecast skill; exact skill values not reproduced here.
c1c7a5b1a425a6497537b0e51e965037d1e47631.open_work: Assimilating more ocean observations and using more advanced assimilation methods.
c1c7a5b1a425a6497537b0e51e965037d1e47631.issues: Simplified ocean dynamics; neural atmosphere trained on short records; skill varies by decade.

5b59b9386070d76568046fc6ffbc047348777194.goal: Classifies ocean colour observations into meaningful water types using an unsupervised method that preserves topological structure.
5b59b9386070d76568046fc6ffbc047348777194.architecture: Topological hierarchical clustering combining a self-organizing map (SOM) with hierarchical agglomerative clustering of its prototypes.
5b59b9386070d76568046fc6ffbc047348777194.data: Satellite ocean colour reflectance data; sensor and region not reported here.

5b59b9386070d76568046fc6ffbc047348777194.issues: No abstract available; unsupervised classes need interpretation; number of clusters is subjective.
