3d7a53714ba6fd2f396a370eac31736ee0830626.open_work: Extension to other sensors, regions and time-series monitoring of upwelling.
3d7a53714ba6fd2f396a370eac31736ee0830626.issues: No abstract available; cloud gaps in infrared imagery; training labels depend on expert interpretation.

b75e98756183e4f7a97052062115896a866aa904.goal: Estimates urban ozone levels with prediction intervals and identifies which meteorological and pollutant factors matter most.
b75e98756183e4f7a97052062115896a866aa904.architecture: Bayesian neural network (multilayer perceptron) with automatic relevance determination (ARD) for input selection and interval estimation.
b75e98756183e4f7a97052062115896a866aa904.data: Hourly ozone, precursor and meteorological measurements from urban monitoring stations in Hong Kong.
b75e98756183e4f7a97052062115896a866aa904.result: The ARD model gives interval estimates of ozone and ranks influential factors, with accuracy comparable to or better than standard networks; exact scores not reproduced here.
b75e98756183e4f7a97052062115896a866aa904.open_work: Extension to forecasting at longer leads and other stations.
b75e98756183e4f7a97052062115896a866aa904.issues: Site-specific; Gaussian assumptions for intervals; limited data for extreme episodes.

4410147f906da1a12eddb4a1a4fb3c1d911e661c.goal: Identifies the radar reflectivity–rain rate (Z–R) relationship with neural networks, exploiting the vertical profile and recent history of reflectivity to improve rainfall intensity estimation.
4410147f906da1a12eddb4a1a4fb3c1d911e661c.architecture: Compares three neural networks: a multilayer perceptron (MLP), a Bayesian neural network and a radial basis function network, fed with principal components of the vertical reflectivity profile and lagged reflectivity.
4410147f906da1a12eddb4a1a4fb3c1d911e661c.data: Volumetric weather radar scans (11 constant-altitude PPI levels) paired with rain gauge measurements of rainfall intensity.
4410147f906da1a12eddb4a1a4fb3c1d911e661c.result: Using the first two principal components of the standardized profile (91% of variance) significantly improves estimates over the lowest level alone; longer time horizons help the Bayesian network but degrade the MLP and RBF network.
4410147f906da1a12eddb4a1a4fb3c1d911e661c.open_work: Testing on other radar sites and rainfall regimes and quantifying uncertainty of the network estimates remain open.
4410147f906da1a12eddb4a1a4fb3c1d911e661c.issues: Single radar–gauge setting; gauge–radar sampling mismatch and limited generality of the fitted relationships are not addressed.

b82d87da3fd33bafdca67f2aabe2d017ba3b2031.goal: Predicts hourly solar radiation by treating the radiation time series as a two-dimensional (day by hour) field to exploit both daily and hourly correlation.
b82d87da3fd33bafdca67f2aabe2d017ba3b2031.architecture: A 2-D modelling approach on the day-by-hour representation of the series; the specific predictor type is not specified in the available information.
b82d87da3fd33bafdca67f2aabe2d017ba3b2031.data: Hourly solar radiation measurements; station and period not reported.
b82d87da3fd33bafdca67f2aabe2d017ba3b2031.result: Not reported; the paper presents the 2-D approach as improving prediction over conventional 1-D time-series treatment.
b82d87da3fd33bafdca67f2aabe2d017ba3b2031.open_work: Comparison against standard 1-D neural and statistical predictors over more stations and climates.
b82d87da3fd33bafdca67f2aabe2d017ba3b2031.issues: No abstract available; details of data, model and skill are unknown.

6ae1a0a4062600414bdbd928660f976d9eca42bc.goal: Forecasts anthracnose disease severity from weather variables to support disease management decisions.
6ae1a0a4062600414bdbd928660f976d9eca42bc.architecture: Artificial neural network models compared with regression-based models; the network type is not specified.
6ae1a0a4062600414bdbd928660f976d9eca42bc.data: Field observations of anthracnose severity with concurrent weather records; sites and years not reported.
6ae1a0a4062600414bdbd928660f976d9eca42bc.result: Neural network models predict disease severity from weather inputs with skill reported as better than or comparable to regression models.
6ae1a0a4062600414bdbd928660f976d9eca42bc.open_work: Validation at independent sites and seasons and integration into operational disease warning systems.
6ae1a0a4062600414bdbd928660f976d9eca42bc.issues: Abstract not available; data size, inputs and error metrics are unknown, and small field datasets risk overfitting.

b7e75c9088e90d6eef1aacbc18117f286c37d04a.goal: Retrieves water constituents and inherent optical properties from ocean color remote sensing, overcoming limitations of empirical and standard semianalytical inversion.
b7e75c9088e90d6eef1aacbc18117f286c37d04a.architecture: Hybrid of a semianalytical ocean reflectance model with a genetic algorithm (GA-SA) used as the optimizer for inversion; no neural network.
b7e75c9088e90d6eef1aacbc18117f286c37d04a.data: Synthetic and in situ datasets compiled by the International Ocean Colour Coordinating Group (IOCCG); applied to MODIS imagery.
b7e75c9088e90d6eef1aacbc18117f286c37d04a.result: GA-SA gives better retrievals of inherent optical properties and water constituents than existing algorithms and produces regional MODIS maps of chlorophyll-a, total suspended matter and CDOM absorption at 443 nm.
b7e75c9088e90d6eef1aacbc18117f286c37d04a.open_work: Validation of the MODIS-derived maps against regional in situ data and assessment of computational cost for operational processing.
b7e75c9088e90d6eef1aacbc18117f286c37d04a.issues: Accuracy depends on the semianalytical model assumptions; GA inversion is computationally heavy and regional map validation is limited.

b8cc49ccfcc5c8b94c5331c90cc7f8ee3ad92c0a.goal: Predicts local maximum ozone concentrations to support air-quality warnings, comparing soft computing approaches.

7f906df8fb1511c22e465dac9420f34b2203734a.architecture: Neural network (feed-forward MLP) using past water levels and wind observations.
7f906df8fb1511c22e465dac9420f34b2203734a.data: Coastal water level and meteorological measurements along the Texas Gulf coast (Texas Coastal Ocean Observation Network).
7f906df8fb1511c22e465dac9420f34b2203734a.result: Not reported in detail; neural networks substantially improve water level forecasts over harmonic tide predictions.
7f906df8fb1511c22e465dac9420f34b2203734a.open_work: Longer lead times and inclusion of forecast winds.
7f906df8fb1511c22e465dac9420f34b2203734a.issues: No abstract available; performance during extreme hurricane surges is uncertain.

7c2cf5e574c7cdd5fd3bb73d88634a8d0c589031.goal: Forecasts the mesoscale wind field from LIDAR Doppler velocity data.
7c2cf5e574c7cdd5fd3bb73d88634a8d0c589031.architecture: Chaotic oscillatory-based neural network (Lee-oscillator recurrent network).
7c2cf5e574c7cdd5fd3bb73d88634a8d0c589031.data: Doppler LIDAR radial velocity data; site and period not reported.
7c2cf5e574c7cdd5fd3bb73d88634a8d0c589031.open_work: Comparison with standard neural networks and extrapolation methods on more cases.
7c2cf5e574c7cdd5fd3bb73d88634a8d0c589031.issues: No abstract available; limited cases and unknown skill.

3c32c2479f197f2bf02d07f923ce7760a7e15041.goal: Forecasts floods using artificial neural networks.
3c32c2479f197f2bf02d07f923ce7760a7e15041.architecture: Artificial neural network rainfall-runoff or water level model; network type is not specified.
3c32c2479f197f2bf02d07f923ce7760a7e15041.data: Hydrological records from a river basin; basin and period not reported.
3c32c2479f197f2bf02d07f923ce7760a7e15041.open_work: Extension of lead time and comparison with conceptual hydrological models.
3c32c2479f197f2bf02d07f923ce7760a7e15041.issues: No abstract available; skill is unknown.

2d78016c760b46db4018ac9bbf0f0ead12184bcd.goal: Provides forecasts of aircraft in-flight icing potential for aviation safety.
2d78016c760b46db4018ac9bbf0f0ead12184bcd.architecture: Fuzzy logic algorithm (Forecast Icing Potential, FIP) combining membership functions of NWP fields; non-ML physically based rules.
2d78016c760b46db4018ac9bbf0f0ead12184bcd.data: Rapid Update Cycle (RUC) numerical model output, verified with pilot reports.
2d78016c760b46db4018ac9bbf0f0ead12184bcd.result: Not reported here; FIP provides operational icing potential forecasts.
2d78016c760b46db4018ac9bbf0f0ead12184bcd.open_work: Adding supercooled large drop diagnosis and severity estimation.
2d78016c760b46db4018ac9bbf0f0ead12184bcd.issues: No abstract available; depends on NWP cloud and moisture accuracy and PIREP verification is biased.

b905265c9e6b4301349093c8630ebb620c1d1b8d.goal: Improves flood routing in river systems with neural networks that adapt to changing conditions.
b905265c9e6b4301349093c8630ebb620c1d1b8d.architecture: Adaptive neural network for flood routing; network type is not specified.
b905265c9e6b4301349093c8630ebb620c1d1b8d.data: Upstream and downstream flow records from a river system; details not reported.
b905265c9e6b4301349093c8630ebb620c1d1b8d.result: Not reported; the adaptive networks route floods with accuracy comparable to or better than conventional methods.
b905265c9e6b4301349093c8630ebb620c1d1b8d.open_work: Testing on more rivers and extreme floods.
b905265c9e6b4301349093c8630ebb620c1d1b8d.issues: No abstract available; extrapolation to unseen extreme floods is uncertain.

b0983853c91596aa5c15b0a5a25a74864737348b.goal: Downscales climate variables by coupling a neural network with an analog model so that predictors are optimized for analog selection.
b0983853c91596aa5c15b0a5a25a74864737348b.architecture: Nonlinear analog predictor analysis (NLAPA): a multilayer perceptron neural network whose outputs feed an analog (nearest neighbour) model, trained to maximize analog performance.
b0983853c91596aa5c15b0a5a25a74864737348b.data: Synthetic test datasets and real climate downscaling datasets (station precipitation and temperature); details not reported.
b0983853c91596aa5c15b0a5a25a74864737348b.result: NLAPA outperforms analog models using raw or linearly transformed predictors and preserves realistic multivariate relationships.
b0983853c91596aa5c15b0a5a25a74864737348b.open_work: Extension to more variables and sites and assessment under climate change projections.
b0983853c91596aa5c15b0a5a25a74864737348b.issues: Analog methods cannot produce values outside the historical record; training is computationally intensive.

51603062f8adfaae08824f256ae77405028db873.goal: Removes non-meteorological echoes (ground clutter, anomalous propagation, biological targets) from weather radar reflectivity so that automated algorithms receive clean data.
51603062f8adfaae08824f256ae77405028db873.architecture: Neural network classifier (MLP) applied pixel by pixel to texture features computed from reflectivity, velocity and spectrum-width fields, followed by post-processing.
51603062f8adfaae08824f256ae77405028db873.data: WSR-88D (NEXRAD) Level II radar volumes with human-labelled examples of good and bad echoes; exact case counts not reported here.
51603062f8adfaae08824f256ae77405028db873.result: The texture-feature neural network removes most contaminating echoes while retaining precipitation better than simple threshold-based quality control; detailed scores not reported here.
51603062f8adfaae08824f256ae77405028db873.open_work: Extending to clear-air and biological echoes in warm seasons and adding dual-polarization variables for better discrimination.
51603062f8adfaae08824f256ae77405028db873.issues: Abstract unavailable; performance depends on hand-labelled training cases and degrades for echoes resembling precipitation such as weak stratiform rain or sea clutter.

2a553b4de9a45f185325a04b4ef081c654a58d71.goal: Extracts the nonlinear, anharmonic structure of the stratospheric quasi-biennial oscillation (QBO), which linear singular spectrum analysis splits across several modes.
2a553b4de9a45f185325a04b4ef081c654a58d71.architecture: Nonlinear singular spectrum analysis: an autoassociative neural network (nonlinear PCA, MLP with a circular bottleneck node) applied to the leading SSA principal components.
2a553b4de9a45f185325a04b4ef081c654a58d71.data: Tropical stratospheric zonal wind time series from radiosonde observations (Singapore and nearby stations) at several levels between about 70 and 10 hPa.
2a553b4de9a45f185325a04b4ef081c654a58d71.result: A single nonlinear mode captures the asymmetric descent of easterly and westerly QBO phases and explains more variance than the leading linear SSA mode pair.
2a553b4de9a45f185325a04b4ef081c654a58d71.open_work: Applying NLSSA to other quasi-periodic climate signals and linking QBO nonlinearity to its interactions with the annual cycle and ENSO.
2a553b4de9a45f185325a04b4ef081c654a58d71.issues: Abstract unavailable; nonlinear PCA networks can overfit and need ensembles and careful regularization; single-record analysis limits generality.

6990f95677199a5f403e9feaa59a5eb20540595d.goal: Quantifies how changes in the frequency of synoptic circulation types explain seasonal, interannual and decadal variations of temperature in Melbourne.
6990f95677199a5f403e9feaa59a5eb20540595d.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) classification of daily synoptic patterns, with temperature variability attributed to changes in pattern frequency versus within-pattern changes.
6990f95677199a5f403e9feaa59a5eb20540595d.data: Daily mean sea level pressure fields from reanalysis and Melbourne station temperatures over several decades; exact period not reported here.
6990f95677199a5f403e9feaa59a5eb20540595d.result: Part of Melbourne's temperature variability and warming is linked to changes in synoptic pattern frequency, with a substantial within-type warming component; numbers not reported here.
6990f95677199a5f403e9feaa59a5eb20540595d.open_work: Extending the attribution to other Australian sites and to projected circulation changes in climate models.
6990f95677199a5f403e9feaa59a5eb20540595d.issues: Abstract unavailable; SOM node number is subjective and results depend on reanalysis quality and a single urban station affected by urban heat effects.

b2fd8500bd98aed251a1c22bf552da27af5fdc53.goal: Retrieves surface rainfall rate from TRMM Microwave Imager brightness temperatures using soft-computing techniques to handle the nonlinear rain-radiance relationship.
b2fd8500bd98aed251a1c22bf552da27af5fdc53.architecture: Soft-computing retrieval scheme; the specific technique (neural network, fuzzy or hybrid) is not specified in the available metadata.
b2fd8500bd98aed251a1c22bf552da27af5fdc53.data: TRMM Microwave Imager (TMI) brightness temperatures, presumably collocated with TRMM rainfall references; details not reported here.
b2fd8500bd98aed251a1c22bf552da27af5fdc53.open_work: Validation across regions and rain regimes and comparison with operational TRMM retrieval algorithms.
b2fd8500bd98aed251a1c22bf552da27af5fdc53.issues: Abstract unavailable; card is based on the title only, so data, method and accuracy cannot be confirmed.

dbe34e3b11dd11dfd5f5000b1657628b5a0b010e.goal: Forecasts daily PM10 concentrations in an urban area to support air-quality warnings.
dbe34e3b11dd11dfd5f5000b1657628b5a0b010e.architecture: Machine learning forecasting tool comparing support vector machine (SVM) regression and neural network models with selected meteorological and pollutant inputs.
dbe34e3b11dd11dfd5f5000b1657628b5a0b010e.data: Urban air quality monitoring station PM10 and meteorological records in northern Italy (Turin area); period not reported here.
dbe34e3b11dd11dfd5f5000b1657628b5a0b010e.result: The machine learning models give useful next-day PM10 forecasts, with the SVM performing comparably to or better than the neural network; scores not reported here.
dbe34e3b11dd11dfd5f5000b1657628b5a0b010e.open_work: Adding forecast meteorology as input and testing at more stations and over longer periods.
dbe34e3b11dd11dfd5f5000b1657628b5a0b010e.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-city setting, short records and limited skill for exceedance episodes are likely constraints.

ba5871fad5c804be4cdd35f1c4f9d6ff0142fc7a.goal: Estimates wind speed from measured ocean wave parameters by inverse modelling, useful where wind records are missing but wave buoys exist.
ba5871fad5c804be4cdd35f1c4f9d6ff0142fc7a.architecture: Data-driven inverse models: genetic programming and model trees, compared with a neural network and statistical regression.
ba5871fad5c804be4cdd35f1c4f9d6ff0142fc7a.data: Wave buoy measurements of significant wave height and wave period with collocated wind speed; buoy locations not reported here.
ba5871fad5c804be4cdd35f1c4f9d6ff0142fc7a.result: The data-driven methods reconstruct wind speed from wave data with reasonable accuracy, genetic programming and model trees performing comparably to neural networks; numbers not reported here.
ba5871fad5c804be4cdd35f1c4f9d6ff0142fc7a.open_work: Testing at more locations, including swell-dominated seas, and estimating wind direction.
ba5871fad5c804be4cdd35f1c4f9d6ff0142fc7a.issues: Abstract unavailable; inverse estimation is ill-posed under swell or fetch-limited conditions, and transferability between sites is untested.

21258d202ab0a79039751a5a2632e99424b1b243.goal: Compares nonlinear time-series methods with linear regression for short-term prediction and statistical downscaling of European daily temperatures.
21258d202ab0a79039751a5a2632e99424b1b243.architecture: Local linear models, multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network and radial basis function (RBF) neural network, benchmarked against multiple linear regression.
21258d202ab0a79039751a5a2632e99424b1b243.data: Daily mean, minimum and maximum temperatures from 25 European stations as predictands; NCEP/NCAR reanalysis fields as downscaling predictors.
21258d202ab0a79039751a5a2632e99424b1b243.result: No nonlinear method is clearly superior, but all beat linear regression in most cases; nonlinearity is strong over most of Europe, weak in the Mediterranean and North Africa, and stronger in winter.
21258d202ab0a79039751a5a2632e99424b1b243.open_work: Testing other predictors and variables such as precipitation, and explaining the geographic and seasonal pattern of nonlinearity.
21258d202ab0a79039751a5a2632e99424b1b243.issues: Only temperature is studied and gains over linear regression are modest; MLPs suffer from practical training disadvantages, and downscaling is tested on reanalysis rather than GCM output.

dcba0cbb227e2c61768deb46fd68acf403b3e3a3.goal: Predicts tropospheric ozone concentrations to give early warning of air pollution episodes.
dcba0cbb227e2c61768deb46fd68acf403b3e3a3.architecture: Three-layer perceptron (MLP) artificial neural network with three pollutant and eight meteorological inputs.
dcba0cbb227e2c61768deb46fd68acf403b3e3a3.data: Air quality and meteorological measurements from selected monitoring areas (Turkey); station details and period not reported in the abstract.
dcba0cbb227e2c61768deb46fd68acf403b3e3a3.result: Correlation between predicted and observed ozone is 0.8 to 0.9 on the test sets.
dcba0cbb227e2c61768deb46fd68acf403b3e3a3.open_work: Extending to longer forecast horizons and comparing with other statistical and chemical transport models.
dcba0cbb227e2c61768deb46fd68acf403b3e3a3.issues: Only correlation-type statistics are reported, there is no comparison with baseline models, and the sites and periods are limited.

47c71f7677022ebfafe5910c1e9845c6fa1f410d.goal: Predicts typhoon storm surge and its deviation from astronomical tide at coastal stations for warning purposes.
47c71f7677022ebfafe5910c1e9845c6fa1f410d.architecture: Back-propagation neural network (MLP) using meteorological inputs such as pressure, wind speed and wind direction.
47c71f7677022ebfafe5910c1e9845c6fa1f410d.data: Typhoon events and tide gauge records in Taiwan; number of events not reported here.
47c71f7677022ebfafe5910c1e9845c6fa1f410d.result: The neural network reproduces observed surge and surge deviation for test typhoons with good agreement; numbers not reported here.
47c71f7677022ebfafe5910c1e9845c6fa1f410d.open_work: Longer lead times using forecast typhoon parameters and application to more stations.
47c71f7677022ebfafe5910c1e9845c6fa1f410d.issues: Abstract unavailable; few typhoon events limit training, and site-specific models may not transfer to other coasts.

2a40d9ce7c8e95a4523f14dd94ea87fd03b2341f.goal: Detects and removes bird contamination from wind profiler radar data, which biases measured wind vectors during migration periods.
2a40d9ce7c8e95a4523f14dd94ea87fd03b2341f.architecture: Neural network classifiers operating on features extracted from wind profiler Doppler spectra or moments.
2a40d9ce7c8e95a4523f14dd94ea87fd03b2341f.data: Wind profiler radar measurements with labelled bird-contaminated and clean samples (Switzerland); details not reported here.
2a40d9ce7c8e95a4523f14dd94ea87fd03b2341f.result: The neural network approach identifies bird-contaminated data with high accuracy, improving the quality of profiler wind estimates; numbers not reported here.
2a40d9ce7c8e95a4523f14dd94ea87fd03b2341f.open_work: Real-time operational implementation and extension to other profiler sites and contamination types.
2a40d9ce7c8e95a4523f14dd94ea87fd03b2341f.issues: Abstract unavailable; labelled data are limited and performance may depend on site and season.

f0fea70f3f730e0f09eab270e08927602b491fbe.goal: Estimates chlorophyll concentration from ocean colour reflectances with an interpretable model instead of empirical band-ratio formulas.
f0fea70f3f730e0f09eab270e08927602b491fbe.architecture: Fuzzy rule-based system (Takagi-Sugeno type) identified from data, compared with standard empirical ocean colour algorithms.
f0fea70f3f730e0f09eab270e08927602b491fbe.data: SeaBAM in situ data set of remote-sensing reflectances at SeaWiFS bands paired with chlorophyll concentrations.
f0fea70f3f730e0f09eab270e08927602b491fbe.result: The fuzzy model achieves accuracy comparable to or better than the OC2/OC4 empirical algorithms with a compact rule base; numbers not reported here.
f0fea70f3f730e0f09eab270e08927602b491fbe.open_work: Application to Case 2 waters and to satellite imagery rather than in situ match-ups.
f0fea70f3f730e0f09eab270e08927602b491fbe.issues: Abstract unavailable; small in situ data set dominated by Case 1 waters, so generalization to optically complex waters is uncertain.

0034dcf1cddddb1987abef6089c7b97f97c6cbd4.goal: Converts CERES broadband radiances to top-of-atmosphere fluxes for scenes where empirical angular distribution models are unavailable or imprecise.
0034dcf1cddddb1987abef6089c7b97f97c6cbd4.architecture: Artificial neural networks (MLP) that predict anisotropic factors from imager-derived scene properties and viewing geometry.
0034dcf1cddddb1987abef6089c7b97f97c6cbd4.data: CERES Terra broadband radiances, including rotating azimuth plane scans, with MODIS cloud and aerosol scene information.
0034dcf1cddddb1987abef6089c7b97f97c6cbd4.result: ANN-based angular models give TOA flux estimates consistent with empirical CERES ADMs, with small biases; numbers not reported here.
0034dcf1cddddb1987abef6089c7b97f97c6cbd4.open_work: Extension to more scene types and instruments such as CERES on Aqua.
0034dcf1cddddb1987abef6089c7b97f97c6cbd4.issues: Abstract unavailable; accuracy depends on scene identification and sampling of viewing geometries in training data.

d26abfb5a455916e649dc741c226c5dd5c4e2805.goal: Improves runoff forecasting by letting genetic programming select relevant input variables.
d26abfb5a455916e649dc741c226c5dd5c4e2805.architecture: Genetic programming (symbolic regression) with input variable selection, compared with models using all inputs.
d26abfb5a455916e649dc741c226c5dd5c4e2805.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a catchment; location and period not reported here.
d26abfb5a455916e649dc741c226c5dd5c4e2805.result: Genetic programming with input selection gives more accurate runoff forecasts and simpler expressions; numbers not reported here.
d26abfb5a455916e649dc741c226c5dd5c4e2805.open_work: Testing at longer lead times and in other catchments.
d26abfb5a455916e649dc741c226c5dd5c4e2805.issues: Abstract unavailable; single catchment and stochastic GP results that may vary between runs.

1c1f6b4e34fd52baa75c8573f41c0bba15f9a5be.goal: Models medium-term (days to weeks) hydrodynamic variability in a shallow tidal sea efficiently by combining a physical model with data-driven methods.
1c1f6b4e34fd52baa75c8573f41c0bba15f9a5be.architecture: Hybrid approach: physically based hydrodynamic model outputs reduced by empirical orthogonal functions, with a neural network relating forcing (wind, tides) to mode amplitudes.
1c1f6b4e34fd52baa75c8573f41c0bba15f9a5be.data: Hydrodynamic model simulations of the German Wadden Sea driven by meteorological forcing; period not reported here.
1c1f6b4e34fd52baa75c8573f41c0bba15f9a5be.result: The combined model reproduces the main medium-term variability of water levels and currents at much lower computational cost; numbers not reported here.
1c1f6b4e34fd52baa75c8573f41c0bba15f9a5be.open_work: Use for long-term morphodynamic and ecological simulations and inclusion of additional forcing.
1c1f6b4e34fd52baa75c8573f41c0bba15f9a5be.issues: Abstract unavailable; trained on model output, so it inherits model biases and may fail outside the training range of forcing.

8a8dd9a8436ac080007fd6befce56d19eaf9da97.goal: Explains how neural networks solve forward and inverse problems in atmospheric and oceanic satellite remote sensing.
8a8dd9a8436ac080007fd6befce56d19eaf9da97.architecture: Review of MLP neural network methods: emulation of radiative transfer forward models and retrieval of geophysical parameters as inverse mappings.
8a8dd9a8436ac080007fd6befce56d19eaf9da97.data: Examples from passive microwave and other satellite sensors such as SSM/I (ocean surface wind speed, water vapour, cloud liquid water).
8a8dd9a8436ac080007fd6befce56d19eaf9da97.result: Neural networks provide accurate, very fast emulations and retrievals, often outperforming traditional regression-based algorithms.
8a8dd9a8436ac080007fd6befce56d19eaf9da97.open_work: Uncertainty estimation for NN retrievals and handling inputs outside the training domain.
8a8dd9a8436ac080007fd6befce56d19eaf9da97.issues: Abstract unavailable; review chapter whose examples come mainly from the author's own work.

7c66b3b041e2899743f5b538dd9ebb66c0567f77.goal: Short-term nowcasting of local weather variables from a single weather station's sensors.
7c66b3b041e2899743f5b538dd9ebb66c0567f77.architecture: Artificial neural networks (MLP) forecasting local variables from recent sensor time series.
7c66b3b041e2899743f5b538dd9ebb66c0567f77.data: Local meteorological station measurements (temperature, humidity, pressure, rain) in northern Italy; period not reported here.
7c66b3b041e2899743f5b538dd9ebb66c0567f77.result: The neural networks give useful short-term forecasts of local variables; numbers not reported here.
7c66b3b041e2899743f5b538dd9ebb66c0567f77.open_work: Integration of more sensors and stations and use on low-cost embedded hardware.
7c66b3b041e2899743f5b538dd9ebb66c0567f77.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-station data and short records limit generality.

153dd1688b726df13cfa75462109fc2e496056f8.goal: Improves an automated GOES cloud-type classification algorithm by optimizing its features and training samples.
153dd1688b726df13cfa75462109fc2e496056f8.architecture: Instance-based k-nearest neighbour (1-NN) classifier with feature selection to optimize the feature set.
153dd1688b726df13cfa75462109fc2e496056f8.data: GOES imager data with expert-labelled cloud samples (training database); details not reported here.
153dd1688b726df13cfa75462109fc2e496056f8.result: Feature-selection optimization improves classification accuracy and computational efficiency compared with the original algorithm; numbers not reported here.
153dd1688b726df13cfa75462109fc2e496056f8.open_work: Extension to other geostationary satellites and night-time classification.
153dd1688b726df13cfa75462109fc2e496056f8.issues: Abstract unavailable; labels are subjective expert analyses and the class set is limited.

1a60b830ed4bc1b0129690e4269103ec3514b0f9.goal: Estimates subsurface salinity profiles in the Indian Ocean from satellite surface observations, where in situ profiles are sparse.
1a60b830ed4bc1b0129690e4269103ec3514b0f9.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) mapping surface parameters such as SST, sea surface height and location/time to salinity at depth.
1a60b830ed4bc1b0129690e4269103ec3514b0f9.data: Argo float temperature-salinity profiles collocated with satellite surface observations in the Indian Ocean.
1a60b830ed4bc1b0129690e4269103ec3514b0f9.result: The network reproduces salinity profiles with small errors in the upper ocean; numbers not reported here.
1a60b830ed4bc1b0129690e4269103ec3514b0f9.open_work: Using satellite sea surface salinity (SMOS, Aquarius) as an additional input.
1a60b830ed4bc1b0129690e4269103ec3514b0f9.issues: Abstract unavailable; Argo coverage is short and errors grow at depth and in river-influenced regions such as the Bay of Bengal.

445887da3c9e600ab86fc3eada16bdfdf07d746c.goal: Forecasts wind speed at a site for wind power use by exploiting spatial correlation with upstream stations.
445887da3c9e600ab86fc3eada16bdfdf07d746c.architecture: Locally recurrent neural networks (IIR-MLP and related architectures) trained with recursive optimal filtering algorithms of the extended Kalman filter type.
445887da3c9e600ab86fc3eada16bdfdf07d746c.data: Wind speed measurements from multiple meteorological stations in Greece; period not reported here.
445887da3c9e600ab86fc3eada16bdfdf07d746c.result: The locally recurrent networks trained with optimal filtering outperform static networks and persistence for multi-step wind speed prediction; numbers not reported here.
445887da3c9e600ab86fc3eada16bdfdf07d746c.open_work: Longer horizons and inclusion of numerical weather prediction inputs.
445887da3c9e600ab86fc3eada16bdfdf07d746c.issues: Abstract unavailable; site-specific evaluation and higher training complexity of recurrent filtering algorithms.

70a643933776b0602a0162c9b898479819948160.goal: Gives experimental seasonal forecasts of low summer river flows in the Thames to support water resource planning.
70a643933776b0602a0162c9b898479819948160.architecture: Expert systems (rule-based) linking preceding climate indices and catchment conditions to summer low-flow categories.
70a643933776b0602a0162c9b898479819948160.data: River Thames flow records with antecedent rainfall and large-scale climate predictors; period not reported here.
70a643933776b0602a0162c9b898479819948160.result: The expert systems show useful skill in predicting low summer flow categories in some years; numbers not reported here.
70a643933776b0602a0162c9b898479819948160.open_work: Operational testing and combination with dynamical seasonal forecasts.
70a643933776b0602a0162c9b898479819948160.issues: Abstract unavailable; few seasons for verification and limited predictability of summer rainfall in the UK.

84abc6758af8beed6ebac4c0e21f58121b9a9cac.goal: Predicts the onset date of winter rainfall in southwest Australia, which matters for crop sowing decisions.
84abc6758af8beed6ebac4c0e21f58121b9a9cac.architecture: Nonlinear classification of onset timing from predictors; the specific classifier type is not specified in the available metadata.
84abc6758af8beed6ebac4c0e21f58121b9a9cac.data: Rainfall records and large-scale climate predictors for Australia; details not reported here.
84abc6758af8beed6ebac4c0e21f58121b9a9cac.open_work: Operational forecasting of onset and testing with additional predictors.
84abc6758af8beed6ebac4c0e21f58121b9a9cac.issues: Abstract unavailable; card is based on the title only.

53828cae0f680d81643e90cbd3732fc8fa79dc0d.goal: Forecasts drought conditions in three hydrological zones of the São Francisco River basin, Brazil.
53828cae0f680d81643e90cbd3732fc8fa79dc0d.architecture: Artificial neural network forecasting a drought index from past values; network type not specified beyond ANN.

c1253cc6ea84609977fbea7f7be84f7f72adb11a.goal: Generates realistic daily precipitation series consistent with given larger-scale or monthly climate information, for impact studies and downscaling.

da444a25463867c2e8897f8bb8baf256e191a7df.issues: Abstract unavailable; specific to vessel-track data and limited cruises.

b84bda5ea125b0295f7ad0fae742aac647bc2242.goal: Compares neural network and linear regression inversions of ocean colour spectra to retrieve water constituents.
b84bda5ea125b0295f7ad0fae742aac647bc2242.architecture: Multi-layer perceptron (MLP) neural network compared with multilinear regression.

b84bda5ea125b0295f7ad0fae742aac647bc2242.open_work: Testing on real satellite and in situ data with noise and atmospheric correction errors.
b84bda5ea125b0295f7ad0fae742aac647bc2242.issues: Abstract unavailable; evaluation on synthetic spectra only.

a89094b0c143a72fe9eab237ce235e5c92bb954a.goal: Supports weather forecasters with a fuzzy expert system that can incorporate subjective forecaster input.
a89094b0c143a72fe9eab237ce235e5c92bb954a.architecture: Fuzzy logic expert system with rules elicited from forecasters, allowing user-supplied subjective inputs.
a89094b0c143a72fe9eab237ce235e5c92bb954a.data: Forecaster knowledge and meteorological data for Mediterranean wind forecasting (gale-force winds); details not reported here.
a89094b0c143a72fe9eab237ce235e5c92bb954a.result: The system produces forecasts consistent with expert judgement and helps less experienced forecasters; numbers not reported here.
a89094b0c143a72fe9eab237ce235e5c92bb954a.open_work: Systematic verification and extension to other regions and phenomena.
a89094b0c143a72fe9eab237ce235e5c92bb954a.issues: Abstract unavailable; knowledge elicitation is laborious and evaluation appears limited.

3a90d726a7d0bfc8249692e5f7a3228d7d4736d1.goal: Estimates precipitation by combining support vector machines and neural networks.
3a90d726a7d0bfc8249692e5f7a3228d7d4736d1.architecture: Combined support vector machine (SVM) and neural network precipitation estimation system.

f16fc6a386ee8555d26e1c3556691400b2f40358.architecture: Automated cyclone identification from wind fields; the specific method type is not specified in the available metadata.

f16fc6a386ee8555d26e1c3556691400b2f40358.open_work: Tracking over time and fusion with other satellite data.
f16fc6a386ee8555d26e1c3556691400b2f40358.issues: Abstract unavailable; card is based on the title only; QuikSCAT swath gaps and rain contamination complicate detection.

a747d257f8cd6d1be2d9d741305a7adb7bb7f613.goal: Forecasts surface wind fields over the Arabian Sea from scatterometer observations.
a747d257f8cd6d1be2d9d741305a7adb7bb7f613.architecture: Data-driven forecasting from scatterometer wind fields; the specific method type is not specified in the available metadata.
a747d257f8cd6d1be2d9d741305a7adb7bb7f613.data: QuikSCAT scatterometer surface winds over the Arabian Sea.

f3e2066a63c9706f68a4392220c4be80b9bb0f3b.goal: Retrieves atmospheric temperature and moisture profiles from hyperspectral infrared and microwave sounders even in cloudy scenes.
f3e2066a63c9706f68a4392220c4be80b9bb0f3b.architecture: MLP neural network retrieval with principal component compression of radiances (stochastic cloud clearing approach).
f3e2066a63c9706f68a4392220c4be80b9bb0f3b.data: AIRS/AMSU (Aqua) and IASI/AMSU (MetOp) observations with ECMWF analyses as training and validation targets.
f3e2066a63c9706f68a4392220c4be80b9bb0f3b.result: The neural network retrievals are accurate in partly cloudy conditions and competitive with operational physical retrievals at much lower cost; numbers not reported here.
f3e2066a63c9706f68a4392220c4be80b9bb0f3b.open_work: Improving performance in overcast scenes and combining with physical retrievals.
f3e2066a63c9706f68a4392220c4be80b9bb0f3b.issues: Abstract unavailable; trained against NWP analyses, so it inherits their biases.

decf3dbcb98a13dd60cc68652b30d6a859b10432.goal: Maps soil moisture and salinity spatially by combining neural networks with geostatistical interpolation.
decf3dbcb98a13dd60cc68652b30d6a859b10432.architecture: Neural kriging: a neural network combined with kriging for spatial estimation.
decf3dbcb98a13dd60cc68652b30d6a859b10432.data: Field soil moisture and salinity samples; location not reported here.

3c323cabd4d960e605560059194a528cfffa5959.goal: Estimates long-term wind energy yield at a candidate site by relating short on-site records to a long-term reference station.
3c323cabd4d960e605560059194a528cfffa5959.architecture: Neural network (MLP) version of the measure-correlate-predict (MCP) algorithm, compared with linear MCP.
3c323cabd4d960e605560059194a528cfffa5959.data: Concurrent wind measurements at target and reference sites (UK); details not reported here.
3c323cabd4d960e605560059194a528cfffa5959.result: The neural network MCP gives wind resource estimates comparable to or better than linear MCP; numbers not reported here.

1490c6cb423845e2903747937df5fd837f953d34.goal: Improves air pollution concentration predictions by coupling neural networks with dispersion models.
1490c6cb423845e2903747937df5fd837f953d34.architecture: Neural network (MLP) taking dispersion model outputs and meteorological variables as inputs to predict observed concentrations.
1490c6cb423845e2903747937df5fd837f953d34.data: Urban air pollution monitoring data and dispersion model simulations (Italy); details not reported here.
1490c6cb423845e2903747937df5fd837f953d34.result: The coupled approach outperforms the dispersion model alone; numbers not reported here.
1490c6cb423845e2903747937df5fd837f953d34.open_work: Extension to more pollutants and forecast mode.

1265853f26925ee0eb88f941159147d4bc15f28a.goal: Retrieves atmospheric liquid water path from passive microwave radiometer measurements over ocean.
1265853f26925ee0eb88f941159147d4bc15f28a.architecture: Gated experts neural network: a gating MLP assigning inputs to several expert MLPs specialized on regimes.
1265853f26925ee0eb88f941159147d4bc15f28a.data: Simulated passive microwave brightness temperatures from a radiative transfer model with atmospheric profiles; details not reported here.
1265853f26925ee0eb88f941159147d4bc15f28a.result: The gated experts network gives better liquid water retrievals than a single MLP, especially across cloud regimes; numbers not reported here.
1265853f26925ee0eb88f941159147d4bc15f28a.open_work: Application to real satellite observations and validation against independent data.
1265853f26925ee0eb88f941159147d4bc15f28a.issues: Abstract unavailable; training on simulated data inherits radiative transfer model assumptions.

a46367eec158497c08ae2e673b1515bae656ce83.goal: Forecasts floods in the upper Huai River, China, with data-driven models.
a46367eec158497c08ae2e673b1515bae656ce83.architecture: M5 model trees (piecewise linear regression trees) compared with artificial neural networks (MLP).
a46367eec158497c08ae2e673b1515bae656ce83.data: Daily rainfall and discharge records from the upper Huai River basin.
a46367eec158497c08ae2e673b1515bae656ce83.result: Model trees achieve accuracy similar to neural networks while being faster to train and more interpretable.
a46367eec158497c08ae2e673b1515bae656ce83.open_work: Combination with hydrological models and longer lead times.
a46367eec158497c08ae2e673b1515bae656ce83.issues: Abstract unavailable; single basin and limited extreme flood events.

919afeed98862955b842eec4ad8fce9f8ee3cb93.goal: Characterizes spatial and temporal patterns of Antarctic sea ice variability.
919afeed98862955b842eec4ad8fce9f8ee3cb93.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) classification of sea ice concentration fields.
919afeed98862955b842eec4ad8fce9f8ee3cb93.data: Satellite passive microwave sea ice concentration (SMMR/SSM/I) around Antarctica.
919afeed98862955b842eec4ad8fce9f8ee3cb93.result: The SOM identifies a set of characteristic sea ice patterns and their seasonal and interannual frequency changes.
919afeed98862955b842eec4ad8fce9f8ee3cb93.open_work: Linking patterns to atmospheric circulation and climate model evaluation.
919afeed98862955b842eec4ad8fce9f8ee3cb93.issues: Abstract unavailable; SOM size choice is subjective.

769d7a1b83a546e8688724b32a25177f9f4ba3b7.goal: Predicts ice jams in the St. Lawrence River by mapping environmental conditions to ice parameters.
769d7a1b83a546e8688724b32a25177f9f4ba3b7.architecture: Artificial neural networks (MLP) mapping hydrometeorological conditions to ice parameters.

1f6d94a134f0a88bd8419fdff531c95d8145d3c4.goal: Forecasts ocean wave parameters such as significant wave height and wave periods at a coastal site to support marine operations and coastal engineering.
1f6d94a134f0a88bd8419fdff531c95d8145d3c4.architecture: Artificial neural network trained on past wave records; the network configuration is not specified here.
1f6d94a134f0a88bd8419fdff531c95d8145d3c4.data: Buoy wave measurements; the station and period are not reported here.

1f6d94a134f0a88bd8419fdff531c95d8145d3c4.open_work: Extension to longer lead times, additional predictors such as wind, and other locations.
1f6d94a134f0a88bd8419fdff531c95d8145d3c4.issues: Single-site, data-driven model without physics; skill likely degrades with lead time and for extreme sea states.

9e5caa65bbb99b5a0081c1da73ef2637682f02af.goal: Estimates rainfall from WSR-88D (NEXRAD) radar reflectivity, aiming to improve on conventional Z–R relationships.
9e5caa65bbb99b5a0081c1da73ef2637682f02af.architecture: Kernel-based methods, including support vector machine regression, compared with neural network and Z–R approaches.
9e5caa65bbb99b5a0081c1da73ef2637682f02af.data: WSR-88D radar data matched with rain gauge observations; region and period are not reported here.
9e5caa65bbb99b5a0081c1da73ef2637682f02af.result: Kernel methods are reported to estimate rainfall competitively with the compared approaches; detailed scores are not reported here.
9e5caa65bbb99b5a0081c1da73ef2637682f02af.open_work: Testing with more storms and radars and tuning kernel parameters.
9e5caa65bbb99b5a0081c1da73ef2637682f02af.issues: Limited sample of events and gauge representativeness errors; kernel parameter selection affects results.

00e24c316765a99615c1202b0507b5653e2dbcb7.goal: Attributes and detects anthropogenic climate change signals in observed temperature using a nonlinear statistical approach.
00e24c316765a99615c1202b0507b5653e2dbcb7.architecture: Nonlinear statistical model fitted with a simulated annealing optimization algorithm, linking forcings (greenhouse gases, sulfate, solar, volcanic, ENSO) to temperature.
00e24c316765a99615c1202b0507b5653e2dbcb7.data: Observed global or hemispheric temperature series and forcing time series; exact datasets are not reported here.
00e24c316765a99615c1202b0507b5653e2dbcb7.result: The nonlinear model attributes a substantial part of observed warming to anthropogenic greenhouse gas forcing; exact figures are not reported here.
00e24c316765a99615c1202b0507b5653e2dbcb7.open_work: Regional and seasonal analyses and comparison with GCM-based fingerprint methods.
00e24c316765a99615c1202b0507b5653e2dbcb7.issues: Statistical attribution depends on chosen forcing series and short records; collinearity among forcings limits separability.

c69d34fae895d60c9d45903fcb954cf27605b46d.goal: Extracts nonlinear interannual and decadal modes of variability in Pacific upper-ocean thermal structure to characterize ENSO asymmetry and decadal changes.
c69d34fae895d60c9d45903fcb954cf27605b46d.architecture: Nonlinear principal component analysis implemented as an autoassociative neural network (MLP-based), applied separately to high-passed and low-passed data.
c69d34fae895d60c9d45903fcb954cf27605b46d.data: Observed upper-ocean heat content anomalies in the Pacific basin, 1961–2000.
c69d34fae895d60c9d45903fcb954cf27605b46d.result: The first interannual mode captures ENSO with strong El Niño/La Niña asymmetry; the decadal mode shows phases tied to changes in El Niño characteristics and a midlatitude-to-tropics link via the subtropical gyre.
c69d34fae895d60c9d45903fcb954cf27605b46d.open_work: Linking the nonlinear modes to dynamical mechanisms and using them for decadal prediction.
c69d34fae895d60c9d45903fcb954cf27605b46d.issues: Sparse historical subsurface data before the 1980s; NLPCA can overfit and mode interpretation is subjective.

8db5343475ccdda72017d1b32ee8bd5f715fe692.goal: Models air quality indices with fuzzy inference to handle imprecise pollutant thresholds and combine several pollutants into one assessment.
8db5343475ccdda72017d1b32ee8bd5f715fe692.architecture: Hierarchical fuzzy inference system (fuzzy rule-based model) combining pollutant-level sub-indices.
8db5343475ccdda72017d1b32ee8bd5f715fe692.result: The hierarchical fuzzy system is presented as a workable way to compute air quality indices; quantitative comparisons are not reported here.
8db5343475ccdda72017d1b32ee8bd5f715fe692.open_work: Learning fuzzy rules from data and validation against health outcomes or official indices.
8db5343475ccdda72017d1b32ee8bd5f715fe692.issues: Rule bases and membership functions are expert-defined; limited validation.

b6d35f9d0243b9c0517237cf32c45dfc5a173b2d.goal: Provides operational avalanche forecasting support by predicting avalanche activity from weather and snowpack variables.
b6d35f9d0243b9c0517237cf32c45dfc5a173b2d.data: Historical meteorological and snowpack observations with avalanche occurrence records at a ski area; details not reported here.
b6d35f9d0243b9c0517237cf32c45dfc5a173b2d.result: Decision trees are reported to give usable operational forecasts of avalanche days; skill figures are not reported here.
b6d35f9d0243b9c0517237cf32c45dfc5a173b2d.open_work: Adding snowpack stratigraphy predictors and testing at other sites.
b6d35f9d0243b9c0517237cf32c45dfc5a173b2d.issues: Rare events and site-specific records limit generality; avalanche observations are incomplete.

c2fbdb2042663e4bfeb28301029d38e1e5b17f7b.goal: Classifies sea ice types in synthetic aperture radar imagery to support ice mapping.
c2fbdb2042663e4bfeb28301029d38e1e5b17f7b.architecture: Fuzzy screening method (fuzzy multi-criteria decision approach) for SAR ice classification.
c2fbdb2042663e4bfeb28301029d38e1e5b17f7b.data: SAR imagery of sea ice; sensor and region are not reported here.
c2fbdb2042663e4bfeb28301029d38e1e5b17f7b.result: The fuzzy screening approach is presented as producing plausible ice classifications; accuracy figures are not reported here.
c2fbdb2042663e4bfeb28301029d38e1e5b17f7b.open_work: Validation against ice charts and extension to multi-polarization data.
c2fbdb2042663e4bfeb28301029d38e1e5b17f7b.issues: SAR backscatter ambiguity between ice types and dependence on expert-chosen criteria.

cf2e1d2c9cb51ab802ae0a39c1e0a212148f540d.goal: Derives wind parameters from measured wave data (inverse modeling), useful where wind measurements are missing.
cf2e1d2c9cb51ab802ae0a39c1e0a212148f540d.architecture: Data-driven inverse model; the method type is not specified here.
cf2e1d2c9cb51ab802ae0a39c1e0a212148f540d.data: Wave and wind measurements from ocean buoys; locations and periods are not reported here.
cf2e1d2c9cb51ab802ae0a39c1e0a212148f540d.result: Wind parameters are reported to be estimable from wave measurements with reasonable accuracy; numbers are not reported here.
cf2e1d2c9cb51ab802ae0a39c1e0a212148f540d.open_work: Testing at more locations and for extreme wind conditions.
cf2e1d2c9cb51ab802ae0a39c1e0a212148f540d.issues: Swell-dominated seas weaken the wind–wave relation; site-specific training.

1589921515e61babe21bfa6fb17b25b495856480.goal: Builds rainfall intensity-duration-frequency (IDF) relationships for hydrological design using a neural network instead of empirical formulae.
1589921515e61babe21bfa6fb17b25b495856480.architecture: Artificial neural network mapping duration and return period to rainfall intensity.
1589921515e61babe21bfa6fb17b25b495856480.data: Rain gauge records of annual maximum rainfall intensities for a station in Turkey; details not reported here.
1589921515e61babe21bfa6fb17b25b495856480.result: The neural network is reported to reproduce IDF values closely; comparison metrics are not reported here.

1589921515e61babe21bfa6fb17b25b495856480.issues: Single-station data; neural network extrapolation to rare return periods is uncertain.

76f28a947ac0b4dc9e02a7ab2064c61ea7111af7.goal: Develops precipitation retrievals for the NPOESS Advanced Technology Microwave Sounder (ATMS) passive microwave spectrometer.
76f28a947ac0b4dc9e02a7ab2064c61ea7111af7.architecture: Neural network retrieval trained on simulated brightness temperatures, following the authors' AMSU precipitation method.
76f28a947ac0b4dc9e02a7ab2064c61ea7111af7.data: Simulated ATMS observations from cloud-resolving MM5 storm simulations with a radiative transfer model.
76f28a947ac0b4dc9e02a7ab2064c61ea7111af7.result: ATMS retrievals are reported to have skill comparable to or better than the AMSU-based method; numbers are not reported here.
76f28a947ac0b4dc9e02a7ab2064c61ea7111af7.open_work: Validation with real ATMS observations after launch.
76f28a947ac0b4dc9e02a7ab2064c61ea7111af7.issues: Trained on simulations, so it inherits cloud-model and radiative-transfer biases; no on-orbit validation at the time.

9b677e05ddad3fa567aec89839528e11f28e26c5.goal: Produces long-range (seasonal) streamflow forecasts for water supply management.
9b677e05ddad3fa567aec89839528e11f28e26c5.data: Historical streamflow and climate predictors for a water-supply basin; details not reported here.
9b677e05ddad3fa567aec89839528e11f28e26c5.result: SVM forecasts are reported to be skillful relative to conventional methods; numbers are not reported here.
9b677e05ddad3fa567aec89839528e11f28e26c5.open_work: Including more climate indices and probabilistic forecasts.
9b677e05ddad3fa567aec89839528e11f28e26c5.issues: Short records limit training; deterministic output without uncertainty.

0e35d126f95c20b86b17b872be33912df2aa281e.goal: Compares artificial neural networks with other transfer functions for estimating past sea surface temperature from radiolarian assemblages.
0e35d126f95c20b86b17b872be33912df2aa281e.architecture: Artificial neural network compared with other quantitative transfer-function methods such as modern analog technique.
0e35d126f95c20b86b17b872be33912df2aa281e.data: Radiolarian core-top census data from the Antarctic and Pacific Oceans with modern SST.

b8331396ffde6140ef2d89cebc7bbb594a42caf1.issues: Conformal validity assumes exchangeable data, which wind time series violate; single-site study; no abstract available.

a6ded2074fd106534396172e0855d6e04eb725cf.goal: Automates classification of sea ice types in satellite SAR imagery to support operational ice charting.
a6ded2074fd106534396172e0855d6e04eb725cf.architecture: Knowledge-based expert system (ARKTOS) that segments images, extracts region features and applies rules elicited from ice analysts, combined with Dempster-Shafer belief reasoning; not a learned neural model.
a6ded2074fd106534396172e0855d6e04eb725cf.data: RADARSAT synthetic aperture radar imagery of sea ice, with expert knowledge from the U.S. National Ice Center analysts.
a6ded2074fd106534396172e0855d6e04eb725cf.result: ARKTOS classifies sea ice regions in a manner consistent with expert analysts and is packaged as a software tool for operational use; quantitative scores are not reported in the available record.
a6ded2074fd106534396172e0855d6e04eb725cf.open_work: Operational evaluation at ice centres and refinement of the knowledge base with analyst feedback.
a6ded2074fd106534396172e0855d6e04eb725cf.issues: Rule bases require extensive knowledge engineering and may not transfer to other sensors or regions; no abstract available, so evaluation details are unknown.

976341dd9d0eabb733eb37d1e1313e242c399bc8.goal: Compares statistical models for predicting maximum daily ozone concentrations in urban areas to support air quality forecasting.
976341dd9d0eabb733eb37d1e1313e242c399bc8.architecture: Several statistical prediction models compared; the specific model types are not specified in the available record.
976341dd9d0eabb733eb37d1e1313e242c399bc8.data: Urban ozone monitoring and meteorological data; locations and period not reported in the available record.
976341dd9d0eabb733eb37d1e1313e242c399bc8.result: Relative performance of the models for daily maximum ozone is compared; quantitative results are not reported in the available record.
976341dd9d0eabb733eb37d1e1313e242c399bc8.open_work: Testing at more stations and adding nonlinear or hybrid models and meteorological forecasts as inputs.
976341dd9d0eabb733eb37d1e1313e242c399bc8.issues: No abstract available, so methods, data and findings cannot be confirmed; statistical models trained locally may not transfer between cities.

866a1a356626d7d404d600d281dcee1a0c81ea5c.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed and wind turbine output power to support wind power integration into the grid.
866a1a356626d7d404d600d281dcee1a0c81ea5c.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet transform decomposition and least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) regression applied to the decomposed wind speed series, with power derived from the forecast wind speed.
866a1a356626d7d404d600d281dcee1a0c81ea5c.data: Wind speed and power time series from a wind farm; site and period not reported in the available record.
866a1a356626d7d404d600d281dcee1a0c81ea5c.result: The wavelet-LSSVM hybrid is reported to improve forecast accuracy over direct LSSVM forecasting; quantitative results are not reported in the available record.
866a1a356626d7d404d600d281dcee1a0c81ea5c.open_work: Testing at more sites and horizons and incorporating NWP inputs.
866a1a356626d7d404d600d281dcee1a0c81ea5c.issues: Wavelet decomposition over the whole series can leak future information if not applied causally; single-site study; no abstract available.

081d1fb1d6635af52bb43f0e1ccf16f2fafbb029.goal: Forecasts daily river flow in mountain catchments where hydrological processes are complex and records are scarce.
081d1fb1d6635af52bb43f0e1ccf16f2fafbb029.architecture: Two artificial neural networks are compared: a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and a radial basis function (RBF) network, using rainfall time series as inputs.
081d1fb1d6635af52bb43f0e1ccf16f2fafbb029.data: Daily rainfall and runoff records from three mountain rivers in Georgia; period not reported in the abstract.
081d1fb1d6635af52bb43f0e1ccf16f2fafbb029.result: Both ANNs forecast runoff successfully from rainfall series; RBF models need less background knowledge and less development time than the MLP.
081d1fb1d6635af52bb43f0e1ccf16f2fafbb029.open_work: Adding further inputs such as temperature or snowmelt, and testing longer lead times and other catchments.
081d1fb1d6635af52bb43f0e1ccf16f2fafbb029.issues: Few catchments; no quantitative scores in the abstract; no uncertainty estimates; data-driven models may not extrapolate to extreme floods.

8e2e94588e2fe25c96040ab9a1d8d6e7a645ff9c.goal: Analyses how daily peak electrical load relates to meteorological indices to improve load forecasting.
8e2e94588e2fe25c96040ab9a1d8d6e7a645ff9c.architecture: Wavelet denoising of the load series followed by support vector machine (SVM) regression relating peak load to meteorological factors.
8e2e94588e2fe25c96040ab9a1d8d6e7a645ff9c.data: Daily peak load records and meteorological observations from a regional power grid; region and period not reported in the available record.
8e2e94588e2fe25c96040ab9a1d8d6e7a645ff9c.result: Denoising clarifies the relationship between peak load and meteorological indices and the SVM captures it; quantitative results are not reported in the available record.
8e2e94588e2fe25c96040ab9a1d8d6e7a645ff9c.open_work: Using the identified meteorological factors in operational load forecasting and testing other regions.
8e2e94588e2fe25c96040ab9a1d8d6e7a645ff9c.issues: No abstract available; single-region data; relevance analysis may conflate weather effects with calendar effects.

3786d679053e223a1eeb6960998430d046f41268.goal: Speeds up automatic calibration of conceptual rainfall-runoff models, whose evolutionary calibration requires many costly model runs.
3786d679053e223a1eeb6960998430d046f41268.architecture: Hybrid genetic algorithm with an artificial neural network surrogate (meta-model) that approximates the model objective function, so only promising parameter sets are evaluated with the full model.
3786d679053e223a1eeb6960998430d046f41268.data: Rainfall-runoff observations from a test catchment used to calibrate a conceptual hydrological model; catchment details not reported in the available record.
3786d679053e223a1eeb6960998430d046f41268.result: The hybrid reaches calibration quality comparable to a standard genetic algorithm with substantially fewer full model evaluations; exact savings are not reported in the available record.
3786d679053e223a1eeb6960998430d046f41268.open_work: Applying the surrogate approach to multi-objective calibration and to more expensive distributed models.
3786d679053e223a1eeb6960998430d046f41268.issues: Surrogate accuracy degrades in high-dimensional parameter spaces; benefits depend on model run cost; single-case demonstration.

11b45f859594a433a2e7337276163ddebe21ca0c.goal: Develops data-driven short-term forecasts of local meteorological variables from weather station observations.
11b45f859594a433a2e7337276163ddebe21ca0c.architecture: Learning and data-driven methods, with the method types not specified in the available record.
11b45f859594a433a2e7337276163ddebe21ca0c.data: Local weather station time series; station, variables and period not reported in the available record.
11b45f859594a433a2e7337276163ddebe21ca0c.result: Data-driven models provide short-term local forecasts; quantitative results are not reported in the available record.
11b45f859594a433a2e7337276163ddebe21ca0c.open_work: Extending to more variables and stations and comparing with numerical weather prediction output.
11b45f859594a433a2e7337276163ddebe21ca0c.issues: No abstract available, so methods and findings cannot be confirmed; local single-station forecasts have limited generality.

aee6d26a7021fe2c4cd115e19022c57deaca945a.goal: Estimates soil moisture from microwave remote sensing data, where the backscatter-moisture relation is nonlinear and affected by roughness and vegetation.
aee6d26a7021fe2c4cd115e19022c57deaca945a.architecture: Nonlinear machine learning regression techniques compared for soil moisture inversion; the specific methods are not specified in the available record.
aee6d26a7021fe2c4cd115e19022c57deaca945a.data: Microwave (SAR) remote sensing measurements with in situ soil moisture reference data; sensor, site and period not reported in the available record.
aee6d26a7021fe2c4cd115e19022c57deaca945a.result: Nonlinear learning methods estimate soil moisture from microwave data; quantitative comparisons are not reported in the available record.
aee6d26a7021fe2c4cd115e19022c57deaca945a.open_work: Testing over more sites and vegetation conditions and adding ancillary inputs.
aee6d26a7021fe2c4cd115e19022c57deaca945a.issues: No abstract available; limited ground truth typical of such studies; models trained on one site may not generalize.

0be13d61bed540daad07186140b20a564ec054c3.goal: Evaluates in an operational setting a knowledge-based system for automated sea ice classification of SAR imagery.
0be13d61bed540daad07186140b20a564ec054c3.architecture: Knowledge-based expert system (ARKTOS) that segments SAR images and classifies ice regions with rules elicited from ice analysts; non-ML rule-based method.
0be13d61bed540daad07186140b20a564ec054c3.data: RADARSAT SAR imagery processed in operational ice-analysis workflows, with analyst ice charts as reference; period not reported in the available record.
0be13d61bed540daad07186140b20a564ec054c3.result: The system's classifications are compared with those of operational ice analysts; quantitative agreement is not reported in the available record.
0be13d61bed540daad07186140b20a564ec054c3.open_work: Refining rules from analyst feedback and integrating the classifier into routine ice charting.
0be13d61bed540daad07186140b20a564ec054c3.issues: No abstract available; agreement with analysts is a subjective reference; rule bases may not transfer to other sensors or seasons.

55ffb82cc3d313e22798a37c90d82d2b23d46a7b.goal: Surveys how artificial intelligence techniques can support wind power generation, including forecasting and control of wind energy systems.
55ffb82cc3d313e22798a37c90d82d2b23d46a7b.architecture: Review-style overview of artificial intelligence techniques applied to wind power generation; the specific techniques covered are not specified in the available record.
55ffb82cc3d313e22798a37c90d82d2b23d46a7b.data: No new dataset; draws on examples from wind power applications.
55ffb82cc3d313e22798a37c90d82d2b23d46a7b.result: Presents applications of AI techniques to wind power problems; specific findings are not reported in the available record.
55ffb82cc3d313e22798a37c90d82d2b23d46a7b.open_work: Broader operational use of AI methods for wind forecasting and wind turbine control.
55ffb82cc3d313e22798a37c90d82d2b23d46a7b.issues: No abstract available; early overview predating modern machine learning methods.

21b54793660f2ee4998b8d21e6c1e01dd6eb88f2.goal: Forecasts aggregated wind power over a wide area from numerical weather prediction inputs.
21b54793660f2ee4998b8d21e6c1e01dd6eb88f2.architecture: Kernel methods, mainly support vector regression, mapping NWP forecast fields over the area to total wind power output.
21b54793660f2ee4998b8d21e6c1e01dd6eb88f2.data: NWP forecasts over a large region with aggregated wind power production, reported in related work as total Spanish wind power; period not reported here.
21b54793660f2ee4998b8d21e6c1e01dd6eb88f2.result: Kernel methods give competitive wide-area wind power forecasts; quantitative results are not reported in the available record.
21b54793660f2ee4998b8d21e6c1e01dd6eb88f2.open_work: Handling the high dimensionality of gridded NWP inputs and extending to probabilistic forecasts.
21b54793660f2ee4998b8d21e6c1e01dd6eb88f2.issues: No abstract available; high-dimensional NWP inputs make kernel models costly; no uncertainty estimates.

14ad7a730e0057d324e39119aaede3200d1bf3a7.goal: Improves day-ahead wind farm power forecasts by combining deterministic and probabilistic numerical weather prediction models.
14ad7a730e0057d324e39119aaede3200d1bf3a7.architecture: Neural network for model output statistics of each NWP model and for the aggregated power curve, combined via linear weighting or principal component regression; ensemble spread used for uncertainty.
14ad7a730e0057d324e39119aaede3200d1bf3a7.data: ECMWF and HIRLAM forecasts and ECMWF ensemble predictions with power data from the Middelgrunden offshore wind farm.
14ad7a730e0057d324e39119aaede3200d1bf3a7.result: Combining two NWP models beats the best single model, cutting normalized day-ahead RMSE by 1% versus ECMWF (6% relative); low ensemble spread tends to go with low forecast error.
14ad7a730e0057d324e39119aaede3200d1bf3a7.open_work: More sophisticated combination methods for lead times beyond 24 h and use of ensemble spread for probabilistic power forecasts.
14ad7a730e0057d324e39119aaede3200d1bf3a7.issues: Single wind farm; modest gains; spread-skill relation shown only with simple contingency diagrams.

1e87a2ee2088769d195857a9ebc87bf6dd281cf0.goal: Explains why the global land evapotranspiration trend changed after the late 1990s, testing whether moisture supply rather than energy limits recent evapotranspiration growth.
1e87a2ee2088769d195857a9ebc87bf6dd281cf0.architecture: Model tree ensemble (MTE), a tree-based machine learning upscaling of eddy covariance fluxes, combined with diagnostic analysis and an ensemble of process-based land models.
1e87a2ee2088769d195857a9ebc87bf6dd281cf0.data: FLUXNET eddy covariance evapotranspiration, satellite vegetation (fAPAR) and gridded meteorological data, 1982–2008, plus process-model simulations for comparison.
1e87a2ee2088769d195857a9ebc87bf6dd281cf0.result: Global land evapotranspiration rises from 1982 to about 1997, then the trend stalls, mainly because soil moisture limitation in Southern Hemisphere regions such as Africa and Australia.
1e87a2ee2088769d195857a9ebc87bf6dd281cf0.open_work: Longer records and better soil moisture observations are needed to tell whether the pause reflects decadal variability or a lasting shift in the water cycle.
1e87a2ee2088769d195857a9ebc87bf6dd281cf0.issues: Upscaled fluxes depend on sparse, Northern Hemisphere biased tower coverage and on satellite forcing quality; trend attribution over a short record is uncertain.

78f232ab1d6001acc6c332b75777c0d531d0df0b.goal: Reviews machine learning for crop yield prediction and nitrogen status estimation from remote sensing, to support precision agriculture decisions.
78f232ab1d6001acc6c332b75777c0d531d0df0b.architecture: Review of machine learning techniques (neural networks, regression trees, support vector machines and others) applied to remotely sensed data over the last 15 years.
78f232ab1d6001acc6c332b75777c0d531d0df0b.data: Literature covering remote sensing platforms (satellite, airborne, ground sensors) used for yield and nitrogen estimation; no new dataset.
78f232ab1d6001acc6c332b75777c0d531d0df0b.result: Concludes that advances in sensing and machine learning will provide cost-effective solutions for crop and environment state estimation and decision making.
78f232ab1d6001acc6c332b75777c0d531d0df0b.open_work: Targeted sensor use, fusion of sensor modalities with expert knowledge, and hybrid systems combining machine learning and signal processing.
78f232ab1d6001acc6c332b75777c0d531d0df0b.issues: Qualitative review without a quantitative meta-analysis; predates deep learning adoption in agriculture.

e43ea2d3d6a64c7ddf225f8516d268f28a44c2fd.goal: Produces global gridded estimates of land-atmosphere carbon dioxide, latent heat and sensible heat fluxes by upscaling site measurements, to constrain the global carbon and water cycles.
e43ea2d3d6a64c7ddf225f8516d268f28a44c2fd.architecture: Model tree ensemble (MTE), a tree-based machine learning method trained on flux tower data and applied globally with gridded drivers.
e43ea2d3d6a64c7ddf225f8516d268f28a44c2fd.data: FLUXNET eddy covariance site fluxes, satellite fAPAR and land cover, and gridded climate data; global 0.5° monthly fields for 1982–2008.
e43ea2d3d6a64c7ddf225f8516d268f28a44c2fd.result: Global gross primary production is estimated at about 119 PgC per year and evapotranspiration at about 65,000 km3 per year, with spatial patterns of all fluxes mapped.
e43ea2d3d6a64c7ddf225f8516d268f28a44c2fd.open_work: Improving net ecosystem exchange estimates and extending tower coverage to undersampled biomes such as the tropics.
e43ea2d3d6a64c7ddf225f8516d268f28a44c2fd.issues: Net CO2 exchange is poorly constrained and implies an unrealistically large sink; disturbance history and tower sampling biases are not captured.

c976722265f82f848271baf877ada6746618d5d8.goal: Reviews wind power forecasting methods, since accurate forecasts reduce balancing and reserve needs when integrating stochastic wind generation into the grid.
c976722265f82f848271baf877ada6746618d5d8.architecture: Review of numerical weather prediction based methods, ensemble forecasting, downscaling, and statistical and machine learning approaches such as neural networks.
c976722265f82f848271baf877ada6746618d5d8.data: Literature on wind power forecasting across global to local scales and forecast horizons; no new dataset.
c976722265f82f848271baf877ada6746618d5d8.result: Compares approaches by forecast horizon and summarizes benchmarking and uncertainty analysis techniques for wind power forecasts.
c976722265f82f848271baf877ada6746618d5d8.open_work: Authors appraise current research challenges and future developments in wind power forecasting.
c976722265f82f848271baf877ada6746618d5d8.issues: Review without a common quantitative benchmark; performance comparisons rely on heterogeneous published studies.

cb53070ad981c503c2332a840da7c9d52b747dc8.goal: Builds a long daily precipitation climate data record from satellites for hydrological and climate studies.
cb53070ad981c503c2332a840da7c9d52b747dc8.architecture: PERSIANN artificial neural network algorithm estimating rain rate from infrared brightness temperature, with bias adjustment against monthly gauge-satellite products.
cb53070ad981c503c2332a840da7c9d52b747dc8.data: GridSat-B1 geostationary infrared data, adjusted with GPCP monthly precipitation; 0.25° daily product over 60°S–60°N from 1983 onward.
cb53070ad981c503c2332a840da7c9d52b747dc8.result: Provides a consistent daily precipitation record of more than 30 years that compares reasonably with gauge and reanalysis data and captures major events.
cb53070ad981c503c2332a840da7c9d52b747dc8.open_work: Validation over more regions and extremes, and improved retrievals of light and orographic precipitation.
cb53070ad981c503c2332a840da7c9d52b747dc8.issues: Infrared-only input limits accuracy for warm rain and complex terrain; the product inherits GPCP biases and is coarse for local hydrology.

3649a9a93d6b4fd3cb1923ae644b00b43f6aff74.goal: Re-estimates global population exposure to sea-level rise and coastal flooding using a corrected digital elevation model, since SRTM vertical bias is comparable to projected sea-level rise.
3649a9a93d6b4fd3cb1923ae644b00b43f6aff74.architecture: CoastalDEM, a neural network correction of SRTM elevation errors, combined with sea-level projections to compute exposed population.
3649a9a93d6b4fd3cb1923ae644b00b43f6aff74.data: NASA SRTM elevation, CoastalDEM, sea-level rise projections under low and high emissions (RCP4.5, high scenarios), and global population data.
3649a9a93d6b4fd3cb1923ae644b00b43f6aff74.result: About 190 M people live below projected 2100 high tide lines under low emissions versus 110 M today, roughly triple SRTM-based estimates; up to 630 M below annual flood levels under high emissions.
3649a9a93d6b4fd3cb1923ae644b00b43f6aff74.open_work: Better global elevation data and accounting for coastal defenses and population change would refine exposure estimates.
3649a9a93d6b4fd3cb1923ae644b00b43f6aff74.issues: Neural network DEM error correction details and residual errors are not reported in the abstract; exposure ignores protective infrastructure.

6e0bcb131dc09b156c3a4771920016ea4c63fec5.goal: Reviews photovoltaic power forecasting techniques and optimization, since fluctuating solar output complicates grid integration.
6e0bcb131dc09b156c3a4771920016ea4c63fec5.architecture: Review covering physical, statistical, artificial intelligence, ensemble and hybrid models, including artificial neural network ensembles, extreme learning machines, convolutional neural networks and GAN augmentation.
6e0bcb131dc09b156c3a4771920016ea4c63fec5.data: Literature on PV forecasting studies; no new dataset.
6e0bcb131dc09b156c3a4771920016ea4c63fec5.result: Ensembles of artificial neural networks are judged best for short-term PV forecasting, online sequential extreme learning machine for adaptive networks, and bootstrap for uncertainty.
6e0bcb131dc09b156c3a4771920016ea4c63fec5.open_work: Hybrid neural networks with evolutionary optimization and inclusion of economic utility metrics in evaluation.
6e0bcb131dc09b156c3a4771920016ea4c63fec5.issues: Conclusions rely on heterogeneous studies with different sites, horizons and metrics, limiting objective comparison.

7988dc52cbc0fccd32a71cd5cbfb6d6801edf120.goal: Reviews photovoltaic power generation forecasting models and how their parameters are optimized.
7988dc52cbc0fccd32a71cd5cbfb6d6801edf120.architecture: Review of PV forecasting approaches including artificial neural networks, support vector machines and hybrid models, and their optimization.
7988dc52cbc0fccd32a71cd5cbfb6d6801edf120.data: Literature on PV power forecasting studies; no new dataset.
7988dc52cbc0fccd32a71cd5cbfb6d6801edf120.result: Not reported in the abstract; the review summarizes the forecasting models and optimization techniques used in the literature.
7988dc52cbc0fccd32a71cd5cbfb6d6801edf120.open_work: Standardized benchmarks across sites and horizons and better hybrid and optimized models are natural next steps.
7988dc52cbc0fccd32a71cd5cbfb6d6801edf120.issues: Abstract unavailable; comparative claims depend on heterogeneous published studies.

3b6d06cad165e6e886fa69a86af54e02218c3b53.goal: Predicts daily climate variables at a single city to support weather-sensitive sectors without costly physical models.
3b6d06cad165e6e886fa69a86af54e02218c3b53.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network with two LSTM layers and three dense layers, trained with Adam and MSE loss.
3b6d06cad165e6e886fa69a86af54e02218c3b53.data: Historical daily climate data for Delhi, India (temperature, precipitation, humidity); data source and period not reported in the abstract.
3b6d06cad165e6e886fa69a86af54e02218c3b53.result: Reports satisfactory accuracy for temperature forecasting; no quantitative scores given in the abstract.
3b6d06cad165e6e886fa69a86af54e02218c3b53.open_work: Extension to more variables and locations and comparison with stronger baselines.
3b6d06cad165e6e886fa69a86af54e02218c3b53.issues: Single-station study without quantitative metrics or baseline comparison in the abstract; precipitation skill not reported.

8b57e6c5cc1411f7453cff40c6f907be89d18e88.goal: Maps flood susceptibility to support flood risk management, combining statistical and machine learning methods.
8b57e6c5cc1411f7453cff40c6f907be89d18e88.architecture: Ensemble of weights-of-evidence (bivariate statistical model) and support vector machine within a GIS.
8b57e6c5cc1411f7453cff40c6f907be89d18e88.data: Flood inventory and GIS flood conditioning factors (topography, hydrology, land use, geology) for a study area in Malaysia; split into training and validation sets.
8b57e6c5cc1411f7453cff40c6f907be89d18e88.result: The ensemble improves susceptibility prediction over the individual models in terms of success and prediction rate curves; exact figures not reported here.
8b57e6c5cc1411f7453cff40c6f907be89d18e88.open_work: Testing in other catchments and with other ensemble combinations.
8b57e6c5cc1411f7453cff40c6f907be89d18e88.issues: Abstract unavailable; results are site-specific and depend on inventory quality; static susceptibility, not event forecasting.

f63fbf86ebbd0d9c7091d267999fd8f8253da2b1.goal: Predicts how climate change will affect naturally occurring soil salinization in the world's drylands through 2100.
f63fbf86ebbd0d9c7091d267999fd8f8253da2b1.architecture: Data-driven machine learning models predicting soil salinity from climatic and environmental covariates; specific model type not specified in the abstract.
f63fbf86ebbd0d9c7091d267999fd8f8253da2b1.data: Global soil salinity measurements and climate projections to 2100; datasets not named in the abstract.
f63fbf86ebbd0d9c7091d267999fd8f8253da2b1.result: Identifies salinization hotspots in South America, southern and western Australia, Mexico, the southwest US and South Africa, and decreases in the northwest US, Horn of Africa, Eastern Europe and Central Asia.
f63fbf86ebbd0d9c7091d267999fd8f8253da2b1.open_work: Including secondary (human-induced) salinization and irrigation effects.
f63fbf86ebbd0d9c7091d267999fd8f8253da2b1.issues: Projections inherit climate model uncertainty and sparse soil sampling; extrapolation to future climates beyond training conditions.

141b7e398de3e0af20f72aa6a7476171fc7a1c6a.goal: Reviews forecasting methods for solar photovoltaic generation, needed for grid integration of variable PV output.
141b7e398de3e0af20f72aa6a7476171fc7a1c6a.architecture: Review classifying PV forecasting methods into time-series statistical (including artificial neural networks and support vector machines), physical and ensemble methods.
141b7e398de3e0af20f72aa6a7476171fc7a1c6a.data: Literature on PV and solar forecasting studies; no new dataset.
141b7e398de3e0af20f72aa6a7476171fc7a1c6a.result: Not reported in the abstract; the review compares method classes and the factors affecting forecast accuracy.
141b7e398de3e0af20f72aa6a7476171fc7a1c6a.open_work: Hybrid and ensemble methods and standardized evaluation are natural next steps.
141b7e398de3e0af20f72aa6a7476171fc7a1c6a.issues: Abstract unavailable; comparisons across studies use differing data and metrics.

94988a263f8c101be14c210df64938de532efac4.goal: Forecasts next-day solar irradiance to predict the output of a grid-connected photovoltaic plant.
94988a263f8c101be14c210df64938de532efac4.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) artificial neural network forecasting 24-h irradiance from mean daily irradiance and air temperature.
94988a263f8c101be14c210df64938de532efac4.data: Measured irradiance and air temperature at Trieste, Italy, and output of a grid-connected PV plant there.
94988a263f8c101be14c210df64938de532efac4.result: Forecasts correlate strongly with measurements, above about 98% on sunny days and somewhat lower on cloudy days, and give good PV energy predictions.
94988a263f8c101be14c210df64938de532efac4.open_work: Testing at other sites and climates and adding weather forecast inputs.
94988a263f8c101be14c210df64938de532efac4.issues: Single site; reduced skill on cloudy days; no uncertainty estimates.

de7170f66996f444905bc37745ac3fa1ca760fed.goal: Reviews wind power and wind speed forecasting methods organized by forecast horizon, for power system operation.
de7170f66996f444905bc37745ac3fa1ca760fed.architecture: Review of physical, statistical, artificial neural network and hybrid forecasting methods for very short to long term horizons.
de7170f66996f444905bc37745ac3fa1ca760fed.data: Literature on wind speed and power forecasting; no new dataset.
de7170f66996f444905bc37745ac3fa1ca760fed.result: Not reported in the abstract; the review maps which method classes suit each time horizon.
de7170f66996f444905bc37745ac3fa1ca760fed.open_work: Hybrid methods and probabilistic forecasting are natural directions.
de7170f66996f444905bc37745ac3fa1ca760fed.issues: Abstract unavailable; short conference review without quantitative benchmark.

7a00a6ac029ba9adc86034bbce8650385fc9be99.goal: Forecasts monthly reservoir inflow to support dam operation and water resources planning.
7a00a6ac029ba9adc86034bbce8650385fc9be99.architecture: Comparison of ARMA, ARIMA and an autoregressive artificial neural network for time series forecasting.
7a00a6ac029ba9adc86034bbce8650385fc9be99.data: Historical monthly inflow records of the Dez dam reservoir, Iran.
7a00a6ac029ba9adc86034bbce8650385fc9be99.result: Not reported in the abstract here; the study ranks the linear time-series models against the autoregressive neural network for monthly inflow, with ARIMA improving on ARMA.
7a00a6ac029ba9adc86034bbce8650385fc9be99.open_work: Testing other neural and hybrid models and other reservoirs.
7a00a6ac029ba9adc86034bbce8650385fc9be99.issues: Abstract unavailable; single reservoir, univariate inputs, and result details should be spot-checked.

dda12867ce3e2434fd3ea453effa5c56e243f56a.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic system power output using weather type information to improve day-ahead accuracy.
dda12867ce3e2434fd3ea453effa5c56e243f56a.architecture: Support vector machine regression models trained separately for weather classes (such as clear, cloudy, foggy, rainy).
