dda12867ce3e2434fd3ea453effa5c56e243f56a.data: Measured PV output and weather forecast data from a PV station in China; period not reported here.
dda12867ce3e2434fd3ea453effa5c56e243f56a.result: Weather classification combined with support vector machines yields accurate PV output forecasts; numbers not reported here.
dda12867ce3e2434fd3ea453effa5c56e243f56a.open_work: Finer weather classification and other sites or larger plants.
dda12867ce3e2434fd3ea453effa5c56e243f56a.issues: Abstract unavailable; single site, deterministic forecasts only, dependence on weather forecast quality.

f40d6c4fee64f62896baaa0166b862b470d62691.goal: Assesses flood susceptibility using support vector machines with different kernel functions in GIS.
f40d6c4fee64f62896baaa0166b862b470d62691.architecture: Support vector machine with linear, polynomial, radial basis function and sigmoid kernels, compared with frequency ratio style approaches.
f40d6c4fee64f62896baaa0166b862b470d62691.data: Flood inventory and GIS conditioning factors for a catchment in Malaysia; specific layers not reported here.
f40d6c4fee64f62896baaa0166b862b470d62691.result: Kernel choice affects susceptibility map accuracy; detailed figures not reported here.
f40d6c4fee64f62896baaa0166b862b470d62691.open_work: Ensemble and hybrid susceptibility models and transfer to other regions.
f40d6c4fee64f62896baaa0166b862b470d62691.issues: Abstract unavailable; site-specific results depending on inventory quality; static susceptibility only.

f6c2a296a610e7353aad45cfe30d65c5e16f09c2.goal: Quantifies how climate extremes affect global yields of maize, soybeans, rice and spring wheat to improve agricultural prediction and adaptation.
f6c2a296a610e7353aad45cfe30d65c5e16f09c2.architecture: Random forest machine learning model relating growing-season mean climate and extreme indices to yield anomalies.
f6c2a296a610e7353aad45cfe30d65c5e16f09c2.data: Global sub-national crop yield data, growing-season climate and climate-extreme indices, and irrigation information.
f6c2a296a610e7353aad45cfe30d65c5e16f09c2.result: Growing-season climate explains 20–49% of yield anomaly variance, 18–43% of which is due to extremes; temperature extremes matter more than precipitation; irrigation partly offsets heat effects.
f6c2a296a610e7353aad45cfe30d65c5e16f09c2.open_work: Using these hotspots in agricultural forecasting and adaptation planning; adding management and socioeconomic drivers.
f6c2a296a610e7353aad45cfe30d65c5e16f09c2.issues: Statistical associations, not causal; much variance unexplained; yield data quality varies across regions.

e617e86d22954759817312f52c983eb260d66943.goal: Compares neural network types for short-term wind speed forecasting.
e617e86d22954759817312f52c983eb260d66943.architecture: Three artificial neural networks: adaptive linear element (ADALINE), back-propagation MLP and radial basis function network.
e617e86d22954759817312f52c983eb260d66943.data: Hourly wind speed observations from sites in North Dakota, USA.
e617e86d22954759817312f52c983eb260d66943.result: No single network is best across all metrics and sites; performance depends on data and evaluation criteria, and input selection matters.
e617e86d22954759817312f52c983eb260d66943.open_work: Systematic model selection and hybrid or ensemble forecasting.
e617e86d22954759817312f52c983eb260d66943.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-region data and short horizons; deterministic forecasts.

c82bd192018d37dd3b58a681e0b774201d7a8a16.goal: Develops a lightweight local weather forecasting system from weather-station time series, for users such as farmers who need detailed short-range forecasts.
c82bd192018d37dd3b58a681e0b774201d7a8a16.architecture: Temporal convolutional network (TCN) compared with long short-term memory (LSTM) networks and classic machine learning methods.
c82bd192018d37dd3b58a681e0b774201d7a8a16.data: Time-series data from one or more local weather stations; station and period not reported in the abstract.
c82bd192018d37dd3b58a681e0b774201d7a8a16.result: The TCN model forecasts better than LSTM and classic machine learning baselines and can run on a personal computer.
c82bd192018d37dd3b58a681e0b774201d7a8a16.open_work: Multi-station networks and integration with NWP output.
c82bd192018d37dd3b58a681e0b774201d7a8a16.issues: Point forecasts from local stations only; no comparison with NWP; quantitative scores not reported in the abstract.

33aa930ebdd5f767b2095ae0d265de526668f89b.goal: Maps flash flood susceptibility in the Haraz watershed, Iran, to identify flood-prone areas.
33aa930ebdd5f767b2095ae0d265de526668f89b.architecture: Four decision-tree classifiers: logistic model trees, reduced error pruning trees, naive Bayes trees and alternating decision trees.
33aa930ebdd5f767b2095ae0d265de526668f89b.data: Spatial database of 201 flood locations and eleven factors (slope, altitude, curvature, SPI, TWI, land use, rainfall, river density, distance from river, lithology, NDVI).
33aa930ebdd5f767b2095ae0d265de526668f89b.result: Alternating decision trees performs best, followed by NBT, LMT and REPT, based on ROC and Friedman and Wilcoxon tests.
33aa930ebdd5f767b2095ae0d265de526668f89b.open_work: Testing in other watersheds and with ensemble or hybrid decision-tree models.
33aa930ebdd5f767b2095ae0d265de526668f89b.issues: Single watershed with small inventory; static susceptibility mapping.

0e241d81ab4bb1def2c770e82c624527bd0f4d4a.goal: Reviews artificial neural network techniques for predicting solar radiation.
0e241d81ab4bb1def2c770e82c624527bd0f4d4a.architecture: Review of artificial neural network models, mainly multilayer perceptrons, and the input parameters used for solar radiation prediction.
0e241d81ab4bb1def2c770e82c624527bd0f4d4a.data: Literature studies using meteorological and geographical inputs such as temperature, sunshine duration, humidity and location.
0e241d81ab4bb1def2c770e82c624527bd0f4d4a.result: Neural network models generally predict solar radiation more accurately than empirical and regression models; detailed numbers not reported here.
0e241d81ab4bb1def2c770e82c624527bd0f4d4a.open_work: Better input selection and testing at more locations and climates.
0e241d81ab4bb1def2c770e82c624527bd0f4d4a.issues: Abstract unavailable; heterogeneous studies limit comparison.

b3f36128116c035202f863547f197d2cf835a0b0.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the Khiyav-Chai watershed, Iran, with an ensemble of models for watershed management.
b3f36128116c035202f863547f197d2cf835a0b0.architecture: Multivariate discriminant analysis, classification and regression trees and support vector machine combined in an ensemble, admitting only models above 80% accuracy.
b3f36128116c035202f863547f197d2cf835a0b0.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors (altitude, slope, aspect, curvature, distance from river, TWI, drainage density, soil depth, soil groups, land use, lithology).
b3f36128116c035202f863547f197d2cf835a0b0.result: MDA reaches 89% accuracy, SVM 88% and CART 83%; slope, drainage density and distance from river are most important.
b3f36128116c035202f863547f197d2cf835a0b0.open_work: Applying the accuracy-filtered ensemble framework to other watersheds and prioritizing remediation in exposed residential areas.
b3f36128116c035202f863547f197d2cf835a0b0.issues: Single watershed; static susceptibility; the abstract reports CART accuracy inconsistently.

78f3f9eebdde8854e5a0e91bc71994f294140b56.goal: Produces probabilistic wind power forecasts to quantify uncertainty for power system operation.
78f3f9eebdde8854e5a0e91bc71994f294140b56.architecture: Extreme learning machine combined with a bootstrap method to construct prediction intervals.
78f3f9eebdde8854e5a0e91bc71994f294140b56.data: Wind power data from wind farms in Australia; periods not reported here.
78f3f9eebdde8854e5a0e91bc71994f294140b56.result: The bootstrap ELM gives reliable prediction intervals at very low computational cost compared with conventional neural network approaches.
78f3f9eebdde8854e5a0e91bc71994f294140b56.open_work: Improving interval sharpness and extending to multi-site forecasting.
78f3f9eebdde8854e5a0e91bc71994f294140b56.issues: Abstract unavailable; bootstrap intervals may underrepresent some uncertainty sources.

36674d9380ca57c6599ea71951f0ea9c423a84ef.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power output accurately with deep recurrent networks.
36674d9380ca57c6599ea71951f0ea9c423a84ef.architecture: Deep long short-term memory recurrent neural network (LSTM-RNN), testing several LSTM architectures.
36674d9380ca57c6599ea71951f0ea9c423a84ef.data: Hourly PV power or solar data from sites in Egypt; details not reported here.
36674d9380ca57c6599ea71951f0ea9c423a84ef.result: LSTM models give lower forecast errors than multiple linear regression, bagged regression trees and standard neural networks.
36674d9380ca57c6599ea71951f0ea9c423a84ef.open_work: Other locations, longer horizons and inclusion of weather inputs.
36674d9380ca57c6599ea71951f0ea9c423a84ef.issues: Abstract unavailable; limited sites; deterministic forecasts only.

965b92478205bb51f9cd158c2a9734b542242bec.goal: Produces global gridded land-atmosphere energy flux estimates with uncertainties to constrain land-atmosphere interactions and benchmark land models.
965b92478205bb51f9cd158c2a9734b542242bec.architecture: Ensemble of machine learning methods (including tree-based and neural network regressors) in a full factorial design across methods, forcings and energy balance corrections.
965b92478205bb51f9cd158c2a9734b542242bec.data: FLUXNET eddy covariance energy fluxes, MODIS remote sensing (0.0833°) and remote sensing plus meteorological forcing (0.5°), 2001–2013.
965b92478205bb51f9cd158c2a9734b542242bec.result: FLUXCOM provides 147 products; global net radiation about 75–78 W m-2, sensible heat 32–36 W m-2 and latent heat about 39 W m-2.
965b92478205bb51f9cd158c2a9734b542242bec.open_work: Use FLUXCOM to benchmark land surface models and study land-atmosphere interactions.
965b92478205bb51f9cd158c2a9734b542242bec.issues: Limited tower representativeness and energy balance closure issues; uncertainty only from the ensemble spread.

2005e33abca73dc70eb9d4afd162d6a5e284c071.goal: Reviews hybrid models coupling wavelet transforms with artificial intelligence for hydrological forecasting.
2005e33abca73dc70eb9d4afd162d6a5e284c071.architecture: Review of wavelet-artificial neural network, wavelet-fuzzy and related hybrid models, including choice of mother wavelet and decomposition level.
2005e33abca73dc70eb9d4afd162d6a5e284c071.data: Literature applications to rainfall-runoff, streamflow, groundwater, sediment and precipitation modelling.
2005e33abca73dc70eb9d4afd162d6a5e284c071.result: Wavelet preprocessing generally improves AI models by capturing multiscale features; details not reported here.
2005e33abca73dc70eb9d4afd162d6a5e284c071.open_work: Guidance on wavelet selection and avoiding use of future information in decomposition.
2005e33abca73dc70eb9d4afd162d6a5e284c071.issues: Abstract unavailable; boundary effects and look-ahead leakage in wavelet preprocessing can overstate skill.

60b75170baddb4301415bb4f25359531588cf8e3.goal: Compares multi-criteria decision-making and machine learning methods for flood susceptibility in the Ningdu Catchment, China.
60b75170baddb4301415bb4f25359531588cf8e3.architecture: VIKOR, TOPSIS and SAW decision-making methods versus naive Bayes trees and naive Bayes classifiers.
60b75170baddb4301415bb4f25359531588cf8e3.data: Flood inventory and twelve conditioning factors (NDVI, lithology, land use, distance from river, curvature, altitude, STI, TWI, SPI, soil type, slope, rainfall).
60b75170baddb4301415bb4f25359531588cf8e3.result: All models perform well (AUC above 0.95); the naive Bayes tree performs best with AUC 0.98.
60b75170baddb4301415bb4f25359531588cf8e3.open_work: Testing in other catchments and with ensemble or hybrid models.
60b75170baddb4301415bb4f25359531588cf8e3.issues: Single catchment; high AUCs may reflect spatial autocorrelation in validation points.

947172bb02ad2d625a627ef9af4f24afe304eccd.goal: Predicts corn and soybean yields across the US Corn Belt from environment and management data.
947172bb02ad2d625a627ef9af4f24afe304eccd.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network and recurrent neural network (CNN-RNN), compared with random forest, deep fully connected networks and LASSO.
947172bb02ad2d625a627ef9af4f24afe304eccd.data: Historical yield, weather, soil and management data for 13 Corn Belt states; tested on 2016–2018.
947172bb02ad2d625a627ef9af4f24afe304eccd.result: RMSE is 9% and 8% of mean corn and soybean yields, outperforming the other methods and generalizing to untested environments.
947172bb02ad2d625a627ef9af4f24afe304eccd.open_work: Including genotype data and improved weather predictions in the model.
947172bb02ad2d625a627ef9af4f24afe304eccd.issues: County-level yields; performance depends on accurate weather inputs; limited interpretability.

2fc5955b33e0c42960ef31e3f8f34315b9c7eb18.goal: Assesses solar power forecasting methods that use only past power output, without exogenous inputs.
2fc5955b33e0c42960ef31e3f8f34315b9c7eb18.architecture: Persistence, ARIMA, k-nearest neighbours, artificial neural networks, and neural networks optimized with genetic algorithms.
2fc5955b33e0c42960ef31e3f8f34315b9c7eb18.data: Power output of a 1 MW PV plant in Merced, California; 1-h and 2-h horizons.
2fc5955b33e0c42960ef31e3f8f34315b9c7eb18.result: GA-optimized artificial neural networks perform best, clearly outperforming persistence.
2fc5955b33e0c42960ef31e3f8f34315b9c7eb18.open_work: Adding exogenous inputs such as sky images and satellite data.
2fc5955b33e0c42960ef31e3f8f34315b9c7eb18.issues: Abstract unavailable; single plant; short horizons only.

72e64193afde2bdba3fdd6b06ba955e6d235ec5a.goal: Forecasts PM2.5 concentrations in smart cities for pollution control.
72e64193afde2bdba3fdd6b06ba955e6d235ec5a.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network and long short-term memory (CNN-LSTM) model named APNet.
72e64193afde2bdba3fdd6b06ba955e6d235ec5a.data: Historical PM2.5 concentration, cumulated rain hours and cumulated wind speed; location and period not reported in the abstract.
72e64193afde2bdba3fdd6b06ba955e6d235ec5a.result: APNet achieves the best MAE, RMSE, correlation and index of agreement among compared machine learning methods.
72e64193afde2bdba3fdd6b06ba955e6d235ec5a.open_work: Applying the model to PM2.5 prevention and control and adding further meteorological inputs.
72e64193afde2bdba3fdd6b06ba955e6d235ec5a.issues: Limited inputs; no spatial transfer test; numbers not given in the abstract.

fbd7f52fcb2367f32070786cc1f44c4296bfa7a5.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels by coupling wavelet decomposition with neural networks, to support groundwater resource management.
fbd7f52fcb2367f32070786cc1f44c4296bfa7a5.architecture: Wavelet-artificial neural network conjunction model (WA-ANN), compared with ANN and ARIMA.
fbd7f52fcb2367f32070786cc1f44c4296bfa7a5.data: Monthly groundwater level, precipitation and temperature data from wells in Quebec, Canada.
fbd7f52fcb2367f32070786cc1f44c4296bfa7a5.result: WA-ANN gives more accurate forecasts than ANN and ARIMA; numbers not reported here.
fbd7f52fcb2367f32070786cc1f44c4296bfa7a5.open_work: Longer forecast horizons, more wells and other aquifers.
fbd7f52fcb2367f32070786cc1f44c4296bfa7a5.issues: Abstract unavailable; wavelet decomposition of the full series may leak future information and inflate skill.

031eb9ecf508af8f49e774eb2d020e061405443f.goal: Simulates floods and maps flood-prone areas in the Johor River Basin, Malaysia.
031eb9ecf508af8f49e774eb2d020e061405443f.architecture: Artificial neural network model coupled with GIS layers to simulate flooding; network configuration not specified here.
031eb9ecf508af8f49e774eb2d020e061405443f.data: Rainfall, slope, elevation, flow accumulation, soil, land use and geology layers in GIS.
031eb9ecf508af8f49e774eb2d020e061405443f.result: The ANN produces flood-prone area maps consistent with historical floods; numbers not reported here.
031eb9ecf508af8f49e774eb2d020e061405443f.open_work: Application to other basins and use of finer-resolution and dynamic rainfall inputs.
031eb9ecf508af8f49e774eb2d020e061405443f.issues: Abstract unavailable; single basin; static mapping with limited validation; details should be spot-checked.

7b5ba39ac2d4ae16f6ef2f3d412e146b65897437.goal: Forecasts river flow in a tropical river with an enhanced extreme learning machine and reviews ELM use in water resources.
7b5ba39ac2d4ae16f6ef2f3d412e146b65897437.architecture: Enhanced extreme learning machine using complete orthogonal decomposition to tune output weights, compared with ELM and support vector regression.
7b5ba39ac2d4ae16f6ef2f3d412e146b65897437.data: River flow records from the Kelantan River, peninsular Malaysia, used for training and testing the models.
7b5ba39ac2d4ae16f6ef2f3d412e146b65897437.result: EELM achieves NSE 0.80 versus 0.74 (ELM) and 0.67 (SVR), with RMSE and MAE reduced by 12–23% and 8–9%.
7b5ba39ac2d4ae16f6ef2f3d412e146b65897437.open_work: Improved ELM variants for other water resource engineering problems, as outlined in the review part.
7b5ba39ac2d4ae16f6ef2f3d412e146b65897437.issues: Single river; univariate setting; no uncertainty estimates.

db37a243daf047b814f9f0e51a6f2be240eace48.goal: Forecasts wind speed with a hybrid decomposition and optimized neural network.
db37a243daf047b814f9f0e51a6f2be240eace48.architecture: Ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) with a back-propagation neural network whose weights are optimized by a genetic algorithm (GA-BP).
db37a243daf047b814f9f0e51a6f2be240eace48.data: Wind speed data from a wind farm in China; details not reported here.
db37a243daf047b814f9f0e51a6f2be240eace48.result: The hybrid EEMD-GA-BP outperforms simpler models such as BP and GA-BP.
db37a243daf047b814f9f0e51a6f2be240eace48.open_work: Multi-step forecasting, other wind farms and probabilistic outputs.
db37a243daf047b814f9f0e51a6f2be240eace48.issues: Abstract unavailable; decomposition may leak future information if applied to the full series.

93582db335a579f32a19557a31b16105ac700f68.goal: Presents applications of artificial neural networks to hydrological problems, as an alternative to conceptual and physically based models.
93582db335a579f32a19557a31b16105ac700f68.architecture: Book covering artificial neural networks (mainly multilayer perceptrons) for hydrological modelling.
93582db335a579f32a19557a31b16105ac700f68.data: Applications such as rainfall-runoff, streamflow, groundwater and water quality modelling; no single dataset.
93582db335a579f32a19557a31b16105ac700f68.result: Not reported; the volume shows the potential of ANNs as hydrological modelling tools.
93582db335a579f32a19557a31b16105ac700f68.open_work: Physical interpretability, extrapolation and generalization of neural network hydrological models remain open.
93582db335a579f32a19557a31b16105ac700f68.issues: Abstract and venue unavailable; the catalog year may not match the original edition; early-generation ANN work.

91b70d03c7298fe9ed005195179696328d83047a.goal: Predicts short-term runoff with recurrent networks without tuning the input time step.
91b70d03c7298fe9ed005195179696328d83047a.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent unit (GRU) networks compared with an artificial neural network.
91b70d03c7298fe9ed005195179696328d83047a.data: Hourly discharge at one station and hourly rainfall at four stations, Yutan catchment, Fujian, China, 2000–2014.
91b70d03c7298fe9ed005195179696328d83047a.result: LSTM and GRU accuracy rises with time step then stabilizes; both beat ANN; GRU matches LSTM with faster training.
91b70d03c7298fe9ed005195179696328d83047a.open_work: Applying large time steps in operational runoff prediction and testing other catchments and longer lead times.
91b70d03c7298fe9ed005195179696328d83047a.issues: Single catchment with few rain gauges; short-term forecasts only; no uncertainty quantification.

45b9424e1b719d05c1ea08d3a1105e8d32ba94e7.goal: Predicts hourly air pollutant concentrations, especially PM2.5, by exploiting long-term temporal dependence and spatial correlation among monitoring stations.
45b9424e1b719d05c1ea08d3a1105e8d32ba94e7.architecture: Extended long short-term memory network (LSTME) that adds spatiotemporal correlations and auxiliary inputs such as meteorology and time stamps to a recurrent neural network.
45b9424e1b719d05c1ea08d3a1105e8d32ba94e7.data: Hourly PM2.5 concentrations from air quality monitoring stations in Beijing, China, with meteorological data; period not reported here.
45b9424e1b719d05c1ea08d3a1105e8d32ba94e7.result: The LSTM-based model outperforms spatiotemporal deep learning, time-delay neural network, ARMA and support vector regression baselines in hourly PM2.5 prediction.
45b9424e1b719d05c1ea08d3a1105e8d32ba94e7.open_work: Extension to other pollutants, longer lead times and other cities.
45b9424e1b719d05c1ea08d3a1105e8d32ba94e7.issues: Abstract unavailable; single city; no emission or chemical transport inputs, so performance under unusual emission changes is untested.

c69a1533b68f9e11dc6ac8c83f9ff2ff04d96709.goal: Forecasts groundwater level fluctuations in a coastal aquifer influenced by rainfall and tides, to support groundwater management.
c69a1533b68f9e11dc6ac8c83f9ff2ff04d96709.architecture: Artificial neural network and support vector machine regression models compared for time-series forecasting.
c69a1533b68f9e11dc6ac8c83f9ff2ff04d96709.data: Groundwater level, precipitation and tide level records from monitoring wells in a coastal aquifer in Korea; period not reported here.
c69a1533b68f9e11dc6ac8c83f9ff2ff04d96709.result: Both models forecast groundwater levels reasonably; the support vector machine generally shows better or more robust performance than the neural network, notably for longer horizons.
c69a1533b68f9e11dc6ac8c83f9ff2ff04d96709.open_work: Testing on more wells and aquifers and adding other drivers such as pumping.
c69a1533b68f9e11dc6ac8c83f9ff2ff04d96709.issues: Abstract unavailable; few wells at one site; result details should be spot-checked.

b0f0145465b448e84a77d87cbb6361ff229a84cf.goal: Forecasts day-ahead PV power to help grid managers mitigate solar fluctuations.
b0f0145465b448e84a77d87cbb6361ff229a84cf.architecture: Long short-term memory recurrent neural network (LSTM-RNN) with time correlation modification under a partial daily pattern prediction framework.
b0f0145465b448e84a77d87cbb6361ff229a84cf.data: Historical PV power data; plant and period not reported in the abstract.
b0f0145465b448e84a77d87cbb6361ff229a84cf.result: The time-correlation-modified LSTM-RNN is more accurate than the LSTM-RNN alone, and gains increase when daily pattern predictions are accurate.
b0f0145465b448e84a77d87cbb6361ff229a84cf.open_work: Improving the accuracy of daily pattern prediction, which controls how much the modification helps.
b0f0145465b448e84a77d87cbb6361ff229a84cf.issues: Gains depend on correct daily pattern prediction; numbers not given in the abstract.

4220213d29d56e827ad4ecd62539daf7512a7958.goal: Quantifies uncertainty in short-term electricity load and wind power forecasts by producing prediction intervals rather than point forecasts, to support power system operation under variability.
4220213d29d56e827ad4ecd62539daf7512a7958.architecture: Feedforward neural network (MLP) trained with the lower upper bound estimation (LUBE) method, whose two outputs are interval bounds, optimized by a particle swarm optimization variant with mutation.
4220213d29d56e827ad4ecd62539daf7512a7958.data: Electricity load and wind power time series; specific datasets, locations and periods are not reported here.
4220213d29d56e827ad4ecd62539daf7512a7958.result: The neural network prediction intervals achieve high coverage with narrower widths than benchmark interval methods across load and wind cases; exact scores are not reported here.
4220213d29d56e827ad4ecd62539daf7512a7958.open_work: Extend to longer horizons, multi-site wind farms and combination with weather forecast inputs; integrate intervals into dispatch and reserve decisions.
4220213d29d56e827ad4ecd62539daf7512a7958.issues: Interval quality depends on the PSO-based training, which is stochastic and costly; evaluation on limited datasets; uses only historical series without NWP inputs.

b6b658fd7e8a821fa4b47a24a3949faa644aa26d.goal: Surveys how ensemble machine learning is used in hydrology to improve accuracy and robustness over single models.
b6b658fd7e8a821fa4b47a24a3949faa644aa26d.architecture: Review of ensemble learning paradigms (bagging, boosting, stacking and related resampling/combination schemes) including random forest and gradient boosting, as applied to hydrological prediction.
b6b658fd7e8a821fa4b47a24a3949faa644aa26d.data: Published hydrology studies covering streamflow, rainfall, floods, groundwater, sediment, evaporation and water quality; no new data.
b6b658fd7e8a821fa4b47a24a3949faa644aa26d.result: Ensemble methods generally outperform their single base learners across hydrological tasks; boosting and bagging dominate the literature.
b6b658fd7e8a821fa4b47a24a3949faa644aa26d.open_work: Broader use of stacking and heterogeneous ensembles, better uncertainty quantification and more interpretable ensembles for hydrology.
b6b658fd7e8a821fa4b47a24a3949faa644aa26d.issues: Literature review: comparisons across studies use different data and metrics, so performance claims are not directly comparable.

48842c07c4aae3f5060b3d6f8f11f844a8cba4f0.goal: Forecasts next-day (24-h) photovoltaic power output online to support grid scheduling of solar generation.
48842c07c4aae3f5060b3d6f8f11f844a8cba4f0.architecture: Self-organizing map classifies days into weather types and a radial basis function neural network is trained per weather type to forecast hourly PV power from forecast weather variables.
48842c07c4aae3f5060b3d6f8f11f844a8cba4f0.data: Measured PV system output in China with weather forecast inputs (irradiance, temperature, weather type); exact period not reported here.
48842c07c4aae3f5060b3d6f8f11f844a8cba4f0.result: Weather-type classification improves the neural network forecasts, with good accuracy on clear days and larger errors on cloudy and rainy days; exact errors not reported here.
48842c07c4aae3f5060b3d6f8f11f844a8cba4f0.open_work: Use richer NWP inputs and finer weather classification; test at more sites and seasons.
48842c07c4aae3f5060b3d6f8f11f844a8cba4f0.issues: Single-site study; accuracy degrades in variable cloudy weather and depends on the quality of public weather forecasts.

12a392788f2eeabdf4d8bbe1c1f43f53d83e1973.goal: Maps flood susceptibility to support flood risk management, proposing a hybrid ensemble classifier for better spatial prediction.
12a392788f2eeabdf4d8bbe1c1f43f53d83e1973.architecture: Hybrid ensemble Bagging-LMT (bagging of logistic model trees), compared with logistic model tree, logistic regression, Bayesian logistic regression and random forest classifiers.
12a392788f2eeabdf4d8bbe1c1f43f53d83e1973.data: Flood inventory and GIS conditioning factors (topography, hydrology, land use, lithology, rainfall) for a watershed in Iran; split into training and validation sets.
12a392788f2eeabdf4d8bbe1c1f43f53d83e1973.result: The Bagging-LMT ensemble gives the highest AUC and best goodness-of-fit among compared models; exact scores not reported here.
12a392788f2eeabdf4d8bbe1c1f43f53d83e1973.open_work: Transfer the hybrid to other basins and compare with deep learning and other ensemble schemes.
12a392788f2eeabdf4d8bbe1c1f43f53d83e1973.issues: Single-catchment study; static susceptibility without hydrodynamics or rainfall scenarios; results depend on inventory quality.

f92a494bdc67c58e940d22d91e350f932f568bbd.goal: Projects current and future global climatic suitability for Arabica and Robusta coffee to inform long-term adaptation of the coffee supply chain.
f92a494bdc67c58e940d22d91e350f932f568bbd.architecture: Species distribution modelling with machine learning algorithms fitted to occurrence data, combined over several parameter settings into a multi-model ensemble; specific algorithms are not named in the abstract.
f92a494bdc67c58e940d22d91e350f932f568bbd.data: Database of geo-referenced coffee production locations with current climate and future climate projections across emission scenarios.
f92a494bdc67c58e940d22d91e350f932f568bbd.result: Global area suitable for coffee falls by about 50% across emission scenarios, with largest losses at low latitudes and altitudes, including Brazil and Vietnam; some East African and Asian areas gain.
f92a494bdc67c58e940d22d91e350f932f568bbd.open_work: Assess adaptation options, shifting regions and links with forest conservation; refine with yield and management data.
f92a494bdc67c58e940d22d91e350f932f568bbd.issues: Suitability is not yield; correlative niche models ignore CO2 effects, adaptation and non-climatic constraints; projections inherit GCM uncertainty.

90fcab429e75bb2f7d123e947beecace69160a5a.goal: Estimates daily global solar radiation where only temperature and precipitation are measured, for humid subtropical China.
90fcab429e75bb2f7d123e947beecace69160a5a.architecture: Support vector machine compared with extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost, gradient-boosted trees) using different combinations of temperature and precipitation inputs.
90fcab429e75bb2f7d123e947beecace69160a5a.data: Daily meteorological and radiation records from weather stations in humid subtropical China; exact stations and period not reported here.
90fcab429e75bb2f7d123e947beecace69160a5a.result: Both models give comparable and acceptable accuracy; SVM is slightly more accurate while XGBoost is more stable and computationally efficient. Exact errors not reported here.
90fcab429e75bb2f7d123e947beecace69160a5a.open_work: Test other regions and climates, add inputs such as humidity or sunshine, and compare with deep learning.
90fcab429e75bb2f7d123e947beecace69160a5a.issues: Station-based empirical models with limited inputs; transferability beyond the studied climate is uncertain.

8ad1ef6e165ab9121009ed833920b17159fa974f.goal: Forecasts spatiotemporal PM2.5 concentrations across monitoring stations up to 72 hours ahead.
8ad1ef6e165ab9121009ed833920b17159fa974f.architecture: Hybrid graph convolutional network and LSTM (GC-LSTM): stations form a spatiotemporal graph series whose node signals are processed by graph convolution and an LSTM.
8ad1ef6e165ab9121009ed833920b17159fa974f.data: Historical station air quality observations, meteorological factors, spatial terms and temporal attributes from ground monitoring stations; region and period not reported in the abstract.
8ad1ef6e165ab9121009ed833920b17159fa974f.result: GC-LSTM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines; for 72-h predictions recall is 68.45% and false alarm rate 4.65% at 115 μg/m3, with R2 of 0.72.
8ad1ef6e165ab9121009ed833920b17159fa974f.open_work: Apply to other pollutants and regions; add emissions or chemical transport model inputs.
8ad1ef6e165ab9121009ed833920b17159fa974f.issues: Moderate skill at 72 h; station-only graph without explicit transport physics; single study region.

d85ebd69d18be2e4605ce511e383bb14c8831302.goal: Improves data-driven weather forecasting from time series by emphasising training samples similar to the test point.
d85ebd69d18be2e4605ce511e383bb14c8831302.architecture: Transductive LSTM (T-LSTM): an LSTM trained with a locally weighted quadratic cost, weights based on cosine similarity between training samples and the test point.
d85ebd69d18be2e4605ce511e383bb14c8831302.data: Weather station time series evaluated over two different periods of the year; specific stations and variables not reported in the abstract.
d85ebd69d18be2e4605ce511e383bb14c8831302.result: T-LSTM achieves better prediction performance than the standard LSTM in both periods.
d85ebd69d18be2e4605ce511e383bb14c8831302.open_work: Reduce the cost of per-test-point retraining and test on more variables, sites and horizons.
d85ebd69d18be2e4605ce511e383bb14c8831302.issues: Transductive refitting per test point is expensive; limited evaluation; no comparison with NWP.

f8ed3b21fe9155284c19e1b42bb6318300a643bd.goal: Reviews support vector machine models for forecasting solar and wind energy resources to guide renewable energy utilization.
f8ed3b21fe9155284c19e1b42bb6318300a643bd.architecture: Review of support vector machine and hybrid SVM models (combined with optimization and decomposition methods) for solar radiation and wind speed/power prediction.
f8ed3b21fe9155284c19e1b42bb6318300a643bd.data: Published solar and wind forecasting studies; no new data.
f8ed3b21fe9155284c19e1b42bb6318300a643bd.result: SVM models generally outperform other approaches, and hybrid SVMs reach higher accuracy for both solar and wind at most locations.
f8ed3b21fe9155284c19e1b42bb6318300a643bd.open_work: Proposes novel hybrid models and lists open problems and opportunities for more accurate solar and wind predictions.
f8ed3b21fe9155284c19e1b42bb6318300a643bd.issues: Review focused on one method family, so comparisons may favour SVM; cross-study results are not directly comparable.

d88fedff7e1d9e9d5aaf72464c801fb827850b55.goal: Reviews surrogate models that replace expensive groundwater simulations in calibration, uncertainty analysis and optimization.
d88fedff7e1d9e9d5aaf72464c801fb827850b55.architecture: Review of surrogate modelling approaches, grouped into data-driven (e.g. neural networks, Gaussian processes, polynomial chaos), projection-based reduced-order and multifidelity/hierarchical surrogates.
d88fedff7e1d9e9d5aaf72464c801fb827850b55.data: Published groundwater modelling studies; no new data.
d88fedff7e1d9e9d5aaf72464c801fb827850b55.result: Surrogates can greatly reduce computational cost, but their suitability depends on the application, and their errors are often insufficiently characterised.
d88fedff7e1d9e9d5aaf72464c801fb827850b55.open_work: Better validation and error characterisation of surrogates, adaptive sampling, and guidance on choosing surrogate types for groundwater problems.
d88fedff7e1d9e9d5aaf72464c801fb827850b55.issues: Review; surrogate accuracy outside the training range and impact on decision-relevant outputs are recurrent concerns.

e0b0b9d1b57cf3b83b0d096adaf9dbed32b89c41.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for wind power generation given the non-stationarity of wind speed series.
e0b0b9d1b57cf3b83b0d096adaf9dbed32b89c41.architecture: Hybrid model combining an LSTM network with signal decomposition into intrinsic mode functions, whose outputs are weighted using the grey wolf optimizer; preprocessing by weighted moving average filling and smoothing.
e0b0b9d1b57cf3b83b0d096adaf9dbed32b89c41.data: Wind speed data from five wind farms in the Marmara region, Turkey.
e0b0b9d1b57cf3b83b0d096adaf9dbed32b89c41.result: The combined model captures nonlinear characteristics and outperforms single forecasting models in accuracy; exact errors not reported in the abstract.
e0b0b9d1b57cf3b83b0d096adaf9dbed32b89c41.open_work: Extend to longer horizons, probabilistic forecasts and other sites.
e0b0b9d1b57cf3b83b0d096adaf9dbed32b89c41.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if applied to the full series; added complexity; point forecasts only.

9841b69f62a2f9cc0cd85178f76960777f7d1bfd.goal: Provides full-coverage, near real-time daily PM2.5 data over China for research, management and health studies.
9841b69f62a2f9cc0cd85178f76960777f7d1bfd.architecture: Two-stage machine learning model with tree-based learners, synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE) for high pollution, and a tree-based gap-filling method for missing AOD.
9841b69f62a2f9cc0cd85178f76960777f7d1bfd.data: Ground observations, satellite AOD, operational chemical transport model simulations, meteorology, land use, population and elevation; daily 10 km PM2.5 since 2000 (TAP dataset).
9841b69f62a2f9cc0cd85178f76960777f7d1bfd.result: Out-of-bag cross-validation R2 averages 0.83, with improved performance at high pollution levels and gap-filled daily coverage.
9841b69f62a2f9cc0cd85178f76960777f7d1bfd.open_work: Extend TAP to other pollutants and support policy and health impact assessments.
9841b69f62a2f9cc0cd85178f76960777f7d1bfd.issues: Out-of-bag CV can overstate skill in sparsely monitored areas; pre-2013 estimates rely on extrapolation where few ground stations existed.

26cfa2d0882cbbd2024985afde6cc3b32f385306.goal: Improves two-day-ahead forecasts of daily PM2.5 in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, especially of high pollution days.
26cfa2d0882cbbd2024985afde6cc3b32f385306.architecture: MLP (back-propagation neural network) hybrid with an air-mass-trajectory-based geographic indicator and wavelet decomposition of the PM2.5 series into sub-series forecast separately.
26cfa2d0882cbbd2024985afde6cc3b32f385306.data: 13 monitoring stations in the Jing-Jin-Ji area, September 2013 to October 2014, with daily meteorological forecasts and pollutant predictors.
26cfa2d0882cbbd2024985afde6cc3b32f385306.result: The hybrid reduces RMSE by up to 40% on average, and the detection rate of high PM2.5 days reaches about 90%.
26cfa2d0882cbbd2024985afde6cc3b32f385306.open_work: Apply the approach to other countries' air quality forecasting systems.
26cfa2d0882cbbd2024985afde6cc3b32f385306.issues: About one year of data; wavelet decomposition may leak future information if not done causally; region-specific trajectory corridors.

134b77182981451c456ad0a02c1d61f67906f892.goal: Forecasts geo-sensor readings several hours ahead, accounting for dynamic spatio-temporal correlations and external factors.
134b77182981451c456ad0a02c1d61f67906f892.architecture: GeoMAN: multi-level attention-based recurrent neural network (encoder-decoder LSTM with local and global spatial attention and temporal attention) plus an external-factor fusion module.
134b77182981451c456ad0a02c1d61f67906f892.data: Real-world air quality sensor data and water quality data, with meteorological and spatial data.
134b77182981451c456ad0a02c1d61f67906f892.result: Outperforms nine baseline methods on both air quality and water quality datasets.
134b77182981451c456ad0a02c1d61f67906f892.open_work: Extend to longer horizons and more sensor types; improve scalability to large networks.
134b77182981451c456ad0a02c1d61f67906f892.issues: Single-sensor target forecasting; evaluated on limited cities and data periods.

fb40b7d4a9b7c1040173c0420b69ccbb7bcdbe5c.goal: Forecasts fine-grained air quality at monitoring stations for the next 48 hours using big data, to support public warnings.
fb40b7d4a9b7c1040173c0420b69ccbb7bcdbe5c.architecture: Hybrid data-driven system combining a linear-regression temporal predictor, a neural network spatial predictor, a dynamic aggregator and an inflection predictor for sudden changes.
fb40b7d4a9b7c1040173c0420b69ccbb7bcdbe5c.data: Air quality, meteorological data and weather forecasts from monitoring stations in Chinese cities.
fb40b7d4a9b7c1040173c0420b69ccbb7bcdbe5c.result: The system outperforms classical baselines, notably in predicting sudden changes, and was deployed operationally; exact scores not reported here.
fb40b7d4a9b7c1040173c0420b69ccbb7bcdbe5c.open_work: Extend to more cities and pollutants and to longer horizons.
fb40b7d4a9b7c1040173c0420b69ccbb7bcdbe5c.issues: Station-based forecasting without explicit chemistry; performance at long horizons and in extreme episodes is limited.

4264b10b109230b87a0ba726c19720b7507c3e11.goal: Estimates historical daily ground-level PM2.5 across China during 2005–2016 for exposure assessment.
4264b10b109230b87a0ba726c19720b7507c3e11.architecture: Random forest regression compared with two traditional regression models.
4264b10b109230b87a0ba726c19720b7507c3e11.data: Daily PM2.5 from 1479 stations (2014–2016), satellite AOD, meteorology and other predictors; national estimates at 0.1° for 2005–2016.
4264b10b109230b87a0ba726c19720b7507c3e11.result: Random forest explains most variability: 10-fold CV R2 = 83%, RMSE = 28.1 μg/m3 daily; up to 86% at monthly and annual scales (RMSE 10.7 and 6.9 μg/m3).
4264b10b109230b87a0ba726c19720b7507c3e11.open_work: Use the estimates for long-term health studies and validate pre-2014 back-extrapolation.
4264b10b109230b87a0ba726c19720b7507c3e11.issues: Model trained on 2014–2016 but applied back to 2005, assuming stable relationships; random CV may overstate spatial skill.

ee57647729a3248689730d6594b18113187d03cf.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting by selecting input parameters carefully for a neural network forecaster.
ee57647729a3248689730d6594b18113187d03cf.architecture: Back-propagation neural network (MLP) whose parameters are optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO-BP), plus a comprehensive input parameter selection step (IS-PSO-BP).
ee57647729a3248689730d6594b18113187d03cf.data: Daily average wind speed at Jiuquan and 6-hourly wind speed at Yumen, Gansu, China, 2001–2006.
ee57647729a3248689730d6594b18113187d03cf.result: IS-PSO-BP achieves much better forecast performance than the basic BP neural network and ARIMA on both datasets.
ee57647729a3248689730d6594b18113187d03cf.open_work: Test the selection scheme on other sites, horizons and forecasting models.
ee57647729a3248689730d6594b18113187d03cf.issues: Two datasets from one region; point forecasts only; limited baselines.

cb9b7caf482d4853206f57fb38009679bb38c2d1.goal: Improves multi-step wind speed forecasting of non-stationary series.
cb9b7caf482d4853206f57fb38009679bb38c2d1.architecture: Modified EMD-FNN: empirical mode decomposition into intrinsic mode functions, each (except the highest frequency) forecast by a feed-forward neural network (MLP) with PACF-selected inputs, then summed.
cb9b7caf482d4853206f57fb38009679bb38c2d1.data: Mean monthly and daily wind speed at Zhangye, China.
cb9b7caf482d4853206f57fb38009679bb38c2d1.result: The modified model is more accurate than the basic FNN and the unmodified EMD-FNN.
cb9b7caf482d4853206f57fb38009679bb38c2d1.open_work: Apply to hourly data and wind power, and compare with other decomposition methods.
cb9b7caf482d4853206f57fb38009679bb38c2d1.issues: Single site; dropping the high-frequency component discards information; decomposition of the full series may leak future data.

042e9af1dc3fd9668ead015636808b10e056da96.goal: Retrieves chlorophyll-a consistently across Sentinel-2 MSI and Sentinel-3 OLCI in optically complex inland and coastal waters.
042e9af1dc3fd9668ead015636808b10e056da96.architecture: Mixture Density Network (MDN), a neural network that outputs a Gaussian mixture distribution of Chla given remote sensing reflectance.
042e9af1dc3fd9668ead015636808b10e056da96.data: In situ database of co-located Chla (n = 2943) and hyperspectral radiometry resampled to MSI and OLCI bands, plus independent satellite matchups; Chla 0.2–1209 mg/m3.
042e9af1dc3fd9668ead015636808b10e056da96.result: Compared with state-of-the-art algorithms, MAE and bias drop by 40–60%, and RMSLE and MAPE improve two to three times for both sensors.
042e9af1dc3fd9668ead015636808b10e056da96.open_work: Extend MDN to other water-quality parameters and sensors, and quantify retrieval uncertainty further.
042e9af1dc3fd9668ead015636808b10e056da96.issues: Performance depends on atmospheric correction for satellite data and on representativeness of the in situ training set.

eba2533af2ba7deacbff7237c0898be04360d04d.goal: Maps flash flood susceptibility in the Teesta River basin, northern Bangladesh, to support flood risk management.
eba2533af2ba7deacbff7237c0898be04360d04d.architecture: Hybrid ensembles Dagging and Random Subspace coupled with artificial neural network, random forest and support vector machine base models.
eba2533af2ba7deacbff7237c0898be04360d04d.data: 413 current and former flood points and twelve flood influencing factors in a GIS for the Teesta River basin.
eba2533af2ba7deacbff7237c0898be04360d04d.result: All models have ROC AUC above 0.80; Dagging performs best, followed by RF, ANN, SVM and Random Subspace.
eba2533af2ba7deacbff7237c0898be04360d04d.open_work: Support local mitigation planning and test the ensembles in other basins.
eba2533af2ba7deacbff7237c0898be04360d04d.issues: Static susceptibility from a limited inventory; spatial autocorrelation in validation not addressed.

ab7970dff12258b46995026e5718e31c33f750b0.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration with limited meteorological data in humid regions of China for irrigation and water management.
ab7970dff12258b46995026e5718e31c33f750b0.architecture: CatBoost (gradient-boosted decision trees with categorical feature support) compared with random forest and support vector machine.
ab7970dff12258b46995026e5718e31c33f750b0.data: Daily meteorological data (Rs, Tmax, Tmin, humidity, wind) from five weather stations in South China, 2001–2015, with eight input combinations; FAO-56 Penman-Monteith target.
ab7970dff12258b46995026e5718e31c33f750b0.result: SVM is most accurate with incomplete inputs, CatBoost with complete inputs; CatBoost is faster and lighter than RF and SVM; generalized models lose under 10% in RMSE or MAPE.
ab7970dff12258b46995026e5718e31c33f750b0.open_work: Test CatBoost in other humid regions worldwide.
ab7970dff12258b46995026e5718e31c33f750b0.issues: Few stations; the target is a Penman-Monteith estimate rather than measured ET; humid climates only.

af2550268c34fb0376a3f18f150bf4f9ce3023b9.goal: Provides high-resolution UAV imagery for post-flood damage assessment, which existing low-resolution satellite datasets cannot support.
af2550268c34fb0376a3f18f150bf4f9ce3023b9.architecture: Benchmark dataset FloodNet with baseline deep learning models for image classification, semantic segmentation and visual question answering.
af2550268c34fb0376a3f18f150bf4f9ce3023b9.data: High-resolution UAV imagery captured after Hurricane Harvey, with pixel-wise labels and question-answer pairs.
af2550268c34fb0376a3f18f150bf4f9ce3023b9.result: Baselines reveal challenges such as detecting flooded roads and buildings and separating natural from flood water; specific scores not reported in the abstract.
af2550268c34fb0376a3f18f150bf4f9ce3023b9.open_work: Develop better segmentation and VQA models for disaster assessment and extend to other events.
af2550268c34fb0376a3f18f150bf4f9ce3023b9.issues: Single event and region; class imbalance between flooded and non-flooded classes may affect baselines.

bd2daf33e4c18039ab164719c6d6ae89911e7c88.goal: Reviews recent progress in forecasting photovoltaic power output for grid integration.
bd2daf33e4c18039ab164719c6d6ae89911e7c88.architecture: Review of PV forecasting methods, including statistical, artificial neural network and hybrid approaches, with their inputs, preprocessing, horizons and evaluation metrics.
bd2daf33e4c18039ab164719c6d6ae89911e7c88.data: Published PV forecasting studies; no new data.
bd2daf33e4c18039ab164719c6d6ae89911e7c88.result: Neural network and hybrid models are the most common and often most accurate; performance depends strongly on horizon, weather and data preprocessing.
bd2daf33e4c18039ab164719c6d6ae89911e7c88.open_work: Better hybrid and ensemble models, probabilistic forecasting and standardized evaluation.
bd2daf33e4c18039ab164719c6d6ae89911e7c88.issues: Review; heterogeneous metrics and datasets make cross-study comparison difficult.

62f1a1dc4ebe66a1aa6d7ca7b50f893da7822b55.goal: Reviews advances in flash flood forecasting given its short lead times and high impacts.
62f1a1dc4ebe66a1aa6d7ca7b50f893da7822b55.architecture: Review of flash flood forecasting components, mostly non-ML: radar and satellite rainfall estimation, nowcasting and NWP rainfall forecasts, hydrological models and flash flood guidance systems.
62f1a1dc4ebe66a1aa6d7ca7b50f893da7822b55.data: Published studies and operational systems; no new data.
62f1a1dc4ebe66a1aa6d7ca7b50f893da7822b55.result: Forecast skill is limited by rainfall estimation and quantitative precipitation forecasting; integrated systems combining remote sensing, NWP and distributed models are advancing.
62f1a1dc4ebe66a1aa6d7ca7b50f893da7822b55.open_work: Improve rainfall nowcasting, data assimilation and uncertainty quantification for flash floods.
62f1a1dc4ebe66a1aa6d7ca7b50f893da7822b55.issues: Review; machine learning plays a minor role, and limitations of individual systems are summarized rather than tested.

80d9e88e9ee954a275d3364c185e0ca7d39db55c.goal: Improves calibration of low-cost multipollutant air quality sensors affected by environmental conditions and cross-sensitivities.
80d9e88e9ee954a275d3364c185e0ca7d39db55c.architecture: Random forest calibration models compared with laboratory univariate and empirical multiple linear regression.
80d9e88e9ee954a275d3364c185e0ca7d39db55c.data: 16–19 RAMP sensor packages (CO, NO2, O3, CO2) collocated with reference monitors in Pittsburgh, PA, August 2016–February 2017.
80d9e88e9ee954a275d3364c185e0ca7d39db55c.result: RF matches or beats other calibrations; MAE 38 ppb CO, 10 ppm CO2, 3.5 ppb NO2, 3.4 ppb O3, Pearson r above 0.8, and only RF meets EPA personal exposure data-quality guidance.
80d9e88e9ee954a275d3364c185e0ca7d39db55c.open_work: Deploy dense calibrated networks and develop multipollutant sensor packages.
80d9e88e9ee954a275d3364c185e0ca7d39db55c.issues: Calibration may not transfer to other climates or concentration ranges; NO2 relative error remains about 29%.

d4e8dd5336e4bdf76341e2f4d45435ac48ba342b.goal: Predicts groundwater levels in populated towns of Selangor, Malaysia, where levels are declining.
d4e8dd5336e4bdf76341e2f4d45435ac48ba342b.architecture: XGBoost (gradient-boosted trees) compared with an artificial neural network and support vector regression.
d4e8dd5336e4bdf76341e2f4d45435ac48ba342b.data: 11 months of rainfall, temperature, evaporation and groundwater level records in Selangor, with three input scenarios.
d4e8dd5336e4bdf76341e2f4d45435ac48ba342b.result: XGBoost performs best; R2 reaches 0.92 when lagged groundwater level is included, versus 0.16 and 0.11 in the other scenarios.
d4e8dd5336e4bdf76341e2f4d45435ac48ba342b.open_work: Use longer records and more wells to build a benchmark for groundwater level prediction.
d4e8dd5336e4bdf76341e2f4d45435ac48ba342b.issues: Very short record; high skill relies on the previous day's groundwater level (persistence).

b475ba71ad43827457dca378e6f7f15c7e87ce2f.goal: Predicts solar energy for real-time and short-term forecasting of solar plants in semi-desert Morocco.
b475ba71ad43827457dca378e6f7f15c7e87ce2f.architecture: Random forest, artificial neural network, linear regression and support vector regression with Pearson-correlation input selection.
b475ba71ad43827457dca378e6f7f15c7e87ce2f.data: Meteorological and solar data from Errachidia, Morocco, 2016–2018, compared with Pirapora, Brazil.
b475ba71ad43827457dca378e6f7f15c7e87ce2f.result: RF and ANN give high accuracy while LR and SVR have large errors; ANN performs well for both real-time and short-term predictions.
b475ba71ad43827457dca378e6f7f15c7e87ce2f.open_work: Extend to longer horizons and other climates.
b475ba71ad43827457dca378e6f7f15c7e87ce2f.issues: Two sites; simple feature selection; limited detail on validation protocol.

5daa64f765790912208b505dbd6fe23296a8459a.goal: Forecasts one-hour-ahead PV power at five-minute intervals to support power system operation.
5daa64f765790912208b505dbd6fe23296a8459a.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet packet decomposition and four LSTM networks for the sub-series, recombined by linear weighting.
5daa64f765790912208b505dbd6fe23296a8459a.data: Actual PV power data from Alice Springs, Australia.
5daa64f765790912208b505dbd6fe23296a8459a.result: Outperforms individual LSTM, RNN, GRU and MLP in MBE, MAPE and RMSE, in both accuracy and stability.
5daa64f765790912208b505dbd6fe23296a8459a.open_work: Add weather inputs and test across sites and horizons.
5daa64f765790912208b505dbd6fe23296a8459a.issues: Single site; univariate power series; decomposition may leak information if not applied causally.

2fd0575a46e927f2d3fa38f83ca842ff5a80cb18.goal: Downscales coarse satellite land surface temperature to finer resolution at regional scale.
2fd0575a46e927f2d3fa38f83ca842ff5a80cb18.architecture: Random forest regression relating LST to finer-scale predictors (surface reflectance indices and terrain), compared with the TsHARP sharpening method.
2fd0575a46e927f2d3fa38f83ca842ff5a80cb18.data: MODIS LST and reflectance with elevation data over a region in the Eastern Mediterranean; exact period not reported here.
2fd0575a46e927f2d3fa38f83ca842ff5a80cb18.result: Random forest downscaling is more accurate than TsHARP, especially over heterogeneous terrain; exact errors not reported here.
2fd0575a46e927f2d3fa38f83ca842ff5a80cb18.open_work: Apply to other regions and sensors and to finer target resolutions.
2fd0575a46e927f2d3fa38f83ca842ff5a80cb18.issues: Assumes scale-invariant LST-predictor relationships; validation data are limited.

9e3b35feddb475d2dad1c014a3bcb11cd0c40c8b.goal: Predicts short-term wind power to aid grid integration of wind farms.
9e3b35feddb475d2dad1c014a3bcb11cd0c40c8b.architecture: Genetic LSTM (GLSTM): LSTM network whose window size and number of neurons are optimized by a genetic algorithm.
9e3b35feddb475d2dad1c014a3bcb11cd0c40c8b.data: Wind power data from seven wind farms in Europe.
9e3b35feddb475d2dad1c014a3bcb11cd0c40c8b.result: GLSTM improves wind power predictions by 6% to 30% on average over existing techniques and differs significantly from standard LSTM (Wilcoxon test).
9e3b35feddb475d2dad1c014a3bcb11cd0c40c8b.open_work: Use meteorological inputs and probabilistic outputs.
9e3b35feddb475d2dad1c014a3bcb11cd0c40c8b.issues: Only power history used; GA tuning is computationally costly.

bc3287dbcbe1c4c56d62bcac31dc68bf8cf8be9c.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration with limited meteorological data across different climates of China.
bc3287dbcbe1c4c56d62bcac31dc68bf8cf8be9c.architecture: Tree-based ensembles (random forest, M5 model tree, gradient boosting decision tree, XGBoost) compared with support vector machine and extreme learning machine.
bc3287dbcbe1c4c56d62bcac31dc68bf8cf8be9c.data: Daily meteorological data from eight stations in different Chinese climates, 1961–2010, with four input combinations; FAO-56 Penman-Monteith target; K-fold cross-validation.
bc3287dbcbe1c4c56d62bcac31dc68bf8cf8be9c.result: Models using Tmax, Tmin, humidity, wind and Ra give satisfactory estimates in several climate zones; tree-based models, especially XGBoost, offer good accuracy, stability and low cost (abstract truncated).
bc3287dbcbe1c4c56d62bcac31dc68bf8cf8be9c.open_work: Test models in other climates and with other input combinations.
bc3287dbcbe1c4c56d62bcac31dc68bf8cf8be9c.issues: Target is a Penman-Monteith estimate; few stations; results vary by climate zone.

943fcdb089194efd02d60b8649f3872389de9797.goal: Reviews gains and problems of data-driven machine learning in environmental pollution research.
943fcdb089194efd02d60b8649f3872389de9797.architecture: Review of machine learning applications in environmental pollution, including satellite-based pollutant retrieval, source apportionment and water pollutant modelling.
943fcdb089194efd02d60b8649f3872389de9797.data: Published environmental studies; no new data.
943fcdb089194efd02d60b8649f3872389de9797.result: Over 40% of environmental ML applications target air pollution; advanced methods such as deep neural networks remain underused in environmental process studies.
943fcdb089194efd02d60b8649f3872389de9797.open_work: Broaden ML to other environmental areas, improve data sharing and model selection.
943fcdb089194efd02d60b8649f3872389de9797.issues: Trade-off between performance and interpretability; review-level conclusions.

8997991e9d8bebca370257ae3c42078cfc7fbca0.goal: Compares data-driven methods for flood susceptibility mapping in the Quannan area, China.
8997991e9d8bebca370257ae3c42078cfc7fbca0.architecture: Naive Bayes tree, alternating decision tree and random forest classifiers.
8997991e9d8bebca370257ae3c42078cfc7fbca0.data: Flood inventory of 363 locations (70/30 split) and thirteen explanatory factors in Quannan, China.
8997991e9d8bebca370257ae3c42078cfc7fbca0.result: Random forest is best, with AUC 0.951 for training and 0.925 for validation, and the highest accuracy and other statistics.
8997991e9d8bebca370257ae3c42078cfc7fbca0.open_work: Apply to other regions and compare with further ensembles.
8997991e9d8bebca370257ae3c42078cfc7fbca0.issues: Static susceptibility from one area; random splitting can inflate accuracy through spatial autocorrelation.

8e45e5d8e4d7ca24699b516105414b29f71431e2.goal: Examines how AI affects greenhouse gas emissions and how to align it with climate change mitigation.
8e45e5d8e4d7ca24699b516105414b29f71431e2.architecture: Perspective framework, not a model: classifies AI's effects into computing-related impacts, immediate application impacts and system-level impacts.
8e45e5d8e4d7ca24699b516105414b29f71431e2.data: Literature and existing estimates of AI-related emissions and applications; no new data.
8e45e5d8e4d7ca24699b516105414b29f71431e2.result: AI can both reduce and increase emissions, and system-level effects such as rebound and steering effects may dominate.
8e45e5d8e4d7ca24699b516105414b29f71431e2.open_work: Better measurement and reporting of AI emissions and policies that steer AI toward mitigation.
8e45e5d8e4d7ca24699b516105414b29f71431e2.issues: Qualitative framework; quantitative estimates of system-level impacts are highly uncertain.

f4cbc4741741b80aa81d93bbfa014fd46536a688.goal: Improves photovoltaic power prediction given the intermittency of solar energy.
f4cbc4741741b80aa81d93bbfa014fd46536a688.architecture: Hybrid LSTM-convolutional neural network: an LSTM extracts temporal features, then a CNN extracts spatial features.
f4cbc4741741b80aa81d93bbfa014fd46536a688.data: Photovoltaic power time series; source and site are not reported in the abstract.
f4cbc4741741b80aa81d93bbfa014fd46536a688.result: The LSTM-CNN beats single LSTM, single CNN and CNN-LSTM across eight error metrics.
f4cbc4741741b80aa81d93bbfa014fd46536a688.open_work: Test on more sites and horizons and add weather inputs.
f4cbc4741741b80aa81d93bbfa014fd46536a688.issues: Limited data description; point forecasts only.

c9d766e1555a7d6b8ae61781a00643c58be0bd83.goal: Forecasts short-term urban water demand in Montreal, Canada, for system management.
c9d766e1555a7d6b8ae61781a00643c58be0bd83.architecture: Compares multiple linear and nonlinear regression, ARIMA, artificial neural network (MLP) and wavelet-ANN hybrids.
c9d766e1555a7d6b8ae61781a00643c58be0bd83.data: Daily urban water demand with maximum air temperature and total precipitation for Montreal; exact period not reported here.
c9d766e1555a7d6b8ae61781a00643c58be0bd83.result: The wavelet-ANN models give the most accurate demand forecasts among all methods; exact errors not reported here.
c9d766e1555a7d6b8ae61781a00643c58be0bd83.open_work: Test wavelet-ANN at other cities and longer lead times.
c9d766e1555a7d6b8ae61781a00643c58be0bd83.issues: Single city; wavelet decomposition may leak future data if not applied causally.

285da642de2f9c8b857f701c5fb56021826339ab.goal: Provides deterministic and probabilistic wind speed forecasts for wind power integration.
285da642de2f9c8b857f701c5fb56021826339ab.architecture: Deep belief network combined with wavelet transform decomposition, with quantile regression for probabilistic forecasts.
285da642de2f9c8b857f701c5fb56021826339ab.data: Wind speed data from wind farms; specific sites and periods are not reported here.
285da642de2f9c8b857f701c5fb56021826339ab.result: The approach outperforms benchmark methods in both deterministic and probabilistic accuracy; exact scores not reported here.
285da642de2f9c8b857f701c5fb56021826339ab.open_work: Extend to wind power and multi-site forecasts.
285da642de2f9c8b857f701c5fb56021826339ab.issues: Decomposition hybrids may leak information; limited sites.

0c19c987853bd3a8fbd92226c228d25b03750f3b.goal: Assesses county-level flash flood risk in Yunnan Province, China, for flood prevention.
0c19c987853bd3a8fbd92226c228d25b03750f3b.architecture: XGBoost (gradient-boosted trees) with two input strategies, compared with least squares support vector machine.
0c19c987853bd3a8fbd92226c228d25b03750f3b.data: Flash flood inventory and environmental factors for Yunnan counties, validated with a separate flash flood inventory.
0c19c987853bd3a8fbd92226c228d25b03750f3b.result: XGBoost reaches 0.84 accuracy in testing and beats LSSVM on all indices; 40.3% of counties are high or highest risk, mainly in southeastern Yunnan.
0c19c987853bd3a8fbd92226c228d25b03750f3b.open_work: Address XGBoost limitations and refine risk factors.
0c19c987853bd3a8fbd92226c228d25b03750f3b.issues: Errors from environmental factors and disaster location accuracy; county-level resolution is coarse.

fb021e0045851f02f425478c8d37ea069fda313f.goal: Improves multi-step wind speed forecasting with a hybrid deep learning approach.
fb021e0045851f02f425478c8d37ea069fda313f.architecture: Hybrid of variational mode decomposition, singular spectrum analysis, LSTM network and extreme learning machine; LSTM forecasts low-frequency and ELM high-frequency components.
fb021e0045851f02f425478c8d37ea069fda313f.data: Wind speed series; specific sites and periods are not reported here.
fb021e0045851f02f425478c8d37ea069fda313f.result: The hybrid outperforms single and simpler hybrid models in multi-step accuracy; exact scores not reported here.
fb021e0045851f02f425478c8d37ea069fda313f.open_work: Test on more sites and probabilistic output.
fb021e0045851f02f425478c8d37ea069fda313f.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids may leak future information; added complexity.

80fd738909738d36d22f57094d0827fcf3cfad7a.goal: Forecasts one-day-ahead hourly PV power output using weather forecast information.
80fd738909738d36d22f57094d0827fcf3cfad7a.architecture: Weather-based hybrid method: self-organizing map and learning vector quantization classify weather, support vector regression forecasts, and fuzzy inference selects models.
80fd738909738d36d22f57094d0827fcf3cfad7a.data: PV power output and weather forecast data from a site in Taiwan; exact period not reported here.
80fd738909738d36d22f57094d0827fcf3cfad7a.result: The hybrid method is more accurate than simple SVR and ANN benchmarks; exact scores not reported here.
80fd738909738d36d22f57094d0827fcf3cfad7a.open_work: Test at more sites and with better weather forecasts.
80fd738909738d36d22f57094d0827fcf3cfad7a.issues: Single site; depends on weather forecast quality.

1b463b36d1bbccc419954cc28bd28b0108c2ca63.goal: Predicts solar panel energy harvesting from National Weather Service forecasts, so that smart-grid and sensor systems can plan around solar generation automatically.
1b463b36d1bbccc419954cc28bd28b0108c2ca63.architecture: Compares regression models, including linear least squares and support vector machine (SVM) regression with linear, polynomial and RBF kernels, mapping forecast weather variables to solar intensity.
1b463b36d1bbccc419954cc28bd28b0108c2ca63.data: Historical National Weather Service forecast variables (sky cover, temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind) paired with observed solar intensity at a single site in Amherst, Massachusetts.
1b463b36d1bbccc419954cc28bd28b0108c2ca63.result: SVM regression with an RBF kernel gives the most accurate predictions, clearly outperforming simple forecast-based solar models; exact error figures are not reported here.
1b463b36d1bbccc419954cc28bd28b0108c2ca63.open_work: Extending to more sites and climates, longer horizons and probabilistic outputs, and integrating predictions into energy-harvesting control.
1b463b36d1bbccc419954cc28bd28b0108c2ca63.issues: Single-site, short record; limited to deterministic point forecasts; accuracy depends on the quality of the public weather forecasts used as inputs.

a0309aebc917601f10a29b91811a70819a68e6a5.goal: Reviews machine learning methods for retrieving vegetation biomass and soil moisture, two essential climate variables, from high-dimensional remote sensing data.
a0309aebc917601f10a29b91811a70819a68e6a5.architecture: Review of machine learning retrieval approaches for remote sensing, covering methods such as artificial neural networks, support vector regression and other non-linear regressors applied to biomass and soil moisture.
a0309aebc917601f10a29b91811a70819a68e6a5.data: Literature on airborne and spaceborne optical, radar and microwave observations plus ground measurements, with attention to the Sentinel satellite family.
a0309aebc917601f10a29b91811a70819a68e6a5.result: Machine learning methods are flexible, handle many inputs and non-linear relations, and are well suited to exploit the growing Sentinel data volume for biomass and soil moisture retrieval.
a0309aebc917601f10a29b91811a70819a68e6a5.open_work: Exploiting dense Sentinel time series, multi-sensor fusion and better ground reference data for training and validation of retrieval models.
a0309aebc917601f10a29b91811a70819a68e6a5.issues: Qualitative review without a quantitative benchmark; retrievals depend on sparse, heterogeneous in situ reference data and may transfer poorly across regions.

21e13cd2d06361edcf7eaa561e698e0d0152c0d4.goal: Reviews forecasting models for renewable energy (wind, solar, geothermal) and electricity load to support energy planning in smart grids and buildings.
21e13cd2d06361edcf7eaa561e698e0d0152c0d4.architecture: Review of forecasting methods grouped into machine learning algorithms, ensemble-based approaches and artificial neural networks, across short-, medium- and long-term horizons.
21e13cd2d06361edcf7eaa561e698e0d0152c0d4.data: Published studies on wind, solar and geothermal generation and electricity demand forecasting; no new dataset.
21e13cd2d06361edcf7eaa561e698e0d0152c0d4.result: Machine learning handles large data with accurate forecasts, ensembles raise accuracy by combining models, and well-configured neural networks are a robust choice without residual distribution assumptions.
21e13cd2d06361edcf7eaa561e698e0d0152c0d4.open_work: Guidance on matching model choice to data availability and planning objectives, and better spatial and long-term forecasting.
21e13cd2d06361edcf7eaa561e698e0d0152c0d4.issues: Broad qualitative review; no common benchmark, so accuracy comparisons across reviewed studies are not directly comparable.

3df7f7dbda3cbc1c30e35d35ab373d4c2e814098.goal: Maps groundwater potential to guide water resource exploration and management in a data-scarce region of Iran.
3df7f7dbda3cbc1c30e35d35ab373d4c2e814098.architecture: Compares support vector machine, random forest and a random forest whose parameters are optimized by a genetic algorithm, trained on spring locations and conditioning factors.
3df7f7dbda3cbc1c30e35d35ab373d4c2e814098.data: Spring occurrence inventory and GIS-derived topographic, hydrological, geological and land use conditioning factors for a watershed in Iran; exact factors not reported in the abstract.
3df7f7dbda3cbc1c30e35d35ab373d4c2e814098.result: All models produce usable potential maps; the genetic-algorithm-optimized random forest gives the best ROC-based performance in the comparison.
3df7f7dbda3cbc1c30e35d35ab373d4c2e814098.open_work: Testing in other hydrogeological settings and adding further optimizers or ensemble learners.
3df7f7dbda3cbc1c30e35d35ab373d4c2e814098.issues: Single study area; spring locations are an indirect proxy for groundwater potential; validation relies on AUC of a held-out inventory.

2945026d08907473c1fced0a8a9a978fd1c48c14.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for wind power operation by combining signal decomposition with an optimized kernel learner.
2945026d08907473c1fced0a8a9a978fd1c48c14.architecture: Hybrid wavelet transform plus support vector machine regression whose hyperparameters are tuned by a genetic algorithm (WT-GA-SVM).
2945026d08907473c1fced0a8a9a978fd1c48c14.data: Wind speed time series from a wind farm in China; exact period and resolution not reported here.
2945026d08907473c1fced0a8a9a978fd1c48c14.result: The hybrid outperforms single SVM and other benchmark models in forecast error measures; specific numbers are not reported here.
2945026d08907473c1fced0a8a9a978fd1c48c14.open_work: Applying to multi-step horizons, other sites, and probabilistic forecasting.
2945026d08907473c1fced0a8a9a978fd1c48c14.issues: Single-site point-forecast evaluation; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if applied to the full series before splitting.

e77b3380c40f68765dc3d5f7baecc9ae1842c4dc.goal: Tests whether a classical seasonal ARIMA model can match deep learning for short-term offshore wind speed forecasting off Scotland.
e77b3380c40f68765dc3d5f7baecc9ae1842c4dc.architecture: Seasonal ARIMA (SARIMA) statistical model compared against recurrent neural networks, gated recurrent unit (GRU) and long short-term memory (LSTM).
e77b3380c40f68765dc3d5f7baecc9ae1842c4dc.data: Three hourly wind speed time series measured at different heights on a coastal met mast in Scotland serving a demonstration offshore turbine.
e77b3380c40f68765dc3d5f7baecc9ae1842c4dc.result: SARIMA gives the highest accuracy and robustness across the three datasets and the tested horizons, outperforming GRU and LSTM.
e77b3380c40f68765dc3d5f7baecc9ae1842c4dc.open_work: Testing on more sites and longer horizons, and combining SARIMA with machine learning in hybrid models.
e77b3380c40f68765dc3d5f7baecc9ae1842c4dc.issues: Single location and univariate inputs; the deep models may be under-tuned, so the comparison may not generalize.

b6e42df7dc8bf15d178606de0112ecdf9cfe16a5.goal: Forecasts hourly urban water demand to support operation of water supply networks.
b6e42df7dc8bf15d178606de0112ecdf9cfe16a5.architecture: Compares artificial neural networks, projection pursuit regression, multivariate adaptive regression splines, random forest and support vector regression, plus a naive baseline.
b6e42df7dc8bf15d178606de0112ecdf9cfe16a5.data: Hourly water demand and associated weather and calendar variables for a city in southeastern Spain.
b6e42df7dc8bf15d178606de0112ecdf9cfe16a5.result: Support vector regression gives the most accurate hourly forecasts, followed by MARS, projection pursuit regression and random forest.
b6e42df7dc8bf15d178606de0112ecdf9cfe16a5.open_work: Testing on other networks and longer horizons, and adding uncertainty estimates.
b6e42df7dc8bf15d178606de0112ecdf9cfe16a5.issues: Single city; short-horizon deterministic forecasts only; limited set of predictors.

ea69bd391929059853cd37e2317039bc7a2e2410.goal: Builds global maps of seafloor biomass and abundance to inform deep-sea food web models, carbon cycling and management.
ea69bd391929059853cd37e2317039bc7a2e2410.architecture: Random forest regression predicting benthic standing stocks from environmental predictors.
ea69bd391929059853cd37e2317039bc7a2e2410.data: Seafloor biomass and abundance database from 24 institutions within the Census of Marine Life, with predictors of surface primary production, water-column and export POC flux, seafloor relief and bottom-water properties.
ea69bd391929059853cd37e2317039bc7a2e2410.result: Models explain 63–88% of stock variance by size group; biomass is highest at the poles, on upwelling margins and equatorial divergence zones, lowest on central abyssal plains.
ea69bd391929059853cd37e2317039bc7a2e2410.open_work: Incorporating the maps into mechanistic deep-sea food web and carbon cycle models and filling sampling gaps.
ea69bd391929059853cd37e2317039bc7a2e2410.issues: Uneven sampling across ocean basins and depths; predictions in unsampled regions are extrapolations; static climatological view.

46fb7b901107d7aeb061e1cb63407cf7529bbace.goal: Maps flood susceptibility for flood risk management using hybrid neuro-fuzzy models.
46fb7b901107d7aeb061e1cb63407cf7529bbace.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) combined in ensembles with metaheuristic optimization algorithms that tune its parameters.
46fb7b901107d7aeb061e1cb63407cf7529bbace.data: Flood inventory and GIS-derived conditioning factors for a study area in Iran; details not reported here.
46fb7b901107d7aeb061e1cb63407cf7529bbace.result: The metaheuristic-optimized ANFIS ensembles produce accurate susceptibility maps and improve on the standalone model in ROC-based validation; exact values not reported here.
46fb7b901107d7aeb061e1cb63407cf7529bbace.open_work: Transfer to other catchments and comparison with deep learning and ensemble tree methods.
46fb7b901107d7aeb061e1cb63407cf7529bbace.issues: Single region; static susceptibility without flood dynamics or rainfall forcing; inventory quality limits validation.

33339b49b16050c0e9efffe85af731e34b154602.goal: Improves flood susceptibility mapping by combining a statistical weighting method with a kernel machine.
33339b49b16050c0e9efffe85af731e34b154602.architecture: Ensemble of frequency ratio (bivariate statistics) and support vector machine classification with tested kernel types.
33339b49b16050c0e9efffe85af731e34b154602.data: Flood inventory and GIS conditioning factors (topography, hydrology, geology, land use) for a flood-prone region in Malaysia.
33339b49b16050c0e9efffe85af731e34b154602.result: The FR–SVM ensemble yields higher success and prediction rates than standalone models; exact rates not reported here.
33339b49b16050c0e9efffe85af731e34b154602.open_work: Applying the ensemble to other regions and adding dynamic triggering factors.
33339b49b16050c0e9efffe85af731e34b154602.issues: Single study area; static susceptibility only; dependent on inventory completeness.

ba73c8328d75eff46d35a5c443d961d364743c8d.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed at newly built wind farms that lack long historical records.
ba73c8328d75eff46d35a5c443d961d364743c8d.architecture: Transfer learning with deep neural networks: a deep network pretrained on data-rich older wind farms and fine-tuned on new farms with little data.
ba73c8328d75eff46d35a5c443d961d364743c8d.data: Wind speed records from multiple wind farms in China; exact periods not reported here.
ba73c8328d75eff46d35a5c443d961d364743c8d.result: Transferring knowledge from data-rich farms improves forecast accuracy at data-poor new farms compared with models trained from scratch and shallow baselines.
ba73c8328d75eff46d35a5c443d961d364743c8d.open_work: Selecting source farms systematically, multi-step and probabilistic forecasting.
ba73c8328d75eff46d35a5c443d961d364743c8d.issues: Benefit depends on similarity between source and target farms; evaluation limited to a few Chinese sites.

78dca796af8445a0d59a188ab2f5ea98800a6ca0.goal: Forecasts Beijing's air quality index at multiple hours and stations, accounting for spatiotemporal patterns of pollution.
78dca796af8445a0d59a188ab2f5ea98800a6ca0.architecture: Compares a back-propagation neural network (MLP), a convolutional neural network (CNN), long short-term memory (LSTM) and a hybrid CNN-LSTM, combined with seasonal and spatial clustering of stations.
78dca796af8445a0d59a188ab2f5ea98800a6ca0.data: Multi-site hourly air quality index observations in Beijing; period and station count not reported in the abstract.
78dca796af8445a0d59a188ab2f5ea98800a6ca0.result: For next-hour forecasts accuracy rises from BPNN to CNN to LSTM to CNN-LSTM; LSTM is best for multi-hour forecasts; cluster-based models improve forecasts for specific clusters.
78dca796af8445a0d59a188ab2f5ea98800a6ca0.open_work: Adding meteorological and emission inputs and extending lead times.
78dca796af8445a0d59a188ab2f5ea98800a6ca0.issues: Single city; seasonal models give little gain; no uncertainty quantification.

586adcb189d98c52cda7fd63669a2a08256b3f6a.goal: Improves multi-step wind speed forecasting by decomposing the signal and assigning suitable networks to each component.
586adcb189d98c52cda7fd63669a2a08256b3f6a.architecture: Hybrid of empirical wavelet transform decomposition, long short-term memory (LSTM) networks for low-frequency subseries and Elman recurrent neural networks for high-frequency subseries.
586adcb189d98c52cda7fd63669a2a08256b3f6a.data: Several observed wind speed time series; site details not reported here.
586adcb189d98c52cda7fd63669a2a08256b3f6a.result: The hybrid EWT-LSTM-Elman model outperforms single networks and other decomposition hybrids in multi-step error metrics.
586adcb189d98c52cda7fd63669a2a08256b3f6a.open_work: Probabilistic outputs, more sites and seasons, and adaptive decomposition.
586adcb189d98c52cda7fd63669a2a08256b3f6a.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if decomposition uses the full series; point forecasts only.

2b5896bd9aad140dfbb6eae933647768c6c040e1.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration when meteorological data at the target station are incomplete or short.
2b5896bd9aad140dfbb6eae933647768c6c040e1.architecture: Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM, gradient boosting trees) compared with M5 model tree, random forest and four empirical equations.
2b5896bd9aad140dfbb6eae933647768c6c040e1.data: Daily Tmax, Tmin, humidity, wind speed and radiation from 49 stations in humid subtropical China (16 in Jiangxi), 2001–2015, in eight input combinations.
2b5896bd9aad140dfbb6eae933647768c6c040e1.result: LightGBM beats M5Tree and RF locally (RMSE 0.08–0.58 vs 0.11–0.62 and 0.13–0.60 mm/d) and in cross-station use; all ML models beat empirical equations; Rs is the most influential input.
2b5896bd9aad140dfbb6eae933647768c6c040e1.open_work: Testing in other climates and with remote sensing or reanalysis inputs.
2b5896bd9aad140dfbb6eae933647768c6c040e1.issues: Targets are FAO-56 Penman-Monteith estimates, not lysimeter measurements; one climatic region.

c0ebb4045bc7a1359a7cafba471fa8592cf7e5f2.goal: Develops and tests a soil moisture retrieval algorithm for the Sentinel-1 SAR mission ahead of launch.
c0ebb4045bc7a1359a7cafba471fa8592cf7e5f2.architecture: Artificial neural network retrieval trained on simulated backscatter from an electromagnetic surface scattering model, then applied to SAR images.
c0ebb4045bc7a1359a7cafba471fa8592cf7e5f2.data: Model-simulated backscatter for training; validation with SAR images from precursor C-band missions (such as ENVISAT ASAR) and ground soil moisture measurements at test sites.
c0ebb4045bc7a1359a7cafba471fa8592cf7e5f2.result: The ANN algorithm retrieves soil moisture with accuracy suited to Sentinel-1 product requirements in preliminary validation; exact errors not reported here.
c0ebb4045bc7a1359a7cafba471fa8592cf7e5f2.open_work: Validation with real Sentinel-1 data, vegetation correction and operational high-resolution products.
c0ebb4045bc7a1359a7cafba471fa8592cf7e5f2.issues: Preliminary validation on precursor data; vegetated and rough surfaces challenge retrieval; training relies on model simulations.

b4c9f49f726f87791768c37e0b29f5e7c8719f6d.goal: Surveys how Big Data and machine learning can benefit environment and water management, and what challenges remain.
b4c9f49f726f87791768c37e0b29f5e7c8719f6d.architecture: Review of Big Data concepts and machine learning, including deep learning, applied to environment and water management areas such as flood warning, weather forecasting and smart water systems.
b4c9f49f726f87791768c37e0b29f5e7c8719f6d.data: Literature using remote sensing, smart sensor networks, social media and other large environmental data sources.
