b4c9f49f726f87791768c37e0b29f5e7c8719f6d.result: ML and Big Data show strong potential for data-driven decision making and discovery, especially for real-time, multidisciplinary tasks where process knowledge is incomplete.
b4c9f49f726f87791768c37e0b29f5e7c8719f6d.open_work: Better integration of physical knowledge with ML, data infrastructure, interpretability and uncertainty handling.
b4c9f49f726f87791768c37e0b29f5e7c8719f6d.issues: Broad survey focused on nexus areas rather than exhaustive coverage; no quantitative comparison.

02f517267bbe3d5441fd69674611f9c20e5d7949.goal: Assesses long-term changes in global vegetation sensitivity to soil moisture and whether land surface models capture them.
02f517267bbe3d5441fd69674611f9c20e5d7949.architecture: Explainable machine learning with feature attribution relating leaf area index anomalies to hydro-climate anomalies; the model type is not specified in the abstract.
02f517267bbe3d5441fd69674611f9c20e5d7949.data: Observation-based leaf area index and hydro-climate anomaly data, 1982–2017, compared with state-of-the-art land surface model (TRENDY-type) simulations.
02f517267bbe3d5441fd69674611f9c20e5d7949.result: LAI sensitivity to soil moisture increases significantly across many semi-arid and arid regions, strongest where precipitation declines; land surface models do not reproduce the trend.
02f517267bbe3d5441fd69674611f9c20e5d7949.open_work: Improving land surface model representation of water-limited vegetation and assessing carbon-uptake consequences under future drought.
02f517267bbe3d5441fd69674611f9c20e5d7949.issues: Relies on satellite LAI and soil moisture products with their own errors; sensitivities are statistical attributions, not causal.

ab1bbacb9e0330981511fa2c952dd9ccf48cc3db.goal: Forecasts long-term wind power from daily wind speed data, including at sites where no plant yet exists.
ab1bbacb9e0330981511fa2c952dd9ccf48cc3db.architecture: Compares five machine learning algorithms; specific methods are not named in the abstract.
ab1bbacb9e0330981511fa2c952dd9ccf48cc3db.data: Historical daily wind speed and wind power data from wind sites; locations not reported in the abstract.
ab1bbacb9e0330981511fa2c952dd9ccf48cc3db.result: ML models forecast long-term wind power well and can be transferred to locations different from the training site.
ab1bbacb9e0330981511fa2c952dd9ccf48cc3db.open_work: Testing transfer across more diverse terrain and climates.
ab1bbacb9e0330981511fa2c952dd9ccf48cc3db.issues: Daily resolution only; transferability shown on limited cases; algorithms and error figures not given in the abstract.

88dafe466cbe8efd8068cbf6635fcc3aa17e8d8f.goal: Forecasts wind speed at sites in Mexico by combining linear and non-linear time series models.
88dafe466cbe8efd8068cbf6635fcc3aa17e8d8f.architecture: Hybrid ARIMA statistical model with an artificial neural network (MLP) modelling the ARIMA residuals.
88dafe466cbe8efd8068cbf6635fcc3aa17e8d8f.data: Measured wind speed time series from three regions of Mexico.
88dafe466cbe8efd8068cbf6635fcc3aa17e8d8f.result: The hybrid ARIMA–ANN model gives lower forecast errors than ARIMA or ANN alone at all three sites.
88dafe466cbe8efd8068cbf6635fcc3aa17e8d8f.open_work: Longer horizons and additional meteorological predictors.
88dafe466cbe8efd8068cbf6635fcc3aa17e8d8f.issues: Univariate, site-specific point forecasts; limited number of sites.

266e6d0d7266831256dd4f841979900e86b9c2eb.goal: Forecasts streamflow in non-perennial rivers of semi-arid watersheds, where intermittent flow challenges standard models.
266e6d0d7266831256dd4f841979900e86b9c2eb.architecture: Coupled wavelet transform and artificial neural network (WA-ANN) compared with a standalone ANN.
266e6d0d7266831256dd4f841979900e86b9c2eb.data: Daily flow records from two non-perennial rivers in semi-arid watersheds of Cyprus.
266e6d0d7266831256dd4f841979900e86b9c2eb.result: WA-ANN forecasts 1 and 3 days ahead more accurately than the standalone ANN.
266e6d0d7266831256dd4f841979900e86b9c2eb.open_work: Longer lead times, other climates and inclusion of rainfall inputs.
266e6d0d7266831256dd4f841979900e86b9c2eb.issues: Two rivers only; wavelet preprocessing can introduce boundary effects or leakage.

3a26b31e6c3699b7b003530f6666d3c96322b096.goal: Assesses flood probability, hazard and risk for a Malaysian catchment to support flood risk management.
3a26b31e6c3699b7b003530f6666d3c96322b096.architecture: Ensemble of frequency ratio weighting with a support vector machine (RBF kernel), combined with a 2D high-resolution sub-grid hydraulic model for inundation depth.
3a26b31e6c3699b7b003530f6666d3c96322b096.data: Thirteen conditioning factors from multi-sensor remote sensing and GIS (topography indices, distance to river, geology, soil, runoff, LULC) plus rainfall for the Damansara River catchment.
3a26b31e6c3699b7b003530f6666d3c96322b096.result: The approach produces flood probability, hazard and risk maps judged effective for flood management along the expressway and replicable elsewhere.
3a26b31e6c3699b7b003530f6666d3c96322b096.open_work: Validation with more flood events and application in other catchments.
3a26b31e6c3699b7b003530f6666d3c96322b096.issues: Single catchment; quantitative accuracy not reported in the abstract; vulnerability weights are subjective.

0211017a00fbec1de083eae939fc57d8f7d6a9b0.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting for stable wind farm and grid operation.
0211017a00fbec1de083eae939fc57d8f7d6a9b0.architecture: Support vector machine regression with hyperparameters chosen by an improved dragonfly metaheuristic (adaptive learning factor and differential evolution).
0211017a00fbec1de083eae939fc57d8f7d6a9b0.data: Real data from the La Haute Borne wind farm in France.
0211017a00fbec1de083eae939fc57d8f7d6a9b0.result: The hybrid model beats a back-propagation neural network and Gaussian process regression in prediction accuracy.
0211017a00fbec1de083eae939fc57d8f7d6a9b0.open_work: Probabilistic forecasts and testing on more farms.
0211017a00fbec1de083eae939fc57d8f7d6a9b0.issues: Single wind farm; numbers not reported in the abstract; gains come mainly from hyperparameter tuning.

5f6baf6a7342715060c389e9e1c71d23398e0f72.goal: Analyses how AI can help understand and combat climate change and the risks it brings, including its own carbon footprint.
5f6baf6a7342715060c389e9e1c71d23398e0f72.architecture: Review and policy analysis of AI for climate change; no ML model is developed.
5f6baf6a7342715060c389e9e1c71d23398e0f72.data: Literature and evidence on AI applications for climate and on the greenhouse gas emissions of AI training and computation.
5f6baf6a7342715060c389e9e1c71d23398e0f72.result: AI offers real opportunities, but its carbon footprint may be significant; the authors give 13 recommendations and see the EU as well placed to lead governance.
5f6baf6a7342715060c389e9e1c71d23398e0f72.open_work: More evidence on the trade-off between AI emissions and efficiency gains, and responsive governance frameworks.
5f6baf6a7342715060c389e9e1c71d23398e0f72.issues: Policy-oriented with limited quantitative assessment; carbon footprint estimates are uncertain.

883e380556f49cfbffd34e3c79f648afa685120b.goal: Improves wind power forecasts by correcting numerical weather prediction wind speed before conversion to power.
883e380556f49cfbffd34e3c79f648afa685120b.architecture: Gaussian process regression used to correct NWP wind forecasts and to model the wind speed–power relation, giving probabilistic outputs.
883e380556f49cfbffd34e3c79f648afa685120b.data: NWP forecasts and measured wind speed and power from a wind farm; site details not reported here.
883e380556f49cfbffd34e3c79f648afa685120b.result: The Gaussian process approach reduces forecast errors relative to uncorrected NWP and other benchmark models and provides uncertainty estimates.
883e380556f49cfbffd34e3c79f648afa685120b.open_work: Extending to multiple farms and spatial correlations.
883e380556f49cfbffd34e3c79f648afa685120b.issues: Gaussian processes scale poorly with data size; single-farm evaluation; depends on NWP quality.

3ee3ba3199e91ecede50c35504c15dc26c6a5a2f.goal: Forecasts short-term photovoltaic power output for microgrid operation.
3ee3ba3199e91ecede50c35504c15dc26c6a5a2f.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet transform, particle swarm optimization and support vector machine regression (Wavelet-PSO-SVM).
3ee3ba3199e91ecede50c35504c15dc26c6a5a2f.data: SCADA records and numerical weather prediction meteorological data for a PV installation in China.
3ee3ba3199e91ecede50c35504c15dc26c6a5a2f.result: The hybrid model gives lower forecast errors than several benchmark models; exact numbers not reported here.
3ee3ba3199e91ecede50c35504c15dc26c6a5a2f.open_work: Longer horizons, more sites and probabilistic forecasting.
3ee3ba3199e91ecede50c35504c15dc26c6a5a2f.issues: Single plant; point forecasts only; relies on NWP input quality.

1c61995f05973e542ff6e96555edae34adb13a17.goal: Predicts sea surface temperature at daily, weekly and monthly scales as a time series regression problem.
1c61995f05973e542ff6e96555edae34adb13a17.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network followed by a fully connected dense layer.
1c61995f05973e542ff6e96555edae34adb13a17.data: SST and SST anomaly data for coastal seas of China; product name not given in the abstract.
1c61995f05973e542ff6e96555edae34adb13a17.result: The LSTM predicts 1- and 3-day SST and weekly and monthly means effectively, and supports online updating.
1c61995f05973e542ff6e96555edae34adb13a17.open_work: Using spatial information (e.g. convolutional LSTM) and longer leads.
1c61995f05973e542ff6e96555edae34adb13a17.issues: Point-wise time series model ignores spatial structure; limited region; baselines unclear in the abstract.

930d313426f0fadf3964fc1fe089252213338bf1.goal: Improves wind speed prediction by hybridizing ARIMA with non-linear and state-space methods.
930d313426f0fadf3964fc1fe089252213338bf1.architecture: Two hybrids: ARIMA used to set up an artificial neural network (ARIMA-ANN), and ARIMA used to initialize a Kalman filter (ARIMA-Kalman).
930d313426f0fadf3964fc1fe089252213338bf1.data: Observed wind speed time series; site details not reported here.
930d313426f0fadf3964fc1fe089252213338bf1.result: Both hybrids give good, robust accuracy for non-stationary wind speed and improve on the individual models.
930d313426f0fadf3964fc1fe089252213338bf1.issues: Univariate point forecasts at limited sites; no uncertainty quantification.

f3bfc382a5f5a740b2fb5ed0f2c84080c74d1dcc.goal: Quantifies recent variability of the global ocean CO2 sink from observations.
f3bfc382a5f5a740b2fb5ed0f2c84080c74d1dcc.architecture: Two-step neural network (SOM-FFN): a self-organizing map clusters ocean provinces and a feedforward neural network reconstructs surface ocean pCO2 within each.
f3bfc382a5f5a740b2fb5ed0f2c84080c74d1dcc.data: Surface ocean pCO2 observations from the SOCAT database with satellite and reanalysis predictors (SST, salinity, chlorophyll, mixed layer depth), roughly 1998–2011.
f3bfc382a5f5a740b2fb5ed0f2c84080c74d1dcc.result: The ocean sink weakened in the 1990s and strengthened substantially in the 2000s, showing large decadal variability.
f3bfc382a5f5a740b2fb5ed0f2c84080c74d1dcc.open_work: Attribution of drivers, better coverage in poorly sampled regions such as the Southern Ocean.
f3bfc382a5f5a740b2fb5ed0f2c84080c74d1dcc.issues: Sparse, uneven observations especially in the Southern Ocean; mapping uncertainty and gas-exchange parameterization errors.

343ce75308263b9595f3fff05aaffe68ffa16534.goal: Reviews artificial neural networks in wind energy systems to identify the methods used for each application.
343ce75308263b9595f3fff05aaffe68ffa16534.architecture: Review of artificial neural network structures in wind energy, grouped into forecasting and prediction, design optimization, fault detection and diagnosis, and optimal control.
343ce75308263b9595f3fff05aaffe68ffa16534.data: 190 references, more than 85% from the previous five years.
343ce75308263b9595f3fff05aaffe68ffa16534.result: ANNs can replace conventional methods in many wind energy applications; strengths and weaknesses of each structure and quantitative trends are summarized.
343ce75308263b9595f3fff05aaffe68ffa16534.open_work: Technological gaps and challenges in applying ANNs to wind turbines identified by the review.
343ce75308263b9595f3fff05aaffe68ffa16534.issues: Restricted to ANN methods; qualitative comparison without a common benchmark.

902caf944da02115b8e7041eb3ea1917c6eb5204.goal: Compares time series methods for hourly power forecasting of a large-scale PV plant, especially where weather measurements are lacking.
902caf944da02115b8e7041eb3ea1917c6eb5204.architecture: Comparison of statistical time series models and artificial intelligence methods (neural networks); exact models not listed in the abstract.
902caf944da02115b8e7041eb3ea1917c6eb5204.data: 3640 hours of operation data from a 20 MW grid-connected PV station in China.
902caf944da02115b8e7041eb3ea1917c6eb5204.result: Methods are compared rigorously across forecast horizons; no single headline figure is given in the abstract.
902caf944da02115b8e7041eb3ea1917c6eb5204.open_work: Adding weather inputs and testing at more plants.
902caf944da02115b8e7041eb3ea1917c6eb5204.issues: Single plant, short record; univariate inputs.

6a01248c9abd6d0f647830b05b671b3c26eae7c9.goal: Monitors drought and flood over the Yunnan-Guizhou karst plateau in Southwest China using terrestrial water storage beyond the GRACE record.
6a01248c9abd6d0f647830b05b671b3c26eae7c9.architecture: Artificial neural network used to extend GRACE terrestrial water storage anomalies from hydro-climatic predictors.
6a01248c9abd6d0f647830b05b671b3c26eae7c9.data: GRACE terrestrial water storage, precipitation, temperature and other hydro-climate data over the karst plateau.
6a01248c9abd6d0f647830b05b671b3c26eae7c9.result: Extended GRACE data capture the severe 2009–2010 drought and flood events in the region.
6a01248c9abd6d0f647830b05b671b3c26eae7c9.open_work: Applying the reconstruction to other regions and longer periods, and merging with hydrological models.
6a01248c9abd6d0f647830b05b671b3c26eae7c9.issues: Reconstruction outside the GRACE period depends on predictor relationships staying stable; coarse GRACE resolution.

67afda38c06ce8f3e05b02d9c6b1c9f500619d11.goal: Predicts air pollutant concentrations by capturing spatiotemporal features across neighboring stations.
67afda38c06ce8f3e05b02d9c6b1c9f500619d11.architecture: Spatiotemporal convolutional neural network combined with long short-term memory (C-LSTME), using adaptive k-nearest neighbor stations plus meteorological and aerosol data.
67afda38c06ce8f3e05b02d9c6b1c9f500619d11.data: Hourly PM2.5 at 1233 monitoring stations in Beijing and China, 2016–2017, with meteorological and aerosol data.
67afda38c06ce8f3e05b02d9c6b1c9f500619d11.result: C-LSTME outperforms state-of-the-art models at different prediction times and regional scales.
67afda38c06ce8f3e05b02d9c6b1c9f500619d11.open_work: Improving long-term and sudden-change prediction and adding emissions data.
67afda38c06ce8f3e05b02d9c6b1c9f500619d11.issues: Two-year record; few extreme events; no uncertainty quantification.

7bba5c987c81032f31029492038e20dceef97f4e.goal: Provides hour-ahead wind power forecasts for wind farm and grid operation.
7bba5c987c81032f31029492038e20dceef97f4e.architecture: Random forest regression with input variable selection.
7bba5c987c81032f31029492038e20dceef97f4e.data: Measured wind farm data (power and meteorological variables); site details not reported here.
7bba5c987c81032f31029492038e20dceef97f4e.result: The random forest model gives accurate hour-ahead forecasts and outperforms benchmark methods; numbers not reported here.

54be361ad20a895831dd19f70712c885c94a6289.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting by exploiting spatial correlations among neighboring wind farms.
54be361ad20a895831dd19f70712c885c94a6289.architecture: Graph neural network: scalable graph convolutional deep learning architecture with LSTM temporal features per node and rough set upper/lower bound parameters.
54be361ad20a895831dd19f70712c885c94a6289.data: Wind speed and direction from neighboring wind sites modelled as an undirected graph; dataset not named in the abstract.
54be361ad20a895831dd19f70712c885c94a6289.result: The model beats state-of-the-art deep learning and shallow architectures in simulations.
54be361ad20a895831dd19f70712c885c94a6289.open_work: Larger networks, longer horizons and dynamic graph structure.
54be361ad20a895831dd19f70712c885c94a6289.issues: Fixed graph; dataset and numbers not given in the abstract.

b7663c4b4c72650279e43ced0c49efb2765455a1.goal: Reviews methods for forecasting photovoltaic power output, focusing on machine learning and metaheuristic techniques.
b7663c4b4c72650279e43ced0c49efb2765455a1.architecture: Review of machine learning and metaheuristic PV forecasting methods with their advantages and disadvantages.
b7663c4b4c72650279e43ced0c49efb2765455a1.data: Published PV forecasting studies, organized by historical data, horizons and input parameters.
b7663c4b4c72650279e43ced0c49efb2765455a1.result: Summarizes pros and cons of each method and compares machine learning with metaheuristic approaches to guide method selection.
b7663c4b4c72650279e43ced0c49efb2765455a1.open_work: Better hybrid methods and standardized evaluation.

91e929e9fa98f3df7fa5a1c04a18bdc88554d556.goal: Examines how parameter tuning of support vector machines affects short-term wind speed forecasting.
91e929e9fa98f3df7fa5a1c04a18bdc88554d556.architecture: Least-squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) regression with linear, Gaussian and polynomial kernels and tuned parameters.
91e929e9fa98f3df7fa5a1c04a18bdc88554d556.data: Wind speed observations from sites in North Dakota, USA.
91e929e9fa98f3df7fa5a1c04a18bdc88554d556.result: Properly tuned LS-SVMs outperform the persistence model; performance is sensitive to kernel and parameter choice.

bb228591f771261a9eb468e10d4b8b4c572c2994.goal: Simulates hourly groundwater levels in a coastal aquifer near the Venice lagoon.
bb228591f771261a9eb468e10d4b8b4c572c2994.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network (MLP) driven by external forcings to simulate groundwater levels over long periods.
bb228591f771261a9eb468e10d4b8b4c572c2994.data: Hourly groundwater levels, rainfall and evapotranspiration records for the coastal aquifer system of the Venice lagoon.
bb228591f771261a9eb468e10d4b8b4c572c2994.result: The ANN reproduces hourly groundwater level dynamics accurately in long-term simulation, not only one-step prediction.
bb228591f771261a9eb468e10d4b8b4c572c2994.open_work: Applying to other aquifers and including more drivers.
bb228591f771261a9eb468e10d4b8b4c572c2994.issues: Single site; extrapolation outside training conditions is uncertain.

90459de57e3d46fecf6a0cea0d56acbf89b3c665.goal: Reviews wind power forecasting methods to guide method selection for grid operation and maintenance.
90459de57e3d46fecf6a0cea0d56acbf89b3c665.architecture: Review of physical, statistical (time series and artificial neural network) and hybrid wind power forecasting methods.
90459de57e3d46fecf6a0cea0d56acbf89b3c665.result: Provides a guideline for screening methods by horizon, inputs, computational time and error measures, with recommendations for research.
90459de57e3d46fecf6a0cea0d56acbf89b3c665.open_work: Recommendations for future wind power forecasting research.

e501dfa75d526a7e61ad704534ba683ce928adbb.goal: Predicts daily global solar radiation in four Turkish provinces to support solar energy design and planning.
e501dfa75d526a7e61ad704534ba683ce928adbb.architecture: Compares support vector machine, artificial neural network, k-nearest neighbors and a deep learning model.
e501dfa75d526a7e61ad704534ba683ce928adbb.data: Turkish State Meteorological Service daily data (temperatures, cloud cover, extraterrestrial radiation, day length, solar radiation), 2018–2019.
e501dfa75d526a7e61ad704534ba683ce928adbb.result: All models reach R² 0.855–0.936 and RMSE 2.27–2.82 MJ/m²; ANN fits best, followed by DL, SVM and k-NN.
e501dfa75d526a7e61ad704534ba683ce928adbb.open_work: Testing longer records and more provinces.
e501dfa75d526a7e61ad704534ba683ce928adbb.issues: Short two-year record; four sites only.

c13bec6b570b70aba2804d4e7918934db0129152.goal: Forecasts daily global solar radiation time series, with preprocessing to improve neural network performance.
c13bec6b570b70aba2804d4e7918934db0129152.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network on preprocessed (seasonally adjusted) series, compared with ARIMA, Bayesian, Markov chain and k-nearest neighbor predictors.
c13bec6b570b70aba2804d4e7918934db0129152.data: Daily global solar radiation measurements from a meteorological station in Corsica, France.
c13bec6b570b70aba2804d4e7918934db0129152.result: The MLP with preprocessed data outperforms the other predictors.

0627acc18ca240386b5eb72c11ae5b76ce669339.goal: Estimates ground-level PM2.5 across China by fusing satellite observations with station measurements, to monitor pollution where monitors are sparse.
0627acc18ca240386b5eb72c11ae5b76ce669339.architecture: Geo-intelligent deep belief network (Geoi-DBN) that adds geographical distance and spatiotemporally correlated neighbouring PM2.5 as inputs to a deep belief network.
0627acc18ca240386b5eb72c11ae5b76ce669339.data: Satellite observations (aerosol-related retrievals) and ground station PM2.5 measurements over China for 2015; out-of-sample cross-validation.
0627acc18ca240386b5eb72c11ae5b76ce669339.result: Cross-validated R2 rises from 0.42 (traditional neural network) to 0.88 and RMSE falls from 29.96 to 13.03 μg/m3; over 80% of the Chinese population lives where annual PM2.5 exceeds 35 μg/m3.
0627acc18ca240386b5eb72c11ae5b76ce669339.open_work: Extending to multiple years and other regions, and testing transfer to periods without station data.
0627acc18ca240386b5eb72c11ae5b76ce669339.issues: Single year of training data; reliance on neighbouring station PM2.5 limits use in station-free regions; satellite gaps not discussed in the abstract.

f5f66b6ee001578e4137afddef557dae2acbf088.goal: Examines how fine-scale topography and coarse-scale weather and climate control satellite-derived forest burn severity in the western US, 1984–2006.
f5f66b6ee001578e4137afddef557dae2acbf088.architecture: Random forest classification of severe versus non-severe fire occurrence from topographic, weather and climate predictors, with variable-importance analysis and trend statistics.
f5f66b6ee001578e4137afddef557dae2acbf088.data: Monitoring Trends in Burn Severity (MTBS) Landsat-derived burn severity for 1,024 Northwest and 497 Southwest fires across six ecoregions, plus topographic and climate data.
f5f66b6ee001578e4137afddef557dae2acbf088.result: Classification accuracies of 68–84%; topography is a stronger predictor than climate or weather; predictability drops in widespread-fire years; Southwest shows increasing area burned severely.
f5f66b6ee001578e4137afddef557dae2acbf088.open_work: Predictive mapping of severe-fire potential using climate data at a resolution matching topography and Landsat severity.
f5f66b6ee001578e4137afddef557dae2acbf088.issues: Short 23-year record limits trend detection; coarse climate data versus fine topography biases importance rankings; binary severity classification.

274fa0c18056788a279dcf8119cb8954626b4ad3.goal: Builds a flood susceptibility map for Poyang County, China, to support flood mitigation and preparedness.
274fa0c18056788a279dcf8119cb8954626b4ad3.architecture: Fuzzy weight of evidence used to delineate non-flood areas and weight factors, combined with logistic regression, random forest and support vector machine classifiers.
274fa0c18056788a279dcf8119cb8954626b4ad3.data: Flood inventory for Poyang County with eleven conditioning factors (lithology, soil, elevation, slope, aspect, TWI, SPI, STI, curvatures, distance to rivers).
274fa0c18056788a279dcf8119cb8954626b4ad3.result: Fuzzy WofE-SVM performs best (AUC 0.9865), significantly above fuzzy WofE-RF (0.9756) and fuzzy WofE-LR (0.9652).
274fa0c18056788a279dcf8119cb8954626b4ad3.open_work: Testing transferability to other basins and adding dynamic rainfall drivers.
274fa0c18056788a279dcf8119cb8954626b4ad3.issues: Single small study area; very high AUCs may reflect spatial autocorrelation between training and test points; static susceptibility only.

283c877b16b7304a658f3410235a4f9a8be3457a.goal: Reviews how artificial neural network models for ambient air pollution prediction are developed, given their black-box nature and uncertainty.
283c877b16b7304a658f3410235a4f9a8be3457a.architecture: Review applying the Maier et al. (2010) ANN development protocol to assess published air pollution forecasting studies; covers MLP and ensemble-type neural networks.
283c877b16b7304a658f3410235a4f9a8be3457a.data: Journal papers on ANN forecasting of outdoor PM10, PM2.5, nitrogen oxides and ozone, mostly using meteorological and emission predictors.
283c877b16b7304a658f3410235a4f9a8be3457a.result: Most studies use ad hoc input selection, data splitting and structure selection; multilayer perceptrons and ensembles dominate.
283c877b16b7304a658f3410235a4f9a8be3457a.open_work: Systematic protocols for input selection, data division, model structure and validation of ANN air quality models.
283c877b16b7304a658f3410235a4f9a8be3457a.issues: Review predates widespread deep learning in the field; assessment limited to the reviewed sample and protocol criteria.

27e828cccc7bd2ae9e479184786f7a31b510c4d9.goal: Reviews methods and models for forecasting urban water demand, to guide utilities in choosing forecasting approaches.
27e828cccc7bd2ae9e479184786f7a31b510c4d9.architecture: Review of urban water demand forecasting literature, spanning regression, time-series, artificial neural network and other soft-computing and hybrid methods.
27e828cccc7bd2ae9e479184786f7a31b510c4d9.data: Published urban water demand forecasting studies; no new data.
27e828cccc7bd2ae9e479184786f7a31b510c4d9.result: Categorizes studies by forecast horizon and method; specific quantitative conclusions are not reported here.
27e828cccc7bd2ae9e479184786f7a31b510c4d9.open_work: Better treatment of forecast uncertainty and of the link between forecast horizon and planning decisions.
27e828cccc7bd2ae9e479184786f7a31b510c4d9.issues: Abstract not available; card based on title and general knowledge; review predates recent deep learning work.

fc8f2264c67107fe3ae5c084d436075afe6486b8.goal: Improves ultra-short and short-term wind speed forecasting for wind farm scheduling and control.
fc8f2264c67107fe3ae5c084d436075afe6486b8.architecture: EnsemLSTM: a cluster of LSTM networks with diverse layers and neurons, combined by a support vector regression top layer whose parameters are tuned by extremal optimization.
fc8f2264c67107fe3ae5c084d436075afe6486b8.data: Wind speed time series from a wind farm in Inner Mongolia, China; 10-minute-ahead and 1-hour-ahead case studies.
fc8f2264c67107fe3ae5c084d436075afe6486b8.result: EnsemLSTM outperforms other popular prediction models in statistical tests; specific error numbers are not reported in the abstract.
fc8f2264c67107fe3ae5c084d436075afe6486b8.open_work: Longer horizons, multi-site application and inclusion of NWP inputs.
fc8f2264c67107fe3ae5c084d436075afe6486b8.issues: Single wind farm; univariate time series; computational cost of training many LSTMs plus optimization not discussed.

1da953cb9c801b0b618386e690ed8cd7008a309a.goal: Quantifies decadal variations and trends of the global ocean CO2 sink from observations, to test whether the sink keeps pace with rising emissions.
1da953cb9c801b0b618386e690ed8cd7008a309a.architecture: Two-step neural network approach (SOM-FFN): a self-organizing map clusters the ocean into biogeochemical provinces and a feedforward neural network maps surface pCO2 from predictors.
1da953cb9c801b0b618386e690ed8cd7008a309a.data: SOCAT surface ocean pCO2 observations with predictors such as SST, salinity, mixed layer depth and chlorophyll, covering roughly 1982–2011.
1da953cb9c801b0b618386e690ed8cd7008a309a.result: The sink shows strong decadal variability: it weakened through the 1990s and reinvigorated substantially from the early 2000s, departing from a steady trend expected from rising atmospheric CO2.
1da953cb9c801b0b618386e690ed8cd7008a309a.open_work: Attributing the variability to physical and biological drivers and extending the reconstruction with more observations.
1da953cb9c801b0b618386e690ed8cd7008a309a.issues: Abstract not available; sparse pCO2 sampling, especially in the Southern Ocean and early decades, makes decadal estimates uncertain.

4fb4f09c1ea1511e06d4990076951fad6eb1a4c0.goal: Produces an urban flood risk map for Sari, Iran, with limited hydrological and hydraulic data.
4fb4f09c1ea1511e06d4990076951fad6eb1a4c0.architecture: Genetic Algorithm Rule-Set Production (GARP) and Quick Unbiased Efficient Statistical Tree (QUEST, a decision tree) for hazard, with Fuzzy Analytical Network Process weighting for vulnerability.
4fb4f09c1ea1511e06d4990076951fad6eb1a4c0.data: 113 flooded points from reports and field surveys; hazard factors (precipitation, slope, curve number, distances, groundwater depth, land use, elevation) and socio-economic vulnerability factors.
4fb4f09c1ea1511e06d4990076951fad6eb1a4c0.result: GARP (AUC-ROC 93.5%, Kappa 0.86) outperforms QUEST (89.2%, 0.79); distance to channel, land use and elevation dominate hazard.
4fb4f09c1ea1511e06d4990076951fad6eb1a4c0.open_work: Coupling with hydraulic modelling where data allow and testing in other cities.
4fb4f09c1ea1511e06d4990076951fad6eb1a4c0.issues: Small inventory of 113 points in one city; vulnerability weights rely on expert judgement.

5c77091b31442fa4564ec497f7bdaf61ff54f7f1.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic and wind power for smart grid applications.
5c77091b31442fa4564ec497f7bdaf61ff54f7f1.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM deep learning model whose hyperparameters are tuned by the coati optimization algorithm, as stated in the title.
5c77091b31442fa4564ec497f7bdaf61ff54f7f1.data: Not reported (abstract unavailable); PV and wind power time series.
5c77091b31442fa4564ec497f7bdaf61ff54f7f1.result: Not reported in the abstract; the hybrid is presented as improving forecast accuracy.
5c77091b31442fa4564ec497f7bdaf61ff54f7f1.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and testing across sites and seasons.
5c77091b31442fa4564ec497f7bdaf61ff54f7f1.issues: Abstract not available; metaheuristic-tuned hybrids risk overfitting and are hard to compare without common benchmarks.

5d5b1b401a02023bfe3398393a00e4e4097a0911.goal: Generates seamless daily maps of surface NO2, SO2 and CO across China to support air pollution and health studies.
5d5b1b401a02023bfe3398393a00e4e4097a0911.architecture: Artificial-intelligence (machine learning) model combining big data sources; the specific model type is not specified in the abstract.
5d5b1b401a02023bfe3398393a00e4e4097a0911.data: Ground observations over China with satellite and auxiliary data, 2013–2020 at 10 km; validated by cross-validation against stations.
5d5b1b401a02023bfe3398393a00e4e4097a0911.result: Daily CV R2 (RMSE) of 0.84 (7.99 µg/m3) for NO2, 0.84 (10.7 µg/m3) for SO2 and 0.80 (0.29 mg/m3) for CO; concentrations fell 12%, 55% and 17% from 2013 to 2020.
5d5b1b401a02023bfe3398393a00e4e4097a0911.open_work: Use in short-term exposure and health studies, and extension to finer resolution and later years.
5d5b1b401a02023bfe3398393a00e4e4097a0911.issues: Input sources and model details not given in the abstract; accuracy may degrade in station-sparse western China.

1114ad3e390d83dc6b134038ae8f6185e5563282.goal: Forecasts wind power by first forecasting wind speed and then mapping it to power output.
1114ad3e390d83dc6b134038ae8f6185e5563282.architecture: Adaptive wavelet neural network (AWNN) for wind speed forecasting followed by a feed-forward neural network that converts forecast wind speed to power.
1114ad3e390d83dc6b134038ae8f6185e5563282.data: Not reported (abstract unavailable); wind speed and wind power records from a wind farm.
1114ad3e390d83dc6b134038ae8f6185e5563282.result: Reported as improving forecast accuracy over benchmark approaches; specific numbers are not available here.
1114ad3e390d83dc6b134038ae8f6185e5563282.issues: Abstract not available; two-stage chain propagates wind-speed errors into power forecasts.

76570af91938c4e68478fb55381c3824ea6b4fb8.goal: Forecasts PV power at multiple sites simultaneously for short horizons, exploiting spatial information from neighbouring systems.
76570af91938c4e68478fb55381c3824ea6b4fb8.architecture: Gradient boosted regression trees using lagged power from the target and nearby sites plus weather forecast inputs.
76570af91938c4e68478fb55381c3824ea6b4fb8.data: Power data from multiple residential PV systems (reported as 42 sites in Japan) with numerical weather forecasts.
76570af91938c4e68478fb55381c3824ea6b4fb8.result: The multi-site GBRT outperforms single-site and persistence-type benchmarks for horizons of 1 to 6 hours ahead.
76570af91938c4e68478fb55381c3824ea6b4fb8.open_work: Probabilistic extensions and denser networks of sites.
76570af91938c4e68478fb55381c3824ea6b4fb8.issues: Abstract not available; site details recalled from knowledge; skill depends on site density and network geometry.

655b92e59298f80df4a25beb58b0f6df492fec79.goal: Improves wind power forecasting despite the high variability of wind.
655b92e59298f80df4a25beb58b0f6df492fec79.architecture: Data-driven pipeline (resampling, anomaly treatment, feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning) with a gated recurrent unit (GRU) network compared against LSTM.
655b92e59298f80df4a25beb58b0f6df492fec79.data: Wind turbine SCADA data; twelve engineered features including wind speeds at four heights, generator and gearbox temperature.
655b92e59298f80df4a25beb58b0f6df492fec79.result: GRU outperforms LSTM in accuracy in all tests, trains faster and is less sensitive to noise.
655b92e59298f80df4a25beb58b0f6df492fec79.open_work: Longer horizons, multiple turbines and probabilistic outputs.
655b92e59298f80df4a25beb58b0f6df492fec79.issues: Single SCADA dataset; error metrics and forecast horizon not stated in the abstract; no NWP inputs.

428e9c6d065c0c491bba37fe14fe1628f2b74a24.goal: Maps flash flood susceptibility in a high-frequency tropical storm area of northwest Vietnam to aid mitigation and land-use planning.
428e9c6d065c0c491bba37fe14fe1628f2b74a24.architecture: Deep learning neural network (MLP with 3 hidden layers, 192 neurons, ReLU, Adam) with information-gain-ratio feature selection in a GIS framework.
428e9c6d065c0c491bba37fe14fe1628f2b74a24.data: GIS database of elevation, slope, curvature, aspect, stream density, NDVI, soil type, lithology and rainfall with flash flood locations.
428e9c6d065c0c491bba37fe14fe1628f2b74a24.result: Classification accuracy 92.05%, positive predictive value 94.55%, negative predictive value 89.55%, better than a shallow MLP and SVM.
428e9c6d065c0c491bba37fe14fe1628f2b74a24.open_work: Transferability to other regions and dynamic rainfall-triggered susceptibility.
428e9c6d065c0c491bba37fe14fe1628f2b74a24.issues: Single region; static factors; spatial autocorrelation between training and validation points may inflate accuracy.

5ae11ff06c9209f72f0c9109afa5ba1ab738ad1f.goal: Forecasts hourly global, beam normal and diffuse solar irradiation 1–6 h ahead at a highly variable site.
5ae11ff06c9209f72f0c9109afa5ba1ab738ad1f.architecture: Random forest and artificial neural network (MLP) compared with smart persistence.
5ae11ff06c9209f72f0c9109afa5ba1ab738ad1f.result: RF is best: GHI nRMSE 19.65% (h+1) to 27.78% (h+6), BNI 34.11–49.08%, DHI 35.08–49.14%; RF advantage grows with horizon; spring and autumn are harder.
5ae11ff06c9209f72f0c9109afa5ba1ab738ad1f.open_work: Adding exogenous inputs such as satellite or NWP data and testing other sites.
5ae11ff06c9209f72f0c9109afa5ba1ab738ad1f.issues: Single site; endogenous inputs only; large errors for beam and diffuse components.

ab87de64be7a2f87dc75325b1f215b95361e8de0.goal: Forecasts short-term wind turbine power and its uncertainty to aid dispatch and reduce curtailment.
ab87de64be7a2f87dc75325b1f215b95361e8de0.architecture: LSTM network for point forecasts, with a Gaussian mixture model to characterize error distributions and confidence intervals.
ab87de64be7a2f87dc75325b1f215b95361e8de0.data: NWP data and historical power for three turbines in one wind farm.
ab87de64be7a2f87dc75325b1f215b95361e8de0.result: LSTM beats RBF, wavelet, DBN, BPNN and Elman networks; GMM gives better intervals than mixture density network and relevance vector machine.
ab87de64be7a2f87dc75325b1f215b95361e8de0.open_work: Farm-level and multi-farm application and longer horizons.
ab87de64be7a2f87dc75325b1f215b95361e8de0.issues: Only three turbines; accuracy depends on training sample size; no specific error values in the abstract.

513969abb237d2e33e05bbc562488d53173ecf17.goal: Seeks an optimal data-driven model for monthly and daily rainfall forecasting by studying inputs, methods and preprocessing.
513969abb237d2e33e05bbc562488d53173ecf17.architecture: Modular artificial neural network (MANN) compared with ANN, K-nearest neighbours and linear regression, coupled with moving average, PCA or singular spectrum analysis preprocessing.
513969abb237d2e33e05bbc562488d53173ecf17.data: Four rainfall records from different regions: two monthly and two daily series.
513969abb237d2e33e05bbc562488d53173ecf17.result: SSA preprocessing gives considerable gains while MA and PCA give slight gains; MANN coupled with SSA is best, especially for daily rainfall.
513969abb237d2e33e05bbc562488d53173ecf17.open_work: Testing at more stations and longer lead times.
513969abb237d2e33e05bbc562488d53173ecf17.issues: Single-step forecasts on few series; SSA applied to whole series can leak future information if not done carefully.

19abad76f905843a307276c098f4a0c1e750abe8.goal: Reviews precision irrigation water-saving systems for improving water use efficiency and crop yield under climate change.
19abad76f905843a307276c098f4a0c1e750abe8.architecture: Review of precision irrigation systems covering monitoring and control, architecture, communication technologies and the role of artificial intelligence.
19abad76f905843a307276c098f4a0c1e750abe8.data: Previously published studies on precision irrigation; no new data.
19abad76f905843a307276c098f4a0c1e750abe8.result: Concludes that precision irrigation systems will play a critical role in sustainable water management as scarcity intensifies.
19abad76f905843a307276c098f4a0c1e750abe8.open_work: Wider adoption, lower-cost sensing and AI-driven irrigation control.
19abad76f905843a307276c098f4a0c1e750abe8.issues: Narrative review with brief literature search; AI coverage is one component rather than the focus.

4a213f73aa80457911f8434d6824f7ac9c0096b4.goal: Provides fast estimates of ocean wave conditions as a surrogate for a physics-based wave model.
4a213f73aa80457911f8434d6824f7ac9c0096b4.architecture: Supervised machine learning surrogates: an MLP regression model for wave height and a support vector machine classifier for characteristic period, trained on wave model runs.
4a213f73aa80457911f8434d6824f7ac9c0096b4.data: Thousands of SWAN-type physics-based wave model runs for Monterey Bay forced by measured waves, ocean-current nowcasts and winds.
4a213f73aa80457911f8434d6824f7ac9c0096b4.result: Wave heights reproduced with RMSE of 9 cm and over 90% of characteristic periods identified correctly, at under 1/1,000 of the physics model's cost.
4a213f73aa80457911f8434d6824f7ac9c0096b4.open_work: Applying to other coasts and to forecast-mode forcing.
4a213f73aa80457911f8434d6824f7ac9c0096b4.issues: Emulates the physical model rather than observations, so inherits its errors; single site.

e9dbbc4abd60168c00c25999849efda32fa60121.goal: Improves rainfall-runoff modelling with data-driven methods by addressing lag effects in predictions.
e9dbbc4abd60168c00c25999849efda32fa60121.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) coupled with singular spectrum analysis of rainfall inputs, compared with plain ANN and linear regression.
e9dbbc4abd60168c00c25999849efda32fa60121.data: Daily rainfall-runoff records from Chinese watersheds; exact catchments not reported here.
e9dbbc4abd60168c00c25999849efda32fa60121.result: SSA preprocessing substantially improves ANN performance and reduces the lag between predicted and observed flows.
e9dbbc4abd60168c00c25999849efda32fa60121.issues: Abstract not available; SSA decomposition on full records can leak future information.

9f97b0a6799f250204b1fb806739ad873dfbf04b.goal: Produces deterministic and probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasts.
9f97b0a6799f250204b1fb806739ad873dfbf04b.architecture: Wavelet decomposition with a deep convolutional neural network for point forecasts, plus quantile regression for probabilistic output.
9f97b0a6799f250204b1fb806739ad873dfbf04b.data: PV power data from solar farms (recalled as Belgian data); details not available here.
9f97b0a6799f250204b1fb806739ad873dfbf04b.result: The hybrid outperforms conventional benchmarks across seasons and horizons; specific values not available here.
9f97b0a6799f250204b1fb806739ad873dfbf04b.open_work: Adding weather inputs and longer horizons.
9f97b0a6799f250204b1fb806739ad873dfbf04b.issues: Abstract not available; data details recalled from knowledge.

cad8516013fe6fef689b1e901b879ffea78eb701.goal: Forecasts PV output and residential load to optimize load dispatch in a grid-connected community microgrid.
cad8516013fe6fef689b1e901b879ffea78eb701.architecture: Deep recurrent neural network with LSTM units (DRNN-LSTM) for forecasting, with particle swarm optimization for dispatch.
cad8516013fe6fef689b1e901b879ffea78eb701.data: Two real-world datasets of power load and PV output.
cad8516013fe6fef689b1e901b879ffea78eb701.result: DRNN-LSTM beats MLP and SVM; storage and coordinated EV charging shift peak load and cut daily costs by 8.97%.
cad8516013fe6fef689b1e901b879ffea78eb701.issues: Forecast error values not reported in abstract; small-scale case.

d9a411c0dd2d23f6a886a4d961e6866b5873d710.goal: Maps flood susceptibility for Salzburg, Austria, comparing multi-criteria decision analysis and machine learning.
d9a411c0dd2d23f6a886a4d961e6866b5873d710.architecture: Random forest and support vector machine versus AHP and ANP, with Dempster Shafer Theory ensembling.
d9a411c0dd2d23f6a886a4d961e6866b5873d710.data: Flood inventory and eleven conditioning factors including elevation, slope, TWI, SPI, NDVI, geology, rainfall and land cover.
d9a411c0dd2d23f6a886a4d961e6866b5873d710.result: RF (AUC 87.8%) and SVM (87%) beat ANP (86.6%) and AHP (85.9%); DST raises accuracy; ensemble of all four reaches 89.3%.
d9a411c0dd2d23f6a886a4d961e6866b5873d710.open_work: Transfer to other regions and dynamic factors.
d9a411c0dd2d23f6a886a4d961e6866b5873d710.issues: Small differences between models; single region; static susceptibility.

c96f3c521ada98cc96a2510d1fb8763075306ee3.goal: Assesses how input-variable selection affects support vector machine performance for monthly streamflow prediction.
c96f3c521ada98cc96a2510d1fb8763075306ee3.architecture: Support vector machine regression with inputs chosen by principal component analysis, Gamma test or forward selection.
c96f3c521ada98cc96a2510d1fb8763075306ee3.data: Monthly streamflow and related hydrological records from a river in Iran; details not reported here.
c96f3c521ada98cc96a2510d1fb8763075306ee3.result: Input preselection reduces inputs and improves SVM performance over using all inputs; specific numbers not available here.
c96f3c521ada98cc96a2510d1fb8763075306ee3.open_work: Comparison with other learners and longer lead times.
c96f3c521ada98cc96a2510d1fb8763075306ee3.issues: Abstract not available; single basin; card relies on title and general knowledge.

0b637666b323fc72e2e0bc7a02e9430803320e86.goal: Produces multi-step-ahead reservoir inflow forecasts for operational flood control.
0b637666b323fc72e2e0bc7a02e9430803320e86.architecture: LSTM-based encoder-decoder (LSTM-ED) compared with a feed-forward neural network encoder-decoder.
0b637666b323fc72e2e0bc7a02e9430803320e86.data: 12,216 hourly records from 23 typhoon events at Shihmen Reservoir, Taiwan; rainfall from ten gauges and inflow.
0b637666b323fc72e2e0bc7a02e9430803320e86.result: LSTM-ED gives more reliable and accurate 1–6 h forecasts than FFNN-ED and captures rainfall-runoff dependence.
0b637666b323fc72e2e0bc7a02e9430803320e86.open_work: Longer lead times and use of forecast rainfall.
0b637666b323fc72e2e0bc7a02e9430803320e86.issues: Single catchment and limited events; observed rainfall inputs only.

c6e79a224697f40301711c987ae0812ea391019f.goal: Compares deep learning networks for short-term PV power forecasting in microgrids.
c6e79a224697f40301711c987ae0812ea391019f.architecture: LSTM, BiLSTM, GRU, BiGRU, 1D convolutional neural network and CNN1D-LSTM and CNN1D-GRU hybrids.
c6e79a224697f40301711c987ae0812ea391019f.data: PV power from the University of Trieste microgrid, Italy; horizons 1, 5, 30 and 60 min.
c6e79a224697f40301711c987ae0812ea391019f.result: Very high accuracy at 1-min one-step (r near 1); multi-step up to 8 steps gives r of 96.9–98%.
c6e79a224697f40301711c987ae0812ea391019f.open_work: Inclusion of weather inputs and longer horizons.
c6e79a224697f40301711c987ae0812ea391019f.issues: Single site; correlation coefficient is a weak skill metric; no persistence baseline reported.

9d1ab25cfbd5783c3d5584cbd348e40a78a4a5bf.goal: Analyzes trends in Indian rainfall since 1901 and forecasts the next 15 years.
9d1ab25cfbd5783c3d5584cbd348e40a78a4a5bf.architecture: Non-parametric trend tests (Pettitt, Mann-Kendall, Sen) and an artificial neural network multilayer perceptron for forecasting, with kriging for mapping.
9d1ab25cfbd5783c3d5584cbd348e40a78a4a5bf.data: Meteorological-division rainfall 1901–2015 for India; ERA5 reanalysis for physical interpretation.
9d1ab25cfbd5783c3d5584cbd348e40a78a4a5bf.result: Most divisions show significant negative trends, especially in the monsoon; change points mainly after 1960; the MLP projects continued decline.
9d1ab25cfbd5783c3d5584cbd348e40a78a4a5bf.open_work: Linking projections to climate model scenarios.
9d1ab25cfbd5783c3d5584cbd348e40a78a4a5bf.issues: Extrapolating 15 years with an MLP on univariate series ignores forcing; physical attribution is qualitative.

5853bf251dc2e8322e9a4a2f7e33462e689df155.goal: Predicts global solar irradiance to support production planning of solar thermal power plants.
5853bf251dc2e8322e9a4a2f7e33462e689df155.architecture: Time-series models compared with machine learning: autoregressive models, artificial neural networks and fuzzy logic applied to irradiance or clearness index series.
5853bf251dc2e8322e9a4a2f7e33462e689df155.data: Ground irradiance measurements from Spanish stations; details not reported here.
5853bf251dc2e8322e9a4a2f7e33462e689df155.result: Neural and fuzzy approaches improve on persistence and autoregressive baselines; specific values not available here.
5853bf251dc2e8322e9a4a2f7e33462e689df155.issues: Abstract not available; card partly based on general knowledge.

21ea5978ca313a8e64bafa1346b5f493949d6482.goal: Evaluates artificial neural network techniques for estimating daily global solar radiation from meteorological data.
21ea5978ca313a8e64bafa1346b5f493949d6482.architecture: Multilayer perceptron and radial basis function neural networks with various input combinations.
21ea5978ca313a8e64bafa1346b5f493949d6482.data: Daily meteorological and solar radiation data from Dezful, Iran.
21ea5978ca313a8e64bafa1346b5f493949d6482.result: The MLP slightly outperforms the RBF network with low percentage errors; specific values not reported here.
21ea5978ca313a8e64bafa1346b5f493949d6482.open_work: Testing at other stations and climates.

92e16c15aa4d48995b5c4a867c72a44675662d3e.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting through decomposition and model combination.
92e16c15aa4d48995b5c4a867c72a44675662d3e.architecture: CEEMDAN decomposition with a combined model whose weights are tuned by a modified flower pollination algorithm; the component networks are not specified here.
92e16c15aa4d48995b5c4a867c72a44675662d3e.data: Wind speed series from wind farm sites; details not reported here.
92e16c15aa4d48995b5c4a867c72a44675662d3e.result: The combined model outperforms individual models; specific values not reported here.
92e16c15aa4d48995b5c4a867c72a44675662d3e.issues: Abstract not available; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage.

3d7fecedc413b71adbcdc27bff835db4e5e589a6.goal: Predicts short-term solar power to support grid integration.
3d7fecedc413b71adbcdc27bff835db4e5e589a6.architecture: Support vector machine regression predicting atmospheric transmissivity, then converted to solar power.
3d7fecedc413b71adbcdc27bff835db4e5e589a6.data: Historical meteorological and solar data (recalled as NREL measurements); details not reported here.
3d7fecedc413b71adbcdc27bff835db4e5e589a6.result: SVM outperforms autoregressive and radial basis function neural network benchmarks.
3d7fecedc413b71adbcdc27bff835db4e5e589a6.open_work: Longer horizons and inclusion of cloud information.
3d7fecedc413b71adbcdc27bff835db4e5e589a6.issues: Abstract not available; data details recalled from knowledge.

c3b27db8f8bd8c209403b0c7595a3840e0bd0269.goal: Identifies which conditioning factors matter for river flood susceptibility mapping.
c3b27db8f8bd8c209403b0c7595a3840e0bd0269.architecture: Decision tree and support vector machine classifiers with multicollinearity and factor-importance analysis.
c3b27db8f8bd8c209403b0c7595a3840e0bd0269.data: 2011 Brisbane flood; LiDAR-derived factors (DS1) and LiDAR plus geology, soil, land use, distances (DS2).
c3b27db8f8bd8c209403b0c7595a3840e0bd0269.result: Best AUC with LiDAR-only factors: SVM 85.52% and DT 88.47%; altitude, SPI and TRI are most influential; more factors do not guarantee accuracy.
c3b27db8f8bd8c209403b0c7595a3840e0bd0269.open_work: Testing with other events and regions.
c3b27db8f8bd8c209403b0c7595a3840e0bd0269.issues: Single event and region; static factors.

e17f9ee5a4eef57aa1d22fa5d776f5732f1ede0f.goal: Gives an overview of methods for forecasting air pollution.
e17f9ee5a4eef57aa1d22fa5d776f5732f1ede0f.architecture: Review of statistical, artificial intelligence (neural network) and numerical forecasting methods and their hybrids.
e17f9ee5a4eef57aa1d22fa5d776f5732f1ede0f.data: Published air pollution forecasting studies; no new data.
e17f9ee5a4eef57aa1d22fa5d776f5732f1ede0f.result: Hybrid models improve accuracy; the review compares advantages and disadvantages of each class.
e17f9ee5a4eef57aa1d22fa5d776f5732f1ede0f.open_work: Better hybrid models and systematic comparisons.
e17f9ee5a4eef57aa1d22fa5d776f5732f1ede0f.issues: Broad narrative review without quantitative synthesis.

8cbbd1649aafb5b31ccb772ac80b2c4335315f4d.goal: Models the rainfall-runoff process with hybrid AI approaches capturing multiscale features.
8cbbd1649aafb5b31ccb772ac80b2c4335315f4d.architecture: Wavelet-artificial neural network and wavelet-adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) hybrids.
8cbbd1649aafb5b31ccb772ac80b2c4335315f4d.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a watershed in Iran; details not reported here.
8cbbd1649aafb5b31ccb772ac80b2c4335315f4d.result: Wavelet-based hybrids improve on plain ANN and ANFIS; specific values not reported here.
8cbbd1649aafb5b31ccb772ac80b2c4335315f4d.issues: Abstract not available; card based partly on general knowledge.

b00d4452cd9869526169b7a2fe893c0a7c31eb4c.goal: Reviews data processing strategies used in wind energy forecasting.
b00d4452cd9869526169b7a2fe893c0a7c31eb4c.architecture: Review classifying data processing into decomposition, feature selection, feature extraction, denoising, residual error modelling, outlier detection and filter-based correction.
b00d4452cd9869526169b7a2fe893c0a7c31eb4c.data: Published wind energy forecasting studies; no new data.
b00d4452cd9869526169b7a2fe893c0a7c31eb4c.result: Outlier detection and filter-based correction are under-used; methods are evaluated on accuracy, frequency, time, robustness and maturity.
b00d4452cd9869526169b7a2fe893c0a7c31eb4c.open_work: Exploring under-used processing methods and listed research directions.

aea570f685851e9a4ef34d634daa90a03baf7012.goal: Reviews machine learning models for groundwater level prediction.
aea570f685851e9a4ef34d634daa90a03baf7012.architecture: Review covering artificial neural networks, support vector machines, ANFIS, tree-based and deep learning models.
aea570f685851e9a4ef34d634daa90a03baf7012.data: Published groundwater level prediction studies; no new data.
aea570f685851e9a4ef34d634daa90a03baf7012.result: Not reported in detail here; summarizes model use and performance trends.
aea570f685851e9a4ef34d634daa90a03baf7012.issues: Abstract not available; card based on title and general knowledge.

6c074420c8d456c0866c4f5e37e5fcf3998732e9.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the Haraz watershed, northern Iran.
6c074420c8d456c0866c4f5e37e5fcf3998732e9.architecture: Bagging ensemble with K-nearest neighbour base classifiers (coarse, cosine, cubic and weighted KNN).
6c074420c8d456c0866c4f5e37e5fcf3998732e9.data: Flood locations from Sentinel-1 SAR and 10 conditioning factors.
6c074420c8d456c0866c4f5e37e5fcf3998732e9.result: Bagging-Cubic-KNN performs best, reducing overfitting and improving on Cubic-KNN (AUC 0.660).

437d716f030158af24b2fcf54553f86b073828e4.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in mountainous areas of China at national scale.
437d716f030158af24b2fcf54553f86b073828e4.architecture: Random forest classifier with conditioning factor importance analysis.
437d716f030158af24b2fcf54553f86b073828e4.data: National flood inventory and topographic, climate and land-use factors for China's mountainous areas; details not reported here.
437d716f030158af24b2fcf54553f86b073828e4.result: Random forest gives high predictive accuracy; specific values not reported here.
437d716f030158af24b2fcf54553f86b073828e4.issues: Abstract not available; card partly based on general knowledge.

fa7885fb4000c2bd6d855b3e6ae56f2af5dcdbf0.goal: Forecasts daily global incident solar radiation with limited meteorological data.
fa7885fb4000c2bd6d855b3e6ae56f2af5dcdbf0.architecture: Wavelet-coupled support vector machine (W-SVM) compared with ANN and other baseline models.
fa7885fb4000c2bd6d855b3e6ae56f2af5dcdbf0.data: Daily meteorological data from sites in Queensland, Australia.
fa7885fb4000c2bd6d855b3e6ae56f2af5dcdbf0.result: W-SVM outperforms standalone SVM and ANN; specific values not reported here.
fa7885fb4000c2bd6d855b3e6ae56f2af5dcdbf0.open_work: Testing at other sites and longer horizons.
fa7885fb4000c2bd6d855b3e6ae56f2af5dcdbf0.issues: Abstract not available; wavelet preprocessing can leak future information.

beeb4a0429adc9c900ad758ccb5d30dd64d8da74.goal: Predicts wind power using deep learning with meta regression and transfer learning.
beeb4a0429adc9c900ad758ccb5d30dd64d8da74.architecture: Deep neural network base regressors (autoencoders) with a deep belief network meta-regressor and transfer learning across wind farms.
beeb4a0429adc9c900ad758ccb5d30dd64d8da74.data: Wind power data from European wind farms; details not reported here.
beeb4a0429adc9c900ad758ccb5d30dd64d8da74.result: The approach improves prediction accuracy over baselines; specific values not reported here.
beeb4a0429adc9c900ad758ccb5d30dd64d8da74.issues: Abstract not available; card partly based on general knowledge.

0878e573a778986fdf1ae8db81462cfccb4b1848.goal: Forecasts one-hour-ahead global horizontal irradiance to support photovoltaic power integration, exploiting spatial correlations with neighboring sites as well as the target site's own history.
0878e573a778986fdf1ae8db81462cfccb4b1848.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM: a convolutional neural network extracts spatial features from a matrix of meteorological parameters at target and neighboring sites, and an LSTM extracts temporal features from irradiance history.
0878e573a778986fdf1ae8db81462cfccb4b1848.data: Three datasets from 34 ground stations across three climate zones in Texas, USA, evaluated over a full year under different seasons and sky conditions.
0878e573a778986fdf1ae8db81462cfccb4b1848.result: The CNN-LSTM outperforms standalone CNN, LSTM and other benchmark models on five evaluation metrics; specific error values are not reported in the abstract.
0878e573a778986fdf1ae8db81462cfccb4b1848.open_work: Extending to longer horizons and multi-step forecasts, adding satellite or sky-image inputs, and testing transfer to other regions.
0878e573a778986fdf1ae8db81462cfccb4b1848.issues: Single-region station network, one-hour horizon only, deterministic output without uncertainty quantification, and no quantitative gains given in the abstract.

94a2d3424911792ca6b97b7b188b6d5906b3f496.goal: Forecasts very short-term photovoltaic power output, both one step and multiple steps ahead, to aid grid integration of PV generation.
94a2d3424911792ca6b97b7b188b6d5906b3f496.architecture: Hybrid LSTM-TCN deep learning model combining a long short-term memory network with a temporal convolutional network, as stated in the title.
94a2d3424911792ca6b97b7b188b6d5906b3f496.data: PV power and related measurements from an operational PV installation; site, period and resolution are not reported here.
94a2d3424911792ca6b97b7b188b6d5906b3f496.result: Reported to be more accurate than reference models for one-step and multistep forecasts; quantitative scores are not reported here.
94a2d3424911792ca6b97b7b188b6d5906b3f496.open_work: Testing across more sites and climates, adding weather forecast inputs, and providing probabilistic forecasts.
94a2d3424911792ca6b97b7b188b6d5906b3f496.issues: Abstract unavailable; likely single-site evaluation, deterministic output, and very short horizons limit generality.

1839b67db835831a2582ce251a3b2be248b84e0a.goal: Reviews the challenges of calibrating low-cost particulate matter mass sensors so that their data can support quantitative air quality assessment, especially in low and middle-income countries.
1839b67db835831a2582ce251a3b2be248b84e0a.architecture: Review of calibration and correction methods for low-cost PM sensors, from simple linear and quadratic regression to complex machine learning algorithms, plus a set of best practices.
1839b67db835831a2582ce251a3b2be248b84e0a.data: Literature on low-cost optical PM sensors co-located with reference-grade monitors; no new dataset.
1839b67db835831a2582ce251a3b2be248b84e0a.result: Identifies biases from meteorology, sensor age, aerosol source, composition and refractive index, and presents best practices for obtaining high-quality data from low-cost sensors.
1839b67db835831a2582ce251a3b2be248b84e0a.open_work: Transferable calibrations across sites and aerosol types, long-term drift handling, and calibration where reference monitors are scarce.
1839b67db835831a2582ce251a3b2be248b84e0a.issues: Narrative review without a quantitative meta-analysis; machine learning calibrations may not generalize beyond their co-location conditions.

4c8364048a0efc4aeed07254d27d68ae22e5e622.goal: Improves ultra-short-term wind power forecasting to reduce the grid security and power quality impacts of wind variability.
4c8364048a0efc4aeed07254d27d68ae22e5e622.architecture: Convolutional neural network for feature extraction fused with the LightGBM gradient boosting algorithm to improve accuracy and robustness.
4c8364048a0efc4aeed07254d27d68ae22e5e622.data: Time series from a wind farm and an adjacent wind farm used to build new feature sets; specific site and period are not reported in the abstract.
4c8364048a0efc4aeed07254d27d68ae22e5e622.result: The CNN-LightGBM fusion is more accurate and efficient than support vector machines, LightGBM and CNN alone; numbers are not reported in the abstract.
4c8364048a0efc4aeed07254d27d68ae22e5e622.open_work: Evaluating on more wind farms and horizons and adding numerical weather prediction inputs.
4c8364048a0efc4aeed07254d27d68ae22e5e622.issues: Limited data description, single case study, deterministic forecasts, and odd use of a classification algorithm for a regression target.

7408c267730a4a3261fad3dc2263ba819da67dbc.goal: Predicts monthly mean daily global solar radiation on a horizontal surface from routine meteorological variables for solar energy assessment.
7408c267730a4a3261fad3dc2263ba819da67dbc.architecture: Support vector machine (SVR) whose hyperparameters are tuned by the firefly metaheuristic algorithm (SVM-FFA), compared with artificial neural network and genetic programming models.
7408c267730a4a3261fad3dc2263ba819da67dbc.data: Monthly sunshine duration and maximum and minimum temperature records from meteorological stations in Nigeria.
7408c267730a4a3261fad3dc2263ba819da67dbc.result: SVM-FFA gives lower errors and higher correlation than the ANN and genetic programming benchmarks.
7408c267730a4a3261fad3dc2263ba819da67dbc.open_work: Testing on daily data, more stations and climates, and with additional predictors.
7408c267730a4a3261fad3dc2263ba819da67dbc.issues: Few stations and monthly averages only; small sample sizes risk overfitting during metaheuristic tuning.

cf990339c286aadd6b62bcb9df0269be45936c34.goal: Develops an operational approach to map soil moisture at high spatial resolution over agricultural areas, for both bare and vegetated soils.
cf990339c286aadd6b62bcb9df0269be45936c34.architecture: Neural network inversion of Sentinel-1 SAR backscatter combined with Sentinel-2 NDVI; network type beyond a generic neural network is not specified in the abstract.
cf990339c286aadd6b62bcb9df0269be45936c34.data: Sentinel-1 VV and VH backscatter and Sentinel-2 NDVI; networks trained on synthetic databases and validated with real in situ databases.
cf990339c286aadd6b62bcb9df0269be45936c34.result: Soil moisture accuracy about 5 vol%; VV alone outperforms VH, VV+VH is similar to VV, and a priori soil moisture information improves accuracy.
cf990339c286aadd6b62bcb9df0269be45936c34.open_work: Extending to dense vegetation (NDVI above 0.75) and rough surfaces, and to other regions and land covers.
cf990339c286aadd6b62bcb9df0269be45936c34.issues: Valid only for NDVI below 0.75 and works best for moderate roughness; relies on synthetic training data from backscatter models.

9f141602156f8dbd8ce272e99ba55d5a8ec86734.goal: Produces flood susceptibility maps for the Seoul metropolitan area to support flood-risk management under increasing flood frequency.
9f141602156f8dbd8ce272e99ba55d5a8ec86734.architecture: Random forest and boosted regression tree models, in regression and classification modes, within a GIS environment.
9f141602156f8dbd8ce272e99ba55d5a8ec86734.data: Flooded-area inventory (2010 for training, 2011 for validation) and 12 factors from topography, geology, soil and land-use datasets.
9f141602156f8dbd8ce272e99ba55d5a8ec86734.result: Random forest validation accuracies of 78.8% (regression) and 79.2% (classification) versus 77.6% and 77.3% for boosted trees; distance to river, geology and DEM are most important.
9f141602156f8dbd8ce272e99ba55d5a8ec86734.open_work: Incorporating rainfall and drainage network data and testing over more flood years.
9f141602156f8dbd8ce272e99ba55d5a8ec86734.issues: Static susceptibility only, two flood years, single city, and modest accuracies.

a64f2b43f0310c8c39fc2e44686a2a3857c55f8d.goal: Reconstructs historical daily PM2.5 across China from satellite aerosol data, addressing poor accuracy when predicting outside the training period.
a64f2b43f0310c8c39fc2e44686a2a3857c55f8d.architecture: Ensemble of random forest, generalized additive model and XGBoost trained per spatial cluster, combined by a generalized additive ensemble model after multiple imputation of missing satellite data.
a64f2b43f0310c8c39fc2e44686a2a3857c55f8d.data: Satellite aerosol optical depth with meteorological and land-use predictors, and ground PM2.5 monitors across China split into seven regions.
a64f2b43f0310c8c39fc2e44686a2a3857c55f8d.result: Cross-validation R2 0.79 (RMSE 21 µg/m3); out-of-range hindcast R2 0.58 daily and 0.76 monthly; cluster-based models improve R2 by about 0.05.
a64f2b43f0310c8c39fc2e44686a2a3857c55f8d.open_work: Extending hindcasts further back and improving daily out-of-range skill.
a64f2b43f0310c8c39fc2e44686a2a3857c55f8d.issues: Daily out-of-period skill is moderate; depends on satellite AOD imputation; monitoring network is sparse before 2013.

133830b4951015348ce7cc26f44ca32475176d7b.goal: Compares individual machine learning and statistical models and their ensembles for flood susceptibility mapping, aiming to reduce model uncertainty.
133830b4951015348ce7cc26f44ca32475176d7b.architecture: Eight models (artificial neural network, CART, FDA, GLM, GAM, boosted regression trees, MARS, MaxEnt) and seven ensemble combinations such as committee averaging, mean, median and weighted mean.
133830b4951015348ce7cc26f44ca32475176d7b.data: 201 flood events and 10,000 random non-occurrence points in the Haraz watershed, Mazandaran province, Iran.
133830b4951015348ce7cc26f44ca32475176d7b.result: Boosted regression trees reach AUROC 0.975 and GLM 0.642; the median ensemble (EMmedian) is best at 0.976.
133830b4951015348ce7cc26f44ca32475176d7b.open_work: Testing ensembles in other watersheds and with independent flood events.
133830b4951015348ce7cc26f44ca32475176d7b.issues: Single watershed, random background points, and high AUC that may reflect spatial autocorrelation rather than true generalization.

30c15627b2363cbfe02cd1d4215773494042ad28.goal: Predicts crop yield from environmental, soil, water and crop parameters with a framework that maps raw data directly to yield.
30c15627b2363cbfe02cd1d4215773494042ad28.architecture: Deep reinforcement learning: a Deep Recurrent Q-Network combining a stacked recurrent neural network with Q-learning, with a linear layer mapping outputs to Q-values.
30c15627b2363cbfe02cd1d4215773494042ad28.data: Environmental, soil, water and crop parameter data; specific dataset and region are not reported in the abstract.
30c15627b2363cbfe02cd1d4215773494042ad28.result: Reported accuracy of 93.7%, outperforming existing models.
30c15627b2363cbfe02cd1d4215773494042ad28.open_work: Validating on independent regions and years and comparing with standard regression baselines.
30c15627b2363cbfe02cd1d4215773494042ad28.issues: Unusual framing of regression as reinforcement learning, accuracy metric unclear for a continuous target, and data not described.

86e1b15818f93684bedb7a7cc929e7762e56339b.goal: Improves LSTM rainfall-runoff simulation by optimizing its hyperparameters automatically.
86e1b15818f93684bedb7a7cc929e7762e56339b.architecture: LSTM neural network whose hyperparameters are tuned by particle swarm optimization (PSO-LSTM), as stated in the title.
86e1b15818f93684bedb7a7cc929e7762e56339b.data: Rainfall and runoff records from study catchments; basins and periods are not reported here.
86e1b15818f93684bedb7a7cc929e7762e56339b.result: Not reported here; the PSO-tuned LSTM is presented as improving runoff simulation over untuned configurations.
86e1b15818f93684bedb7a7cc929e7762e56339b.open_work: Testing across more catchments and comparing with other hyperparameter search methods.
86e1b15818f93684bedb7a7cc929e7762e56339b.issues: Abstract unavailable; results likely catchment-specific and PSO tuning adds computational cost.

1f343d0707a6aafa3df1833ae72c15f3b3cf518b.goal: Forecasts next-24-hour PM2.5 concentration in Beijing to support health protection.
1f343d0707a6aafa3df1833ae72c15f3b3cf518b.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM in which a convolutional neural network extracts air quality features and an LSTM models the time series; compared with univariate and multivariate LSTM variants.
1f343d0707a6aafa3df1833ae72c15f3b3cf518b.data: Air quality data from the previous 7 days in Beijing as input and next-day PM2.5 as target.
1f343d0707a6aafa3df1833ae72c15f3b3cf518b.result: The multivariate CNN-LSTM gives the lowest MAE and RMSE and shorter training time; values are not reported in the abstract.
1f343d0707a6aafa3df1833ae72c15f3b3cf518b.open_work: Adding meteorological forecasts and testing at more cities and longer leads.
1f343d0707a6aafa3df1833ae72c15f3b3cf518b.issues: Single city, limited baselines, no uncertainty, and quantitative results absent from the abstract.

c43effab66139ceadb0935e98411fdbb6d05a5aa.goal: Maps groundwater potential to support conservation and management of groundwater resources.
c43effab66139ceadb0935e98411fdbb6d05a5aa.architecture: Convolutional neural network compared with support vector regression for spatial prediction.
c43effab66139ceadb0935e98411fdbb6d05a5aa.data: 140 groundwater survey points (70/30 split) and 15 conditioning factors including terrain indices, texture, land cover and geology.
c43effab66139ceadb0935e98411fdbb6d05a5aa.result: CNN AUC 0.843 on test data versus 0.75 for SVR, so CNN predicts groundwater potential better.
c43effab66139ceadb0935e98411fdbb6d05a5aa.open_work: Using larger inventories and testing in other aquifer settings.
c43effab66139ceadb0935e98411fdbb6d05a5aa.issues: Very small sample of 140 points for a CNN, single study area, and no hydrogeological validation beyond AUC.

31d6dd068394c143a3c9f2154a253fd4194ed62f.goal: Forecasts daily average wind speed one year ahead for wind farm planning, accounting for location-specific seasonal patterns.
31d6dd068394c143a3c9f2154a253fd4194ed62f.architecture: Back-propagation (BP) neural network, an MLP, combined with seasonal exponential adjustment to remove seasonal effects.
31d6dd068394c143a3c9f2154a253fd4194ed62f.data: Wind speed records from the Minqin area, China, 2001–2006.
31d6dd068394c143a3c9f2154a253fd4194ed62f.result: Seasonal adjustment lowers mean absolute errors compared with the unadjusted BP network.
31d6dd068394c143a3c9f2154a253fd4194ed62f.open_work: Testing at other wind farms and comparing with more advanced models.
31d6dd068394c143a3c9f2154a253fd4194ed62f.issues: Single site, simple baselines, and one-year-ahead daily forecasts of limited practical skill.

0a682944d0820ca6220013486205fe2fd7176a3b.goal: Compares hybrid decomposition-based approaches for wind speed forecasting.
0a682944d0820ca6220013486205fe2fd7176a3b.architecture: Wavelet and wavelet packet decomposition combined with time series models (ARIMA) and artificial neural networks (MLP-type).
0a682944d0820ca6220013486205fe2fd7176a3b.data: Wind speed time series; site and period are not reported here.
0a682944d0820ca6220013486205fe2fd7176a3b.result: Decomposition-based hybrids improve on single models, with wavelet packet-ANN combinations performing best in multistep forecasts.
0a682944d0820ca6220013486205fe2fd7176a3b.open_work: Extending to other sites, horizons and newer neural architectures.
0a682944d0820ca6220013486205fe2fd7176a3b.issues: Possible leakage from decomposing the full series before splitting; single dataset; deterministic forecasts.

72973298f34c8553d57c414f5ad2ff51f5847cec.goal: Compares machine learning models for forecasting river flow in a semiarid mountain region, where data are limited.
72973298f34c8553d57c414f5ad2ff51f5847cec.architecture: Artificial neural network, adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and support vector machine.
72973298f34c8553d57c414f5ad2ff51f5847cec.data: River flow records from a semiarid mountain catchment in northwestern China; details are not reported here.
72973298f34c8553d57c414f5ad2ff51f5847cec.result: Comparative performance of the three models; details are not reported here.
72973298f34c8553d57c414f5ad2ff51f5847cec.open_work: Adding snowmelt and climate inputs and testing longer lead times.
72973298f34c8553d57c414f5ad2ff51f5847cec.issues: Abstract unavailable; likely few gauges and short records, limiting generality.

e2d1964604588d8b9ad89e1b19c420a19d654707.goal: Models flood susceptibility in a tropical-cyclone-prone area to support flood risk management.
e2d1964604588d8b9ad89e1b19c420a19d654707.architecture: Neural fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) whose parameters are optimized by metaheuristic algorithms, in a GIS framework, compared with other machine learning models.
e2d1964604588d8b9ad89e1b19c420a19d654707.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors (topography, land use, soil, rainfall) for a tropical cyclone area in Vietnam.
e2d1964604588d8b9ad89e1b19c420a19d654707.result: The hybrid metaheuristic-ANFIS model is reported to outperform benchmark models; exact scores are not reported here.
e2d1964604588d8b9ad89e1b19c420a19d654707.open_work: Testing in other basins and with multi-temporal flood inventories.
e2d1964604588d8b9ad89e1b19c420a19d654707.issues: Single study area, static susceptibility, and validation on the same inventory.

8283d4e2508c9a250b84118bacde9d0014711796.goal: Interprets a deep learning model that forecasts NO2 concentrations so that forecasters can understand individual predictions.
8283d4e2508c9a250b84118bacde9d0014711796.architecture: Deep neural network forecaster explained with Shapley additive explanations (SHAP), compared with two other explanation methods.
8283d4e2508c9a250b84118bacde9d0014711796.data: NO2 air quality time series from Madrid, Spain, with associated predictors.
8283d4e2508c9a250b84118bacde9d0014711796.result: SHAP gives per-feature contributions to each prediction and is judged suitable for air quality data, giving insight into model behavior.
8283d4e2508c9a250b84118bacde9d0014711796.open_work: Using explanations to improve model design and extending to other pollutants and cities.
8283d4e2508c9a250b84118bacde9d0014711796.issues: Focus on interpretability rather than accuracy; explanation fidelity is hard to verify and correlated inputs complicate SHAP attributions.

036710b322a9715ff06c0c374da857abbf1e9cea.goal: Predicts county-level rice yield across China in a timely, scalable way to support food security under climate change.
036710b322a9715ff06c0c374da857abbf1e9cea.architecture: LASSO regression, random forest and LSTM compared within Google Earth Engine.
036710b322a9715ff06c0c374da857abbf1e9cea.data: Satellite vegetation indices (EVI) and solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF), meteorological indices and soil properties.
036710b322a9715ff06c0c374da857abbf1e9cea.result: LSTM R2 0.77–0.87 and random forest R2 0.76–0.82 beat LASSO (0.33–0.42); combining EVI and SIF helps slightly; optimal predictions come one to two months before maturity.
036710b322a9715ff06c0c374da857abbf1e9cea.open_work: Applying to other crops and data-sparse regions worldwide.
036710b322a9715ff06c0c374da857abbf1e9cea.issues: County statistics as targets; modest gain from SIF; transferability outside China untested.

fbf1078dbc349fcea590306e0aadf23eba18fc34.goal: Builds a machine learning baseline for large-scale regional crop yield forecasting comparable to the operational MARS system.
fbf1078dbc349fcea590306e0aadf23eba18fc34.architecture: Modular machine learning workflow with agronomically designed features from crop simulations, avoiding information leakage; specific algorithms compared are not named in the abstract.
fbf1078dbc349fcea590306e0aadf23eba18fc34.data: MCYFS database: crop simulation outputs, weather, remote sensing and soil data for five crops in the Netherlands, Germany and France.
fbf1078dbc349fcea590306e0aadf23eba18fc34.result: Early-season NRMSE comparable to MCYFS in many cases (e.g., 7.87 vs 6.32 for Dutch soft wheat) but about twice as large for some crop-country pairs.
fbf1078dbc349fcea590306e0aadf23eba18fc34.open_work: Adding data sources, designing better features and testing more algorithms.
fbf1078dbc349fcea590306e0aadf23eba18fc34.issues: Underperforms the operational system in several cases; regional yield statistics are short and noisy.

57ac9dfecab41c46564a121af9c766723ca2fbe6.goal: Surveys computational intelligence methods for flood management systems, including flood debris forecasting and early detection.
57ac9dfecab41c46564a121af9c766723ca2fbe6.architecture: Review of single and hybrid computational intelligence methods such as neural networks, fuzzy systems and evolutionary algorithms for flood management.
57ac9dfecab41c46564a121af9c766723ca2fbe6.data: Literature on flood prediction and flood debris management; no new dataset.
57ac9dfecab41c46564a121af9c766723ca2fbe6.result: Ensemble computational intelligence approaches are identified as highly efficient for flood prediction.
57ac9dfecab41c46564a121af9c766723ca2fbe6.open_work: Research directions for big-data flood management and debris forecasting.
57ac9dfecab41c46564a121af9c766723ca2fbe6.issues: Broad scope with limited quantitative comparison across studies.

3cb4daea75de559c4274da5f1099993b486c052b.goal: Predicts hourly solar radiation for solar energy applications by combining linear and nonlinear time series models.
3cb4daea75de559c4274da5f1099993b486c052b.architecture: Hybrid of an ARMA statistical model and a time-delay neural network (TDNN).
3cb4daea75de559c4274da5f1099993b486c052b.data: Hourly solar radiation measurements from Singapore.
3cb4daea75de559c4274da5f1099993b486c052b.result: The hybrid ARMA-TDNN model is reported to outperform the individual models; exact errors are not reported here.
3cb4daea75de559c4274da5f1099993b486c052b.open_work: Adding meteorological inputs and extending to other climates.
3cb4daea75de559c4274da5f1099993b486c052b.issues: Single site and univariate inputs; tropical cloud variability limits skill.

28ee7aa7b7037e548f06d2858e088b36bb4936b3.goal: Improves wind speed prediction for stable power grid operation given the strong randomness of wind.
28ee7aa7b7037e548f06d2858e088b36bb4936b3.architecture: Hybrid of empirical mode decomposition, LSTM/GRU recurrent neural networks for high-entropy subseries and ARIMA for low-frequency subseries.
28ee7aa7b7037e548f06d2858e088b36bb4936b3.data: Four wind speed datasets from Inner Mongolia, China.
28ee7aa7b7037e548f06d2858e088b36bb4936b3.result: RMSEs of 0.416, 0.209, 0.161 and 0.279 on the four datasets, generally lower than five comparison models.
28ee7aa7b7037e548f06d2858e088b36bb4936b3.open_work: Testing at other sites and horizons and adding meteorological inputs.
28ee7aa7b7037e548f06d2858e088b36bb4936b3.issues: Possible leakage from decomposing the full series; one region; deterministic point forecasts.

8e6cd8edf60d40abc0a103a638c4dc083ed57df1.goal: Forecasts intraday PV power using publicly available type-of-sky forecasts converted into synthetic irradiance forecasts.
8e6cd8edf60d40abc0a103a638c4dc083ed57df1.architecture: LSTM neural network, with K-means clustering to build dynamic hourly sky-type irradiance classes; compared with RNN, GRNN and extreme learning machine.
8e6cd8edf60d40abc0a103a638c4dc083ed57df1.data: Historical irradiance and PV generation at a target plant plus public city sky-type forecasts.
8e6cd8edf60d40abc0a103a638c4dc083ed57df1.result: Synthetic irradiance forecasts improve accuracy by up to 33% versus hourly categorical sky forecasts and 44.6% versus daily ones.
8e6cd8edf60d40abc0a103a638c4dc083ed57df1.open_work: Testing at other plants and integrating NWP forecasts.
8e6cd8edf60d40abc0a103a638c4dc083ed57df1.issues: Single site; accuracy depends on the quality of public sky forecasts.

11a99eeb2e7391e3c51098a6d9f86b4a9b8271f7.goal: Reconstructs naturalized daily river discharge globally at reach level, including small streams, for hydrology and the SWOT mission.
