11a99eeb2e7391e3c51098a6d9f86b4a9b8271f7.architecture: Physically based VIC land surface model and RAPID routing, calibrated and bias-corrected with machine-learning-derived global runoff characteristic maps.
11a99eeb2e7391e3c51098a6d9f86b4a9b8271f7.data: 0.1° merged precipitation (MSWEP), 2.94 million flowlines from a 90 m DEM, and over 14,000 gauges for evaluation over 35 years.
11a99eeb2e7391e3c51098a6d9f86b4a9b8271f7.result: 35% of gauges have bias within ±20% and 29% have monthly KGE of at least 0.6.
11a99eeb2e7391e3c51098a6d9f86b4a9b8271f7.open_work: Serving as a priori discharge for SWOT and improving simulations in human-impacted basins.
11a99eeb2e7391e3c51098a6d9f86b4a9b8271f7.issues: Naturalized flows ignore reservoirs and withdrawals; skill is modest at many gauges.

6e0adcc4130d42b4ebf5b2dc2d6614bd3c8dda1b.goal: Improves solar PV generation forecasting for grid integration using a stacked ensemble.
6e0adcc4130d42b4ebf5b2dc2d6614bd3c8dda1b.architecture: Stacked ensemble (DSE-XGB) with artificial neural network and LSTM base models combined by XGBoost, interpreted with SHAP.
6e0adcc4130d42b4ebf5b2dc2d6614bd3c8dda1b.data: Four solar PV generation datasets; sites are not reported in the abstract.
6e0adcc4130d42b4ebf5b2dc2d6614bd3c8dda1b.result: R2 improves by 10–12% over individual ANN, LSTM and bagging models, with consistent results across weather conditions.
6e0adcc4130d42b4ebf5b2dc2d6614bd3c8dda1b.open_work: Adding weather forecast inputs and probabilistic outputs.
6e0adcc4130d42b4ebf5b2dc2d6614bd3c8dda1b.issues: Limited data description, deterministic forecasts, and modest baselines.

319a750b99323b51c7bed96e4cdbd1ce44e7d0a4.goal: Predicts short and mid-term daily sea surface temperature anomalies, which matter for extreme weather and climate.
319a750b99323b51c7bed96e4cdbd1ce44e7d0a4.architecture: LSTM recurrent neural network and AdaBoost ensemble trained separately and averaged (LSTM-AdaBoost), after polynomial removal of seasonality.
319a750b99323b51c7bed96e4cdbd1ce44e7d0a4.data: Time series of satellite SST anomaly in the East China Sea.
319a750b99323b51c7bed96e4cdbd1ce44e7d0a4.result: For daily SSTA up to 10 days ahead, the combination outperforms LSTM, AdaBoost, optimized SVR, BPNN and a stacking variant.
319a750b99323b51c7bed96e4cdbd1ce44e7d0a4.open_work: Extending to longer leads, larger regions and multivariate predictors.
319a750b99323b51c7bed96e4cdbd1ce44e7d0a4.issues: Pointwise time series without explicit spatial context; single region; no uncertainty estimates.

d74f032a8457b8690c43fed83f52ca77ded7f02c.goal: Reviews techniques for modeling solar energy resources and systems.
d74f032a8457b8690c43fed83f52ca77ded7f02c.architecture: Review of solar radiation and PV modeling techniques, including empirical models and artificial intelligence methods such as artificial neural networks and fuzzy logic.
d74f032a8457b8690c43fed83f52ca77ded7f02c.data: Published solar radiation and PV modeling studies; no new data.
d74f032a8457b8690c43fed83f52ca77ded7f02c.result: Summarizes the strengths and weaknesses of modeling approaches; detailed conclusions are not reported here.
d74f032a8457b8690c43fed83f52ca77ded7f02c.open_work: More systematic comparison of methods and data across climates.
d74f032a8457b8690c43fed83f52ca77ded7f02c.issues: Abstract unavailable; narrative review predating deep learning methods.

b41b9e281ab76ff78fdb3ea749de70b95d950dcb.goal: Constrains global ocean methane emissions, a highly uncertain term in the atmospheric CH4 budget, despite sparse sampling.
b41b9e281ab76ff78fdb3ea749de70b95d950dcb.architecture: Machine learning models (an ensemble of artificial neural networks and random forests) mapping surface methane disequilibrium from environmental predictors.
b41b9e281ab76ff78fdb3ea749de70b95d950dcb.data: Compiled in situ dissolved CH4 measurements and gridded oceanographic predictors.
b41b9e281ab76ff78fdb3ea749de70b95d950dcb.result: Diffusive flux of 2–6 Tg CH4/yr and total oceanic emissions of 6–12 Tg CH4/yr, narrowing prior ranges by a factor of three; dominated by shallow coastal waters.
b41b9e281ab76ff78fdb3ea749de70b95d950dcb.open_work: More coastal and seafloor sampling and better constraints on ebullitive fluxes.
b41b9e281ab76ff78fdb3ea749de70b95d950dcb.issues: Sparse observations, uncertain gas transfer velocities, and extrapolation into unsampled regions.

80ec93ebe6a67de6a4be96d74e05b71025f80751.goal: Projects local urban climates worldwide, which global climate models usually do not represent explicitly.
80ec93ebe6a67de6a4be96d74e05b71025f80751.architecture: Data-driven statistical emulator trained on urban climate simulations and applied to a multi-model ensemble of Earth system models; the specific model family is not specified here.
80ec93ebe6a67de6a4be96d74e05b71025f80751.data: Urban simulations from CESM with an urban land model and CMIP5 multi-model projections.
80ec93ebe6a67de6a4be96d74e05b71025f80751.result: Urban areas warm substantially by the end of the century under high emissions, with large inter-model spread and higher heat stress.
80ec93ebe6a67de6a4be96d74e05b71025f80751.open_work: Accounting for urban expansion, adaptation and more urban-resolving models.
80ec93ebe6a67de6a4be96d74e05b71025f80751.issues: Emulator inherits biases of the training model; fixed urban extent.

b978f0d5943f729a4044324f0ef450d8a30d7887.goal: Improves day-ahead PV power forecasting by accounting for aerosol effects on surface irradiance.
b978f0d5943f729a4044324f0ef450d8a30d7887.architecture: Back-propagation artificial neural network (an MLP) using an aerosol index as an additional input to meteorological variables.
b978f0d5943f729a4044324f0ef450d8a30d7887.data: PV power output, meteorological data and aerosol index data for a PV plant in China.
b978f0d5943f729a4044324f0ef450d8a30d7887.result: Adding the aerosol index improves forecast accuracy over a model without it; numbers are not reported here.
b978f0d5943f729a4044324f0ef450d8a30d7887.open_work: Testing at more sites and with aerosol forecasts rather than observations.
b978f0d5943f729a4044324f0ef450d8a30d7887.issues: Single site and simple network; dependence on aerosol data availability.

a9629cbe607b230b5de0412afa285327a2513492.goal: Selects input variables for data-driven rainfall-runoff models automatically.
a9629cbe607b230b5de0412afa285327a2513492.architecture: Binary-coded particle swarm optimization wrapper combined with Extreme Learning Machines, a single-hidden-layer neural network.
a9629cbe607b230b5de0412afa285327a2513492.data: Rainfall and runoff records from study catchments; details are not reported here.
a9629cbe607b230b5de0412afa285327a2513492.result: The approach identifies parsimonious input sets with good forecasting performance; details are not reported here.
a9629cbe607b230b5de0412afa285327a2513492.open_work: Applying to more catchments and longer lead times.
a9629cbe607b230b5de0412afa285327a2513492.issues: Abstract unavailable; wrapper selection may be computationally expensive and sensitive to ELM randomness.

d91649df351be70c5f985c6ac94b96e572c3434b.goal: Compares machine learning models for estimating actual evapotranspiration to support irrigation management.
d91649df351be70c5f985c6ac94b96e572c3434b.architecture: M5P regression tree, bagging, random forest and support vector regression with three different input variable sets.
d91649df351be70c5f985c6ac94b96e572c3434b.data: Measurements from an experimental site in Central Florida with humid subtropical climate.
d91649df351be70c5f985c6ac94b96e572c3434b.result: The model with net radiation, sensible-heat flux, soil moisture, wind, humidity and temperature is best; a three-variable model is still satisfactory.
d91649df351be70c5f985c6ac94b96e572c3434b.open_work: Testing in other climates and with fewer inputs.
d91649df351be70c5f985c6ac94b96e572c3434b.issues: Single site; some inputs such as sensible-heat flux are rarely available.

e184f730775262869952b0b6de99d0967147301a.goal: Supports global flood mapping with deep learning by providing a georeferenced training and test dataset for Sentinel-1.
e184f730775262869952b0b6de99d0967147301a.architecture: Benchmark dataset for surface water segmentation, with baseline fully convolutional neural networks compared with backscatter thresholding.
e184f730775262869952b0b6de99d0967147301a.data: 4,831 512x512 Sentinel-1 chips covering 120,406 km2 from 11 flood events on six continents, with hand labels, JRC Landsat permanent water and Sentinel-2 derived labels.
e184f730775262869952b0b6de99d0967147301a.result: FCNN trained on Sentinel-2-derived flood labels performs best for flood and total water; thresholding is best for permanent water only.
e184f730775262869952b0b6de99d0967147301a.open_work: Adding sensors and flood events and building new models on the dataset.
e184f730775262869952b0b6de99d0967147301a.issues: Only 11 flood events; label noise in automatically generated labels.

021ad2d9279c5ee19c3f0baea743b269755bab32.goal: Forecasts short-term PV power generation, which is unstable due to irradiance and temperature variability.
021ad2d9279c5ee19c3f0baea743b269755bab32.architecture: Hybrid ensemble of two LSTM networks with an attention mechanism, combined by a fully connected layer.
021ad2d9279c5ee19c3f0baea743b269755bab32.data: Recently collected real-world PV generation datasets; sites are not reported in the abstract.
021ad2d9279c5ee19c3f0baea743b269755bab32.result: Outperforms persistence, ARIMAX, MLP and standard LSTM in all four seasons and various horizons.
021ad2d9279c5ee19c3f0baea743b269755bab32.open_work: Adding weather forecast inputs and probabilistic outputs.
021ad2d9279c5ee19c3f0baea743b269755bab32.issues: Limited data description and no quantitative gains in the abstract.

5a2ebcfa9294aaf33e9aa3a89da4a8e8bf109b68.goal: Forecasts monthly streamflow by combining wavelet decomposition with support vector machines.
5a2ebcfa9294aaf33e9aa3a89da4a8e8bf109b68.architecture: Wavelet-support vector machine (support vector regression) conjunction model, compared with a single SVM.
5a2ebcfa9294aaf33e9aa3a89da4a8e8bf109b68.data: Monthly streamflow records from rivers in Turkey.
5a2ebcfa9294aaf33e9aa3a89da4a8e8bf109b68.result: The wavelet-SVM model is reported to be more accurate than the single SVM; details are not reported here.
5a2ebcfa9294aaf33e9aa3a89da4a8e8bf109b68.open_work: Testing on other rivers and with exogenous predictors.
5a2ebcfa9294aaf33e9aa3a89da4a8e8bf109b68.issues: Possible leakage from wavelet decomposition of the full series; few stations.

3253cb434e792d5e28fe08b58317d74bd6ea5525.goal: Simulates reservoir operation (outflow) with AI models to support planning and scheduling.
3253cb434e792d5e28fe08b58317d74bd6ea5525.architecture: Back-propagation neural network, support vector regression and LSTM compared at monthly, daily and hourly scales.
3253cb434e792d5e28fe08b58317d74bd6ea5525.data: About 30 years of historical reservoir operation records.
3253cb434e792d5e28fe08b58317d74bd6ea5525.result: BP and SVR suit small data; LSTM reduces time and memory and simulates low-flow and peak-period outflow well.
3253cb434e792d5e28fe08b58317d74bd6ea5525.open_work: Generalizing to other reservoirs and multi-reservoir systems.
3253cb434e792d5e28fe08b58317d74bd6ea5525.issues: Single reservoir; reproduces historical rules rather than optimizing operation.

e06eade0ebfd2653f95dbd6ced5cc59285f87108.goal: Predicts suspended sediment load in rivers, which is hard to measure continuously.
e06eade0ebfd2653f95dbd6ced5cc59285f87108.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward MLP) compared with multiple linear and nonlinear regression and ARIMA.
e06eade0ebfd2653f95dbd6ced5cc59285f87108.data: Daily discharge, precipitation and sediment records from large US rivers including the Mississippi, Missouri and Rio Grande.
e06eade0ebfd2653f95dbd6ced5cc59285f87108.result: The ANN gives better sediment load predictions than the regression and ARIMA benchmarks.
e06eade0ebfd2653f95dbd6ced5cc59285f87108.open_work: Applying to other river systems and extreme events.
e06eade0ebfd2653f95dbd6ced5cc59285f87108.issues: Large rivers only; extreme sediment events may be underpredicted.

757e299668fd5df3b32607f7bd592cd1e5804450.goal: Reviews machine learning and deep learning for forecasting renewable energy generation for grid integration.
757e299668fd5df3b32607f7bd592cd1e5804450.architecture: Review of ML and DL models for solar, wind and other renewable forecasting, discussing strengths and limitations.
757e299668fd5df3b32607f7bd592cd1e5804450.data: Published renewable energy forecasting studies; no new data.
757e299668fd5df3b32607f7bd592cd1e5804450.result: Highlights uncertainty, variability, data availability and interpretability as key challenges.
757e299668fd5df3b32607f7bd592cd1e5804450.open_work: Robust, interpretable and uncertainty-aware forecasting models.
757e299668fd5df3b32607f7bd592cd1e5804450.issues: Broad narrative review without quantitative benchmarking.

0eafe079ba47715f311448613b7059745d68e82c.goal: Maps urban flooding from UAV imagery for fast detection of inundated areas in complex urban landscapes.
0eafe079ba47715f311448613b7059745d68e82c.architecture: Random forest classifier with 200 trees on spectral and GLCM texture features, compared with maximum likelihood, artificial neural network and SVM.
0eafe079ba47715f311448613b7059745d68e82c.data: Mini-UAV optical imagery of urban waterlogging in Yuyao, China.
0eafe079ba47715f311448613b7059745d68e82c.result: Overall accuracy 87.3% and kappa 0.746; texture features improve accuracy; RF beats ML and ANN and is similar to SVM.
0eafe079ba47715f311448613b7059745d68e82c.open_work: Applying to other cities and flood events and to multitemporal UAV data.
0eafe079ba47715f311448613b7059745d68e82c.issues: Single event and city; optical imagery limited by clouds during floods.

db7d9aa890be27ea585a9988348843ab3bfe7496.goal: Optimizes neural network models for precipitation analysis in a humid region so that drought and wet-year alarms can be issued from rainfall forecasts.
db7d9aa890be27ea585a9988348843ab3bfe7496.architecture: Artificial neural networks with tuned configurations; the specific network type and optimization settings are not specified here.
db7d9aa890be27ea585a9988348843ab3bfe7496.data: Precipitation records from a humid region; the stations and period are not reported here.
db7d9aa890be27ea585a9988348843ab3bfe7496.result: The title implies optimized neural networks can flag drought and wet years; quantitative skill is not reported here.
db7d9aa890be27ea585a9988348843ab3bfe7496.open_work: Testing across other climate regimes and comparison with standardized drought indices and physically based forecasts.
db7d9aa890be27ea585a9988348843ab3bfe7496.issues: Single-region, station-based study; generalization and uncertainty of the alarms are unclear.

8243535c6475df9876eaf8dc4494439793bf7f45.goal: Forecasts short-term wind power in Portugal to support power system operation and market bidding under variable wind generation.
8243535c6475df9876eaf8dc4494439793bf7f45.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet transform decomposition and artificial neural networks, with the network forecasting the decomposed wind power series.
8243535c6475df9876eaf8dc4494439793bf7f45.data: Historical wind power data from Portugal; the exact period and horizons are not reported here.
8243535c6475df9876eaf8dc4494439793bf7f45.result: The wavelet-neural network hybrid is reported to improve accuracy over persistence and other benchmark forecasting methods; exact error values are not given here.
8243535c6475df9876eaf8dc4494439793bf7f45.open_work: Adding numerical weather prediction inputs and probabilistic forecasts.
8243535c6475df9876eaf8dc4494439793bf7f45.issues: Uses only past power series, so skill degrades at longer horizons; single-country data and no uncertainty quantification.

e02db2febb1618a54dda5a322100877abd6b8076.goal: Detects the effect of air quality interventions in pollutant time series by removing the confounding influence of meteorology.
e02db2febb1618a54dda5a322100877abd6b8076.architecture: Meteorological normalisation based on a random forest regression of concentrations on meteorological and time variables, followed by resampling of meteorology.
e02db2febb1618a54dda5a322100877abd6b8076.data: Routine air quality monitoring observations: SO2 at Dover (port city, England) and NOx/NO2 at London Marylebone Road, with associated meteorological data.
e02db2febb1618a54dda5a322100877abd6b8076.result: Normalised series clearly show SO2 drops from stricter marine fuel sulfur limits at Dover and NO2/NOx changes tied to primary NO2 emissions at Marylebone Road, not visible in raw data.
e02db2febb1618a54dda5a322100877abd6b8076.open_work: Applying the technique to other interventions and pollutants, and formal change-point or uncertainty analysis of normalised trends.
e02db2febb1618a54dda5a322100877abd6b8076.issues: Only two sites; attribution depends on the meteorological covariates captured and gives no formal uncertainty on intervention effects.

9cceeec39cdc1199fef954200352d349d19781e2.goal: Improves accuracy and stability of short-term wind speed forecasting for wind energy planning, scheduling and control.
9cceeec39cdc1199fef954200352d349d19781e2.architecture: Hybrid LSTMDE-HELM: LSTM networks and a hysteretic extreme learning machine, with differential evolution optimizing LSTM layers and neurons, combined by a nonlinear LSTM-based mechanism.
9cceeec39cdc1199fef954200352d349d19781e2.data: Wind speed data from a wind farm in Inner Mongolia, China; 10-minute and 1-hour ahead horizons.
9cceeec39cdc1199fef954200352d349d19781e2.result: The hybrid outperforms comparison models on four performance indices and statistical tests at both horizons.
9cceeec39cdc1199fef954200352d349d19781e2.open_work: Testing at more sites and longer horizons, and adding probabilistic outputs.
9cceeec39cdc1199fef954200352d349d19781e2.issues: Single wind farm, very short horizons, complex multi-stage pipeline with costly tuning and no uncertainty estimates.

b1bbaffd68efbd31980a56235b0a4bca7ca732a8.goal: Surveys how artificial intelligence is used in renewable energy research and identifies future scope.
b1bbaffd68efbd31980a56235b0a4bca7ca732a8.architecture: Review of AI techniques such as artificial neural networks, fuzzy logic, genetic algorithms and hybrid methods applied across renewable energy sources.
b1bbaffd68efbd31980a56235b0a4bca7ca732a8.data: Literature on solar, wind and other renewable energy applications; the review period is not reported here.
b1bbaffd68efbd31980a56235b0a4bca7ca732a8.result: Summarizes the broad uptake of AI methods for forecasting, design and control of renewable energy systems.
b1bbaffd68efbd31980a56235b0a4bca7ca732a8.open_work: Points to further AI integration in renewable energy forecasting and management.
b1bbaffd68efbd31980a56235b0a4bca7ca732a8.issues: Narrative review without quantitative synthesis; predates the deep learning surge in the field.

322c70e0db11f1f0ca7cfe389f7e64ff1c7d0374.goal: Short-term wind speed forecasting that handles uncertainty and noise in wind time series.
322c70e0db11f1f0ca7cfe389f7e64ff1c7d0374.architecture: Deep neural architecture built from stacked autoencoders whose neurons use rough-set interval (upper and lower bound) representations, with a regression output layer.
322c70e0db11f1f0ca7cfe389f7e64ff1c7d0374.data: Wind speed time series; the specific sites and periods are not reported here.
322c70e0db11f1f0ca7cfe389f7e64ff1c7d0374.result: The rough deep network is reported to outperform classical and shallow neural forecasting baselines; exact errors are not given here.
322c70e0db11f1f0ca7cfe389f7e64ff1c7d0374.open_work: Extension to multi-site spatiotemporal forecasting and probabilistic outputs.
322c70e0db11f1f0ca7cfe389f7e64ff1c7d0374.issues: Univariate, point-wise evaluation on limited sites; gains over simpler models may be dataset-dependent.

d34b0401e93d491485eff5c0d2429aec25e6d8e4.goal: Maps flash-flood hazard areas in Iran to support adaptation, mitigation policy and disaster risk reduction in data-scarce regions.
d34b0401e93d491485eff5c0d2429aec25e6d8e4.architecture: Ensemble models boosted generalized linear model (GLMBoost) and random forest, plus Bayesian generalized linear model, with simulated annealing feature selection.
d34b0401e93d491485eff5c0d2429aec25e6d8e4.data: Historical flash-flood locations and conditioning factors (distance from stream, vegetation, drainage density, land use, elevation and others) for a study area in Iran.
d34b0401e93d491485eff5c0d2429aec25e6d8e4.result: High performance: accuracy 90–92%, Kappa 79–84%, success ratio 94–96%, threat score 80–84%, Heidke skill score 79–84%.
d34b0401e93d491485eff5c0d2429aec25e6d8e4.open_work: Transfer to other basins and integration with temporal flash-flood forecasting.
d34b0401e93d491485eff5c0d2429aec25e6d8e4.issues: Static susceptibility mapping depends on flood inventory quality; spatial autocorrelation between training and test points may inflate scores.

11413499875c438b3ce16fca7eecfaf21850d4d9.goal: Identifies research gaps in deep learning and remote sensing for crop yield prediction and the role of vegetation indices and environmental factors.
11413499875c438b3ce16fca7eecfaf21850d4d9.architecture: Systematic literature review of deep learning approaches (LSTM, CNN and others) combined with remote sensing for crop yield prediction.
11413499875c438b3ce16fca7eecfaf21850d4d9.data: Studies published 2012–2022 from multiple databases; MODIS satellite data are the most common source.
11413499875c438b3ce16fca7eecfaf21850d4d9.result: LSTM and CNN are the most used architectures, satellite remote sensing (especially MODIS) dominates, and vegetation indices are the most used features.
11413499875c438b3ce16fca7eecfaf21850d4d9.open_work: Improving model accuracy, practical usefulness for farmers and policymakers, and interpretability of black-box models.
11413499875c438b3ce16fca7eecfaf21850d4d9.issues: Descriptive review without meta-analysis of reported accuracies; frequently used features do not work equally for all approaches.

a735f228ea49682347bd1b47b785583cbd1c0839.goal: Improves monthly streamflow prediction by decomposing the nonstationary flow series before regression.
a735f228ea49682347bd1b47b785583cbd1c0839.architecture: Modified empirical mode decomposition (dropping the noisiest high-frequency component) combined with support vector machine regression.
a735f228ea49682347bd1b47b785583cbd1c0839.data: Monthly streamflow records from gauging stations in the Wei River basin, China.
a735f228ea49682347bd1b47b785583cbd1c0839.result: The modified EMD-SVM model outperforms plain SVM and standard EMD-SVM in monthly streamflow prediction.
a735f228ea49682347bd1b47b785583cbd1c0839.open_work: Applying the approach to other basins and longer lead times, and adding climate predictors.
a735f228ea49682347bd1b47b785583cbd1c0839.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids risk using future information if decomposition is applied to the full series; single-basin evaluation.

6f809eb0f791a8841c59a30040ba5600590374c9.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration when only limited climatic data are available in a semi-arid highland environment.
6f809eb0f791a8841c59a30040ba5600590374c9.architecture: Comparison of support vector machine, adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS), multiple regression and empirical climate-based equations.
6f809eb0f791a8841c59a30040ba5600590374c9.data: Climatic data from a semi-arid highland station in Iran, with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 as reference.
6f809eb0f791a8841c59a30040ba5600590374c9.result: SVM and ANFIS give better ET0 estimates than regression and climate-based empirical models with limited inputs.
6f809eb0f791a8841c59a30040ba5600590374c9.open_work: Testing in other climates and with other input combinations.
6f809eb0f791a8841c59a30040ba5600590374c9.issues: Single-site setting; target is itself a model (Penman-Monteith) rather than measured evapotranspiration.

f8ab26c4038931f5c9f5e1a0804dcfde6d186b58.goal: Day-ahead hourly photovoltaic power forecasting to support grid integration of solar generation.
f8ab26c4038931f5c9f5e1a0804dcfde6d186b58.architecture: Attention-based CNN-LSTM neural network with a prediction pattern using multiple relevant and target variables.
f8ab26c4038931f5c9f5e1a0804dcfde6d186b58.data: Photovoltaic power and related meteorological variables; the specific plant and period are not reported here.
f8ab26c4038931f5c9f5e1a0804dcfde6d186b58.result: The title implies improved day-ahead accuracy over baselines; quantitative results are not reported here.
f8ab26c4038931f5c9f5e1a0804dcfde6d186b58.open_work: Testing across more plants and climates and adding probabilistic forecasts.
f8ab26c4038931f5c9f5e1a0804dcfde6d186b58.issues: Details not available; likely single-site evaluation with no uncertainty quantification.

3fb05a391068a1b80127fabdb84c16c34c70597e.goal: 24-hour-ahead wind power generation forecasting to support efficient power system operation under wind uncertainty.
3fb05a391068a1b80127fabdb84c16c34c70597e.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network cascaded with a radial basis function neural network using a double Gaussian activation function; implemented in TensorFlow and Keras.
3fb05a391068a1b80127fabdb84c16c34c70597e.data: Measured wind power generation from a wind farm.
3fb05a391068a1b80127fabdb84c16c34c70597e.result: The hybrid CNN-RBFNN is more accurate than traditional methods for 24-h ahead wind power forecasting.
3fb05a391068a1b80127fabdb84c16c34c70597e.open_work: Including numerical weather prediction inputs and testing on more farms.
3fb05a391068a1b80127fabdb84c16c34c70597e.issues: Single wind farm; no quantitative error values or uncertainty estimates reported in the abstract.

7300e3670e6040e71c627cc6371d8bc0cb257265.goal: Accurate hourly day-ahead photovoltaic power forecasting that avoids physically unreasonable outputs of purely data-driven models.
7300e3670e6040e71c627cc6371d8bc0cb257265.architecture: Physics-constrained LSTM (PC-LSTM) incorporating PV domain knowledge, with a two-stage hybrid input feature selection.
7300e3670e6040e71c627cc6371d8bc0cb257265.data: Real-life PV generation datasets with meteorological inputs; sites not reported in the abstract.
7300e3670e6040e71c627cc6371d8bc0cb257265.result: PC-LSTM is more accurate and robust than standard LSTM, conventional machine learning and statistical methods, and suits sparse data.
7300e3670e6040e71c627cc6371d8bc0cb257265.open_work: Extending physical constraints and testing on more sites and horizons.

84db0086790043d474dc2ba54350e96b0812a738.goal: Improves weather-classification-based day-ahead PV power forecasting when training data for some weather types (especially extremes) are scarce.
84db0086790043d474dc2ba54350e96b0812a738.architecture: Generative adversarial network for data augmentation plus a convolutional neural network weather classifier, compared with SVM, MLP and k-nearest neighbors.
84db0086790043d474dc2ba54350e96b0812a738.data: Solar irradiance data with 33 meteorological weather types regrouped into 10 classes, augmented with GAN-generated samples.
84db0086790043d474dc2ba54350e96b0812a738.result: GAN samples capture intrinsic data features without memorization; CNN classifiers beat traditional ones, and GAN augmentation improves all classifiers.
84db0086790043d474dc2ba54350e96b0812a738.open_work: Extending to more locations and integrating classification directly with probabilistic power forecasting.
84db0086790043d474dc2ba54350e96b0812a738.issues: Single-region data; quality of synthetic samples for rare extremes is hard to verify.

9b3a4b3e5fe22f98c174f0c7f7044330eaf02655.goal: Accurate and stable wind speed forecasting for reliable wind turbine operation.
9b3a4b3e5fe22f98c174f0c7f7044330eaf02655.architecture: Decomposition (wavelet transform, EMD, EEMD, empirical wavelet transform) followed by bidirectional LSTM networks per sub-series, including variants with skip connections.
9b3a4b3e5fe22f98c174f0c7f7044330eaf02655.data: Wind speed time series; site details are not reported in the abstract.
9b3a4b3e5fe22f98c174f0c7f7044330eaf02655.result: The EWT-BiDLSTM hybrid outperforms other decomposition-based models, and BiDLSTM with skip connections gives the best accuracy.
9b3a4b3e5fe22f98c174f0c7f7044330eaf02655.open_work: Multi-step and multi-site forecasting and probabilistic outputs.
9b3a4b3e5fe22f98c174f0c7f7044330eaf02655.issues: Decomposition hybrids may leak future information if not done online; no quantitative values or uncertainty in the abstract.

2edf111509726eae4d37a52a116b729bc4c6b03f.goal: Long-term seasonal spring rainfall forecasting in Victoria, Australia, using large-scale climate modes as predictors.
2edf111509726eae4d37a52a116b729bc4c6b03f.architecture: Multilayer perceptron artificial neural network trained with Levenberg-Marquardt compared with multiple regression, using lagged ENSO and IOD indices.
2edf111509726eae4d37a52a116b729bc4c6b03f.data: Spring rainfall at stations across east, central and west Victoria with lagged ENSO and Indian Ocean Dipole indices; out-of-sample test sets.
2edf111509726eae4d37a52a116b729bc4c6b03f.result: ANN generalizes better: test correlations 0.42–0.93 (east), 0.68–0.85 (central), 0.58–0.97 (west), versus −0.99 to −0.90 for regression in east Victoria.
2edf111509726eae4d37a52a116b729bc4c6b03f.open_work: Adding other climate drivers and longer records.
2edf111509726eae4d37a52a116b729bc4c6b03f.issues: Short seasonal samples make correlations unstable; small test sets risk overfitting.

a5f4e1964046c79f4d971e86839bddb74c78b2b9.goal: Short-term solar irradiance forecasting for operation and power prediction of grid-connected PV plants under variable weather.
a5f4e1964046c79f4d971e86839bddb74c78b2b9.architecture: Artificial neural network with inputs built from statistical feature parameters of irradiance and temperature (ANN-SFP), structure set by cross-validation and trained with Levenberg-Marquardt.
a5f4e1964046c79f4d971e86839bddb74c78b2b9.data: Historical irradiance and ambient temperature series; site not reported in the abstract.
a5f4e1964046c79f4d971e86839bddb74c78b2b9.result: ANN-SFP clearly improves accuracy over a conventional ANN using historical data series, especially under variable weather.
a5f4e1964046c79f4d971e86839bddb74c78b2b9.open_work: Testing on more sites and integration with weather forecasts.
a5f4e1964046c79f4d971e86839bddb74c78b2b9.issues: Single dataset, no quantitative errors in the abstract, deterministic only.

11cc72c0ade933a1ea20ea37d31829420a9bc5c3.goal: Forecasts hourly electricity load for the Kaggle Global Energy Forecasting Competition 2012 load track.
11cc72c0ade933a1ea20ea37d31829420a9bc5c3.architecture: Component-wise gradient boosting of additive models with separate models per hour of day, using temperature and calendar effects.
11cc72c0ade933a1ea20ea37d31829420a9bc5c3.data: GEFCom2012 data: hourly load for 20 US utility zones and temperatures from 11 weather stations.
11cc72c0ade933a1ea20ea37d31829420a9bc5c3.result: The approach placed among the top entries (fifth of over 100 teams) in the competition.
11cc72c0ade933a1ea20ea37d31829420a9bc5c3.open_work: Probabilistic load forecasting and better temperature forecast handling.
11cc72c0ade933a1ea20ea37d31829420a9bc5c3.issues: Competition-specific setup; relies on temperature inputs that must themselves be forecast.

5723220f8368d56f03a1e89e5d96b25a81326181.goal: Forecasts streamflow in a semi-arid region of Iraq for water resources management.
5723220f8368d56f03a1e89e5d96b25a81326181.architecture: Extreme learning machine compared with support vector regression and generalized regression neural network.
5723220f8368d56f03a1e89e5d96b25a81326181.data: Monthly streamflow records from the Tigris River, Iraq.
5723220f8368d56f03a1e89e5d96b25a81326181.result: ELM gives more accurate forecasts and faster training than the comparison models.
5723220f8368d56f03a1e89e5d96b25a81326181.open_work: Adding climatic inputs and testing on other rivers.
5723220f8368d56f03a1e89e5d96b25a81326181.issues: Single river, univariate lagged inputs, no uncertainty quantification.

321ac07bff5491014728932506e45432015ddddd.goal: Improves rainfall time series prediction using modular soft computing approaches.
321ac07bff5491014728932506e45432015ddddd.architecture: Modular soft computing models (modular artificial neural networks and support vector regression) combined with data preprocessing; the exact configuration is not confirmed here.
321ac07bff5491014728932506e45432015ddddd.data: Rainfall time series; the stations and periods are not reported here.
321ac07bff5491014728932506e45432015ddddd.result: Modular models are reported to improve rainfall prediction over single global models; values not reported here.
321ac07bff5491014728932506e45432015ddddd.open_work: Testing longer lead times and more regions.
321ac07bff5491014728932506e45432015ddddd.issues: Rainfall series are noisy and intermittent; details of evaluation unclear.

372881e4824748c18ca974f3762f559f0324a074.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction to support grid safety and reliable power supply.
372881e4824748c18ca974f3762f559f0324a074.architecture: Artificial neural network optimized with a genetic algorithm (GA-ANN) applied to variational mode decomposition sub-series, with hierarchical clustering to select similar historical days.
372881e4824748c18ca974f3762f559f0324a074.data: Historical wind speed data; site not reported in the abstract.
372881e4824748c18ca974f3762f559f0324a074.result: Clustering captures periodic fluctuations, GA-ANN errors are lower than a BP neural network, and VMD decomposition further improves accuracy.
372881e4824748c18ca974f3762f559f0324a074.open_work: Multi-step and multi-site validation and probabilistic forecasting.
372881e4824748c18ca974f3762f559f0324a074.issues: No quantitative values or site details in the abstract; decomposition on full series may leak information.

262c4d8534bc4d75776144d37be83c518166c9e7.goal: Downscales coarse SMOS satellite soil moisture to finer resolution for hydrological applications using MODIS land surface temperature.
262c4d8534bc4d75776144d37be83c518166c9e7.architecture: Comparison of machine learning methods: artificial neural network, support vector machine, relevance vector machine and generalized linear model.
262c4d8534bc4d75776144d37be83c518166c9e7.data: SMOS soil moisture and MODIS land surface temperature over a catchment in England (Brue catchment).
262c4d8534bc4d75776144d37be83c518166c9e7.result: The artificial neural network gives the best downscaling performance among the tested methods.
262c4d8534bc4d75776144d37be83c518166c9e7.open_work: Testing in other climates and adding further predictors such as vegetation indices.
262c4d8534bc4d75776144d37be83c518166c9e7.issues: Single small catchment and limited validation against in situ soil moisture.

65c0e72fb5a503b193ddd72bb84a3fd66ffcd749.goal: Identifies flood-prone areas of the Topľa river basin, Slovakia, to update preliminary flood risk assessment.
65c0e72fb5a503b193ddd72bb84a3fd66ffcd749.architecture: Comparison of GIS multi-criteria decision making (DEMATEL-ANP), bivariate statistics (frequency ratio, statistical index), naïve Bayes tree hybrids and logistic regression.
65c0e72fb5a503b193ddd72bb84a3fd66ffcd749.data: Physical-geographical conditioning factors and historical flood points in the Topľa basin, Slovakia.
65c0e72fb5a503b193ddd72bb84a3fd66ffcd749.result: Very high and high susceptibility classes cover 20–47% of the area; DEMATEL-ANP performs best (AUC > 0.97, accuracy 0.922, HSS 0.844).
65c0e72fb5a503b193ddd72bb84a3fd66ffcd749.open_work: Use for EU Floods Directive updates and testing in other basins.
65c0e72fb5a503b193ddd72bb84a3fd66ffcd749.issues: Expert-weighted criteria are subjective; validation limited to past flood points in one basin.

63c496e1977009b4dea7c4cc41fdd4d95cf75179.goal: Constructs optimal prediction intervals for wind power generation to quantify forecast uncertainty for power system operation.
63c496e1977009b4dea7c4cc41fdd4d95cf75179.architecture: Extreme learning machine that directly outputs interval bounds, trained with particle swarm optimization on a coverage-width-based cost.
63c496e1977009b4dea7c4cc41fdd4d95cf75179.data: Wind power data from wind farms in Australia.
63c496e1977009b4dea7c4cc41fdd4d95cf75179.result: The method produces high-quality prediction intervals with good coverage and narrow width, outperforming benchmark interval methods.
63c496e1977009b4dea7c4cc41fdd4d95cf75179.open_work: Extension to multi-step and multi-farm interval forecasting.
63c496e1977009b4dea7c4cc41fdd4d95cf75179.issues: Interval quality depends on the chosen cost trade-off; limited farms and horizons.

c0478feaa4cf108787aa4aa0bcf33cfc7459aae0.goal: Demonstrates on-board AI for Earth observation to discard cloudy images, saving bandwidth and reducing latency.
c0478feaa4cf108787aa4aa0bcf33cfc7459aae0.architecture: CloudScout segmentation convolutional neural network running on an Intel Movidius Myriad 2 accelerator on the ESA Φ-sat-1 satellite.
c0478feaa4cf108787aa4aa0bcf33cfc7459aae0.data: Hyperspectral imagery from the HyperScout-2 sensor; radiation testing of the Myriad 2 hardware.
c0478feaa4cf108787aa4aa0bcf33cfc7459aae0.result: First demonstration of a deep CNN inferencing on a dedicated accelerator on board a satellite, with reliable on-board cloud detection.
c0478feaa4cf108787aa4aa0bcf33cfc7459aae0.open_work: Wider on-board AI applications and commercial uses in future missions.
c0478feaa4cf108787aa4aa0bcf33cfc7459aae0.issues: Cloud detection only; on-orbit accuracy details and generalization across scenes are not given in the abstract.

1a9e7cbc9efdd232d511cfd3201ecdadcce8baa3.goal: Forecasts low-flow hydrological time series important for water supply and drought management.
1a9e7cbc9efdd232d511cfd3201ecdadcce8baa3.architecture: Long short-term memory recurrent neural network compared with a simple recurrent neural network and naive methods.
1a9e7cbc9efdd232d511cfd3201ecdadcce8baa3.data: Daily discharge records from a river basin in India (Mahanadi basin).
1a9e7cbc9efdd232d511cfd3201ecdadcce8baa3.result: LSTM gives better low-flow forecasts than the comparison methods.
1a9e7cbc9efdd232d511cfd3201ecdadcce8baa3.open_work: Adding meteorological inputs and longer horizons.
1a9e7cbc9efdd232d511cfd3201ecdadcce8baa3.issues: Single basin, univariate inputs and no uncertainty quantification.

a339efd4859848332abf660f30f4e8c5f242ce55.goal: Improves solar radiation prediction to support model predictive control in smart buildings.
a339efd4859848332abf660f30f4e8c5f242ce55.architecture: Recurrent neural network compared with a feedforward artificial neural network, with different sampling frequencies and moving-window inputs.
a339efd4859848332abf660f30f4e8c5f242ce55.data: Actual meteorological year data from a local weather station in Alabama, USA.
a339efd4859848332abf660f30f4e8c5f242ce55.result: RNN improves NMBE by 47% and RMSE by 26% over ANN; 10-minute sampling cuts CV(RMSE) from 30.9% to 9.41% (ANN) and 9.83% to 7.64% (RNN).
a339efd4859848332abf660f30f4e8c5f242ce55.open_work: Including cloud cover information to further improve accuracy.
a339efd4859848332abf660f30f4e8c5f242ce55.issues: Single station; cloud cover strongly affects accuracy.

47e980c77d85f3f73d159c674aad8a0aac1d2f64.goal: Reviews deep learning time series models for forecasting solar irradiance and PV power.
47e980c77d85f3f73d159c674aad8a0aac1d2f64.architecture: Review of RNN, LSTM, GRU and hybrid CNN-LSTM models, compared on accuracy, inputs, horizon, season, weather and training time.
47e980c77d85f3f73d159c674aad8a0aac1d2f64.data: Published studies on solar irradiance and PV power forecasting.
47e980c77d85f3f73d159c674aad8a0aac1d2f64.result: LSTM performs best among standalone models; CNN-LSTM outperforms them but trains longer; deep models beat conventional machine learning.
47e980c77d85f3f73d159c674aad8a0aac1d2f64.open_work: Recommends relative RMSE as a standard metric for cross-study comparison.
47e980c77d85f3f73d159c674aad8a0aac1d2f64.issues: Limited to four model types; cross-study comparisons are confounded by different datasets.

e6518d960fd552af969f682c74ba7a3f5fe7056f.goal: Accurate short-term wind speed prediction for wind energy management.
e6518d960fd552af969f682c74ba7a3f5fe7056f.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet packet decomposition, convolutional neural network and convolutional LSTM network.
e6518d960fd552af969f682c74ba7a3f5fe7056f.data: Wind speed time series; sites and periods not reported here.
e6518d960fd552af969f682c74ba7a3f5fe7056f.result: The hybrid is reported to outperform benchmark models; exact errors not reported here.
e6518d960fd552af969f682c74ba7a3f5fe7056f.issues: Decomposition-based pipeline may leak future information; details not available.

a246391da5e2dd67ebdbe6ff94fe39ebb19c9465.goal: Compares univariate and multivariate one-step-ahead wind speed forecasting to assess the value of meteorological inputs.
a246391da5e2dd67ebdbe6ff94fe39ebb19c9465.architecture: Linear ARIMA model versus a nonlinear autoregressive exogenous artificial neural network (NARX).
a246391da5e2dd67ebdbe6ff94fe39ebb19c9465.data: Hourly data from La Mata, Oaxaca and 10-minute data from Metepec, Hidalgo, Mexico, with pressure, temperature, wind direction, radiation and humidity.
a246391da5e2dd67ebdbe6ff94fe39ebb19c9465.result: NARX improves on ARIMA by 5.5–10.6% (hourly) and 2.3–12.8% (10-minute) in MAE and MSE.

0c9e09d19530d841e09ad38c11ef4ab7c5bde16d.goal: Predicts solar power output using satellite imagery to capture cloud movement.
0c9e09d19530d841e09ad38c11ef4ab7c5bde16d.architecture: Support vector machine using features derived from satellite images, such as cloud motion vectors.
0c9e09d19530d841e09ad38c11ef4ab7c5bde16d.data: Satellite images over South Korea and solar power data; specific products not confirmed here.
0c9e09d19530d841e09ad38c11ef4ab7c5bde16d.result: The SVM-based method with satellite inputs is reported to outperform conventional benchmarks; values not reported here.
0c9e09d19530d841e09ad38c11ef4ab7c5bde16d.open_work: Incorporating numerical weather prediction and higher-resolution imagery.
0c9e09d19530d841e09ad38c11ef4ab7c5bde16d.issues: Limited sites; image-derived features depend on cloud motion estimation quality.

8d27fbd53db48ba151aa2b575a563e313c31e80b.goal: Compares empirical mode decomposition-based hybrid methods for short-term wind speed forecasting.
8d27fbd53db48ba151aa2b575a563e313c31e80b.architecture: Comparative study of EMD variants combined with support vector regression and artificial neural networks.
8d27fbd53db48ba151aa2b575a563e313c31e80b.data: Wind speed time series; datasets not reported here.
8d27fbd53db48ba151aa2b575a563e313c31e80b.result: Reports which EMD-based hybrids give the most accurate forecasts; specific rankings not reported here.
8d27fbd53db48ba151aa2b575a563e313c31e80b.open_work: Guidance for decomposition choices in hybrid forecasting.
8d27fbd53db48ba151aa2b575a563e313c31e80b.issues: Comparison limited to EMD family and selected learners.

4eef09c3c36e5df3e2cee9577c876bde7835328c.goal: Assesses flood susceptibility in Shangyou County, China, to help mitigate and manage floods.
4eef09c3c36e5df3e2cee9577c876bde7835328c.architecture: Convolutional neural network frameworks for classification and feature extraction with three data representations, compared with support vector machine.
4eef09c3c36e5df3e2cee9577c876bde7835328c.data: 13 flood triggering factors and historical flood events in Shangyou County, China.
4eef09c3c36e5df3e2cee9577c876bde7835328c.result: CNN classifiers score 0.022–0.054 higher AUC than SVM, and CNN feature extraction improves SVM by 0.021–0.051 AUC.
4eef09c3c36e5df3e2cee9577c876bde7835328c.open_work: Applying the frameworks to other regions.
4eef09c3c36e5df3e2cee9577c876bde7835328c.issues: Single county; spatial autocorrelation may inflate scores.

4dede7414ace0e3a93867947a9c8ca2e38be385f.goal: Daily wind speed forecasting handling nonlinear and uncertain wind data.
4dede7414ace0e3a93867947a9c8ca2e38be385f.architecture: Hybrid Kalman filter and artificial neural network built on an ARIMA model structure.
4dede7414ace0e3a93867947a9c8ca2e38be385f.data: Daily wind speed data from stations in Iraq and Malaysia.
4dede7414ace0e3a93867947a9c8ca2e38be385f.result: The hybrid KF-ANN outperforms standalone ARIMA, ANN and KF models.
4dede7414ace0e3a93867947a9c8ca2e38be385f.open_work: Testing at other horizons and sites.
4dede7414ace0e3a93867947a9c8ca2e38be385f.issues: Two sites, daily resolution only, no uncertainty quantification.

a432c702527094602fee5d6991f44b886bdf0241.goal: Short-term wind speed prediction with improved accuracy for wind power integration.
a432c702527094602fee5d6991f44b886bdf0241.architecture: Support vector regression embedded as a state-space model and filtered with an unscented Kalman filter.
a432c702527094602fee5d6991f44b886bdf0241.data: Wind speed data; sites not reported here.
a432c702527094602fee5d6991f44b886bdf0241.result: The UKF-SVR approach is reported to improve accuracy over standalone SVR and other benchmarks.
a432c702527094602fee5d6991f44b886bdf0241.issues: Limited datasets; details not available here.

dc5f5d03d800b33fb91401e6b3949d3a8989afe5.goal: Short-term wind forecasting with improved accuracy via multi-model blending and feature selection.
dc5f5d03d800b33fb91401e6b3949d3a8989afe5.architecture: Multi-model methodology with deep feature selection, first-layer learners (artificial neural network, support vector regression, gradient boosting and random forest) and a second-layer blending model.
dc5f5d03d800b33fb91401e6b3949d3a8989afe5.data: Wind data from multiple sites, reportedly from the NREL WIND Toolkit.
dc5f5d03d800b33fb91401e6b3949d3a8989afe5.result: The multi-model blended approach outperforms single-algorithm forecasts in accuracy.
dc5f5d03d800b33fb91401e6b3949d3a8989afe5.open_work: Extension to probabilistic forecasting and more horizons.
dc5f5d03d800b33fb91401e6b3949d3a8989afe5.issues: Short horizons; details of blending gains are site-dependent.

4f69164a5d5aa28ac3f23e7ae07f8ccba2db67d5.goal: Analyses climate and human drivers of wildfire burned area globally and regionally.
4f69164a5d5aa28ac3f23e7ae07f8ccba2db67d5.architecture: Statistical and machine learning regression including regression trees and random forests relating burned area to climate and human variables.
4f69164a5d5aa28ac3f23e7ae07f8ccba2db67d5.data: Global satellite burned area data with climate and socioeconomic variables.
4f69164a5d5aa28ac3f23e7ae07f8ccba2db67d5.result: Climate variables dominate globally while human factors are important regionally.
4f69164a5d5aa28ac3f23e7ae07f8ccba2db67d5.open_work: Attribution under future climate and land-use change.
4f69164a5d5aa28ac3f23e7ae07f8ccba2db67d5.issues: Correlative analysis cannot establish causation; coarse resolution.

6552b236d09a73c336f2ef4e94c4b9b5431f1431.goal: Monthly streamflow and rainfall forecasting for water resources planning and management.
6552b236d09a73c336f2ef4e94c4b9b5431f1431.architecture: Two LSTM-based hybrids: wavelet-LSTM (à trous wavelet decomposition) and convolutional LSTM (CNN feature extraction plus LSTM), compared with MLP and LSTM.
6552b236d09a73c336f2ef4e94c4b9b5431f1431.data: Two streamflow and two rainfall monthly datasets; sites not reported in the abstract.
6552b236d09a73c336f2ef4e94c4b9b5431f1431.result: LSTM is applicable to time series prediction, but WLSTM and CLSTM are superior alternatives.
6552b236d09a73c336f2ef4e94c4b9b5431f1431.open_work: Testing longer lead times and adding exogenous predictors.
6552b236d09a73c336f2ef4e94c4b9b5431f1431.issues: No quantitative values in the abstract; monthly series are short.

84d98a624a17d18ab252fa53eef93629e01f0b7f.goal: Forecasts air quality time series to support pollution warnings.
84d98a624a17d18ab252fa53eef93629e01f0b7f.architecture: Recurrent neural network with long short-term memory units, with decision trees used for input selection.
84d98a624a17d18ab252fa53eef93629e01f0b7f.data: Hourly air quality and meteorological monitoring data; specific network not confirmed here.
84d98a624a17d18ab252fa53eef93629e01f0b7f.result: The LSTM model is reported to forecast 8-hour average ozone up to 72 hours ahead with reasonable accuracy.
84d98a624a17d18ab252fa53eef93629e01f0b7f.open_work: Adding emissions and meteorological forecasts as inputs.
84d98a624a17d18ab252fa53eef93629e01f0b7f.issues: Error grows with forecast horizon; limited stations.

e43264e1d006b8a49cdab4618081e1f4ef36ab37.goal: Analyses and forecasts PM10 and PM2.5 concentrations for air quality management.
e43264e1d006b8a49cdab4618081e1f4ef36ab37.architecture: Recursive (recurrent) neural network compared with multiple linear regression and feedforward neural network.
e43264e1d006b8a49cdab4618081e1f4ef36ab37.data: PM10, PM2.5 and meteorological data from a coastal site in central Italy (Pescara).
e43264e1d006b8a49cdab4618081e1f4ef36ab37.result: The recurrent network gives better PM forecasts than the comparison models.
e43264e1d006b8a49cdab4618081e1f4ef36ab37.open_work: Extend to other sites and longer horizons.

5ea056b68a3eeb2755318b9963211d87cc39171f.goal: Surveys machine learning approaches for forecasting air pollutant concentrations so authorities can anticipate high-pollution episodes and act in advance.
5ea056b68a3eeb2755318b9963211d87cc39171f.architecture: Review of 155 papers (2011–2021) on machine learning and deep learning air quality forecasting, classified by region, predicted values, predictors, metrics and model type.
5ea056b68a3eeb2755318b9963211d87cc39171f.data: Literature collected from major scientific publication databases; no new observational data are used.
5ea056b68a3eeb2755318b9963211d87cc39171f.result: Deep learning models are widely used; the review provides a classification of studies by geography, target pollutants, predictor variables, evaluation metrics and model family.
5ea056b68a3eeb2755318b9963211d87cc39171f.open_work: Standardized benchmarks and evaluation metrics, and more consistent reporting of predictors and horizons, would ease comparison across studies.
5ea056b68a3eeb2755318b9963211d87cc39171f.issues: Coverage stops in 2021 and depends on the selection criteria; studies are compared as reported, without re-evaluation on common data.

3308dc3509886a5ffe8e30e703ab165001ebeae5.goal: Forecasts global and direct normal solar irradiance at the ground to support solar power integration, using weather forecast information as predictors.
3308dc3509886a5ffe8e30e703ab165001ebeae5.architecture: Stochastic learning methods, mainly artificial neural networks (MLP), with input selection from forecast variables; exact configuration not reported here.
3308dc3509886a5ffe8e30e703ab165001ebeae5.data: Ground irradiance measurements from a local experimental site combined with U.S. National Weather Service (NWS) forecast database variables such as sky cover.
3308dc3509886a5ffe8e30e703ab165001ebeae5.result: Using NWS forecast variables as inputs improves irradiance forecasts relative to simple reference methods; detailed skill numbers are not reported here.
3308dc3509886a5ffe8e30e703ab165001ebeae5.open_work: Extending to other sites and climates and adding satellite or sky-imager inputs for shorter horizons.
3308dc3509886a5ffe8e30e703ab165001ebeae5.issues: Single-site experiment; abstract not available, so details of horizons, metrics and baselines are not confirmed.

daa74a66896937d5c16b60f3a776789e90fe696c.goal: Improves short-term wind power prediction for grid operation by combining signal transforms, feature selection and a closed-loop forecasting scheme.
daa74a66896937d5c16b60f3a776789e90fe696c.architecture: Hybrid method based on ridgelet transforms with hybrid feature selection and closed-loop (iterative) forecasting; the learning model type is not specified in the available record.
daa74a66896937d5c16b60f3a776789e90fe696c.data: Wind power and related measurements from a wind farm; specific dataset not reported.
daa74a66896937d5c16b60f3a776789e90fe696c.result: The title suggests improved accuracy over benchmark predictors; quantitative results are not reported in the available record.
daa74a66896937d5c16b60f3a776789e90fe696c.open_work: Testing transferability across wind farms and horizons and adding probabilistic outputs.
daa74a66896937d5c16b60f3a776789e90fe696c.issues: Abstract missing; method details, data and gains could not be verified.

6c1115ade6c1dbab1fc55b1490fbc5cf450016ab.goal: Predicts daily direct solar radiation to supply a race sailboat with electricity exclusively from renewable sources.
6c1115ade6c1dbab1fc55b1490fbc5cf450016ab.architecture: Nonlinear Autoregressive Exogenous (NARX) recurrent neural network trained with periodic retraining under the sailboat operating conditions.
6c1115ade6c1dbab1fc55b1490fbc5cf450016ab.data: Solar radiation and meteorological time series relevant to the sailboat operation; specific dataset not reported in the abstract.
6c1115ade6c1dbab1fc55b1490fbc5cf450016ab.result: Best prediction performance is obtained when the network training phase is repeated periodically.
6c1115ade6c1dbab1fc55b1490fbc5cf450016ab.open_work: Validation under real sailing conditions over varying routes and coupling with on-board energy management.
6c1115ade6c1dbab1fc55b1490fbc5cf450016ab.issues: Very specific application; quantitative metrics and comparison baselines are not reported in the abstract.

ac09c599f7499786500727abae346aec6789eccc.goal: Ranks 15 common hydrological signatures by their predictability in space to guide signature selection for catchment classification and model calibration.
ac09c599f7499786500727abae346aec6789eccc.architecture: Random forest regression of signatures from catchment attributes, benchmarked against Sacramento Soil Moisture Accounting model simulations and spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I).
ac09c599f7499786500727abae346aec6789eccc.data: CAMELS dataset of 600+ U.S. catchments with climate, topography, land cover, soil and geology attributes and streamflow.
ac09c599f7499786500727abae346aec6789eccc.result: The three approaches give similar rankings; signatures with noisy spatial patterns are poorly simulated, weakly related to attributes and sensitive to discharge uncertainty.
ac09c599f7499786500727abae346aec6789eccc.open_work: Better understanding of signature drivers and better characterization of discharge uncertainties to increase signature value.
ac09c599f7499786500727abae346aec6789eccc.issues: Restricted to U.S. catchments in CAMELS; random forests capture correlation, not causal drivers.

bad46b264dcf1f0959f78f57bb72270a74af446f.goal: Forecasts daily air pollutant concentrations using meteorological conditions to support urban air quality warning.
bad46b264dcf1f0959f78f57bb72270a74af446f.architecture: Back-propagation neural network (MLP) combined with wavelet decomposition of pollutant series, with meteorological inputs.
bad46b264dcf1f0959f78f57bb72270a74af446f.data: Daily pollutant concentrations and meteorological observations from urban monitoring stations in China; exact stations and period not reported here.
bad46b264dcf1f0959f78f57bb72270a74af446f.result: Wavelet decomposition is expected to improve the BP network over the undecomposed version; quantitative results not reported here.
bad46b264dcf1f0959f78f57bb72270a74af446f.open_work: Testing at more sites and longer horizons and comparing with deep sequence models.
bad46b264dcf1f0959f78f57bb72270a74af446f.issues: Abstract missing; data, pollutants and gains not verified; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if applied to full series.

4b009f83469830ab725e6ba5743c7bb85bc74a6c.goal: Assesses how climate extremes affected the yields of nine crop species in Europe, focusing on the 2018 drought and heatwave.
4b009f83469830ab725e6ba5743c7bb85bc74a6c.architecture: Machine learning models relating regional yield anomalies to climate variables; specific model family not named in the abstract.
4b009f83469830ab725e6ba5743c7bb85bc74a6c.data: More than 82,000 regional yield records from 17 European countries since 1901, with climate data.
4b009f83469830ab725e6ba5743c7bb85bc74a6c.result: Models explain up to 65% of historical yield anomalies; 2018 losses in Northern and Eastern Europe were tied to low rainfall plus heat, offset by high Southern European yields.
4b009f83469830ab725e6ba5743c7bb85bc74a6c.open_work: Considering compound climate extremes more explicitly in yield-loss attribution.
4b009f83469830ab725e6ba5743c7bb85bc74a6c.issues: Statistical associations rather than process modelling; regional aggregation hides local management effects.

f700fe9a299fd16a8e618927a1fa70c952de269b.goal: Improves multistep-ahead photovoltaic power prediction by incorporating weather forecast data.
f700fe9a299fd16a8e618927a1fa70c952de269b.architecture: LSTM network combined with a self-attention mechanism, using weather forecast variables as inputs.
f700fe9a299fd16a8e618927a1fa70c952de269b.data: Measured PV power and weather forecast data for a PV system; site and period not reported here.
f700fe9a299fd16a8e618927a1fa70c952de269b.result: The title implies the LSTM with self-attention improves multistep predictions over baselines; numbers not reported here.
f700fe9a299fd16a8e618927a1fa70c952de269b.open_work: Testing on more PV systems and climates and adding probabilistic outputs.
f700fe9a299fd16a8e618927a1fa70c952de269b.issues: Abstract missing; performance depends on the quality of the weather forecast inputs.

d70dd46fcf7caebb3494c4bb289952e8fba85cef.goal: Compares LSTM networks with other methods for day-ahead global horizontal irradiance forecasting using satellite-derived data.
d70dd46fcf7caebb3494c4bb289952e8fba85cef.architecture: LSTM recurrent neural networks compared with benchmark models such as gradient boosting and feed-forward neural networks.
d70dd46fcf7caebb3494c4bb289952e8fba85cef.data: Satellite-derived GHI and weather data for multiple locations; exact product and sites not reported here.
d70dd46fcf7caebb3494c4bb289952e8fba85cef.result: LSTM is reported to outperform the competing models for day-ahead GHI; exact skill scores not reported here.
d70dd46fcf7caebb3494c4bb289952e8fba85cef.open_work: Extending to intraday horizons and probabilistic forecasts.
d70dd46fcf7caebb3494c4bb289952e8fba85cef.issues: Abstract missing; satellite-derived data introduce retrieval errors relative to ground measurements.

86877ee74043eaeebb786f2a40ed109f766f6f59.goal: Reviews machine learning for crop yield prediction with emphasis on palm oil yield.
86877ee74043eaeebb786f2a40ed109f766f6f59.architecture: Review of machine learning crop yield prediction methods, features and palm oil applications, proposing a prospective ML architecture for palm oil yield prediction.
86877ee74043eaeebb786f2a40ed109f766f6f59.data: Published literature on crop yield prediction and palm oil; no new data.
86877ee74043eaeebb786f2a40ed109f766f6f59.result: Summarizes widely used features and algorithms, advantages and challenges, and covers remote sensing, disease recognition, mapping and tree counting.
86877ee74043eaeebb786f2a40ed109f766f6f59.open_work: Developing efficient palm oil yield models, optimal feature and algorithm selection, and wider use of remote sensing.
86877ee74043eaeebb786f2a40ed109f766f6f59.issues: Proposed architecture is conceptual and not tested; review methodology not quantified in the abstract.

662a7984601f7a13ff833d6de350ea9f3e3bde3b.goal: Maps surface water from multispectral satellite imagery and separates it from land, snow, ice, clouds and shadows.
662a7984601f7a13ff833d6de350ea9f3e3bde3b.architecture: DeepWaterMap, a fully convolutional neural network (CNN) for per-pixel water segmentation.
662a7984601f7a13ff833d6de350ea9f3e3bde3b.data: Landsat multispectral imagery with reference water masks from existing global inland water datasets.
662a7984601f7a13ff833d6de350ea9f3e3bde3b.result: The CNN produces accurate surface water maps and distinguishes water from snow, ice, clouds and shadows better than index-based approaches.
662a7984601f7a13ff833d6de350ea9f3e3bde3b.open_work: Applying to other sensors and to temporal water dynamics at global scale.
662a7984601f7a13ff833d6de350ea9f3e3bde3b.issues: Accuracy depends on the quality of the reference labels; turbid or small water bodies remain difficult.

3384bf9640569f7411ddc6db5bb1e9d829bdb532.goal: Compares modern machine learning algorithms for rainfall time-series forecasting.
3384bf9640569f7411ddc6db5bb1e9d829bdb532.architecture: Comparison of LSTM, stacked LSTM, bidirectional LSTM, XGBoost and an AutoML ensemble for rainfall forecasting.
3384bf9640569f7411ddc6db5bb1e9d829bdb532.data: Hourly weather observations from several UK cities; exact source not confirmed here.
3384bf9640569f7411ddc6db5bb1e9d829bdb532.result: Bidirectional and stacked LSTM networks with few hidden layers are reported to perform best; numbers not reported here.
3384bf9640569f7411ddc6db5bb1e9d829bdb532.open_work: Testing in other climates and at longer horizons with physically informed inputs.
3384bf9640569f7411ddc6db5bb1e9d829bdb532.issues: Abstract missing; limited regions; point time series ignore spatial information.

a9e3a234a8cbfc75b598af193fe7d314d40cc153.goal: Produces a flash-flood susceptibility map for the Bâsca Chiojdului River Basin in Romania to support disaster management.
a9e3a234a8cbfc75b598af193fe7d314d40cc153.architecture: Classification and regression tree (CART) and tree ensembles: random forest, boosted regression trees and XGBoost.
a9e3a234a8cbfc75b598af193fe7d314d40cc153.data: 962 flash-flood locations from orthophotomaps and field surveys with conditioning factors such as slope, LULC, soil groups, lithology, TWI, TPI and SPI.
a9e3a234a8cbfc75b598af193fe7d314d40cc153.result: Random forest achieves the highest AUC (0.956), followed by BRT (0.899), XGBoost (0.892) and CART (0.868); slope is the most important factor.
a9e3a234a8cbfc75b598af193fe7d314d40cc153.open_work: Transfer to other basins and inclusion of rainfall and dynamic factors.
a9e3a234a8cbfc75b598af193fe7d314d40cc153.issues: Single basin; static susceptibility only, no temporal prediction; inventory from orthophotos may be incomplete.

7e584295edb972f4602b247c728c64b8e1fc200d.goal: Improves daily rainfall prediction by combining data preprocessing with machine learning models.
7e584295edb972f4602b247c728c64b8e1fc200d.architecture: Hybrid model coupling singular spectrum analysis with artificial neural network (MLP) and support vector regression components.
7e584295edb972f4602b247c728c64b8e1fc200d.data: Daily rainfall series from rain gauges in China; exact stations not confirmed here.
7e584295edb972f4602b247c728c64b8e1fc200d.result: SSA preprocessing is reported to improve rainfall prediction over models without it; numbers not reported here.
7e584295edb972f4602b247c728c64b8e1fc200d.open_work: Extending to longer lead times and to more stations and climates.
7e584295edb972f4602b247c728c64b8e1fc200d.issues: Abstract missing; decomposition on full series can leak future information; details not verified.

fd9fe160c10f1cbc0775713df5e7952be87d5b2e.goal: Evaluates hybrid statistical and machine learning approaches for forecasting wind speed and wind power generation time series.
fd9fe160c10f1cbc0775713df5e7952be87d5b2e.architecture: Hybrid ARIMA with artificial neural network and support vector machine models, compared with single models.
fd9fe160c10f1cbc0775713df5e7952be87d5b2e.data: Wind speed and wind power generation time series; sites and period not reported here.
fd9fe160c10f1cbc0775713df5e7952be87d5b2e.result: Hybrid approaches are reported not to consistently outperform single models; numbers not reported here.
fd9fe160c10f1cbc0775713df5e7952be87d5b2e.open_work: Developing guidelines for when hybridization helps and testing longer horizons.
fd9fe160c10f1cbc0775713df5e7952be87d5b2e.issues: Abstract missing; results may depend on site and data resolution.

9598eef9d973a6bae4cf4de222e2b173d3f68b79.goal: Improves PM2.5 forecasting at 1–8 h horizons by using information from nearby industrial and external pollution source stations.
9598eef9d973a6bae4cf4de222e2b173d3f68b79.architecture: Aggregated LSTM (ALSTM) combining three LSTM networks for local, nearby industrial and external source stations.
9598eef9d973a6bae4cf4de222e2b173d3f68b79.data: Taiwan Environmental Protection Agency monitoring data with 17 attributes, 2012–2017 training, 2018 testing.
9598eef9d973a6bae4cf4de222e2b173d3f68b79.result: ALSTM improves accuracy over SVR, gradient boosted tree regression and a single LSTM in MAE, RMSE and MAPE.
9598eef9d973a6bae4cf4de222e2b173d3f68b79.open_work: Extending to more regions, longer horizons and including meteorological forecasts.
9598eef9d973a6bae4cf4de222e2b173d3f68b79.issues: Single region; specific numbers not given in the abstract; no uncertainty estimates.

f61eb8fbe8888cf7a8b0904cf24b595485e5ad91.goal: Evaluates machine learning models for estimating daily reference evapotranspiration, useful for irrigation scheduling where full meteorological data are lacking.
f61eb8fbe8888cf7a8b0904cf24b595485e5ad91.architecture: Random forest and generalized regression neural network (GRNN) compared with empirical ET0 equations.
f61eb8fbe8888cf7a8b0904cf24b595485e5ad91.data: Daily meteorological records from weather stations in China, with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 as reference; exact stations not confirmed here.
f61eb8fbe8888cf7a8b0904cf24b595485e5ad91.result: Both machine learning models are reported to estimate ET0 satisfactorily, outperforming temperature-based empirical formulas; numbers not reported here.
f61eb8fbe8888cf7a8b0904cf24b595485e5ad91.open_work: Testing generalization across climates and spatially between stations.
f61eb8fbe8888cf7a8b0904cf24b595485e5ad91.issues: Abstract missing; few stations; details of input combinations not verified.

b7ab6bee5ecf5ee7bb4563250cee91942267d032.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting using numerical weather prediction inputs.
b7ab6bee5ecf5ee7bb4563250cee91942267d032.architecture: Deep belief network (DBN) with k-means clustering to select representative NWP samples as inputs.
b7ab6bee5ecf5ee7bb4563250cee91942267d032.data: NWP data and measured wind power from the Sotavento wind farm in Spain.
b7ab6bee5ecf5ee7bb4563250cee91942267d032.result: DBN errors are mostly small, with accuracy over 44% better than back-propagation and Morlet wavelet neural networks.
b7ab6bee5ecf5ee7bb4563250cee91942267d032.open_work: Testing at more wind farms and producing probabilistic forecasts.
b7ab6bee5ecf5ee7bb4563250cee91942267d032.issues: Single wind farm; baselines are relatively weak shallow networks.

25cdc8e62a045ea379096ca0c09ed205335dbc17.goal: Examines artificial neural networks for nonlinear weather forecasting, specifically maximum temperature.
25cdc8e62a045ea379096ca0c09ed205335dbc17.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) tested with different transfer functions, hidden layers and neuron counts.
25cdc8e62a045ea379096ca0c09ed205335dbc17.data: Weather observations used to forecast maximum temperature for 365 days of a year; data source not specified in the abstract.
25cdc8e62a045ea379096ca0c09ed205335dbc17.result: ANN models are shown to be applicable for maximum temperature prediction, with performance varying with network configuration.
25cdc8e62a045ea379096ca0c09ed205335dbc17.open_work: Comparing against NWP and statistical baselines and extending to other variables.
25cdc8e62a045ea379096ca0c09ed205335dbc17.issues: Small, poorly described dataset; no rigorous baselines or quantitative metrics in the abstract.

d897bfd2e8b28ee79f1a5630f020813a646ba87c.goal: Forecasts hourly solar radiation accurately over multi-step horizons for solar energy management.
d897bfd2e8b28ee79f1a5630f020813a646ba87c.architecture: BiLSTM (bidirectional LSTM) with CEEMDAN decomposition, ACF/PACF input selection and sine cosine algorithm hyperparameter optimization.
d897bfd2e8b28ee79f1a5630f020813a646ba87c.data: Hourly solar radiation series from four real-world datasets; sites not specified in the abstract.
d897bfd2e8b28ee79f1a5630f020813a646ba87c.result: The integrated model outperforms seven comparison models for all datasets and horizons.
d897bfd2e8b28ee79f1a5630f020813a646ba87c.open_work: Testing with exogenous meteorological inputs and probabilistic forecasts.
d897bfd2e8b28ee79f1a5630f020813a646ba87c.issues: Univariate decomposition approach; decomposition on full series may leak information; numbers not given in the abstract.

591e895007472818eb11515ec11aa8438c2a6773.goal: Analyzes and validates 24-hour-ahead forecasting of photovoltaic plant output power.
591e895007472818eb11515ec11aa8438c2a6773.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward MLP) driven by day-ahead weather forecasts.
591e895007472818eb11515ec11aa8438c2a6773.data: Measured PV output from a PV plant and weather forecast data; site details not confirmed here.
591e895007472818eb11515ec11aa8438c2a6773.result: The network provides usable day-ahead PV power forecasts; error figures not reported here.
591e895007472818eb11515ec11aa8438c2a6773.open_work: Hybridizing with physical clear-sky models and evaluating across seasons and sites.
591e895007472818eb11515ec11aa8438c2a6773.issues: Abstract missing; forecast quality limited by weather forecast errors, especially on cloudy days.

6f82c099d235f63bae214f98ba862d8cd1b4cf12.goal: Compares neural network and empirical models for predicting daily global solar radiation across climate zones in China.
6f82c099d235f63bae214f98ba862d8cd1b4cf12.architecture: Three artificial neural networks (MLP, generalized regression neural network, radial basis neural network) compared with an improved Bristow-Campbell model.
6f82c099d235f63bae214f98ba862d8cd1b4cf12.data: Daily air temperature, pressure, humidity, vapour pressure and sunshine duration at 12 stations in different climatic zones, 1961–2014.
6f82c099d235f63bae214f98ba862d8cd1b4cf12.result: MLP and RBNN outperform GRNN and the improved Bristow-Campbell model; MLP MAE 1.53–2.29 and RMSE 1.94–3.27 MJ m-2 day-1.
6f82c099d235f63bae214f98ba862d8cd1b4cf12.open_work: Improving prediction of high radiation values and transfer between stations.
6f82c099d235f63bae214f98ba862d8cd1b4cf12.issues: ANNs underestimate some high radiation values, likely from differences in training and test distributions.

cc23d61fc8d72bef80218b6402ef437378793c8e.goal: Retrieves ocean colour products in normal and extremely optically complex coastal and inland waters from Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-3.
cc23d61fc8d72bef80218b6402ef437378793c8e.architecture: Case-2 Regional CoastColour (C2RCC) processor: neural networks (MLP) inverting reflectances to inherent optical properties and concentrations, extended for extreme waters.
cc23d61fc8d72bef80218b6402ef437378793c8e.data: Training on simulated reflectances from radiative transfer modelling, applied to Sentinel-2 MSI and Sentinel-3 OLCI.
cc23d61fc8d72bef80218b6402ef437378793c8e.result: Describes the evolution of C2RCC for the new sensors and extended training ranges for extreme waters; quantitative validation not reported here.
cc23d61fc8d72bef80218b6402ef437378793c8e.open_work: Broader in-situ validation and refinement of bio-optical models for extreme waters.
cc23d61fc8d72bef80218b6402ef437378793c8e.issues: Relies on simulated training data and assumed bio-optical models; abstract not available.

a9696ed8abbe9b9ceb4820ded30d96dade7328f6.goal: Improves wind speed prediction for wind power systems using signal decomposition with neural networks.
a9696ed8abbe9b9ceb4820ded30d96dade7328f6.architecture: Hybrid model combining empirical mode decomposition (EMD) with artificial neural networks (MLP).
a9696ed8abbe9b9ceb4820ded30d96dade7328f6.data: Measured wind speed time series; site and period not reported here.
a9696ed8abbe9b9ceb4820ded30d96dade7328f6.result: The EMD-ANN hybrid is reported to improve over the ANN alone; numbers not reported here.
a9696ed8abbe9b9ceb4820ded30d96dade7328f6.open_work: Using improved decompositions and multi-step horizons.
a9696ed8abbe9b9ceb4820ded30d96dade7328f6.issues: Abstract missing; decomposition on full series may leak future information.

82a32d99b23afabc552d80be0ebcf2302ef66cc3.goal: Forecasts short-term PM2.5 concentration from meteorological factors.
82a32d99b23afabc552d80be0ebcf2302ef66cc3.architecture: CBGRU, combining 1D convolutional neural networks (CNN) with bidirectional gated recurrent units (GRU).
82a32d99b23afabc552d80be0ebcf2302ef66cc3.data: Beijing PM2.5 data set from the UCI Machine Learning Repository.
82a32d99b23afabc552d80be0ebcf2302ef66cc3.result: CBGRU yields lower errors and better prediction than traditional models.
82a32d99b23afabc552d80be0ebcf2302ef66cc3.open_work: Testing on more cities and multi-site data and longer horizons.
82a32d99b23afabc552d80be0ebcf2302ef66cc3.issues: Single public benchmark dataset; quantitative gains not stated in the abstract.

aa88135057ffa43a7bcdd4871de09026849ef05a.goal: Reviews AI methods for photovoltaic output power forecasting needed for grid integration.
aa88135057ffa43a7bcdd4871de09026849ef05a.architecture: Review of machine learning, deep learning and hybrid methods for PV power forecasting, with emphasis on deep learning and future trends.
aa88135057ffa43a7bcdd4871de09026849ef05a.data: Published literature on PV forecasting; no new data.
aa88135057ffa43a7bcdd4871de09026849ef05a.result: Highlights growing use of deep learning and hybrid methods, especially for multistep-ahead prediction.
aa88135057ffa43a7bcdd4871de09026849ef05a.open_work: Future trends in deep learning for PV forecasting, including multistep prediction.
aa88135057ffa43a7bcdd4871de09026849ef05a.issues: Narrative review; no quantitative meta-analysis reported in the abstract.

c03aaeb3356b9fe22714998fe87b9326dae2c258.goal: Improves wind power forecasting to ease peak load and frequency regulation pressure on power systems.
c03aaeb3356b9fe22714998fe87b9326dae2c258.architecture: LSTM with an enhanced forget gate (LSTM-EFG), with features from correlated turbine groups selected by spectral clustering.
c03aaeb3356b9fe22714998fe87b9326dae2c258.data: Wind turbine group power and feature data from a wind farm; dataset not specified in the abstract.
c03aaeb3356b9fe22714998fe87b9326dae2c258.result: With spectral clustering, accuracy improves by 18.3% over other forecasting models and convergence is faster.
c03aaeb3356b9fe22714998fe87b9326dae2c258.open_work: Testing on other farms and horizons and adding meteorological forecasts.
c03aaeb3356b9fe22714998fe87b9326dae2c258.issues: Data source and baselines not detailed in the abstract.

9844b3abb0c9b340adf395fbe056fe816878ae85.goal: Predicts the water-energy partitioning parameter of the Budyko framework to assess global water availability.
9844b3abb0c9b340adf395fbe056fe816878ae85.architecture: Neural network (MLP) predicting Fu's equation parameter from local (slope, NDVI) and global (geolocation) factors.
9844b3abb0c9b340adf395fbe056fe816878ae85.data: 224 small U.S. basins and 32 large global basins; predictions for ~36,600 basins checked against a satellite-based ET product.
9844b3abb0c9b340adf395fbe056fe816878ae85.result: Predicted mean annual ET agrees with the independent satellite ET product (R2 = 0.72).
9844b3abb0c9b340adf395fbe056fe816878ae85.open_work: Adding more controlling factors and assessing changes under climate change.
9844b3abb0c9b340adf395fbe056fe816878ae85.issues: Validation against a satellite product with its own errors; mean annual scale only.

3aa84e37b798ad1c815f9d7e375380a876554209.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for wind power scheduling.
3aa84e37b798ad1c815f9d7e375380a876554209.architecture: Hybrid of crow search algorithm, wavelet transform, entropy and mutual information feature selection, and LSTM neural networks.
3aa84e37b798ad1c815f9d7e375380a876554209.data: Wind speed data from Sotavento (Galicia, Spain) and Kerman (Iran).
3aa84e37b798ad1c815f9d7e375380a876554209.result: The proposed method is more efficient and accurate than several existing wind speed forecasting methods.
3aa84e37b798ad1c815f9d7e375380a876554209.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and testing at more sites.
3aa84e37b798ad1c815f9d7e375380a876554209.issues: Quantitative gains not stated in the abstract; complex pipeline adds tuning burden.

e8591e1303e7abe7a3edce2c273486a55b40802c.goal: Provides easy public access to PERSIANN satellite precipitation datasets.
e8591e1303e7abe7a3edce2c273486a55b40802c.architecture: Dataset and data portal paper describing PERSIANN, PERSIANN-CCS and PERSIANN-CDR, precipitation estimates from remotely sensed data using artificial neural networks.
e8591e1303e7abe7a3edce2c273486a55b40802c.data: Satellite infrared-based global precipitation products PERSIANN, PERSIANN-CCS and PERSIANN-CDR.
e8591e1303e7abe7a3edce2c273486a55b40802c.result: Presents the CHRS Data Portal, an overview of the PERSIANN algorithms and datasets, and procedures to access the data.
e8591e1303e7abe7a3edce2c273486a55b40802c.open_work: Adding new products and user features to the portal.
e8591e1303e7abe7a3edce2c273486a55b40802c.issues: Describes data access, not new validation; product biases inherited from infrared-based estimation.

d8b92024ad9e852535d66ddbf4aa3ee04983c41c.goal: Forecasts daily river water levels to support flood and water resources management.
d8b92024ad9e852535d66ddbf4aa3ee04983c41c.architecture: Wavelet decomposition combined with artificial intelligence models such as artificial neural networks and ANFIS.
d8b92024ad9e852535d66ddbf4aa3ee04983c41c.data: Daily water level records from river gauging stations; exact sites not confirmed here.
d8b92024ad9e852535d66ddbf4aa3ee04983c41c.result: Wavelet-based hybrids are reported to outperform the corresponding single models; numbers not reported here.
d8b92024ad9e852535d66ddbf4aa3ee04983c41c.open_work: Extending to longer lead times and other basins.
d8b92024ad9e852535d66ddbf4aa3ee04983c41c.issues: Abstract missing; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if not done causally.

a5ae44c6f7076d4ce00dbe954f8f78f10091a8c3.goal: Reviews AI techniques for modelling and performance prediction of solar photovoltaic systems.
a5ae44c6f7076d4ce00dbe954f8f78f10091a8c3.architecture: Review of 122 articles (2009–2019) on artificial neural networks, fuzzy logic, genetic algorithms and hybrid models for PV systems and solar radiation.
a5ae44c6f7076d4ce00dbe954f8f78f10091a8c3.data: Published literature: 90 articles on PV systems and 32 on solar radiation prediction.
a5ae44c6f7076d4ce00dbe954f8f78f10091a8c3.result: ANN, FL, GA and hybrid models are found suitable and reliable for solar radiation and PV performance prediction.
a5ae44c6f7076d4ce00dbe954f8f78f10091a8c3.open_work: Guidance for selecting prediction tools; newer deep learning methods are beyond the review scope.
a5ae44c6f7076d4ce00dbe954f8f78f10091a8c3.issues: Ends in 2019; little coverage of deep learning; no quantitative meta-analysis.

2c87e6e4d98a60a82982b3d01a0157b7907eca77.goal: Organizes AI-based deterministic solar power forecasting methods into a taxonomy.
2c87e6e4d98a60a82982b3d01a0157b7907eca77.architecture: Review and taxonomy of machine learning and deep learning solar forecasting models, optimizers and prediction frameworks.
2c87e6e4d98a60a82982b3d01a0157b7907eca77.data: Published literature on solar power forecasting; no new data.
2c87e6e4d98a60a82982b3d01a0157b7907eca77.result: Provides a taxonomy and discusses challenges and future directions in AI-based solar forecasting.
