2c87e6e4d98a60a82982b3d01a0157b7907eca77.open_work: Future research directions identified by the authors, including improved models and frameworks.
2c87e6e4d98a60a82982b3d01a0157b7907eca77.issues: Limited to deterministic forecasting; no quantitative comparison reported in the abstract.

8326115349a9f00ebebf53a24e04e6d50a683f47.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting through secondary decomposition of the wind series.
8326115349a9f00ebebf53a24e04e6d50a683f47.architecture: Secondary decomposition (wavelet packet decomposition followed by ensemble empirical mode decomposition) with Elman recurrent neural networks.
8326115349a9f00ebebf53a24e04e6d50a683f47.data: Measured wind speed time series; sites not reported here.
8326115349a9f00ebebf53a24e04e6d50a683f47.result: Secondary decomposition is reported to improve accuracy over single decomposition and Elman network alone; numbers not reported here.
8326115349a9f00ebebf53a24e04e6d50a683f47.open_work: Multi-step and probabilistic forecasting and comparison with deep sequence models.
8326115349a9f00ebebf53a24e04e6d50a683f47.issues: Abstract missing; decomposition-based setups can leak future information.

1b78adc60cebe7b672ca8b22e1c148b79473e206.goal: Predicts flash-flood susceptibility in a tropical typhoon-prone area of Northwest Vietnam.
1b78adc60cebe7b672ca8b22e1c148b79473e206.architecture: Extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer neural network) optimized with particle swarm optimization (PSO-ELM), compared with MLP, SVM and C4.5 decision tree.
1b78adc60cebe7b672ca8b22e1c148b79473e206.data: Geospatial database of 654 flash flood locations and 12 factors including elevation, slope, NDVI, soil, lithology and rainfall.
1b78adc60cebe7b672ca8b22e1c148b79473e206.result: PSO-ELM achieves kappa 0.801, RMSE 0.281, MAE 0.079, R2 0.829 and AUC 0.954, outperforming the benchmarks.
1b78adc60cebe7b672ca8b22e1c148b79473e206.open_work: Testing in other regions and adding dynamic rainfall information.
1b78adc60cebe7b672ca8b22e1c148b79473e206.issues: Single study area; static susceptibility, not event forecasting.

bf3f1eab3d3fd339aa920b866babbf1b90ad586c.goal: Reviews ML and deep learning approaches for crop yield prediction to support food security and resource management.
bf3f1eab3d3fd339aa920b866babbf1b90ad586c.architecture: Systematic literature review of machine learning (random forest, ANN, SVM) and deep learning (CNN, LSTM, DNN) for crop yield prediction.
bf3f1eab3d3fd339aa920b866babbf1b90ad586c.data: Published studies; highlights inputs such as temperature, rainfall, soil type, humidity and vegetation indices (NDVI, EVI, LAI, NDWI).
bf3f1eab3d3fd339aa920b866babbf1b90ad586c.result: Random forest, ANN and SVM are most used in ML; CNN, LSTM and DNN emerge as promising deep learning candidates.
bf3f1eab3d3fd339aa920b866babbf1b90ad586c.open_work: Addressing geographical diversity, crop heterogeneity and changing environmental conditions.
bf3f1eab3d3fd339aa920b866babbf1b90ad586c.issues: Qualitative synthesis; no quantitative comparison reported in the abstract.

65718036b29b6e039f8136f0851d6ba63bee7853.goal: Analyzes and predicts air quality in Indian cities using machine learning.
65718036b29b6e039f8136f0851d6ba63bee7853.architecture: Comparison of five machine learning models including Gaussian Naive Bayes, support vector machine and XGBoost, with resampling for class imbalance.
65718036b29b6e039f8136f0851d6ba63bee7853.data: Six years of air pollution data from 23 Indian cities.
65718036b29b6e039f8136f0851d6ba63bee7853.result: Gaussian Naive Bayes has the highest accuracy and SVM the lowest; XGBoost shows the highest linearity between predicted and actual values.
65718036b29b6e039f8136f0851d6ba63bee7853.open_work: Adding meteorological predictors and forecasting at future horizons.
65718036b29b6e039f8136f0851d6ba63bee7853.issues: Mixed classification/regression framing; pollutant drop in pandemic year 2020 may affect generalization.

6b1e75abeae1f5d3c3bdaee554b1122b77549eda.goal: Forecasts county-level corn yields in the US Corn Belt early in the season with machine learning ensembles.
6b1e75abeae1f5d3c3bdaee554b1122b77549eda.architecture: Machine learning ensembles (optimized weighted, average and stacked LASSO ensembles) of base learners, built with blocked sequential procedures.
6b1e75abeae1f5d3c3bdaee554b1122b77549eda.data: County-level corn yields and weather, soil and management data for Illinois, Indiana and Iowa.
6b1e75abeae1f5d3c3bdaee554b1122b77549eda.result: Weighted and average ensembles reach RRMSE 9.5%; stacked LASSO has least bias (MBE 53 kg/ha); forecasts with RRMSE 9.2% are possible by June 1.
6b1e75abeae1f5d3c3bdaee554b1122b77549eda.open_work: Extending to other crops and regions and refining ensemble feature importance.
6b1e75abeae1f5d3c3bdaee554b1122b77549eda.issues: Limited to three states; stacked ensembles underperform for time-series data.

686d19b209279a615df5ed6533f1ee103d19df31.goal: Quantifies three decades of surface water extent dynamics in a semi-arid region at subcontinental scale.
686d19b209279a615df5ed6533f1ee103d19df31.architecture: Supervised classification of seasonally continuous Landsat time series, using a random forest classifier.
686d19b209279a615df5ed6533f1ee103d19df31.data: Landsat TM/ETM+ time series over roughly 25 years covering the Murray-Darling Basin, Australia.
686d19b209279a615df5ed6533f1ee103d19df31.result: Produces seasonal surface water maps showing strong variability linked to drought and flood periods; accuracy figures not reported here.
686d19b209279a615df5ed6533f1ee103d19df31.open_work: Linking water dynamics to climate drivers and extending with newer sensors.
686d19b209279a615df5ed6533f1ee103d19df31.issues: Abstract missing; cloud and Landsat 7 gaps limit continuity; small water bodies hard to detect.

b371b763a20b2fde9eea880cd56305d430f49dc0.goal: Reviews deep learning methods for wind and solar energy forecasting to support power system operation.
b371b763a20b2fde9eea880cd56305d430f49dc0.architecture: Review and taxonomy of deep learning wind and solar forecasting over five years, including hybrid models, RNN (LSTM, GRU) and CNN.
b371b763a20b2fde9eea880cd56305d430f49dc0.data: Published studies; discusses datasets, preprocessing, and deterministic and probabilistic methods.
b371b763a20b2fde9eea880cd56305d430f49dc0.result: Hybrid models are most used, followed by LSTM/GRU recurrent networks and CNNs; probabilistic and multistep forecasting are gaining attention.
b371b763a20b2fde9eea880cd56305d430f49dc0.open_work: Current challenges and future directions, including probabilistic and multistep forecasting.
b371b763a20b2fde9eea880cd56305d430f49dc0.issues: Limited to five years of literature; no quantitative benchmark across studies.

51481afdbc9af75ab7de774d1606d02703bbe729.goal: Forecasts six monthly climate variables one month ahead for Jinan, China, to support disaster prevention, flood control and drought planning.
51481afdbc9af75ab7de774d1606d02703bbe729.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM (convolutional neural network feeding a long short-term memory network), compared with an MLP-type ANN, a simple RNN, a standalone LSTM and a standalone CNN; inputs are 12 lagged months.
51481afdbc9af75ab7de774d1606d02703bbe729.data: Monthly station records for Jinan, 1951–2022: mean, extreme minimum and extreme maximum air temperature, precipitation, mean relative humidity and sunshine hours.
51481afdbc9af75ab7de774d1606d02703bbe729.result: CNN-LSTM gives the lowest errors; for mean temperature the test RMSE is 0.63 °C, against 2.07 (ANN), 1.44 (RNN), 1.35 (LSTM) and 0.80 °C (CNN).
51481afdbc9af75ab7de774d1606d02703bbe729.open_work: Test multi-month lead times, other stations and climate regimes, and predictors from large-scale circulation or climate indices.
51481afdbc9af75ab7de774d1606d02703bbe729.issues: Single station and one-month lead; a strong seasonal cycle inflates skill for temperature; no comparison with climatology, persistence or dynamical seasonal forecasts and no uncertainty estimates.

1a92e6692c7ae87279ee932adab75b9c8eb13651.goal: Predicts PM2.5 concentrations one day ahead in Xi'an, China, to support rapid air-quality warning systems.
1a92e6692c7ae87279ee932adab75b9c8eb13651.architecture: Hybrid EEMD-GRNN: ensemble empirical mode decomposition splits the PM2.5 series into intrinsic mode functions, each predicted by a general regression neural network; inputs are selected with principal component regression.
1a92e6692c7ae87279ee932adab75b9c8eb13651.data: Daily air-quality and meteorological data for Xi'an; training 1 January–1 November 2013, validation 2–21 November 2013.
1a92e6692c7ae87279ee932adab75b9c8eb13651.result: EEMD-GRNN outperforms a plain GRNN, multiple linear regression, PCR and ARIMA for one-day-ahead PM2.5 prediction; no headline numbers given in the abstract.
1a92e6692c7ae87279ee932adab75b9c8eb13651.open_work: Validate over longer periods covering all seasons, more cities and multi-day leads.
1a92e6692c7ae87279ee932adab75b9c8eb13651.issues: Very short validation window (20 days); decomposition-based forecasting can leak future information if EEMD is applied to the full series; single city.

a976c37650aadfb345ce05b4beafc859269dc70d.goal: Reviews and benchmarks empirical and machine learning models that estimate daily global solar radiation from sunshine duration, for solar energy system design.
a976c37650aadfb345ce05b4beafc859269dc70d.architecture: Review plus benchmark of 12 empirical sunshine-based model forms and 12 machine learning algorithms, including ANFIS, extreme learning machine, LSSVM, MARS, XGBoost, M5Tree, GRNN and MLP.
a976c37650aadfb345ce05b4beafc859269dc70d.data: Daily station observations of sunshine duration and global solar radiation across four climatic zones of China (temperate continental, temperate monsoon, mountain plateau, subtropical monsoon).
a976c37650aadfb345ce05b4beafc859269dc70d.result: Machine learning models (RMSE 2.06–2.75 MJ m−2 d−1, R2 0.84–0.94) generally beat empirical ones (RMSE 2.12–3.54); ANFIS is recommended overall, with MARS and XGBoost as accurate, cheap alternatives.
a976c37650aadfb345ce05b4beafc859269dc70d.open_work: Extend to other input combinations, sub-daily scales and regions outside China; assess spatial transferability between stations.
a976c37650aadfb345ce05b4beafc859269dc70d.issues: Gains over the best empirical models are modest; results are station-based and China-specific; model hyperparameter tuning effort may differ across methods.

f7cb5a6914fe75c36d26c4f13d604d9ad4a56d38.goal: Predicts mid-to-long term wind and photovoltaic power generation with limited historical samples, for grid planning and complementary dispatch.
f7cb5a6914fe75c36d26c4f13d604d9ad4a56d38.architecture: Copula functions select key meteorological drivers from nonlinear and tail dependence; LSTM networks then forecast wind, PV and joint wind-PV generation, benchmarked against persistence and support vector machine models.
f7cb5a6914fe75c36d26c4f13d604d9ad4a56d38.data: Actual generation and meteorological data from wind farms and photovoltaic power stations in China and the United States; record lengths not reported in the abstract.
f7cb5a6914fe75c36d26c4f13d604d9ad4a56d38.result: Independent and joint LSTM models outperform persistence and SVM baselines; no headline error values are given in the abstract.
f7cb5a6914fe75c36d26c4f13d604d9ad4a56d38.open_work: Couple with longer-range weather or climate forecasts as inputs and test on more plants and longer records.
f7cb5a6914fe75c36d26c4f13d604d9ad4a56d38.issues: Mid-to-long term skill depends on weather predictability that the method does not address directly; limited samples raise overfitting risk; quantitative gains not stated.

a829bb4e480091149527b29294eeee6c98e48588.goal: Estimates daily horizontal global solar radiation from routinely measured meteorological variables in the warm sub-humid Yucatán Peninsula, Mexico.
a829bb4e480091149527b29294eeee6c98e48588.architecture: Comparison of three soft computing methods: adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS), artificial neural network (MLP-type ANN) and support vector machine (SVM) regression.
a829bb4e480091149527b29294eeee6c98e48588.data: Daily station meteorology in the Yucatán Peninsula (maximum and minimum air temperature, rainfall) plus extraterrestrial radiation; number of stations and years not reported in the abstract.
a829bb4e480091149527b29294eeee6c98e48588.result: SVM using maximum and minimum temperature, extraterrestrial radiation and rainfall performs best by RMSE, MAE and R2.
a829bb4e480091149527b29294eeee6c98e48588.open_work: Test transferability to other climates and stations and include humidity or cloud-related predictors.
a829bb4e480091149527b29294eeee6c98e48588.issues: Regional, station-based study; numerical skill and train/test split not stated in the abstract; no comparison to satellite radiation products.

c9fdbf116dd68c953df0e952578c5224bdb48e79.goal: Maps flood susceptibility with GIS and ensemble machine learning to locate flood-prone areas.
c9fdbf116dd68c953df0e952578c5224bdb48e79.architecture: Reduced-error pruning tree (REPTree, a decision tree) used alone and inside bagging (Bag-REPTree) and random subspace (RS-REPTree) ensembles; inputs chosen by correlation attribute evaluation.
c9fdbf116dd68c953df0e952578c5224bdb48e79.data: Flood inventory of 363 locations with 13 conditioning factors (altitude, slope, aspect, curvature, SPI, STI, TWI, distance to rivers, NDVI, soil, land use, lithology, rainfall); study area not named in the abstract.
c9fdbf116dd68c953df0e952578c5224bdb48e79.result: RS-REPTree is best (AUC 0.949 training, 0.907 validation), followed by Bag-REPTree and single REPTree, showing ensembles help.
c9fdbf116dd68c953df0e952578c5224bdb48e79.open_work: Compare with other ensemble learners and test transfer to other basins and dynamic flood drivers.
c9fdbf116dd68c953df0e952578c5224bdb48e79.issues: Static susceptibility only (no timing or depth); random point-based validation may be spatially autocorrelated; single study area.

145efd49ab2aac92eed878d09ffd9ecabbb0da42.goal: Models daily pan evaporation in subtropical climates from meteorological variables, as a proxy for evaporative demand in water management.
145efd49ab2aac92eed878d09ffd9ecabbb0da42.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural network, least-squares support vector regression (LS-SVR), fuzzy logic and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) models, with empirical evaporation formulas as reference.
145efd49ab2aac92eed878d09ffd9ecabbb0da42.data: Daily meteorological and pan evaporation records from subtropical station(s) in India; exact stations and period not reported here.
145efd49ab2aac92eed878d09ffd9ecabbb0da42.result: Machine learning models reproduce daily pan evaporation better than the empirical methods, with LS-SVR and fuzzy logic among the best performers.
145efd49ab2aac92eed878d09ffd9ecabbb0da42.open_work: Test across more stations and climates and with reduced input sets.
145efd49ab2aac92eed878d09ffd9ecabbb0da42.issues: Station-based study with limited spatial generality; pan evaporation measurements carry their own errors; no abstract available to confirm details.

546476c89b82bbfb58baacdaa67e2ad40c2138a4.goal: Surveys low-cost outdoor air-quality sensors and their in-field calibration, which is needed because the sensors drift and suffer cross-sensitivities.
546476c89b82bbfb58baacdaa67e2ad40c2138a4.architecture: Review of low-cost sensor technologies and machine learning calibration methods (regression, neural networks and other learners) for air-quality monitoring.
546476c89b82bbfb58baacdaa67e2ad40c2138a4.data: Literature survey; no new dataset. Covers studies co-locating low-cost sensors with reference monitoring stations.
546476c89b82bbfb58baacdaa67e2ad40c2138a4.result: Machine-learning-based calibration is promising for in-field recalibration, but cross-sensitivity, environmental effects and sensor ageing remain key obstacles.
546476c89b82bbfb58baacdaa67e2ad40c2138a4.open_work: Open challenges include calibration transfer across sites, drift handling, network-wide calibration and standardized evaluation protocols.
546476c89b82bbfb58baacdaa67e2ad40c2138a4.issues: Survey without quantitative meta-analysis; rapidly evolving sensor technology dates some conclusions.

ffb56761b55a503109f9c3479202440db576bf81.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration across Brazil when only temperature, or temperature and humidity, are available instead of full FAO-56 Penman-Monteith inputs.
ffb56761b55a503109f9c3479202440db576bf81.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) and support vector machine regression, with K-means clustering of stations into climatic groups and lagged meteorological inputs, compared with empirical ET0 equations.
ffb56761b55a503109f9c3479202440db576bf81.data: Daily data from 203 weather stations across Brazil; FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 as target.
ffb56761b55a503109f9c3479202440db576bf81.result: ANN and SVM beat calibrated empirical equations; clustering and previous-day inputs help. An ANN with four previous days of data is recommended for both input sets.
ffb56761b55a503109f9c3479202440db576bf81.open_work: Test with reanalysis or gridded inputs for ungauged areas and assess transfer to other countries.
ffb56761b55a503109f9c3479202440db576bf81.issues: Target is a computed FAO-56 value rather than measured ET; gains vary by region; skill numbers not given in the abstract.

5cc9991f5085173b07bb14cdbde068903b397183.goal: Produces very short-term probabilistic forecasts of renewable generation, demonstrated for solar power, without assuming a parametric predictive distribution.
5cc9991f5085173b07bb14cdbde068903b397183.architecture: Nonparametric quantile forecasting based on extreme learning machines (single-hidden-layer feedforward networks) to give fast predictive densities.
5cc9991f5085173b07bb14cdbde068903b397183.data: Solar power generation data; site and period not reported here.
5cc9991f5085173b07bb14cdbde068903b397183.result: The method yields reliable and sharp predictive quantiles at very short lead times with low computational cost, compared favourably with benchmark probabilistic methods.
5cc9991f5085173b07bb14cdbde068903b397183.open_work: Extend to multi-site and spatio-temporal settings and to wind power.
5cc9991f5085173b07bb14cdbde068903b397183.issues: No abstract available; details of data and scores could not be confirmed. Quantile crossing and calibration at extreme quantiles are typical concerns.

b70e05eee925c5223ee5a2c4f44409994fffd681.goal: Builds complete daily PM2.5 estimates across China for 2000–2016, extending exposure records before the 2013 national monitoring network.
b70e05eee925c5223ee5a2c4f44409994fffd681.architecture: Machine learning model with high-dimensional expansion of predictors so the PM2.5–AOD relationship varies with space-time covariates, followed by a generalized additive model to fill gaps where AOD is missing.
b70e05eee925c5223ee5a2c4f44409994fffd681.data: Satellite AOD and other satellite covariates, meteorological variables and chemical transport model simulations; trained on in-situ PM2.5 from 2013–2016 with year-wise held-out cross-validation.
b70e05eee925c5223ee5a2c4f44409994fffd681.result: Cross-validated R2 of 0.61 (daily), 0.68 (monthly) and 0.75 (annual); gap-filled R2 0.55/0.71/0.77. Population-weighted PM2.5 rose 2.10 μg/m3/yr in 2000–2007 and fell 4.51 μg/m3/yr in 2013–2016.
b70e05eee925c5223ee5a2c4f44409994fffd681.open_work: Use the product in epidemiological studies and validate pre-2013 hindcasts against independent historical observations.
b70e05eee925c5223ee5a2c4f44409994fffd681.issues: Pre-2013 estimates rely on extrapolation in time; daily accuracy is moderate, especially after gap filling; errors in AOD and CTM inputs propagate.

192e99b1db791a6e0fdb43e70643485a8ee2ea1c.goal: Forecasts hourly PM2.5 concentration in Beijing to warn citizens ahead of harmful pollution episodes.
192e99b1db791a6e0fdb43e70643485a8ee2ea1c.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM that combines convolutional feature extraction with LSTM, compared with LSTM, Bi-LSTM, GRU, Bi-GRU and CNN models.
192e99b1db791a6e0fdb43e70643485a8ee2ea1c.data: Historical hourly pollutant concentrations, meteorological data and PM2.5 at adjacent monitoring stations in Beijing, China.
192e99b1db791a6e0fdb43e70643485a8ee2ea1c.result: The multivariate hybrid CNN-LSTM gives the most accurate hourly PM2.5 predictions among the compared models; numbers not given in the abstract.
192e99b1db791a6e0fdb43e70643485a8ee2ea1c.open_work: Extend to multi-step horizons, other cities and additional pollutants.
192e99b1db791a6e0fdb43e70643485a8ee2ea1c.issues: Single city; forecast horizon and error values not stated in the abstract; no meteorological forecasts used as inputs.

6aec8f8f093d05273c298fc37d513a09601eced2.goal: Provides short-term wind speed prediction intervals for wind power production, where variability makes reliable intervals difficult.
6aec8f8f093d05273c298fc37d513a09601eced2.architecture: Variational mode decomposition plus gated recurrent unit (GRU) networks: an interval model for the main mode, point models for other modes, and a GRU error-correction model, combined in an ensemble.
6aec8f8f093d05273c298fc37d513a09601eced2.data: Wind speed time series from two wind fields, eight test cases; sites and periods not reported in the abstract.
6aec8f8f093d05273c298fc37d513a09601eced2.result: The method gives higher prediction-interval coverage probability and narrower interval width than compared approaches.
6aec8f8f093d05273c298fc37d513a09601eced2.open_work: Extend to wind power directly and to longer horizons with NWP inputs.
6aec8f8f093d05273c298fc37d513a09601eced2.issues: Univariate, data-driven setup; decomposition over the whole series may leak information; limited number of sites.

f9213932ab6ec75f65eb174c5cb1a5eb84f78132.goal: Forecasts short-term power output of a residential-scale PV system under variable weather.
f9213932ab6ec75f65eb174c5cb1a5eb84f78132.architecture: Genetic-algorithm-optimized support vector machine (GASVM): an SVM classifies weather conditions and a genetic algorithm tunes the ensemble.
f9213932ab6ec75f65eb174c5cb1a5eb84f78132.data: PV output and data from a local weather station installed with the PV system at Deakin University, Australia.
f9213932ab6ec75f65eb174c5cb1a5eb84f78132.result: GASVM improves on a conventional SVM by about 670 W in RMSE and 98.8% in MAPE.
f9213932ab6ec75f65eb174c5cb1a5eb84f78132.open_work: Test on more systems, seasons and with NWP forecast inputs.
f9213932ab6ec75f65eb174c5cb1a5eb84f78132.issues: Single small system; very large MAPE improvement suggests a weak baseline; data length not stated.

a6f3c93bad17ac5b17cbc7da97a4d459e0af267c.goal: Predicts hydrological drought indices to support drought monitoring and water management.
a6f3c93bad17ac5b17cbc7da97a4d459e0af267c.architecture: Comparison of support vector regression, gene expression programming and M5 model trees for predicting SPI, SSI and SPEI.
a6f3c93bad17ac5b17cbc7da97a4d459e0af267c.data: Precipitation, evapotranspiration and runoff-based drought index series; basin and period not reported in the abstract.
a6f3c93bad17ac5b17cbc7da97a4d459e0af267c.result: SPI is predicted most accurately; for SSI the M5 model tree is best with correlation coefficient 0.82 and RMSE 0.82.
a6f3c93bad17ac5b17cbc7da97a4d459e0af267c.open_work: Test longer lead times and include climate indices and other basins.
a6f3c93bad17ac5b17cbc7da97a4d459e0af267c.issues: Abstract gives little on data, lead time or validation design; skill for SSI is moderate.

1a250f3242eb05d40ee944935d155da93817e1f7.goal: Forecasts drought conditions in eastern Australia to support agricultural and water resource planning.
1a250f3242eb05d40ee944935d155da93817e1f7.architecture: Comparison of multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS), least-squares support vector machine (LSSVM) and M5Tree model trees.
1a250f3242eb05d40ee944935d155da93817e1f7.data: Drought index series and predictor variables for stations in eastern Australia; details not reported here.
1a250f3242eb05d40ee944935d155da93817e1f7.result: Reported in the paper as a comparison of the three methods; specific skill values are not available here.
1a250f3242eb05d40ee944935d155da93817e1f7.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and to more sites and hybrid or ensemble methods.
1a250f3242eb05d40ee944935d155da93817e1f7.issues: No abstract available; data, lead time and results could not be confirmed. Station-based models may not generalize.

edce51390acd08050bb259b490baff315f9a528b.goal: Detects oil spills in SAR images and separates them from look-alikes, and provides a common benchmark so methods can be compared.
edce51390acd08050bb259b490baff315f9a528b.architecture: Semantic segmentation with deep convolutional neural networks; several known models (U-Net-style and DeepLab variants) are compared, with DeepLabv3+ best. Also introduces a benchmark dataset.
edce51390acd08050bb259b490baff315f9a528b.data: New public SAR oil spill dataset with pixel-wise labels for oil spills, look-alikes, ships, land and sea; built from Sentinel-1 imagery per the authors.
edce51390acd08050bb259b490baff315f9a528b.result: DeepLabv3+ gives the best test accuracy and inference time; discriminating oil from look-alikes remains the hardest part.
edce51390acd08050bb259b490baff315f9a528b.open_work: Use the benchmark to develop methods that better separate look-alikes and add contextual data such as wind.
edce51390acd08050bb259b490baff315f9a528b.issues: Class imbalance and look-alike confusion persist; single-sensor dataset; no wind or ancillary inputs.

714aafa2d01bad33da58464597956cdbd6d2285e.goal: Predicts wind speed and wind direction for wind energy applications.
714aafa2d01bad33da58464597956cdbd6d2285e.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural network (MLP), support vector regression and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) models.
714aafa2d01bad33da58464597956cdbd6d2285e.data: Wind measurements from a wind site; location and period not reported here.
714aafa2d01bad33da58464597956cdbd6d2285e.result: Results not available here; the paper compares the three methods' accuracy for speed and direction.
714aafa2d01bad33da58464597956cdbd6d2285e.open_work: Extend to multi-step horizons and to power forecasting.
714aafa2d01bad33da58464597956cdbd6d2285e.issues: No abstract available; details unconfirmed. Wind direction is circular and needs care in regression.

4326d001abf0fac34edddac535dd19e94777fcc8.goal: Assesses flood susceptibility across Bangladesh, a highly flood-prone country, by combining machine learning and multi-criteria decision analysis.
4326d001abf0fac34edddac535dd19e94777fcc8.architecture: Machine learning classifiers combined with multi-criteria decision analysis; the specific model types are not specified here.
4326d001abf0fac34edddac535dd19e94777fcc8.data: Flood inventory and geospatial conditioning factors for Bangladesh; details not reported here.
4326d001abf0fac34edddac535dd19e94777fcc8.result: Produces flood susceptibility maps for Bangladesh; quantitative results not available here.
4326d001abf0fac34edddac535dd19e94777fcc8.open_work: Validate against independent flood events and add dynamic hydrological drivers.
4326d001abf0fac34edddac535dd19e94777fcc8.issues: No abstract available; methods and results could not be confirmed. Static susceptibility mapping ignores flood timing and magnitude.

9edc3135cd563d38cacea5313d461d94b1ad635d.goal: Forecasts the day-ahead power output time series of a large PV plant, treating ideal and non-ideal weather separately.
9edc3135cd563d38cacea5313d461d94b1ad635d.architecture: LSTM networks: for ideal weather driven by next-day meteorological data; for non-ideal weather adding adjacent-day series and weather-type information, with daily totals from a discrete grey model used for correction.
9edc3135cd563d38cacea5313d461d94b1ad635d.data: Power output and meteorological data from a large-scale PV plant; location and period not reported in the abstract.
9edc3135cd563d38cacea5313d461d94b1ad635d.result: RMSE reaches 4.62% under ideal weather, and the proposed methods beat traditional algorithms under non-ideal weather.
9edc3135cd563d38cacea5313d461d94b1ad635d.open_work: Use NWP forecasts directly and test on more plants and seasons.
9edc3135cd563d38cacea5313d461d94b1ad635d.issues: Relies on correct weather-type classification for the next day; single plant; error for non-ideal weather not quantified in the abstract.

35ce2b93de51b17a8cde9a4834c02f75b2ce8be4.goal: Detects clouds and cloud shadows in optical satellite imagery, a key preprocessing step, especially over bright surfaces.
35ce2b93de51b17a8cde9a4834c02f75b2ce8be4.architecture: Encoder-decoder convolutional neural network with multi-scale convolutional feature fusion (MSCFF) producing pixel-wise cloud and shadow probability maps.
35ce2b93de51b17a8cde9a4834c02f75b2ce8be4.data: Hundreds of global optical images at 0.5–50 m from Landsat-5/7/8, Gaofen-1/2/4, Sentinel-2, Ziyuan-3, CBERS-04, Huanjing-1 and Google Earth; validation dataset released.
35ce2b93de51b17a8cde9a4834c02f75b2ce8be4.result: MSCFF beats rule-based methods and other deep learning models in accuracy, particularly over bright surfaces.
35ce2b93de51b17a8cde9a4834c02f75b2ce8be4.open_work: Extend to thin cloud handling and to more sensors with limited bands.
35ce2b93de51b17a8cde9a4834c02f75b2ce8be4.issues: Labels are manual and may be uncertain for thin cloud; numbers not given in the abstract.

cc03033871fc386170f0f438841bfc7d2ed5c062.goal: Forecasts short-term wind power to support grid operation with variable wind generation.
cc03033871fc386170f0f438841bfc7d2ed5c062.architecture: Least-squares support vector machine (LSSVM) whose parameters are tuned with the gravitational search algorithm (GSA).
cc03033871fc386170f0f438841bfc7d2ed5c062.data: Wind power data from a wind farm; details not reported here.
cc03033871fc386170f0f438841bfc7d2ed5c062.result: The LSSVM-GSA model is reported to improve accuracy over compared models; specific numbers not available here.
cc03033871fc386170f0f438841bfc7d2ed5c062.open_work: Add NWP inputs and test probabilistic variants.
cc03033871fc386170f0f438841bfc7d2ed5c062.issues: No abstract available; data and results unconfirmed. Single-site, point-forecast setting.

e05e7b4be88c04a180de86fdb9eb0ec5467f8a75.goal: Solves interpolation, prediction and feature analysis of fine-grained urban air quality in one model instead of three separate ones.
e05e7b4be88c04a180de86fdb9eb0ec5467f8a75.architecture: Deep Air Learning (DAL): a deep neural network that embeds feature selection and semi-supervised learning in its layers to use unlabeled spatio-temporal data.
e05e7b4be88c04a180de86fdb9eb0ec5467f8a75.data: Real air quality and related urban data sources from Beijing, China.
e05e7b4be88c04a180de86fdb9eb0ec5467f8a75.result: DAL outperforms recent peer models on interpolation, prediction and feature analysis; numbers not given in the abstract.
e05e7b4be88c04a180de86fdb9eb0ec5467f8a75.open_work: Apply to other cities and longer horizons, and refine interpretability of selected features.
e05e7b4be88c04a180de86fdb9eb0ec5467f8a75.issues: Single city; data sources and error metrics are not specified in the abstract.

ca48ebb411dab77aeffcca178f65db06b384fd51.goal: Forecasts wind speed despite its chaotic, nonstationary nature.
ca48ebb411dab77aeffcca178f65db06b384fd51.architecture: Hybrid EMD-ENN: empirical mode decomposition into intrinsic mode functions, each forecast by an Elman recurrent neural network, with input size set by partial autocorrelation.
ca48ebb411dab77aeffcca178f65db06b384fd51.data: Four wind speed prediction cases; sites and periods not reported in the abstract.
ca48ebb411dab77aeffcca178f65db06b384fd51.result: EMD-ENN has the lowest MAE, MSE and MAPE compared with persistence, a back-propagation neural network and plain ENN.
ca48ebb411dab77aeffcca178f65db06b384fd51.open_work: Test multi-step horizons and add meteorological inputs.
ca48ebb411dab77aeffcca178f65db06b384fd51.issues: Decomposition of the full series can leak future information; univariate; limited cases.

e6004e86e34a274d73fb100f09238bf90fca7904.goal: Detects clouds at multiple levels (thick cloud, thin cloud, clear) in remote sensing images.
e6004e86e34a274d73fb100f09238bf90fca7904.architecture: Superpixel segmentation (SLIC) followed by a two-branch convolutional neural network that classifies each superpixel into cloud levels.
e6004e86e34a274d73fb100f09238bf90fca7904.data: Optical remote sensing images; sensors and dataset details not reported here.
e6004e86e34a274d73fb100f09238bf90fca7904.result: The method separates thick and thin cloud and outperforms the compared cloud detection methods, per the paper.
e6004e86e34a274d73fb100f09238bf90fca7904.open_work: Extend to cloud shadow and to other sensors.
e6004e86e34a274d73fb100f09238bf90fca7904.issues: No abstract available; data and scores could not be confirmed. Superpixel errors propagate to labels.

e81503b69e0178c5d4179635cd9f9a62b36d8096.goal: Builds multi-model ensembles of GCM precipitation and temperature over Pakistan with machine learning and finds the optimal number of GCMs.
e81503b69e0178c5d4179635cd9f9a62b36d8096.architecture: Machine learning ensemble weighting with artificial neural network, k-nearest neighbours, support vector machine and relevance vector machine; GCMs ranked by Taylor skill score and a rating metric.
e81503b69e0178c5d4179635cd9f9a62b36d8096.data: 36 CMIP5 GCMs; annual, monsoon and winter precipitation, Tmax and Tmin over Pakistan against observational reference data.
e81503b69e0178c5d4179635cd9f9a62b36d8096.result: HadGEM2-AO ranks best and IPSL-CM5B-LR worst; MME skill stops improving after about 18 top GCMs; KNN and RVM ensembles beat SVM and ANN.
e81503b69e0178c5d4179635cd9f9a62b36d8096.open_work: Apply to CMIP6 and to projection periods, checking whether historical weights hold.
e81503b69e0178c5d4179635cd9f9a62b36d8096.issues: Weights trained on the historical period may not transfer to future climates; reference data quality in Pakistan is limited.

ecac5956b501940792e65c0ad89bba4d599a7736.goal: Forecasts annual rainfall-runoff, where short records and nonstationarity hinder prediction.
ecac5956b501940792e65c0ad89bba4d599a7736.architecture: Hybrid of ensemble empirical mode decomposition with a support vector machine whose parameters are tuned by particle swarm optimization (PSO-SVM).
ecac5956b501940792e65c0ad89bba4d599a7736.data: Annual runoff and rainfall series for a Chinese basin; details not reported here.
ecac5956b501940792e65c0ad89bba4d599a7736.result: The EEMD-based PSO-SVM is reported to outperform models without decomposition; numbers not available here.
ecac5956b501940792e65c0ad89bba4d599a7736.open_work: Test on more basins and with climate indices as predictors.
ecac5956b501940792e65c0ad89bba4d599a7736.issues: No abstract available; details unconfirmed. Annual series give very few samples for training.

5aef0e2e1c7e1eaecf459be4ed4b73c334293fe4.goal: Forecasts solar PV and wind generation in grid-connected microgrids to improve energy management.
5aef0e2e1c7e1eaecf459be4ed4b73c334293fe4.architecture: Support vector regression using historical generation, weather and grid conditions, compared with linear regression and coupled to an energy management scheme.
5aef0e2e1c7e1eaecf459be4ed4b73c334293fe4.data: Historical energy production, weather and grid condition data for a microgrid; site and period not reported in the abstract.
5aef0e2e1c7e1eaecf459be4ed4b73c334293fe4.result: RMSE of 1.415 (solar) and 1.749 (wind); 8.4% lower operating costs, 15% lower peak load and 12% more renewable use.
5aef0e2e1c7e1eaecf459be4ed4b73c334293fe4.open_work: Test with deep learning and probabilistic forecasts and on real deployments.
5aef0e2e1c7e1eaecf459be4ed4b73c334293fe4.issues: Only a linear regression baseline; units and data source unclear; system-level gains may be simulation-based.

6cd22bfadc2c9d658c3135b7708bf810af1d2cd1.goal: Predicts solar irradiance for planning and operation of photovoltaic systems.
6cd22bfadc2c9d658c3135b7708bf810af1d2cd1.architecture: Deep recurrent neural network (stacked RNN), compared with support vector regression and feedforward neural networks.
6cd22bfadc2c9d658c3135b7708bf810af1d2cd1.data: Real solar irradiance data from Natural Resources Canada.
6cd22bfadc2c9d658c3135b7708bf810af1d2cd1.result: The deep RNN outperforms the compared methods on performance tests; numbers not given in the abstract.
6cd22bfadc2c9d658c3135b7708bf810af1d2cd1.open_work: Extend to multi-horizon forecasts and additional meteorological inputs.
6cd22bfadc2c9d658c3135b7708bf810af1d2cd1.issues: Short conference paper; data length, horizon and metrics are not detailed in the abstract.

96d34a4e37cd6742b1b85f4b9dcb4f1dbc1bd530.goal: Forecasts global horizontal irradiance one hour and one day ahead, especially on cloudy days where forecasts fail.
96d34a4e37cd6742b1b85f4b9dcb4f1dbc1bd530.architecture: LSTM network with clearness index as input and k-means classification of days into weather types, compared with RNN, ANN and SVR.
96d34a4e37cd6742b1b85f4b9dcb4f1dbc1bd530.data: GHI and meteorological data from sites including Atlanta and Hawaii, used for a cross-regional study.
96d34a4e37cd6742b1b85f4b9dcb4f1dbc1bd530.result: Hourly LSTM R2 exceeds 0.9 on cloudy and mixed days versus 0.70 and 0.79 for RNN; daily R2 on cloudy days is about 0.85.
96d34a4e37cd6742b1b85f4b9dcb4f1dbc1bd530.open_work: Add sky-image or satellite inputs for cloud dynamics and test more climates.
96d34a4e37cd6742b1b85f4b9dcb4f1dbc1bd530.issues: Station-based; no comparison with NWP; R2 on irradiance includes diurnal cycle skill.

1cd9b155d80cb27200984c4e4ec8320c2085d0ab.goal: Improves intra-hour forecasts of power output from a 48 MWe solar PV plant by reforecasting baseline forecasts.
1cd9b155d80cb27200984c4e4ec8320c2085d0ab.architecture: Artificial neural network reforecasting of baseline models (such as persistence and other time-series models), with sky-image features and genetic-algorithm optimization.
1cd9b155d80cb27200984c4e4ec8320c2085d0ab.data: Power output from a 48 MWe PV plant and ground-based sky imager data; site and period not confirmed here.
1cd9b155d80cb27200984c4e4ec8320c2085d0ab.result: Reforecasting improves forecast skill over the baseline models at short horizons; exact values not confirmed here.
1cd9b155d80cb27200984c4e4ec8320c2085d0ab.open_work: Extend to longer horizons and other plants, and add satellite inputs.
1cd9b155d80cb27200984c4e4ec8320c2085d0ab.issues: No abstract available; details are from partial knowledge. Single plant; sky imagers have limited field of view.

108321750ee5884ace0a0a4ce24f973dfa79be34.goal: Predicts monthly Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI) in eastern Australia for drought assessment.
108321750ee5884ace0a0a4ce24f973dfa79be34.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward MLP) driven by hydrometeorological variables and climate indices.
108321750ee5884ace0a0a4ce24f973dfa79be34.data: Monthly hydrometeorological station data and climate indices (such as ENSO-related indices) for eastern Australia; stations and period not confirmed here.
108321750ee5884ace0a0a4ce24f973dfa79be34.result: The ANN predicts monthly SPEI well; specific scores not available here.
108321750ee5884ace0a0a4ce24f973dfa79be34.open_work: Compare with other learners and extend to forecasting at longer leads.
108321750ee5884ace0a0a4ce24f973dfa79be34.issues: No abstract available; details unconfirmed. Station-based models may not generalize.

e3ee686f07e4f89fbdaee1461a1477b32f0b8bee.goal: Forecasts wind speed with an optimized compound extreme learning machine model.
e3ee686f07e4f89fbdaee1461a1477b32f0b8bee.architecture: Compound structure of extreme learning machines (single-hidden-layer networks) with feature selection and parameter optimization by a hybrid backtracking search algorithm.
e3ee686f07e4f89fbdaee1461a1477b32f0b8bee.data: Wind speed time series; sites and period not reported here.
e3ee686f07e4f89fbdaee1461a1477b32f0b8bee.result: Reported to outperform compared benchmark models; numbers not available here.
e3ee686f07e4f89fbdaee1461a1477b32f0b8bee.open_work: Test probabilistic outputs and other sites.
e3ee686f07e4f89fbdaee1461a1477b32f0b8bee.issues: No abstract available; data and results unconfirmed. Univariate, site-specific setup.

2dd9a9895c50bbf402064b46f91918f027777dc1.goal: Models river suspended sediment load, important for reservoir and watershed management.
2dd9a9895c50bbf402064b46f91918f027777dc1.architecture: Classification and regression tree (CART, a decision tree), compared with other machine learning techniques.
2dd9a9895c50bbf402064b46f91918f027777dc1.data: River discharge and sediment observations; basin and period not reported here.
2dd9a9895c50bbf402064b46f91918f027777dc1.result: CART is reported to perform competitively or best among the compared methods; numbers not available here.
2dd9a9895c50bbf402064b46f91918f027777dc1.open_work: Test ensemble tree methods and other basins.
2dd9a9895c50bbf402064b46f91918f027777dc1.issues: No abstract available; data and results unconfirmed. Sediment rating data are sparse and noisy.

6414b47bb1962a71b46792e451329e50a383878d.goal: Predicts hourly streamflow for water resources planning, hydropower, agriculture and flood control.
6414b47bb1962a71b46792e451329e50a383878d.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM (convolutional layers extract features, LSTM predicts), compared with CNN, LSTM, deep neural network and conventional AI and ensemble models.
6414b47bb1962a71b46792e451329e50a383878d.data: Hourly streamflow at Brisbane River and Teewah Creek, Australia; evaluated over 1-week, 2-week, 4-week and 9-month periods.
6414b47bb1962a71b46792e451329e50a383878d.result: CNN-LSTM is best; 84% of prediction errors fall below 0.05 m3 s−1, versus 80% for LSTM and 66% for DNN.
6414b47bb1962a71b46792e451329e50a383878d.open_work: Add rainfall and other inputs and test multi-step forecasting.
6414b47bb1962a71b46792e451329e50a383878d.issues: Univariate streamflow inputs; error threshold is small relative to streamflow scale; only two sites.

67cee70dd5ca40e259dd0df1ed599ef2686f20d5.goal: Forecasts weather variables with a data-driven sequence-to-sequence model.
67cee70dd5ca40e259dd0df1ed599ef2686f20d5.architecture: Sequence-to-sequence LSTM recurrent neural network (stacked LSTM encoder-decoder style).
67cee70dd5ca40e259dd0df1ed599ef2686f20d5.data: Hourly station weather data (temperature, humidity, wind speed) from cities in Morocco, per the authors.
67cee70dd5ca40e259dd0df1ed599ef2686f20d5.result: The LSTM model produces competitive 24- and 72-hour forecasts of the variables; specific scores not confirmed here.
67cee70dd5ca40e259dd0df1ed599ef2686f20d5.open_work: Add more variables and stations, and compare with NWP.
67cee70dd5ca40e259dd0df1ed599ef2686f20d5.issues: No abstract available; details partly unconfirmed. Single-station time series lack spatial context.

fc7b466f36364cd75457684088f813689dfde391.goal: Forecasts particulate matter (PM2.5) concentration to support air pollution management.
fc7b466f36364cd75457684088f813689dfde391.architecture: Comparison of machine learning regression models; the specific model types are not specified in the abstract.
fc7b466f36364cd75457684088f813689dfde391.result: The machine learning models perform better than traditional models by RMSE, MAE, MSE and R2; numbers not given in the abstract.
fc7b466f36364cd75457684088f813689dfde391.open_work: Extend to multi-step forecasts and other regions.
fc7b466f36364cd75457684088f813689dfde391.issues: Abstract gives no model names or scores; forecast horizon unclear.

dac394b68faf9759fa637867435830a282297291.goal: Surveys intelligent predictors for deterministic wind speed and wind power forecasting.
dac394b68faf9759fa637867435830a282297291.architecture: Review of shallow predictors (artificial neural network, extreme learning machine, support vector machine, fuzzy logic) and deep learning (autoencoder, restricted Boltzmann machine, convolutional neural network, recurrent neural network), plus ensemble learning and metaheuristic optimization.
dac394b68faf9759fa637867435830a282297291.result: Summarizes frameworks of mainstream intelligent models and classifies ensemble and metaheuristic auxiliary methods.
dac394b68faf9759fa637867435830a282297291.open_work: Three development directions for wind energy forecasting are proposed.
dac394b68faf9759fa637867435830a282297291.issues: Limited to deterministic forecasts; no quantitative benchmark across methods.

e7e16d9152a9afb06105d2eedea41dcfe08acc48.goal: Maps urban flood susceptibility in Beijing when flood inventories are limited.
e7e16d9152a9afb06105d2eedea41dcfe08acc48.architecture: Weakly labeled support vector machine (WELLSVM), a semi-supervised SVM, compared with logistic regression, artificial neural network and a standard support vector machine.
e7e16d9152a9afb06105d2eedea41dcfe08acc48.data: Beijing flood inventories 2004–2014 and nine meteorological, geographical and anthropogenic factors.
e7e16d9152a9afb06105d2eedea41dcfe08acc48.result: WELLSVM uses unlabeled spatial data well and outperforms all compared models.
e7e16d9152a9afb06105d2eedea41dcfe08acc48.open_work: Apply to other cities and include drainage network data.
e7e16d9152a9afb06105d2eedea41dcfe08acc48.issues: Static susceptibility; numbers not given in the abstract; inventory incompleteness.

0b421d358f4144af4264d6b366d8cc0a74660104.goal: Reviews artificial neural network use for solar radiation prediction and solar system design.
0b421d358f4144af4264d6b366d8cc0a74660104.architecture: Systematic literature review of artificial neural network (mainly MLP-type) approaches to solar radiation prediction.
0b421d358f4144af4264d6b366d8cc0a74660104.result: ANNs are widely reported to predict solar radiation more accurately than empirical models; review details not available here.
0b421d358f4144af4264d6b366d8cc0a74660104.open_work: Calls for wider comparison with other machine learning methods and standardized evaluation.
0b421d358f4144af4264d6b366d8cc0a74660104.issues: No abstract available; details unconfirmed. Review predates deep learning work.

03b7c73aa39f7f8fc1b2dc142b366fcc39fd37be.goal: Improves regional multi-step-ahead air quality forecasts in a city, addressing spatio-temporal instability, time-lag effects and error accumulation of shallow multi-output LSTM models.
03b7c73aa39f7f8fc1b2dc142b366fcc39fd37be.architecture: Deep multi-output LSTM (DM-LSTM) recurrent neural network trained with mini-batch gradient descent, dropout and L2 regularization, compared against a shallow multi-output LSTM.
03b7c73aa39f7f8fc1b2dc142b366fcc39fd37be.data: Hourly PM2.5, PM10 and NOx time series from five air quality monitoring stations in Taipei City, Taiwan.
03b7c73aa39f7f8fc1b2dc142b366fcc39fd37be.result: Test MSE at horizon t+4 drops from 0.87 (SM-LSTM) to 0.72 (DM-LSTM); Gbench reaches 0.95 at t+1 and exceeds 0.81 at t+4 for all three pollutants.
03b7c73aa39f7f8fc1b2dc142b366fcc39fd37be.open_work: Adding meteorological and emission inputs, extending to longer horizons and more stations, and testing transfer to other cities.
03b7c73aa39f7f8fc1b2dc142b366fcc39fd37be.issues: Single city with five stations; evaluation limited to short horizons; skill degrades with lead time; no uncertainty quantification or comparison with chemical transport models.

d2a23d0566154c5f412c6e521da59100784cc69d.goal: Estimates actual wheat yields across the Australian wheat belt to map yield-gap hotspots, where crop growth models are too data-hungry for large-scale actual-yield estimation.
d2a23d0566154c5f412c6e521da59100784cc69d.architecture: Comparison of nine machine-learning regression base learners and two ensembles; support vector regression with an RBF kernel is the best single learner.
d2a23d0566154c5f412c6e521da59100784cc69d.data: Climate records and satellite image time series (NDVI) over the Australian wheat belt, with yield statistics from statistical units for evaluation.
d2a23d0566154c5f412c6e521da59100784cc69d.result: SVR-RBF achieves RMSE 0.55 t/ha and R2 0.77 at pixel level and explains 73% of national yield variability, largely outperforming peak-NDVI and harvest-index benchmarks.
d2a23d0566154c5f412c6e521da59100784cc69d.open_work: Using the yield maps to quantify yield gaps against modelled potential yields and testing in-season forecasting.
d2a23d0566154c5f412c6e521da59100784cc69d.issues: Statistical model without crop physiology; transferability to anomalous seasons or other regions untested; pixel-level reference yields have their own uncertainty.

0768f4a6dce0881241f0ee1455362a14cdb268c5.goal: Maps urban flood risk in Jiroft, Iran, by combining machine-learning flood hazard maps with a socio-economic vulnerability analysis to support flood management in data-limited cities.
0768f4a6dce0881241f0ee1455362a14cdb268c5.architecture: Support vector machine, random forest and boosted regression tree for hazard mapping, combined with the TOPSIS multi-criteria decision method for vulnerability.
0768f4a6dce0881241f0ee1455362a14cdb268c5.data: 218 flood inundation points with conditioning factors (elevation, slope, rainfall, distances to streets, rivers and drainage, drainage density, land cover, curve number) and socio-economic indicators.
0768f4a6dce0881241f0ee1455362a14cdb268c5.result: Random forest gives the most accurate hazard map; urban drainage density and distance to drainage are the most important factors; high population density areas are most vulnerable.
0768f4a6dce0881241f0ee1455362a14cdb268c5.open_work: Incorporating hydrodynamic modelling and dynamic rainfall scenarios, and testing the framework in other cities.
0768f4a6dce0881241f0ee1455362a14cdb268c5.issues: Single small city with few inventory points; static susceptibility rather than event-based inundation; vulnerability weights are subjective.

be163a0e5670153469f18c5a2a154c7dd08c945b.goal: Examines whether global ecosystem water use efficiency has kept increasing with rising CO2, given the interacting effects of climate change on carbon uptake and evapotranspiration.
be163a0e5670153469f18c5a2a154c7dd08c945b.architecture: Machine-learning upscaling of eddy-covariance fluxes to global gross primary production and evapotranspiration estimates; the specific learner is not specified in the abstract.
be163a0e5670153469f18c5a2a154c7dd08c945b.data: Global FLUXNET eddy-covariance observations upscaled with gridded drivers; analysis covers roughly 1982–2016.
be163a0e5670153469f18c5a2a154c7dd08c945b.result: Global ecosystem water use efficiency rose until about 2000 but has not increased since 2001, because a higher vapor pressure deficit depressed photosynthesis and enhanced evapotranspiration.
be163a0e5670153469f18c5a2a154c7dd08c945b.open_work: Assessing how projected VPD increases will alter coupling of terrestrial carbon and water cycles and constraining process models with these findings.
be163a0e5670153469f18c5a2a154c7dd08c945b.issues: Upscaled products inherit sparse flux-site coverage and machine-learning extrapolation errors, and may underrepresent CO2 fertilization trends.

2a81ee4b08cba917d93c201418c84e4f67452b4a.goal: Determines how many distinct ENSO spatial patterns (flavors), such as eastern versus central Pacific events, can be statistically distinguished in the observational record.
2a81ee4b08cba917d93c201418c84e4f67452b4a.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) clustering of tropical Pacific sea surface temperature anomaly patterns, with significance testing of the resulting nodes.
2a81ee4b08cba917d93c201418c84e4f67452b4a.data: Observed tropical Pacific SST anomaly analyses covering several decades; exact product and period not reported here.
2a81ee4b08cba917d93c201418c84e4f67452b4a.result: Identifies a small set of statistically distinguishable ENSO patterns forming a continuum rather than two discrete types; apparent trends toward central Pacific events are hard to separate from sampling and background warming.
2a81ee4b08cba917d93c201418c84e4f67452b4a.open_work: Applying the approach to longer records and climate model simulations to assess changes in ENSO diversity under warming.
2a81ee4b08cba917d93c201418c84e4f67452b4a.issues: Short observational record limits the number of separable flavors; SOM results depend on map size and preprocessing choices.

e8b4bea72bb6e346e1ba28830027f532ee453c93.goal: Produces nonparametric probabilistic forecasts of wind power by directly estimating quantiles, avoiding distributional assumptions and costly two-stage interval construction.
e8b4bea72bb6e346e1ba28830027f532ee453c93.architecture: Direct quantile regression using an extreme learning machine (single hidden-layer neural network) whose output weights are obtained by a linear-programming quantile loss formulation.
e8b4bea72bb6e346e1ba28830027f532ee453c93.data: Wind farm power generation records; exact sites and periods not reported here.
e8b4bea72bb6e346e1ba28830027f532ee453c93.result: Produces reliable and sharp quantile forecasts with high computational efficiency, outperforming benchmark probabilistic methods.
e8b4bea72bb6e346e1ba28830027f532ee453c93.open_work: Extending to multi-site and longer-horizon forecasting and incorporating NWP inputs.
e8b4bea72bb6e346e1ba28830027f532ee453c93.issues: Quantiles estimated separately can cross; performance shown on limited wind farm datasets; details of evaluation not reported here.

ce8ff666c0365c754fbbb81ac98c09cb79093a60.goal: Develops an urban air pollution monitoring system with forecasting models to provide timely pollutant concentration predictions from low-cost sensor networks.
ce8ff666c0365c754fbbb81ac98c09cb79093a60.architecture: Wireless sensor network monitoring combined with machine-learning forecasters, including support vector machine, M5P model tree and artificial neural network.
ce8ff666c0365c754fbbb81ac98c09cb79093a60.data: Pollutant (e.g. ozone, NO2, SO2) and meteorological measurements from a deployed urban sensor network in Qatar.
ce8ff666c0365c754fbbb81ac98c09cb79093a60.result: Machine-learning models forecast pollutant concentrations with reasonable accuracy; the M5P model tree performs best among the tested approaches.
ce8ff666c0365c754fbbb81ac98c09cb79093a60.open_work: Scaling the network, adding more pollutants and integrating forecasts into public alerting.
ce8ff666c0365c754fbbb81ac98c09cb79093a60.issues: Limited deployment and short record; low-cost sensor calibration issues; forecasts evaluated only at sensor sites.

a4a8bcd10511afd228c72009933069f41778032c.goal: Tests whether recurrent neural networks forecast wind speed better than conventional time-series models, for wind energy planning.
a4a8bcd10511afd228c72009933069f41778032c.architecture: Recurrent neural networks in univariate and multivariate configurations, compared with ARIMA models.
a4a8bcd10511afd228c72009933069f41778032c.data: Observed hourly wind speed and related meteorological measurements at a monitoring site; exact site not reported here.
a4a8bcd10511afd228c72009933069f41778032c.result: Recurrent neural networks outperform ARIMA benchmarks in forecast accuracy, with multivariate inputs adding skill.
a4a8bcd10511afd228c72009933069f41778032c.open_work: Longer horizons, more sites and combination with NWP predictions.
a4a8bcd10511afd228c72009933069f41778032c.issues: Single-site evaluation; short horizons only; no probabilistic output.

c49d031aad2ce861f9310a88cbf1c4597e2f543d.goal: Selects the most relevant meteorological and geographical inputs for neural network solar radiation prediction to simplify models and improve accuracy.
c49d031aad2ce861f9310a88cbf1c4597e2f543d.architecture: WEKA attribute-selection algorithms for input ranking, followed by artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) solar radiation models.
c49d031aad2ce861f9310a88cbf1c4597e2f543d.data: Meteorological and geographic data (temperature, sunshine hours, latitude, longitude, altitude and others) from multiple Indian stations.
c49d031aad2ce861f9310a88cbf1c4597e2f543d.result: Temperature, maximum temperature and sunshine duration are identified as the most relevant inputs; ANN models using the selected inputs predict solar radiation with good accuracy.
c49d031aad2ce861f9310a88cbf1c4597e2f543d.open_work: Testing selected inputs at more climates and comparing with other learners.
c49d031aad2ce861f9310a88cbf1c4597e2f543d.issues: Monthly or daily mean radiation only; station network limited to India; feature ranking depends on WEKA method choice.

f9d94297e7bb137a88ae5ef2a2f0fbc1eeb1dded.goal: Predicts daily ambient ozone concentrations across China for human exposure assessment where monitoring coverage is incomplete.
f9d94297e7bb137a88ae5ef2a2f0fbc1eeb1dded.architecture: Random forest regression with spatiotemporal predictors.
f9d94297e7bb137a88ae5ef2a2f0fbc1eeb1dded.data: Ground ozone monitoring data across China combined with meteorology and other spatial covariates; exact period and products not reported here.
f9d94297e7bb137a88ae5ef2a2f0fbc1eeb1dded.result: Random forest reproduces daily ozone spatiotemporal variability with good cross-validated accuracy, enabling national exposure maps.
f9d94297e7bb137a88ae5ef2a2f0fbc1eeb1dded.open_work: Extending to multiple years, finer resolution and health impact studies.
f9d94297e7bb137a88ae5ef2a2f0fbc1eeb1dded.issues: Performance details not reported here; random forest may underpredict extremes and extrapolates poorly to unmonitored regions.

f77e70369d8065ad73369485ee3604a0182aee15.goal: Predicts site-based rice yields in China and quantifies the contribution of phenology alongside climate and geography.
f77e70369d8065ad73369485ee3604a0182aee15.architecture: Multiple linear regression compared with backpropagation neural network (MLP), support vector machine and random forest over eleven predictor combinations.
f77e70369d8065ad73369485ee3604a0182aee15.data: Site-based rice phenology observations, growing-season climate variables and geographic information from Chinese agro-meteorological stations.
f77e70369d8065ad73369485ee3604a0182aee15.result: ML outperforms MLR; combining phenology, climate and geography is best, with RMSE 800, 737 and 744 kg/ha (R2 0.24, 0.33, 0.31) for BP, SVM and RF; phenology is as important as climate.
f77e70369d8065ad73369485ee3604a0182aee15.open_work: Better representing phenology and climate in crop models and integrating ML for yield prediction under climate change.
f77e70369d8065ad73369485ee3604a0182aee15.issues: Explained variance is low (R2 at most 0.33); site-level data only; no management or remote sensing inputs.

03eff0dce52b55476adf330706aa78daf4aed6c7.goal: Reviews emerging artificial intelligence techniques for air pollution forecasting, covering fundamentals, applications and reported performance.
03eff0dce52b55476adf330706aa78daf4aed6c7.architecture: Review of AI methods for air pollution forecasting, including artificial neural networks, support vector machines, fuzzy logic and deep learning models.
03eff0dce52b55476adf330706aa78daf4aed6c7.data: Review of published studies; no new data.
03eff0dce52b55476adf330706aa78daf4aed6c7.result: Summarizes the dominance of ANN and SVM approaches and their reported accuracy across pollutants and regions.
03eff0dce52b55476adf330706aa78daf4aed6c7.open_work: Hybrid and deep learning models, better data quality and standardized evaluation.
03eff0dce52b55476adf330706aa78daf4aed6c7.issues: Literature-based; performance comparisons across studies with different data are not directly comparable.

ecb8961faa5bc19ebca2f39d5052a71db2393639.goal: Forecasts short-term power output of a self-consumption PV plant to aid energy management.
ecb8961faa5bc19ebca2f39d5052a71db2393639.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM and ConvLSTM deep learning models compared with standard LSTM and other baselines.
ecb8961faa5bc19ebca2f39d5052a71db2393639.data: Historical power production data from a self-consumption PV plant in Morocco.
ecb8961faa5bc19ebca2f39d5052a71db2393639.result: ConvLSTM gives the best accuracy across forecast horizons, outperforming CNN-LSTM and LSTM baselines.
ecb8961faa5bc19ebca2f39d5052a71db2393639.open_work: Adding weather inputs and testing on larger plants and longer horizons.
ecb8961faa5bc19ebca2f39d5052a71db2393639.issues: Single plant; limited inputs; no probabilistic forecasts.

5b3baa5f7e280afff2fd3db974f25eb128e52911.goal: Tests whether observed changes in dry-season water availability can be attributed to human-induced climate change.
5b3baa5f7e280afff2fd3db974f25eb128e52911.architecture: Detection and attribution analysis comparing observation-based reconstructions with climate model simulations; not primarily a machine-learning method.
5b3baa5f7e280afff2fd3db974f25eb128e52911.data: Observation-based estimates of dry-season water availability (precipitation minus evapotranspiration) and climate model simulations; details not reported here.
5b3baa5f7e280afff2fd3db974f25eb128e52911.result: Detects significant changes in dry-season water availability over recent decades, with drying in many regions attributable to anthropogenic forcing.
5b3baa5f7e280afff2fd3db974f25eb128e52911.open_work: Narrowing observational uncertainty and projecting future changes in dry-season water availability.
5b3baa5f7e280afff2fd3db974f25eb128e52911.issues: Observation-based reconstructions carry substantial uncertainty; attribution relies on climate model fidelity.

4e0df663f51b6bb2ea525091394da88f13cef222.goal: Quantifies how urban morphology influences urban flooding susceptibility to guide planning.
4e0df663f51b6bb2ea525091394da88f13cef222.architecture: XGBoost gradient-boosted trees for susceptibility mapping, interpreted with SHAP explanations.
4e0df663f51b6bb2ea525091394da88f13cef222.data: Urban flood records and morphological and environmental indicators for a study city; details not reported here.
4e0df663f51b6bb2ea525091394da88f13cef222.result: XGBoost gives accurate susceptibility predictions and SHAP identifies influential morphological factors and their nonlinear effects.
4e0df663f51b6bb2ea525091394da88f13cef222.open_work: Testing in other cities and incorporating dynamic rainfall and drainage data.
4e0df663f51b6bb2ea525091394da88f13cef222.issues: Single study area; static susceptibility; flood inventory quality not reported here.

2d71f995fbfb9158982b8d560c696a82f5b0cdbd.goal: Improves time-series prediction of wind speed for renewable energy management.
2d71f995fbfb9158982b8d560c696a82f5b0cdbd.architecture: Wavelet neural network combined with multi-resolution wavelet decomposition of the wind speed series.
2d71f995fbfb9158982b8d560c696a82f5b0cdbd.data: Measured wind speed time series; site details not reported here.
2d71f995fbfb9158982b8d560c696a82f5b0cdbd.result: Multi-resolution wavelet neural network improves prediction accuracy relative to direct neural network forecasting.
2d71f995fbfb9158982b8d560c696a82f5b0cdbd.open_work: Longer horizons and integration with energy management systems.
2d71f995fbfb9158982b8d560c696a82f5b0cdbd.issues: Limited dataset; decomposition may introduce boundary effects; no probabilistic output.

cc5b4896af404f8f57ab67326b8a02b1ffac71e5.goal: Maps flash-flood susceptibility using remote sensing and GIS-derived conditioning factors to support hazard management.
cc5b4896af404f8f57ab67326b8a02b1ffac71e5.architecture: Analytical Hierarchy Process combined with k-nearest neighbor and K-Star instance-based classifiers, both stand-alone and as kNN-AHP and KS-AHP ensembles.
cc5b4896af404f8f57ab67326b8a02b1ffac71e5.data: Torrential areas identified from remote sensing, about 70% used for training, with 10 flash-flood predictors (eight derived from remote sensing).
cc5b4896af404f8f57ab67326b8a02b1ffac71e5.result: Slope angle is the most predictive factor; the kNN-AHP ensemble gives the best performance based on ROC-AUC and other metrics.
cc5b4896af404f8f57ab67326b8a02b1ffac71e5.open_work: Applying the ensemble to other basins and adding rainfall-event information.
cc5b4896af404f8f57ab67326b8a02b1ffac71e5.issues: Study area specifics and AUC values not given in the abstract; static susceptibility; AHP weights subjective.

3766bc9e42dbf2be490a7d3ec172d712a8e665ad.goal: Improves the representation of daily precipitation patterns in data-scarce regions by merging gridded products with rain gauges.
3766bc9e42dbf2be490a7d3ec172d712a8e665ad.architecture: Random forest-based merging procedure (RF-MEP) using gridded precipitation products and topography-related features as predictors.
3766bc9e42dbf2be490a7d3ec172d712a8e665ad.data: Chile 2000–2016; 258 gauges for training, 111 for validation; PERSIANN-CDR, ERA-Interim, CHIRPSv2, CMORPHv1, TRMM 3B42v7; compared against MSWEPv2.2.
3766bc9e42dbf2be490a7d3ec172d712a8e665ad.result: Merged products outperform all inputs and other merging techniques and generally MSWEPv2.2, and remain skilful when training uses only 10% of gauges.
3766bc9e42dbf2be490a7d3ec172d712a8e665ad.open_work: Applying RF-MEP to other regions and other climatological variables; R package released.
3766bc9e42dbf2be490a7d3ec172d712a8e665ad.issues: Requires ground gauge data; daily resolution only; performance in complex terrain depends on gauge density.

17ba1ee3e062e97806af44d89223fb70264ea833.goal: Forecasts daily inflow to the Ermenek hydroelectric dam reservoir, Turkey, to optimize water management and energy production.
17ba1ee3e062e97806af44d89223fb70264ea833.architecture: Recurrent neural networks (simple RNN, LSTM, GRU, bidirectional LSTM) compared with a two-hidden-layer artificial neural network (MLP).
17ba1ee3e062e97806af44d89223fb70264ea833.data: Daily observed streamflow 2012–2018 at the Ermenek dam; only lagged streamflow as inputs.
17ba1ee3e062e97806af44d89223fb70264ea833.result: LSTM performs best (90% training and 87% testing accuracy) versus 86% and 85% for the ANN.
17ba1ee3e062e97806af44d89223fb70264ea833.open_work: Adding meteorological inputs and testing longer horizons.
17ba1ee3e062e97806af44d89223fb70264ea833.issues: Single reservoir; short record; only autoregressive inputs; accuracy metric loosely defined.

ca95d98a412dfc8bc4841d5072055fb4348ddc9f.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting by handling the non-stationarity of wind power time series.
ca95d98a412dfc8bc4841d5072055fb4348ddc9f.architecture: Variational mode decomposition combined with extreme learning machine (single hidden-layer neural network), with feature selection of decomposed modes.
ca95d98a412dfc8bc4841d5072055fb4348ddc9f.data: Wind power time series from wind farms; exact sites not reported here.
ca95d98a412dfc8bc4841d5072055fb4348ddc9f.result: The VMD-ELM hybrid gives lower forecast errors than benchmark methods including ELM alone and other decompositions.
ca95d98a412dfc8bc4841d5072055fb4348ddc9f.issues: Decomposition applied to the whole series may leak future information; limited datasets.

9946f19268a49712b8c63f12dfe5fb1c913531e9.goal: Builds an adaptive model to forecast weather variables at an Indonesian airport and tests the benefit of intermediate weather variables.
9946f19268a49712b8c63f12dfe5fb1c913531e9.architecture: Single-layer and four-layer LSTM recurrent neural networks extended with an intermediate-variable signal in the memory block.
9946f19268a49712b8c63f12dfe5fb1c913531e9.data: Weather Underground observations at Hang Nadim airport, Indonesia; visibility as target; temperature, pressure, humidity and dew point as intermediate variables.
9946f19268a49712b8c63f12dfe5fb1c913531e9.result: Multi-layer LSTM with pressure as the intermediate variable is best, with validation accuracy 0.8060 and RMSE 0.0775.
9946f19268a49712b8c63f12dfe5fb1c913531e9.open_work: Testing other target variables and locations.
9946f19268a49712b8c63f12dfe5fb1c913531e9.issues: Single station; limited evaluation; no comparison with NWP.

62d80220b3218610ffacb8eef49870b2854a6b65.goal: Predicts monthly streamflow in the mountainous Swat River Basin, Pakistan, using precipitation and temperature inputs.
62d80220b3218610ffacb8eef49870b2854a6b65.architecture: Least square support vector machine, multivariate adaptive regression splines, optimally pruned extreme learning machine and M5 model tree, compared with SARIMA.
62d80220b3218610ffacb8eef49870b2854a6b65.data: Monthly streamflow, precipitation and temperature at Kalam and Chakdara stations, Swat River Basin, Pakistan.
62d80220b3218610ffacb8eef49870b2854a6b65.result: LSSVM and MARS are most accurate; LSSVM reduces RMSE by 9–35% at Kalam; temperature alone predicts Kalam streamflow well; heuristic methods beat SARIMA.
62d80220b3218610ffacb8eef49870b2854a6b65.open_work: Applying the models in other mountainous basins and with snow data.
62d80220b3218610ffacb8eef49870b2854a6b65.issues: Two stations only; monthly scale; no uncertainty assessment.

dd66bb6817f8c62cfc533f55eb32673c9b2d6e06.goal: Provides reliable deterministic and probabilistic wind speed predictions for wind power integration with reduced training cost.
dd66bb6817f8c62cfc533f55eb32673c9b2d6e06.architecture: Shared Weight LSTM recurrent neural network combined with Gaussian process regression (SWLSTM-GPR) for probabilistic prediction.
dd66bb6817f8c62cfc533f55eb32673c9b2d6e06.data: Four wind speed prediction cases in Inner Mongolia, China.
dd66bb6817f8c62cfc533f55eb32673c9b2d6e06.result: SWLSTM-GPR achieves high-precision point predictions, appropriate prediction intervals and reliable probabilistic predictions with shorter training time than state-of-the-art methods.
dd66bb6817f8c62cfc533f55eb32673c9b2d6e06.open_work: Applying to wind power and multi-site settings.
dd66bb6817f8c62cfc533f55eb32673c9b2d6e06.issues: Limited cases from one region; short-term horizons only.

24fa0aeef63e72445312993ca5dfd51dcff8f487.goal: Forecasts multi-site PV power at fine spatial and temporal resolution, exploiting the dense network of PV systems as virtual weather stations.
24fa0aeef63e72445312993ca5dfd51dcff8f487.architecture: Graph neural networks: graph-convolutional LSTM (GCLSTM) and graph-convolutional transformer (GCTrafo).
24fa0aeef63e72445312993ca5dfd51dcff8f487.data: Production data from 304 real PV systems and simulated production from 1000 PV systems across Switzerland, one year each.
24fa0aeef63e72445312993ca5dfd51dcff8f487.result: Models outperform state-of-the-art multi-site methods up to 6 hours ahead and single-site methods with NWP inputs up to 4 hours ahead.
24fa0aeef63e72445312993ca5dfd51dcff8f487.open_work: Adding NWP and satellite inputs to extend skill to longer horizons.
24fa0aeef63e72445312993ca5dfd51dcff8f487.issues: Production-only inputs limit longer-horizon skill; one year of data; deterministic forecasts only.

92e6f42bba3e8724267041da35d5df201766c0b7.goal: Improves daily streamflow prediction by coupling a process-based hydrological model with a neural network.
92e6f42bba3e8724267041da35d5df201766c0b7.architecture: SWAT hydrological model outputs (e.g. baseflow and stormflow) used as inputs to an artificial neural network (MLP).
92e6f42bba3e8724267041da35d5df201766c0b7.data: Daily streamflow from watersheds in the southeastern US near Atlanta, Georgia; details not reported here.
92e6f42bba3e8724267041da35d5df201766c0b7.result: The coupled SWAT-ANN model improves daily streamflow predictions relative to SWAT or ANN alone.
92e6f42bba3e8724267041da35d5df201766c0b7.open_work: Testing in ungauged settings and other climates.
92e6f42bba3e8724267041da35d5df201766c0b7.issues: Regional scope; ANN component inherits SWAT structural errors.

ac3cd1f180288fad13dee48ffcd86203ff483dfa.goal: Critically reviews models used to estimate solar radiation for solar energy applications.
ac3cd1f180288fad13dee48ffcd86203ff483dfa.architecture: Review of solar radiation estimation models, including empirical sunshine-, temperature- and cloud-based models and machine-learning methods such as artificial neural networks.
ac3cd1f180288fad13dee48ffcd86203ff483dfa.data: Review of published studies; no new data.
ac3cd1f180288fad13dee48ffcd86203ff483dfa.result: Compares strengths, weaknesses and accuracy of model categories.

a8e2c19e7529e7e1158000f6d5919f9ee3341d67.goal: Improves wind and solar power forecasting by exploiting a spatial grid of numerical weather predictions rather than a single grid point.
a8e2c19e7529e7e1158000f6d5919f9ee3341d67.architecture: Feature engineering from gridded NWP (spatial and temporal features, principal components) with gradient boosting trees for point and probabilistic forecasts.
a8e2c19e7529e7e1158000f6d5919f9ee3341d67.data: Gridded NWP forecasts and power measurements from wind and solar plants; details not reported here.
a8e2c19e7529e7e1158000f6d5919f9ee3341d67.result: Grid-derived features improve forecast skill for both wind and solar power compared with single-point NWP inputs.
a8e2c19e7529e7e1158000f6d5919f9ee3341d67.open_work: Applying to more plants and longer horizons.
a8e2c19e7529e7e1158000f6d5919f9ee3341d67.issues: Limited number of plants; benefits depend on NWP quality.

66ec17be10688bbb10218c50c487223623767bf7.goal: Reviews multi-step-ahead wind speed forecasting models for wind power integration.
66ec17be10688bbb10218c50c487223623767bf7.architecture: Review of wind speed forecasting models, including physical, statistical, artificial neural network, hybrid and decomposition-based approaches.
66ec17be10688bbb10218c50c487223623767bf7.data: Review of published studies; no new data.
66ec17be10688bbb10218c50c487223623767bf7.result: Summarizes performance of model classes and the advantages of hybrid approaches for multi-step forecasting.
66ec17be10688bbb10218c50c487223623767bf7.open_work: Developing robust hybrid models and standardized evaluation.

6e4e7c97baaae48c21c3083f86aea14c9422ef6e.goal: Reviews solar PV power forecasting techniques, focusing on data-driven procedures.
6e4e7c97baaae48c21c3083f86aea14c9422ef6e.architecture: Review of data-driven solar PV power forecasting methods, including machine learning and deep learning models.
6e4e7c97baaae48c21c3083f86aea14c9422ef6e.data: Review of published studies; no new data.
6e4e7c97baaae48c21c3083f86aea14c9422ef6e.result: Critically analyzes strengths and weaknesses of recent PV forecasting techniques.
6e4e7c97baaae48c21c3083f86aea14c9422ef6e.open_work: Higher accuracy models and better applications.

5c026a88056c799fe6401cce3657e836b96bd91a.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting by handling non-stationarity.
5c026a88056c799fe6401cce3657e836b96bd91a.architecture: Discrete wavelet transform decomposition with an independent LSTM recurrent neural network for each component.
5c026a88056c799fe6401cce3657e836b96bd91a.data: Wind power data from three wind farms.
5c026a88056c799fe6401cce3657e836b96bd91a.result: DWT-LSTM improves MAE, MAPE and RMSE over benchmarks.
5c026a88056c799fe6401cce3657e836b96bd91a.issues: Three farms only; decomposition may leak future information.

ebfb65d3574edd963353d551e27ca42bbc31a93b.goal: Assesses the state of the art in accuracy of solar resource forecasting.
ebfb65d3574edd963353d551e27ca42bbc31a93b.architecture: Review of accuracy tests across forecasting classes: persistence, classical statistics, machine learning, cloud-motion tracking, NWP and hybrid models.
ebfb65d3574edd963353d551e27ca42bbc31a93b.data: 1705 accuracy tests reported in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
ebfb65d3574edd963353d551e27ca42bbc31a93b.result: Machine learning and hybrid models are best intra-hour; hybrids best day-ahead; normalized MBE and RMSE reduced by two thirds and one third over the decade.
ebfb65d3574edd963353d551e27ca42bbc31a93b.open_work: More consistent reporting and additional error measures.
ebfb65d3574edd963353d551e27ca42bbc31a93b.issues: Literature avoids reporting poor-performance cases, biasing the assessment.

0c71a4f2be03e80198cca95743f32786c2de4695.goal: Reviews and evaluates the PERSIANN family of satellite precipitation products.
0c71a4f2be03e80198cca95743f32786c2de4695.architecture: Review of PERSIANN, PERSIANN-CCS and PERSIANN-CDR retrieval algorithms, which use artificial neural networks on satellite infrared data.
0c71a4f2be03e80198cca95743f32786c2de4695.data: Evaluation over CONUS against CPC unified gauge analysis, plus quasi-global comparison.
0c71a4f2be03e80198cca95743f32786c2de4695.result: Describes product differences and evaluates strengths and limitations at daily and coarser scales.
0c71a4f2be03e80198cca95743f32786c2de4695.issues: Daily scale only due to the CPC benchmark.

7ef7d9345fc6f6c78d3445dcd0e3dd3327e223e9.goal: Predicts monthly rainfall by combining wavelet decomposition with neural networks.
7ef7d9345fc6f6c78d3445dcd0e3dd3327e223e9.architecture: Wavelet neural network combining wavelet decomposition and artificial neural networks, compared with ANN.
7ef7d9345fc6f6c78d3445dcd0e3dd3327e223e9.data: Monthly rainfall data at Darjeeling rain gauge station, India.
7ef7d9345fc6f6c78d3445dcd0e3dd3327e223e9.result: Wavelet neural network models outperform ANN models.

7ab622171148518544ab304f9708c2fc0896ab1d.goal: Detects cloud and cloud shadow in single-date Landsat imagery for ecological applications.
7ab622171148518544ab304f9708c2fc0896ab1d.architecture: Neural network pixel classifier with spatial post-processing (SPARCS) for cloud, shadow, water, snow/ice and clear sky.
7ab622171148518544ab304f9708c2fc0896ab1d.result: SPARCS gives substantially lower shadow omission errors than FMask with slightly higher cloud omission and fewer commission errors, plus uncertainty estimates.
7ab622171148518544ab304f9708c2fc0896ab1d.open_work: Using SPARCS for obstruction-free composites and change detection.
7ab622171148518544ab304f9708c2fc0896ab1d.issues: Landsat-specific; validation scene count not reported in the abstract.

7c403fcf15c70be9124c6024079420e22912bbc8.goal: Constructs prediction intervals for short-term wind farm power forecasts to quantify uncertainty.
7c403fcf15c70be9124c6024079420e22912bbc8.architecture: Neural network-based prediction interval construction via the lower upper bound estimation approach.
7c403fcf15c70be9124c6024079420e22912bbc8.data: Wind farm power generation data; details not reported here.
7c403fcf15c70be9124c6024079420e22912bbc8.result: Constructs high-quality prediction intervals with good coverage and narrow width compared with traditional methods.
7c403fcf15c70be9124c6024079420e22912bbc8.issues: Limited datasets; details not reported here.

bc003b975dbd2b60d01dedc3a483fa5b84c31499.goal: Reveals the drivers of severe haze pollution episodes in China, including those during COVID-19 lockdown.
bc003b975dbd2b60d01dedc3a483fa5b84c31499.architecture: Random forest coupled with SHAP explanations to attribute PM2.5 to meteorology, emissions and chemistry.
bc003b975dbd2b60d01dedc3a483fa5b84c31499.data: Five severe haze episodes in China before or during COVID-19 lockdown, with PM2.5, meteorological and chemical observations.
bc003b975dbd2b60d01dedc3a483fa5b84c31499.result: Meteorology contributes 30–65 μg/m3 and chemistry about 15–30 μg/m3; photochemistry drives nitrate, humidity drives sulfate.
bc003b975dbd2b60d01dedc3a483fa5b84c31499.open_work: Applying explainable ML as a complement to chemical transport models.

5cd5268ab8dfafad7b63d9261978d2ed0f14943f.goal: Compares methods to avoid overfitting in neural network training for catchment runoff modeling.
5cd5268ab8dfafad7b63d9261978d2ed0f14943f.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural networks trained with overfitting-control methods such as early stopping, noise injection and weight decay.
5cd5268ab8dfafad7b63d9261978d2ed0f14943f.data: Catchment rainfall-runoff data; details not reported here.
