5cd5268ab8dfafad7b63d9261978d2ed0f14943f.result: Different overfitting-avoidance methods yield different runoff prediction accuracy; no single method dominates.
5cd5268ab8dfafad7b63d9261978d2ed0f14943f.issues: Limited catchments; details not reported here.

ff08ec1adf118148b8999e333399420bbcdd0629.goal: Merges multiple satellite-based precipitation products with gauges over the Chinese mainland.
ff08ec1adf118148b8999e333399420bbcdd0629.architecture: Double machine learning: random forest classification combined with regression by random forest, ANN, SVM or extreme learning machine.
ff08ec1adf118148b8999e333399420bbcdd0629.data: Multiple satellite precipitation products and 697 gauges over the Chinese mainland (70% training, 30% evaluation).
ff08ec1adf118148b8999e333399420bbcdd0629.result: DML products reach median KGE 0.67–0.71 versus 0.31–0.54 for original products and 0.47–0.65 for single ML.
ff08ec1adf118148b8999e333399420bbcdd0629.open_work: Testing with smaller gauge networks and other regions.
ff08ec1adf118148b8999e333399420bbcdd0629.issues: Requires gauge coverage; ensembles of DML do not improve accuracy.

2a714abbcfd95af7765f8cffb997a2a10ab9478f.goal: Forecasts short-term output power of three grid-connected PV systems.
2a714abbcfd95af7765f8cffb997a2a10ab9478f.architecture: Extreme learning machine (single hidden-layer neural network) compared with SVR and ANN.
2a714abbcfd95af7765f8cffb997a2a10ab9478f.data: PV output and meteorological data from three grid-connected PV systems in Malaysia.
2a714abbcfd95af7765f8cffb997a2a10ab9478f.result: ELM achieves better accuracy and faster training than SVR and ANN.
2a714abbcfd95af7765f8cffb997a2a10ab9478f.open_work: Testing longer horizons and probabilistic outputs.
2a714abbcfd95af7765f8cffb997a2a10ab9478f.issues: Three systems in one location; limited data.

843bb035941906830cd77a17faa47f9e112d6a49.goal: Maps wind speed profiles across Nigeria for energy applications.
843bb035941906830cd77a17faa47f9e112d6a49.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) predicting wind speed from geographical and temporal inputs.
843bb035941906830cd77a17faa47f9e112d6a49.data: Multi-year wind speed records from meteorological stations across Nigeria.
843bb035941906830cd77a17faa47f9e112d6a49.result: The ANN reproduces monthly mean wind speeds with good correlation, allowing national wind speed maps.
843bb035941906830cd77a17faa47f9e112d6a49.open_work: Using the maps for wind energy siting.
843bb035941906830cd77a17faa47f9e112d6a49.issues: Coarse station coverage; monthly means only.

7402ea19b9998a6483afc60c2a96ed10a2dd00b6.goal: Improves flood susceptibility mapping by replacing single train-test splits, which bias results, with multi-run resampling of training and validation data.
7402ea19b9998a6483afc60c2a96ed10a2dd00b6.architecture: Generalized additive model (GAM), boosted regression trees (BRT) and multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS), each combined with random subsampling or bootstrapping over 10 runs and averaged.
7402ea19b9998a6483afc60c2a96ed10a2dd00b6.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors for Ardabil Province on the Caspian Sea margin, Iran; MLP and SVM used as benchmarks.
7402ea19b9998a6483afc60c2a96ed10a2dd00b6.result: Bootstrapping beats random subsampling; BT-GAM performs best (AUC 0.98, TSS 0.93, COR 0.91), ahead of BT-MARS (AUC 0.97) and BT-BRT (AUC 0.95), outperforming standalone models.
7402ea19b9998a6483afc60c2a96ed10a2dd00b6.open_work: Testing transferability to other regions and flood types, and quantifying spread across resampling runs as uncertainty.
7402ea19b9998a6483afc60c2a96ed10a2dd00b6.issues: Single study region; susceptibility validated against an inventory of past floods only; very high AUC may reflect spatial autocorrelation between training and test points.

9cb1f38da599eae8b05128a2bcdbc29dfdc1173d.goal: Forecasts short-term offshore wind power, which is hard because offshore wind is intermittent, to support wind-farm operation and maintenance.
9cb1f38da599eae8b05128a2bcdbc29dfdc1173d.architecture: Hybrid of discrete wavelet transform decomposition, SARIMA for components and an LSTM recurrent neural network, with Isolation Forest outlier removal, resampling and interpolation for preprocessing.
9cb1f38da599eae8b05128a2bcdbc29dfdc1173d.data: SCADA power time series from one offshore wind turbine in Scotland.
9cb1f38da599eae8b05128a2bcdbc29dfdc1173d.result: The DWT-SARIMA-LSTM hybrid gives the highest accuracy among all tested models; specific error values are not reported in the abstract.
9cb1f38da599eae8b05128a2bcdbc29dfdc1173d.open_work: Extending to farm-level forecasts, longer horizons and inclusion of meteorological forecast inputs.
9cb1f38da599eae8b05128a2bcdbc29dfdc1173d.issues: Single turbine; univariate power history without NWP inputs; no probabilistic output; wavelet decomposition over the whole series risks look-ahead leakage if not applied causally.

bc5c775e8be549cc02c57e15849723caf33f5a80.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for wind power integration by decomposing the signal before prediction.
bc5c775e8be549cc02c57e15849723caf33f5a80.architecture: Wavelet packet decomposition of wind speed followed by artificial neural networks (feed-forward) whose training is performed by the crisscross optimization metaheuristic instead of gradient backpropagation.
bc5c775e8be549cc02c57e15849723caf33f5a80.data: Measured wind speed series from wind sites; details not reported here.
bc5c775e8be549cc02c57e15849723caf33f5a80.result: The hybrid is reported to outperform benchmark ANN and decomposition models; numbers not reported here.
bc5c775e8be549cc02c57e15849723caf33f5a80.open_work: Testing on more sites and horizons and comparing with deep learning forecasters.
bc5c775e8be549cc02c57e15849723caf33f5a80.issues: No abstract available; evaluation likely limited to a few series; decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information if not applied causally.

4e09ea7644457deeec73772e0ce741f056e61db3.goal: Predicts daily streamflow for flood warning, navigation and reservoir operation using a fast heuristic learning method.
4e09ea7644457deeec73772e0ce741f056e61db3.architecture: Optimally pruned extreme learning machine (OP-ELM, a single-hidden-layer neural network) with various kernels, compared with ANFIS-PSO, MARS and M5 model tree under cross-validation.
4e09ea7644457deeec73772e0ce741f056e61db3.data: Daily streamflow and hydro-climatic data at Fujiangqiao and Shehang stations on the Fujiang River, China.
4e09ea7644457deeec73772e0ce741f056e61db3.result: OP-ELM is best upstream and ANFIS-PSO downstream for prediction; in estimation OP-ELM reduces ANFIS-PSO error by 12%, and local data improve downstream estimates.
4e09ea7644457deeec73772e0ce741f056e61db3.open_work: Applying OP-ELM to other basins, longer lead times and with additional predictors.
4e09ea7644457deeec73772e0ce741f056e61db3.issues: Two stations on one river; one-day-ahead setting; no uncertainty quantification or extreme-event analysis.

3456743c42dfff1342bc1a9bcb340bf7d7fe4233.goal: Predicts hourly global solar radiation for solar energy system sizing and operation using a tuned ensemble learner.
3456743c42dfff1342bc1a9bcb340bf7d7fe4233.architecture: Random forest whose hyperparameters (number of trees and leaves) are optimized with the firefly algorithm, compared with standard random forest and artificial neural networks.
3456743c42dfff1342bc1a9bcb340bf7d7fe4233.data: Hourly meteorological and solar radiation measurements from a site in Malaysia.
3456743c42dfff1342bc1a9bcb340bf7d7fe4233.result: The firefly-optimized random forest gives lower errors and faster computation than the plain random forest and ANN baselines.
3456743c42dfff1342bc1a9bcb340bf7d7fe4233.open_work: Testing at other climates and for multi-step forecasting.
3456743c42dfff1342bc1a9bcb340bf7d7fe4233.issues: Single site; metaheuristic tuning gains are modest; no probabilistic output; details limited without abstract.

d2d3b180f4e37dc30adf2e0f3b732656a257d9c4.goal: Compares air quality across two cities and forecasts daily PM10 and PM2.5 to support public warnings.
d2d3b180f4e37dc30adf2e0f3b732656a257d9c4.architecture: Principal component analysis for intercomparison of monitoring data, and multilayer perceptron (MLP) artificial neural networks for forecasting daily particulate matter concentrations.
d2d3b180f4e37dc30adf2e0f3b732656a257d9c4.data: Air quality and meteorological monitoring data from Thessaloniki (Greece) and Helsinki (Finland).
d2d3b180f4e37dc30adf2e0f3b732656a257d9c4.result: PCA reveals differing pollution regimes between the cities; MLP models forecast daily PM10 and PM2.5 with useful skill, better for the city-specific dominant sources.
d2d3b180f4e37dc30adf2e0f3b732656a257d9c4.open_work: Including more predictors and forecasting exceedance events directly.
d2d3b180f4e37dc30adf2e0f3b732656a257d9c4.issues: Two cities; station-level forecasts only; no abstract to verify quantitative scores.

a377b1d7add12365b08c5939f187284ca21249d1.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power output and assesses how the choice of weather input data affects forecast accuracy.
a377b1d7add12365b08c5939f187284ca21249d1.architecture: Statistical methods: multiple regression and an Elman recurrent artificial neural network, using different combinations of weather variables as inputs.
a377b1d7add12365b08c5939f187284ca21249d1.data: Measured PV power and meteorological data from a PV plant in southern Italy (Lecce), several forecast horizons.
a377b1d7add12365b08c5939f187284ca21249d1.result: The Elman neural network outperforms multiple regression, and adding weather variables such as module temperature and irradiance improves forecasts.
a377b1d7add12365b08c5939f187284ca21249d1.open_work: Using NWP forecast inputs and extending to more plants.
a377b1d7add12365b08c5939f187284ca21249d1.issues: Single plant; inputs are measured rather than forecast weather, which overstates operational skill.

301d8603bb12123c30cff95664786402f2276f14.goal: Produces a high-resolution daily soil moisture dataset over China because existing satellite and model products are coarse or biased.
301d8603bb12123c30cff95664786402f2276f14.architecture: Random forest regression mapping meteorological forcing, vegetation, land cover, terrain and soil properties to in situ soil moisture at multiple depths.
301d8603bb12123c30cff95664786402f2276f14.data: In situ soil moisture from China Meteorological Administration stations (about 1,700) with ERA5-Land forcing, MODIS LAI, land cover, DEM and soil property maps; 1 km daily, 2000–2020 (SMCI1.0).
301d8603bb12123c30cff95664786402f2276f14.result: The dataset reproduces station soil moisture with correlation near 0.9 and ubRMSE around 0.04–0.05 cm3/cm3 in cross-validation, improving on ERA5-Land and satellite products.
301d8603bb12123c30cff95664786402f2276f14.open_work: Extending coverage beyond station-dense regions and adding uncertainty estimates.
301d8603bb12123c30cff95664786402f2276f14.issues: Accuracy degrades where stations are sparse (western China); random forest may smooth extremes; inherits ERA5-Land forcing errors.

846b30678941c89d69200b550ef03a7e11f6dc29.goal: Reviews statistical wind forecasting and proposes a hybrid method for hourly wind speed forecasts to support energy trading and planning.
846b30678941c89d69200b550ef03a7e11f6dc29.architecture: Review of statistical wind forecasting methods across horizons plus a hybrid combining adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and an artificial neural network (ANN).
846b30678941c89d69200b550ef03a7e11f6dc29.data: Wind speed measurements at three locations; data source not reported in the abstract.
846b30678941c89d69200b550ef03a7e11f6dc29.result: The hybrid yields MAPE of 2.26%, 3.35% and 3.86% at the three locations for daily average wind speeds.
846b30678941c89d69200b550ef03a7e11f6dc29.open_work: Extending to wind power and multi-step horizons and comparing with deep learning methods.
846b30678941c89d69200b550ef03a7e11f6dc29.issues: Evaluation on daily averages despite hourly framing; few sites; no probabilistic output.

035e1b6a8033e41aea5d4f6645ec509afa97941a.goal: Models the rainfall-runoff process with soft computing techniques as alternatives to conceptual hydrological models.
035e1b6a8033e41aea5d4f6645ec509afa97941a.architecture: Soft computing models including artificial neural networks, adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and gene expression programming compared for daily runoff simulation.
035e1b6a8033e41aea5d4f6645ec509afa97941a.data: Daily rainfall and runoff records from a catchment in Turkey.
035e1b6a8033e41aea5d4f6645ec509afa97941a.result: Gene expression programming and the neural approaches give accurate runoff estimates, with relative ranking depending on input combinations.
035e1b6a8033e41aea5d4f6645ec509afa97941a.open_work: Testing on more catchments and adding other predictors such as evaporation or snow.
035e1b6a8033e41aea5d4f6645ec509afa97941a.issues: Single catchment; no abstract available to confirm details; data-driven models lack physical constraints for extrapolation.

951bceda47033ba6c91af5c44e92cc8b8cc618b1.goal: Forecasts peak weekly urban water demand to support utility operations, comparing neural networks with regression.
951bceda47033ba6c91af5c44e92cc8b8cc618b1.architecture: Multiple linear regression versus feed-forward artificial neural networks trained with Levenberg-Marquardt, resilient backpropagation and conjugate gradient algorithms.
951bceda47033ba6c91af5c44e92cc8b8cc618b1.data: Weekly water demand with maximum temperature and rainfall inputs for Nicosia, Cyprus.
951bceda47033ba6c91af5c44e92cc8b8cc618b1.result: ANNs outperform multiple linear regression, with the Levenberg-Marquardt-trained network giving the most accurate peak demand forecasts.
951bceda47033ba6c91af5c44e92cc8b8cc618b1.open_work: Testing at other time scales and cities and incorporating more climate variables.
951bceda47033ba6c91af5c44e92cc8b8cc618b1.issues: Single city with a short weekly record; no uncertainty quantification or test under changing demand patterns.

252cd06af073a744739d1c84f9484d64db1b88b9.goal: Forecasts hourly global solar radiation for solar energy integration by grouping similar conditions before prediction.
252cd06af073a744739d1c84f9484d64db1b88b9.architecture: k-means clustering of the time series combined with nonlinear autoregressive (NAR) neural networks trained per cluster.
252cd06af073a744739d1c84f9484d64db1b88b9.data: Hourly global solar radiation measurements from a site in Algeria.
252cd06af073a744739d1c84f9484d64db1b88b9.result: The k-means plus NAR hybrid outperforms a single NAR network and other benchmarks; exact errors not reported here.
252cd06af073a744739d1c84f9484d64db1b88b9.open_work: Adding meteorological inputs and testing other climates.
252cd06af073a744739d1c84f9484d64db1b88b9.issues: Univariate input; single site; no abstract available to confirm numbers.

6cbeca878249c95c907660281e41eaf4e19a6944.goal: Estimates daily horizontal global solar radiation where measurements are lacking.
6cbeca878249c95c907660281e41eaf4e19a6944.architecture: Hybrid support vector machine with wavelet transform preprocessing (SVM-WT), compared with ANN, genetic programming and ARMA models.
6cbeca878249c95c907660281e41eaf4e19a6944.data: Daily meteorological and solar radiation data from a station in Iran.
6cbeca878249c95c907660281e41eaf4e19a6944.result: SVM-WT gives the most accurate estimates among the compared models.
6cbeca878249c95c907660281e41eaf4e19a6944.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates.
6cbeca878249c95c907660281e41eaf4e19a6944.issues: Single station; no abstract to confirm specifics; wavelet preprocessing can leak information if not applied causally.

4f42ad1ad4c962c1f9f7d9e15a2b5ee7333913b3.goal: Builds a long observation-based global runoff record to study past freshwater variability in data-sparse regions.
4f42ad1ad4c962c1f9f7d9e15a2b5ee7333913b3.architecture: Machine learning reconstruction (random forest in the paper) predicting monthly runoff from antecedent precipitation and temperature, trained on in situ streamflow; GRUN dataset.
4f42ad1ad4c962c1f9f7d9e15a2b5ee7333913b3.data: In situ streamflow from small catchments (GSIM) with GSWP3 reanalysis forcing; global 0.5° monthly runoff 1902–2014, compared with 13 global hydrological models.
4f42ad1ad4c962c1f9f7d9e15a2b5ee7333913b3.result: GRUN agrees better with streamflow observations than the 13-model ensemble and estimates global mean runoff of 38,452 km3/yr.
4f42ad1ad4c962c1f9f7d9e15a2b5ee7333913b3.open_work: Using the dataset for drought propagation, teleconnection studies and evaluating hydrological models.
4f42ad1ad4c962c1f9f7d9e15a2b5ee7333913b3.issues: No explicit human water use or storage dynamics; depends on reanalysis forcing quality, especially early in the record and in data-poor regions.

3189493d42787fb6bbb1583ea58e98d90fa9b99c.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power output under changing weather to support stable plant operation.
3189493d42787fb6bbb1583ea58e98d90fa9b99c.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN) that classifies weather conditions and LSTM that learns power generation patterns conditioned on them.
3189493d42787fb6bbb1583ea58e98d90fa9b99c.data: PV power output data from a power plant in Busan, Korea.
3189493d42787fb6bbb1583ea58e98d90fa9b99c.result: MAPE of 4.58% on a sunny day and 7.06% on a cloudy day.
3189493d42787fb6bbb1583ea58e98d90fa9b99c.open_work: Testing on more plants and longer horizons with weather forecast inputs.
3189493d42787fb6bbb1583ea58e98d90fa9b99c.issues: Single plant; evaluation on selected days; no probabilistic output.

25e59de0214dda47f28813e6ac92a583da845366.goal: Simulates river water level and water quality to support water management in a regulated basin.
25e59de0214dda47f28813e6ac92a583da845366.architecture: Combined deep learning approach: a convolutional neural network (CNN) for water level and LSTM for total nitrogen, total phosphorus and total organic carbon.
25e59de0214dda47f28813e6ac92a583da845366.data: Nakdong River basin, Korea: WAMIS water level, real-time water quality, KMA rainfall radar images and estuary barrage operation; calibration Jan 2016–Mar 2017, validation Mar–Nov 2017.
25e59de0214dda47f28813e6ac92a583da845366.result: Both CNN and LSTM reach 'very good' performance with Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency above 0.75 and capture pollutant temporal variations.
25e59de0214dda47f28813e6ac92a583da845366.open_work: Longer records and testing transfer to other basins.
25e59de0214dda47f28813e6ac92a583da845366.issues: Under two years of data; single basin; no uncertainty quantification.

9c5176e31ef6e9b7499dbcdcc7d3322f1a70ef44.goal: Combines physics-based models with recurrent networks to model physical processes accurately, consistently with physical laws and with scarce observations.
9c5176e31ef6e9b7499dbcdcc7d3322f1a70ef44.architecture: Physics-guided recurrent neural network (PGRNN, LSTM-based) with a density-depth physical constraint in the loss and pre-training on simulations from a process-based lake model.
9c5176e31ef6e9b7499dbcdcc7d3322f1a70ef44.data: Observed and General Lake Model (GLM)-simulated temperature profiles for lakes such as Lake Mendota, Wisconsin.
9c5176e31ef6e9b7499dbcdcc7d3322f1a70ef44.result: PGRNN improves accuracy over the physical model, produces physically consistent outputs and generalizes better than a standard RNN; pre-training and density constraints both help.
9c5176e31ef6e9b7499dbcdcc7d3322f1a70ef44.open_work: Applying the approach to other scientific systems and adding further physical constraints.
9c5176e31ef6e9b7499dbcdcc7d3322f1a70ef44.issues: Demonstrated on few lakes; physical constraints are soft penalties; relies on a calibrated process model for pre-training.

cf931002c739e23f71833073ecff57bcb0020db1.goal: Produces short-term probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasts by combining a deterministic neural forecast with an analog ensemble.
cf931002c739e23f71833073ecff57bcb0020db1.architecture: Artificial neural network deterministic forecast combined with the Analog Ensemble (AnEn) method to generate a probabilistic forecast.
cf931002c739e23f71833073ecff57bcb0020db1.data: Power from PV plants in Italy with NWP model forecasts as predictors, horizons up to about 72 hours.
cf931002c739e23f71833073ecff57bcb0020db1.result: The ANN-AnEn combination gives accurate deterministic forecasts and well-calibrated probabilistic forecasts compared with either method alone.
cf931002c739e23f71833073ecff57bcb0020db1.open_work: Testing on more plants and with longer training records.
cf931002c739e23f71833073ecff57bcb0020db1.issues: Few plants; analog quality depends on historical record length; no abstract available to confirm numbers.

0423b043d31ff52779f8876a6c38e8e300e0c0b1.goal: Forecasts wheat yield dynamically during the season, accounting for stage-specific climate extremes missed by crop or regression models alone.
0423b043d31ff52779f8876a6c38e8e300e0c0b1.architecture: Hybrid of the APSIM process-based crop model with random forest or multiple linear regression using growth stage-specific simulated biomass, climate extreme indices, NDVI and SPEI.
0423b043d31ff52779f8876a6c38e8e300e0c0b1.data: Plot-scale wheat yields 2008–2017 in the southeastern Australian wheat belt, with APSIM simulations, NDVI and SPEI.
0423b043d31ff52779f8876a6c38e8e300e0c0b1.result: Random forest beats linear regression at every forecast date; one month before harvest r=0.85, MAPE 17.6%, RMSE 0.70 t/ha; two months before r=0.62.
0423b043d31ff52779f8876a6c38e8e300e0c0b1.open_work: Extending the system to other cropping regions as farming data become available.
0423b043d31ff52779f8876a6c38e8e300e0c0b1.issues: Ten-year record; regional study; skill drops sharply at longer lead times.

7d09c676c2f9ca8acb633b1d0240307cb997c5f8.goal: Forecasts hourly global horizontal irradiance for planning and design of solar energy systems.
7d09c676c2f9ca8acb633b1d0240307cb997c5f8.architecture: Ensemble of extreme gradient boosting forest and a deep neural network (MLP) combined via ridge regression (XGBF-DNN), with selected inputs.
7d09c676c2f9ca8acb633b1d0240307cb997c5f8.data: Hourly data from three Indian locations in different climates; inputs temperature, clear-sky index, relative humidity, hour of day.
7d09c676c2f9ca8acb633b1d0240307cb997c5f8.result: XGBF-DNN gives the best stability and accuracy across seasons, with forecast skill of about 33–40% over smart persistence, beating random forest, SVR, XGBoost and DNN alone.
7d09c676c2f9ca8acb633b1d0240307cb997c5f8.open_work: Applying to solar and wind power and electricity demand forecasting.
7d09c676c2f9ca8acb633b1d0240307cb997c5f8.issues: Hourly ahead only; three sites; no probabilistic forecasts.

4e5cf5d8d6f9e3d27b12c94084492469a191cce5.goal: Generates spatiotemporally continuous surface soil moisture at 30 m for field-scale water management, beyond coarse microwave products.
4e5cf5d8d6f9e3d27b12c94084492469a191cce5.architecture: Data fusion of MODIS and Landsat (NDVI, albedo, LST) plus random forest downscaling using fused variables and coarse soil moisture background fields.
4e5cf5d8d6f9e3d27b12c94084492469a191cce5.data: MODIS, Landsat, CLDAS, ESA CCI v4.4, SMAP Level-4 soil moisture, precipitation, soil texture and in situ sites on the North China Plain.
4e5cf5d8d6f9e3d27b12c94084492469a191cce5.result: Downscaled SMAP_L4 plus CLDAS soil moisture performs best at four of seven sites, R 0.70–0.84, RMSE 0.031–0.050 cm3/cm3; multiple background fields help.
4e5cf5d8d6f9e3d27b12c94084492469a191cce5.open_work: Applying the framework to other regions and validating with denser in situ networks.
4e5cf5d8d6f9e3d27b12c94084492469a191cce5.issues: Few validation sites; depends on fusion product quality and cloud gaps; North China Plain only.

83ee03144e916a5ff981418733b470fa684d0858.goal: Improves monthly streamflow prediction for strongly non-stationary series to support water resources management.
83ee03144e916a5ff981418733b470fa684d0858.architecture: Modified empirical mode decomposition with polynomial fitting for boundary effects combined with a support vector machine (M-EMDSVM), compared with ANN, SVM, WA-SVM and EMD-SVM.
83ee03144e916a5ff981418733b470fa684d0858.data: Monthly streamflow at stations in the Wei River Basin, China, plus simulated series with varying non-stationarity.
83ee03144e916a5ff981418733b470fa684d0858.result: ANN performs worst; M-EMDSVM beats EMD-SVM for strongly non-stationary series and matches it for weakly non-stationary series.
83ee03144e916a5ff981418733b470fa684d0858.open_work: Testing other decomposition methods and basins.
83ee03144e916a5ff981418733b470fa684d0858.issues: Single basin; decomposition of full series may leak future information; monthly scale only.

2358ed5cbd28fc2ac998ffccf5299d7a33801560.goal: Forecasts very short-term wind power to reduce risk in power system operation and dispatch.
2358ed5cbd28fc2ac998ffccf5299d7a33801560.architecture: Variational mode decomposition features converted into images and fed to an improved residual-based deep convolutional neural network (CNN, ResNet-style).
2358ed5cbd28fc2ac998ffccf5299d7a33801560.data: Wind speed, direction and power from a wind farm in Turkey, January–December 2018.
2358ed5cbd28fc2ac998ffccf5299d7a33801560.result: The method outperforms SqueezeNet, GoogLeNet, ResNet-18, AlexNet, VGG-16 and a physical model using meteorological forecasts.
2358ed5cbd28fc2ac998ffccf5299d7a33801560.open_work: Testing at more farms and longer horizons.
2358ed5cbd28fc2ac998ffccf5299d7a33801560.issues: One year, one farm; no probabilistic output; numbers not reported in the abstract.

211332718632452cc7be993c54e1337353d6b6e6.goal: Models wind turbine power curves accurately for performance monitoring and power forecasting.
211332718632452cc7be993c54e1337353d6b6e6.architecture: Parametric (e.g., logistic functions) and nonparametric (neural network, clustering and data mining) power curve modeling algorithms.
211332718632452cc7be993c54e1337353d6b6e6.data: Measured wind speed and power data from wind turbines; details not reported here.
211332718632452cc7be993c54e1337353d6b6e6.result: Advanced nonparametric and data mining models fit the power curve more accurately than conventional approaches.
211332718632452cc7be993c54e1337353d6b6e6.open_work: Including additional inputs such as air density and turbulence.
211332718632452cc7be993c54e1337353d6b6e6.issues: No abstract; limited sites; scatter from curtailment and faults needs filtering.

b1635aee19282de1e8de7ddbd096da22567ddc89.goal: Produces precise day-ahead photovoltaic power forecasts for generation scheduling and dispatch.
b1635aee19282de1e8de7ddbd096da22567ddc89.architecture: Deep convolutional neural networks (ResNet and DenseNet) trained with a meta-learning strategy based on a multi-loss-function network, giving point and probabilistic forecasts.
b1635aee19282de1e8de7ddbd096da22567ddc89.data: Historical PV power, meteorological measurements and numerical weather prediction inputs arranged as feature maps; site not reported in the abstract.
b1635aee19282de1e8de7ddbd096da22567ddc89.result: Accurate and reliable point and probabilistic day-ahead forecasts are reported; numbers not given in the abstract.
b1635aee19282de1e8de7ddbd096da22567ddc89.open_work: Testing on more plants and climates.
b1635aee19282de1e8de7ddbd096da22567ddc89.issues: Single case study; deep models need large training sets; no quantitative results in the abstract.

8f5373132c7900003c6c315699ac7bdb9c70a5a6.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for grid dispatch through decomposition, denoising and feature selection.
8f5373132c7900003c6c315699ac7bdb9c70a5a6.architecture: VMD decomposition with wavelet denoising of each mode, PCA-BP feature selection and radial basis function (RBF) neural networks predicting each mode.
8f5373132c7900003c6c315699ac7bdb9c70a5a6.data: Wind speed series and related meteorological factors from wind farms in Spain and China; periods not reported in the abstract.
8f5373132c7900003c6c315699ac7bdb9c70a5a6.result: VMD-WT handles mode aliasing and endpoint effects better than EMD, feature selection improves RBF performance, and the hybrid beats traditional models.
8f5373132c7900003c6c315699ac7bdb9c70a5a6.open_work: Extending to wind power and multi-step forecasting.
8f5373132c7900003c6c315699ac7bdb9c70a5a6.issues: Decomposition over full series may leak future information; no probabilistic output.

640a932208e0fc67b49019961bc420dfb91ac676.goal: Predicts PM2.5 concentrations in Japan more accurately than the operational system.
640a932208e0fc67b49019961bc420dfb91ac676.architecture: Deep recurrent neural network (DRNN) with an autoencoder-based pre-training method designed for time series, and sparsity-based sensor selection.
640a932208e0fc67b49019961bc420dfb91ac676.data: Environmental monitoring sensor data from Japan; compared with the VENUS prediction system.
640a932208e0fc67b49019961bc420dfb91ac676.result: The pre-trained DRNN beats canonical and state-of-the-art autoencoder pre-training and improves on VENUS PM2.5 predictions.
640a932208e0fc67b49019961bc420dfb91ac676.open_work: Extending to other pollutants and longer horizons.
640a932208e0fc67b49019961bc420dfb91ac676.issues: Evaluated in Japan only at monitoring stations; no quantitative error figures in the abstract; no uncertainty estimates.

fcf065134dcf27f6b6926c744e9dd216074c2cf6.goal: Produces probabilistic wind power forecasts so that system operators can account for wind uncertainty in scheduling and reserve allocation.
fcf065134dcf27f6b6926c744e9dd216074c2cf6.architecture: Radial basis function (RBF) neural networks estimating prediction intervals or quantiles of wind power from NWP-based inputs.
fcf065134dcf27f6b6926c744e9dd216074c2cf6.data: NWP forecasts and wind farm power measurements; details not reported here.
fcf065134dcf27f6b6926c744e9dd216074c2cf6.result: The RBF approach yields reliable and sharp probabilistic forecasts compared with benchmark methods.
fcf065134dcf27f6b6926c744e9dd216074c2cf6.open_work: Extending to multiple farms and scenario generation.
fcf065134dcf27f6b6926c744e9dd216074c2cf6.issues: No abstract available to confirm data or scores; evaluation likely covers few wind farms; skill depends on the quality of the NWP inputs.

c74538de9c8384e6a07ddffbab505a7a01939299.goal: Forecasts urban water levels multiple steps ahead in real time to support flood control.
c74538de9c8384e6a07ddffbab505a7a01939299.architecture: Recurrent neural networks (including NARX) for multi-step-ahead water level forecasting.
c74538de9c8384e6a07ddffbab505a7a01939299.data: Rainfall and water level data from an urban pumping station in Taipei, Taiwan.
c74538de9c8384e6a07ddffbab505a7a01939299.result: The RNNs give accurate multi-step forecasts useful for pump operation.
c74538de9c8384e6a07ddffbab505a7a01939299.open_work: Extending to more stations and integrating into control systems.
c74538de9c8384e6a07ddffbab505a7a01939299.issues: Single site; error accumulates over steps; no abstract to confirm numbers.

5be6821d662957aa7d6bb0d94461b2baf309feb2.goal: Predicts wind turbine power output with interpretable ensemble models so that operators can understand which inputs drive predictions.
5be6821d662957aa7d6bb0d94461b2baf309feb2.architecture: Ensemble learning methods with SHAP analysis for interpretation; the specific ensemble algorithms are not specified here.
5be6821d662957aa7d6bb0d94461b2baf309feb2.data: Wind turbine operational data; source and period not reported here.
5be6821d662957aa7d6bb0d94461b2baf309feb2.result: The ensemble models are reported to predict turbine power accurately, with SHAP used to rank input importance; numbers not reported here.
5be6821d662957aa7d6bb0d94461b2baf309feb2.open_work: Testing across turbines, sites and seasons.
5be6821d662957aa7d6bb0d94461b2baf309feb2.issues: No abstract available, so data and scores are unknown; SHAP explains model behaviour rather than physical causation.

57cbc4def1cdc28cab3f5ba0bb5e2b64644c2447.goal: Forecasts wind farm power one day ahead from NWP and historical data to reduce grid operation costs.
57cbc4def1cdc28cab3f5ba0bb5e2b64644c2447.architecture: t-SNE dimension reduction and K-means clustering of 78 features, then a Seq2Seq model with attention (recurrent encoder-decoder) per cluster.
57cbc4def1cdc28cab3f5ba0bb5e2b64644c2447.data: NWP data and wind farm historical power at 10-min resolution, 1-day horizon.
57cbc4def1cdc28cab3f5ba0bb5e2b64644c2447.result: Seq2Seq outperforms Deep Belief Network and random forest; clustering improves accuracy.
57cbc4def1cdc28cab3f5ba0bb5e2b64644c2447.open_work: Testing at more farms and adding probabilistic output.
57cbc4def1cdc28cab3f5ba0bb5e2b64644c2447.issues: Apparently a single wind farm; error values are not reported in the abstract; separate models per cluster need enough data in each cluster.

6e67b05ad59b09710468f2b23aa1c8f9efed83ca.goal: Forecasts solar power generation with a hybrid of machine learning and statistical methods.
6e67b05ad59b09710468f2b23aa1c8f9efed83ca.architecture: Ensemble of LSTM, GRU, autoencoder LSTM and Auto-GRU recurrent networks combined with the Theta statistical method using four combination schemes.
6e67b05ad59b09710468f2b23aa1c8f9efed83ca.data: Solar power time series from Shagaya (Kuwait) and Cocoa (USA).
6e67b05ad59b09710468f2b23aa1c8f9efed83ca.result: The hybrid ensemble beats individual models, and including the statistical method beats ML-only ensembles.
6e67b05ad59b09710468f2b23aa1c8f9efed83ca.open_work: Adding weather forecast inputs and testing more sites.
6e67b05ad59b09710468f2b23aa1c8f9efed83ca.issues: Only two sites; models use the power series alone without weather forecasts; no quantitative errors in the abstract.

d24a1dd5f8d5ccff0b65b68c534e96ac98bb4559.goal: Identifies global patterns of terrestrial ecosystem recovery time after drought and the environmental factors that control it, which are poorly understood.
d24a1dd5f8d5ccff0b65b68c534e96ac98bb4559.architecture: Random forest regression relating recovery time to environmental factors, combined with partial correlation analysis to map the dominant factor per location.
d24a1dd5f8d5ccff0b65b68c534e96ac98bb4559.data: Global remote sensing vegetation indices to derive recovery time, with soil moisture, temperature and vapour pressure deficit (VPD) as drivers.
d24a1dd5f8d5ccff0b65b68c534e96ac98bb4559.result: Global mean recovery time is about 3.3 months, longest in mid-latitude drylands; soil moisture during recovery dominates over 58.4% of assessed land, followed by temperature and VPD.
d24a1dd5f8d5ccff0b65b68c534e96ac98bb4559.open_work: Projecting how declining soil moisture in over 65% of regions will lengthen recovery, especially in the southwestern US, Mediterranean and southern Africa.
d24a1dd5f8d5ccff0b65b68c534e96ac98bb4559.issues: Correlational attribution rather than causal; recovery time from vegetation indices depends on index choice and saturation; random forest importance can be biased by collinear drivers.

75bee76ca0b566025e8df590ea20f5077f11e825.goal: Maps flood susceptibility by improving a neuro-fuzzy model with metaheuristic optimization of its parameters.
75bee76ca0b566025e8df590ea20f5077f11e825.architecture: Adaptive network-based fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) whose parameters are tuned by biogeography-based optimization (BBO) and the bat algorithm (BA).
75bee76ca0b566025e8df590ea20f5077f11e825.data: Flood inventory and flood conditioning factors for a study area; region and data details not reported here.
75bee76ca0b566025e8df590ea20f5077f11e825.result: The optimized ANFIS-BBO and ANFIS-BA hybrids are reported to produce accurate flood susceptibility maps; comparative scores not reported here.
75bee76ca0b566025e8df590ea20f5077f11e825.open_work: Testing the hybrids in other regions and against newer machine learning classifiers.
75bee76ca0b566025e8df590ea20f5077f11e825.issues: No abstract available; single study area; susceptibility validated only against past flood locations.

94179e0b73d57c6c515a832d6f515b7f561224f0.goal: Maps flood susceptibility while explaining how conditioning factors drive predictions, to make data-driven flood maps more trustworthy for planners.
94179e0b73d57c6c515a832d6f515b7f561224f0.architecture: A machine learning flood susceptibility model paired with explainable AI (XAI) attribution methods; the model type is not specified here.
94179e0b73d57c6c515a832d6f515b7f561224f0.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors (terrain, hydrology, land cover) for a study area; details not reported here.
94179e0b73d57c6c515a832d6f515b7f561224f0.result: The model is reported to give accurate susceptibility maps and to rank influential conditioning factors; numbers not reported here.
94179e0b73d57c6c515a832d6f515b7f561224f0.open_work: Applying XAI flood mapping to other regions and comparing explanation methods.
94179e0b73d57c6c515a832d6f515b7f561224f0.issues: No abstract available; explanations describe model behaviour rather than physical causation; single study area.

54be780d787a760ea707647277c30dc6ab59c86f.goal: Classifies ground-based cloud image patches with high accuracy despite small training datasets, which limit deep learning.
54be780d787a760ea707647277c30dc6ab59c86f.architecture: Purpose-designed convolutional neural network (CNN) for small datasets with regularization, combined in a model average ensemble to reduce prediction variance.
54be780d787a760ea707647277c30dc6ab59c86f.data: Singapore whole-sky imaging categories (SWIMCAT) dataset of ground-based sky image patches.
54be780d787a760ea707647277c30dc6ab59c86f.result: The ensemble achieves perfect classification accuracy for most cloud classes and is robust.
54be780d787a760ea707647277c30dc6ab59c86f.open_work: Testing on larger, more diverse sky image datasets and full-sky images.
54be780d787a760ea707647277c30dc6ab59c86f.issues: SWIMCAT is small and relatively easy, so near-perfect accuracy may not transfer to operational imagery.

5ef15cbf35a7d70dd5444c8333de6dd82962eb2f.goal: Forecasts PM2.5 concentrations, which depend on many factors acting over long periods, by encoding domain knowledge in a graph model.
5ef15cbf35a7d70dd5444c8333de6dd82962eb2f.architecture: PM2.5-GNN: a graph neural network over city nodes with domain-knowledge edges (wind-driven transport, terrain) coupled with a recurrent unit (GRU) for long-term dependencies.
5ef15cbf35a7d70dd5444c8333de6dd82962eb2f.data: KnowAir dataset of PM2.5 and ERA5 meteorology for about 184 Chinese cities, 2015–2018.
5ef15cbf35a7d70dd5444c8333de6dd82962eb2f.result: PM2.5-GNN captures fine-grained and long-term influences, outperforms baselines and is deployed online as a free forecasting service; numbers not in the abstract.
5ef15cbf35a7d70dd5444c8333de6dd82962eb2f.open_work: Extending to other pollutants, regions and longer horizons.
5ef15cbf35a7d70dd5444c8333de6dd82962eb2f.issues: City-level graph only; relies on reanalysis meteorology in evaluation rather than forecasts.

db42ed1548e4f8ac721c2cc9427958ab6bed5e87.goal: Benchmarks machine learning against linear methods for short-term solar radiation forecasting on islands, where grids are small and isolated.
db42ed1548e4f8ac721c2cc9427958ab6bed5e87.architecture: Benchmark comparing artificial neural networks, Gaussian processes and support vector machines with linear autoregressive models and persistence.
db42ed1548e4f8ac721c2cc9427958ab6bed5e87.data: Hourly global horizontal irradiance measurements from three French islands (Corsica, Guadeloupe, Réunion), horizons of 1 to 6 hours.
db42ed1548e4f8ac721c2cc9427958ab6bed5e87.result: Machine learning methods gain over linear autoregressive models mainly in unstable, variable climates; in stable conditions linear models are competitive.
db42ed1548e4f8ac721c2cc9427958ab6bed5e87.open_work: Testing with exogenous inputs such as satellite or NWP data and at longer horizons.
db42ed1548e4f8ac721c2cc9427958ab6bed5e87.issues: Univariate endogenous inputs; three sites; gains of ML are modest.

83948523dc46b3f6f157a0a76d245fa56a56b65a.goal: Forecasts short-term PM2.5 concentrations, whose series are noisy and non-stationary, using decomposition and ensemble learning.
83948523dc46b3f6f157a0a76d245fa56a56b65a.architecture: Decomposition-and-ensemble hybrid: complementary ensemble empirical mode decomposition (CEEMD) with support vector regression tuned by the grey wolf optimizer (GWO).
83948523dc46b3f6f157a0a76d245fa56a56b65a.data: Daily PM2.5 concentration series from Chinese cities; details not reported here.
83948523dc46b3f6f157a0a76d245fa56a56b65a.result: The CEEMD-GWO hybrid outperforms single and other decomposition-based benchmark models; numbers not reported here.
83948523dc46b3f6f157a0a76d245fa56a56b65a.open_work: Adding meteorological predictors and testing more cities and horizons.
83948523dc46b3f6f157a0a76d245fa56a56b65a.issues: No abstract available; univariate input; decomposition over full series risks look-ahead leakage.

cf945bc31c74212bfc756559b447bef0cd0b14ba.goal: Forecasts heat load in district heating substations to improve operation and efficiency.
cf945bc31c74212bfc756559b447bef0cd0b14ba.architecture: Supervised machine learning methods compared: support vector regression, multiple linear regression, regression trees and feed-forward neural networks.
cf945bc31c74212bfc756559b447bef0cd0b14ba.data: Operational substation data from a district heating system in Sweden combined with weather data.
cf945bc31c74212bfc756559b447bef0cd0b14ba.result: Support vector regression is reported as the most accurate model.
cf945bc31c74212bfc756559b447bef0cd0b14ba.open_work: Testing on more substations and buildings and longer forecast horizons.
cf945bc31c74212bfc756559b447bef0cd0b14ba.issues: Limited number of substations and seasons; no abstract available to confirm scores.

387cdb1448d283af58e5cd92f42f71757ba15f94.goal: Reviews synthetic aperture radar (SAR) flood detection, since SAR images floods regardless of cloud cover and daylight and supports rapid disaster response.
387cdb1448d283af58e5cd92f42f71757ba15f94.architecture: Review of SAR flood mapping methods, from classical thresholding and change detection to fuzzy logic, machine learning and data fusion, plus open SAR flood datasets and validation strategies.
387cdb1448d283af58e5cd92f42f71757ba15f94.data: Review of the literature and of open SAR flood datasets with ground-truth reference maps; no new data are produced.
387cdb1448d283af58e5cd92f42f71757ba15f94.result: Advanced paradigms such as fuzzy logic, machine learning and data fusion outperform traditional classification, and new open benchmark datasets enable objective, reproducible validation.
387cdb1448d283af58e5cd92f42f71757ba15f94.open_work: Better handling of vegetated and urban areas, standardized quantitative quality metrics and wider high-quality reference data for SAR flood mapping.
387cdb1448d283af58e5cd92f42f71757ba15f94.issues: Complex scattering in vegetated and urban areas still impairs water extraction; the review is qualitative and does not benchmark methods on a common dataset.

06f08ffbd2ff5067dcd5681a186fb475727e6ad7.goal: Improves PM2.5 concentration forecasting at surface monitoring sites by handling the non-stationarity of the concentration time series.
06f08ffbd2ff5067dcd5681a186fb475727e6ad7.architecture: Hybrid EMD-GRU: empirical mode decomposition splits the PM2.5 series into stationary sub-series, each predicted with meteorological features by a gated recurrent unit (GRU) recurrent neural network, then summed.
06f08ffbd2ff5067dcd5681a186fb475727e6ad7.data: PM2.5 concentrations and meteorological features at surface monitoring sites; station locations and periods are not reported in the abstract.
06f08ffbd2ff5067dcd5681a186fb475727e6ad7.result: EMD-GRU reduces RMSE by 44%, MAE by 40.82% and SMAPE by 11.63% relative to a single GRU model.
06f08ffbd2ff5067dcd5681a186fb475727e6ad7.open_work: Testing on more sites and longer horizons, and comparing against other decomposition and deep learning baselines.
06f08ffbd2ff5067dcd5681a186fb475727e6ad7.issues: Only compared with a plain GRU; decomposing the full series can leak future information if not done causally; single case study.

f67b193af85f6834d2400e2909b306f7d65ed39d.goal: Improves monthly streamflow forecasting for water resources management, including floods and droughts, by optimizing AI models with a metaheuristic.
f67b193af85f6834d2400e2909b306f7d65ed39d.architecture: Hybrid models coupling Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) with artificial intelligence regressors; the specific AI model types are not specified in the abstract.
f67b193af85f6834d2400e2909b306f7d65ed39d.data: About 130 years of monthly natural streamflow records; the river or station is not reported in the abstract.
f67b193af85f6834d2400e2909b306f7d65ed39d.result: GWO-integrated AI models outperform standard AI models in both training and testing for all input cases of monthly inflow.
f67b193af85f6834d2400e2909b306f7d65ed39d.open_work: Comparing GWO with other optimizers and testing transfer to other basins and lead times.
f67b193af85f6834d2400e2909b306f7d65ed39d.issues: No quantitative scores given in the abstract; single record; gains from metaheuristic tuning may be modest relative to well-tuned baselines.

01abbab4bdf07639bfed54d4b24fde737d277128.goal: Forecasts short-term wind power generation for Turkish wind farms to support smart grid operation and renewable integration.
01abbab4bdf07639bfed54d4b24fde737d277128.architecture: Comparison of five tuned regression methods: random forest, gradient boosting machine, k-nearest neighbor, decision tree and extra trees regression.
01abbab4bdf07639bfed54d4b24fde737d277128.data: Historical wind speed, wind direction and turbine power from wind farms in western Turkey.
01abbab4bdf07639bfed54d4b24fde737d277128.result: Gradient boosting machine regression gives the best short-term wind power forecasting accuracy among the methods compared.
01abbab4bdf07639bfed54d4b24fde737d277128.open_work: Adding numerical weather prediction inputs, longer horizons and probabilistic forecasts.
01abbab4bdf07639bfed54d4b24fde737d277128.issues: Inputs limited to wind speed and direction; single region; no comparison with deep learning or physical power-curve baselines.

4a1da8d29a720260c62efe1f99eb6fe3f9284f46.goal: Tests extreme learning machines as a fast, accurate alternative for estimating reference evapotranspiration (ET0) when full Penman-Monteith inputs are costly to use.
4a1da8d29a720260c62efe1f99eb6fe3f9284f46.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM), a single-hidden-layer feedforward neural network with random hidden weights, compared with a backpropagation feedforward neural network.
4a1da8d29a720260c62efe1f99eb6fe3f9284f46.data: Daily meteorological records from weather stations in Iraq, with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 as target.
4a1da8d29a720260c62efe1f99eb6fe3f9284f46.result: ELM reproduces Penman-Monteith ET0 with high accuracy and trains much faster than the backpropagation network.
4a1da8d29a720260c62efe1f99eb6fe3f9284f46.open_work: Testing reduced-input configurations and generalization to other climates and stations.
4a1da8d29a720260c62efe1f99eb6fe3f9284f46.issues: Targets are Penman-Monteith estimates rather than lysimeter measurements; few stations; details not verified against the abstract.

37d5e03ebd21b5bb3e7c0d7d93b99321fa253d31.goal: Estimates daily ground-level NO2 exposure across China, where monitoring stations are sparse, by combining satellite retrievals with machine learning.
37d5e03ebd21b5bb3e7c0d7d93b99321fa253d31.architecture: Hybrid model: random forest regression followed by spatiotemporal kriging of the residuals.
37d5e03ebd21b5bb3e7c0d7d93b99321fa253d31.data: OMI satellite tropospheric NO2 columns, meteorological and land-use predictors, and ground NO2 from the national monitoring network in China.
37d5e03ebd21b5bb3e7c0d7d93b99321fa253d31.result: The hybrid random forest and kriging model gives better cross-validated accuracy than random forest alone and yields daily national NO2 maps.
37d5e03ebd21b5bb3e7c0d7d93b99321fa253d31.open_work: Higher-resolution satellite products and extension to longer periods and health exposure studies.
37d5e03ebd21b5bb3e7c0d7d93b99321fa253d31.issues: Abstract not available here; performance numbers are not reported; OMI coarse resolution and cloud gaps limit fine-scale exposure estimates.

55b2dbc6e8ee82dc57e1fa45ed1e515def0fd57e.goal: Estimates daily maximum 8-hour ozone at high spatiotemporal resolution over the contiguous United States for environmental health studies.
55b2dbc6e8ee82dc57e1fa45ed1e515def0fd57e.architecture: Geographically weighted ensemble of three machine learners: neural network, random forest and gradient boosting.
55b2dbc6e8ee82dc57e1fa45ed1e515def0fd57e.data: Ozone monitoring observations and multiple predictor types, 1 km grid over the contiguous US, daily for 2000–2016.
55b2dbc6e8ee82dc57e1fa45ed1e515def0fd57e.result: Cross-validated R2 of 0.90 for daily and 0.86 for annual averages; ensemble beats each single learner; weakest in western mountains (R2 0.86) and New England (0.87).
55b2dbc6e8ee82dc57e1fa45ed1e515def0fd57e.open_work: Improving performance in complex terrain and using the estimates in intra-urban health impact studies.
55b2dbc6e8ee82dc57e1fa45ed1e515def0fd57e.issues: Lower skill in mountainous and sparsely monitored regions; uncertainty quantified only monthly; spatial cross-validation may overstate skill far from monitors.

14de666a633fa46f852ea5b62540cb187e4bd78e.goal: Models daily reference evapotranspiration (ET0) accurately for irrigation scheduling under different arid climates in Iran.
14de666a633fa46f852ea5b62540cb187e4bd78e.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) with input selection by relief, random forest, PCA or correlation, and a hybrid SVR coupled with the whale optimization algorithm (WOA).
14de666a633fa46f852ea5b62540cb187e4bd78e.data: Daily meteorological data at Isfahan (arid), Urmia (semi-arid) and Yazd (hyper-arid) stations, Iran.
14de666a633fa46f852ea5b62540cb187e4bd78e.result: Random forest input selection works best, and the hybrid RF-SVR-WOA model outperforms SVR-only models on RMSE, MAE, R2 and Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency.
14de666a633fa46f852ea5b62540cb187e4bd78e.open_work: Testing more stations and climates and comparing with other optimizers and deep learning models.
14de666a633fa46f852ea5b62540cb187e4bd78e.issues: Only three stations; ET0 target is computed rather than measured; numerical gains not given in the abstract.

d990fa40d9c42f11f69476cb6dadd5ca4ab6c0db.goal: Predicts short- to mid-term solar photovoltaic power output to support integration of solar generation.
d990fa40d9c42f11f69476cb6dadd5ca4ab6c0db.architecture: Artificial neural network; the specific network configuration is not specified here.
d990fa40d9c42f11f69476cb6dadd5ca4ab6c0db.data: Measured output of a photovoltaic system; site and period not reported here.
d990fa40d9c42f11f69476cb6dadd5ca4ab6c0db.result: Not reported here; the title indicates artificial neural networks can predict PV power at short and mid-term horizons.
d990fa40d9c42f11f69476cb6dadd5ca4ab6c0db.open_work: Not reported; extending to longer horizons and weather forecast inputs would follow naturally.
d990fa40d9c42f11f69476cb6dadd5ca4ab6c0db.issues: Abstract unavailable; scope of the PV system and site could not be verified.

0a741f8f8820ecae624c4995ff5337e9cf65edfa.goal: Forecasts solar radiation by combining fuzzy logic with neural networks, to supply inputs for solar power planning.
0a741f8f8820ecae624c4995ff5337e9cf65edfa.architecture: Hybrid of fuzzy logic and artificial neural network: fuzzy logic processes weather condition information that feeds a neural network forecaster.
0a741f8f8820ecae624c4995ff5337e9cf65edfa.data: Not reported here; solar radiation measurements and weather information at the study site.
0a741f8f8820ecae624c4995ff5337e9cf65edfa.result: Not reported here; the combined fuzzy-neural approach is presented as giving usable solar radiation forecasts.
0a741f8f8820ecae624c4995ff5337e9cf65edfa.open_work: Not reported; testing under more variable cloud regimes and other locations would follow naturally.
0a741f8f8820ecae624c4995ff5337e9cf65edfa.issues: Abstract unavailable; details of data, horizon and skill could not be verified.

ab61ed58dcf358d2a0b1af55a3081c0f5dcbd293.goal: Forecasts long-term wind speed and recognizes general wind patterns to support wind energy assessment.
ab61ed58dcf358d2a0b1af55a3081c0f5dcbd293.architecture: Neural networks (feedforward multilayer perceptron types) for wind speed prediction, with a data fusion approach combining stations.
ab61ed58dcf358d2a0b1af55a3081c0f5dcbd293.data: Hourly wind speed and meteorological records from stations in Malaysia.
ab61ed58dcf358d2a0b1af55a3081c0f5dcbd293.result: Neural networks give reasonable long-term wind speed forecasts and capture general wind patterns at the sites.
ab61ed58dcf358d2a0b1af55a3081c0f5dcbd293.open_work: Not reported; extending to more sites and probabilistic forecasts would follow naturally.
ab61ed58dcf358d2a0b1af55a3081c0f5dcbd293.issues: Abstract unavailable; few stations; quantitative skill not verified here.

3d95f484be855664273d442d90e3d8c2e1dc0b0d.goal: Reviews data mining approaches for wind power prediction to guide forecasting for grid integration.
3d95f484be855664273d442d90e3d8c2e1dc0b0d.architecture: Literature review of data mining and machine learning wind power prediction methods (neural networks, statistical and hybrid methods) across horizons.
3d95f484be855664273d442d90e3d8c2e1dc0b0d.data: Review of published studies; no new data.
3d95f484be855664273d442d90e3d8c2e1dc0b0d.result: Not reported here; the review categorizes methods by approach and forecast horizon.
3d95f484be855664273d442d90e3d8c2e1dc0b0d.open_work: Not reported; hybrid and uncertainty-aware forecasting are natural next steps.
3d95f484be855664273d442d90e3d8c2e1dc0b0d.issues: Abstract unavailable; review dates from 2012 and predates deep learning.

89431fa5fb4c0cd4e8d7bcc5fbd904ea7ffaa61e.goal: Improves short-term wind speed and wind power forecasting for wind farm operation.
89431fa5fb4c0cd4e8d7bcc5fbd904ea7ffaa61e.architecture: Improved neural network-based approach; the network type is not specified here.
89431fa5fb4c0cd4e8d7bcc5fbd904ea7ffaa61e.data: Not reported here; wind speed and wind power records from a wind farm.
89431fa5fb4c0cd4e8d7bcc5fbd904ea7ffaa61e.result: Not reported here; the improved network is presented as more accurate than baseline forecasters.
89431fa5fb4c0cd4e8d7bcc5fbd904ea7ffaa61e.open_work: Not reported; extension to longer horizons and probabilistic outputs would follow naturally.
89431fa5fb4c0cd4e8d7bcc5fbd904ea7ffaa61e.issues: Abstract unavailable; data, horizon and gains could not be verified.

0c413d8af5e31ae3f210b509087148c7abd58dbf.goal: Fills missing values in geo-sensory time series, such as air quality and meteorological station readings, which are common and harm downstream analysis.
0c413d8af5e31ae3f210b509087148c7abd58dbf.architecture: ST-MVL multi-view learning: combines inverse distance weighting, simple exponential smoothing and user- and item-based collaborative filtering, capturing local and global spatial and temporal views, then aggregates them.
0c413d8af5e31ae3f210b509087148c7abd58dbf.data: Air quality and meteorological readings from monitoring stations in Beijing; the authors release the dataset.
0c413d8af5e31ae3f210b509087148c7abd58dbf.result: ST-MVL outperforms a range of baseline imputation methods on the Beijing data.
0c413d8af5e31ae3f210b509087148c7abd58dbf.open_work: Applying to other sensor networks and handling long, contiguous gaps.
0c413d8af5e31ae3f210b509087148c7abd58dbf.issues: Abstract unavailable here; evaluation mainly on one city; block-missing and sensor-wide outages remain harder.

b08709e7368ac17f9df1083cd27bda892a5957cc.goal: Detects sea ice changes in multitemporal SAR images, where speckle noise degrades existing change detection methods.
b08709e7368ac17f9df1083cd27bda892a5957cc.architecture: Convolutional-wavelet neural network (CWNN): a convolutional neural network with dual-tree complex wavelet transform layers, plus virtual sample generation for training.
b08709e7368ac17f9df1083cd27bda892a5957cc.data: Two real multitemporal SAR image datasets of sea ice; sensors and regions not specified in the abstract.
b08709e7368ac17f9df1083cd27bda892a5957cc.result: CWNN effectively reduces speckle effects and gives accurate, robust changed/unchanged classification on both datasets.
b08709e7368ac17f9df1083cd27bda892a5957cc.open_work: Testing on more regions, seasons and SAR sensors, and multi-class ice change.
b08709e7368ac17f9df1083cd27bda892a5957cc.issues: Only two scenes; no quantitative numbers in the abstract; pseudo-labels from virtual samples may propagate errors.

d15cb448afbf53fc6432b24a7160dddcc9105a0e.goal: Improves multi-step wind speed prediction for wind energy exploitation.
d15cb448afbf53fc6432b24a7160dddcc9105a0e.architecture: Hybrid SSA-EMD-CNNSVM: singular spectrum analysis denoising, empirical mode decomposition into sub-layers, and a convolutional neural network combined with a support vector machine to predict each sub-layer.
d15cb448afbf53fc6432b24a7160dddcc9105a0e.data: Wind speed time series from four experiments; sites not reported in the abstract.
d15cb448afbf53fc6432b24a7160dddcc9105a0e.result: Outperforms seven comparison models for 1- to 3-step forecasts, with average MAPE, MAE and RMSE improvements of 42.85%, 39.21% and 39.25%.
d15cb448afbf53fc6432b24a7160dddcc9105a0e.open_work: Longer horizons and multivariate inputs such as numerical weather predictions.
d15cb448afbf53fc6432b24a7160dddcc9105a0e.issues: Only 1–3 step horizons; decomposition of full series risks information leakage; baselines are relatively simple.

d91a2b60d8af92061729e226655f28b9feaebaa3.goal: Forecasts short-term photovoltaic power generation to reduce solar curtailment from large-scale PV development.
d91a2b60d8af92061729e226655f28b9feaebaa3.architecture: Hybrid RF-CEEMD-DIFPSO-BPNN: random forest feature ranking, similar-day selection, CEEMD decomposition, and a backpropagation neural network (MLP) tuned by particle swarm optimization.
d91a2b60d8af92061729e226655f28b9feaebaa3.data: Measurements from one PV power plant with associated weather factors; location not specified in the abstract.
d91a2b60d8af92061729e226655f28b9feaebaa3.result: The hybrid model is shown to be a promising and more accurate approach for PV power forecasting in the case study.
d91a2b60d8af92061729e226655f28b9feaebaa3.open_work: Testing on multiple plants and weather regimes, and probabilistic outputs.
d91a2b60d8af92061729e226655f28b9feaebaa3.issues: Single plant case study; complex pipeline with many tuned stages; no numbers in the abstract.

f189821644bf9fa144e90137d5afe9d95b9a6ea6.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels over several prediction periods to support aquifer management.
f189821644bf9fa144e90137d5afe9d95b9a6ea6.architecture: Wavelet-ANFIS hybrid (wavelet decomposition feeding an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system), compared with ANN, ANFIS and wavelet-ANN.
f189821644bf9fa144e90137d5afe9d95b9a6ea6.data: Monthly groundwater level records from observation wells in Iran.
f189821644bf9fa144e90137d5afe9d95b9a6ea6.result: The wavelet-ANFIS model performs best, with accuracy declining as the prediction period lengthens.
f189821644bf9fa144e90137d5afe9d95b9a6ea6.open_work: Not reported; using climatic and pumping inputs and more wells would follow naturally.
f189821644bf9fa144e90137d5afe9d95b9a6ea6.issues: Abstract unavailable here; few wells; univariate inputs ignore pumping and recharge drivers.

98eda877eb9e36e0bd10d0a26cb31c30afe7846d.goal: Reviews flood modeling approaches to summarize current status, problems and future directions for flood risk management.
98eda877eb9e36e0bd10d0a26cb31c30afe7846d.architecture: Review of hydrologic, hydraulic, numerical, rainfall-runoff, remote sensing and GIS, AI and machine learning, multi-criteria decision analysis and metaheuristic flood models.
98eda877eb9e36e0bd10d0a26cb31c30afe7846d.data: Review of the literature; no new data.
98eda877eb9e36e0bd10d0a26cb31c30afe7846d.result: Each model class has distinct strengths and weaknesses; data limitations, model uncertainty and complexity are key challenges.
98eda877eb9e36e0bd10d0a26cb31c30afe7846d.open_work: Integrated and hybrid models and advanced technologies for flood prediction, alongside ongoing research to improve flood risk management.
98eda877eb9e36e0bd10d0a26cb31c30afe7846d.issues: Broad and qualitative; no systematic quantitative comparison of methods.

7e8e380b135e8a6ba163854614d4337ef9daf617.goal: Forecasts power of an offshore wind turbine from high-frequency SCADA data, where harsh conditions make prediction harder.
7e8e380b135e8a6ba163854614d4337ef9daf617.architecture: Deep learning neural network (deep feedforward network) with physics-informed feature engineering and correlation-based feature reduction.
7e8e380b135e8a6ba163854614d4337ef9daf617.data: 1-second SCADA data from an offshore wind turbine: wind speeds at four heights, blade pitch angles, nacelle orientation, yaw error and ambient temperature.
7e8e380b135e8a6ba163854614d4337ef9daf617.result: Nacelle orientation, yaw error and ambient temperature can be dropped; the model keeps high accuracy while reducing computational cost and time.
7e8e380b135e8a6ba163854614d4337ef9daf617.open_work: Extending to forecasts at longer horizons and to multiple turbines or farms.
7e8e380b135e8a6ba163854614d4337ef9daf617.issues: Single turbine; high-frequency SCADA inputs mean near-concurrent estimation rather than genuine ahead forecasting.

b4051ba39290728932f7f193999d1ad892149f34.goal: Improves short-term photovoltaic power forecasting by recognizing weather status from solar irradiance patterns.
b4051ba39290728932f7f193999d1ad892149f34.architecture: Support vector machine classifier on extracted irradiance features to recognize weather status, used to select weather-specific PV forecasting models.
b4051ba39290728932f7f193999d1ad892149f34.data: Measured solar irradiance and PV power from a PV station; details not verified here.
b4051ba39290728932f7f193999d1ad892149f34.result: Weather status recognition with SVM improves classification and supports more accurate short-term PV forecasts.
b4051ba39290728932f7f193999d1ad892149f34.open_work: Not reported; finer weather classes and forecast-based classification would follow naturally.
b4051ba39290728932f7f193999d1ad892149f34.issues: Abstract unavailable; single site; skill numbers not verified here.

75e1de297f1b292b6762a0a4a3012122e2f7b770.goal: Improves medium- and long-term runoff forecasting accuracy by decomposing nonstationary runoff series.
75e1de297f1b292b6762a0a4a3012122e2f7b770.architecture: EEMD-ANN hybrid: ensemble empirical mode decomposition of runoff into components, each forecast by an artificial neural network, then recombined.
75e1de297f1b292b6762a0a4a3012122e2f7b770.data: Monthly runoff records from stations in China; specific stations not verified here.
75e1de297f1b292b6762a0a4a3012122e2f7b770.result: EEMD-ANN improves accuracy over a single ANN for medium- and long-term runoff forecasts.
75e1de297f1b292b6762a0a4a3012122e2f7b770.open_work: Not reported; avoiding look-ahead in decomposition and testing other basins would follow naturally.
75e1de297f1b292b6762a0a4a3012122e2f7b770.issues: Abstract unavailable; decomposing the whole series before splitting can leak future information and inflate skill.

5dc56fefef9f13e036eea3776c38edb84d3e303c.goal: Improves one-hour-ahead wind power forecasting for reliable grid operation with high renewable shares, avoiding overfitting of stacked Bi-LSTMs.
5dc56fefef9f13e036eea3776c38edb84d3e303c.architecture: Deep concatenated residual network joining a multi-level residual network and DenseNet with long and short bidirectional LSTM recurrent layers.
5dc56fefef9f13e036eea3776c38edb84d3e303c.data: A widely used temperature time-series dataset and an actual wind power dataset.
5dc56fefef9f13e036eea3776c38edb84d3e303c.result: Superior accuracy and parameter efficiency compared with baselines, with good peak forecasting, generalization and credible confidence ranges.
5dc56fefef9f13e036eea3776c38edb84d3e303c.open_work: Using it as a general forecasting framework for other grid quantities and horizons.
5dc56fefef9f13e036eea3776c38edb84d3e303c.issues: Only one-hour-ahead; limited datasets; no meteorological forecast inputs.

7dc56f468d6313b4116a8700bb1da418de7b67f0.goal: Forecasts daily global solar radiation locally to support solar energy management.
7dc56f468d6313b4116a8700bb1da418de7b67f0.architecture: Artificial neural network applied to local daily solar radiation forecasting, combined with meteorological forecast inputs.
7dc56f468d6313b4116a8700bb1da418de7b67f0.data: Not verified here; local solar radiation measurements and weather forecast products.
7dc56f468d6313b4116a8700bb1da418de7b67f0.result: Not reported here; the ANN approach is presented as improving local daily forecasts.
7dc56f468d6313b4116a8700bb1da418de7b67f0.open_work: Not reported; extension to other sites and intra-day horizons would follow naturally.
7dc56f468d6313b4116a8700bb1da418de7b67f0.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified.

f3793b2990373745ff1533b1498beee123bd20c4.goal: Provides accurate middle- and long-term runoff forecasts, especially in flood seasons, without using future information as in hindcast decomposition schemes.
f3793b2990373745ff1533b1498beee123bd20c4.architecture: Adaptive EEMD-ANN: ensemble empirical mode decomposition with artificial neural network forecasting of each sub-series, re-fitted adaptively as new data arrive.
f3793b2990373745ff1533b1498beee123bd20c4.data: Monthly streamflow at three stations in the Yangtze River Basin, China; 1-month-ahead forecasts.
f3793b2990373745ff1533b1498beee123bd20c4.result: AEEMD-ANN improves flood-season accuracy but is worse than ANN, ANFIS, SVM and SAR(1) in dry seasons; SAR(1) is recommended for dry seasons.
f3793b2990373745ff1533b1498beee123bd20c4.open_work: Season-dependent model selection and extension to longer lead times and other basins.
f3793b2990373745ff1533b1498beee123bd20c4.issues: Gains limited to flood season; only three stations; one-month lead only.

3cd7c2098e806f5a5c2b19305a79c246d2737b3f.goal: Estimates daily reference crop evapotranspiration with limited meteorological data in arid and semi-arid Northern China for irrigation planning.
3cd7c2098e806f5a5c2b19305a79c246d2737b3f.architecture: CatBoost gradient boosting on decision trees, compared with a generalized regression neural network and random forests.
3cd7c2098e806f5a5c2b19305a79c246d2737b3f.data: Daily Tmax, Tmin, wind speed, relative humidity and net radiation from 15 weather stations, 1996–2015, with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 as target.
3cd7c2098e806f5a5c2b19305a79c246d2737b3f.result: CatBoost gives the best local-model accuracy (RMSE 0.096–0.821 mm/d vs 0.206–0.847 for GRNN, 0.169–0.866 for RF); generalized models perform worse than local ones.
3cd7c2098e806f5a5c2b19305a79c246d2737b3f.open_work: Applying to other regions with similar climates and improving generalized models.
3cd7c2098e806f5a5c2b19305a79c246d2737b3f.issues: Target is computed Penman-Monteith ET0, not measured; generalized models lose skill.

c27bb2a65f62452dada8b44c2507724b7cd592bf.goal: Produces a long-term, high-resolution precipitation dataset for the Third Pole region, where complex terrain makes existing products unreliable.
c27bb2a65f62452dada8b44c2507724b7cd592bf.architecture: Dataset built by merging ERA5_CNN downscaled atmospheric simulation with gauges using climatologically aided interpolation and random forest.
c27bb2a65f62452dada8b44c2507724b7cd592bf.data: ERA5_CNN precipitation and more than 9000 rain gauges; daily 1/30° for 1979–2020; validated on 197 independent gauges.
c27bb2a65f62452dada8b44c2507724b7cd592bf.result: Nearly unbiased with RMSE 5.0 mm/d, correlation 0.76 and CSI 0.61; outperforms ERA5-Land, IMERG, MSWEP v2 and AERA5-Asia, including for extremes.
c27bb2a65f62452dada8b44c2507724b7cd592bf.open_work: Extending in time and applying to hydrological and ecological studies.
c27bb2a65f62452dada8b44c2507724b7cd592bf.issues: Accuracy depends on uneven gauge density in remote high-altitude areas; gauge undercatch of snowfall is not addressed in the abstract.

693ad2b0b12b1ca80903bf2842233867858d6b58.goal: Predicts short-term wind speed (10-minute and 1-hour ahead) accurately and stably for smart grid wind power management.
693ad2b0b12b1ca80903bf2842233867858d6b58.architecture: Two-layer nonlinear combination (EEL-ELM): extreme learning machine, Elman neural network and LSTM forecast separately, then an ELM aggregates them.
693ad2b0b12b1ca80903bf2842233867858d6b58.data: Two real-world wind speed datasets from a wind farm in Inner Mongolia, China.
693ad2b0b12b1ca80903bf2842233867858d6b58.result: EEL-ELM outperforms eight other wind speed prediction methods on three metrics and three statistical tests.
693ad2b0b12b1ca80903bf2842233867858d6b58.open_work: Longer horizons and inclusion of meteorological covariates.
693ad2b0b12b1ca80903bf2842233867858d6b58.issues: Single wind farm region; short horizons only; numbers not given in the abstract.

9c9eb32421d2439d0525bfbbf03a9446a939e295.goal: Predicts wind speed with interpretability using multivariate meteorological time series.
9c9eb32421d2439d0525bfbbf03a9446a939e295.architecture: Temporal fusion transformer, an attention-based transformer model with variable selection for interpretability.
9c9eb32421d2439d0525bfbbf03a9446a939e295.data: Multivariate wind and meteorological time series; sources not verified here.
9c9eb32421d2439d0525bfbbf03a9446a939e295.result: Not reported here; the title indicates accurate and interpretable multivariate wind speed prediction.
9c9eb32421d2439d0525bfbbf03a9446a939e295.open_work: Not reported; probabilistic forecasting and transfer to other sites would follow naturally.
9c9eb32421d2439d0525bfbbf03a9446a939e295.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified.

006f4cbdc93518a191c3b85a1ec4ddc4aedf3ffc.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the Haraz watershed, Iran, to support floodplain management and damage mitigation.
006f4cbdc93518a191c3b85a1ec4ddc4aedf3ffc.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) hybridized with cultural, bees and invasive weed optimization algorithms, using SWARA factor weights.
006f4cbdc93518a191c3b85a1ec4ddc4aedf3ffc.data: 201 flood locations and ten conditioning factors (TWI, river density, SPI, curvature, distance to river, lithology, elevation, slope, land use, rainfall).
006f4cbdc93518a191c3b85a1ec4ddc4aedf3ffc.result: ANFIS-IWO has lowest RMSE (0.359); ANFIS-BA has highest AUROC (94.4%), followed by ANFIS-IWO (0.939) and ANFIS-CA (0.921).
006f4cbdc93518a191c3b85a1ec4ddc4aedf3ffc.open_work: Applying to similar climatic and physiographic areas.
006f4cbdc93518a191c3b85a1ec4ddc4aedf3ffc.issues: Single watershed; static susceptibility ignores event dynamics; small sample of flood points.

9f38e794bf60fc31c31fe7797ef0a53ea2cf592d.goal: Reviews the use of artificial neural networks for modeling evapotranspiration.
9f38e794bf60fc31c31fe7797ef0a53ea2cf592d.architecture: Review of artificial neural network approaches (mainly feedforward multilayer perceptrons) for evapotranspiration estimation.
9f38e794bf60fc31c31fe7797ef0a53ea2cf592d.data: Review of published studies; no new data.
9f38e794bf60fc31c31fe7797ef0a53ea2cf592d.result: Not reported here; the review summarizes ANN applications and their performance relative to conventional methods.
9f38e794bf60fc31c31fe7797ef0a53ea2cf592d.open_work: Not reported; generalization across climates and limited-input models are natural next steps.
9f38e794bf60fc31c31fe7797ef0a53ea2cf592d.issues: Abstract unavailable; early review predating modern deep learning.

1fcf15a59e0caeb3817fa668b2e6d3dfd9f25779.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed and power ramp events for grid stability using support vector regression variants.
1fcf15a59e0caeb3817fa668b2e6d3dfd9f25779.architecture: Wavelet-based hybrid with support vector regression variants: epsilon-SVR, LS-SVR, epsilon-twin SVR and twin SVR, versus persistence.
1fcf15a59e0caeb3817fa668b2e6d3dfd9f25779.data: Wind data from multiple wind farm sites in the USA and India, with ramp analysis at five sites and several hub heights.
1fcf15a59e0caeb3817fa668b2e6d3dfd9f25779.result: Performance indices identify the best SVR variant for wind forecasting; larger datasets and ramp events are evaluated across sites.
1fcf15a59e0caeb3817fa668b2e6d3dfd9f25779.open_work: Not reported; probabilistic ramp forecasting and NWP inputs would follow naturally.
1fcf15a59e0caeb3817fa668b2e6d3dfd9f25779.issues: Abstract gives no numbers; comparisons limited to SVR variants and persistence.

5a25879a03209df5727854fce19946a67e15829c.goal: Calibrates biased and underdispersive ensemble weather forecasts with a nonparametric method that needs no distributional assumptions.
5a25879a03209df5727854fce19946a67e15829c.architecture: Quantile regression forests (random forest generalization) for ensemble postprocessing, compared with EMOS.
5a25879a03209df5727854fce19946a67e15829c.data: Météo-France 35-member PEARP ensemble forecasts of surface temperature and wind speed, lead times 3–54 h, with station observations.
5a25879a03209df5727854fce19946a67e15829c.result: All postprocessed ensembles are much better calibrated than raw PEARP, and QRF performs better than EMOS in experiments.
5a25879a03209df5727854fce19946a67e15829c.open_work: Applying to other variables such as precipitation and preserving spatial and temporal dependence.
5a25879a03209df5727854fce19946a67e15829c.issues: Marginal calibration only; QRF cannot extrapolate beyond training range, which matters for extremes.

2835707f20ed793e2cf512890a6323c3bff1ddcf.goal: Improves wind power prediction accuracy with a dual-scale deep learning model.
2835707f20ed793e2cf512890a6323c3bff1ddcf.architecture: Hybrid of extreme learning machine and bidirectional LSTM recurrent network, tuned by an improved reptile search algorithm.
2835707f20ed793e2cf512890a6323c3bff1ddcf.data: Wind power data; sources not verified here.
2835707f20ed793e2cf512890a6323c3bff1ddcf.result: Not reported here; the title presents improved wind power prediction from the hybrid dual-scale model.
2835707f20ed793e2cf512890a6323c3bff1ddcf.open_work: Not reported; probabilistic and multi-site extensions would follow naturally.
2835707f20ed793e2cf512890a6323c3bff1ddcf.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified.

43e69ded89931b64f7d24d992efc06b551f5bc14.goal: Forecasts ultra-short-term multi-step wind farm power, as intermittency threatens power system stability.
43e69ded89931b64f7d24d992efc06b551f5bc14.architecture: CNN-LSTM spatio-temporal correlation model: convolutional neural network extracts spatial features of multi-site meteorology, LSTM extracts temporal relations.
43e69ded89931b64f7d24d992efc06b551f5bc14.data: Measured meteorological factors at multiple sites and power data from a wind farm in China.
43e69ded89931b64f7d24d992efc06b551f5bc14.result: CNN-LSTM extracts spatial and temporal features better and forecasts more accurately than CNN or LSTM alone on four metrics.
43e69ded89931b64f7d24d992efc06b551f5bc14.open_work: Applying to farms with other layouts and longer horizons.
43e69ded89931b64f7d24d992efc06b551f5bc14.issues: Requires multi-site measurements within the farm; single wind farm; no numbers in the abstract.

3e02d9734fe01fbb9256bfa00bca5f7c046b89bf.goal: Compares machine learning methods for real-time radar-derived rainfall forecasting at short lead times.
3e02d9734fe01fbb9256bfa00bca5f7c046b89bf.architecture: Comparison of random forests and support vector machines (support vector regression).
3e02d9734fe01fbb9256bfa00bca5f7c046b89bf.data: Radar-derived rainfall for a catchment in Taiwan; details not verified here.
3e02d9734fe01fbb9256bfa00bca5f7c046b89bf.result: Not reported here; both methods provide usable short lead-time rainfall forecasts, with relative skill compared in the paper.
3e02d9734fe01fbb9256bfa00bca5f7c046b89bf.open_work: Not reported; longer lead times and blending with NWP would follow naturally.
3e02d9734fe01fbb9256bfa00bca5f7c046b89bf.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified.

5070d57e320840fcfe6552ce2be4d282d7524c13.goal: Reviews machine learning models for global solar radiation prediction to guide model development.
5070d57e320840fcfe6552ce2be4d282d7524c13.architecture: Review of 232 papers covering input sources, feature selection (filter, wrapper, embedded) and seven classes of machine learning models.
5070d57e320840fcfe6552ce2be4d282d7524c13.data: Review of the literature, discussing surface station, satellite and NWP reanalysis inputs.
5070d57e320840fcfe6552ce2be4d282d7524c13.result: Classifies models into seven classes by pre-processing, output ensembling and purpose, and assesses pros and cons of input sources and feature selection.
5070d57e320840fcfe6552ce2be4d282d7524c13.open_work: Future research directions on model modification and novel model development for solar radiation forecasting.
5070d57e320840fcfe6552ce2be4d282d7524c13.issues: No quantitative meta-analysis; heterogeneous studies make comparisons difficult.

86b6f5a2b7e02d6fa184594dea35f2e7aea1c210.goal: Reviews machine learning applications across water resources management sectors amid population growth and climate change.
86b6f5a2b7e02d6fa184594dea35f2e7aea1c210.architecture: Review of machine learning methods, including LSTM, ANN and hybrid and physics-based hybrid models, across groundwater, streamflow, water quality, demand, hydropower and floods.
86b6f5a2b7e02d6fa184594dea35f2e7aea1c210.data: Review of recent literature; no new data.
86b6f5a2b7e02d6fa184594dea35f2e7aea1c210.result: LSTM networks often outperform ANN, traditional ML and physics-based models; hybrid ML methods show high forecasting accuracy across water fields.
86b6f5a2b7e02d6fa184594dea35f2e7aea1c210.open_work: Physics-based hybrid models and ML-enhanced decision support systems.
86b6f5a2b7e02d6fa184594dea35f2e7aea1c210.issues: Qualitative review; publication bias toward positive results.

9592f1f9ad9e61447cfa0332df8e76270ba2e6c1.goal: Maps and attributes the rapidly growing literature on observed climate impacts that global assessments struggle to appraise.
9592f1f9ad9e61447cfa0332df8e76270ba2e6c1.architecture: BERT transformer language model to identify and classify climate impact studies, combined with grid-cell-level attribution of temperature and precipitation changes.
9592f1f9ad9e61447cfa0332df8e76270ba2e6c1.data: Scientific literature on observed climate impacts; grid-cell attributable temperature and precipitation trends.
9592f1f9ad9e61447cfa0332df8e76270ba2e6c1.result: Estimates 102,160 (64,958–164,274) relevant studies; attributable impacts may occur over 80% of land area with 85% of population; evidence is twice as prevalent in high-income countries.
9592f1f9ad9e61447cfa0332df8e76270ba2e6c1.open_work: Closing the attribution gap at regional and sectoral levels, especially in low-income countries.
9592f1f9ad9e61447cfa0332df8e76270ba2e6c1.issues: Classifier errors and tentative attribution; literature coverage biased toward English and high-income regions.

3ab274ccc812dcb972e17ac6bd06ddc928f82600.goal: Enables flood mapping onboard low-cost CubeSats so that compact flood masks, rather than raw images, are downlinked for faster disaster response.
