3ab274ccc812dcb972e17ac6bd06ddc928f82600.architecture: Flood segmentation convolutional neural networks run on a power-constrained ML accelerator aboard ESA PhiSat-1.
3ab274ccc812dcb972e17ac6bd06ddc928f82600.data: WorldFloods dataset of 119 globally verified flood events from disaster response organizations, with multispectral satellite imagery; independent test locations.
3ab274ccc812dcb972e17ac6bd06ddc928f82600.result: Produces fast, accurate segmentation masks on the hardware accelerator, as a proof of concept for onboard flood mapping.
3ab274ccc812dcb972e17ac6bd06ddc928f82600.open_work: Deployment in orbit and robustness to clouds and diverse sensors.
3ab274ccc812dcb972e17ac6bd06ddc928f82600.issues: Optical imagery is blocked by clouds during floods; proof of concept on hardware rather than operational in-orbit validation.

5e0de0032c5bb210150e01e88e547e28870fb8d7.goal: China's future maize self-sufficiency under rising food and feed demand and climate change, and how much yield gain optimal crop management could deliver by the 2030s.
5e0de0032c5bb210150e01e88e547e28870fb8d7.architecture: Data-driven yield projections combined with a machine learning model; the specific ML method family is not specified in the abstract.
5e0de0032c5bb210150e01e88e547e28870fb8d7.data: Data from 402 stations and 87 field experiments across China, with future climate under the SSP585 scenario.
5e0de0032c5bb210150e01e88e547e28870fb8d7.result: Optimal planting density and management roughly double current yields; dense planting plus soil improvement give a 52% yield gain in the 2030s under SSP585, outweighing climate change effects.
5e0de0032c5bb210150e01e88e547e28870fb8d7.open_work: Extend the projections to other crops and scenarios, and test whether the management gains are achievable at farm scale across regions.
5e0de0032c5bb210150e01e88e547e28870fb8d7.issues: Projections rely on a single high-end scenario and on extrapolating field experiments; the ML model, its uncertainty and its socioeconomic constraints are not detailed in the abstract.

a0670e49b888b0b6671a843215eb76dcc7f93919.goal: Provide open on-site solar and wind generation data to support data-driven renewable power forecasting and grid scheduling.
a0670e49b888b0b6671a843215eb76dcc7f93919.architecture: Benchmark dataset of power generation and weather-related measurements from renewable stations, with description of collection, processing and potential applications; not a modelling paper.
a0670e49b888b0b6671a843215eb76dcc7f93919.data: Six wind farms and eight solar stations in China, 2019–2020 at 15-minute intervals, SCADA data; used in the 2021 Chinese State Grid Renewable Energy Generation Forecasting Competition.
a0670e49b888b0b6671a843215eb76dcc7f93919.result: Releases a two-year, 15-minute resolution dataset of generation and weather variables for 14 stations, ready for training forecasting models.
a0670e49b888b0b6671a843215eb76dcc7f93919.open_work: Use the dataset to develop and benchmark forecasting models and to optimise demand response programs.
a0670e49b888b0b6671a843215eb76dcc7f93919.issues: Limited to 14 Chinese stations over two years; no baseline model results are reported in the abstract, and weather data come from on-site sources of unspecified quality.

62d43542653f4f2b3bd13959fc81c22386e5775c.goal: Forecast the effective drought index (EDI) to support drought early warning and water management.
62d43542653f4f2b3bd13959fc81c22386e5775c.architecture: Wavelet-coupled extreme learning machine (W-ELM): wavelet decomposition of inputs fed to an extreme learning machine, a single-hidden-layer neural network.
62d43542653f4f2b3bd13959fc81c22386e5775c.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); station-based drought index time series implied.
62d43542653f4f2b3bd13959fc81c22386e5775c.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the wavelet-ELM model forecasts EDI skilfully; benchmark comparisons are not verifiable.
62d43542653f4f2b3bd13959fc81c22386e5775c.open_work: Test at more sites and climates, extend lead times and add uncertainty estimates.
62d43542653f4f2b3bd13959fc81c22386e5775c.issues: Abstract unavailable, so data, lead times and metrics cannot be verified; wavelet preprocessing can leak future information if not applied carefully in a forecasting setting.

d9c2e398411d437f1f5ff60a6e1ccdab3df55ef4.goal: Evaluate lagged climate indices as predictors for monthly rainfall forecasting in Queensland, Australia, and compare with the official dynamical seasonal forecast.
d9c2e398411d437f1f5ff60a6e1ccdab3df55ef4.architecture: Artificial neural networks (MLP-type) with input selection and optimisation over climate indices such as the Inter-decadal Pacific Oscillation.
d9c2e398411d437f1f5ff60a6e1ccdab3df55ef4.data: Monthly rainfall at sites in 3 geographically distinct regions of Queensland with lagged climate indices; benchmark against POAMA forecasts.
d9c2e398411d437f1f5ff60a6e1ccdab3df55ef4.result: ANN forecasts have lower RMSE and MAE and higher correlation than POAMA; the Inter-decadal Pacific Oscillation proves a valuable predictor.
d9c2e398411d437f1f5ff60a6e1ccdab3df55ef4.open_work: Extend to more sites and lead times and assess probabilistic skill relative to newer dynamical systems.
d9c2e398411d437f1f5ff60a6e1ccdab3df55ef4.issues: Few sites; deterministic point forecasts only; comparison with a since-replaced GCM; risk of overfitting from input selection on limited monthly records.

5f043ce14848d7684c6ff4a5d1c215f495b76ba2.goal: Improve short-term wind speed forecasting for power grid security, given the nonlinear and nonstationary nature of wind speed.
5f043ce14848d7684c6ff4a5d1c215f495b76ba2.architecture: Hybrid system of data decomposition into subseries, recurrent neural network prediction, and error decomposition to correct the predictions.
5f043ce14848d7684c6ff4a5d1c215f495b76ba2.data: Wind speed series from four wind farms in China.
5f043ce14848d7684c6ff4a5d1c215f495b76ba2.result: The hybrid system outperforms single and traditional models; no specific error values are given in the abstract.
5f043ce14848d7684c6ff4a5d1c215f495b76ba2.open_work: Apply to multi-step and probabilistic forecasting and to operational smart grid settings.
5f043ce14848d7684c6ff4a5d1c215f495b76ba2.issues: Point forecasts only; decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information if applied over the full series; only four Chinese sites.

55d6aa557671c314a38600c9a2ff2a16673f1075.goal: Forecast solar energy output to support power system operation under variable solar generation.
55d6aa557671c314a38600c9a2ff2a16673f1075.architecture: Hybrid neural network trained with an improved metaheuristic optimisation algorithm; exact network design not reported here.
55d6aa557671c314a38600c9a2ff2a16673f1075.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
55d6aa557671c314a38600c9a2ff2a16673f1075.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies improved accuracy over benchmark forecasting methods.
55d6aa557671c314a38600c9a2ff2a16673f1075.open_work: Test across more sites and seasons and add probabilistic output.
55d6aa557671c314a38600c9a2ff2a16673f1075.issues: Abstract unavailable, so data, horizon and gains cannot be verified; metaheuristic-tuned hybrids are hard to reproduce.

ff1803ad40550fdf9277b4ea94da9900ea6a2303.goal: Forecast hourly photovoltaic power, addressing limited or imbalanced training data for PV time series.
ff1803ad40550fdf9277b4ea94da9900ea6a2303.architecture: Conditional generative adversarial network (GAN) used to generate additional training samples combined with a bidirectional LSTM forecaster.
ff1803ad40550fdf9277b4ea94da9900ea6a2303.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); hourly PV power time series implied.
ff1803ad40550fdf9277b4ea94da9900ea6a2303.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the CGAN-augmented Bi-LSTM improves hourly PV forecasts over baselines.
ff1803ad40550fdf9277b4ea94da9900ea6a2303.open_work: Evaluate on more plants and climates and assess the realism of the synthetic samples.
ff1803ad40550fdf9277b4ea94da9900ea6a2303.issues: Abstract unavailable; benefits of GAN augmentation depend on sample quality and are hard to verify; deterministic forecasts implied.

dbc546fb8912a6c0bcbe05d2b050c3d01804d1a3.goal: Compare widely used machine learning algorithms for predicting river inflow to support flood control and water supply planning.
dbc546fb8912a6c0bcbe05d2b050c3d01804d1a3.architecture: Comparison of CatBoost, ElasticNet, KNN, Lasso, LightGBM, linear regression, MLP, random forest, Ridge, SGD and XGBoost with lagged and seasonal feature engineering.
dbc546fb8912a6c0bcbe05d2b050c3d01804d1a3.data: River inflow records for the Garudeshwar watershed, India, with temporal lags and Indian-season context features.
dbc546fb8912a6c0bcbe05d2b050c3d01804d1a3.result: CatBoost performs best on MAE, RMSE and R2 for training and testing; XGBoost and LightGBM show more errors above 35% for moderate inflows above 10,000.
dbc546fb8912a6c0bcbe05d2b050c3d01804d1a3.open_work: Test on other basins, add meteorological drivers and extend to multi-step forecasting.
dbc546fb8912a6c0bcbe05d2b050c3d01804d1a3.issues: Single watershed; mainly autoregressive lag features; no uncertainty quantification; extremes poorly sampled.

1b787d7305ec752df7effb25d19791a6a5619eeb.goal: Estimate root zone soil moisture at daily scale with machine learning as an alternative to process-based vadose zone models.
1b787d7305ec752df7effb25d19791a6a5619eeb.architecture: Random forest regression for interpolation and extrapolation of root zone soil moisture.
1b787d7305ec752df7effb25d19791a6a5619eeb.data: In situ soil moisture measurements in a small agricultural catchment (Netherlands), 2016–2018; compared with a process-based model with data assimilation.
1b787d7305ec752df7effb25d19791a6a5619eeb.result: Random forest is slightly more accurate for interpolation and similar for extrapolation versus the process-based model, but less accurate in extreme wet and dry conditions.
1b787d7305ec752df7effb25d19791a6a5619eeb.open_work: Add covariates representing subsurface processes and more samples of extremes; apply in data-poor regions lacking soil hydraulic parameters.
1b787d7305ec752df7effb25d19791a6a5619eeb.issues: Small catchment and short record; extremes infrequently sampled; random forest cannot extrapolate beyond its training range.

4a535ddd507f5f072323cb563fe0b8f6689712b6.goal: Review applications of artificial neural networks in wind energy systems.
4a535ddd507f5f072323cb563fe0b8f6689712b6.architecture: Review of artificial neural network (MLP and related) applications in wind energy, such as wind speed and power forecasting, and system modelling and control.
4a535ddd507f5f072323cb563fe0b8f6689712b6.data: Review of published studies; no new data.
4a535ddd507f5f072323cb563fe0b8f6689712b6.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); the review surveys ANN uses across wind energy applications.
4a535ddd507f5f072323cb563fe0b8f6689712b6.open_work: Not reported in the abstract; hybrid and deep models and standardised comparisons follow naturally.
4a535ddd507f5f072323cb563fe0b8f6689712b6.issues: Abstract unavailable; a 2015 review predates deep learning advances in the field.

2ceaed5f3d8d64255fb450842755e1b28a910d5d.goal: Predict daily PM2.5 concentrations for air pollution warning and management.
2ceaed5f3d8d64255fb450842755e1b28a910d5d.architecture: Principal component analysis for input reduction followed by a least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) tuned by the cuckoo search algorithm.
2ceaed5f3d8d64255fb450842755e1b28a910d5d.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); daily PM2.5 and related pollutant and meteorological data implied.
2ceaed5f3d8d64255fb450842755e1b28a910d5d.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the PCA–CS–LSSVM model outperforms benchmark models.
2ceaed5f3d8d64255fb450842755e1b28a910d5d.open_work: Test at more cities and longer horizons and add uncertainty estimates.
2ceaed5f3d8d64255fb450842755e1b28a910d5d.issues: Abstract unavailable, so data and gains cannot be verified; single-city studies with metaheuristic tuning may not generalise.

4d1e1a9d38f2cddf434e1c42846d87ed841112c8.goal: Provide accurate point and interval short-term wind speed forecasts, since no single model is best for all wind series.
4d1e1a9d38f2cddf434e1c42846d87ed841112c8.architecture: Combined forecasting system integrating statistical, artificial neural network and deep learning sub-models, with optimal sub-model selection, a modified multi-objective optimisation for weighting, and distribution fitting for intervals.
4d1e1a9d38f2cddf434e1c42846d87ed841112c8.data: Wind speed series from two sites; details not reported in the abstract.
4d1e1a9d38f2cddf434e1c42846d87ed841112c8.result: Point forecast MAPE of 2.92%, 3.17% and 4.84% at Site 1 and 2.27%, 2.59% and 3.48% at Site 2 for one- to three-step forecasts, better than benchmarks.
4d1e1a9d38f2cddf434e1c42846d87ed841112c8.open_work: Extend to longer horizons and more sites and evaluate in power system scheduling.
4d1e1a9d38f2cddf434e1c42846d87ed841112c8.issues: Only two sites and very short horizons; complex combination may be hard to reproduce; interval forecast calibration is not quantified in the abstract.

bc0e7679c2f036df7905e484147c88788ae88a7f.goal: Systematically review deep learning with remote sensing data for crop mapping and crop yield prediction.
bc0e7679c2f036df7905e484147c88788ae88a7f.architecture: Systematic review of 90 papers covering platforms, sensors, input features, deep learning architectures (CNN, LSTM and others), frameworks, training data and performance.
bc0e7679c2f036df7905e484147c88788ae88a7f.data: 90 peer-reviewed studies using satellite and other remote sensing data for crop mapping and yield estimation.
bc0e7679c2f036df7905e484147c88788ae88a7f.result: Multiple deep learning solutions with different remote sensing inputs give reliable crop mapping and yield prediction.
bc0e7679c2f036df7905e484147c88788ae88a7f.open_work: Address scarce training data, build efficient and generalisable models and improve prediction transparency for large-scale use.
bc0e7679c2f036df7905e484147c88788ae88a7f.issues: Review restricted to the selected databases and period; performance comparisons across heterogeneous studies are not directly comparable.

0575d70cfc347df31c7a6023d6dcee8e682f7027.goal: Map groundwater potential to support groundwater exploration and management.
0575d70cfc347df31c7a6023d6dcee8e682f7027.architecture: Comparison of C5.0 decision tree, random forest and multivariate adaptive regression spline (MARS) models in a GIS framework.
0575d70cfc347df31c7a6023d6dcee8e682f7027.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); groundwater well or spring locations with geo-environmental conditioning factors implied; study area not verified.
0575d70cfc347df31c7a6023d6dcee8e682f7027.result: Not reported in the abstract; the paper compares the three models' predictive accuracy for groundwater potential maps.
0575d70cfc347df31c7a6023d6dcee8e682f7027.open_work: Test in other aquifers and with more conditioning factors and ensemble methods.
0575d70cfc347df31c7a6023d6dcee8e682f7027.issues: Abstract unavailable; susceptibility-style mapping depends on absence-sample choice and spatial autocorrelation in validation.

748c9f88b8e86b493c0c9b2fca760db12c10ba20.goal: Build a lightweight data-driven alternative to computationally costly numerical weather prediction for fine-grained local forecasts.
748c9f88b8e86b493c0c9b2fca760db12c10ba20.architecture: Deep learning models with LSTM and temporal convolutional network (TCN) layers, compared with regression, SVR, random forest, ARIMA, VAR, VECM and a dynamic ensemble.
748c9f88b8e86b493c0c9b2fca760db12c10ba20.data: Surface weather parameter time series; compared against the WRF model. Station details not reported in the abstract.
748c9f88b8e86b493c0c9b2fca760db12c10ba20.result: The lightweight LSTM/TCN model outperforms WRF and other baselines for forecasts up to 12 h.
748c9f88b8e86b493c0c9b2fca760db12c10ba20.open_work: Extend to longer lead times, more variables and spatial forecasting.
748c9f88b8e86b493c0c9b2fca760db12c10ba20.issues: Single-location surface time series with short horizons; comparison with WRF may depend on its configuration; no uncertainty.

5546db9af11d622e00616fa61c3fd4fa1ce6fa48.goal: Improve monthly streamflow forecasting accuracy for water resource planning.
5546db9af11d622e00616fa61c3fd4fa1ce6fa48.architecture: GMM-XGBoost: Gaussian mixture model clustering of streamflow followed by extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) per cluster, combined by weighted average; tree-based feature selection.
5546db9af11d622e00616fa61c3fd4fa1ce6fa48.data: Monthly streamflow at Cuntan and Hankou stations, Yangtze River Basin; benchmarks SVM and standalone XGBoost.
5546db9af11d622e00616fa61c3fd4fa1ce6fa48.result: All models do well one month ahead, but GMM-XGBoost gives the best NSE and RMSE; XGBoost generally beats SVM.
5546db9af11d622e00616fa61c3fd4fa1ce6fa48.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and other basins and quantify predictive uncertainty.
5546db9af11d622e00616fa61c3fd4fa1ce6fa48.issues: Only two stations and one-month lead; deterministic output; monthly records limit training samples.

8d1116152a8ab0be5385764a93b4f5403529daf0.goal: Predict Irish potato and maize yields from weather to give early information for food security planning in Rwanda.
8d1116152a8ab0be5385764a93b4f5403529daf0.architecture: Random forest, polynomial regression and support vector regression with rainfall and temperature as predictors.
8d1116152a8ab0be5385764a93b4f5403529daf0.data: Historical weather and crop yield data for Musanze district, Rwanda, gathered from various sources.
8d1116152a8ab0be5385764a93b4f5403529daf0.result: Random forest is best, with RMSE 510.8 and 129.9 and R2 0.875 and 0.817 for potato and maize; optimal weather conditions are identified.
8d1116152a8ab0be5385764a93b4f5403529daf0.open_work: Add soil, management and remote sensing predictors and test in other districts.
8d1116152a8ab0be5385764a93b4f5403529daf0.issues: Single district with small datasets; only rainfall and temperature as inputs; risk of overfitting.

cac327586f004d404775e893846e5b2486df1c29.goal: Improve wind power prediction using ensembles of machine learning models.
cac327586f004d404775e893846e5b2486df1c29.architecture: Ensembles of regressors, including support vector regression and decision tree ensembles, using neighbouring turbine information.
cac327586f004d404775e893846e5b2486df1c29.data: Wind power time series from the NREL Western Wind dataset.
cac327586f004d404775e893846e5b2486df1c29.result: Heterogeneous and decision tree ensembles improve accuracy and reduce computation compared with single SVR models.
cac327586f004d404775e893846e5b2486df1c29.open_work: Extend ensembles to longer horizons and probabilistic outputs.
cac327586f004d404775e893846e5b2486df1c29.issues: Abstract unavailable here; synthetic NREL data may not reflect real farm conditions; deterministic forecasts.

195d19d90dd6f24c2363d522c41da0d516cdc0ca.goal: Classify daily weather types for day-ahead short-term solar PV power forecasting and assess how classifier choice and sample size affect accuracy.
195d19d90dd6f24c2363d522c41da0d516cdc0ca.architecture: K-nearest neighbors (KNN) and support vector machine (SVM) classifiers for daily weather type classification.
195d19d90dd6f24c2363d522c41da0d516cdc0ca.data: Operation data from a grid-connected PV plant in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, China.
195d19d90dd6f24c2363d522c41da0d516cdc0ca.result: SVM performs well with small samples, while KNN is more sensitive to training data length and can beat SVM with sufficient samples.
195d19d90dd6f24c2363d522c41da0d516cdc0ca.open_work: Link classification accuracy to downstream PV forecast skill and test more classifiers and plants.
195d19d90dd6f24c2363d522c41da0d516cdc0ca.issues: Single plant; classification step only; results depend on the weather categories defined.

420d565af652515f6d823762f99003747533fb3e.goal: Improve neural network river flow forecasting by separating baseflow and optimising input selection.
420d565af652515f6d823762f99003747533fb3e.architecture: Artificial neural networks (MLP) combined with baseflow separation and binary-coded swarm optimisation for input variable selection.
420d565af652515f6d823762f99003747533fb3e.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); river flow records and related hydrological inputs implied.
420d565af652515f6d823762f99003747533fb3e.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies baseflow separation and swarm-based input selection improve forecasts over standard ANNs.
420d565af652515f6d823762f99003747533fb3e.open_work: Test across more catchments and lead times and compare with other input selection approaches.
420d565af652515f6d823762f99003747533fb3e.issues: Abstract unavailable, so catchment, horizon and gains cannot be verified.

3ae0973a218e4f9969376b43355f3c4ea88fcf35.goal: Improve short-term wind speed forecasts by adaptively combining forecasts from several neural network models.
3ae0973a218e4f9969376b43355f3c4ea88fcf35.architecture: Bayesian model averaging that adaptively weights forecasts from different neural networks (ADALINE, back-propagation MLP and radial basis function networks).
3ae0973a218e4f9969376b43355f3c4ea88fcf35.data: Hourly wind speed data from sites in North Dakota, USA.
3ae0973a218e4f9969376b43355f3c4ea88fcf35.result: The Bayesian combination is more robust than individual neural networks, though not always the best at every site.
3ae0973a218e4f9969376b43355f3c4ea88fcf35.open_work: Extend to multi-step and probabilistic wind power forecasting.
3ae0973a218e4f9969376b43355f3c4ea88fcf35.issues: Abstract unavailable here; few sites and short horizons; member networks are simple by modern standards.

b40d2aed7d36f3d957038314507f1a7cbc9a824c.goal: Predict short-term wind speed with support vector regression whose hyperparameters are tuned by evolutionary algorithms.
b40d2aed7d36f3d957038314507f1a7cbc9a824c.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) with evolutionary algorithms (such as evolutionary programming and particle swarm optimisation) for hyperparameter search.
b40d2aed7d36f3d957038314507f1a7cbc9a824c.data: Wind speed data from a wind farm; specifics not reported here (abstract unavailable).
b40d2aed7d36f3d957038314507f1a7cbc9a824c.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); evolutionary tuning yields SVR models that outperform standard grid search tuning.
b40d2aed7d36f3d957038314507f1a7cbc9a824c.open_work: Apply to wind power and longer horizons and test other evolutionary tuning approaches.
b40d2aed7d36f3d957038314507f1a7cbc9a824c.issues: Abstract unavailable; single site; deterministic point forecasts.

2571e2d108d7bef9fe609b5dd73ca07560105e1a.goal: Compare imputation methods for missing values in spatio-temporal meteorological time series.
2571e2d108d7bef9fe609b5dd73ca07560105e1a.architecture: Comparison of six imputation methods: simple arithmetic average, normal ratio, correlation-weighted normal ratio, multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network, and EM-MCMC multiple imputation, plus a proposed EM-MCMC modification.
2571e2d108d7bef9fe609b5dd73ca07560105e1a.data: Monthly total precipitation and mean temperature series from the Turkish State Meteorological Service with artificially created gaps.
2571e2d108d7bef9fe609b5dd73ca07560105e1a.result: Computational methods, particularly EM-MCMC, perform best across missingness periods despite high cost; the correlation dimension measure is proposed for evaluation.
2571e2d108d7bef9fe609b5dd73ca07560105e1a.open_work: Extend to daily data and other variables and test modern ML imputation methods.
2571e2d108d7bef9fe609b5dd73ca07560105e1a.issues: Artificial gaps may not mimic real missingness patterns; monthly data only; computational cost of EM-MCMC is high.

9ddcfbc17762cb753dc7ea22d0bb1414a9d79e27.goal: Map flash flood susceptibility to support flood hazard management.
9ddcfbc17762cb753dc7ea22d0bb1414a9d79e27.architecture: Tree-based ensemble machine learning: boosted regression tree, random forest, parallel random forest, regularized random forest and extremely randomized trees.
9ddcfbc17762cb753dc7ea22d0bb1414a9d79e27.data: Fifteen climatic and geo-environmental variables in the Kalvan watershed, Markazi Province, Iran, with flash flood inventory points.
9ddcfbc17762cb753dc7ea22d0bb1414a9d79e27.result: Extremely randomized trees perform best (AUC 0.82), then RRF 0.80, PRF 0.79, RF 0.78, BRT 0.75; 28.33% of the area is moderate to very high susceptibility.
9ddcfbc17762cb753dc7ea22d0bb1414a9d79e27.open_work: Apply to other watersheds and add dynamic rainfall drivers.
9ddcfbc17762cb753dc7ea22d0bb1414a9d79e27.issues: Single watershed; moderate AUC; susceptibility maps are static and depend on the flood inventory and absence sampling.

bc657d7b69fb734d2b4e1deaa823a552b50fc142.goal: Identify urban air pollution sources and predict air quality indices in Lucknow, India.
bc657d7b69fb734d2b4e1deaa823a552b50fc142.architecture: Principal component analysis for source identification, and tree-based ensembles (single decision tree, decision tree forest, decision treeboost) compared with support vector machines.
bc657d7b69fb734d2b4e1deaa823a552b50fc142.data: Five years of air quality and meteorological data for Lucknow, India.
bc657d7b69fb734d2b4e1deaa823a552b50fc142.result: Ensembles beat SVM: misclassification 4.12% (DTF) and 5.62% (DTB) vs 6.18% (SVM); AQI regression r 0.959 and RMSE 4.38 for DTB.
bc657d7b69fb734d2b4e1deaa823a552b50fc142.open_work: Extend to forecasting with lead time and to other cities.
bc657d7b69fb734d2b4e1deaa823a552b50fc142.issues: Single city; evaluation on complete data may overstate skill; predictions are concurrent rather than forecasts.

0178f5396cd95572ef5ee43e35504142f5861dbe.goal: Predict hourly criteria air pollutant concentrations and air quality indices in highly polluted Ahvaz, Iran.
0178f5396cd95572ef5ee43e35504142f5861dbe.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) with nine inputs, one hidden layer of 30 neurons and one output.
0178f5396cd95572ef5ee43e35504142f5861dbe.data: Hourly O3, NO2, PM10, PM2.5, SO2, CO and meteorology at four sites in Ahvaz, Iran, August 2009–August 2010.
0178f5396cd95572ef5ee43e35504142f5861dbe.result: Across pollutants and sites, R is 0.87 and RMSE 59.9; AQHI predictions are significant at three sites and AQI at one.
0178f5396cd95572ef5ee43e35504142f5861dbe.open_work: Compare ANN with numerical, computational and statistical models.
0178f5396cd95572ef5ee43e35504142f5861dbe.issues: One year of data; only 5–10% held out for validation and testing; lagged pollutant inputs dominate.

3652118d018b37942a366b5395942e982661456d.goal: Map shallow water bathymetry from satellites without requiring local supervised depth data.
3652118d018b37942a366b5395942e982661456d.architecture: Random forest regression trained on multi-temporal satellite images to build a generalised depth estimation model.
3652118d018b37942a366b5395942e982661456d.data: 135 Landsat-8 images and training bathymetry data for five areas, processed in Google Earth Engine.
3652118d018b37942a366b5395942e982661456d.result: RMSE of estimated depth is 1.41 m for depths of 0–20 m across five test areas.
3652118d018b37942a366b5395942e982661456d.open_work: Apply to other shallow regions and turbid waters.
3652118d018b37942a366b5395942e982661456d.issues: Limited to highly transparent waters and depths below 20 m; accuracy depends on reference bathymetry availability.

9ede54b85fe403a80fb90a072c721cdb2c8f4405.goal: Forecast wind power accurately for power system operation.
9ede54b85fe403a80fb90a072c721cdb2c8f4405.architecture: Forecast engine composed of a modified hybrid neural network trained with an enhanced particle swarm optimisation algorithm.
9ede54b85fe403a80fb90a072c721cdb2c8f4405.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); wind farm power data implied.
9ede54b85fe403a80fb90a072c721cdb2c8f4405.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the engine improves accuracy over other wind power forecasting methods.
9ede54b85fe403a80fb90a072c721cdb2c8f4405.open_work: Extend to probabilistic forecasts and more wind farms.
9ede54b85fe403a80fb90a072c721cdb2c8f4405.issues: Abstract unavailable, so data and gains cannot be verified.

c3f9a9ee076b62a45571ab19256d7c3b667c1292.goal: Forecast flood flows for flood warning and management.
c3f9a9ee076b62a45571ab19256d7c3b667c1292.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural networks (MLP), adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and regression models.
c3f9a9ee076b62a45571ab19256d7c3b667c1292.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); rainfall and flow records from a single watershed implied.
c3f9a9ee076b62a45571ab19256d7c3b667c1292.result: Not reported in the abstract; the paper compares ANN, ANFIS and regression accuracy for flood flow forecasting.
c3f9a9ee076b62a45571ab19256d7c3b667c1292.open_work: Test at more catchments and lead times.
c3f9a9ee076b62a45571ab19256d7c3b667c1292.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-catchment comparisons may not generalise.

9a5af5f85ba4f527dbc8a504f397887670ea0e47.goal: Review applications of the self-organizing map for feature extraction and pattern analysis in meteorology and oceanography.
9a5af5f85ba4f527dbc8a504f397887670ea0e47.architecture: Review of self-organizing map (SOM, Kohonen map) applications, an unsupervised neural network based on competitive learning.
9a5af5f85ba4f527dbc8a504f397887670ea0e47.data: Review of published studies using in situ observations, satellite images and numerical model outputs.
9a5af5f85ba4f527dbc8a504f397887670ea0e47.result: SOM is widely used for clustering, visualization and extraction of characteristic patterns in ocean-atmosphere data.
9a5af5f85ba4f527dbc8a504f397887670ea0e47.open_work: Not reported; broader and more standardised SOM use in geosciences is implied.
9a5af5f85ba4f527dbc8a504f397887670ea0e47.issues: Abstract truncated and venue not recorded; review is from 2011 and predates deep learning methods.

0d136698dc10f40f100aaebe5af9612679885a8b.goal: Estimate agricultural drought by fusing remotely sensed drought factors to reproduce a ground-based drought index.
0d136698dc10f40f100aaebe5af9612679885a8b.architecture: Bias-corrected random forest, support vector machine and multi-layer perceptron neural network regression.
0d136698dc10f40f100aaebe5af9612679885a8b.data: Thirty drought factors from TRMM and MODIS to reproduce SPEI, 2001–2017, New South Wales wheat belt; station climate data and observed wheat yields for evaluation.
0d136698dc10f40f100aaebe5af9612679885a8b.result: Bias-corrected random forest gives the lowest RMSE and highest R2 for SPEI prediction.
0d136698dc10f40f100aaebe5af9612679885a8b.open_work: Extend to other regions and crops and to drought forecasting.
0d136698dc10f40f100aaebe5af9612679885a8b.issues: Abstract truncated; target is a derived index; TRMM is discontinued; regional study only.

3f2d9853c91d0d29689ee53980087c2415c187e6.goal: Forecast long-term monthly PV power generation at new candidate sites for PV plant siting.
3f2d9853c91d0d29689ee53980087c2415c187e6.architecture: Recurrent neural network with long short-term memory (LSTM).
3f2d9853c91d0d29689ee53980087c2415c187e6.data: 63 months of data from 164 PV sites in South Korea: plant capacity, electricity trading, weather and estimated solar irradiation.
3f2d9853c91d0d29689ee53980087c2415c187e6.result: On new plants, nRMSE is 7.416% and MAPE 10.805%; using the previous 10 months gives MAPE 11.535%.
3f2d9853c91d0d29689ee53980087c2415c187e6.open_work: Apply across wider regions and include terrain and climate change scenarios.
3f2d9853c91d0d29689ee53980087c2415c187e6.issues: Monthly resolution only; Korean sites only; uncertainty not quantified.

ce8e00ab14adbb936820e926f518dcbe823ccdd5.goal: Improve monthly runoff prediction for hydropower reservoir operation given multi-frequency runoff components.
ce8e00ab14adbb936820e926f518dcbe823ccdd5.architecture: Hybrid of variational mode decomposition and support vector machine tuned by quantum-behaved particle swarm optimisation.
ce8e00ab14adbb936820e926f518dcbe823ccdd5.data: Monthly streamflow at Three Gorges and Danjiangkou reservoirs, Yangtze Valley, China.
ce8e00ab14adbb936820e926f518dcbe823ccdd5.result: The hybrid model beats ANN and extreme learning machine benchmarks on three metrics.
ce8e00ab14adbb936820e926f518dcbe823ccdd5.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and other basins.
ce8e00ab14adbb936820e926f518dcbe823ccdd5.issues: Decomposition over the full series may leak future information; deterministic output; two reservoirs.

4789ca0eaa3c213e0ed40b33b045ab3e3961b881.goal: Compare machine learning methods for massive crop yield prediction across many crops for agricultural planning.
4789ca0eaa3c213e0ed40b33b045ab3e3961b881.architecture: Comparison of multiple linear regression, M5-Prime regression trees, MLP neural networks, support vector regression and k-nearest neighbor.
4789ca0eaa3c213e0ed40b33b045ab3e3961b881.data: Ten crop datasets from an irrigation zone in Mexico; tested on two consecutive years.
4789ca0eaa3c213e0ed40b33b045ab3e3961b881.result: M5-Prime and KNN have lowest errors (RMSE 5.14 and 4.91, RRSE about 79%) and highest correlations (0.41 and 0.42); M5-Prime is best overall.
4789ca0eaa3c213e0ed40b33b045ab3e3961b881.open_work: Add more predictors and test other regions.
4789ca0eaa3c213e0ed40b33b045ab3e3961b881.issues: Low correlations overall (about 0.4); short test period; single irrigation zone.

fbf50edeed310fcf79d60277b75e1941c79344d3.goal: Predict rainfall from time series to support disaster prevention decisions.
fbf50edeed310fcf79d60277b75e1941c79344d3.architecture: Intensified LSTM recurrent neural network with weighted linear units.
fbf50edeed310fcf79d60277b75e1941c79344d3.data: A standard rainfall dataset; details not reported in the abstract.
fbf50edeed310fcf79d60277b75e1941c79344d3.result: Improves on Holt-Winters, ELM, ARIMA, RNN and LSTM baselines; specific numbers not given in the abstract.
fbf50edeed310fcf79d60277b75e1941c79344d3.open_work: Test on other regions and variables.
fbf50edeed310fcf79d60277b75e1941c79344d3.issues: Dataset and lead time unclear; only univariate time series; no uncertainty.

60f404f17e248eec4e5ec8d60a99845203e4976b.goal: Produce global daily gapless 1 km PM2.5 estimates to study air pollution variability, exposure and health impact.
60f404f17e248eec4e5ec8d60a99845203e4976b.architecture: Machine learning model with big data; the model type is not specified in the abstract.
60f404f17e248eec4e5ec8d60a99845203e4976b.data: Global data 2017–2022; satellite and other big data inputs, details not reported in the abstract.
60f404f17e248eec4e5ec8d60a99845203e4976b.result: 96%, 82% and 53% of populated areas face unhealthy air for at least one day, week and month in 2022; COVID-19 lockdown changes and biomass burning episodes are captured.
60f404f17e248eec4e5ec8d60a99845203e4976b.open_work: Extend the record and refine estimates in data-sparse regions.
60f404f17e248eec4e5ec8d60a99845203e4976b.issues: Ground monitors are sparse in developing regions; gap-filling may be less accurate where satellite data are missing; uncertainty not detailed.

7c5c9ec4d90d25948eb11c317da01ac36146808c.goal: Forecast air quality index accurately for pollution warning.
7c5c9ec4d90d25948eb11c317da01ac36146808c.architecture: Hybrid model with two-phase decomposition of the AQI series and a modified extreme learning machine.
7c5c9ec4d90d25948eb11c317da01ac36146808c.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); AQI time series implied.
7c5c9ec4d90d25948eb11c317da01ac36146808c.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the hybrid model outperforms benchmark models.
7c5c9ec4d90d25948eb11c317da01ac36146808c.open_work: Test at more cities and longer horizons.
7c5c9ec4d90d25948eb11c317da01ac36146808c.issues: Abstract unavailable; decomposition-based hybrids may leak future information.

5e00c33d720a4e2be767f7e0fe033a6f4cc91ebe.goal: Predict groundwater levels and compare multiple linear regression with artificial neural networks.
5e00c33d720a4e2be767f7e0fe033a6f4cc91ebe.architecture: Comparison of multiple linear regression and artificial neural network (MLP) models.
5e00c33d720a4e2be767f7e0fe033a6f4cc91ebe.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); groundwater level observations with hydrological and meteorological predictors implied.
5e00c33d720a4e2be767f7e0fe033a6f4cc91ebe.result: Not reported in the abstract; the paper compares ANN and MLR performance for groundwater level prediction.
5e00c33d720a4e2be767f7e0fe033a6f4cc91ebe.open_work: Test with more wells and predictors.
5e00c33d720a4e2be767f7e0fe033a6f4cc91ebe.issues: Abstract unavailable, so site and results cannot be verified.

41de39e0cfa898bae4a977f45408ce19dab329de.goal: Improve rainfall prediction with neural networks optimized by evolutionary methods.
41de39e0cfa898bae4a977f45408ce19dab329de.architecture: Radial basis function neural network evolved with a hybrid of particle swarm optimisation and genetic algorithm.
41de39e0cfa898bae4a977f45408ce19dab329de.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); rainfall time series implied.
41de39e0cfa898bae4a977f45408ce19dab329de.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies better accuracy than conventional RBF networks.
41de39e0cfa898bae4a977f45408ce19dab329de.open_work: Test at more sites and longer horizons.
41de39e0cfa898bae4a977f45408ce19dab329de.issues: Abstract unavailable; metaheuristic tuning is hard to reproduce.

2e67b5b79397f31c7bc149252ad15b486e0492c1.goal: Detect thin cloud, thick cloud and non-cloud pixels simultaneously in remote sensing images.
2e67b5b79397f31c7bc149252ad15b486e0492c1.architecture: Multiscale features convolutional neural network (MF-CNN) combining high-level semantic and low-level spatial information.
2e67b5b79397f31c7bc149252ad15b486e0492c1.data: Landsat 8 imagery with visible, near-infrared, short-wave, cirrus and thermal infrared bands at various cloud cover levels.
2e67b5b79397f31c7bc149252ad15b486e0492c1.result: MF-CNN outperforms common cloud detection methods for thick and thin cloud and overall cloud regions.
2e67b5b79397f31c7bc149252ad15b486e0492c1.open_work: Extend to other sensors and to cloud removal tasks.
2e67b5b79397f31c7bc149252ad15b486e0492c1.issues: Only Landsat 8 tested; thin cloud labels are subjective; quantitative values not given in the abstract.

8196bfdac66b9b1d52a0d69e356b7aae421bdced.goal: Examines how the choice of sigmoid transfer function affects neural network performance for multistep-ahead streamflow forecasting.
8196bfdac66b9b1d52a0d69e356b7aae421bdced.architecture: Feedforward MLP neural networks with different sigmoid-type transfer functions in the hidden layer are compared.
8196bfdac66b9b1d52a0d69e356b7aae421bdced.data: Not reported in the available metadata. Observed streamflow series from one or more catchments are implied.
8196bfdac66b9b1d52a0d69e356b7aae421bdced.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the paper compares forecast skill across transfer functions and lead times.
8196bfdac66b9b1d52a0d69e356b7aae421bdced.open_work: Testing whether conclusions hold across more catchments, lead times and network configurations.
8196bfdac66b9b1d52a0d69e356b7aae421bdced.issues: Abstract unavailable; findings and data details could not be verified. Comparisons of activation functions may be sensitive to training setup.

3abfeaf56e1b6e82f403349ba90be26891836a91.goal: Maps hyperlocal (10–30 m) urban air temperature rather than land surface temperature, since air temperature matters for heat health risk and energy use.
3abfeaf56e1b6e82f403349ba90be26891836a91.architecture: Random forest regression linking remote sensing and LiDAR-derived predictors to crowdsourced air temperature observations.
3abfeaf56e1b6e82f403349ba90be26891836a91.data: Sentinel, Landsat and LiDAR data over Oslo, Norway, with crowdsourced air temperature from 1310 private (Netatmo-type) weather stations in 2018.
3abfeaf56e1b6e82f403349ba90be26891836a91.result: Annual mean Tair is mapped with RMSE 0.52 °C (R2 = 0.5); daily maximum and minimum are harder (RMSE 1.85 °C, R2 = 0.05; 1.46 °C, R2 = 0.33).
3abfeaf56e1b6e82f403349ba90be26891836a91.open_work: Improving daily extreme temperature mapping and transferring the approach to other cities and periods.
3abfeaf56e1b6e82f403349ba90be26891836a91.issues: Single city and single year; crowdsourced stations need quality control and have uneven coverage; low skill for daily maximum temperature.

2dbed426b7871a33317cbac27d237f8dba9d9bea.goal: Quantifies uncertainty in wind power forecasts through prediction intervals, since forecast errors are poorly described by parametric distributions.
2dbed426b7871a33317cbac27d237f8dba9d9bea.architecture: Neural network lower upper bound estimation (LUBE) with a combined-PI framework, a new fuzzy-based cost function and a modified bat algorithm for training.
2dbed426b7871a33317cbac27d237f8dba9d9bea.data: Wind power data from several wind farms in Australia.
2dbed426b7871a33317cbac27d237f8dba9d9bea.result: The combined fuzzy LUBE method produces prediction intervals with satisfactory coverage and width, balancing coverage probability and normalized width per decision-maker preferences.
2dbed426b7871a33317cbac27d237f8dba9d9bea.open_work: Extending to multi-step horizons and comparing with probabilistic deep learning approaches.
2dbed426b7871a33317cbac27d237f8dba9d9bea.issues: Metaheuristic training adds tuning effort; quantitative gains are not reported in the abstract and evaluation is limited to Australian farms.

94a9dbb3477213e444e083fca74a8054119bca51.goal: Maps maximum urban air temperature on hot summer days at fine resolution, where station networks are sparse and land surface temperature is a poor proxy.
94a9dbb3477213e444e083fca74a8054119bca51.architecture: Random forest regression on satellite-derived and land-cover predictors, compared with simpler regression approaches.
94a9dbb3477213e444e083fca74a8054119bca51.data: Landsat-derived surface variables and other spatial predictors with weather station air temperature over Vancouver, Canada.
94a9dbb3477213e444e083fca74a8054119bca51.result: Random forest gives the most accurate maps of maximum air temperature among the methods tested; exact error statistics are not reported here.
94a9dbb3477213e444e083fca74a8054119bca51.open_work: Extending to other cities, more days and higher-density observations.
94a9dbb3477213e444e083fca74a8054119bca51.issues: Limited number of stations and hot days; results are city-specific and details could not be checked against the abstract.

dc033d7e43f4a8e20b5c97f0809c71d496d77d99.goal: Reviews hybrid artificial intelligence and optimization models for hydrological streamflow forecasting, motivated by reservoir operation needs.
dc033d7e43f4a8e20b5c97f0809c71d496d77d99.architecture: Review of machine learning models grouped into three categories combined with nature-inspired optimization algorithms (swarm, evolutionary) in hydrology.
dc033d7e43f4a8e20b5c97f0809c71d496d77d99.result: Hybrid AI–optimization models generally outperform standalone models; advantages and disadvantages of each class are summarized.
dc033d7e43f4a8e20b5c97f0809c71d496d77d99.open_work: Recommends further development of hybrid models and guidelines for selecting optimizers and AI models.
dc033d7e43f4a8e20b5c97f0809c71d496d77d99.issues: Narrative review with limited quantitative synthesis; may be biased toward positive published results.

516bd5681140544b1f253e98fe5db5fdd259d3c2.goal: Predicts wind speed time series at the Osorio wind farm in Brazil to support wind energy planning and operation.
516bd5681140544b1f253e98fe5db5fdd259d3c2.architecture: Several machine learning time-series models are compared; the specific model families are not specified in the available metadata.
516bd5681140544b1f253e98fe5db5fdd259d3c2.data: Wind speed measurements from the Osorio wind farm, Brazil; record length and horizons not reported.
516bd5681140544b1f253e98fe5db5fdd259d3c2.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
516bd5681140544b1f253e98fe5db5fdd259d3c2.open_work: Testing at other sites and horizons and adding probabilistic forecasts.
516bd5681140544b1f253e98fe5db5fdd259d3c2.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-site case study, so generality is uncertain.

d5aed39e53c2d0cc2ceb5f5b00651eb558ae1c7c.goal: Improves wind power prediction by combining linear long-memory and nonlinear models.
d5aed39e53c2d0cc2ceb5f5b00651eb558ae1c7c.architecture: Hybrid of autoregressive fractionally integrated moving average (ARFIMA) and least squares support vector machine (LSSVM).
d5aed39e53c2d0cc2ceb5f5b00651eb558ae1c7c.data: Not reported in the available metadata. Wind farm power series are implied.
d5aed39e53c2d0cc2ceb5f5b00651eb558ae1c7c.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the hybrid is presented as improving on its components.
d5aed39e53c2d0cc2ceb5f5b00651eb558ae1c7c.open_work: Extension to multi-step and probabilistic wind power forecasts.
d5aed39e53c2d0cc2ceb5f5b00651eb558ae1c7c.issues: Abstract unavailable; evaluation details and data size unknown.

04630e7b6266be756cc11bc25ec3acf9dae34d3f.goal: Forecasts short-term significant wave height in coastal zones to support ocean renewable energy.
04630e7b6266be756cc11bc25ec3acf9dae34d3f.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM) coupled with ICEEMDAN signal decomposition; each IMF forecast separately using PACF-selected lags, then summed.
04630e7b6266be756cc11bc25ec3acf9dae34d3f.data: 30-min significant wave height records, January 2000–March 2018, at two coastal sites in Queensland, Australia.
04630e7b6266be756cc11bc25ec3acf9dae34d3f.result: ICEEMDAN-ELM outperforms ICEEMDAN-OSELM, ICEEMDAN-RF and standalone ELM, OSELM and random forest on several error metrics.
04630e7b6266be756cc11bc25ec3acf9dae34d3f.open_work: Adding meteorological predictors and testing at more sites and longer horizons.
04630e7b6266be756cc11bc25ec3acf9dae34d3f.issues: Decomposing the full series before splitting can leak future information; univariate inputs only; two sites.

d2dc4a6617fc12d7dd39b29b67b1e8ad7ecda64a.goal: Shows that many wavelet-based hydrological forecasting models are incorrectly built and proposes best practices for real-world use.
d2dc4a6617fc12d7dd39b29b67b1e8ad7ecda64a.architecture: Not a new network: a Wavelet Data-Driven Forecasting Framework (WDDFF) using boundary-corrected MODWT and à trous coefficients, input variable selection and data-driven models such as extreme learning machine.
d2dc4a6617fc12d7dd39b29b67b1e8ad7ecda64a.data: Urban water demand data from Montreal, Canada.
d2dc4a6617fc12d7dd39b29b67b1e8ad7ecda64a.result: Common DWT-MRA and MODWT-MRA set-ups use future data and overstate skill; WDDFF gives realistic forecasts and beats random walk, linear regression, ELM and Volterra benchmarks.
d2dc4a6617fc12d7dd39b29b67b1e8ad7ecda64a.open_work: Applying WDDFF to streamflow, rainfall, evaporation and other processes.
d2dc4a6617fc12d7dd39b29b67b1e8ad7ecda64a.issues: Demonstrated on a single water demand case study; framework choices still require careful filter and level selection.

672fcf8e6a4c069f0fb824c41761970743b0730c.goal: Automatically classifies ground-based cloud images into meteorological cloud types, which affect radiation and weather.
672fcf8e6a4c069f0fb824c41761970743b0730c.architecture: CloudNet, a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) for image classification.
672fcf8e6a4c069f0fb824c41761970743b0730c.data: New Cirrus Cumulus Stratus Nimbus (CCSN) ground-based cloud image dataset with 11 categories including contrails.
672fcf8e6a4c069f0fb824c41761970743b0730c.result: CloudNet achieves good classification performance; the dataset is three times larger than earlier databases. Exact accuracy is not given in the abstract.
672fcf8e6a4c069f0fb824c41761970743b0730c.open_work: Larger and more diverse datasets and linking cloud types to radiative effects.
672fcf8e6a4c069f0fb824c41761970743b0730c.issues: Accuracy not quantified in the abstract; images from limited sites and visual categories can be ambiguous.

02dec79a8cc54b474f81e2a91a51e24c469f2f06.goal: Predicts monthly mean daily global solar radiation in India and identifies the most influential inputs.
02dec79a8cc54b474f81e2a91a51e24c469f2f06.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) and artificial neural network (ANN) models compared with four new empirical models; WEKA used for input selection.
02dec79a8cc54b474f81e2a91a51e24c469f2f06.data: Meteorological data (sunshine hours, temperature, humidity, etc.) for several Indian cities, including Tamil Nadu smart cities.
02dec79a8cc54b474f81e2a91a51e24c469f2f06.result: SVM with month, latitude, maximum temperature and sunshine hours performs best; excluding humidity does not hurt; annual GSR is 17–22 MJ/m2/day.
02dec79a8cc54b474f81e2a91a51e24c469f2f06.open_work: Extension to daily or hourly radiation and more locations.
02dec79a8cc54b474f81e2a91a51e24c469f2f06.issues: Monthly means only; limited station network; metrics not given in the abstract.

c56e71d299054e96a7a02e47890f3bff29f39025.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power output 24 h ahead to support smart grid stability.
c56e71d299054e96a7a02e47890f3bff29f39025.architecture: PVPNet, a multiple-input deep convolutional neural network (CNN) producing deterministic and probabilistic forecasts.
c56e71d299054e96a7a02e47890f3bff29f39025.data: Historical PV output and meteorological data (temperature, solar radiation); site not specified in the abstract.
c56e71d299054e96a7a02e47890f3bff29f39025.result: PVPNet achieves MAE 109.5 and RMSE 163.2 (units not given) and outperforms benchmark models.
c56e71d299054e96a7a02e47890f3bff29f39025.open_work: Testing at more plants and with numerical weather prediction inputs.
c56e71d299054e96a7a02e47890f3bff29f39025.issues: Single dataset; error units and baselines unclear in the abstract; probabilistic skill not quantified.

67351e2ae490768f741d2b9be04596f32d285356.goal: Forecasts River Nile flow at Dongola Station, Sudan, to detect flood hazard.
67351e2ae490768f741d2b9be04596f32d285356.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN), using upstream station flows as inputs.
67351e2ae490768f741d2b9be04596f32d285356.data: Flow records from stations on the Blue Nile, White Nile, Main Nile and Atbara, 1965–2003.
67351e2ae490768f741d2b9be04596f32d285356.result: The ANN provides a reliable means of forecasting flows and detecting flood hazard at Dongola.
67351e2ae490768f741d2b9be04596f32d285356.open_work: Including rainfall and remote sensing inputs and longer lead times.
67351e2ae490768f741d2b9be04596f32d285356.issues: Single station; quantitative skill not reported in the abstract; relies on upstream gauges availability.

1a89cbe1bbdd45c3279b3f2dfbd447b00f0e4458.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting of volatile, irregular series.
1a89cbe1bbdd45c3279b3f2dfbd447b00f0e4458.architecture: Hybrid ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) with support vector machine (SVM) forecasting of each IMF, discarding the highest-frequency IMF.
1a89cbe1bbdd45c3279b3f2dfbd447b00f0e4458.data: Mean monthly wind speed from three wind farms in northwest China.
1a89cbe1bbdd45c3279b3f2dfbd447b00f0e4458.result: The EEMD-SVM hybrid improves forecast validity over the comparison models.
1a89cbe1bbdd45c3279b3f2dfbd447b00f0e4458.open_work: Application to shorter time scales and to other volatile series.
1a89cbe1bbdd45c3279b3f2dfbd447b00f0e4458.issues: Decomposition of the whole series may leak future information; monthly data only; small sample.

0f91d6c338c08f3de97dc17907bc05375bb3b028.goal: Builds reliable prediction intervals of wind power for power system operation.
0f91d6c338c08f3de97dc17907bc05375bb3b028.architecture: Beta-PSO-LSTM: long short-term memory (LSTM) network with a Beta distribution error model whose parameters are optimized by particle swarm optimization.
0f91d6c338c08f3de97dc17907bc05375bb3b028.data: Wind power series; site not specified in the abstract.
0f91d6c338c08f3de97dc17907bc05375bb3b028.result: Beta-PSO-LSTM gives higher reliability and narrower intervals than Beta-PSO-BP, Norm-LSTM, Beta-LSTM and Beta-IM-LSTM.
0f91d6c338c08f3de97dc17907bc05375bb3b028.open_work: Testing on more farms and longer horizons.
0f91d6c338c08f3de97dc17907bc05375bb3b028.issues: Simulation results on limited data; quantitative metrics not given in the abstract.

5f215fedced5a0580e52c86ea7f4e40bee559ff8.goal: Maps flash flood susceptibility for catchment flood management.
5f215fedced5a0580e52c86ea7f4e40bee559ff8.architecture: Credal decision tree (CDT) ensembles with AdaBoostM1, Bagging, Dagging and MultiBoostAB, with correlation-based feature selection.
5f215fedced5a0580e52c86ea7f4e40bee559ff8.data: About 320 past flash flood events and nine conditioning factors in a catchment of Markazi province, Iran (GIS layers).
5f215fedced5a0580e52c86ea7f4e40bee559ff8.result: ABM-CDT performs best (AUC 0.957), followed by Dag-CDT 0.947, MBAB-CDT 0.933, Bag-CDT 0.932 and CDT 0.900; distance to rivers is most important.
5f215fedced5a0580e52c86ea7f4e40bee559ff8.open_work: Transfer to other regions and inclusion of dynamic rainfall information.
5f215fedced5a0580e52c86ea7f4e40bee559ff8.issues: Static susceptibility only; single catchment; inventory quality and sampling of non-flood points affect results.

6fb3d9f73541cb6e2b3bd76f9294798a3b4029f3.goal: Downscales SMAP passive soil moisture to finer resolution for hydrological applications.
6fb3d9f73541cb6e2b3bd76f9294798a3b4029f3.architecture: Random forest regression linking coarse SMAP soil moisture to fine-scale land surface predictors.
6fb3d9f73541cb6e2b3bd76f9294798a3b4029f3.data: SMAP passive surface soil moisture with MODIS-derived variables and terrain data; validated against in situ networks (Iberian Peninsula, REMEDHUS).
6fb3d9f73541cb6e2b3bd76f9294798a3b4029f3.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the downscaled product is reported to retain SMAP accuracy while adding spatial detail.
6fb3d9f73541cb6e2b3bd76f9294798a3b4029f3.open_work: Testing in other climates and vegetation regimes.
6fb3d9f73541cb6e2b3bd76f9294798a3b4029f3.issues: Optical predictors are limited by cloud cover; validation network coverage is limited.

957fac8c714bfc0026abda931c6e098ffe4dc10a.goal: Improves rainfall rate retrieval from geostationary optical satellite data for day, night and twilight.
957fac8c714bfc0026abda931c6e098ffe4dc10a.architecture: Random forest regression models tuned separately for day, night and twilight conditions.
957fac8c714bfc0026abda931c6e098ffe4dc10a.data: MSG SEVIRI channels and cloud properties; DWD RADOLAN RW gauge-adjusted radar rainfall for training and validation over Germany.
957fac8c714bfc0026abda931c6e098ffe4dc10a.result: Hourly Rsq is 0.50 (day and night) and 0.48 (twilight), rising to about 0.75–0.78 for 8-h aggregates; daytime is best.
957fac8c714bfc0026abda931c6e098ffe4dc10a.open_work: Extending to other regions and cloud regimes and to full rain area delineation.
957fac8c714bfc0026abda931c6e098ffe4dc10a.issues: Rain areas are pre-identified; mid-latitude cyclones only; moderate hourly skill; radar reference has its own errors.

8ccb2869a049d2abd1b741dae31abd4abaf7c074.goal: Forecasts daily air quality index in Chinese cities to support pollution warnings.
8ccb2869a049d2abd1b741dae31abd4abaf7c074.architecture: Hybrid forecasting models; the specific components are not specified in the available metadata.
8ccb2869a049d2abd1b741dae31abd4abaf7c074.data: Daily AQI series for cities in China; details not reported in the available metadata.
8ccb2869a049d2abd1b741dae31abd4abaf7c074.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the hybrid models are presented as improving on single models.
8ccb2869a049d2abd1b741dae31abd4abaf7c074.open_work: Adding meteorological predictors and multi-step forecasts.
8ccb2869a049d2abd1b741dae31abd4abaf7c074.issues: Abstract unavailable; univariate time-series hybrids may not capture emission or meteorological drivers.

e3707931c7be45af9de688d62ab66114e1a4d971.goal: Improves multi-step spatio-temporal wind speed forecasts on the Norwegian continental shelf by exploiting station spatial relations.
e3707931c7be45af9de688d62ab66114e1a4d971.architecture: Graph neural network (GNN) with transformer update functions (Informer, LogSparse Transformer, Autoformer) and a new FFTransformer, versus LSTM and MLP.
e3707931c7be45af9de688d62ab66114e1a4d971.data: Measurement station wind data on the Norwegian continental shelf, 10-minute resolution.
e3707931c7be45af9de688d62ab66114e1a4d971.result: Transformer-based GNNs beat LSTM and MLP; FFTransformer and Autoformer are best at 10 min and 1 h, and FFTransformer is clearly best at 4 h.
e3707931c7be45af9de688d62ab66114e1a4d971.open_work: Probabilistic forecasts and use of NWP inputs.
e3707931c7be45af9de688d62ab66114e1a4d971.issues: Station data from one region; no uncertainty quantification; short horizons only.

eaf52f290fa8c7d725ec4b2e7ad3af40e559d0f9.goal: Short-term and ultra-short-term wind speed forecasting robust to outliers in industrial measurements.
eaf52f290fa8c7d725ec4b2e7ad3af40e559d0f9.architecture: Stacked extreme learning machine (SELM), a deep ELM, trained with a generalized correntropy criterion instead of MSE.
eaf52f290fa8c7d725ec4b2e7ad3af40e559d0f9.data: Real measured wind speed data; source not specified in the abstract.
eaf52f290fa8c7d725ec4b2e7ad3af40e559d0f9.result: The correntropy SELM achieves better forecasting performance than traditional and recent methods.
eaf52f290fa8c7d725ec4b2e7ad3af40e559d0f9.open_work: Applying to multi-site and probabilistic wind forecasting.
eaf52f290fa8c7d725ec4b2e7ad3af40e559d0f9.issues: Quantitative gains and dataset details not reported in the abstract.

15c837667b9e77f18d0a6604008c05307071d48b.goal: Forecasts rainfall-induced shallow landslides over large areas, where empirical thresholds and physical models fall short.
15c837667b9e77f18d0a6604008c05307071d48b.architecture: Deep learning model linking rainfall to landslide occurrence; the network type is not specified in the abstract.
15c837667b9e77f18d0a6604008c05307071d48b.data: Rainfall and landslide records over Italy for about 20 years.
15c837667b9e77f18d0a6604008c05307071d48b.result: Landslide occurrence can be anticipated effectively over large areas; timing and location are controlled mainly by precipitation.
15c837667b9e77f18d0a6604008c05307071d48b.open_work: Operational forecasting using rainfall measurements and quantitative precipitation forecasts.
15c837667b9e77f18d0a6604008c05307071d48b.issues: Landslide inventory incompleteness; dependence on rainfall data quality; operational skill with forecast rainfall untested.

8b790cbcb44004d47d6ce61e0c1a6b7eca226f32.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration for irrigation scheduling in Punjab, India.
8b790cbcb44004d47d6ce61e0c1a6b7eca226f32.architecture: Deep learning multilayer perceptron (MLP) compared with generalized linear model, random forest and gradient boosting machine in the H2O framework.
8b790cbcb44004d47d6ce61e0c1a6b7eca226f32.data: Daily meteorological data from Hoshiarpur and Patiala districts, Punjab.
8b790cbcb44004d47d6ce61e0c1a6b7eca226f32.result: Models achieve high skill (NSE 0.95–0.98, r2 0.95–0.99, RMSE 0.19–0.27); the deep learning model performs best.
8b790cbcb44004d47d6ce61e0c1a6b7eca226f32.open_work: Testing in other climates and with limited inputs.
8b790cbcb44004d47d6ce61e0c1a6b7eca226f32.issues: Two districts only; target is FAO-56 computed ETo rather than measured ET.

09959d56dd6b281630cfc38189fa795ec0f193f6.goal: Rapid flood extent mapping from high-resolution UAV imagery for emergency response.
09959d56dd6b281630cfc38189fa795ec0f193f6.architecture: VGG-based fully convolutional network (FCN-16s, a CNN) fine-tuned for segmentation, compared with FCN-8s, FCN-32s and SVM.
09959d56dd6b281630cfc38189fa795ec0f193f6.data: UAV imagery dataset with about one hundred training samples; k-fold cross-validation.
09959d56dd6b281630cfc38189fa795ec0f193f6.result: Water-class accuracy is 97.5% (FCN-16s), 97.8% (FCN-8s), 94.2% (FCN-32s) versus 89% for SVM.
09959d56dd6b281630cfc38189fa795ec0f193f6.open_work: Larger datasets and transfer to other flood events and sensors.
09959d56dd6b281630cfc38189fa795ec0f193f6.issues: Very small training set; single event area; accuracy reported for water class only.

e78487d857cc1a379f6f2bd33251a7d0c6ce682c.goal: Provides fast, ready-to-use pixel classification of clouds, cirrus, snow, shadow, water and clear sky in Sentinel-2 images.
e78487d857cc1a379f6f2bd33251a7d0c6ce682c.architecture: Decision trees and a classical Bayesian classifier on single-pixel reflectance spectra, compared with random forests, SVM and stochastic gradient descent.
e78487d857cc1a379f6f2bd33251a7d0c6ce682c.data: Public database of manually classified Sentinel-2A MSI images (top-of-atmosphere reflectance).
e78487d857cc1a379f6f2bd33251a7d0c6ce682c.result: Decision trees label about 91% of validation spectra correctly; the Bayesian method reaches 98%; random forests and SVM perform similarly to it.
e78487d857cc1a379f6f2bd33251a7d0c6ce682c.open_work: Adding spatial context and updating with new labeled images.
e78487d857cc1a379f6f2bd33251a7d0c6ce682c.issues: Pixel-wise spectra only, no spatial context; manual labels may contain errors.

60adc56e2665e98d65dc53803aa9c9680efb0426.goal: Predicts flood susceptible areas in the Middle Ganga Plain, India, a subsiding flood-prone floodplain.
60adc56e2665e98d65dc53803aa9c9680efb0426.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and ensembles with genetic algorithm, differential evolution and particle swarm optimization.
60adc56e2665e98d65dc53803aa9c9680efb0426.data: Flood inventory and 12 conditioning factors (rainfall, soil, TWI, slope, land cover, etc.), 70:30 train/validation split.
60adc56e2665e98d65dc53803aa9c9680efb0426.result: ANFIS-GA performs best with success-rate AUC 0.922, prediction-rate AUC 0.924 and accuracy 0.886/0.883.
60adc56e2665e98d65dc53803aa9c9680efb0426.open_work: Comparing with other classes of susceptibility models to establish a benchmark.
60adc56e2665e98d65dc53803aa9c9680efb0426.issues: Static susceptibility; assumes input data quality constant; single region.

1378cdbdb81b915d037ed71896b62848903f7d8e.goal: Provides a homogeneous satellite climatology of ocean–atmosphere fluxes and water cycle variables over the ice-free ocean.
1378cdbdb81b915d037ed71896b62848903f7d8e.architecture: Satellite climatology dataset (HOAPS-3) whose precipitation and wind speed retrievals use neural network algorithms; other variables from physical/empirical retrievals.
1378cdbdb81b915d037ed71896b62848903f7d8e.data: Intercalibrated SSM/I passive microwave data from DMSP satellites, 1987–2005, plus AVHRR SST.
1378cdbdb81b915d037ed71896b62848903f7d8e.result: HOAPS-3 delivers turbulent heat fluxes, evaporation, precipitation and freshwater flux at pentad, monthly and twice-daily resolution.
1378cdbdb81b915d037ed71896b62848903f7d8e.open_work: Extending the record with newer sensors and improving retrieval validation.
1378cdbdb81b915d037ed71896b62848903f7d8e.issues: Coverage limited to ice-free ocean; retrieval errors and sensor changes affect homogeneity.

a5880bc66041ffe4ed37d9deebcb091689169983.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for grid integration of offshore wind.
a5880bc66041ffe4ed37d9deebcb091689169983.architecture: Hybrid bidirectional LSTM with hierarchical evolutionary decomposition and an improved generalised normal distribution optimizer for hyperparameters.
a5880bc66041ffe4ed37d9deebcb091689169983.data: Data from an offshore turbine in the Lillgrund wind farm, Baltic Sea; 10-minute and 1-hour horizons.
a5880bc66041ffe4ed37d9deebcb091689169983.result: The hybrid outperforms six ML models and seven hybrid models across seven performance criteria.
a5880bc66041ffe4ed37d9deebcb091689169983.open_work: Testing on more turbines and with probabilistic outputs.
a5880bc66041ffe4ed37d9deebcb091689169983.issues: Single turbine; heavy hybrid pipeline is costly to tune; no uncertainty estimates.

4ced8b6ba62d250ac866af4cabeb80fe0ef6e9fa.goal: Short-term forecasting of PV generator power output to aid grid integration.
4ced8b6ba62d250ac866af4cabeb80fe0ef6e9fa.architecture: Dynamic artificial neural network for time-series forecasting.
4ced8b6ba62d250ac866af4cabeb80fe0ef6e9fa.data: Not reported in the available metadata. Measured PV power and meteorological series are implied.
4ced8b6ba62d250ac866af4cabeb80fe0ef6e9fa.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
4ced8b6ba62d250ac866af4cabeb80fe0ef6e9fa.open_work: Longer horizons and other PV technologies and sites.
4ced8b6ba62d250ac866af4cabeb80fe0ef6e9fa.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified.

815fccb9b1d3560aaba8809aa3d1fc90b3899128.goal: Downscales SMAP soil moisture to high resolution after the failure of the SMAP radar.
815fccb9b1d3560aaba8809aa3d1fc90b3899128.architecture: DENSE: gradient boosting decision tree regression linking soil moisture proxies to SMAP observations.
815fccb9b1d3560aaba8809aa3d1fc90b3899128.data: SMAP soil moisture with 26 MODIS- and DEM-derived indices over the Tibetan Plateau, 2015–2017; validated with Ngari, Naqu and Maqu networks.
815fccb9b1d3560aaba8809aa3d1fc90b3899128.result: Downscaling from 36 km to 1 km captures spatio-temporal variability and preserves SMAP accuracy, but fails in the densely vegetated Maqu network.
815fccb9b1d3560aaba8809aa3d1fc90b3899128.open_work: Correcting vegetation effects in the downscaling.
815fccb9b1d3560aaba8809aa3d1fc90b3899128.issues: Poor performance under dense vegetation; MODIS predictors are affected by clouds.

4dc76d16fc31d7b2a9705fcb347ea242f38579b6.goal: Builds a decomposition ensemble streamflow forecast that avoids using future information.
4dc76d16fc31d7b2a9705fcb347ea242f38579b6.architecture: SF-VMD-LSTM: variational mode decomposition with a single long short-term memory (LSTM) model trained to adapt to the boundary effect.
4dc76d16fc31d7b2a9705fcb347ea242f38579b6.data: Daily streamflow from the Han River and Jing River, China; 1–7 day lead times.
4dc76d16fc31d7b2a9705fcb347ea242f38579b6.result: SF beats multi-model ensemble schemes, VMD beats EEMD and DWT, and SF-VMD-LSTM reaches NSE above 0.8 in almost all scenarios.
4dc76d16fc31d7b2a9705fcb347ea242f38579b6.open_work: Adding meteorological inputs and testing on more basins.
4dc76d16fc31d7b2a9705fcb347ea242f38579b6.issues: Two basins; univariate inputs; boundary effects are mitigated rather than eliminated.

bbaa3ec52ae598ed61d88fd0552c311a35c75401.goal: Produces global maps of streamflow characteristics for ungauged regions.
bbaa3ec52ae598ed61d88fd0552c311a35c75401.architecture: Ensembles of artificial neural networks regionalize streamflow characteristics from climate and physiographic predictors.
bbaa3ec52ae598ed61d88fd0552c311a35c75401.data: Observed streamflow from several thousand catchments worldwide with global climate and landscape datasets.
bbaa3ec52ae598ed61d88fd0552c311a35c75401.result: Global gridded maps of multiple streamflow characteristics (e.g. mean flow, baseflow index, runoff coefficient) with reasonable cross-validated skill.
bbaa3ec52ae598ed61d88fd0552c311a35c75401.open_work: Use of the maps to evaluate and calibrate global hydrological models.
bbaa3ec52ae598ed61d88fd0552c311a35c75401.issues: Gauge coverage is uneven, so uncertainty is higher in sparsely gauged regions; human influences on flows are hard to separate.

6d40c57d25095ace2fd165056f5e3578122ddecd.goal: Short-term multi-step wind power forecasting using spatio-temporal correlations between turbines or sites.
6d40c57d25095ace2fd165056f5e3578122ddecd.architecture: Transformer neural network exploiting spatio-temporal correlations.
6d40c57d25095ace2fd165056f5e3578122ddecd.data: Not reported in the available metadata. Wind power data from wind farms are implied.
6d40c57d25095ace2fd165056f5e3578122ddecd.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
6d40c57d25095ace2fd165056f5e3578122ddecd.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified.

aea27b1f4190d6d5c540f2ced6a63436e29bd6f6.goal: Very short-term solar PV power forecasting comparing univariate and multivariate inputs.
aea27b1f4190d6d5c540f2ced6a63436e29bd6f6.architecture: Univariate and multivariate forecasting methods are compared; the specific model families are not specified in the available metadata.
aea27b1f4190d6d5c540f2ced6a63436e29bd6f6.data: Not reported in the available metadata. PV power and weather series are implied.
aea27b1f4190d6d5c540f2ced6a63436e29bd6f6.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
aea27b1f4190d6d5c540f2ced6a63436e29bd6f6.open_work: Testing across seasons, sites and horizons.
aea27b1f4190d6d5c540f2ced6a63436e29bd6f6.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified.

d5b00761f4a81d8dc5a30643f0580955c61c6910.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting by combining preprocessing and multiple models.
d5b00761f4a81d8dc5a30643f0580955c61c6910.architecture: Combined model: CEEMDAN denoising, four neural network models and a linear model weighted by a multi-objective grasshopper optimization algorithm.
d5b00761f4a81d8dc5a30643f0580955c61c6910.data: Wind speed series from a wind farm in China.
d5b00761f4a81d8dc5a30643f0580955c61c6910.result: The combined model gives more accurate and stable forecasts than traditional single models.
d5b00761f4a81d8dc5a30643f0580955c61c6910.open_work: Testing at more sites and adding probabilistic forecasting.
d5b00761f4a81d8dc5a30643f0580955c61c6910.issues: Single wind farm; complex pipeline; quantitative gains not stated in the abstract.

4d4079f9d5236e58d2151a85b35ff043315b0205.goal: Tests how Amazon rainforest photosynthesis responds to atmospheric dryness, which Earth system models predict to reduce it.
4d4079f9d5236e58d2151a85b35ff043315b0205.architecture: Nonlinear machine learning analysis of observations; the specific model type is not specified in the abstract.
4d4079f9d5236e58d2151a85b35ff043315b0205.data: In situ flux observations and satellite solar-induced fluorescence over the Amazon.
4d4079f9d5236e58d2151a85b35ff043315b0205.result: In the wettest regions photosynthesis and biomass increase with atmospheric dryness, explained by dry-season leaf flushing with higher photosynthetic capacity.
4d4079f9d5236e58d2151a85b35ff043315b0205.open_work: Revising Earth system model representation of photosynthesis response to dryness in wet regions.
4d4079f9d5236e58d2151a85b35ff043315b0205.issues: Observational, correlative inference; SIF is a proxy for photosynthesis; limited flux tower coverage.

3baa3f858e53d2f4fb27359e4611cadca790eb31.goal: Forecasts AC power output of PV plants with confidence intervals for owners and system operators.
3baa3f858e53d2f4fb27359e4611cadca790eb31.architecture: Nonparametric PV model using quantile regression forests (random forest family) in R.
3baa3f858e53d2f4fb27359e4611cadca790eb31.data: NWP forecasts of meteorological variables and measured AC power from five PV plants.
3baa3f858e53d2f4fb27359e4611cadca790eb31.result: Daily production is predicted with absolute cvMBE below 1.3%, with confidence intervals.
3baa3f858e53d2f4fb27359e4611cadca790eb31.open_work: Improving intraday skill and testing with other NWP models.
3baa3f858e53d2f4fb27359e4611cadca790eb31.issues: Five plants only; skill depends on NWP quality; intra-day metrics not given in the abstract.

8af0c836a992d6eec86d8fafa9b4d67d586a03ef.goal: Compares physical and hybrid methods for day-ahead PV output power forecasting.
8af0c836a992d6eec86d8fafa9b4d67d586a03ef.architecture: Physical PV models compared with hybrid methods; the hybrid model type is not specified in the available metadata.
8af0c836a992d6eec86d8fafa9b4d67d586a03ef.data: Not reported in the available metadata. PV plant output and weather forecasts are implied.
8af0c836a992d6eec86d8fafa9b4d67d586a03ef.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
8af0c836a992d6eec86d8fafa9b4d67d586a03ef.open_work: Testing on more plants and climates.
8af0c836a992d6eec86d8fafa9b4d67d586a03ef.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified.

57efb2edf9b536078303520a120998880629d70e.goal: Forecasts and explains daily PM2.5 concentrations in Beijing.
57efb2edf9b536078303520a120998880629d70e.architecture: Stacked ensemble: LASSO, AdaBoost, XGBoost and GA-optimized MLP at level 0, combined by support vector regression at level 1.
57efb2edf9b536078303520a120998880629d70e.data: Daily air pollutant and meteorological data for Beijing and surrounding cities (e.g. Zhangjiakou, Chengde).
57efb2edf9b536078303520a120998880629d70e.result: R2 0.90 and RMSE 23.69 μg/m3; NO2 and CO in Zhangjiakou are the most important features; grade classification accuracy 73.93%.
57efb2edf9b536078303520a120998880629d70e.issues: Weaker on heavily polluted days; single city target; feature engineering is case-specific.

a22e01bcce0eb6d1ad8340fffd5fdba2a86e349e.goal: Predicts dominant wind speed and direction from temporal wind data, e.g. for turbine siting.
a22e01bcce0eb6d1ad8340fffd5fdba2a86e349e.architecture: One-dimensional convolutional neural networks (1D CNN): single (1DS) and multiple-view (1DM) architectures used as classifiers.
a22e01bcce0eb6d1ad8340fffd5fdba2a86e349e.data: Historical wind datasets from Stuttgart (Germany) and the Netherlands for different months.
a22e01bcce0eb6d1ad8340fffd5fdba2a86e349e.result: 1DM reaches up to 98.8% and 99.7% accuracy for dominant speed and direction, versus 95.2% and 95.1% for 1DS.
a22e01bcce0eb6d1ad8340fffd5fdba2a86e349e.open_work: Extending to regression of continuous values and longer horizons.
a22e01bcce0eb6d1ad8340fffd5fdba2a86e349e.issues: Classification of dominant classes is coarse; class definitions and baselines limit comparability.

81be97b8359a14c148fa645c9ec7f0b208dc6dd9.goal: Improves multi-step wind speed forecasting, which is hampered by intermittent, noisy wind signals, by adding a multi-stage decomposition preprocessing step.
81be97b8359a14c148fa645c9ec7f0b208dc6dd9.architecture: Hybrid decomposition of variational mode decomposition and singular spectrum analysis with modulation signal theory, feeding LSTM, ANFIS, echo state network, support vector regression and Gaussian process regression models in ensemble learning frameworks.
81be97b8359a14c148fa645c9ec7f0b208dc6dd9.data: Wind speed time series from measurement sites; the specific sites, sampling interval and record length are not reported in the abstract.
81be97b8359a14c148fa645c9ec7f0b208dc6dd9.result: The decomposition-based ensembles stabilize errors, separate wind speed into uncorrelated components and reduce errors from one up to twelve steps ahead; ensemble frameworks are judged robust and reliable.
81be97b8359a14c148fa645c9ec7f0b208dc6dd9.open_work: Testing on more sites and longer horizons, and adding probabilistic outputs, would follow naturally.
81be97b8359a14c148fa645c9ec7f0b208dc6dd9.issues: Decomposition applied over full series can leak future information if not done in a strictly causal way; point forecasts only; site-specific evaluation.

2572d2376399de283bb3e6a43837098f7fa74532.goal: Predicts fine particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10) concentrations in Seoul to provide fine dust forecasts relevant to urban health.
2572d2376399de283bb3e6a43837098f7fa74532.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network and deep autoencoder (DAE) models, compared via RMSE with tuned learning rate, epochs and batch sizes.
2572d2376399de283bb3e6a43837098f7fa74532.data: Hourly air quality data from 25 monitoring stations in Seoul, South Korea, 1 January 2015 to 31 December 2018; prediction of the following 10 days.
2572d2376399de283bb3e6a43837098f7fa74532.result: Both models predict fine PM concentrations effectively, with the LSTM slightly outperforming the deep autoencoder in RMSE.
2572d2376399de283bb3e6a43837098f7fa74532.open_work: Adding meteorological and emission predictors and extending evaluation to longer test periods and other cities.
2572d2376399de283bb3e6a43837098f7fa74532.issues: Very short 10-day test window; comparison limited to two deep models without strong statistical or chemical-transport baselines; meteorological inputs not described in the abstract.

b69527d8135c2c6689a2ade06819befe45331b39.goal: Tests whether GRACE satellite gravimetry can be used to predict groundwater level changes at individual wells, where in-situ monitoring is sparse.
b69527d8135c2c6689a2ade06819befe45331b39.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward) models driven by GRACE-derived water storage anomalies and hydrometeorological inputs.
b69527d8135c2c6689a2ade06819befe45331b39.data: GRACE terrestrial water storage anomalies with meteorological forcing, and groundwater level records from monitoring wells in the United States.
b69527d8135c2c6689a2ade06819befe45331b39.result: The neural network models reproduce well-level changes with reasonable skill at many wells, showing GRACE data carry useful information for local groundwater prediction; detailed scores not reproduced here.
b69527d8135c2c6689a2ade06819befe45331b39.open_work: Downscaling GRACE signals more rigorously and extending to more aquifers and to GRACE Follow-On data.
b69527d8135c2c6689a2ade06819befe45331b39.issues: GRACE has coarse spatial resolution (hundreds of km) relative to single wells; short GRACE record; performance varies by well. Abstract not available, so details are from memory.

4c8292fdd045d1e8aaf6a668ac5340b58e8e77a1.goal: Addresses costly and unreliable hyperparameter tuning of deep learning wind power forecasting models by comparing automatic optimization frameworks.
4c8292fdd045d1e8aaf6a668ac5340b58e8e77a1.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) and LSTM forecasting models tuned with Scikit-opt, Optuna (Tree-structured Parzen Estimator) and Hyperopt (annealing search); also studies sensitivity to random weight initialization.
4c8292fdd045d1e8aaf6a668ac5340b58e8e77a1.data: Wind power time series; the specific wind farm and period are not reported in the abstract.
4c8292fdd045d1e8aaf6a668ac5340b58e8e77a1.result: Optuna with TPE and expected improvement is most efficient for both models; all optimizers give similar CNN accuracy, while Hyperopt-tuned LSTM gives the highest accuracy.
4c8292fdd045d1e8aaf6a668ac5340b58e8e77a1.open_work: Extending the comparison to other architectures, horizons and wind farms, and to multi-objective tuning of accuracy and cost.
4c8292fdd045d1e8aaf6a668ac5340b58e8e77a1.issues: Results may be dataset-specific; abstract gives no quantitative error values or details of the single data source.

fed2fb89f8c650611cc0a7bef14283c374ec0a07.goal: Improves the accuracy of hourly-averaged day-ahead photovoltaic power forecasts to support grid integration in areas with high PV shares.
fed2fb89f8c650611cc0a7bef14283c374ec0a07.architecture: Framework with data quality control, artificial neural network (MLP-type) power model, K-means weather clustering and linear regression post-processing correction of forecasts.
fed2fb89f8c650611cc0a7bef14283c374ec0a07.data: Historical PV system datasets with irradiance forecasts, validated at a hot and a cold semi-arid climate location.
fed2fb89f8c650611cc0a7bef14283c374ec0a07.result: Linear regression post-processing corrects irradiance forecast biases, giving MAPE of 4.7% on historical data and 4.7% and 6.3% at the two validation locations.
