fed2fb89f8c650611cc0a7bef14283c374ec0a07.open_work: Testing at more climates and system types, and providing probabilistic forecasts.
fed2fb89f8c650611cc0a7bef14283c374ec0a07.issues: Evaluated at few sites; MAPE can be flattering when low-production hours are excluded; deterministic only.

9a69aad72a69bbbf36190e53cbd8bd7698b50fd1.goal: Explores deep learning techniques for weather forecasting, focusing on rainfall prediction in Indonesia.
9a69aad72a69bbbf36190e53cbd8bd7698b50fd1.architecture: Comparison of deep learning models including a recurrent neural network, a conditional restricted Boltzmann machine and a convolutional network.
9a69aad72a69bbbf36190e53cbd8bd7698b50fd1.data: Weather station observations from the Jakarta (Indonesia) area; exact variables and period not reproduced here.
9a69aad72a69bbbf36190e53cbd8bd7698b50fd1.result: Deep learning models give reasonable rainfall prediction accuracy, with the recurrent network performing comparatively well; detailed scores not reproduced here.
9a69aad72a69bbbf36190e53cbd8bd7698b50fd1.open_work: Larger datasets, more predictors and comparison against numerical weather prediction would follow naturally.
9a69aad72a69bbbf36190e53cbd8bd7698b50fd1.issues: Early conference study with small single-region data and limited baselines; abstract not available, so details are from memory and should be checked.

4c786c3536bc09eb9d3bc3a9f7aa6ca481d2277b.goal: Evaluates whether random forest can serve as a low-cost alternative to conceptual hydrological models for large-scale daily flood discharge simulation across heterogeneous catchments.
4c786c3536bc09eb9d3bc3a9f7aa6ca481d2277b.architecture: Random forest regression compared with the conceptual rainfall-runoff modelling package hydromad, with analysis of catchment characteristics versus skill.
4c786c3536bc09eb9d3bc3a9f7aa6ca481d2277b.data: Daily discharge and forcing data for 95 study basins in Canada and the USA.
4c786c3536bc09eb9d3bc3a9f7aa6ca481d2277b.result: Random forest is competitive with hydromad for low and medium floods, but both models are inaccurate for high floods; climate and elevation mainly control simulation skill.
4c786c3536bc09eb9d3bc3a9f7aa6ca481d2277b.open_work: Model advancements are needed to simulate large floods and catchments at high altitude or outside warm temperate climates.
4c786c3536bc09eb9d3bc3a9f7aa6ca481d2277b.issues: Robust only for small and medium floods in low-altitude warm temperate catchments; random forest cannot extrapolate beyond training range.

7c4f23f07cca85eb007f39b4b8e07e075d5ad91b.goal: Studies regression tree ensembles for wind energy prediction at farm and national scales and for solar radiation prediction.
7c4f23f07cca85eb007f39b4b8e07e075d5ad91b.architecture: Random forest regression, gradient boosted regression and XGBoost (tree ensembles), compared with support vector regression.
7c4f23f07cca85eb007f39b4b8e07e075d5ad91b.data: Wind energy production for an individual wind farm and over a large geographic region, plus a solar radiation dataset, with numerical weather prediction features; specific products not reported in the abstract.
7c4f23f07cca85eb007f39b4b8e07e075d5ad91b.result: Ensembles improve on SVR for single wind farm prediction, GBR and XGBoost are competitive for large-scale wind energy, and gradient ensembles beat SVR for solar radiation.
7c4f23f07cca85eb007f39b4b8e07e075d5ad91b.open_work: Combining ensembles with probabilistic outputs and testing on further renewable datasets.
7c4f23f07cca85eb007f39b4b8e07e075d5ad91b.issues: No quantitative scores in the abstract; deterministic predictions only.

dfb4cff4868fa407d1cd379fc19f456bd7074794.goal: Reviews weather forecasting for renewable energy systems, particularly solar radiation and wind speed prediction needed for grid integration.
dfb4cff4868fa407d1cd379fc19f456bd7074794.architecture: Review of forecasting methods for renewable energy, covering empirical, statistical, machine learning and deep learning models.
dfb4cff4868fa407d1cd379fc19f456bd7074794.data: Literature survey; no new data. Covers studies using ground station and model-based meteorological data.
dfb4cff4868fa407d1cd379fc19f456bd7074794.result: Summarizes the relative performance of forecasting approaches reported in the literature; specific conclusions not available without the abstract.
dfb4cff4868fa407d1cd379fc19f456bd7074794.open_work: Not reported; hybrid and deep learning models and standardized evaluation are common next steps in this area.
dfb4cff4868fa407d1cd379fc19f456bd7074794.issues: Abstract not available, so the scope is inferred from the title; card is general.

6e4b79cc17365de554a5fdd94b1ce4215409068f.goal: Forecasts rainfall at Tasik Kenyir, Terengganu, Malaysia, to support reservoir water level management under variable rainfall.
6e4b79cc17365de554a5fdd94b1ce4215409068f.architecture: Comparison of Bayesian linear regression, boosted decision tree regression, decision forest regression and neural network regression, using autocorrelation-based and projected-error forecasting methods.
6e4b79cc17365de554a5fdd94b1ce4215409068f.data: Average rainfall from 10 stations around the study area weighted by Thiessen polygons, at daily, weekly, 10-day and monthly horizons.
6e4b79cc17365de554a5fdd94b1ce4215409068f.result: Boosted decision tree regression with the autocorrelation method performs best, with R2 of about 0.97 daily, 0.99 weekly and 10-day, and 0.9998 monthly.
6e4b79cc17365de554a5fdd94b1ce4215409068f.open_work: Testing on independent periods and other catchments, and including climate drivers as predictors.
6e4b79cc17365de554a5fdd94b1ce4215409068f.issues: Extremely high R2 values suggest possible overfitting or leakage; single study area; limited description of validation.

b3ddb71451abd3685d7aea8e5daf728b91a999cc.goal: Develops a neural network system for short-term weather forecasting, focused on temperature prediction.
b3ddb71451abd3685d7aea8e5daf728b91a999cc.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) trained with back-propagation.
b3ddb71451abd3685d7aea8e5daf728b91a999cc.data: Real-time meteorological station observations; exact location and period not reproduced here.
b3ddb71451abd3685d7aea8e5daf728b91a999cc.result: The back-propagation network gives acceptable temperature forecast accuracy compared with simple baselines; detailed scores not available.
b3ddb71451abd3685d7aea8e5daf728b91a999cc.open_work: Extending to more variables and longer horizons.
b3ddb71451abd3685d7aea8e5daf728b91a999cc.issues: Early small-scale study with limited data and baselines; abstract not available, so details are from memory.

a20d67cb552c1cdea4261c807873ff55e4f72b52.goal: Predicts daily global solar radiation on a horizontal surface, needed for solar energy design where measurements are scarce.
a20d67cb552c1cdea4261c807873ff55e4f72b52.architecture: Support vector regression with different kernel functions and input combinations of meteorological variables.
a20d67cb552c1cdea4261c807873ff55e4f72b52.data: Meteorological station data (e.g. sunshine duration and temperature); the station and period are not specified here.
a20d67cb552c1cdea4261c807873ff55e4f72b52.result: Support vector regression gives more accurate estimates than the compared empirical or other models; specific error values not available.
a20d67cb552c1cdea4261c807873ff55e4f72b52.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates.
a20d67cb552c1cdea4261c807873ff55e4f72b52.issues: Abstract not available; location and inputs are not confirmed, so the card is general.

fb8fe98ba4e871d18052e031c1dadb778dffadab.goal: Models soil moisture dynamics to enable predictive, closed-loop irrigation scheduling that saves water.
fb8fe98ba4e871d18052e031c1dadb778dffadab.architecture: Dynamic neural network (recurrent, NARX-type) predicting one-day-ahead volumetric soil moisture from past soil moisture, precipitation and climate measurements.
fb8fe98ba4e871d18052e031c1dadb778dffadab.data: Field soil moisture and climate measurements from three sites; AquaCrop simulations of a potato growing season for irrigation evaluation.
fb8fe98ba4e871d18052e031c1dadb778dffadab.result: R2 above 0.94 at all sites, with robust predictions at independent sites; predictive scheduling saves 20 to 46% water with similar yield and water use efficiency as rule-based irrigation.
fb8fe98ba4e871d18052e031c1dadb778dffadab.open_work: Field deployment of the closed-loop system and testing for other crops and soils.
fb8fe98ba4e871d18052e031c1dadb778dffadab.issues: Irrigation benefits are shown in AquaCrop simulations, not field trials; three sites only.

dae93a40a90abc8e1e2cff5d9570d86b5e441188.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed over a two-dimensional region rather than at a single site, exploiting spatial and temporal correlations.
dae93a40a90abc8e1e2cff5d9570d86b5e441188.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network and LSTM (CNN-LSTM) model, with the CNN extracting spatial features from gridded wind fields and the LSTM modelling temporal evolution.
dae93a40a90abc8e1e2cff5d9570d86b5e441188.data: Gridded regional wind speed data; the specific product, region and period are not reported here.
dae93a40a90abc8e1e2cff5d9570d86b5e441188.result: The CNN-LSTM is reported to outperform the compared single and conventional models in regional short-term wind speed forecasting; scores not available.
dae93a40a90abc8e1e2cff5d9570d86b5e441188.open_work: Longer lead times, probabilistic forecasts and integration with NWP inputs.
dae93a40a90abc8e1e2cff5d9570d86b5e441188.issues: Abstract not available, so details are inferred from the title; a gridded data source may inherit its own biases.

b814f8edf16dad56edeba2b1c734d00168e3d19b.goal: Forecasts short-term electrical load for the city of Burbank, especially during periods with large temperature variations when forecasts degrade.
b814f8edf16dad56edeba2b1c734d00168e3d19b.architecture: Support vector machine regression with hyperparameters optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO-SVM hybrid).
b814f8edf16dad56edeba2b1c734d00168e3d19b.data: Historical hourly load and temperature data for Burbank, California; exact period not reported here.
b814f8edf16dad56edeba2b1c734d00168e3d19b.result: The hybrid PSO-SVM improves load forecast accuracy during temperature swing periods relative to the compared methods; detailed scores not available.
b814f8edf16dad56edeba2b1c734d00168e3d19b.open_work: Testing in other utilities and adding weather forecast uncertainty.
b814f8edf16dad56edeba2b1c734d00168e3d19b.issues: Abstract not available; single-city case study.

fdabbb0386d1c574300c7e64f502e2385fa73151.goal: Quantifies how meteorology and emissions contributed to long-term PM2.5 trends over eastern China during 2000 to 2018, informing air quality management.
fdabbb0386d1c574300c7e64f502e2385fa73151.architecture: Two-stage machine learning PM2.5 model with synthetic minority oversampling for polluted days, plus a generalized additive model and the WRF/CMAQ chemical transport model for meteorological attribution.
fdabbb0386d1c574300c7e64f502e2385fa73151.data: Satellite-based full-coverage daily PM2.5 retrievals with ground measurements, meteorological fields and WRF/CMAQ simulations, 2000 to 2018, eastern China.
fdabbb0386d1c574300c7e64f502e2385fa73151.result: GAM and CMAQ meteorological contributions agree monthly (r 0.53 to 0.72); emissions dominate trends, while meteorology contributes -3.9% to 2.8% of annual mean PM2.5 in eastern China and up to -25.6% to 12.3% in the Pearl River Delta.
fdabbb0386d1c574300c7e64f502e2385fa73151.open_work: Stricter clean air actions are needed given worsening meteorology in northern China; future climate-driven changes merit study.
fdabbb0386d1c574300c7e64f502e2385fa73151.issues: Attribution depends on statistical and model assumptions; satellite-based PM2.5 uncertainty, especially early years and polluted days.

096b09c4506a652b49d28e0a42ef62410427a29d.goal: Builds a robust short-term wind power forecast that tolerates outliers and non-Gaussian errors which degrade MSE-trained models.
096b09c4506a652b49d28e0a42ef62410427a29d.architecture: LSTM neural network trained with a maximum correntropy criterion loss, combined with improved variational mode decomposition (K chosen by correntropy) and sample entropy reconstruction.
096b09c4506a652b49d28e0a42ef62410427a29d.data: Real wind power data from two wind farms in China at different sampling intervals.
096b09c4506a652b49d28e0a42ef62410427a29d.result: Across four experiments, the proposed hybrid outperforms traditional methods; quantitative gains not given in the abstract.
096b09c4506a652b49d28e0a42ef62410427a29d.open_work: Probabilistic extensions and testing on more farms and horizons.
096b09c4506a652b49d28e0a42ef62410427a29d.issues: Point forecasts only; limited to two farms; decomposition must be applied causally to avoid leakage.

48982f65e78bab7d91f1b26814e367a9661e14bb.goal: Reconstructs long-term nationwide surface ozone in China back to 2005, when in-situ measurements are scarce, to support health and trend studies.
48982f65e78bab7d91f1b26814e367a9661e14bb.architecture: XGBoost (gradient boosted trees) predicting daily maximum 8-hour average ozone.
48982f65e78bab7d91f1b26814e367a9661e14bb.data: MDA8 observations 2013 to 2017 with satellite ozone retrievals, aerosol reanalysis, meteorology and land use; external tests with 2005 to 2012 regional and 2018 national data; 0.1° output.
48982f65e78bab7d91f1b26814e367a9661e14bb.result: Daily cross-validation R2 of 0.61 to 0.78 and external monthly R2 of 0.60 to 0.87; BTH ozone rose 1.37 μg/m3/year in 2013 to 2017 and 26.24% of the population exceeded standards in 2017.
48982f65e78bab7d91f1b26814e367a9661e14bb.open_work: Applying the product to long-term health impact studies and pollution control policy.
48982f65e78bab7d91f1b26814e367a9661e14bb.issues: Hindcasts before 2013 rely on few validation sites; only monthly means before 2013; tree models do not extrapolate beyond training conditions.

590c5dab4f2b89b535e81168ea63703530565845.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power to mitigate uncertainty from PV generation in microgrid and smart grid energy management.
590c5dab4f2b89b535e81168ea63703530565845.architecture: Extreme learning machine (single-layer feed-forward network) with weights tuned by particle swarm optimization variants, compared with back-propagation neural network.
590c5dab4f2b89b535e81168ea63703530565845.data: Real-time PV system data from a site with irradiance and temperature, modelled with incremental conductance MPPT in MATLAB/Simulink.
590c5dab4f2b89b535e81168ea63703530565845.result: PSO-optimized ELM variants give improved forecasting compared with the back-propagation model; quantitative values not given in the abstract.
590c5dab4f2b89b535e81168ea63703530565845.open_work: Testing on longer records, multiple sites and multi-step horizons.
590c5dab4f2b89b535e81168ea63703530565845.issues: Partly simulation-based system; abstract lacks error metrics and data period.

928543969ae7d3dde66a004c920651fc47d93c3f.goal: Predicts wind signals (wind speed or power) with a hybrid forecast engine to support wind energy integration.
928543969ae7d3dde66a004c920651fc47d93c3f.architecture: Hybrid forecast engine combining feature selection with an intelligent optimization algorithm and neural network-based predictors; the specific network type is not specified here.
928543969ae7d3dde66a004c920651fc47d93c3f.result: The hybrid engine is reported to improve prediction accuracy over compared methods; scores not available.
928543969ae7d3dde66a004c920651fc47d93c3f.issues: Abstract not available and venue metadata appear unreliable; card is based on the title only.

48f60ebab4854711d37de74fe0211d03f1c128e7.goal: Estimates urban air pollutant concentrations at unmonitored locations to produce accurate pollution fields for health risk assessment.
48f60ebab4854711d37de74fe0211d03f1c128e7.architecture: Artificial neural networks (MLP) for spatial interpolation compared with multiple linear regression.
48f60ebab4854711d37de74fe0211d03f1c128e7.data: Urban air quality monitoring network of the greater Athens area, Greece, for NO2, NO, O3, CO and SO2.
48f60ebab4854711d37de74fe0211d03f1c128e7.result: Neural networks are significantly superior in most cases, especially where network density is limited and spatial correlation among sites is lower.
48f60ebab4854711d37de74fe0211d03f1c128e7.open_work: Adding meteorological and land use predictors and testing in other cities.
48f60ebab4854711d37de74fe0211d03f1c128e7.issues: Limited number of monitoring sites; no uncertainty estimates; no quantitative values in abstract.

9060b81a8068772e848c238270f44775a6c8c4b1.goal: Estimates monthly solar radiation from widely measured air temperatures where radiation measurements are lacking.
9060b81a8068772e848c238270f44775a6c8c4b1.architecture: Support vector machines (support vector regression) with temperature-based inputs, compared with empirical temperature-based radiation models.
9060b81a8068772e848c238270f44775a6c8c4b1.data: Measured temperature and solar radiation records from meteorological stations in China (Chongqing area); exact period not reproduced here.
9060b81a8068772e848c238270f44775a6c8c4b1.result: Support vector machine models outperform the empirical temperature-based models in estimating monthly solar radiation; specific scores not available.
9060b81a8068772e848c238270f44775a6c8c4b1.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates and adding other inputs.
9060b81a8068772e848c238270f44775a6c8c4b1.issues: Abstract not available; station details and scores from memory should be checked; few stations.

e63499bf3c9e59b74475678f5cedcebb46accca6.goal: Predicts short-term solar PV power generation to support balanced electricity grid operation under weather-dependent production.
e63499bf3c9e59b74475678f5cedcebb46accca6.architecture: LSTM recurrent neural network compared with a multilayer perceptron (MLP).
e63499bf3c9e59b74475678f5cedcebb46accca6.data: Solar PV power data from a PV plant, grouped by day category; specific site and period not reported in the abstract.
e63499bf3c9e59b74475678f5cedcebb46accca6.result: The LSTM gives the best MAE, MAPE, RMSE and R2 for each category of days compared with the MLP.
e63499bf3c9e59b74475678f5cedcebb46accca6.open_work: Adding weather forecast inputs and probabilistic predictions.
e63499bf3c9e59b74475678f5cedcebb46accca6.issues: Single comparison against MLP only; no numeric values in the abstract.

87d571d97f5c90b2621fcdc9aad2d40ac75e83cf.goal: Forecasts one-hour-ahead PV power output to reduce costs and difficulties of integrating variable solar generation into the grid.
87d571d97f5c90b2621fcdc9aad2d40ac75e83cf.architecture: Wavelet transform decomposition combined with artificial intelligence (neural network) techniques; the specific network type is not specified in the abstract.
87d571d97f5c90b2621fcdc9aad2d40ac75e83cf.data: PV power output with solar radiation and temperature data; site and period not reported in the abstract.
87d571d97f5c90b2621fcdc9aad2d40ac75e83cf.result: The wavelet-AI combination handles ill-behaved PV series and captures nonlinear fluctuations better; quantitative gains not given in the abstract.
87d571d97f5c90b2621fcdc9aad2d40ac75e83cf.issues: Abstract gives no error metrics; short one-hour horizon only.

dd4a98aaa028c0c1bc623fe77c9eefb4570974ed.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting by combining signal decomposition and nonlinear dynamics analysis with an improved neural network.
dd4a98aaa028c0c1bc623fe77c9eefb4570974ed.architecture: Fast ensemble empirical mode decomposition, phase space reconstruction and sample entropy feeding an improved back-propagation neural network (MLP).
dd4a98aaa028c0c1bc623fe77c9eefb4570974ed.data: Wind speed time series; specific sites and periods not reported here.
dd4a98aaa028c0c1bc623fe77c9eefb4570974ed.result: The hybrid is reported to outperform the compared single and hybrid models; scores not available.
dd4a98aaa028c0c1bc623fe77c9eefb4570974ed.issues: Abstract not available; card inferred from the title; decomposition-based hybrids risk leakage if not applied causally.

66025f88c72df133db9f0ab1b76f47326946a746.goal: Maps groundwater potential in the arid Shahroud plain, Iran, to support sustainable groundwater management.
66025f88c72df133db9f0ab1b76f47326946a746.architecture: Random forest compared with weight of evidence, binary logistic regression and TOPSIS multi-criteria decision making in a GIS.
66025f88c72df133db9f0ab1b76f47326946a746.data: 122 high-yield wells (70%/30% split) from the Iranian Department of Water Resources Management and field surveys; 15 conditioning factors including an ALOS 30 m DEM, land use and soil type.
66025f88c72df133db9f0ab1b76f47326946a746.result: Binary logistic regression is most accurate (prediction rate 0.905, success rate 0.918), ahead of weight of evidence (0.885), random forest (0.873) and TOPSIS (0.870).
66025f88c72df133db9f0ab1b76f47326946a746.open_work: Applying the methodology to other arid regions for decision-making.
66025f88c72df133db9f0ab1b76f47326946a746.issues: Small sample of wells; presence-only target; single study area.

7d20846ded023093398693fe7116f1c67df7fc19.goal: Forecasts meteorological drought in Malaysia's Langat River Basin to support drought risk management.
7d20846ded023093398693fe7116f1c67df7fc19.architecture: Hybrid of discrete wavelet transform, ARIMA for low-frequency components and artificial neural network for high-frequency components (W-2A).
7d20846ded023093398693fe7116f1c67df7fc19.data: 30 years (1986 to 2016) of rainfall for the Langat River Basin, converted to SPI and SIAP drought indices.
7d20846ded023093398693fe7116f1c67df7fc19.result: W-2A outperforms ANN and wavelet-ANN, with R of 0.914 (SPI) and 0.934 (SIAP) versus about 0.42 for ANN alone.
7d20846ded023093398693fe7116f1c67df7fc19.open_work: Testing at other basins and with other drought indices and lead times.
7d20846ded023093398693fe7116f1c67df7fc19.issues: Single basin; wavelet decomposition over full series may leak future information; lead time not detailed in abstract.

4c235b46e0423189a4808d670c45edb770dfe953.goal: Develops a wind speed forecasting system that achieves both accuracy and stability for power grid management.
4c235b46e0423189a4808d670c45edb770dfe953.architecture: Complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with an extreme learning machine optimized by multi-objective grey wolf optimization (CEEMD-MOGWO-ELM).
4c235b46e0423189a4808d670c45edb770dfe953.data: 10-minute wind speed data from Shandong Peninsula, China.
4c235b46e0423189a4808d670c45edb770dfe953.result: The hybrid system outperforms single and traditional models, achieving high accuracy and strong stability.
4c235b46e0423189a4808d670c45edb770dfe953.open_work: Extending to longer horizons and probabilistic forecasting.
4c235b46e0423189a4808d670c45edb770dfe953.issues: Single region; no numbers in the abstract; decomposition leakage risk.

7e68800878b2095009390ab9c406f6cf63891463.goal: Improves day-ahead forecasting of PV plant power output for renewable integration in smart grids.
7e68800878b2095009390ab9c406f6cf63891463.architecture: Physical Hybrid Artificial Neural Network (PHANN) combining an artificial neural network with PV plant clear sky curves, compared with a standard ANN.
7e68800878b2095009390ab9c406f6cf63891463.data: PV plant power output data with weather forecasts; specific site and period not reported in the abstract.
7e68800878b2095009390ab9c406f6cf63891463.result: The PHANN improves forecasts relative to the standard ANN; error analysis characterizes its intrinsic errors.
7e68800878b2095009390ab9c406f6cf63891463.open_work: Evaluating its potential for wider energy forecasting applications.
7e68800878b2095009390ab9c406f6cf63891463.issues: No quantitative results in the abstract; single plant evaluation.

a4b9f85c156d803d526b797ff7888f0a52704269.goal: Reviews deep learning methods for air quality forecasting.
a4b9f85c156d803d526b797ff7888f0a52704269.architecture: Review of deep learning approaches for air quality forecasts, such as recurrent, convolutional and hybrid networks.
a4b9f85c156d803d526b797ff7888f0a52704269.result: Summarizes progress of deep learning in air quality forecasting; specific conclusions not available without the abstract.
a4b9f85c156d803d526b797ff7888f0a52704269.open_work: Not reported; open problems in this area include interpretability, integration with chemical transport models and generalization.
a4b9f85c156d803d526b797ff7888f0a52704269.issues: Abstract not available, so the card is inferred from the title.

a8d80947732db6e4e313b13ddb611851829065f6.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels at wells using only easily available meteorological inputs.
a8d80947732db6e4e313b13ddb611851829065f6.architecture: Nonlinear autoregressive networks with exogenous inputs (NARX), a recurrent neural network type, with delays chosen via STL decomposition and correlation analysis.
a8d80947732db6e4e313b13ddb611851829065f6.data: Groundwater levels from wells in porous, fractured and karst aquifers in southwest Germany, with precipitation and temperature as predictors.
a8d80947732db6e4e313b13ddb611851829065f6.result: NARX shows outstanding suitability for groundwater level forecasts up to half a year ahead in all three aquifer types, for influenced and uninfluenced wells.
a8d80947732db6e4e313b13ddb611851829065f6.open_work: Extending to more wells and predictors such as pumping data.
a8d80947732db6e4e313b13ddb611851829065f6.issues: Limited inputs cannot represent human influences explicitly; no quantitative scores in the abstract.

eb870abb8e86ed34627162bf7ab28edd9a049e6c.goal: Predicts short-term wind power intelligently and robustly for wind energy integration.
eb870abb8e86ed34627162bf7ab28edd9a049e6c.architecture: Ensemble of artificial neural networks combined by genetic programming.
eb870abb8e86ed34627162bf7ab28edd9a049e6c.data: Wind power data from wind farms; specific sites and period not reported here.
eb870abb8e86ed34627162bf7ab28edd9a049e6c.result: The genetic programming ensemble is reported to outperform individual networks and compared methods; scores not available.
eb870abb8e86ed34627162bf7ab28edd9a049e6c.issues: Abstract not available; card inferred from the title.

481ee5872e19c91ac097b2921826bba793ac0c59.goal: Estimates spatially continuous ground-level PM2.5 across China by fusing station measurements and satellite observations, and assesses competing models.
481ee5872e19c91ac097b2921826bba793ac0c59.architecture: Generalized regression neural network (GRNN) compared with linear regression, multiple linear regression, semi-empirical model, geographically weighted regression and back-propagation neural network.
481ee5872e19c91ac097b2921826bba793ac0c59.data: National monitoring network PM2.5 measurements and 3 km MODIS aerosol optical depth over China.

481ee5872e19c91ac097b2921826bba793ac0c59.issues: MODIS AOD gaps limit coverage; only yearly and seasonal means mapped.

329937d62b79a649d20a33aec56ffb9d53b87f87.goal: Produces prediction intervals for streamflow discharge forecasts so that flood and water managers receive uncertainty bounds rather than point values.
329937d62b79a649d20a33aec56ffb9d53b87f87.architecture: Artificial neural network trained with the lower upper bound estimation (LUBE) method, optimized by MOFIPS, a multi-objective fully informed particle swarm algorithm.

e5e2c278ef34406716a4414bf82f27d452489dd7.goal: Forecasts urban water demand and quantifies forecast uncertainty to support utility operations and planning.
e5e2c278ef34406716a4414bf82f27d452489dd7.architecture: Hybrid wavelet-bootstrap-neural network ensemble: wavelet decomposition of demand series feeds artificial neural networks, with bootstrap resampling to form ensembles and confidence intervals.

da411d39fb65d6d4dab3d0138c022901b8c85517.goal: Develops a standard processing scheme to map topsoil moisture in arid farmland from UAV hyperspectral imagery for agricultural management.
da411d39fb65d6d4dab3d0138c022901b8c85517.architecture: Random forest and extreme learning machine regressions on optimal 2D spectral indices derived after six spectral pretreatments, compared with linear models.
da411d39fb65d6d4dab3d0138c022901b8c85517.data: UAV hyperspectral imagery and 70 topsoil (0–10 cm) samples from a 2.5 × 10^4 m2 farmland in Fukang, Xinjiang, China.
da411d39fb65d6d4dab3d0138c022901b8c85517.result: Random forest beats extreme learning machine; the best model (PIR pretreatment) reaches validation R2 0.907, RMSEP 1.477 and RPD 3.396, and the predicted map matches measurements well.

153cec77aec124a993bf5e0d3b23fca9c8af8304.architecture: Hybrid of ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) and adaptive wavelet neural networks, each decomposed component forecast separately and summed.
153cec77aec124a993bf5e0d3b23fca9c8af8304.data: Wind speed measurements from a wind farm in South India.
153cec77aec124a993bf5e0d3b23fca9c8af8304.result: The EEMD-adaptive wavelet neural network outperforms persistence, backpropagation, RBF, Elman, generalized regression and wavelet neural networks with lower uncertainty and computational cost.

5306cba62917815eb577d24069d2fc59a306cd0e.goal: Detects clouds and cloud shadows in Landsat imagery, a key preprocessing step for land surface remote sensing.

5306cba62917815eb577d24069d2fc59a306cd0e.data: 38 Landsat 7 and 32 Landsat 8 globally distributed scenes with USGS reference masks, split into 512 × 512 blocks (60% train, 10% validation, 30% test).
5306cba62917815eb577d24069d2fc59a306cd0e.result: Overall accuracy improves from 89.88% and 84.58% (CFMask) to 95.26% and 95.47% for Landsat 7 and 8, with over 40% gain in user's accuracy for Landsat 8 cloud shadows.
5306cba62917815eb577d24069d2fc59a306cd0e.open_work: Operational implementation issues such as processing whole scenes and generalization to other sensors are discussed.
5306cba62917815eb577d24069d2fc59a306cd0e.issues: Limited number of reference scenes; train and test blocks come from the same scenes, which may inflate accuracy.

47a68d299ec93e7a2cc85dfd7bc5ab06ae817c3c.goal: Predicts hourly solar irradiance for power system operation and analyzes its error characteristics.

47a68d299ec93e7a2cc85dfd7bc5ab06ae817c3c.data: Meteorological and irradiance data; details are not reported here.

a1a053773b706f9cd2eb33210950b5a93db6746e.goal: Forecasts daily urban air quality index to protect public health.
a1a053773b706f9cd2eb33210950b5a93db6746e.architecture: Hybrid of variational mode decomposition, sample entropy recombination of sub-series and LSTM neural network forecasting of each component.
a1a053773b706f9cd2eb33210950b5a93db6746e.data: Daily AQI series from Beijing and Baoding, China.
a1a053773b706f9cd2eb33210950b5a93db6746e.result: The VMD-SE-LSTM model outperforms single and other hybrid models and achieves a high rate of correct AQI class forecasts.
a1a053773b706f9cd2eb33210950b5a93db6746e.open_work: Inclusion of meteorological and emission predictors and multi-step forecasts.
a1a053773b706f9cd2eb33210950b5a93db6746e.issues: Univariate series; decomposition of full series can leak future information; quantitative metrics not given in the abstract.

5018c596a3f401efdee87f739085fe8123049981.goal: Models the air pollution index more efficiently than complex conventional calculation methods.
5018c596a3f401efdee87f739085fe8123049981.architecture: Support vector machine regression, comparing kernel functions including radial basis function.
5018c596a3f401efdee87f739085fe8123049981.data: Air pollution data; location and period are not reported in the abstract.
5018c596a3f401efdee87f739085fe8123049981.result: The RBF-kernel SVM gives R2 of 0.9843 for air pollution index modeling.
5018c596a3f401efdee87f739085fe8123049981.open_work: Tuning penalty and regularization parameters, which were not investigated.
5018c596a3f401efdee87f739085fe8123049981.issues: Only kernel type explored; dataset details and validation design not described.

ccc3dfeb611686dab8f15944576d1a087dc0c9ff.goal: Models wind turbine power curves accurately for performance monitoring and power prediction.
ccc3dfeb611686dab8f15944576d1a087dc0c9ff.architecture: Data partitioning of operating data followed by data mining models per segment; the specific algorithms are not specified here.
ccc3dfeb611686dab8f15944576d1a087dc0c9ff.data: Wind turbine operational (SCADA) data; details are not reported here.
ccc3dfeb611686dab8f15944576d1a087dc0c9ff.result: The title indicates a partitioning and data mining approach improves power curve modeling; quantitative results are not available here.
ccc3dfeb611686dab8f15944576d1a087dc0c9ff.open_work: Use for condition monitoring and other turbine types.
ccc3dfeb611686dab8f15944576d1a087dc0c9ff.issues: Abstract unavailable; segment boundaries and data cleaning affect results.

b7add8f1c1161d1500a027179608ef86b56d060c.goal: Simulates and supports real-time operation of multi-purpose reservoirs under normal and extreme flows.
b7add8f1c1161d1500a027179608ef86b56d060c.architecture: Recurrent neural networks: NARX, LSTM and genetic-algorithm-optimized NARX, coupled with inflow forecasts from a distributed hydrological model.
b7add8f1c1161d1500a027179608ef86b56d060c.data: Historical operation data of three reservoirs in the upper Chao Phraya River basin, Thailand, with distributed hydrological model inflow forecasts.
b7add8f1c1161d1500a027179608ef86b56d060c.result: GA-NARX is most accurate and more stable than NARX, works under extreme floods and droughts, and the real-time system has reasonable accuracy in wet and dry seasons.
b7add8f1c1161d1500a027179608ef86b56d060c.open_work: Practical deployment in water management and handling longer forecast horizons.
b7add8f1c1161d1500a027179608ef86b56d060c.issues: Learns historical operating rules, so it may not generalize to new policies; GA-NARX needs longer training.

a5c029dd5d4a11a948fb64e7293fa99a1bcb9446.goal: Monitors wind farm power curves with machine learning to detect underperformance and anomalies.
a5c029dd5d4a11a948fb64e7293fa99a1bcb9446.architecture: Machine learning models of the farm power curve; the specific methods are not specified here.
a5c029dd5d4a11a948fb64e7293fa99a1bcb9446.data: Wind farm operational data; details are not reported here.
a5c029dd5d4a11a948fb64e7293fa99a1bcb9446.result: The title indicates ML-based power curve monitoring; quantitative results are not available here.
a5c029dd5d4a11a948fb64e7293fa99a1bcb9446.open_work: Use for fault detection and extension to other farms.

f794cb1512d3fb557bda7de51bbe6e657c0a103c.goal: Provides probabilistic spatiotemporal wind speed forecasts for wind energy utilization and power system operation.
f794cb1512d3fb557bda7de51bbe6e657c0a103c.architecture: Spatial-temporal neural network combining convolutional GRU and 3D convolutional neural network in an encoder-forecaster, with variational Bayesian inference for uncertainty.
f794cb1512d3fb557bda7de51bbe6e657c0a103c.data: Wind turbine wind speeds embedded on a grid from two real-world case studies in the United States.
f794cb1512d3fb557bda7de51bbe6e657c0a103c.result: The model significantly outperforms other models in forecast skill and reliability and provides effective uncertainty estimates in time and space.
f794cb1512d3fb557bda7de51bbe6e657c0a103c.open_work: Longer horizons and inclusion of NWP inputs.
f794cb1512d3fb557bda7de51bbe6e657c0a103c.issues: Two case studies only; variational approximations may underestimate uncertainty; numbers not given in the abstract.

dcc94d7757d183a0a7b8c8c770b9324626b83555.goal: Estimates evapotranspiration and water-use efficiency of terrestrial ecosystems across the conterminous United States.
dcc94d7757d183a0a7b8c8c770b9324626b83555.architecture: Data-driven upscaling of flux tower observations with remote sensing predictors, reported as a support vector machine regression approach.
dcc94d7757d183a0a7b8c8c770b9324626b83555.data: MODIS products and AmeriFlux eddy covariance observations over the conterminous United States in the 2000s.
dcc94d7757d183a0a7b8c8c770b9324626b83555.result: Produces spatially explicit ET and water-use efficiency estimates for US ecosystems; quantitative results are not available here.
dcc94d7757d183a0a7b8c8c770b9324626b83555.open_work: Extension to longer periods and evaluation against independent water balance estimates.
dcc94d7757d183a0a7b8c8c770b9324626b83555.issues: Abstract unavailable; upscaling inherits flux tower representativeness and energy-closure biases.

3dce3d4e21d8bc8124d605239c0352348417d5df.goal: Produces flood risk maps combining susceptibility and consequences to support disaster management in Quang Nam, Vietnam.
3dce3d4e21d8bc8124d605239c0352348417d5df.architecture: Hybrid ensembles AdaBoost-Decision Table and Bagging-Decision Table for susceptibility, combined with multi-criteria decision analysis for risk.
3dce3d4e21d8bc8124d605239c0352348417d5df.data: 847 flood locations from 2007, 2009 and 2013 events and 14 topographic, geological, hydrological and environmental factors.
3dce3d4e21d8bc8124d605239c0352348417d5df.result: Bagging-DT performs best (AUC 0.96) versus AdaBoost-DT (0.953) and single DT (0.929), and its map is combined with consequences into a risk map.
3dce3d4e21d8bc8124d605239c0352348417d5df.open_work: Application of the framework to other flood-prone areas.
3dce3d4e21d8bc8124d605239c0352348417d5df.issues: Susceptibility is static; consequence weights in MCDA are subjective; validation relies on AUC.

8203e570eb6889be03d53c85388b4397ea5973a8.goal: Predicts hourly solar radiation on Abu Musa Island, Iran, for solar energy assessment.
8203e570eb6889be03d53c85388b4397ea5973a8.architecture: Several machine learning algorithms are compared; the specific model types are not specified here.
8203e570eb6889be03d53c85388b4397ea5973a8.data: Hourly meteorological and solar radiation measurements at Abu Musa Island; details are not reported here.
8203e570eb6889be03d53c85388b4397ea5973a8.result: The title indicates hourly solar radiation prediction with ML; quantitative results are not available here.
8203e570eb6889be03d53c85388b4397ea5973a8.open_work: Testing at other sites and forecast horizons.

5a9b8626aa19a5ac9fc4bebe54aecaa1ca763f70.goal: Manages saltwater intrusion in coastal aquifers by optimizing pumping with computationally cheap surrogates of density-dependent flow models.
5a9b8626aa19a5ac9fc4bebe54aecaa1ca763f70.architecture: Genetic programming and modular neural network surrogate models of a numerical simulator, embedded in multi-objective optimization.
5a9b8626aa19a5ac9fc4bebe54aecaa1ca763f70.data: Training data generated from a density-dependent coupled flow and transport simulation of a coastal aquifer; details are not reported here.
5a9b8626aa19a5ac9fc4bebe54aecaa1ca763f70.result: The title indicates surrogates enable multi-objective management; genetic programming is reported to be competitive or superior to modular neural networks, but details are not available here.
5a9b8626aa19a5ac9fc4bebe54aecaa1ca763f70.open_work: Uncertainty in aquifer parameters and application to real field aquifers.
5a9b8626aa19a5ac9fc4bebe54aecaa1ca763f70.issues: Abstract unavailable; surrogate accuracy limited to the trained range; likely illustrative aquifer.

10fc8c60785aa0b1a354068b475962824831cf39.goal: Assesses flood risk and investigates its driving mechanisms with machine learning to support flood risk management.
10fc8c60785aa0b1a354068b475962824831cf39.architecture: Machine learning models for flood risk assessment with interpretation of factor contributions; model types are not specified here.
10fc8c60785aa0b1a354068b475962824831cf39.data: Flood records and hazard, exposure and vulnerability indicators; details are not reported here.
10fc8c60785aa0b1a354068b475962824831cf39.result: The title indicates ML-based flood risk assessment and mechanism analysis; quantitative results are not available here.
10fc8c60785aa0b1a354068b475962824831cf39.open_work: Application to other regions and dynamic risk under climate change.
10fc8c60785aa0b1a354068b475962824831cf39.issues: Abstract unavailable; mechanism inference from ML importance is correlational.

32614c0771fc61c7274d774b743ef7ff0d68e085.goal: Improves regional wheat yield estimation for food security by integrating remote sensing and meteorological data across growth stages.
32614c0771fc61c7274d774b743ef7ff0d68e085.architecture: LSTM neural network with different time steps, compared with backpropagation neural network and support vector machine.
32614c0771fc61c7274d774b743ef7ff0d68e085.data: Meteorological data plus remotely sensed VTCI and LAI at main growth stages for the Guanzhong Plain, China, with yields at irrigated and rain-fed sites 2008–2016.
32614c0771fc61c7274d774b743ef7ff0d68e085.result: Best LSTM (two time steps, all inputs) reaches RMSE 357.77 kg/ha and R2 0.83, far better than BPNN (R2 0.42) and SVM (R2 0.41).
32614c0771fc61c7274d774b743ef7ff0d68e085.open_work: Application to other crops and regions and in-season forecasting.
32614c0771fc61c7274d774b743ef7ff0d68e085.issues: Limited sample of sites and years; single region.

2a879d805a32b61876af21375c39d614e4895200.goal: Quantifies how anthropogenic warming has changed and will change the risk of extreme daily wildfire growth in California.
2a879d805a32b61876af21375c39d614e4895200.architecture: Machine learning model linking daily fire growth to climate, fuel and other predictors, applied to counterfactual and future climates; the model type is not specified here.
2a879d805a32b61876af21375c39d614e4895200.data: Satellite-observed daily fire growth in California for roughly 2003–2020 with meteorological predictors and CMIP6 climate model warming signals.
2a879d805a32b61876af21375c39d614e4895200.result: Warming is reported to have already increased the average frequency of extreme daily wildfire growth by about 25%, with further increases projected under high emissions.
2a879d805a32b61876af21375c39d614e4895200.open_work: Incorporating fuel management scenarios and extending to other regions.
2a879d805a32b61876af21375c39d614e4895200.issues: Attribution relies on the ML model extrapolating to warmer conditions and on modeled climate changes; human ignition and suppression are simplified.

d81323ed96f9cfd86469be14aa6edb4396aa7a3b.goal: Predicts daily rainfall amount in Bahir Dar, Ethiopia, to support agriculture and water management.
d81323ed96f9cfd86469be14aa6edb4396aa7a3b.architecture: Multivariate linear regression, random forest and extreme gradient boosting with Pearson correlation feature selection.
d81323ed96f9cfd86469be14aa6edb4396aa7a3b.data: Local meteorological office station data from Bahir Dar City, Ethiopia.
d81323ed96f9cfd86469be14aa6edb4396aa7a3b.result: Extreme gradient boosting performs better than random forest and linear regression by RMSE and MAE.
d81323ed96f9cfd86469be14aa6edb4396aa7a3b.open_work: Use of more stations and longer lead times.
d81323ed96f9cfd86469be14aa6edb4396aa7a3b.issues: Single station; numerical errors not reported in the abstract; daily rainfall extremes hard to capture.

021f472f7b5bf4cfbc41863f28c0e53af2300f63.goal: Disentangles climatic, human and vegetation controls on global forest fire trends and emissions.
021f472f7b5bf4cfbc41863f28c0e53af2300f63.architecture: Machine learning grouping of forest ecoregions into 12 pyromes with distinct sensitivities to climate, human and vegetation controls; the algorithm type is not specified in the abstract.
021f472f7b5bf4cfbc41863f28c0e53af2300f63.data: Global forest fire extent and carbon emissions with climate, human and vegetation drivers, 2001–2023.
021f472f7b5bf4cfbc41863f28c0e53af2300f63.result: Forest fire carbon emissions rose 60% globally; one extratropical boreal pyrome nearly tripled, driven by fire weather, while tropical pyromes declined.
021f472f7b5bf4cfbc41863f28c0e53af2300f63.open_work: Better reporting of forest fire emissions to the UN and accounting for fire risk in reforestation crediting.
021f472f7b5bf4cfbc41863f28c0e53af2300f63.issues: Attribution is observational and correlational; satellite fire products have detection limits for small and understory fires.

2a8ebeeb67b8b434bbd2d57e310bcdc0f46e05b7.goal: Improves real-time flood forecasting with a fuzzy inference approach.
2a8ebeeb67b8b434bbd2d57e310bcdc0f46e05b7.architecture: Fuzzy inference system for real-time flood forecasting; the specific fuzzy model and comparison baselines are not specified here.
2a8ebeeb67b8b434bbd2d57e310bcdc0f46e05b7.data: River stage or discharge records from a river basin; details are not reported here.
2a8ebeeb67b8b434bbd2d57e310bcdc0f46e05b7.result: The title indicates improved real-time flood forecasts with fuzzy inference; quantitative results are not available here.
2a8ebeeb67b8b434bbd2d57e310bcdc0f46e05b7.open_work: Longer lead times and other basins.
2a8ebeeb67b8b434bbd2d57e310bcdc0f46e05b7.issues: Abstract unavailable; data-driven forecasts limited by training range of floods.

4c3cfbc61f53cef31a5c964c7621d7b963f8295e.goal: Forecasts solar power production from time series to support renewable energy planning.
4c3cfbc61f53cef31a5c964c7621d7b963f8295e.architecture: Hybrid deep learning combinations of convolutional neural network, LSTM and transformer, compared with single models across optimizers.
4c3cfbc61f53cef31a5c964c7621d7b963f8295e.data: Solar power time series; source and period not reported in the abstract.
4c3cfbc61f53cef31a5c964c7621d7b963f8295e.result: CNN-LSTM-transformer hybrid performs best with MAE 0.551% using Nadam, while TF-LSTM performs poorly (MAE 16.17%).
4c3cfbc61f53cef31a5c964c7621d7b963f8295e.open_work: Testing on more sites and horizons and adding weather inputs.
4c3cfbc61f53cef31a5c964c7621d7b963f8295e.issues: Single dataset; large performance spread suggests sensitivity to configuration; no uncertainty.

76632ca86a9f2b4ebe20944d5d2bb9a5165ca887.goal: Estimates daily solar radiation from sunshine duration where radiation measurements are scarce.
76632ca86a9f2b4ebe20944d5d2bb9a5165ca887.architecture: Support vector machine regression with sunshine-duration-based inputs, compared with empirical models.
76632ca86a9f2b4ebe20944d5d2bb9a5165ca887.data: Daily sunshine duration and solar radiation station data; details are not reported here.
76632ca86a9f2b4ebe20944d5d2bb9a5165ca887.result: The title indicates SVM is assessed for daily solar radiation estimation; quantitative results are not available here.
76632ca86a9f2b4ebe20944d5d2bb9a5165ca887.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates.

7a9a78ef5e6280ef70e393d75bc6bf337aa429bf.goal: Short-term rainfall forecasting, needed for flood warning and urban water management, is addressed by comparing machine learning approaches.
7a9a78ef5e6280ef70e393d75bc6bf337aa429bf.architecture: Compares support vector regression tuned by particle swarm optimization (PSO-SVR) with long short-term memory (LSTM) and convolutional neural network (CNN) models.
7a9a78ef5e6280ef70e393d75bc6bf337aa429bf.data: Rainfall observations from the study area; the specific gauges, period and temporal resolution are not available here (abstract missing).
7a9a78ef5e6280ef70e393d75bc6bf337aa429bf.result: Relative skill of PSO-SVR, LSTM and CNN is compared; the specific scores are not available here.
7a9a78ef5e6280ef70e393d75bc6bf337aa429bf.open_work: Testing on more regions and rainfall regimes, longer lead times and probabilistic forecasts would follow naturally.
7a9a78ef5e6280ef70e393d75bc6bf337aa429bf.issues: Point-based data-driven forecasts without physical constraints; generalization beyond the study site and skill for extreme rainfall are uncertain.

6ae17b121453eb7f1d50e5835346b024fc72c5b7.goal: Predicts urban PM2.5 concentrations in Quito, Ecuador, from meteorological variables, as complex terrain and urban factors complicate physics-based air quality forecasting.
6ae17b121453eb7f1d50e5835346b024fc72c5b7.architecture: Machine learning classification and regression models using wind speed, wind direction and precipitation as predictors; the specific algorithm family is not specified in the abstract.
6ae17b121453eb7f1d50e5835346b024fc72c5b7.data: Six years of meteorological and PM2.5 monitoring data from Quito, Ecuador.
6ae17b121453eb7f1d50e5835346b024fc72c5b7.result: Classification of low versus moderate PM2.5 levels is highly reliable; regression predicts PM2.5 better under extreme conditions (strong winds, heavy precipitation), with high correlation in the wet season.
6ae17b121453eb7f1d50e5835346b024fc72c5b7.open_work: Adding further predictors such as emissions, boundary-layer height or traffic, and testing other cities, would follow naturally.
6ae17b121453eb7f1d50e5835346b024fc72c5b7.issues: Only three meteorological predictors; weaker skill under ordinary conditions; single-city study with limited details on model validation.

24d41ba31ef2eb5629d450a4c081e5c9853dc16e.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for wind power by combining signal decomposition with a regression learner.
24d41ba31ef2eb5629d450a4c081e5c9853dc16e.architecture: Hybrid of empirical mode decomposition (EMD family) with support vector regression (SVR), forecasting decomposed components of the wind speed series.
24d41ba31ef2eb5629d450a4c081e5c9853dc16e.data: Wind speed time series; the specific sites, periods and resolutions are not available here (abstract missing).
24d41ba31ef2eb5629d450a4c081e5c9853dc16e.result: The decomposition-based SVR is reported to improve forecast accuracy over non-decomposed baselines; specific scores are not available here.
24d41ba31ef2eb5629d450a4c081e5c9853dc16e.open_work: Extension to multi-step and probabilistic forecasts and to other decomposition variants would follow naturally.
24d41ba31ef2eb5629d450a4c081e5c9853dc16e.issues: Decomposition of the full series can leak future information if not applied causally; single-variable, site-specific forecasts.

ffa37c9b32808e3aa6aa3633c00c2c3554bb6b67.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting for wind energy dispatch by accounting for spatio-temporal correlations and the influence of multiple meteorological factors across sites.
ffa37c9b32808e3aa6aa3633c00c2c3554bb6b67.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) model: the CNN extracts spatial relations among meteorological factors at sites and the LSTM temporal dependencies, with a 3D matrix data reconstruction.
ffa37c9b32808e3aa6aa3633c00c2c3554bb6b67.data: Multi-site meteorological datasets from the National Wind Institute in Texas.
ffa37c9b32808e3aa6aa3633c00c2c3554bb6b67.result: Outperforms 14 baseline models across 8 evaluation metrics, with hypothesis tests confirming improved accuracy and generalization.
ffa37c9b32808e3aa6aa3633c00c2c3554bb6b67.open_work: Testing other regions, longer horizons and probabilistic outputs would follow naturally.
ffa37c9b32808e3aa6aa3633c00c2c3554bb6b67.issues: Single-region station data; point forecasts without uncertainty; specific lead times and error values are not reported in the abstract.

3d79403b5024834c6a81a87db8657d61c32e25df.goal: Derives Arctic-wide melt pond fraction on sea ice, which strongly reduces albedo and accelerates ice decay, from multispectral satellite data.
3d79403b5024834c6a81a87db8657d61c32e25df.architecture: Spectral unmixing of snow, ice and water fractions implemented with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network to reduce computational cost.
3d79403b5024834c6a81a87db8657d61c32e25df.data: MODIS level 3 surface reflectance; validation with MELTEX 2008 aerial photos (Beaufort Sea), NSIDC 2000–2001 data at four sites, and HOTRAX 2005 ship observations.
3d79403b5024834c6a81a87db8657d61c32e25df.result: RMSE ranges from 3.8% (HOTRAX) to about 11% (NSIDC, MELTEX) with R2 of 0.28–0.45; Arctic melt pond fraction peaks near 15% in late June, with latitude-dependent timing.
3d79403b5024834c6a81a87db8657d61c32e25df.open_work: Using the dataset to correct passive microwave sea ice concentration retrievals and to constrain sea ice albedo models.
3d79403b5024834c6a81a87db8657d61c32e25df.issues: Moderate R2 against validation data; relies on clear-sky MODIS observations and fixed spectral endmembers; sparse validation sites.

0cf93e3694615e616e398fee15022cf46c3428ee.goal: Maps urban flood hazard in Seoul, where hydraulic information and runoff time series are insufficient for physical modelling.
0cf93e3694615e616e398fee15022cf46c3428ee.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) and recurrent neural network (RNN) classifiers trained on flood-conditioning factors.
0cf93e3694615e616e398fee15022cf46c3428ee.data: Flood inventory of 295 flooded sites in Seoul and 10 flood-affecting factors (terrain, slope, elevation, etc.), split 70:30 spatially at random.
0cf93e3694615e616e398fee15022cf46c3428ee.result: The CNN (AUC 84%, RMSE 0.163) slightly outperforms the RNN (AUC 82%, RMSE 0.186); terrain ruggedness index is the most important predictor, followed by slope and elevation.
0cf93e3694615e616e398fee15022cf46c3428ee.open_work: Applying the approach to other cities and including rainfall scenarios or drainage data would follow naturally.
0cf93e3694615e616e398fee15022cf46c3428ee.issues: Static susceptibility mapping without rainfall dynamics; random spatial split may inflate skill through spatial autocorrelation; relative errors up to about 20%.

4b4281c208a16245de3dc7454ddad77e30e70c9d.goal: Forecasts hourly day-ahead solar irradiance for microgrids that lack historical irradiance records, using only widely available weather variables.
4b4281c208a16245de3dc7454ddad77e30e70c9d.architecture: Deep long short-term memory recurrent neural network (LSTM-RNN), compared with a feedforward neural network (MLP) and persistence.
4b4281c208a16245de3dc7454ddad77e30e70c9d.data: Weather station measurements (dry-bulb temperature, dew-point temperature, relative humidity) from Germany, the USA, Switzerland and South Korea in six experiments.
4b4281c208a16245de3dc7454ddad77e30e70c9d.result: The LSTM beats the feedforward network with RMSE down to 60.31 W/m2 and mean forecast skill of 50.9% (up to 68.9%) over persistence; microgrid simulation shows 2% more annual energy savings.
4b4281c208a16245de3dc7454ddad77e30e70c9d.open_work: Adding numerical weather prediction or cloud inputs and probabilistic forecasts would follow naturally.
4b4281c208a16245de3dc7454ddad77e30e70c9d.issues: No cloud or NWP inputs, so cloudy-day skill is limited; day-ahead inputs assume known or forecast weather variables.

e53a0a0a17ec07005bad42830849da4eaba77dd5.goal: Produces fast, accurate cloud and cloud shadow masks for multispectral imagery across sensors, needed for time-critical applications such as flood and damage mapping.
e53a0a0a17ec07005bad42830849da4eaba77dd5.architecture: Modified U-Net convolutional neural network for semantic segmentation into five classes (shadow, cloud, water, land, snow/ice), compared with Fmask and a random forest.
e53a0a0a17ec07005bad42830849da4eaba77dd5.data: Global Landsat OLI training database; multi-sensor test set covering Landsat TM, ETM+, OLI and Sentinel-2.
e53a0a0a17ec07005bad42830849da4eaba77dd5.result: Best U-Net reaches accuracy 0.89, Kappa 0.82 and Dice 0.85, beating random forest (0.79/0.65/0.74) and Fmask (0.75/0.60/0.72) and running far faster than Fmask; RGB+NIR already suffices.
e53a0a0a17ec07005bad42830849da4eaba77dd5.open_work: Extending to more sensors, thin cloud handling and temporal information would follow naturally.
e53a0a0a17ec07005bad42830849da4eaba77dd5.issues: Single-date imagery only; shadow and thin cloud remain harder; labels may contain errors that bound achievable accuracy.

8245cdc63768e48255862052afa419e83f374151.goal: Bridges the data gap between the GRACE and GRACE-FO missions in total water storage observations to preserve continuity for hydrologic studies.
8245cdc63768e48255862052afa419e83f374151.architecture: Compares a deep neural network (MLP-type DNN), multiple linear regression and SARIMAX models to reconstruct missing monthly total water storage anomalies at grid-cell scale.
8245cdc63768e48255862052afa419e83f374151.data: Six GRACE solutions (JPL, CSR, GFZ spherical harmonics; JPL, CSR, GSFC mascons) over global land and 60 basins.
8245cdc63768e48255862052afa419e83f374151.result: All three models are reliable in humid basins with little human intervention; the DNN slightly outperforms SARIMAX and clearly beats MLR in most basins; mascon solutions perform better than spherical harmonics.
8245cdc63768e48255862052afa419e83f374151.open_work: Improving reconstruction in arid and heavily managed basins and quantifying reconstruction uncertainty.
8245cdc63768e48255862052afa419e83f374151.issues: Performance degrades in arid regions and basins with strong human intervention; reconstruction relies on predictor relationships staying stable through the gap.

c2f6a865efe702c6b00cf4c1a6de8f0866d34621.goal: Reviews the state of ensemble flood forecasting to identify capabilities, knowledge gaps and future research directions.
c2f6a865efe702c6b00cf4c1a6de8f0866d34621.architecture: Review of 70 papers on ensemble flood forecasting worldwide; not a new ML method, though machine learning is discussed as an opportunity.
c2f6a865efe702c6b00cf4c1a6de8f0866d34621.data: Literature review; no new training data.
c2f6a865efe702c6b00cf4c1a6de8f0866d34621.result: Identifies progress driven by ensemble NWP, HPC and HEPEX, and gaps in data assimilation, uncertainty sources, additional variables such as inundation, and use in decision-making.
c2f6a865efe702c6b00cf4c1a6de8f0866d34621.open_work: Improve data assimilation and uncertainty treatment, forecast more variables (e.g., inundation) using machine learning, and improve communication of probabilistic forecasts to flood managers.
c2f6a865efe702c6b00cf4c1a6de8f0866d34621.issues: Review limited to 70 papers; machine learning is a minor theme rather than a central focus.

1e3fe19d4a957237e6b2a3d2362efd34bf9f60ac.goal: Models wind turbine power curves more accurately than wind-speed-only methods, important for performance monitoring and energy yield estimation.
1e3fe19d4a957237e6b2a3d2362efd34bf9f60ac.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) power curve model using multiple inputs beyond wind speed, such as air density, turbulence intensity and wind shear.
1e3fe19d4a957237e6b2a3d2362efd34bf9f60ac.data: Operational wind turbine measurement data from a wind farm; exact site and period are not available here (abstract missing).
1e3fe19d4a957237e6b2a3d2362efd34bf9f60ac.result: Multi-input neural network models reduce power prediction error compared with conventional wind-speed-only power curve approaches.
1e3fe19d4a957237e6b2a3d2362efd34bf9f60ac.open_work: Testing across more turbines and sites and using the model for condition monitoring would follow naturally.
1e3fe19d4a957237e6b2a3d2362efd34bf9f60ac.issues: Turbine-specific fitting; performance depends on availability of met-mast or SCADA variables; transferability not established.

78df1ef9a0b614a76417a0abd42775f046e7cfda.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction for wind energy by boosting neural network forecasters.
78df1ef9a0b614a76417a0abd42775f046e7cfda.architecture: Compares four artificial neural network models combined with the Adaboost ensemble algorithm; the specific network types are not available here (abstract missing).
78df1ef9a0b614a76417a0abd42775f046e7cfda.data: Wind speed time series; specific sites and periods are not available here.
78df1ef9a0b614a76417a0abd42775f046e7cfda.result: The Adaboost-based neural networks are compared against each other and single networks; specific scores are not available here.
78df1ef9a0b614a76417a0abd42775f046e7cfda.open_work: Extension to multi-step horizons, other sites and probabilistic forecasting would follow naturally.
78df1ef9a0b614a76417a0abd42775f046e7cfda.issues: Univariate site-specific forecasting; no uncertainty quantification; generalization unclear.

73f8b067c2a7ccd27e0ab103a696b34c5726bf8b.goal: Maps groundwater potential to support water resource planning using a hybrid machine learning approach.
73f8b067c2a7ccd27e0ab103a696b34c5726bf8b.architecture: Hybrid ensemble machine learning classifier combining a base learner with an ensemble or optimization technique; the specific method type is not specified here (abstract missing).
73f8b067c2a7ccd27e0ab103a696b34c5726bf8b.data: Spring or well locations as inventory and groundwater conditioning factors (topographic, hydrologic, geologic); specific study area and data are not available here.
73f8b067c2a7ccd27e0ab103a696b34c5726bf8b.result: The hybrid model is reported to outperform its standalone counterparts in AUC-type validation; specific values are not available here.
73f8b067c2a7ccd27e0ab103a696b34c5726bf8b.open_work: Testing the hybrid approach in other aquifers and with dynamic hydrologic predictors would follow naturally.
73f8b067c2a7ccd27e0ab103a696b34c5726bf8b.issues: Static susceptibility mapping depends on inventory quality; spatial autocorrelation in validation may inflate scores.

0f8d685f1fac7a79e5e7430d92fdadfd6d37da40.goal: Improves monthly river flow forecasting for water resources management by combining wavelet preprocessing with data-driven models.
0f8d685f1fac7a79e5e7430d92fdadfd6d37da40.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) and support vector regression (SVR) models, each coupled with discrete wavelet transform decomposition of the inputs.
0f8d685f1fac7a79e5e7430d92fdadfd6d37da40.data: Monthly river flow records from gauging stations in Iran; exact stations and period are not available here (abstract missing).
0f8d685f1fac7a79e5e7430d92fdadfd6d37da40.result: Wavelet-coupled models improve on standalone ANN and SVR models; specific scores are not available here.
0f8d685f1fac7a79e5e7430d92fdadfd6d37da40.open_work: Choice of wavelet and decomposition level, and longer lead times, remain to be explored.
0f8d685f1fac7a79e5e7430d92fdadfd6d37da40.issues: Wavelet decomposition applied to whole series can introduce look-ahead leakage; few stations; univariate inputs.

e5e1e2ca688f6c05680c7a7a648d117bd0adc634.goal: Estimates monthly mean reference evapotranspiration with data-driven models as an alternative to data-demanding FAO-56 Penman-Monteith calculations.
e5e1e2ca688f6c05680c7a7a648d117bd0adc634.architecture: Compares multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS), support vector machines (SVM) and gene expression programming (GEP) against empirical equations.
e5e1e2ca688f6c05680c7a7a648d117bd0adc634.data: Monthly meteorological data from synoptic stations across Iran; FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference values as target.
e5e1e2ca688f6c05680c7a7a648d117bd0adc634.result: The machine learning models, notably MARS and SVM, outperform the empirical equations; specific scores are not available here.
e5e1e2ca688f6c05680c7a7a648d117bd0adc634.open_work: Testing with reduced input sets and in other climates would follow naturally.
e5e1e2ca688f6c05680c7a7a648d117bd0adc634.issues: Targets are themselves computed from Penman-Monteith rather than lysimeter measurements; regional study.

c094476d49ba2b47de5abddba9d332d5756fe260.goal: Downscales coarse passive microwave soil moisture to finer resolution for hydrological and agricultural applications.
c094476d49ba2b47de5abddba9d332d5756fe260.architecture: Tree-based machine learning regressors (random forest, boosted regression trees, Cubist) relating coarse soil moisture to MODIS land surface products.
c094476d49ba2b47de5abddba9d332d5756fe260.data: AMSR-E soil moisture and MODIS products (e.g., land surface temperature, vegetation indices, albedo); study regions and validation sites not confirmed here (abstract missing).
c094476d49ba2b47de5abddba9d332d5756fe260.result: Machine learning downscaling yields finer-resolution soil moisture consistent with the original product; specific skill values are not available here.
c094476d49ba2b47de5abddba9d332d5756fe260.open_work: Applying the approach to newer sensors (SMAP, AMSR2) and validating with denser in situ networks.
c094476d49ba2b47de5abddba9d332d5756fe260.issues: Downscaled fields inherit AMSR-E errors; MODIS inputs are cloud-limited; validation against point measurements is limited.

4877d6beff23d5c478195461590ce74c219d7aeb.goal: Reviews artificial neural network applications for energy production and reliability prediction in solar PV, hydraulic and wind energy.
4877d6beff23d5c478195461590ce74c219d7aeb.architecture: Review of artificial neural network (ANN) studies for renewable energy production forecasting, asset reliability and maintenance.
4877d6beff23d5c478195461590ce74c219d7aeb.result: Summarizes case-study scopes, approaches and variables per energy source, highlighting ANN use for anticipating reliability problems and maintenance policies.
4877d6beff23d5c478195461590ce74c219d7aeb.open_work: Further use of ANNs for dependability analysis and predictive maintenance of renewable assets.
4877d6beff23d5c478195461590ce74c219d7aeb.issues: Narrative review restricted to ANNs; no quantitative comparison across studies.

025db699195b9c5223136650a07ae59385378a05.goal: Predicts soil moisture in the Beijing area for irrigation and drought management, where physical models are hard to build.
025db699195b9c5223136650a07ae59385378a05.architecture: Deep neural network regression model (DNNR, an MLP-type deep network) using selected meteorological features.
025db699195b9c5223136650a07ae59385378a05.data: Integrated soil moisture and meteorological dataset for the Beijing area; features selected with Taylor diagram analysis.
025db699195b9c5223136650a07ae59385378a05.result: The deep learning model predicts soil moisture trends and values with high accuracy and good generalization; specific scores are not reported in the abstract.
025db699195b9c5223136650a07ae59385378a05.open_work: Extending to other regions, soil depths and longer forecast horizons would follow naturally.
025db699195b9c5223136650a07ae59385378a05.issues: Single region; no quantitative scores or baseline comparisons reported in the abstract.

c1bfe0431434eba280d24dc1b97f8d930bbebcc1.goal: Maps flood inundation extent by combining SAR and multispectral imagery, overcoming cloud limits of optical data and speckle in SAR.
c1bfe0431434eba280d24dc1b97f8d930bbebcc1.architecture: U-Net convolutional neural network applied to combinations of Sentinel-1 SAR bands, Sentinel-2 water indices or HSV transforms, and a DEM.
c1bfe0431434eba280d24dc1b97f8d930bbebcc1.data: Sen1Floods11 dataset: 446 hand-labelled chips (313 train, 44 validation, 89 test) across 11 flood events.
c1bfe0431434eba280d24dc1b97f8d930bbebcc1.result: S1 plus DEM gives median F1 0.74 versus 0.63 for S1 alone; HSV-transformed Sentinel-2 reaches 0.94 and 0.95 when combined with S1, beating standard water indices.
c1bfe0431434eba280d24dc1b97f8d930bbebcc1.open_work: Testing on more flood events and operational near-real-time mapping would follow naturally.
c1bfe0431434eba280d24dc1b97f8d930bbebcc1.issues: Small labelled dataset of 11 events; optical bands unavailable under cloud during floods; conference abstract with limited detail.

a4ddbe43679fa2af2669059d64e0748efc23ee2e.goal: Improves runoff prediction from historical meteorological and runoff data with an adaptive ensemble of deep learning models.
a4ddbe43679fa2af2669059d64e0748efc23ee2e.architecture: Adaptive-weighted ensemble of a CNN-LSTM (convolutional neural network with long short-term memory) and a GRU, with weights or hyperparameters tuned by an improved sparrow search algorithm.
a4ddbe43679fa2af2669059d64e0748efc23ee2e.data: Historical meteorological and runoff records from the study basin; details are not available here (abstract missing).
a4ddbe43679fa2af2669059d64e0748efc23ee2e.result: The ensemble is reported to outperform its single component models; specific scores are not available here.
a4ddbe43679fa2af2669059d64e0748efc23ee2e.open_work: Testing across more basins and lead times would follow naturally.
a4ddbe43679fa2af2669059d64e0748efc23ee2e.issues: Complex hybrid with many tuned components risks overfitting; generalization and uncertainty not established.

0592c84230380b3f6aef9690f4bccd713692f4d3.goal: Forecasts crop yield from climatic parameters to support farmers' decisions in India.
0592c84230380b3f6aef9690f4bccd713692f4d3.architecture: Decision tree classifier (C4.5-type) relating climatic variables to yield classes, delivered as a decision-support tool.
0592c84230380b3f6aef9690f4bccd713692f4d3.data: Historical climate and crop yield records for districts of Madhya Pradesh, India; exact period not confirmed here (abstract missing).
0592c84230380b3f6aef9690f4bccd713692f4d3.result: The decision tree yields interpretable rules and reasonable accuracy in predicting yield categories; specific scores are not available here.
0592c84230380b3f6aef9690f4bccd713692f4d3.open_work: Adding soil and management inputs and more crops or regions would follow naturally.
0592c84230380b3f6aef9690f4bccd713692f4d3.issues: Coarse yield classes; small district-level dataset; climate-only predictors ignore management and soil.

31f5f9c637cedf094ceb17328a6fa4921d6c1e98.goal: Generates spatially complete, daily, 1 km surface soil moisture, as microwave products are too coarse (~40 km) for water management and drought monitoring.
31f5f9c637cedf094ceb17328a6fa4921d6c1e98.architecture: Random forest regression combined with data fusion that downscales CLDAS land surface temperature using clear-sky MODIS LST.
31f5f9c637cedf094ceb17328a6fa4921d6c1e98.data: North China Plain: CLDAS LST and soil moisture (0.0625°), MODIS LST, NDVI and albedo, precipitation, soil texture, ESA CCI soil moisture (0.25°) and in situ soil moisture.
31f5f9c637cedf094ceb17328a6fa4921d6c1e98.result: Downscaled soil moisture has bias of −0.001 cm3/cm3, RMSE 0.041 cm3/cm3 and correlation 0.72, improving on original CCI and CLDAS in accuracy and resolution.
31f5f9c637cedf094ceb17328a6fa4921d6c1e98.open_work: Applying the framework to other regions and using it for drought monitoring and irrigation scheduling.
31f5f9c637cedf094ceb17328a6fa4921d6c1e98.issues: Correlation of 0.72 leaves substantial unexplained variance; relies on in situ data for training; regional study.

0da886796a421fe3e04fec490abcd176d33b3062.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the monsoon-affected Ajoy River basin, eastern India, under climate and land use change threats.
0da886796a421fe3e04fec490abcd176d33b3062.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM), random forest (RF) and biogeography-based optimization (BBO) models in a GIS environment.
0da886796a421fe3e04fec490abcd176d33b3062.data: Flood inventory and topographic, hydrological, soil, environmental and geological conditioning factors for the Ajoy River basin.
0da886796a421fe3e04fec490abcd176d33b3062.result: BBO performs best (AUC 0.985), followed by RF (0.925) and SVM (0.896).
0da886796a421fe3e04fec490abcd176d33b3062.open_work: Linking susceptibility to projected climate and land use scenarios more quantitatively would follow naturally.
0da886796a421fe3e04fec490abcd176d33b3062.issues: Static susceptibility mapping; validation details and how future climate is represented are not clear in the abstract.

d2cd8f37c7837b32cd5a8ee96542afc0dbd7adfb.goal: Predicts ocean wave heights accurately and quickly for marine warning.
d2cd8f37c7837b32cd5a8ee96542afc0dbd7adfb.architecture: Back-propagation neural network (MLP) whose initial weights and thresholds are optimized by a Mind Evolutionary Algorithm (MEA-BP), compared with GA-BP and standard BP.
d2cd8f37c7837b32cd5a8ee96542afc0dbd7adfb.data: Observations from 12 points in the Bohai Sea and Yellow Sea, 1 January to 31 December 2016.
d2cd8f37c7837b32cd5a8ee96542afc0dbd7adfb.result: MEA-BP achieves higher accuracy and faster running time than GA-BP and the standard BP network.
d2cd8f37c7837b32cd5a8ee96542afc0dbd7adfb.open_work: Longer lead times and broader validation would follow naturally.
d2cd8f37c7837b32cd5a8ee96542afc0dbd7adfb.issues: One year of data; point predictions; lead times and error magnitudes not reported in the abstract.

96a40f6282c7f0e61b3b3b993488af9dc4576613.goal: Forecasts 24-hour-ahead photovoltaic power output without complex physical modelling for grid integration.
96a40f6282c7f0e61b3b3b993488af9dc4576613.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) trained with an improved back-propagation algorithm, combined with similar-day selection based on forecast-day weather.
96a40f6282c7f0e61b3b3b993488af9dc4576613.data: Measured output of a photovoltaic system; site and period are not reported in the abstract.
96a40f6282c7f0e61b3b3b993488af9dc4576613.result: The approach is reported to forecast PV output with good accuracy and efficiency across weather types; numbers are not reported in the abstract.
96a40f6282c7f0e61b3b3b993488af9dc4576613.open_work: Testing on more systems and including irradiance forecasts would follow naturally.
96a40f6282c7f0e61b3b3b993488af9dc4576613.issues: Single system, no quantitative metrics in the abstract, no baseline comparison described.

eb9edd1b98886c5e9213992c478b575c0c26b44a.goal: Improves multi-model ensemble (MME) projections of daily precipitation and temperature over a tropical Indian river basin using machine learning combination.
eb9edd1b98886c5e9213992c478b575c0c26b44a.architecture: Compares arithmetic mean, multiple linear regression, support vector machine, extra trees, random forest and long short-term memory (LSTM) for ensembling GCM outputs.
eb9edd1b98886c5e9213992c478b575c0c26b44a.data: 21 GCMs from NASA NEX-GDDP and 13 CMIP6 GCMs over a tropical river basin in India, with observed precipitation and temperature as targets.
eb9edd1b98886c5e9213992c478b575c0c26b44a.result: LSTM is best for precipitation (R2 about 0.9); for temperature RF and LSTM perform consistently well (R2 0.82–0.93); all ML methods beat the mean ensemble.
eb9edd1b98886c5e9213992c478b575c0c26b44a.open_work: Assessing how learned ensemble weights behave for future projections.
eb9edd1b98886c5e9213992c478b575c0c26b44a.issues: Weights trained on historical period may not hold under future climate; single basin; daily R2 of 0.9 for precipitation warrants scrutiny.

5c7efb061bd14cd8e41ed7314967b4e13347bbad.goal: Identifies the best data-driven approach for one-month-ahead monthly streamflow prediction.
5c7efb061bd14cd8e41ed7314967b4e13347bbad.architecture: Compares ARMA, k-nearest neighbors, artificial neural networks (MLP) and phase-space-reconstruction ANN, and proposes a moving-average ANN (MA-ANN).
5c7efb061bd14cd8e41ed7314967b4e13347bbad.data: Monthly streamflow from Xiangjiaba, Cuntan, Manwan and Danjiangkou, China.
5c7efb061bd14cd8e41ed7314967b4e13347bbad.result: KNN is best among the four baselines but only marginally better than ARMA; MA-ANN significantly improves accuracy, with optimal moving-average lengths of 3 and 6 months.
5c7efb061bd14cd8e41ed7314967b4e13347bbad.open_work: Explaining and generalizing the moving-average input benefit to other horizons and basins.
5c7efb061bd14cd8e41ed7314967b4e13347bbad.issues: Univariate inputs; moving-average preprocessing must be applied causally to avoid information leakage.

786ad84823cc71c5863f35db238b156856a1878d.goal: Detects clouds in Landsat 8 imagery, a key first step for remote sensing applications, especially with few spectral bands.
786ad84823cc71c5863f35db238b156856a1878d.architecture: Cloud-Net, an end-to-end fully convolutional network (FCN, U-Net-like encoder-decoder) trained on image patches.
786ad84823cc71c5863f35db238b156856a1878d.data: Landsat 8 image patches; evaluated on a cloud detection benchmark dataset (38-Cloud).
786ad84823cc71c5863f35db238b156856a1878d.result: Outperforms the state-of-the-art method on the benchmark by 8.7% in Jaccard index.
786ad84823cc71c5863f35db238b156856a1878d.open_work: Extending to cloud shadow detection and other sensors would follow naturally.
786ad84823cc71c5863f35db238b156856a1878d.issues: Uses only a few spectral bands; benchmark scenes are limited; no thin-cloud analysis reported.

1af1a8b45cfc3bd0a3b5b3a33365b5a251792c41.goal: Assesses artificial neural networks for monthly and seasonal rainfall forecasting in Queensland, Australia.
1af1a8b45cfc3bd0a3b5b3a33365b5a251792c41.architecture: Dynamic recurrent time-delay artificial neural network (recurrent neural network) using climate indices, historical rainfall and atmospheric temperatures.
1af1a8b45cfc3bd0a3b5b3a33365b5a251792c41.data: Monthly rainfall at 17 Queensland sites, forecasts for 1993–2009, compared with the POAMA-1.5 general circulation model.
1af1a8b45cfc3bd0a3b5b3a33365b5a251792c41.result: Forecasts three months ahead achieve lower RMSE than POAMA-1.5 at 16 of 17 sites.
1af1a8b45cfc3bd0a3b5b3a33365b5a251792c41.open_work: Include GCM output as inputs and experiment with other input attributes.
1af1a8b45cfc3bd0a3b5b3a33365b5a251792c41.issues: Prototype design; skill compared mainly by RMSE against an older GCM; risk of overfitting with limited samples.

6fc65342d41e224bfdfaaf2e3df1290a4392613d.goal: Predicts crop yield, which depends on many weather and soil factors, by evaluating hybrid deep learning models.
6fc65342d41e224bfdfaaf2e3df1290a4392613d.architecture: Compares XGBoost with hybrid CNN-DNN (convolutional neural network with MLP), CNN-XGBoost, CNN-RNN and CNN-LSTM models.
6fc65342d41e224bfdfaaf2e3df1290a4392613d.data: Public soybean dataset with 395 weather and soil features and 25,345 samples.
6fc65342d41e224bfdfaaf2e3df1290a4392613d.result: CNN-DNN is best (RMSE 0.266, MAE 0.199, R2 0.87); XGBoost is second and much faster.
6fc65342d41e224bfdfaaf2e3df1290a4392613d.open_work: Testing on other crops and regions would follow naturally.
6fc65342d41e224bfdfaaf2e3df1290a4392613d.issues: Single dataset; spatial and temporal split strategy not described in the abstract.

807114d860fbd1afdfd638c129e1396e5fa90c17.goal: Simulates evaporation and assesses which meteorological inputs drive it under different climatic regimes.
807114d860fbd1afdfd638c129e1396e5fa90c17.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward MLP) with sensitivity analysis of the network outputs to inputs.
807114d860fbd1afdfd638c129e1396e5fa90c17.data: Meteorological and pan evaporation data from stations in different climatic regimes (Iran); details are not available here (abstract missing).
807114d860fbd1afdfd638c129e1396e5fa90c17.result: The ANN simulates evaporation well and sensitivity analysis ranks the importance of inputs per regime; specific values are not available here.
807114d860fbd1afdfd638c129e1396e5fa90c17.open_work: Extending to more stations and using sensitivity results for input reduction.
807114d860fbd1afdfd638c129e1396e5fa90c17.issues: Few stations; pan evaporation targets; sensitivity analysis depends on the trained network.

0a22a990f0ba6f7f5b3e574c77433bc9f219e0fe.goal: Predicts the Air Quality Index and pollutant concentrations to support air pollution warnings.
0a22a990f0ba6f7f5b3e574c77433bc9f219e0fe.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) and random forest regression (RFR).
0a22a990f0ba6f7f5b3e574c77433bc9f219e0fe.data: Public datasets: Beijing AQI and NOx concentrations in an Italian city.
0a22a990f0ba6f7f5b3e574c77433bc9f219e0fe.result: SVR is best for Beijing AQI (RMSE 7.666, R2 0.978), RFR best for NOx (RMSE 83.67, R2 0.840).
0a22a990f0ba6f7f5b3e574c77433bc9f219e0fe.open_work: Testing additional algorithms, longer horizons and more cities would follow naturally.
0a22a990f0ba6f7f5b3e574c77433bc9f219e0fe.issues: Forecast horizon and lagged-input setup are unclear; only two datasets; no uncertainty.

f118621df076a2709d45e3b2528640c7be864917.goal: Compares machine learning and numerical models for simulating groundwater dynamics in the middle Heihe River Basin.
