f118621df076a2709d45e3b2528640c7be864917.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP), radial basis function network and support vector machine, compared with a physically based numerical groundwater model.
f118621df076a2709d45e3b2528640c7be864917.data: Historical groundwater levels and streamflow rates in the middle reaches of the Heihe River Basin, northwestern China.
f118621df076a2709d45e3b2528640c7be864917.result: Machine learning models are more accurate than the numerical model in training and verification; SVM and RBF perform best, but the numerical model generalizes better.
f118621df076a2709d45e3b2528640c7be864917.open_work: Combining physical mechanisms with ML to improve generalization.
f118621df076a2709d45e3b2528640c7be864917.issues: ML models lack physical mechanism and generalize worse beyond training conditions.

12545b1de233f0cc098279262f4220357d77e1b1.goal: Estimates surface soil moisture over irrigated grassland from X-band SAR combined with optical vegetation descriptors.
12545b1de233f0cc098279262f4220357d77e1b1.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks inverting the Water Cloud Model, trained on noisy synthetic data.
12545b1de233f0cc098279262f4220357d77e1b1.data: TerraSAR-X and COSMO-SkyMed SAR with SPOT 4/5 and Landsat 7/8 optical images over irrigated grassland in southeastern France.
12545b1de233f0cc098279262f4220357d77e1b1.result: HH polarization plus one vegetation descriptor gives best results: RMSE 3.6 vol.% for NDVI 0.45–0.75 and 6.1 vol.% for NDVI 0.75–0.90.
12545b1de233f0cc098279262f4220357d77e1b1.open_work: Testing other land covers and frequencies would follow naturally.
12545b1de233f0cc098279262f4220357d77e1b1.issues: Accuracy drops under dense vegetation; relies on Water Cloud Model assumptions; single region.

165d8186abb945394a89d417f8d4f24e2b9fb2c7.goal: Predicts wind speed at offshore wind farms during typhoons, when extreme and rapidly changing winds threaten operation.
165d8186abb945394a89d417f8d4f24e2b9fb2c7.architecture: Bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) network tuned by particle swarm optimization, with variational mode decomposition (VMD) of the wind series.
165d8186abb945394a89d417f8d4f24e2b9fb2c7.data: Wind speed records from offshore wind farms under typhoon conditions; details are not available here (abstract missing).
165d8186abb945394a89d417f8d4f24e2b9fb2c7.result: The VMD-PSO-Bi-LSTM model is reported to outperform comparison models; specific scores are not available here.
165d8186abb945394a89d417f8d4f24e2b9fb2c7.open_work: Testing on more typhoon events and longer horizons would follow naturally.
165d8186abb945394a89d417f8d4f24e2b9fb2c7.issues: Few typhoon events likely available; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage; point forecasts only.

b93c1e7bd00312195b1fb7b9caf4ac4b612be5f4.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the Haraz watershed, Iran, with hybrid neuro-fuzzy models.
b93c1e7bd00312195b1fb7b9caf4ac4b612be5f4.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) optimized by imperialist competitive algorithm (ANFIS-ICA) and firefly algorithm (ANFIS-FA).
b93c1e7bd00312195b1fb7b9caf4ac4b612be5f4.data: Flood inventory and ten conditioning factors (slope, elevation, SPI, TWI, lithology, rainfall, land use, etc.) in the Haraz watershed, Mazandaran, Iran.
b93c1e7bd00312195b1fb7b9caf4ac4b612be5f4.result: ANFIS-ICA achieves AUC 0.947, ahead of Bagging-LMT (0.940), BLR, LMT, ANFIS-FA (0.917), LR and RF (0.806).
b93c1e7bd00312195b1fb7b9caf4ac4b612be5f4.open_work: Applying the hybrids in other watersheds would follow naturally.
b93c1e7bd00312195b1fb7b9caf4ac4b612be5f4.issues: Static susceptibility mapping; single watershed; small differences in AUC among top models.

6b8de5bbb5ac646742ce0db5f8a6fa83ca23b6d2.goal: Improves wind power forecasting under high grid penetration, given the volatile nature of wind.
6b8de5bbb5ac646742ce0db5f8a6fa83ca23b6d2.architecture: Improved empirical mode decomposition (IEMD) feeding a bagging neural network (MLP ensemble) with K-means clustering, tuned by a new ChB-SSO optimizer.
6b8de5bbb5ac646742ce0db5f8a6fa83ca23b6d2.data: Real-world wind farm data from Alberta and Sotavento, in seasonal subsets and multiple horizons.
6b8de5bbb5ac646742ce0db5f8a6fa83ca23b6d2.result: The framework outperforms other well-known prediction strategies across all test cases and error criteria.
6b8de5bbb5ac646742ce0db5f8a6fa83ca23b6d2.open_work: Probabilistic extensions and other sites would follow naturally.
6b8de5bbb5ac646742ce0db5f8a6fa83ca23b6d2.issues: Complex hybrid pipeline; specific error values not reported in the abstract; decomposition may leak future information.

b32a49db954ec157b535154b58b419d862ab2478.goal: Predicts crop yields in West African countries to support food security planning.
b32a49db954ec157b535154b58b419d862ab2478.architecture: Machine learning regression models; the specific method type is not specified here (abstract missing).
b32a49db954ec157b535154b58b419d862ab2478.data: Country-level crop yield records with climatic and possibly agricultural inputs for West African countries; details are not available here.
b32a49db954ec157b535154b58b419d862ab2478.result: Relative model performance is compared; specific scores are not available here.
b32a49db954ec157b535154b58b419d862ab2478.open_work: Finer spatial resolution and inclusion of soil and management data would follow naturally.
b32a49db954ec157b535154b58b419d862ab2478.issues: Coarse aggregated data; limited sample size; generalization uncertain.

08cd8eebc87ff4b21671ad16bdcfd0f6ed910862.goal: Improves short-term drought prediction in China using the SPEI index.
08cd8eebc87ff4b21671ad16bdcfd0f6ed910862.architecture: Hybrid ARIMA and long short-term memory (LSTM) model, compared with ARIMA, SVR, LSTM, ARIMA-SVR and LS-SVR.
08cd8eebc87ff4b21671ad16bdcfd0f6ed910862.data: SPEI at multiple time scales (1–24 months) for China.
08cd8eebc87ff4b21671ad16bdcfd0f6ed910862.result: Hybrid models beat single ones; ARIMA-LSTM is best at 6, 12 and 24-month scales (NSE 0.93 for SPEI24) but weak for SPEI1 (NSE 0.368).
08cd8eebc87ff4b21671ad16bdcfd0f6ed910862.open_work: Improving short-time-scale drought prediction would follow naturally.
08cd8eebc87ff4b21671ad16bdcfd0f6ed910862.issues: Low skill at short SPEI scales; high skill at long scales partly reflects index autocorrelation.

133b59bf65451d916e2b83c6fdcf74c4dae958d0.goal: Forecasts lake water levels up to three months ahead for flood control and water resources management.
133b59bf65451d916e2b83c6fdcf74c4dae958d0.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network and long short-term memory (CNN-LSTM) coupled with boundary-corrected MODWT wavelet decomposition, compared with random forest and SVR.
133b59bf65451d916e2b83c6fdcf74c4dae958d0.data: Monthly water levels of Lake Michigan and Lake Ontario, 1918–1988 calibration and 1988–2018 validation.
133b59bf65451d916e2b83c6fdcf74c4dae958d0.result: BC-MODWT-CNN-LSTM with Haar wavelet is best, e.g. Lake Michigan one-month r 0.994, RMSE 0.04 m; Lake Ontario three-month r 0.755.
133b59bf65451d916e2b83c6fdcf74c4dae958d0.open_work: Testing other lakes and including meteorological predictors would follow naturally.
133b59bf65451d916e2b83c6fdcf74c4dae958d0.issues: Water level lags only as inputs; skill declines with lead time, especially for Lake Ontario.

1dec269f0e43279b5df6920f91d28b3cb13ae373.goal: Improves short-term wind energy forecasting in China by combining several individual forecasting models instead of relying on a single predictor.
1dec269f0e43279b5df6920f91d28b3cb13ae373.architecture: Combined (ensemble) forecasting framework that weights the outputs of several individual forecasting models; the specific component model types are not specified here.
1dec269f0e43279b5df6920f91d28b3cb13ae373.data: Wind speed or wind power records from Chinese wind farms; exact sites and periods not reported here.
1dec269f0e43279b5df6920f91d28b3cb13ae373.result: The combined model is presented as more accurate than its individual component models; quantitative scores are not available here.
1dec269f0e43279b5df6920f91d28b3cb13ae373.open_work: Testing the combination scheme across more sites, horizons and probabilistic outputs would clarify how general the gains are.
1dec269f0e43279b5df6920f91d28b3cb13ae373.issues: No abstract available; details of components, data and metrics are unverified. Single-country case study with point forecasts only.

d88519c21bda0d0ebfb865e160d2124294e88bc6.goal: Applies data mining to weather prediction and climate change studies, aiming to forecast local meteorological variables from historical station records.
d88519c21bda0d0ebfb865e160d2124294e88bc6.architecture: Artificial neural network and decision tree classification algorithms applied to historical meteorological records.
d88519c21bda0d0ebfb865e160d2124294e88bc6.data: Station meteorological data from Ibadan, Nigeria (about 2000–2009), including temperature, rainfall, evaporation and wind speed.
d88519c21bda0d0ebfb865e160d2124294e88bc6.result: Both neural network and decision tree methods are reported to capture useful relationships for predicting weather variables, supporting data mining as a forecasting aid.
d88519c21bda0d0ebfb865e160d2124294e88bc6.open_work: Longer records, more stations and modern ensemble or deep learning methods could test whether the findings generalize.
d88519c21bda0d0ebfb865e160d2124294e88bc6.issues: Small single-station dataset, simple baselines and limited quantitative verification; no physical constraints or uncertainty estimates.

36f457bda1ad9018e39d2d83932267bb89b598f9.goal: Proposes a new intelligent-computation method to predict concentrations of air pollutants for air quality management.
36f457bda1ad9018e39d2d83932267bb89b598f9.architecture: Intelligent computation forecasting method; the specific model family is not specified here.
36f457bda1ad9018e39d2d83932267bb89b598f9.data: Not reported in the abstract. The title implies air pollutant concentration records.
36f457bda1ad9018e39d2d83932267bb89b598f9.result: The proposed method is presented as improving air pollution prediction; quantitative results not available here.
36f457bda1ad9018e39d2d83932267bb89b598f9.open_work: Validation across more cities, pollutants and longer horizons would be needed to assess robustness.
36f457bda1ad9018e39d2d83932267bb89b598f9.issues: No abstract available; method, data and metrics could not be verified from the record.

824f7127154f2c14b765df9331a2a1515a66e2e5.goal: Forecasts the daily air quality index (AQI) accurately for public health protection while accounting for influential pollutant factors.
824f7127154f2c14b765df9331a2a1515a66e2e5.architecture: Hybrid secondary decomposition model: wavelet decomposition plus sample-entropy-improved VMD, LSTM neural network for high-frequency components and Bat-algorithm-optimized least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) for the low-frequency component.
824f7127154f2c14b765df9331a2a1515a66e2e5.data: Daily AQI series for Beijing and Guilin, China, from 1 December 2016 to 31 December 2018, with PM2.5, PM10, SO2, CO, NO2 and O3 as factors.
824f7127154f2c14b765df9331a2a1515a66e2e5.result: The optimal-hybrid model captures AQI series characteristics and achieves high accuracy in forecasting AQI classes, outperforming comparison models across several indices.
824f7127154f2c14b765df9331a2a1515a66e2e5.open_work: Extending to multi-step horizons, more cities and meteorological predictors would test generality.
824f7127154f2c14b765df9331a2a1515a66e2e5.issues: Only two cities and about two years of data; decomposition over the full series may leak future information; one-day-ahead focus without uncertainty.

5750d1e29d2299ad032fbf4083c1e092b466c0dc.goal: Forecasts daily lake water levels, which matter for water resources management and shoreline planning, using artificial intelligence methods.
5750d1e29d2299ad032fbf4083c1e092b466c0dc.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural networks (ANN), adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and gene expression programming (GEP) using lagged lake levels as inputs.
5750d1e29d2299ad032fbf4083c1e092b466c0dc.data: Daily water level records of Lake Iznik, Turkey.
5750d1e29d2299ad032fbf4083c1e092b466c0dc.result: The AI approaches give accurate one-day-ahead lake level forecasts, with performance degrading at longer lead times; exact scores are not reproduced here.
5750d1e29d2299ad032fbf4083c1e092b466c0dc.open_work: Adding meteorological and inflow predictors and testing other lakes would broaden applicability.
5750d1e29d2299ad032fbf4083c1e092b466c0dc.issues: Single lake, autoregressive inputs only, short lead times and no uncertainty quantification.

dd0425b126ff6b3027ca7220962b44183fceca91.goal: Improves short-term wind power prediction by handling noise and capturing both local and long-range temporal patterns.
dd0425b126ff6b3027ca7220962b44183fceca91.architecture: Hybrid deep learning model with a parallel temporal convolutional network (TCN) and LSTM branches, with Savitzky-Golay filtering of the input series.
dd0425b126ff6b3027ca7220962b44183fceca91.data: Not reported in the abstract. Wind farm power time series are implied by the title.
dd0425b126ff6b3027ca7220962b44183fceca91.result: The parallel TCN-LSTM with Savitzky-Golay filtering is reported to outperform comparison models; quantitative results not available here.
dd0425b126ff6b3027ca7220962b44183fceca91.open_work: Probabilistic outputs and validation on more wind farms and horizons would be natural extensions.
dd0425b126ff6b3027ca7220962b44183fceca91.issues: No abstract available; data, horizons and metrics unverified. Filtering of the full series could introduce look-ahead if not applied causally.

86aae981f1f95123ad2bb556ffbaf70667ba9948.goal: Compares how well multiple statistical downscaling methods reproduce climate extremes in the present climate, to guide method choice for impact studies.
86aae981f1f95123ad2bb556ffbaf70667ba9948.architecture: Intercomparison of statistical downscaling methods, including bias-correction (BCSD, BCCA), regression-based and expanded downscaling approaches; not a single ML model.
86aae981f1f95123ad2bb556ffbaf70667ba9948.data: Reanalysis predictors downscaled to station observations in British Columbia, Canada, evaluated with ETCCDI-type climate extreme indices.
86aae981f1f95123ad2bb556ffbaf70667ba9948.result: Methods differ substantially in their skill at reproducing extreme indices, with no single method best for all indices; methods that preserve variance and temporal structure perform better for extremes.
86aae981f1f95123ad2bb556ffbaf70667ba9948.open_work: Extending the evaluation to future-climate (non-stationary) conditions and more regions is needed.
86aae981f1f95123ad2bb556ffbaf70667ba9948.issues: Present-climate evaluation only cannot test stationarity; single region; results depend on the chosen indices and predictors.

8a2ba731ab04a20e61b8ea8e0a7faf110c9b4071.goal: Maps urban flood risk for Kermanshah, Iran, by combining machine-learning flood hazard maps with flood vulnerability assessment.
8a2ba731ab04a20e61b8ea8e0a7faf110c9b4071.architecture: Maximum Entropy (MaxEnt) and Genetic Algorithm Rule-Set Production (GARP) models for hazard, with Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchical Process (FAHP) weighting for vulnerability.
8a2ba731ab04a20e61b8ea8e0a7faf110c9b4071.data: 117 flood sites from reports and field surveys and 163 non-flooded points in Kermanshah city, with flood conditioning factors and economic, social and infrastructure criteria.
8a2ba731ab04a20e61b8ea8e0a7faf110c9b4071.result: MaxEnt outperforms GARP (AUC-ROC 96.76–98.32%, kappa 0.82–0.86); infrastructure has the highest vulnerability weight, and population, urban texture and drainage distance dominate risk.
8a2ba731ab04a20e61b8ea8e0a7faf110c9b4071.open_work: Including hydrodynamic modelling and temporal dynamics could refine risk estimates.
8a2ba731ab04a20e61b8ea8e0a7faf110c9b4071.issues: Small inventory of flood points; static susceptibility without event magnitude; vulnerability weights depend on expert judgement.

06060899f698bb10a5cd491ab614478c40cdf82a.goal: Provides accurate short-term wind speed and wind power prediction with a fast, non-iterative learning approach.
06060899f698bb10a5cd491ab614478c40cdf82a.architecture: Hybrid empirical mode decomposition with kernel ridge regression (EMD-KRR), compared with EMD-based random vector functional link network (RVFL), extreme learning machine (ELM) and a firefly-optimized RVFL.
06060899f698bb10a5cd491ab614478c40cdf82a.data: Wind speed and wind power time series from three real-world wind farms, forecast at 10 min, 30 min, 1 h and 3 h ahead.
06060899f698bb10a5cd491ab614478c40cdf82a.result: EMD-KRR and EMD-RVFL give the most accurate forecasts; a reduced EMD-KRR using random support vectors cuts computation substantially with reasonable accuracy.
06060899f698bb10a5cd491ab614478c40cdf82a.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and inclusion of NWP inputs could extend the approach to longer horizons.
06060899f698bb10a5cd491ab614478c40cdf82a.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids may leak future information; wind farm details and metrics not given in the abstract; point forecasts only.

ec2767f050e9b0d177e10cbe2d389d9494914971.goal: Forecasts hourly electrical load accounting for weather and calendar effects, to support power system operation.
ec2767f050e9b0d177e10cbe2d389d9494914971.architecture: Two-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) feature extractor feeding bidirectional LSTM and GRU recurrent neural networks, with kernel size set from autocorrelation.
ec2767f050e9b0d177e10cbe2d389d9494914971.data: Hourly load and temperature series from two datasets; dataset names not reported in the abstract.
ec2767f050e9b0d177e10cbe2d389d9494914971.result: The CNN-RNN model outperforms several recent short-term load forecasting methods on both datasets.
ec2767f050e9b0d177e10cbe2d389d9494914971.open_work: Probabilistic forecasts and use of forecast rather than observed weather would make the method more operational.
ec2767f050e9b0d177e10cbe2d389d9494914971.issues: Weather link limited to temperature; likely uses observed temperatures; quantitative gains not stated in the abstract.

1d82fa2ea9c0781460c36e865973b5ba74b1710f.goal: Improves multi-step short-term wind speed forecasting for safe and reliable wind energy generation.
1d82fa2ea9c0781460c36e865973b5ba74b1710f.architecture: Hybrid SSA-CNNGRU-SVR: singular spectrum analysis decomposition, convolutional neural network with gated recurrent unit for the trend component and support vector regression for detail components.
1d82fa2ea9c0781460c36e865973b5ba74b1710f.data: Wind speed time series; site and period not reported in the abstract.
1d82fa2ea9c0781460c36e865973b5ba74b1710f.result: The hybrid outperforms ARIMA, persistence, GRU, LSTM, CNNGRU, SSA-SVR and SSA-CNNGRU benchmarks.
1d82fa2ea9c0781460c36e865973b5ba74b1710f.open_work: Testing on more sites and providing probabilistic forecasts are natural next steps.
1d82fa2ea9c0781460c36e865973b5ba74b1710f.issues: No numbers in the abstract; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage; single univariate series.

26887143a6d56a4452725b464e0f69eba6679b1f.goal: Builds an accurate short-term wind speed forecasting model to help exploit volatile wind energy.
26887143a6d56a4452725b464e0f69eba6679b1f.architecture: Support vector machine regression with feature selection and hyperparameters optimized by the Jaya algorithm (Jaya-SVM).
26887143a6d56a4452725b464e0f69eba6679b1f.data: Wind speed data from Jilin, China.
26887143a6d56a4452725b464e0f69eba6679b1f.result: Jaya-SVM beats LASSO, XGBoost, MLP, deep belief network, Gaussian process regression, stacked sparse autoencoder and granular computing on MAE, MSE, MAPE and R2.
26887143a6d56a4452725b464e0f69eba6679b1f.open_work: Multi-step and probabilistic forecasting and other regions remain to be tested.
26887143a6d56a4452725b464e0f69eba6679b1f.issues: Single region; short-term only; gains may depend on tuning effort given to baselines.

7b0d625396b36d30634824be79891271eb7baf99.goal: Forecasts drought conditions via the Standard Precipitation Index to support drought mitigation in the Awash River Basin, Ethiopia.
7b0d625396b36d30634824be79891271eb7baf99.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural networks (ANN), support vector regression (SVR) and wavelet neural networks (WN).
7b0d625396b36d30634824be79891271eb7baf99.data: SPI-3 and SPI-12 derived from precipitation in the Awash River Basin, Ethiopia, forecast at 1 and 6 month lead times.
7b0d625396b36d30634824be79891271eb7baf99.result: Coupled wavelet neural network models are the best performers across lead times by RMSE, MAE and R2.
7b0d625396b36d30634824be79891271eb7baf99.open_work: Adding climate indices and testing longer leads or other basins could improve drought early warning.
7b0d625396b36d30634824be79891271eb7baf99.issues: Single basin; wavelet decomposition may leak future information if applied to the full series; no uncertainty estimates.

1fd8dbfd978b375ad71799ec20844e3f372ab610.goal: Forecasts monthly soil moisture for agricultural planning in the Murray-Darling Basin while handling non-stationarity.
1fd8dbfd978b375ad71799ec20844e3f372ab610.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM) hybridized with EEMD and CEEMDAN decomposition, benchmarked against random forest equivalents.
1fd8dbfd978b375ad71799ec20844e3f372ab610.data: WaterDyn model hind-simulated soil moisture for upper (0–0.2 m) and lower (0.2–1.5 m) layers at seven sites in the Murray-Darling Basin, Australia, without climate inputs.
1fd8dbfd978b375ad71799ec20844e3f372ab610.result: CEEMDAN-ELM is best at three of seven sites for the upper layer, and EEMD-ELM is best at all seven sites for the lower layer.
1fd8dbfd978b375ad71799ec20844e3f372ab610.open_work: Adding climate predictors and testing on observed soil moisture are logical extensions.
1fd8dbfd978b375ad71799ec20844e3f372ab610.issues: Targets are model-simulated rather than observed soil moisture; no climate inputs; decomposition may leak information.

86744a6de8a6eb2dd3e1496e62a42b7b17d818aa.goal: Improves flood susceptibility mapping in a mountainous Vietnamese province hit by severe flash floods in 2018.
86744a6de8a6eb2dd3e1496e62a42b7b17d818aa.architecture: Deep learning neural network trained with swarm intelligence optimization algorithms, benchmarked against particle swarm optimization, support vector machine and random forest.
86744a6de8a6eb2dd3e1496e62a42b7b17d818aa.data: Lai Chau province, Vietnam: DEM-derived factors, rainfall, stream density, stream power index, distance to river, NDVI and NDBI.
86744a6de8a6eb2dd3e1496e62a42b7b17d818aa.result: The swarm-optimized deep learning models outperform benchmarks on RMSE, MAE, overall accuracy and AUC in almost all indicators.
86744a6de8a6eb2dd3e1496e62a42b7b17d818aa.open_work: Transfer to other regions and inclusion of dynamic rainfall scenarios are open.
86744a6de8a6eb2dd3e1496e62a42b7b17d818aa.issues: Single province; flood inventory size not stated; static susceptibility; no numbers in the abstract.

ba8504a6cf8d564211c78eae58630600e2261eb3.goal: Automates rapid flood mapping from satellite radar to speed emergency response.
ba8504a6cf8d564211c78eae58630600e2261eb3.architecture: Fully convolutional neural network (CNN) segmentation, comparing several architectures including U-Net and XNet encoder-decoder variants.
ba8504a6cf8d564211c78eae58630600e2261eb3.data: Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR imagery with flood masks from semi-automated methods plus manual cleaning, over a range of locations.
ba8504a6cf8d564211c78eae58630600e2261eb3.result: The method cuts flood map production time by 80% while achieving strong performance across many locations and conditions.
ba8504a6cf8d564211c78eae58630600e2261eb3.open_work: Integration into end-to-end continuous monitoring pipelines is proposed.
ba8504a6cf8d564211c78eae58630600e2261eb3.issues: Labels derived partly from semi-automated methods may carry their errors; SAR limits in urban and vegetated areas.

3d6e2632737c6abba89209e8fe8ea254075bda0d.goal: Corrects numerical weather prediction wind speed forecasts with hybrid deep learning to improve short-term wind speed prediction for wind energy.
3d6e2632737c6abba89209e8fe8ea254075bda0d.architecture: Hybrid deep learning post-processing of NWP wind forecasts; the specific network components are not specified here.
3d6e2632737c6abba89209e8fe8ea254075bda0d.data: Not reported in the abstract. NWP wind forecasts and observed wind speed are implied by the title.
3d6e2632737c6abba89209e8fe8ea254075bda0d.result: The hybrid correction is reported to improve on raw NWP and benchmark models; quantitative results not available here.
3d6e2632737c6abba89209e8fe8ea254075bda0d.open_work: Probabilistic correction and validation at more sites are natural extensions.
3d6e2632737c6abba89209e8fe8ea254075bda0d.issues: No abstract available; architecture, data and metrics unverified.

788d1262bc33da9d169c3469e5a1fa04ff8a9679.goal: Predicts rice crop yield in India from climate and crop data to support agricultural planning.
788d1262bc33da9d169c3469e5a1fa04ff8a9679.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) model, implemented as sequential minimal optimization in WEKA.
788d1262bc33da9d169c3469e5a1fa04ff8a9679.data: District-level rice and climate records (precipitation, temperatures, area, production) for Maharashtra, India.
788d1262bc33da9d169c3469e5a1fa04ff8a9679.result: SVM is reported to give usable yield predictions with accuracy metrics compared against other classifiers; exact values not reproduced here.
788d1262bc33da9d169c3469e5a1fa04ff8a9679.open_work: Using more years, remote sensing inputs and other algorithms could improve accuracy.
788d1262bc33da9d169c3469e5a1fa04ff8a9679.issues: Small dataset and short record; yield discretized into classes; limited validation.

2f8731dd58c21a6405a8017f0bfe0bc92f4d12db.goal: Improves photovoltaic power forecasting accuracy by reducing noise and avoiding manual parameter tuning.
2f8731dd58c21a6405a8017f0bfe0bc92f4d12db.architecture: Random forest optimized by a Differential Evolution Grey Wolf Optimizer, with Principal Component Analysis and K-means clustering to select similar hourly samples.
2f8731dd58c21a6405a8017f0bfe0bc92f4d12db.data: Photovoltaic power generation data from three regions; dataset details not reported in the abstract.
2f8731dd58c21a6405a8017f0bfe0bc92f4d12db.result: The proposed model achieves higher accuracy and robustness than comparison models.
2f8731dd58c21a6405a8017f0bfe0bc92f4d12db.open_work: Probabilistic forecasts and use of NWP inputs could extend the approach.
2f8731dd58c21a6405a8017f0bfe0bc92f4d12db.issues: No quantitative results or horizons in the abstract; regions not identified.

21e9478db0dd7da17f595e42f457e42a34788f8a.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting with a decomposition-plus-fuzzy-neural approach.
21e9478db0dd7da17f595e42f457e42a34788f8a.architecture: Generalized dynamic fuzzy neural network (GDFNN) on singular spectrum analysis (SSA) components, with parameters optimized by brain storm optimization.
21e9478db0dd7da17f595e42f457e42a34788f8a.data: Not reported in the abstract. Wind speed time series are implied by the title.
21e9478db0dd7da17f595e42f457e42a34788f8a.result: The hybrid model is reported to outperform comparison models; quantitative results not available here.
21e9478db0dd7da17f595e42f457e42a34788f8a.open_work: Probabilistic outputs and tests on more sites would strengthen the evidence.
21e9478db0dd7da17f595e42f457e42a34788f8a.issues: No abstract available; data and metrics unverified; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage.

0014f952ad661367259ff97ee0edacf3e510991f.goal: Estimates monthly urban water demand in Gauteng Province, South Africa, under climate change and population growth pressures.
0014f952ad661367259ff97ee0edacf3e510991f.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) optimized with the Backtracking Search Algorithm (BSA-ANN) after data pre-processing, compared with a Crow Search Algorithm ANN.
0014f952ad661367259ff97ee0edacf3e510991f.data: Monthly water consumption in Gauteng Province, South Africa, 2007–2016.
0014f952ad661367259ff97ee0edacf3e510991f.result: BSA-ANN gives RMSE 0.0099 megaliters and coefficient of efficiency 0.979, outperforming CSA-ANN.
0014f952ad661367259ff97ee0edacf3e510991f.open_work: Incorporating climate and demographic drivers explicitly and projecting future demand are open.
0014f952ad661367259ff97ee0edacf3e510991f.issues: Short single-region record; relies on lagged consumption so it may not capture regime shifts.

f9b284e06011943c443be5ff25bc56919e561410.goal: Quantifies the effect of the Wuhan Covid-19 lockdown on air pollution and associated health outcomes.
f9b284e06011943c443be5ff25bc56919e561410.architecture: Machine learning weather normalisation of pollutant concentrations followed by an augmented synthetic control method; ML model type not specified in the abstract.
f9b284e06011943c443be5ff25bc56919e561410.data: Concentrations of NO2, PM10, SO2 and CO in Wuhan and control cities in China, with weather data.
f9b284e06011943c443be5ff25bc56919e561410.result: NO2 fell by up to 24 µg/m3 (63%) and PM10 by a similar amount for a shorter period; no effect on SO2 or CO; NO2 reduction may have prevented up to 10,822 deaths in China.
f9b284e06011943c443be5ff25bc56919e561410.open_work: Extending to other cities and pollutants and refining health impact functions are natural steps.
f9b284e06011943c443be5ff25bc56919e561410.issues: Health estimates depend on assumed concentration-response functions; control cities may be affected by spillovers.

d9ee3f5917c2acc9c52da1c93ca4b8602d7da91c.goal: Forecasts monthly solar radiation for solar energy planning using a multi-stage hybrid model.
d9ee3f5917c2acc9c52da1c93ca4b8602d7da91c.architecture: Multivariate empirical mode decomposition with ant colony optimization feature selection and random forest (MEMD-ACO-RF), benchmarked against M5 tree and minimax probability machine regression.
d9ee3f5917c2acc9c52da1c93ca4b8602d7da91c.data: Multivariate climate data from January 1905 to June 2018 at three locations in Queensland, Australia.
d9ee3f5917c2acc9c52da1c93ca4b8602d7da91c.result: MEMD-ACO-RF outperforms hybrid and standalone comparison models in testing.
d9ee3f5917c2acc9c52da1c93ca4b8602d7da91c.open_work: Extending to daily scales and other regions is a natural next step.
d9ee3f5917c2acc9c52da1c93ca4b8602d7da91c.issues: Few sites; decomposition-based hybrids may leak information; no uncertainty quantification.

27c66ba3d08b3c45124140bebce20e2c30abf60a.goal: Improves ultra short-term wind power forecasting with decomposition and attention-based deep learning.
27c66ba3d08b3c45124140bebce20e2c30abf60a.architecture: Empirical mode decomposition combined with a causal convolutional network and a transformer.
27c66ba3d08b3c45124140bebce20e2c30abf60a.data: Not reported in the abstract. Wind power time series are implied by the title.
27c66ba3d08b3c45124140bebce20e2c30abf60a.result: The integrated model is reported to outperform comparison models; quantitative results not available here.
27c66ba3d08b3c45124140bebce20e2c30abf60a.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and multi-site validation are natural extensions.
27c66ba3d08b3c45124140bebce20e2c30abf60a.issues: No abstract available; data and metrics unverified; EMD hybrids risk information leakage.

fb7d1c27718b30a450ef253cc42cafc50b556ac8.goal: Improves very short-term wind power generation forecasting for power system reliability.
fb7d1c27718b30a450ef253cc42cafc50b556ac8.architecture: Hybrid deep learning model with convolutional layers, gated recurrent unit (GRU) layers and a fully connected neural network.
fb7d1c27718b30a450ef253cc42cafc50b556ac8.data: Five-minute data from the Bodangora wind farm and the Capital wind farm, New South Wales, Australia.
fb7d1c27718b30a450ef253cc42cafc50b556ac8.result: Outperforms LSTM, GRU, ARIMA and SVM, improving MAE by up to 1.59%, RMSE by 3.73% and MAPE by 8.13% at Bodangora.
fb7d1c27718b30a450ef253cc42cafc50b556ac8.open_work: Longer horizons and probabilistic forecasts remain to be explored.
fb7d1c27718b30a450ef253cc42cafc50b556ac8.issues: Two wind farms only; very short horizon; point forecasts without uncertainty.

1eae734bc85fceef8377310851d7410a4c487eb7.goal: Estimates daily ground PM2.5 across China while handling the large share of missing satellite AOD retrievals.
1eae734bc85fceef8377310851d7410a4c487eb7.architecture: Extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) with a non-linear exposure-lag-response model, after two-step AOD gap filling with a mixed-effect model and inverse distance weighting.
1eae734bc85fceef8377310851d7410a4c487eb7.data: Satellite AOD at 3 km resolution and ground PM2.5 monitors across China, 2014–2015.
1eae734bc85fceef8377310851d7410a4c487eb7.result: Gap filling cuts missing AOD from 87.91% to 13.83%; PM2.5 cross-validation gives R2 0.86, RMSE 14.98 and MAPE 23.72%.
1eae734bc85fceef8377310851d7410a4c487eb7.open_work: Extending to more years and evaluating gap-filled areas independently are natural steps.
1eae734bc85fceef8377310851d7410a4c487eb7.issues: Only two years; interpolated AOD may be less reliable in persistently cloudy regions; cross-validation may be optimistic.

5663eb12b106266f1edd8bf6c036433cc71ff45a.goal: Predicts daily rainfall in Hoa Binh province, Vietnam, with advanced AI models.
5663eb12b106266f1edd8bf6c036433cc71ff45a.architecture: PSO-optimized adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (PSOANFIS), artificial neural networks (ANN) and support vector machines (SVM).
5663eb12b106266f1edd8bf6c036433cc71ff45a.data: Station meteorological variables (max and min temperature, wind speed, relative humidity, solar radiation) and daily rainfall in Hoa Binh, Vietnam.
5663eb12b106266f1edd8bf6c036433cc71ff45a.result: All models give reasonable predictions, with SVM the best and most robust under Monte Carlo input variability.
5663eb12b106266f1edd8bf6c036433cc71ff45a.open_work: Using forecast predictors for true lead-time prediction would be a next step.
5663eb12b106266f1edd8bf6c036433cc71ff45a.issues: Uses same-day meteorological variables, so it is estimation rather than forecasting; single province; no numbers in the abstract.

cd7f50dd9d498cb3b0ff4bdb7eca9ec5e09a4471.goal: Forecasts monthly rainfall in Pakistan while addressing non-stationarity in rainfall time series.
cd7f50dd9d498cb3b0ff4bdb7eca9ec5e09a4471.architecture: Hybrid CEEMD-RF-KRR: complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition, random forest forecasts of components and kernel ridge regression to combine them.
cd7f50dd9d498cb3b0ff4bdb7eca9ec5e09a4471.data: Monthly rainfall at Gilgit, Muzaffarabad and Parachinar, Pakistan.
cd7f50dd9d498cb3b0ff4bdb7eca9ec5e09a4471.result: Correlation 0.97–0.99, Nash-Sutcliffe 0.94–0.97 and Legates-McCabe 0.74–0.81; at Gilgit RMSE 2.52 mm and MAE 1.98 mm.
cd7f50dd9d498cb3b0ff4bdb7eca9ec5e09a4471.open_work: Testing at more stations and adding climate drivers are natural extensions.
cd7f50dd9d498cb3b0ff4bdb7eca9ec5e09a4471.issues: Very high scores may reflect decomposition leakage; only three stations; no uncertainty quantification.

a773dc95b2561e17d2482962774299bb2bcf1ae5.goal: Reviews deep learning for flood forecasting and management to summarize progress and challenges.
a773dc95b2561e17d2482962774299bb2bcf1ae5.architecture: Review of deep learning models for flood forecasting and management, covering data sources, model types and evaluation measures.
a773dc95b2561e17d2482962774299bb2bcf1ae5.data: Literature on deep learning flood prediction; no new data.
a773dc95b2561e17d2482962774299bb2bcf1ae5.result: Deep learning shows strong capability, but data accessibility, interpretability and ethics remain challenges.
a773dc95b2561e17d2482962774299bb2bcf1ae5.open_work: Uncertainty estimates, multi-source data integration, hybrid models and interpretability are highlighted as future directions.
a773dc95b2561e17d2482962774299bb2bcf1ae5.issues: Broad narrative review; no quantitative meta-analysis.

6495c832322df78518f43f67ae3c9e9dea89a87f.goal: Reviews wind speed and solar irradiance forecasting techniques to support grid integration of renewable energy.
6495c832322df78518f43f67ae3c9e9dea89a87f.architecture: Review of forecasting techniques for wind speed and solar irradiance, spanning physical NWP, statistical, artificial neural network and hybrid methods.
6495c832322df78518f43f67ae3c9e9dea89a87f.result: Summarizes the strengths and limits of forecasting approaches across horizons; detailed findings not available here.
6495c832322df78518f43f67ae3c9e9dea89a87f.open_work: Hybrid and probabilistic approaches are natural future directions for grid integration.
6495c832322df78518f43f67ae3c9e9dea89a87f.issues: No abstract available; content and conclusions unverified.

16800f0181d98dfa5c6f25e79cd1af3c1d7bc1be.goal: Predicts urban flood depth under different rainfall return periods to support urban flood control in Zhengzhou, China.
16800f0181d98dfa5c6f25e79cd1af3c1d7bc1be.architecture: Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT) regression (described as deep learning by the authors) built on an urban flood data warehouse.
16800f0181d98dfa5c6f25e79cd1af3c1d7bc1be.data: Urban flood data warehouse for Zhengzhou with rainfall, duration, peak rainfall, evaporation, land use, permeability, catchment area and slope.
16800f0181d98dfa5c6f25e79cd1af3c1d7bc1be.result: Flooding points and depth increase sharply beyond the two-year return period; relative prediction error is 11.52%.
16800f0181d98dfa5c6f25e79cd1af3c1d7bc1be.open_work: Coupling with hydrodynamic models and real-time data could improve operational use.
16800f0181d98dfa5c6f25e79cd1af3c1d7bc1be.issues: Single city; GBDT is not deep learning despite the label; limited validation details.

c2a488a565990fc61608008b22fc0a3c649f6a67.goal: Optimizes an artificial neural network for multivariate forecasting of daily global solar radiation.
c2a488a565990fc61608008b22fc0a3c649f6a67.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network with exogenous meteorological inputs, compared with time-series models such as ARMA.
c2a488a565990fc61608008b22fc0a3c649f6a67.data: Daily global radiation in Corsica, France, with meteorological predictors including ALADIN NWP outputs.
c2a488a565990fc61608008b22fc0a3c649f6a67.result: Adding exogenous meteorological inputs improves the MLP over univariate approaches; exact nRMSE values not reproduced here.
c2a488a565990fc61608008b22fc0a3c649f6a67.open_work: Testing other sites and horizons and combining with other predictors are natural steps.
c2a488a565990fc61608008b22fc0a3c649f6a67.issues: Single island region; abstract unavailable so details rely on recollection.

36a906fd56f0aa5b188206821edfe66a26b2fa0b.goal: Identifies driving factors of runoff generation by combining a hydrological model with interpretable machine learning.
36a906fd56f0aa5b188206821edfe66a26b2fa0b.architecture: Hydrological model coupled with an interpretable machine learning method; the specific ML model type is not specified here.
36a906fd56f0aa5b188206821edfe66a26b2fa0b.data: Not reported in the abstract. Catchment hydrometeorological data are implied by the title.
36a906fd56f0aa5b188206821edfe66a26b2fa0b.result: Interpretable ML reveals the relative importance of factors controlling runoff generation; quantitative results not available here.
36a906fd56f0aa5b188206821edfe66a26b2fa0b.open_work: Extending to more catchments and testing causal interpretation are open.
36a906fd56f0aa5b188206821edfe66a26b2fa0b.issues: No abstract available; data, model and findings unverified; attribution reflects correlation not causation.

4e1cdcb84fefaa0b813dd2b6baed6f13092ca46c.goal: Evaluates how limited training data affect machine learning streamflow prediction in data-scarce settings.
4e1cdcb84fefaa0b813dd2b6baed6f13092ca46c.architecture: Tree-based gradient boosting (XGBoost) and LSTM recurrent neural networks.
4e1cdcb84fefaa0b813dd2b6baed6f13092ca46c.data: CAMELS dataset meteorological forcings and streamflow for US basins, varying training period, number of basins and input sequence length.
4e1cdcb84fefaa0b813dd2b6baed6f13092ca46c.result: Tree- and LSTM-based models are similarly accurate on small datasets, while LSTMs are superior with more training data.
4e1cdcb84fefaa0b813dd2b6baed6f13092ca46c.open_work: Applying findings to truly ungauged regions and transfer learning are open.
4e1cdcb84fefaa0b813dd2b6baed6f13092ca46c.issues: CAMELS US basins only; limited-data scenarios are simulated rather than real.

fa7964299aa77c6e57ae486f7ae1a91b82d84b21.goal: Enhances numerical weather prediction wind speed forecasts at offshore wind turbine locations.
fa7964299aa77c6e57ae486f7ae1a91b82d84b21.architecture: Support vector regressor to fuse NWP predictions followed by Multi-Task Gaussian Process (MTGP) regression.
fa7964299aa77c6e57ae486f7ae1a91b82d84b21.data: NWP wind predictions and observed data from a large-scale offshore wind farm.
fa7964299aa77c6e57ae486f7ae1a91b82d84b21.result: Significantly improves NWP accuracy at 1–6 h and 7–24 h horizons, with short-term accuracy comparable or better than statistical models.
fa7964299aa77c6e57ae486f7ae1a91b82d84b21.open_work: Extending to more wind farms and probabilistic use of GP uncertainty would be natural.
fa7964299aa77c6e57ae486f7ae1a91b82d84b21.issues: Single wind farm; NWP model not identified in abstract; no numbers given.

0777df13674d0315fc9116ff0331ba58d16cd4d9.goal: Compares machine learning and land use regression for fine-scale ozone estimation across the contiguous US for exposure assessment.
0777df13674d0315fc9116ff0331ba58d16cd4d9.architecture: Thirteen algorithms from nine categories, including linear land use regression, random forest and extreme gradient boosting.
0777df13674d0315fc9116ff0331ba58d16cd4d9.data: Daily maximum 8-hour ozone with chemistry-transport model predictions, meteorology, land use and emissions at census tract level across the contiguous US.
0777df13674d0315fc9116ff0331ba58d16cd4d9.result: Nonlinear ML reduces RMSE by about 10–40% versus LUR; tuned sample weights reduce cross-validated RMSE by about 30%; RF and XGBoost perform best.
0777df13674d0315fc9116ff0331ba58d16cd4d9.open_work: Careful hyperparameter tuning and validation design remain crucial.
0777df13674d0315fc9116ff0331ba58d16cd4d9.issues: Ozone only; results depend on validation strategy; potential overfitting.

e9ebda87ae3389cdafa2c2162323ca1655da65c6.goal: Detects clouds efficiently from remote sensing image thumbnails for preprocessing.
e9ebda87ae3389cdafa2c2162323ca1655da65c6.architecture: CDnet convolutional neural network with an encoder-decoder structure, feature pyramid module and boundary refinement block.
e9ebda87ae3389cdafa2c2162323ca1655da65c6.data: ZY-3 satellite thumbnails, GF-1 WFV cloud data and Landsat-8 Cloud Cover Assessment data.
e9ebda87ae3389cdafa2c2162323ca1655da65c6.result: CDnet achieves accurate detection and outperforms several state-of-the-art methods.
e9ebda87ae3389cdafa2c2162323ca1655da65c6.open_work: Extending to cloud shadow and full-resolution imagery would be useful.
e9ebda87ae3389cdafa2c2162323ca1655da65c6.issues: Thumbnails lose resolution and spectral information; no numbers in the abstract.

1ab61187d5e931613029da8ae5d34d4da56bbbf0.goal: Provides interpretable probabilistic short-term photovoltaic power forecasts.
1ab61187d5e931613029da8ae5d34d4da56bbbf0.architecture: Natural gradient boosting (NGBoost) for probabilistic forecasts with SHAP explanations.
1ab61187d5e931613029da8ae5d34d4da56bbbf0.data: Real data from two PV parks in Southern Germany.
1ab61187d5e931613029da8ae5d34d4da56bbbf0.result: Outperforms Gaussian process and lower upper bound estimation in point and probabilistic accuracy, with learned relationships following physical properties.
1ab61187d5e931613029da8ae5d34d4da56bbbf0.open_work: Applying to more sites and horizons is natural.
1ab61187d5e931613029da8ae5d34d4da56bbbf0.issues: Two PV parks only; SHAP explanations are associative.

c782ce7ae9e3189eb3ebdd20f751e7f1f43e7d64.goal: Improves 15-minute-ahead PV power forecasting using sky images and output history.
c782ce7ae9e3189eb3ebdd20f751e7f1f43e7d64.architecture: SUNSET convolutional neural network (CNN) using sky images and PV output history.
c782ce7ae9e3189eb3ebdd20f751e7f1f43e7d64.data: One-year database of sky images and minutely PV output.
c782ce7ae9e3189eb3ebdd20f751e7f1f43e7d64.result: Achieves 16.3% forecast skill in cloudy conditions and 15.7% overall versus smart persistence; down-sampling reduces training time by 83%.
c782ce7ae9e3189eb3ebdd20f751e7f1f43e7d64.open_work: Longer horizons and multi-site deployment are open.
c782ce7ae9e3189eb3ebdd20f751e7f1f43e7d64.issues: Single site and one year of data; skill modest.

164d562a30ee2d16809b9e9ca3d85d90393aad50.goal: Estimates high spatio-temporal resolution soil moisture from CYGNSS GNSS-R observations.
164d562a30ee2d16809b9e9ca3d85d90393aad50.architecture: Fully connected artificial neural network (ANN) regression with physics-aware inputs.
164d562a30ee2d16809b9e9ca3d85d90393aad50.data: CYGNSS reflectivity, trailing edge slope and incidence angle with NDVI, vegetation water content, elevation, slope and roughness, labeled by ISMN in situ soil moisture.
164d562a30ee2d16809b9e9ca3d85d90393aad50.result: Unbiased RMSE 0.0544 cm3/cm3 and correlation 0.9009 for 2017–2018 test data.
164d562a30ee2d16809b9e9ca3d85d90393aad50.open_work: Extending coverage beyond ISMN sites and longer periods are open.
164d562a30ee2d16809b9e9ca3d85d90393aad50.issues: Assumes uniform soil moisture in 9 km cells; trained on limited ISMN sites.

488fc4e82b425e0f472f36525c97fd27ca1ae7c6.goal: Forecasts drought conditions with data-driven models and compares their skill to identify a suitable tool for drought early warning.
488fc4e82b425e0f472f36525c97fd27ca1ae7c6.architecture: Compares an artificial neural network (MLP), an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and a support vector machine (SVM) regression model.
488fc4e82b425e0f472f36525c97fd27ca1ae7c6.data: Station-based drought index series; the specific region, index and period are not available here (no abstract).
488fc4e82b425e0f472f36525c97fd27ca1ae7c6.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title indicates a skill comparison among ANN, ANFIS and SVM forecasts.
488fc4e82b425e0f472f36525c97fd27ca1ae7c6.open_work: Testing at longer lead times and across more regions and drought indices would clarify generality.
488fc4e82b425e0f472f36525c97fd27ca1ae7c6.issues: Single-region, station-based comparison; no abstract available to confirm data, metrics or which model performed best.

dd23985aa9ece5fee95a1c90fa8d923a17b6810a.goal: Assesses regional flood disaster risk in the rapidly urbanizing Yangtze River Delta to support flood control and emergency management.
dd23985aa9ece5fee95a1c90fa8d923a17b6810a.architecture: Random forest screens important indicators within a DPSIR (driving force-pressure-state-impact-response) framework, then a radial basis function (RBF) neural network classifies flood risk into levels I-V, mapped in GIS.
dd23985aa9ece5fee95a1c90fa8d923a17b6810a.data: Socio-economic, land-use and hydrometeorological indicators (flood-season rainfall, impervious area ratio, GDP density, population density, rescue capacity) for YRD cities, 2009-2018.
dd23985aa9ece5fee95a1c90fa8d923a17b6810a.result: Flood risk rose over the decade with urbanization and correlates positively with economic development; rainfall, impervious ratio, GDP density, water area and population density are key drivers.
dd23985aa9ece5fee95a1c90fa8d923a17b6810a.open_work: Extending to finer spatial units and linking risk indices to observed flood losses would strengthen the assessment.
dd23985aa9ece5fee95a1c90fa8d923a17b6810a.issues: Validation is qualitative ('in line with the actual situation'); risk levels are index-based without independent loss data; small sample of city-years.

d90c79afee77dc84028d3ac36fc0efbfbfb4cf0b.goal: Evaluates whether an LSTM network can simulate daily runoff better than a conventional ANN and the physically based SWAT model, especially where topographic data are scarce.
d90c79afee77dc84028d3ac36fc0efbfbfb4cf0b.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network compared with a feed-forward artificial neural network (ANN) and the SWAT hydrological model; window size of past inputs is tested.
d90c79afee77dc84028d3ac36fc0efbfbfb4cf0b.data: Daily meteorological forcing (precipitation only, or all available meteorological variables) and streamflow in the Poyang Lake Basin, China.
d90c79afee77dc84028d3ac36fc0efbfbfb4cf0b.result: A 15-day input window works best; LSTM reaches NSE 0.60-0.92 with precipitation only and 0.74-0.94 with all meteorological inputs, clearly outperforming ANN and SWAT, which are comparable.
d90c79afee77dc84028d3ac36fc0efbfbfb4cf0b.open_work: Testing in ungauged settings, transfer across basins and adding physical constraints are natural next steps.
d90c79afee77dc84028d3ac36fc0efbfbfb4cf0b.issues: Single basin; purely data-driven model needs long gauge records; no uncertainty quantification or extreme-flow analysis.

b00d1a99b17266aaf1c171891697b5caecc8c4a7.goal: Produces full probability density forecasts of wind power, rather than point forecasts, to quantify uncertainty for grid operation.
b00d1a99b17266aaf1c171891697b5caecc8c4a7.architecture: Quantile regression neural network (QRNN) generates conditional quantiles, which are converted into a continuous probability density with kernel density estimation (KDE).
b00d1a99b17266aaf1c171891697b5caecc8c4a7.data: Wind power (and related) time series from operating wind farms; specific sites and periods are not reported here.
b00d1a99b17266aaf1c171891697b5caecc8c4a7.result: Not reported in the abstract; the method is presented as yielding probabilistic density forecasts that improve on benchmark point and interval approaches.
b00d1a99b17266aaf1c171891697b5caecc8c4a7.open_work: Extending to multi-site, longer horizons and including NWP inputs would broaden applicability.
b00d1a99b17266aaf1c171891697b5caecc8c4a7.issues: No abstract available to confirm data or scores; quantile crossing and KDE bandwidth choice can affect density quality.

83b2a1c591badd628a97188995bb4846e5743eea.goal: Forecasts monthly PM10 concentrations in the Oviedo metropolitan area (Spain) to support air-quality management and health protection.
83b2a1c591badd628a97188995bb4846e5743eea.architecture: Compares support vector machine regression (SVM), multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network, and statistical VARMA and ARIMA models.
83b2a1c591badd628a97188995bb4846e5743eea.data: Seven years of monthly averaged air-pollutant measurements, including PM10, from monitoring stations in Oviedo, northern Spain.
83b2a1c591badd628a97188995bb4846e5743eea.result: SVM regression outperforms MLP, VARMA and ARIMA for forecasts one month ahead and for the following seven months.
83b2a1c591badd628a97188995bb4846e5743eea.open_work: Using meteorological predictors and daily resolution would make the forecasts more operationally useful.
83b2a1c591badd628a97188995bb4846e5743eea.issues: Monthly averages from a single city give a small sample; no meteorological drivers; limited out-of-sample evaluation details.

27efa74ae88307cb191edd952edfb8aa9e0d15cd.goal: Improves numerical wave-model forecasts of significant wave height, peak period and peak direction at a specific coastal site by learning the forecast error.
27efa74ae88307cb191edd952edfb8aa9e0d15cd.architecture: Random forest and gradient boosting trees for error prediction, compared with neural networks; hyperparameters tuned with Bayesian optimization.
27efa74ae88307cb191edd952edfb8aa9e0d15cd.data: Numerical sea-state forecasts and buoy observations at Biarritz, France; corrected outputs used to compute extreme wave run-up (R2%).
27efa74ae88307cb191edd952edfb8aa9e0d15cd.result: Gradient boosting and random forest give RMSE 20% and 10% lower than neural networks; Bayesian tuning further lowers gradient boosting RMSE by 8-11% for wave height and period; run-up estimates also improve.
27efa74ae88307cb191edd952edfb8aa9e0d15cd.open_work: Extending error correction to multiple sites, spectral outputs and longer lead times is a natural next step.
27efa74ae88307cb191edd952edfb8aa9e0d15cd.issues: Single-site, site-specific correction; tree models cannot extrapolate beyond training range, which matters for extreme storms.

9a24cd3b70392b918be69fd93e612571e1f057dc.goal: Evaluates twelve evapotranspiration (ET) products over CONUS to guide dataset selection for hydrological analysis.
9a24cd3b70392b918be69fd93e612571e1f057dc.architecture: Intercomparison study, not a new model: one machine-learning product (GFET), three remote-sensing products and eight land surface model outputs, with uncertainties quantified by the three-cornered hat (TCH) method.
9a24cd3b70392b918be69fd93e612571e1f057dc.data: GFET, SSEBop, MOD16, GLEAM, NLDAS-2 (Mosaic, Noah28, SAC, VIC403) and NLDAS-3 (CLSM25, Noah36, NoahMP36, VIC412) ET; validated against AmeriFlux towers and water-balance ET.
9a24cd3b70392b918be69fd93e612571e1f057dc.result: All products capture seasonality; basin-scale correlation with water-balance ET exceeds 0.83; NLDAS-3 uncertainties (4-7 mm/month) are lower than NLDAS-2 and MODIS products; GFET (4.37 mm/month) and GLEAM are comparably low.
9a24cd3b70392b918be69fd93e612571e1f057dc.open_work: Extending the evaluation to other regions and to sub-monthly and drought-specific performance is suggested.
9a24cd3b70392b918be69fd93e612571e1f057dc.issues: Point-scale flux towers have footprint mismatch; TCH assumes independent errors among products; ML product evaluated only as a dataset.

be122aa8b21c20b60e70711861226fea24ea7249.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration (ETo) in arid Northwest China from limited climatic inputs for irrigation scheduling and water management.
be122aa8b21c20b60e70711861226fea24ea7249.architecture: Hybrid extreme learning machine (ELM) with parameters optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO-ELM), compared with ELM, artificial neural networks (ANN), random forests (RF) and six empirical equations.
be122aa8b21c20b60e70711861226fea24ea7249.data: Daily meteorological station data from arid Northwest China; FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ETo as target; radiation-, temperature- and mass-transfer-based input combinations.
be122aa8b21c20b60e70711861226fea24ea7249.result: Machine learning beats empirical equations with the same inputs; PSO-ELM performs best overall, and the temperature-only PSO-ELM gives reasonable estimates.
be122aa8b21c20b60e70711861226fea24ea7249.open_work: Testing in other climates and for forecasting with weather-forecast temperatures is suggested.
be122aa8b21c20b60e70711861226fea24ea7249.issues: Regional study; target is itself a Penman-Monteith calculation rather than lysimeter measurements; metric values not given in the abstract.

8de60abde906750b2f7aa2a87a4eef2510dbf008.goal: Quantifies uncertainty in neural-network flood forecasts and produces ensemble forecasts with confidence bands for operational flood warning.
8de60abde906750b2f7aa2a87a4eef2510dbf008.architecture: Bootstrap-based artificial neural networks (BANN): an ensemble of feed-forward ANNs trained on bootstrap resamples, whose spread gives confidence intervals.
8de60abde906750b2f7aa2a87a4eef2510dbf008.data: Hourly water-level/discharge records from an Indian river basin (Mahanadi); exact stations and periods not reported here.
8de60abde906750b2f7aa2a87a4eef2510dbf008.result: BANN yields more accurate and more reliable forecasts than a single ANN and provides confidence intervals that widen with lead time.
8de60abde906750b2f7aa2a87a4eef2510dbf008.open_work: Combining bootstrap ensembles with other uncertainty sources (input rainfall, structure) and longer lead times is a next step.
8de60abde906750b2f7aa2a87a4eef2510dbf008.issues: Bootstrap captures parameter/data-sample uncertainty only; single basin; performance at longer leads degrades.

4723d986f21ef0d5b67eb0431df828eee0032da7.goal: Reviews real-time flood forecasting models for urban drainage systems to identify the state of the art and knowledge gaps for early warning.
4723d986f21ef0d5b67eb0431df828eee0032da7.architecture: Review of real-time urban flood forecasting models, covering data sources, physically based, data-driven and artificial intelligence approaches.
4723d986f21ef0d5b67eb0431df828eee0032da7.data: Literature on real-time flood forecasting in urban drainage systems; no new dataset.
4723d986f21ef0d5b67eb0431df828eee0032da7.result: AI is present in most new real-time forecasting models; combining multiple real-time rainfall sources and adding soil moisture, wind, evaporation, fluvial flow and infiltration data deserves more study.
4723d986f21ef0d5b67eb0431df828eee0032da7.open_work: Further development of AI-based real-time models and multi-source data integration is expected.
4723d986f21ef0d5b67eb0431df828eee0032da7.issues: Review scope and selection criteria determine conclusions; no quantitative benchmark of methods.

2082478076bed6b829d80103d1726c3917c18e31.goal: Predicts wind speed on very short horizons (seconds to minutes) for wind turbine control and grid integration.
2082478076bed6b829d80103d1726c3917c18e31.architecture: Hybrid of an artificial neural network (feed-forward) with a Markov chain that adjusts the ANN predictions using long-term transition patterns of wind speed.
2082478076bed6b829d80103d1726c3917c18e31.data: Measured wind speed time series from a wind site; location and period not reported here.
2082478076bed6b829d80103d1726c3917c18e31.result: Not reported in the abstract; the hybrid ANN-Markov chain is presented as improving on the stand-alone ANN.
2082478076bed6b829d80103d1726c3917c18e31.open_work: Testing on more sites and longer horizons, and comparison with modern recurrent models, would help.
2082478076bed6b829d80103d1726c3917c18e31.issues: No abstract available to confirm data and scores; single-site, univariate setting.

e475dc075f350a0608cb334215f87a79e65a15e4.goal: Improves short-term wind power prediction from wind farms to ease grid integration and balance supply and demand.
e475dc075f350a0608cb334215f87a79e65a15e4.architecture: Wavenet LSTM (WN-LSTM): long short-term memory recurrent network with wavelet activation kernels (Gaussian, Morlet, Ricker, Shannon); interval prediction for uncertainty.
e475dc075f350a0608cb334215f87a79e65a15e4.data: Wind power data from seven wind farms in Europe.
e475dc075f350a0608cb334215f87a79e65a15e4.result: Up to 30% MAE improvement over established techniques; interval predictions differ from actual mean power by 0.02 at 95% confidence (Tukey and Fisher tests).
e475dc075f350a0608cb334215f87a79e65a15e4.open_work: Extending to longer horizons and including meteorological forecasts as inputs are natural next steps.
e475dc075f350a0608cb334215f87a79e65a15e4.issues: Univariate power history only; comparisons with baselines whose tuning is unclear; no explicit treatment of ramps or extremes.

e772a7c3a04f69d46fa36aeec4b2abdcfb5e03ae.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting by combining signal decomposition with deep feature extraction.
e772a7c3a04f69d46fa36aeec4b2abdcfb5e03ae.architecture: Wavelet decomposition; for low-frequency sub-series, recurrent neural networks (simple RNN, LSTM, GRU) extract deep features fed to a support vector machine (SVM) predictor.
e772a7c3a04f69d46fa36aeec4b2abdcfb5e03ae.data: Four real-world wind speed series; sites and periods not reported in the abstract.
e772a7c3a04f69d46fa36aeec4b2abdcfb5e03ae.result: The three hybrid models (RNN-SVM, LSTM-SVM, GRU-SVM) give more accurate predictions than conventional methods.
e772a7c3a04f69d46fa36aeec4b2abdcfb5e03ae.open_work: Extending to multi-step and probabilistic forecasting, and to multi-site data, is a natural next step.
e772a7c3a04f69d46fa36aeec4b2abdcfb5e03ae.issues: Wavelet decomposition over the whole series can leak future information if not done causally; no numbers given in the abstract.

e9d66ee378399f4bbc94d7753532c8fd96eeeced.goal: Produces multi-step-ahead wind speed forecasts for wind energy operation using decomposition plus deep learning.
e9d66ee378399f4bbc94d7753532c8fd96eeeced.architecture: Hybrid decomposition of the wind speed series followed by temporal convolutional networks (TCN) that forecast the components.
e9d66ee378399f4bbc94d7753532c8fd96eeeced.data: Measured wind speed time series; sites, resolution and periods are not reported here.
e9d66ee378399f4bbc94d7753532c8fd96eeeced.result: Not reported in the abstract; the hybrid is presented as outperforming benchmark models across forecast steps.
e9d66ee378399f4bbc94d7753532c8fd96eeeced.open_work: Probabilistic outputs and multi-site spatial information could be added.
e9d66ee378399f4bbc94d7753532c8fd96eeeced.issues: No abstract available; decomposition-based forecasts risk information leakage if decomposition is not applied causally.

7d313ca5543d40bd06b9fe1e370f6c9434f90907.goal: Produces high-resolution maps of monthly air temperature on the southern slopes of Mt. Kilimanjaro for scaling plot-based biodiversity research.
7d313ca5543d40bd06b9fe1e370f6c9434f90907.architecture: Comparison of 14 machine learning algorithms (stochastic gradient boosting, Cubist, random forest, model-averaged neural networks, linear and nonlinear regression) against kriging, plus Cubist with residual kriging.
7d313ca5543d40bd06b9fe1e370f6c9434f90907.data: Monthly air temperature from a network of observation plots on Mt. Kilimanjaro, Tanzania, with 10-fold cross-validation.
7d313ca5543d40bd06b9fe1e370f6c9434f90907.result: Tree-based models perform best, led by stochastic gradient boosting, then Cubist and random forest; ML beats kriging quantitatively, but maps are visually ambiguous, so Cubist plus residual kriging is preferred.
7d313ca5543d40bd06b9fe1e370f6c9434f90907.open_work: Including more physically meaningful predictors and denser station networks would improve maps.
7d313ca5543d40bd06b9fe1e370f6c9434f90907.issues: Small station network on complex terrain; good cross-validation scores do not guarantee realistic maps.

a5184930786fb4a72c6798f17e02a01a3431c463.goal: Improves monthly streamflow prediction by combining classification and regression trees (CART) with ensemble learning.
a5184930786fb4a72c6798f17e02a01a3431c463.architecture: Classification and regression trees (CART) enhanced with ensemble learning such as bagging and boosting, compared with single CART and other baselines.
a5184930786fb4a72c6798f17e02a01a3431c463.data: Monthly streamflow records from a river in Turkey; exact gauge and period not reported here.
a5184930786fb4a72c6798f17e02a01a3431c463.result: Not reported in the abstract; ensemble CART variants are presented as more accurate than single CART.
a5184930786fb4a72c6798f17e02a01a3431c463.open_work: Testing on more basins and with exogenous climate predictors would establish generality.
a5184930786fb4a72c6798f17e02a01a3431c463.issues: No abstract available to confirm data or which ensemble performed best; single-basin study.

bc1cad44712a37f49b3c5472c6e181e3d9822f77.goal: Maps groundwater potential in Boryeong city, Korea, to support groundwater exploration and management.
bc1cad44712a37f49b3c5472c6e181e3d9822f77.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) and support vector machine (SVM) models in a GIS framework, relating well productivity to conditioning factors.
bc1cad44712a37f49b3c5472c6e181e3d9822f77.data: Groundwater well data and GIS layers (e.g., topography, geology, land use, soil); exact factors and counts not reported here.
bc1cad44712a37f49b3c5472c6e181e3d9822f77.result: Not reported in the abstract; both models produce groundwater potential maps that are validated, for example with ROC curves.
bc1cad44712a37f49b3c5472c6e181e3d9822f77.open_work: Comparing with ensemble or deep models and other regions would test robustness.
bc1cad44712a37f49b3c5472c6e181e3d9822f77.issues: No abstract available; single-city case study with limited well data.

335df24c2fa0831e67f010c53094f0bcd157e32e.goal: Predicts wind speed at multiple sites by exploiting spatial and temporal correlations jointly.
335df24c2fa0831e67f010c53094f0bcd157e32e.architecture: Predictive spatio-temporal network (PSTN): a convolutional neural network (CNN) extracts spatial features from wind speed matrices and an LSTM captures temporal dependencies, trained end to end.
335df24c2fa0831e67f010c53094f0bcd157e32e.data: Real-world multi-site wind speed data; specific network and period not reported in the abstract.
335df24c2fa0831e67f010c53094f0bcd157e32e.result: PSTN outperforms prior methods for short-term multi-site predictions.
335df24c2fa0831e67f010c53094f0bcd157e32e.open_work: Longer horizons and inclusion of NWP or terrain information are natural extensions.
335df24c2fa0831e67f010c53094f0bcd157e32e.issues: Requires gridded site arrangement; no quantitative scores or uncertainty in the abstract.

5d8c5c061a4ebd2c518ca0d3a921efe12a264876.goal: Reviews meta-heuristic optimization algorithms used in wind power prediction.
5d8c5c061a4ebd2c518ca0d3a921efe12a264876.architecture: Review of meta-heuristic algorithms (e.g., swarm and evolutionary optimizers) applied to wind power prediction for parameter tuning, feature selection and model combination.
5d8c5c061a4ebd2c518ca0d3a921efe12a264876.data: Literature on wind power prediction; no new dataset.
5d8c5c061a4ebd2c518ca0d3a921efe12a264876.result: Not reported in the abstract; the review summarizes methodologies, applications and challenges of meta-heuristics in wind power forecasting.
5d8c5c061a4ebd2c518ca0d3a921efe12a264876.open_work: Standardized benchmarks and assessment of real gains from meta-heuristics are needed.
5d8c5c061a4ebd2c518ca0d3a921efe12a264876.issues: No abstract available; reviews of this kind may not compare methods on common data.

1b69a4cb2d22ab76f93110848cfb39d90c1231a6.goal: Reviews solar irradiance resources and forecasting methods to support PV integration into power grids.
1b69a4cb2d22ab76f93110848cfb39d90c1231a6.architecture: Review of solar irradiance forecasting methods: numerical weather prediction, satellite-based, sky-image based, data-driven (statistical and machine learning) and sensor-network approaches.
1b69a4cb2d22ab76f93110848cfb39d90c1231a6.data: Literature plus discussion of error metrics and accessible sensor-network datasets for validation.
1b69a4cb2d22ab76f93110848cfb39d90c1231a6.result: Summarizes methods by forecast horizon and reviews sensor networks, error metrics and available datasets.
1b69a4cb2d22ab76f93110848cfb39d90c1231a6.open_work: Better use of sensor networks and standardized validation are highlighted.
1b69a4cb2d22ab76f93110848cfb39d90c1231a6.issues: Broad review; no quantitative benchmark comparison of methods.

e49e3a339517b72797becf435d9459a75d18567b.goal: Maps flood susceptibility at national scale across Iran to guide flood mitigation and land-use planning.
e49e3a339517b72797becf435d9459a75d18567b.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) classifier using ten flood conditioning factors.
e49e3a339517b72797becf435d9459a75d18567b.data: 2769 flood location records across Iran (70% training, 30% testing); slope, altitude, aspect, curvatures, rainfall, geology, land use, distance to roads and rivers.
e49e3a339517b72797becf435d9459a75d18567b.result: Susceptibility map reaches about 75% area under the prediction-rate curve; about 12% and 3% of Iran are highly and very highly susceptible, containing 29% and 49% of cities.
e49e3a339517b72797becf435d9459a75d18567b.open_work: Adding hydrodynamic or temporal information and comparing with other ML models would strengthen results.
e49e3a339517b72797becf435d9459a75d18567b.issues: Moderate accuracy; static factors only; flood inventory and non-flood sampling biases affect susceptibility estimates.

5a30525e13d4e9a5af8126a9eaaca96d950a853a.goal: Transfers streamflow models from data-rich to data-sparse regions to improve hydrologic prediction where gauges and catchment attributes are scarce.
5a30525e13d4e9a5af8126a9eaaca96d950a853a.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) streamflow models pretrained on CONUS and transferred by transfer learning (weight initialization and weight freezing).
5a30525e13d4e9a5af8126a9eaaca96d950a853a.data: CONUS basins as source (CAMELS-type data); targets: 664 basins in Great Britain, 49 in central Chile, and 5 in China with only remotely sensed attributes.
5a30525e13d4e9a5af8126a9eaaca96d950a853a.result: Transfer learning significantly improves performance in China and Chile over locally trained models; benefits grow with source data size and physiographic diversity, and exceed pretraining on uncalibrated hydrologic model output.
5a30525e13d4e9a5af8126a9eaaca96d950a853a.open_work: Building larger, more diverse global source datasets and global benchmarks is suggested.
5a30525e13d4e9a5af8126a9eaaca96d950a853a.issues: Very few target basins in China; gains depend on similarity to source basins; attribute inconsistencies across continents.

9026b36668224407feb02f9ce2053d5811680372.goal: Provides 0-6 h quantitative precipitation forecasts for flood warning by extrapolating satellite cloud-top brightness temperature.
9026b36668224407feb02f9ce2053d5811680372.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network forecasts cloud-top brightness temperature, which the PERSIANN neural-network retrieval converts into rainfall.
9026b36668224407feb02f9ce2053d5811680372.data: Geostationary infrared cloud-top brightness temperature and PERSIANN precipitation over Oregon, Oklahoma and Florida; compared with RNN, persistence, Farneback optical flow and RAPv1.0 NWP.
9026b36668224407feb02f9ce2053d5811680372.result: LSTM-PERSIANN yields better correlation, RMSE, POD, FAR and CSI than RAPv1.0 and the other extrapolation methods, especially for convective rainfall.
9026b36668224407feb02f9ce2053d5811680372.open_work: Global implementation as an alternative short-term forecast product is proposed.
9026b36668224407feb02f9ce2053d5811680372.issues: Point/pixel-wise temporal model ignores spatial structure; inherits PERSIANN retrieval errors; three regions only.

a80851f4a13966aeb43ff24c90fa5e34142f16e7.goal: Predicts groundwater levels in a drought-prone area with machine learning to support water resources planning.
a80851f4a13966aeb43ff24c90fa5e34142f16e7.architecture: Several machine learning algorithms are compared; the specific model types are not specified here.
a80851f4a13966aeb43ff24c90fa5e34142f16e7.data: Groundwater level and hydro-climatic records from a drought-prone region; location and period not reported here.
a80851f4a13966aeb43ff24c90fa5e34142f16e7.open_work: Testing longer lead times and the effect of drought conditions on predictability would be useful.
a80851f4a13966aeb43ff24c90fa5e34142f16e7.issues: No abstract available; details of data, models and scores cannot be confirmed.

799b38b1546508d6dc84616166329b2e8ce9cb4b.goal: Forecasts long-term (monthly) global solar radiation at regional locations in Queensland for solar energy planning.
799b38b1546508d6dc84616166329b2e8ce9cb4b.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) using satellite-derived MODIS land surface temperature as predictor, compared with simpler statistical models.
799b38b1546508d6dc84616166329b2e8ce9cb4b.data: MODIS land surface temperature and ground-based global solar radiation for regional sites in Queensland, Australia.
799b38b1546508d6dc84616166329b2e8ce9cb4b.result: Not reported in the abstract; the ANN coupled with MODIS LST is reported to forecast solar radiation more accurately than the comparison models.
799b38b1546508d6dc84616166329b2e8ce9cb4b.open_work: Adding further satellite predictors and testing more sites is a natural extension.
799b38b1546508d6dc84616166329b2e8ce9cb4b.issues: Abstract unavailable; relies on a single satellite predictor; limited number of sites.

5c804f4cbb6efde7b22e6056bba08832d7693ac2.goal: Forecasts daily potential evapotranspiration from limited climatic data for irrigation management.
5c804f4cbb6efde7b22e6056bba08832d7693ac2.architecture: Machine learning regression with multivariate relevance vector machine (MVM) and support vector machine (SVM) models.
5c804f4cbb6efde7b22e6056bba08832d7693ac2.data: Daily weather station data with limited variables (e.g., temperature) from an agricultural area in Utah, USA; exact period not reported here.
5c804f4cbb6efde7b22e6056bba08832d7693ac2.result: Not reported in the abstract; the learning machines are reported to forecast daily ETo several days ahead with reasonable accuracy from limited inputs.
5c804f4cbb6efde7b22e6056bba08832d7693ac2.open_work: Coupling with weather forecasts and testing in other climates are natural next steps.
5c804f4cbb6efde7b22e6056bba08832d7693ac2.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-region study with limited inputs; target is a computed rather than measured ET.

e96566d5515073568b1f5e670d5a300163e9d3e8.goal: Compares heuristic data-driven models with empirical equations for estimating reference evapotranspiration from limited inputs across Iran.
e96566d5515073568b1f5e670d5a300163e9d3e8.architecture: Heuristic models such as gene expression programming, artificial neural networks, ANFIS and support vector machines, compared with empirical ETo equations; the exact model set is not confirmed here.
e96566d5515073568b1f5e670d5a300163e9d3e8.data: Meteorological station data from multiple sites in Iran with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ETo as reference; local and cross-station evaluation.
e96566d5515073568b1f5e670d5a300163e9d3e8.result: Not reported in the abstract; heuristic models are generally more accurate than empirical equations with the same limited inputs.
e96566d5515073568b1f5e670d5a300163e9d3e8.open_work: Assessing spatial transferability across climates is highlighted.
e96566d5515073568b1f5e670d5a300163e9d3e8.issues: Abstract unavailable; target is a computed ETo; results may not transfer between stations.

770ccfba0148ef0e5a644a4823fdaafb0011177e.goal: Detects clouds on board a nanosatellite to reduce downlink volume by transmitting only usable hyperspectral images.
770ccfba0148ef0e5a644a4823fdaafb0011177e.architecture: CloudScout: a custom convolutional neural network (CNN) deployed on an edge AI accelerator on the HyperScout-2 payload (ESA Phi-Sat-1).
770ccfba0148ef0e5a644a4823fdaafb0011177e.data: Sentinel-2 imagery pre-processed to emulate the HyperScout-2 hyperspectral sensor; images labeled by cloud fraction (>70% cloudy discarded).
770ccfba0148ef0e5a644a4823fdaafb0011177e.result: 92% accuracy with 1% false positives on the test set; first in-orbit demonstration of a deep neural network for on-board data processing.
770ccfba0148ef0e5a644a4823fdaafb0011177e.open_work: In-orbit performance assessment and extension to other on-board edge applications are planned.
770ccfba0148ef0e5a644a4823fdaafb0011177e.issues: Trained on emulated rather than real sensor data; image-level binary classification only, not pixel-level cloud masks.

649963939da41dd47b01dcb8bb38bb2a5ec0971e.goal: Forecasts multi-step-ahead wind energy of a turbine in a Brazilian wind farm to manage uncertainty in power supply.
649963939da41dd47b01dcb8bb38bb2a5ec0971e.architecture: Decomposition-ensemble approach: CEEMD decomposition with stacking ensemble of k-nearest neighbors, partial least squares, ridge regression, support vector regression and Cubist.
649963939da41dd47b01dcb8bb38bb2a5ec0971e.data: Wind energy data from a turbine at Parazinho, Brazil; Box-Cox, correlation and PCA preprocessing.
649963939da41dd47b01dcb8bb38bb2a5ec0971e.result: The proposed models beat CEEMD-only, stacking-only and single models at all horizons, with improvements of 0.06%-97.53%, confirmed by Diebold-Mariano tests.
649963939da41dd47b01dcb8bb38bb2a5ec0971e.open_work: Extending to probabilistic forecasting and other sites is a natural next step.
649963939da41dd47b01dcb8bb38bb2a5ec0971e.issues: Single turbine; decomposition on full series may leak information; very wide range of improvements.

a1e3a703b6949dd9592f7cd9b2708b684d2a1346.goal: Evaluates AI methods for forecasting daily streamflow to support sustainable water resources and reservoir management.
a1e3a703b6949dd9592f7cd9b2708b684d2a1346.architecture: Compares artificial neural network (ANN), ANFIS, extreme learning machine (ELM), Gaussian process regression (GPR) and support vector machine (SVM).
a1e3a703b6949dd9592f7cd9b2708b684d2a1346.data: Daily inflow series at two large hydropower reservoirs in China.
a1e3a703b6949dd9592f7cd9b2708b684d2a1346.result: All five methods give satisfactory forecasts; SVM, GPR and ELM outperform ANN and ANFIS in training and testing on four metrics.
a1e3a703b6949dd9592f7cd9b2708b684d2a1346.open_work: Choosing models according to reservoir characteristics and testing more advanced deep models are suggested.
a1e3a703b6949dd9592f7cd9b2708b684d2a1346.issues: Two reservoirs only; univariate lagged inputs; no uncertainty or extreme-flow analysis.

cb2e9d4ed7b36ce250de76c1f41234aa81c2abe0.goal: Forecasts PM2.5 concentrations across Taiwan to support air pollution warning.
cb2e9d4ed7b36ce250de76c1f41234aa81c2abe0.architecture: Recurrent neural network with long short-term memory (LSTM) built in Keras/TensorFlow.
cb2e9d4ed7b36ce250de76c1f41234aa81c2abe0.data: Taiwan EPA monitoring data, 2012-2016 for training (20-dimensional input), 2017 for testing, at 66 stations.
cb2e9d4ed7b36ce250de76c1f41234aa81c2abe0.result: The LSTM effectively forecasts PM2.5 for the next four hours; no quantitative scores in the abstract.
cb2e9d4ed7b36ce250de76c1f41234aa81c2abe0.open_work: Adding meteorological forecasts and longer horizons is a natural extension.
cb2e9d4ed7b36ce250de76c1f41234aa81c2abe0.issues: No baseline comparison or metrics reported in the abstract; short horizon.

8438f479ae4ec222afc6febfaea82b0c98a719e3.goal: Identifies the most accurate time-series model for wind speed prediction for renewable energy integration.
8438f479ae4ec222afc6febfaea82b0c98a719e3.architecture: Compares artificial neural networks (ANN), recurrent neural networks (RNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) with ARIMA.
8438f479ae4ec222afc6febfaea82b0c98a719e3.data: Measured wind speed time series; site and period not reported in the abstract.
8438f479ae4ec222afc6febfaea82b0c98a719e3.result: LSTM is more accurate than ARIMA by RMSE.
8438f479ae4ec222afc6febfaea82b0c98a719e3.open_work: Multi-step and long-term forecasting with richer inputs is still not well resolved.
8438f479ae4ec222afc6febfaea82b0c98a719e3.issues: Single metric; limited details on data and tuning; univariate setting.

09cffce33a9ae72e9e5de21f404b80b4c03a74cd.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction with a probabilistic hybrid model.
09cffce33a9ae72e9e5de21f404b80b4c03a74cd.architecture: Hybrid approach built on Gaussian process regression (GPR), combined with other time-series components.
09cffce33a9ae72e9e5de21f404b80b4c03a74cd.data: Measured wind speed series from wind farm sites; details not reported here.
09cffce33a9ae72e9e5de21f404b80b4c03a74cd.result: Not reported in the abstract; the hybrid is presented as more accurate than its component and benchmark models and providing prediction intervals.
09cffce33a9ae72e9e5de21f404b80b4c03a74cd.open_work: Multi-step and multi-site extensions are natural next steps.
09cffce33a9ae72e9e5de21f404b80b4c03a74cd.issues: No abstract available to confirm the components, data or scores.

49ac671a95d56eb554bffcf8e661d747975f54c1.goal: Estimates half-hourly soil temperature at several depths from meteorological data on the Loess Plateau, China.
