49ac671a95d56eb554bffcf8e661d747975f54c1.architecture: Compares extreme learning machine (ELM), generalized regression neural network (GRNN), backpropagation neural network (BPNN) and random forests (RF).
49ac671a95d56eb554bffcf8e661d747975f54c1.data: Field experiment on the Loess Plateau: half-hourly soil temperature at 2, 5, 10 and 20 cm with air temperature, wind speed, humidity, solar radiation and vapor pressure deficit as inputs.
49ac671a95d56eb554bffcf8e661d747975f54c1.result: All models perform well: RMSE about 2.3-3.1 °C, NSE 0.84-0.93; ELM is slightly best.
49ac671a95d56eb554bffcf8e661d747975f54c1.open_work: Testing at other sites and deeper layers would assess transferability.
49ac671a95d56eb554bffcf8e661d747975f54c1.issues: Single site; differences between models are small; no soil moisture or prior-time inputs mentioned.

922a2d17ba01dd291db62452235d9d14cf7bbb82.goal: Forecasts air pollutant indicator levels in Istanbul three days ahead to support public warnings.
922a2d17ba01dd291db62452235d9d14cf7bbb82.architecture: Feed-forward neural networks combined with geographic models that use data from neighboring districts as inputs.
922a2d17ba01dd291db62452235d9d14cf7bbb82.data: Air pollutant (e.g., SO2, PM10, CO) and meteorological measurements from monitoring stations in Istanbul districts; period not reported here.
922a2d17ba01dd291db62452235d9d14cf7bbb82.result: Not reported in the abstract; including geographic neighborhood information is reported to reduce forecast errors relative to non-geographic models.
922a2d17ba01dd291db62452235d9d14cf7bbb82.open_work: Including meteorological forecasts and longer records would extend the approach.
922a2d17ba01dd291db62452235d9d14cf7bbb82.issues: No abstract available to confirm data and scores; city-specific model.

98be9fa836f3fd0c8cad95d5c8f483833ac6c6e8.goal: Forecasts reference evapotranspiration with soft computing methods for agricultural water management.
98be9fa836f3fd0c8cad95d5c8f483833ac6c6e8.architecture: Soft computing models compared; specific types (e.g., support vector machines, neural networks, genetic programming hybrids) are not confirmed here.
98be9fa836f3fd0c8cad95d5c8f483833ac6c6e8.data: Meteorological station data with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ETo as reference; region and period not reported here.
98be9fa836f3fd0c8cad95d5c8f483833ac6c6e8.open_work: Testing over more stations and climates would assess generalization.
98be9fa836f3fd0c8cad95d5c8f483833ac6c6e8.issues: No abstract available; target is a computed ETo rather than measured ET.

d4fefe70c9ed7efdd771fd1f6759774a9bcf0268.goal: Estimates multi-layer, high-resolution soil moisture in ungauged locations across CONUS for agricultural water management and drought monitoring.
d4fefe70c9ed7efdd771fd1f6759774a9bcf0268.architecture: Extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) trained region-wise and layer-wise after clustering CONUS into homogeneous regions by climate and landscape controls.
d4fefe70c9ed7efdd771fd1f6759774a9bcf0268.data: SMAP Level 4 surface and root-zone soil moisture plus climate and landscape predictors; in situ soil moisture from SCAN, SNOTEL and USCRN as targets; 1-km output at 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100 cm.
d4fefe70c9ed7efdd771fd1f6759774a9bcf0268.result: Validation at 79 independent sites shows most achieve ubRMSE below 0.04 m3/m3; predictor importance changes with depth and meteorological variables matter least.
d4fefe70c9ed7efdd771fd1f6759774a9bcf0268.open_work: Extending to other continents and to near-real-time products is a natural next step.
d4fefe70c9ed7efdd771fd1f6759774a9bcf0268.issues: Sparse in situ networks limit training in some regions; inherits SMAP L4 model biases; deep layers harder to validate.

0a9be3386a9e9c0900e2c90a9915b32513c77be5.goal: Estimates daily maximum, minimum and mean air temperature from MODIS land surface temperature in mountainous northwest Vietnam.
0a9be3386a9e9c0900e2c90a9915b32513c77be5.architecture: Compares multiple linear regression, Cubist regression and random forest using combinations of four MODIS LST datasets with or without auxiliary data.
0a9be3386a9e9c0900e2c90a9915b32513c77be5.data: MODIS LST (Aqua and Terra, day and night), elevation and Julian day; three climate stations, 2009-2013.
0a9be3386a9e9c0900e2c90a9915b32513c77be5.result: With auxiliary data, Cubist or random forest give R2 above 0.93/0.80/0.89 and RMSE about 1.5/2.0/1.6 °C for Ta-max, Ta-min and Ta-mean.
0a9be3386a9e9c0900e2c90a9915b32513c77be5.open_work: Testing with more stations and cloud-gap filling would support spatial mapping.
0a9be3386a9e9c0900e2c90a9915b32513c77be5.issues: Only three stations; MODIS LST gaps under cloud; spatial transferability not tested.

37e231a1c5ec5b6d8683ffe8a5b3ff7eedd42e80.goal: Forecasts Beijing's air quality index to support environmental management decisions.
37e231a1c5ec5b6d8683ffe8a5b3ff7eedd42e80.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM: a convolutional neural network extracts features, which an LSTM uses to learn temporal dynamics; compared with ARMA, SARIMA, RNN, LSTM and GRU.
37e231a1c5ec5b6d8683ffe8a5b3ff7eedd42e80.data: Beijing air quality index time series; period not reported in the abstract.
37e231a1c5ec5b6d8683ffe8a5b3ff7eedd42e80.result: CNN-LSTM is most accurate; relative to SARIMA, MAE and RMSE drop 3.17% and 5.46% and R2 rises 8.45%.
37e231a1c5ec5b6d8683ffe8a5b3ff7eedd42e80.open_work: Adding meteorological and emission inputs and multi-step forecasts is a natural extension.
37e231a1c5ec5b6d8683ffe8a5b3ff7eedd42e80.issues: Modest improvements; single city; univariate index without meteorological drivers.

ec64da6f7eedac5dc138db5570a73d168a7ede54.goal: Optimizes short-term operation of a hydro-wind-solar hybrid system under renewable output uncertainty.
ec64da6f7eedac5dc138db5570a73d168a7ede54.architecture: Improved generative adversarial networks (GAN) generate wind and PV power scenarios capturing spatio-temporal correlations, feeding a stochastic mixed-integer linear program solved in two stages with a heuristic unit commitment.
ec64da6f7eedac5dc138db5570a73d168a7ede54.data: Measured wind farm and PV plant data from a renewable energy base in southwest China, with cascade hydropower stations.
ec64da6f7eedac5dc138db5570a73d168a7ede54.result: The hybrid system can meet power transmission demand with coordinated operation, and GAN scenarios further improve system performance.
ec64da6f7eedac5dc138db5570a73d168a7ede54.open_work: Extending to longer horizons and including market or load uncertainty are natural next steps.
ec64da6f7eedac5dc138db5570a73d168a7ede54.issues: GAN scenario quality is hard to verify for extremes; linearization of hydropower nonlinearities introduces approximations; single case study.

1b0634af7eeb45f09c662d737db1b03be0244f73.goal: Forecasts solar radiation two days ahead from observed meteorological data to estimate photovoltaic power output.
1b0634af7eeb45f09c662d737db1b03be0244f73.architecture: Wavelet recurrent neural network (WRNN) that takes timescale bands of second-generation wavelet coefficients as input, predicts in the wavelet domain and performs the inverse wavelet transform to output the signal.
1b0634af7eeb45f09c662d737db1b03be0244f73.data: Observed solar radiation, wind speed, humidity and temperature time series from an experimental station at the University of Catania, Italy.
1b0634af7eeb45f09c662d737db1b03be0244f73.result: The WRNN yields very low RMSE, lower than hybrid neural network solar radiation predictors reported in the literature; exact values are not reported in the abstract.
1b0634af7eeb45f09c662d737db1b03be0244f73.open_work: Testing on other sites and climates, longer horizons and comparison with NWP-based solar forecasts would establish generality.
1b0634af7eeb45f09c662d737db1b03be0244f73.issues: Single-site dataset; comparison is against literature results rather than a common benchmark; no uncertainty quantification.

41f9f994304aaf6f1025adc8c584cbdc310ae0a6.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels 1–3 months ahead when levels show multiscale changes, for irrigation, water supply and land-subsidence management.
41f9f994304aaf6f1025adc8c584cbdc310ae0a6.architecture: Wavelet transforms coupled properly (avoiding future-data leakage) with machine learning models including eXtreme Gradient Boosting (gradient boosting) and random forest.
41f9f994304aaf6f1025adc8c584cbdc310ae0a6.data: Groundwater level records and drivers such as rainfall for 7 wells in Kumamoto City, southern Japan.
41f9f994304aaf6f1025adc8c584cbdc310ae0a6.result: Properly coupled wavelet–ML models give accurate 1–3 month groundwater level forecasts; the paper highlights that commonly neglected wavelet issues make many published forecasts unusable in practice.
41f9f994304aaf6f1025adc8c584cbdc310ae0a6.open_work: Extending the correct wavelet–ML coupling to other aquifers, longer leads and probabilistic forecasts.
41f9f994304aaf6f1025adc8c584cbdc310ae0a6.issues: Limited to 7 wells in one city; specific skill metrics are not reported in the abstract.

d1f4b1b8c0cd4f7ac8de8ea4c7ccb207678c8a4a.goal: Improves PM2.5 concentration forecasting for haze management, addressing LSTM gradient issues and arbitrary choice of wavelet order and decomposition levels.
d1f4b1b8c0cd4f7ac8de8ea4c7ccb207678c8a4a.architecture: Hybrid WT-SAE-LSTM: wavelet transform decomposition into frequency components, each predicted by a stacked autoencoder plus LSTM, then reconstructed.
d1f4b1b8c0cd4f7ac8de8ea4c7ccb207678c8a4a.data: PM2.5 time series from six study sites in China.
d1f4b1b8c0cd4f7ac8de8ea4c7ccb207678c8a4a.result: SAE-LSTM outperforms comparison models such as BP neural networks; the most appropriate wavelet order and level differ by site (e.g. five orders, six or seven layers).
d1f4b1b8c0cd4f7ac8de8ea4c7ccb207678c8a4a.open_work: Automatic selection of wavelet settings and inclusion of meteorological and emission predictors.
d1f4b1b8c0cd4f7ac8de8ea4c7ccb207678c8a4a.issues: Univariate time-series approach; site-specific tuning of wavelet parameters; quantitative error values not reported in the abstract.

fb3ace5081187da4d67d976a4dd646e9fc29854a.goal: Maps urban floods from SAR, where detection in built-up areas is difficult, and reduces the need for large annotated training sets.
fb3ace5081187da4d67d976a4dd646e9fc29854a.architecture: Active self-learning convolutional neural network (A-SL CNN) with temporal-ensembling CNN for sample selection, multi-scale spatial-filter pseudo-labelling and consistency regularization.
fb3ace5081187da4d67d976a4dd646e9fc29854a.data: Multi-temporal TerraSAR-X intensity and interferometric coherence over Houston, USA, during Hurricane Harvey, August 2017.
fb3ace5081187da4d67d976a4dd646e9fc29854a.result: Multi-temporal pre- and co-event intensity is the most important input, coherence improves reliability, and A-SL CNN raises kappa from 0.614 to 0.686 versus the supervised counterpart.
fb3ace5081187da4d67d976a4dd646e9fc29854a.open_work: Testing on other cities and sensors and in operational rapid-mapping settings.
fb3ace5081187da4d67d976a4dd646e9fc29854a.issues: Single flood event case study; relies on pre-event TerraSAR-X acquisitions and coherence that may not always be available.

9efaa8073b26a2864135cecdddc7af9b91474f38.goal: Short-term wind power forecasting using an attention mechanism with deep learning to support grid operation.
9efaa8073b26a2864135cecdddc7af9b91474f38.architecture: Attention-based deep learning model; the specific network type is not specified in the available metadata.
9efaa8073b26a2864135cecdddc7af9b91474f38.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
9efaa8073b26a2864135cecdddc7af9b91474f38.open_work: Not reported; validation across multiple farms and horizons would follow naturally.
9efaa8073b26a2864135cecdddc7af9b91474f38.issues: Card based only on the title; data, horizon and skill unknown.

9d591544b9f179d93ad85720e8382e8e1c04c916.goal: Wind power prediction using a hybrid attention-based deep learning approach.
9d591544b9f179d93ad85720e8382e8e1c04c916.architecture: Hybrid attention-based deep learning model; the specific network components are not specified in the available metadata.
