9d591544b9f179d93ad85720e8382e8e1c04c916.open_work: Not reported; generalization to other wind farms and probabilistic output would follow naturally.
9d591544b9f179d93ad85720e8382e8e1c04c916.issues: Card based only on the title; data and quantitative results unknown.

6c96916186bbd66134bd5c643adeb2996590119a.goal: Short-term wind speed prediction from large, high-resolution wind history datasets for wind farm warning and regulation.
6c96916186bbd66134bd5c643adeb2996590119a.architecture: EEMD decomposition into intrinsic mode functions as candidate features, with a genetic algorithm selecting the feature subset jointly with an LSTM recurrent neural network.
6c96916186bbd66134bd5c643adeb2996590119a.data: Large-scale high-temporal-resolution wind speed time series; site details not reported in the abstract.
6c96916186bbd66134bd5c643adeb2996590119a.result: Decomposed sequences as inputs significantly improve accuracy over mainstream models, and GA feature selection reduces dimension while improving accuracy by up to 28.33%.
6c96916186bbd66134bd5c643adeb2996590119a.open_work: Application to multi-site and longer-horizon wind prediction and reducing computational cost of the GA search.
6c96916186bbd66134bd5c643adeb2996590119a.issues: Point forecasts only; EEMD on full series can leak future information if not applied causally; site and data specifics unclear.

8e131dfa9db62637c0aa71c4883faee06285d4ee.goal: Predicts groundwater level fluctuations from meteorological drivers and compares soft computing techniques.
8e131dfa9db62637c0aa71c4883faee06285d4ee.architecture: Comparison of soft computing models including artificial neural networks (MLP), adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS), gene expression programming and support vector machines.
8e131dfa9db62637c0aa71c4883faee06285d4ee.data: Groundwater level and meteorological records from observation wells in South Korea; exact periods not reported here.
8e131dfa9db62637c0aa71c4883faee06285d4ee.result: Not reported in the available metadata beyond the comparative ranking of the soft computing methods.
8e131dfa9db62637c0aa71c4883faee06285d4ee.open_work: Longer lead times and testing on more wells and aquifer types.
8e131dfa9db62637c0aa71c4883faee06285d4ee.issues: No abstract available; details on data and quantitative results are not confirmed.

6d134023ef0637de93219d68ba4c362e1afb7d9a.goal: Short-term forecasting of solar irradiance by combining satellite imaging and ground telemetry as inputs.
6d134023ef0637de93219d68ba4c362e1afb7d9a.architecture: Artificial neural networks (MLP) fed with cloud-related indices derived from satellite images and ground-measured irradiance telemetry.
6d134023ef0637de93219d68ba4c362e1afb7d9a.data: Geostationary satellite imagery and ground irradiance measurements in California; exact periods not reported here.
6d134023ef0637de93219d68ba4c362e1afb7d9a.result: The hybrid inputs improve intra-hour to few-hour irradiance forecasts over persistence; exact skill values are not reported here.
6d134023ef0637de93219d68ba4c362e1afb7d9a.open_work: Better cloud-motion representation and probabilistic forecasts.
6d134023ef0637de93219d68ba4c362e1afb7d9a.issues: No abstract available; single-site evaluation and limited horizon range.

639d956743eded7b49c5ea2d70759caf9acf05f1.goal: Corrects NWP wind speed errors to improve short-term wind power forecasting for grid scheduling and electricity trading.
639d956743eded7b49c5ea2d70759caf9acf05f1.architecture: Bidirectional gated recurrent unit (GRU) recurrent neural network error-correction model using NWP wind speed and trend/detail terms of an error-weight series, followed by a wind power curve model.
639d956743eded7b49c5ea2d70759caf9acf05f1.data: NWP wind speed forecasts and actual wind farm measurements; site not reported in the abstract.
639d956743eded7b49c5ea2d70759caf9acf05f1.result: The proposed model outperforms benchmark models in short-term wind power forecasting; numeric gains are not reported in the abstract.
639d956743eded7b49c5ea2d70759caf9acf05f1.open_work: Extension to multiple farms and probabilistic forecasts.
639d956743eded7b49c5ea2d70759caf9acf05f1.issues: Single wind farm data; relies on a deterministic power curve; quantitative results not given in the abstract.

1363319b8d55512fa25247ac92c860330ef4dfe8.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasts by adjusting numerical weather prediction inputs using data mining.
1363319b8d55512fa25247ac92c860330ef4dfe8.architecture: Data-mining-based adjustment of NWP inputs before a wind power forecasting model; the specific learning algorithm is not specified in the available metadata.
1363319b8d55512fa25247ac92c860330ef4dfe8.data: NWP forecasts and wind farm power data; details not reported (no abstract available).
1363319b8d55512fa25247ac92c860330ef4dfe8.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
1363319b8d55512fa25247ac92c860330ef4dfe8.open_work: Not reported; extension to other farms and NWP sources would follow naturally.
1363319b8d55512fa25247ac92c860330ef4dfe8.issues: Card based mainly on the title; methods and results unconfirmed.

a2bdbf0d077df606641d42ddabda656790cc5086.goal: Predicts photovoltaic power hours ahead at utility scale, capturing both hourly trends and intra-hour fluctuations from cloud movement.
a2bdbf0d077df606641d42ddabda656790cc5086.architecture: Hybrid framework of three temporal convolutional networks (TCN, a convolutional neural network for sequences): blending NWP sources in a physics-based trend model, capturing spatio-temporal neighbour correlations, and reconciling both outputs.
a2bdbf0d077df606641d42ddabda656790cc5086.data: Multiple NWP sources and actual PV data from 95 PV farms in North Carolina, USA.
a2bdbf0d077df606641d42ddabda656790cc5086.result: 6-hour-ahead PV power forecasting improves by 20–30% over state-of-the-art methods; scenario-based detector-site selection improves capture of large power drops.
a2bdbf0d077df606641d42ddabda656790cc5086.open_work: Transfer to other regions and probabilistic extensions.
a2bdbf0d077df606641d42ddabda656790cc5086.issues: Depends on a dense network of neighbouring PV sites; evaluated in one region.

94e9f48eb1218dd418b62ef7c662100d2d8cabf5.goal: Short-term wind speed forecasting combining signal decomposition with feature selection.
94e9f48eb1218dd418b62ef7c662100d2d8cabf5.architecture: Empirical mode decomposition with a feature selection step feeding a forecasting model; the forecasting model type is not specified in the available metadata.
94e9f48eb1218dd418b62ef7c662100d2d8cabf5.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
94e9f48eb1218dd418b62ef7c662100d2d8cabf5.open_work: Not reported; multi-site evaluation would follow naturally.
94e9f48eb1218dd418b62ef7c662100d2d8cabf5.issues: Card based only on the title; decomposition of full series may leak future information if not done causally.

cbf3ae8323a57672202946c05135ef2ed7ca30e0.goal: Reviews how climate change affects crop yields and how statistical crop models and machine learning estimate these impacts, for food security.
cbf3ae8323a57672202946c05135ef2ed7ca30e0.architecture: Review of about 230 statistical crop modelling studies, covering empirical findings, statistical crop models and machine learning methods.
cbf3ae8323a57672202946c05135ef2ed7ca30e0.data: Published studies for major crops (maize, wheat, soybean and others).
cbf3ae8323a57672202946c05135ef2ed7ca30e0.result: Warming reduces yields: 1 °C warming decreases yields by 7.5 ± 5.3% for maize, 6.0 ± 3.3% for wheat and 6.8 ± 5.9% for soybean.
cbf3ae8323a57672202946c05135ef2ed7ca30e0.open_work: Better integration of ML with process understanding, adaptation effects and extreme events; specifics not in the truncated abstract.
cbf3ae8323a57672202946c05135ef2ed7ca30e0.issues: Abstract is truncated; conclusions on ML methods are not visible in the provided text.

b2fb9a9caa0ce8e49e4a00a85000ff3d88f7316e.goal: Determines dominant European drought types and how drought typology has changed over centuries, given limits of single-index approaches.
b2fb9a9caa0ce8e49e4a00a85000ff3d88f7316e.architecture: Multidimensional machine-learning-based clustering of drought events in space and time.
b2fb9a9caa0ce8e49e4a00a85000ff3d88f7316e.data: Multi-century hydrologic reconstruction of European drought (model-based soil moisture/runoff reconstruction).
b2fb9a9caa0ce8e49e4a00a85000ff3d88f7316e.result: Shorter warm-season droughts have increased substantially, concurrent with rising potential evapotranspiration, replacing other drought types.
b2fb9a9caa0ce8e49e4a00a85000ff3d88f7316e.open_work: Implications for adaptive water management and vegetation and ecosystem changes if shifts persist.
b2fb9a9caa0ce8e49e4a00a85000ff3d88f7316e.issues: Relies on a model-based reconstruction with its own uncertainties, especially in early centuries.

bf0ef3a9eda33fe7f71566215b182b1074806091.goal: Forecasts marine environmental time series from noisy, redundant sensor big data.
bf0ef3a9eda33fe7f71566215b182b1074806091.architecture: Semi-supervised model combining an improved unsupervised clustering algorithm for a fuzzy partition function with a neural network prediction function, run on Spark.
bf0ef3a9eda33fe7f71566215b182b1074806091.data: Marine environmental factor datasets and UCI public datasets.
bf0ef3a9eda33fe7f71566215b182b1074806091.result: The method achieves satisfactory prediction compared with traditional methods and runs efficiently on Spark; numbers not reported in the abstract.
bf0ef3a9eda33fe7f71566215b182b1074806091.open_work: Application to operational ocean monitoring and multi-step forecasting.
bf0ef3a9eda33fe7f71566215b182b1074806091.issues: Marine datasets and variables are vaguely described; generic method not tailored to ocean physics.

7f3e80bc3e56e833d8a17800074b4722c1d4ceec.goal: Maps real-time intra-urban air pollution health risk where fixed monitoring networks are sparse.
7f3e80bc3e56e833d8a17800074b4722c1d4ceec.architecture: Neural network (MLP) models in a land-use-regression-inspired framework, with a relative importance measure for interpretability.
7f3e80bc3e56e833d8a17800074b4722c1d4ceec.data: Mobile monitoring campaigns in Hamilton, Canada, 2005–2013, with land use, meteorology, fixed-monitor concentrations and traffic; 20% held out for validation.
7f3e80bc3e56e833d8a17800074b4722c1d4ceec.result: Validation R² is 0.78 for PM2.5 and 0.34 for NO2.
7f3e80bc3e56e833d8a17800074b4722c1d4ceec.open_work: Improving NO2 prediction and expanding mobile data coverage.
7f3e80bc3e56e833d8a17800074b4722c1d4ceec.issues: Weak NO2 skill; mobile sampling is sparse in time; single city.

810391bebd89223c8d4eaaa644b965b8542f621d.goal: Predicts daily global solar radiation at sites without stations using gridded reanalysis fields, to support solar energy site assessment.
810391bebd89223c8d4eaaa644b965b8542f621d.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) compared with support vector regression, Gaussian process regression, genetic programming and statistical models (ARIMA, temperature model, Fourier series), with NCA feature selection.
810391bebd89223c8d4eaaa644b965b8542f621d.data: 87 ERA-Interim predictors (1979–2015) for 5 Queensland, Australia sites, targeted against SILO surface radiation; 70/15/15 split.
810391bebd89223c8d4eaaa644b965b8542f621d.result: ANN performs best with RMSE 1.715–2.27 MJ m-2 day-1 versus 2.14–5.90 for other models, robust across ENSO and IOD phases (RRMSE ≤ 11%).
810391bebd89223c8d4eaaa644b965b8542f621d.open_work: Applying to forecast rather than reanalysis fields and other climates.
810391bebd89223c8d4eaaa644b965b8542f621d.issues: Uses reanalysis rather than forecast fields so it is estimation, not true forecasting; limited to five nearby sites.

13aea66f18050187c58b20aa56c0d04a83962719.goal: Multi-step wind speed forecasting for wind farm operational planning given non-linear, volatile wind series.
13aea66f18050187c58b20aa56c0d04a83962719.architecture: Hybrid decomposition (CEEMDAN plus empirical wavelet transform on high-frequency IMFs) with a back-propagation neural network (MLP) optimized by an improved flower-pollination algorithm.
13aea66f18050187c58b20aa56c0d04a83962719.data: Wind speed data from two wind farms in Shandong, China.
13aea66f18050187c58b20aa56c0d04a83962719.result: The proposed model outperforms all compared models for one- to five-step ahead forecasts.
13aea66f18050187c58b20aa56c0d04a83962719.issues: Decomposition-based approaches risk information leakage if applied to the full series; only two farms.

11d264faaacec7f75237ddc20a85dfe875ef8178.goal: Predicts daily and mean monthly global solar radiation in an arid climate for solar energy applications.
11d264faaacec7f75237ddc20a85dfe875ef8178.architecture: Support vector machine (support vector regression) with different combinations of meteorological inputs, compared with empirical models.
11d264faaacec7f75237ddc20a85dfe875ef8178.data: Meteorological and radiation measurements from Ghardaïa, Algeria.
11d264faaacec7f75237ddc20a85dfe875ef8178.result: The SVM gives accurate estimates and outperforms the compared empirical models; exact values are not reported here.
11d264faaacec7f75237ddc20a85dfe875ef8178.open_work: Testing in other arid sites and with satellite inputs.

040bf8a93a9a48a258eef139baf7d30ed52888df.goal: Examines how fire weather and forest management (ownership, plantation forestry) drive fire severity in a mixed-ownership landscape.
040bf8a93a9a48a258eef139baf7d30ed52888df.architecture: Random forest modelling of fire severity against weather, topography, vegetation and ownership/management predictors.
040bf8a93a9a48a258eef139baf7d30ed52888df.data: Satellite-derived burn severity for the 2013 Douglas Complex fire in southwestern Oregon, USA, with daily fire weather and land ownership data.
040bf8a93a9a48a258eef139baf7d30ed52888df.result: Fire weather is the strongest driver, and intensively managed private industrial forests burn at higher severity than other ownerships.
040bf8a93a9a48a258eef139baf7d30ed52888df.open_work: Testing across other fires and management regimes to inform landscape fuel management.
040bf8a93a9a48a258eef139baf7d30ed52888df.issues: Single fire complex; observational design cannot fully separate management from site effects.

0dd63e3582a76143ed8eaa142428ca659b6755ea.goal: Monthly streamflow forecasting with an improved support vector machine model.
0dd63e3582a76143ed8eaa142428ca659b6755ea.architecture: Improved support vector machine (support vector regression); the specific improvement is not specified in the available metadata.
0dd63e3582a76143ed8eaa142428ca659b6755ea.data: Monthly streamflow records; basin not reported (no abstract available).
0dd63e3582a76143ed8eaa142428ca659b6755ea.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
0dd63e3582a76143ed8eaa142428ca659b6755ea.open_work: Not reported; testing on further basins would follow naturally.
0dd63e3582a76143ed8eaa142428ca659b6755ea.issues: Card based only on the title; data and results unknown.

e48f7ae5e705a61c6ceadbef0e0e7950841f6ce9.goal: Estimates daily 1 km PM2.5 inorganic chemical composition across China since 2000 given sparse surface observations and chemical model uncertainty.
e48f7ae5e705a61c6ceadbef0e0e7950841f6ce9.architecture: Four-dimensional spatiotemporal deep forest (4D-STDF), a cascade tree-ensemble (random forest based) deep forest model.
e48f7ae5e705a61c6ceadbef0e0e7950841f6ce9.data: High-density PM2.5 species observations, satellite PM2.5 retrievals, atmospheric reanalyses and chemical model simulations over China, 2000 onward.
e48f7ae5e705a61c6ceadbef0e0e7950841f6ce9.result: CV-R² of 0.74, 0.75, 0.71, 0.66 for sulfate, nitrate, ammonium, chloride (RMSE 6.0, 6.6, 4.3, 2.3 µg m-3); inorganic components fell 40–43% from 2013 to 2020 while SIA share rose.
e48f7ae5e705a61c6ceadbef0e0e7950841f6ce9.open_work: Extending to organic and other species and to uncertainty estimates.
e48f7ae5e705a61c6ceadbef0e0e7950841f6ce9.issues: Early-period estimates depend on sparse observations; cross-validation may overstate skill where stations are absent.

ade63a4190b879b434b26aa1faa61f6ea7434a85.goal: Improves station weather forecasting and quantifies uncertainty by learning from historical data together with NWP prior knowledge.
ade63a4190b879b434b26aa1faa61f6ea7434a85.architecture: End-to-end deep learning model (sequence-to-sequence recurrent neural network) with NWP information fusion, a negative log-likelihood loss and deep ensembles for deep uncertainty quantification.
ade63a4190b879b434b26aa1faa61f6ea7434a85.data: Public dataset from weather stations in Beijing, China, with NWP forecasts (AI Challenger competition data).
ade63a4190b879b434b26aa1faa61f6ea7434a85.result: The NLE loss generalizes better than MSE and MAE losses, and the approach improves accuracy by 47.76% over NWP.
ade63a4190b879b434b26aa1faa61f6ea7434a85.open_work: Applying to more stations and variables and evaluating calibration of the uncertainty.
ade63a4190b879b434b26aa1faa61f6ea7434a85.issues: Limited regional benchmark; Gaussian likelihood assumption for uncertainty.

8c0b31088d7f68fb2ead5a0cf58864042b1b7e10.goal: Estimates solar radiation for cities in Turkey's Mediterranean region to support solar device design.
8c0b31088d7f68fb2ead5a0cf58864042b1b7e10.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) with the number of input parameters varied from 2 to 6.
8c0b31088d7f68fb2ead5a0cf58864042b1b7e10.data: Turkish State Meteorological Service data for seven cities; 2006 for testing and 2005, 2007, 2008 estimated.
8c0b31088d7f68fb2ead5a0cf58864042b1b7e10.result: The ANN estimates solar radiation adequately, and the number of input parameters is the most influential factor on accuracy.
8c0b31088d7f68fb2ead5a0cf58864042b1b7e10.open_work: Extending to more regions and comparing with other ML and empirical models.
8c0b31088d7f68fb2ead5a0cf58864042b1b7e10.issues: Short record of a few years; no quantitative metrics given in the abstract.

b292e8bf5bbf87814631b3878157c10ccc60ca97.goal: Forecasts solar power for distributed PV in smart grids by exploiting spatial and temporal dependence among neighbouring systems.
b292e8bf5bbf87814631b3878157c10ccc60ca97.architecture: Vector autoregression framework (statistical time-series model, not a neural network) using data from distributed PV sites, with a distributed learning variant.
b292e8bf5bbf87814631b3878157c10ccc60ca97.data: Power data from distributed residential PV systems in a smart grid pilot in Portugal.
b292e8bf5bbf87814631b3878157c10ccc60ca97.result: Using spatio-temporal information improves forecasts over single-site models for horizons up to a few hours; exact gains not reported here.
b292e8bf5bbf87814631b3878157c10ccc60ca97.open_work: Privacy-preserving and distributed estimation, and probabilistic extensions.
b292e8bf5bbf87814631b3878157c10ccc60ca97.issues: No abstract available; linear model may miss nonlinear cloud effects.

399ccbcfb9d1477fc3ea879213f9bded3e4dcb10.goal: Forecasts wind and solar power generation with hybrid deep learning models.
399ccbcfb9d1477fc3ea879213f9bded3e4dcb10.architecture: Hybrid CNN-ABiLSTM (convolutional neural network with attention-based bidirectional LSTM) and CNN-Transformer-MLP models.
399ccbcfb9d1477fc3ea879213f9bded3e4dcb10.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
399ccbcfb9d1477fc3ea879213f9bded3e4dcb10.open_work: Not reported; generalization across sites and probabilistic output would follow naturally.
399ccbcfb9d1477fc3ea879213f9bded3e4dcb10.issues: Card based only on the title; data and results unknown.

eb55899ab77837222a6d104fd1317b27d3bd2595.goal: Monthly streamflow forecasting with a hybrid optimization-tuned support vector machine.
eb55899ab77837222a6d104fd1317b27d3bd2595.architecture: Support vector machine (support vector regression) with parameters optimized by particle swarm optimization.
eb55899ab77837222a6d104fd1317b27d3bd2595.data: Monthly streamflow records; rivers not reported (no abstract available).
eb55899ab77837222a6d104fd1317b27d3bd2595.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
eb55899ab77837222a6d104fd1317b27d3bd2595.open_work: Not reported; comparison with other learners and more basins would follow naturally.
eb55899ab77837222a6d104fd1317b27d3bd2595.issues: Card based only on the title; data and results unknown.

5611ae0a4d69fccb5d3c43d42f793167f8c83976.goal: Predicts daily global solar radiation using a hybrid metaheuristic and machine learning approach.
5611ae0a4d69fccb5d3c43d42f793167f8c83976.architecture: Coral Reefs Optimization metaheuristic for feature selection combined with an extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer neural network).
5611ae0a4d69fccb5d3c43d42f793167f8c83976.data: Meteorological predictor data and measured daily global solar radiation at a station in Spain.
5611ae0a4d69fccb5d3c43d42f793167f8c83976.result: The CRO-ELM hybrid improves on ELM without feature selection and other alternatives; exact values not reported here.
5611ae0a4d69fccb5d3c43d42f793167f8c83976.open_work: Testing at more sites and with satellite or NWP predictors.

47cd3bf6a39daaa866b75d0e1cd392d3dc722601.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power when site weather data are rough or sensors are unreliable.
47cd3bf6a39daaa866b75d0e1cd392d3dc722601.architecture: Convolutional neural network combined with LSTM recurrent neural network.
47cd3bf6a39daaa866b75d0e1cd392d3dc722601.data: PV power records with roughly estimated weather data from national weather centers; site details not reported in the abstract.
47cd3bf6a39daaa866b75d0e1cd392d3dc722601.result: The method predicts solar power well with coarse weather inputs and is robust without outlier-removal preprocessing; numbers not reported in the abstract.
47cd3bf6a39daaa866b75d0e1cd392d3dc722601.issues: No quantitative metrics or baseline details given in the abstract.

e27489b8b3d54759e615d304d2c0b7467a0d7129.goal: Improves ANN rainfall–runoff modelling by space–time pre-processing of satellite precipitation and runoff data.
e27489b8b3d54759e615d304d2c0b7467a0d7129.architecture: Self-organizing maps (unsupervised neural network) cluster spatial satellite rainfall, wavelet transforms decompose time series, and a feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) predicts runoff.
e27489b8b3d54759e615d304d2c0b7467a0d7129.data: TRMM satellite precipitation and observed runoff for a watershed in Iran (Ajichay).
e27489b8b3d54759e615d304d2c0b7467a0d7129.result: SOM and wavelet pre-processing improve runoff prediction over ANN without pre-processing; exact values not reported here.
e27489b8b3d54759e615d304d2c0b7467a0d7129.open_work: Testing on other basins and with newer satellite precipitation products.
e27489b8b3d54759e615d304d2c0b7467a0d7129.issues: No abstract available; single watershed; wavelet decomposition may leak future information if not causal.

127597cb7cbabaaa6e71fb82c047040806cc14c2.goal: Regional wind power forecasting 24–72 hours ahead for power systems with high wind penetration.
127597cb7cbabaaa6e71fb82c047040806cc14c2.architecture: Multi-to-multi mapping network with stacked denoising autoencoders (deep neural network) correcting multiple NWPs and an ensemble of SDAEs for regional and farm-level forecasts.
127597cb7cbabaaa6e71fb82c047040806cc14c2.data: Multiple NWP forecasts and wind farm power data from a region; two datasets.
127597cb7cbabaaa6e71fb82c047040806cc14c2.result: The m2m mapping and SDAE capture inter-site correlations and outperform counterparts for NWP correction and regional and individual farm forecasts; ensemble SDAE beats individual models.
127597cb7cbabaaa6e71fb82c047040806cc14c2.open_work: Probabilistic regional forecasts and transfer to other regions.
127597cb7cbabaaa6e71fb82c047040806cc14c2.issues: Quantitative gains not given in the abstract; deterministic only.

69889f2b1f3d6258fa3494237863ce540c8bfa43.goal: Evaluates gap-filling strategies for missing satellite AOD in daily 1 km PM2.5 prediction.
69889f2b1f3d6258fa3494237863ce540c8bfa43.architecture: Random forest PM2.5 model combined with four gap-filling strategies (multiple imputation, decision tree, ordinary kriging, generalized additive mixed model).
69889f2b1f3d6258fa3494237863ce540c8bfa43.data: Ground PM2.5 observations, chemical transport model simulations and satellite AOD for 2013 in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei and the Yangtze River Delta.
69889f2b1f3d6258fa3494237863ce540c8bfa43.result: Regression-based gap-filling (multiple imputation, decision tree) is robust, kriging and GAMM are overrated and oversmooth, and CTM inputs help even at 12 km resolution.
69889f2b1f3d6258fa3494237863ce540c8bfa43.open_work: Extending evaluation to other years, regions and sparse-station settings.
69889f2b1f3d6258fa3494237863ce540c8bfa43.issues: Single year and two regions; out-of-bag metrics may overstate skill.

77091353610aaecb343c3b945a77f05709bc4e80.goal: Wind speed forecasting with decomposition and evolutionary-optimized neural networks.
77091353610aaecb343c3b945a77f05709bc4e80.architecture: Fast ensemble empirical mode decomposition with artificial neural networks (MLP) optimized by genetic algorithm and Mind Evolutionary Algorithm.
77091353610aaecb343c3b945a77f05709bc4e80.data: Wind speed series; site not reported (no abstract available).
77091353610aaecb343c3b945a77f05709bc4e80.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
77091353610aaecb343c3b945a77f05709bc4e80.open_work: Not reported; probabilistic and multi-site extensions would follow naturally.
77091353610aaecb343c3b945a77f05709bc4e80.issues: Card based only on the title; decomposition of full series may leak future information if not causal.

2f22538f443f961368186b2a6be306e27080c39f.goal: Compares deep learning models for hourly short-term streamflow forecasting.
2f22538f443f961368186b2a6be306e27080c39f.architecture: Comparative evaluation of LSTM, convolutional neural network (CNN) and ConvLSTM.
2f22538f443f961368186b2a6be306e27080c39f.data: Hourly streamflow data; basin not reported (no abstract available).
2f22538f443f961368186b2a6be306e27080c39f.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
2f22538f443f961368186b2a6be306e27080c39f.open_work: Not reported; testing on more basins and lead times would follow naturally.
2f22538f443f961368186b2a6be306e27080c39f.issues: Card based only on the title; data and results unknown.

5f90348454c4e197a8150f2d49624ac83478ebfd.goal: Projects spatial and temporal rainfall changes in Bangladesh by downscaling GCM output.
5f90348454c4e197a8150f2d49624ac83478ebfd.architecture: Model output statistics downscaling using support vector machine (support vector regression), with GCM ensemble selection by past performance and envelope methods.
5f90348454c4e197a8150f2d49624ac83478ebfd.data: CMIP5 GCMs under four RCPs, with GPCC gauge-based gridded monthly rainfall as reference.
5f90348454c4e197a8150f2d49624ac83478ebfd.result: SVM-MOS reproduces GPCC variability; annual rainfall changes range from -4.2% to 24.6%, increasing more in the drier west and during monsoon.
5f90348454c4e197a8150f2d49624ac83478ebfd.open_work: Daily-scale downscaling and extremes, and CMIP6 updates.
5f90348454c4e197a8150f2d49624ac83478ebfd.issues: Monthly scale only; stationarity assumption of statistical downscaling.

797ff1e852c0c4f283ed30d1db7034b09db39125.goal: Hourly PM2.5 concentration forecasting for public health early warning.
797ff1e852c0c4f283ed30d1db7034b09db39125.architecture: Ensemble LSTM (E-LSTM): EEMD decomposition into modes, an LSTM per mode with meteorological inputs, and inverse EEMD integration.
797ff1e852c0c4f283ed30d1db7034b09db39125.data: PM2.5 and meteorological data from two environmental monitoring stations in Beijing, China.
797ff1e852c0c4f283ed30d1db7034b09db39125.result: E-LSTM beats single LSTM and feed-forward networks, with MAPE 19.6% and 16.9%, RMSE 12.1 and 14.0 µg m-3 and correlation 0.994 and 0.991.
797ff1e852c0c4f283ed30d1db7034b09db39125.open_work: Longer lead times and more stations.
797ff1e852c0c4f283ed30d1db7034b09db39125.issues: Only two stations; EEMD on full series may leak future information; one-hour-ahead only.

849c66f241d6b870339e29eac2cbd17e820a1d34.goal: Quantifies how land surface temperature differs from air temperature in cities and what controls their relationship.
849c66f241d6b870339e29eac2cbd17e820a1d34.architecture: Machine learning analysis of LST–Ta relationships with urban form predictors; the specific algorithm is not specified in the abstract.
849c66f241d6b870339e29eac2cbd17e820a1d34.data: Crowdsourced air temperature in Sydney, Australia, satellite LST, high-resolution imagery, urban landscape data and Local Climate Zones.
849c66f241d6b870339e29eac2cbd17e820a1d34.result: LST and Ta differ in space and season; dense built areas show insignificant or negative summer LST–Ta relations, so LST is an inappropriate proxy for urban thermal environment there.
849c66f241d6b870339e29eac2cbd17e820a1d34.open_work: Extending to other cities and combining with canopy-layer modelling.
849c66f241d6b870339e29eac2cbd17e820a1d34.issues: Crowdsourced sensors have quality issues; single city.

7196ad80a4afc53579e100fb196d28a3656f792c.goal: Estimates surface soil moisture from multi-sensor satellite images on the Kosi alluvial fan, Himalayan Foreland.
7196ad80a4afc53579e100fb196d28a3656f792c.architecture: Fully connected feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP), compared with ten ML methods including GRNN, RBN, GPR, SVR, random forest, boosting, RNN and AutoML.
7196ad80a4afc53579e100fb196d28a3656f792c.data: Sentinel-1 backscatter, Sentinel-2 red/NIR and SRTM DEM features with TDR field measurements at 224 locations (Dec 2019, Mar 2022); 60:10:30 split.
7196ad80a4afc53579e100fb196d28a3656f792c.result: The ANN achieves R = 0.80, RMSE 0.040 m3/m3 and bias 0.004 m3/m3, outperforming all benchmarks across thirty resampled splits.
7196ad80a4afc53579e100fb196d28a3656f792c.issues: Small field sample from two campaigns; one region.

a4831623df5266bc4eef7a68e419a7ef8d655d89.goal: Surveys machine learning for crop yield prediction and the factors influencing yield.
a4831623df5266bc4eef7a68e419a7ef8d655d89.architecture: Review/survey of machine learning and deep learning methods for crop yield prediction.
a4831623df5266bc4eef7a68e419a7ef8d655d89.data: Published literature; scope details not reported (no abstract available).
a4831623df5266bc4eef7a68e419a7ef8d655d89.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
a4831623df5266bc4eef7a68e419a7ef8d655d89.open_work: Not reported; standardized benchmarks and data integration are typical open questions.
a4831623df5266bc4eef7a68e419a7ef8d655d89.issues: Card based only on the title.

126ff5ea420dec5069feec7f16706e3f6d93f95c.goal: Improves multi-step wind speed prediction for grid integration by correcting errors of a numerical weather prediction model, since wind is random and volatile.
126ff5ea420dec5069feec7f16706e3f6d93f95c.architecture: Hybrid WRF-VMD-PCA-LSTM: WRF simulates wind speed, variational mode decomposition and PCA extract features, and an LSTM recurrent network corrects the WRF forecast error.
126ff5ea420dec5069feec7f16706e3f6d93f95c.data: WRF wind speed simulations and observed wind speed at a wind farm in Sichuan Province, China; period and resolution not reported in the abstract.
126ff5ea420dec5069feec7f16706e3f6d93f95c.result: The WRF-VMD-PCA-LSTM model outperforms the compared models in multi-step prediction, and VMD-PCA effectively extracts hidden features from WRF output.
126ff5ea420dec5069feec7f16706e3f6d93f95c.open_work: Testing at other wind farms and terrains, longer horizons, and probabilistic error correction would establish generality.
126ff5ea420dec5069feec7f16706e3f6d93f95c.issues: Single wind farm case study; quantitative gains and horizons are not given in the abstract; performance depends on the WRF configuration.

781ec03b9d94fed6372fcb2856fc1d1c78043197.goal: Downscales the MODIS 8-day 1 km evapotranspiration product to 30 m to provide spatially detailed ET for water management.
781ec03b9d94fed6372fcb2856fc1d1c78043197.architecture: Machine learning regression comparing support vector regression, Cubist and random forest, trained at 1 km on upscaled Landsat indicators and applied at 30 m.
781ec03b9d94fed6372fcb2856fc1d1c78043197.data: 32 Landsat 8 image and MODIS 8-day 1 km ET pairs at four sites (two in the United States, two in South Korea), with eleven indicators such as albedo, LST and vegetation indices; in situ ET for validation.
781ec03b9d94fed6372fcb2856fc1d1c78043197.result: Random forest gives the lowest error (rRMSE below 20%); downscaled ET agrees with MODIS ET (average rRMSE 22%) and matches in situ ET better (R2 = 0.56) with more spatial detail.
781ec03b9d94fed6372fcb2856fc1d1c78043197.open_work: Authors propose spatio-temporal fusion of Landsat and MODIS ET to increase the temporal resolution of the downscaled ET.
781ec03b9d94fed6372fcb2856fc1d1c78043197.issues: Accuracy is bounded by the MODIS ET product it is trained on; LST varies within 8-day periods; few sites and image pairs.

dd4d774645a23180d57b6673f64c4ec3a5592b9c.goal: Models the rainfall-runoff process with a neural network that mimics emotional responses, aiming to better capture peaks and nonlinear hydrological behaviour than conventional ANNs.
dd4d774645a23180d57b6673f64c4ec3a5592b9c.architecture: Emotional artificial neural network (EANN): a feed-forward neural network augmented with an artificial emotional (hormonal) system that adjusts weights and activations, compared with a conventional feed-forward ANN.
dd4d774645a23180d57b6673f64c4ec3a5592b9c.data: Observed rainfall and runoff series from catchments at daily and monthly scales; specific basins and periods are not reported here.
dd4d774645a23180d57b6673f64c4ec3a5592b9c.result: The EANN is reported to outperform the conventional feed-forward ANN in rainfall-runoff simulation; exact scores are not reported here.
dd4d774645a23180d57b6673f64c4ec3a5592b9c.open_work: Application to more catchments, multi-step forecasting and comparison with other deep learning models remain open.
dd4d774645a23180d57b6673f64c4ec3a5592b9c.issues: Abstract not available; few catchments; the emotional parameters add tuning complexity and the model is a black box without physical constraints.

a39c37d3a854cdd0b6aeb97ad5154cf866845500.goal: Models how traffic flow and meteorological conditions drive short-term NO2, NOx and PM2.5 concentrations at an urban roadside site.
a39c37d3a854cdd0b6aeb97ad5154cf866845500.architecture: Random forest regression with predictor importance analysis, fitted separately for nine seasonal and climatic time subsets.
a39c37d3a854cdd0b6aeb97ad5154cf866845500.data: Hourly NO2, NOx and PM2.5, wind speed and direction, temperature, pressure, humidity, temporal variables and traffic flow at a station 40 m from a large intersection in Wrocław, Poland, 2015–2016.
a39c37d3a854cdd0b6aeb97ad5154cf866845500.result: Fit is best for the warm season and summer; traffic flow dominates nitrogen oxide concentrations, while temperature, wind speed and direction dominate PM2.5; temporal variables are largely unimportant.
a39c37d3a854cdd0b6aeb97ad5154cf866845500.open_work: Extending to multiple stations, other pollutants and forecasting rather than explanatory modelling would broaden the findings.
a39c37d3a854cdd0b6aeb97ad5154cf866845500.issues: Single station and two years; explanatory rather than predictive validation; importance measures can be biased by correlated predictors.

444c0ef9e263d552714a02807bcaf792f9ce0fd9.goal: Improves day-ahead solar irradiance forecasting, the key input to photovoltaic power forecasting, under complex weather-driven fluctuations.
444c0ef9e263d552714a02807bcaf792f9ce0fd9.architecture: Hybrid deep learning model: discrete wavelet decomposition of irradiance, a convolutional neural network (CNN) feature extractor and LSTM per subsequence, with wavelet reconstruction; separate models for four weather types.
444c0ef9e263d552714a02807bcaf792f9ce0fd9.data: Historical solar irradiance series classified into sunny, cloudy, rainy and heavy rainy days; site and period not reported in the abstract.
444c0ef9e263d552714a02807bcaf792f9ce0fd9.result: The proposed model achieves higher forecasting accuracy than traditional and single deep learning models in the case study.
444c0ef9e263d552714a02807bcaf792f9ce0fd9.open_work: Use of numerical weather prediction inputs and probabilistic forecasts, and tests at more sites, are natural next steps.
444c0ef9e263d552714a02807bcaf792f9ce0fd9.issues: Requires the weather type of the forecast day to be known; no quantitative scores in the abstract; single case study.

4131c0bf30b8579e359746d2edc0d7083f69fcd1.goal: Improves multi-step ahead wind speed forecasting for wind power operation by combining signal decomposition with an enhanced neural predictor.
4131c0bf30b8579e359746d2edc0d7083f69fcd1.architecture: Hybrid of variational mode decomposition, phase space reconstruction for input selection, and an improved wavelet neural network as predictor.
4131c0bf30b8579e359746d2edc0d7083f69fcd1.data: Wind speed time series from wind farm measurements; specific sites, sampling and periods are not reported here.
4131c0bf30b8579e359746d2edc0d7083f69fcd1.result: Title and venue indicate the hybrid model improves multi-step accuracy over benchmark models; quantitative results are not reported here.
4131c0bf30b8579e359746d2edc0d7083f69fcd1.open_work: Comparison with deep learning predictors and probabilistic forecasting remain to be addressed.
4131c0bf30b8579e359746d2edc0d7083f69fcd1.issues: Abstract not available; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if decomposition is applied to the full series before splitting.

a40b0472ad1b8a82612c326e16532a22da7631db.goal: Estimates soil moisture under dense maize canopy, where optical remote sensing loses sensitivity to the soil, to support irrigation management.
a40b0472ad1b8a82612c326e16532a22da7631db.architecture: Machine learning regression on UAV multimodal (multisensor) features; the specific model types are not specified here.
a40b0472ad1b8a82612c326e16532a22da7631db.data: UAV multimodal imagery over maize fields with ground soil moisture measurements; details not reported here.
a40b0472ad1b8a82612c326e16532a22da7631db.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies multimodal UAV data with machine learning can estimate soil moisture under high canopy cover.
a40b0472ad1b8a82612c326e16532a22da7631db.open_work: Transfer to other crops, growth stages and fields, and to deeper soil layers, remain open.
a40b0472ad1b8a82612c326e16532a22da7631db.issues: Abstract not available; site and season coverage unknown, so generalization is uncertain; canopy effects may confound soil signals.

1c1dcd4e56b7be68686f79d11c6793058c2fada5.goal: Forecasts daily dam water levels to support reservoir operation, comparing two data-driven methods.
1c1dcd4e56b7be68686f79d11c6793058c2fada5.architecture: Support vector machine (support vector regression) compared with an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS), using different input combinations of past water levels and inflows.
1c1dcd4e56b7be68686f79d11c6793058c2fada5.data: Daily dam water level and hydrological records for a reservoir in Malaysia (Klang Gate Dam); period not reported here.
1c1dcd4e56b7be68686f79d11c6793058c2fada5.result: The SVM model is reported to outperform ANFIS in daily water level forecasting; exact scores are not reported here.
1c1dcd4e56b7be68686f79d11c6793058c2fada5.open_work: Longer lead times, inclusion of rainfall forecasts and testing on other reservoirs would extend the study.
1c1dcd4e56b7be68686f79d11c6793058c2fada5.issues: Abstract not available; single reservoir; no uncertainty quantification.

f6b54470ead6f6d436ec54d3da7681d0f6c513f4.goal: Reconstructs gaps and forecasts nearshore significant wave height off Norderney (North Sea), accounting for changing sandbank bathymetry, for coastal protection.
f6b54470ead6f6d436ec54d3da7681d0f6c513f4.architecture: LSTM neural networks, including a parallel LSTM (P-LSTM), tuned with Bayesian hyperparameter optimization and compared with deep feed-forward networks and other ML methods.
f6b54470ead6f6d436ec54d3da7681d0f6c513f4.data: Sea state and weather time series from adjacent buoys and bathymetric surveys of the Ebb-Tidal Delta sandbanks, 2004–2017.
f6b54470ead6f6d436ec54d3da7681d0f6c513f4.result: Including bathymetry reduces RMSE by 16.7% for reconstruction and 7.4–11.7% and 8.8–9.1% for short- and long-term prediction; P-LSTM reaches 0.069 m RMSE for reconstruction.
f6b54470ead6f6d436ec54d3da7681d0f6c513f4.open_work: Transfer to other coasts with morphodynamic change and probabilistic prediction of extremes are open.
f6b54470ead6f6d436ec54d3da7681d0f6c513f4.issues: Single site; bathymetry is sparse in time; extreme storm waves may be underrepresented in training.

8059001d94a789d371e8170b6e605ffeea9db397.goal: Improves multi-step wind speed forecasting for wind power conversion and management through decomposition and error modelling.
8059001d94a789d371e8170b6e605ffeea9db397.architecture: Hybrid EWT-LSTM-RELM-IEWT: empirical wavelet transform decomposition, LSTM as principal predictor per sub-layer, regularized extreme learning machine for error correction, and inverse EWT reconstruction with outlier filtering.
8059001d94a789d371e8170b6e605ffeea9db397.data: Five wind speed time series; site details and sampling not reported in the abstract.
8059001d94a789d371e8170b6e605ffeea9db397.result: The hybrid model performs best among seven models for one- to five-step predictions; EWT, RELM error modelling and IEWT outlier correction each improve accuracy and stability.
8059001d94a789d371e8170b6e605ffeea9db397.open_work: Longer horizons, probabilistic forecasts and use of meteorological inputs remain open.
8059001d94a789d371e8170b6e605ffeea9db397.issues: Complex multi-stage pipeline; possible leakage from decomposing full series; univariate inputs only.

8a63f31f1cc08dc731594d0b7104271944219633.goal: Compares deep learning models for multi-step photovoltaic power forecasting to support grid operation.
8a63f31f1cc08dc731594d0b7104271944219633.architecture: Transformer models compared with recurrent neural networks for multi-step forecasting.
8a63f31f1cc08dc731594d0b7104271944219633.data: Photovoltaic power generation and associated weather data; sites and periods are not reported here.
8a63f31f1cc08dc731594d0b7104271944219633.result: Not reported in the abstract; the study evaluates how transformer and recurrent architectures perform across forecast steps.
8a63f31f1cc08dc731594d0b7104271944219633.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and transfer across PV plants and climates remain open.
8a63f31f1cc08dc731594d0b7104271944219633.issues: Abstract not available; findings may depend on the dataset and hyperparameter tuning.

69c29ccc3f38caf4776a488fd4d859de4e7c3b2c.goal: Develops a high-resolution soil moisture drought index to monitor meteorological, agricultural and hydrological droughts over the Korean peninsula.
69c29ccc3f38caf4776a488fd4d859de4e7c3b2c.architecture: Random forest downscaling of AMSR-E soil moisture to 1 km using MODIS and TRMM predictors, followed by a drought index (HSMDI).
69c29ccc3f38caf4776a488fd4d859de4e7c3b2c.data: AMSR-E soil moisture 2003–2011 (March–November), seven MODIS and TRMM products, in situ soil moisture, SPI, crop yields and streamflow for validation.
69c29ccc3f38caf4776a488fd4d859de4e7c3b2c.result: Downscaled soil moisture correlates with in situ and AMSR-E data (mean R2 0.29 and 0.59); HSMDI tracks 3-month SPI and crop yields (mean R2 0.77) but poorly tracks streamflow.
69c29ccc3f38caf4776a488fd4d859de4e7c3b2c.open_work: Using newer microwave missions (SMAP, AMSR2) and all-weather predictors could improve wet-season performance.
69c29ccc3f38caf4776a488fd4d859de4e7c3b2c.issues: Optical predictors limited by clouds in the wet season; low R2 against in situ data; weak hydrological drought skill.

60ee0f5595f5af642570e4206db4337fefb369b3.goal: Simulates monthly mean streamflow water level in eastern Queensland, Australia, for water resource management.
60ee0f5595f5af642570e4206db4337fefb369b3.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM), a single-hidden-layer feedforward network with random hidden weights, compared with a conventional artificial neural network.
60ee0f5595f5af642570e4206db4337fefb369b3.data: Monthly hydro-meteorological predictors and streamflow water level records at sites in eastern Queensland; periods not reported here.
60ee0f5595f5af642570e4206db4337fefb369b3.result: The ELM is reported to outperform the ANN in accuracy and to train much faster; exact scores are not reported here.
60ee0f5595f5af642570e4206db4337fefb369b3.open_work: Forecasting at longer lead times and testing on other climates and catchments remain open.
60ee0f5595f5af642570e4206db4337fefb369b3.issues: Abstract not available; few stations; monthly scale only.

408a61ba2b4108458e00bb0d0f8429d42b2b0deb.goal: Estimates ocean carbonate system variables and nutrients from widely measured temperature, salinity and oxygen, as dynamic alternatives to static climatologies.
408a61ba2b4108458e00bb0d0f8429d42b2b0deb.architecture: CANYON-B, a Bayesian neural network mapping with uncertainty estimates, plus CONTENT, which refines carbonate variables for chemical consistency.
408a61ba2b4108458e00bb0d0f8429d42b2b0deb.data: GLODAPv2 bottle data for training; independent GO-SHIP bottle and sensor data for validation; applications to BGC-Argo and underway observations.
408a61ba2b4108458e00bb0d0f8429d42b2b0deb.result: Methods compare favourably with other mappings, resolve 40–120 d and 500–1500 km scales better than climatologies, and reveal a Revelle factor increase of 0.1–0.4 units per decade.
408a61ba2b4108458e00bb0d0f8429d42b2b0deb.open_work: Better surface pCO2 estimation in productive regions and integration across observing systems are open.
408a61ba2b4108458e00bb0d0f8429d42b2b0deb.issues: pCO2 overestimated in highly productive surface waters due to O2–C decoupling; limited by training data coverage.

9b417f0f668af0825c2e437e0ffe91a9b8f0ec82.goal: Reviews cloud detection methods for satellite remote sensing imagery published from 2004 to 2018.
9b417f0f668af0825c2e437e0ffe91a9b8f0ec82.architecture: Review of threshold-based classical algorithms and machine learning approaches for cloud/no-cloud, snow/cloud and thin/thick cloud detection.
9b417f0f668af0825c2e437e0ffe91a9b8f0ec82.data: Literature on cloud detection from multispectral satellite imagery; no new data.
9b417f0f668af0825c2e437e0ffe91a9b8f0ec82.result: Threshold methods have poor universality across locations, and many models lack ground-based validation; a hybrid of ML, physical retrieval and ground validation is recommended.
9b417f0f668af0825c2e437e0ffe91a9b8f0ec82.open_work: Developing hybrid physically informed ML methods with ground-based validation.
9b417f0f668af0825c2e437e0ffe91a9b8f0ec82.issues: Coverage stops at 2018 and predates most deep learning cloud masking; no quantitative benchmark.

70b4bb580b99d0889150a7980713cb4e0c0c583e.goal: Forecasts crop yield at county scale from satellite imagery before harvest to support food security and agricultural planning.
70b4bb580b99d0889150a7980713cb4e0c0c583e.architecture: DeepYield: a combined convolutional neural network and LSTM (ConvLSTM with 3D CNN) on image time series, compared with other deep learning baselines.
70b4bb580b99d0889150a7980713cb4e0c0c583e.data: MODIS satellite products (such as surface reflectance and land surface temperature) and county-level soybean yields in the United States; periods not reported here.
70b4bb580b99d0889150a7980713cb4e0c0c583e.result: DeepYield is reported to outperform the compared deep learning models in yield forecasting; exact scores are not reported here.
70b4bb580b99d0889150a7980713cb4e0c0c583e.open_work: Adding weather and soil inputs, other crops and uncertainty quantification.
70b4bb580b99d0889150a7980713cb4e0c0c583e.issues: Abstract not available; county aggregation limits field-scale use; interpretability is limited.

b851a381d267c87ce9b748af364ce5267d850e62.goal: Compares a data-driven rainfall-runoff model with a physically based model for urban drainage.
b851a381d267c87ce9b748af364ce5267d850e62.architecture: Support vector regression (SVM variant) compared with the EPA Storm Water Management Model (SWMM), a non-ML physically based model.
b851a381d267c87ce9b748af364ce5267d850e62.data: Recorded rainfall and flow rates from two experimental urban basins in northern Italy.
b851a381d267c87ce9b748af364ce5267d850e62.result: Both models perform comparably for hydrograph shape, time to peak and total runoff; SVR underestimates peak discharge while SWMM overestimates it.
b851a381d267c87ce9b748af364ce5267d850e62.open_work: Improving SVR calibration and peak prediction, and testing in more basins.
b851a381d267c87ce9b748af364ce5267d850e62.issues: Only two basins; SVR calibration has significant limitations; few events.

7f0bbcf38d1754df12c25d2b58a18c9dbd24f01f.goal: Forecasts medium-term daily wind speed for wind power operation and planning, with emphasis on handling outliers in raw data.
7f0bbcf38d1754df12c25d2b58a18c9dbd24f01f.architecture: Hybrid models (PMERNN, PAERNN) combining support vector regression for outlier detection, seasonal index adjustment and an Elman recurrent neural network.
7f0bbcf38d1754df12c25d2b58a18c9dbd24f01f.data: Eight years of daily wind speed at three sites in Xinjiang, China.
7f0bbcf38d1754df12c25d2b58a18c9dbd24f01f.result: The hybrid models forecast daily wind speed more accurately than the compared models over the prediction horizon.
7f0bbcf38d1754df12c25d2b58a18c9dbd24f01f.open_work: Extension to hourly data, other regions and probabilistic output.
7f0bbcf38d1754df12c25d2b58a18c9dbd24f01f.issues: No quantitative scores in the abstract; univariate inputs; three sites in one region.

8bc1fa1e0bd1e166f351aee3847c49d930dd359e.goal: Automatically classifies sea ice types in SAR imagery to support ice charting and navigation in the Arctic.
8bc1fa1e0bd1e166f351aee3847c49d930dd359e.architecture: Neural network (multilayer perceptron) classifier using texture features from grey-level co-occurrence matrices of SAR backscatter.
8bc1fa1e0bd1e166f351aee3847c49d930dd359e.data: ENVISAT ASAR wide swath images of Arctic sea ice with ice chart or expert interpretation as reference; period not reported here.
8bc1fa1e0bd1e166f351aee3847c49d930dd359e.result: The classifier separates main ice types such as multiyear and first-year ice and open water with reasonably high accuracy; exact figures are not reported here.
8bc1fa1e0bd1e166f351aee3847c49d930dd359e.open_work: Use of dual-polarization SAR (e.g. Sentinel-1) and deep learning, and handling of incidence angle effects.
8bc1fa1e0bd1e166f351aee3847c49d930dd359e.issues: Abstract not available; single-polarization data; confusion between young ice, smooth ice and wind-roughened water.

a23ec4b2ef75944790907f95cd4bf8699f42ea71.goal: Forecasts daily lake water levels for Poyang Lake, China, to support water resource management.
a23ec4b2ef75944790907f95cd4bf8699f42ea71.architecture: Random forest compared with artificial neural networks, support vector regression and a linear model, with variable importance analysis.
a23ec4b2ef75944790907f95cd4bf8699f42ea71.data: Daily water levels at five Poyang Lake stations and discharge series including the Yangtze River and tributaries.
a23ec4b2ef75944790907f95cd4bf8699f42ea71.result: Random forest performs best; using 4-day-ahead discharge and previous-week mean water level gives an average RMSE of 0.25 m; previous water level is the strongest predictor.
a23ec4b2ef75944790907f95cd4bf8699f42ea71.open_work: Longer lead times and coupling with hydrodynamic models or climate scenarios.
a23ec4b2ef75944790907f95cd4bf8699f42ea71.issues: Single lake; relies on known discharge inputs; tree models cannot extrapolate beyond observed ranges.

8fee767befb69899e805c9508ae8766db084c6a9.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting and quantifies its uncertainty given the stochastic nature of wind power.
8fee767befb69899e805c9508ae8766db084c6a9.architecture: EEMD decomposition, LASSO feature selection with a quantile regression neural network (QRNN), and kernel density estimation post-processing for probabilistic forecasts.
8fee767befb69899e805c9508ae8766db084c6a9.data: Six wind power datasets: two from a wind farm in Spain and four from a forecasting competition.
8fee767befb69899e805c9508ae8766db084c6a9.result: The proposed method improves point forecast accuracy and better quantifies and reduces uncertainty compared with benchmark models.
8fee767befb69899e805c9508ae8766db084c6a9.open_work: Incorporating NWP inputs and testing at more farms and longer horizons.
8fee767befb69899e805c9508ae8766db084c6a9.issues: No numbers given in the abstract; multi-stage pipeline with possible decomposition leakage.

9b04737f8c0eff348cb9b1401516c57a73408274.goal: Estimates root zone soil moisture at field scale for precision irrigation from high-resolution UAS optical data and soil information.
9b04737f8c0eff348cb9b1401516c57a73408274.architecture: Automated machine learning (H2O AutoML ensemble of algorithms) applied to twelve hierarchical models fusing UAS reflectance and soil physical and hydraulic properties.
9b04737f8c0eff348cb9b1401516c57a73408274.data: UAS optical surface reflectance, measured soil properties and TDR soil moisture sensors at surface, near-surface and root zone depths in a water-limited field.
9b04737f8c0eff348cb9b1401516c57a73408274.result: Adding soil properties improves estimates (root zone RMSE about 0.04 cm3 cm−3); adding measured surface soil moisture yields RMSE below 0.02 and R, NSE above 0.90.
9b04737f8c0eff348cb9b1401516c57a73408274.open_work: Testing across fields, seasons and crops, and replacing in situ inputs with remote sensing.
9b04737f8c0eff348cb9b1401516c57a73408274.issues: Single site; best results need in situ near-surface soil moisture; AutoML reduces interpretability.

c1e8444c87f5a705f5cc30ef9d41ddfd3fa42cd2.goal: Maps flood susceptibility and explains factor contributions to support flood risk management.
c1e8444c87f5a705f5cc30ef9d41ddfd3fa42cd2.architecture: Boosting-based ensemble machine learning (specific boosting variants not specified here) with SHapley Additive exPlanations for interpretation.
c1e8444c87f5a705f5cc30ef9d41ddfd3fa42cd2.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors (topographic, hydrologic, land cover); study region not reported here.
c1e8444c87f5a705f5cc30ef9d41ddfd3fa42cd2.result: Boosting ensembles achieve high predictive skill and SHAP identifies dominant flood conditioning factors; exact scores are not reported here.
c1e8444c87f5a705f5cc30ef9d41ddfd3fa42cd2.open_work: Validating with independent flood events and incorporating dynamic rainfall inputs.
c1e8444c87f5a705f5cc30ef9d41ddfd3fa42cd2.issues: Abstract not available; susceptibility maps are static and depend on inventory quality and sampling of non-flood points.

f43dbf892612c4940d0903943179e36dfeb55cfc.goal: Predicts groundwater level of the Bastam plain, Iran, to support aquifer management.
f43dbf892612c4940d0903943179e36dfeb55cfc.architecture: Artificial neural network compared with an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS).
f43dbf892612c4940d0903943179e36dfeb55cfc.data: Groundwater level records and inputs such as pumping, rainfall recharge and return flow for the Bastam plain, Iran; period not reported here.
f43dbf892612c4940d0903943179e36dfeb55cfc.result: ANFIS is reported to give more accurate groundwater level predictions than the ANN; exact scores are not reported here.
f43dbf892612c4940d0903943179e36dfeb55cfc.open_work: Testing management and climate scenarios and longer horizons.
f43dbf892612c4940d0903943179e36dfeb55cfc.issues: Abstract not available; single aquifer; limited data length.

940594fbf70c3a47b83e4947add2f4b7261f6804.goal: Estimates daily maximum and minimum air temperature in urban landscapes from satellite data where station networks are sparse.
940594fbf70c3a47b83e4947add2f4b7261f6804.architecture: Machine learning regression on MODIS time series predictors; the specific model type is not specified here.
940594fbf70c3a47b83e4947add2f4b7261f6804.data: MODIS time series (land surface temperature and related products) with weather station air temperature in urban areas; details not reported here.
940594fbf70c3a47b83e4947add2f4b7261f6804.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies daily Tmax and Tmin can be estimated from MODIS time series in cities.
940594fbf70c3a47b83e4947add2f4b7261f6804.open_work: Higher spatial resolution inputs and handling of cloud-related gaps.
940594fbf70c3a47b83e4947add2f4b7261f6804.issues: Abstract not available; MODIS LST gaps under clouds and 1 km resolution limit urban detail.

dc2824756dd058ef3f130e7c4326e23d3f388b2c.goal: Maps groundwater spring potential in the Koohdasht–Nourabad plain, Iran, for sustainable groundwater management.
dc2824756dd058ef3f130e7c4326e23d3f388b2c.architecture: Hybrids of an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) with five metaheuristics (IWO, DE, FA, PSO, BA), with SWARA for factor weighting.
dc2824756dd058ef3f130e7c4326e23d3f388b2c.data: 2463 spring locations split 70/30 for training and validation, with 13 conditioning factors including slope, altitude, TWI, lithology, land use and rainfall.
dc2824756dd058ef3f130e7c4326e23d3f388b2c.result: All models perform well; ANFIS–DE is best (AUC 0.875), followed by ANFIS–IWO, ANFIS–FA (0.873), ANFIS–PSO (0.865) and ANFIS–BA (0.839).
dc2824756dd058ef3f130e7c4326e23d3f388b2c.open_work: Validating with independent regions and field data and comparing to other ML methods.
dc2824756dd058ef3f130e7c4326e23d3f388b2c.issues: Small AUC differences between models; random spatial split may inflate skill; static factors only.

915c6031f9625ff51c18766b2a7ad0b3a75b8b87.goal: Reviews monitoring, diagnosis and power forecasting for photovoltaic fields.
915c6031f9625ff51c18766b2a7ad0b3a75b8b87.architecture: Review covering electrical monitoring methods, AI-based data analysis, power forecasting, UAV thermal imaging and power converter reliability.
915c6031f9625ff51c18766b2a7ad0b3a75b8b87.data: Literature mainly from the previous five years; no new data.
915c6031f9625ff51c18766b2a7ad0b3a75b8b87.result: Research contributions are classified into five macroareas, highlighting AI-based analysis and forecasting across temporal horizons.
915c6031f9625ff51c18766b2a7ad0b3a75b8b87.open_work: Integration of monitoring, diagnosis and forecasting into unified PV management systems.
915c6031f9625ff51c18766b2a7ad0b3a75b8b87.issues: Broad scope with limited depth on ML forecasting; coverage restricted to recent years before 2017.

a05003abb8778d6e4efb585cd779d76041093f76.goal: Forecasts PM2.5 concentrations by capturing linear, nonlinear and volatility components of the series.
a05003abb8778d6e4efb585cd779d76041093f76.architecture: Hybrid of ARIMA for the linear part, support vector machine for nonlinear residuals, and a GARCH model for volatility.
a05003abb8778d6e4efb585cd779d76041093f76.data: PM2.5 concentration time series from a Chinese city; details not reported here.
a05003abb8778d6e4efb585cd779d76041093f76.result: The hybrid-GARCH model is reported to outperform single models; exact scores are not reported here.
a05003abb8778d6e4efb585cd779d76041093f76.open_work: Adding meteorological predictors and multi-step forecasting.
a05003abb8778d6e4efb585cd779d76041093f76.issues: Abstract not available; univariate inputs; single location.

249a9fd8ecf20be042ecf22071e775820c42b1f7.goal: Explores hybrid modelling of the global hydrological cycle, combining physical structure with machine learning to reduce uncertainty in global hydrological models.
249a9fd8ecf20be042ecf22071e775820c42b1f7.architecture: H2M hybrid model: mass-conserving water pools (snow, soil moisture, groundwater) with fluxes from an embedded recurrent neural network, trained by multi-task learning.
249a9fd8ecf20be042ecf22071e775820c42b1f7.data: Global 1° daily simulations trained against observational products of GRACE terrestrial water storage, runoff, evapotranspiration and snow water equivalent.
249a9fd8ecf20be042ecf22071e775820c42b1f7.result: H2M reproduces key global water cycle patterns on par with four state-of-the-art global hydrological models and learns physically plausible responses to soil moisture.
249a9fd8ecf20be042ecf22071e775820c42b1f7.open_work: Adding more Earth observation streams and processes, and refining interpretability of learned relationships.
249a9fd8ecf20be042ecf22071e775820c42b1f7.issues: Proof of concept; coarse 1° resolution; constrained by observational product uncertainty and equifinality.

bd8d4fe8968af6b71c69595db78b52b3827d6ed3.goal: Analyzes data-driven approaches for daily solar power prediction to support PV integration.
bd8d4fe8968af6b71c69595db78b52b3827d6ed3.architecture: Comparison of data-driven methods including artificial neural networks, support vector machine, k-nearest neighbours and multiple linear regression.
bd8d4fe8968af6b71c69595db78b52b3827d6ed3.data: Daily solar power and meteorological data from a PV system; details not reported here.
bd8d4fe8968af6b71c69595db78b52b3827d6ed3.result: Not reported in the abstract; the study compares the accuracy of the data-driven methods for daily solar power prediction.
bd8d4fe8968af6b71c69595db78b52b3827d6ed3.open_work: Using NWP inputs and testing on more systems.
bd8d4fe8968af6b71c69595db78b52b3827d6ed3.issues: Abstract not available; single system and daily resolution.

9ad0b5a08c37c2558662608cb5eab764e7c5efc2.goal: Analyzes and forecasts atmospheric pollutants in Hangzhou, China, ahead of the 2022 Asian Games.
9ad0b5a08c37c2558662608cb5eab764e7c5efc2.architecture: Random forest for feature importance analysis and a recurrent neural network (RNN) coupled to WRF for 24 h forecasts and source identification.
9ad0b5a08c37c2558662608cb5eab764e7c5efc2.data: Pollutant (SO2, NO2, CO, PM2.5, PM10, O3) and meteorological observations in Hangzhou plus WRF meteorological fields.
9ad0b5a08c37c2558662608cb5eab764e7c5efc2.result: CO plays an important role in shaping O3, NO2 and PM; dew-point deficit matters more than relative humidity; the WRF/RNN method forecasts pollutants 24 h ahead.
9ad0b5a08c37c2558662608cb5eab764e7c5efc2.open_work: Evaluating emission-source attribution and applying to other cities.
9ad0b5a08c37c2558662608cb5eab764e7c5efc2.issues: Quantitative skill not given in the abstract; ML ignores emission inventories and chemistry.

2aa6f405284aa690867aa97e968944fb3af53197.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting for grid operation.
2aa6f405284aa690867aa97e968944fb3af53197.architecture: Hybrid of a temporal convolutional network (TCN) and the Informer transformer model.
2aa6f405284aa690867aa97e968944fb3af53197.data: Wind farm power and meteorological data; details not reported here.
2aa6f405284aa690867aa97e968944fb3af53197.result: Not reported in the abstract; the hybrid model is evaluated against other forecasting models according to the title.
2aa6f405284aa690867aa97e968944fb3af53197.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and transfer across wind farms.
2aa6f405284aa690867aa97e968944fb3af53197.issues: Abstract not available; results may be dataset-specific.

eb8b0f31bd637b7b39f3b62349e2ebc6d4cd7efe.goal: Forecasts wind speed in time and space across Iran to support wind energy assessment.
eb8b0f31bd637b7b39f3b62349e2ebc6d4cd7efe.architecture: Artificial neural networks; the specific network variants are not specified here.
eb8b0f31bd637b7b39f3b62349e2ebc6d4cd7efe.data: Wind speed observations from meteorological stations in Iran; details not reported here.
eb8b0f31bd637b7b39f3b62349e2ebc6d4cd7efe.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies ANNs can forecast wind speed temporally and interpolate it spatially.
eb8b0f31bd637b7b39f3b62349e2ebc6d4cd7efe.open_work: Comparison with deep learning and numerical model outputs.
eb8b0f31bd637b7b39f3b62349e2ebc6d4cd7efe.issues: Abstract not available; station density limits spatial prediction.

d8451e04fe01a6a2496e318e269dc67cb6955527.goal: Applies physics-informed neural networks to inverse problems in unsaturated groundwater flow.
d8451e04fe01a6a2496e318e269dc67cb6955527.architecture: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) solving the Richards equation with van Genuchten parameters, using a single deep neural network.
d8451e04fe01a6a2496e318e269dc67cb6955527.data: Synthetic Richards equation problems with known solution values at sparse spatio-temporal points.
d8451e04fe01a6a2496e318e269dc67cb6955527.result: PINNs efficiently solve the inverse problem with relatively accurate solutions and van Genuchten parameter estimates.
d8451e04fe01a6a2496e318e269dc67cb6955527.open_work: Testing with real field measurements, noise and heterogeneous soils.
d8451e04fe01a6a2496e318e269dc67cb6955527.issues: Synthetic cases only; no comparison with field data; PINN training can be sensitive.

2e07957d3d24f313c75a7009a88f9492678f34df.goal: Provides interval (probabilistic) wind speed forecasts for wind power production.
2e07957d3d24f313c75a7009a88f9492678f34df.architecture: Temporal convolutional network interval prediction model with fully connected tanh layers and an end-to-end sorting layer, plus an adaptive interval label construction strategy.
2e07957d3d24f313c75a7009a88f9492678f34df.data: Eight cases from two wind fields; details not reported in the abstract.
2e07957d3d24f313c75a7009a88f9492678f34df.result: The model significantly improves prediction interval coverage probability and interval width over recent state-of-the-art models.
2e07957d3d24f313c75a7009a88f9492678f34df.open_work: Extension to wind power and multi-step intervals.
2e07957d3d24f313c75a7009a88f9492678f34df.issues: Limited to two wind fields; numbers not given in the abstract.

015e1f462e6dc952a5090f0a5f4ed8afe1a1bb5b.goal: Post-processes US National Water Model streamflow with deep learning and diagnoses NWM error sources.
015e1f462e6dc952a5090f0a5f4ed8afe1a1bb5b.architecture: LSTM networks: a post-processor on NWM outputs, one with NWM outputs plus forcings, and one with forcings only.
015e1f462e6dc952a5090f0a5f4ed8afe1a1bb5b.data: 531 CONUS basins; trained 2004–2014 and evaluated 1994–2002 against the NWM reanalysis.
015e1f462e6dc952a5090f0a5f4ed8afe1a1bb5b.result: Median NSE 0.73–0.75 for the LSTMs versus 0.62 for NWM; forcing-only LSTM is best in ungauged basins; channel routing identified as timing error source.
015e1f462e6dc952a5090f0a5f4ed8afe1a1bb5b.open_work: Improving NWM channel routing and land surface components.
015e1f462e6dc952a5090f0a5f4ed8afe1a1bb5b.issues: Post-processing does not improve physics directly; CAMELS-type basins only.

753eaab588c5f10ba14d6786824721580b3f805f.goal: Forecasts daily PM2.5 concentrations including meteorological factors for air quality warnings.
753eaab588c5f10ba14d6786824721580b3f805f.architecture: Hybrid CEEMD-PSOGSA-SVR-GRNN: decomposition, support vector regression optimized by PSOGSA, grey correlation analysis for meteorological factor selection and a GRNN for residual correction.
753eaab588c5f10ba14d6786824721580b3f805f.data: Daily PM2.5 and meteorological data for Chongqing, Harbin and Jinan, China.
753eaab588c5f10ba14d6786824721580b3f805f.result: The hybrid model outperforms six comparison models.
753eaab588c5f10ba14d6786824721580b3f805f.open_work: Multi-step forecasts and inclusion of emission data.
753eaab588c5f10ba14d6786824721580b3f805f.issues: No quantitative metrics in the abstract; complex pipeline.

1bbd06ce6fae4e47aa8881ba14b0462ee749d059.goal: Provides operational intra-hour (10–60 minute) solar forecasts from sky images.
1bbd06ce6fae4e47aa8881ba14b0462ee749d059.architecture: Deep convolutional neural networks (two CNN structures inspired by a common architecture) using only sky image sequences.
1bbd06ce6fae4e47aa8881ba14b0462ee749d059.data: Six years of sky images (over 150,000 data points) with solar irradiance measurements.
1bbd06ce6fae4e47aa8881ba14b0462ee749d059.result: Best CNN achieves 20–39% skill over persistence of cloudiness and about 7% improvement over shallow ML with meteorological predictors.
1bbd06ce6fae4e47aa8881ba14b0462ee749d059.open_work: Deployment challenges and future work discussed by the authors.
1bbd06ce6fae4e47aa8881ba14b0462ee749d059.issues: Single site; sky image settings affect accuracy.

06886969b8a5a68808ee0955b90e503f6f68b923.goal: Assesses how algorithm choice, data volume and partitioning affect ML crop yield forecasting.
06886969b8a5a68808ee0955b90e503f6f68b923.architecture: Comparison of regularized linear models, random forest and artificial neural networks.
06886969b8a5a68808ee0955b90e503f6f68b923.data: Synthetic sunflower and wheat yields simulated with DSSAT (OilcropSun, Ceres-Wheat), 2001–2020, five areas of Spain.
06886969b8a5a68808ee0955b90e503f6f68b923.result: Random forest performs best (RMSE 35–38%) but is only modestly better than a farm-average baseline (42%).
06886969b8a5a68808ee0955b90e503f6f68b923.open_work: Accounting for seasonal weather forecast errors and validating with real data.
06886969b8a5a68808ee0955b90e503f6f68b923.issues: Synthetic data; real performance expected closer to baseline.

43a61658e601e4dfe0c1a49dfc9493ce811de901.goal: Forecasts solar energy production for grid integration.
43a61658e601e4dfe0c1a49dfc9493ce811de901.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM-Transformer with clustering and self-organizing map feature selection.
43a61658e601e4dfe0c1a49dfc9493ce811de901.result: The hybrid achieves the highest accuracy versus existing models and other combinations.
43a61658e601e4dfe0c1a49dfc9493ce811de901.open_work: Testing on other datasets and longer horizons.
43a61658e601e4dfe0c1a49dfc9493ce811de901.issues: Single dataset; no numbers in the abstract.

c8814d87550bf2de4b599e1b92d7946ec2e1373a.goal: Predicts wind speed for wind energy applications using a compact kernel model with selected input features to reduce computation.
c8814d87550bf2de4b599e1b92d7946ec2e1373a.architecture: Reduced support vector machine (SVM) regression combined with a feature selection step to choose informative predictors.
c8814d87550bf2de4b599e1b92d7946ec2e1373a.data: Wind speed measurement time series; site, period and resolution are not reported here.
c8814d87550bf2de4b599e1b92d7946ec2e1373a.result: The title indicates the reduced SVM with feature selection is proposed as an efficient wind speed predictor; quantitative skill is not reported here.
c8814d87550bf2de4b599e1b92d7946ec2e1373a.open_work: Testing at more sites and horizons and comparison with deep sequence models would clarify generality.
c8814d87550bf2de4b599e1b92d7946ec2e1373a.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-site point forecasts without uncertainty are likely limitations of this type of study.

4738b2e0c065e7d204cc104017dee26332059b63.goal: Maps solar energy potential across Indonesia, where ground radiation measurements are sparse, to support renewable energy planning.
4738b2e0c065e7d204cc104017dee26332059b63.architecture: Artificial neural network estimating solar radiation from meteorological and geographical inputs, combined with a geographical information system (GIS) for mapping.
4738b2e0c065e7d204cc104017dee26332059b63.data: Meteorological and geographical variables at Indonesian locations; specific datasets and periods are not reported here.
4738b2e0c065e7d204cc104017dee26332059b63.result: The study produces a national solar potential map from ANN estimates integrated in GIS; quantitative accuracy is not reported here.

4738b2e0c065e7d204cc104017dee26332059b63.issues: Abstract unavailable; interpolation across sparse stations and limited validation are likely caveats.

de6b84c82aab26e574f7829d3c888390df6233e9.goal: Predicts and simulates monthly groundwater levels to support aquifer management.
de6b84c82aab26e574f7829d3c888390df6233e9.architecture: Genetic programming (symbolic regression), an evolutionary machine learning method producing explicit equations.
de6b84c82aab26e574f7829d3c888390df6233e9.data: Monthly groundwater level records with hydrological inputs from an aquifer; site and period are not reported here.
de6b84c82aab26e574f7829d3c888390df6233e9.result: The title indicates genetic programming reproduces monthly groundwater levels; quantitative skill is not reported here.
de6b84c82aab26e574f7829d3c888390df6233e9.open_work: Comparison with neural and kernel methods and multi-aquifer testing would be natural next steps.
de6b84c82aab26e574f7829d3c888390df6233e9.issues: Abstract unavailable; a single-aquifer case and short monthly records likely limit generality.

1451e5a729c66b705928ef6fb7f65113ea207e2b.goal: Corrects wind farm power curves contaminated by curtailment periods so that power forecasting and assessment use realistic wind-to-power relationships.
1451e5a729c66b705928ef6fb7f65113ea207e2b.architecture: Data-driven correction procedure for the wind farm power curve; the specific learning algorithm is not specified in the available information.

1451e5a729c66b705928ef6fb7f65113ea207e2b.open_work: Integration with power forecasting systems and testing across many farms would be natural extensions.
1451e5a729c66b705928ef6fb7f65113ea207e2b.issues: Abstract unavailable; dependence on correctly identifying curtailment periods is a likely caveat.

b774cc80da6ff888ed51a7d096758e002a7c7f15.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels near Lake Okeechobee, Florida, comparing machine learning models for water management.
b774cc80da6ff888ed51a7d096758e002a7c7f15.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural networks, support vector machines and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS).
b774cc80da6ff888ed51a7d096758e002a7c7f15.data: Groundwater level records at wells near Lake Okeechobee with hydrometeorological inputs; periods and variables are not reported here.

b774cc80da6ff888ed51a7d096758e002a7c7f15.open_work: Longer lead times and uncertainty quantification would extend the comparison.
b774cc80da6ff888ed51a7d096758e002a7c7f15.issues: Abstract unavailable; a small number of wells in one region limits generality.

4dc99ae4f2f96ba231e5b0141c590dbfd573aa48.goal: Compares empirical regression models and artificial neural networks for estimating global solar radiation where measurements are lacking.
4dc99ae4f2f96ba231e5b0141c590dbfd573aa48.architecture: Comparison of statistical regression (empirical) models with artificial neural network models; the paper may be review-style in scope.
4dc99ae4f2f96ba231e5b0141c590dbfd573aa48.data: Meteorological predictors and measured global solar radiation; specific stations and periods are not reported here.
4dc99ae4f2f96ba231e5b0141c590dbfd573aa48.result: ANN models are generally reported to match or outperform regression models for solar radiation estimation; specific numbers are not reported here.
4dc99ae4f2f96ba231e5b0141c590dbfd573aa48.open_work: Standardized benchmarks across climates would help compare published models.
4dc99ae4f2f96ba231e5b0141c590dbfd573aa48.issues: Abstract unavailable; heterogeneous datasets across compared studies limit direct comparison.

2221485a916315ffef5940081a93b404726d0c10.goal: Maps groundwater potential in arid regions and assesses the importance of climate factors relative to terrain and geology.
2221485a916315ffef5940081a93b404726d0c10.architecture: Tree ensembles: random forest, XGBoost and LightGBM gradient boosting classifiers.
2221485a916315ffef5940081a93b404726d0c10.data: Groundwater occurrence inventory with climate, topographic, hydrogeological and land-cover conditioning factors in an arid region; specifics are not reported here.
2221485a916315ffef5940081a93b404726d0c10.result: The title indicates climate factors play a critical role in groundwater potential; model accuracies are not reported here.
