2221485a916315ffef5940081a93b404726d0c10.issues: Abstract unavailable; susceptibility-style mapping depends on inventory quality and spatial autocorrelation in validation.

285c4b9eb483d3ac0e9478908364b36a58949b22.goal: Estimates evapotranspiration from limited climatic data, needed for irrigation and water balance where full Penman-Monteith inputs are lacking.
285c4b9eb483d3ac0e9478908364b36a58949b22.architecture: Two adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference systems (ANFIS), differing in rule construction (grid partition versus subtractive clustering).
285c4b9eb483d3ac0e9478908364b36a58949b22.data: Daily climatic data from weather stations, with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith-type reference values as targets; stations are not reported here.
285c4b9eb483d3ac0e9478908364b36a58949b22.result: Both neuro-fuzzy systems estimate evapotranspiration well and compare favorably with empirical equations; specific scores are not reported here.
285c4b9eb483d3ac0e9478908364b36a58949b22.open_work: Testing in other climates and with fewer inputs would assess transferability.
285c4b9eb483d3ac0e9478908364b36a58949b22.issues: Targets are themselves model-derived reference ET rather than lysimeter measurements; few stations.

8e43311c1ce85411c88a81ff255a9ff8958637a5.goal: Produces prediction intervals rather than point forecasts for short-term wind speed to support grid integration of wind power.
8e43311c1ce85411c88a81ff255a9ff8958637a5.architecture: Two approaches: MLP neural networks trained with a multiobjective genetic algorithm, and extreme learning machines combined with nearest neighbors.
8e43311c1ce85411c88a81ff255a9ff8958637a5.data: Real hourly wind speed measurements from the Regina region, Saskatchewan, Canada.
8e43311c1ce85411c88a81ff255a9ff8958637a5.result: Both approaches give good prediction precision and offer complementary advantages under different prediction interval evaluation criteria.
8e43311c1ce85411c88a81ff255a9ff8958637a5.open_work: Extending to wind power and multi-site data, and to longer horizons, would be natural next steps.
8e43311c1ce85411c88a81ff255a9ff8958637a5.issues: Single-site dataset; no comparison with numerical weather prediction inputs.

cc24dc3368b4df0d44697216464eec0ff3c273b3.goal: Improves short-term and ultra-short-term wind power forecasts to support unit commitment and secure power system operation.
cc24dc3368b4df0d44697216464eec0ff3c273b3.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM, single-hidden-layer network) for short-term forecasting, followed by a persistence-based error correction model for ultra-short-term forecasts.
cc24dc3368b4df0d44697216464eec0ff3c273b3.data: Wind farm power records with 66 days of evaluation; site details are not reported in the abstract.
cc24dc3368b4df0d44697216464eec0ff3c273b3.result: Short-term ELM forecasts give NRMSE 21.09%; after error correction, ultra-short-term NRMSE falls to 5.76% with nearly unbiased errors mostly within ±10 MW.
cc24dc3368b4df0d44697216464eec0ff3c273b3.open_work: Improving the short-term base model itself, for example with NWP inputs, is needed.
cc24dc3368b4df0d44697216464eec0ff3c273b3.issues: The ELM alone performs poorly; the gain comes largely from persistence correction at very short horizons; short evaluation period.

11d287c98304acd13066ea5366925e70fd0a6cfe.goal: Identifies flood-prone areas in data-scarce, ungauged regions where hydrodynamic modeling is impractical.
11d287c98304acd13066ea5366925e70fd0a6cfe.architecture: Comparison of three data mining classifiers for flood susceptibility; the specific model types are not specified in the available information.
11d287c98304acd13066ea5366925e70fd0a6cfe.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors (topography, hydrology, land use) for an ungauged region; specifics are not reported here.
11d287c98304acd13066ea5366925e70fd0a6cfe.result: The study ranks three data mining models for flood susceptibility mapping; accuracies are not reported here.
11d287c98304acd13066ea5366925e70fd0a6cfe.open_work: Validation with independent flood events and other regions would test transferability.
11d287c98304acd13066ea5366925e70fd0a6cfe.issues: Abstract unavailable; susceptibility maps depend on inventory completeness and are static.

087f666b1a9cca014b80a7498ccdc8a79bd0a1e2.goal: Surveys the use of artificial neural networks for rainfall prediction.
087f666b1a9cca014b80a7498ccdc8a79bd0a1e2.architecture: Review of artificial neural network approaches (MLP/backpropagation and related networks) used for rainfall prediction.
087f666b1a9cca014b80a7498ccdc8a79bd0a1e2.data: Literature on ANN rainfall forecasting studies; specific datasets are not reported here.
087f666b1a9cca014b80a7498ccdc8a79bd0a1e2.result: The survey summarizes reported ANN rainfall prediction studies; specific conclusions are not reported here.

087f666b1a9cca014b80a7498ccdc8a79bd0a1e2.issues: Abstract unavailable; early survey predating deep learning, likely without quantitative meta-analysis.

cb64dae6223c2b350d839906bdf2a2217c5ba589.goal: Forecasts monthly streamflow in the drought-prone Murray-Darling Basin to support water resources planning.
cb64dae6223c2b350d839906bdf2a2217c5ba589.architecture: Wavelet-hybrid artificial neural network (MLP) with iterative input selection and MODWT decomposition (IIS-W-ANN), benchmarked against M5 model tree.
cb64dae6223c2b350d839906bdf2a2217c5ba589.data: Lagged streamflow water level plus precipitation, max/min temperature, solar radiation, vapor pressure and evaporation at Richmond, Gwydir and Darling River sites, Australia.
cb64dae6223c2b350d839906bdf2a2217c5ba589.result: IIS-W-ANN performs best (WI 0.936–0.979, ENS 0.770–0.920, RRMSE 15.65–21.00%), improving r by 7.5% and lowering RMSE by 21.3% over IIS-ANN.
cb64dae6223c2b350d839906bdf2a2217c5ba589.open_work: Extending to longer leads and more catchments, and quantifying forecast uncertainty, are natural next steps.
cb64dae6223c2b350d839906bdf2a2217c5ba589.issues: Only three sites; MODWT applied to predictors must avoid using future information; accuracy varies by river.

31115c4723d403a92d498134d69932035a0429c0.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting at Chinese wind sites with a novel hybrid model.
31115c4723d403a92d498134d69932035a0429c0.architecture: Hybrid forecasting model combining preprocessing and forecasting components; the specific model family is not specified in the available information.
31115c4723d403a92d498134d69932035a0429c0.data: Wind speed time series from sites in China; specifics are not reported here.
31115c4723d403a92d498134d69932035a0429c0.result: The title indicates the hybrid model improves wind speed forecasts in a China case study; quantitative skill is not reported here.

31115c4723d403a92d498134d69932035a0429c0.issues: Abstract unavailable; hybrid decomposition models can leak future information if decomposition is done over the full series.

7cba272c6e8586fca766b35529ffd73ae04cc233.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the Koiya River basin, Eastern India, a monsoon region with recurrent floods.
7cba272c6e8586fca766b35529ffd73ae04cc233.architecture: Ensemble of hyperpipes (HP) and support vector regression (SVR), compared with standalone HP and SVR.
7cba272c6e8586fca766b35529ffd73ae04cc233.data: Flood inventory map and eight conditioning variables based on topography and hydro-climatology (distance to river, rainfall, LULC, NDVI and others).
7cba272c6e8586fca766b35529ffd73ae04cc233.result: The HP-SVR ensemble performs best (AUC 0.915, accuracy 0.928, kappa 0.835), ahead of HP (AUC 0.885) and SVR (AUC 0.871); distance to river dominates.
7cba272c6e8586fca766b35529ffd73ae04cc233.open_work: Testing in other basins and with dynamic rainfall scenarios would extend the approach.
7cba272c6e8586fca766b35529ffd73ae04cc233.issues: Single basin; static susceptibility without flood depth or timing; validation depends on inventory quality.

7ff030684e481422a452e9b9a578ecd6586fb2ef.goal: Forecasts ultra-short-term solar PV power for real-time grid dispatch despite strong weather-driven fluctuations.
7ff030684e481422a452e9b9a578ecd6586fb2ef.architecture: Optimal frequency-domain decomposition into low- and high-frequency components, each forecast with a convolutional neural network (CNN) and summed.
7ff030684e481422a452e9b9a578ecd6586fb2ef.data: Actual PV power data including heavy rain days; plant details are not reported in the abstract.
7ff030684e481422a452e9b9a578ecd6586fb2ef.result: MAPE drops by 52.97%, 64.07% and 31.21% versus wavelet, VMD and direct models; the CNN beats RNN and LSTM by 23.64% and 46.22% MAPE and trains about 86–88% faster.
7ff030684e481422a452e9b9a578ecd6586fb2ef.open_work: Testing on more plants and seasons and adding probabilistic outputs would extend the method.
7ff030684e481422a452e9b9a578ecd6586fb2ef.issues: Evaluation focuses on heavy rain days at limited sites; no uncertainty estimates.

3835d8b818dd198abc612bf8242696eef8328440.goal: Systematically reviews deep learning for crop yield prediction to identify motivations, methods, features, data sources and gaps.
3835d8b818dd198abc612bf8242696eef8328440.architecture: Systematic literature review of deep learning methods (CNN, LSTM and others) for crop yield prediction.
3835d8b818dd198abc612bf8242696eef8328440.data: 456 retrieved studies, 44 selected primary studies analyzed for crops, algorithms, features and data sources.
3835d8b818dd198abc612bf8242696eef8328440.result: CNN is the most common algorithm and performs best in RMSE; lack of large training datasets and overfitting risk are key challenges.
3835d8b818dd198abc612bf8242696eef8328440.open_work: Larger datasets and work on under-studied topics identified in the review are needed.
3835d8b818dd198abc612bf8242696eef8328440.issues: Review limited to 44 studies; heterogeneous metrics hinder quantitative comparison.

49a33c78e609a1aa0f8e970ed59a480fd3c8da55.goal: Predicts monthly rainfall at Tenggarong station, East Kalimantan, Indonesia.
49a33c78e609a1aa0f8e970ed59a480fd3c8da55.architecture: Backpropagation neural network (MLP) with two hidden layers; architectures 2-50-10-1 and 2-50-20-1 trained for 500–1500 epochs.
49a33c78e609a1aa0f8e970ed59a480fd3c8da55.data: Monthly rainfall records from Tenggarong station; period not reported in the abstract.
49a33c78e609a1aa0f8e970ed59a480fd3c8da55.result: The 2-50-20-1 network at 1000 epochs gives the best MSE of 0.00096341 on normalized data.
49a33c78e609a1aa0f8e970ed59a480fd3c8da55.open_work: Comparison with statistical baselines and other stations would establish usefulness.
49a33c78e609a1aa0f8e970ed59a480fd3c8da55.issues: Single station; MSE on normalized data only; no baseline or independent skill metrics.

e5cb4fb49747f02a8d0ebaeaf7fd72edd179c4d9.goal: Models reference evapotranspiration in the Sudano-Sahelian zone, where full meteorological data for Penman-Monteith are often missing.
e5cb4fb49747f02a8d0ebaeaf7fd72edd179c4d9.architecture: Artificial neural network mapping limited climatic inputs to reference evapotranspiration, compared with empirical equations.
e5cb4fb49747f02a8d0ebaeaf7fd72edd179c4d9.data: Climatic station data from the Sudano-Sahelian zone of West Africa with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference values; specifics are not reported here.
e5cb4fb49747f02a8d0ebaeaf7fd72edd179c4d9.result: The ANN reproduces reference evapotranspiration well with reduced inputs and generally outperforms empirical equations; specific scores are not reported here.
e5cb4fb49747f02a8d0ebaeaf7fd72edd179c4d9.open_work: Testing across more stations and transfer between sites would assess robustness.
e5cb4fb49747f02a8d0ebaeaf7fd72edd179c4d9.issues: Abstract unavailable; targets are model-derived reference ET; few stations.

8789c9f2564e1f97ed985ac1aa5039548b638691.goal: Forecasts runoff in data-limited Himalayan micro-watersheds for water resources management.
8789c9f2564e1f97ed985ac1aa5039548b638691.architecture: Comparison of multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS) with coupled wavelet transform artificial neural networks (WA-ANN).
8789c9f2564e1f97ed985ac1aa5039548b638691.data: Limited rainfall and runoff records from Himalayan micro-watersheds; periods are not reported here.
8789c9f2564e1f97ed985ac1aa5039548b638691.result: The study compares MARS and WA-ANN for runoff forecasting with limited data; which performs better and by how much is not reported here.
8789c9f2564e1f97ed985ac1aa5039548b638691.open_work: Longer records and more watersheds would test robustness.
8789c9f2564e1f97ed985ac1aa5039548b638691.issues: Abstract unavailable; small datasets limit generalization of either model.

406715292cafbd4af60dd842f6d6f377db15c32b.goal: Detects wildfire-affected areas from satellite imagery without hand-built functional relationships, for fire management and damage assessment.
406715292cafbd4af60dd842f6d6f377db15c32b.architecture: U-Net convolutional neural network for semantic segmentation, one single-input model per instrument, with fusion of predictions from model pairs.
406715292cafbd4af60dd842f6d6f377db15c32b.data: Newly created dataset from Sentinel-1 C-SAR, Sentinel-2 MSI, Sentinel-3 SLSTR and MODIS (Terra and Aqua).
406715292cafbd4af60dd842f6d6f377db15c32b.result: Sentinel-2 plus Sentinel-3 fusion gives the best detection in clear conditions; Sentinel-1 plus Sentinel-2 fusion helps significantly under clouds.
406715292cafbd4af60dd842f6d6f377db15c32b.open_work: Joint multi-input networks and operational near-real-time deployment are natural next steps.
406715292cafbd4af60dd842f6d6f377db15c32b.issues: Fusion only at prediction level; dataset coverage of fire regimes and regions is not detailed.

be1f482662a8392afc34524031338e5c160bbd2d.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power across multiple timescales for grid operation.
be1f482662a8392afc34524031338e5c160bbd2d.architecture: Improved stacking ensemble combining LSTM and Informer (transformer-based) models.
be1f482662a8392afc34524031338e5c160bbd2d.data: PV power and meteorological data; plant and period are not reported here.
be1f482662a8392afc34524031338e5c160bbd2d.result: The title indicates the stacked LSTM-Informer model improves multi-timescale PV forecasts; quantitative skill is not reported here.
be1f482662a8392afc34524031338e5c160bbd2d.open_work: Testing on more plants and with probabilistic outputs would extend the work.
be1f482662a8392afc34524031338e5c160bbd2d.issues: Abstract unavailable; ensemble complexity and single-site evaluation are likely limitations.

21c25616694bde9277f7e1bb902f8c3b8b641dfd.goal: Predicts crop yields for maize, potatoes, rice and wheat in India to support food security and site-specific input management.
21c25616694bde9277f7e1bb902f8c3b8b641dfd.architecture: Machine learning regression models; the specific algorithms are not specified in the abstract.
21c25616694bde9277f7e1bb902f8c3b8b641dfd.data: Indian crop yield history with weather (rain, humidity, temperature) and pesticide information.
21c25616694bde9277f7e1bb902f8c3b8b641dfd.result: Machine learning models are trained to predict the four crops; quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
21c25616694bde9277f7e1bb902f8c3b8b641dfd.open_work: Adding soil and remote sensing data and spatially explicit prediction are natural extensions.
21c25616694bde9277f7e1bb902f8c3b8b641dfd.issues: Methods and metrics are not described in the abstract; aggregated statistics limit field-level use.

863a4cc1750a1065550dbdc4ea546f63a38c211d.goal: Clusters spatial-temporal precipitation data to identify regions with similar rainfall regimes.
863a4cc1750a1065550dbdc4ea546f63a38c211d.architecture: Wavelet transform for multiscale feature extraction combined with a self-organizing map (SOM) neural network for unsupervised clustering.
863a4cc1750a1065550dbdc4ea546f63a38c211d.data: Precipitation records from a network of rain gauges; region and period are not reported here.
863a4cc1750a1065550dbdc4ea546f63a38c211d.result: The wavelet-SOM approach yields precipitation clusters reflecting multiscale temporal variability; quantitative results are not reported here.
863a4cc1750a1065550dbdc4ea546f63a38c211d.open_work: Linking clusters to climate drivers and using them for regional frequency analysis would be follow-ups.
863a4cc1750a1065550dbdc4ea546f63a38c211d.issues: Abstract unavailable; cluster interpretation depends on SOM settings and gauge density.

a8e441ea3be7145b1d76120cf6ae1b7ab7c9e77e.goal: Forecasts sea water level for coastal engineering and management.
a8e441ea3be7145b1d76120cf6ae1b7ab7c9e77e.architecture: Genetic programming (symbolic regression) compared with artificial neural networks.
a8e441ea3be7145b1d76120cf6ae1b7ab7c9e77e.data: Tide gauge sea level time series; the station and period are not reported here.
a8e441ea3be7145b1d76120cf6ae1b7ab7c9e77e.result: Genetic programming is reported to perform comparably to or better than ANNs for sea level forecasting; specific scores are not reported here.
a8e441ea3be7145b1d76120cf6ae1b7ab7c9e77e.open_work: Longer horizons and multi-station tests would extend the comparison.
a8e441ea3be7145b1d76120cf6ae1b7ab7c9e77e.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-station univariate forecasting ignores meteorological forcing.

65454c77930835593a007060531937220ee03c5b.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration in an arid climate where Penman-Monteith inputs may be incomplete.
65454c77930835593a007060531937220ee03c5b.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural networks with gene expression programming (GEP).
65454c77930835593a007060531937220ee03c5b.data: Meteorological station data from an arid region with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference values; specifics are not reported here.
65454c77930835593a007060531937220ee03c5b.result: The study compares ANN and GEP accuracy for reference ET; which performs better and by how much is not reported here.
65454c77930835593a007060531937220ee03c5b.open_work: Testing input-reduced configurations and other arid sites would assess transferability.
65454c77930835593a007060531937220ee03c5b.issues: Abstract unavailable; targets are model-derived reference ET.

9b8a00ea71feea7b01a20f75391014b0d46c554e.goal: Forecasts monthly ambient PM2.5 in Dezhou City, China, to support air pollution prevention and control.
9b8a00ea71feea7b01a20f75391014b0d46c554e.architecture: Eight deep learning models compared, including ANN, CNN, GRU, LSTM and hybrid CNN-GRU-LSTM (convolutional plus recurrent).
9b8a00ea71feea7b01a20f75391014b0d46c554e.data: Air pollution data for Dezhou City, January 2014 to December 2023.
9b8a00ea71feea7b01a20f75391014b0d46c554e.result: CNN-GRU-LSTM performs best (R 0.9686, RMSE 4.6491 μg/m3), 34.28% more accurate than ANN; CNN, GRU and LSTM RMSE are 32.78–57.00% higher.
9b8a00ea71feea7b01a20f75391014b0d46c554e.open_work: Adding meteorological and emission predictors and testing other cities would extend the work.
9b8a00ea71feea7b01a20f75391014b0d46c554e.issues: Single city with about 120 monthly samples, risking overfitting of deep models; no uncertainty estimates.

d3cdf901957a26e2a25717623ec1d9ac78e8c04f.goal: Predicts monthly average and extreme atmospheric temperatures in Zhengzhou for forest management planning.
d3cdf901957a26e2a25717623ec1d9ac78e8c04f.architecture: ANN (MLP with 14 hidden neurons, several training algorithms) and deep learning models GRU, LSTM, CNN, CNN-GRU and CNN-LSTM.
d3cdf901957a26e2a25717623ec1d9ac78e8c04f.data: Monthly average and extreme temperatures in Zhengzhou, 1951–2000 training and 2001–2022 testing; 22 months as input.
d3cdf901957a26e2a25717623ec1d9ac78e8c04f.result: ANN with Bayesian regularization reaches R up to 0.9952; CNN-LSTM performs best overall and projects 2040 mean temperature of 17.36 °C.
d3cdf901957a26e2a25717623ec1d9ac78e8c04f.open_work: Testing in other regions is suggested; physically based climate projections would be a needed comparison.
d3cdf901957a26e2a25717623ec1d9ac78e8c04f.issues: Extrapolating a statistical time-series model to 2030–2040 projections ignores forcing scenarios; single station.

dd03ad883ffcb6b2a777bf916d021682c34281bf.goal: Improves daily SMAP L4 soil moisture prediction over China despite the short SMAP record that causes deep learning overfitting.
dd03ad883ffcb6b2a777bf916d021682c34281bf.architecture: CNN, LSTM and ConvLSTM models with transfer learning: pretraining on ERA5-Land and fine-tuning on SMAP.
dd03ad883ffcb6b2a777bf916d021682c34281bf.data: ERA5-Land source domain and SMAP L4 soil moisture target over China, with lagged soil moisture, soil temperature, season and precipitation predictors.
dd03ad883ffcb6b2a777bf916d021682c34281bf.result: Transfer ConvLSTM is best (R2 0.909–0.916, RMSE 0.0239–0.0247) at 3–7 day leads; transfer improves all models, by over 20% explained variance in some regions.
dd03ad883ffcb6b2a777bf916d021682c34281bf.open_work: Applying cross-source transfer learning to other newly built datasets is advocated.
dd03ad883ffcb6b2a777bf916d021682c34281bf.issues: SMAP L4 is itself a model-assimilated product; short leads only; ERA5-Land biases may transfer.

c19970b4ec7d7303ae1e6dac522dc19d69c985d2.goal: Detects non-linear climate influences on vegetation dynamics that linear Granger-causality analyses miss.
c19970b4ec7d7303ae1e6dac522dc19d69c985d2.architecture: Non-linear Granger-causality framework with time series decomposition, feature construction and random forest predictive models.
c19970b4ec7d7303ae1e6dac522dc19d69c985d2.data: Global satellite-based climate data records of climatic and vegetation variables from various databases.
c19970b4ec7d7303ae1e6dac522dc19d69c985d2.result: The framework reveals non-linear climate-vegetation patterns much less visible to traditional linear Granger causality.
c19970b4ec7d7303ae1e6dac522dc19d69c985d2.open_work: Applying the framework to quantify drivers globally and benchmark Earth system models is a natural next step.
c19970b4ec7d7303ae1e6dac522dc19d69c985d2.issues: Granger causality is predictive, not true causality; results depend on satellite record quality and confounders.

5a8e6963b0db0a26631bc2d9f7dfdfd64eaa2557.goal: Downscales coarse GRACE water storage data to high-resolution groundwater storage change maps for local management in California's Central Valley.
5a8e6963b0db0a26631bc2d9f7dfdfd64eaa2557.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type) downscaling model linking GRACE total water storage changes and hydrologic covariates to local groundwater changes.
5a8e6963b0db0a26631bc2d9f7dfdfd64eaa2557.data: GRACE total water storage, PRISM precipitation and temperature, DEM-derived slope and NRCS soil type, 2002–2010, with well-based groundwater data.
5a8e6963b0db0a26631bc2d9f7dfdfd64eaa2557.result: Maps at about 16 km2, 100-fold finer than GRACE, with NSE 0.24–0.96 in calibration and 0.04–0.75 in validation.
5a8e6963b0db0a26631bc2d9f7dfdfd64eaa2557.open_work: Applying the maps to local groundwater management and extending to other basins are proposed.
5a8e6963b0db0a26631bc2d9f7dfdfd64eaa2557.issues: Validation NSE is low at some locations; limited period; no uncertainty quantification.

453d5fdeab15646599ce27ebcd7d68f3da95a31f.goal: Captures diurnal variation of ground-level PM2.5 across China using geostationary satellite data rather than polar-orbiter snapshots.
453d5fdeab15646599ce27ebcd7d68f3da95a31f.architecture: Space-time LightGBM (STLG), a gradient boosting decision tree model incorporating spatiotemporal features.
453d5fdeab15646599ce27ebcd7d68f3da95a31f.data: Himawari-8/AHI aerosol products plus environmental variables, with 1,415,188 hourly ground PM2.5 samples in China; output ChinaHigh PM2.5 at 5 km.
453d5fdeab15646599ce27ebcd7d68f3da95a31f.result: Hourly estimates reach CV-R2 0.85, RMSE 13.62 and MAE 8.49 μg/m3; PM2.5 peaks near 10:00 local time and declines until sunset.
453d5fdeab15646599ce27ebcd7d68f3da95a31f.open_work: Extending to nighttime and other geostationary sensors would broaden coverage.
453d5fdeab15646599ce27ebcd7d68f3da95a31f.issues: Daytime only due to AHI aerosol retrievals; gaps under clouds; random cross-validation may overstate spatial skill.

36da428b85725ab4e00a72b6a319abd9e9ad5672.goal: Simulates groundwater level variations to support aquifer management.
36da428b85725ab4e00a72b6a319abd9e9ad5672.architecture: Wavelet transform combined with neural network, multiple linear regression and support vector machine models.
36da428b85725ab4e00a72b6a319abd9e9ad5672.data: Groundwater level records with hydrological inputs from an aquifer; site and period are not reported here.
36da428b85725ab4e00a72b6a319abd9e9ad5672.result: The title indicates wavelet preprocessing is evaluated for improving all three models; quantitative results are not reported here.
36da428b85725ab4e00a72b6a319abd9e9ad5672.open_work: Longer forecast horizons and multi-aquifer tests would extend the comparison.
36da428b85725ab4e00a72b6a319abd9e9ad5672.issues: Abstract unavailable; wavelet hybrids may use future information if decomposition is applied to whole series.

0296e9990007ef8b34daf3a732f001fc8e7155ca.goal: Quantifies the main climatic drivers of monthly vegetation variability globally to understand climate-vegetation feedbacks.
0296e9990007ef8b34daf3a732f001fc8e7155ca.architecture: Non-linear Granger causality framework based on random forest predictive models.
0296e9990007ef8b34daf3a732f001fc8e7155ca.data: Multi-decadal global satellite records of vegetation and climate variables, 1981–2010.
0296e9990007ef8b34daf3a732f001fc8e7155ca.result: About 61% of vegetated land is primarily water-limited; vegetation responds to precipitation about three months earlier; extremes explain up to 10% of variability.
0296e9990007ef8b34daf3a732f001fc8e7155ca.open_work: The approach can benchmark Earth system models and compare ecosystem resistance and resilience.
0296e9990007ef8b34daf3a732f001fc8e7155ca.issues: Predictive Granger causality is not strict causality; satellite record artifacts may affect results.

b0595162b795d8fbe6706a6b2ca5f1599b0df248.goal: Maps flood susceptibility on the central west coast of India with new ensemble machine learning models.
b0595162b795d8fbe6706a6b2ca5f1599b0df248.architecture: Ensembles of adabag (AdaBoost bagging) with rotation forest, nearest shrunken centroids, k-nearest neighbour, boosted regression tree and logitboost.
b0595162b795d8fbe6706a6b2ca5f1599b0df248.data: 210 flood localities and twelve conditioning factors selected by the Boruta algorithm, central west coast of India.
b0595162b795d8fbe6706a6b2ca5f1599b0df248.result: AB-RF ensemble performs best (AUC 94%) versus the best single model AB (92.74%); adabag improves all base learners.
b0595162b795d8fbe6706a6b2ca5f1599b0df248.open_work: Applying the ensembles in similar geographic settings for flood hazard planning is suggested.
b0595162b795d8fbe6706a6b2ca5f1599b0df248.issues: Single region with a small inventory; static susceptibility only.

fc127471833b52e74ac2079d1551d1e05c3cf11a.goal: Predicts groundwater levels in Visakhapatnam, India, to support urban water management.
fc127471833b52e74ac2079d1551d1e05c3cf11a.architecture: Integrated wavelet-support vector machine (wavelet decomposition plus SVM regression), compared with standard models.
fc127471833b52e74ac2079d1551d1e05c3cf11a.data: Monthly groundwater level records and hydrometeorological inputs from Visakhapatnam; periods are not reported here.
fc127471833b52e74ac2079d1551d1e05c3cf11a.result: The wavelet-SVM is reported to outperform the non-wavelet models compared; specific scores are not reported here.
fc127471833b52e74ac2079d1551d1e05c3cf11a.open_work: Longer horizons and more wells would test robustness.
fc127471833b52e74ac2079d1551d1e05c3cf11a.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-city case; possible leakage from wavelet decomposition.

6213b8b0b55af8df6365f902e13c2f2616746774.goal: Detects clouds in optical remote sensing images accurately with low computation for onboard use, and sharpens cloud boundaries.
6213b8b0b55af8df6365f902e13c2f2616746774.architecture: Lightweight convolutional neural network (DABNet) with a deformable context feature pyramid module and a boundary-weighted loss.
6213b8b0b55af8df6365f902e13c2f2616746774.data: Public GF-1 WFV cloud detection benchmark and a self-built higher-resolution GF-2 cloud dataset.
6213b8b0b55af8df6365f902e13c2f2616746774.result: DABNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with only 4.12M parameters and 8.29G multiply-adds, with clearer boundaries and fewer false alarms.
6213b8b0b55af8df6365f902e13c2f2616746774.open_work: Testing on other sensors and actual onboard deployment are natural next steps.
6213b8b0b55af8df6365f902e13c2f2616746774.issues: Evaluated on Chinese GF sensors only; cloud versus snow and bright surfaces not discussed in the abstract.

8cc1722347b33ace56eb5676693a891ef7634830.goal: Predicts streamflow and compares an explicit evolutionary model with a hybrid neural approach.
8cc1722347b33ace56eb5676693a891ef7634830.architecture: Linear genetic programming compared with a neuro-wavelet (wavelet plus artificial neural network) technique.
8cc1722347b33ace56eb5676693a891ef7634830.data: Streamflow records from gauging stations; basin and period are not reported here.
8cc1722347b33ace56eb5676693a891ef7634830.result: The study compares linear genetic programming and neuro-wavelet streamflow predictions; which performs better is not reported here.
8cc1722347b33ace56eb5676693a891ef7634830.open_work: Multi-step forecasts and more basins would extend the comparison.
8cc1722347b33ace56eb5676693a891ef7634830.issues: Abstract unavailable; few stations limit generality.

5f8d37811eae7b7062060bab5961b06588127f01.goal: Builds fine-grained real-time air quality index maps with UAV-mounted sensors while limiting battery use.
5f8d37811eae7b7062060bab5961b06588127f01.architecture: Gaussian plume model based on a neural network (GPM-NN) for particle dispersion, plus an adaptive battery-efficient monitoring algorithm.
5f8d37811eae7b7062060bab5961b06588127f01.data: UAV-sensed AQI measurements in a 2-D roadside park and a 3-D building courtyard.
5f8d37811eae7b7062060bab5961b06588127f01.result: GPM-NN gives higher AQI prediction accuracy than existing models while the adaptive algorithm greatly reduces power consumption.
5f8d37811eae7b7062060bab5961b06588127f01.open_work: Scaling to larger urban areas and multiple UAVs would extend the system.
5f8d37811eae7b7062060bab5961b06588127f01.issues: Small local test scenarios; quantitative accuracy not given in the abstract.

70a360e2e8ac733af606c2455b99b911efe33aa6.goal: Upscales eddy covariance land-atmosphere fluxes to global, high-resolution carbon and water flux products with a more flexible framework.
70a360e2e8ac733af606c2455b99b911efe33aa6.architecture: FLUXCOM-X machine learning upscaling framework; the X-BASE products use gradient boosted decision trees (XGBoost).
70a360e2e8ac733af606c2455b99b911efe33aa6.data: Eddy covariance site measurements with satellite and meteorological drivers; products for 2001–2020 at 0.05° and hourly resolution.
70a360e2e8ac733af606c2455b99b911efe33aa6.result: Global NEE −5.75 ± 0.33 Pg C/yr (more consistent with atmospheric constraints), GPP 125 Pg C/yr, ET 74.7×10^3 km3/yr with 57% transpiration.
70a360e2e8ac733af606c2455b99b911efe33aa6.open_work: Exploring site and satellite data processing choices and machine learning configurations within the flexible framework.
70a360e2e8ac733af606c2455b99b911efe33aa6.issues: Very low NEE interannual variability; ET exceeds precipitation in many dry areas, indicating overestimation.

136cdaf5827ac6528dfb37fa296b64caeebe0065.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting, needed for grid scheduling and reserve planning, by combining a statistical state-transition model with a learned classifier/regressor.
136cdaf5827ac6528dfb37fa296b64caeebe0065.architecture: Support vector machine combined with a finite-state Markov chain model of wind power transitions, as named in the title; further details are not available here.
136cdaf5827ac6528dfb37fa296b64caeebe0065.data: Wind farm power time series; the specific sites and periods are not reported here.
136cdaf5827ac6528dfb37fa296b64caeebe0065.result: The title implies the SVM-enhanced Markov model improves on a plain Markov chain forecast; quantitative skill is not reported here.
136cdaf5827ac6528dfb37fa296b64caeebe0065.open_work: Extending the approach to probabilistic outputs, longer horizons and multiple wind farms would follow naturally.
136cdaf5827ac6528dfb37fa296b64caeebe0065.issues: No abstract available; site, horizon and error metrics cannot be confirmed. Discretizing power into Markov states limits resolution of rapid ramps.

6a3eddd4a99b0a5707d2bbc3dd8fb26f3a2fddca.goal: Improves daily runoff prediction by optimizing and combining multiple models that couple physically based hydrological modelling with LSTM networks.
6a3eddd4a99b0a5707d2bbc3dd8fb26f3a2fddca.architecture: LSTM network coupled with physically based hydrological models, with an optimized combination strategy across multiple prediction models; the exact physical models are not specified here.
6a3eddd4a99b0a5707d2bbc3dd8fb26f3a2fddca.data: Daily runoff and meteorological forcing for one or more catchments; basin and period not reported here.
6a3eddd4a99b0a5707d2bbc3dd8fb26f3a2fddca.result: The title implies that the coupled and combined models outperform single models for daily runoff; quantitative results are not reported here.
6a3eddd4a99b0a5707d2bbc3dd8fb26f3a2fddca.open_work: Testing transferability to ungauged or contrasting basins and adding uncertainty quantification would be natural extensions.
6a3eddd4a99b0a5707d2bbc3dd8fb26f3a2fddca.issues: No abstract available; catchment, metrics and combination weights cannot be verified. Hybrid physics-LSTM chains inherit errors of the process model.

dd1ecf5bc25a6ceb7e13460a32bab4706b729bd8.goal: Provides both point and interval forecasts of ultra-short-term wind power to support real-time grid dispatch under uncertainty.
dd1ecf5bc25a6ceb7e13460a32bab4706b729bd8.architecture: Hybrid deep learning model combined with a data-driven preprocessing method, as stated in the title; the specific network type is not specified here.
dd1ecf5bc25a6ceb7e13460a32bab4706b729bd8.data: Wind farm power (and possibly meteorological) time series at ultra-short-term resolution; site and period not reported here.
dd1ecf5bc25a6ceb7e13460a32bab4706b729bd8.result: The title implies accurate point forecasts and reliable prediction intervals relative to benchmarks; numbers are not reported here.
dd1ecf5bc25a6ceb7e13460a32bab4706b729bd8.open_work: Validation across multiple wind farms and seasons and comparison with probabilistic NWP-based methods would follow.
dd1ecf5bc25a6ceb7e13460a32bab4706b729bd8.issues: No abstract available (SSRN preprint); architecture details, data and metrics cannot be confirmed. Interval calibration across regimes is not verifiable.

7915c7277e94f865f616b36c4647f7409ccea14f.goal: Estimates global solar radiation at the surface from geostationary satellite imagery, offering spatially continuous radiation where ground stations are sparse.
7915c7277e94f865f616b36c4647f7409ccea14f.architecture: Ensemble of artificial neural networks taking Meteosat image information as inputs, as named in the title.
7915c7277e94f865f616b36c4647f7409ccea14f.data: Meteosat satellite images with ground pyranometer measurements of global radiation for training and validation; exact stations and years not reported here.
7915c7277e94f865f616b36c4647f7409ccea14f.result: The title implies the ANN ensemble estimates global solar radiation from satellite images with useful accuracy; specific error statistics are not reported here.
7915c7277e94f865f616b36c4647f7409ccea14f.open_work: Extending to other regions, to newer satellite sensors and to sub-daily or direct/diffuse components would follow naturally.
7915c7277e94f865f616b36c4647f7409ccea14f.issues: No abstract available; region, temporal resolution and skill cannot be confirmed. Satellite-to-surface ANN mappings may not transfer across climates or sensors.

c02f31145fe80ee8b82815a5ede8e9731b0c5d6a.goal: Compares a process-based hydrological model and a data-driven model for daily streamflow simulation in catchments with contrasting climates, to guide water-resources planning.
c02f31145fe80ee8b82815a5ede8e9731b0c5d6a.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward ANN) compared with the physically based SWAT hydrological model; performance assessed by flow-duration-curve segments.
c02f31145fe80ee8b82815a5ede8e9731b0c5d6a.data: Daily streamflow and meteorological data for two catchments in Peninsular Spain, one Atlantic and one Mediterranean climate; periods not reported in the abstract.
c02f31145fe80ee8b82815a5ede8e9731b0c5d6a.result: Both SWAT and ANNs perform well for daily streamflow; SWAT better simulates low flows, while ANNs are superior for high flows in all cases.
c02f31145fe80ee8b82815a5ede8e9731b0c5d6a.open_work: Hybrid SWAT-ANN schemes exploiting each model's strength in different flow regimes are a natural next step.
c02f31145fe80ee8b82815a5ede8e9731b0c5d6a.issues: Only two catchments; ANN lacks physical interpretability and extrapolation ability; quantitative metrics not given in the abstract.

c8da074813ff78bc858e93157f6f5fce661d1672.goal: Reviews deep learning approaches for wind speed and wind power forecasting to summarize progress and challenges for renewable energy integration.
c8da074813ff78bc858e93157f6f5fce661d1672.architecture: Review of deep learning methods for wind forecasting, such as recurrent networks (LSTM/GRU), convolutional networks, autoencoders and hybrid decomposition-based models.
c8da074813ff78bc858e93157f6f5fce661d1672.data: Review of published studies; no new data. Covers wind speed and wind power datasets used in the literature.
c8da074813ff78bc858e93157f6f5fce661d1672.result: Summarizes the categories of deep learning wind forecasting models and their reported advantages; specific conclusions are not reported here.
c8da074813ff78bc858e93157f6f5fce661d1672.open_work: Typical open directions include probabilistic forecasting, spatio-temporal modelling across farms, and interpretability.
c8da074813ff78bc858e93157f6f5fce661d1672.issues: No abstract available; coverage and conclusions cannot be verified. Reviews of this kind rarely benchmark methods on common data.

6cfab2934ea2865effd57d3d995734c99b8bd4d2.goal: Improves hourly air temperature prediction, which is difficult because of nonlinear links with other meteorological variables and long time series.
6cfab2934ea2865effd57d3d995734c99b8bd4d2.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM: a convolutional neural network reduces dimensionality of the time series and an LSTM captures long-term memory; compared with standalone CNN and LSTM.
6cfab2934ea2865effd57d3d995734c99b8bd4d2.data: 60,133 hourly records (temperature, dew point, pressure, wind direction and speed, cloud amount) from the Yinchuan meteorological station, China, January 2000 to October 2020.
6cfab2934ea2865effd57d3d995734c99b8bd4d2.result: CNN-LSTM testing MAE 1.02, MAPE 0.8, RMSE 1.97; goodness of fit 0.7258 versus 0.5291 for CNN and 0.5949 for LSTM.
6cfab2934ea2865effd57d3d995734c99b8bd4d2.open_work: Extending to multiple stations, longer lead times and spatial inputs from NWP or reanalysis would follow naturally.
6cfab2934ea2865effd57d3d995734c99b8bd4d2.issues: Single station; lead time and train/test split details are limited; no comparison with NWP or simple persistence baselines.

9fe972926d673b28ed67f95315c5667ffe6de82b.goal: Maps groundwater spring potential zones in arid and semi-arid areas, where robust predictive models support sustainable water resources management.
9fe972926d673b28ed67f95315c5667ffe6de82b.architecture: Logistic model tree (hybrid decision tree with logistic regression) compared with support vector machine and C4.5 decision tree classifiers.
9fe972926d673b28ed67f95315c5667ffe6de82b.data: 359 springs from field surveys and national reports, three random 70/30 training/validation splits, and 12 significant geo-environmental and morphometric factors selected from 16.
9fe972926d673b28ed67f95315c5667ffe6de82b.result: LMT is most accurate (mean efficiency 0.860, TSS 0.718, AUC 0.904); relative slope position is the most important factor, followed by distance from faults and lithology.
9fe972926d673b28ed67f95315c5667ffe6de82b.open_work: Testing in other regions and improving model stability to input data changes are natural next steps.
9fe972926d673b28ed67f95315c5667ffe6de82b.issues: LMT shows some sensitivity to input data; single study area; spring absence points and spatial autocorrelation may inflate accuracy.

1f880d154f1ef6107ed738d11fab6d1103f0bba1.goal: Detects water bodies from multispectral satellite imagery for urban hydrology, exploiting bands beyond RGB that prior deep learning methods underused.
1f880d154f1ef6107ed738d11fab6d1103f0bba1.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network (MC-WBDN) with a multichannel fusion module, an enhanced atrous spatial pyramid pooling module and space-to-depth/depth-to-space operations for semantic segmentation.
1f880d154f1ef6107ed738d11fab6d1103f0bba1.data: Multispectral satellite imagery with water body labels; the sensor and dataset are not reported in the abstract.
1f880d154f1ef6107ed738d11fab6d1103f0bba1.result: MC-WBDN outperforms state-of-the-art DCNN water detection methods, is more robust to light and weather variations and better detects tiny water bodies.
1f880d154f1ef6107ed738d11fab6d1103f0bba1.open_work: Evaluation across sensors and regions and extension to temporal monitoring of water extent would follow.
1f880d154f1ef6107ed738d11fab6d1103f0bba1.issues: Abstract gives no quantitative metrics or dataset details; generalization to other sensors and cloud-contaminated scenes is unclear.

0b80ed9df48facf4df73df5413c80f246c6369f5.goal: Detects the anthropogenic signal in global extreme precipitation observations, which is masked by internal variability, model uncertainty and observational dataset differences.
0b80ed9df48facf4df73df5413c80f246c6369f5.architecture: Machine learning detection framework trained on climate model simulations to identify time-evolving spatial fingerprints of forcing; the specific model types are not specified in the abstract.
0b80ed9df48facf4df73df5413c80f246c6369f5.data: CMIP climate model simulations for training; multiple global gridded daily precipitation observational datasets over land for detection.
0b80ed9df48facf4df73df5413c80f246c6369f5.result: A physically interpretable anthropogenic signal in extreme precipitation is detectable in all global observational datasets examined.
0b80ed9df48facf4df73df5413c80f246c6369f5.open_work: Extending detection to regional scales, other extreme indices and attribution of specific forcings would follow.
0b80ed9df48facf4df73df5413c80f246c6369f5.issues: Relies on climate models to define the forced signal, so model structural errors can affect detection; observational datasets have inhomogeneous sampling.

368b776ffc0c9ab87eb1d3c5b98ab0c26477217e.goal: Tests the Transformer architecture for one-day-ahead river water level forecasting to support flood warning.
368b776ffc0c9ab87eb1d3c5b98ab0c26477217e.architecture: Transformer neural network using past water levels of upstream branches as predictors, compared with recurrent neural networks; attention offers interpretability.
368b776ffc0c9ab87eb1d3c5b98ab0c26477217e.data: River water level records of upstream branches and the target station, validated on the severe May 2014 flood in Southeast Europe.
368b776ffc0c9ab87eb1d3c5b98ab0c26477217e.result: The Transformer beats recurrent networks by more than 4% in RMSE and 7% in MAE at lower computational cost, with errors acceptable by domain standards.
368b776ffc0c9ab87eb1d3c5b98ab0c26477217e.open_work: Adding precipitation and meteorological forecasts as inputs and testing longer lead times and other basins would follow.
368b776ffc0c9ab87eb1d3c5b98ab0c26477217e.issues: Single basin and event focus; one-day horizon only; inputs restricted to upstream water levels.

2c37cf1427d3f0f4e8100bd28d68cb258d43bd2b.goal: Identifies dominant environmental controls on freshwater wetland methane fluxes across diel, synoptic and seasonal scales to reduce uncertainty in the global methane budget.
2c37cf1427d3f0f4e8100bd28d68cb258d43bd2b.architecture: Statistical and machine learning analysis in a wavelet multi-resolution framework: correlation analysis, generalized additive models, mutual information and random forests.
2c37cf1427d3f0f4e8100bd28d68cb258d43bd2b.data: Eddy covariance methane flux and environmental measurements from 23 freshwater wetland sites (FLUXNET-CH4 network).
2c37cf1427d3f0f4e8100bd28d68cb258d43bd2b.result: Temperature dominates seasonally where water table varies little, while water table depth dominates elsewhere; seasonal fluxes lag water table by about 17 days; pressure drops trigger releases at peat sites.
2c37cf1427d3f0f4e8100bd28d68cb258d43bd2b.open_work: Incorporating identified predictors and lags into process-based wetland methane models and expanding site coverage.
2c37cf1427d3f0f4e8100bd28d68cb258d43bd2b.issues: Limited number of sites with uneven representation of wetland types; correlative analysis does not establish causality.

0793d79f954ac87b72f73e0543b48d9cd8e20f18.goal: Predicts wind speed in a mountainous region of India, where complex terrain makes wind resource assessment difficult, to support wind energy planning.
0793d79f954ac87b72f73e0543b48d9cd8e20f18.architecture: Artificial neural network using locally measured meteorological variables as inputs; the specific network configuration is not specified here.
0793d79f954ac87b72f73e0543b48d9cd8e20f18.data: Meteorological measurements from locations in the Himalayan state of Himachal Pradesh, India; exact stations and periods not reported here.
0793d79f954ac87b72f73e0543b48d9cd8e20f18.result: The ANN predicts wind speed with good agreement to measured values; specific error statistics are not reported here.
0793d79f954ac87b72f73e0543b48d9cd8e20f18.open_work: Testing at more sites, with longer records and against NWP or reanalysis winds would follow.
0793d79f954ac87b72f73e0543b48d9cd8e20f18.issues: No abstract available; small, region-specific dataset; ANN trained on local data may not transfer to other terrain.

48732fe5e38f34b709b0e1df7a7b9c691c9a48de.goal: Forecasts one-day-ahead solar power generation for system operators, who need accurate forecasts of distributed energy resources for unit commitment and ramp management.
48732fe5e38f34b709b0e1df7a7b9c691c9a48de.architecture: Simplified LSTM recurrent neural network with cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning, compared with an MLP.
48732fe5e38f34b709b0e1df7a7b9c691c9a48de.data: Solar PV power and weather data; the plant and period are not reported in the abstract.
48732fe5e38f34b709b0e1df7a7b9c691c9a48de.result: The simplified LSTM outperforms the MLP, captures intra-hour ramping under different weather scenarios, and achieves average RMSE of 0.512.
48732fe5e38f34b709b0e1df7a7b9c691c9a48de.open_work: Incorporating NWP inputs and probabilistic outputs and testing on multiple plants would follow.
48732fe5e38f34b709b0e1df7a7b9c691c9a48de.issues: Data source, normalization of RMSE and baselines beyond MLP are not specified; single comparison model.

6a96b0c8cad063dbb53325ac458dd6c11638e63c.goal: Assesses how much numerical weather prediction inputs improve statistical wind power forecasts for a wind farm.
6a96b0c8cad063dbb53325ac458dd6c11638e63c.architecture: Artificial neural networks (feed-forward) compared with ARMA time-series models, with and without NWP-forecast inputs.
6a96b0c8cad063dbb53325ac458dd6c11638e63c.data: Wind farm power measurements and NWP forecasts of meteorological variables for a farm in southern Italy; period not reported here.
6a96b0c8cad063dbb53325ac458dd6c11638e63c.result: Including NWP predictions improves ANN wind power forecasts, especially at longer horizons, relative to purely statistical models.
6a96b0c8cad063dbb53325ac458dd6c11638e63c.open_work: Combining multiple NWP sources and providing probabilistic forecasts would follow.
6a96b0c8cad063dbb53325ac458dd6c11638e63c.issues: No abstract available; single wind farm; skill depends on NWP quality and resolution.

16bcb9dc969f365e65ac2da15f8a334a2fcfdd0e.goal: Estimates daily global solar radiation from widely available air temperature data in a semi-arid environment where radiation measurements are scarce.
16bcb9dc969f365e65ac2da15f8a334a2fcfdd0e.architecture: Artificial neural network using air temperature and extraterrestrial radiation inputs, compared with the empirical Hargreaves-Samani equation.
16bcb9dc969f365e65ac2da15f8a334a2fcfdd0e.data: Daily meteorological and solar radiation observations from a station in Khuzestan province, southwest Iran; period not reported here.
16bcb9dc969f365e65ac2da15f8a334a2fcfdd0e.result: The ANN estimates solar radiation more accurately than the Hargreaves-Samani temperature-based empirical model.
16bcb9dc969f365e65ac2da15f8a334a2fcfdd0e.open_work: Testing at multiple stations and climates and adding other routinely measured inputs would follow.
16bcb9dc969f365e65ac2da15f8a334a2fcfdd0e.issues: No abstract available; single site and semi-arid climate limit generality.

1f823cbfc23ecda3380f0abd13b81f343f0dbe11.goal: Forecasts the energy output of photovoltaic systems using a hybrid approach to improve accuracy over single models.
1f823cbfc23ecda3380f0abd13b81f343f0dbe11.architecture: Hybrid method combining stepwise regression for input selection with artificial neural networks; the specific ANN variants are not specified here.
1f823cbfc23ecda3380f0abd13b81f343f0dbe11.data: PV system output and meteorological measurements, from Mauritius; period not reported here.
1f823cbfc23ecda3380f0abd13b81f343f0dbe11.result: The hybrid model forecasts PV energy output more accurately than standalone regression and ANN models; specific numbers are not reported here.
1f823cbfc23ecda3380f0abd13b81f343f0dbe11.open_work: Extending to multiple PV systems and intraday horizons with NWP inputs would follow.
1f823cbfc23ecda3380f0abd13b81f343f0dbe11.issues: No abstract available; single site and limited data; details are uncertain.

f2d27c552697b7d6ac8b4a22c3212beef9202b89.goal: Reviews machine learning methods for PV power forecasting, needed for optimal grid management and stability.
f2d27c552697b7d6ac8b4a22c3212beef9202b89.architecture: Review of ML-based PV power forecasting, covering direct forecasting and indirect chains (irradiance forecast, plane-of-array model, PV performance model), deep neural networks and ensemble/hybrid models.
f2d27c552697b7d6ac8b4a22c3212beef9202b89.data: Review of published studies; no new data. Discusses forecast horizons and input parameters used in the literature.
f2d27c552697b7d6ac8b4a22c3212beef9202b89.result: No universal best model, but deep neural networks and ensemble or hybrid models outperform conventional methods for short-term PV forecasting.
f2d27c552697b7d6ac8b4a22c3212beef9202b89.open_work: Standardized benchmarking, data preparation and optimization techniques, and indirect forecasting for new plants without history.
f2d27c552697b7d6ac8b4a22c3212beef9202b89.issues: Narrative review without quantitative meta-analysis; performance comparisons across studies are confounded by different data and metrics.

428dee339c824274b55701236adf10aa9c83bfea.goal: Forecasts hourly photovoltaic power under varying weather and seasons to support dispatch and scheduling of PV plants.
428dee339c824274b55701236adf10aa9c83bfea.architecture: Convolutional neural network (SolarNet) with parallel max- and average-pooling blocks; inputs decomposed with variational mode decomposition and converted to HSV feature maps.
428dee339c824274b55701236adf10aa9c83bfea.data: Measured solar radiation, temperature, humidity and active power from a 23.40 kW PV plant at the Desert Knowledge Australia Solar Centre.
428dee339c824274b55701236adf10aa9c83bfea.result: Average R 0.9871, RMSE 0.3090 and MAE 0.1750 for 1-h forecasts across weather conditions, outperforming benchmark deep learning methods.
428dee339c824274b55701236adf10aa9c83bfea.open_work: Testing at multiple plants, longer horizons and with weather forecasts as inputs would follow.
428dee339c824274b55701236adf10aa9c83bfea.issues: Single small plant; VMD decomposition can leak future information if applied to the full series; no probabilistic output.

e2bf7b4e8940bf8059fada9f5dbd4aed3ebc153a.goal: Estimates historical daily PM10 exposure across China from satellite aerosol data to study long-term trends and health effects.
e2bf7b4e8940bf8059fada9f5dbd4aed3ebc153a.architecture: Random forest model compared with two traditional regression models, using AOD, land use and weather predictors.
e2bf7b4e8940bf8059fada9f5dbd4aed3ebc153a.data: Daily PM10 at 1479 sites (2014-2016), two MODIS AOD products, land use and meteorological data; predictions at 0.1 degree for 2005-2016.
e2bf7b4e8940bf8059fada9f5dbd4aed3ebc153a.result: Cross-validated R2 0.78 daily (RMSE 31.5 ug/m3), 0.82 monthly and 0.81 annually; about one-third of China exceeded the Grade II standard; PM10 peaked in 2006-2007 and declined after 2008.
e2bf7b4e8940bf8059fada9f5dbd4aed3ebc153a.open_work: Applying the estimates to long-term health studies and improving coverage where AOD is missing.
e2bf7b4e8940bf8059fada9f5dbd4aed3ebc153a.issues: Back-extrapolation to 2005-2013 relies on a model trained on 2014-2016 monitoring data; AOD gaps and random CV may overstate skill.

cf7e45b140806ecd7805961c280c463b91717559.goal: Reviews AI methods for forecasting air pollution and related human health outcomes such as chronic airway diseases and heat waves.
cf7e45b140806ecd7805961c280c463b91717559.architecture: Narrative review of artificial intelligence and machine learning methods, especially hybrid models, for forecasting PM2.5, PM10, O3, CO, SO2, NO2 and CO2.
cf7e45b140806ecd7805961c280c463b91717559.data: Review of published studies; no new data.
cf7e45b140806ecd7805961c280c463b91717559.result: Hybrid models perform better than single AI models and offer greater accuracy for prediction and early warning.
cf7e45b140806ecd7805961c280c463b91717559.open_work: Integrating pollution forecasts with health prediction and early-warning systems.
cf7e45b140806ecd7805961c280c463b91717559.issues: Narrative rather than systematic review; comparisons based on reported R2, RMSE, MAE and MAPE across heterogeneous studies.

5b05d605e0a33c571db1e7f95e0cb48fad386703.goal: Improves wind power forecasting by tuning LSTM hyperparameters with a metaheuristic optimizer.
5b05d605e0a33c571db1e7f95e0cb48fad386703.architecture: LSTM recurrent neural network whose parameters are optimized with the heap-based optimizer (HBO), as named in the title.
5b05d605e0a33c571db1e7f95e0cb48fad386703.data: Wind power time series from wind farm datasets; sites and periods not reported here.
5b05d605e0a33c571db1e7f95e0cb48fad386703.result: The title implies HBO-LSTM outperforms LSTM variants tuned by other optimizers; numbers are not reported here.
5b05d605e0a33c571db1e7f95e0cb48fad386703.open_work: Testing on more farms, longer horizons and probabilistic forecasting would follow.
5b05d605e0a33c571db1e7f95e0cb48fad386703.issues: No abstract available; metaheuristic tuning adds computational cost and gains may be dataset-specific.

bf35420d92e58baa46d1932d0cc31282a56718a1.goal: Simulates human-controlled reservoir outflows and extracts operation patterns, which differ from natural hydrological processes, for adaptive reservoir management.
bf35420d92e58baa46d1932d0cc31282a56718a1.architecture: Classification and regression tree (CART) enhanced by a shuffled cross-validation scheme, compared with original CART and random forest.
bf35420d92e58baa46d1932d0cc31282a56718a1.data: Inflow, storage, water allocation and related operation data for nine major reservoirs in California.
bf35420d92e58baa46d1932d0cc31282a56718a1.result: Enhanced CART and random forest outperform CART; enhanced CART simulates peak flows better than random forest; Oroville releases are dominated by State Water Project allocation.
bf35420d92e58baa46d1932d0cc31282a56718a1.open_work: Coupling the release model with hydrological models and climate projections for planning.
bf35420d92e58baa46d1932d0cc31282a56718a1.issues: Trained on historical operating rules, so may not reflect future policy changes; California-specific.

34909d618cbe51f3aaf6b2e9949111112d0a102c.goal: Assesses flood risk by combining hazard, exposure and vulnerability, with deep learning for flood susceptibility.
34909d618cbe51f3aaf6b2e9949111112d0a102c.architecture: Deep neural network (fully connected DNN) for flood susceptibility combined with Analytic Hierarchy Process multi-criteria decision analysis; compared with Bagging and Decorate ensembles of Forest by Penalizing Attributes.
34909d618cbe51f3aaf6b2e9949111112d0a102c.data: 847 past flood locations in Quang Nam province, Vietnam, with conditioning factors for training and testing.
34909d618cbe51f3aaf6b2e9949111112d0a102c.result: The DNN-MCDA integration produces accurate flood risk maps; performance validated with ROC curves and standard statistics.
34909d618cbe51f3aaf6b2e9949111112d0a102c.open_work: Applying to other regions and incorporating dynamic hydrological drivers.
34909d618cbe51f3aaf6b2e9949111112d0a102c.issues: No quantitative metrics in the abstract; AHP weights are subjective; single province.

06ba40867d0afef04de404ceefbcf990dec80109.goal: Predicts air pollution in space and time while handling missing values common in sensor time series.
06ba40867d0afef04de404ceefbcf990dec80109.architecture: Deep recurrent neural network with LSTM and fully connected layers, combined with three missing-value fixing algorithms; baselines are deep feed-forward networks and gradient boosting decision trees.
06ba40867d0afef04de404ceefbcf990dec80109.data: Air quality and meteorological datasets from the Jingjinji (Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei) area, China.
06ba40867d0afef04de404ceefbcf990dec80109.result: The DRNN framework outperforms deep feed-forward networks and GBDT; missing-value strategies affect performance.
06ba40867d0afef04de404ceefbcf990dec80109.open_work: Better spatial modelling across stations and longer forecast horizons.
06ba40867d0afef04de404ceefbcf990dec80109.issues: No numerical results in the abstract; limited description of spatial component.

2c8c03a9ec79701e503fd0c8ef947598f0f308f3.goal: Estimates solar radiation using an air pollution index as an additional predictor, since aerosols attenuate surface radiation.
2c8c03a9ec79701e503fd0c8ef947598f0f308f3.architecture: Random forest regression with meteorological variables and air pollution index inputs, compared with other models.
2c8c03a9ec79701e503fd0c8ef947598f0f308f3.data: Meteorological, radiation and air pollution index data from stations in China; details not reported here.
2c8c03a9ec79701e503fd0c8ef947598f0f308f3.result: The title implies that random forest with air pollution index improves solar radiation estimation; numbers are not reported here.
2c8c03a9ec79701e503fd0c8ef947598f0f308f3.open_work: Using direct aerosol measurements such as AOD and testing at more stations would follow.
2c8c03a9ec79701e503fd0c8ef947598f0f308f3.issues: No abstract available; station, period and metrics cannot be confirmed.

da565fe32c26c7c50340e94dd6c9b7923c90e44b.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction by correcting the residual errors of a fast learning model.
da565fe32c26c7c50340e94dd6c9b7923c90e44b.architecture: Extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer feed-forward network) with an error-correction stage.
da565fe32c26c7c50340e94dd6c9b7923c90e44b.data: Wind speed time series; sites and periods not reported here.
da565fe32c26c7c50340e94dd6c9b7923c90e44b.result: The title implies error correction improves ELM forecasts; numbers are not reported here.
da565fe32c26c7c50340e94dd6c9b7923c90e44b.open_work: Extending to multi-step and probabilistic forecasts and to more sites.
da565fe32c26c7c50340e94dd6c9b7923c90e44b.issues: No abstract available; data, horizons and metrics cannot be confirmed; single-model error correction may not transfer across sites.

44643067a26609bab0204de2b9581b12d276fc04.goal: Improves multi-step ahead wind speed forecasting by decomposing the non-stationary signal before learning.
44643067a26609bab0204de2b9581b12d276fc04.architecture: Hybrid model with two-stage signal decomposition and an AdaBoost ensemble of extreme learning machines (single-hidden-layer feed-forward networks).
44643067a26609bab0204de2b9581b12d276fc04.data: Wind speed time series; sites and periods not reported here.
44643067a26609bab0204de2b9581b12d276fc04.result: The title implies the hybrid model outperforms single-stage and non-decomposed benchmarks; numbers are not reported here.
44643067a26609bab0204de2b9581b12d276fc04.open_work: Testing on longer horizons and using exogenous meteorological inputs.
44643067a26609bab0204de2b9581b12d276fc04.issues: No abstract available; decomposition over the full series can leak future information; site-specific evaluation.

2abaceaf252c225aa22fd928c488beade6684d5c.goal: Builds an air quality monitoring and early warning system combining assessment of air quality with pollutant concentration prediction.
2abaceaf252c225aa22fd928c488beade6684d5c.architecture: Combined system of air quality evaluation and hybrid forecasting models; the machine learning model type is not specified here.
2abaceaf252c225aa22fd928c488beade6684d5c.data: Air pollutant concentration data from Chinese cities; details not reported here.
2abaceaf252c225aa22fd928c488beade6684d5c.result: The title implies the system provides air quality assessment and accurate pollutant forecasts; numbers are not reported here.
2abaceaf252c225aa22fd928c488beade6684d5c.open_work: Operational deployment and extension to more pollutants and regions.
2abaceaf252c225aa22fd928c488beade6684d5c.issues: No abstract available; method details, data and metrics cannot be confirmed.

887a725022cf5b7bdc13cfdeebff86f546ed6cec.goal: Predicts daily and monthly solar radiation with machine learning and relates it to compound extreme climate events.
887a725022cf5b7bdc13cfdeebff86f546ed6cec.architecture: Twelve machine learning models compared, including gradient boosting regression tree, XGBoost, Gaussian process regression and random forest, plus a stacking ensemble.
887a725022cf5b7bdc13cfdeebff86f546ed6cec.data: Meteorological factors including sunshine duration, land surface temperature and visibility with solar radiation observations; stations not reported in the abstract.
887a725022cf5b7bdc13cfdeebff86f546ed6cec.result: Stacking model best for daily radiation; no advantage over XGBoost monthly; stacking and XGBoost are the best models overall.
887a725022cf5b7bdc13cfdeebff86f546ed6cec.open_work: Further exploring links between solar radiation and compound extreme events.
887a725022cf5b7bdc13cfdeebff86f546ed6cec.issues: Locations and quantitative metrics are not given in the abstract; station-based evaluation.

cff6ebe3fe36a8aa1e0a330783aed3d802083b6a.goal: Automates detection of methane super-emitter plumes in TROPOMI data, where manual inspection of millions of daily observations is infeasible.
cff6ebe3fe36a8aa1e0a330783aed3d802083b6a.architecture: Two-step machine learning: a convolutional neural network detects plume-like structures, then a support vector classifier separates true plumes from retrieval artifacts.
cff6ebe3fe36a8aa1e0a330783aed3d802083b6a.data: TROPOMI methane data, training on pre-2021 data and application to 2021; GHGSat, PRISMA and Sentinel-2 for facility-level follow-up.
cff6ebe3fe36a8aa1e0a330783aed3d802083b6a.result: 2974 plumes detected in 2021 (mean source 44 t/h) from 94 persistent clusters; sources are urban areas/landfills 35%, gas 24%, oil 21%, coal 20%.
cff6ebe3fe36a8aa1e0a330783aed3d802083b6a.open_work: Continued operational monitoring and tip-and-cue with high-resolution satellites for facility attribution.
cff6ebe3fe36a8aa1e0a330783aed3d802083b6a.issues: Detection limited by TROPOMI resolution and retrieval artifacts; emission rate estimates are uncertain.

14594f059237e78a66efb74580ccec48bad9a30e.goal: Compares hybrid models that decompose wind speed series before learning, to improve prediction of non-stationary wind speed for wind energy.
14594f059237e78a66efb74580ccec48bad9a30e.architecture: Hybrid models combining fast ensemble empirical mode decomposition or wavelet packet decomposition with MLP neural networks or ANFIS.
14594f059237e78a66efb74580ccec48bad9a30e.data: Wind speed time series; sites and periods not reported here.
14594f059237e78a66efb74580ccec48bad9a30e.result: The title implies a comparison of four hybrid decomposition-learning models; which performs best is not reported here.
14594f059237e78a66efb74580ccec48bad9a30e.open_work: Testing the hybrids on more sites, longer horizons and against non-decomposition deep learning baselines would follow.
14594f059237e78a66efb74580ccec48bad9a30e.issues: No abstract available; decomposition can leak future information; metrics cannot be confirmed.

ce3c4dfd21e6501e4c2f1d0e8f8e646dddfe28dc.goal: Produces a long-term global gap-free surface soil moisture dataset at fine resolution, overcoming satellite gaps and coarse spatial resolution.
ce3c4dfd21e6501e4c2f1d0e8f8e646dddfe28dc.architecture: Benchmark dataset produced by gap-filling ESA-CCI soil moisture with ERA5 and downscaling to 1 km with a random forest.
ce3c4dfd21e6501e4c2f1d0e8f8e646dddfe28dc.data: ESA-CCI combined soil moisture at 0.25 degree, ERA5 soil moisture, International Soil Moisture Network in situ data and optical remote sensing; 2000-2020.
ce3c4dfd21e6501e4c2f1d0e8f8e646dddfe28dc.result: The 1-km product has correlation 0.89 and unbiased RMSE 0.045 m3/m3 in cross-validation; claimed only long-term global gap-free 1-km dataset.
ce3c4dfd21e6501e4c2f1d0e8f8e646dddfe28dc.open_work: Extending in time and to deeper soil layers, and validation in sparsely monitored regions.
ce3c4dfd21e6501e4c2f1d0e8f8e646dddfe28dc.issues: Gap-filling inherits ERA5 biases; in situ validation is sparse in many regions; cross-validation may overstate accuracy.

5904a3725f1d2e3cc7143ec782f41052933b9810.goal: Forecasts near real-time wind speed at a target station using neighbouring station data, supporting wind energy monitoring.
5904a3725f1d2e3cc7143ec782f41052933b9810.architecture: Hybrid bidirectional LSTM with three-stage feature selection (correlation, RReliefF, Boruta-RF) and Bayesian hyperparameter optimization; compared with LSTM, RNN, MLP and random forest.
5904a3725f1d2e3cc7143ec782f41052933b9810.data: Wind speed and climate indices from neighbouring reference stations; locations not reported in the abstract.
5904a3725f1d2e3cc7143ec782f41052933b9810.result: Hybrid BiLSTM best at all sites, with 76.6-84.8% of errors within 0.5 m/s, relative RMSE 9.6-23.8% and MAPE 8.8-21.5%.
5904a3725f1d2e3cc7143ec782f41052933b9810.open_work: Extending to longer horizons, wind power output and operational deployment would follow.
5904a3725f1d2e3cc7143ec782f41052933b9810.issues: Station-based with very short horizons; depends on availability of neighbouring stations; sites are not named in the abstract.

36ab6ff1c37e3799761b78fbaf398abe4af2fce3.goal: Forecasts hourly PM10 concentrations in Cyprus to support local environmental management.
36ab6ff1c37e3799761b78fbaf398abe4af2fce3.architecture: Artificial neural networks compared with multiple linear regression models.
36ab6ff1c37e3799761b78fbaf398abe4af2fce3.data: Hourly PM10 and meteorological data from monitoring stations in Cyprus; details not reported here.
36ab6ff1c37e3799761b78fbaf398abe4af2fce3.result: The title implies ANNs provide useful hourly PM10 forecasts compared with regression; numbers are not reported here.
36ab6ff1c37e3799761b78fbaf398abe4af2fce3.open_work: Accounting for desert dust transport episodes and extending to more stations and longer horizons would follow naturally.
36ab6ff1c37e3799761b78fbaf398abe4af2fce3.issues: No abstract available; stations, inputs and metrics cannot be confirmed; dust events make PM10 hard to predict from local data.

c939afd8a08c7a63d382416a677572e7a282079b.goal: Estimates future burned areas in EU-Mediterranean countries under changing climate, to inform fire management and adaptation planning.
c939afd8a08c7a63d382416a677572e7a282079b.architecture: Statistical and machine learning models, including multivariate adaptive regression splines, random forest and multiple regression, relating burned area to climate and fire weather indices.
c939afd8a08c7a63d382416a677572e7a282079b.data: Historical burned area statistics (European Forest Fire Information System) for EU-Mediterranean countries and climate projections under emission scenarios.
c939afd8a08c7a63d382416a677572e7a282079b.result: Burned areas are projected to increase under future climate scenarios in EU-Mediterranean countries; multivariate adaptive regression splines perform best among the tested models.
c939afd8a08c7a63d382416a677572e7a282079b.open_work: Accounting for changes in vegetation, land use and fire management in future projections would follow.
c939afd8a08c7a63d382416a677572e7a282079b.issues: Statistical models assume stationary climate-fire relationships, ignore human ignition and suppression changes, and depend on climate model projections.

0f452ebe7258d624264bfda5f2590df056168fd1.goal: Forecasts day-ahead power output of a photovoltaic plant by feeding numerically predicted cloudiness into a machine learning regressor, since clouds dominate PV variability.
0f452ebe7258d624264bfda5f2590df056168fd1.architecture: Support vector regression with NWP-predicted cloudiness and other weather variables as inputs.
0f452ebe7258d624264bfda5f2590df056168fd1.data: Power output of a PV plant in Kitakyushu, Japan, and NWP forecasts from the Japan Meteorological Agency.
0f452ebe7258d624264bfda5f2590df056168fd1.result: Using numerically predicted cloudiness as an input improves SVR forecasts of PV power output relative to configurations without it; specific error values are not reported here.
0f452ebe7258d624264bfda5f2590df056168fd1.open_work: Testing at additional plants and climates, and adding further NWP variables or probabilistic outputs, would follow naturally.
0f452ebe7258d624264bfda5f2590df056168fd1.issues: No abstract available; single plant, so generality is untested. Errors in NWP cloudiness forecasts propagate directly into the power forecast.

e4f8b7f6b2599b08907141f6cc20e9fcaf02b62a.goal: Estimates daily global solar radiation at stations across Turkey with deep learning, since measured radiation is sparse but needed for climate, energy and engineering applications.
e4f8b7f6b2599b08907141f6cc20e9fcaf02b62a.architecture: Deep learning model (deep neural network) using extraterrestrial radiation and climatic inputs; the specific layer configuration is not specified in the abstract.
e4f8b7f6b2599b08907141f6cc20e9fcaf02b62a.data: Extraterrestrial radiation, sunshine duration, cloud cover, min and max temperature from Turkish stations, 2001-2007.
e4f8b7f6b2599b08907141f6cc20e9fcaf02b62a.result: Overall R2 0.980, RMSE 0.78 and MAE 0.61 MJ/m2/day.
e4f8b7f6b2599b08907141f6cc20e9fcaf02b62a.open_work: Applying the method to similar regions and to ungauged locations, and comparing with satellite-based radiation products, would follow.
e4f8b7f6b2599b08907141f6cc20e9fcaf02b62a.issues: The abstract is inconsistent about station numbers (30 vs 34) and the train/test split; network design is not detailed; station-based evaluation only.

5c6ed773784c14840c2c7c85b0e427fa485d84ee.goal: Predicts groundwater levels with several data-driven techniques to support groundwater resources management where physically based models are data-demanding.
5c6ed773784c14840c2c7c85b0e427fa485d84ee.architecture: Several data-driven techniques compared; the specific model types are not specified here.
5c6ed773784c14840c2c7c85b0e427fa485d84ee.data: Groundwater level observations; aquifer and period not reported here.
5c6ed773784c14840c2c7c85b0e427fa485d84ee.result: The title implies a comparison of several data-driven techniques for groundwater level prediction; which performs best is not reported here.
5c6ed773784c14840c2c7c85b0e427fa485d84ee.open_work: Testing at more wells and aquifers and at longer prediction horizons would follow naturally.
5c6ed773784c14840c2c7c85b0e427fa485d84ee.issues: No abstract available; model types, data and metrics cannot be confirmed, so this card is general.

653529ca67340b63ce44f121079e505a860055dd.goal: Predicts urban flood occurrence with machine learning and GIS, giving city managers a tool for resilience planning as extreme weather and urbanization increase.
653529ca67340b63ce44f121079e505a860055dd.architecture: Machine learning classifiers, of which random forest performs best, combined with GIS hot spot analysis into a flood risk index.
653529ca67340b63ce44f121079e505a860055dd.data: Observed urban flood history and weather conditions for a city; details not reported in the abstract.
653529ca67340b63ce44f121079e505a860055dd.result: Random forest reaches Matthews correlation 0.77 and accuracy 0.96; combined with hot spots into a flood risk index.
653529ca67340b63ce44f121079e505a860055dd.open_work: Integrating real-time weather forecasts and testing transfer to other cities would follow naturally.
653529ca67340b63ce44f121079e505a860055dd.issues: Single city; with rare flood events, accuracy of 0.96 can be inflated by class imbalance; the city and data are not named in the abstract.

57197fa6907705ef869584c4875d3478e478ae8f.goal: Disentangles the roles of vapor pressure deficit and soil water content in limiting gross primary production, including climatic confounding and their interaction, to inform vegetation models.
57197fa6907705ef869584c4875d3478e478ae8f.architecture: Extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) models interpreted with SHAP main and interaction values, combined with statistical analyses that remove the effect of main climatic drivers.
57197fa6907705ef869584c4875d3478e478ae8f.data: Eddy-covariance site observations from the global FLUXNET2015 dataset across plant functional types, about a decade of records per site.
57197fa6907705ef869584c4875d3478e478ae8f.result: VPD is more important than SWC for water stress across most plant functional types once climatic drivers are removed; VPD-SWC interaction reverses sign with soil moisture and VPD stress shows a threshold; no significant CO2 alleviation found.
57197fa6907705ef869584c4875d3478e478ae8f.open_work: Use the identified VPD and SWC limitations and thresholds to improve water-stress formulations in dynamic global vegetation models; revisit CO2 effects with longer records.
57197fa6907705ef869584c4875d3478e478ae8f.issues: Records of about ten years are too short to detect CO2 effects; SHAP attributions are associative, not causal; site-level results may not scale uniformly.

2d547692aa4461f31ab134a92fb68093ce3193b1.goal: Forecasts monthly rainfall with a model that has memory of past values, addressing uncertainty of memoryless data-mining approaches.
2d547692aa4461f31ab134a92fb68093ce3193b1.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network with fixed sliding input windows to select optimal lags, compared against a random forest model.
2d547692aa4461f31ab134a92fb68093ce3193b1.data: Monthly rainfall 1980–2020 from two meteorological stations in Turkey (Rize and Konya) with contrasting climates.
2d547692aa4461f31ab134a92fb68093ce3193b1.result: LSTM outperforms random forest at both stations, improving RMSE by 12.2–14.9%, RSR by 12.3–14.8%, R by 9.4–13.5% and NSE by 32.9–33.2%.
2d547692aa4461f31ab134a92fb68093ce3193b1.open_work: Test the approach under other climates and at more stations, and add exogenous climate predictors.
2d547692aa4461f31ab134a92fb68093ce3193b1.issues: Only two stations and univariate monthly series; single benchmark model; no uncertainty quantification or extreme-event analysis.

d7e0969c163b582a22cdfa9689e14b5c97478628.goal: Forecasts precipitation by combining wavelet decomposition with support vector machines to improve on single-model forecasts.
d7e0969c163b582a22cdfa9689e14b5c97478628.architecture: Conjunction model in which discrete wavelet transform subseries feed a support vector machine regressor, compared with a plain support vector machine.
d7e0969c163b582a22cdfa9689e14b5c97478628.data: Station precipitation time series; specific stations and period not reported in the available metadata.
d7e0969c163b582a22cdfa9689e14b5c97478628.result: The wavelet-SVM conjunction model is reported to forecast precipitation better than the single SVM; exact metrics not available here.
d7e0969c163b582a22cdfa9689e14b5c97478628.open_work: Test on more stations and climates and compare against other hybrid and deep learning models.
d7e0969c163b582a22cdfa9689e14b5c97478628.issues: Station-scale univariate forecasting; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if applied to the full series; details unverified without abstract.

7e92679a83cd5acae6156abad212d4aa5252255f.goal: Describes the operational cloud retrieval algorithms for TROPOMI on Sentinel-5 Precursor, needed to improve trace-gas retrievals and extend the oxygen A-band cloud record.
7e92679a83cd5acae6156abad212d4aa5252255f.architecture: Two tandem algorithms: OCRA, a non-ML optical cloud fraction method in UV/VIS, and ROCINN, a neural network inversion of oxygen A-band radiances for cloud top height and optical thickness.
7e92679a83cd5acae6156abad212d4aa5252255f.data: Prototype results in the UPAS processor using OMI and GOME-2 measurements before TROPOMI launch; radiative transfer simulations for training ROCINN.
7e92679a83cd5acae6156abad212d4aa5252255f.result: OCRA and ROCINN are integrated in the S5P operational processor UPAS and produce cloud fraction, cloud top pressure and optical thickness from OMI and GOME-2 data.
7e92679a83cd5acae6156abad212d4aa5252255f.open_work: Validate the TROPOMI cloud products after launch and address anticipated challenges such as higher spatial resolution and instrument effects.
7e92679a83cd5acae6156abad212d4aa5252255f.issues: Pre-launch paper with no TROPOMI data; neural network accuracy depends on the radiative transfer training set and cloud model assumptions.

07a71524a4508034ede828ab0e82ec4347391e39.goal: Automates ice versus open-water discrimination in dual-polarization SAR imagery for the Canadian Ice Service, for navigation and environmental analysis.
07a71524a4508034ede828ab0e82ec4347391e39.architecture: MAGIC system: hierarchical region-based IRGS segmentation of the HV image combined with a pixel-based support vector machine (RBF kernel) on GLCM texture and backscatter features via a modified energy function.
07a71524a4508034ede828ab0e82ec4347391e39.data: 20 ground-truthed RADARSAT-2 dual-polarization scenes of the Beaufort Sea covering melt, summer and freeze-up periods.
07a71524a4508034ede828ab0e82ec4347391e39.result: Average leave-one-out accuracy of 96.42%, minimum 89.95% for one scene; the system is under consideration for operational use at CIS.
07a71524a4508034ede828ab0e82ec4347391e39.open_work: Extend from ice-water discrimination to ice-type classification and test on more regions and seasons.
07a71524a4508034ede828ab0e82ec4347391e39.issues: Small set of 20 scenes from one region; binary classification only; hand-crafted texture features.

dae235e886aa0a5b82ca055a313669bffbfabf1f.goal: Isolates vegetation physiological responses to drought (photosynthesis, evaporation, water content) from structural changes at large scales using satellite data.
