dae235e886aa0a5b82ca055a313669bffbfabf1f.architecture: Machine learning technique used to separate physiological from structural responses; the model type is not specified in the abstract. Results are checked against a soil–plant–atmosphere continuum model coupled with radiative transfer.
dae235e886aa0a5b82ca055a313669bffbfabf1f.data: Remotely sensed proxies of photosynthesis, evaporation and vegetation water content, plus hydro-meteorological drivers; process-model simulations for comparison.
dae235e886aa0a5b82ca055a313669bffbfabf1f.result: Functional declines under drought are largely driven by downregulated stomatal conductance and light use efficiency, strongest in water-limited regions; spatial patterns are controlled mainly by aridity.
dae235e886aa0a5b82ca055a313669bffbfabf1f.open_work: Use the isolated physiological responses to constrain ecosystem feedbacks in land surface and climate models.
dae235e886aa0a5b82ca055a313669bffbfabf1f.issues: Attribution relies on satellite proxies with their own retrieval uncertainties; separating physiology from structure is model-dependent.

001828d5a183800a672fa2368354d8b24b2fe46e.goal: Improves groundwater level modelling with artificial neural networks by selecting informative wavelet-decomposed inputs.
001828d5a183800a672fa2368354d8b24b2fe46e.architecture: Wavelet transform combined with an entropy-based measure to select dominant subseries as inputs to a feed-forward artificial neural network (ANN).
001828d5a183800a672fa2368354d8b24b2fe46e.data: Hydro-meteorological and groundwater level time series from observation wells, reportedly in the Ardabil plain, Iran; period not reported here.
001828d5a183800a672fa2368354d8b24b2fe46e.result: The wavelet-entropy preprocessed ANN is reported to outperform ANN models with conventional inputs; specific metrics not available here.
001828d5a183800a672fa2368354d8b24b2fe46e.open_work: Extend the input selection approach to other aquifers and multi-step forecasting.
001828d5a183800a672fa2368354d8b24b2fe46e.issues: Results tied to one aquifer; wavelet preprocessing risks boundary effects and look-ahead leakage; details unverified without abstract.

b15040ebf41e00d3288582beb0c1c54c84ef09c9.goal: Predicts haze occurrence or intensity from meteorological factors to understand and forecast haze pollution.
b15040ebf41e00d3288582beb0c1c54c84ef09c9.architecture: Back-propagation (BP) neural network, a feed-forward MLP.
b15040ebf41e00d3288582beb0c1c54c84ef09c9.data: Meteorological factors and haze observations; region and period not reported in the available metadata.
b15040ebf41e00d3288582beb0c1c54c84ef09c9.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the BP network is presented as able to capture the meteorology-haze relationship.
b15040ebf41e00d3288582beb0c1c54c84ef09c9.open_work: Add emission and pollutant precursor inputs and compare with modern deep learning and tree models.
b15040ebf41e00d3288582beb0c1c54c84ef09c9.issues: Meteorology-only inputs ignore emissions; simple network; details unverified without abstract.

17014b80fdd673879a129bdb38aef9f9c9dee09a.goal: Predicts wind speed for an unmanned sailboat to support navigation and control at sea.
17014b80fdd673879a129bdb38aef9f9c9dee09a.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) network.
17014b80fdd673879a129bdb38aef9f9c9dee09a.data: Wind speed time series relevant to the sailboat's operating area; source and period not reported in the available metadata.
17014b80fdd673879a129bdb38aef9f9c9dee09a.result: The CNN-LSTM hybrid is reported to predict wind speed more accurately than single models; metrics not available here.
17014b80fdd673879a129bdb38aef9f9c9dee09a.open_work: Integrate the forecasts into sailboat route planning and control, and test in field deployments.
17014b80fdd673879a129bdb38aef9f9c9dee09a.issues: Single dataset and short-term horizon; no uncertainty estimates; details unverified without abstract.

2deb7820d48e817fd246fc3da2c3a5666b0c966b.goal: Improves rainfall-runoff simulation during extreme typhoon events by combining a physically based hydrological model with machine learning.
2deb7820d48e817fd246fc3da2c3a5666b0c966b.architecture: Hybrid approach coupling a physically based rainfall-runoff model (HEC-HMS) with machine learning models (support vector machine and artificial neural network) that refine its runoff output.
2deb7820d48e817fd246fc3da2c3a5666b0c966b.data: Hourly rainfall and runoff for typhoon events in a watershed in Taiwan; event counts not reported here.
2deb7820d48e817fd246fc3da2c3a5666b0c966b.result: The hybrid model is reported to simulate typhoon runoff more accurately than the physically based or machine learning models alone.
2deb7820d48e817fd246fc3da2c3a5666b0c966b.open_work: Extend to real-time forecasting with rainfall forecasts and to other basins.
2deb7820d48e817fd246fc3da2c3a5666b0c966b.issues: Limited number of extreme events; site-specific calibration; details partly from knowledge, abstract not available.

48b89aa7b061607efffe96243797793b8ed490ef.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction for wind energy by combining decomposition, optimization and deep learning.
48b89aa7b061607efffe96243797793b8ed490ef.architecture: Time-varying filter EMD (TVFEMD) decomposition, an improved sine cosine algorithm for hyperparameter optimization, and a convolutional neural network (CNN) with bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM).
48b89aa7b061607efffe96243797793b8ed490ef.data: Wind speed time series from wind farm sites; specific sites and period not reported in the available metadata.
48b89aa7b061607efffe96243797793b8ed490ef.result: The hybrid model is reported to outperform benchmark models; metrics not available here.
48b89aa7b061607efffe96243797793b8ed490ef.open_work: Add multi-site and probabilistic forecasting and reduce computational cost.
48b89aa7b061607efffe96243797793b8ed490ef.issues: Complex pipeline with risk of decomposition leakage and overfitting; single-variable inputs; details unverified without abstract.

9897be84230e0b382ea04531dd70dc4827bc04c1.goal: Models daily reference evapotranspiration in extreme arid regions where climatic data are limited.
9897be84230e0b382ea04531dd70dc4827bc04c1.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression with different input combinations, compared with artificial neural network and empirical ET0 equations.
9897be84230e0b382ea04531dd70dc4827bc04c1.data: Daily meteorological data with FAO-56 Penman–Monteith ET0 as target, reportedly from the Ejina Basin in northwestern China.
9897be84230e0b382ea04531dd70dc4827bc04c1.result: SVM models with limited inputs such as temperature and radiation are reported to estimate ET0 well and outperform ANN and empirical methods.
9897be84230e0b382ea04531dd70dc4827bc04c1.open_work: Test transferability to other arid sites and with fewer inputs.
9897be84230e0b382ea04531dd70dc4827bc04c1.issues: Single arid region; target is a computed Penman–Monteith ET0, not measured ET; details unverified without abstract.

d747ab8f9a7eda4d7dcc9f5c98d643aaa52c6344.goal: Forecasts daily PM2.5 in Shanghai from meteorological elements and lagged PM2.5 to support exposure reduction.
d747ab8f9a7eda4d7dcc9f5c98d643aaa52c6344.architecture: Artificial neural networks (feed-forward MLP) and wavelet-ANNs, testing twelve training algorithms and 21 network structures; Bayesian regularization training performs best.
d747ab8f9a7eda4d7dcc9f5c98d643aaa52c6344.data: Daily PM2.5 and fourteen meteorological elements in Shanghai, 2014–2020, including the COVID-19 lockdown period.
d747ab8f9a7eda4d7dcc9f5c98d643aaa52c6344.result: Optimal inputs are PM2.5 at 1–3 day lags plus meteorology; the WANN1 model gives the best prediction with R = 0.9316.
d747ab8f9a7eda4d7dcc9f5c98d643aaa52c6344.open_work: Add emission and regional transport information and test multi-day forecasts.
d747ab8f9a7eda4d7dcc9f5c98d643aaa52c6344.issues: Single city; no emission inputs; COVID-19 period may shift relationships; correlation-based input selection.

71f21c29772f48bcfbcddd870eb4c96506ed0494.goal: Improves short-term wind speed and power forecasting by accounting for heteroscedastic noise in wind data.
71f21c29772f48bcfbcddd870eb4c96506ed0494.architecture: Support vector regression with a heteroscedastic noise model, compared with standard SVR.
71f21c29772f48bcfbcddd870eb4c96506ed0494.data: Wind speed and power records from wind farms; sites and periods not reported in the available metadata.
71f21c29772f48bcfbcddd870eb4c96506ed0494.result: The heteroscedastic SVR is reported to reduce forecast errors compared with standard SVR; metrics not available here.
71f21c29772f48bcfbcddd870eb4c96506ed0494.open_work: Extend to probabilistic intervals and multi-step horizons.
71f21c29772f48bcfbcddd870eb4c96506ed0494.issues: Point forecasts only; limited sites; details unverified without abstract.

e29947d38d95208d07b1635dc21c0939de09a7aa.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting by denoising wavelet decompositions with singular spectrum analysis.
e29947d38d95208d07b1635dc21c0939de09a7aa.architecture: Wavelet transform improved with singular spectrum analysis (SSA) preprocessing, feeding an Elman recurrent neural network.
e29947d38d95208d07b1635dc21c0939de09a7aa.data: Wind speed time series; sites and period not reported in the available metadata.
e29947d38d95208d07b1635dc21c0939de09a7aa.result: The hybrid model is reported to outperform single and conventional hybrid models; metrics not available here.
e29947d38d95208d07b1635dc21c0939de09a7aa.open_work: Test on more sites and longer horizons.
e29947d38d95208d07b1635dc21c0939de09a7aa.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids risk look-ahead leakage; details unverified without abstract.

b19789c7eaa168cd5db124133840577e8866b544.goal: Compares numerical and machine learning modelling of soil water content when input data are limited.
b19789c7eaa168cd5db124133840577e8866b544.architecture: Physically based HYDRUS-2D numerical model compared with machine learning models (artificial neural network, ANFIS and support vector machine).
b19789c7eaa168cd5db124133840577e8866b544.data: Field soil water content measurements under different irrigation and fertilization treatments, reportedly a maize field in Iran.
b19789c7eaa168cd5db124133840577e8866b544.result: Machine learning models are reported to estimate soil water content with accuracy comparable to or better than HYDRUS-2D when inputs are limited.
b19789c7eaa168cd5db124133840577e8866b544.open_work: Test generalization of the data-driven models to other soils and management.
b19789c7eaa168cd5db124133840577e8866b544.issues: Single field site; ML models lack physical consistency and transferability; details partly from knowledge.

7669ae364c9e72780e30dfa959ac8d77cfae76c9.goal: Predicts corn and soybean yield accurately while providing interpretable environment-by-management interactions.
7669ae364c9e72780e30dfa959ac8d77cfae76c9.architecture: Interaction regression model combining optimization-based feature and interaction selection with regression, compared against state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms.
7669ae364c9e72780e30dfa959ac8d77cfae76c9.data: County-scale corn and soybean yield with weather, soil and management data for Illinois, Indiana and Iowa; years not reported in the abstract.
7669ae364c9e72780e30dfa959ac8d77cfae76c9.result: Relative RMSE of 8% or less for both crops, outperforming ML benchmarks; identifies about a dozen environment-by-management interactions and decomposes yield contributions.
7669ae364c9e72780e30dfa959ac8d77cfae76c9.open_work: Verify the newly identified interactions through experiments and extend to more regions and crops.
7669ae364c9e72780e30dfa959ac8d77cfae76c9.issues: Limited to three US Midwest states; some interactions lack agronomic confirmation.

c7fc9101fd3ba550751f1f1b1f78f1a45e31b0bc.goal: Examines whether deep learning crop yield forecasts are interpretable and agree with agronomic knowledge.
c7fc9101fd3ba550751f1f1b1f78f1a45e31b0bc.architecture: Deep learning models (LSTM and 1D convolutional neural network) explained with feature attribution methods.
c7fc9101fd3ba550751f1f1b1f78f1a45e31b0bc.data: Regional crop yield statistics with weather, remote sensing and crop model indicators, reportedly from the European MARS/CGMS crop monitoring data.
c7fc9101fd3ba550751f1f1b1f78f1a45e31b0bc.result: Attributions are reported to highlight plausible weather drivers in sensitive crop growth periods, with differences between models and methods.
c7fc9101fd3ba550751f1f1b1f78f1a45e31b0bc.open_work: Develop evaluation standards for attributions and include interpretability in model selection.
c7fc9101fd3ba550751f1f1b1f78f1a45e31b0bc.issues: Attributions are not ground-truthed; results depend on attribution method; details partly from knowledge.

ef9c6b1a4ce41f77d10c3ef95c08141d0cbe4daf.goal: Predicts rainfall in real time for smart cities by fusing several machine learning classifiers.
ef9c6b1a4ce41f77d10c3ef95c08141d0cbe4daf.architecture: Decision tree, naive Bayes, k-nearest neighbors and support vector machine classifiers whose outputs are fused with fuzzy logic.
ef9c6b1a4ce41f77d10c3ef95c08141d0cbe4daf.data: Twelve years of historical weather data (2005–2017) for Lahore, Pakistan, cleaned and normalized.
ef9c6b1a4ce41f77d10c3ef95c08141d0cbe4daf.result: The fuzzy fusion framework outperforms the individual classifiers; specific metrics not given in the abstract.
ef9c6b1a4ce41f77d10c3ef95c08141d0cbe4daf.open_work: Deploy in real-time systems and add more cities and predictors.
ef9c6b1a4ce41f77d10c3ef95c08141d0cbe4daf.issues: Single city; rain/no-rain classification only; no comparison with NWP or deep learning.

2b0b4558fca66928a8ce0fdb5ad4af8dc678efa6.goal: Selects optimal predictive features for wind speed prediction at wind farms.
2b0b4558fca66928a8ce0fdb5ad4af8dc678efa6.architecture: Hybrid wrapper in which a coral reefs optimization algorithm selects features evaluated by an extreme learning machine (ELM).
2b0b4558fca66928a8ce0fdb5ad4af8dc678efa6.data: Predictive variables from a mesoscale numerical weather model (reportedly MM5) and wind speed measured at a wind farm in Spain.
2b0b4558fca66928a8ce0fdb5ad4af8dc678efa6.result: The CRO-ELM selection is reported to improve wind speed prediction over using all features and other selection methods.
2b0b4558fca66928a8ce0fdb5ad4af8dc678efa6.open_work: Apply to other farms and horizons and compare with other metaheuristics.
2b0b4558fca66928a8ce0fdb5ad4af8dc678efa6.issues: Single wind farm; metaheuristic results vary between runs; details partly from knowledge.

55346ae6d3da765718107ff7101f7ce1317ff9d6.goal: Compares soft sensor models for predicting ambient ozone concentration and assesses input variable sets.
55346ae6d3da765718107ff7101f7ce1317ff9d6.architecture: Linear regression, neural networks (including recurrent neural networks) and random forest regression across 72 soft sensor configurations.
55346ae6d3da765718107ff7101f7ce1317ff9d6.data: Air pollutant and meteorological measurements including PM2.5 and PM10; site and period not reported in the abstract.
55346ae6d3da765718107ff7101f7ce1317ff9d6.result: Neural networks, especially RNNs, perform best; the best sensor reaches R2 = 0.8902, RMSE 24.91, MAE 19.16 and 81.44% accuracy; adding PM10 does not help due to multicollinearity.
55346ae6d3da765718107ff7101f7ce1317ff9d6.open_work: Test across sites and seasons and address multicollinearity in inputs.
55346ae6d3da765718107ff7101f7ce1317ff9d6.issues: Data source not reported; single dataset; no uncertainty analysis.

26b8b78402818c2085d65f96a6fff9b961c4eb26.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting by combining multiple decomposition methods with fast learners.
26b8b78402818c2085d65f96a6fff9b961c4eb26.architecture: Three hybrid models using multi-decomposing strategies (secondary decomposition of wind series) with extreme learning machine (ELM) predictors.
26b8b78402818c2085d65f96a6fff9b961c4eb26.data: Wind speed time series; sites and period not reported in the available metadata.
26b8b78402818c2085d65f96a6fff9b961c4eb26.result: The multi-decomposition hybrids are reported to outperform single-decomposition and benchmark models; metrics not available here.
26b8b78402818c2085d65f96a6fff9b961c4eb26.open_work: Investigate leakage-free decomposition and probabilistic outputs.
26b8b78402818c2085d65f96a6fff9b961c4eb26.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids risk look-ahead leakage; details unverified without abstract.

3a80c1428eaa3e88434233eb3cf8a811ca40748c.goal: Maps current and future flood hazard under climate and land-use change to support flood management.
3a80c1428eaa3e88434233eb3cf8a811ca40748c.architecture: Conditional inference random forest, gradient boosting model, extreme gradient boosting and their ensemble; CA-Markov model for future land use.
3a80c1428eaa3e88434233eb3cf8a811ca40748c.data: 512 flood and non-flood locations with 20 conditioning factors in the Kalvan watershed, Iran; GCM precipitation under RCP2.6 and RCP8.5 for 2050.
3a80c1428eaa3e88434233eb3cf8a811ca40748c.result: Ensemble AUC 0.83, GBM 0.80, XGB 0.79, CIRF 0.78; moderate to very high risk areas increase by 2050 under both RCPs.
3a80c1428eaa3e88434233eb3cf8a811ca40748c.open_work: Use multiple GCMs and dynamic hydrological simulations to refine future risk.
3a80c1428eaa3e88434233eb3cf8a811ca40748c.issues: Single GCM; static susceptibility mapping, not hydrodynamic; small inventory; moderate AUC.

fb104bedc6edcf0c036c34711afa30162f382b8f.goal: Produces deterministic and probabilistic interval predictions for short-term wind power generation.
fb104bedc6edcf0c036c34711afa30162f382b8f.architecture: Variational mode decomposition (VMD) combined with machine learning regressors; the specific model types are not specified in the available metadata.
fb104bedc6edcf0c036c34711afa30162f382b8f.data: Wind power time series from wind farms; sites and period not reported in the available metadata.
fb104bedc6edcf0c036c34711afa30162f382b8f.result: The approach is reported to give accurate point forecasts and reliable prediction intervals; metrics not available here.
fb104bedc6edcf0c036c34711afa30162f382b8f.open_work: Extend to longer horizons and multi-farm settings.
fb104bedc6edcf0c036c34711afa30162f382b8f.issues: Details unverified without abstract; decomposition leakage risk.

99ce369f45be83f0b766260ae7afd240d6cbfc5b.goal: Improves day-ahead wind power prediction by clustering numerical weather prediction inputs.
99ce369f45be83f0b766260ae7afd240d6cbfc5b.architecture: Cluster analysis of NWP data to group weather patterns, with separate prediction models per cluster; the model types are not specified in the available metadata.
99ce369f45be83f0b766260ae7afd240d6cbfc5b.data: NWP forecasts and wind farm power records; sources and period not reported in the available metadata.
99ce369f45be83f0b766260ae7afd240d6cbfc5b.result: Clustering is reported to improve day-ahead accuracy compared with a single model; metrics not available here.
99ce369f45be83f0b766260ae7afd240d6cbfc5b.open_work: Test on additional farms and NWP products.
99ce369f45be83f0b766260ae7afd240d6cbfc5b.issues: Depends on NWP quality; details unverified without abstract.

15848482b44c92145e8fcfafc8d6273862e8b0a1.goal: Co-optimizes agricultural management practices in space and time for climate-smart crop production balancing yield and environmental impacts.
15848482b44c92145e8fcfafc8d6273862e8b0a1.architecture: Optimization framework for management practices; the modelling approach and any machine learning type are not specified in the available metadata.
15848482b44c92145e8fcfafc8d6273862e8b0a1.data: Not reported in the available metadata.
15848482b44c92145e8fcfafc8d6273862e8b0a1.result: Optimized management is reported to improve production while reducing environmental footprints; quantities not available here.
15848482b44c92145e8fcfafc8d6273862e8b0a1.open_work: Account for adoption barriers and future climate in recommendations.
15848482b44c92145e8fcfafc8d6273862e8b0a1.issues: Model-based optimization may not reflect farmer constraints; details unverified without abstract.

c8aa62f02357e64891cf6a1320263c4743136f74.goal: Predicts mean monthly wind speed for wind energy evaluation in the Hexi Corridor, China.
c8aa62f02357e64891cf6a1320263c4743136f74.architecture: Hybrid SARIMA and least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) model, compared with ARIMA, SARIMA, LSSVM and ARIMA-SVM.
c8aa62f02357e64891cf6a1320263c4743136f74.data: Monthly wind speed from January 2001 to December 2006 at Mazong Mountain and Jiuquan.
c8aa62f02357e64891cf6a1320263c4743136f74.result: The SARIMA-LSSVM hybrid forecasts better than single and other hybrid models and is described as simple and efficient.
c8aa62f02357e64891cf6a1320263c4743136f74.open_work: Test on longer records and more stations.
c8aa62f02357e64891cf6a1320263c4743136f74.issues: Very short record (six years) and two stations; monthly scale only.

cdacbc550fa8a82fee30dcef3adc508d0fbace6d.goal: Estimates power outages from tropical cyclones and asks whether simpler models can be more accurate.
cdacbc550fa8a82fee30dcef3adc508d0fbace6d.architecture: Random forest model with a reduced set of covariates, compared with previously published more complex outage models.
cdacbc550fa8a82fee30dcef3adc508d0fbace6d.data: Hurricane outage records for a US Gulf Coast electric utility with storm, environmental and system covariates.
cdacbc550fa8a82fee30dcef3adc508d0fbace6d.result: The random forest with fewer variables is reported to improve accuracy over earlier models.
cdacbc550fa8a82fee30dcef3adc508d0fbace6d.open_work: Extend to other utilities and regions and to forecast use ahead of landfall.
cdacbc550fa8a82fee30dcef3adc508d0fbace6d.issues: Single utility service area; few historical storms; details partly from knowledge.

9301045233307b965ed96cd7ded31c12a7f1873e.goal: Predicts monthly streamflow using only its own past values with support vector regression.
9301045233307b965ed96cd7ded31c12a7f1873e.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) using endogenous lagged streamflow inputs.
9301045233307b965ed96cd7ded31c12a7f1873e.data: Monthly streamflow records, reportedly from the Mahanadi River basin, India.
9301045233307b965ed96cd7ded31c12a7f1873e.result: SVR is reported to provide good monthly streamflow predictions from endogenous inputs; metrics not available here.
9301045233307b965ed96cd7ded31c12a7f1873e.open_work: Add exogenous climate predictors and longer lead times.
9301045233307b965ed96cd7ded31c12a7f1873e.issues: Univariate inputs cannot capture climate-driven shifts; single basin; details partly from knowledge.

4b05cbae570b510fb528ecccc7547696cae50ab4.goal: Estimates chlorophyll-a in optically complex coastal waters where standard ocean colour algorithms perform poorly.
4b05cbae570b510fb528ecccc7547696cae50ab4.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) mapping MERIS full-resolution reflectances to chlorophyll-a.
4b05cbae570b510fb528ecccc7547696cae50ab4.data: MERIS full-resolution imagery matched with in situ chlorophyll-a in the Galician rias, NW Spain.
4b05cbae570b510fb528ecccc7547696cae50ab4.result: The neural network is reported to estimate chlorophyll-a better than standard MERIS products in these waters; metrics not available here.
4b05cbae570b510fb528ecccc7547696cae50ab4.open_work: Validate on other coastal systems and sensors such as OLCI.
4b05cbae570b510fb528ecccc7547696cae50ab4.issues: Regional training limits transferability; small match-up dataset; details unverified without abstract.

b0631ba8f0eac53588f739388ee5ee158ca3db37.goal: Improves streamflow forecasting by tuning support vector machine parameters with quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization.
b0631ba8f0eac53588f739388ee5ee158ca3db37.architecture: Support vector machine regression with parameters optimized by quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization (QPSO).
b0631ba8f0eac53588f739388ee5ee158ca3db37.data: Monthly streamflow records from a river in India; station and period not reported in the available metadata.
b0631ba8f0eac53588f739388ee5ee158ca3db37.result: SVM-QPSO is reported to outperform ANN and other benchmarks; metrics not available here.
b0631ba8f0eac53588f739388ee5ee158ca3db37.open_work: Test on other basins and horizons.
b0631ba8f0eac53588f739388ee5ee158ca3db37.issues: Single river; univariate inputs; details unverified without abstract.

465e669f8c1f77794f55e3a59d4de27c6a8a9eae.goal: Predicts monthly maximum and minimum temperature in northeastern Bangladesh and assesses trends.
465e669f8c1f77794f55e3a59d4de27c6a8a9eae.architecture: Wavelet decomposition combined with ARIMA and with an artificial neural network; Mann–Kendall and Sen's slope trend tests.
465e669f8c1f77794f55e3a59d4de27c6a8a9eae.data: Monthly maximum and minimum temperature at Sylhet and Sreemangal, 1957–2000 training and 2001–2012 testing.
465e669f8c1f77794f55e3a59d4de27c6a8a9eae.result: Warming trends are found except maximum temperature at Sreemangal; wavelet-ARIMA outperforms wavelet-ANN.
465e669f8c1f77794f55e3a59d4de27c6a8a9eae.open_work: Extend to more stations and daily data.
465e669f8c1f77794f55e3a59d4de27c6a8a9eae.issues: Two stations; possible wavelet leakage; ANN configuration may be under-tuned.

58d3eb185d74ff584943ee8f8559cd8a369d4a23.goal: Emulates spatio-temporal outputs of a 2D hydraulic inundation model to enable fast, uncertainty-aware flood predictions.
58d3eb185d74ff584943ee8f8559cd8a369d4a23.architecture: Gaussian process emulator with dimensionality reduction of the output space, compared with a neural network emulator.
58d3eb185d74ff584943ee8f8559cd8a369d4a23.data: Simulation outputs from the LISFLOOD-FP hydraulic model for an inland flood case study.
58d3eb185d74ff584943ee8f8559cd8a369d4a23.result: The GP accurately reproduces water depths and inundation extent with about 10,000× speedup over the simulator and 80× over a neural network emulator, with built-in uncertainty.
58d3eb185d74ff584943ee8f8559cd8a369d4a23.open_work: Test on other catchments and larger parameter spaces.
58d3eb185d74ff584943ee8f8559cd8a369d4a23.issues: Single case study; emulates the model, not observations; GPs scale poorly with training size.

e5a74285636b694fac039294d8152c4b63c9cc62.goal: Predicts Indian summer monsoon rainfall to support agriculture and water planning.
e5a74285636b694fac039294d8152c4b63c9cc62.architecture: Artificial neural network; the specific architecture is not specified in the available metadata.
e5a74285636b694fac039294d8152c4b63c9cc62.data: Historical all-India summer monsoon rainfall time series; period not reported in the available metadata.
e5a74285636b694fac039294d8152c4b63c9cc62.result: The ANN is reported to predict ISMR with better skill than benchmark methods; metrics not available here.
e5a74285636b694fac039294d8152c4b63c9cc62.open_work: Add large-scale climate predictors and evaluate operational skill.
e5a74285636b694fac039294d8152c4b63c9cc62.issues: Short annual series give few samples; overfitting risk; details unverified without abstract.

fa3efd8e936d0ff2d50b12d3aefaa11e322f3b88.goal: Improves wind power forecasting with a hybrid of data mining and wavelet analysis.
fa3efd8e936d0ff2d50b12d3aefaa11e322f3b88.architecture: Hybrid using clustering-based data mining and wavelet decomposition with a neural network predictor; the exact network type is not specified in the available metadata.
fa3efd8e936d0ff2d50b12d3aefaa11e322f3b88.data: Wind power time series; sites and period not reported in the available metadata.
fa3efd8e936d0ff2d50b12d3aefaa11e322f3b88.result: The hybrid model is reported to outperform benchmark forecasting models; metrics not available here.
fa3efd8e936d0ff2d50b12d3aefaa11e322f3b88.open_work: Test on more farms and probabilistic outputs.

4fda60602d04fcd3d7a75fa6235f8d778f2df298.goal: Uses machine learning multi-model ensembles of CMIP5 GCMs to reproduce observed monthly rainfall and temperature in Australia.
4fda60602d04fcd3d7a75fa6235f8d778f2df298.architecture: Random forest and support vector machine ensembles compared with Bayesian model averaging and the arithmetic ensemble mean.
4fda60602d04fcd3d7a75fa6235f8d778f2df298.data: 33 CMIP5 GCM simulations and observed monthly rainfall and temperature in Australia.
4fda60602d04fcd3d7a75fa6235f8d778f2df298.result: RF and SVM outperform BMA and the ensemble mean; RF importance correlates with Taylor skill (0.95 temperature, 0.54 rainfall); GCMs reducible from 33 to 25 with under 2% error.
4fda60602d04fcd3d7a75fa6235f8d778f2df298.open_work: Apply ML ensembles to future projections and other variables.
4fda60602d04fcd3d7a75fa6235f8d778f2df298.issues: Fitted to historical observations, so future skill is unverified; ML weighting may break physical consistency.

8498ffa8c9ff788b578129034e99054ab75c36f7.goal: Corrects biases of gridded ECMWF-IFS forecasts at 24–240 h leads for severe weather warnings in North China.
8498ffa8c9ff788b578129034e99054ab75c36f7.architecture: CU-net, a U-Net-style convolutional neural network for image-to-image translation, compared with anomaly numerical correction (ANO).
8498ffa8c9ff788b578129034e99054ab75c36f7.data: ECMWF-IFS forecasts as predictors and ERA5 reanalysis as labels, 2005–2018, for 2-m temperature, 2-m relative humidity, 10-m wind speed and direction.
8498ffa8c9ff788b578129034e99054ab75c36f7.result: CU-net reduces RMSE, bias and MAE and raises correlation at all leads for all four variables, including wind direction, outperforming ANO.
8498ffa8c9ff788b578129034e99054ab75c36f7.open_work: Extend to precipitation and probabilistic correction, and evaluate against station observations.
8498ffa8c9ff788b578129034e99054ab75c36f7.issues: ERA5 labels inherit reanalysis biases; regional domain only; deterministic correction.

1b4836f0ad6865aa88f2d928cacc3caa11476c5e.goal: Produces a year-round Arctic sea-ice thickness record from CryoSat-2, filling the summer gap caused by melt ponds.
1b4836f0ad6865aa88f2d928cacc3caa11476c5e.architecture: Convolutional neural network to classify radar echoes into leads and floes in summer, combined with physical radar waveform modelling for freeboard retrieval.
1b4836f0ad6865aa88f2d928cacc3caa11476c5e.data: CryoSat-2 radar altimetry over the Arctic, roughly 2011–2020, evaluated against independent observations.
1b4836f0ad6865aa88f2d928cacc3caa11476c5e.result: Delivers the first year-round CryoSat-2 sea-ice thickness record; summer thickness information improves seasonal predictions of September sea-ice extent.
1b4836f0ad6865aa88f2d928cacc3caa11476c5e.open_work: Extend to other altimeters and the Antarctic, and assimilate summer thickness in forecasting systems.
1b4836f0ad6865aa88f2d928cacc3caa11476c5e.issues: Summer retrievals have larger uncertainties from melt ponds and snow assumptions; limited validation data in summer.

72561eff5fe84c9667761f470578547e8895dacb.goal: Improves short-term wind power prediction using wavelet transform and support vector machines.
72561eff5fe84c9667761f470578547e8895dacb.architecture: Two methods: wavelet decomposition of inputs with separate SVM models per mode, and SVM with a wavelet kernel instead of RBF, compared with RBF SVM.
72561eff5fe84c9667761f470578547e8895dacb.data: Operational data from one wind farm in Texas.
72561eff5fe84c9667761f470578547e8895dacb.result: The wavelet-based SVM methods are evaluated with mean relative error and relative mean square error against RBF SVM; a precision evaluation method is proposed.
72561eff5fe84c9667761f470578547e8895dacb.open_work: Test on more wind farms and longer horizons.
72561eff5fe84c9667761f470578547e8895dacb.issues: Single wind farm; no quantitative gains given in the abstract.

36cb710ca42928ae5904cf7445cd64d709c10acf.goal: Models the effects of land use and land cover change on daily streamflow.
36cb710ca42928ae5904cf7445cd64d709c10acf.architecture: Hybrid of an artificial neural network with the SCS curve number method to represent land-use effects.
36cb710ca42928ae5904cf7445cd64d709c10acf.data: Daily streamflow and land use/cover data; watershed and period not reported in the available metadata.
36cb710ca42928ae5904cf7445cd64d709c10acf.result: The hybrid ANN-curve number model is reported to capture land-use effects on daily streamflow better than ANN alone.
36cb710ca42928ae5904cf7445cd64d709c10acf.open_work: Apply to land-use scenarios and other basins.

fe35936220f0771b45637bc771d78d1bfe26bbf8.goal: Predicts rainfall amount from multichannel 3D weather radar data to improve short-term precipitation forecasting.
fe35936220f0771b45637bc771d78d1bfe26bbf8.architecture: DeepRain, a two-layer stacked convolutional LSTM (ConvLSTM) network that maps sequences of radar volumes to rainfall amounts.
fe35936220f0771b45637bc771d78d1bfe26bbf8.data: Two years of four-channel, three-dimensional radar reflectivity data at 6-minute intervals, with 15-record input sequences; radar product and region not specified.
fe35936220f0771b45637bc771d78d1bfe26bbf8.result: The two-stacked ConvLSTM reduces RMSE by 23.0% relative to a linear regression baseline.
fe35936220f0771b45637bc771d78d1bfe26bbf8.open_work: Comparison with stronger nowcasting baselines such as optical flow extrapolation and longer lead times remain to be tested.
fe35936220f0771b45637bc771d78d1bfe26bbf8.issues: Only a linear regression baseline is reported, the dataset is short, and skill for heavy rain events and lead-time dependence are not described.

b055e0e32db1f4aa235e422eaffeec13bb13454a.goal: Forecasts wind speed for wind energy applications with a hybrid decomposition-plus-deep-learning scheme.
b055e0e32db1f4aa235e422eaffeec13bb13454a.architecture: Hybrid model: ICEEMDAN signal decomposition of the wind speed series followed by a transformer forecaster trained with a novel loss function.
b055e0e32db1f4aa235e422eaffeec13bb13454a.data: Wind speed time series; site, period and resolution not reported here.
b055e0e32db1f4aa235e422eaffeec13bb13454a.result: The hybrid model is reported to outperform comparison models; specific error metrics are not reported here.
b055e0e32db1f4aa235e422eaffeec13bb13454a.open_work: Testing across more sites, horizons and probabilistic outputs would clarify generality.
b055e0e32db1f4aa235e422eaffeec13bb13454a.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if decomposition is applied to the full series; single-site evaluation and point-only forecasts are probable limits.

4e5bfad99086534d0abc77f78e4da661f7d30eac.goal: Maps flood risk and identifies the most influential flood-conditioning factors in the Galikesh River basin, northern Iran.
4e5bfad99086534d0abc77f78e4da661f7d30eac.architecture: Random forest used to rank the importance of 11 flood risk indices and produce the flood hazard map, with GIS-based index normalization.
4e5bfad99086534d0abc77f78e4da661f7d30eac.data: Landsat 8 imagery and SRTM DEM processed in Google Earth Engine to derive 11 indices (elevation, slope, aspect, land use, NDVI, NDWI, TWI, river distance, waterway density, soil texture, maximum one-day precipitation).
4e5bfad99086534d0abc77f78e4da661f7d30eac.result: Waterway and river density, river distance, maximum one-day precipitation and elevation explain about 68.3% of total flood risk; about 21% and 18% of the basin fall in high and highest risk classes.
4e5bfad99086534d0abc77f78e4da661f7d30eac.open_work: Validation against observed flood inventories and transfer to other basins would strengthen the mapping.
4e5bfad99086534d0abc77f78e4da661f7d30eac.issues: Single small basin; validation of the hazard map against independent flood events is not detailed in the abstract.

67b934f27c5ae0f81d41d9e6d9769ad74cd2ecd7.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for wind power operation by combining several individual forecasters.
67b934f27c5ae0f81d41d9e6d9769ad74cd2ecd7.architecture: Combined forecasting model with variable (time-varying) weights assigned to component models; the component model types are not specified here.
67b934f27c5ae0f81d41d9e6d9769ad74cd2ecd7.data: Wind speed time series from wind farm sites; locations and periods not reported here.
67b934f27c5ae0f81d41d9e6d9769ad74cd2ecd7.result: The variable-weight combined model is reported to outperform its individual components and fixed-weight combinations; numbers not reported here.
67b934f27c5ae0f81d41d9e6d9769ad74cd2ecd7.open_work: Extension to probabilistic forecasts and multi-site validation are natural next steps.
67b934f27c5ae0f81d41d9e6d9769ad74cd2ecd7.issues: Details unavailable without the abstract; combination weights optimized on limited data may overfit and results may be site-specific.

b0d5b1862831c82a0b15f4c3bd3726d1aba3bb25.goal: Quantifies uncertainty in wind speed forecasts by constructing prediction intervals instead of point forecasts, for safer power system operation.
b0d5b1862831c82a0b15f4c3bd3726d1aba3bb25.architecture: Hybrid framework with signal decomposition and feature selection modules plus a machine-learning forecaster tuned by a multi-objective optimization algorithm; Pareto compromise chosen by a min-max rule. Network type not specified.
b0d5b1862831c82a0b15f4c3bd3726d1aba3bb25.data: Hourly wind speed data from two periods in Penglai, China.
b0d5b1862831c82a0b15f4c3bd3726d1aba3bb25.result: Prediction intervals achieve high coverage with narrow width, outperforming single-objective and other multi-objective models, including variants with different preprocessing.
b0d5b1862831c82a0b15f4c3bd3726d1aba3bb25.open_work: Testing at other sites and longer horizons and comparison with probabilistic NWP-based methods remain open.
b0d5b1862831c82a0b15f4c3bd3726d1aba3bb25.issues: Single location, hourly univariate data only; the specific coverage and width values are not given in the abstract.

23d3c290252505d0ed5ee296022c857e01ec28ba.goal: Develops rapid urban flood detection from satellite imagery to support timely flood management in San Diego, California.
23d3c290252505d0ed5ee296022c857e01ec28ba.architecture: Supervised random forest, support vector machine and maximum likelihood classifiers compared with a new unsupervised change-detection framework combining Otsu thresholding, fuzzy rules and iso-clustering.
23d3c290252505d0ed5ee296022c857e01ec28ba.data: Sentinel-1 SAR imagery with ground truth from police road-closure reports for the City of San Diego.
23d3c290252505d0ed5ee296022c857e01ec28ba.result: F1 scores are 0.67 (RF), 0.85 (SVM), 0.79 (MLC) and 0.85 (change detection); the unsupervised method matches the best accuracy (0.87) with the least data and computation.
23d3c290252505d0ed5ee296022c857e01ec28ba.open_work: Application to other cities and to nuisance flooding is suggested.
23d3c290252505d0ed5ee296022c857e01ec28ba.issues: Ground truth from road-closure reports is sparse and indirect; SAR flood detection in dense urban areas suffers from layover and shadow effects.

a14f0e2c2057d36da2f3ad2c8c66cb385bf3a274.goal: Improves rainfall prediction for hydrological modelling by exploiting multi-scale variability in rainfall time series.
a14f0e2c2057d36da2f3ad2c8c66cb385bf3a274.architecture: Hybrid model: EEMD decomposes rainfall series; support vector regression predicts short-period components and an artificial neural network (MLP) predicts long-period components.
a14f0e2c2057d36da2f3ad2c8c66cb385bf3a274.data: Station rainfall series from Kunming, Lincang and Mengzi in Yunnan Province, China.
a14f0e2c2057d36da2f3ad2c8c66cb385bf3a274.result: The combined model outperforms traditional methods in accuracy and time efficiency; specific metrics are not given in the abstract.
a14f0e2c2057d36da2f3ad2c8c66cb385bf3a274.open_work: Testing on more stations, climates and forecast horizons is a natural extension.
a14f0e2c2057d36da2f3ad2c8c66cb385bf3a274.issues: Only three stations; EEMD-based hybrids can leak future information if decomposition is not done causally; no quantitative results in the abstract.

8b8ba251c11a326fd1b8e6acba7e9ea2318391bb.goal: Projects the impact of climate change on building cooling energy consumption under SSP scenarios and explains the drivers of the predictions.
8b8ba251c11a326fd1b8e6acba7e9ea2318391bb.architecture: Explainable AI (XAI) model relating outdoor conditions to cooling energy use, with explanation of temperature inflection points; the underlying learner type is not specified in the abstract.
8b8ba251c11a326fd1b8e6acba7e9ea2318391bb.data: Residential and commercial building cooling energy data in hot-humid and mixed-humid US climate regions, driven by future climate under SSP126, SSP245, SSP370 and SSP585 to 2100.
8b8ba251c11a326fd1b8e6acba7e9ea2318391bb.result: Predictions reach R2 > 0.9; cooling energy increases persistently to 2100, by up to 24.5–87.2% (hot-humid) and 37.1–121% (mixed-humid) across SSPs.
8b8ba251c11a326fd1b8e6acba7e9ea2318391bb.open_work: Integrating adaptation measures, building stock change and other climate regions is suggested by the results.
8b8ba251c11a326fd1b8e6acba7e9ea2318391bb.issues: Assumes present building-use relationships persist under extrapolated future temperatures; climate projection uncertainty across models is not detailed.

3ed3f6d075e058a859974338be2dcfe401b78c06.goal: Forecasts 24-hour-ahead solar global horizontal irradiance for grid planning and balancing.
3ed3f6d075e058a859974338be2dcfe401b78c06.architecture: Ensemble of wavelet transform decomposition and bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) networks, one per merged sub-series, with reconstruction of the final forecast.
3ed3f6d075e058a859974338be2dcfe401b78c06.data: One year of GHI data for Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, with monthly forecasting using a one-month moving window.
3ed3f6d075e058a859974338be2dcfe401b78c06.result: Monthly average RMSE is reduced by 5.2–31.4% vs standalone BiLSTM and more vs GRU, LSTM and naive models; R2 = 0.94 and forecast skill 47%.
3ed3f6d075e058a859974338be2dcfe401b78c06.open_work: Longer datasets, more sites and use of NWP or satellite inputs remain to be explored.
3ed3f6d075e058a859974338be2dcfe401b78c06.issues: Single site and one year of data; wavelet decomposition of the full series may introduce look-ahead bias.

f24d1791fe6bfc86097f59ceb486609bab2f0b8a.goal: Estimates evapotranspiration in different terrestrial ecosystems with machine learning as an alternative to physically based models.
f24d1791fe6bfc86097f59ceb486609bab2f0b8a.architecture: Comparison of four machine learning approaches, reported in the literature as artificial neural network, support vector machine, extreme learning machine and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system.
f24d1791fe6bfc86097f59ceb486609bab2f0b8a.data: Eddy covariance flux and meteorological measurements from sites across different ecosystems; specific sites not reported here.
f24d1791fe6bfc86097f59ceb486609bab2f0b8a.result: The models estimate ET well across ecosystems, with differences in performance among methods; exact metrics not reported here.
f24d1791fe6bfc86097f59ceb486609bab2f0b8a.open_work: Extension to more ecosystems and gap-filling or upscaling applications is a natural next step.
f24d1791fe6bfc86097f59ceb486609bab2f0b8a.issues: Site-based evaluation may not generalize; eddy covariance energy-balance closure errors propagate into targets.

1e6ecf35dfcb094d61f360b3bdfe241c54a3b404.goal: Compares gradient boosting models for daily streamflow forecasting in a mountainous catchment.
1e6ecf35dfcb094d61f360b3bdfe241c54a3b404.architecture: Gradient boosting decision trees: XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost, with default and tuned hyperparameters.
1e6ecf35dfcb094d61f360b3bdfe241c54a3b404.data: Daily precipitation, upstream gauge runoff and two preceding days of observations for a mountainous catchment; at least 12 years of training data.
1e6ecf35dfcb094d61f360b3bdfe241c54a3b404.result: All models reach NSE 0.85–0.89 and RMSE 6.8–7.8 m3/s; CatBoost is best with default settings and LightGBM after tuning; hyperparameter effects exceed between-model differences.
1e6ecf35dfcb094d61f360b3bdfe241c54a3b404.open_work: Comparison with deep learning models such as LSTM and longer lead times remain open.
1e6ecf35dfcb094d61f360b3bdfe241c54a3b404.issues: Single catchment; one-day-ahead forecasts using upstream observations limit applicability to ungauged settings.

bc4ce192d4ac25fefc4ac386ddb0565e1d9eee29.goal: Produces reliable flood susceptibility maps for flood management in Iranian basins.
bc4ce192d4ac25fefc4ac386ddb0565e1d9eee29.architecture: Cascade forest model (deep forest of tree ensembles) compared with support vector machine, decision tree, random forest, deep neural network, LightGBM, XGBoost and CatBoost.
bc4ce192d4ac25fefc4ac386ddb0565e1d9eee29.data: 21 flood-conditioning factors with flood inventories from satellite imagery, historical reports and field data in the Karun and Gorganrud basins, Iran.
bc4ce192d4ac25fefc4ac386ddb0565e1d9eee29.result: The cascade forest achieves the highest accuracy in both areas, with overall accuracy above 95%, kappa above 0.8 and AUC above 0.95.
bc4ce192d4ac25fefc4ac386ddb0565e1d9eee29.open_work: Transfer to other regions and dynamic susceptibility under climate change remain open.
bc4ce192d4ac25fefc4ac386ddb0565e1d9eee29.issues: Susceptibility mapping depends on the quality of the flood inventory; spatial autocorrelation between training and test samples may inflate accuracy.

db049ca199d3ca9039b616bda1e250382907da75.goal: Models urban coastal flood severity from crowd-sourced flood reports to support flood management in a tidally influenced city.
db049ca199d3ca9039b616bda1e250382907da75.architecture: Poisson regression compared with random forest to predict the number of flood reports per event from environmental drivers.
db049ca199d3ca9039b616bda1e250382907da75.data: Crowd-sourced street flood reports in Norfolk, Virginia, with rainfall, tide level and other environmental variables.
db049ca199d3ca9039b616bda1e250382907da75.result: Random forest predicts flood report counts better than Poisson regression; rainfall and tide-related variables are key predictors.
db049ca199d3ca9039b616bda1e250382907da75.open_work: Using the models for real-time flood warning and adding more reports are natural next steps.
db049ca199d3ca9039b616bda1e250382907da75.issues: Crowd-sourced reports are biased by reporting behaviour and location; report counts are a proxy for severity.

59b07ac07f60dea7df4963a05a8c53625f48fcaa.goal: Provides short-term prediction of meteorological time series relevant to solar energy and other applications.
59b07ac07f60dea7df4963a05a8c53625f48fcaa.architecture: Least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) regression for time-series prediction.
59b07ac07f60dea7df4963a05a8c53625f48fcaa.data: Measured meteorological time series at a station; variables, site and period not reported here.
59b07ac07f60dea7df4963a05a8c53625f48fcaa.result: LS-SVM is reported to give accurate short-term predictions compared with reference methods; specific metrics not reported here.
59b07ac07f60dea7df4963a05a8c53625f48fcaa.open_work: Testing at more sites and with additional predictors would extend the work.
59b07ac07f60dea7df4963a05a8c53625f48fcaa.issues: Details unavailable without the abstract; likely single-site evaluation.

aa1603eaae6bdc598556c581352f292bf6aaffb6.goal: Characterizes the global climatology, physical properties and radiative effects of marine stratocumulus cloud morphologies (mesoscale cellular convection types).
aa1603eaae6bdc598556c581352f292bf6aaffb6.architecture: Artificial neural network cloud classification scheme assigning scenes to closed, open or disorganized cellular MCC, combined with A-train observational analysis.
aa1603eaae6bdc598556c581352f292bf6aaffb6.data: A-train satellite observations (e.g. MODIS imagery, CloudSat radar reflectivity) on a global scale.
aa1603eaae6bdc598556c581352f292bf6aaffb6.result: Closed MCC has mean cloud fraction of about 90%, versus 51% for open and 40% for disorganized MCC; morphologies differ markedly in drizzle, cloud top height and shortwave reflectance.
aa1603eaae6bdc598556c581352f292bf6aaffb6.open_work: Linking morphology changes to cloud feedbacks and evaluating model representation of MCC types follow from the results.
aa1603eaae6bdc598556c581352f292bf6aaffb6.issues: Classification relies on a pre-trained ANN with limited categories; observational sampling and retrieval uncertainties affect the statistics.

bcc341319b885be6955ca8fb7f03df88c003dce3.goal: Forecasts a regional air pollution index for NO2, CO, SO2 and O3 three days ahead in Athens, Greece, for public warning.
bcc341319b885be6955ca8fb7f03df88c003dce3.data: Air quality monitoring and meteorological data from the Athens area; period not reported here.
bcc341319b885be6955ca8fb7f03df88c003dce3.result: The ANN models are reported to forecast the pollution index with useful skill three days ahead; metrics not reported here.
bcc341319b885be6955ca8fb7f03df88c003dce3.open_work: Inclusion of meteorological forecasts and particulate matter are natural extensions.
bcc341319b885be6955ca8fb7f03df88c003dce3.issues: Details unavailable without the abstract; skill for extreme pollution episodes is uncertain.

eaa55053d6894b6b00134ab6e4ad81d847145405.goal: Forecasts day-ahead photovoltaic power and quantifies its uncertainty for grid operation.
eaa55053d6894b6b00134ab6e4ad81d847145405.architecture: A novel forecasting method combining point prediction with uncertainty analysis; the model type is not specified in the title.
eaa55053d6894b6b00134ab6e4ad81d847145405.data: Photovoltaic power and meteorological data; sites and period not reported here.
eaa55053d6894b6b00134ab6e4ad81d847145405.result: The proposed method is reported to improve accuracy and uncertainty estimates over comparison methods; numbers not reported here.
eaa55053d6894b6b00134ab6e4ad81d847145405.open_work: Validation across plants and climates is a natural next step.

f194dde7b1c6fa3a6594d65bd7fa9ebe70e3c0df.goal: Improves global estimates of soil hydraulic properties needed for land surface and hydrological models.
f194dde7b1c6fa3a6594d65bd7fa9ebe70e3c0df.architecture: Hierarchical pedotransfer functions estimating Kosugi retention and conductivity parameters using machine learning combined with bootstrapping (neural network based in the Rosetta tradition).
f194dde7b1c6fa3a6594d65bd7fa9ebe70e3c0df.data: Global dataset of nearly 50,000 soil samples (118,000 retention points); applied to a 1 km global map of texture and bulk density.
f194dde7b1c6fa3a6594d65bd7fa9ebe70e3c0df.result: Kosugi-based PTFs outperform two van Genuchten-based PTFs; global 1 km maps of hydraulic parameters, field capacity, wilting point and plant available water with uncertainties are produced.
f194dde7b1c6fa3a6594d65bd7fa9ebe70e3c0df.open_work: Better sampling of under-represented regions and inclusion of soil structure are open directions.
f194dde7b1c6fa3a6594d65bd7fa9ebe70e3c0df.issues: Training samples are unevenly distributed geographically; PTFs rely on texture and bulk density and ignore structure and organic effects.

8906171568521bec09e5333938f129df72091dc5.goal: Forecasts evapotranspiration in different climates for irrigation and water management.
8906171568521bec09e5333938f129df72091dc5.architecture: Ensembles of recurrent neural networks for ET forecasting; the specific recurrent cell types are not specified here.
8906171568521bec09e5333938f129df72091dc5.data: Meteorological and ET data from sites in different climates; specifics not reported here.
8906171568521bec09e5333938f129df72091dc5.result: The RNN ensembles are reported to forecast ET accurately across climates; specific metrics not reported here.
8906171568521bec09e5333938f129df72091dc5.open_work: Longer horizons and use of weather forecasts as inputs are natural next steps.
8906171568521bec09e5333938f129df72091dc5.issues: Details unavailable without the abstract; site-based results may not transfer.

04f97db6d1a262f9b195a18a0cab6015c7cb44c7.goal: Forecasts short-term PM2.5 concentrations while capturing non-linear spatial and temporal dependencies among air quality sensors.
04f97db6d1a262f9b195a18a0cab6015c7cb44c7.architecture: GC-DCRNN: geo-context based diffusion convolutional recurrent neural network (graph neural network) with a sequence-to-sequence encoder-decoder; graph built from built-environment similarity.
04f97db6d1a262f9b195a18a0cab6015c7cb44c7.data: Two real-world air quality sensor datasets plus geographic features such as parks and factories around each sensor (Los Angeles and Beijing in the paper).
04f97db6d1a262f9b195a18a0cab6015c7cb44c7.result: Consistent 5–10% improvement over baseline approaches including ARIMA and ANN-type models.
04f97db6d1a262f9b195a18a0cab6015c7cb44c7.open_work: Adding meteorological forecasts and dynamic graphs are natural extensions.
04f97db6d1a262f9b195a18a0cab6015c7cb44c7.issues: Static graph from geographic features; short-term horizons only; limited number of datasets.

2ebb2aead4490354f4e74547f7f3f21c5bb944dc.goal: Predicts soil temperature from meteorological variables for agricultural and climate applications.
2ebb2aead4490354f4e74547f7f3f21c5bb944dc.architecture: Linear and nonlinear regression models compared with an artificial neural network (feed-forward).
2ebb2aead4490354f4e74547f7f3f21c5bb944dc.data: Meteorological station and soil temperature measurements; site and depths not reported here.
2ebb2aead4490354f4e74547f7f3f21c5bb944dc.result: The ANN is reported to predict soil temperature better than the regression models; metrics not reported here.
2ebb2aead4490354f4e74547f7f3f21c5bb944dc.open_work: Testing at more stations and depths would extend the work.
2ebb2aead4490354f4e74547f7f3f21c5bb944dc.issues: Details unavailable without the abstract; single-region data.

d05e4befb6082af02caaecfc324001db3ffb923f.goal: Improves multistep-ahead forecasting of global horizontal irradiance for photovoltaic plant planning by automatically designing the network architecture.
d05e4befb6082af02caaecfc324001db3ffb923f.architecture: Deep CNN-LSTM (convolutional LSTM) whose architecture is optimized by an improved sine-cosine swarm evolutionary algorithm with a three-phase modification.
d05e4befb6082af02caaecfc324001db3ffb923f.data: Three datasets from three solar stations in the eastern United States.
d05e4befb6082af02caaecfc324001db3ffb923f.result: The method outperforms other forecasting models; numbers not given in the abstract.
d05e4befb6082af02caaecfc324001db3ffb923f.open_work: Extension to probabilistic forecasting and other climates is natural.
d05e4befb6082af02caaecfc324001db3ffb923f.issues: Architecture search is computationally costly; limited to three stations; no quantitative results in the abstract.

55881ccce27bc2f1e0437ac605aea6370530eed0.goal: Surveys machine learning and deep learning for wind, solar and photovoltaic energy forecasting and storage optimization.
55881ccce27bc2f1e0437ac605aea6370530eed0.architecture: Review of ML and DL methods for renewable energy with a new performance taxonomy, emphasizing hybrid learning and optimization methods.
55881ccce27bc2f1e0437ac605aea6370530eed0.data: Published literature on wind and solar energy learning-based models.
55881ccce27bc2f1e0437ac605aea6370530eed0.result: Hybrid learning methods consistently outperform single methods; efficiency, robustness, accuracy and generalization remain main difficulties.
55881ccce27bc2f1e0437ac605aea6370530eed0.open_work: Recommends developing hybrid learning techniques combined with optimization methods.
55881ccce27bc2f1e0437ac605aea6370530eed0.issues: Literature survey without new experiments; comparisons across studies with different data are not standardized.

839518ec503846e8bc4a5301bf5c0eace4f83ad3.goal: Predicts short-term photovoltaic power output despite weather-driven fluctuations.
839518ec503846e8bc4a5301bf5c0eace4f83ad3.architecture: Hybrid HKGE model: improved K-means clustering and grey relational analysis select similar days, and an Elman recurrent neural network maps meteorological factors to power.
839518ec503846e8bc4a5301bf5c0eace4f83ad3.data: Two years of multivariate meteorological factors and historical PV power data.
839518ec503846e8bc4a5301bf5c0eace4f83ad3.result: Outperforms eight other prediction methods in accuracy; exact metrics not given in the abstract.
839518ec503846e8bc4a5301bf5c0eace4f83ad3.open_work: Testing on more plants and longer horizons is natural.
839518ec503846e8bc4a5301bf5c0eace4f83ad3.issues: Single plant dataset; reliance on similar-day selection may fail under unusual weather.

217ee256dbcfc0a2b24b3f04a9c8597c5727535b.goal: Forecasts streamflow with uncertainty to support flood management.
217ee256dbcfc0a2b24b3f04a9c8597c5727535b.architecture: Ensemble of wavelet neural networks (wavelet decomposition combined with artificial neural networks) to give ensemble streamflow forecasts.
217ee256dbcfc0a2b24b3f04a9c8597c5727535b.data: Streamflow and hydrometeorological records from a river basin; specifics not reported here.
217ee256dbcfc0a2b24b3f04a9c8597c5727535b.result: The wavelet neural network ensemble is reported to improve forecast accuracy and provide uncertainty bounds; numbers not reported here.
217ee256dbcfc0a2b24b3f04a9c8597c5727535b.open_work: Operational testing for flood warning and longer lead times are natural next steps.
217ee256dbcfc0a2b24b3f04a9c8597c5727535b.issues: Details unavailable without the abstract; wavelet-based inputs can introduce boundary effects in real-time use.

0a460026208c1d3a82bfd9704ca4329a0322f2c5.goal: Produces short-term probabilistic wind power forecasts for a wind farm using past forecast analogs.
0a460026208c1d3a82bfd9704ca4329a0322f2c5.architecture: Analog ensemble: a non-neural, nearest-neighbour style method that builds an ensemble from past observations whose NWP forecasts match the current forecast.

3985f3fcfaab5c4289018416282adc92991dac31.goal: Addresses the lack of standardized, labeled underwater imagery that limits machine learning for ocean visual monitoring.

3985f3fcfaab5c4289018416282adc92991dac31.open_work: Growing the database with more community-labeled data and taxa.
3985f3fcfaab5c4289018416282adc92991dac31.issues: Label coverage is uneven across taxa and regions; models may not generalize to new imaging systems.

ef545c2efe282aaa9188e732e75e3d7c28c43bf3.goal: Forecasts very short-term wind power for grid integration in variable wind conditions.
ef545c2efe282aaa9188e732e75e3d7c28c43bf3.architecture: Neural networks trained with an adaptive Bayesian learning scheme.

408e3acc9b09ef66aa9394f69ee167dc4c418f21.result: The GRU model is reported to give accurate multi-hour forecasts versus comparison models; numbers not reported here.
408e3acc9b09ef66aa9394f69ee167dc4c418f21.open_work: Adding NWP inputs and probabilistic outputs is natural.

09a7175e43246e1e01d1df1e6b6b9e80f4e0a55a.goal: Improves regional wind power and solar irradiance forecasts by post-processing NWP output.
09a7175e43246e1e01d1df1e6b6b9e80f4e0a55a.architecture: Principal component analysis for dimension reduction combined with artificial neural network and analog ensemble post-processing.
09a7175e43246e1e01d1df1e6b6b9e80f4e0a55a.data: NWP forecasts with regional wind power observations and solar irradiance measurements; specifics not reported here.

f22b41aefc9143af1122b2ff31b596a1fcbdbde9.goal: Identifies meteorological drivers and forecasts PM10 and PM2.5 in Bogotá, Colombia, to support early warnings.

f22b41aefc9143af1122b2ff31b596a1fcbdbde9.data: 2010–2015 data from 13 Bogotá monitoring stations; Kennedy (most polluted) and Parque Simón Bolívar (least polluted) stations used for models.

99e55d0feb702e412c5e8057ef77fb024f1fe3d6.goal: Selects the most reliable hourly solar irradiation forecasting model for 1–6 h horizons according to the meteorological variability of a site.
99e55d0feb702e412c5e8057ef77fb024f1fe3d6.architecture: Comparison of eleven statistical and machine learning tools, including ARMA, multi-layer perceptron (MLP), bagged regression trees and random forest, with a variability-based model selection methodology.
99e55d0feb702e412c5e8057ef77fb024f1fe3d6.data: Hourly global solar irradiation measured at three Mediterranean sites with low, medium and high variability: Ajaccio, Tilos and Odeillo; variability quantified by mean absolute log return.

99e55d0feb702e412c5e8057ef77fb024f1fe3d6.issues: Only three sites are used and inputs are mostly endogenous irradiation series; no satellite or NWP inputs and no uncertainty quantification.

38dcf5a33005b5a072fd96781f5c739061207c72.goal: Improves multi-step-ahead wind speed prediction for wind power integration by combining signal decomposition, deep learning and error correction.
38dcf5a33005b5a072fd96781f5c739061207c72.architecture: Hybrid model: variational mode decomposition with feature selection (KL divergence, energy measure, sample entropy), an LSTM network per sub-signal, and a GARCH-based error correction stage.
38dcf5a33005b5a072fd96781f5c739061207c72.data: Three real wind speed forecasting cases; site names and record lengths are not reported in the abstract.
38dcf5a33005b5a072fd96781f5c739061207c72.result: The hybrid model consistently yields the smallest statistical errors and outperforms the benchmark methods in all three cases.

38dcf5a33005b5a072fd96781f5c739061207c72.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information if decomposition is applied to the full series; single-site univariate setting with no meteorological predictors.

376ffcc0f5ac6bb3b228c071f976b84d36ca93f9.goal: Assesses how well LSTM-based models forecast solar radiation and photovoltaic power to support grid reliability and energy market decisions.

a9f68dce034cb480e9e82413a455cde08b6b961a.goal: Forecasts hourly production of newly installed solar plants that lack long training records, using transfer learning.
a9f68dce034cb480e9e82413a455cde08b6b961a.architecture: Stacked LSTM network with three transfer learning strategies (weight initialization and feature extraction with different layer freezing), compared with a non-TL LSTM and smart persistence.
a9f68dce034cb480e9e82413a455cde08b6b961a.data: Hourly production of 6 solar plants; experiments with training sets from 1 year down to 3 months.
a9f68dce034cb480e9e82413a455cde08b6b961a.result: Transfer learning improves RMSE by 12.6% and forecast skill by 16.3% with 1 year of data, with larger gains for shorter (3-month) training sets.

a9f68dce034cb480e9e82413a455cde08b6b961a.issues: Only six plants are tested; dependence on similarity between source and target plants is not fully characterized.

3974c40a4cb4ffef107a16766cf8585ff9aba3d2.goal: Evaluates how the choice of mother wavelet affects hybrid wavelet neural network rainfall-runoff models.
3974c40a4cb4ffef107a16766cf8585ff9aba3d2.architecture: Hybrid wavelet artificial neural networks: multilayer perceptron (MLP) and radial basis function (RBF) networks with continuous and discrete wavelet transform preprocessing of rainfall, using 23 mother wavelets (92 models).

7b69de63505a48aa039542797402575f3144f51b.goal: Estimates water-column nutrient and carbonate system variables globally from routinely measured hydrographic properties and oxygen, where direct biogeochemical observations are sparse.

e5bbdce354ea84ad6c36cd420415429f950038ea.issues: Single reservoir; lead time and inputs unclear; no uncertainty quantification or extreme-flood analysis.

5f43f570a5da507aefa7f78b4910fed537473bc9.goal: Quantifies coastal-ocean surface pCO2 and its seasonality, as continental shelf air–sea CO2 exchange is poorly constrained due to sparse sampling.
5f43f570a5da507aefa7f78b4910fed537473bc9.architecture: Modified two-step SOM-FFN neural network: self-organizing map clustering followed by feed-forward neural networks (MLP), with sea ice and wind speed added as predictors.
5f43f570a5da507aefa7f78b4910fed537473bc9.data: SOCATv4 pCO2 observations for training; independent validation with LDEO2015; monthly 0.25° product over continental margins, 1998–2015.
5f43f570a5da507aefa7f78b4910fed537473bc9.result: Confirms a meridional pCO2 gradient on shelves and reveals strong basin differences in seasonality, larger at high latitudes and not explained by temperature alone.
5f43f570a5da507aefa7f78b4910fed537473bc9.open_work: Merging with open-ocean pCO2 products into a seamless global climatology and estimating coastal air–sea CO2 fluxes.
5f43f570a5da507aefa7f78b4910fed537473bc9.issues: Coastal data remain sparse and heterogeneous, so interpolation uncertainty is large in undersampled shelves; predictor products carry their own biases.

30c752e54949c088f7b86c0c316cad06e8440bc6.goal: Produces probabilistic wind power forecasts for the GEFCom2014 wind track.
30c752e54949c088f7b86c0c316cad06e8440bc6.architecture: Gradient boosting machines (tree ensembles) trained with quantile loss to output forecast quantiles, with engineered wind features.
30c752e54949c088f7b86c0c316cad06e8440bc6.data: GEFCom2014 wind track: power from 10 wind farms with ECMWF forecasts of 10 m and 100 m wind components.
30c752e54949c088f7b86c0c316cad06e8440bc6.result: The quantile gradient boosting approach ranked at the top of the GEFCom2014 wind track on pinball loss.
30c752e54949c088f7b86c0c316cad06e8440bc6.open_work: Better calibration of extreme quantiles and joint modelling across farms.
30c752e54949c088f7b86c0c316cad06e8440bc6.issues: Competition setting with a single dataset; independent per-quantile models can cross; heavy feature engineering limits transferability.

2082b0565ee8b49b7797f06d207524152c05ada4.goal: Downscales large-scale atmospheric circulation to local river flows to assess hydrological impacts of climate.
2082b0565ee8b49b7797f06d207524152c05ada4.architecture: Comparison of statistical downscaling models: generalized linear models, generalized additive models, aggregated boosted trees and multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks.
2082b0565ee8b49b7797f06d207524152c05ada4.data: Large-scale reanalysis predictors (NCEP) and daily flows at French river gauging stations.
2082b0565ee8b49b7797f06d207524152c05ada4.result: Nonlinear methods (GAM, boosted trees, MLP) generally outperform the linear GLM in reproducing observed flows.
2082b0565ee8b49b7797f06d207524152c05ada4.open_work: Applying the downscaling to GCM projections to estimate future river flow changes.
2082b0565ee8b49b7797f06d207524152c05ada4.issues: Statistical downscaling assumes stationary predictor–flow relationships under climate change; inherits reanalysis biases.

97f0fa76de96a3a100b629e143f94835aa7a330d.goal: Forecasts short-term solar radiation at small spatial scale for solar energy applications.
97f0fa76de96a3a100b629e143f94835aa7a330d.architecture: Comparison and combination of linear ARMA models and a nonlinear autoregressive (NAR) neural network.
97f0fa76de96a3a100b629e143f94835aa7a330d.data: Measured solar radiation time series from a station in Algeria; resolution and period not reported here.
97f0fa76de96a3a100b629e143f94835aa7a330d.result: The nonlinear autoregressive neural network is reported to capture nonlinear variability better than ARMA alone.
97f0fa76de96a3a100b629e143f94835aa7a330d.open_work: Adding exogenous meteorological inputs and testing at more sites and horizons.
97f0fa76de96a3a100b629e143f94835aa7a330d.issues: Univariate single-site evaluation; cloud-driven ramps hard to capture from past radiation alone; no probabilistic output.

f1314d5cba02755f476c5363fd05dfc8e88eac07.goal: Forecasts meteorological drought using the Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) to support drought management.
f1314d5cba02755f476c5363fd05dfc8e88eac07.architecture: Comparison of artificial intelligence models (artificial neural network, ANFIS and support vector machine) with a stochastic ARIMAX model.
f1314d5cba02755f476c5363fd05dfc8e88eac07.data: Precipitation-derived SPI series from stations in Iran; details not reported here.
f1314d5cba02755f476c5363fd05dfc8e88eac07.result: Model performances are compared for SPI forecasting; specific rankings and errors not available here.
f1314d5cba02755f476c5363fd05dfc8e88eac07.open_work: Testing longer lead times, more stations and hybrid approaches.
f1314d5cba02755f476c5363fd05dfc8e88eac07.issues: Single region, short records typical of SPI studies, and limited independent testing.

f8106d7902a2231bdf13b2e40ab360ffa93a82e9.goal: Forecasts significant wave height for ocean engineering and coastal operations at multiple lead times.
f8106d7902a2231bdf13b2e40ab360ffa93a82e9.architecture: Hybrid wavelet fuzzy logic: discrete wavelet decomposition of wave height series combined with a fuzzy logic inference model.
f8106d7902a2231bdf13b2e40ab360ffa93a82e9.data: Significant wave height observations from ocean buoys; specific stations and periods not reported here.
f8106d7902a2231bdf13b2e40ab360ffa93a82e9.result: The wavelet fuzzy approach is reported to improve forecasts over plain fuzzy logic, especially at longer lead times.
f8106d7902a2231bdf13b2e40ab360ffa93a82e9.open_work: Adding wind forcing inputs and comparing with numerical wave models.
f8106d7902a2231bdf13b2e40ab360ffa93a82e9.issues: Univariate buoy-based forecasts; non-causal wavelet decomposition can leak information; limited sites.

9efd841a563524dde3b6ab023065ee204732c56a.goal: Downscales coarse climate model information to local precipitation, selecting the most informative large-scale predictors.
9efd841a563524dde3b6ab023065ee204732c56a.architecture: Machine learning statistical downscaling with support vector machine and relevance vector machine regressors plus an optimal predictor selection step.
9efd841a563524dde3b6ab023065ee204732c56a.data: Large-scale atmospheric predictors from reanalysis and GCM output with station precipitation; region and period not reported here.
9efd841a563524dde3b6ab023065ee204732c56a.result: Predictor selection improves downscaling skill and the machine learning models reproduce observed precipitation statistics reasonably; detailed scores not available here.
9efd841a563524dde3b6ab023065ee204732c56a.open_work: Applying to future scenarios and quantifying downscaling uncertainty across GCMs.
9efd841a563524dde3b6ab023065ee204732c56a.issues: Stationarity assumption; precipitation extremes and occurrence are hard for regression-based downscaling.

3da90283fd8ef08687d3a443ee69232af1c68240.goal: Estimates monthly mean reference evapotranspiration (ET0) across Turkey where full meteorological data are limited.
3da90283fd8ef08687d3a443ee69232af1c68240.architecture: Artificial neural network and ANFIS models compared with regression and empirical ET0 equations.
3da90283fd8ef08687d3a443ee69232af1c68240.data: Long-term monthly climate records from meteorological stations in Turkey with FAO-56 Penman–Monteith ET0 as target.
3da90283fd8ef08687d3a443ee69232af1c68240.result: The data-driven models are reported to estimate ET0 more accurately than the empirical equations; exact scores not available here.
3da90283fd8ef08687d3a443ee69232af1c68240.open_work: Testing spatial transfer to ungauged sites and other climates.
3da90283fd8ef08687d3a443ee69232af1c68240.issues: Targets are calculated Penman–Monteith ET0 rather than measured ET; monthly means smooth variability.

42aa08f71e4ffd844c5c6fac5fa86a16655398b7.goal: Classifies sea ice types from SAR imagery to support ice charting and navigation.
42aa08f71e4ffd844c5c6fac5fa86a16655398b7.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) classifier using grey-level co-occurrence texture features and ice concentration as inputs.
42aa08f71e4ffd844c5c6fac5fa86a16655398b7.data: RADARSAT-2 dual-polarization ScanSAR imagery with ice concentration information; region and dates not reported here.
42aa08f71e4ffd844c5c6fac5fa86a16655398b7.result: Adding ice concentration to texture features improves SVM sea ice classification accuracy; exact accuracy not available here.
42aa08f71e4ffd844c5c6fac5fa86a16655398b7.open_work: Extending to more seasons, regions and automatic operational charting.
42aa08f71e4ffd844c5c6fac5fa86a16655398b7.issues: Limited scenes; SAR backscatter ambiguity with wind and melt; hand-crafted features.

c36313e6f453106c683c7b3a6b79f7f4a02c98db.goal: Predicts local rainfall automatically using meteorological data collected from the Internet and shared local sensors.
c36313e6f453106c683c7b3a6b79f7f4a02c98db.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) trained with a hybrid back-propagation and random-optimization algorithm, compared with a radial basis function network.
c36313e6f453106c683c7b3a6b79f7f4a02c98db.data: Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) website data: Matsuyama, Sapporo, Naha (train 2011, test 2012), 16 points in Japan, and Tokyo 2000–2010 for heavy rainfall in 2011–2012.
c36313e6f453106c683c7b3a6b79f7f4a02c98db.result: The MLP outperforms the RBFN but not JMA's operational forecasts; heavy summer afternoon rainfall in Tokyo is captured with a high hit rate.
c36313e6f453106c683c7b3a6b79f7f4a02c98db.open_work: Incorporating more shared local sensor and big Internet data to improve skill toward operational level.
c36313e6f453106c683c7b3a6b79f7f4a02c98db.issues: Point predictions with short training records; underperforms JMA forecasts; heavy rain test limited to Tokyo.

6aa783715a0675894d8e26e09227d8ff66131ce9.goal: Forecasts dynamic line rating (ampacity) of overhead power lines from weather predictions to increase transmission capacity safely.
6aa783715a0675894d8e26e09227d8ff66131ce9.architecture: Machine learning regression applied to numerical weather prediction outputs; the specific model family is not specified here.
6aa783715a0675894d8e26e09227d8ff66131ce9.data: NWP forecasts and line monitoring measurements from a case-study transmission line; details not reported here.
6aa783715a0675894d8e26e09227d8ff66131ce9.result: Machine learning post-processing of NWP is reported to give useful ampacity forecasts compared with static ratings.
6aa783715a0675894d8e26e09227d8ff66131ce9.open_work: Probabilistic ratings and validation on more lines and terrains.
6aa783715a0675894d8e26e09227d8ff66131ce9.issues: Single case study; local wind at conductor level poorly resolved by NWP.

34749dc83d001050e48b9e9b4cf9c00c913745d0.goal: Assesses the consequences of training and testing data-driven ET0 models with calculated FAO56-PM targets instead of lysimeter measurements.
34749dc83d001050e48b9e9b4cf9c00c913745d0.architecture: Gene expression programming (GEP) symbolic regression models, compared with FAO56 Penman–Monteith and calibrated Hargreaves equations; non-deep method.
34749dc83d001050e48b9e9b4cf9c00c913745d0.data: Lysimeter measurements and calculated ET0 targets at stations (Spain), with two input combinations and k-fold testing including cross-station evaluation.
34749dc83d001050e48b9e9b4cf9c00c913745d0.result: GEP trained on lysimeter targets beats HG and FAO56-PM locally, but loses accuracy cross-station; models trained on calculated targets degrade markedly against lysimeter benchmarks.
34749dc83d001050e48b9e9b4cf9c00c913745d0.open_work: Wider use of experimental targets for training and evaluating ET0 models; four new GEP equations provided.
34749dc83d001050e48b9e9b4cf9c00c913745d0.issues: Few lysimeter stations; conclusions from calculated-only benchmarks may be misleading, which also affects much prior literature.

269bf49e00c6cd43e23c2f7ff7285bdb4e0cf4db.goal: Predicts mean daily river water temperature across a region, including unmonitored streams, for aquatic habitat assessment.
269bf49e00c6cd43e23c2f7ff7285bdb4e0cf4db.architecture: Ensemble of artificial neural networks (MLP) trained regionally with air temperature and landscape predictors.
269bf49e00c6cd43e23c2f7ff7285bdb4e0cf4db.data: Daily stream temperature observations from many sites in the eastern United States with gridded meteorology and catchment attributes; details not reported here.
269bf49e00c6cd43e23c2f7ff7285bdb4e0cf4db.result: The regional neural network ensemble predicts daily stream temperature with low error at withheld sites.
269bf49e00c6cd43e23c2f7ff7285bdb4e0cf4db.open_work: Using the model to project stream temperature under climate and land-use change.
269bf49e00c6cd43e23c2f7ff7285bdb4e0cf4db.issues: Lacks explicit groundwater and process representation; extrapolation to future climates uncertain.

dbfea9492ca41bb4c0dba488b54a5023091878ea.goal: Reviews parameters and methods used in flood susceptibility mapping to identify strengths, limitations and trends.
dbfea9492ca41bb4c0dba488b54a5023091878ea.architecture: Review of about 160 methods including MCDM, physically based hydrological models, statistical methods and soft computing (machine learning, fuzzy logic, metaheuristics).
dbfea9492ca41bb4c0dba488b54a5023091878ea.data: Scientific publications indexed in Web of Science on flood susceptibility mapping.
dbfea9492ca41bb4c0dba488b54a5023091878ea.result: Studies use 5 to 21 conditioning parameters; the most common is used in 97% of studies; methods have shifted from expert judgment to statistical and machine learning approaches.
dbfea9492ca41bb4c0dba488b54a5023091878ea.open_work: Standardizing parameter choice and methodology across flood susceptibility studies.
dbfea9492ca41bb4c0dba488b54a5023091878ea.issues: Bibliometric scope limited to WoS; no quantitative benchmarking of method performance.

0e5cd2129995e4f37d3ccb78eb0f49f115dcaec4.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area to support urban flood risk management.
0e5cd2129995e4f37d3ccb78eb0f49f115dcaec4.architecture: Tree-based machine learning models (decision-tree ensembles); the exact variants are not specified here.
0e5cd2129995e4f37d3ccb78eb0f49f115dcaec4.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors (topography, rainfall, land use etc.) for the Greater Bay Area; details not reported here.
0e5cd2129995e4f37d3ccb78eb0f49f115dcaec4.result: Tree-based models produce flood susceptibility maps with good discrimination; specific scores not available here.
0e5cd2129995e4f37d3ccb78eb0f49f115dcaec4.open_work: Incorporating dynamic rainfall scenarios and urban drainage.
0e5cd2129995e4f37d3ccb78eb0f49f115dcaec4.issues: Susceptibility mapping depends on incomplete flood inventories and static factors; spatial autocorrelation may inflate validation.

4adee5be5f061f769fc7142311796849cbef5013.goal: Predicts wind turbine power output accounting for turbulence and shear in addition to hub height wind speed.
4adee5be5f061f769fc7142311796849cbef5013.architecture: Regression trees trained on aeroelastic turbine simulations, compared with the traditional power curve method.
4adee5be5f061f769fc7142311796849cbef5013.data: Aerostructural simulations of a generic 1.5 MW turbine across combinations of wind speed, turbulence intensity and shear.
4adee5be5f061f769fc7142311796849cbef5013.result: Hub wind speed matters most, then turbulence intensity and shear; regression tree predictions are three times more accurate than the power curve.
4adee5be5f061f769fc7142311796849cbef5013.open_work: Training turbine-specific trees from manufacturer test-site data to predict performance at new sites.
4adee5be5f061f769fc7142311796849cbef5013.issues: Based on simulations of a generic turbine; validation against field data not shown.

c6eee1a6ef559678e422c275155fa2011f97b6f0.goal: Forecasts global climate drivers such as ENSO-type modes from spatial fields for seasonal prediction.
c6eee1a6ef559678e422c275155fa2011f97b6f0.architecture: Convolutional autoencoder for dimension reduction combined with Gaussian process regression for forecasting.
c6eee1a6ef559678e422c275155fa2011f97b6f0.data: Gridded climate fields (e.g., sea surface temperature); specific products and periods not reported here.
c6eee1a6ef559678e422c275155fa2011f97b6f0.result: The Gaussian process and convolutional autoencoder approach is reported to produce skilful probabilistic forecasts of climate indices; details not available here.
