c6eee1a6ef559678e422c275155fa2011f97b6f0.open_work: Extending lead times and testing on more drivers and datasets.
c6eee1a6ef559678e422c275155fa2011f97b6f0.issues: Short observational records limit training; latent-space forecasting may lose small-scale information.

7ec0c8c1fe1cc0d6876ebeda8800f7a3c4f64b5b.goal: Estimates air dew point temperature from easily measured variables for engineering and meteorological applications.
7ec0c8c1fe1cc0d6876ebeda8800f7a3c4f64b5b.architecture: Computational intelligence regressors such as neural networks; the exact set of models is not specified here.
7ec0c8c1fe1cc0d6876ebeda8800f7a3c4f64b5b.data: Air temperature and relative humidity measurements; source not reported here.
7ec0c8c1fe1cc0d6876ebeda8800f7a3c4f64b5b.result: The computational intelligence models are reported to estimate dew point accurately; details not available here.
7ec0c8c1fe1cc0d6876ebeda8800f7a3c4f64b5b.open_work: Testing the models on independent climates and comparing directly with psychrometric formulas.
7ec0c8c1fe1cc0d6876ebeda8800f7a3c4f64b5b.issues: Dew point follows closely from temperature and humidity via psychrometric relations, so the added value of ML over physical formulas is limited; data source unclear.

ec6105bf1a6f54adc2bc59c6b76e714d455e7625.goal: Predicts solar radiation where measurements are lacking, comparing AI techniques with empirical equations.
ec6105bf1a6f54adc2bc59c6b76e714d455e7625.architecture: Artificial intelligence models (artificial neural network, ANFIS) and multiple regression compared with empirical solar radiation equations.
ec6105bf1a6f54adc2bc59c6b76e714d455e7625.data: Meteorological station data from Turkey; details not reported here.
ec6105bf1a6f54adc2bc59c6b76e714d455e7625.result: AI techniques are reported to outperform the empirical equations; specific scores not available here.
ec6105bf1a6f54adc2bc59c6b76e714d455e7625.open_work: Testing spatial generalization to ungauged stations and adding cloud or satellite predictors.
ec6105bf1a6f54adc2bc59c6b76e714d455e7625.issues: Regional station dataset; inputs and test design not known here; empirical baselines are weak references.

151dea6a0d2569849283c565f7180151c032a1eb.goal: Predicts short-term meteorological drought at the Sakarya station, Turkey.
151dea6a0d2569849283c565f7180151c032a1eb.architecture: Hybrid machine learning methods combining signal decomposition with ML regressors; exact models not specified here.
151dea6a0d2569849283c565f7180151c032a1eb.data: Precipitation-based drought index series from Sakarya Meteorological Station, Turkey.
151dea6a0d2569849283c565f7180151c032a1eb.result: Hybrid models are reported to outperform standalone models; details not available here.
151dea6a0d2569849283c565f7180151c032a1eb.open_work: Testing at more stations, multiple SPI time scales and longer lead times.
151dea6a0d2569849283c565f7180151c032a1eb.issues: Single station; decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information if the decomposition is not applied causally.

f71a24e8717a1fc70238a584e1d2f331a0564abb.goal: Models evapotranspiration from hydro-climatic variables in a sub-tropical agricultural environment.
f71a24e8717a1fc70238a584e1d2f331a0564abb.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression driven by hydro-climatic variables, compared with conventional empirical ET estimation methods.
f71a24e8717a1fc70238a584e1d2f331a0564abb.data: Lysimeter-measured crop evapotranspiration and weather data from south Florida, USA.
f71a24e8717a1fc70238a584e1d2f331a0564abb.result: SVM models estimate ET with good accuracy relative to traditional methods; exact scores not available here.
f71a24e8717a1fc70238a584e1d2f331a0564abb.open_work: Generalizing across crops, seasons and sites.
f71a24e8717a1fc70238a584e1d2f331a0564abb.issues: Limited site and crop coverage; short records.

85fe19ca88fe9a5f1032fba7b8a313f44111af9d.goal: Predicts next-day accumulated rainfall from local meteorological observations using deep learning.
85fe19ca88fe9a5f1032fba7b8a313f44111af9d.architecture: Deep learning architecture combining an autoencoder for feature learning with a multilayer perceptron (MLP).
85fe19ca88fe9a5f1032fba7b8a313f44111af9d.data: Meteorological station data from Manizales, Colombia.
85fe19ca88fe9a5f1032fba7b8a313f44111af9d.result: The deep learning approach is reported to improve next-day rainfall prediction over baselines; details not available here.
85fe19ca88fe9a5f1032fba7b8a313f44111af9d.open_work: Testing with more stations, longer records and additional atmospheric predictors.
85fe19ca88fe9a5f1032fba7b8a313f44111af9d.issues: Single location and small dataset for a deep model; no probabilistic output.

757e428024294bc8c8265a5dc5fae981d4195f23.goal: Forecasts short-term SPI drought in the Awash River Basin, Ethiopia.
757e428024294bc8c8265a5dc5fae981d4195f23.architecture: Wavelet transforms coupled with machine learning methods such as artificial neural networks and support vector regression.
757e428024294bc8c8265a5dc5fae981d4195f23.data: SPI derived from precipitation records at stations in the Awash River Basin, Ethiopia.
757e428024294bc8c8265a5dc5fae981d4195f23.result: Wavelet-coupled models are reported to outperform standalone models; details not available here.
757e428024294bc8c8265a5dc5fae981d4195f23.open_work: Longer lead times, more stations and uncertainty estimates for operational drought early warning.
757e428024294bc8c8265a5dc5fae981d4195f23.issues: Wavelet preprocessing can leak future information; limited stations.

2edbc11a1d4e2157a55b5bb44ccf4fd022422cb7.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed for wind energy operation using non-parametric hybrid models rather than parametric time series models.
2edbc11a1d4e2157a55b5bb44ccf4fd022422cb7.architecture: Non-parametric hybrid forecasting models; the specific model type is not specified here.
2edbc11a1d4e2157a55b5bb44ccf4fd022422cb7.data: Wind speed time series; source not reported here.
2edbc11a1d4e2157a55b5bb44ccf4fd022422cb7.result: Hybrid models are reported to improve over benchmark models; details not available here.
2edbc11a1d4e2157a55b5bb44ccf4fd022422cb7.open_work: Probabilistic extensions and testing at more sites and horizons.
2edbc11a1d4e2157a55b5bb44ccf4fd022422cb7.issues: Model details, data and evaluation design not known here; hybrid gains are often site-specific.

12616feabcf2b58a88521671f01e7c80bdf37084.goal: Simulates runoff in an arid area and explains the drivers of model predictions, since runoff in arid basins is highly nonlinear and data-limited.
12616feabcf2b58a88521671f01e7c80bdf37084.architecture: Combined LSTM and LightGBM (gradient boosting trees) model with interpretability analysis.
12616feabcf2b58a88521671f01e7c80bdf37084.data: Runoff and meteorological records from an arid-region basin in China; details not reported here.
12616feabcf2b58a88521671f01e7c80bdf37084.result: The combined LSTM–LightGBM model is reported to improve runoff simulation over single models; details not available here.
12616feabcf2b58a88521671f01e7c80bdf37084.open_work: Transferring the combined model to other arid basins and longer forecast horizons.
12616feabcf2b58a88521671f01e7c80bdf37084.issues: Single basin; post hoc interpretability (feature attribution) does not establish physical causality.

f0262bd07c737e561e1162157370fbb821142d46.goal: Reviews machine learning for groundwater level forecasting to guide researchers and water managers.
f0262bd07c737e561e1162157370fbb821142d46.architecture: Review of 142 articles (2017–2023) covering ANN, ANFIS, SVR, evolutionary computing, deep learning, ensemble learning and hybrid models.
f0262bd07c737e561e1162157370fbb821142d46.data: 142 Web of Science indexed articles from 2017–2023.
f0262bd07c737e561e1162157370fbb821142d46.result: Synthesizes best practices on dataset size, data splitting, input selection, forecast time step, performance metrics, study zones and aquifers.
f0262bd07c737e561e1162157370fbb821142d46.open_work: Recommendations on dataset size, data splitting, input selection and metrics to make GWL forecasting studies comparable and transferable.
f0262bd07c737e561e1162157370fbb821142d46.issues: Limited to WoS 2017–2023; reported exceptional results may reflect publication bias.

2b7631d23aa9408e4dac50c28991f444d3f5475d.goal: Estimates hurricane damage to electric power distribution systems before landfall so utilities can pre-position crews and materials.
2b7631d23aa9408e4dac50c28991f444d3f5475d.architecture: Statistical regression models for count data; the specific model type is not specified here.
2b7631d23aa9408e4dac50c28991f444d3f5475d.data: Historical utility damage records from past hurricanes combined with storm and system characteristics; details not reported here.
2b7631d23aa9408e4dac50c28991f444d3f5475d.result: The models are reported to provide useful pre-storm damage estimates; details not available here.
2b7631d23aa9408e4dac50c28991f444d3f5475d.open_work: Combining with hurricane track forecasts and outage-duration models for operational use.
2b7631d23aa9408e4dac50c28991f444d3f5475d.issues: Few hurricane events for training; limited transferability across utilities and storm types.

4d0b44a2b226e6db7d88123843fae8bb80fba901.goal: Estimates flood quantiles at ungauged catchments in Australia via regional flood frequency analysis.
4d0b44a2b226e6db7d88123843fae8bb80fba901.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) regression of flood quantiles on catchment characteristics, compared with regression-based methods.
4d0b44a2b226e6db7d88123843fae8bb80fba901.data: Gauged catchments across Australia with flood quantiles and catchment descriptors.
4d0b44a2b226e6db7d88123843fae8bb80fba901.result: ANN is reported to perform comparably or better than regression-based methods; details not available here.
4d0b44a2b226e6db7d88123843fae8bb80fba901.open_work: Testing other nonlinear methods and handling non-stationarity in flood records.
4d0b44a2b226e6db7d88123843fae8bb80fba901.issues: Limited numbers of gauged catchments for ANN training; stationarity of flood series assumed.

8ec77d58e73b2a204564bb3243a86825e1425a35.goal: Produces probabilistic solar and wind power forecasts for GEFCom2014.
8ec77d58e73b2a204564bb3243a86825e1425a35.architecture: Tree ensemble with a generalized additive structure, producing quantile (probabilistic) forecasts; non-deep machine learning.
8ec77d58e73b2a204564bb3243a86825e1425a35.data: GEFCom2014 solar and wind tracks with ECMWF NWP forecasts.
8ec77d58e73b2a204564bb3243a86825e1425a35.result: The approach ranked highly in the competition; details not available here.
8ec77d58e73b2a204564bb3243a86825e1425a35.open_work: Better treatment of extreme quantiles and spatial dependence among farms or sites.
8ec77d58e73b2a204564bb3243a86825e1425a35.issues: Competition setting with fixed data; transferability to other sites and NWP sources unclear.

4b57687610d44b563b6f780cb8b836eef21a662b.goal: Forecasts solar radiation with several machine learning approaches to support solar energy and agricultural applications.
4b57687610d44b563b6f780cb8b836eef21a662b.architecture: Comparison of different machine learning approaches; the specific model types are not specified here.
4b57687610d44b563b6f780cb8b836eef21a662b.data: Solar radiation data from stations in Turkey; details not reported here.
4b57687610d44b563b6f780cb8b836eef21a662b.result: Several ML approaches are compared for solar radiation forecasting; rankings and errors not available here.
4b57687610d44b563b6f780cb8b836eef21a662b.open_work: Testing at more stations and with satellite-derived inputs.
4b57687610d44b563b6f780cb8b836eef21a662b.issues: Model set, inputs and test design not known here; station-based regional evaluation.

99c24faaefdfde34713ad2bcb01fc2bfb2ee30a0.goal: Improves multi-step wind power forecasting and quantifies its uncertainty for grid integration.
99c24faaefdfde34713ad2bcb01fc2bfb2ee30a0.architecture: Deep neural networks integrated with stacking-based probabilistic learning; specific architectures not specified here.
99c24faaefdfde34713ad2bcb01fc2bfb2ee30a0.data: Wind power data; source not reported here.
99c24faaefdfde34713ad2bcb01fc2bfb2ee30a0.result: The stacking-based probabilistic framework is reported to improve multi-step forecasts over individual deep models; details not available here.
99c24faaefdfde34713ad2bcb01fc2bfb2ee30a0.open_work: Testing on more wind farms and longer horizons.
99c24faaefdfde34713ad2bcb01fc2bfb2ee30a0.issues: Data source, horizons and baselines not known here; deep ensembles are computationally heavy.

ef6abf1485e4567f3cbb414a70fa5bc870dbc33c.goal: Improves multi-step-ahead flood (streamflow) forecasts, where error accumulation degrades recurrent predictions at longer lead times.
ef6abf1485e4567f3cbb414a70fa5bc870dbc33c.architecture: Reinforced recurrent neural networks (RNN) for multi-step-ahead forecasting.
ef6abf1485e4567f3cbb414a70fa5bc870dbc33c.data: Flood event data; details not reported here.
ef6abf1485e4567f3cbb414a70fa5bc870dbc33c.result: Reinforced RNNs are reported to improve multi-step flood forecasts; details not available here.
ef6abf1485e4567f3cbb414a70fa5bc870dbc33c.open_work: Extending to longer horizons and coupling with rainfall forecasts.
ef6abf1485e4567f3cbb414a70fa5bc870dbc33c.issues: Error accumulation at longer steps; limited number of flood events; single catchment study.

23a3556a68a88d9809cea12eb6af8b2e3bd152cb.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed in Hebei, China, to support wind power integration.
23a3556a68a88d9809cea12eb6af8b2e3bd152cb.architecture: Fast ensemble empirical mode decomposition (FEEMD) with echo state networks and regularized extreme learning machine.
23a3556a68a88d9809cea12eb6af8b2e3bd152cb.data: Wind speed series from Hebei, China; details not reported here.
23a3556a68a88d9809cea12eb6af8b2e3bd152cb.result: Hybrid model reported to outperform benchmarks; details not available here.
23a3556a68a88d9809cea12eb6af8b2e3bd152cb.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and testing at other wind sites.
23a3556a68a88d9809cea12eb6af8b2e3bd152cb.issues: Decomposition hybrids can leak future information if decomposition is non-causal; single region.

e3fa9492d95717db078c4f833191ea2093d748f9.goal: Models long-term monthly evapotranspiration using only geographic and periodicity inputs, for regions lacking climatic data.
e3fa9492d95717db078c4f833191ea2093d748f9.architecture: Several data-driven methods such as artificial neural networks and ANFIS using geographic and periodicity inputs.
e3fa9492d95717db078c4f833191ea2093d748f9.data: Monthly ET from stations; details not reported here.
e3fa9492d95717db078c4f833191ea2093d748f9.result: Data-driven methods estimate monthly ET reasonably without climatic inputs; details not available here.
e3fa9492d95717db078c4f833191ea2093d748f9.open_work: Combining geographic inputs with limited climate data and testing spatial transfer.
e3fa9492d95717db078c4f833191ea2093d748f9.issues: Ignoring climatic inputs cannot capture interannual variability; stationarity assumption.

eba1a6868831e988139a2992c2c980cf7325ba75.goal: Predicts crop yield in India using machine learning with feature selection.
eba1a6868831e988139a2992c2c980cf7325ba75.architecture: Several machine learning models with optimal feature selection and an ensemble technique.
eba1a6868831e988139a2992c2c980cf7325ba75.data: Soil and environmental data (rainfall, humidity, temperature) for Indian crops; specific dataset not reported in the abstract.
eba1a6868831e988139a2992c2c980cf7325ba75.result: An ensemble technique gives better prediction accuracy than individual models.
eba1a6868831e988139a2992c2c980cf7325ba75.open_work: Specifying data sources and quantitative metrics and testing across regions and crops.
eba1a6868831e988139a2992c2c980cf7325ba75.issues: Dataset, models and metrics are not specified in the abstract; no quantitative results reported.

f1143e4865cbd47248712077a0d1b03a4648ec65.goal: Forecasts the power output of a solar photovoltaic plant to support grid integration of variable solar generation.
f1143e4865cbd47248712077a0d1b03a4648ec65.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network for time-series forecasting of PV power.
f1143e4865cbd47248712077a0d1b03a4648ec65.data: Plant-level PV power and related measurements; specific site, period and inputs not reported here.
f1143e4865cbd47248712077a0d1b03a4648ec65.result: The title reports an LSTM-based forecast of PV output; quantitative skill is not available without the abstract.
f1143e4865cbd47248712077a0d1b03a4648ec65.open_work: Extension to probabilistic forecasts, longer horizons and other plants would test generality.
f1143e4865cbd47248712077a0d1b03a4648ec65.issues: Single-plant study; details on baselines, horizons and weather inputs are unknown, so the gain over simpler models cannot be judged.

396d71faf5f185f702113525ecc82441b3474ea1.goal: Predicts daily global solar radiation for solar energy planning by optimizing input features in a hybrid deep learning model.
396d71faf5f185f702113525ecc82441b3474ea1.architecture: Hybrid fusion of a convolutional neural network (CNN), long short-term memory (LSTM) network and multilayer perceptron (MLP), with a feature optimization step.
396d71faf5f185f702113525ecc82441b3474ea1.data: Daily solar radiation records with meteorological or climate predictors; specific stations and products are not reported in the available abstract.
396d71faf5f185f702113525ecc82441b3474ea1.result: The hybrid CNN-LSTM-MLP model is presented as improving daily solar radiation prediction over comparison models; numbers are not available here.
396d71faf5f185f702113525ecc82441b3474ea1.open_work: Testing at more sites and climates and adding uncertainty quantification are natural next steps.
396d71faf5f185f702113525ecc82441b3474ea1.issues: The abstract is essentially missing; site-specific training and the complexity of the hybrid model may limit transferability.

0d4ad25e6f0846e4fa03ca0075cfc64fd6a7c82d.goal: Compares machine learning methods for predicting aquifer groundwater levels to support groundwater management.
0d4ad25e6f0846e4fa03ca0075cfc64fd6a7c82d.architecture: Support vector machines (SVM) compared with artificial neural networks (ANN) for water level; the ANN variant is not specified here prediction.
0d4ad25e6f0846e4fa03ca0075cfc64fd6a7c82d.data: Observed groundwater levels and hydrological/meteorological inputs for an aquifer; site and period not reported here.
0d4ad25e6f0846e4fa03ca0075cfc64fd6a7c82d.result: The title indicates a head-to-head SVM versus ANN comparison; the reported winner and error statistics are not available without the abstract.
0d4ad25e6f0846e4fa03ca0075cfc64fd6a7c82d.open_work: Longer-lead prediction and testing in other aquifers would extend the comparison.
0d4ad25e6f0846e4fa03ca0075cfc64fd6a7c82d.issues: Single-aquifer comparison with data-driven models only; no physical groundwater model or uncertainty analysis is indicated.

4e6ac3d0129af14db4594171ad2f6dc5c1bf2a2b.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting in China, where growing wind penetration and its intermittence challenge safe and economical grid operation.
4e6ac3d0129af14db4594171ad2f6dc5c1bf2a2b.architecture: Hybrid combination via an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) of three individual models: backpropagation neural network (MLP), radial basis function neural network and least squares support vector machine; Pearson-correlation input selection.
4e6ac3d0129af14db4594171ad2f6dc5c1bf2a2b.data: Wind farm power and related measurements from China; specific farm and period not reported in the abstract.
4e6ac3d0129af14db4594171ad2f6dc5c1bf2a2b.result: PCC-based input selection improves the individual models, and the ANFIS combination significantly outperforms each of the three individual forecasters.
4e6ac3d0129af14db4594171ad2f6dc5c1bf2a2b.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and testing on more wind farms and horizons would follow naturally.
4e6ac3d0129af14db4594171ad2f6dc5c1bf2a2b.issues: No quantitative error values in the abstract; evaluation appears limited to one case and deterministic point forecasts.

00fd004b8fd08d7ec23c1551aa542676aeb540f4.goal: Forecasts weekly groundwater levels simultaneously at multiple observation wells to support groundwater management.
00fd004b8fd08d7ec23c1551aa542676aeb540f4.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP) with multiple outputs forecasting levels at several sites at once.
00fd004b8fd08d7ec23c1551aa542676aeb540f4.data: Weekly groundwater level observations from multiple wells in an Indian river basin with hydrometeorological inputs; details not reported here.
00fd004b8fd08d7ec23c1551aa542676aeb540f4.result: The ANN is reported to forecast weekly groundwater levels at multiple sites with acceptable accuracy, with skill decreasing at longer lead times.
00fd004b8fd08d7ec23c1551aa542676aeb540f4.open_work: Longer-lead forecasts, uncertainty estimates and coupling with physically based models are natural extensions.
00fd004b8fd08d7ec23c1551aa542676aeb540f4.issues: Purely data-driven, basin-specific model; performance depends on the observation record and may not transfer to other aquifers.

903e5b2deb1f6ed5b9e9ab3ef8fa30a83ca71958.goal: Assesses how to forecast ocean wave energy flux for wave power integration by comparing a physics-based wave model with statistical time-series methods.
903e5b2deb1f6ed5b9e9ab3ef8fa30a83ca71958.architecture: Comparison of the ECMWF WAM wave model forecasts with statistical time-series models (regressions on past wave data) and combinations; not a neural network study.
903e5b2deb1f6ed5b9e9ab3ef8fa30a83ca71958.data: Wave height and period observations from ocean buoys and corresponding ECMWF wave model forecasts.
903e5b2deb1f6ed5b9e9ab3ef8fa30a83ca71958.result: Statistical time-series models are competitive at very short horizons of a few hours, while the ECMWF physics-based model performs better at longer horizons.
903e5b2deb1f6ed5b9e9ab3ef8fa30a83ca71958.open_work: Combining physical and statistical forecasts across horizons and testing more sites are natural follow-ups.
903e5b2deb1f6ed5b9e9ab3ef8fa30a83ca71958.issues: Limited number of buoy locations; statistical methods are simple linear time-series models rather than modern ML.

dc605dcb8febbf6d455b29e370f3fcdb4dd9fe14.goal: Quantifies recent trends in Arctic lake and surface water extent and identifies the climatic drivers behind them.
dc605dcb8febbf6d455b29e370f3fcdb4dd9fe14.architecture: Satellite-based surface water trend analysis with statistical attribution of drivers; the specific machine learning method type is not specified here.
dc605dcb8febbf6d455b29e370f3fcdb4dd9fe14.data: Multi-decade satellite surface water observations (Landsat-based) across lake-rich Arctic permafrost regions, with climate reanalysis variables.
dc605dcb8febbf6d455b29e370f3fcdb4dd9fe14.result: Surface water is declining across most lake-rich Arctic regions, with declines linked to warming and lengthening thaw seasons that indicate permafrost thaw as the main driver.
dc605dcb8febbf6d455b29e370f3fcdb4dd9fe14.open_work: Projecting future lake loss under warming and its consequences for carbon and ecosystems remains open.
dc605dcb8febbf6d455b29e370f3fcdb4dd9fe14.issues: Attribution from observational correlations; satellite water masks have resolution limits for small ponds, and process-level permafrost mechanisms are not directly observed.

876860b4d8e2fd39712d3c0408d9f8a7bd9e7751.goal: Improves short-term wind power prediction for power system operation.
876860b4d8e2fd39712d3c0408d9f8a7bd9e7751.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression with a wavelet kernel function.
876860b4d8e2fd39712d3c0408d9f8a7bd9e7751.data: Historical wind speed and wind power data from wind farm sites; specific source and period not reported here.
876860b4d8e2fd39712d3c0408d9f8a7bd9e7751.result: The wavelet-kernel SVM is reported to outperform persistence and standard (e.g. RBF-kernel) SVM models for short-term prediction.
876860b4d8e2fd39712d3c0408d9f8a7bd9e7751.open_work: Extension to probabilistic forecasts and NWP inputs for longer horizons.
876860b4d8e2fd39712d3c0408d9f8a7bd9e7751.issues: Deterministic forecasts only; limited sites and kernel choice tuned to the case data.

5bd5be29d93bfac8e03f7e2166f6b4387a9568c7.goal: Develops an automatic operational algorithm to distinguish sea ice from open water in dual-polarized SAR imagery.
5bd5be29d93bfac8e03f7e2166f6b4387a9568c7.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) supervised classification using texture features from HH and HV channels, after thermal noise reduction and incidence-angle correction.
5bd5be29d93bfac8e03f7e2166f6b4387a9568c7.data: RADARSAT-2 dual-polarization SAR between Greenland and Franz Josef Land; trained on 24 winter scenes (2011–2012), applied to 2705 scenes (2013–2015), validated against Norwegian Meteorological Institute ice charts.
5bd5be29d93bfac8e03f7e2166f6b4387a9568c7.result: Average ice–water classification accuracy is 91 ± 4 % against manual ice charts.
5bd5be29d93bfac8e03f7e2166f6b4387a9568c7.open_work: Extension to summer melt conditions, other SAR sensors such as Sentinel-1, and more ice types.
5bd5be29d93bfac8e03f7e2166f6b4387a9568c7.issues: Trained on winter scenes only; validation against manually derived ice charts that have their own subjectivity and coarse resolution.

c790c1d0ed5d4f06ada9f24f9e327685593f95a1.goal: Improves solar and wind generation forecasting by combining multiple machine learning models.
c790c1d0ed5d4f06ada9f24f9e327685593f95a1.architecture: Stacking ensemble in which ridge regression combines the outputs of several base machine learning models; the base model types are not specified here.
c790c1d0ed5d4f06ada9f24f9e327685593f95a1.data: Solar and wind generation data from sites in Brazil and Spain; specific datasets and periods not reported here.
c790c1d0ed5d4f06ada9f24f9e327685593f95a1.result: The ridge-regression ensemble is reported to improve accuracy over the individual base models for both resources and countries.
c790c1d0ed5d4f06ada9f24f9e327685593f95a1.open_work: Probabilistic ensembles and broader multi-site evaluation would extend the work.
c790c1d0ed5d4f06ada9f24f9e327685593f95a1.issues: Abstract unavailable; gains depend on the base models and data used, which are not detailed here.

fc6a7f85f125b16656571f8e2fd33d727cfe5d8f.goal: Improves atmospheric correction of ocean color imagery over optically complex coastal waters, where standard NIR-based algorithms fail.
fc6a7f85f125b16656571f8e2fd33d727cfe5d8f.architecture: Multilayer neural networks (MLP) trained to map top-of-atmosphere reflectances to water-leaving reflectance and aerosol properties.
fc6a7f85f125b16656571f8e2fd33d727cfe5d8f.data: Training on coupled atmosphere–ocean radiative transfer simulations; applied to SeaWiFS and MODIS-Aqua imagery and validated against AERONET-OC in situ measurements.
fc6a7f85f125b16656571f8e2fd33d727cfe5d8f.result: The neural network correction retrieves remote-sensing reflectance in coastal waters more accurately than the standard SeaDAS algorithms, especially in turbid waters.
fc6a7f85f125b16656571f8e2fd33d727cfe5d8f.open_work: Extension to other sensors and to absorbing aerosols, plus uncertainty estimates, are natural next steps.
fc6a7f85f125b16656571f8e2fd33d727cfe5d8f.issues: Relies on the realism of simulated training data; performance depends on coverage of aerosol and water types in the simulations.

02adbdc78ce45034ff77dc6d6d6bc27896c65b81.goal: Improves long-lead seasonal streamflow forecasts in Colorado River sub-basins using large-scale ocean–atmosphere climate patterns.
02adbdc78ce45034ff77dc6d6d6bc27896c65b81.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression driven by climate predictors identified from correlation with streamflow.
02adbdc78ce45034ff77dc6d6d6bc27896c65b81.data: Observed streamflow for the Gunnison and San Juan River Basins with Pacific and Atlantic sea surface temperature and 500-mb geopotential height fields.
02adbdc78ce45034ff77dc6d6d6bc27896c65b81.result: Using large-scale climate pattern predictors improves long-lead streamflow forecast skill relative to benchmark approaches.
02adbdc78ce45034ff77dc6d6d6bc27896c65b81.open_work: Application to more basins and operational water management forecasts.
02adbdc78ce45034ff77dc6d6d6bc27896c65b81.issues: Limited record lengths constrain training and validation; predictor-streamflow relationships may not be stationary.

f99b4493ac322ab805f745ebc92b939e79e0faa8.goal: Systematically reviews machine learning for groundwater monitoring and prediction and quantifies model accuracy through meta-analysis.
f99b4493ac322ab805f745ebc92b939e79e0faa8.architecture: Review and meta-analysis of regression machine learning models (feed-forward artificial neural networks, support vector machines, tree ensembles and others) for groundwater.
f99b4493ac322ab805f745ebc92b939e79e0faa8.data: 197 peer-reviewed articles from 2010–2020 across 28 countries, following the Center for Evidence-Based Conservation protocol.
f99b4493ac322ab805f745ebc92b939e79e0faa8.result: Feed-forward ANNs are most used and most accurate, but performance depends more on input information than model choice; about 10–12 years of monthly data are needed.
f99b4493ac322ab805f745ebc92b939e79e0faa8.open_work: Merging deep learning with physics-based models and new data such as InSAR to raise spatiotemporal resolution.
f99b4493ac322ab805f745ebc92b939e79e0faa8.issues: Meta-analysis across heterogeneous studies with differing metrics and sites; publication bias toward successful applications.

1cfb243c73a9fa34566d100f45cbabc1ee0db843.goal: Produces accurate short-term spatio-temporal wind speed forecasts to support renewable energy integration in smart grids.
1cfb243c73a9fa34566d100f45cbabc1ee0db843.architecture: Recurrent neural network (RNN) on a graph representation where nodes are measurement sites and edges model their interactions, forecasting all nodes jointly.
1cfb243c73a9fa34566d100f45cbabc1ee0db843.data: Recorded wind speed time series from a collection of wind sites in the north-east United States.
1cfb243c73a9fa34566d100f45cbabc1ee0db843.result: The deep learning forecaster significantly improves short-term forecasts over widely used benchmark models.
1cfb243c73a9fa34566d100f45cbabc1ee0db843.open_work: Extension to solar and other renewables and to probabilistic forecasts.
1cfb243c73a9fa34566d100f45cbabc1ee0db843.issues: Single regional case study; graph structure defined by the authors and no NWP inputs, so skill is limited to very short horizons.

f75dbd66d39b9b3e9d2de0442cf1b093afd64f38.goal: Improves multi-step wind speed forecasting for wind energy operations.
f75dbd66d39b9b3e9d2de0442cf1b093afd64f38.architecture: Hybrid forecasting architecture combining data decomposition and neural network forecasters, with parameters optimized by an improved bat algorithm; exact network types are not specified here.
f75dbd66d39b9b3e9d2de0442cf1b093afd64f38.data: Wind speed time series from wind farm sites; specific locations and periods not reported here.
f75dbd66d39b9b3e9d2de0442cf1b093afd64f38.result: The hybrid model with the improved bat algorithm is reported to outperform the compared single and hybrid models for multi-step forecasts.
f75dbd66d39b9b3e9d2de0442cf1b093afd64f38.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and evaluation on more sites would extend the work.
f75dbd66d39b9b3e9d2de0442cf1b093afd64f38.issues: Abstract unavailable; complex metaheuristic-tuned hybrids risk overfitting to the case data.

e8ed5fd9fbc7fa8c2d89752a71c5c5f5373f161b.goal: Forecasts monthly rainfall and the resulting runoff into Urmia Lake, Iran, whose declining level causes ecological problems, to support water management.
e8ed5fd9fbc7fa8c2d89752a71c5c5f5373f161b.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) compared with an ARIMA time-series model; runoff derived from forecast rainfall with a runoff coefficient regime.
e8ed5fd9fbc7fa8c2d89752a71c5c5f5373f161b.data: Monthly rainfall and runoff for the Urmia lake basin over 39 years; 6-year test period, with forecasts for 2012–2017.
e8ed5fd9fbc7fa8c2d89752a71c5c5f5373f161b.result: Feed-forward NN rainfall estimates are close to ARIMA, with correlation 0.62 and RMSE 12.43 mm over the 6-year test period.
e8ed5fd9fbc7fa8c2d89752a71c5c5f5373f161b.open_work: Including climate predictors and testing physically based runoff models would improve multi-year projections.
e8ed5fd9fbc7fa8c2d89752a71c5c5f5373f161b.issues: Modest correlation; multi-year extrapolation from past rainfall alone and a fixed runoff coefficient ignore climate and land-use change.

2d66654015e34498f48a7998f97dda5c107deba5.goal: Evaluates machine learning for regional crop yield forecasting across Europe to support operational yield monitoring.
2d66654015e34498f48a7998f97dda5c107deba5.architecture: Several machine learning algorithms with engineered features from weather, remote sensing and crop model indicators; specific model types are not reported here.
2d66654015e34498f48a7998f97dda5c107deba5.data: Regional yield statistics and predictors from the European MARS crop yield forecasting system for several crops and countries; details not reported here.
2d66654015e34498f48a7998f97dda5c107deba5.result: Machine learning is reported to improve on baseline (trend) forecasts in many crop–country cases, though not uniformly.
2d66654015e34498f48a7998f97dda5c107deba5.open_work: Better handling of extreme years, more data and interpretable, transferable models.
2d66654015e34498f48a7998f97dda5c107deba5.issues: Abstract unavailable; short yield records and regional heterogeneity limit model training and generalization.

0f2d1fc4c5a8492a4b69764485358e3c781fce58.goal: Estimates solar radiation to assess the solar energy resource potential at 76 sites in Northwestern India.
0f2d1fc4c5a8492a4b69764485358e3c781fce58.architecture: Artificial neural network, type not specified, built in the RapidMiner software environment.
0f2d1fc4c5a8492a4b69764485358e3c781fce58.data: Meteorological and geographical inputs for 76 sites in Northwestern India; specific data source not reported here.
0f2d1fc4c5a8492a4b69764485358e3c781fce58.result: The ANN is reported to predict solar radiation with good accuracy, enabling resource maps across the sites.
0f2d1fc4c5a8492a4b69764485358e3c781fce58.open_work: Validation against ground measurements at more sites and use of satellite inputs.
0f2d1fc4c5a8492a4b69764485358e3c781fce58.issues: Abstract unavailable; regional study with conventional ANN and limited methodological novelty.

e438d9b107f2cfe3a1016b87f53258a5c84dc23d.goal: Forecasts PM2.5 concentrations during winter haze episodes in Delhi, India, to support air quality warnings.
e438d9b107f2cfe3a1016b87f53258a5c84dc23d.architecture: Neuro-fuzzy model compared with an artificial neural network (MLP) and multiple linear regression.
e438d9b107f2cfe3a1016b87f53258a5c84dc23d.data: Observed PM2.5 and meteorological variables in Delhi during haze episodes; period not reported here.
e438d9b107f2cfe3a1016b87f53258a5c84dc23d.result: The neuro-fuzzy model outperforms the ANN and multiple linear regression for haze-episode PM2.5 forecasts.
e438d9b107f2cfe3a1016b87f53258a5c84dc23d.open_work: Adding emissions and chemical transport model information and extending to other cities.
e438d9b107f2cfe3a1016b87f53258a5c84dc23d.issues: Single-city, episode-focused dataset; limited sample size and no uncertainty estimates.

0c435f49f3d9bd087c62481dcc423a819ee94cd2.goal: Predicts monthly average daily global solar radiation where measurements are lacking, for solar energy design.
0c435f49f3d9bd087c62481dcc423a819ee94cd2.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) with optimisation of its architecture and input set.
0c435f49f3d9bd087c62481dcc423a819ee94cd2.data: Monthly meteorological and geographical data from multiple measurement sites; source and period not reported here.
0c435f49f3d9bd087c62481dcc423a819ee94cd2.result: The optimised ANN is reported to estimate monthly average daily global radiation with low errors across test sites.
0c435f49f3d9bd087c62481dcc423a819ee94cd2.open_work: Testing in other climates and with satellite-derived inputs.
0c435f49f3d9bd087c62481dcc423a819ee94cd2.issues: Abstract unavailable; monthly averages hide day-to-day variability and site coverage may limit generalization.

03a81a3623bea4d485d259e1312b76e797c952fa.goal: Improves flood forecasting by combining a data-driven error correction with a traditional hydrological model.
03a81a3623bea4d485d259e1312b76e797c952fa.architecture: Improved backpropagation neural network (MLP) coupled to the semi-distributed Xinanjiang (XAJ) model to update flow forecast errors without losing lead time.
03a81a3623bea4d485d259e1312b76e797c952fa.data: A real flood forecasting case study basin in China; data details not reported in the abstract.
03a81a3623bea4d485d259e1312b76e797c952fa.result: The method significantly increases flood forecast accuracy, and its global correction outperforms second-order autoregressive real-time correction.
03a81a3623bea4d485d259e1312b76e797c952fa.open_work: Testing across more basins and events and quantifying forecast uncertainty.
03a81a3623bea4d485d259e1312b76e797c952fa.issues: Single case study; no numbers reported in the abstract, and error correction depends on observed flows being available in real time.

0770833fe540ca262baa68947cc69610de606713.goal: Quantifies aerosol–cloud interaction forcing by separating cloud cover and cloud brightness responses using a natural volcanic aerosol experiment.
0770833fe540ca262baa68947cc69610de606713.architecture: Machine learning emulator predicting cloud properties under counterfactual no-aerosol conditions from meteorology; the specific model type is not specified here.
0770833fe540ca262baa68947cc69610de606713.data: Satellite cloud retrievals (MODIS) and meteorological reanalysis around the 2014 Holuhraun eruption in Iceland.
0770833fe540ca262baa68947cc69610de606713.result: Aerosol-induced increases in cloud fraction dominate the aerosol–cloud forcing, exceeding the contribution from brighter clouds, while liquid water path changes are small.
0770833fe540ca262baa68947cc69610de606713.open_work: Testing the result for other regions, cloud regimes and aerosol sources, and constraining climate models accordingly.
0770833fe540ca262baa68947cc69610de606713.issues: Based on one eruption event and region; counterfactual predictions depend on emulator accuracy and satellite retrieval biases.

307126fd3c27060096ceb066a17be6e98d85977e.goal: Surveys machine learning methods and their applications in water resources management amid climate change and resource pressures.
307126fd3c27060096ceb066a17be6e98d85977e.architecture: Review of ML algorithm taxonomy (supervised prediction, clustering, reinforcement learning) mapped to water management tasks.
307126fd3c27060096ceb066a17be6e98d85977e.data: Literature on irrigation optimization, water quality monitoring, flood forecasting and water demand forecasting using remote sensing, sensors and social media data.
307126fd3c27060096ceb066a17be6e98d85977e.result: Provides a comparative mapping of ML methods to water management tasks and a tabulation of representative studies.
307126fd3c27060096ceb066a17be6e98d85977e.open_work: Addressing data heterogeneity, stakeholder education and cost barriers to wider AI adoption.
307126fd3c27060096ceb066a17be6e98d85977e.issues: Broad narrative survey without systematic search protocol or quantitative synthesis.

407470f28855a632f6e118e4968f8f323af94986.goal: Improves multivariate wind speed forecasting by selecting informative meteorological inputs.
407470f28855a632f6e118e4968f8f323af94986.architecture: Hybrid deep learning model combined with a multi-objective feature selection approach; the specific network types are not specified here.
407470f28855a632f6e118e4968f8f323af94986.data: Multivariate meteorological and wind speed data from wind sites; specific sources not reported here.
407470f28855a632f6e118e4968f8f323af94986.result: The proposed feature selection and hybrid deep learning model are reported to outperform comparison models.
407470f28855a632f6e118e4968f8f323af94986.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and generalization to more sites.
407470f28855a632f6e118e4968f8f323af94986.issues: Abstract unavailable; complex hybrid pipelines tuned on limited sites may not transfer.

242f8148f4a08ea78397f2db740d7ef3704de8e1.goal: Compares neural network types for predicting river water temperature, which matters for aquatic ecosystems and water use.
242f8148f4a08ea78397f2db740d7ef3704de8e1.architecture: Several artificial neural network types, including multilayer perceptron (MLP) and other variants, compared with simpler models.
242f8148f4a08ea78397f2db740d7ef3704de8e1.data: Observed river water temperature with meteorological and hydrological inputs; specific rivers and periods not reported here.
242f8148f4a08ea78397f2db740d7ef3704de8e1.result: The study ranks the network types by prediction skill; the specific ranking and error values are not available without the abstract.
242f8148f4a08ea78397f2db740d7ef3704de8e1.open_work: Assessment under climate change scenarios and in other river types.
242f8148f4a08ea78397f2db740d7ef3704de8e1.issues: Abstract unavailable; findings may be specific to the studied catchments and inputs.

b553c7ce6542d6e04d366b344772851fb5a08007.goal: Improves cloud screening of multispectral satellite images when labeled samples are scarce.
b553c7ce6542d6e04d366b344772851fb5a08007.architecture: Semisupervised kernel methods using mean map kernels within support vector machine (SVM) classification, exploiting clusters of unlabeled pixels.
b553c7ce6542d6e04d366b344772851fb5a08007.data: Multispectral satellite images (MERIS) with few labeled cloud and cloud-free samples.
b553c7ce6542d6e04d366b344772851fb5a08007.result: The semisupervised mean map kernel approach improves cloud classification accuracy over standard supervised SVM when labels are scarce.
b553c7ce6542d6e04d366b344772851fb5a08007.open_work: Extension to other sensors and to operational cloud masking.
b553c7ce6542d6e04d366b344772851fb5a08007.issues: Few test scenes; performance depends on clustering quality and kernel parameter choices.

5052f1459b4b36ed1ae87633bee4d1e4649019fa.goal: Improves seasonal prediction of northeast monsoon rainfall over south peninsular India by combining multiple climate models.
5052f1459b4b36ed1ae87633bee4d1e4649019fa.architecture: Extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer neural network) used to build a multi-model ensemble from general circulation model hindcasts.
5052f1459b4b36ed1ae87633bee4d1e4649019fa.data: Hindcasts of several general circulation models and observed northeast monsoon rainfall over south peninsular India; specific models and period not reported here.
5052f1459b4b36ed1ae87633bee4d1e4649019fa.result: The ELM-based multi-model ensemble is reported to outperform individual models and simple ensemble averages.
5052f1459b4b36ed1ae87633bee4d1e4649019fa.open_work: Application to other seasons and regions and to probabilistic seasonal forecasts.
5052f1459b4b36ed1ae87633bee4d1e4649019fa.issues: Short hindcast records limit training and verification; the ensemble inherits biases of the member models.

91637ff156098d6f6245211272de46bb1c092111.goal: Improves wind power forecasting accuracy and robustness by combining neural networks with input selection.
91637ff156098d6f6245211272de46bb1c092111.architecture: Ensembles of neural networks (network type not specified here) with feature selection of input variables.
91637ff156098d6f6245211272de46bb1c092111.data: Wind farm power and meteorological data; specific sites and periods not reported here.
91637ff156098d6f6245211272de46bb1c092111.result: The neural network ensemble with feature selection is reported to outperform single networks and benchmark models.
91637ff156098d6f6245211272de46bb1c092111.issues: Abstract unavailable; gains are case-specific and point forecasts only.

706d4c937f69a7611f176e7ccbb56e5716649e77.goal: Distinguishes cloud from snow in satellite imagery, which have similar visible reflectance and are often confused in cloud masks.
706d4c937f69a7611f176e7ccbb56e5716649e77.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network (CNN) performing pixel-level cloud and snow classification.
706d4c937f69a7611f176e7ccbb56e5716649e77.data: Multispectral satellite images (Gaofen-1 wide field of view) with manually labeled cloud and snow.
706d4c937f69a7611f176e7ccbb56e5716649e77.result: The deep CNN distinguishes cloud and snow more accurately than conventional threshold-based and classical classifier methods.
706d4c937f69a7611f176e7ccbb56e5716649e77.open_work: Extension to other sensors and larger, more diverse labeled datasets.
706d4c937f69a7611f176e7ccbb56e5716649e77.issues: Limited training scenes and labels; restricted spectral bands without thermal infrared.

56d906d9fd20e9127114f022f7d255ae653dbe31.goal: Improves crop yield prediction by better capturing interactions between environmental factors and crop growth through feature selection and tuning.
56d906d9fd20e9127114f022f7d255ae653dbe31.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) with K-means and correlation-based filtering, a hybrid FMIG-RFE feature selection, and hyperparameters tuned by an improved Crayfish Optimization Algorithm.
56d906d9fd20e9127114f022f7d255ae653dbe31.data: Crop yield datasets with environmental features; specific datasets not reported in the abstract.
56d906d9fd20e9127114f022f7d255ae653dbe31.result: The framework outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, and the improved optimizer improves both accuracy and computational efficiency.
56d906d9fd20e9127114f022f7d255ae653dbe31.open_work: Testing on more crops, regions and spatially explicit data.
56d906d9fd20e9127114f022f7d255ae653dbe31.issues: No numbers or dataset details in the abstract; heavily engineered pipeline risks overfitting.

81f8888448fc19901ec9baa1c63d4ba88f74f6ca.goal: Systematically reviews deterministic and probabilistic wind forecasting methods to clarify their classification and state of the art.
81f8888448fc19901ec9baa1c63d4ba88f74f6ca.architecture: Review of physical, statistical, machine learning and hybrid wind speed and power forecasting methods, deterministic and probabilistic.
81f8888448fc19901ec9baa1c63d4ba88f74f6ca.data: Literature on wind forecasting covering data sources, evaluation frameworks, theoretical basis and reported performance.
81f8888448fc19901ec9baa1c63d4ba88f74f6ca.result: Provides a structured classification of wind forecasting methods and comparison of their performance for newcomers to the field.
81f8888448fc19901ec9baa1c63d4ba88f74f6ca.open_work: Developing more accurate and practical probabilistic wind forecasting models.
81f8888448fc19901ec9baa1c63d4ba88f74f6ca.issues: Narrative review; performance comparisons across studies with different data and metrics are not directly comparable.

e53b735016a611502fa38ace6ed99f76c2e9f6f0.goal: Produces wind power prediction intervals directly, without assuming a forecast error distribution, to quantify forecast uncertainty for power systems.
e53b735016a611502fa38ace6ed99f76c2e9f6f0.architecture: Extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer neural network) trained with particle swarm optimization to minimize an interval-quality objective balancing coverage and width.
e53b735016a611502fa38ace6ed99f76c2e9f6f0.data: Wind farm power data; specific farms and periods not reported here.
e53b735016a611502fa38ace6ed99f76c2e9f6f0.result: The direct interval approach produces well-calibrated, sharp prediction intervals and is computationally efficient compared with benchmark interval methods.
e53b735016a611502fa38ace6ed99f76c2e9f6f0.open_work: Extension to multi-step horizons and to other renewable sources.
e53b735016a611502fa38ace6ed99f76c2e9f6f0.issues: Intervals for single quantile levels; performance assessed on limited wind farm data.

89c20075e0994e4384b0cb8881bafa30ef271743.goal: Downscales GRACE terrestrial water storage to monitor hydrological droughts in the Indus Basin Irrigation System at finer resolution.
89c20075e0994e4384b0cb8881bafa30ef271743.architecture: Extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) compared with an artificial neural network for downscaling; partial least squares regression for drought–climate links.
89c20075e0994e4384b0cb8881bafa30ef271743.data: GRACE TWSA downscaled from 1° to 0.25° with hydroclimatic predictors; compared with SPEI and sc-PDSI drought indices.
89c20075e0994e4384b0cb8881bafa30ef271743.result: XGBoost outperforms the ANN (NSE 0.99, R 0.99, RMSE 5.22 mm, MAE 2.75 mm); eight drought episodes detected, and potential evaporation is the second strongest driver after precipitation.
89c20075e0994e4384b0cb8881bafa30ef271743.open_work: Validation of downscaled storage against independent in situ groundwater data.
89c20075e0994e4384b0cb8881bafa30ef271743.issues: Near-perfect scores are against GRACE-derived values, not independent fine-scale truth; downscaled detail is limited by predictor information.

100c56403003f0d24619aa8e9c57112f1fc61c6d.goal: Solves forward and inverse problems of unsaturated soil water flow (Richardson–Richards equation) without requiring precisely prescribed boundary conditions.
100c56403003f0d24619aa8e9c57112f1fc61c6d.architecture: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) with adaptive activation functions and domain decomposition (separate networks per soil layer).
100c56403003f0d24619aa8e9c57112f1fc61c6d.data: Analytical and numerical reference solutions for homogeneous and layered soils, and sparse synthetic soil moisture measurements.
100c56403003f0d24619aa8e9c57112f1fc61c6d.result: PINN solutions match traditional numerical methods, correctly simulate layered soils with discontinuous conductivity, and recover water fluxes from sparse data.
100c56403003f0d24619aa8e9c57112f1fc61c6d.open_work: Improving robustness to initialization and computational speed, and applying to field data.
100c56403003f0d24619aa8e9c57112f1fc61c6d.issues: PINNs are sensitive to network initialization and much slower than traditional numerical solvers; tests are largely synthetic.

75cc28e454668ba6c878d6e9e809f270dc5c9a04.goal: Improves short-term wind power prediction by combining complementary forecasting approaches.
75cc28e454668ba6c878d6e9e809f270dc5c9a04.architecture: Hybrid prediction strategy combining forecasting models; the specific method family is not specified here.
75cc28e454668ba6c878d6e9e809f270dc5c9a04.data: Wind farm power and meteorological data; sources not reported here.
75cc28e454668ba6c878d6e9e809f270dc5c9a04.result: The hybrid strategy is reported to improve accuracy over its individual component models.
75cc28e454668ba6c878d6e9e809f270dc5c9a04.open_work: Probabilistic extension and evaluation at more wind farms.
75cc28e454668ba6c878d6e9e809f270dc5c9a04.issues: Abstract unavailable; component methods and evaluation details are unknown.

a7c7152ac91eb1e85cbc0178bf3300df1317224c.goal: Estimates pan evaporation across different climate zones of China, important for water balance and irrigation planning.
a7c7152ac91eb1e85cbc0178bf3300df1317224c.architecture: Six heuristic methods including multilayer perceptron (MLP), generalized regression neural network, fuzzy genetic, least squares support vector regression, MARS and adaptive neuro-fuzzy models, compared with empirical equations.
a7c7152ac91eb1e85cbc0178bf3300df1317224c.data: Daily meteorological data and pan evaporation from stations across different climates of China.
a7c7152ac91eb1e85cbc0178bf3300df1317224c.result: Heuristic ML methods generally outperform empirical formulas, with neural-network-type models among the best; skill varies by climate region.
a7c7152ac91eb1e85cbc0178bf3300df1317224c.open_work: Testing spatial transferability and use of fewer inputs at ungauged stations.
a7c7152ac91eb1e85cbc0178bf3300df1317224c.issues: Station-based results may not transfer to other regions; no uncertainty analysis.

90335903e1f6a9ccdba09514e309d9414bad72cb.goal: Enables rapid real-time urban flood prediction in coastal cities, where physically based models are too slow.
90335903e1f6a9ccdba09514e309d9414bad72cb.architecture: Light gradient boosting machine (LightGBM) trained on outputs of a PCSWMM hydrological–hydraulic model, tuned by grid search and K-fold cross-validation; compared with random forest, XGBoost and KNN.
90335903e1f6a9ccdba09514e309d9414bad72cb.data: Simulated inundation from PCSWMM driven by rainfall and tide level scenarios for Haidian Island, Hainan, China.
90335903e1f6a9ccdba09514e309d9414bad72cb.result: LightGBM achieves NSE 0.9896 on the test set and outperforms random forest, XGBoost and KNN; tide level variables dominate inundation depth.
90335903e1f6a9ccdba09514e309d9414bad72cb.open_work: Validation with observed flood events and extension to other coastal cities.
90335903e1f6a9ccdba09514e309d9414bad72cb.issues: Trained and tested on simulator outputs, so it inherits PCSWMM biases; site-specific model.

894023762c9b02f8a9651d77bc22db98e73c9a60.goal: Produces probabilistic short-term solar power forecasts from an operational weather ensemble.
894023762c9b02f8a9651d77bc22db98e73c9a60.architecture: ECMWF ensemble members converted to PV power with an artificial neural network (MLP), followed by statistical calibration of the ensemble spread.
894023762c9b02f8a9651d77bc22db98e73c9a60.data: ECMWF Ensemble Prediction System (51 members) forecasts and PV power measurements from plants in Italy.
894023762c9b02f8a9651d77bc22db98e73c9a60.result: The calibrated EPS-based ensemble provides skillful, more reliable probabilistic PV forecasts than the raw ensemble.
894023762c9b02f8a9651d77bc22db98e73c9a60.open_work: Higher-resolution ensembles and improved calibration methods.
894023762c9b02f8a9651d77bc22db98e73c9a60.issues: Few plants and limited period; ensemble underdispersion requires post-processing.

a681f6d234e874109a858e21c352a3c97a696c9f.goal: Provides real-time prediction intervals for intra-hour direct normal irradiance (DNI) forecasts to quantify solar forecast uncertainty.
a681f6d234e874109a858e21c352a3c97a696c9f.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) based forecasting with prediction interval models, using sky-image features and classification of irradiance variability.
a681f6d234e874109a858e21c352a3c97a696c9f.data: Ground DNI measurements and sky images from a site in California (Folsom).
a681f6d234e874109a858e21c352a3c97a696c9f.result: The proposed models produce prediction intervals with good coverage and sharpness for intra-hour DNI, outperforming benchmark interval methods.
a681f6d234e874109a858e21c352a3c97a696c9f.open_work: Extension to other sites and to global horizontal irradiance and PV power.
a681f6d234e874109a858e21c352a3c97a696c9f.issues: Single-site evaluation; sky-imager dependence limits applicability where such instruments are lacking.

f8921a443dbc9d6418982fec6845c65022839db2.goal: Predicts monthly air temperature at stations in Australia and New Zealand for climate monitoring and planning.
f8921a443dbc9d6418982fec6845c65022839db2.architecture: Machine learning regressors including support vector regression and multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks.
f8921a443dbc9d6418982fec6845c65022839db2.data: Monthly station temperature and climate predictors for Australia and New Zealand; specific stations and period not reported here.
f8921a443dbc9d6418982fec6845c65022839db2.result: The ML models are reported to predict monthly air temperature accurately, with support vector regression among the best performers.
f8921a443dbc9d6418982fec6845c65022839db2.open_work: Longer-lead forecasting and use of large-scale climate indices.
f8921a443dbc9d6418982fec6845c65022839db2.issues: Abstract unavailable; station-based results with limited records.

96d07076473a6a6b30516a649d666c20980f5e2e.goal: Improves very short-term (minutes-ahead) solar power forecasting, where cloud movement, temperature and humidity changes cause rapid ramps that degrade forecasts.
96d07076473a6a6b30516a649d666c20980f5e2e.architecture: Three-layer feed-forward MLP (artificial neural network) trained with back-propagation, with a fuzzy logic pre-processing stage and an error-correction input from the previous 5-min forecast.
96d07076473a6a6b30516a649d666c20980f5e2e.data: Weather information (cloud cover, temperature, wind speed and direction) with irradiance and solar power records; site and period are not reported in the abstract.
96d07076473a6a6b30516a649d666c20980f5e2e.result: The fuzzy pre-processed ANN is compared with other ANN forecast algorithms and is presented as more accurate; no numbers are given in the abstract.
96d07076473a6a6b30516a649d666c20980f5e2e.open_work: Test on more sites and seasons and compare against modern sequence models and sky-image or satellite-based nowcasting.
96d07076473a6a6b30516a649d666c20980f5e2e.issues: Single-study evaluation with unreported error metrics; fuzzy rules are hand-designed and the shallow ANN may not generalize to other climates.

6784ddd93b60330c9791747f1e4c6e4b1f6b0ec4.goal: Estimates daily pan evaporation, a key input for irrigation and water balance, comparing data-driven and climate-based approaches.
6784ddd93b60330c9791747f1e4c6e4b1f6b0ec4.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type ANN) compared with multiple regression and conventional climate-based evaporation models.
6784ddd93b60330c9791747f1e4c6e4b1f6b0ec4.data: Daily meteorological observations and measured pan evaporation from a station; location and period are not reported here.
6784ddd93b60330c9791747f1e4c6e4b1f6b0ec4.result: Not reported here; the study ranks ANN, regression and climate-based models for daily pan evaporation estimation.
6784ddd93b60330c9791747f1e4c6e4b1f6b0ec4.open_work: Test transferability to other stations and climates and compare with newer ML methods.
6784ddd93b60330c9791747f1e4c6e4b1f6b0ec4.issues: Likely single-site data with limited record length; no abstract available to confirm metrics or validation design.

81eebe75bfc14e03a87e7468d1a8751741732f59.goal: Forecasts significant wave height at multiple lead times for coastal and offshore operations.
81eebe75bfc14e03a87e7468d1a8751741732f59.architecture: Hybrid discrete wavelet transform plus artificial neural network (wavelet neural network): wave height series are decomposed into sub-series fed to an ANN.
81eebe75bfc14e03a87e7468d1a8751741732f59.data: Observed significant wave height time series from buoy records; location and period are not reported here.
81eebe75bfc14e03a87e7468d1a8751741732f59.result: Not reported here; the wavelet-ANN is presented as improving multistep-ahead forecasts relative to a plain ANN.
81eebe75bfc14e03a87e7468d1a8751741732f59.open_work: Extend to longer leads, include wind forcing and compare with spectral wave models.
81eebe75bfc14e03a87e7468d1a8751741732f59.issues: Wavelet decomposition in hybrid models can leak future information if not applied causally; single-site evaluation.

dbffabfa961bebeb678a59e9cfff7f27ed0937e9.goal: Predicts solar radiation on tilted surfaces for photovoltaic system design in Saudi Arabia.
dbffabfa961bebeb678a59e9cfff7f27ed0937e9.architecture: Support vector machine (support vector regression) compared with artificial neural networks (MLP-type ANN).
dbffabfa961bebeb678a59e9cfff7f27ed0937e9.data: Measured solar radiation data from sites in Saudi Arabia; exact stations and periods are not reported here.
dbffabfa961bebeb678a59e9cfff7f27ed0937e9.result: Not reported here; the study compares SVM and ANN accuracy for tilted-surface radiation.
dbffabfa961bebeb678a59e9cfff7f27ed0937e9.open_work: Extend to more sites, tilt angles and modern ensemble or deep learning models.
dbffabfa961bebeb678a59e9cfff7f27ed0937e9.issues: Limited site coverage; no abstract available to confirm metrics or validation design.

36590fb374781739575dccab381885c1012cfb71.goal: Investigates how best to train neural networks for river flow forecasting, comparing evolutionary computation optimizers with gradient-based training.
36590fb374781739575dccab381885c1012cfb71.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks trained with several evolutionary computation algorithms (e.g. differential evolution, particle swarm) versus the Levenberg–Marquardt algorithm.
36590fb374781739575dccab381885c1012cfb71.data: Observed river flow and related hydrological time series from a catchment; details are not reported here.
36590fb374781739575dccab381885c1012cfb71.result: Not reported here; the study compares the forecasting skill and efficiency of evolutionary versus Levenberg–Marquardt training.
36590fb374781739575dccab381885c1012cfb71.open_work: Assess training strategies for deeper networks and multiple catchments.
36590fb374781739575dccab381885c1012cfb71.issues: Conclusions depend on the chosen catchment, network sizes and optimizer settings; no abstract available to confirm results.

7791c7552954c2e50d7d81b4747c293d978916e2.goal: Develops a real-time flood forecasting model driven by satellite rainfall to support warning in data-scarce basins.
7791c7552954c2e50d7d81b4747c293d978916e2.architecture: Wavelet-based non-linear autoregressive with exogenous inputs (WNARX) dynamic recurrent neural network combining wavelet decomposition with a NARX network.
7791c7552954c2e50d7d81b4747c293d978916e2.data: Satellite-based rainfall products and observed river discharge; basin and period are not reported here.
7791c7552954c2e50d7d81b4747c293d978916e2.result: Not reported here; WNARX is presented as improving flood forecasts relative to non-wavelet models.
7791c7552954c2e50d7d81b4747c293d978916e2.open_work: Test with other satellite rainfall products, longer lead times and other basins.
7791c7552954c2e50d7d81b4747c293d978916e2.issues: Satellite rainfall errors propagate to forecasts; wavelet hybrids risk boundary leakage; no abstract to confirm metrics.

f08436da150b2ac0de710c62d6f67fd5ab74cfb1.goal: Improves short-term global solar radiation forecasting for solar energy integration by extracting deep features from decomposed time series.
f08436da150b2ac0de710c62d6f67fd5ab74cfb1.architecture: Hybrid: CEEMDAN decomposition, continuous wavelet transform scalograms, cascaded convolutional neural network (AlexNet and GoogLeNet) feature extraction, RReliefF feature selection and an extreme learning machine regressor.
f08436da150b2ac0de710c62d6f67fd5ab74cfb1.data: Global solar radiation time series at hourly and daily scales; location and period are not reported in the abstract.
f08436da150b2ac0de710c62d6f67fd5ab74cfb1.result: RMSE/MAE/MAPE of 0.0642/0.0241/0.1201 one step ahead rising to 0.0724/0.0315/0.1317 three steps ahead, outperforming conventional regression models.
f08436da150b2ac0de710c62d6f67fd5ab74cfb1.open_work: Test on multiple sites and longer horizons and compare with end-to-end deep sequence models.
f08436da150b2ac0de710c62d6f67fd5ab74cfb1.issues: Complex pipeline with decomposition that may leak future information; normalized errors only; baselines are conventional regressions.

853f5be1246f8ddd1015c19ddbc999b30ea7afa6.goal: Downscales and improves NWP 3-h accumulated solar radiation forecasts for solar energy applications.
853f5be1246f8ddd1015c19ddbc999b30ea7afa6.architecture: Support vector regression, gradient boosted regression and random forest regression, plus a hybrid combining them; clear-sky model interpolation for hourly disaggregation.
853f5be1246f8ddd1015c19ddbc999b30ea7afa6.data: NWP 3-h accumulated radiation forecasts (NWP system not named in the abstract) and measured radiation at seven locations in Spain.
853f5be1246f8ddd1015c19ddbc999b30ea7afa6.result: Both direct 3-h and daily-then-disaggregated ML approaches outperform base NWP forecasts; empirical clear-sky interpolation gives the best hourly disaggregation.
853f5be1246f8ddd1015c19ddbc999b30ea7afa6.open_work: Extend to more sites and probabilistic forecasts, and exploit spatial NWP information.
853f5be1246f8ddd1015c19ddbc999b30ea7afa6.issues: Limited to seven Spanish sites; skill numbers not given in the abstract; deterministic forecasts only.

39dfd4edbdf439ac558c443071fd72892b342a12.goal: Improves short-term daily precipitation forecasts by correcting numerical weather prediction biases across climatic regions of China.
39dfd4edbdf439ac558c443071fd72892b342a12.architecture: XGBoost (gradient boosted trees) used as a post-processing bias-correction model for NWP precipitation forecasts.
39dfd4edbdf439ac558c443071fd72892b342a12.data: NWP daily precipitation forecasts and station observations in different regions of China; specific NWP product and period are not reported here.
39dfd4edbdf439ac558c443071fd72892b342a12.result: Not reported here; XGBoost correction is presented as improving NWP precipitation forecasts across regions.
39dfd4edbdf439ac558c443071fd72892b342a12.open_work: Extend to probabilistic correction, longer leads and extreme precipitation evaluation.
39dfd4edbdf439ac558c443071fd72892b342a12.issues: Tree-based correction may underpredict extremes; regional performance differences likely; no abstract available.

8e09b1369ebf60776c74615e45e34c527ef35bd1.goal: Forecasts solar irradiance for grid integration of photovoltaics using a hybrid clustering and regression approach.
8e09b1369ebf60776c74615e45e34c527ef35bd1.architecture: Hybrid self-organizing map (SOM) for clustering, support vector regression (SVR) for prediction and particle swarm optimization for hyperparameter tuning.
8e09b1369ebf60776c74615e45e34c527ef35bd1.data: Measured solar irradiance time series (reportedly from Singapore); exact period is not reported here.
8e09b1369ebf60776c74615e45e34c527ef35bd1.result: Not reported here; the hybrid SOM-SVR-PSO is presented as outperforming conventional forecasting benchmarks.
8e09b1369ebf60776c74615e45e34c527ef35bd1.open_work: Test at other climates and incorporate sky imagery or NWP inputs.
8e09b1369ebf60776c74615e45e34c527ef35bd1.issues: Results tied to a tropical site; no abstract to confirm metrics or baselines.

92591de8087cd07f50f723155a0af329639e8c21.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels across a well network by exploiting spatial dependencies between wells.
92591de8087cd07f50f723155a0af329639e8c21.architecture: Graph neural network combining spatial graph learning across wells with temporal modelling of level series.
92591de8087cd07f50f723155a0af329639e8c21.data: Observed groundwater level records from multiple monitoring wells with meteorological drivers; location and period are not reported here.
92591de8087cd07f50f723155a0af329639e8c21.result: Not reported here; the GNN is presented as outperforming models that treat wells independently.
92591de8087cd07f50f723155a0af329639e8c21.open_work: Incorporate physical aquifer connectivity and pumping data, and test longer horizons.
92591de8087cd07f50f723155a0af329639e8c21.issues: Graph construction choices affect skill; data gaps at wells; no abstract available to confirm results.

7a6938e8f604a2c95b8fce2e9511f3c576a401fb.goal: Builds a simple, operational statistical crop model for large-scale rice development and yield simulation in China, as an alternative to complex process models.
7a6938e8f604a2c95b8fce2e9511f3c576a401fb.architecture: Support vector machine models for rice developmental stage and yield prediction integrated in an open crop model system (SBOCM); not a crop physiology model.
7a6938e8f604a2c95b8fce2e9511f3c576a401fb.data: Surface weather station observations in China, the 1:1,000,000 soil database of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and rice development and yield records.
7a6938e8f604a2c95b8fce2e9511f3c576a401fb.result: SBOCM supports perennial simulation and one-year rice predictions within certain scale ranges and is described as simple and regionally applicable; no metrics in the abstract.
7a6938e8f604a2c95b8fce2e9511f3c576a401fb.open_work: Integrate social and economic factors to improve accuracy and practicability.
7a6938e8f604a2c95b8fce2e9511f3c576a401fb.issues: Statistical model without physiological processes; accuracy metrics not reported; limited to rice and to scale ranges of training.

0d336504596f74c7f87cb698e809f6f9d5fdecd7.goal: Provides short-term wind power forecasts to support power system operation with variable wind generation.
0d336504596f74c7f87cb698e809f6f9d5fdecd7.architecture: Support vector machine (support vector regression) forecasting of wind speed and power.
0d336504596f74c7f87cb698e809f6f9d5fdecd7.data: Wind speed and power measurement time series; site and period are not reported here.
0d336504596f74c7f87cb698e809f6f9d5fdecd7.result: Not reported here; SVM is presented as outperforming persistence and neural network benchmarks.
0d336504596f74c7f87cb698e809f6f9d5fdecd7.open_work: Extend to multi-site and probabilistic forecasts and add NWP inputs.
0d336504596f74c7f87cb698e809f6f9d5fdecd7.issues: Point forecasts only; single-site data; no abstract available to confirm metrics.

7f70ba0fa2809c6c8c4975e5dc8403470502682b.goal: Simulates river stage for flood management, comparing a data-driven model with a hydrodynamic model.
7f70ba0fa2809c6c8c4975e5dc8403470502682b.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type) compared with the MIKE 11 hydrodynamic model (non-ML physics-based).
7f70ba0fa2809c6c8c4975e5dc8403470502682b.data: Observed river stage and discharge records at gauging stations; river and period are not reported here.
7f70ba0fa2809c6c8c4975e5dc8403470502682b.result: Not reported here; the study compares ANN and MIKE 11 stage simulation accuracy.
7f70ba0fa2809c6c8c4975e5dc8403470502682b.open_work: Couple ANN and hydrodynamic models, and test under extreme floods.
7f70ba0fa2809c6c8c4975e5dc8403470502682b.issues: ANN cannot extrapolate beyond observed conditions; single river reach; no abstract available.

0ba508d49ed3fb969ca629eb73ec180ae3be6338.goal: Forecasts water levels of Lake Eğirdir (Turkey) for water resources management.
0ba508d49ed3fb969ca629eb73ec180ae3be6338.architecture: Recurrent neural network and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) compared with stochastic time series models.
0ba508d49ed3fb969ca629eb73ec180ae3be6338.data: Observed lake level records of Lake Eğirdir; period is not reported here.
0ba508d49ed3fb969ca629eb73ec180ae3be6338.result: Not reported here; the study compares RNN, ANFIS and stochastic models for lake level forecasting.
0ba508d49ed3fb969ca629eb73ec180ae3be6338.open_work: Add climatic and inflow predictors and test longer horizons.
0ba508d49ed3fb969ca629eb73ec180ae3be6338.issues: Single lake and univariate-style setup; no abstract to confirm metrics.

650bb190056a8f108b14e29d251a701326581682.goal: Enables onboard, autonomous satellite detection of wildfires from hyperspectral imagery to generate rapid alerts for disaster management.
650bb190056a8f108b14e29d251a701326581682.architecture: One-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN) classifying hyperspectral pixel spectra, sized for onboard hardware accelerators (Intel Movidius NCS-2, Nvidia Jetson Nano and TX2).
650bb190056a8f108b14e29d251a701326581682.data: Hyperspectral satellite imagery of the December 2019 Australian wildfires; sensor details are not reported in the abstract.
650bb190056a8f108b14e29d251a701326581682.result: The 1-D CNN classifies wildfires with performance comparable to literature results and runs on the tested onboard hardware, supporting trusted autonomous satellite operations.
650bb190056a8f108b14e29d251a701326581682.open_work: Validate on more fire events and sensors and in actual in-orbit demonstrations.
650bb190056a8f108b14e29d251a701326581682.issues: Single case study; accuracy numbers not given in the abstract; hardware tests are ground-based prototypes.

a48ca8589c4fd68f798eaa9e290f4a7eccd0b847.goal: Predicts daily global solar radiation using numerical weather model outputs as predictors, selecting the most informative inputs.
a48ca8589c4fd68f798eaa9e290f4a7eccd0b847.architecture: Grouping genetic algorithm for feature selection wrapped around an extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer neural network) regressor.
a48ca8589c4fd68f798eaa9e290f4a7eccd0b847.data: Numerical weather model output variables and measured global solar radiation at a radiometric station (reportedly in Spain); details not reported here.
a48ca8589c4fd68f798eaa9e290f4a7eccd0b847.result: Not reported here; the GGA-ELM is presented as improving prediction over models using all inputs or other selection methods.
a48ca8589c4fd68f798eaa9e290f4a7eccd0b847.open_work: Test at more sites and with probabilistic outputs.
a48ca8589c4fd68f798eaa9e290f4a7eccd0b847.issues: Single-station evaluation; feature selection may overfit to site; no abstract available.

4630207ed382bec42f30982268a3bc355ee30b56.goal: Improves wind power prediction by combining multiple variables and models.
4630207ed382bec42f30982268a3bc355ee30b56.architecture: Combined multivariate forecasting model; the specific component model types are not specified here.
4630207ed382bec42f30982268a3bc355ee30b56.data: Wind farm power and meteorological measurements; site and period are not reported here.
4630207ed382bec42f30982268a3bc355ee30b56.result: Not reported here; the combined model is presented as outperforming individual models.
4630207ed382bec42f30982268a3bc355ee30b56.open_work: Test on more wind farms and add probabilistic forecasts.
4630207ed382bec42f30982268a3bc355ee30b56.issues: No abstract available to confirm methods, data or metrics.

c9c3427164a11af347d8ec1cb06db567d6ffc634.goal: Estimates diffuse solar radiation, which is rarely measured but needed for solar energy system design.
c9c3427164a11af347d8ec1cb06db567d6ffc634.architecture: Hybrid support vector machine (support vector regression) coupled with wavelet transform decomposition of inputs.
c9c3427164a11af347d8ec1cb06db567d6ffc634.data: Measured radiation and meteorological data at a station (reportedly in Iran); details not reported here.
c9c3427164a11af347d8ec1cb06db567d6ffc634.result: Not reported here; the SVM-wavelet model is presented as more accurate than standalone SVM and empirical models.
c9c3427164a11af347d8ec1cb06db567d6ffc634.open_work: Validate at additional sites and climates.
c9c3427164a11af347d8ec1cb06db567d6ffc634.issues: Single-site study; wavelet hybrids can leak information; no abstract to confirm metrics.

e826f5a88910bbdfd95692e2af4d0bb7b307b36b.goal: Forecasts hour-ahead wind speed and wind power for power system dispatch.
e826f5a88910bbdfd95692e2af4d0bb7b307b36b.architecture: Neural network with fuzzy inputs trained using the simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) algorithm.
e826f5a88910bbdfd95692e2af4d0bb7b307b36b.data: Wind speed and power measurements from a wind site (reportedly in Taiwan); period not reported here.
e826f5a88910bbdfd95692e2af4d0bb7b307b36b.result: Not reported here; the SPSA-trained fuzzy-input network is presented as improving accuracy over conventional training.
e826f5a88910bbdfd95692e2af4d0bb7b307b36b.open_work: Extend to longer horizons and multiple sites.
e826f5a88910bbdfd95692e2af4d0bb7b307b36b.issues: Limited data and baselines; no abstract available.

9df8b394cb19ccb90dbbac9b3922d826c1fa7722.goal: Provides a transparent, richly annotated global reference dataset to benchmark cloud and cloud shadow detection for Sentinel-2 imagery.
9df8b394cb19ccb90dbbac9b3922d826c1fa7722.architecture: Benchmark dataset: 49,400 image patches with hand-crafted labels of thick and thin clouds and cloud shadows, plus outputs of eight state-of-the-art cloud detection algorithms.
9df8b394cb19ccb90dbbac9b3922d826c1fa7722.data: Copernicus Sentinel-2 level-1C and level-2A multispectral data, Sentinel-1 SAR data and auxiliary remote sensing products, globally distributed and multi-temporal.
9df8b394cb19ccb90dbbac9b3922d826c1fa7722.result: CloudSEN12 exceeds previous datasets in annotation richness, scene variability, geographic distribution, metadata, quality control and sample count.
9df8b394cb19ccb90dbbac9b3922d826c1fa7722.open_work: Use the dataset to train and benchmark deep learning cloud masks and extend to other sensors.
9df8b394cb19ccb90dbbac9b3922d826c1fa7722.issues: Manual labels of thin clouds and shadows are subjective; patches may not cover all surface types and seasons equally.

c5aa10ee1b228fe6ed36aff629f12086f2428eeb.goal: Improves streamflow prediction by optimizing neural network training with a metaheuristic.
c5aa10ee1b228fe6ed36aff629f12086f2428eeb.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type) trained with an extended marine predators algorithm, compared with other metaheuristic-trained ANNs.
c5aa10ee1b228fe6ed36aff629f12086f2428eeb.data: Observed streamflow (and possibly climatic) records from river stations; details not reported here.
c5aa10ee1b228fe6ed36aff629f12086f2428eeb.result: Not reported here; the extended marine predators algorithm ANN is presented as outperforming compared models.
c5aa10ee1b228fe6ed36aff629f12086f2428eeb.open_work: Test on more catchments and against deep learning sequence models.
c5aa10ee1b228fe6ed36aff629f12086f2428eeb.issues: Metaheuristic comparisons are sensitive to tuning; no abstract available.

994058bca5697c9354dbaae5622a486b66144094.goal: Reviews the application of artificial neural networks to crop yield prediction.
994058bca5697c9354dbaae5622a486b66144094.architecture: Review of artificial neural network (MLP-type and related) approaches for crop yield prediction.
994058bca5697c9354dbaae5622a486b66144094.data: Literature on ANN crop yield studies; covered datasets are not reported here.
994058bca5697c9354dbaae5622a486b66144094.result: Not reported here; the review summarizes how ANNs have been applied to yield prediction.
994058bca5697c9354dbaae5622a486b66144094.open_work: Not reported here; reviews typically point to more data and hybrid models.
994058bca5697c9354dbaae5622a486b66144094.issues: Venue not recorded and no abstract available; coverage likely limited to pre-2014 shallow ANN studies.

8f9ec8340e36019d3e353a2c4f53285e0884c317.goal: Produces full-coverage, high-resolution daily ozone estimates over mainland China for exposure assessment and epidemiology.
8f9ec8340e36019d3e353a2c4f53285e0884c317.architecture: Random forest model fusing station measurements with CMAQ simulations and other predictors.
8f9ec8340e36019d3e353a2c4f53285e0884c317.data: Ground ozone monitoring stations, CMAQ ozone simulations, meteorological parameters, population density, road length and elevation; daily MDA8 ozone at 1 km, 2013–2019.
8f9ec8340e36019d3e353a2c4f53285e0884c317.result: Cross-validated R2 0.80 and RMSE 20.93 μg/m3; population-weighted median MDA8 rose from 89.34 to 100.96 μg/m3 between 2013 and 2019, with regionally heterogeneous trends.
8f9ec8340e36019d3e353a2c4f53285e0884c317.open_work: Use the predictions in health studies at multiple spatiotemporal scales.
8f9ec8340e36019d3e353a2c4f53285e0884c317.issues: Random cross-validation may overstate skill in sparsely monitored areas; depends on CMAQ quality; no uncertainty estimates reported.

ec6c2f685be23b15c7eb2b5c6c420ebd9c6d1bf7.goal: Quantifies uncertainty in wind power generation forecasts by constructing prediction intervals.
ec6c2f685be23b15c7eb2b5c6c420ebd9c6d1bf7.architecture: Combination of nonparametric prediction intervals from multiple models; the model family is not specified here.
ec6c2f685be23b15c7eb2b5c6c420ebd9c6d1bf7.data: Wind power generation time series from wind farms; details not reported here.
ec6c2f685be23b15c7eb2b5c6c420ebd9c6d1bf7.result: Not reported here; combined prediction intervals are presented as better in coverage and width than individual intervals.
ec6c2f685be23b15c7eb2b5c6c420ebd9c6d1bf7.open_work: Extend to multi-step and spatial forecasts.
