ec6c2f685be23b15c7eb2b5c6c420ebd9c6d1bf7.issues: No abstract available to confirm methods, data or metrics.

d4a7f6ced26f5f6432050e3821c9b39a1c657eda.goal: Improves short-term photovoltaic power forecasting under weather-driven variability for stable grid operation.
d4a7f6ced26f5f6432050e3821c9b39a1c657eda.architecture: Hybrid temporal convolutional network (TCN) with efficient channel attention (ECANet) for feature extraction and a gated recurrent unit (GRU) for temporal prediction.
d4a7f6ced26f5f6432050e3821c9b39a1c657eda.data: Generation data from an Australian PV power station, evaluated across all four seasons.
d4a7f6ced26f5f6432050e3821c9b39a1c657eda.result: Best normalized RMSE 0.0195, MAE 0.0128 and R2 99.72%, improving up to 11.32%, 8.57% and 0.38% over the next-best model; also superior for 3-, 6- and 9-step forecasts.
d4a7f6ced26f5f6432050e3821c9b39a1c657eda.open_work: Test at other plants and climates and add probabilistic forecasts.
d4a7f6ced26f5f6432050e3821c9b39a1c657eda.issues: Single station; normalized metrics hinder comparison; no uncertainty quantification.

49d861d84563cce54ab5f4fb12e05883a5ed286d.goal: Forecasts station weather variables by modelling hierarchical spatial and temporal dependencies across many weather stations.
49d861d84563cce54ab5f4fb12e05883a5ed286d.architecture: Hierarchical spatio-temporal graph neural network (HiSTGNN) with adaptive graph learning across stations and temporal convolution modules.
49d861d84563cce54ab5f4fb12e05883a5ed286d.data: Station weather datasets including WD_BJ (Beijing); other datasets are not reported in the available abstract text.
49d861d84563cce54ab5f4fb12e05883a5ed286d.result: Outperforms the state-of-the-art method on WD_BJ with a 4.25% decrease in MAE and 5.34% decrease in RMSE.
49d861d84563cce54ab5f4fb12e05883a5ed286d.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and gridded data and integrate physical constraints.
49d861d84563cce54ab5f4fb12e05883a5ed286d.issues: Abstract text is truncated; station-based evaluation with limited variables; no probabilistic outputs.

4b2e1a5dff21cb5756c4abf572f8fdf7046256f0.goal: Automatically classifies sea ice types in high-resolution X-band SAR imagery for ice charting and navigation.
4b2e1a5dff21cb5756c4abf572f8fdf7046256f0.architecture: Neural network classifier (MLP-type) using texture features extracted from SAR images.
4b2e1a5dff21cb5756c4abf572f8fdf7046256f0.data: X-band SAR imagery (TerraSAR-X) of Arctic sea ice; scenes and periods are not reported here.
4b2e1a5dff21cb5756c4abf572f8fdf7046256f0.result: Not reported here; the neural network is presented as classifying several ice types with good accuracy.
4b2e1a5dff21cb5756c4abf572f8fdf7046256f0.open_work: Extend to more seasons, incidence angles and multi-frequency SAR.
4b2e1a5dff21cb5756c4abf572f8fdf7046256f0.issues: Few scenes and subjective reference labels; melt season conditions are challenging; no abstract available.

f446b38f9470c99d6cfad45785a4f63988c8ed49.goal: Maps daily near-surface air temperature over Antarctica, where weather stations are sparse, from satellite land surface temperature.
f446b38f9470c99d6cfad45785a4f63988c8ed49.architecture: Random forest, generalized boosted regression models (GBM) and Cubist compared with simple linear regression; Cubist-based forward feature selection.
f446b38f9470c99d6cfad45785a4f63988c8ed49.data: MODIS land surface temperature at 1 km with auxiliary predictors and air temperature from 32 Antarctic weather stations; maps produced for 2013.
f446b38f9470c99d6cfad45785a4f63988c8ed49.result: GBM with LST and month performs best (leave-one-station-out R2 0.71, RMSE 10.51 °C), only slightly better than linear regression (R2 0.64, RMSE 11.02 °C).
f446b38f9470c99d6cfad45785a4f63988c8ed49.open_work: Extend training to more years to build air temperature time series from 2000 onward.
f446b38f9470c99d6cfad45785a4f63988c8ed49.issues: Large RMSE; only clear-sky LST available; few stations; ML gains over linear regression are small.

be7c7466550e33692ced69419b8beda46352f1ca.goal: Directly forecasts wind speed prediction intervals to quantify uncertainty for wind energy operation.
be7c7466550e33692ced69419b8beda46352f1ca.architecture: Radial basis function neural network whose interval outputs are optimized in a multi-objective optimization framework balancing coverage and width.
be7c7466550e33692ced69419b8beda46352f1ca.data: Wind speed time series from wind sites; details not reported here.
be7c7466550e33692ced69419b8beda46352f1ca.result: Not reported here; the method is presented as producing high-quality intervals versus benchmark interval methods.
be7c7466550e33692ced69419b8beda46352f1ca.open_work: Extend to wind power and multi-step horizons.
be7c7466550e33692ced69419b8beda46352f1ca.issues: No abstract available to confirm data or metrics.

5f62fb8f2fc45741128db3cc876e9a0df2aef618.goal: Introduces a special issue on meta-heuristic techniques for calibrating and improving data-driven rainfall-runoff models for flood prediction.
5f62fb8f2fc45741128db3cc876e9a0df2aef618.architecture: Editorial review of meta-heuristic optimization techniques applied to data-driven rainfall-runoff modelling; no new model.
5f62fb8f2fc45741128db3cc876e9a0df2aef618.data: Not applicable; summarizes contributions to a Water special issue.
5f62fb8f2fc45741128db3cc876e9a0df2aef618.result: Frames meta-heuristic calibration as a growing field for improving peak discharge timing and magnitude forecasts.
5f62fb8f2fc45741128db3cc876e9a0df2aef618.open_work: Advance effective hydrological predictions and precautionary flood measures.
5f62fb8f2fc45741128db3cc876e9a0df2aef618.issues: Editorial with no new data or quantitative evaluation.

e79ca81065c93530cbaaa5cb9d85cf68a8281496.goal: Retrieves ocean color products from Sentinel-3 OLCI across a wide range of optical water types, including extreme absorbing and scattering coastal waters.
e79ca81065c93530cbaaa5cb9d85cf68a8281496.architecture: Swarm of blended neural networks (MLP-type) specialized for 13 optical water classes, producing constituent concentrations, optical properties and uncertainty estimates.
e79ca81065c93530cbaaa5cb9d85cf68a8281496.data: Sentinel-3 OLCI reflectances; networks span chlorophyll up to 200 mg m-3, non-algae particles up to 1500 g m-3 and CDOM absorption up to 20 m-1.
e79ca81065c93530cbaaa5cb9d85cf68a8281496.result: Baseline validation across water types indicates the algorithm is suitable for estimating water properties and constituents of most natural waters, with per-product uncertainties.
e79ca81065c93530cbaaa5cb9d85cf68a8281496.open_work: Extend validation with more in situ matchups and refine atmospheric correction.
e79ca81065c93530cbaaa5cb9d85cf68a8281496.issues: Validation is a baseline; performance depends on atmospheric correction and on the simulated training data.

d2ea6a49f48737f4db5e2029100a7028110437b7.goal: Classifies weather conditions such as sunny versus cloudy from ordinary outdoor photographs.
d2ea6a49f48737f4db5e2029100a7028110437b7.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network (ImageNet-pretrained CNN features) for two-class weather image classification.
d2ea6a49f48737f4db5e2029100a7028110437b7.data: A public two-class weather image dataset of outdoor photos; details not reported here.
d2ea6a49f48737f4db5e2029100a7028110437b7.result: Not reported here; the CNN substantially improves accuracy over earlier hand-crafted feature methods.
d2ea6a49f48737f4db5e2029100a7028110437b7.open_work: Extend to more weather classes and to video or camera networks.
d2ea6a49f48737f4db5e2029100a7028110437b7.issues: Coarse two-class labels; not tied to meteorological measurements; no abstract available.

230433ca55a9cc5b19a96920074ea413ea47383d.goal: Estimates monthly-mean daily global solar radiation over regions with sparse radiation stations using satellite products.
230433ca55a9cc5b19a96920074ea413ea47383d.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type) using satellite-derived predictors.
230433ca55a9cc5b19a96920074ea413ea47383d.data: MODIS products (e.g. land surface temperature) and TRMM precipitation, with ground radiation station observations in China; period not reported here.
230433ca55a9cc5b19a96920074ea413ea47383d.result: Not reported here; the satellite-driven model is presented as estimating monthly-mean radiation more accurately than empirical models.
230433ca55a9cc5b19a96920074ea413ea47383d.open_work: Extend to daily resolution and other regions.
230433ca55a9cc5b19a96920074ea413ea47383d.issues: Monthly-mean only; station coverage limits validation; no abstract available.

971d007253f6edcd0fc8764f1b4164dc798e591c.goal: Estimates air pollution levels from photographs to complement sparse monitoring stations.
971d007253f6edcd0fc8764f1b4164dc798e591c.architecture: Convolutional neural network classifying photos into air pollution levels.
971d007253f6edcd0fc8764f1b4164dc798e591c.data: Outdoor photos paired with PM2.5 pollution levels; details not reported here.
971d007253f6edcd0fc8764f1b4164dc798e591c.result: Not reported here; the CNN is presented as estimating pollution levels from photos better than baseline image methods.
971d007253f6edcd0fc8764f1b4164dc798e591c.open_work: Combine with station data and test across cities and lighting conditions.
971d007253f6edcd0fc8764f1b4164dc798e591c.issues: Image appearance depends on lighting and scene; coarse levels; no abstract available.

a7b6ebec724af9a61392c4247d99ae96e35b616d.goal: Models global solar radiation accurately while explaining the role of meteorological predictors.
a7b6ebec724af9a61392c4247d99ae96e35b616d.architecture: Tree-based ensemble machine learning models (e.g. random forest and gradient boosting) with Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) for interpretation.
a7b6ebec724af9a61392c4247d99ae96e35b616d.data: Meteorological observations and measured global solar radiation; sites and periods are not reported here.
a7b6ebec724af9a61392c4247d99ae96e35b616d.result: Not reported here; tree ensembles are presented as accurate, with SHAP identifying dominant predictors.
a7b6ebec724af9a61392c4247d99ae96e35b616d.open_work: Test transferability to other climates and time scales.
a7b6ebec724af9a61392c4247d99ae96e35b616d.issues: SHAP attributions are correlational; no abstract to confirm data or metrics.

57282ba797282bf7e2c0f0b26cc1e7f68cfe9830.goal: Predicts storm-induced outages on an electric distribution network in the northeastern USA to support utility preparedness.
57282ba797282bf7e2c0f0b26cc1e7f68cfe9830.architecture: Decision tree, random forest and Bayesian additive regression trees models, plus an ensemble, relating weather and infrastructure variables to outage counts.
57282ba797282bf7e2c0f0b26cc1e7f68cfe9830.data: Numerical weather simulations (WRF) of past storms with utility outage records, tree and land cover and infrastructure data in Connecticut.
57282ba797282bf7e2c0f0b26cc1e7f68cfe9830.result: Not reported here; tree-based models, especially random forest, predict outages with useful skill across storm types.
57282ba797282bf7e2c0f0b26cc1e7f68cfe9830.open_work: Add more storms, improve vegetation data and move to operational forecasting.
57282ba797282bf7e2c0f0b26cc1e7f68cfe9830.issues: Limited number of storms, especially extreme events; outage data quality; depends on weather simulation errors.

726e17caf1b19983d7ed77793ee3c17855c19fcc.goal: Compares data-driven methods for wind power prediction.
726e17caf1b19983d7ed77793ee3c17855c19fcc.architecture: Comparison of data-driven regression models; the specific model families are not specified here.
726e17caf1b19983d7ed77793ee3c17855c19fcc.data: Wind speed and power data from a wind site; details not reported here.
726e17caf1b19983d7ed77793ee3c17855c19fcc.result: Not reported here; the study ranks the data-driven approaches for wind power prediction.
726e17caf1b19983d7ed77793ee3c17855c19fcc.open_work: Extend to probabilistic forecasting and more sites.
726e17caf1b19983d7ed77793ee3c17855c19fcc.issues: No abstract available to confirm methods, data or metrics.

a96fee13c2220929483e7b010505d0e4bd9864e8.goal: Retrieves soil moisture from satellite images, addressing low revisit frequency and vegetation effects.
a96fee13c2220929483e7b010505d0e4bd9864e8.architecture: Improved Water Cloud Model for vegetation correction followed by a hybrid deep learning model combining a Deep Maxout Network and a bidirectional gated recurrent unit (Bi-GRU) with score-level fusion.
a96fee13c2220929483e7b010505d0e4bd9864e8.data: Satellite images with derived vegetation indices (NDVI, GLAI, GNDVI, WDRVI); sensor, region and period are not reported in the abstract.
a96fee13c2220929483e7b010505d0e4bd9864e8.result: The hybrid Bi-GRU and DMN achieves RMSE 0.9565 and ME 0.7287, lower than variants without vegetation index, without water cloud or with the traditional WCM.
a96fee13c2220929483e7b010505d0e4bd9864e8.open_work: Validate against in situ soil moisture networks and other regions.
a96fee13c2220929483e7b010505d0e4bd9864e8.issues: Units and data sources are unclear; comparisons are mainly ablations; limited external baselines.

aa8216f048d507e040dadf81ffd6094718208607.goal: Estimates soil temperature at different depths from meteorological variables for agricultural applications.
aa8216f048d507e040dadf81ffd6094718208607.architecture: Extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer neural network) optimized with a self-adaptive evolutionary algorithm (SaE-ELM).
aa8216f048d507e040dadf81ffd6094718208607.data: Meteorological and soil temperature data from weather stations (reportedly in Iran); details not reported here.
aa8216f048d507e040dadf81ffd6094718208607.result: Not reported here; SaE-ELM is presented as more accurate than standard ELM and ANN models.
aa8216f048d507e040dadf81ffd6094718208607.open_work: Test at more stations and depths and over longer periods.
aa8216f048d507e040dadf81ffd6094718208607.issues: Limited stations; no abstract available to confirm metrics.

3615c0925f5385cbe562e2a6ed7d88fc7baeb81e.goal: Reviews how interpretable machine learning has been used for air pollution forecasting, since most studies favour accuracy over interpretability.
3615c0925f5385cbe562e2a6ed7d88fc7baeb81e.architecture: Systematic review of interpretability methods (model-agnostic, model-specific and hybrid) applied to machine learning models for air pollutant prediction.
3615c0925f5385cbe562e2a6ed7d88fc7baeb81e.data: Literature from PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect and JuSER, 2011–2023: 5,396 records screened, 480 on air pollution prediction, 56 with model interpretation.
3615c0925f5385cbe562e2a6ed7d88fc7baeb81e.result: Identifies 20 interpretation methods; SHAP is most used (46.4%), followed by partial dependence plots (17.4%), both model-agnostic, revealing important atmospheric drivers.
3615c0925f5385cbe562e2a6ed7d88fc7baeb81e.open_work: Wider and more rigorous use of interpretability, and better reproducibility of interpretable air quality models, to support public health decisions.
3615c0925f5385cbe562e2a6ed7d88fc7baeb81e.issues: Only 56 studies report interpretations; quality was scored with an ecological niche checklist; the review compiles rather than compares methods quantitatively.

1e7312be09197f92fa7c804eed0b22f35de9f83b.goal: Predicts air pollutant concentrations with machine learning so that virtual monitoring stations could replace or supplement existing physical monitoring stations.
1e7312be09197f92fa7c804eed0b22f35de9f83b.architecture: Machine learning regression models; the specific model types are not specified in the title and no abstract is available.
1e7312be09197f92fa7c804eed0b22f35de9f83b.data: Not reported (no abstract available); the title implies observations from existing air quality monitoring stations, with details unknown.
1e7312be09197f92fa7c804eed0b22f35de9f83b.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies predictions accurate enough to consider virtual stations in place of some physical ones.
1e7312be09197f92fa7c804eed0b22f35de9f83b.open_work: Testing transferability to other networks and pollutants, and long-term robustness of virtual stations when surrounding conditions change.
1e7312be09197f92fa7c804eed0b22f35de9f83b.issues: Virtual stations depend on neighbouring stations remaining active; skill for extreme pollution episodes and under changing emissions is uncertain.

e65d738fca6152c2eddb7ac44dd80b72fd8f5273.goal: Improves short-term photovoltaic power forecasting by exploiting spatial information from neighbouring PV sites while avoiding redundancy from using all sites indiscriminately.
e65d738fca6152c2eddb7ac44dd80b72fd8f5273.architecture: Graph convolutional network (GCN) on an optimised hierarchical directed graph; neighbouring sites selected by geographic and weather similarity, with a complex-network connectivity index guiding graph structure.
e65d738fca6152c2eddb7ac44dd80b72fd8f5273.data: Power data from a target PV site and neighbouring PV sites plus numerical weather prediction (NWP) inputs; site details and periods not reported in the abstract.
e65d738fca6152c2eddb7ac44dd80b72fd8f5273.result: The method outperforms benchmark forecasting methods in accuracy in the case study; specific error values are not reported in the abstract.
e65d738fca6152c2eddb7ac44dd80b72fd8f5273.open_work: Extending the graph construction to larger PV fleets, longer horizons and probabilistic forecasts.
e65d738fca6152c2eddb7ac44dd80b72fd8f5273.issues: Single case study; no quantitative gains in the abstract; depends on NWP quality and on availability of nearby PV sites.

6d080c7db7622703b832961084e30c752055d57d.goal: Forecasts reservoir water level of dams in hydroelectric power plants to support generation planning and water management.
6d080c7db7622703b832961084e30c752055d57d.architecture: Hybrid model combining wavelet decomposition with a sequence-to-sequence LSTM network with an attention mechanism.
6d080c7db7622703b832961084e30c752055d57d.data: Historical dam level time series from hydroelectric power plants; specific plants and periods are not reported here (no abstract available).
6d080c7db7622703b832961084e30c752055d57d.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the wavelet-Seq2Seq-LSTM with attention gives accurate dam level forecasts versus simpler models.
6d080c7db7622703b832961084e30c752055d57d.open_work: Adding hydrometeorological inputs such as precipitation and inflow forecasts and testing at more reservoirs and longer horizons.
6d080c7db7622703b832961084e30c752055d57d.issues: Univariate-style time series approach may miss operational decisions and extreme hydrological events; details of benchmarks and errors unknown.

ccd0c419bc29dfc17548d536021a87f899368bc7.goal: Improves solar radiation forecasting by adding satellite-derived information to ground-based inputs.
ccd0c419bc29dfc17548d536021a87f899368bc7.architecture: Bayesian artificial neural networks (Bayesian ANN) for solar radiation forecasting.
ccd0c419bc29dfc17548d536021a87f899368bc7.data: Satellite data combined with ground solar radiation measurements; the satellite product, sites and periods are not reported here (no abstract available).
ccd0c419bc29dfc17548d536021a87f899368bc7.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies satellite inputs improve forecast skill relative to ground-only predictors.
ccd0c419bc29dfc17548d536021a87f899368bc7.open_work: Extending to more sites and horizons and exploiting the Bayesian uncertainty estimates in probabilistic forecasting.
ccd0c419bc29dfc17548d536021a87f899368bc7.issues: Details of horizons, sites and error metrics are unknown; satellite-derived irradiance carries its own retrieval errors.

4d1efcd25b6957d15df297f3676ebb14d8adfa98.goal: Estimates daily global solar radiation from readily available air temperature measurements where radiation measurements are scarce, using Iran as a case study.
4d1efcd25b6957d15df297f3676ebb14d8adfa98.architecture: Kernel extreme learning machine (KELM), compared with other machine learning and empirical temperature-based models.
4d1efcd25b6957d15df297f3676ebb14d8adfa98.data: Daily air temperature and measured global solar radiation from station(s) in Iran; specific stations and periods not reported here (no abstract available).
4d1efcd25b6957d15df297f3676ebb14d8adfa98.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies KELM gives accurate daily radiation estimates from temperatures alone.
4d1efcd25b6957d15df297f3676ebb14d8adfa98.open_work: Testing across more climates and stations and adding other routinely measured predictors such as sunshine duration or humidity.
4d1efcd25b6957d15df297f3676ebb14d8adfa98.issues: Temperature-only predictors limit skill on cloudy days; generalisation beyond the study station(s) is unclear.

9816dd3eeb1ff75b93b8841ec5c6d9e1232eefef.goal: Evaluates and improves the accuracy of an operational day-ahead wind power forecasting system in China.
9816dd3eeb1ff75b93b8841ec5c6d9e1232eefef.architecture: Day-ahead wind power forecasting system; the forecasting and correction method types are not specified in the title and no abstract is available.
9816dd3eeb1ff75b93b8841ec5c6d9e1232eefef.data: Not reported (no abstract available); the title implies operational forecasts and measured wind power from wind farms in China.
9816dd3eeb1ff75b93b8841ec5c6d9e1232eefef.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies enhancement measures improve day-ahead forecast accuracy over the original system.
9816dd3eeb1ff75b93b8841ec5c6d9e1232eefef.open_work: Assessing the improvements over more wind farms and seasons, and adding probabilistic forecasts.
9816dd3eeb1ff75b93b8841ec5c6d9e1232eefef.issues: Specific methods, sites and error reductions are unknown; day-ahead skill is bounded by NWP errors.

28beae521b35f4b302886942298d85525a44ee81.goal: Improves wind power prediction with a hybrid deep learning architecture.
28beae521b35f4b302886942298d85525a44ee81.architecture: Hybrid deep learning network with a bi-attention mechanism, with crisscross optimization used for tuning; specific layer types are not specified in the title.
28beae521b35f4b302886942298d85525a44ee81.data: Wind power time series from wind farm(s); specific sites and periods not reported here (no abstract available).
28beae521b35f4b302886942298d85525a44ee81.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the bi-attention hybrid outperforms comparison models.
28beae521b35f4b302886942298d85525a44ee81.open_work: Probabilistic extensions and testing on more wind farms and horizons.
28beae521b35f4b302886942298d85525a44ee81.issues: Complex hybrid with metaheuristic tuning risks overfitting and high computational cost; details of benchmarks unknown.

0db049b3b41f91790b1cd76b191d29284b47c0e6.goal: Evaluates whether coupling discrete wavelet transform with support vector regression improves daily and monthly streamflow forecasting.
0db049b3b41f91790b1cd76b191d29284b47c0e6.architecture: Hybrid of discrete wavelet transform (DWT) decomposition and support vector regression (SVR), compared with standalone SVR.
0db049b3b41f91790b1cd76b191d29284b47c0e6.data: Daily and monthly streamflow records; the river basin and period are not reported here (no abstract available).
0db049b3b41f91790b1cd76b191d29284b47c0e6.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the DWT-SVR coupling improves forecasts at daily and monthly scales.
0db049b3b41f91790b1cd76b191d29284b47c0e6.open_work: Testing other wavelet families and decomposition levels and applying the model to more basins.
0db049b3b41f91790b1cd76b191d29284b47c0e6.issues: Wavelet decomposition of the full series can leak future information if not done causally; single-basin generality unclear.

d05ddf4665cbf6f6d95b186377fbe92f5a99b8d3.goal: Compares hybrid models for hour-ahead wind speed forecasting that combine decomposition, singular spectrum analysis and neural networks.
d05ddf4665cbf6f6d95b186377fbe92f5a99b8d3.architecture: Elman recurrent neural network combined with empirical mode decomposition based techniques (EMD variants) and singular spectrum analysis (SSA) preprocessing.
d05ddf4665cbf6f6d95b186377fbe92f5a99b8d3.data: Measured wind speed time series; site and period not reported here (no abstract available).

d05ddf4665cbf6f6d95b186377fbe92f5a99b8d3.open_work: Extending to longer horizons, multiple sites and probabilistic forecasts.
d05ddf4665cbf6f6d95b186377fbe92f5a99b8d3.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids may leak future information; single-site, short-horizon setting.

bbbd08ce47b9161abf98d1740a437d9d270bf6c4.goal: Forecasts short-term residential electricity demand using weather and social variables.
bbbd08ce47b9161abf98d1740a437d9d270bf6c4.architecture: Data-driven forecasting model; the method type is not specified in the title and no abstract is available.

bbbd08ce47b9161abf98d1740a437d9d270bf6c4.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies weather and social variables help forecast residential demand.
bbbd08ce47b9161abf98d1740a437d9d270bf6c4.open_work: Testing at finer temporal resolution and in other regions, and assessing variable importance over time.
bbbd08ce47b9161abf98d1740a437d9d270bf6c4.issues: Method and error metrics unknown from the available information; social variables may be coarse and lagged.

89717e5da691f2724681b49ea8605a2140ebe4a0.goal: Improves multi-step photovoltaic power forecasting up to 24 h ahead to support microgrids and economic dispatch.
89717e5da691f2724681b49ea8605a2140ebe4a0.architecture: Least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM), GMDH neural network and a hybrid GLSSVM, each with Direct, Recursive and DirRec multi-step strategies; compared with a traditional ANN.
89717e5da691f2724681b49ea8605a2140ebe4a0.data: Historical output power of a 960 kWp grid-connected PV system in southern Italy.
89717e5da691f2724681b49ea8605a2140ebe4a0.result: GLSSVM with the DirRec strategy achieves a normalized mean error of 2.92% under different weather conditions, clearly better than the traditional ANN.
89717e5da691f2724681b49ea8605a2140ebe4a0.open_work: Adding weather forecast inputs and testing on other plants and climates.
89717e5da691f2724681b49ea8605a2140ebe4a0.issues: Single PV plant; relies on power history only, so skill on rapidly changing cloudy days is limited.

16b44f42ca6db94ae180f24dfa7aec2f397cff78.goal: Quantifies rooftop dew, fog and rain water collection in southwest Morocco and models dew yield to assess dew as an alternative water source.
16b44f42ca6db94ae180f24dfa7aec2f397cff78.architecture: Neural network model predicting dew yield from meteorological variables; the network type is not specified in the title.
16b44f42ca6db94ae180f24dfa7aec2f397cff78.data: Field measurements of dew, fog and rain collection on rooftops in southwest Morocco with concurrent meteorological observations; period not reported here.
16b44f42ca6db94ae180f24dfa7aec2f397cff78.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the neural network predicts dew yields from meteorological data.
16b44f42ca6db94ae180f24dfa7aec2f397cff78.open_work: Mapping dew potential regionally and testing the model at other sites.
16b44f42ca6db94ae180f24dfa7aec2f397cff78.issues: Single region and limited observation period; neural network transferability to other climates unclear.

bae398120c1553d2d0cd1dc801fa04593214ab5a.goal: Optimises artificial neural network modelling of the rainfall-runoff process by combining wavelet analysis with genetic programming.
bae398120c1553d2d0cd1dc801fa04593214ab5a.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet transform, genetic programming (GP) for input selection and an artificial neural network (ANN) rainfall-runoff model.
bae398120c1553d2d0cd1dc801fa04593214ab5a.data: Rainfall and runoff time series from watershed(s); specific basins and periods not reported here (no abstract available).
bae398120c1553d2d0cd1dc801fa04593214ab5a.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the wavelet-GP input selection improves ANN rainfall-runoff performance.
bae398120c1553d2d0cd1dc801fa04593214ab5a.open_work: Testing in additional catchments and longer horizons.
bae398120c1553d2d0cd1dc801fa04593214ab5a.issues: Small catchment set; wavelet hybrids can leak future information; details unknown.

966e03d42d86f8a6da88a1bfdec5e45f4b801a00.goal: Compares neural network approaches for groundwater level prediction.
966e03d42d86f8a6da88a1bfdec5e45f4b801a00.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural networks (ANN), Bayesian neural networks and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS).
966e03d42d86f8a6da88a1bfdec5e45f4b801a00.data: Groundwater level records and related predictors from well(s); location and period not reported here (no abstract available).
966e03d42d86f8a6da88a1bfdec5e45f4b801a00.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies a ranking of ANN, Bayesian neural network and ANFIS skill.
966e03d42d86f8a6da88a1bfdec5e45f4b801a00.open_work: Using the Bayesian network's uncertainty estimates and testing at more wells.
966e03d42d86f8a6da88a1bfdec5e45f4b801a00.issues: Limited site coverage; details of inputs and metrics unknown.

2d2394de51db1cf79dbb80b5a4bc05385c1a5592.goal: Forecasts solar radiation from multivariate meteorological data for several cities of Bangladesh.
2d2394de51db1cf79dbb80b5a4bc05385c1a5592.architecture: Neural network models for multivariate time series forecasting; the specific network types are not specified in the title.
2d2394de51db1cf79dbb80b5a4bc05385c1a5592.data: Meteorological data and solar radiation for different cities of Bangladesh; data source and period not reported here.
2d2394de51db1cf79dbb80b5a4bc05385c1a5592.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies neural networks forecast solar radiation accurately across cities.
2d2394de51db1cf79dbb80b5a4bc05385c1a5592.open_work: Extending to more locations and horizons and to satellite or NWP inputs.
2d2394de51db1cf79dbb80b5a4bc05385c1a5592.issues: Details of networks, horizons and metrics unknown; station data quality may vary.

00fec7edf909505a95339a60f03a9977667bcf64.goal: Predicts annual crop yields for decision-making using IoT-based precision agriculture data combined with climate and chemical information.
00fec7edf909505a95339a60f03a9977667bcf64.architecture: Crop Yield Prediction Algorithm (CYPA) comparing five machine learning regressors including decision tree, random forest and extra trees, plus an active learning algorithm to reduce labeled data.
00fec7edf909505a95339a60f03a9977667bcf64.data: Climate, weather, agricultural yield and chemical (e.g. pesticide or fertiliser) data; specific sources and regions not reported in the abstract.
00fec7edf909505a95339a60f03a9977667bcf64.result: ExtraTreeRegressor scores 0.9933, RandomForestRegressor 0.9903 and DecisionTreeRegressor 0.9814; active learning is proposed to cut labeling needs.
00fec7edf909505a95339a60f03a9977667bcf64.open_work: Validating the active learning component and deploying with real IoT field sensor streams.
00fec7edf909505a95339a60f03a9977667bcf64.issues: Very high scores suggest possible leakage or random splits; data sources, spatial scope and evaluation design are vague.

95d2975f009afdf8ce7ac037376c2a7db5baa210.goal: Statistically downscales GCM output to predict rainfall at regional scale for climate change impact assessment.
95d2975f009afdf8ce7ac037376c2a7db5baa210.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression coupled with probabilistic global search Lausanne (PGSL) optimisation of its parameters.
95d2975f009afdf8ce7ac037376c2a7db5baa210.data: Large-scale GCM output and reanalysis predictors with observed rainfall; region and models not reported here (no abstract available).
95d2975f009afdf8ce7ac037376c2a7db5baa210.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the SVM-PGSL approach yields skilful rainfall downscaling from GCM output.
95d2975f009afdf8ce7ac037376c2a7db5baa210.open_work: Applying to multiple GCMs and scenarios and representing downscaling uncertainty.
95d2975f009afdf8ce7ac037376c2a7db5baa210.issues: Statistical downscaling assumes stationary predictor-predictand relations under climate change; inherits GCM biases.

9c2677cca49ee8c075895b6566a2c7aea400499d.goal: Forecasts daily streamflow with online sequential extreme learning machines that can update as new data arrive.
9c2677cca49ee8c075895b6566a2c7aea400499d.architecture: Online sequential extreme learning machine (OS-ELM), compared with batch-trained models such as ELM and other neural or regression approaches.
9c2677cca49ee8c075895b6566a2c7aea400499d.data: Daily streamflow and meteorological predictors from watersheds in western Canada; exact basins and periods not reported here.
9c2677cca49ee8c075895b6566a2c7aea400499d.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies OS-ELM gives accurate daily forecasts with cheap sequential updating.
9c2677cca49ee8c075895b6566a2c7aea400499d.open_work: Applying online learning to longer horizons and to nonstationary climate conditions.
9c2677cca49ee8c075895b6566a2c7aea400499d.issues: Limited set of basins; extreme flows may be poorly represented in training.

8edc19d3ae017420b4e208bc643e974898d0274f.goal: Predicts daily dew point temperature from meteorological variables for agricultural and hydrological applications.
8edc19d3ae017420b4e208bc643e974898d0274f.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM), compared with other machine learning models such as support vector machines and ANNs.
8edc19d3ae017420b4e208bc643e974898d0274f.data: Daily meteorological station data from Iran; specific stations and periods not reported here (no abstract available).
8edc19d3ae017420b4e208bc643e974898d0274f.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies ELM predicts daily dew point temperature accurately.
8edc19d3ae017420b4e208bc643e974898d0274f.open_work: Testing in more climates and with fewer input variables.
8edc19d3ae017420b4e208bc643e974898d0274f.issues: Few stations; dew point is strongly tied to humidity inputs, so the task may be near-trivial depending on predictors.

c0d5586d7c71cbaa4d4b268de8b45c3b65c7622f.goal: Improves wind speed prediction with a deep learning model combined with signal decomposition and swarm-intelligence parameter optimization.
c0d5586d7c71cbaa4d4b268de8b45c3b65c7622f.architecture: Deep learning model with signal decomposition preprocessing and parameters tuned by an improved chimp optimization algorithm; the network type is not specified in the title.
c0d5586d7c71cbaa4d4b268de8b45c3b65c7622f.data: Measured wind speed series; sites and periods not reported here (no abstract available).
c0d5586d7c71cbaa4d4b268de8b45c3b65c7622f.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the optimised hybrid outperforms comparison models.
c0d5586d7c71cbaa4d4b268de8b45c3b65c7622f.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and testing at more sites and horizons.
c0d5586d7c71cbaa4d4b268de8b45c3b65c7622f.issues: Decomposition hybrids may leak future information; metaheuristic tuning adds cost and overfitting risk.

cccec4cc1fcde15620106c8fce0e8763f19d529c.goal: Provides real-time estimates of snow water equivalent (SWE) in remote mountain watersheds where reconstructed SWE is only available retrospectively.
cccec4cc1fcde15620106c8fce0e8763f19d529c.architecture: Bagged regression trees and feed-forward neural networks (MLP) predicting reconstructed SWE from physiographic and remotely sensed predictors.
cccec4cc1fcde15620106c8fce0e8763f19d529c.data: Reconstructed SWE as target; AMSR-E passive microwave brightness temperatures, fractional snow-covered area and physiographic data, April–June 2003–2011, at 3.125 km over Afghanistan and the Sierra Nevada.
cccec4cc1fcde15620106c8fce0e8763f19d529c.result: Both methods give similar results: 0–14% bias, 46–48 mm RMSE and mean Nash–Sutcliffe efficiency of 0.68; SWE climatology and fractional snow cover are most important.
cccec4cc1fcde15620106c8fce0e8763f19d529c.open_work: Using the estimates to forecast runoff and extending to sensors beyond AMSR-E for current operational use.
cccec4cc1fcde15620106c8fce0e8763f19d529c.issues: Target is a reconstruction rather than direct measurement; limited to the AMSR-E era and spring months; coarse 3.125 km resolution.

9ba449be8413dbebdca18d3d6c50116774645383.goal: Forecasts daily streamflow by combining wavelet decomposition with artificial neural networks.
9ba449be8413dbebdca18d3d6c50116774645383.architecture: Hybrid wavelet transform and artificial neural network (wavelet-ANN) models, compared with a standalone ANN.
9ba449be8413dbebdca18d3d6c50116774645383.data: Daily streamflow series from a river basin; specific gauges and periods not reported here (no abstract available).
9ba449be8413dbebdca18d3d6c50116774645383.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies wavelet-ANN hybrids outperform plain ANNs for daily streamflow.
9ba449be8413dbebdca18d3d6c50116774645383.open_work: Extending to longer lead times and other basins.
9ba449be8413dbebdca18d3d6c50116774645383.issues: Possible information leakage from non-causal wavelet decomposition; single-basin evaluation.

c7495d94bb8de810856855a2245e39ed15b271b8.goal: Forecasts hierarchical electricity load for the Global Energy Forecasting Competition 2012 load track, using temperature information.
c7495d94bb8de810856855a2245e39ed15b271b8.architecture: Gradient boosting machines and Gaussian process regression, combined for hierarchical load forecasting.
c7495d94bb8de810856855a2245e39ed15b271b8.data: GEFCom2012 load forecasting data: hourly loads for 20 zones of a US utility with temperature records from 11 weather stations.
c7495d94bb8de810856855a2245e39ed15b271b8.result: The approach was among the winning entries of the GEFCom2012 hierarchical load forecasting track.
c7495d94bb8de810856855a2245e39ed15b271b8.open_work: Better use of hierarchical structure and temperature station selection, and probabilistic load forecasts.
c7495d94bb8de810856855a2245e39ed15b271b8.issues: Tailored to competition data and metric; temperatures were given rather than forecast, overstating operational skill.

1382478970f2025a836867695a606cb260fb055b.goal: Models air pollution in Athens with a hybrid computational intelligence system that combines multiple machine learning models.
1382478970f2025a836867695a606cb260fb055b.architecture: HISYCOL, a hybrid computational intelligence system combining several machine learning models; the specific model types are not specified in the title.
1382478970f2025a836867695a606cb260fb055b.data: Air pollutant and meteorological measurements from Athens monitoring stations; pollutants and periods not reported here (no abstract available).
1382478970f2025a836867695a606cb260fb055b.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies combined learners model Athens air pollution better than single models.
1382478970f2025a836867695a606cb260fb055b.open_work: Testing in other cities and for forecasting rather than modelling of concentrations.
1382478970f2025a836867695a606cb260fb055b.issues: Single city; details of models and metrics unknown.

e5d405aa994320e1e235c05641871f0ad18e5d43.goal: Forecasts solar radiation using neural networks driven by multiple meteorological parameters.
e5d405aa994320e1e235c05641871f0ad18e5d43.architecture: Artificial neural networks (ANN) using multiple input parameters.
e5d405aa994320e1e235c05641871f0ad18e5d43.data: Meteorological measurements and solar radiation; locations and periods not reported here (no abstract available).
e5d405aa994320e1e235c05641871f0ad18e5d43.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies multi-parameter neural networks improve solar radiation forecasts.
e5d405aa994320e1e235c05641871f0ad18e5d43.open_work: Testing more sites and horizons and adding satellite or NWP inputs.
e5d405aa994320e1e235c05641871f0ad18e5d43.issues: Details of sites, horizons and metrics are unknown.

fdfb71784877f51969176fc88d9efc1d8a4341df.goal: Argues that hydrology should adopt a data-intensive fourth paradigm to test scaling and similarity hypotheses beyond computational simulation.
fdfb71784877f51969176fc88d9efc1d8a4341df.architecture: Synthesis and perspective paper proposing a mutual information framework for testing hydrologic scaling and similarity hypotheses; not a specific ML model.
fdfb71784877f51969176fc88d9efc1d8a4341df.data: No new dataset; discusses boundary condition, state, flux and parameter data requirements across scales.
fdfb71784877f51969176fc88d9efc1d8a4341df.result: Summarises key scaling and similarity hypotheses, outlines information-theoretic testing and calls for a community effort on data-driven hydrology.
fdfb71784877f51969176fc88d9efc1d8a4341df.open_work: Community effort to apply the fourth paradigm to scaling and similarity challenges and assemble the required multiscale data.
fdfb71784877f51969176fc88d9efc1d8a4341df.issues: Conceptual paper without empirical demonstration; data gaps across scales remain a major obstacle.

ebb125b9607c481bd6465c601c58e718bf1d7664.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction by combining decomposition, feature selection and error correction.
ebb125b9607c481bd6465c601c58e718bf1d7664.architecture: Hybrid of ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD), feature selection and an error-correction step; the core predictor type is not specified in the title.
ebb125b9607c481bd6465c601c58e718bf1d7664.data: Measured wind speed series; sites and periods not reported here (no abstract available).
ebb125b9607c481bd6465c601c58e718bf1d7664.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the hybrid with error correction outperforms simpler models.
ebb125b9607c481bd6465c601c58e718bf1d7664.open_work: Extending to multi-site and probabilistic prediction.
ebb125b9607c481bd6465c601c58e718bf1d7664.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids may leak future information; details unknown.

0a1db94ee1ec21f9c3ebf8377760fd9c45b17e93.goal: Estimates solar radiation over Turkey from satellite remote sensing using artificial neural networks.
0a1db94ee1ec21f9c3ebf8377760fd9c45b17e93.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) using satellite-derived and geographic inputs.
0a1db94ee1ec21f9c3ebf8377760fd9c45b17e93.data: Satellite remote sensing data and ground solar radiation measurements in Turkey; specific products and stations not reported here.
0a1db94ee1ec21f9c3ebf8377760fd9c45b17e93.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the ANN estimates solar radiation accurately across Turkey.
0a1db94ee1ec21f9c3ebf8377760fd9c45b17e93.open_work: Mapping solar resource at higher resolution and validating at more stations.
0a1db94ee1ec21f9c3ebf8377760fd9c45b17e93.issues: Limited station validation; satellite retrieval errors propagate into estimates.

0fae2a51287a1f9dd6b393d55843998c45fb1b33.goal: Assesses how well Gene Expression Programming models for daily reference evapotranspiration generalise across coastal stations in Iran.
0fae2a51287a1f9dd6b393d55843998c45fb1b33.architecture: Gene Expression Programming (GEP) symbolic regression, evaluated across stations and compared with empirical ET0 equations.
0fae2a51287a1f9dd6b393d55843998c45fb1b33.data: Daily meteorological data from coastal stations of Iran with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET0 as reference; periods not reported here.
0fae2a51287a1f9dd6b393d55843998c45fb1b33.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies a test of cross-station generalisability of GEP ET0 models.
0fae2a51287a1f9dd6b393d55843998c45fb1b33.open_work: Testing generalisability in inland and other climates and with reduced inputs.
0fae2a51287a1f9dd6b393d55843998c45fb1b33.issues: Reference ET0 is itself computed rather than measured; limited to Iranian coastal climate.

d969ff841c0b0e48f50ba06c9df760f0cb766b0a.goal: Predicts Indian summer monsoon rainfall from ENSO-related Niño indices.
d969ff841c0b0e48f50ba06c9df760f0cb766b0a.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) using Niño indices as predictors.
d969ff841c0b0e48f50ba06c9df760f0cb766b0a.data: Niño sea surface temperature indices and observed Indian summer monsoon rainfall; periods not reported here (no abstract available).
d969ff841c0b0e48f50ba06c9df760f0cb766b0a.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies Niño indices provide useful neural network predictions of monsoon rainfall.
d969ff841c0b0e48f50ba06c9df760f0cb766b0a.open_work: Adding other predictors such as Indian Ocean Dipole indices and testing in independent periods.
d969ff841c0b0e48f50ba06c9df760f0cb766b0a.issues: Short seasonal record limits training data and raises overfitting risk; ENSO-monsoon relation is nonstationary.

aa1803938fb9895f5be57fc4c07c1b80eb302afe.goal: Produces a global, long-term, spatially continuous 1 km surface soil moisture dataset for hydrologic and climate applications.
aa1803938fb9895f5be57fc4c07c1b80eb302afe.architecture: Physics-informed machine learning guided by knowledge of soil moisture processes; the specific learner type is not specified in the abstract. Benchmark dataset GSSM1 km.
aa1803938fb9895f5be57fc4c07c1b80eb302afe.data: International Soil Moisture Network (ISMN) in situ data, remote sensing and meteorological data; 18 predictors; output 0–5 cm soil moisture, daily, 1 km, 2000–2020.
aa1803938fb9895f5be57fc4c07c1b80eb302afe.result: Test RMSE is 0.05 cm3/cm3 with correlation 0.9; antecedent precipitation evaporation index is the most important predictor, followed by evaporation and longitude.
aa1803938fb9895f5be57fc4c07c1b80eb302afe.open_work: Using GSSM1 km to study large-scale climate extremes and long-term trends.
aa1803938fb9895f5be57fc4c07c1b80eb302afe.issues: ISMN stations are unevenly distributed, limiting validation in data-sparse regions; longitude as an important predictor suggests spatial overfitting.

a087ec53cae3f3eef813aeed8b37f76525d5dabb.goal: Maps flood risk combining machine-learning flood susceptibility with often-neglected socio-economic vulnerability in data-constrained regions.
a087ec53cae3f3eef813aeed8b37f76525d5dabb.architecture: Decision tree, random forest and gradient-boosted decision trees on geomorphic flood descriptors; Data Envelopment Analysis (CCR model) for vulnerability; Jenks breaks for risk classes.
a087ec53cae3f3eef813aeed8b37f76525d5dabb.data: Digital terrain model-derived geomorphic flood descriptors and socio-economic indicators for Jagatsinghpur district, lower Mahanadi basin, India.
a087ec53cae3f3eef813aeed8b37f76525d5dabb.result: Random forest performs best with AUC 0.88 on training and testing; over 40% of villages face high or very high flood risk.
a087ec53cae3f3eef813aeed8b37f76525d5dabb.open_work: Applying the generic framework over larger regions and other hazards.
a087ec53cae3f3eef813aeed8b37f76525d5dabb.issues: Terrain descriptors ignore hydrodynamics and rainfall scenarios; single district; validation relies on past flood inventory.

e606c37a62e8883d1d61653e3bf4126ac3164a23.goal: Detects clouds in high-resolution satellite imagery, a prerequisite for atmospheric correction and land cover classification.
e606c37a62e8883d1d61653e3bf4126ac3164a23.architecture: Machine learning classifier on fused spectral, textural and other features with object-oriented post-processing; the classifier type is not specified in the abstract.
e606c37a62e8883d1d61653e3bf4126ac3164a23.data: 102 Gaofen-1 and Gaofen-2 (GF-1, GF-2) high-resolution satellite images over varied land surfaces.
e606c37a62e8883d1d61653e3bf4126ac3164a23.result: Overall accuracy above 91.45%, Kappa above 80%, producer accuracy 93.67% and user accuracy 95.67%, better than other feature fusion methods.
e606c37a62e8883d1d61653e3bf4126ac3164a23.open_work: Extending to thin clouds and cloud shadows and to other sensors.
e606c37a62e8883d1d61653e3bf4126ac3164a23.issues: Limited to GF-1/GF-2; bright surfaces still require post-processing; hand-crafted features.

373b0a2b4d4a0b8a81a95f4472108a8840aa9519.goal: Provides probabilistic wind speed forecasts with a denoising and deep learning approach.
373b0a2b4d4a0b8a81a95f4472108a8840aa9519.architecture: Convolutional transformer combined with a truncated Gaussian density network for probabilistic output, with data denoising preprocessing.
373b0a2b4d4a0b8a81a95f4472108a8840aa9519.data: Wind speed time series; sites and periods not reported here (no abstract available).
373b0a2b4d4a0b8a81a95f4472108a8840aa9519.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies improved deterministic and probabilistic wind speed forecasts.
373b0a2b4d4a0b8a81a95f4472108a8840aa9519.open_work: Testing on more sites and longer horizons and adding NWP inputs.
373b0a2b4d4a0b8a81a95f4472108a8840aa9519.issues: Details of datasets and metrics unknown; denoising of the full series can leak information.

39a25e79f3e764363e50cff23c7373fc924927fd.goal: Predicts water level fluctuations of Lake Urmia, a shrinking hypersaline lake in Iran.
39a25e79f3e764363e50cff23c7373fc924927fd.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) optimised with the firefly algorithm, compared with other models.
39a25e79f3e764363e50cff23c7373fc924927fd.data: Lake Urmia water level records; period not reported here (no abstract available).
39a25e79f3e764363e50cff23c7373fc924927fd.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the SVM-firefly hybrid improves lake level prediction.
39a25e79f3e764363e50cff23c7373fc924927fd.open_work: Adding hydroclimatic and water-use predictors to capture drivers of lake decline.
39a25e79f3e764363e50cff23c7373fc924927fd.issues: Level-history inputs may not capture anthropogenic drivers; single lake.

a5b0cc4bc8a8c388b0cfa0ba0652dee7001c84dd.goal: Quantifies aerobic methane oxidation in shallow marine waters and its role in limiting global ocean methane emissions.
a5b0cc4bc8a8c388b0cfa0ba0652dee7001c84dd.architecture: Machine learning models trained to map global aerobic methane oxidation rates; the model type is not specified in the abstract. Combined with field biogeochemical measurements.
a5b0cc4bc8a8c388b0cfa0ba0652dee7001c84dd.data: Field observations in the East China Sea plus measured MOx rates, methane concentrations and other variables from a global database.
a5b0cc4bc8a8c388b0cfa0ba0652dee7001c84dd.result: About half of methane, 1.8 ± 2.7 Tg per year, is oxidised in global near-shore waters shallower than 50 m.
a5b0cc4bc8a8c388b0cfa0ba0652dee7001c84dd.open_work: More global MOx measurements to reduce the large uncertainty in the estimate.
a5b0cc4bc8a8c388b0cfa0ba0652dee7001c84dd.issues: Very large uncertainty (± larger than estimate); sparse global rate measurements limit ML extrapolation.

49bbf000f0b5c43c0b3885f11f9d4fcf72c70a04.goal: Identifies agro-ecological zones for Arabica coffee and how climate change shifts them, to guide adaptation research.
49bbf000f0b5c43c0b3885f11f9d4fcf72c70a04.architecture: Clustering of coffee occurrence locations on bioclimatic variables, then random forest classification of climate layers to map the zones.
49bbf000f0b5c43c0b3885f11f9d4fcf72c70a04.data: Geo-referenced Coffea arabica occurrence locations and current and future bioclimatic climate data layers.
49bbf000f0b5c43c0b3885f11f9d4fcf72c70a04.result: Hot and dry zones are most affected; better-suited zones migrate upward by about 500 m; stable sites for germplasm evaluation are identified.
49bbf000f0b5c43c0b3885f11f9d4fcf72c70a04.open_work: Using stable locations for long-term evaluation of adaptation and germplasm.
49bbf000f0b5c43c0b3885f11f9d4fcf72c70a04.issues: Climate-only niche approach ignores soils and management; future projections depend on climate model choices.

d7a421ec058dfbed32793c314a5c3213deaf46b9.goal: Models soil temperatures at several depths from meteorological variables using neural computing techniques.
d7a421ec058dfbed32793c314a5c3213deaf46b9.architecture: Comparison of three neural network techniques; the specific types are not specified in the title.
d7a421ec058dfbed32793c314a5c3213deaf46b9.data: Meteorological and soil temperature observations at several depths; station and period not reported here (no abstract available).
d7a421ec058dfbed32793c314a5c3213deaf46b9.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies a comparison of how well the three techniques model soil temperatures.

d7a421ec058dfbed32793c314a5c3213deaf46b9.issues: Number of stations and data period unknown; generalisation to other climates and depths is untested.

011d06e22f1469f774400183b81cd4f8c3741f20.goal: Improves streamflow forecasting for water resources management with a denoising and optimised neural network hybrid.
011d06e22f1469f774400183b81cd4f8c3741f20.architecture: Empirical wavelet transform denoising, PACF input selection and an artificial neural network (ANN) with weights optimised by the multi-verse optimizer (MVO-ANN).
011d06e22f1469f774400183b81cd4f8c3741f20.data: Annual streamflow observations from four hydrological stations in the upper Yangtze River, China.
011d06e22f1469f774400183b81cd4f8c3741f20.result: The hybrid outperforms non-denoising models, back-propagation neural network and PSO-ANN; specific errors not reported in the abstract.
011d06e22f1469f774400183b81cd4f8c3741f20.open_work: Testing at daily or monthly scales and in other basins.
011d06e22f1469f774400183b81cd4f8c3741f20.issues: Annual series are short; denoising applied to the full series may leak information.

f09a953114744dd234a24b4bf6cab103f44e1788.goal: Detects clouds in optical remote sensing images automatically, since cloud contamination limits the usability of satellite imagery for surface analysis.
f09a953114744dd234a24b4bf6cab103f44e1788.architecture: A deep learning classifier for cloud versus clear pixels or regions; the specific network type is not specified in the available metadata.
f09a953114744dd234a24b4bf6cab103f44e1788.data: Optical satellite remote sensing images; sensor, region and sample sizes not reported.
f09a953114744dd234a24b4bf6cab103f44e1788.result: Not reported; the title indicates deep learning is used for cloud detection, presumably compared with conventional threshold-based methods.
f09a953114744dd234a24b4bf6cab103f44e1788.open_work: Testing across sensors, surfaces such as snow and bright desert, and thin or broken cloud would establish generality.
f09a953114744dd234a24b4bf6cab103f44e1788.issues: Abstract unavailable, so method, data and accuracy cannot be verified; conference-length study likely with limited evaluation scenes.

6f89ed60200920ca2b23a1471120cfa97ec934de.goal: Reviews satellite methods for extracting surface water extent, motivated by changing water distribution under climate change and human activity and the need for water monitoring.
6f89ed60200920ca2b23a1471120cfa97ec934de.architecture: Review of water extraction methods from optical and radar imagery: threshold (NDWI-based) methods, support vector machine, decision tree, object-oriented extraction and deep learning, with a comparative application.
6f89ed60200920ca2b23a1471120cfa97ec934de.data: Optical and radar satellite images over the Huai River Basin, China, and Nam Co lake on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau used for the method comparison.
6f89ed60200920ca2b23a1471120cfa97ec934de.result: All methods give reliable water maps; NDWI-based threshold segmentation is the most robust among the compared approaches.
6f89ed60200920ca2b23a1471120cfa97ec934de.open_work: More automatic, large-scale and high-precision water extraction methods are needed.
6f89ed60200920ca2b23a1471120cfa97ec934de.issues: Comparison limited to two test regions; many factors still restrict extraction accuracy, and deep learning is compared without large training sets.

0d3bdcc75ca28a6ba15c2144ad0ac77da8cccf96.goal: Predicts near-term air temperature for agricultural decision support (e.g. frost protection) while reducing the training data and cost needed by machine learning models.
0d3bdcc75ca28a6ba15c2144ad0ac77da8cccf96.architecture: Support vector regression trained on reduced training sets, compared with artificial neural networks (MLP) developed earlier for the same task.
0d3bdcc75ca28a6ba15c2144ad0ac77da8cccf96.data: Weather station records from the Georgia Automated Environmental Monitoring Network (USA); prediction horizons of a few hours ahead.
0d3bdcc75ca28a6ba15c2144ad0ac77da8cccf96.result: SVR trained on much smaller subsets achieves accuracy comparable to ANNs trained on the full data, with lower computational cost.
0d3bdcc75ca28a6ba15c2144ad0ac77da8cccf96.open_work: Extending to other variables, longer horizons and other climates, and smarter training-subset selection.
0d3bdcc75ca28a6ba15c2144ad0ac77da8cccf96.issues: Point forecasts only without uncertainty; single regional network; exact horizons and errors not verified here.

7a0bec55aa1f0182ba4df435c0dd9a0c0e15041e.goal: Improves multi-step wind speed forecasting by combining decomposition, feature selection and deep learning to handle nonstationary wind series.
7a0bec55aa1f0182ba4df435c0dd9a0c0e15041e.architecture: Hybrid CGRU model (convolutional neural network plus gated recurrent unit) with secondary signal decomposition and multi-label-specific XGBoost feature selection.
7a0bec55aa1f0182ba4df435c0dd9a0c0e15041e.data: Wind speed time series from wind sites; specific datasets not reported.
7a0bec55aa1f0182ba4df435c0dd9a0c0e15041e.result: Not reported; the hybrid is presumably claimed to outperform benchmark forecasters on multi-step horizons.
7a0bec55aa1f0182ba4df435c0dd9a0c0e15041e.open_work: Testing on more sites and horizons and probabilistic outputs would strengthen conclusions.
7a0bec55aa1f0182ba4df435c0dd9a0c0e15041e.issues: Abstract unavailable (SSRN preprint); complex decomposition pipelines risk information leakage if decomposition uses future data.

de51cf65c77612d9b2d7ac11f774a6113c6d5e15.goal: Forecasts river streamflow for water resource management using least-squares support vector machines as an alternative to conventional models.
de51cf65c77612d9b2d7ac11f774a6113c6d5e15.architecture: Least-squares support vector machine (LSSVM) regression with lagged streamflow inputs, compared with conventional benchmarks such as ANN and ARIMA.
de51cf65c77612d9b2d7ac11f774a6113c6d5e15.data: Historical river streamflow records; specific stations and periods not reported here.
de51cf65c77612d9b2d7ac11f774a6113c6d5e15.result: LSSVM is reported to give more accurate streamflow forecasts than the comparison models.
de51cf65c77612d9b2d7ac11f774a6113c6d5e15.open_work: Including exogenous inputs such as rainfall and testing other basins and lead times.
de51cf65c77612d9b2d7ac11f774a6113c6d5e15.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-catchment style study with lagged inputs only and no uncertainty quantification.

97d909468d796f3640b7f19d90a454a78e00191d.goal: Reconstructs regional and global mean sea level anomalies over the twentieth century from sparse tide gauge records.
97d909468d796f3640b7f19d90a454a78e00191d.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural networks (MLP) mapping tide gauge records to regional mean sea level anomalies.
97d909468d796f3640b7f19d90a454a78e00191d.data: Tide gauge records (PSMSL) as inputs and satellite altimetry (TOPEX/Poseidon, Jason) sea level anomalies as training targets for the overlap period.
97d909468d796f3640b7f19d90a454a78e00191d.result: Neural networks reconstruct regional sea level anomalies back to about 1900 and yield a twentieth-century global mean rise of roughly 1.5–1.6 mm/yr.
97d909468d796f3640b7f19d90a454a78e00191d.open_work: Better treatment of vertical land motion and extending to more regions and gauges.
97d909468d796f3640b7f19d90a454a78e00191d.issues: Short altimetry training period relative to reconstruction span; sparse, unevenly distributed gauges and stationarity assumption for the learned mapping.

0a8666e5f1ace5ac8d876524d7e71cb41b9207aa.goal: Assesses solar energy potential in Himachal Pradesh, India, by predicting solar radiation where measurements are scarce.
0a8666e5f1ace5ac8d876524d7e71cb41b9207aa.architecture: J48 decision tree (WEKA) used to select the most relevant input parameters for an artificial neural network that predicts solar radiation.
0a8666e5f1ace5ac8d876524d7e71cb41b9207aa.data: Meteorological and geographical data for locations in Himachal Pradesh; details not reported.
0a8666e5f1ace5ac8d876524d7e71cb41b9207aa.result: The ANN with J48-selected inputs predicts solar radiation with good accuracy, supporting solar potential mapping of the state.
0a8666e5f1ace5ac8d876524d7e71cb41b9207aa.open_work: Validation with more stations and satellite-derived radiation products.
0a8666e5f1ace5ac8d876524d7e71cb41b9207aa.issues: Abstract unavailable; limited station network in mountainous terrain and no uncertainty estimates.

c3df7939b32001d222c351388eaee0fdcf023ca0.goal: Improves global solar radiation modeling by decomposing input series before learning, for solar energy applications.
c3df7939b32001d222c351388eaee0fdcf023ca0.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet multiresolution analysis and artificial neural networks (MLP-type feed-forward networks, with other ANN variants compared).
c3df7939b32001d222c351388eaee0fdcf023ca0.data: Meteorological and solar radiation measurements, reportedly from Abu Dhabi, UAE; exact period not reported here.
c3df7939b32001d222c351388eaee0fdcf023ca0.result: The wavelet-ANN hybrid outperforms ANNs without wavelet preprocessing.
c3df7939b32001d222c351388eaee0fdcf023ca0.open_work: Testing other climates and longer horizons and comparing with deep learning models.
c3df7939b32001d222c351388eaee0fdcf023ca0.issues: Single-site study; wavelet decomposition must avoid using future data in forecasting mode.

88c5dc6ba2f02203cc523712906cbaf296d2e2d9.goal: Reviews forecasting of solar radiation and photovoltaic power across spatial and temporal scales in urban environments.
88c5dc6ba2f02203cc523712906cbaf296d2e2d9.architecture: Review of machine learning algorithms (ANN, SVM, tree ensembles, deep learning) for multi-scale solar radiation and PV forecasting in cities.
88c5dc6ba2f02203cc523712906cbaf296d2e2d9.result: Not reported; summarizes method performance and challenges such as urban shading and data availability.
88c5dc6ba2f02203cc523712906cbaf296d2e2d9.open_work: Integrating building-scale geometry, sky imagery and satellite data for urban forecasts.
88c5dc6ba2f02203cc523712906cbaf296d2e2d9.issues: Abstract unavailable; review scope and conclusions not verified.

bd8668bae70d41e8db425808a1f184d4214fc4b5.goal: Forecasts solar irradiance jointly at groups of distributed PV sites to support ramp-rate control and grid resilience.
bd8668bae70d41e8db425808a1f184d4214fc4b5.architecture: Group solar irradiance neural network combining a convolutional graph neural network over distributed PV sites with an LSTM recurrent neural network for temporal correlations.
bd8668bae70d41e8db425808a1f184d4214fc4b5.data: Solar irradiance data from the U.S. National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL).
bd8668bae70d41e8db425808a1f184d4214fc4b5.result: Achieves the highest accuracy among compared prediction methods and suits a master-slave deployment that lowers system cost.
bd8668bae70d41e8db425808a1f184d4214fc4b5.open_work: Extending to probabilistic forecasts and larger, heterogeneous PV networks.
bd8668bae70d41e8db425808a1f184d4214fc4b5.issues: No quantitative scores in the abstract; graph construction and evaluation details unclear; deterministic forecasts only.

5ab87d276243d337687720934db8b05c8c6c9a98.goal: Retrieves the spectral diffuse attenuation coefficient Kd(λ) from ocean color in both open ocean and optically complex coastal waters.
5ab87d276243d337687720934db8b05c8c6c9a98.architecture: Neural network inversion (multilayer perceptron) from remote sensing reflectances to Kd at multiple wavelengths.
5ab87d276243d337687720934db8b05c8c6c9a98.data: In situ bio-optical datasets (e.g. NOMAD) and radiative-transfer simulated data at ocean color sensor bands such as SeaWiFS/MODIS.
5ab87d276243d337687720934db8b05c8c6c9a98.result: The neural network retrieves Kd(λ) accurately in both open and coastal waters, outperforming empirical band-ratio algorithms in turbid waters.
5ab87d276243d337687720934db8b05c8c6c9a98.open_work: Application to full satellite archives and extension to other sensors and turbid regimes.
5ab87d276243d337687720934db8b05c8c6c9a98.issues: Abstract unavailable; accuracy depends on atmospheric correction and on representativeness of training data in coastal waters.

cc91131788396817cff594e334e4ab286f299dc2.goal: Forecasts groundwater level fluctuations in semiarid regions where groundwater is critical for water supply.
cc91131788396817cff594e334e4ab286f299dc2.architecture: Artificial neural network and ARIMA models with inputs selected by the Gamma test and M-test.
cc91131788396817cff594e334e4ab286f299dc2.data: Groundwater level and related hydro-meteorological records from a semiarid region; site details not reported.
cc91131788396817cff594e334e4ab286f299dc2.result: Not reported; compares ANN and ARIMA performance with Gamma/M-test input selection.
cc91131788396817cff594e334e4ab286f299dc2.open_work: Testing deep learning models and multi-well spatial approaches.
cc91131788396817cff594e334e4ab286f299dc2.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-region study and point forecasts without uncertainty.

a6dbfbb912318b771eec0b627997f8b36e167b01.goal: Provides fast peak storm surge prediction for tropical storms as a cheap surrogate for expensive process-based surge models.
a6dbfbb912318b771eec0b627997f8b36e167b01.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) mapping storm parameters (central pressure, radius to maximum winds, forward speed, track) to peak surge, compared with support vector machine.
a6dbfbb912318b771eec0b627997f8b36e167b01.data: 1050 synthetic tropical storms simulated by the USACE North Atlantic Comprehensive Coastal Study coupled wave-surge model; validated on synthetic and real storms for Rhode Island.
a6dbfbb912318b771eec0b627997f8b36e167b01.result: ANN outperforms SVM for extreme storms, with RMSE below 35 cm for observed and synthetic storms; about 200 storms are insufficient for a reliable model.
a6dbfbb912318b771eec0b627997f8b36e167b01.open_work: Extending to other coastlines and including time-varying surge, waves and tides.
a6dbfbb912318b771eec0b627997f8b36e167b01.issues: Trained on synthetic simulations so inherits model biases; peak surge only; few real storms for validation.

47f1339f24d06135fb44fc9f703ade1d3ac8790b.goal: Predicts daily soil moisture at field scale for agricultural and hydrological applications by fusing radar and passive microwave data with static geophysical features.
47f1339f24d06135fb44fc9f703ade1d3ac8790b.architecture: LSTM network with two hidden layers of 32 units and a fully connected output layer, using static and dynamic features.
47f1339f24d06135fb44fc9f703ade1d3ac8790b.data: Sentinel-1 backscatter, SMAP soil moisture, climate data, soil texture and topography; in situ targets from the International Soil Moisture Network (ISMN).
47f1339f24d06135fb44fc9f703ade1d3ac8790b.result: R2 0.87, RMSE 0.046, ubRMSE 0.045 and MAE 0.033; performance is lower in high-NDVI areas and better in arid and semi-arid climates.
47f1339f24d06135fb44fc9f703ade1d3ac8790b.open_work: Improving performance under dense vegetation and producing spatially continuous maps.
47f1339f24d06135fb44fc9f703ade1d3ac8790b.issues: Point-based training on sparse ISMN stations; reduced skill over dense vegetation; generalization to unseen regions not fully tested.

ae30e2918fc7d09e37e8c90fa795a36c2e570dbd.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power output and analyses forecast errors to support unit commitment and economic dispatch.
ae30e2918fc7d09e37e8c90fa795a36c2e570dbd.architecture: Hybrid least-squares support vector machine with wavelet decomposition, compared with an artificial neural network and LS-SVM without decomposition.
ae30e2918fc7d09e37e8c90fa795a36c2e570dbd.data: Historical output power of a PV system in Apulia, southern Italy; horizons from 1 to 24 h.
ae30e2918fc7d09e37e8c90fa795a36c2e570dbd.result: The LS-SVM with wavelet decomposition outperforms the other methods in most cases, and better accuracy reduces imbalance penalties.
ae30e2918fc7d09e37e8c90fa795a36c2e570dbd.open_work: Adding weather forecast inputs and extending error analysis to more plants.
ae30e2918fc7d09e37e8c90fa795a36c2e570dbd.issues: Single PV plant; uses only historical power; wavelet decomposition may leak future information if applied to the full series.

f830671671336c0934e415a1d544b6dd5e589cf3.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting by combining several forecasting models and correcting their errors with an error forecast.

b230f6017d18fcf6aedce5d54244ec261a0cd68a.goal: Forecasts short-term drought to mitigate agricultural impacts in the Awash River Basin, Ethiopia.
b230f6017d18fcf6aedce5d54244ec261a0cd68a.architecture: Artificial neural networks, support vector regression and wavelet-ANN hybrids (wavelet preprocessing of inputs).
b230f6017d18fcf6aedce5d54244ec261a0cd68a.data: Precipitation-based Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI 3 and SPI 6) in the Awash River Basin, Ethiopia.
b230f6017d18fcf6aedce5d54244ec261a0cd68a.result: Wavelet-ANN models are the most accurate for SPI 3 and SPI 6 at 1- and 3-month lead times by RMSE and R2.
b230f6017d18fcf6aedce5d54244ec261a0cd68a.open_work: Longer lead times and inclusion of climate indices or other drought indices.
b230f6017d18fcf6aedce5d54244ec261a0cd68a.issues: Single basin, short lead times, deterministic forecasts; SPI uses precipitation only.

6d479faf176d19d7997871c040471f30f03b765d.architecture: Artificial intelligence regression models with periodicity input component; the specific model types are not specified in the available metadata.

7bf3833b28c8d65d9e8c946052f3629e2261a57d.goal: Reviews deep learning methods for hydrological time series forecasting.
7bf3833b28c8d65d9e8c946052f3629e2261a57d.architecture: Review of CNNs, RNNs, LSTM and enhanced LSTM variants, GRU, generative adversarial networks, ResNets and graph neural networks for hydrological forecasting.

e2016ea325db3baba2c4e7addf11bd355a4c6f8c.goal: Accelerates three-dimensional urban wind field simulation for real-time microclimate analysis, as CFD is too costly at city scale.
e2016ea325db3baba2c4e7addf11bd355a4c6f8c.architecture: Fourier neural operator (FNO) learning the 3D velocity field dynamics.
e2016ea325db3baba2c4e7addf11bd355a4c6f8c.data: Training and testing data from CFD simulations of an urban area (semi-Lagrangian, fractional-step solver), including unseen wind directions.
e2016ea325db3baba2c4e7addf11bd355a4c6f8c.result: FNO accurately reconstructs instantaneous velocity fields, generalizes to unseen wind directions and predicts within milliseconds on a GPU.
e2016ea325db3baba2c4e7addf11bd355a4c6f8c.open_work: Including thermal effects and other microclimate variables, and validating on real cities and measurements.
e2016ea325db3baba2c4e7addf11bd355a4c6f8c.issues: Trained and evaluated only on simulations of one urban domain; no observational validation; long-rollout stability not reported.

eba8a1758536d7d24691870a8af7cb921bcd980c.architecture: Stacking and blending ensembles over base models including linear regression, K-nearest neighbours and support vector machine (further base learners in the truncated abstract).

63b3946446e419051269eacae5737c3e64b0f03a.goal: Retrieves hourly high-resolution surface solar radiation by obtaining cloud parameters at geostationary temporal resolution.
63b3946446e419051269eacae5737c3e64b0f03a.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) relating MTSAT geostationary signals to MODIS cloud products, feeding an efficient physical parameterization model for SSR.
63b3946446e419051269eacae5737c3e64b0f03a.data: MODIS cloud, atmosphere and land products; MTSAT radiances; evaluated against BSRN (44 stations), Haihe River basin stations and 90 CMA stations.
63b3946446e419051269eacae5737c3e64b0f03a.result: Hourly SSR MBE 12.0 W m-2 and RMSE 98.5 W m-2; daily RMSE 34.2 and monthly 22.1 W m-2, comparable to or better than GLASS and ISCCP-FD at 5 km.
63b3946446e419051269eacae5737c3e64b0f03a.open_work: Extending to other geostationary sensors and longer records.
63b3946446e419051269eacae5737c3e64b0f03a.issues: Hourly errors near 29%; ANN cloud parameters inherit MODIS product errors; evaluation mainly over China.

ff1087f6e3e1a67d8bf9a1ed0f0f06ff874ab39f.goal: Provides real-time forecasts of after-runner storm surges, which occur after typhoon passage, on the Tottori coast, Japan.

6c3d2d3f76ff62b01888de7ef4272afb924ae9e0.goal: Develops long-term solar PV power forecasting for grid integration planning.
6c3d2d3f76ff62b01888de7ef4272afb924ae9e0.architecture: LSTM network trained with the Nadam optimizer, compared with ARIMA, SARIMA and LSTMs with other optimizers.
6c3d2d3f76ff62b01888de7ef4272afb924ae9e0.data: Power output of a 250.25 kW PV system at MANIT Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India.
6c3d2d3f76ff62b01888de7ef4272afb924ae9e0.result: Improves accuracy by 30.56% over ARIMA, 47.48% over SARIMA and 1.35–58.29% over LSTMs trained with other optimizers.

76c61018864484a942dffd0f293bf9ad1486b13f.goal: Extracts flood extent from SAR imagery using deep learning for the 2019 central US flooding.

610c1785a1b32aa80a73251a199a6400fde1bc71.issues: Abstract unavailable; quantitative scores not verified; depends on radar-based CI labels.

70a07b5866822b0a5f0babc41506cfa554424196.goal: Quantifies effects of emission sources and meteorological conditions on PM2.5 pollution and on secondary nitrate formation.
70a07b5866822b0a5f0babc41506cfa554424196.architecture: Random forest with SHAP and partial dependence plots, combined with positive matrix factorization source apportionment.
70a07b5866822b0a5f0babc41506cfa554424196.data: Online PM2.5 composition and meteorological datasets; location not reported in the abstract.
70a07b5866822b0a5f0babc41506cfa554424196.result: Anthropogenic emissions contribute about 67% (40.5 μg/m3) and meteorology 33% (19.7 μg/m3); secondary nitrate is the largest source (about 45%).
70a07b5866822b0a5f0babc41506cfa554424196.open_work: Strategies to reduce secondary nitrate by controlling primary emissions under suitable meteorology.
70a07b5866822b0a5f0babc41506cfa554424196.issues: Single site and period; attribution via SHAP is correlational, not causal.

40df287e08b02813e2e9700f6cdfc093aeb717df.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting using multivariate multi-step deep learning.
40df287e08b02813e2e9700f6cdfc093aeb717df.architecture: Multivariate multi-step LSTM with a temporal feature attention mechanism.
40df287e08b02813e2e9700f6cdfc093aeb717df.data: Wind farm data; details not reported.
40df287e08b02813e2e9700f6cdfc093aeb717df.result: Not reported; the attention LSTM is presumably reported to outperform baselines.
40df287e08b02813e2e9700f6cdfc093aeb717df.open_work: Probabilistic forecasts and transfer across farms.

f7ef1590f1463f7d2308b6cefc0eebb05fc3342c.goal: Builds a digital twin of wind farms that reconstructs and predicts wind fields for monitoring and control.
f7ef1590f1463f7d2308b6cefc0eebb05fc3342c.architecture: Physics-informed deep learning (physics-informed neural network embedding the governing flow equations).
f7ef1590f1463f7d2308b6cefc0eebb05fc3342c.data: Wind farm flow data such as simulations and/or lidar measurements; details not reported.
f7ef1590f1463f7d2308b6cefc0eebb05fc3342c.result: Not reported; the physics-informed model is presented as enabling accurate wind farm flow reconstruction.
f7ef1590f1463f7d2308b6cefc0eebb05fc3342c.issues: Abstract unavailable; details cannot be verified.

46e984814c76c1a8cca14868fc07ebf3f7e541b8.goal: Assesses which meteorological variables drive evaporation and estimates evaporation using neural networks.
46e984814c76c1a8cca14868fc07ebf3f7e541b8.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) neural network to analyze variable effects and estimate evaporation.
46e984814c76c1a8cca14868fc07ebf3f7e541b8.data: Meteorological station data and evaporation measurements; site details not reported.
46e984814c76c1a8cca14868fc07ebf3f7e541b8.result: Not reported; the SOM is presumably shown to estimate evaporation well and identify key variables.
46e984814c76c1a8cca14868fc07ebf3f7e541b8.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates.

6309741844f8035449fce0d53d001aa8ebcc232b.goal: Forecasts solar power output using artificial neural networks.
6309741844f8035449fce0d53d001aa8ebcc232b.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (MLP), compared with multiple linear regression.
6309741844f8035449fce0d53d001aa8ebcc232b.data: Solar power and NWP weather data, reportedly from the Global Energy Forecasting Competition 2014.
6309741844f8035449fce0d53d001aa8ebcc232b.result: Not reported; the ANN is reported to outperform the regression benchmark.
6309741844f8035449fce0d53d001aa8ebcc232b.issues: Abstract unavailable; small number of plants.

a73990f72df32ba7c6a9f372af2a349ccf0a1ff5.goal: Estimates streamflow in the upper Yangtze River using SVM coupled with time series decomposition.
a73990f72df32ba7c6a9f372af2a349ccf0a1ff5.architecture: Support vector machine coupled with decomposition methods such as wavelet transform and empirical mode decomposition variants.
a73990f72df32ba7c6a9f372af2a349ccf0a1ff5.data: Streamflow records from the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, China.
a73990f72df32ba7c6a9f372af2a349ccf0a1ff5.result: Not reported; decomposition-coupled SVM presumably improves over standalone SVM.
a73990f72df32ba7c6a9f372af2a349ccf0a1ff5.open_work: Testing other basins and lead times.
a73990f72df32ba7c6a9f372af2a349ccf0a1ff5.issues: Abstract unavailable; decomposition of full series may leak future information.

a57115b4a1cf0f5596374020f0549039ce2eb3cf.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting by jointly modeling spatial correlations among variables and temporal features.
a57115b4a1cf0f5596374020f0549039ce2eb3cf.architecture: Graph convolution network with maximum information coefficient graph plus multiresolution convolutional neural network with self-attention.
a57115b4a1cf0f5596374020f0549039ce2eb3cf.data: A real wind farm dataset; details not reported.
a57115b4a1cf0f5596374020f0549039ce2eb3cf.result: Outperforms three state-of-the-art methods; ablations confirm component contributions.
a57115b4a1cf0f5596374020f0549039ce2eb3cf.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and testing on more farms.
a57115b4a1cf0f5596374020f0549039ce2eb3cf.issues: Single dataset; no quantitative scores in the abstract.

9dda77d33eb21c84f3192cc37838318a93c5798e.goal: Models the rainfall-runoff relationship of a catchment with a kernel learning method to provide a data-driven alternative to conceptual hydrological models.
9dda77d33eb21c84f3192cc37838318a93c5798e.architecture: Least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) regression mapping rainfall and antecedent flow inputs to runoff.
9dda77d33eb21c84f3192cc37838318a93c5798e.data: Observed rainfall and runoff records of a gauged catchment; basin, period and time step are not reported here.
9dda77d33eb21c84f3192cc37838318a93c5798e.result: Not reported here; the title implies LS-SVM is presented as an effective rainfall-runoff model.
9dda77d33eb21c84f3192cc37838318a93c5798e.open_work: Comparison with other machine-learning and conceptual models across more catchments and climates.
9dda77d33eb21c84f3192cc37838318a93c5798e.issues: Single-catchment data-driven model; no physical constraints, likely limited extrapolation to extremes and changed climate conditions.

a99120373c829cb1d12e053a656dfac7324d3c73.goal: Corrects systematic errors in numerical weather prediction wind speed forecasts to improve local forecasts for wind energy use.
a99120373c829cb1d12e053a656dfac7324d3c73.architecture: Polynomial neural network (GMDH-type polynomial network) post-processing model correcting forecast wind speed from forecast and observed predictors.
