a99120373c829cb1d12e053a656dfac7324d3c73.data: NWP wind speed forecasts and local observed wind data; the specific model, sites and periods are not reported here.
a99120373c829cb1d12e053a656dfac7324d3c73.result: Not reported here; the title implies the polynomial network corrections improve the raw forecasts.
a99120373c829cb1d12e053a656dfac7324d3c73.open_work: Testing at more sites and lead times and comparison with standard model output statistics methods.
a99120373c829cb1d12e053a656dfac7324d3c73.issues: Site-specific statistical correction; transferability, extreme winds and probabilistic output are not addressed as far as known.

ac0a459652667a0debefb451b64863fa9b1c3907.goal: Predicts tropospheric ozone concentrations in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, to support air-quality management in a large tropical city.
ac0a459652667a0debefb451b64863fa9b1c3907.architecture: Artificial neural network and support vector machine regression models compared for ozone prediction.
ac0a459652667a0debefb451b64863fa9b1c3907.data: Air-quality monitoring and meteorological data from a Rio de Janeiro station; exact variables and periods are not reported here.
ac0a459652667a0debefb451b64863fa9b1c3907.result: Not reported here; both ANN and SVM are evaluated, with relative skill not stated in the title.
ac0a459652667a0debefb451b64863fa9b1c3907.open_work: Extension to multiple stations and to forecasting with meteorological forecasts as inputs.
ac0a459652667a0debefb451b64863fa9b1c3907.issues: Single-city, station-based statistical model; may not generalize to other sites or emission regimes.

b18800ad59eda88b015cdbd6bae3f133350f61b2.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction for wind energy by exploiting spatial dependencies among multiple sites.
b18800ad59eda88b015cdbd6bae3f133350f61b2.architecture: Graph neural network modeling spatio-temporal correlations between wind measurement sites.
b18800ad59eda88b015cdbd6bae3f133350f61b2.data: Multi-site wind speed observations; the dataset and region are not reported here.
b18800ad59eda88b015cdbd6bae3f133350f61b2.result: Not reported here; the title states the graph neural network gives precise wind speed predictions.
b18800ad59eda88b015cdbd6bae3f133350f61b2.open_work: Longer horizons, probabilistic outputs and inclusion of NWP inputs.
b18800ad59eda88b015cdbd6bae3f133350f61b2.issues: Evaluation details unknown; data-driven model may degrade under unusual weather and requires dense site networks.

c917a53b80d40c044cb8b86da6814afc32530609.goal: Forecasts short-term solar irradiance (GHI) and plane-of-array irradiance to support photovoltaic integration into the grid.
c917a53b80d40c044cb8b86da6814afc32530609.architecture: Hybrid multi-step convolutional neural network (CNN) feature extractor feeding a stacked LSTM with dropout.
c917a53b80d40c044cb8b86da6814afc32530609.data: Measured solar data from the Sweihan Photovoltaic Independent Power Project, Abu Dhabi, UAE.
c917a53b80d40c044cb8b86da6814afc32530609.result: Best RMSE 0.36 and R2 0.98 for GHI and RMSE 61.24 with R2 0.96 for POA, outperforming other machine-learning and deep-learning baselines.
c917a53b80d40c044cb8b86da6814afc32530609.open_work: Testing at other plants and climates and adding weather forecast or satellite inputs for longer horizons.
c917a53b80d40c044cb8b86da6814afc32530609.issues: Single-site desert dataset; deterministic forecasts only, and baseline comparison partly relies on published values.

2452bd0892d48b4f790230b9e077e11aaab34f5c.goal: Identifies the meteorological conditions controlling open versus closed mesoscale cellular convection in marine cold-air outbreaks, relevant to low-cloud feedbacks.
2452bd0892d48b4f790230b9e077e11aaab34f5c.architecture: Neural-network cloud-scene classification of satellite imagery into open and closed cellular convection, combined with compositing against reanalysis meteorology.
2452bd0892d48b4f790230b9e077e11aaab34f5c.data: MODIS satellite observations of marine boundary-layer clouds with reanalysis meteorological fields over midlatitude oceans.
2452bd0892d48b4f790230b9e077e11aaab34f5c.result: Cold-air outbreak strength, measured by a marine cold-air outbreak index, strongly controls the occurrence of open versus closed cells.
2452bd0892d48b4f790230b9e077e11aaab34f5c.open_work: Process-level understanding of the transition and testing of model representation of cellular convection in climate models.
2452bd0892d48b4f790230b9e077e11aaab34f5c.issues: Classification is observational and correlational; reanalysis biases and classifier errors affect attribution of controls.

83edfaf85d67c5111c25c68c23d72b899b80ebde.goal: Forecasts seasonal rainfall months ahead using large-scale climate drivers to support water resources planning.
83edfaf85d67c5111c25c68c23d72b899b80ebde.architecture: Adaptive network-based fuzzy inference system (ANFIS), a neuro-fuzzy model, using lagged climate indices as inputs, compared with regression.
83edfaf85d67c5111c25c68c23d72b899b80ebde.data: Station rainfall in Victoria, Australia, with large-scale climate indices such as ENSO and Indian Ocean Dipole indicators.
83edfaf85d67c5111c25c68c23d72b899b80ebde.result: ANFIS using combined climate signals gives better seasonal rainfall forecasts than linear regression approaches.
83edfaf85d67c5111c25c68c23d72b899b80ebde.open_work: Inclusion of additional climate drivers and evaluation over more regions and seasons.
83edfaf85d67c5111c25c68c23d72b899b80ebde.issues: Short records limit training and validation; skill depends on the stability of teleconnections.

becf0e4476a25f29a56a37d122d2ccad2553dff4.goal: Forecasts significant wave height at Dayyer in the Persian Gulf for coastal and offshore engineering operations.
becf0e4476a25f29a56a37d122d2ccad2553dff4.architecture: Artificial neural network (feed-forward) models forecasting wave height from wind and previous wave inputs.
becf0e4476a25f29a56a37d122d2ccad2553dff4.data: Buoy wave and wind measurements at Dayyer, Persian Gulf; period not reported here.
becf0e4476a25f29a56a37d122d2ccad2553dff4.result: Neural network forecasts give reasonable short-lead wave height predictions, with skill declining as lead time increases.
becf0e4476a25f29a56a37d122d2ccad2553dff4.open_work: Use of forecast winds and extension to other wave parameters and locations.
becf0e4476a25f29a56a37d122d2ccad2553dff4.issues: Single-station, short record; limited representation of extreme sea states.

ec2a40150b5b499919417c42888a70dc1b28965b.goal: Forecasts hourly river runoff for flood risk management and compares several computational intelligence approaches.
ec2a40150b5b499919417c42888a70dc1b28965b.architecture: Artificial neural networks and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference systems, including wavelet-based hybrid variants, for multi-hour-ahead runoff forecasting.
ec2a40150b5b499919417c42888a70dc1b28965b.data: Hourly rainfall and runoff observations from a catchment; specific basin and period are not reported here.
ec2a40150b5b499919417c42888a70dc1b28965b.result: Wavelet-based hybrid models give the most accurate hourly runoff forecasts among the compared models.
ec2a40150b5b499919417c42888a70dc1b28965b.open_work: Longer lead times and use of rainfall forecasts as inputs.
ec2a40150b5b499919417c42888a70dc1b28965b.issues: Single-catchment study; possible wavelet boundary effects and limited peak-flow events.

2d417dce31e008307d582e57183eafccb1a36507.goal: Predicts monsoon river floods to support flood warning in monsoon-dominated river basins.
2d417dce31e008307d582e57183eafccb1a36507.architecture: Hybrid wavelet transform, genetic algorithm and artificial neural network model, where wavelet-decomposed inputs feed a GA-optimized neural network.
2d417dce31e008307d582e57183eafccb1a36507.data: River discharge and rainfall data from monsoon rivers; basins and periods are not reported here.
2d417dce31e008307d582e57183eafccb1a36507.result: Not reported here; the title implies the wavelet-GA-ANN hybrid improves flood prediction over simpler models.
2d417dce31e008307d582e57183eafccb1a36507.open_work: Testing longer lead times and more river basins.
2d417dce31e008307d582e57183eafccb1a36507.issues: Data-driven hybrid with limited extreme events; wavelet decomposition may leak future information if not done causally.

2af4050694d6fb8415701d586eda8c72056e2329.goal: Estimates wind speed at a site for wind resource assessment using data from reference stations.
2af4050694d6fb8415701d586eda8c72056e2329.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network regression of target-site wind speed.
2af4050694d6fb8415701d586eda8c72056e2329.data: Wind and meteorological measurements from nearby stations; locations and periods are not reported here.
2af4050694d6fb8415701d586eda8c72056e2329.result: Not reported here; the title implies the MLP gives useful wind speed estimates.
2af4050694d6fb8415701d586eda8c72056e2329.open_work: Comparison with measure-correlate-predict methods and extension to more sites.
2af4050694d6fb8415701d586eda8c72056e2329.issues: Site-specific model; transferability to complex terrain and long-term climate variability not addressed as far as known.

a582132082b9cae422ac1cbfdfecdb42f8fb8eb3.goal: Explains and applies learning machines to predict ground-level ozone concentrations for air-quality warning.
a582132082b9cae422ac1cbfdfecdb42f8fb8eb3.architecture: Learning machines such as support vector machines and neural networks; the specific comparison set is not stated in the title.
a582132082b9cae422ac1cbfdfecdb42f8fb8eb3.data: Ground-level ozone and meteorological monitoring data; site and period are not reported here.
a582132082b9cae422ac1cbfdfecdb42f8fb8eb3.result: Not reported here; the paper argues for the rationale and usefulness of learning machines for ozone prediction.
a582132082b9cae422ac1cbfdfecdb42f8fb8eb3.open_work: Better feature selection and multi-station evaluation.
a582132082b9cae422ac1cbfdfecdb42f8fb8eb3.issues: Station-based statistical models; limited interpretability and transferability.

5c8f8e919edb6dd0fa0249511dad34585bc640e1.goal: Predicts soil moisture ahead in time for agricultural and hydrological decision making.
5c8f8e919edb6dd0fa0249511dad34585bc640e1.architecture: Multihead long short-term memory (LSTM) network producing soil moisture forecasts.
5c8f8e919edb6dd0fa0249511dad34585bc640e1.data: Soil moisture and meteorological time series; datasets are not reported here.
5c8f8e919edb6dd0fa0249511dad34585bc640e1.open_work: Multi-site evaluation and inclusion of remote sensing inputs.
5c8f8e919edb6dd0fa0249511dad34585bc640e1.issues: Preprint without reviewed evaluation details; generalization unknown.

6bf463d22615a73c454a0d2fbcac36ac185bfa00.goal: Generates seasonal, regional-scale crop yield forecasts with quantified bias and uncertainty across the Canadian Prairies.
6bf463d22615a73c454a0d2fbcac36ac185bfa00.architecture: Integrated probabilistic model combining robust variable selection, Markov-Chain Monte Carlo simulation and random forest machine learning for sequential in-season forecasts.
6bf463d22615a73c454a0d2fbcac36ac185bfa00.data: Agroclimate variables and remotely sensed indices at Census Agricultural Region scale; spring wheat yields 1987-2011 hindcasts and 2012 validation against survey data.
6bf463d22615a73c454a0d2fbcac36ac185bfa00.result: Wheat yield underestimated by 1-4% mid-season and overestimated by about 1% at season end.
6bf463d22615a73c454a0d2fbcac36ac185bfa00.open_work: Application to other crops and regions and operational sequential updating as new data arrive.
6bf463d22615a73c454a0d2fbcac36ac185bfa00.issues: Validated on one independent season; relies on survey data quality and region-specific predictor sets.

f8303f5da615f05c6b8336f26b029716504a58ce.goal: Improves wind speed prediction for wind power by combining signal decomposition with optimized neural networks.
f8303f5da615f05c6b8336f26b029716504a58ce.architecture: Two hybrid frameworks combining wavelet decomposition with multilayer perceptron (MLP) networks optimized by genetic algorithm and particle swarm optimization.
f8303f5da615f05c6b8336f26b029716504a58ce.data: Measured wind speed time series; sites and periods are not reported here.
f8303f5da615f05c6b8336f26b029716504a58ce.result: Not reported here; the experiments compare both hybrid frameworks and their optimizers.
f8303f5da615f05c6b8336f26b029716504a58ce.open_work: Multi-step and probabilistic forecasting and broader site testing.
f8303f5da615f05c6b8336f26b029716504a58ce.issues: Univariate, site-specific series; decomposition of full series can cause information leakage.

8389fef173cc6a44faa37ddabc6b3fb0bf1bdad1.goal: Forecasts drought in the Algerois basin, north Algeria, to support drought preparedness.
8389fef173cc6a44faa37ddabc6b3fb0bf1bdad1.architecture: Artificial neural networks and wavelet neural networks compared with stochastic ARIMA/SARIMA models for drought index forecasting.
8389fef173cc6a44faa37ddabc6b3fb0bf1bdad1.data: Precipitation-based drought index (SPI) series from stations in the Algerois basin.
8389fef173cc6a44faa37ddabc6b3fb0bf1bdad1.result: Wavelet neural networks give the best drought forecasts, outperforming plain neural networks and stochastic models.
8389fef173cc6a44faa37ddabc6b3fb0bf1bdad1.open_work: Longer lead times and inclusion of climate indices.
8389fef173cc6a44faa37ddabc6b3fb0bf1bdad1.issues: Station SPI only; limited sample of severe droughts.

a803e5409eb541ba0da3dfccdab5dc62877a2436.goal: Forecasts multi-step-ahead reservoir inflows using radar rainfall reduced to a compact spatio-temporal representation.
a803e5409eb541ba0da3dfccdab5dc62877a2436.architecture: Data-driven inflow forecasting models fed by a nonlinear spatio-temporal lumping of radar rainfall; the specific network type is not specified here.
a803e5409eb541ba0da3dfccdab5dc62877a2436.data: Radar rainfall and observed reservoir inflow during storm events; catchment details are not reported here.
a803e5409eb541ba0da3dfccdab5dc62877a2436.result: Not reported here; the title implies the nonlinear lumping improves multi-step inflow forecasts.
a803e5409eb541ba0da3dfccdab5dc62877a2436.open_work: Use of radar nowcasts for longer lead times.
a803e5409eb541ba0da3dfccdab5dc62877a2436.issues: Event-based training with few extreme storms; radar rainfall errors propagate to forecasts.

05cbe3f039409579403e8f0310553f95994ef794.goal: Reviews lake water temperature modeling in the context of climate change impacts on lake thermal dynamics and ecosystems.
05cbe3f039409579403e8f0310553f95994ef794.architecture: Review of process-based and data-driven lake temperature models, including hybrid process-based and deep learning approaches, ensembles and digital twins.
05cbe3f039409579403e8f0310553f95994ef794.data: Reviews in situ monitoring and satellite Earth observation sources of lake water temperature data.
05cbe3f039409579403e8f0310553f95994ef794.result: Classifies available models and performance metrics and identifies emerging approaches such as forecasting, digital twins and climate-lake coupling.
05cbe3f039409579403e8f0310553f95994ef794.open_work: Combining process-based modeling with deep learning, ensemble assessment of structural differences and coupling with climate models.
05cbe3f039409579403e8f0310553f95994ef794.issues: Broad review; deep learning is one of many topics and quantitative comparisons are not provided.

fc81f831f494c2713797f3659e04269bd9a6974d.goal: Produces probabilistic solar power forecasts for the GEFCom2014 competition.
fc81f831f494c2713797f3659e04269bd9a6974d.architecture: Semi-empirical approach combining gradient boosting and k-nearest neighbors regression to produce quantile forecasts.
fc81f831f494c2713797f3659e04269bd9a6974d.data: GEFCom2014 solar track data: solar farm power and ECMWF NWP forecast variables.
fc81f831f494c2713797f3659e04269bd9a6974d.result: Not reported here; the approach was among the competitive entries in the GEFCom2014 solar track.
fc81f831f494c2713797f3659e04269bd9a6974d.open_work: Better handling of clear-sky normalization and quantile calibration.
fc81f831f494c2713797f3659e04269bd9a6974d.issues: Competition-specific setup with three farms; generalization to other plants not shown.

f362c5bae7b5690bca96cf78b972f6f80bada810.goal: Forecasts flood inundation depths quickly for flood warning as an alternative to costly hydrodynamic simulation.
f362c5bae7b5690bca96cf78b972f6f80bada810.architecture: Clustering-based hybrid inundation model combining cluster analysis of inundated grids with neural network forecasting of representative depths.
f362c5bae7b5690bca96cf78b972f6f80bada810.data: Simulated inundation maps from a hydrodynamic model and rainfall data in a flood-prone area; details not reported here.
f362c5bae7b5690bca96cf78b972f6f80bada810.result: Not reported here; the hybrid model is intended to forecast inundation depths efficiently.
f362c5bae7b5690bca96cf78b972f6f80bada810.open_work: Testing with real-time rainfall forecasts and observed inundation.
f362c5bae7b5690bca96cf78b972f6f80bada810.issues: Trained on simulated inundation, so it inherits hydrodynamic model errors.

89c4ca223c93f3d1eca01081d1af8281bafcae8d.goal: Predicts wind speed for wind energy and compares statistical and machine learning methods.
89c4ca223c93f3d1eca01081d1af8281bafcae8d.architecture: New ridge regression, artificial neural network and support vector machine models for wind speed prediction.
89c4ca223c93f3d1eca01081d1af8281bafcae8d.data: Wind speed observations; datasets are not reported here.
89c4ca223c93f3d1eca01081d1af8281bafcae8d.open_work: Hybrid and multi-step forecasting and evaluation at more sites.
89c4ca223c93f3d1eca01081d1af8281bafcae8d.issues: Evaluation scope unknown; deterministic predictions only.

21ba8bab08f3b63c5421ba49deaeebbde317d7a6.goal: Predicts daily maximum air temperature for applications including energy demand.
21ba8bab08f3b63c5421ba49deaeebbde317d7a6.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) using synoptic and local predictors.
21ba8bab08f3b63c5421ba49deaeebbde317d7a6.data: Meteorological station observations and predictor variables; sites and periods are not reported here.
21ba8bab08f3b63c5421ba49deaeebbde317d7a6.result: Not reported here; the title implies SVR gives accurate daily maximum temperature predictions.
21ba8bab08f3b63c5421ba49deaeebbde317d7a6.open_work: Extension to longer lead times and comparison with NWP post-processing.

825521878dd32ad852b145ca22c435f280f1911e.goal: Extracts flooded areas by detecting changes between images from different sensing modalities.
825521878dd32ad852b145ca22c435f280f1911e.architecture: Convolutional neural network for cross-modal change detection between pre- and post-flood images.
825521878dd32ad852b145ca22c435f280f1911e.data: Multi-modal remote sensing imagery of flood events; sensors and sites are not reported here.
825521878dd32ad852b145ca22c435f280f1911e.open_work: Testing on more flood events and sensor combinations.
825521878dd32ad852b145ca22c435f280f1911e.issues: Requires labeled flood maps; performance across regions unknown.

01bae100a7e3e2f9cc5d5e8fc9653d4b80c6a442.goal: Forecasts short-term reference evapotranspiration for irrigation scheduling using publicly available weather forecasts.
01bae100a7e3e2f9cc5d5e8fc9653d4b80c6a442.architecture: Artificial neural network forecasting evapotranspiration from weather forecast message variables.
01bae100a7e3e2f9cc5d5e8fc9653d4b80c6a442.data: Public weather forecast messages and meteorological station data; region not reported here.
01bae100a7e3e2f9cc5d5e8fc9653d4b80c6a442.result: Not reported here; the title implies ANN gives usable short-term ET forecasts from limited forecast inputs.
01bae100a7e3e2f9cc5d5e8fc9653d4b80c6a442.open_work: Use at more stations and with additional forecast variables.
01bae100a7e3e2f9cc5d5e8fc9653d4b80c6a442.issues: Restricted inputs and forecast errors limit accuracy.

4bdfbfe5473e01924b124a5c866bd2ad4f221dff.goal: Estimates land surface temperature at high spatio-temporal resolution under cloudy conditions, where thermal infrared retrievals fail.
4bdfbfe5473e01924b124a5c866bd2ad4f221dff.architecture: Artificial neural network relating a passive microwave vegetation index and other inputs to land surface temperature.
4bdfbfe5473e01924b124a5c866bd2ad4f221dff.data: Passive microwave observations (AMSR-E-derived microwave vegetation index) and MODIS land surface temperature.
4bdfbfe5473e01924b124a5c866bd2ad4f221dff.result: The ANN predicts cloudy-sky LST with reasonable accuracy; detailed scores are not reported here.
4bdfbfe5473e01924b124a5c866bd2ad4f221dff.open_work: Application to newer microwave sensors and other regions.
4bdfbfe5473e01924b124a5c866bd2ad4f221dff.issues: Microwave and thermal resolutions differ; validation under cloud is difficult.

62341c3a8276628b3ebe162fe69ee6598154dd2a.goal: Evaluates methods for filling missing climatological data series.
62341c3a8276628b3ebe162fe69ee6598154dd2a.architecture: Comparison of estimation methods for missing climate data, including artificial neural networks and classical interpolation and regression methods.
62341c3a8276628b3ebe162fe69ee6598154dd2a.data: Climatological station records; region and variables are not reported here.
62341c3a8276628b3ebe162fe69ee6598154dd2a.open_work: Extension to more variables and gap lengths.
62341c3a8276628b3ebe162fe69ee6598154dd2a.issues: Results depend on station density and correlation.

4c4045f96be7a978be9df0a7afd86b8f074c75ac.goal: Maps ocean surface pCO2 in the North Pacific to quantify spatial and temporal carbon variability.
4c4045f96be7a978be9df0a7afd86b8f074c75ac.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM) neural network relating pCO2 to proxy variables.
4c4045f96be7a978be9df0a7afd86b8f074c75ac.data: NIES volunteer observing ship pCO2 data with SST, mixed layer depth, chlorophyll a and SSS; 0.25° grid, 2002-2008.
4c4045f96be7a978be9df0a7afd86b8f074c75ac.result: RMSE of 17.6 μatm on training data and 20.2 μatm on independent data; adding SSS and the secular CO2 trend improves estimates.
4c4045f96be7a978be9df0a7afd86b8f074c75ac.open_work: Extension to longer periods and improved representation of biological processes.
4c4045f96be7a978be9df0a7afd86b8f074c75ac.issues: Sparse observations in some regions and seasons; proxy-based mapping cannot capture all processes.

f1f9c3878a63025051d8a84939af486048e3d680.goal: Estimates soil moisture under maize using UAV multimodal data.
f1f9c3878a63025051d8a84939af486048e3d680.architecture: Machine learning regression algorithms applied to UAV multimodal features; specific types are not stated in the title.
f1f9c3878a63025051d8a84939af486048e3d680.data: UAV multimodal imagery and field soil moisture samples in maize fields.
f1f9c3878a63025051d8a84939af486048e3d680.open_work: Testing across growth stages, soils and sites.

5c71c41365d82e7ca9456edc9e833553ec92a779.goal: Estimates corn yield in Iowa from satellite and climate data using machine learning.
5c71c41365d82e7ca9456edc9e833553ec92a779.architecture: Comparison of machine learning approaches; specific model types are not stated in the title.
5c71c41365d82e7ca9456edc9e833553ec92a779.data: Satellite images and climate data for Iowa with county-level corn yield statistics.
5c71c41365d82e7ca9456edc9e833553ec92a779.open_work: Extension to other states and earlier in-season prediction.

c13ec2c48a9aea4b1d94689ac4faa71a5baa1244.goal: Forecasts wind speed with a self-adaptive hybrid approach to improve wind energy planning.
c13ec2c48a9aea4b1d94689ac4faa71a5baa1244.architecture: Self-adaptive hybrid forecasting framework combining decomposition and machine learning components; components are not specified here.
c13ec2c48a9aea4b1d94689ac4faa71a5baa1244.data: Wind speed time series; sites are not reported here.

f5a85c0b2fb32aae634e4b034ae78d8d82c59613.goal: Automatically detects methane emission plumes in multispectral satellite imagery to monitor emissions globally at high resolution.
f5a85c0b2fb32aae634e4b034ae78d8d82c59613.architecture: Vision transformer deep learning model detecting methane plumes from multispectral bands.
f5a85c0b2fb32aae634e4b034ae78d8d82c59613.data: Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery; detections compared with airborne methane measurement campaigns.
f5a85c0b2fb32aae634e4b034ae78d8d82c59613.result: Detects point sources down to plumes of 0.01 km2 (200-300 kg CH4/h), an order of magnitude improvement over the state of the art.
f5a85c0b2fb32aae634e4b034ae78d8d82c59613.open_work: Global automated monitoring every few days and quantification of emission rates.
f5a85c0b2fb32aae634e4b034ae78d8d82c59613.issues: Multispectral data limit sensitivity; false positives over heterogeneous surfaces remain a concern.

0884e109bffee7434b9bb80e1ea299aeaa1bdafb.goal: Predicts next-day solar insolation for effective operation of photovoltaic systems.
0884e109bffee7434b9bb80e1ea299aeaa1bdafb.architecture: Least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) using day number, temperatures, sunshine duration and previous-day insolation.
0884e109bffee7434b9bb80e1ea299aeaa1bdafb.data: Turkish State Meteorological Service daily data: 2000-2002 training, 2003 testing.
0884e109bffee7434b9bb80e1ea299aeaa1bdafb.result: LS-SVM estimates daily insolation with a reported 99.294% accuracy.
0884e109bffee7434b9bb80e1ea299aeaa1bdafb.open_work: Testing at more locations and with forecast inputs.
0884e109bffee7434b9bb80e1ea299aeaa1bdafb.issues: Single-site, short record; accuracy metric is not standard.

c79c5606f0052070911bbdaa83b6945b9fcdcc38.goal: Reviews solar forecasting techniques and the role of artificial intelligence in grid integration.
c79c5606f0052070911bbdaa83b6945b9fcdcc38.architecture: Review of neural network, supervised learning, regression, ensemble and physics-based solar forecasting methods across horizons from 1 minute to 24 hours.
c79c5606f0052070911bbdaa83b6945b9fcdcc38.data: Reviews studies using satellite imagery, weather predictions and historical data.
c79c5606f0052070911bbdaa83b6945b9fcdcc38.result: AI methods, especially neural networks, are prominent; standardized datasets and benchmarks are essential.

54f46a0aaecf05027307cc1b70c367621003132d.goal: Analyzes applicability of transformers to wind speed forecasting with multiple atmospheric variables.
54f46a0aaecf05027307cc1b70c367621003132d.architecture: Transformer-based deep learning framework using multiple atmospheric variables.
54f46a0aaecf05027307cc1b70c367621003132d.data: Wind speed and atmospheric variables; datasets are not reported here.

97f9dedefa8b456f4c7de6cf2b6556480f4d8a67.goal: Assesses how spatial sampling of flux towers affects ANN-based upscaling of carbon and water fluxes.
97f9dedefa8b456f4c7de6cf2b6556480f4d8a67.architecture: Artificial neural networks trained on flux tower data to estimate carbon and water fluxes.
97f9dedefa8b456f4c7de6cf2b6556480f4d8a67.data: European eddy covariance flux tower data with meteorological and remote sensing drivers.
97f9dedefa8b456f4c7de6cf2b6556480f4d8a67.result: The number and distribution of sites affect upscaled flux estimates.
97f9dedefa8b456f4c7de6cf2b6556480f4d8a67.open_work: Optimized network design and uncertainty from site representativeness.
97f9dedefa8b456f4c7de6cf2b6556480f4d8a67.issues: Uneven tower distribution; results depend on European network coverage.

741152bf7d387f1f9ce929ec6cb66071c38a8710.goal: Identifies clutter in weather radar data using polarimetric signatures.
741152bf7d387f1f9ce929ec6cb66071c38a8710.architecture: Artificial intelligence classifiers; specific types are not stated in the title.
741152bf7d387f1f9ce929ec6cb66071c38a8710.data: Polarimetric weather radar observations; radar site not reported here.
741152bf7d387f1f9ce929ec6cb66071c38a8710.issues: Limited events; labeled clutter may be imperfect.

d9165af0a91e5eb223500da35754e189b580d5c5.goal: Models daily rainfall-runoff with support vector regression and a geomorphologic ANN.
d9165af0a91e5eb223500da35754e189b580d5c5.architecture: Support vector regression integrated with a geomorphologic artificial neural network.
d9165af0a91e5eb223500da35754e189b580d5c5.data: Daily rainfall and runoff with basin geomorphologic characteristics.

e4353fb040bb92e67efc17f98ed8f0383e0f03da.goal: Predicts storm surge time series rapidly with an ANN surrogate trained on high-fidelity hurricane simulations.
e4353fb040bb92e67efc17f98ed8f0383e0f03da.architecture: Artificial neural network surrogate model predicting time-dependent storm surge from hurricane parameters.
e4353fb040bb92e67efc17f98ed8f0383e0f03da.result: The surrogate reproduces simulated surge time series at much lower cost than high-fidelity models.
e4353fb040bb92e67efc17f98ed8f0383e0f03da.issues: Trained on synthetic storms, so inherits simulation model limitations.

220b7f1b97dcf6f7a0648f31c78f05fed9f63272.goal: Downscales watershed precipitation from large-scale climate predictors.
220b7f1b97dcf6f7a0648f31c78f05fed9f63272.architecture: Gene Expression Programming (GEP), an evolutionary symbolic regression method.
220b7f1b97dcf6f7a0648f31c78f05fed9f63272.data: Large-scale reanalysis predictors and watershed precipitation observations.
220b7f1b97dcf6f7a0648f31c78f05fed9f63272.result: GEP gives comparable or better downscaling than benchmark methods.

d84b5f35f9f53f6efb940d688d6879e2c232ca0e.goal: Predicts diffuse solar irradiance using machine learning and multivariable regression.
d84b5f35f9f53f6efb940d688d6879e2c232ca0e.architecture: Machine learning models compared with multivariable regression; specific types are not stated in the title.
d84b5f35f9f53f6efb940d688d6879e2c232ca0e.data: Measured solar irradiance and meteorological data; site not reported here.
d84b5f35f9f53f6efb940d688d6879e2c232ca0e.open_work: Testing at more sites and climates.

ddcd40782fcec6aa230ddc68222038d0f7d0eaa1.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting, which is hard because wind power series are nonstationary and noisy, to support grid dispatch.
ddcd40782fcec6aa230ddc68222038d0f7d0eaa1.architecture: Hybrid decomposition-forecasting model: variational mode decomposition (VMD) splits the series into modes forecast by long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, with an SSA component tuning the pipeline as named in the title.
ddcd40782fcec6aa230ddc68222038d0f7d0eaa1.data: Wind farm power time series; site, period and resolution are not reported here.
ddcd40782fcec6aa230ddc68222038d0f7d0eaa1.result: The hybrid model is presented as more accurate than its simpler counterparts; specific error values are not available here.
ddcd40782fcec6aa230ddc68222038d0f7d0eaa1.open_work: Testing across more wind farms and forecast horizons, and adding probabilistic output, would follow naturally.
ddcd40782fcec6aa230ddc68222038d0f7d0eaa1.issues: Single-site style evaluation; decomposition of the full series can leak future information if not applied causally; point forecasts only.

e32040c240e595b06a7e2edb052533faeb70398f.goal: Reviews drought concepts, indicators and prediction models to guide researchers and practitioners in forecasting drought onset under a changing climate.
e32040c240e595b06a7e2edb052533faeb70398f.architecture: Review of drought prediction approaches, from statistical models to machine learning and deep learning models, plus supporting technologies such as remote sensing and hydrological modelling.
e32040c240e595b06a7e2edb052533faeb70398f.data: Surveyed literature using meteorological observations, remote sensing data, hydrological model output, drought indices and climate indices such as sea surface temperature anomalies.
e32040c240e595b06a7e2edb052533faeb70398f.result: Machine learning and deep learning models are found to outperform traditional statistical models in drought prediction accuracy in the reviewed studies.
e32040c240e595b06a7e2edb052533faeb70398f.open_work: Better integration of remote sensing, observations, hydrological models and climate indices, and addressing identified challenges for operational drought prediction.
e32040c240e595b06a7e2edb052533faeb70398f.issues: Narrative review without a quantitative meta-analysis; comparative claims depend on heterogeneous studies with differing data and metrics.

41457f21df2db8ddf71f2036864c5bfa0bfe3276.goal: Discusses how data-driven modelling can support socio-hydrology, the study of coupled human-water systems, within the IAHS Panta Rhei Science Plan.
41457f21df2db8ddf71f2036864c5bfa0bfe3276.architecture: Review and perspective on data-driven modelling approaches, such as artificial neural networks and other machine learning methods, for coupled human-water systems; no single new model is proposed.
41457f21df2db8ddf71f2036864c5bfa0bfe3276.data: No new dataset; draws on published data-driven hydrological studies and the data needs of socio-hydrology.
41457f21df2db8ddf71f2036864c5bfa0bfe3276.result: Argues that data-driven methods offer opportunities to capture human-water feedbacks but face challenges in data availability, interpretability and process understanding.
41457f21df2db8ddf71f2036864c5bfa0bfe3276.open_work: Developing data sources on human activities and methods that combine data-driven and process-based understanding for socio-hydrological systems.
41457f21df2db8ddf71f2036864c5bfa0bfe3276.issues: Position paper; claims are qualitative and not tested on a case study.

b0a9367620df8e12b0a4eedac4b11f612f9392dd.goal: Tests whether supervised machine learning classifiers can map flooded areas from optical Landsat imagery more accurately than water index thresholding.
b0a9367620df8e12b0a4eedac4b11f612f9392dd.architecture: Support vector machines (SVM) and regularised kernel Fisher's discriminant analysis (rkFDA), each in linear and non-linear kernel versions, compared with NDWI thresholding.
b0a9367620df8e12b0a4eedac4b11f612f9392dd.data: Landsat TM imagery acquired shortly after a 2010 riverine flood in a heterogeneous Mediterranean region.
b0a9367620df8e12b0a4eedac4b11f612f9392dd.result: Non-linear rkFDA is most accurate (OA 96.23%, kappa 0.877) versus NDWI thresholding (OA 94.63%, kappa 0.818); rkFDA misses fewer flooded pixels, SVM gives fewer false detections.
b0a9367620df8e12b0a4eedac4b11f612f9392dd.open_work: Applying the approach to other flood events and regions to exploit open, global Landsat archives for economical flood mapping.
b0a9367620df8e12b0a4eedac4b11f612f9392dd.issues: Single flood event and scene; optical imagery is limited by cloud cover and revisit time; modest overall accuracy gain over thresholding.

d510d241e04cb3f6c143d096ef40165880602145.goal: Improves precipitation nowcasting by constraining deep learning with other meteorological elements so predicted precipitation motion follows atmospheric dynamics.
d510d241e04cb3f6c143d096ef40165880602145.architecture: Multimodal recurrent neural network (MM-RNN) framework compatible with ConvLSTM, PredRNN, MIM and MotionRNN, using additional meteorological element inputs to guide radar precipitation prediction.
d510d241e04cb3f6c143d096ef40165880602145.data: Multimodal datasets MeteoNet and RAIN-F, combining radar precipitation with other meteorological variables.
d510d241e04cb3f6c143d096ef40165880602145.result: On MeteoNet, MM-MotionRNN raises CSI (R>=10) by 23.4% and lowers MSE by 6.7% versus MS-MotionRNN; on RAIN-F, MM-MIM raises HSS (R>=5) by 209.4% versus MS-MIM.
d510d241e04cb3f6c143d096ef40165880602145.open_work: Extending to more modalities, longer lead times and probabilistic nowcasts.
d510d241e04cb3f6c143d096ef40165880602145.issues: Deterministic RNN nowcasts tend to blur at longer leads; evaluated on two regional datasets only.

07fd23074b1bad1bb9092ec88d0e19f27e10e020.goal: Improves monthly river flow forecasting with a hybrid model that selects informative lagged inputs automatically.
07fd23074b1bad1bb9092ec88d0e19f27e10e020.architecture: Hybrid GLSSVM: group method of data handling (GMDH) selects input variables for a least squares support vector machine (LSSVM); compared with ANN, ARIMA, GMDH and LSSVM.
07fd23074b1bad1bb9092ec88d0e19f27e10e020.data: Long-term monthly river flow records from the Selangor and Bernam rivers, Peninsular Malaysia.
07fd23074b1bad1bb9092ec88d0e19f27e10e020.result: The hybrid GLSSVM gives more accurate forecasts (lower RMSE, higher correlation) than all benchmark models at both stations.
07fd23074b1bad1bb9092ec88d0e19f27e10e020.open_work: Testing on more catchments, daily data and exogenous inputs such as rainfall.
07fd23074b1bad1bb9092ec88d0e19f27e10e020.issues: Two stations only; univariate monthly series; no uncertainty quantification.

ee21b2b841fc4f9c6dae6daf93a07a581223a1e7.goal: Forecasts wind speed at multiple sites of an offshore wind farm by exploiting spatial correlations between turbines as well as temporal dynamics.
ee21b2b841fc4f9c6dae6daf93a07a581223a1e7.architecture: Spatio-temporal model combining an optimally weighted graph convolutional network (GCN) for inter-site dependencies with a gated recurrent unit (GRU) for temporal dynamics.
ee21b2b841fc4f9c6dae6daf93a07a581223a1e7.data: Wind speed time series from multiple sites in an offshore wind farm; location and period are not reported here.
ee21b2b841fc4f9c6dae6daf93a07a581223a1e7.result: The GCN-GRU model is presented as outperforming comparison models; quantitative values are not available here.
ee21b2b841fc4f9c6dae6daf93a07a581223a1e7.open_work: Extending to longer horizons, wind power and probabilistic forecasts across other farms.
ee21b2b841fc4f9c6dae6daf93a07a581223a1e7.issues: Single wind farm; graph weighting is site-specific; details of evaluation unavailable without the abstract.

0cc53ef840c70bab9db3156a7124cde25f2de3d8.goal: Predicts the standardized precipitation index (SPI) for drought monitoring in Sakarya, Türkiye.
0cc53ef840c70bab9db3156a7124cde25f2de3d8.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network compared with a hybrid empirical mode decomposition and extreme learning machine (EMD-ELM) model.
0cc53ef840c70bab9db3156a7124cde25f2de3d8.data: Precipitation-derived SPI series for Sakarya, Türkiye; stations, timescales and period are not reported here.
0cc53ef840c70bab9db3156a7124cde25f2de3d8.result: Comparative skill of LSTM and EMD-ELM for SPI prediction is reported in the paper; specific values are not available here.
0cc53ef840c70bab9db3156a7124cde25f2de3d8.open_work: Testing additional SPI timescales, regions and climate predictors.
0cc53ef840c70bab9db3156a7124cde25f2de3d8.issues: Single region; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if decomposed over the full record.

0ba618a4b6e576ca3ac9194277613f063a50b543.goal: Compares statistical time series and neural network models for short-term forecasting of photovoltaic power generation.
0ba618a4b6e576ca3ac9194277613f063a50b543.architecture: Time series models compared with artificial neural networks (ANN) for short-term PV power forecasting.
0ba618a4b6e576ca3ac9194277613f063a50b543.data: PV power generation records; site and period are not reported here.
0ba618a4b6e576ca3ac9194277613f063a50b543.result: Relative accuracy of the time series and ANN approaches is reported in the paper; values are not available here.
0ba618a4b6e576ca3ac9194277613f063a50b543.open_work: Incorporating numerical weather prediction inputs and probabilistic forecasting.
0ba618a4b6e576ca3ac9194277613f063a50b543.issues: Site coverage is not reported here; findings may not transfer across climates.

21eb43870916f01915b25094e180d272c694d498.goal: Estimates daily river water temperature for ecosystem management and water resources planning.
21eb43870916f01915b25094e180d272c694d498.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) models with hyperparameters tuned by reptile search algorithm (RSA) and weighted mean of vectors optimizer (INFO).
21eb43870916f01915b25094e180d272c694d498.data: Daily data from the Bailong River, China: air temperature, streamflow, precipitation, sediment flow and day of year as input combinations.
21eb43870916f01915b25094e180d272c694d498.result: LSTM-INFO with day-of-year input gives the lowest RMSE and MAE among the compared models.
21eb43870916f01915b25094e180d272c694d498.open_work: Testing on other rivers and under climate change scenarios.
21eb43870916f01915b25094e180d272c694d498.issues: Single river; gains attributed to metaheuristic tuning may be modest relative to standard tuning; no uncertainty estimates.

789df36e687e22857dfe59ef0bc6d4b9303543fe.goal: Extracts clouds from high-resolution satellite imagery, where spectral thresholds struggle to separate clouds from bright surfaces.
789df36e687e22857dfe59ef0bc6d4b9303543fe.architecture: Object-based classification that segments the image into objects and describes them with bag-of-words features before classifying cloud versus non-cloud; classifier type is not specified here.
789df36e687e22857dfe59ef0bc6d4b9303543fe.data: Optical satellite imagery; sensors and scenes are not reported here.
789df36e687e22857dfe59ef0bc6d4b9303543fe.result: The approach is presented as extracting clouds more accurately than comparison methods; numbers are not available here.
789df36e687e22857dfe59ef0bc6d4b9303543fe.open_work: Extension to thin and semi-transparent clouds and other sensors.
789df36e687e22857dfe59ef0bc6d4b9303543fe.issues: Thin clouds and bright surfaces such as snow remain difficult; evaluation scope unknown without the abstract.

40db72773432c5302f058040faa88bf651047e21.goal: Predicts forest fire occurrence with minimal inputs so fire danger can be assessed in developing countries with sparse weather networks.
40db72773432c5302f058040faa88bf651047e21.architecture: Machine learning classifiers, support vector machines and artificial neural networks, using only two weather parameters.
40db72773432c5302f058040faa88bf651047e21.data: Weather records and fire occurrence data from Lebanon, using relative humidity and cumulative precipitation as inputs.
40db72773432c5302f058040faa88bf651047e21.result: Fire occurrence and danger levels can be predicted with useful accuracy from only two weather parameters.
40db72773432c5302f058040faa88bf651047e21.open_work: Adding vegetation and fuel information and testing in other regions.
40db72773432c5302f058040faa88bf651047e21.issues: Very small input set ignores fuel, topography and human ignition; limited regional data.

01bd9276567bb13748e1f186a48e2d0685513832.goal: Predicts groundwater level in Izeh City, Khuzestan, Iran, to support water resource management under scarcity.
01bd9276567bb13748e1f186a48e2d0685513832.architecture: Comparison of convolutional neural network (CNN), recurrent neural network (RNN), support vector machine (SVM), decision tree, random forest and generative adversarial network (GAN).
01bd9276567bb13748e1f186a48e2d0685513832.data: Local records of groundwater extraction rate, rainfall rate and river flow rate as inputs for Izeh City.
01bd9276567bb13748e1f186a48e2d0685513832.result: CNN performs best with RMSE 0.0558 and R2 0.9948 and no outlier predictions; river flow and extraction are the most influential inputs.
01bd9276567bb13748e1f186a48e2d0685513832.open_work: Adding more input variables and applying the approach to other water-scarce regions.
01bd9276567bb13748e1f186a48e2d0685513832.issues: Single site with three inputs; extremely high R2 suggests possible overfitting or leakage; GAN use for regression is unusual.

1707ca5fa8d84c589d9232e24905985b0fbafe7f.goal: Forecasts wind power by better capturing temporal dependencies in wind power series.
1707ca5fa8d84c589d9232e24905985b0fbafe7f.architecture: Powerformer, a temporal-based transformer model adapted to wind power forecasting.
1707ca5fa8d84c589d9232e24905985b0fbafe7f.data: Wind power time series; sites and period are not reported here.
1707ca5fa8d84c589d9232e24905985b0fbafe7f.result: Powerformer is presented as outperforming baseline forecasting models; values are not available here.
1707ca5fa8d84c589d9232e24905985b0fbafe7f.open_work: Adding meteorological forecasts as inputs and probabilistic outputs.
1707ca5fa8d84c589d9232e24905985b0fbafe7f.issues: Evaluation details unknown without the abstract; transformers can overfit small wind datasets.

c339a6648a3bea2c10df89796de1b5a1366c2fd2.goal: Predicts wind farm power production with a hybrid approach to improve short-term forecast accuracy.
c339a6648a3bea2c10df89796de1b5a1366c2fd2.architecture: Wavelet transform decomposition with hybrid neural networks, optimized by the imperialist competitive algorithm.
c339a6648a3bea2c10df89796de1b5a1366c2fd2.data: Wind farm power production records; site and period are not reported here.
c339a6648a3bea2c10df89796de1b5a1366c2fd2.result: The hybrid approach is presented as more accurate than comparison models; values are not available here.
c339a6648a3bea2c10df89796de1b5a1366c2fd2.open_work: Testing on other wind farms and adding probabilistic forecasts.
c339a6648a3bea2c10df89796de1b5a1366c2fd2.issues: Complex hybrid with metaheuristic tuning raises overfitting risk.

e972fc6a014fecc1ea136c297e15654dca5fc087.goal: Predicts monthly streamflow at a downstream station from upstream station records, useful where only successive gauges are available.
e972fc6a014fecc1ea136c297e15654dca5fc087.architecture: Comparison of different artificial neural network (ANN) algorithms for successive-station streamflow prediction.
e972fc6a014fecc1ea136c297e15654dca5fc087.data: Monthly streamflow records from successive gauging stations on a river; details are not reported here.
e972fc6a014fecc1ea136c297e15654dca5fc087.result: Relative performance of the ANN algorithms is reported in the paper; values are not available here.
e972fc6a014fecc1ea136c297e15654dca5fc087.open_work: Adding climatic inputs and testing on more river systems.
e972fc6a014fecc1ea136c297e15654dca5fc087.issues: Few stations; monthly data only; no uncertainty quantification.

94b70f752f3b3973386168214b4436b2eed90015.goal: Estimates significant wave height from X-band marine radar images without calibration against in situ buoys.
94b70f752f3b3973386168214b4436b2eed90015.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) using shadowing information extracted from radar images of the sea surface.
94b70f752f3b3973386168214b4436b2eed90015.data: Simulated X-band radar images and real measured X-band radar images of the sea surface.
94b70f752f3b3973386168214b4436b2eed90015.result: SVR with shadowing features estimates significant wave height accurately on both simulated and real data; values are not available here.
94b70f752f3b3973386168214b4436b2eed90015.open_work: Testing across more sea states and radar installations.
94b70f752f3b3973386168214b4436b2eed90015.issues: Limited real-data sites; shadowing depends on radar geometry and sea state.

0a26130414d7c4594f943c08a994cce2dfda6d67.goal: Maps fractional snow cover at sub-pixel level from MODIS, improving on binary snow maps in mixed pixels.
0a26130414d7c4594f943c08a994cce2dfda6d67.architecture: Artificial neural network regression from MODIS surface reflectance to fractional snow cover.
0a26130414d7c4594f943c08a994cce2dfda6d67.data: MODIS surface reflectance with fractional snow cover reference derived from higher-resolution Landsat imagery.
0a26130414d7c4594f943c08a994cce2dfda6d67.result: The neural network estimates fractional snow cover with accuracy comparable to or better than index-based approaches.
0a26130414d7c4594f943c08a994cce2dfda6d67.open_work: Testing across more land cover types, seasons and regions.
0a26130414d7c4594f943c08a994cce2dfda6d67.issues: Reference data from Landsat are limited in time; forest canopy and illumination effects remain challenging.

49d514bbd5c492221d648a68abbc13050f393ee7.goal: Proposes a strategy for short-term wind speed prediction using soft computing models.
49d514bbd5c492221d648a68abbc13050f393ee7.architecture: Soft computing models such as neural networks; the specific network type is not specified here.
49d514bbd5c492221d648a68abbc13050f393ee7.data: Wind speed time series; site and period are not reported here.
49d514bbd5c492221d648a68abbc13050f393ee7.result: The proposed strategy is presented as improving short-term wind speed forecasts; values are not available here.
49d514bbd5c492221d648a68abbc13050f393ee7.open_work: Extension to wind power forecasting and other sites.
49d514bbd5c492221d648a68abbc13050f393ee7.issues: Evaluation scope unknown without the abstract.

aa37a9c737840b721dd5905b9ed8d1ef038413ee.goal: Estimates surface particulate matter in eastern China by combining satellite aerosol retrievals with ground-based observations.
aa37a9c737840b721dd5905b9ed8d1ef038413ee.architecture: Statistical model linking satellite aerosol optical depth and ground observations to particulate matter; the method type is not specified here.
aa37a9c737840b721dd5905b9ed8d1ef038413ee.data: Satellite aerosol optical depth (MODIS) and ground-based meteorological and particulate matter measurements in eastern China.
aa37a9c737840b721dd5905b9ed8d1ef038413ee.result: Combining satellite and ground data improves particulate matter estimates over satellite data alone; values are not available here.
aa37a9c737840b721dd5905b9ed8d1ef038413ee.open_work: Extending to finer resolution, PM2.5 and longer periods.
aa37a9c737840b721dd5905b9ed8d1ef038413ee.issues: Depends on satellite AOD coverage gaps from clouds; vertical profile effects on AOD-PM relations.

eabff4ce864ed022cd93c24159e9dc09aa1052cd.goal: Improves very short-term (5-min) wind power prediction for grid operation.
eabff4ce864ed022cd93c24159e9dc09aa1052cd.architecture: CEMOLS: CEEMDAN decomposition, long short-term memory (LSTM) networks with dropout, and monarch butterfly optimization for hyperparameter tuning.
eabff4ce864ed022cd93c24159e9dc09aa1052cd.data: Data from four real wind farms in New South Wales, Australia.
eabff4ce864ed022cd93c24159e9dc09aa1052cd.result: CEMOLS improves on persistence by on average 32.96% MAE, 47.10% RMSE and 32.33% MAPE with low computation time.
eabff4ce864ed022cd93c24159e9dc09aa1052cd.open_work: Sensitivity and statistical analyses to select robust models for practical deployment.
eabff4ce864ed022cd93c24159e9dc09aa1052cd.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids may leak information if not applied causally; point forecasts only.

18e7bc433718e4d86695d11b87e9a48f4eb90664.goal: Retrieves atmospheric temperature profiles and surface temperature from IASI hyperspectral infrared radiances quickly and robustly.
18e7bc433718e4d86695d11b87e9a48f4eb90664.architecture: Regularized multilayer perceptron neural network retrieval, with regularization and input compression to handle many correlated channels.
18e7bc433718e4d86695d11b87e9a48f4eb90664.data: Simulated IASI radiances computed from a climatological atmospheric profile database (TIGR).
18e7bc433718e4d86695d11b87e9a48f4eb90664.result: The regularized neural network gives accurate temperature profile and surface temperature retrievals in simulation.
18e7bc433718e4d86695d11b87e9a48f4eb90664.open_work: Application to real IASI observations and comparison with physical retrievals.
18e7bc433718e4d86695d11b87e9a48f4eb90664.issues: Trained and tested on simulated radiances; real-instrument noise and cloud contamination not fully addressed.

d21a4f41b9e990e8fe8ab6a5ded2bd3829b8074b.goal: Forecasts meteorological drought at several time steps in southeastern East Azerbaijan, Iran.
d21a4f41b9e990e8fe8ab6a5ded2bd3829b8074b.architecture: Hybrid wavelet transform and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (Wavelet-ANFIS).
d21a4f41b9e990e8fe8ab6a5ded2bd3829b8074b.data: Meteorological drought index series for stations in southeastern East Azerbaijan province, Iran.
d21a4f41b9e990e8fe8ab6a5ded2bd3829b8074b.result: Wavelet-ANFIS is presented as more accurate than standalone ANFIS; values are not available here.
d21a4f41b9e990e8fe8ab6a5ded2bd3829b8074b.open_work: Extending to longer lead times and other regions.
d21a4f41b9e990e8fe8ab6a5ded2bd3829b8074b.issues: Small regional dataset; wavelet decomposition may introduce boundary leakage.

00daf1b3565d78058a2c6938929e166474f5f1af.goal: Predicts direct normal irradiance and global radiation to design solar energy systems for a residential building.
00daf1b3565d78058a2c6938929e166474f5f1af.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) models for direct normal irradiance and global radiation.
00daf1b3565d78058a2c6938929e166474f5f1af.data: Meteorological and radiation measurements at the study site; details are not reported here.
00daf1b3565d78058a2c6938929e166474f5f1af.result: The ANN predicts direct normal irradiance and global radiation with good accuracy; values are not available here.
00daf1b3565d78058a2c6938929e166474f5f1af.open_work: Testing at other locations and integrating into system energy simulations.
00daf1b3565d78058a2c6938929e166474f5f1af.issues: Single site; generalization to other climates untested.

67a591143c6c063f3593ee07cd44c3b7af949172.goal: Forecasts daily Air Quality Index in Delhi to support public health warnings.
67a591143c6c063f3593ee07cd44c3b7af949172.architecture: Artificial neural network with principal component analysis (PCA) reducing input variables.
67a591143c6c063f3593ee07cd44c3b7af949172.data: Delhi air quality and meteorological data; details are not reported here.
67a591143c6c063f3593ee07cd44c3b7af949172.result: PCA-based neural network improves AQI forecast accuracy over a network without PCA; values are not available here.
67a591143c6c063f3593ee07cd44c3b7af949172.open_work: Extension to other cities and pollutants.

3c017266c77291b7f05366c2747f644d08d93806.goal: Produces probabilistic wind power forecasts with automatically tuned deep network hyperparameters.
3c017266c77291b7f05366c2747f644d08d93806.architecture: NGOA-DeepAR: auto-regressive recurrent neural network (DeepAR) with hyperparameters tuned by an improved grasshopper optimization algorithm with opposition-based learning and chaos.
3c017266c77291b7f05366c2747f644d08d93806.data: GEFCom-2014 wind dataset and Australian Energy Market Operator (AEMO) data.
3c017266c77291b7f05366c2747f644d08d93806.result: Prediction interval coverage probability and pinball loss are [0.902, 0.320] and [0.933, 1.4885]; the model learns faster and beats benchmark DNNs and neuroevolution models.
3c017266c77291b7f05366c2747f644d08d93806.open_work: Extending to multi-site and longer-horizon probabilistic forecasting.
3c017266c77291b7f05366c2747f644d08d93806.issues: Metaheuristic tuning is costly; evaluation on two datasets only.

958e835b462a4f28acc1fb7fac21341bea3f2ab0.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction for wind energy operations.
958e835b462a4f28acc1fb7fac21341bea3f2ab0.architecture: Gated recurrent unit (GRU) recurrent neural network and a hybrid stationary wavelet transform plus GRU (SWT-GRU) model.
958e835b462a4f28acc1fb7fac21341bea3f2ab0.data: Wind speed time series; site and period are not reported here.
958e835b462a4f28acc1fb7fac21341bea3f2ab0.result: The SWT-GRU hybrid is presented as more accurate than the standalone GRU; values are not available here.
958e835b462a4f28acc1fb7fac21341bea3f2ab0.open_work: Testing across other sites and horizons.
958e835b462a4f28acc1fb7fac21341bea3f2ab0.issues: Evaluation scope unknown without the abstract.

e0a1d390524e25d9b455fe05d53e1f982d00007e.goal: Estimates root-zone soil moisture from more easily observed data, since remote sensing only sees the surface layer.
e0a1d390524e25d9b455fe05d53e1f982d00007e.architecture: Data-driven (machine learning) methods relating surface and meteorological information to root-zone soil moisture; the specific model types are not specified here.
e0a1d390524e25d9b455fe05d53e1f982d00007e.data: In situ soil moisture observations; sites and period are not reported here.
e0a1d390524e25d9b455fe05d53e1f982d00007e.result: Data-driven models estimate root-zone soil moisture with useful skill; values are not available here.
e0a1d390524e25d9b455fe05d53e1f982d00007e.open_work: Combining with satellite surface soil moisture products for large-scale root-zone estimates.
e0a1d390524e25d9b455fe05d53e1f982d00007e.issues: Site-specific training; transfer to ungauged locations uncertain.

79a2488d237b5523dadc1af77f8a232846242724.goal: Develops a rainfall-runoff model suited to short and low-quality datasets in a Pakistani watershed.
79a2488d237b5523dadc1af77f8a232846242724.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) rainfall-runoff model with cross-validation, compared with a mathematical conceptual model.
79a2488d237b5523dadc1af77f8a232846242724.data: Precipitation data from the Pakistan Meteorological Department and runoff data for a watershed in Pakistan.
79a2488d237b5523dadc1af77f8a232846242724.result: The ANN is a viable alternative to the conceptual model when data are short and of low quality.
79a2488d237b5523dadc1af77f8a232846242724.open_work: Testing on longer records and other watersheds.
79a2488d237b5523dadc1af77f8a232846242724.issues: Short, low-quality dataset; single watershed; quantitative results not given in the abstract.

eddb747a402af052f9eea1f32fbf41c51b540ae1.goal: Predicts daily global solar irradiation for solar energy applications.
eddb747a402af052f9eea1f32fbf41c51b540ae1.architecture: Temporal Gaussian process regression models incorporating time-related information.
eddb747a402af052f9eea1f32fbf41c51b540ae1.data: Daily solar irradiation and predictor data; details are not reported here.
eddb747a402af052f9eea1f32fbf41c51b540ae1.result: Temporal Gaussian processes are presented as more accurate than standard regression approaches; values are not available here.
eddb747a402af052f9eea1f32fbf41c51b540ae1.open_work: Testing at more stations and exploiting predictive uncertainty.
eddb747a402af052f9eea1f32fbf41c51b540ae1.issues: Evaluation scope unknown without the abstract.

3cd294b6f0bdf7646366044bc038576f2bd2d15a.goal: Predicts daily watershed runoff with neural networks.
3cd294b6f0bdf7646366044bc038576f2bd2d15a.architecture: Radial basis function (RBF) neural network compared with feed-forward neural network trained with Levenberg-Marquardt.
3cd294b6f0bdf7646366044bc038576f2bd2d15a.data: Daily rainfall and runoff data for a watershed; details are not reported here.
3cd294b6f0bdf7646366044bc038576f2bd2d15a.result: Comparison of RBF and LM-feed-forward networks is reported; values are not available here.
3cd294b6f0bdf7646366044bc038576f2bd2d15a.open_work: Testing in other watersheds and adding exogenous inputs.

fa820539bc1409d264fc66277ebf5eea983e27bf.goal: Models and predicts rainfall at rain gauges from radar reflectivity using data mining.
fa820539bc1409d264fc66277ebf5eea983e27bf.architecture: Data-mining (machine learning) models relating radar reflectivity to gauge rainfall; the specific algorithm types are not specified here.
fa820539bc1409d264fc66277ebf5eea983e27bf.data: Weather radar reflectivity data and rain gauge measurements; details are not reported here.
fa820539bc1409d264fc66277ebf5eea983e27bf.result: Data-mining models predict gauge rainfall from radar reflectivity with useful accuracy; values are not available here.
fa820539bc1409d264fc66277ebf5eea983e27bf.open_work: Extension to longer lead times and more gauges.
fa820539bc1409d264fc66277ebf5eea983e27bf.issues: Limited gauges and region; radar-gauge representativeness errors.

b1470f9d8fe6dc21c868a09ac3c9a1ff22e28b2f.goal: Tests whether the choice of machine learning algorithm matters for satellite-based optical rainfall retrievals.
b1470f9d8fe6dc21c868a09ac3c9a1ff22e28b2f.architecture: Comparison of random forest, artificial neural network, support vector machine and gradient boosting machine.
b1470f9d8fe6dc21c868a09ac3c9a1ff22e28b2f.data: MSG SEVIRI satellite data over Germany with RADOLAN radar-based rainfall as reference.
b1470f9d8fe6dc21c868a09ac3c9a1ff22e28b2f.result: The four algorithms perform similarly for rain area delineation and rain rate; algorithm choice matters less than predictors.
b1470f9d8fe6dc21c868a09ac3c9a1ff22e28b2f.open_work: Improving predictor information rather than algorithm choice.
b1470f9d8fe6dc21c868a09ac3c9a1ff22e28b2f.issues: Single region; optical retrievals limited at night and for some cloud types.

a1ab4d9442e88fde6d8d7f7e2e11114a2588e145.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in Idukki district, Kerala, India, to support flood risk management.
a1ab4d9442e88fde6d8d7f7e2e11114a2588e145.architecture: Machine learning boosting algorithms for flood susceptibility mapping; specific variants are not reported here.
a1ab4d9442e88fde6d8d7f7e2e11114a2588e145.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors for Idukki district; details are not reported here.
a1ab4d9442e88fde6d8d7f7e2e11114a2588e145.result: Boosting models produce flood susceptibility maps with good accuracy; values are not available here.
a1ab4d9442e88fde6d8d7f7e2e11114a2588e145.open_work: Testing in other districts and with dynamic factors.
a1ab4d9442e88fde6d8d7f7e2e11114a2588e145.issues: Static susceptibility; inventory quality and spatial autocorrelation can inflate accuracy.

0f0fd78b2ab180e39558779633f2bff099e016cd.goal: Forecasts intermittent streamflow, which is hard because of frequent zero-flow periods.
0f0fd78b2ab180e39558779633f2bff099e016cd.architecture: Several data-driven (machine learning) techniques compared for intermittent streamflow forecasting; the specific model types are not specified here.
0f0fd78b2ab180e39558779633f2bff099e016cd.data: Streamflow records from an intermittent river; details are not reported here.
0f0fd78b2ab180e39558779633f2bff099e016cd.result: Relative accuracy of the data-driven techniques is reported; values are not available here.
0f0fd78b2ab180e39558779633f2bff099e016cd.open_work: Testing on more intermittent rivers and longer horizons.
0f0fd78b2ab180e39558779633f2bff099e016cd.issues: Zero-flow periods complicate error metrics; limited stations.

29d90a87b03611f8308d82f07d62eb1e7a6e1a6a.goal: Simulates real-time pluvial flooding over large areas under spatiotemporally varying rainstorms for emergency management.
29d90a87b03611f8308d82f07d62eb1e7a6e1a6a.architecture: Coarse-grid hydrodynamic model output converted to high-resolution flood depth and velocity maps by a deep learning super-resolution model; network type is not specified in the abstract.
29d90a87b03611f8308d82f07d62eb1e7a6e1a6a.data: Hydrodynamic simulations for a limited number of assumed rainfall scenarios over 352 km2 of Hong Kong covering mountain and urban terrain.
29d90a87b03611f8308d82f07d62eb1e7a6e1a6a.result: Flood depth and velocity RMSEs are as low as 0.082 m and 0.088 m/s with correlations 0.962 and 0.921; a 48-h event runs in under 30 s, 2690 times faster.
29d90a87b03611f8308d82f07d62eb1e7a6e1a6a.open_work: Testing with observed rainfall events and other cities.
29d90a87b03611f8308d82f07d62eb1e7a6e1a6a.issues: Trained on synthetic rainfall scenarios; inherits coarse model errors.

d84c67ba4e40d838bd65d8988a4dbacbf09e850b.goal: Provides a large-scale fine-grained dataset to advance automated plankton classification from in situ imaging.
d84c67ba4e40d838bd65d8988a4dbacbf09e850b.architecture: Benchmark dataset of expert-labeled plankton images with baseline hand-engineered features and two convolutional neural network (CNN) classifiers.
d84c67ba4e40d838bd65d8988a4dbacbf09e850b.data: Over 3.4 million expert-labeled Imaging FlowCytobot images across 70 classes from the Martha's Vineyard Coastal Observatory over 8 years.
d84c67ba4e40d838bd65d8988a4dbacbf09e850b.result: CNN baselines are evaluated against a traditional feature-based method; metrics are discussed for class imbalance.
d84c67ba4e40d838bd65d8988a4dbacbf09e850b.open_work: Improving classification for rare and similar classes.
d84c67ba4e40d838bd65d8988a4dbacbf09e850b.issues: Strong class imbalance; single instrument and site.

1dfb812832e58ef6be1c45e92abcf179f3320af8.goal: Compares methods for statistically downscaling daily precipitation from GCMs to the Punjab region.
1dfb812832e58ef6be1c45e92abcf179f3320af8.architecture: Comparison of three statistical downscaling methods for daily precipitation; specific methods are not reported here.
1dfb812832e58ef6be1c45e92abcf179f3320af8.data: GCM output and observed daily precipitation for Punjab; details are not reported here.
1dfb812832e58ef6be1c45e92abcf179f3320af8.result: Relative skill of the three downscaling methods is reported; values are not available here.
1dfb812832e58ef6be1c45e92abcf179f3320af8.open_work: Extending to multiple GCMs and scenarios.

dab0760bbeecff3189523dd8ef2d91b564803d03.goal: Simulates the spatial and temporal distribution of groundwater hydraulic head.
dab0760bbeecff3189523dd8ef2d91b564803d03.architecture: Hybrid artificial neural networks (ANN) with Kriging and optional fuzzy logic inference.
dab0760bbeecff3189523dd8ef2d91b564803d03.data: Hydraulic head and meteorological data for an aquifer in Bavaria, Germany, with leave-one-out cross validation.
dab0760bbeecff3189523dd8ef2d91b564803d03.result: Best results use two-hidden-layer ANNs, fuzzy logic and a power-law variogram, with RMSE of order 0.01 m.
dab0760bbeecff3189523dd8ef2d91b564803d03.open_work: Application to aquifers with obscure geology.
dab0760bbeecff3189523dd8ef2d91b564803d03.issues: Single study area; leave-one-out may overstate skill.

7da844a17a139d41002c2281cfc136671998dd98.goal: Compares statistical models for wind speed and wind power forecasting.
7da844a17a139d41002c2281cfc136671998dd98.architecture: Autoregressive moving average (ARMA) models and artificial neural networks (ANN).
7da844a17a139d41002c2281cfc136671998dd98.data: Wind speed and wind power time series; details are not reported here.
7da844a17a139d41002c2281cfc136671998dd98.result: Relative skill of ARMA and ANN is reported; values are not available here.
7da844a17a139d41002c2281cfc136671998dd98.open_work: Hybrid models and inclusion of NWP inputs.
7da844a17a139d41002c2281cfc136671998dd98.issues: Data and site coverage not reported here; no probabilistic forecasts.

1dc7f5fccedc33b473459f074ebbf2a6e5c01e6a.goal: Forecasts reservoir inflow with artificial neural networks to support reservoir operation and water allocation.
1dc7f5fccedc33b473459f074ebbf2a6e5c01e6a.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type) approaches compared for inflow forecasting; the specific network variants are not detailed here.
1dc7f5fccedc33b473459f074ebbf2a6e5c01e6a.data: Historical inflow records of a single reservoir; dataset details not reported here.
1dc7f5fccedc33b473459f074ebbf2a6e5c01e6a.result: Reports that ANN approaches give usable inflow forecasts; specific skill scores not reported here.
1dc7f5fccedc33b473459f074ebbf2a6e5c01e6a.open_work: Testing on other reservoirs and longer lead times, and comparison with conceptual hydrological models.
1dc7f5fccedc33b473459f074ebbf2a6e5c01e6a.issues: Single-site study with no abstract available; generalization and uncertainty treatment are unclear.

a71988fbc466ecf4f8e416b2bce4acf8664bdf88.goal: Quantifies predictive uncertainty of ANN rainfall–runoff models by constructing prediction intervals instead of single deterministic forecasts.
a71988fbc466ecf4f8e416b2bce4acf8664bdf88.architecture: Ensemble of artificial neural networks (MLP-type) whose spread of simulations is used to build prediction intervals for runoff.
a71988fbc466ecf4f8e416b2bce4acf8664bdf88.data: Observed rainfall and runoff records from a catchment; specific basin and period not reported here.
a71988fbc466ecf4f8e416b2bce4acf8664bdf88.result: Ensemble-based intervals are shown to bracket observed runoff reasonably; quantitative coverage metrics not reported here.
a71988fbc466ecf4f8e416b2bce4acf8664bdf88.open_work: Separating parameter, input and structural uncertainty and testing on more catchments.
a71988fbc466ecf4f8e416b2bce4acf8664bdf88.issues: Ensemble spread may not capture all uncertainty sources; intervals may be miscalibrated for extremes.

e40cde51535614ba20717d2ebf44c6faf3309390.goal: Predicts intermittent daily and hourly reservoir inflow several time steps ahead using AI techniques with lumped and distributed rainfall inputs.
e40cde51535614ba20717d2ebf44c6faf3309390.architecture: Compares artificial neural network (MLP), adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and linear genetic programming models.
e40cde51535614ba20717d2ebf44c6faf3309390.data: Rainfall and inflow records for a reservoir in India (Koyna), using lumped and spatially distributed rain-gauge inputs.
e40cde51535614ba20717d2ebf44c6faf3309390.result: Linear genetic programming tends to outperform ANN and ANFIS for multi-step intermittent inflow; skill decreases with lead time.
e40cde51535614ba20717d2ebf44c6faf3309390.open_work: Better handling of zero-flow periods and longer lead times, and transfer to other reservoirs.
e40cde51535614ba20717d2ebf44c6faf3309390.issues: Single reservoir; intermittent flows make error metrics sensitive to dry periods; no uncertainty quantification.

ec1154626aba6c7426d847d30c13760acd9b4741.goal: Models daily runoff at multiple gauging stations, including data-scarce sub-basins, by combining geomorphological information with neuro-fuzzy modeling.
ec1154626aba6c7426d847d30c13760acd9b4741.architecture: Integrated Geomorphological ANFIS (adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system, Sugeno) with fuzzy C-means clustering of the inputs.
ec1154626aba6c7426d847d30c13760acd9b4741.data: Daily rainfall and discharge at multiple stations in the Eel River watershed, California, plus sub-basin spatial variables; cross-validation on one station.
ec1154626aba6c7426d847d30c13760acd9b4741.result: The IGANFIS with fuzzy C-means clustering gives good goodness-of-fit and can estimate runoff at stations treated as ungauged.
ec1154626aba6c7426d847d30c13760acd9b4741.open_work: Testing on other watersheds and comparing with distributed physically based models.
ec1154626aba6c7426d847d30c13760acd9b4741.issues: Single watershed; daily only; limited quantitative detail in the abstract and no uncertainty estimates.

954a551c382b66eb0375a07931b16c0bf4883b95.goal: Extends streamflow forecast lead time in a snowmelt-driven catchment using large-scale oceanic–atmospheric climate patterns as predictors.
954a551c382b66eb0375a07931b16c0bf4883b95.architecture: Data-driven model using climate-index predictors; the specific machine-learning type is not specified here.
954a551c382b66eb0375a07931b16c0bf4883b95.data: Streamflow records and large-scale climate indices (e.g., Pacific and Atlantic ocean–atmosphere patterns); exact datasets not reported here.
954a551c382b66eb0375a07931b16c0bf4883b95.result: Reports that climate-pattern predictors allow skillful forecasts at longer lead times; numbers not reported here.
954a551c382b66eb0375a07931b16c0bf4883b95.open_work: Testing other catchments and combining climate predictors with snowpack observations.
954a551c382b66eb0375a07931b16c0bf4883b95.issues: No abstract available; teleconnection relationships may be non-stationary under climate change.

d480c2f6b5f4e40df19aa0c9d0cf6c6a8b7b6c1a.goal: Forecasts long-term wind speed and wind power generation for wind farm planning, where wind series are nonlinear and intermittent.
d480c2f6b5f4e40df19aa0c9d0cf6c6a8b7b6c1a.architecture: LSTM, GRU, CNN and hybrid CNN-LSTM deep learning models using a direct multistep strategy.
d480c2f6b5f4e40df19aa0c9d0cf6c6a8b7b6c1a.data: Wind and meteorological time series at Zabol, Iran, in univariate and multivariate configurations; horizons of 6 months, 1 year and 5 years.
d480c2f6b5f4e40df19aa0c9d0cf6c6a8b7b6c1a.result: GRU is most accurate; multivariate inputs improve accuracy over univariate; five-year power production of the wind farm is estimated.
d480c2f6b5f4e40df19aa0c9d0cf6c6a8b7b6c1a.open_work: Uncertainty quantification for long horizons and testing at other sites.
d480c2f6b5f4e40df19aa0c9d0cf6c6a8b7b6c1a.issues: Single site; multi-year deterministic wind forecasts from past data alone have limited physical basis; no probabilistic output.

d40d7010312c9c68270dbf3d2ac8775b67204487.goal: Forecasts hourly global solar irradiation for New Zealand sites to support solar energy integration.
d40d7010312c9c68270dbf3d2ac8775b67204487.architecture: Artificial neural network forecasting model compared with simpler statistical baselines; specific network details not confirmed here.
d40d7010312c9c68270dbf3d2ac8775b67204487.data: Hourly solar irradiation and meteorological measurements at New Zealand station(s); period not reported here.
d40d7010312c9c68270dbf3d2ac8775b67204487.result: Reports that the neural model improves on baseline approaches; specific error values not reported here.
d40d7010312c9c68270dbf3d2ac8775b67204487.open_work: Extension to more sites, cloudy-sky conditions and probabilistic forecasts.
d40d7010312c9c68270dbf3d2ac8775b67204487.issues: No abstract available; limited sites; deterministic forecasts only.

c0d0be0d0e7373546dc8c6b275fe6245c6e3399a.goal: Improves daily PM10 concentration forecasting for air quality warnings.
c0d0be0d0e7373546dc8c6b275fe6245c6e3399a.architecture: Wavelet decomposition of the series combined with an ensemble of neural predictors (e.g., MLP, RBF, SVM-type) whose outputs are fused.
c0d0be0d0e7373546dc8c6b275fe6245c6e3399a.data: Measured PM10 and meteorological data from an urban monitoring site (Warsaw, Poland); period not reported here.
c0d0be0d0e7373546dc8c6b275fe6245c6e3399a.result: The wavelet plus ensemble approach reduces forecast error relative to single predictors.
c0d0be0d0e7373546dc8c6b275fe6245c6e3399a.open_work: Testing other pollutants and stations, and adding emission and transport information.
c0d0be0d0e7373546dc8c6b275fe6245c6e3399a.issues: Single site; wavelet decomposition of full series may leak future information if not done causally.

dc1e6cfb9380080bce0f247014c5043ec353c3d6.goal: Predicts water table depth in western Orissa, India, to support groundwater management.
dc1e6cfb9380080bce0f247014c5043ec353c3d6.architecture: Back-propagation neural network (MLP) and radial basis function network compared.
dc1e6cfb9380080bce0f247014c5043ec353c3d6.data: Hydrometeorological and groundwater level records from western Orissa; details not reported here.
dc1e6cfb9380080bce0f247014c5043ec353c3d6.result: Both networks predict water table depth reasonably; which is better is not confirmed here.
dc1e6cfb9380080bce0f247014c5043ec353c3d6.open_work: Longer records, more wells and spatially explicit modeling.
dc1e6cfb9380080bce0f247014c5043ec353c3d6.issues: No abstract available; regional, small-sample study without uncertainty estimates.

5e15bfd009e9d5c5aab662f8341955a1332ec63c.goal: Validates and gap-fills FY-3B microwave soil moisture over the Tibetan Plateau, where passive microwave retrievals have gaps and biases.
5e15bfd009e9d5c5aab662f8341955a1332ec63c.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type) relating soil moisture to reconstructed MODIS optical products.
5e15bfd009e9d5c5aab662f8341955a1332ec63c.data: FY-3B/MWRI soil moisture, gap-filled MODIS products (e.g., land surface temperature, NDVI, albedo) and in situ soil moisture over the Tibetan Plateau.
5e15bfd009e9d5c5aab662f8341955a1332ec63c.result: The ANN reconstructs spatially continuous soil moisture consistent with the satellite product and in situ observations; numbers not reported here.
5e15bfd009e9d5c5aab662f8341955a1332ec63c.open_work: Higher-resolution downscaling and extension to other microwave products and regions.
5e15bfd009e9d5c5aab662f8341955a1332ec63c.issues: Inherits errors of the reference microwave product and of reconstructed MODIS inputs; sparse in situ validation.

40b04a11b3e2e70a945c4157e6b1327c4408d712.goal: Improves reservoir inflow forecasting by combining neural networks with wavelet analysis and bootstrap resampling.
40b04a11b3e2e70a945c4157e6b1327c4408d712.architecture: Ensemble of artificial neural networks (MLP) with wavelet decomposition of inputs and bootstrap resampling (wavelet-bootstrap-ANN).
40b04a11b3e2e70a945c4157e6b1327c4408d712.data: Historical reservoir inflow records from an Indian reservoir; details not reported here.
40b04a11b3e2e70a945c4157e6b1327c4408d712.result: Hybrid wavelet-bootstrap ensembles outperform single ANNs; specific scores not reported here.
40b04a11b3e2e70a945c4157e6b1327c4408d712.open_work: Use of the bootstrap spread for uncertainty bounds and testing at more sites.
40b04a11b3e2e70a945c4157e6b1327c4408d712.issues: No abstract available; wavelet preprocessing can leak future data if not applied causally.

a80ae7a5d6ba7dfd8abdd354f47bcee7f3fa1fb2.goal: Forecasts monthly rainfall, whose series are nonlinear and nonstationary.
a80ae7a5d6ba7dfd8abdd354f47bcee7f3fa1fb2.architecture: Ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) with support vector regression on phase-space-reconstructed inputs.
a80ae7a5d6ba7dfd8abdd354f47bcee7f3fa1fb2.data: Monthly rainfall series from station(s); location and period not reported here.
a80ae7a5d6ba7dfd8abdd354f47bcee7f3fa1fb2.result: The EEMD-SVR hybrid improves on single models; numbers not reported here.
a80ae7a5d6ba7dfd8abdd354f47bcee7f3fa1fb2.open_work: Applying to more climates and examining decomposition-induced information leakage.
a80ae7a5d6ba7dfd8abdd354f47bcee7f3fa1fb2.issues: No abstract available; decomposition-based hybrids are prone to look-ahead bias if decomposed on the full series.

e3a7457ae545e5564a0799ae565217cb6da22873.goal: Improves high-resolution radar precipitation nowcasting, especially multi-scale evolution and extreme precipitation.
e3a7457ae545e5564a0799ae565217cb6da22873.architecture: Cascaded framework: a deterministic model for mesoscale distributions plus a frame-wise-guided diffusion transformer in a latent space for small-scale patterns.
e3a7457ae545e5564a0799ae565217cb6da22873.data: Three radar precipitation benchmark datasets (SEVIR, HKO-7, MeteoNet).
e3a7457ae545e5564a0799ae565217cb6da22873.result: Competitive overall performance and up to +91.8% improvement over baseline for regional extreme-precipitation nowcasting.
e3a7457ae545e5564a0799ae565217cb6da22873.open_work: Longer lead times, multi-source inputs and operational evaluation.
e3a7457ae545e5564a0799ae565217cb6da22873.issues: Radar-only inputs; diffusion sampling adds cost; evaluated on benchmark datasets rather than operational settings.

b5be615a2c64d763cc34e2c2079d09fb3965e082.goal: Forecasts daily reservoir runoff for hydropower and grid operation while avoiding slow, locally trapped ANN training.
b5be615a2c64d763cc34e2c2079d09fb3965e082.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) whose weights and thresholds are optimized by quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization (ANN-QPSO).
b5be615a2c64d763cc34e2c2079d09fb3965e082.data: Daily runoff of Hongjiadu reservoir, Guizhou, China, 2006–2014.
b5be615a2c64d763cc34e2c2079d09fb3965e082.result: ANN-QPSO achieves much better forecast accuracy than the basic ANN.
b5be615a2c64d763cc34e2c2079d09fb3965e082.open_work: Comparison with other optimizers and deep models, and testing at other reservoirs.
b5be615a2c64d763cc34e2c2079d09fb3965e082.issues: Single reservoir; baseline limited to a standard ANN; no uncertainty quantification.

348e462fb00f68e8fc54ed707b79f8de90e83208.goal: Derives monthly reservoir operation rules for hydropower generation.
348e462fb00f68e8fc54ed707b79f8de90e83208.architecture: Support vector regression rule functions combined with NSGA-II multi-objective genetic optimization (SVR-NSGAII).
348e462fb00f68e8fc54ed707b79f8de90e83208.data: Reservoir inflow and operation data for a hydropower reservoir; details not reported here.
348e462fb00f68e8fc54ed707b79f8de90e83208.result: The SVR-NSGAII rules provide efficient operation policies; quantitative gains not reported here.
348e462fb00f68e8fc54ed707b79f8de90e83208.open_work: Incorporating inflow forecast uncertainty and testing on multi-reservoir systems.
348e462fb00f68e8fc54ed707b79f8de90e83208.issues: No abstract available; rules depend on the historical inflow record and may not hold under changed hydrology.
