bbf04338787c9c9735fc6182daf30aa6cc23952e.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels in space and time in a coastal aquifer.
bbf04338787c9c9735fc6182daf30aa6cc23952e.architecture: Hybrid of an artificial neural network (MLP) for temporal forecasting at wells and geostatistics (kriging) for spatial interpolation.
bbf04338787c9c9735fc6182daf30aa6cc23952e.data: Groundwater level and hydrological records from observation wells in a coastal aquifer; details not reported here.
bbf04338787c9c9735fc6182daf30aa6cc23952e.result: The hybrid ANN-geostatistics model produces reasonable spatiotemporal groundwater level maps; numbers not reported here.
bbf04338787c9c9735fc6182daf30aa6cc23952e.open_work: Including pumping and seawater intrusion processes and testing other aquifers.
bbf04338787c9c9735fc6182daf30aa6cc23952e.issues: No abstract available; case study with limited wells; interpolation errors compound ANN errors.

d62a80e234b3e5a69556915aae330f4be9952444.goal: Builds a global monthly climatology of surface ocean CO2 fugacity from sparse ship observations.
d62a80e234b3e5a69556915aae330f4be9952444.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) mapping fCO2 from oceanographic predictors and position/time.
d62a80e234b3e5a69556915aae330f4be9952444.data: Surface ocean fCO2 observations from the SOCAT database with predictors such as SST, salinity and chlorophyll.
d62a80e234b3e5a69556915aae330f4be9952444.result: Produces a global gridded monthly fCO2 climatology that reproduces observations reasonably; error statistics not reported here.
d62a80e234b3e5a69556915aae330f4be9952444.open_work: Interannual variability mapping and use for air–sea CO2 flux estimates.
d62a80e234b3e5a69556915aae330f4be9952444.issues: Sparse sampling in the Southern Ocean and other regions limits reliability there; no abstract available.

385168cd0573fb9136e00e01c3c60df04398d897.goal: Predicts extreme rainfall events by recognizing associated large-scale weather patterns.
385168cd0573fb9136e00e01c3c60df04398d897.architecture: Support vector machine classifier on large-scale atmospheric pattern predictors.
385168cd0573fb9136e00e01c3c60df04398d897.data: Reanalysis atmospheric fields and station rainfall for an Indian region; details not reported here.
385168cd0573fb9136e00e01c3c60df04398d897.result: The SVM classifier identifies extreme-rainfall-producing patterns with useful skill; numbers not reported here.
385168cd0573fb9136e00e01c3c60df04398d897.open_work: Probabilistic outputs and application to forecast model fields for operational use.
385168cd0573fb9136e00e01c3c60df04398d897.issues: No abstract available; extremes are rare, so class imbalance and false alarms are concerns.

1f1fcce84dd830c1d0ff2eb059721e9c32a52805.goal: Detects flooded areas from SAR imagery, which works under clouds but is hampered by speckle and similar backscatter of water-like surfaces.
1f1fcce84dd830c1d0ff2eb059721e9c32a52805.architecture: Siamese vision transformer with a differential attention metric for change-detection-style flood mapping (DAM-Net).
1f1fcce84dd830c1d0ff2eb059721e9c32a52805.data: Sentinel-1 SAR pre- and post-flood image pairs from a global flood dataset; details not confirmed here.
1f1fcce84dd830c1d0ff2eb059721e9c32a52805.result: Reports improved flood detection accuracy over competing CNN and transformer methods; numbers not reported here.
1f1fcce84dd830c1d0ff2eb059721e9c32a52805.open_work: Generalization to other SAR sensors and to urban or vegetated flooding.
1f1fcce84dd830c1d0ff2eb059721e9c32a52805.issues: No abstract available; SAR struggles with flooded vegetation and urban areas.

d387e1a096bc12eb79242b8aa437c82a94b157e6.goal: Forecasts precipitation at specific regions of Greece with artificial neural networks.
d387e1a096bc12eb79242b8aa437c82a94b157e6.data: Long-term precipitation records from Greek meteorological stations; details not reported here.
d387e1a096bc12eb79242b8aa437c82a94b157e6.result: Reports that ANNs give acceptable precipitation forecasts; numbers not reported here.
d387e1a096bc12eb79242b8aa437c82a94b157e6.open_work: Adding large-scale predictors and comparing with other statistical methods.
d387e1a096bc12eb79242b8aa437c82a94b157e6.issues: No abstract available; station-based, few sites, no uncertainty estimates.

06ce50525ea0caf5496e176dc0de623c1417b55c.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration in an arid area of northwest China for irrigation planning with limited weather data.
06ce50525ea0caf5496e176dc0de623c1417b55c.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type) models with different input combinations, compared with empirical equations.
06ce50525ea0caf5496e176dc0de623c1417b55c.data: Meteorological station data in arid northwest China with FAO-56 Penman–Monteith ET0 as target; details not reported here.
06ce50525ea0caf5496e176dc0de623c1417b55c.result: ANNs estimate ET0 more accurately than empirical methods under limited inputs; numbers not reported here.
06ce50525ea0caf5496e176dc0de623c1417b55c.open_work: Testing across more stations and climates.
06ce50525ea0caf5496e176dc0de623c1417b55c.issues: No abstract available; targets are computed ET0, not lysimeter measurements.

a5a463c41b1ade93e78a529a946dc44b4bf8b10b.goal: Improves wind speed prediction with a hybrid neural computing model.
a5a463c41b1ade93e78a529a946dc44b4bf8b10b.architecture: Hybrid neural network model; the specific combination of networks is not confirmed here.
a5a463c41b1ade93e78a529a946dc44b4bf8b10b.data: Wind speed and meteorological time series; site and period not reported here.
a5a463c41b1ade93e78a529a946dc44b4bf8b10b.result: The hybrid model reduces prediction error relative to single networks; numbers not reported here.
a5a463c41b1ade93e78a529a946dc44b4bf8b10b.issues: No abstract available; data and evaluation details are unknown.

df8b4ce500154db927f8da12e032cb6776b7fcac.goal: Models daily pan evaporation across different climatic zones with neural computing.
df8b4ce500154db927f8da12e032cb6776b7fcac.architecture: Neural network models (MLP-type and related neural computing approaches); exact variants not confirmed here.
df8b4ce500154db927f8da12e032cb6776b7fcac.data: Meteorological station data from different climatic zones; details not reported here.
df8b4ce500154db927f8da12e032cb6776b7fcac.result: Neural models estimate pan evaporation acceptably, with performance varying by climate; numbers not reported here.
df8b4ce500154db927f8da12e032cb6776b7fcac.open_work: Cross-station transfer and inclusion of more climate regimes.
df8b4ce500154db927f8da12e032cb6776b7fcac.issues: No abstract available; pan measurements carry their own errors.

e192a0866d9eaf3052ecf011b18862e8d25e156a.goal: Estimates weather-related outages in power distribution systems to aid utility planning.
e192a0866d9eaf3052ecf011b18862e8d25e156a.architecture: AdaBoost+, a modified AdaBoost boosting ensemble for regression of outage counts.
e192a0866d9eaf3052ecf011b18862e8d25e156a.data: Historical outage records and weather data (e.g., wind, lightning) for a utility service area; details not reported here.
e192a0866d9eaf3052ecf011b18862e8d25e156a.result: AdaBoost+ estimates outages more accurately than baseline regression and neural approaches; numbers not reported here.
e192a0866d9eaf3052ecf011b18862e8d25e156a.open_work: Forecasting with predicted weather and extension to other utilities.
e192a0866d9eaf3052ecf011b18862e8d25e156a.issues: No abstract available; utility-specific data; extreme storms are rare in training.

9a4496c81be25316b427ea7d8cb52f3a08cc07d8.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration from air temperature only, for subtropical Iran where full weather data are scarce.
9a4496c81be25316b427ea7d8cb52f3a08cc07d8.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) using air temperature (and extraterrestrial radiation) inputs, compared with the Hargreaves equation.
9a4496c81be25316b427ea7d8cb52f3a08cc07d8.data: Meteorological station data in a subtropical region of Iran with Penman–Monteith ET0 as reference; details not reported here.
9a4496c81be25316b427ea7d8cb52f3a08cc07d8.result: The temperature-based ANN outperforms the Hargreaves equation; numbers not reported here.
9a4496c81be25316b427ea7d8cb52f3a08cc07d8.open_work: Transfer to other climates and addition of humidity or wind proxies.
9a4496c81be25316b427ea7d8cb52f3a08cc07d8.issues: No abstract available; reference ET0 is computed rather than measured.

c5736888198ac233738eca8a57dbfdb044bd610c.goal: Forecasts solar irradiance in the tropics, where frequent convective clouds make forecasting difficult.
c5736888198ac233738eca8a57dbfdb044bd610c.architecture: Hybrid of exponential smoothing state space (ESSS) time-series model and artificial neural network using satellite-derived cloud information.
c5736888198ac233738eca8a57dbfdb044bd610c.data: Satellite imagery-derived cloud cover indices and ground irradiance measurements in Singapore.
c5736888198ac233738eca8a57dbfdb044bd610c.result: The hybrid ESSS/ANN model improves irradiance forecasts over individual models; numbers not reported here.
c5736888198ac233738eca8a57dbfdb044bd610c.open_work: Higher-resolution cloud motion and probabilistic forecasting.
c5736888198ac233738eca8a57dbfdb044bd610c.issues: No abstract available; single tropical location; short-term horizons only.

dd8e63a33274c74e7ac48175a5d866aff95d390c.goal: Generates synthetic daily global solar radiation where ground measurements are lacking.
dd8e63a33274c74e7ac48175a5d866aff95d390c.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) mapping ERA-Interim reanalysis variables to daily global solar radiation.
dd8e63a33274c74e7ac48175a5d866aff95d390c.data: ERA-Interim reanalysis variables as inputs and ground radiometric station measurements (southern Spain) for training and validation.
dd8e63a33274c74e7ac48175a5d866aff95d390c.result: The ANN produces daily radiation estimates with improved accuracy over reanalysis radiation; numbers not reported here.
dd8e63a33274c74e7ac48175a5d866aff95d390c.open_work: Application to other regions and newer reanalyses.
dd8e63a33274c74e7ac48175a5d866aff95d390c.issues: No abstract available; inherits reanalysis biases; daily resolution only.

3ff87eceb619cce3dd9a7ff6e2e1ca8420ee65c9.goal: Forecasts wind speed one day ahead for wind energy operation.
3ff87eceb619cce3dd9a7ff6e2e1ca8420ee65c9.architecture: Resampling-based (bootstrap-type) ensemble forecasting approach; the base model type is not specified here.
3ff87eceb619cce3dd9a7ff6e2e1ca8420ee65c9.data: Wind speed time series from wind farm site(s); details not reported here.
3ff87eceb619cce3dd9a7ff6e2e1ca8420ee65c9.result: The resampling approach improves day-ahead accuracy over benchmarks; numbers not reported here.
3ff87eceb619cce3dd9a7ff6e2e1ca8420ee65c9.open_work: Probabilistic evaluation and use of NWP inputs.
3ff87eceb619cce3dd9a7ff6e2e1ca8420ee65c9.issues: No abstract available; method and data details uncertain.

d49aebece24dfc312a4e2fd0166185631670e8cf.goal: Forecasts daily river flow in Sohu Stream, Turkey.
d49aebece24dfc312a4e2fd0166185631670e8cf.architecture: M5 model tree (piecewise linear regression tree); comparison models are not specified here.
d49aebece24dfc312a4e2fd0166185631670e8cf.data: Daily river flow records from Sohu Stream, Turkey; period not reported here.
d49aebece24dfc312a4e2fd0166185631670e8cf.result: M5 model tree gives accurate daily flow forecasts with interpretable rules; numbers not reported here.
d49aebece24dfc312a4e2fd0166185631670e8cf.open_work: Testing other streams and longer lead times.

c968bfec42525fd333d646a68543c5e33e15ac87.goal: Downscales coarse satellite precipitation to 1 km for hydrologic and environmental applications.
c968bfec42525fd333d646a68543c5e33e15ac87.architecture: Compares CART regression tree, k-nearest neighbors, support vector machine and random forest regression using land surface predictors.
c968bfec42525fd333d646a68543c5e33e15ac87.data: Monthly TRMM 3B43 V7 (25 km) over North China; MODIS LST (day, night, difference), NDVI, DEM and geolocation; validation with meteorological stations.
c968bfec42525fd333d646a68543c5e33e15ac87.result: Random forest is most accurate, followed by SVM, CART and k-NN; accuracy is lower in July–September; LST features are more important than NDVI.
c968bfec42525fd333d646a68543c5e33e15ac87.open_work: Daily downscaling and use of newer products such as GPM IMERG.
c968bfec42525fd333d646a68543c5e33e15ac87.issues: Errors grow with precipitation amount; SVM depends on residual correction; monthly scale only.

137d94deeb9d8d6e14890b21b915fe3201ee919e.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the Vu Gia-Thu Bon basin, Vietnam, combining machine learning with physically based hydrological modeling.
137d94deeb9d8d6e14890b21b915fe3201ee919e.architecture: Random forest, LightGBM and CatBoost (tree ensembles / gradient boosting) compared with the RRI rainfall-runoff-inundation model.
137d94deeb9d8d6e14890b21b915fe3201ee919e.data: Inventory of about 850 flood sites from post-flood surveys, ten conditioning factors; 70/30 train-test split; different training sizes tested.
137d94deeb9d8d6e14890b21b915fe3201ee919e.result: AUC-ROC of 97.9% (CatBoost), 99.5% (LightGBM) and 99.5% (RF); 10–13% of the area highly susceptible, consistent with RRI maps.
137d94deeb9d8d6e14890b21b915fe3201ee919e.open_work: Dynamic, event-based susceptibility and transfer to other basins.
137d94deeb9d8d6e14890b21b915fe3201ee919e.issues: Very high AUC may reflect spatial autocorrelation in random splits; susceptibility is static.

4c16317c10e3a6671746ae8a363867377ff8a508.goal: Reviews AI techniques for rainfall forecasting with emphasis on Thailand, where rainfall drives agriculture and water resources.
4c16317c10e3a6671746ae8a363867377ff8a508.architecture: Review of machine learning, artificial neural networks and deep learning models for rainfall forecasting, including hybrid wavelet and bootstrap approaches.
4c16317c10e3a6671746ae8a363867377ff8a508.data: Literature published 2000–2022 from academic search libraries, Thai and worldwide applications.
4c16317c10e3a6671746ae8a363867377ff8a508.result: Concludes that hybrid models combining ANNs with wavelet transformation and bootstrapping can improve rainfall forecast accuracy in Thailand.
4c16317c10e3a6671746ae8a363867377ff8a508.open_work: Benchmark comparisons on common Thai datasets and integration with numerical weather prediction.
4c16317c10e3a6671746ae8a363867377ff8a508.issues: Narrative review; conclusions depend on heterogeneous studies with different data and metrics.

ebc944472d4e81103b11e2490766820953017307.goal: Models reference evapotranspiration equations with extreme learning machine to estimate ET0 with less computation.
ebc944472d4e81103b11e2490766820953017307.architecture: Extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer feedforward network) compared with other soft-computing models.
ebc944472d4e81103b11e2490766820953017307.data: Meteorological station data and ET0 from several empirical equations; locations (Serbia) not confirmed here.
ebc944472d4e81103b11e2490766820953017307.result: ELM reproduces ET0 equations accurately; numbers not reported here.
ebc944472d4e81103b11e2490766820953017307.open_work: Validation against lysimeter measurements and more climates.
ebc944472d4e81103b11e2490766820953017307.issues: No abstract available; targets are empirical-equation outputs rather than measured ET.

eead25ef3a97786eb04892b87aae8a1713ff91ee.goal: Improves sea surface temperature forecasts by combining numerical ocean model output with neural networks.
eead25ef3a97786eb04892b87aae8a1713ff91ee.architecture: Neural network (MLP-type) used to correct or complement numerical model SST forecasts.
eead25ef3a97786eb04892b87aae8a1713ff91ee.data: Numerical model SST forecasts and observed SST at locations in the Indian Ocean; details not reported here.
eead25ef3a97786eb04892b87aae8a1713ff91ee.result: The combined numerical-neural approach improves SST forecast accuracy over the numerical model alone; numbers not reported here.
eead25ef3a97786eb04892b87aae8a1713ff91ee.open_work: Spatially extended correction and longer lead times.
eead25ef3a97786eb04892b87aae8a1713ff91ee.issues: No abstract available; point-based correction may not generalize spatially.

63c1d4741a97fa3ab7f3eb69ceac5207f1d8586b.goal: Forecasts monthly streamflow in Iran using machine learning applied to dynamic weather prediction model outputs.
63c1d4741a97fa3ab7f3eb69ceac5207f1d8586b.architecture: Machine learning regression models; the specific types are not specified here.
63c1d4741a97fa3ab7f3eb69ceac5207f1d8586b.data: Monthly streamflow observations in Iranian basins and dynamical seasonal forecast model outputs; details not reported here.
63c1d4741a97fa3ab7f3eb69ceac5207f1d8586b.result: Machine learning post-processing of dynamical predictions yields skillful monthly streamflow forecasts; numbers not reported here.
63c1d4741a97fa3ab7f3eb69ceac5207f1d8586b.issues: No abstract available; skill depends on dynamical model forecast quality.

49e3ddb80a7139b9f13b4ed6e1fab31ddf5ed989.goal: Predicts rainfall across an altitudinal gradient in the data-limited North-Western Himalayas, important for monsoon-dependent agriculture and disaster preparedness.
49e3ddb80a7139b9f13b4ed6e1fab31ddf5ed989.architecture: Compares random forest, SVR, ANN (MLP), k-NN, LSTM, bidirectional LSTM, deep LSTM, GRU, simple RNN, ARIMA and TBATS.
49e3ddb80a7139b9f13b4ed6e1fab31ddf5ed989.data: Meteorological data from six weather stations at different elevations, 1980–2021.
49e3ddb80a7139b9f13b4ed6e1fab31ddf5ed989.result: Deep learning is most accurate (BiLSTM best, then LSTM, RNN, deep LSTM, GRU), followed by ML (ANN, KNN, SVR, RF) and time series models; altitude affects accuracy.
49e3ddb80a7139b9f13b4ed6e1fab31ddf5ed989.open_work: Denser station networks in mountainous terrain and inclusion of large-scale predictors.
49e3ddb80a7139b9f13b4ed6e1fab31ddf5ed989.issues: Only six stations; station-based time series without spatial or physical predictors; no uncertainty estimates.

c581b9a130d005f2d6a6f6f16c6470e7cda4f223.goal: Downscales extreme rainfall indices on the east coast of Peninsular Malaysia for climate change assessment.
c581b9a130d005f2d6a6f6f16c6470e7cda4f223.architecture: Genetic programming-based logistic regression, compared with multilayer perceptron neural network and SDSM linear regression downscaling.
c581b9a130d005f2d6a6f6f16c6470e7cda4f223.data: NCEP reanalysis predictors at 42 grid points; daily station rainfall 1961–1990 for calibration and 1991–2000 for validation.
c581b9a130d005f2d6a6f6f16c6470e7cda4f223.result: GP predicts annual and seasonal extreme rainfall indices more accurately than ANN and SDSM.
c581b9a130d005f2d6a6f6f16c6470e7cda4f223.open_work: Application to GCM projections to estimate future extreme rainfall changes.
c581b9a130d005f2d6a6f6f16c6470e7cda4f223.issues: Single region; evaluation on reanalysis-driven downscaling only; stationarity of predictor relations assumed.

f2a49dd5e41b305f544d35771a11cb44cd5df14c.goal: Identifies patterns of the Loop Current system and regions of sea surface height variability in the eastern Gulf of Mexico.
f2a49dd5e41b305f544d35771a11cb44cd5df14c.architecture: Self-organizing maps (unsupervised neural network) for pattern extraction.
f2a49dd5e41b305f544d35771a11cb44cd5df14c.data: Satellite altimetry sea surface height fields over the eastern Gulf of Mexico; period not reported here.
f2a49dd5e41b305f544d35771a11cb44cd5df14c.result: SOM reveals characteristic Loop Current configurations and distinct regions of SSH variability; details not reported here.
f2a49dd5e41b305f544d35771a11cb44cd5df14c.open_work: Linking patterns to eddy shedding prediction and shelf impacts.
f2a49dd5e41b305f544d35771a11cb44cd5df14c.issues: No abstract available; altimetry resolution limits small-scale features; descriptive rather than predictive.

94899523353e046bc0be960bfc8be4ad1508e044.goal: Forecasts maximum daily total precipitation at Athens, Greece, relevant to flood risk.
94899523353e046bc0be960bfc8be4ad1508e044.data: Long-term daily precipitation records from Athens; period not reported here.
94899523353e046bc0be960bfc8be4ad1508e044.result: ANN forecasts reproduce maximum daily precipitation with acceptable accuracy; numbers not reported here.
94899523353e046bc0be960bfc8be4ad1508e044.open_work: Inclusion of atmospheric predictors and testing at other stations.
94899523353e046bc0be960bfc8be4ad1508e044.issues: No abstract available; single station; extremes are few in the training data.

693f346ed6675009c1aaf90756d2eb3f74ddb31f.goal: Improves wind power forecasting accuracy for grid integration.
693f346ed6675009c1aaf90756d2eb3f74ddb31f.architecture: Hybrid system: time-series refining (decomposition/denoising), deep learning optimized with a nonlinear multi-objective algorithm, and linear error correction.
693f346ed6675009c1aaf90756d2eb3f74ddb31f.data: Wind power time series from wind farm(s); details not reported here.
693f346ed6675009c1aaf90756d2eb3f74ddb31f.result: The integrated system outperforms benchmark models; numbers not reported here.
693f346ed6675009c1aaf90756d2eb3f74ddb31f.open_work: Probabilistic extensions and use of NWP inputs.
693f346ed6675009c1aaf90756d2eb3f74ddb31f.issues: No abstract available; complex hybrid pipelines risk decomposition leakage and overfitting.

903cbe8b40b1627aa259a932e5e76b4b13d67478.goal: Reviews AI methods for wind speed forecasting, which is needed for grid stability given wind intermittency and fast-growing wind energy production.
903cbe8b40b1627aa259a932e5e76b4b13d67478.architecture: Review that classifies recent forecasting models by input type, pre- and post-processing technique, artificial neural network model, prediction horizon, steps ahead and evaluation metric; covers statistical, hybrid and ANN approaches.
903cbe8b40b1627aa259a932e5e76b4b13d67478.data: Literature survey of published wind speed forecasting studies; no new dataset.
903cbe8b40b1627aa259a932e5e76b4b13d67478.result: Concludes that ANN-based and hybrid models can provide accurate wind speed forecasts and useful site-specific information for wind power plant planning.
903cbe8b40b1627aa259a932e5e76b4b13d67478.open_work: Identifying the main factors that drive forecast skill and establishing a common basis for selecting ANN configurations remain open.
903cbe8b40b1627aa259a932e5e76b4b13d67478.issues: Review without a unified benchmark, so reported accuracies across studies are not directly comparable; focus on ANNs may under-represent newer deep learning architectures.

e8ac94ab18b625a2c64106ba7e8a617a985dc557.goal: Reviews in-situ, remote sensing and machine learning approaches for estimating soil moisture, a key variable for hydrology, agriculture and earth system studies.
e8ac94ab18b625a2c64106ba7e8a617a985dc557.architecture: Review with bibliometric analysis plus a comparison of ten widely used machine learning models (random forest is the most used in the literature); discusses physics-informed ML and AutoML.
e8ac94ab18b625a2c64106ba7e8a617a985dc557.data: Bibliometric corpus of soil moisture literature; a public dataset of in-situ soil moisture measurements and satellite images for the model comparison; discusses upcoming NISAR SAR data.
e8ac94ab18b625a2c64106ba7e8a617a985dc557.result: Finds TDR is the most used in-situ instrument, remote sensing the preferred application and random forest the most applied algorithm for surface soil moisture.
e8ac94ab18b625a2c64106ba7e8a617a985dc557.open_work: Exploiting NISAR SAR imagery and physics-informed and AutoML models to estimate surface soil moisture at higher spatial and temporal resolution.
e8ac94ab18b625a2c64106ba7e8a617a985dc557.issues: Model comparison uses a single public dataset, so generalization of the ranking is uncertain; review scope is broad rather than deep.

09c8912257df3ca41aa4a5df5809511ab3e784fb.goal: Estimates daily pan evaporation in Khuzestan Province, south-western Iran, using artificial intelligence techniques with both measured and estimated climatic inputs.
09c8912257df3ca41aa4a5df5809511ab3e784fb.architecture: Artificial intelligence data-driven models; the specific model families are not specified here.
09c8912257df3ca41aa4a5df5809511ab3e784fb.data: Daily climatic records from weather stations in Khuzestan Province, Iran; details not reported.
09c8912257df3ca41aa4a5df5809511ab3e784fb.open_work: Testing transferability to other stations and climates and quantifying how estimated (rather than measured) inputs affect accuracy.
09c8912257df3ca41aa4a5df5809511ab3e784fb.issues: Regional single-province study; abstract unavailable, so model details and performance cannot be confirmed.

9e1257ca8dae11e42cc2ac033dc8e3c25a31ea92.goal: Forecasts weekly and monthly rainfall at the Klang River basin, Malaysia, testing whether a dynamic neural network capturing temporal dependence beats static networks.
9e1257ca8dae11e42cc2ac033dc8e3c25a31ea92.architecture: Compares two static networks, a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) and a radial basis function neural network (RBFNN), with a dynamic input delay neural network (IDNN).
9e1257ca8dae11e42cc2ac033dc8e3c25a31ea92.data: Klang River rain records: 12 years (1997–2008) of weekly data and 22 years (1987–2008) of monthly data.
9e1257ca8dae11e42cc2ac033dc8e3c25a31ea92.result: MLP follows rainfall trends but not accurately; RBFNN beats MLP; IDNN gives the best accuracy in training and testing, with consistent skill on unseen data.
9e1257ca8dae11e42cc2ac033dc8e3c25a31ea92.open_work: Testing recurrent architectures and additional climate predictors, and extending to other basins and shorter horizons.
9e1257ca8dae11e42cc2ac033dc8e3c25a31ea92.issues: Single basin and short records; no uncertainty quantification; quantitative error values are not stated in the abstract.

a8c552a73d875a4732a55b6cf96e5564ec1372c5.goal: Applies an artificial neural network to river flow forecasting in a developing-country catchment where data and modelling resources are limited.
a8c552a73d875a4732a55b6cf96e5564ec1372c5.architecture: Artificial neural network; the specific network type is not specified here.
a8c552a73d875a4732a55b6cf96e5564ec1372c5.data: River flow and related hydrometeorological records from a catchment in a developing country; details not reported.
a8c552a73d875a4732a55b6cf96e5564ec1372c5.open_work: Comparison with conceptual hydrological models and extension to longer lead times and other data-scarce basins.
a8c552a73d875a4732a55b6cf96e5564ec1372c5.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-catchment data-driven study with likely limited data length and no uncertainty quantification reported.

c9f2b3fee2f26d146f85c93c0bc6cb35405034e5.goal: Revisits climate classification from a data-driven perspective, asking whether unsupervised clustering reproduces or improves on the heuristic Köppen–Geiger zones.
c9f2b3fee2f26d146f85c93c0bc6cb35405034e5.architecture: Unsupervised k-means clustering of combined climate and remotely sensed vegetation variables, with a cluster-stability analysis; compared against the Köppen–Geiger classification.
c9f2b3fee2f26d146f85c93c0bc6cb35405034e5.data: Global gridded climate variables and remotely sensed vegetation variables; specific products not reported in the abstract.
c9f2b3fee2f26d146f85c93c0bc6cb35405034e5.result: k-means clearly outperforms classical climate classifications statistically, but stability analysis gives a meaningful number of clusters only when both climate and vegetation data are used.
c9f2b3fee2f26d146f85c93c0bc6cb35405034e5.open_work: Future classification schemes should be assessed with data-driven approaches; explaining vegetation from climate alone remains unresolved.
c9f2b3fee2f26d146f85c93c0bc6cb35405034e5.issues: k-means assumes spherical clusters and depends on variable scaling and choice of k; results depend on chosen input variables.

2772d531c937347e18462d99c039e464035f6f8a.goal: Predicts monthly rainfall over homogeneous monsoon regions of India from large-scale ocean-atmosphere circulation patterns.
2772d531c937347e18462d99c039e464035f6f8a.architecture: Genetic programming (symbolic regression) linking large-scale climate indices to regional monthly rainfall.
2772d531c937347e18462d99c039e464035f6f8a.data: Monthly rainfall for homogeneous Indian monsoon regions and large-scale circulation indices (ENSO and equatorial Indian Ocean indices); periods not reported here.
2772d531c937347e18462d99c039e464035f6f8a.result: Genetic programming models capture rainfall variability with useful skill using circulation predictors; exact metrics not reported here.
2772d531c937347e18462d99c039e464035f6f8a.open_work: Adding further climate drivers and extending to longer lead times and finer spatial scales.
2772d531c937347e18462d99c039e464035f6f8a.issues: Abstract unavailable; monthly rainfall predictability from indices is modest and may not hold for extremes or under nonstationary teleconnections.

a8b8364dda05ec1539a4e321af3b89746d9cd7ce.goal: Builds a long, cloud-independent global flood extent record to support flood monitoring and disaster response, since global multi-year flood datasets are scarce.
a8b8364dda05ec1539a4e321af3b89746d9cd7ce.architecture: Deep learning flood segmentation model applied to Sentinel-1 SAR imagery; network type not specified in the abstract.
a8b8364dda05ec1539a4e321af3b89746d9cd7ce.data: Ten years of global Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar imagery; case studies in Ethiopia and the May 2024 Kenya floods.
a8b8364dda05ec1539a4e321af3b89746d9cd7ce.result: Produces a public decade-long global flood extent dataset unaffected by cloud cover, reveals historically flood-prone areas missed by prior datasets and hints at increasing global flood extent.
a8b8364dda05ec1539a4e321af3b89746d9cd7ce.open_work: Further validation of flood extent trends and their links to climate change; operational use for real-time disaster response.
a8b8364dda05ec1539a4e321af3b89746d9cd7ce.issues: Trend signal is tentative and needs validation; SAR flood detection has known difficulties in urban and vegetated areas; Sentinel-1 revisit limits capture of short floods.

671b7e582a207705a42559d128d6edd732858ed8.goal: Models solar radiation in the Mediterranean region of Turkey for solar energy applications where radiation measurements are sparse.
671b7e582a207705a42559d128d6edd732858ed8.architecture: Fuzzy genetic approach (fuzzy logic model optimized by a genetic algorithm), compared with other models not detailed here.
671b7e582a207705a42559d128d6edd732858ed8.data: Meteorological station data from the Mediterranean region of Turkey; details not reported.
671b7e582a207705a42559d128d6edd732858ed8.open_work: Testing the fuzzy genetic model in other climate regions and at finer temporal resolution.
671b7e582a207705a42559d128d6edd732858ed8.issues: Abstract unavailable; regional station-based study whose spatial transferability is unclear.

e39aa921e82d752826bd3b260a15a72f5f95e708.goal: Estimates changes in lake water level using artificial intelligence methods to support water resources management.
e39aa921e82d752826bd3b260a15a72f5f95e708.architecture: Artificial intelligence data-driven methods; specific model families are not specified here.
e39aa921e82d752826bd3b260a15a72f5f95e708.data: Lake water level time series; lake and record details not reported.
e39aa921e82d752826bd3b260a15a72f5f95e708.open_work: Extension to longer forecast horizons and inclusion of hydro-climatic drivers.
e39aa921e82d752826bd3b260a15a72f5f95e708.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-lake data-driven study with limited generalization and no uncertainty reported.

ec60c442bdaa886382bc95ddc25e3782dd58081e.goal: Predicts monthly total water storage (TWS) changes over West Africa, where hydrological models perform poorly due to data scarcity, and bridges GRACE data gaps.
ec60c442bdaa886382bc95ddc25e3782dd58081e.architecture: Statistical data-driven approach: independent component analysis to extract teleconnection modes, linked by low-degree autoregressive models (non-neural method).
ec60c442bdaa886382bc95ddc25e3782dd58081e.data: GRACE gravity-derived TWS, TRMM rainfall and sea surface temperature over the Atlantic, Pacific and Indian Oceans; 72-month learning phase.
ec60c442bdaa886382bc95ddc25e3782dd58081e.result: Predicted TWS fits GRACE better than a global hydrological model: 79% and 67% fit for the annual and inter-annual modes in year one, 62% and 57% in year two.
ec60c442bdaa886382bc95ddc25e3782dd58081e.open_work: Bridging GRACE gaps and the GRACE to GRACE-FO gap, and near-real-time GRACE forecasts in regions with strong teleconnections.
ec60c442bdaa886382bc95ddc25e3782dd58081e.issues: Linear statistical framework relies on stationary teleconnections; short training record; skill degrades with lead time.

aac7d5288589a0daeef30b60c2c3838fe76ef1a4.goal: Forecasts monthly rainfall with a hybrid wavelet neural network model that selects inputs by mutual information and optimizes parameters with particle swarm optimization.
aac7d5288589a0daeef30b60c2c3838fe76ef1a4.architecture: Hybrid wavelet neural network with mutual information input selection and particle swarm optimization.
aac7d5288589a0daeef30b60c2c3838fe76ef1a4.data: Monthly rainfall records; study region and period not reported here.
aac7d5288589a0daeef30b60c2c3838fe76ef1a4.open_work: Testing on other regions and incorporating large-scale climate predictors.
aac7d5288589a0daeef30b60c2c3838fe76ef1a4.issues: Abstract unavailable; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if not applied carefully in forecasting mode.

56477999778c39f6a24d9fefbffb3620ba38cd8a.goal: Forecasts Great Lakes water levels, important for navigation, hydropower and shoreline management, using a reservoir computing approach.
56477999778c39f6a24d9fefbffb3620ba38cd8a.architecture: Reservoir computing (echo state network, a type of recurrent neural network), compared with other neural network models.
56477999778c39f6a24d9fefbffb3620ba38cd8a.data: Historical Great Lakes water level records with climate-related inputs; details not reported.
56477999778c39f6a24d9fefbffb3620ba38cd8a.result: Reservoir computing gives competitive or better water level forecasts than the benchmark networks; exact metrics not reported here.
56477999778c39f6a24d9fefbffb3620ba38cd8a.open_work: Longer horizons and use of climate forecasts as inputs.
56477999778c39f6a24d9fefbffb3620ba38cd8a.issues: Abstract unavailable; data-driven model may not capture regime shifts or long-term climate-driven changes in lake levels.

30aa24169abfcdca34131b031d0ac678ed4c6de4.goal: Infers vertical profiles of the particulate backscattering coefficient (bbp) by merging satellite ocean color products with Argo temperature-salinity profiles.
30aa24169abfcdca34131b031d0ac678ed4c6de4.architecture: Neural network (MLP) method SOCA-BBP using satellite surface bbp and chlorophyll a, Argo-derived physical profiles and day of year.
30aa24169abfcdca34131b031d0ac678ed4c6de4.data: 4725 concurrent Bio-Argo profiles with satellite ocean color matchups; independent validation with four Bio-Argo floats and an AMT cruise (2009).
30aa24169abfcdca34131b031d0ac678ed4c6de4.result: Global error of 21% on held-out data; independent tests confirm robustness; produces a depth-resolved global bbp climatology.
30aa24169abfcdca34131b031d0ac678ed4c6de4.open_work: Extending to other bio-optical variables and using real-time Argo data for 3D biogeochemical fields.
30aa24169abfcdca34131b031d0ac678ed4c6de4.issues: Limited to open ocean; depends on satellite matchup quality and cloud gaps; training data unevenly sample regions and seasons.

f3cd9205f3b151e07aff546b5d495d523d872569.goal: Assesses flash flood susceptibility using ensemble machine learning combined with wrapper-based feature selection.
f3cd9205f3b151e07aff546b5d495d523d872569.architecture: Hybrid ensemble machine learning models with recursive feature elimination (RFE) and Boruta wrapper feature selection; base learner families not specified here.
f3cd9205f3b151e07aff546b5d495d523d872569.data: Flash flood inventory and geo-environmental conditioning factors for a study area; details not reported.
f3cd9205f3b151e07aff546b5d495d523d872569.open_work: Transfer to other basins and integration of dynamic rainfall drivers.
f3cd9205f3b151e07aff546b5d495d523d872569.issues: Abstract unavailable; susceptibility maps are static and depend on inventory quality and spatial autocorrelation in validation.

0426134e7a5c32fcdb02ab8b8643ade3105e03cf.goal: Forecasts average daily and monthly rainfall for Fukuoka, Japan, comparing input selection, modelling methods and pre-processing.
0426134e7a5c32fcdb02ab8b8643ade3105e03cf.architecture: Hybrid multi-model ensemble of artificial neural network (MLP), multivariate adaptive regression splines, k-nearest neighbour and support vector regression, weighted after leave-one-out ranking; moving average and PCA pre-processing.
0426134e7a5c32fcdb02ab8b8643ade3105e03cf.data: Daily and monthly rainfall records for Fukuoka city, Japan; period not reported in the abstract.
0426134e7a5c32fcdb02ab8b8643ade3105e03cf.result: The hybrid method combining top-ranked sub-models is proposed as optimal; quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
0426134e7a5c32fcdb02ab8b8643ade3105e03cf.open_work: Testing the hybrid ensemble at other sites and with additional meteorological predictors.
0426134e7a5c32fcdb02ab8b8643ade3105e03cf.issues: Single city; daily rainfall is hard to predict from its own history; moving-average pre-processing may smooth extremes.

3b2306d12a8c00392c4936a01dac341de9e1d1a7.goal: Estimates 5-minute global solar irradiation on tilted surfaces from horizontal measurements for solar energy applications.
3b2306d12a8c00392c4936a01dac341de9e1d1a7.architecture: Artificial neural network mapping horizontal irradiation and solar geometry to tilted-plane irradiation; the specific network type is not specified here.
3b2306d12a8c00392c4936a01dac341de9e1d1a7.data: 5-minute solar irradiation measurements at a station in Algeria; details not reported here.
3b2306d12a8c00392c4936a01dac341de9e1d1a7.open_work: Testing other tilt angles, sites and climates.
3b2306d12a8c00392c4936a01dac341de9e1d1a7.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-site training limits transferability.

ee6c77dc357a71292061d3a12ed188378508e16e.goal: Predicts precipitation occurrence with support vector classifiers using novel predictive variables and observational data.
ee6c77dc357a71292061d3a12ed188378508e16e.data: Observational meteorological data with newly proposed predictor variables; site and period not reported here.
ee6c77dc357a71292061d3a12ed188378508e16e.open_work: Extension to precipitation amounts and other locations.
ee6c77dc357a71292061d3a12ed188378508e16e.issues: Abstract unavailable; binary classification provides no amount or uncertainty information.

367074017997a529191a68fad0fd626761ae68d5.goal: Improves storm surge forecasts for Venice and the northern Adriatic by combining a dynamic hydrodynamic model with a neural network.
367074017997a529191a68fad0fd626761ae68d5.architecture: Hybrid of a hydrodynamic model and an artificial neural network that corrects the dynamic model forecast errors.
367074017997a529191a68fad0fd626761ae68d5.data: Tide gauge observations and hydrodynamic model forecasts driven by meteorological forcing for the Adriatic Sea and Venice; periods not reported here.
367074017997a529191a68fad0fd626761ae68d5.result: The combined model reduces storm surge forecast errors relative to the dynamic model alone; exact numbers not reported here.
367074017997a529191a68fad0fd626761ae68d5.open_work: Extension to longer lead times and probabilistic forecasts.
367074017997a529191a68fad0fd626761ae68d5.issues: Abstract unavailable; correction depends on the stationarity of model errors and on available extreme events in training.

89fc3527b9ccb0cadf794f0284ceea52e11766f6.goal: Assesses and predicts agricultural drought vulnerability in the drought-prone Barind Tract of Bangladesh.
89fc3527b9ccb0cadf794f0284ceea52e11766f6.architecture: Cellular Automata–Artificial Neural Network (CA-ANN) model to project the Vegetation Health Index built from VCI and TCI.
89fc3527b9ccb0cadf794f0284ceea52e11766f6.data: Landsat imagery 1996–2021 with NDVI, MNDWI, soil moisture content, TCI, VCI and VHI; projections for 2026 and 2031.
89fc3527b9ccb0cadf794f0284ceea52e11766f6.result: Healthy vegetation fell 19% and surface water 26% with >5 °C warming; extreme drought rose from 2% to 7%; projected extreme and severe drought reaches 18% and 24% by 2031.
89fc3527b9ccb0cadf794f0284ceea52e11766f6.open_work: Using projections to plan drought mitigation and community preparedness.
89fc3527b9ccb0cadf794f0284ceea52e11766f6.issues: Projections extrapolate past land-cover trends without climate scenario forcing; validation of future predictions is not possible; Landsat temporal sampling is coarse.

f8ea45c2169e9a0fd2ae0ec719c248f3897cf8cb.goal: Zones flood risk with interpretable classification rules mined by an ant colony optimization algorithm.
f8ea45c2169e9a0fd2ae0ec719c248f3897cf8cb.architecture: Ant colony optimization rule mining (swarm intelligence classifier), not a neural network.
f8ea45c2169e9a0fd2ae0ec719c248f3897cf8cb.data: Flood hazard, exposure and vulnerability indicators for a study region; details not reported.
f8ea45c2169e9a0fd2ae0ec719c248f3897cf8cb.open_work: Comparison with other ML classifiers and application to other regions.
f8ea45c2169e9a0fd2ae0ec719c248f3897cf8cb.issues: Abstract unavailable; risk zoning depends on indicator selection and historical loss data quality.

17fafeabc80fdd48cb0f0f77c600330b6dcb219e.goal: Reviews neural network models for short-term solar irradiance forecasting needed for power system planning and operation.
17fafeabc80fdd48cb0f0f77c600330b6dcb219e.architecture: Review of deep learning forecasters: LSTM, GRU, RNN, CNN, generative adversarial networks, attention mechanisms and hybrid models.
17fafeabc80fdd48cb0f0f77c600330b6dcb219e.result: Deep learning models outperform conventional models, especially with feature extraction enhancements and data augmentation.
17fafeabc80fdd48cb0f0f77c600330b6dcb219e.open_work: Provides baseline guidance for PV power, wind power and electricity consumption forecasting at medium and long term.
17fafeabc80fdd48cb0f0f77c600330b6dcb219e.issues: Review without standardized benchmarking across studies.

24042765914ac593de942199dd7f8a358c49ef1a.goal: Improves prediction of low-flow indices in ungaged basins, needed for water supply and ecological flow management.
24042765914ac593de942199dd7f8a358c49ef1a.architecture: Machine learning regression methods compared with traditional regional regression; specific families not specified here.
24042765914ac593de942199dd7f8a358c49ef1a.data: Streamgage low-flow statistics and basin characteristics; region not reported here.
24042765914ac593de942199dd7f8a358c49ef1a.open_work: Extension to other flow statistics and regions.
24042765914ac593de942199dd7f8a358c49ef1a.issues: Abstract unavailable; ungaged predictions depend on representativeness of gaged training basins.

228dfb1bdf42e19ed1e8e06c49e69814391b7a54.goal: Forecasts short-term wind power from wind farm SCADA data.
228dfb1bdf42e19ed1e8e06c49e69814391b7a54.architecture: Wavelet decomposition combined with LSTM recurrent neural network.
228dfb1bdf42e19ed1e8e06c49e69814391b7a54.data: Wind farm SCADA data; site and period not reported here.
228dfb1bdf42e19ed1e8e06c49e69814391b7a54.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and inclusion of NWP inputs.
228dfb1bdf42e19ed1e8e06c49e69814391b7a54.issues: Abstract unavailable; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if applied to the full series.

db67bd715805df0af66b43f701f241858280f5ac.goal: Assesses solar radiation resource and photovoltaic power potential across China.
db67bd715805df0af66b43f701f241858280f5ac.architecture: Optimized interpretable machine learning model combined with GIS analysis; model family not specified here.
db67bd715805df0af66b43f701f241858280f5ac.data: Meteorological station data across China with GIS layers; details not reported.
db67bd715805df0af66b43f701f241858280f5ac.open_work: Higher-resolution mapping and incorporating land-use constraints.
db67bd715805df0af66b43f701f241858280f5ac.issues: Abstract unavailable; station interpolation may miss local variability.

282975c9610b9021c5aa8ab0a92eba8ad02edff5.goal: Develops deterministic and interval forecasts of particulate matter for early warning in the Yangtze River Delta, China.
282975c9610b9021c5aa8ab0a92eba8ad02edff5.architecture: Distribution fitting with AI-optimized parameters plus an adaptive neuro-fuzzy (ANF) model for deterministic forecasts, combined into interval forecasts.
282975c9610b9021c5aa8ab0a92eba8ad02edff5.data: Hourly and 12 h-averaged air pollutant observations in the Yangtze River Delta region.
282975c9610b9021c5aa8ab0a92eba8ad02edff5.result: Lognormal or gamma distributions fit PM data with R² ≈ 0.998; deterministic and interval forecasts are accurate by MSE, MAPE, coverage probability and average width.
282975c9610b9021c5aa8ab0a92eba8ad02edff5.open_work: Adding meteorological predictors and extending to other pollutants and regions.
282975c9610b9021c5aa8ab0a92eba8ad02edff5.issues: Statistical forecasting without meteorology or emissions may fail during unusual episodes.

6a3869fd6fb59df7481683679ce06b9d4c1a23ed.goal: Forecasts maize yield in Jilin Province, China.
6a3869fd6fb59df7481683679ce06b9d4c1a23ed.architecture: Linear regression compared with artificial neural networks.
6a3869fd6fb59df7481683679ce06b9d4c1a23ed.data: Maize yield and predictor data for Jilin; details not reported.
6a3869fd6fb59df7481683679ce06b9d4c1a23ed.open_work: Adding remote sensing predictors and testing at finer scales.
6a3869fd6fb59df7481683679ce06b9d4c1a23ed.issues: Abstract unavailable; short yield records limit ANN training.

af72c345f9e3431080b712d351bd3f442767b2ab.goal: Predicts photovoltaic module temperature from air temperature and solar radiation to estimate PV efficiency in Turkey's Aegean region.
af72c345f9e3431080b712d351bd3f442767b2ab.architecture: Artificial neural network trained on experimental measurements.
af72c345f9e3431080b712d351bd3f442767b2ab.data: Open-air experiments at 10–40 °C ambient temperature with measured solar radiation; application to Aegean cities.
af72c345f9e3431080b712d351bd3f442767b2ab.result: Kutahya, Usak and Afyon are the most suitable cities for PV electrical efficiency and power.
af72c345f9e3431080b712d351bd3f442767b2ab.open_work: Validation at operational PV plants and inclusion of wind speed effects.
af72c345f9e3431080b712d351bd3f442767b2ab.issues: Small experimental dataset; no quantitative error metrics in the abstract.

133ff593382853c27b9bbe6f7f8f01dfad9bcefc.goal: Models river suspended sediment concentration, important for reservoir sedimentation and water quality.
133ff593382853c27b9bbe6f7f8f01dfad9bcefc.architecture: Neural network trained by differential evolution (neural differential evolution).
133ff593382853c27b9bbe6f7f8f01dfad9bcefc.data: River discharge and sediment records; details not reported.
133ff593382853c27b9bbe6f7f8f01dfad9bcefc.open_work: Testing on other rivers and longer horizons.
133ff593382853c27b9bbe6f7f8f01dfad9bcefc.issues: Abstract unavailable; sediment records are sparse and hysteretic.

28d4006d13101db9c959279ce0fdf296348c7461.goal: Forecasts wind power with machine learning to support power grid operation.
28d4006d13101db9c959279ce0fdf296348c7461.architecture: Compares ANN (MLP), RNN, CNN and LSTM; missing data filled with k-nearest neighbours.
28d4006d13101db9c959279ce0fdf296348c7461.data: Turbine data (wind speed, direction, theoretical and active power) combined with an external meteorological dataset.
28d4006d13101db9c959279ce0fdf296348c7461.result: LSTM performs best: R² 0.9574, MAE 0.0209, MSE 0.0038, RMSE 0.0614.
28d4006d13101db9c959279ce0fdf296348c7461.open_work: Testing on multiple wind farms, longer horizons and with numerical weather prediction inputs.
28d4006d13101db9c959279ce0fdf296348c7461.issues: Single dataset with normalized error metrics; the forecast horizon and site are unclear, limiting comparison with other studies.

97ad065ac2fc18df386228ffac29899dbb42fa33.goal: Generates maps of soil moisture and snow depth from spaceborne microwave radiometers for hydrology and civil protection.
97ad065ac2fc18df386228ffac29899dbb42fa33.architecture: HydroAlgo retrieval algorithm with artificial neural network retrieval branches for soil moisture and snow depth.
97ad065ac2fc18df386228ffac29899dbb42fa33.data: AMSR-E data; calibration with field data from Mongolia, Australia and Siberia plus model simulations; validation in Northern Italy and Scandinavia.
97ad065ac2fc18df386228ffac29899dbb42fa33.result: Validated soil moisture and snow depth maps, plus vegetation biomass auxiliary output.
97ad065ac2fc18df386228ffac29899dbb42fa33.issues: Coarse radiometer resolution and masking of dense vegetation, urban areas and water limit coverage; quantitative errors are not reported in the abstract.

6dc5a8d18c19061c480a027966ddebe0ed552bf1.goal: Reviews deep learning models for photovoltaic power forecasting needed for grid scheduling and energy management.
6dc5a8d18c19061c480a027966ddebe0ed552bf1.architecture: Review of MLP, RNN, CNN and graph neural network architectures for PV forecasting.
6dc5a8d18c19061c480a027966ddebe0ed552bf1.data: Survey of commonly used PV power datasets; no new data.
6dc5a8d18c19061c480a027966ddebe0ed552bf1.result: Each architecture has strengths: MLP nonlinear fitting, RNN long-term dependencies, CNN local features, GNN spatiotemporal modelling.
6dc5a8d18c19061c480a027966ddebe0ed552bf1.open_work: Challenges and opportunities for deep learning in PV forecasting.
6dc5a8d18c19061c480a027966ddebe0ed552bf1.issues: Review without standardized benchmarking, so reported accuracies across studies are not directly comparable.

cfbf01d56d03a1f3df51d975b2d88dde0bd2c205.goal: Forecasts floods during typhoons for flood warning.
cfbf01d56d03a1f3df51d975b2d88dde0bd2c205.architecture: Integrated two-stage support vector machine approach.
cfbf01d56d03a1f3df51d975b2d88dde0bd2c205.data: Typhoon event rainfall and runoff records; details not reported.
cfbf01d56d03a1f3df51d975b2d88dde0bd2c205.issues: Abstract unavailable; few typhoon events are available for training, so robustness for unprecedented extremes is uncertain.

481de9aee0b06835929faec62ce8e2114cdc78ef.goal: Forecasts river stage, testing wavelet regression as an alternative to neural networks.
481de9aee0b06835929faec62ce8e2114cdc78ef.architecture: Wavelet regression model compared with artificial neural networks.
481de9aee0b06835929faec62ce8e2114cdc78ef.data: River stage records; stations not reported here.
481de9aee0b06835929faec62ce8e2114cdc78ef.issues: Abstract unavailable; wavelet decomposition may leak future information.

4932ee2c43be63b6e8e48b94131757fd56f9aff9.goal: Predicts runoff from rainfall, comparing static and dynamic wavelet-coupled neural networks.
4932ee2c43be63b6e8e48b94131757fd56f9aff9.architecture: Wavelet-coupled time-lagged recurrent neural networks (TLRNN) versus wavelet-coupled MLP; discrete wavelet transform with six wavelet functions.
4932ee2c43be63b6e8e48b94131757fd56f9aff9.data: Rainfall and runoff data from a catchment; details not reported in the abstract.
4932ee2c43be63b6e8e48b94131757fd56f9aff9.result: Wavelet TLRNN is a viable alternative to wavelet MLP; db8 best for MLP and small-memory TLRNN.
4932ee2c43be63b6e8e48b94131757fd56f9aff9.issues: Single-catchment study; DWT may leak future information.

ab8fe053929fa155e9605cc8e97f585f14d353fd.goal: Quantifies compounding effects among flood drivers across magnitudes to improve extreme flood estimates under climate change.
ab8fe053929fa155e9605cc8e97f585f14d353fd.architecture: Explainable machine learning (model family not specified in the abstract) with attribution to disentangle interactions.
ab8fe053929fa155e9605cc8e97f585f14d353fd.data: Flood events and driver data across thousands of catchments worldwide; products not reported in the abstract.
ab8fe053929fa155e9605cc8e97f585f14d353fd.result: Compounding effects are ubiquitous and often grow with flood magnitude.
ab8fe053929fa155e9605cc8e97f585f14d353fd.open_work: Incorporating compounding effects into flood risk assessment.
ab8fe053929fa155e9605cc8e97f585f14d353fd.issues: Attribution results depend on the fidelity of the fitted model and the chosen driver set; observational records contain few very extreme floods.

412e3d3c523253677ca8e314efafcb1984476fb2.goal: Compares neural network, fuzzy logic and linear transfer function models for daily rainfall-runoff modelling under different inputs.
412e3d3c523253677ca8e314efafcb1984476fb2.architecture: Artificial neural network, fuzzy logic and linear transfer function models.
412e3d3c523253677ca8e314efafcb1984476fb2.data: Daily rainfall and runoff data; details not reported.
412e3d3c523253677ca8e314efafcb1984476fb2.open_work: Testing the models on other catchments and climates and examining which input domains generalize best.
412e3d3c523253677ca8e314efafcb1984476fb2.issues: Abstract unavailable, so catchment, record length and skill metrics cannot be confirmed; daily rainfall-runoff models of this kind are typically calibrated on a single catchment.

8b923cded53a1c3b714bc8148512917acd29aed4.goal: Estimates global solar radiation from air temperature and humidity in south-western Algeria.
8b923cded53a1c3b714bc8148512917acd29aed4.data: ENERGARID station data: training Feb–May 2011, testing 651 hours of June 2011.
8b923cded53a1c3b714bc8148512917acd29aed4.result: Neural networks estimate global solar radiation well from temperature and relative humidity.
8b923cded53a1c3b714bc8148512917acd29aed4.open_work: Use at sites with only temperature and humidity data.
8b923cded53a1c3b714bc8148512917acd29aed4.issues: Very short record (about four months of training data) at a single station, so seasonal and spatial generalization is untested.

1e81ea221e4b6331566cf815957315455d2b56a4.goal: Forecasts lake levels with wavelet conjunction models.
1e81ea221e4b6331566cf815957315455d2b56a4.architecture: Wavelet-support vector regression, wavelet-ANFIS and wavelet-ARMA models.
1e81ea221e4b6331566cf815957315455d2b56a4.data: Lake level records; details not reported.
1e81ea221e4b6331566cf815957315455d2b56a4.open_work: Testing longer forecast horizons and adding climatic drivers such as precipitation and evaporation.
1e81ea221e4b6331566cf815957315455d2b56a4.issues: Abstract unavailable; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if applied to the full series, inflating forecast skill.

5d6ae641e61598ae216703fb8b58595e8e324317.goal: Models air temperature in Turkey from satellite remote sensing.
5d6ae641e61598ae216703fb8b58595e8e324317.architecture: Artificial neural network; the specific network type is not specified here.
5d6ae641e61598ae216703fb8b58595e8e324317.data: Satellite remote sensing data with station observations; products not reported.
5d6ae641e61598ae216703fb8b58595e8e324317.open_work: Higher-resolution mapping of air temperature and testing in regions with sparse station networks.
5d6ae641e61598ae216703fb8b58595e8e324317.issues: Abstract unavailable, so the satellite product, period and accuracy cannot be confirmed; satellite-based estimates are affected by cloud gaps.

7cc1c0290299118d9e0eb71ebc212027ebc1e331.goal: Estimates annual precipitation in the Colorado River Basin from large-scale oceanic-atmospheric oscillation indices to support long-lead water supply planning.
7cc1c0290299118d9e0eb71ebc212027ebc1e331.architecture: Support vector machine regression using lagged climate indices such as ENSO, PDO, AMO and NAO as predictors, compared with simpler data-driven baselines.
7cc1c0290299118d9e0eb71ebc212027ebc1e331.data: Annual precipitation records at stations in the Colorado River Basin and historical oceanic-atmospheric oscillation indices; exact periods not reported here.
7cc1c0290299118d9e0eb71ebc212027ebc1e331.result: Oscillation indices provide useful skill for estimating annual basin precipitation at long lead times; specific scores are not reported here.
7cc1c0290299118d9e0eb71ebc212027ebc1e331.open_work: Extending to other basins, seasonal targets and probabilistic forecasts would test how general the teleconnection signal is.
7cc1c0290299118d9e0eb71ebc212027ebc1e331.issues: Annual records give small samples, teleconnections can be non-stationary, and station-based evaluation may not represent the whole basin.

0354cf9b1899c811cbc9d8a63b0c9b09c528b0e6.goal: Reviews how artificial intelligence can support climate change adaptation for communities, infrastructure and businesses.
0354cf9b1899c811cbc9d8a63b0c9b09c528b0e6.architecture: Review of AI-enabled adaptation strategies, including vulnerability mapping, scenario simulation and risk assessment, with discussion of ethics and bias; no new model is proposed.
0354cf9b1899c811cbc9d8a63b0c9b09c528b0e6.data: Literature and examples drawing on climate model output, satellite imagery and other large datasets; no specific dataset is analysed.
0354cf9b1899c811cbc9d8a63b0c9b09c528b0e6.result: Argues that AI can identify vulnerable areas, simulate future scenarios and assess risks, but must be transparent, fair and equitable.
0354cf9b1899c811cbc9d8a63b0c9b09c528b0e6.open_work: Developing transparent, fair and equitable AI tools and integrating them into adaptation decision-making.
0354cf9b1899c811cbc9d8a63b0c9b09c528b0e6.issues: Broad narrative overview without quantitative synthesis or systematic literature search; claims are largely qualitative.

0d11d73a90653713c90642897b71bfcc64b2a527.goal: Predicts global horizontal solar irradiance in Zimbabwe for solar energy resource assessment where measurements are scarce.
0d11d73a90653713c90642897b71bfcc64b2a527.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type feedforward network) mapping meteorological and geographical inputs to global horizontal irradiance.
0d11d73a90653713c90642897b71bfcc64b2a527.data: Meteorological and solar irradiance data from locations in Zimbabwe; details not reported here.
0d11d73a90653713c90642897b71bfcc64b2a527.result: The neural network reproduces measured irradiance with useful accuracy; specific error statistics are not reported here.
0d11d73a90653713c90642897b71bfcc64b2a527.open_work: Testing on more stations and comparison with satellite-derived irradiance and other ML methods.
0d11d73a90653713c90642897b71bfcc64b2a527.issues: Limited station coverage and site-specific training may restrict transferability; details unavailable without the abstract.

f9fe88fdc86f77a20314f7a7ea49dc5879b848fa.goal: Infills missing rainfall and streamflow records in the Shire River basin, Malawi, to provide complete series for hydrological analysis.
f9fe88fdc86f77a20314f7a7ea49dc5879b848fa.architecture: Self-organizing map (SOM, Kohonen network) used to cluster multivariate records and impute missing rainfall and streamflow values.
f9fe88fdc86f77a20314f7a7ea49dc5879b848fa.data: Rainfall and streamflow gauge records from the Shire River basin, Malawi; record lengths not reported here.
f9fe88fdc86f77a20314f7a7ea49dc5879b848fa.result: The SOM approach infills gaps in rainfall and streamflow with acceptable accuracy; specific scores are not reported here.
f9fe88fdc86f77a20314f7a7ea49dc5879b848fa.open_work: Comparison with other imputation methods and assessment of infilling under long continuous gaps.
f9fe88fdc86f77a20314f7a7ea49dc5879b848fa.issues: Performance likely degrades for long gaps and extremes; evaluation details unknown without the abstract.

dc4f2c7eb22535d2496e46350ce13362d71ea168.goal: Predicts solar PV power generation from meteorological parameters to cope with the intermittency of solar energy in Eastern India.
dc4f2c7eb22535d2496e46350ce13362d71ea168.architecture: Ensemble machine learning models including bagging, boosting, stacking and voting, with a test-bed framework for data mining, feature selection and reduction.
dc4f2c7eb22535d2496e46350ce13362d71ea168.data: Field data from a 10 kWp solar PV plant in Eastern India with weather inputs such as solar radiation, ambient temperature, rainfall and wind speed.
dc4f2c7eb22535d2496e46350ce13362d71ea168.result: Stacking and voting ensembles reach about 96% prediction accuracy, outperforming the other ensemble variants tested.
dc4f2c7eb22535d2496e46350ce13362d71ea168.open_work: Applying the framework to large-scale PV plants and other climates as the authors suggest.
dc4f2c7eb22535d2496e46350ce13362d71ea168.issues: Single small plant and site; accuracy metric definition is vague and generalization to large plants is asserted rather than shown.

f1f1ec7f1f06764c19883829aed1a74174d05215.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting from multivariate time series while keeping the model interpretable.
f1f1ec7f1f06764c19883829aed1a74174d05215.architecture: Transformer with feature-wise and temporal attention (feature-temporal transformer) whose attention weights provide interpretability of input variables and time steps.
f1f1ec7f1f06764c19883829aed1a74174d05215.data: Multivariate wind farm time series of power and meteorological variables; sites and periods not reported here.
f1f1ec7f1f06764c19883829aed1a74174d05215.result: The interpretable transformer improves short-term wind power forecast accuracy over baselines; specific numbers are not reported here.
f1f1ec7f1f06764c19883829aed1a74174d05215.open_work: Extending to probabilistic forecasts and testing across more wind farms and horizons.
f1f1ec7f1f06764c19883829aed1a74174d05215.issues: Attention-based interpretability is not causal; results depend on site data whose details are unavailable without the abstract.

9a35a0aac04f4f712f38ea9bbfd2f0b0108242f5.goal: Predicts county-level crop yields across the United States accounting for both growing-season weather variation and long-term climate change.
9a35a0aac04f4f712f38ea9bbfd2f0b0108242f5.architecture: Multi-Modal Spatial-Temporal Vision Transformer (MMST-ViT) with multi-modal, spatial and temporal transformers, pre-trained by multi-modal contrastive learning.
9a35a0aac04f4f712f38ea9bbfd2f0b0108242f5.data: Satellite remote sensing imagery and short-term meteorological data for over 200 US counties; dataset and code released.
9a35a0aac04f4f712f38ea9bbfd2f0b0108242f5.result: MMST-ViT outperforms competing models on three performance metrics for county-level yield prediction.
9a35a0aac04f4f712f38ea9bbfd2f0b0108242f5.open_work: Extending to more crops, regions and climate projection scenarios for adaptation planning.
9a35a0aac04f4f712f38ea9bbfd2f0b0108242f5.issues: Evaluated over about 200 counties only; climate change effects are learned from limited historical years and are hard to verify.

1fd1c8f1625287c26d9e7e22b84ae378513a8b0c.goal: Estimates daily pan evaporation from climatic data in Illinois, USA, where direct measurements are incomplete.
1fd1c8f1625287c26d9e7e22b84ae378513a8b0c.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) compared with an artificial neural network (ANN) using various combinations of climatic inputs.
1fd1c8f1625287c26d9e7e22b84ae378513a8b0c.data: Daily climatic records and pan evaporation from stations in Illinois, USA; periods not reported here.
1fd1c8f1625287c26d9e7e22b84ae378513a8b0c.result: Both data-driven models estimate daily pan evaporation reasonably; relative performance figures are not reported here.
1fd1c8f1625287c26d9e7e22b84ae378513a8b0c.open_work: Testing spatial transfer to stations without pan data and comparing with empirical evaporation formulas.
1fd1c8f1625287c26d9e7e22b84ae378513a8b0c.issues: Station-specific calibration and limited regional coverage; details unavailable without the abstract.

28f5186b909f8fdeed494b429ef6a32a48520080.goal: Models spatiotemporal groundwater level variations by combining data-driven temporal prediction with spatial interpolation.
28f5186b909f8fdeed494b429ef6a32a48520080.architecture: Hybrid of an artificial neural network for temporal forecasting at wells and a meshless numerical method for spatial groundwater level estimation.
28f5186b909f8fdeed494b429ef6a32a48520080.data: Groundwater level observations from piezometers in an aquifer; site and period not reported here.
28f5186b909f8fdeed494b429ef6a32a48520080.result: The hybrid AI-meshless approach reproduces spatiotemporal groundwater levels well; specific scores are not reported here.
28f5186b909f8fdeed494b429ef6a32a48520080.open_work: Adding physical constraints and testing in other aquifers and longer periods.
28f5186b909f8fdeed494b429ef6a32a48520080.issues: Depends on observation well density; evaluation details unknown without the abstract.

f8a62c97bd57133e6dd6d472542028e5ee75d780.goal: Forecasts drought via the monthly standardized precipitation index (SPI) with statistical uncertainty estimates to support water and agricultural management.
f8a62c97bd57133e6dd6d472542028e5ee75d780.architecture: Random forest forecast model with confidence intervals for SPI time series, compared against ARIMA.
f8a62c97bd57133e6dd6d472542028e5ee75d780.data: Monthly SPI series from four stations in the Haihe River basin, China.
f8a62c97bd57133e6dd6d472542028e5ee75d780.result: Random forest gives better predictive skill than ARIMA for both short and long drought forecasting, and its confidence intervals generally have good coverage.

1a182093842c80aead5c075598d76f78a2a1674b.goal: Improves river flow forecasting by combining several artificial intelligence techniques in a hybrid system.
1a182093842c80aead5c075598d76f78a2a1674b.architecture: Hybrid artificial intelligence model; the specific component methods are not specified in the available information.

8cf9aacdb41bae51b9bc5ae133408d3ce78217fb.issues: Skill decreases with depth where surface signals weaken; depends on sparse in situ profiles for training.

c506d3e5524c15396d1d281ccee5ef5524438606.goal: Corrects TROPOMI methane retrieval biases by reference to GOSAT to create a blended product for quantifying methane emissions.
c506d3e5524c15396d1d281ccee5ef5524438606.architecture: Gradient-boosted decision tree model (LightGBM) trained to predict the TROPOMI minus GOSAT difference using only TROPOMI retrieval variables, then applied to the full TROPOMI record.
