614cd665575f7c70569d8cdf234331e944fe2500.architecture: Ensemble machine learning model with SHAP explanations, combined with positive matrix factorization for source apportionment.
614cd665575f7c70569d8cdf234331e944fe2500.data: Observations from April to October 2021–2022 in Hangzhou, including meteorology, VOCs, PM2.5 and NOx.
614cd665575f7c70569d8cdf234331e944fe2500.result: Ensemble model reaches R2 0.91; meteorology contributes 57–60% of O3 variability, mainly relative humidity and radiation; vehicle exhaust (35%) is the main source.
614cd665575f7c70569d8cdf234331e944fe2500.open_work: Using the framework for rapid diagnosis of O3 pollution events to support control policies.
614cd665575f7c70569d8cdf234331e944fe2500.issues: Single city and two seasons; SHAP attributions are associational, not causal.

a0dfed8884c45fc37cba56d2999d7420bfe73f28.goal: Selects network complexity for karst flood forecasting in the Lez basin, southern France.
a0dfed8884c45fc37cba56d2999d7420bfe73f28.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network with complexity selection by cross-validation and regularization.
a0dfed8884c45fc37cba56d2999d7420bfe73f28.data: Rainfall and discharge records from the Lez karst basin, southern France; period not reported here.
a0dfed8884c45fc37cba56d2999d7420bfe73f28.result: Appropriate complexity selection yields good flood forecasts for the karst system; numbers are not reported here.
a0dfed8884c45fc37cba56d2999d7420bfe73f28.open_work: Interpreting network behaviour in terms of karst hydrology and extending lead times.
a0dfed8884c45fc37cba56d2999d7420bfe73f28.issues: Few flood events available for training and testing.

6fd437bba310216490c017040b03a5c0f21eff37.goal: Bridges spatio-temporal gaps in global soil moisture mapping by coupling physics with deep learning.
6fd437bba310216490c017040b03a5c0f21eff37.architecture: Physics-coupled deep learning framework; the specific network type is not specified in the available information.
6fd437bba310216490c017040b03a5c0f21eff37.data: Satellite soil moisture products and in situ measurements globally; specific products not reported here.
6fd437bba310216490c017040b03a5c0f21eff37.result: The approach produces spatio-temporally continuous global soil moisture with improved accuracy; numbers are not reported here.
6fd437bba310216490c017040b03a5c0f21eff37.open_work: Extending to finer resolution and longer records.

2f10ad011c5e37a29ac5a33bcadec3bcf6f5fc0c.goal: Compares artificial neural networks with regression techniques for predicting runoff from rainfall, to assess whether ANNs better capture the nonlinear rainfall-runoff relation.
2f10ad011c5e37a29ac5a33bcadec3bcf6f5fc0c.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) compared against regression models; the specific ANN configuration is not reported in the available information.
2f10ad011c5e37a29ac5a33bcadec3bcf6f5fc0c.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a catchment; the basin, period and record length are not reported in the available information.
2f10ad011c5e37a29ac5a33bcadec3bcf6f5fc0c.result: The title implies a performance comparison between ANN and regression models; quantitative results are not available here.
2f10ad011c5e37a29ac5a33bcadec3bcf6f5fc0c.open_work: Testing on other catchments and lead times, and comparison with conceptual hydrological models.
2f10ad011c5e37a29ac5a33bcadec3bcf6f5fc0c.issues: Single-study comparison of data-driven models; transferability and uncertainty are not addressed as far as can be judged from the title.

bf5581c50ddb0c7dabf475683549a4e443f57b6d.goal: Forecasts short-term photovoltaic power generation to support grid stability and energy storage management under intermittent solar output.
bf5581c50ddb0c7dabf475683549a4e443f57b6d.architecture: Hybrid deep learning model combining a convolutional neural network (CNN) for feature extraction with an LSTM autoencoder for temporal dependencies.
bf5581c50ddb0c7dabf475683549a4e443f57b6d.data: Power generation from a solar farm in southern UK with co-located weather data; baselines LSTM, GRU, CNN-LSTM and CNN-GRU.
bf5581c50ddb0c7dabf475683549a4e443f57b6d.result: Improves RMSE and MAE by about 5-25% on average over competing models and cuts training time by roughly 70%.
bf5581c50ddb0c7dabf475683549a4e443f57b6d.open_work: Testing on other sites and climates, longer horizons and probabilistic forecasts.
bf5581c50ddb0c7dabf475683549a4e443f57b6d.issues: Single solar farm; deterministic point forecasts only; details of forecast horizon and data split are not given in the abstract.

9cbf52926d0865d413881e92db46c372baeae7c6.goal: Compares data-driven techniques for forecasting river flow, to identify which method gives the most reliable short-term flow forecasts.
9cbf52926d0865d413881e92db46c372baeae7c6.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural networks (ANN), genetic programming (GP) and model trees as data-driven forecasting models.
9cbf52926d0865d413881e92db46c372baeae7c6.data: Daily river flow records from catchments in India; exact stations and periods are not reported in the available information.
9cbf52926d0865d413881e92db46c372baeae7c6.result: All three data-driven methods give reasonable one-day-ahead forecasts, with differences in accuracy between techniques; detailed scores are not reported here.
9cbf52926d0865d413881e92db46c372baeae7c6.open_work: Extension to longer lead times and to combinations of data-driven and physically based models.
9cbf52926d0865d413881e92db46c372baeae7c6.issues: Purely data-driven models without physical constraints; limited to the studied rivers and short lead times.

19422ccf48d68dd73d5b22e5c71bbe4addc1ae1f.goal: Quantifies the contributions of chemical, precursor and meteorological drivers to PM2.5 pollution events, to support targeted air pollution control.
19422ccf48d68dd73d5b22e5c71bbe4addc1ae1f.architecture: Random forest model interpreted with decision plots, permutation importance, partial dependence plots and SHAP (Shapley additive explanations).
19422ccf48d68dd73d5b22e5c71bbe4addc1ae1f.data: Hourly PM2.5, aerosol chemical composition (SO4, NO3, NH4, K, EC, OC) and meteorological data in Zibo, China, autumn-winter 2021, including ten pollution events.
19422ccf48d68dd73d5b22e5c71bbe4addc1ae1f.result: Random forest predicts PM2.5 with R2 0.94, RMSE 9.4 and MAE 5.7 ug/m3; NH4+ contributes 19.9-65.4 ug/m3 across events, and sensitivity order is NH4+ > NO3- > SO4 2-.
19422ccf48d68dd73d5b22e5c71bbe4addc1ae1f.open_work: Applying the interpretability framework to other cities and seasons and linking attributions to emission-control scenarios.
19422ccf48d68dd73d5b22e5c71bbe4addc1ae1f.issues: Single city and season; SHAP attributions reflect correlation rather than causation and include co-varying chemical species.

4a03db10eb2d6a036bcdbf4b45788cc55b7ab423.goal: Compares regression and artificial neural network models for predicting wind speed, relevant to wind energy assessment.
4a03db10eb2d6a036bcdbf4b45788cc55b7ab423.architecture: Linear and nonlinear regression models compared with an artificial neural network (ANN).
4a03db10eb2d6a036bcdbf4b45788cc55b7ab423.data: Wind speed measurements from meteorological stations in Turkey, with neighbouring-station data as predictors; exact periods are not reported here.
4a03db10eb2d6a036bcdbf4b45788cc55b7ab423.result: The ANN is reported to give more accurate wind speed predictions than the regression models; detailed error figures are not reported here.
4a03db10eb2d6a036bcdbf4b45788cc55b7ab423.open_work: Testing at more sites and finer time scales and including additional meteorological predictors.
4a03db10eb2d6a036bcdbf4b45788cc55b7ab423.issues: Station-based study with limited spatial generality; no uncertainty quantification.

c849a3ebfa40ea693202f2aa2d0edf51772ec873.goal: Benchmarks surrogate models for fast flood inundation simulation, since high-resolution hydrodynamic models are too costly for real-time and probabilistic use.
c849a3ebfa40ea693202f2aa2d0edf51772ec873.architecture: Physics-guided LSG surrogate: a low-fidelity hydrodynamic model upskilled with empirical orthogonal functions and sparse Gaussian process regression, compared with four state-of-the-art machine learning surrogates.
c849a3ebfa40ea693202f2aa2d0edf51772ec873.data: Hydrodynamic simulations of flood events for three case studies in Australia and the United Kingdom, including events beyond the training range.
c849a3ebfa40ea693202f2aa2d0edf51772ec873.result: LSG is the most accurate for flood extent and water depth, including for out-of-range events, while remaining computationally efficient; the low-fidelity model is key to its skill.
c849a3ebfa40ea693202f2aa2d0edf51772ec873.open_work: Further development of physics-guided surrogates and testing on more catchments and flood types.
c849a3ebfa40ea693202f2aa2d0edf51772ec873.issues: Surrogates are trained and evaluated against hydrodynamic model output rather than observations; only three case studies.

48d18c470b5a75379537366b9ab9010236bdadac.goal: Reviews artificial neural network models for photovoltaic power forecasting, needed to manage weather-driven fluctuations in PV output.
48d18c470b5a75379537366b9ab9010236bdadac.architecture: Review of five ANN families: MLP, recurrent neural network (RNN), LSTM, GRU and convolutional neural network (CNN), standalone and hybrid, including metaheuristic optimization.
48d18c470b5a75379537366b9ab9010236bdadac.data: Literature on PV power forecasting across regions, horizons and meteorological conditions.
48d18c470b5a75379537366b9ab9010236bdadac.result: Bidirectional GRU and LSTM give the highest accuracy standalone or hybrid, and metaheuristic-tuned models perform exceptionally well.
48d18c470b5a75379537366b9ab9010236bdadac.open_work: Addressing practical implementation limitations of PV forecasting and further hybrid model development.
48d18c470b5a75379537366b9ab9010236bdadac.issues: Narrative review limited to five ANN families; comparisons across studies use heterogeneous datasets and metrics.

06dc84bb5a5f61d197988977cf0337812972a7fd.goal: Reviews supervised machine learning for predicting key urban air pollutants to support smart-city air quality management.
06dc84bb5a5f61d197988977cf0337812972a7fd.architecture: Systematic review following PRISMA of supervised methods including LSTM, random forest, artificial neural networks and support vector regression.
06dc84bb5a5f61d197988977cf0337812972a7fd.data: Published studies predicting PM, NOx, CO and O3 in urban settings.
06dc84bb5a5f61d197988977cf0337812972a7fd.result: LSTM, random forest, ANN and SVR are the most frequently used methods and are effective for predicting key pollutants; benefits and challenges are summarized.
06dc84bb5a5f61d197988977cf0337812972a7fd.open_work: Integration of ML forecasts into urban planning and policy decision-making.
06dc84bb5a5f61d197988977cf0337812972a7fd.issues: Review largely descriptive; no quantitative meta-analysis reported in the abstract.

e92c128267c8117ec0a1e7a6e3da300edb7fc666.goal: Compares wavelet-based artificial neural networks with regression models for forecasting reservoir inflow, for reservoir operation planning.
e92c128267c8117ec0a1e7a6e3da300edb7fc666.architecture: Wavelet-transform preprocessing coupled with an artificial neural network (wavelet-ANN), compared with regression models, as stated in the title.
e92c128267c8117ec0a1e7a6e3da300edb7fc666.data: Reservoir inflow records; reservoir, time step and period are not reported in the available information.
e92c128267c8117ec0a1e7a6e3da300edb7fc666.result: Quantitative results are not available here; the title implies a comparison of wavelet-ANN and regression accuracy.
e92c128267c8117ec0a1e7a6e3da300edb7fc666.open_work: Testing at other reservoirs and lead times and against other hybrid data-driven models.
e92c128267c8117ec0a1e7a6e3da300edb7fc666.issues: Wavelet decomposition can leak future information if not applied carefully; single-case evaluation as far as can be judged.

a1adc184d0dfd2e59e204dc18c049382086704b1.goal: Compares fuzzy linear regression and support vector regression for predicting global solar radiation in Iran, for solar energy assessment.
a1adc184d0dfd2e59e204dc18c049382086704b1.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) with different kernels compared with fuzzy linear regression.
a1adc184d0dfd2e59e204dc18c049382086704b1.data: Meteorological and global solar radiation data from Iran (Tehran region); exact variables and period are not reported here.
a1adc184d0dfd2e59e204dc18c049382086704b1.result: SVR is reported to outperform fuzzy linear regression; detailed scores are not reported here.
a1adc184d0dfd2e59e204dc18c049382086704b1.open_work: Testing across more stations and climates in Iran.

e122d9f9f10880d4566dbee4279d544dc39b76b7.goal: Estimates daily global solar radiation from temperature-based inputs, useful where radiation measurements are scarce.
e122d9f9f10880d4566dbee4279d544dc39b76b7.architecture: Comparison of wavelet regression, artificial neural network (ANN), gene expression programming (GEP) and empirical temperature-based models.
e122d9f9f10880d4566dbee4279d544dc39b76b7.data: Daily temperature and solar radiation records from meteorological stations; locations and periods are not reported in the available information.
e122d9f9f10880d4566dbee4279d544dc39b76b7.result: Quantitative results are not available here; the title implies a comparative ranking of the approaches.
e122d9f9f10880d4566dbee4279d544dc39b76b7.open_work: Extension to additional stations and inputs beyond temperature.
e122d9f9f10880d4566dbee4279d544dc39b76b7.issues: Temperature-only inputs limit accuracy on cloudy days; site-specific calibration.

dca6940e279719445b453ebd968f1670af49bb76.goal: Forecasts short-term wind power in Portugal to support power system operation with growing wind penetration.
dca6940e279719445b453ebd968f1670af49bb76.architecture: Hybrid approach combining wavelet transform, particle swarm optimization and an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS).
dca6940e279719445b453ebd968f1670af49bb76.data: Wind power data from Portugal; exact period is not reported in the available information.
dca6940e279719445b453ebd968f1670af49bb76.result: The hybrid approach is reported to improve forecast accuracy over benchmark approaches, with modest computation time; detailed errors are not reported here.
dca6940e279719445b453ebd968f1670af49bb76.open_work: Extension to probabilistic forecasts and use of numerical weather prediction inputs.
dca6940e279719445b453ebd968f1670af49bb76.issues: Purely time-series based; evaluated on limited test periods.

3b26b2915266ea0866970fb8dfc9c212727c005d.goal: Improves wind speed prediction by selecting the most informative predictors with an evolutionary algorithm.
3b26b2915266ea0866970fb8dfc9c212727c005d.architecture: Coral reefs optimization algorithm with harmony search operators for feature selection, combined with an extreme learning machine (ELM) neural network regressor.
3b26b2915266ea0866970fb8dfc9c212727c005d.data: Predictors from mesoscale numerical weather model outputs and wind speed measurements at a wind farm; site details are not reported here.
3b26b2915266ea0866970fb8dfc9c212727c005d.result: The feature selection improves prediction accuracy compared with using all predictors and with alternative approaches; numbers are not reported here.
3b26b2915266ea0866970fb8dfc9c212727c005d.open_work: Testing at other wind farms and with other regressors.
3b26b2915266ea0866970fb8dfc9c212727c005d.issues: Single-site evaluation; evolutionary search is computationally expensive.

59c8689cd372e655febc72d0ab36fea2c25b43ed.goal: Predicts wind power using machine learning and deep learning models, to support wind energy integration.
59c8689cd372e655febc72d0ab36fea2c25b43ed.architecture: Machine learning and deep learning models are compared; the specific network types are not specified in the available information.
59c8689cd372e655febc72d0ab36fea2c25b43ed.data: Wind power data; the dataset and site are not reported in the available information.
59c8689cd372e655febc72d0ab36fea2c25b43ed.result: Not reported in the available information.
59c8689cd372e655febc72d0ab36fea2c25b43ed.open_work: Evaluation on additional sites and longer horizons.
59c8689cd372e655febc72d0ab36fea2c25b43ed.issues: Details of data, model types and evaluation are unknown; generality cannot be judged.

2ef55acd58a2ccad68c5094516ad6963991c4e3a.goal: Forecasts river discharge with a fast sequentially updating learning model, as a case study for the Neckar River, Germany.
2ef55acd58a2ccad68c5094516ad6963991c4e3a.architecture: Online sequential extreme learning machine (OS-ELM), a single-hidden-layer neural network updated online, compared with other data-driven models such as ANN, genetic programming and SVR.
2ef55acd58a2ccad68c5094516ad6963991c4e3a.data: Discharge records from the Neckar River, Germany; exact period is not reported here.
2ef55acd58a2ccad68c5094516ad6963991c4e3a.result: OS-ELM is reported to give more accurate discharge forecasts than the comparison models; detailed scores are not reported here.
2ef55acd58a2ccad68c5094516ad6963991c4e3a.open_work: Testing on other basins and longer lead times.
2ef55acd58a2ccad68c5094516ad6963991c4e3a.issues: Single river; data-driven model without physical constraints.

e6811f975acbf7778344e2ce05363af61e3d47e2.goal: Uses ensembles of artificial neural networks to produce probabilistic hydrological forecasts, conveying forecast uncertainty.
e6811f975acbf7778344e2ce05363af61e3d47e2.architecture: Ensembles of artificial neural networks (ANN) combined to produce probabilistic forecasts.
e6811f975acbf7778344e2ce05363af61e3d47e2.data: Hydrological time series from case-study basins; details are not reported in the available information.
e6811f975acbf7778344e2ce05363af61e3d47e2.result: The title implies ANN ensembles can deliver probabilistic forecasts; quantitative results are not available here.
e6811f975acbf7778344e2ce05363af61e3d47e2.open_work: Comparison with other probabilistic and Bayesian forecasting approaches.
e6811f975acbf7778344e2ce05363af61e3d47e2.issues: Ensemble spread may not fully represent forecast uncertainty; calibration evaluation unclear.

4113e044c1a3cc4ca6d3a11005c808b99f929ff4.goal: Predicts monthly runoff with a decomposition-ensemble model, aiming to handle nonstationarity of runoff series.
4113e044c1a3cc4ca6d3a11005c808b99f929ff4.architecture: Least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) with variational mode decomposition, dung beetle optimization for tuning and an error correction strategy.
4113e044c1a3cc4ca6d3a11005c808b99f929ff4.data: Monthly runoff series; stations and period are not reported in the available information.
4113e044c1a3cc4ca6d3a11005c808b99f929ff4.result: Not reported in the available information.
4113e044c1a3cc4ca6d3a11005c808b99f929ff4.open_work: Testing on more basins and with other decomposition methods.
4113e044c1a3cc4ca6d3a11005c808b99f929ff4.issues: Decomposition-based models can leak future information if decomposition is applied to the full series; complexity of the hybrid chain.

1652664c79c3798b92c2c9f0db7adccd780c75ed.goal: Develops a support vector regression formulation matched to the noise characteristics of wind speed, to improve short-term forecasting.
1652664c79c3798b92c2c9f0db7adccd780c75ed.architecture: Noise-model-based v-support vector regression (SVR), deriving the loss from a specified noise distribution rather than the standard epsilon-insensitive loss.
1652664c79c3798b92c2c9f0db7adccd780c75ed.data: Short-term wind speed series; dataset details are not reported in the available information.
1652664c79c3798b92c2c9f0db7adccd780c75ed.result: Not reported in the available information.
1652664c79c3798b92c2c9f0db7adccd780c75ed.open_work: Extension to other noise models and to probabilistic forecasting.
1652664c79c3798b92c2c9f0db7adccd780c75ed.issues: Performance depends on the correctness of the assumed noise distribution.

652d10d342236ff39de1a3c6ea0dab5452dae277.goal: Reviews crop yield forecasting with remote sensing, agrarian factors and machine learning to support food policy and disaster response.
652d10d342236ff39de1a3c6ea0dab5452dae277.architecture: Review of machine learning and deep learning approaches using vegetation indices and environmental variables for crop yield prediction.
652d10d342236ff39de1a3c6ea0dab5452dae277.data: Literature from 2011-2022; most reviewed studies use satellite data, mainly MODIS vegetation indices.
652d10d342236ff39de1a3c6ea0dab5452dae277.result: Satellite remote sensing, especially MODIS, is the most used data source and vegetation indices are the most common predictors; pros and cons of techniques are compared.
652d10d342236ff39de1a3c6ea0dab5452dae277.open_work: Filling gaps in applying deep learning with remote sensing in specific regions.
652d10d342236ff39de1a3c6ea0dab5452dae277.issues: Narrative review with no quantitative synthesis; selection criteria are loosely described.

edc860fc21ed61d56bf60ece2f9830462445f6a5.goal: Forecasts hourly PM2.5 in Santiago de Chile, focusing on night-time pollution episodes that are hard to predict.
edc860fc21ed61d56bf60ece2f9830462445f6a5.architecture: Statistical/machine learning forecasting model; the specific model type is not specified in the available information.
edc860fc21ed61d56bf60ece2f9830462445f6a5.data: Hourly PM2.5 and meteorological data from Santiago de Chile monitoring stations; period not reported here.
edc860fc21ed61d56bf60ece2f9830462445f6a5.result: Not reported in the available information.
edc860fc21ed61d56bf60ece2f9830462445f6a5.open_work: Improving forecasts of night-time episodes and integration into operational air quality warnings.
edc860fc21ed61d56bf60ece2f9830462445f6a5.issues: Single city; method and skill details unknown from available information.

5c9e84db812abce9ebe2065547414f721fb802ce.goal: Improves monthly streamflow predictions by coupling a physically based hydrological model with deep learning, where training data are limited.
5c9e84db812abce9ebe2065547414f721fb802ce.architecture: Hybrid of a simplified VIC hydrological model driven by bias-corrected GCM forecasts and a CNN-GRU deep learning model (convolutional neural network plus gated recurrent unit) using simulated soil moisture as predictor.
5c9e84db812abce9ebe2065547414f721fb802ce.data: Reservoir inflows to the Danjiangkou Reservoir, China, with bias-corrected GCM predictions and multi-source predictors; 1-, 3- and 6-month leads.
5c9e84db812abce9ebe2065547414f721fb802ce.result: The hybrid model outperforms VIC and CNN-GRU alone with large KGE gains up to 6-month lead, and beats hybrids using LASSO, XGBoost, CNN or GRU, while cutting computation.
5c9e84db812abce9ebe2065547414f721fb802ce.open_work: Applying to other basins and exploring other hydrological and DL model combinations.
5c9e84db812abce9ebe2065547414f721fb802ce.issues: Single reservoir; skill depends on GCM forecast quality and bias correction.

7a89bd1d633f077193214242d6cecb51605d856b.goal: Forecasts very short-term solar irradiance by fusing sky images with meteorological data, to manage rapid PV fluctuations from cloud motion.
7a89bd1d633f077193214242d6cecb51605d856b.architecture: Multimodal fusion deep learning model using a gating mechanism and a transformer to combine sky-image and meteorological features.
7a89bd1d633f077193214242d6cecb51605d856b.data: Ground-based sky images and meteorological measurements; site and period are not reported in the available information.
7a89bd1d633f077193214242d6cecb51605d856b.result: Not reported in the available information.
7a89bd1d633f077193214242d6cecb51605d856b.open_work: Testing at other sites and longer horizons.
7a89bd1d633f077193214242d6cecb51605d856b.issues: Sky-camera approaches are site specific; generalization to other locations is unknown.

f5890ae78d4c0c075d3b2c10ef3f9d99f357905a.goal: Forecasts fine-grained future air quality including unmonitored urban regions, a gap between station forecasting and spatial inference.
f5890ae78d4c0c075d3b2c10ef3f9d99f357905a.architecture: Self-supervised hierarchical graph neural network (SSH-GNN) with a hierarchical recurrent graph neural network and spatiotemporal self-supervision.
f5890ae78d4c0c075d3b2c10ef3f9d99f357905a.data: Two real-world urban datasets with air quality observations and contextual factors such as weather and traffic flow.
f5890ae78d4c0c075d3b2c10ef3f9d99f357905a.result: SSH-GNN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both datasets.
f5890ae78d4c0c075d3b2c10ef3f9d99f357905a.open_work: Extension to more cities and pollutants and to uncertainty-aware forecasts.
f5890ae78d4c0c075d3b2c10ef3f9d99f357905a.issues: Evaluation for unmonitored regions relies on sparse stations; quantitative gains are not given in the abstract.

88fe0dd9b23accc23414008383b0ab1eb88601b6.goal: Forecasts electricity load for an urban area using weather forecast information, since load depends strongly on weather.
88fe0dd9b23accc23414008383b0ab1eb88601b6.architecture: Load forecasting model using weather forecast inputs; the specific model type is not specified in the available information.
88fe0dd9b23accc23414008383b0ab1eb88601b6.data: Urban electricity load and weather forecast data; location and period are not reported in the available information.

88fe0dd9b23accc23414008383b0ab1eb88601b6.issues: Skill depends on weather forecast accuracy; details unknown.

38b98754b5ad3b019a91419314b6156cf7a94664.goal: Produces wind speed prediction intervals by jointly optimizing coverage and interval width, to quantify forecast uncertainty.
38b98754b5ad3b019a91419314b6156cf7a94664.architecture: Multiobjective optimization framework for constructing prediction intervals; the underlying regression model type is not specified in the available information.

f39000fef0b03eca7339ca6bf6438cb5eb9a7c81.issues: Accuracy is bounded by reanalysis wind quality, particularly in coastal and storm conditions; extremes are sparse in training and may be underestimated.

7f1439d502a0739cf6f26818a7b7bfab4b381c26.goal: Evaluates whether a solar radiation model built from air temperature at one station can be transferred to estimate radiation at other stations without radiation measurements.
7f1439d502a0739cf6f26818a7b7bfab4b381c26.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression using air temperature-based inputs, trained at a source site and applied at a different estimation site.
7f1439d502a0739cf6f26818a7b7bfab4b381c26.data: Station measurements of global solar radiation and air temperature in subtropical China, covering northeastern and southwestern plateau regions.
7f1439d502a0739cf6f26818a7b7bfab4b381c26.result: Transferred SVM models estimate radiation well; RMSE grows with distance and temperature difference between sites and depends logarithmically or linearly on source-site altitude, leading to a source-site selection strategy.
7f1439d502a0739cf6f26818a7b7bfab4b381c26.open_work: Extending the transferability analysis to other climate zones and to other machine learning models would test the generality of the selection strategy.
7f1439d502a0739cf6f26818a7b7bfab4b381c26.issues: Restricted to one region of China and to temperature-only inputs; the derived altitude relationships are empirical and may not generalize.

755441d4df55bfc2aa7061c56444110825b6a323.goal: Predicts daily rainfall by combining wavelet decomposition and seasonal information with a neural network, aiming to improve on single-model rainfall forecasts.
755441d4df55bfc2aa7061c56444110825b6a323.architecture: Hybrid wavelet-season-neuro model: wavelet decomposition of the rainfall series combined with a seasonal component and an artificial neural network.
755441d4df55bfc2aa7061c56444110825b6a323.data: Daily rainfall station records; study region and period not reported here.
755441d4df55bfc2aa7061c56444110825b6a323.result: The title implies the hybrid model improves daily rainfall prediction relative to simpler models; quantitative results are not reported here.
755441d4df55bfc2aa7061c56444110825b6a323.open_work: Testing across more climates and comparing with modern sequence models would clarify the benefit of the hybrid design.
755441d4df55bfc2aa7061c56444110825b6a323.issues: Abstract unavailable; wavelet-based hybrids can leak future information if decomposition is applied to the full series, and daily rainfall extremes are hard to capture.

0c21631411eb35c1ba24fa60112cc53f9c49d599.goal: Reviews applications of artificial neural networks in hydrology to summarize where they have been used and how well they perform.
0c21631411eb35c1ba24fa60112cc53f9c49d599.architecture: Review of artificial neural network applications in hydrology, such as rainfall-runoff, streamflow, water quality and groundwater modelling.
0c21631411eb35c1ba24fa60112cc53f9c49d599.data: Literature review; no new dataset is used.
0c21631411eb35c1ba24fa60112cc53f9c49d599.result: Not reported in the abstract; the review presumably concludes that ANNs are a useful alternative to conventional hydrological models in many applications.
0c21631411eb35c1ba24fa60112cc53f9c49d599.open_work: Open questions typically include model interpretability, data requirements and generalization beyond training conditions.
0c21631411eb35c1ba24fa60112cc53f9c49d599.issues: Abstract unavailable; scope and depth of the review are unknown, and it predates deep learning methods in hydrology.

172792fce82c98789bb12b0782e93df12e47cbbc.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the Metlili watershed in northwestern Morocco to support flood risk assessment and mitigation planning.
172792fce82c98789bb12b0782e93df12e47cbbc.architecture: Comparison of random forest, CART decision tree, support vector machine and XGBoost (gradient boosting) classifiers using 12 conditioning factors.
172792fce82c98789bb12b0782e93df12e47cbbc.data: SAR-derived flood inventory split 70/30 for training and validation; conditioning factors include elevation, slope, TWI, SPI, lithology, rainfall, land cover and NDVI.
172792fce82c98789bb12b0782e93df12e47cbbc.result: Random forest performs best (AUC 0.807), followed by CART 0.780, SVM 0.756 and XGBoost 0.727; about 31.7% of the watershed is rated very highly susceptible.
172792fce82c98789bb12b0782e93df12e47cbbc.open_work: Applying the approach to other watersheds and adding more flood events or dynamic factors could improve robustness.
172792fce82c98789bb12b0782e93df12e47cbbc.issues: Single small watershed with moderate AUC values; flood inventory depends on SAR detection, and random train/test splitting can overstate skill due to spatial autocorrelation.

086a0043d75bd095a793f9574895a4cc983ede5a.goal: Retrieves near-surface atmospheric variables over the ocean (air temperature, humidity, wind speed) from passive microwave data to improve turbulent surface flux estimates.
086a0043d75bd095a793f9574895a4cc983ede5a.architecture: Neural network retrieval using SSM/I brightness temperatures together with a first-guess estimate of the target variables as additional inputs.
086a0043d75bd095a793f9574895a4cc983ede5a.data: Special Sensor Microwave/Imager observations matched with in situ ship and buoy measurements; details of periods not reported here.
086a0043d75bd095a793f9574895a4cc983ede5a.result: The first-guess neural network approach reduces retrieval errors of near-surface humidity and air temperature compared with earlier satellite retrieval methods.
086a0043d75bd095a793f9574895a4cc983ede5a.open_work: Extension to newer microwave sensors and use in global ocean surface flux products are natural next steps.
086a0043d75bd095a793f9574895a4cc983ede5a.issues: Retrieval quality depends on the first-guess source and on in situ matchup coverage; performance in high-latitude and extreme conditions is less certain.

1f9cd69d997e36060b782cd99d930fc49d0fb601.goal: Reconstructs historical floodplain inundation of the Cuiaba River in the Pantanal to quantify flood characteristics and relate them to geomorphology and vegetation.
1f9cd69d997e36060b782cd99d930fc49d0fb601.architecture: Three-layer artificial neural network (MLP) that estimates floodplain water depth from the river-level record.
1f9cd69d997e36060b782cd99d930fc49d0fb601.data: Historic river levels 1969–2009 and 11 floodplain gauges along a 12 km transect monitored during floods of 2004–2007.
1f9cd69d997e36060b782cd99d930fc49d0fb601.result: Water depth errors stay within 0.09 m in 95% of cases; the median flood gives 1.80 m mean depth lasting 119 days, and 1995 was the highest flood at 2.56 m.
1f9cd69d997e36060b782cd99d930fc49d0fb601.open_work: Extending the reconstruction to other transects and linking flood regimes to ecological change are suggested directions.
1f9cd69d997e36060b782cd99d930fc49d0fb601.issues: Training covers only four flood seasons along one transect; reconstruction assumes stationary river-floodplain relations over four decades.

51aac934506f568cb3f5d7b1bf0d4251d6feb48b.goal: Develops prediction models for river water variables by comparing neural network, fuzzy and wavelet-coupled approaches.
51aac934506f568cb3f5d7b1bf0d4251d6feb48b.architecture: Artificial neural network, fuzzy logic and wavelet-coupled neural network models compared for river water prediction.
51aac934506f568cb3f5d7b1bf0d4251d6feb48b.data: River monitoring time series; the river, variables and period are not reported here.
51aac934506f568cb3f5d7b1bf0d4251d6feb48b.result: The title implies the wavelet-coupled model is compared with neural network and fuzzy models; quantitative results are not reported here.
51aac934506f568cb3f5d7b1bf0d4251d6feb48b.open_work: Testing on more rivers and variables and quantifying prediction uncertainty would strengthen conclusions.
51aac934506f568cb3f5d7b1bf0d4251d6feb48b.issues: Abstract unavailable; the specific target variable and data are unknown, and wavelet preprocessing can introduce look-ahead leakage.

63c95cef936b82fbf05c83188d663894ed1fe761.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration in arid regions from incomplete meteorological data, since the Penman-Monteith equation needs many inputs that stations often lack.
63c95cef936b82fbf05c83188d663894ed1fe761.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) with two hidden layers of eight neurons, compared against multiple linear regression.
63c95cef936b82fbf05c83188d663894ed1fe761.data: Daily temperature, relative humidity, wind speed and sunshine duration from an arid-region station, with Penman-Monteith ET0 as target.
63c95cef936b82fbf05c83188d663894ed1fe761.result: The best network reaches test R2 near 1, Nash efficiency near 1 and MSE of 0.01, outperforming multiple linear regression.
63c95cef936b82fbf05c83188d663894ed1fe761.open_work: Applying the model to other arid sites and with fewer inputs would test the claimed generalization.
63c95cef936b82fbf05c83188d663894ed1fe761.issues: Targets are Penman-Monteith estimates rather than lysimeter measurements, so the near-perfect scores mostly reflect learning a formula; site coverage is limited.

de880cd47dbef96b6ab58d8b969c20e227663055.goal: Develops an operational precipitation retrieval for cross-track passive microwave sounders that works over varied surfaces in Europe and the Mediterranean.
de880cd47dbef96b6ab58d8b969c20e227663055.architecture: Neural network retrieval (PNPR) using AMSU-A and MHS brightness temperatures and 183.31 GHz channel differences, also giving precipitation phase and a confidence index.
de880cd47dbef96b6ab58d8b969c20e227663055.data: Training on a cloud-radiation database from cloud-resolving model simulations coupled with radiative transfer; case-study evaluation with ground radar and rain gauges in Europe.
de880cd47dbef96b6ab58d8b969c20e227663055.result: PNPR detects and retrieves precipitation well over land, ocean, coast and snow surfaces and captures heavy convective rain, with larger uncertainty for light precipitation.
de880cd47dbef96b6ab58d8b969c20e227663055.open_work: Extension to ATMS and to Africa and the South Atlantic with TRMM radar validation is in progress.
de880cd47dbef96b6ab58d8b969c20e227663055.issues: Evaluated on four case studies only; training relies on simulated databases, so model biases propagate, and light precipitation is less accurate.

d1e07acdb30cfe2a14b3a3e31dbf5265dbe5f64c.goal: Classifies hydrometeors from polarimetric radar without predefining classes, letting the data determine how many distinct types can be identified.
d1e07acdb30cfe2a14b3a3e31dbf5265dbe5f64c.architecture: Unsupervised clustering with criteria on data similarity and spatial smoothness, followed by human labelling of clusters into hydrometeor classes.
d1e07acdb30cfe2a14b3a3e31dbf5265dbe5f64c.data: X-band polarimetric weather radar data from two field campaigns, about 50 precipitation events.
d1e07acdb30cfe2a14b3a3e31dbf5265dbe5f64c.result: Seven classes are found: light rain, rain, heavy rain, melting snow, ice crystals/small aggregates, aggregates and rimed ice.
d1e07acdb30cfe2a14b3a3e31dbf5265dbe5f64c.open_work: Applying the method to other radar frequencies and climates, and automating class labelling, are natural extensions.
d1e07acdb30cfe2a14b3a3e31dbf5265dbe5f64c.issues: Cluster-to-class assignment relies on human interpretation; no direct in situ validation, and results depend on campaign locations and X-band attenuation.

3c6ceb7d365547a758cc88039325d295f2ea6c4f.goal: Automatically identifies dominant phytoplankton groups in open-ocean waters from satellite ocean colour radiance anomalies.
3c6ceb7d365547a758cc88039325d295f2ea6c4f.architecture: Self-organizing map (unsupervised neural network) classification of normalized water-leaving radiance anomaly spectra, extending the PHYSAT approach.
3c6ceb7d365547a758cc88039325d295f2ea6c4f.data: Global SeaWiFS imagery, with phytoplankton group labels from in situ pigment-based observations.
3c6ceb7d365547a758cc88039325d295f2ea6c4f.result: The automatic classification reproduces and extends PHYSAT phytoplankton group detection in open-ocean waters.
3c6ceb7d365547a758cc88039325d295f2ea6c4f.open_work: Applying the method to other sensors and longer time series would allow analysis of phytoplankton community changes.
3c6ceb7d365547a758cc88039325d295f2ea6c4f.issues: Limited to open-ocean (Case 1) waters; in situ group labels are sparse, and anomaly signals can be confounded by other optical constituents.

5f7b3126ffd8bbd3bedd585fe8f51bf058ddc16a.goal: Classifies and forecasts wind power ramp events, which are large rapid changes in output that challenge power system operation.
5f7b3126ffd8bbd3bedd585fe8f51bf058ddc16a.architecture: Data-mining classification approach for ramp events; the specific classifier type is not specified here.
5f7b3126ffd8bbd3bedd585fe8f51bf058ddc16a.data: Wind power production time series from wind farms; region and period not reported here.
5f7b3126ffd8bbd3bedd585fe8f51bf058ddc16a.result: Not reported in the abstract; the study proposes a data-mining framework to classify ramp events and forecast their occurrence.
5f7b3126ffd8bbd3bedd585fe8f51bf058ddc16a.open_work: Incorporating numerical weather prediction inputs and testing on more wind farms would improve ramp forecasts.
5f7b3126ffd8bbd3bedd585fe8f51bf058ddc16a.issues: Abstract unavailable; ramp events are rare, so class imbalance and short records may limit forecast reliability.

5038e667d4a55f2ac3a4a96acdc239d7d247252a.goal: Forecasts short-term wind energy at turbines using machine learning on wind time series from the target and neighbouring locations.
5038e667d4a55f2ac3a4a96acdc239d7d247252a.architecture: Support vector regression using spatio-temporal wind measurements as features.
5038e667d4a55f2ac3a4a96acdc239d7d247252a.data: NREL Western Wind data set of simulated wind speeds and power for wind sites in the western United States.
5038e667d4a55f2ac3a4a96acdc239d7d247252a.result: Support vector regression provides accurate short-term wind power forecasts, and including neighbouring sites improves predictions.
5038e667d4a55f2ac3a4a96acdc239d7d247252a.open_work: Feature selection over neighbouring sites and scaling to larger regions are natural extensions.
5038e667d4a55f2ac3a4a96acdc239d7d247252a.issues: The dataset is model-based rather than measured turbine output; short horizons only, and no probabilistic forecasts.

7f148fb2bf73012a3791ac376604dd51e0df46cb.goal: Simulates daily pan evaporation from meteorological data, as a cheaper alternative to direct measurement for water resources management.
7f148fb2bf73012a3791ac376604dd51e0df46cb.architecture: Soft computing techniques compared with multiple linear regression; the specific network types are not specified here.
7f148fb2bf73012a3791ac376604dd51e0df46cb.data: Daily meteorological station data with measured pan evaporation; site and period not reported here.
7f148fb2bf73012a3791ac376604dd51e0df46cb.result: The title implies soft computing models are compared against multiple linear regression; quantitative results are not reported here.
7f148fb2bf73012a3791ac376604dd51e0df46cb.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates and with reduced input sets would clarify practical applicability.
7f148fb2bf73012a3791ac376604dd51e0df46cb.issues: Abstract unavailable; likely single-site evaluation, limiting generalization.

1fd8bc5092ae754a7aef14a8b015d3ea468b75b8.goal: Predicts short-term wind power with a hybrid machine learning model to improve grid integration of wind energy.
1fd8bc5092ae754a7aef14a8b015d3ea468b75b8.architecture: Hybrid machine learning model combining learning algorithms; the specific model types are not specified here.
1fd8bc5092ae754a7aef14a8b015d3ea468b75b8.data: Wind farm power and meteorological data; source and period not reported here.
1fd8bc5092ae754a7aef14a8b015d3ea468b75b8.result: The title implies the hybrid model improves short-term wind power prediction; quantitative results are not reported here.
1fd8bc5092ae754a7aef14a8b015d3ea468b75b8.open_work: Testing on more wind farms and longer horizons and adding probabilistic outputs are natural next steps.
1fd8bc5092ae754a7aef14a8b015d3ea468b75b8.issues: Abstract unavailable; details on data, horizons and baselines are unknown.

61e61292cf401252f5b628ccd9ca033596029789.goal: Estimates precipitation rates from geostationary infrared and visible imagery consistently for daytime, nighttime and twilight conditions.
61e61292cf401252f5b628ccd9ca033596029789.architecture: Random forest models for rain area delineation and rain rate estimation, using SEVIRI spectral channels and derived cloud properties.
61e61292cf401252f5b628ccd9ca033596029789.data: MSG SEVIRI data over Germany with RADOLAN RW gauge-adjusted radar product as reference.
61e61292cf401252f5b628ccd9ca033596029789.result: Random forests give reasonable rain area detection and rain rate estimates, with better performance during daytime than at night or twilight.
61e61292cf401252f5b628ccd9ca033596029789.open_work: Adding further predictors and extending the approach to other regions are suggested.
61e61292cf401252f5b628ccd9ca033596029789.issues: Rain rate estimation remains weaker than rain area detection; reference radar has its own errors, and the region is limited to Germany.

590bef73fea8ea35ef846586981506b6e5bb686d.goal: Combines active and passive microwave observations to produce improved surface soil moisture estimates.
590bef73fea8ea35ef846586981506b6e5bb686d.architecture: Machine learning approaches integrating ASCAT and SMAP observations; the specific model types are not specified here.
590bef73fea8ea35ef846586981506b6e5bb686d.data: ASCAT backscatter and SMAP passive microwave observations, with in situ soil moisture networks for validation implied.
590bef73fea8ea35ef846586981506b6e5bb686d.result: Not reported in the abstract; the integrated product is expected to improve on individual active or passive retrievals.
590bef73fea8ea35ef846586981506b6e5bb686d.open_work: Extending to longer records and other sensors to support continuous soil moisture climate data records is a natural next step.
590bef73fea8ea35ef846586981506b6e5bb686d.issues: Abstract unavailable; results depend on reference training targets and on sparse in situ validation.

691ace910ad947c125bb2e8e4ad1283bd64540ed.goal: Nowcasts cloud fraction at solar photovoltaic plants for 0–4 h ahead to stabilize solar electricity generation and grid operation.
691ace910ad947c125bb2e8e4ad1283bd64540ed.architecture: Recurrent neural network applied to sequences of geostationary satellite radiance images, within a cyclically updated prediction system.
691ace910ad947c125bb2e8e4ad1283bd64540ed.data: Continuous high-resolution geostationary satellite radiance images; tested at five photovoltaic plants and cloud fraction stations in China.
691ace910ad947c125bb2e8e4ad1283bd64540ed.result: Forecasts are skillful especially within 2 h, with average correlation near 0.8 between predicted clear-sky ratio and actual photovoltaic power.
691ace910ad947c125bb2e8e4ad1283bd64540ed.open_work: Extending to more plants and coupling with direct power forecasting could raise operational value.
691ace910ad947c125bb2e8e4ad1283bd64540ed.issues: Skill degrades beyond 2 h; evaluation is limited to China, and cloud fraction is only a proxy for irradiance and power.

2e2e0ee1523f11830849a1e105c3318b9b68ba95.goal: Forecasts streamflow for Central European rivers and tests whether Kolmogorov-Arnold networks are competitive with transformers.
2e2e0ee1523f11830849a1e105c3318b9b68ba95.architecture: Kolmogorov-Arnold networks compared against transformer models for streamflow forecasting.
2e2e0ee1523f11830849a1e105c3318b9b68ba95.data: Streamflow (and likely meteorological) records from Central European rivers; specific gauges and periods not reported here.
2e2e0ee1523f11830849a1e105c3318b9b68ba95.result: Not reported in the abstract; the comparison assesses relative accuracy of KAN and transformer forecasts.
2e2e0ee1523f11830849a1e105c3318b9b68ba95.open_work: Testing on more basins and longer lead times and studying KAN interpretability are natural extensions.
2e2e0ee1523f11830849a1e105c3318b9b68ba95.issues: Abstract unavailable; few rivers may limit generality of conclusions.

689b7bc64a4058b99e904556cf5cbc67421f2916.goal: Improves the interpretability of deep learning flood prediction so that model drivers can be understood by practitioners.
689b7bc64a4058b99e904556cf5cbc67421f2916.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM (convolutional and long short-term memory network) combined with SHAP explanations.
689b7bc64a4058b99e904556cf5cbc67421f2916.data: Hydrological and meteorological time series for a study basin; details not reported here.
689b7bc64a4058b99e904556cf5cbc67421f2916.result: Not reported in the abstract; SHAP is used to identify the contributions of input variables to CNN-LSTM flood predictions.
689b7bc64a4058b99e904556cf5cbc67421f2916.open_work: Testing across basins and comparing explanation methods would strengthen trust in the interpretations.
689b7bc64a4058b99e904556cf5cbc67421f2916.issues: Abstract unavailable; SHAP explanations describe the model rather than physical causality.

bfd25cb6c932b9a196f85eb1c5218ed7cfa01c08.goal: Produces short-term rainfall forecasts for a mountainous typhoon-affected watershed by merging gauge, radar and satellite rainfall estimates.
bfd25cb6c932b9a196f85eb1c5218ed7cfa01c08.architecture: Bias-corrected multi-sensor merging with optimized weights, followed by an adaptive network-based fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) for multi-step forecasts.
bfd25cb6c932b9a196f85eb1c5218ed7cfa01c08.data: 641 hourly records from 13 typhoon events in the Shihmen Reservoir watershed, Taiwan, using rain gauges, QPESUMS radar and PERSIANN-CCS satellite products.
bfd25cb6c932b9a196f85eb1c5218ed7cfa01c08.result: Bias adjustment improves QPESUMS RMSE by 30–60%; ANFIS forecasts reach correlations above 0.85 at 1 h and 0.72 at 2 h ahead.
bfd25cb6c932b9a196f85eb1c5218ed7cfa01c08.open_work: Extending lead times and coupling with flood warning models are natural next steps.
bfd25cb6c932b9a196f85eb1c5218ed7cfa01c08.issues: Limited to 13 typhoon events in one watershed; skill drops quickly with lead time.

64ec94e1e6dcdb613f95498ae9f9729733175c33.goal: Forecasts monthly precipitation in the drought-prone Maharloo Basin in southern Iran using large-scale climate indices to support water management.
64ec94e1e6dcdb613f95498ae9f9729733175c33.architecture: Artificial neural network compared with stepwise multiple regression, with predictors chosen by cross-correlation and stepwise selection from 40 climate indices.
64ec94e1e6dcdb613f95498ae9f9729733175c33.data: Monthly observed precipitation in the Maharloo Basin and 40 atmospheric circulation indices such as NAO, PNA and ENSO.
64ec94e1e6dcdb613f95498ae9f9729733175c33.result: The ANN outperforms multiple regression; NAO, PNA and El Nino are the key predictors, with best accuracy in September and worst in March.
64ec94e1e6dcdb613f95498ae9f9729733175c33.open_work: Adding other climatic and physiographic factors such as wind and topography is suggested.
64ec94e1e6dcdb613f95498ae9f9729733175c33.issues: Coarse data and high system complexity introduce uncertainty; many candidate predictors raise overfitting risk.

0edf6381b8d212d298b9d5bc066d6bb9baee6a1c.goal: Predicts wind energy production using a neural network to support wind farm operation.
0edf6381b8d212d298b9d5bc066d6bb9baee6a1c.architecture: Feed-forward neural network with two hidden layers.
0edf6381b8d212d298b9d5bc066d6bb9baee6a1c.data: Wind farm meteorological and power data; site and period not reported here.
0edf6381b8d212d298b9d5bc066d6bb9baee6a1c.result: The title implies the two-hidden-layer network gives accurate wind energy predictions; quantitative results are not reported here.
0edf6381b8d212d298b9d5bc066d6bb9baee6a1c.open_work: Comparisons with other models and testing on additional sites would strengthen the results.
0edf6381b8d212d298b9d5bc066d6bb9baee6a1c.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-site evaluation is likely, limiting generality.

670f691d602a24bb3f076ad7fb26410e1123f78a.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration when some climatic inputs are missing, using measured and estimated meteorological variables.
670f691d602a24bb3f076ad7fb26410e1123f78a.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) and artificial neural network models compared.
670f691d602a24bb3f076ad7fb26410e1123f78a.data: Daily climatic station data, with some inputs estimated from available variables; sites and period not reported here.
670f691d602a24bb3f076ad7fb26410e1123f78a.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies both models can estimate ET0 using available and estimated climatic data.
670f691d602a24bb3f076ad7fb26410e1123f78a.open_work: Testing across more stations and climates would establish transferability.
670f691d602a24bb3f076ad7fb26410e1123f78a.issues: Abstract unavailable; target ET0 is likely derived from an empirical equation rather than measured.

c8e074e33afdc7c73dcf0b457cfb034fdcf1e587.goal: Models the runoff coefficient time series and compares a hybrid neural network with classical stochastic time series models.
c8e074e33afdc7c73dcf0b457cfb034fdcf1e587.architecture: Hybrid artificial neural network model compared with ARIMA and ARIMAX models.
c8e074e33afdc7c73dcf0b457cfb034fdcf1e587.data: Hydrological time series for computing runoff coefficients; basin and period not reported here.
c8e074e33afdc7c73dcf0b457cfb034fdcf1e587.result: Not reported in the abstract; the study compares predictive accuracy of the ANN hybrid with ARIMA and ARIMAX.
c8e074e33afdc7c73dcf0b457cfb034fdcf1e587.open_work: Testing on more basins and including additional exogenous predictors are natural extensions.
c8e074e33afdc7c73dcf0b457cfb034fdcf1e587.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and performance details are unknown.

7ebc23ecbf8132c76b86bbc3eca2e54c7c1df08a.goal: Forecasts wind farm power while accounting for blockage effects, where turbines slow upstream flow and alter farm-level output.
7ebc23ecbf8132c76b86bbc3eca2e54c7c1df08a.architecture: Temporal-spatial graph neural network that models turbines as graph nodes with spatial and temporal dependencies.
7ebc23ecbf8132c76b86bbc3eca2e54c7c1df08a.data: Wind farm turbine-level SCADA or power data; source and period not reported here.
7ebc23ecbf8132c76b86bbc3eca2e54c7c1df08a.result: Not reported in the abstract; the model is expected to improve accuracy by representing blockage-induced spatial interactions.
7ebc23ecbf8132c76b86bbc3eca2e54c7c1df08a.open_work: Generalization to other farm layouts and inclusion of weather forecast inputs are natural next steps.
7ebc23ecbf8132c76b86bbc3eca2e54c7c1df08a.issues: Abstract unavailable; physical representation of blockage in the graph structure is unclear, and evaluation may cover few farms.

0d3395beb19f8cc9af8d2a20bacf11d16334ed9e.goal: Assesses how future climate change and land use change will affect flood risk, combining hazard, exposure and vulnerability.
0d3395beb19f8cc9af8d2a20bacf11d16334ed9e.architecture: XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM and ExtraTrees models for flood susceptibility, combined with hydraulic modelling and an analytical hierarchy process for risk.

0d3395beb19f8cc9af8d2a20bacf11d16334ed9e.issues: Single RCP 8.5 scenario; AHP weighting is subjective, and machine learning skill metrics are not reported in the abstract.

f0123f9beee35b56bd7ba316594d97155d99f85d.goal: Predicts the cloud patterns of the Madden-Julian Oscillation at intraseasonal lead times using a simple model of its spatial modes.

f0123f9beee35b56bd7ba316594d97155d99f85d.issues: The low-order model captures only large-scale patterns and depends on the mode extraction; skill varies between strong and weak MJO years.

6733df0745d1643e78708580dab79039722843ee.goal: Short-term solar radiation forecasting, using clustering to group similar weather conditions before forecasting.
6733df0745d1643e78708580dab79039722843ee.architecture: A novel clustering approach combined with neural network forecasting models; specific network type not confirmed.

f420e95093137e9a2466e9685952623fc14c18e1.goal: Evaluates machine learning for daily streamflow forecasting in a data-scarce semi-arid mountain basin in Morocco facing drought and rising water demand.
f420e95093137e9a2466e9685952623fc14c18e1.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) and random forest compared with multiple linear regression (MLR).
f420e95093137e9a2466e9685952623fc14c18e1.data: Daily hydrometeorological and streamflow data for the Rheraya sub-basin (Tensift basin, Morocco), 2003–2016.

c465f8bf306e6adbb4623249175a3f1689ed3bb5.architecture: Improved partial mutual information (PMI) input variable selection algorithm, applied with artificial neural networks.

8ed2cce79783174100dbb4c84ae78731226755e2.goal: Online multistep-ahead forecasting of flood inundation depths during typhoons, where observed inputs are unavailable at forecast time.
8ed2cce79783174100dbb4c84ae78731226755e2.architecture: Recurrent NARX network (R-NARX, a recurrent neural network) compared with time-delay (T-NARX) and online feedback (O-NARX) NARX configurations.

8ed2cce79783174100dbb4c84ae78731226755e2.open_work: Validation with observed inundation data and extension to spatially distributed inundation maps.
8ed2cce79783174100dbb4c84ae78731226755e2.issues: Trained and tested on simulated rather than observed inundation; site-based point forecasts only.

0dcadfcb559095e6ae44f9432635e1deb7cee7bc.goal: Combines multiple satellite-retrieved datasets into a coherent estimate of terrestrial water cycle components that closes the water budget.
0dcadfcb559095e6ae44f9432635e1deb7cee7bc.architecture: Integration methods: simple weighting, constrained linear, optimal interpolation and neural networks (MLP), plus a post-processing filter imposing budget closure; no model assimilation.

0dcadfcb559095e6ae44f9432635e1deb7cee7bc.issues: Depends on error estimates of the input products; closure does not guarantee unbiased components.

96a3b520fa9e3b01761fa18bff583f87abc1b4e1.goal: Daily river flow forecasting for water management and flood warning.

2a453a632026fdcd27305d89445022a6fc314050.architecture: Compares four neural network types: generalized regression neural network (GRNN), feed-forward backpropagation MLP, cascade-forward network and Elman recurrent network.
2a453a632026fdcd27305d89445022a6fc314050.data: Hourly solar radiation and meteorological measurements; site, period and exact inputs are not detailed in the abstract (the authors work on Malaysian sites).
2a453a632026fdcd27305d89445022a6fc314050.result: GRNN performs best with MAPE 4.9%, MBE 0.29% and RMSE 5.75%; FFNN and CFNN reach about 22-23% MAPE and degrade in poor radiation conditions; Elman is worst (34.5% MAPE).
2a453a632026fdcd27305d89445022a6fc314050.open_work: Testing GRNN across more sites and climates, longer lead times and comparison against physical or satellite-based irradiance models.
2a453a632026fdcd27305d89445022a6fc314050.issues: Single-study comparison with limited sites; percentage errors at hourly scale are hard to compare across studies; no uncertainty estimates.

956ee9a80ee7ca0aa53c64d299d28f8bdff3e07c.goal: Improves monthly reservoir inflow prediction for dam operation by exploiting multiscale information in meteorological inputs.
956ee9a80ee7ca0aa53c64d299d28f8bdff3e07c.architecture: Wavelet neural network: discrete wavelet transform decomposition feeding a Levenberg-Marquardt feed-forward MLP, with Mallows' Cp subset selection; also wavelet-regression (WREG), plain MLP and multiple linear regression baselines.
956ee9a80ee7ca0aa53c64d299d28f8bdff3e07c.data: Monthly meteorological data and inflows for the Kemer Dam basin, Aegean region of Turkey; record length not reported in the abstract.
956ee9a80ee7ca0aa53c64d299d28f8bdff3e07c.result: Wavelet decomposition improves both neural network and regression models, and the WNN gives the best monthly inflow predictions among the compared methods.
956ee9a80ee7ca0aa53c64d299d28f8bdff3e07c.open_work: Testing on other basins, longer lead times and alternative wavelet families or decomposition levels.
956ee9a80ee7ca0aa53c64d299d28f8bdff3e07c.issues: Single basin; wavelet decomposition over the full record can leak future information if not done causally; no uncertainty quantification.

20a0cd49a26866d69e0d2154707487f0a5386dc6.open_work: Incorporating climate and water-use drivers and testing longer-horizon forecasts of lake level.
20a0cd49a26866d69e0d2154707487f0a5386dc6.issues: Single lake; data-driven predictions may not extrapolate under rapidly changing human water withdrawals.

eb2fec3c696d4cebef2834f4a3977fe9ce6cdd3c.goal: Estimates flood flows at ungauged sites, comparing artificial neural network regionalization with the L-moments regional flood frequency approach.

eb2fec3c696d4cebef2834f4a3977fe9ce6cdd3c.issues: Limited number of gauged sites for training; results are region-specific.

52b9628f05c5de1f7f7245d437637c03b88b5039.goal: Predicts maize, rice and soybean yields in Northeast China from multi-source data to support food security and agricultural planning.
52b9628f05c5de1f7f7245d437637c03b88b5039.architecture: CNN-LSTM-Attention hybrid (convolutional neural network, LSTM and attention mechanism) compared with random forest, XGBoost and a CNN.
52b9628f05c5de1f7f7245d437637c03b88b5039.data: Multi-source data 2014-2020: vegetation indices including kNDVI, environmental variables and photosynthetically active parameters, with yield statistics for Northeast China.
52b9628f05c5de1f7f7245d437637c03b88b5039.result: The CNN-LSTM-Attention model gives significantly more accurate yields than the traditional models, and kNDVI proves an effective predictor for multiple crops; numbers not given in the abstract.
52b9628f05c5de1f7f7245d437637c03b88b5039.open_work: Extending to other regions and longer records, and using the model for in-season yield forecasting.
52b9628f05c5de1f7f7245d437637c03b88b5039.issues: Short seven-year record limits temporal generalization; no uncertainty estimates; gains over baselines not quantified in the abstract.

2e6b4a3dde0009e07d6087e45c6e710347c0457d.goal: Reviews how flood prediction and forecasting models used in flood early warning systems evolved from 1993 to 2023, to guide model selection in data-scarce regions.
2e6b4a3dde0009e07d6087e45c6e710347c0457d.architecture: Review (PRISMA scoping review) of time series models, machine learning models (mainly artificial neural networks) and coupled hydrological-hydraulic-ANN systems.
2e6b4a3dde0009e07d6087e45c6e710347c0457d.data: Literature from Scopus and Web of Science, 1993-2023.
2e6b4a3dde0009e07d6087e45c6e710347c0457d.result: Time series models dominated 1993-2010 and machine learning, mostly ANNs, since 2011; coupled hydrological, hydraulic and ANN models are the most used ensemble; satellite precipitation products can fill gauge gaps.
2e6b4a3dde0009e07d6087e45c6e710347c0457d.open_work: Interdisciplinary and institutional collaboration, and use of satellite precipitation products to build operational warning systems in poorly gauged regions.
2e6b4a3dde0009e07d6087e45c6e710347c0457d.issues: Scoping review limited to two databases; descriptive synthesis without quantitative comparison of model skill.

b65263661c67cba3a81ae9dcdfd618e8aa5de490.issues: Satellite retrievals are known to be weak over snow-covered, complex terrain; few basins.

b5743c8e771c3ca4d510a3d9b892ad7c510d3f6f.goal: Predicts solar radiation as input for modelling and sizing a concentrating photovoltaic (CPV) system.
b5743c8e771c3ca4d510a3d9b892ad7c510d3f6f.architecture: Artificial neural network models; the specific topology is not specified in the available metadata.

19012125470ea6641567e1703556e97935004ffd.goal: Predicts district-level wheat yield in Multan, Punjab, Pakistan, and clarifies the contribution of climate, soil, socioeconomic and remote sensing inputs.
19012125470ea6641567e1703556e97935004ffd.architecture: Support vector machine, random forest and LASSO regression on fused data built in Google Earth Engine, with attribute subset selection.
19012125470ea6641567e1703556e97935004ffd.data: 2017-2022 climate, satellite NDVI, soil properties and spatial data via Google Earth Engine; benchmark yields from Crop Report Services Punjab.
19012125470ea6641567e1703556e97935004ffd.result: Combining all data gives R2 0.74-0.88; random forest is best (RMSE 0.05 q/ha, R2 0.88); adding spatial information improves benchmark models by 0.08-0.12.
19012125470ea6641567e1703556e97935004ffd.open_work: Extending to more districts, crops and years, and to in-season forecasting.
19012125470ea6641567e1703556e97935004ffd.issues: Very short six-year record and a single region; high reported accuracy risks overfitting with small samples.

7b56692db6aecd56386476c6ef4daf3fc38a6c29.goal: Forecasts daily mean sea level at the Burgas tide gauge on the Bulgarian Black Sea coast for hazard monitoring of low-lying coasts.
7b56692db6aecd56386476c6ef4daf3fc38a6c29.architecture: Compares feed-forward, cascade-forward, time-delay, radial basis function and generalized regression neural networks with harmonic tide prediction and multiple linear regression.
7b56692db6aecd56386476c6ef4daf3fc38a6c29.data: Daily tide gauge data at Burgas, Bulgaria, 1990-2003.
7b56692db6aecd56386476c6ef4daf3fc38a6c29.result: Neural networks capture nonlinear sea level relationships and are judged suitable for short- and long-term sea level forecasts, competitive with harmonic analysis; numbers not given in the abstract.
7b56692db6aecd56386476c6ef4daf3fc38a6c29.open_work: Adding meteorological forcing (wind, pressure) and testing at other Black Sea gauges.
7b56692db6aecd56386476c6ef4daf3fc38a6c29.issues: Single gauge, univariate inputs; quantitative skill not reported in the abstract.

da004e09d48a2ae4fd44aea0695a0b13c4b9708f.goal: Quantifies uncertainty of wind power forecasts through reliable, informative prediction intervals for grid integration of wind farms.
da004e09d48a2ae4fd44aea0695a0b13c4b9708f.architecture: Mean-variance estimation with two neural networks (one for the mean, one for the variance), trained with a new prediction-interval-based optimization algorithm.
da004e09d48a2ae4fd44aea0695a0b13c4b9708f.data: Seasonal datasets from three geographically dispersed wind farms in Australia; confidence levels 50-90%.
da004e09d48a2ae4fd44aea0695a0b13c4b9708f.result: Both traditional and optimized intervals are valid, but optimized intervals are much more informative (narrower at similar coverage) than standard MVE intervals.
da004e09d48a2ae4fd44aea0695a0b13c4b9708f.open_work: Combining with NWP inputs and testing at longer horizons and more farms.
da004e09d48a2ae4fd44aea0695a0b13c4b9708f.issues: Gaussian assumption of MVE; limited to three farms; horizon details not given in the abstract.

89785597864366f289e86cce9c81c2b994ddd778.goal: Generates 1 km precipitation fields over the Tibetan Plateau and High Asia, where reanalyses are too coarse to capture topographic precipitation heterogeneity.

89785597864366f289e86cce9c81c2b994ddd778.data: ERA-Interim large-scale predictors, high-resolution terrain parameters and station precipitation observations in central Asia.
89785597864366f289e86cce9c81c2b994ddd778.result: The model captures temporal and spatial variation of monthly precipitation sums, rainy days and maximum daily precipitation at 1 km; sensitivity analysis shows predictor effects by subregion.
89785597864366f289e86cce9c81c2b994ddd778.open_work: Applying the transfer functions to climate model output for projections and validating in data-sparse high elevations.
89785597864366f289e86cce9c81c2b994ddd778.issues: Sparse, valley-biased station network in High Asia; inherits ERA-Interim biases; quantitative skill not given in the abstract.

301e4048136a943cfa7259d5788446c42ddd95f9.goal: Predicts daily ground-level air pollutant concentrations near Sohar Industrial Port, Oman, with a rigorous data preparation procedure.
301e4048136a943cfa7259d5788446c42ddd95f9.architecture: Multilayer perceptron trained with backpropagation, one model per pollutant.
301e4048136a943cfa7259d5788446c42ddd95f9.data: Daily CO, PM10, NO, NO2, NOx, SO2, H2S and O3 plus meteorology from a monitoring station in Ghadafan village, 700 m downwind of the port.
301e4048136a943cfa7259d5788446c42ddd95f9.result: R2 exceeds 0.70 for all pollutant models; temperature drives O3, SO2 and NOx, while wind speed and direction drive NO, CO, NO2 and H2S.
301e4048136a943cfa7259d5788446c42ddd95f9.open_work: Forecasting rather than same-day estimation, and testing at additional stations.
301e4048136a943cfa7259d5788446c42ddd95f9.issues: Single station; daily resolution; meteorology-only predictors without emission information.

25bdaaa1e41b3a6f47859efb39064704a82d1268.goal: Improves data-driven rainfall-runoff and flood simulation, addressing hyperparameter selection and loss of stability at longer lead times.
25bdaaa1e41b3a6f47859efb39064704a82d1268.architecture: Hybrid LSTM-Transformer tuned by random search (RS-LSTM-Transformer), compared with RS-LSTM, RS-Transformer, RS-BP and RS-MLP.
25bdaaa1e41b3a6f47859efb39064704a82d1268.data: Rainfall and runoff from basin stations in the Jingle watershed, middle Yellow River, China.
25bdaaa1e41b3a6f47859efb39064704a82d1268.result: At 1-h lead, NSE 0.970 (calibration) and 0.953 (validation), RMSE about 14 m3/s, bias about 0.5%; it gives more accurate peak flows as lead time increases.

25bdaaa1e41b3a6f47859efb39064704a82d1268.issues: Single watershed with limited flood events; deterministic output without uncertainty.

7e8ff447cf7c5a59476da439f4ecae0e6cff7e53.goal: Reconstructs high-resolution urban wind fields from sparse sensors for wind hazard mitigation, wind environment assessment and drone route planning.

48dd01cbdf9c605cf2e1bc6b8a08ae5bf401b1ad.goal: Predicts hourly solar irradiance at a photovoltaic station to reduce effects of intermittency on system stability.
48dd01cbdf9c605cf2e1bc6b8a08ae5bf401b1ad.architecture: Nonlinear autoregressive network with exogenous inputs (NARX recurrent neural network), compared with linear regression and other models.
48dd01cbdf9c605cf2e1bc6b8a08ae5bf401b1ad.data: NSRDB (National Solar Radiation Database) data for the Vichy-Rolla National Airport photovoltaic station, with time, day of year, sky cover, pressure and wind speed inputs.
