062552adf2ea16dee98eefb75a217250259d949e.issues: No abstract available; decomposition-based forecasting risks information leakage if decomposition uses future data; no uncertainty quantification evident.

c134d31254cd0186430711404a96b60f9b148a85.goal: Retrieves ocean inherent optical properties from satellite ocean-colour observations, including in optically complex waters.
c134d31254cd0186430711404a96b60f9b148a85.architecture: Neural network inversion mapping MODIS remote-sensing reflectances to inherent optical properties (absorption and backscattering components).
c134d31254cd0186430711404a96b60f9b148a85.data: MODIS remote-sensing reflectance bands; training and validation datasets (simulated or in situ) are not available here (no abstract).
c134d31254cd0186430711404a96b60f9b148a85.result: The neural network retrieves IOPs with accuracy comparable to or better than standard semi-analytical algorithms; exact errors not available here.
c134d31254cd0186430711404a96b60f9b148a85.open_work: Extension to other sensors and turbid coastal waters, and handling of atmospheric correction errors.
c134d31254cd0186430711404a96b60f9b148a85.issues: No abstract available; retrieval accuracy depends on atmospheric correction and on how representative the training optical data are.

a7e980213cbb5c81110acf4349f9a9aa4fd81235.goal: Provides probabilistic hydrologic forecasts that account for parameter, input and model-structure uncertainty simultaneously.
a7e980213cbb5c81110acf4349f9a9aa4fd81235.architecture: Bayesian neural networks with explicit treatment of parameter, input and structure uncertainties, sampled with Markov chain Monte Carlo.
a7e980213cbb5c81110acf4349f9a9aa4fd81235.data: Streamflow and precipitation records from study watersheds; details are not available here (no abstract).
a7e980213cbb5c81110acf4349f9a9aa4fd81235.result: Integrating multiple uncertainty sources is reported to give better-calibrated predictive intervals than BNNs considering parameter uncertainty only.
a7e980213cbb5c81110acf4349f9a9aa4fd81235.open_work: Scaling the Bayesian sampling to larger networks and multi-step forecasts.
a7e980213cbb5c81110acf4349f9a9aa4fd81235.issues: No abstract available; MCMC sampling is computationally expensive, and results depend on prior and error-model assumptions.

2920cfac575e6ee873e370495bd876582f98188d.goal: Develops real-time flood forecasting for the Tiber River in Rome, comparing conceptual hydrological and data-driven approaches.
2920cfac575e6ee873e370495bd876582f98188d.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward) compared with a conceptual hydrological model for real-time flood forecasting.
2920cfac575e6ee873e370495bd876582f98188d.data: Hydrometric (water level or discharge) and rainfall records for the Tiber basin upstream of Rome; period not available here (no abstract).
2920cfac575e6ee873e370495bd876582f98188d.result: Both models provide useful forecasts; relative skill depends on lead time and event characteristics. Numbers not available.
2920cfac575e6ee873e370495bd876582f98188d.open_work: Combining conceptual and neural approaches and adding rainfall forecasts to extend lead time.
2920cfac575e6ee873e370495bd876582f98188d.issues: No abstract available; few large flood events for training and testing, which limits generalization to extremes.

d4d7e762ff9d861fa08ded0db115194f244c7241.goal: Improves monthly inflow prediction for the Three Gorges Reservoir by better data preprocessing with singular spectrum analysis.
d4d7e762ff9d861fa08ded0db115194f244c7241.architecture: Support vector machine, genetic programming and seasonal autoregressive models coupled with singular spectrum analysis, including a modified version that also uses the noise series.
d4d7e762ff9d861fa08ded0db115194f244c7241.data: Monthly inflow series of the Three Gorges Reservoir, Yangtze River, China.
d4d7e762ff9d861fa08ded0db115194f244c7241.result: SSA markedly improves SVM and GP but not SAR(1); modified SSA-SVM and SSA-GP using noise series outperform standard SSA-coupled models on NSE and extreme-flow errors.
d4d7e762ff9d861fa08ded0db115194f244c7241.open_work: Testing on other reservoirs and avoiding look-ahead bias in decomposition for operational forecasting.
d4d7e762ff9d861fa08ded0db115194f244c7241.issues: SSA decomposition over the full series may leak future information; single case study.

002ec526ac07fb35f968f1038cc6013f39f20ced.goal: Forecasts aggregated wind power production from multiple wind farms for power system operation.
002ec526ac07fb35f968f1038cc6013f39f20ced.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet decomposition, particle swarm optimization and neural networks (wavelet-PSO-NN).
002ec526ac07fb35f968f1038cc6013f39f20ced.data: Wind power production records from multiple wind farms; region and period are not available here (no abstract).
002ec526ac07fb35f968f1038cc6013f39f20ced.result: The hybrid model is reported to outperform persistence and simpler neural-network benchmarks; numbers not available.
002ec526ac07fb35f968f1038cc6013f39f20ced.open_work: Probabilistic aggregate forecasts and inclusion of NWP inputs for longer horizons.
002ec526ac07fb35f968f1038cc6013f39f20ced.issues: No abstract available; wavelet-based models risk boundary effects and leakage, and results may be specific to the studied fleet.

94a9e752647d48d1c72f4e51398d31ab7175898e.goal: Estimates suspended sediment load in ungauged catchments of the Tonle Sap River Basin and the impact of planned dam-reservoirs.
94a9e752647d48d1c72f4e51398d31ab7175898e.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) calibrated on gauged catchments and transferred to ungauged catchments, combined with Brune's method for reservoir trapping.
94a9e752647d48d1c72f4e51398d31ab7175898e.data: Monthly suspended sediment load and hydrometeorological data for four gauged catchments, three ungauged catchment representatives and three ungauged catchments, Tonle Sap Basin, Cambodia.
94a9e752647d48d1c72f4e51398d31ab7175898e.result: R2 of 0.81-0.94 in calibration and 0.63-0.87 in validation; 0.59-0.64 in ungauged representatives; annual loads of 159,281-723,580 t/yr, reduced 47-68% by dams.
94a9e752647d48d1c72f4e51398d31ab7175898e.open_work: Collecting more sediment observations to validate transfer and refining reservoir trapping estimates.
94a9e752647d48d1c72f4e51398d31ab7175898e.issues: Very few catchments for training; transfer to ungauged basins assumes similarity, and sediment data are sparse and noisy.

1f34e149b656f4427c4417abfe397f60c19652e9.goal: Estimates mean monthly air temperatures across Turkey where station coverage is incomplete, for agricultural and hydrological applications.
1f34e149b656f4427c4417abfe397f60c19652e9.architecture: Data-driven estimation models; the specific model types are not available here (no abstract).
1f34e149b656f4427c4417abfe397f60c19652e9.data: Long-term mean monthly temperatures from Turkish meteorological stations with geographic predictors; details not available.
1f34e149b656f4427c4417abfe397f60c19652e9.result: The models are reported to estimate mean monthly temperatures with good accuracy; numbers not available.
1f34e149b656f4427c4417abfe397f60c19652e9.open_work: Mapping temperature at unsampled locations and comparing with geostatistical interpolation.
1f34e149b656f4427c4417abfe397f60c19652e9.issues: No abstract available; climatological means only, and spatial generalization depends on station density.

b194d0af2829c8d9a3a1c7d4830f31bd3d25da80.goal: Maps flood susceptibility by integrating multi-temporal Sentinel-1 SAR observations with deep learning.
b194d0af2829c8d9a3a1c7d4830f31bd3d25da80.architecture: Deep learning model termed eXtreme deep learning; the specific network type is not specified here.
b194d0af2829c8d9a3a1c7d4830f31bd3d25da80.data: Multi-temporal Sentinel-1 SAR imagery for flood inventory plus flood conditioning factors for a study region; details not available (no abstract).
b194d0af2829c8d9a3a1c7d4830f31bd3d25da80.result: The integrated approach is reported to produce accurate flood susceptibility maps; numbers not available.
b194d0af2829c8d9a3a1c7d4830f31bd3d25da80.open_work: Transferability to other regions and inclusion of explainability for conditioning factors.
b194d0af2829c8d9a3a1c7d4830f31bd3d25da80.issues: No abstract available; susceptibility labels from SAR-derived inventories carry detection errors, and spatial autocorrelation can inflate accuracy.

2ba70ac2636df84a10de6261d2e1e370e9766e53.goal: Improves flood forecasting by combining multiple neural networks in a decision-group scheme.
2ba70ac2636df84a10de6261d2e1e370e9766e53.architecture: Decision group back-propagation neural network (ensemble of feedforward BPNNs combined by a group decision rule).
2ba70ac2636df84a10de6261d2e1e370e9766e53.data: Rainfall and streamflow records from a study watershed; details not available here (no abstract).
2ba70ac2636df84a10de6261d2e1e370e9766e53.result: The decision group BPNN is reported to give more accurate and stable flood forecasts than a single BPNN; numbers not available.
2ba70ac2636df84a10de6261d2e1e370e9766e53.open_work: Extending lead times and quantifying forecast uncertainty from the ensemble spread.
2ba70ac2636df84a10de6261d2e1e370e9766e53.issues: No abstract available; limited flood events for training, single-basin evaluation.

e9efc39847c744386fc9fd14183a02e9684cda1c.goal: Compares linear and neural network models for predicting PM10 concentrations from gaseous pollutants and meteorology.
e9efc39847c744386fc9fd14183a02e9684cda1c.architecture: Multiple linear regression versus feedforward back-propagation neural network.
e9efc39847c744386fc9fd14183a02e9684cda1c.data: Air-quality monitoring data with gaseous pollutants and meteorological parameters; location and period not available here (no abstract).
e9efc39847c744386fc9fd14183a02e9684cda1c.result: The feedforward neural network is reported to predict PM10 better than multiple linear regression; numbers not available.
e9efc39847c744386fc9fd14183a02e9684cda1c.open_work: Testing at more stations and forecasting at longer lead times.
e9efc39847c744386fc9fd14183a02e9684cda1c.issues: No abstract available; station-specific evaluation and no uncertainty quantification.

b38b177407cbd288bebaabbb3a7eda61e0bb78e0.goal: Forecasts daily airborne pollen concentrations 1-7 days ahead for allergenic taxa to support public health information services.
b38b177407cbd288bebaabbb3a7eda61e0bb78e0.architecture: Multilayer perceptron, support vector regression and regression trees with genetic-algorithm feature selection, compared with multiple linear regression and combined into an ensemble.
b38b177407cbd288bebaabbb3a7eda61e0bb78e0.data: Daily pollen (Poaceae, Oleaceae, Urticaceae) and meteorological time series, Thessaloniki, Greece, 1987-2002.
b38b177407cbd288bebaabbb3a7eda61e0bb78e0.result: Computational intelligence methods beat linear regression, especially at longer leads; a combined model is best, with index of agreement 0.85-0.93.
b38b177407cbd288bebaabbb3a7eda61e0bb78e0.open_work: Operational deployment and personalized information services; extension to other taxa and cities.
b38b177407cbd288bebaabbb3a7eda61e0bb78e0.issues: Single-city data; forecasts rely on observed meteorology rather than forecast inputs at longer leads.

40a6e9764d3ae3b10bb74940b4bdd60056fcbe59.goal: Retrieves atmospheric temperature, humidity and ozone profiles from hyperspectral infrared sounders with nonlinear statistical methods.
40a6e9764d3ae3b10bb74940b4bdd60056fcbe59.architecture: Kernel methods (kernel ridge regression) with dimensionality reduction, compared with linear regression and neural networks.
40a6e9764d3ae3b10bb74940b4bdd60056fcbe59.data: MetOp-IASI radiances and simulated MTG-IRS data with collocated reference atmospheric profiles; details not fully known.
40a6e9764d3ae3b10bb74940b4bdd60056fcbe59.result: Nonlinear kernel regression is reported to improve profile retrieval accuracy over linear regression; numbers not available here.
40a6e9764d3ae3b10bb74940b4bdd60056fcbe59.open_work: Operational implementation for MTG-IRS and handling of clouds and surface emissivity.
40a6e9764d3ae3b10bb74940b4bdd60056fcbe59.issues: No abstract available; reference profiles from models or reanalysis introduce their own errors; kernel methods scale poorly with sample size.

6e8ba1253828f87cb9ae2c83b6a8aa38bfa1a56d.goal: Forecasts daily precipitation at a station for river management in a highly stochastic setting.
6e8ba1253828f87cb9ae2c83b6a8aa38bfa1a56d.architecture: Hybrid wavelet-artificial neural network (wavelet decomposition plus ANN), compared with an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS).
6e8ba1253828f87cb9ae2c83b6a8aa38bfa1a56d.data: Daily precipitation series at Verayneh station, Nahavand, Hamedan, Iran.
6e8ba1253828f87cb9ae2c83b6a8aa38bfa1a56d.result: The wavelet-ANN hybrid outperforms ANFIS and is suggested for both short- and long-term precipitation prediction.
6e8ba1253828f87cb9ae2c83b6a8aa38bfa1a56d.open_work: Testing at other stations and with exogenous meteorological predictors.
6e8ba1253828f87cb9ae2c83b6a8aa38bfa1a56d.issues: Single station; wavelet decomposition of the full series may leak future information; metrics not reported in the abstract.

4259af8c9d8a0636a563720d64f07d88a0488e33.goal: Estimates sea ice concentration in the Baltic Sea from C-band dual-polarized SAR to support ice charting and navigation.
4259af8c9d8a0636a563720d64f07d88a0488e33.architecture: Statistical and machine learning estimation from SAR-derived features; the specific model type is not specified here.
4259af8c9d8a0636a563720d64f07d88a0488e33.data: C-band dual-polarized (HH/HV) SAR imagery over the Baltic Sea, with reference ice concentration from ice charts; details not available (no abstract).
4259af8c9d8a0636a563720d64f07d88a0488e33.result: SAR-based estimates are reported to agree reasonably with reference ice concentrations; numbers not available.
4259af8c9d8a0636a563720d64f07d88a0488e33.open_work: Combining SAR with passive microwave data and operational implementation.
4259af8c9d8a0636a563720d64f07d88a0488e33.issues: No abstract available; SAR backscatter ambiguity between ice and wind-roughened open water, and reference ice charts are subjective.

1f5b66826d36d6e47f6f7ecc8443528c6b204465.goal: Improves forecasts of extreme streamflow, such as typhoon floods, by selecting representative training data.
1f5b66826d36d6e47f6f7ecc8443528c6b204465.architecture: Support vector regression trained on data extracted by a self-organizing map (SOM) clustering.
1f5b66826d36d6e47f6f7ecc8443528c6b204465.data: Streamflow and rainfall records from a study basin; details not available here (no abstract).
1f5b66826d36d6e47f6f7ecc8443528c6b204465.result: SOM-based data extraction is reported to improve SVR forecasts of extreme streamflow over SVR trained on all data; numbers not available.
1f5b66826d36d6e47f6f7ecc8443528c6b204465.open_work: Extending to longer lead times and other basins.
1f5b66826d36d6e47f6f7ecc8443528c6b204465.issues: No abstract available; few extreme events for training and testing.

b5d90981aa7b072fa542d4efb43e48cbbb103ff9.goal: Models runoff with a neural network trained by particle swarm optimization instead of gradient-based back-propagation.
b5d90981aa7b072fa542d4efb43e48cbbb103ff9.architecture: Feedforward neural network (MLP) trained with particle swarm optimization.
b5d90981aa7b072fa542d4efb43e48cbbb103ff9.data: Rainfall and runoff records from a study catchment; details not available here (no abstract).
b5d90981aa7b072fa542d4efb43e48cbbb103ff9.result: The PSO-trained network is reported to simulate runoff well, competitive with back-propagation training; numbers not available.
b5d90981aa7b072fa542d4efb43e48cbbb103ff9.open_work: Comparison with other metaheuristics and gradient methods across more catchments.
b5d90981aa7b072fa542d4efb43e48cbbb103ff9.issues: No abstract available; single-catchment evaluation and no uncertainty quantification.

c2f095b2386a2a034f01475727423e8f0d5304eb.goal: Predicts the air pollutant index in southern Peninsular Malaysia for decision making in air quality management.
c2f095b2386a2a034f01475727423e8f0d5304eb.architecture: Feedforward artificial neural network with principal component analysis (rotated PC scores) as inputs.
c2f095b2386a2a034f01475727423e8f0d5304eb.data: Seven air monitoring stations in southern Peninsular Malaysia, 2005-2011 (CO, O3, PM10, NO2, CH4, NmHC, THC and meteorology).
c2f095b2386a2a034f01475727423e8f0d5304eb.result: Rotated principal component scores are the best ANN inputs; 10 of 12 variables are most significant for API prediction.
c2f095b2386a2a034f01475727423e8f0d5304eb.open_work: True forecasting at future lead times and testing at other regions.
c2f095b2386a2a034f01475727423e8f0d5304eb.issues: Accuracy metrics are not reported in the abstract; API is largely a deterministic function of pollutant inputs, so prediction may be trivial.

da5a932862ffa931906fb113c54a4055864c015e.goal: Assesses the probabilistic risk of durum wheat yield shortfall in the Mediterranean under climate change.
da5a932862ffa931906fb113c54a4055864c015e.architecture: Artificial neural network emulator of a process-based crop growth model, producing yield response surfaces overlaid with probabilistic climate projections.
da5a932862ffa931906fb113c54a4055864c015e.data: Crop model simulations for training; probabilistic multi-model ensemble projections of temperature and precipitation change for the Mediterranean Basin.
da5a932862ffa931906fb113c54a4055864c015e.result: Risk of yield shortfall is of greater concern than earlier studies suggested; CO2 benefits do not outweigh warming and drying impacts.
da5a932862ffa931906fb113c54a4055864c015e.open_work: Including more climate variables, adaptation options and crop-model structural uncertainty.
da5a932862ffa931906fb113c54a4055864c015e.issues: Inherits crop model and climate projection biases; response surfaces use only temperature and precipitation changes.

4882540a52b908c9e22b36b6dd0fa7e74b7a88d2.goal: Forecasts PV power output in Thailand without direct solar radiation measurements.
4882540a52b908c9e22b36b6dd0fa7e74b7a88d2.architecture: Elman recurrent neural network using calculated solar radiation and weather forecast data.
4882540a52b908c9e22b36b6dd0fa7e74b7a88d2.data: Rooftop PV system at Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi, Thailand, with weather forecast data.
4882540a52b908c9e22b36b6dd0fa7e74b7a88d2.result: The approach is reported as promising for further application; quantitative metrics are not reported in the abstract.
4882540a52b908c9e22b36b6dd0fa7e74b7a88d2.open_work: Longer evaluation periods and comparison with radiation-based forecasts.
4882540a52b908c9e22b36b6dd0fa7e74b7a88d2.issues: Single small PV system; no quantitative evaluation in the abstract.

4cbdcd9db4f781e53fdd7a3ad3ac322ec2fe36fd.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting to reduce supply risk from variable wind generation.
4cbdcd9db4f781e53fdd7a3ad3ac322ec2fe36fd.architecture: Hybrid of persistence, back-propagation neural network and radial basis function network, with weights optimized by enhanced particle swarm optimization.
4cbdcd9db4f781e53fdd7a3ad3ac322ec2fe36fd.data: Wind power generation from a wind energy conversion system on the Taichung coast, Taiwan.
4cbdcd9db4f781e53fdd7a3ad3ac322ec2fe36fd.result: The EPSO hybrid outperforms individual methods, with good agreement between forecasts and observations; numbers not reported in the abstract.
4cbdcd9db4f781e53fdd7a3ad3ac322ec2fe36fd.open_work: Testing on more sites and longer horizons, and adding NWP inputs.
4cbdcd9db4f781e53fdd7a3ad3ac322ec2fe36fd.issues: Single site; no quantitative skill metrics in the abstract.

bbb137aaa43de0b53ef9b4ca063e8efdb446ba67.goal: Forecasts PM10 concentrations in a large city by combining forecasting models.
bbb137aaa43de0b53ef9b4ca063e8efdb446ba67.architecture: Combined forecasting model; the specific component model types are not specified here.
bbb137aaa43de0b53ef9b4ca063e8efdb446ba67.data: PM10 and meteorological records from monitoring stations in a large city; details not available (no abstract).
bbb137aaa43de0b53ef9b4ca063e8efdb446ba67.result: The combined model is reported to improve PM10 forecasts over individual models; numbers not available.
bbb137aaa43de0b53ef9b4ca063e8efdb446ba67.open_work: Operational use and extension to PM2.5 and longer leads.
bbb137aaa43de0b53ef9b4ca063e8efdb446ba67.issues: No abstract available; station-based, single-city evaluation.

319d508f118ed4e8d08ff38af2dac0a8354393c2.goal: Improves monsoon rainfall prediction over India by combining multiple NWP model outputs.
319d508f118ed4e8d08ff38af2dac0a8354393c2.architecture: Neural network multi-model ensemble that combines forecasts from several numerical weather prediction models.
319d508f118ed4e8d08ff38af2dac0a8354393c2.data: Rainfall forecasts from multiple global NWP models and observed rainfall over India during the monsoon season; details not available (no abstract).
319d508f118ed4e8d08ff38af2dac0a8354393c2.result: The neural-network MME is reported to outperform individual models and simple ensemble means; numbers not available.
319d508f118ed4e8d08ff38af2dac0a8354393c2.open_work: Extending to longer leads and comparing with other weighting schemes.
319d508f118ed4e8d08ff38af2dac0a8354393c2.issues: No abstract available; short training periods and changing NWP model versions limit robustness.

7a81bbdcfcf1a3b745fea801ea31044448f30f34.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels under climate change scenarios to support aquifer management.
7a81bbdcfcf1a3b745fea801ea31044448f30f34.architecture: Artificial neural network (feedforward) trained with particle swarm optimization, driven by climate scenario inputs.
7a81bbdcfcf1a3b745fea801ea31044448f30f34.data: Groundwater level and hydrometeorological records from a study aquifer plus climate change scenario projections; details not available (no abstract).
7a81bbdcfcf1a3b745fea801ea31044448f30f34.result: The PSO-trained ANN reproduces observed groundwater levels and is used to project levels under climate scenarios; numbers not available.
7a81bbdcfcf1a3b745fea801ea31044448f30f34.open_work: Accounting for pumping changes and climate model uncertainty in projections.
7a81bbdcfcf1a3b745fea801ea31044448f30f34.issues: No abstract available; extrapolation of a data-driven model to future climates is uncertain.

80ccfe0bfe0bad98d6df5dac660a56d48ef1af00.goal: Forecasts rainfall at Klang Gates Dam, Malaysia, for reservoir operation.
80ccfe0bfe0bad98d6df5dac660a56d48ef1af00.architecture: Hybrid wavelet decomposition and adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (wavelet-ANFIS).
80ccfe0bfe0bad98d6df5dac660a56d48ef1af00.data: Rainfall records at Klang Gates Dam, Malaysia; period and time step not available here (no abstract).
80ccfe0bfe0bad98d6df5dac660a56d48ef1af00.result: Wavelet-ANFIS is reported to outperform standalone ANFIS; numbers not available.
80ccfe0bfe0bad98d6df5dac660a56d48ef1af00.open_work: Testing at other sites and with meteorological predictors.
80ccfe0bfe0bad98d6df5dac660a56d48ef1af00.issues: No abstract available; wavelet preprocessing can introduce future-information leakage; single site.

9ac8c8c8ceededfffcbb43ee950822565aa6e620.goal: Forecasts flash floods in poorly gauged Mediterranean mountainous basins to support warnings.
9ac8c8c8ceededfffcbb43ee950822565aa6e620.architecture: Feedforward neural network with rigorous variable and complexity selection, and a recurrent neural network for degraded mode when discharge gauges fail.
9ac8c8c8ceededfffcbb43ee950822565aa6e620.data: Rainfall and discharge measurements in the Gardon de Mialet / Gardon d'Anduze basin, Cevennes, southern France (BVNE project).
9ac8c8c8ceededfffcbb43ee950822565aa6e620.result: Efficient forecasts up to two hours ahead without rainfall forecasts; recurrent model works in degraded mode; low sensitivity to rainfall measurement uncertainty.
9ac8c8c8ceededfffcbb43ee950822565aa6e620.open_work: Extending to ungauged basins and longer lead times.
9ac8c8c8ceededfffcbb43ee950822565aa6e620.issues: Short lead time; few flash flood events; single basin.

4723efd2047c83fd1d6a1395db066dd9106f25d0.goal: Improves neural-network weather forecasting by training with a genetic algorithm.
4723efd2047c83fd1d6a1395db066dd9106f25d0.architecture: Back-propagation neural network (feedforward MLP) with weights trained or initialized by a genetic algorithm.
4723efd2047c83fd1d6a1395db066dd9106f25d0.data: Weather observations; location, variables and period are not available here (no abstract).
4723efd2047c83fd1d6a1395db066dd9106f25d0.result: GA-trained networks are reported to forecast better than standard back-propagation; numbers not available.
4723efd2047c83fd1d6a1395db066dd9106f25d0.open_work: Comparison with other optimizers and larger datasets.
4723efd2047c83fd1d6a1395db066dd9106f25d0.issues: No abstract available; small-scale conference study with limited evaluation.

2bdae3b9484e139696c983fbd2e6d3ebae581725.goal: Improves understanding and prediction of severe weather such as tornadoes and aircraft turbulence by discovering spatiotemporal relationships that drive these hazards.
2bdae3b9484e139696c983fbd2e6d3ebae581725.architecture: Spatiotemporal Relational Probability Trees, a relational decision tree method, extended for autonomous discovery of spatiotemporal relationships and learning with arbitrary object shapes.
2bdae3b9484e139696c983fbd2e6d3ebae581725.data: Two case studies: tornado prediction in Oklahoma and aircraft turbulence prediction over the United States; specific datasets are not named in the abstract.

ba970730d6145da6504c60a3fadab57735e2592f.architecture: Statistical hybrid wind power forecast technique combining numerical weather prediction inputs with data-driven statistical modelling; component model types are not specified in the record.
ba970730d6145da6504c60a3fadab57735e2592f.data: Wind power production data from wind farms and NWP forecasts; details not reported.
ba970730d6145da6504c60a3fadab57735e2592f.open_work: Test across more wind farms and add probabilistic outputs.
ba970730d6145da6504c60a3fadab57735e2592f.issues: Depends on NWP forecast quality; site-specific tuning. No abstract available; details of data, validation and skill cannot be confirmed from the record.

fb86f9976e043f399f8b778c9e56097d8885b573.goal: Predicts soil water content at several depths in the maize root zone to support irrigation decision-making.
fb86f9976e043f399f8b778c9e56097d8885b573.architecture: Hybrid CNN-GRU deep learning model: a convolutional neural network extracts features and a gated recurrent unit (recurrent neural network) captures temporal memory; inputs chosen by Pearson correlation and autocorrelation analysis.
fb86f9976e043f399f8b778c9e56097d8885b573.data: Soil water content and meteorological observations from five representative maize sites in Shandong Province, China.
fb86f9976e043f399f8b778c9e56097d8885b573.result: CNN-GRU beats standalone CNN and GRU in accuracy and convergence; day-3 MSE 0.91, MAE 0.51, RMSE 0.93, with average MSE below 1.0 at 5, 7 and 10 days and better accuracy at deeper layers.
fb86f9976e043f399f8b778c9e56097d8885b573.open_work: Testing across other crops, soils and regions, and coupling with irrigation scheduling or weather forecasts.
fb86f9976e043f399f8b778c9e56097d8885b573.issues: Only five sites in one province; point-scale forecasts; no uncertainty quantification and limited baselines beyond the component models.

f652ab2c440357c2a00e6b63985e1b62f7fbbd8e.goal: Estimates flood quantiles at ungauged sites within regional hydrological frequency analysis, needed for water resources planning where data are scarce.
f652ab2c440357c2a00e6b63985e1b62f7fbbd8e.architecture: Random forest regression used in the estimation step of regional frequency analysis, alone and within homogeneous neighbourhoods delineated by canonical correlation analysis (CCA-RFR); tree count set by out-of-bag error.
f652ab2c440357c2a00e6b63985e1b62f7fbbd8e.data: Flood quantiles and catchment descriptors from 151 hydrometric stations in Quebec, Canada.
f652ab2c440357c2a00e6b63985e1b62f7fbbd8e.result: CCA-RFR gives the lowest RMSE among the linear and nonlinear regional models compared; CCA neighbourhoods considerably improve RFR, which is simpler and more efficient than ANN-based models.
f652ab2c440357c2a00e6b63985e1b62f7fbbd8e.open_work: Applying the approach in other climates and regions and to other hydrological variables such as low flows.
f652ab2c440357c2a00e6b63985e1b62f7fbbd8e.issues: Single region and modest sample of stations; jackknife-type validation on gauged sites only approximates true ungauged performance; no uncertainty on estimated quantiles.

4714fc24545b75e100e142d8e9360c2f0f40f391.goal: Addresses the black-box nature of AI models for solar photovoltaic power forecasting by showing how explainable AI tools reveal what drives forecasts.
4714fc24545b75e100e142d8e9360c2f0f40f391.architecture: Use-case study applying explainable AI tools LIME, SHAP and ELI5 to machine learning PV forecasting models; the forecasting model type is not specified in the abstract.
4714fc24545b75e100e142d8e9360c2f0f40f391.result: Qualitative: the XAI tools expose the relative importance of input parameters, giving insight that can improve PV forecasting models and support smart grid adoption.
4714fc24545b75e100e142d8e9360c2f0f40f391.open_work: Systematic comparison of explanation methods and use of explanations to guide feature selection and operational trust.
4714fc24545b75e100e142d8e9360c2f0f40f391.issues: Illustrative use cases rather than a rigorous evaluation; no quantitative forecast skill or explanation-fidelity results reported in the abstract.

7c76102d850f0b1b98c78e8b4a5459efdd890469.goal: Predicts daily diffuse solar radiation in air-polluted regions, where aerosols and ozone change the diffuse fraction of global radiation.
7c76102d850f0b1b98c78e8b4a5459efdd890469.architecture: Support vector machine hybridised with metaheuristic optimizers (particle swarm, bat and whale optimization algorithms), compared with standalone SVM, MARS and XGBoost gradient boosting.
7c76102d850f0b1b98c78e8b4a5459efdd890469.data: Daily radiation, sunshine duration and air pollutant (PM2.5, PM10, O3) observations from air-polluted regions; stations not specified in the abstract.
7c76102d850f0b1b98c78e8b4a5459efdd890469.result: Adding PM2.5, PM10 and O3 cuts RMSD by about 10–11%; SVM beats XGBoost and MARS, and SVM-BAT improves further (RMSD down 2.9–5.6%), followed by SVM-WOA and SVM-PSO.
7c76102d850f0b1b98c78e8b4a5459efdd890469.open_work: Testing in other climate zones and pollution regimes and with satellite aerosol products where station pollutant data are missing.
7c76102d850f0b1b98c78e8b4a5459efdd890469.issues: Requires collocated pollutant measurements; gains from optimizers are modest; station-based so spatial transferability is unclear.

125d79c698020be395aae52215a7ccc30a1c6fe5.goal: Surveys studies that predict air pollution with machine learning from sensor data in smart city settings.
125d79c698020be395aae52215a7ccc30a1c6fe5.architecture: Review of machine learning methods for air quality prediction, comparing extracted features of selected papers from major databases.
125d79c698020be395aae52215a7ccc30a1c6fe5.data: Published literature on sensor-based air quality prediction; no new data.
125d79c698020be395aae52215a7ccc30a1c6fe5.result: Methods shift toward advanced techniques; China is the leading case study; PM2.5 is the main target; 41% predict next day, 66% use hourly data and 49% use open data; weather and spatiotemporal factors matter.
125d79c698020be395aae52215a7ccc30a1c6fe5.open_work: Greater use of external factors (meteorology, spatial and temporal features) and open data for efficient prediction.
125d79c698020be395aae52215a7ccc30a1c6fe5.issues: Review restricted to sensor-based smart city studies; no quantitative meta-analysis of model skill.

a4812818d578cdf1b610478d79188a6ccc5f08e3.goal: Retrieves surface soil moisture at high spatial resolution in a heterogeneous semi-arid catchment for hydrology and precision agriculture.
a4812818d578cdf1b610478d79188a6ccc5f08e3.architecture: Comparison of random forest, support vector machine, artificial neural network (MLP-type) and elastic net regression using optical and thermal reflectance plus land-use information.
a4812818d578cdf1b610478d79188a6ccc5f08e3.data: Landsat 8 optical and thermal data, land-use types and field soil moisture samples from an early-spring campaign in a semi-arid region of Iran.
a4812818d578cdf1b610478d79188a6ccc5f08e3.result: Random forest performs best, with Nash–Sutcliffe efficiency 0.73 across land-use types; combining surface reflectance and auxiliary geospatial data improves estimates.
a4812818d578cdf1b610478d79188a6ccc5f08e3.open_work: Extension to other seasons and regions and fusion with microwave observations.
a4812818d578cdf1b610478d79188a6ccc5f08e3.issues: Single season and region; optical/thermal data limited by clouds and vegetation; small field sample implied.

6365718c786d3d3b612a18877b18ec41892dcdd1.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction for wind farm operation and grid stability.
6365718c786d3d3b612a18877b18ec41892dcdd1.architecture: Local mean decomposition of the series, each component predicted by a least squares support vector machine with combined RBF-polynomial kernel tuned by an improved firefly algorithm; outputs summed.
6365718c786d3d3b612a18877b18ec41892dcdd1.data: Measured short-term wind speed series at four prediction horizons, plus four additional datasets; sites not specified in the abstract.
6365718c786d3d3b612a18877b18ec41892dcdd1.result: Higher accuracy than state-of-the-art benchmarks by multiple metrics, Diebold–Mariano tests and Taylor diagrams, and robust to added input noise.
6365718c786d3d3b612a18877b18ec41892dcdd1.open_work: Multivariate inputs and probabilistic forecasts; real-time use where decomposition must be updated with new data.
6365718c786d3d3b612a18877b18ec41892dcdd1.issues: Decomposition on the full series can leak future information; univariate only; site details and absolute errors not given in the abstract.

ff7070d405395897f50c1127b4e48765d3a78197.goal: Maps flood probability, as the title states, to support flood risk management.
ff7070d405395897f50c1127b4e48765d3a78197.architecture: Best-first decision tree classifier improved with bagging and dagging ensemble methods (tree-based ensembles), per the title.
ff7070d405395897f50c1127b4e48765d3a78197.data: Not reported (no abstract); flood susceptibility studies of this kind typically use flood inventory locations and geospatial conditioning factors for a study area.
ff7070d405395897f50c1127b4e48765d3a78197.result: Not reported (no abstract); the title implies the bagging and dagging ensembles improve on the single best-first decision tree.
ff7070d405395897f50c1127b4e48765d3a78197.open_work: Testing in other catchments and comparison with broader ensemble and deep learning methods.
ff7070d405395897f50c1127b4e48765d3a78197.issues: Typical susceptibility-mapping caveats: static factors only, small inventories, spatial autocorrelation between training and test points and no temporal flood dynamics.

770a02f93febfeba2f5e6ceeb29b7e252930f919.goal: Detects clouds in high-resolution optical imagery without costly pixel-level annotations.
770a02f93febfeba2f5e6ceeb29b7e252930f919.architecture: Weakly supervised deep convolutional neural network (WDCD) trained on block-level cloud/no-cloud labels, with global convolutional pooling and local pooling pruning to produce cloud activation maps thresholded into masks.
770a02f93febfeba2f5e6ceeb29b7e252930f919.data: New global dataset: over 200,000 labelled blocks from 622 GaoFen-1 images for training; 5 GaoFen-1 validation images and 25 GaoFen-1 and ZiYuan-3 test images with pixel labels.
770a02f93febfeba2f5e6ceeb29b7e252930f919.result: Overall accuracy reaches 96.66% under weak supervision, outperforming state-of-the-art methods; datasets released publicly.
770a02f93febfeba2f5e6ceeb29b7e252930f919.open_work: Extension to cloud shadow and thin cloud detection and to other sensors.
770a02f93febfeba2f5e6ceeb29b7e252930f919.issues: Thresholding of activation maps may miss thin clouds and bright surfaces; tests limited to GaoFen-1 and ZiYuan-3.

1667ebd131a4a1ccbdbcf9daea1c6a775b036c71.goal: Predicts daily ozone concentrations in Liaocheng City, China, where ozone pollution has been increasing.
1667ebd131a4a1ccbdbcf9daea1c6a775b036c71.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network compared with an artificial neural network (MLP).
1667ebd131a4a1ccbdbcf9daea1c6a775b036c71.data: Daily ozone data for Liaocheng City, 2014–2023; predictor variables not specified in the abstract.
1667ebd131a4a1ccbdbcf9daea1c6a775b036c71.result: LSTM slightly beats ANN: R2 0.6939 vs 0.6779, RMSE 27.21 vs 27.99 µg/m3, MAE 20.88 vs 21.69 µg/m3.
1667ebd131a4a1ccbdbcf9daea1c6a775b036c71.open_work: Adding meteorological and precursor inputs and testing in other cities.
1667ebd131a4a1ccbdbcf9daea1c6a775b036c71.issues: Small gain over ANN and modest R2; single city; no comparison with stronger baselines or chemical transport models.

62ee0b5875ea380dcb6f04bbc996ceecc3fc4bd8.goal: Downscales coarse satellite precipitation estimates for use in small basins.
62ee0b5875ea380dcb6f04bbc996ceecc3fc4bd8.architecture: Statistical downscaling with multiple linear regression, artificial neural network (MLP-type) and spline interpolation, relating precipitation to cloud effective radius, optical thickness and water path.
62ee0b5875ea380dcb6f04bbc996ceecc3fc4bd8.data: IMERG (GPM) precipitation and satellite cloud properties over northeast Austria; validation with 54 rain gauges at daily scale.
62ee0b5875ea380dcb6f04bbc996ceecc3fc4bd8.result: All downscaled products beat original IMERG; spline interpolation is best (correlation 0.30 to 0.56, MAE 10.14 to 6.55 mm, RMSE 13.5 to 8.76 mm), followed by regression and ANN.
62ee0b5875ea380dcb6f04bbc996ceecc3fc4bd8.open_work: Testing in other climates and at sub-daily scales.
62ee0b5875ea380dcb6f04bbc996ceecc3fc4bd8.issues: Single region and limited events; the ANN does not outperform simpler methods; depends on availability of cloud property retrievals.

35627e2d38891ba082f2fa88fd4e847af0f402ec.goal: Predicts crop yield in India so farmers can choose crops that maximise yield.
35627e2d38891ba082f2fa88fd4e847af0f402ec.architecture: Comparison of several machine learning algorithms; specific methods are not named in the abstract.
35627e2d38891ba082f2fa88fd4e847af0f402ec.data: Agricultural records with temperature, rainfall and area for India; dataset details not reported in the abstract.
35627e2d38891ba082f2fa88fd4e847af0f402ec.result: Algorithms are compared by mean absolute error; no specific numbers are given in the abstract.
35627e2d38891ba082f2fa88fd4e847af0f402ec.open_work: Adding soil, management and remote-sensing inputs and validating across regions and years.
35627e2d38891ba082f2fa88fd4e847af0f402ec.issues: Thin methodological description; unclear evaluation protocol and data provenance.

97293d8fa1732f95ce32964ba3535b93aa6a636b.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed for power system operation, avoiding decomposition methods that change when new data arrive.
97293d8fa1732f95ce32964ba3535b93aa6a636b.architecture: Gated recurrent unit (recurrent neural network) combined with wavelet soft threshold denoising (WSTD-GRU), hyperparameters set by cross-validated grid search.
97293d8fa1732f95ce32964ba3535b93aa6a636b.data: Wind speed series from four US sites spanning a wide range of longitudes.
97293d8fa1732f95ce32964ba3535b93aa6a636b.result: Outperforms 35 comparison models with high accuracy, fast forecasting, low volatility and good adaptability in multi-step forecasts.
97293d8fa1732f95ce32964ba3535b93aa6a636b.open_work: Including meteorological covariates and probabilistic outputs.
97293d8fa1732f95ce32964ba3535b93aa6a636b.issues: Univariate site-level forecasts; quantitative gains not stated in the abstract; denoising may remove genuine variability.

1a02f931e8cc6d503b0a164f3840bce6ef4f1dcd.goal: Predicts daily global solar radiation where only air temperature data are available, for solar energy system design.
1a02f931e8cc6d503b0a164f3840bce6ef4f1dcd.architecture: Comparison of machine learning models (hybrid mind evolutionary algorithm-artificial neural network, plain ANN, random forest, wavelet neural network) with four empirical temperature-based models.
1a02f931e8cc6d503b0a164f3840bce6ef4f1dcd.data: Daily air temperature and solar radiation from stations in temperate continental regions of China.
1a02f931e8cc6d503b0a164f3840bce6ef4f1dcd.result: The hybrid mind evolutionary algorithm-ANN gives the best estimates among machine learning and empirical models.
1a02f931e8cc6d503b0a164f3840bce6ef4f1dcd.open_work: Combining the model with air temperature forecasts to predict future solar radiation.
1a02f931e8cc6d503b0a164f3840bce6ef4f1dcd.issues: Temperature-only inputs limit skill in cloudy conditions; regional scope; quantitative scores not in the abstract.

bb530a067422e27f37fb1c186110a8fbda7149a6.goal: Combines satellite and in-situ solar data (site adaptation) and builds accurate solar radiation forecasts for solar energy planning.
bb530a067422e27f37fb1c186110a8fbda7149a6.architecture: Machine learning site-adaptation of satellite irradiance followed by deep learning forecasting models; the specific network type is not specified in the abstract.
bb530a067422e27f37fb1c186110a8fbda7149a6.data: Satellite-derived irradiance and in-situ measurements with missing data for a case-study region; products not named in the abstract.
bb530a067422e27f37fb1c186110a8fbda7149a6.result: Machine learning site adaptation performs up to 38% better than traditional methods and enables precise forecasting models.
bb530a067422e27f37fb1c186110a8fbda7149a6.open_work: Application to more sites and climates and to operational forecasting horizons.
bb530a067422e27f37fb1c186110a8fbda7149a6.issues: Single case study; forecast skill numbers not given in the abstract.

0c2bbd253235f2c90ff0344cd17246e4807dda5e.goal: Assesses flood susceptibility, as the title states, as a tool for flood risk management.
0c2bbd253235f2c90ff0344cd17246e4807dda5e.architecture: Bivariate statistical methods combined or compared with machine learning models; the specific machine learning types are not specified.
0c2bbd253235f2c90ff0344cd17246e4807dda5e.data: Not reported (no abstract); flood susceptibility studies of this kind typically use a flood inventory and geospatial conditioning factors for a study catchment.
0c2bbd253235f2c90ff0344cd17246e4807dda5e.open_work: Validation in other catchments and comparison with newer ensemble methods.
0c2bbd253235f2c90ff0344cd17246e4807dda5e.issues: Typical susceptibility-mapping caveats: static predictors, limited flood inventories and possible spatial overfitting.

9c37dec8a5764ebc5be897adfd498acb41acc323.goal: Improves multi-step short-term wind speed forecasting for power system scheduling and safety.
9c37dec8a5764ebc5be897adfd498acb41acc323.architecture: Hybrid of optimal variational mode decomposition, singular spectrum analysis and phase space reconstruction, with an extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer network) whose parameters are tuned by an improved hybrid grey wolf-sine cosine optimizer.
9c37dec8a5764ebc5be897adfd498acb41acc323.data: Seven wind speed datasets from Sotavento Galicia (Spain) and Inner Mongolia (China).
9c37dec8a5764ebc5be897adfd498acb41acc323.result: Lower RMSE, MAE and MAPE than benchmarks; decomposition and dominant-ingredient analysis improve multi-step skill and the optimizer converges fast.
9c37dec8a5764ebc5be897adfd498acb41acc323.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and operational real-time decomposition.
9c37dec8a5764ebc5be897adfd498acb41acc323.issues: Complex pipeline with many tuned parts; decomposition over whole series may leak future information; univariate.

1950a1d6acb0455ce4b6ddfb8a0c008b249b1bce.goal: Forecasts solar radiation one year ahead at hourly and daily resolution for microgrid planning.
1950a1d6acb0455ce4b6ddfb8a0c008b249b1bce.architecture: Comparison of deep learning models (gated recurrent unit, LSTM, simple recurrent neural network, feed-forward neural network) with support vector regression and random forest regression.
1950a1d6acb0455ce4b6ddfb8a0c008b249b1bce.data: Historical solar radiation and clear-sky global horizontal irradiance; site not specified in the abstract.
1950a1d6acb0455ce4b6ddfb8a0c008b249b1bce.result: All models perform well; GRU is relatively best, and deep models beat random forest regression.
1950a1d6acb0455ce4b6ddfb8a0c008b249b1bce.open_work: Multi-site validation and inclusion of climate variability inputs.
1950a1d6acb0455ce4b6ddfb8a0c008b249b1bce.issues: One-year-ahead hourly forecasts largely capture climatology; quantitative errors not in the abstract.

d4413c5621bf5af34461295cf6c5e429f458e2dc.goal: Maps groundwater yield potential to guide rural water supply development.
d4413c5621bf5af34461295cf6c5e429f458e2dc.architecture: Boosted classification tree (tree ensemble) and an ensemble with frequency ratio (FR-BCT) in a GIS framework.
d4413c5621bf5af34461295cf6c5e429f458e2dc.data: 53 wells with specific capacity and transmissivity in Yangpyeong-gun, South Korea; 17 remote-sensing-derived topographic, hydrological, forest, soil, land-use and geological factors; 70/30 split.
d4413c5621bf5af34461295cf6c5e429f458e2dc.result: AUC for specific capacity 80.48% (BCT) and 87.75% (FR-BCT); for transmissivity 72.27% and 81.49%; soil is the most influential factor.
d4413c5621bf5af34461295cf6c5e429f458e2dc.open_work: Testing in other regions and with more well data.
d4413c5621bf5af34461295cf6c5e429f458e2dc.issues: Very small sample of 53 wells; single region; random split ignores spatial autocorrelation.

e405a7f2c1d466f84c21568287f5b569caa2897b.goal: Assesses flash flood susceptibility in the Gorgan Basin, Iran, using hybrid machine learning ensembles.
e405a7f2c1d466f84c21568287f5b569caa2897b.architecture: Functional tree classifier combined with bagging, dagging and rotation forest ensembles; random forest used to rank conditioning factors.
e405a7f2c1d466f84c21568287f5b569caa2897b.data: 426 flood locations and 15 flood conditioning factors (including elevation, stream distance and NDVI) for the Gorgan Basin.
e405a7f2c1d466f84c21568287f5b569caa2897b.result: Bagging-functional tree performs best (AUC success 0.933, prediction 0.959, efficiency 0.76, TSS 0.72); all ensembles improve on the single functional tree.
e405a7f2c1d466f84c21568287f5b569caa2897b.issues: Static susceptibility only; point inventory sampling and spatial autocorrelation may inflate scores.

063a5bb6f86a7b39ee27600bf6169506b3337995.goal: Detects clouds and cloud shadows across satellite platforms, especially over bright surfaces, within the NASA NeMO-Net coral reef project.
063a5bb6f86a7b39ee27600bf6169506b3337995.architecture: Convolutional neural network using spectral and spatial information, with a domain adversarial neural network for domain adaptation between platforms.
063a5bb6f86a7b39ee27600bf6169506b3337995.data: WorldView-2 imagery for training and Sentinel-2 imagery for transfer, using RGB and NIR channels.
063a5bb6f86a7b39ee27600bf6169506b3337995.result: Cloud detection accuracy 89% on WV-2; on S-2 the augmented CNN detects clouds better than the S-2 mask (81% vs 48%) but clear pixels worse (81% vs 91%); domain adaptation improves both.
063a5bb6f86a7b39ee27600bf6169506b3337995.open_work: Training on a more global dataset for multi-platform global cloud detection.
063a5bb6f86a7b39ee27600bf6169506b3337995.issues: Limited dataset; reduced clear-pixel accuracy on Sentinel-2; only four channels used.

27f2fbc7a7109b84b42908a4f6e7c93e208f66b6.goal: Forecasts daily streamflow by combining many machine learning algorithms and tests the approach at large scale.
27f2fbc7a7109b84b42908a4f6e7c93e208f66b6.architecture: Super ensemble learning: stacking that combines forecasts of multiple base machine learning algorithms (including tree ensembles such as random forest and boosting) via a combiner learner.
27f2fbc7a7109b84b42908a4f6e7c93e208f66b6.data: Daily streamflow and meteorological data for a large sample of US catchments (CAMELS dataset).
27f2fbc7a7109b84b42908a4f6e7c93e208f66b6.result: The stacked super ensemble improves on the individual base learners in daily streamflow forecasting; specific gains not stated here.
27f2fbc7a7109b84b42908a4f6e7c93e208f66b6.open_work: Extension to multi-step and probabilistic forecasts and other ensemble combiners.
27f2fbc7a7109b84b42908a4f6e7c93e208f66b6.issues: One-step daily forecasts with lagged inputs; gains over the best single learner may be modest; US catchments only.

b65c33c7c3c3af8f5246fb1d8e723de55e592020.goal: Predicts flood susceptibility in the Putna river catchment, Romania, with ensembles of bivariate statistics and AI.
b65c33c7c3c3af8f5246fb1d8e723de55e592020.architecture: Six ensembles coupling MLP neural network, rotation forest and CART decision tree with frequency ratio or weights of evidence.
b65c33c7c3c3af8f5246fb1d8e723de55e592020.data: 132 flood locations and 14 conditioning factors (lithology, slope, soil group, TWI, land use, rainfall, etc.) for the Putna catchment.
b65c33c7c3c3af8f5246fb1d8e723de55e592020.result: AUC ranges from 86.8% (RF-FR) to 93.9% (rotation forest-WOE), indicating high predictive performance for all ensembles.
b65c33c7c3c3af8f5246fb1d8e723de55e592020.open_work: Application to other catchments and dynamic flood conditions.
b65c33c7c3c3af8f5246fb1d8e723de55e592020.issues: Small inventory; static factors; validation points spatially close to training points.

f3077a82c50f2daefecf9b1fec14362524c8db88.goal: Projects future precipitation changes over Syria under climate change.
f3077a82c50f2daefecf9b1fec14362524c8db88.architecture: GCM selection with symmetrical uncertainty and multi-criteria decision analysis, bias correction by four methods, and a random forest to build the multi-model ensemble.
f3077a82c50f2daefecf9b1fec14362524c8db88.data: CMIP5 GCM precipitation under RCP 2.6, 4.5, 6.0 and 8.5, with observed precipitation for bias correction.
f3077a82c50f2daefecf9b1fec14362524c8db88.result: Best GCMs are HadGEM2-AO, CSIRO-Mk3-6-0, NorESM1-M and CESM1-CAM5; linear scaling is best; annual precipitation drops 30–85.2% for RCP4.5–8.5 and up to 30% for RCP2.6, with dry-season drops of 12–93%.
f3077a82c50f2daefecf9b1fec14362524c8db88.open_work: Use of CMIP6 and higher-resolution regional models.
f3077a82c50f2daefecf9b1fec14362524c8db88.issues: Large projected declines depend on few GCMs and simple bias correction; random forest ensemble weights calibrated on the historical period may not hold in the future.

8bd6683e715863b0033fd02f9a803faed1babd5a.goal: Forecasts river water level for flood mitigation with fast data-driven models instead of costly physical models.
8bd6683e715863b0033fd02f9a803faed1babd5a.architecture: Hybrid of ARIMA with statistical machine learning regressors (specific algorithms not named in the abstract) to capture linear and nonlinear components.
8bd6683e715863b0033fd02f9a803faed1babd5a.data: Water level of the Red River at Vu Quang and Hanoi (3-hourly, 2008–2017) and Hung Yen (hourly, 2008–April 2015).
8bd6683e715863b0033fd02f9a803faed1babd5a.result: The hybrid models are effective on the three datasets and improve over individual methods; numbers not given in the abstract.
8bd6683e715863b0033fd02f9a803faed1babd5a.open_work: Extension to longer leads and upstream inputs.
8bd6683e715863b0033fd02f9a803faed1babd5a.issues: Univariate station-level forecasts; quantitative gains not stated.

7cf418b72938185d4373bee3fb45e60239a4a58b.goal: Builds a comprehensive drought monitoring model using deep learning on multi-source satellite data.
7cf418b72938185d4373bee3fb45e60239a4a58b.architecture: Deep learning model; the network type is not specified in the abstract.
7cf418b72938185d4373bee3fb45e60239a4a58b.data: MODIS and TRMM satellite data over Henan Province, China; station comprehensive meteorological drought index (CI) as target and SPEI for comparison.
7cf418b72938185d4373bee3fb45e60239a4a58b.result: Drought grade consistency 85.6% (training) and 79.8% (test); correlation with SPEI 0.772–0.910; applicable to meteorological and agricultural drought.
7cf418b72938185d4373bee3fb45e60239a4a58b.open_work: Application in other regions and to drought forecasting.
7cf418b72938185d4373bee3fb45e60239a4a58b.issues: Single province; target index derived from stations; network architecture details not given.

c8310c228c80da1240711f51d292dca1e27d56f5.goal: Forecasts regional multi-step-ahead PM2.5 concentrations while limiting error accumulation.
c8310c228c80da1240711f51d292dca1e27d56f5.architecture: Multi-output support vector machine trained with multi-task learning (MM-SVM), benchmarked against single-output SVMs; inputs selected by Kendall tau.
c8310c228c80da1240711f51d292dca1e27d56f5.data: Hourly PM2.5, air quality and meteorological data (2010–2016) from three types of monitoring stations in Taipei, Taiwan.
c8310c228c80da1240711f51d292dca1e27d56f5.result: MM-SVM forecasts agree better with observations than any station-specific single-output SVM and need only one model for the region.
c8310c228c80da1240711f51d292dca1e27d56f5.open_work: Expansion to more stations and pollutants.
c8310c228c80da1240711f51d292dca1e27d56f5.issues: Few stations; quantitative improvements not stated in the abstract.

f874e9bc3d50fc44a81c3baf124eda5b4f63184f.goal: Detects smoke scenes in satellite imagery for wildfire monitoring across diverse regions and classes.
f874e9bc3d50fc44a81c3baf124eda5b4f63184f.architecture: Benchmark dataset plus SmokeNet, a convolutional neural network with spatial and channel-wise attention for scene classification.
f874e9bc3d50fc44a81c3baf124eda5b4f63184f.data: USTC_SmokeRS: 6225 MODIS images in six classes (cloud, dust, haze, land, seaside, smoke) worldwide.
f874e9bc3d50fc44a81c3baf124eda5b4f63184f.result: SmokeNet with 64% training images reaches 92.75% accuracy and kappa 0.9130; with 16% training images improves accuracy by at least 4.99% over state-of-the-art models.
f874e9bc3d50fc44a81c3baf124eda5b4f63184f.open_work: Pixel-level smoke segmentation and use of geostationary data.
f874e9bc3d50fc44a81c3baf124eda5b4f63184f.issues: Scene-level classification only; MODIS resolution limits small fire detection.

bb5a2bfe41a7429faebfd6dd50302702ea2389f2.goal: Forecasts daily river water temperature for environmental assessment and fisheries management.
bb5a2bfe41a7429faebfd6dd50302702ea2389f2.architecture: Hybrid of discrete wavelet transform and artificial neural network (WT-ANN, MLP-type), testing four mother wavelets.
bb5a2bfe41a7429faebfd6dd50302702ea2389f2.data: Daily water temperature at eight gauges on the Warta River, Poland, and air temperature at seven meteorological stations.
bb5a2bfe41a7429faebfd6dd50302702ea2389f2.result: WT-ANN outperforms linear, nonlinear and plain ANN models, especially in heat waves and drought; discrete Meyer wavelet is best, Haar worst; higher decomposition levels help.
bb5a2bfe41a7429faebfd6dd50302702ea2389f2.open_work: Application to other rivers and climate projections.
bb5a2bfe41a7429faebfd6dd50302702ea2389f2.issues: Single river; wavelet decomposition may leak future information if not causal.

30e27c4c77855528baee8cf34dee4f9bbb9260e7.goal: Helps researchers choose drought forecasting models by reviewing approaches from 2007–2017.
30e27c4c77855528baee8cf34dee4f9bbb9260e7.architecture: Review of drought forecasting models categorized as regression, stochastic, probabilistic, artificial intelligence, hybrid and dynamic modelling.
30e27c4c77855528baee8cf34dee4f9bbb9260e7.data: Published literature 2007–2017; tabulated inputs, metrics, time scales and drought types.
30e27c4c77855528baee8cf34dee4f9bbb9260e7.result: Provides concepts, applications, benefits and limitations of each approach.
30e27c4c77855528baee8cf34dee4f9bbb9260e7.open_work: Future outlooks and potential modelling techniques for drought research.
30e27c4c77855528baee8cf34dee4f9bbb9260e7.issues: Covers only up to 2017, before the deep learning surge.

ce01073470b8870f8af2f601b0d345be5ad8d581.goal: Maps groundwater potential zones on the Sindhudurg coast, west India.
ce01073470b8870f8af2f601b0d345be5ad8d581.architecture: Random forest, boosted regression tree and RF-SVM ensemble, with ground-penetrating radar for water table validation.
ce01073470b8870f8af2f601b0d345be5ad8d581.data: 165 spring and well locations and 15 influencing factors (elevation, slope, lithology, NDVI, rainfall, etc.); 70/30 split.
ce01073470b8870f8af2f601b0d345be5ad8d581.result: AUROC: RF 94%, RF-SVM 93.4%, BRT 89.8%; GPR water table within 14 cm of measured wells.
ce01073470b8870f8af2f601b0d345be5ad8d581.open_work: Using results to site new wells.
ce01073470b8870f8af2f601b0d345be5ad8d581.issues: Single region; random split ignores spatial autocorrelation.

336a67de000cf67b1e8abe28a6cf9fb66d2036e0.goal: Estimates hourly global solar radiation from geostationary satellite imagery.
336a67de000cf67b1e8abe28a6cf9fb66d2036e0.architecture: Hybrid deep network: convolutional neural network extracts spatial cloud patterns and a multilayer perceptron (MLP) adds time and location information.
336a67de000cf67b1e8abe28a6cf9fb66d2036e0.data: Geostationary satellite imagery with ground GSR at 90 Chinese radiation stations (2008), plus radiative transfer simulations at Mt. Everest; validation at 5 independent stations (2008) and all stations (2007).
336a67de000cf67b1e8abe28a6cf9fb66d2036e0.result: R2 0.82 at independent stations and 0.88 in 2007; RMSE 84.18 W/m2 hourly, 1.92 MJ/m2 daily and 1.08 MJ/m2 monthly; reproduces diurnal cycles.
336a67de000cf67b1e8abe28a6cf9fb66d2036e0.open_work: Application to other regions and satellites.
336a67de000cf67b1e8abe28a6cf9fb66d2036e0.issues: Trained on one year; few stations at high elevation.

491c28d338512fcaf4e3e9938a3b61bb5b2d5033.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for wind power integration.
491c28d338512fcaf4e3e9938a3b61bb5b2d5033.architecture: Hybrid mode decomposition (VMD, sample entropy, wavelet packet) with an online sequential outlier-robust extreme learning machine optimized by the crisscross algorithm.
491c28d338512fcaf4e3e9938a3b61bb5b2d5033.data: Wind speed series; sites not specified in the abstract.
491c28d338512fcaf4e3e9938a3b61bb5b2d5033.result: Hybrid decomposition improves accuracy; online learning beats offline models; multi-step accuracy greatly improved.
491c28d338512fcaf4e3e9938a3b61bb5b2d5033.issues: Univariate; data details and numbers not in the abstract.

07bffc23387ad173626db294f9924eb81833b867.goal: Forecasts drought (SPEI) with long lead times for early warning.
07bffc23387ad173626db294f9924eb81833b867.architecture: Stacked long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network.
07bffc23387ad173626db294f9924eb81833b867.data: Climatic Research Unit gridded data for New South Wales, Australia; training 1901–2000, testing 2001–2018.
07bffc23387ad173626db294f9924eb81833b867.result: Stacked LSTM forecasts effectively at 1–12 month leads, assessed by R2, RMSE and threat score.
07bffc23387ad173626db294f9924eb81833b867.open_work: Testing at shorter temporal scales of days to weeks.
07bffc23387ad173626db294f9924eb81833b867.issues: Single region; skill numbers not stated in the abstract.

502fec9e3dbdb966d205b464dc1fbbc53952f65f.goal: Predicts snow avalanche hazard in mountainous regions.
502fec9e3dbdb966d205b464dc1fbbc53952f65f.architecture: Support vector machine and multivariate discriminant analysis.
502fec9e3dbdb966d205b464dc1fbbc53952f65f.data: Avalanche occurrence locations, meteorological and terrain factors; 70/30 split.
502fec9e3dbdb966d205b464dc1fbbc53952f65f.result: Both models AUC above 0.90; MDA better on hits and misses; TPI, slope, precipitation and TWI most important.
502fec9e3dbdb966d205b464dc1fbbc53952f65f.open_work: Other regions and temporal avalanche forecasting.
502fec9e3dbdb966d205b464dc1fbbc53952f65f.issues: Static susceptibility; study area not named in the abstract.

f66c68aa884d28a4ca1448d72ce325eb1f31c8d5.goal: Predicts flood occurrence in India from temperature and rainfall intensity.
f66c68aa884d28a4ca1448d72ce325eb1f31c8d5.architecture: Deep neural network compared with SVM, k-nearest neighbour and naive Bayes.
f66c68aa884d28a4ca1448d72ce325eb1f31c8d5.data: Temperature and rainfall intensity data in India; details not reported in the abstract.
f66c68aa884d28a4ca1448d72ce325eb1f31c8d5.result: The deep neural network achieves the highest accuracy.
f66c68aa884d28a4ca1448d72ce325eb1f31c8d5.issues: Very limited inputs; dataset and accuracy numbers not given.

5d7e219ec8ab45234e905cbf334e13bbc517b00b.goal: Maps flash flood susceptibility in the Haraz watershed, Iran.
5d7e219ec8ab45234e905cbf334e13bbc517b00b.architecture: Deep belief network with backpropagation optimized by a genetic algorithm (DBPGA).
5d7e219ec8ab45234e905cbf334e13bbc517b00b.data: 194 flood locations and ten conditioning factors.
5d7e219ec8ab45234e905cbf334e13bbc517b00b.result: Training AUC 0.989 and validation AUC 0.985, beating LR, LMT, ADT, ANFIS variants and others.

e438adc2103dbc890922928d8c33d67c6268251f.goal: Produces probabilistic spatio-temporal solar irradiance forecasts across many sites.
e438adc2103dbc890922928d8c33d67c6268251f.architecture: Convolutional graph autoencoder: a generative graph neural network using spectral graph convolutions and variational Bayesian inference.
e438adc2103dbc890922928d8c33d67c6268251f.data: National Solar Radiation Database sites in northern US states modelled as a graph.
e438adc2103dbc890922928d8c33d67c6268251f.result: State-of-the-art reliability, sharpness and CRPS for probabilistic irradiance prediction.
e438adc2103dbc890922928d8c33d67c6268251f.open_work: Extension to other regions and NWP inputs.
e438adc2103dbc890922928d8c33d67c6268251f.issues: Numbers and lead times not given in the abstract.

ff33d2ea013cd19f430dca9c0d46ed633add8750.goal: Predicts flood susceptibility in the Haraz-Neka watershed, Iran.
ff33d2ea013cd19f430dca9c0d46ed633add8750.architecture: Support vector regression and group method of data handling (GMDH) neural network optimized by genetic algorithm and harmony search.
ff33d2ea013cd19f430dca9c0d46ed633add8750.data: 132 flood locations (70/30 split) and nine geospatial factors.
ff33d2ea013cd19f430dca9c0d46ed633add8750.result: SVR-GA best (AUC 0.75, RMSE 0.29); SVR beats GMDH; GA and HS improve both.

6da807537547951837292aee528b30e3c79519f0.goal: Assesses storm surge flood susceptibility in the Sundarban Biosphere Reserve, India.
6da807537547951837292aee528b30e3c79519f0.architecture: Support vector machine compared with frequency ratio and modified frequency ratio models.
6da807537547951837292aee528b30e3c79519f0.data: Storm surge flood inventory and conditioning factors for the Sundarban Biosphere Reserve.
6da807537547951837292aee528b30e3c79519f0.result: SVM best (success AUC 0.8347, prediction AUC 0.8221); spatial agreement up to 83.2% between modified FR and SVM.
6da807537547951837292aee528b30e3c79519f0.open_work: Incorporating surge dynamics and sea level rise.
6da807537547951837292aee528b30e3c79519f0.issues: Static mapping; no hydrodynamic surge modelling.

3ae61556e2cdcc9d3956475723395870d2e29a3f.goal: Provides large-scale evidence on whether stochastic or machine learning methods give better multi-step ahead forecasts of hydrological time series, beyond single case studies.
3ae61556e2cdcc9d3956475723395870d2e29a3f.architecture: Comparison of 11 stochastic time-series methods (ARIMA-type and similar) with 9 machine learning methods, including neural networks, random forest and support vector machines, evaluated with 18 metrics.
3ae61556e2cdcc9d3956475723395870d2e29a3f.data: 12 simulation experiments with 2000 synthetic series from linear stationary stochastic processes (100 and 300 values each), plus 405 real mean annual river discharge series of 100 values.
3ae61556e2cdcc9d3956475723395870d2e29a3f.result: Stochastic and machine learning methods may produce equally useful forecasts; no family dominates consistently across experiments and metrics.
3ae61556e2cdcc9d3956475723395870d2e29a3f.open_work: Extending the comparison to nonlinear, nonstationary and sub-annual hydrological series and to probabilistic forecasts.
3ae61556e2cdcc9d3956475723395870d2e29a3f.issues: Synthetic data come from linear stationary processes, which favour stochastic models; the real-world test uses short annual series only.

8d84929c5984ba4d00ff323fdbd9f2c910f2335f.goal: Forecasts daily reference evapotranspiration seven days ahead to support irrigation planning, comparing deep learning with traditional machine learning and forecasting strategies.
8d84929c5984ba4d00ff323fdbd9f2c910f2335f.architecture: LSTM, 1D CNN and hybrid CNN-LSTM deep learning models versus an ANN (MLP) and random forest, with iterated, direct and MIMO multi-step strategies and three input combinations.
8d84929c5984ba4d00ff323fdbd9f2c910f2335f.data: Daily meteorological data from 53 weather stations in Minas Gerais, Brazil, with four held-out test stations; local and regional training scenarios; two climatological baselines.
8d84929c5984ba4d00ff323fdbd9f2c910f2335f.result: MIMO is the best strategy; deep learning is slightly better than machine learning and both beat the monthly-mean baseline mainly on days 1–2; best mean RMSE about 0.87–0.88 mm/day (CNN-LSTM).
8d84929c5984ba4d00ff323fdbd9f2c910f2335f.open_work: Adding weather-forecast inputs to improve skill at longer lead times and testing in other climates.
8d84929c5984ba4d00ff323fdbd9f2c910f2335f.issues: Overall accuracy remains modest and gains over climatology fade with lead time; single Brazilian state.

16f5b5fe5e0bca6329ad58b1d68458cfe4e03f3d.goal: Reconstructs and gap-fills long groundwater level records to extend short monitoring series for studying groundwater variability.
16f5b5fe5e0bca6329ad58b1d68458cfe4e03f3d.architecture: LSTM recurrent neural network trained on groundwater level fluctuations alone, with tuning of architecture and data quantity and quality.
16f5b5fe5e0bca6329ad58b1d68458cfe4e03f3d.data: About 50 years of groundwater level records from 31 piezometers in the chalk aquifer of northwestern Normandy, France.
16f5b5fe5e0bca6329ad58b1d68458cfe4e03f3d.result: LSTM reconstructs missing groundwater levels step by step with increasing gap lengths, without time-lag calibration; quantitative scores not reported in the abstract.
16f5b5fe5e0bca6329ad58b1d68458cfe4e03f3d.open_work: Adding meteorological drivers such as rainfall and testing transfer to other aquifers.
16f5b5fe5e0bca6329ad58b1d68458cfe4e03f3d.issues: Uses only groundwater level series, so it cannot capture changes not reflected in neighbouring records; accuracy for long gaps not quantified in the abstract.

d58712228972cc5723899292a042c5b77a1f4b11.goal: Forecasts monthly lake water levels, an indicator of lake ecosystem health, to support water resources management.
d58712228972cc5723899292a042c5b77a1f4b11.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) compared with a deep learning neural network model for one-month-ahead forecasting.
d58712228972cc5723899292a042c5b77a1f4b11.data: Monthly water level records of 69 temperate lakes in Poland.
d58712228972cc5723899292a042c5b77a1f4b11.result: Both models perform well with marginal differences; the deep learning model shows no significant superiority and the FFNN is slightly better for 33 of 69 lakes.
d58712228972cc5723899292a042c5b77a1f4b11.open_work: Testing longer lead times and climate-driven inputs, and clarifying when deep models add value.
d58712228972cc5723899292a042c5b77a1f4b11.issues: One-month-ahead only; the deep learning architecture is not detailed in the abstract; limited to one region.

81f3e1a9190598a7f350117a507ed69470cb87ea.goal: Downscales coarse global gridded crop model outputs to fine resolution with machine learning meta-models to support regional agricultural assessment.
81f3e1a9190598a7f350117a507ed69470cb87ea.architecture: Extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) and random forest meta-models (emulators) trained on crop model output against high-resolution covariates.
81f3e1a9190598a7f350117a507ed69470cb87ea.data: Global-scale maize simulations from a global gridded crop model for training, applied over Mexico at finer resolution with climate, soil and management covariates.
81f3e1a9190598a7f350117a507ed69470cb87ea.result: Predictions of maize yield, evapotranspiration and crop available water reach R2 > 0.96 with low bias; monthly and growing-season climate inputs are needed to reproduce inter-annual variability.
81f3e1a9190598a7f350117a507ed69470cb87ea.open_work: Developing scalable crop model emulators for other crops, regions and climate scenarios.
81f3e1a9190598a7f350117a507ed69470cb87ea.issues: Emulates a crop model rather than observed yields, so it inherits that model's biases; single crop and one application region.

e4723632973626afc5674b2b6db19b1f3db5c5d4.goal: Assesses whether satellite solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF) improves large-scale crop yield prediction compared with vegetation indices and land surface temperature.
e4723632973626afc5674b2b6db19b1f3db5c5d4.architecture: Five machine learning regression algorithms (specific models not named in the abstract) using remote-sensing-only and combined climate and remote sensing predictors.
e4723632973626afc5674b2b6db19b1f3db5c5d4.data: OCO-2 gap-filled SIF, TROPOMI SIF and GOME-2 SIF, NDVI, EVI, NIRv and LST, and climate variables, with county maize and soybean yields in the U.S. Midwest; cross-validation and forward 2018 testing.
e4723632973626afc5674b2b6db19b1f3db5c5d4.result: High-resolution OCO-2 and TROPOMI SIF beat GOME-2 and give the best 2018 forward predictions, but are not consistently better than other variables; NIRv matches or beats SIF.
e4723632973626afc5674b2b6db19b1f3db5c5d4.open_work: Re-evaluating as longer, higher-quality high-resolution SIF records accumulate.
e4723632973626afc5674b2b6db19b1f3db5c5d4.issues: Short record of high-resolution SIF limits training; results depend on crop, testing method and record length.

dd2e6d3ef62b2e7c7369e5f7210f6ac95f685ad3.goal: Compares machine learning regression methods for estimating solar radiation from routine climatic variables to support solar energy applications.
dd2e6d3ef62b2e7c7369e5f7210f6ac95f685ad3.architecture: Gradient boosting tree, MLP neural network, two ANFIS variants (fuzzy c-means and subtractive clustering), MARS and CART regression tree.
dd2e6d3ef62b2e7c7369e5f7210f6ac95f685ad3.data: Wind speed, maximum and minimum air temperature and relative humidity at two USA stations (Fairfield, Monmouth) and two Turkish stations (Antalya, Mersin).
dd2e6d3ef62b2e7c7369e5f7210f6ac95f685ad3.result: Gradient boosting tree performs best, reducing RMSE relative to other models by 0.2–55% depending on station and model.
dd2e6d3ef62b2e7c7369e5f7210f6ac95f685ad3.open_work: Testing more stations and climates and adding radiation-related inputs such as sunshine duration.
dd2e6d3ef62b2e7c7369e5f7210f6ac95f685ad3.issues: Only four stations; station-specific models with no spatial generalization test.

4ce5245b86971acb4759d4cdbbb5688c965c281e.goal: Estimates daily potato crop evapotranspiration with machine learning under different availability of meteorological inputs.
4ce5245b86971acb4759d4cdbbb5688c965c281e.architecture: k-nearest neighbour, ANN (MLP-type neural network) and AdaBoost models with four input scenarios from temperature only to full meteorology.
4ce5245b86971acb4759d4cdbbb5688c965c281e.data: Field experiments with potato under optimal water supply in Southern Italy in 2009 and 2010; reference ETc from FAO Penman-Monteith soil water balance and gravimetric soil water measurements.
4ce5245b86971acb4759d4cdbbb5688c965c281e.result: kNN performs best with limited inputs (R2 0.81–0.97, RMSE 0.35–0.79 mm/day for scenarios 1–3); ANN is slightly better when all variables are available.
4ce5245b86971acb4759d4cdbbb5688c965c281e.open_work: Validating across more seasons, sites, crops and water-stress conditions.
4ce5245b86971acb4759d4cdbbb5688c965c281e.issues: Two seasons at one site under non-limiting water; reference ETc is itself a model-based estimate.

e6fc85c11ad520ff8b1df2360c7bd6aa628d865e.goal: Predicts and maps daily global solar radiation and photovoltaic potential where radiation measurements are scarce.
e6fc85c11ad520ff8b1df2360c7bd6aa628d865e.architecture: Hybrid particle swarm optimization extreme learning machine (PSO-ELM) compared with ELM, support vector machine, generalized regression neural network, M5 model tree and autoencoder.
e6fc85c11ad520ff8b1df2360c7bd6aa628d865e.data: Daily radiation and climatic data from seven stations on the Loess Plateau of China, 1961–2016; applied to fifty other stations and gridded at 0.25° with an empirical PV power model.
e6fc85c11ad520ff8b1df2360c7bd6aa628d865e.result: PSO-ELM with full climatic inputs is most accurate; derived maps show significant long-term reductions in solar radiation and PV power over the region.
e6fc85c11ad520ff8b1df2360c7bd6aa628d865e.open_work: Applying the approach to other regions and linking trends to aerosols and cloud changes.
e6fc85c11ad520ff8b1df2360c7bd6aa628d865e.issues: Few training stations; mapped values at unmeasured sites cannot be directly validated; PV power from an empirical model.

9b4b19544148214738b6223d0a3441f2371fa840.goal: Predicts hourly photovoltaic power output from meteorological information to support PV operators and electricity markets.
9b4b19544148214738b6223d0a3441f2371fa840.architecture: ANN, deep neural network (MLP) and LSTM recurrent neural network models, with the LSTM designed to capture hourly and seasonal patterns.
9b4b19544148214738b6223d0a3441f2371fa840.data: A real-world PV power and meteorological dataset; site and period not reported in the abstract.
9b4b19544148214738b6223d0a3441f2371fa840.result: The ANN fails to give satisfactory results while the LSTM improves mean absolute error by more than 50% relative to conventional statistical models.
9b4b19544148214738b6223d0a3441f2371fa840.open_work: Using weather forecast inputs and testing across multiple plants.
9b4b19544148214738b6223d0a3441f2371fa840.issues: Single dataset with limited details; comparison mainly against statistical baselines.

47faa65624bafeb8c9efc0c71324a3176716a1a7.goal: Quantifies the impact of the COVID-19 lockdown on NO2 pollution in Spain after removing the confounding effect of meteorological variability.
47faa65624bafeb8c9efc0c71324a3176716a1a7.architecture: Machine learning regression models fed by meteorology and time features to predict business-as-usual NO2; the method is gradient boosting according to the paper.
47faa65624bafeb8c9efc0c71324a3176716a1a7.data: NO2 observations at urban background and traffic stations across more than 50 Spanish provinces and islands, with meteorological data (ERA5 reanalysis per the paper).
47faa65624bafeb8c9efc0c71324a3176716a1a7.result: Models perform well (bias +4%, RMSE 29%, r 0.86); lockdown causes about a 50% meteorology-normalized NO2 reduction on average, stronger in phases II–III and at traffic stations.
47faa65624bafeb8c9efc0c71324a3176716a1a7.open_work: Linking reductions to emission inventories and quantifying health impacts.
47faa65624bafeb8c9efc0c71324a3176716a1a7.issues: Counterfactual depends on model skill and training period; uncertainties in emission changes remain.

50cf5e282acd162ea89e2139c8728ba296460435.goal: Provides reliable short-term solar irradiance prediction for photovoltaic system design and management using ensemble learning.
50cf5e282acd162ea89e2139c8728ba296460435.architecture: Ensemble tree methods (boosted trees, bagged trees, random forest, generalized random forest) compared with Gaussian process regression and support vector regression.
50cf5e282acd162ea89e2139c8728ba296460435.data: Typical Meteorological Year data from several locations; meteorological predictors and lagged irradiance.
50cf5e282acd162ea89e2139c8728ba296460435.result: Ensemble methods outperform the single regressors and remain consistent across locations; lagged irradiance variables contribute most.
50cf5e282acd162ea89e2139c8728ba296460435.open_work: Testing on measured operational time series and multi-step horizons.
50cf5e282acd162ea89e2139c8728ba296460435.issues: Typical Meteorological Year data are synthetic composites rather than real sequential records, which may overstate skill.

7a45180bb62075b71ad77939cd4c42350794eddc.goal: Combines uncertainty quantification with physical consistency in deep learning models of lake temperature profiles.
7a45180bb62075b71ad77939cd4c42350794eddc.architecture: Physics-guided architecture of neural networks in which physical constraints (density-depth monotonicity) are hard-coded, combined with Monte Carlo dropout for uncertainty.
7a45180bb62075b71ad77939cd4c42350794eddc.data: Observed lake temperature profiles from Lake Mendota, Wisconsin, and Falling Creek Reservoir, Virginia, with limited training data.
7a45180bb62075b71ad77939cd4c42350794eddc.result: The architecture gives better generalization and physically consistent Monte Carlo estimates whose distribution matches observations.
7a45180bb62075b71ad77939cd4c42350794eddc.open_work: Extending to other physical constraints, systems and uncertainty methods.
7a45180bb62075b71ad77939cd4c42350794eddc.issues: Two water bodies only; MC dropout is an approximate uncertainty method.

0414aa9148ffae8153566af34e1fce4f1fdc0ee2.goal: Compares automatic thresholding with machine learning classifiers for mapping small, spectrally complex waterbodies from Sentinel data.
0414aa9148ffae8153566af34e1fce4f1fdc0ee2.architecture: Automatic thresholding of NDWI and VH backscatter versus decision tree, k-nearest neighbour, random forest and two support vector machine implementations.
0414aa9148ffae8153566af34e1fce4f1fdc0ee2.data: Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery with field surveys of small reservoirs of varying turbidity and vegetation.
0414aa9148ffae8153566af34e1fce4f1fdc0ee2.result: Dual thresholding of S1 VH and S2 NDWI reaches 89.3% overall accuracy, comparable to machine learning; SVM is less sensitive to turbidity and aquatic plants.
0414aa9148ffae8153566af34e1fce4f1fdc0ee2.open_work: Operational automatic mapping that avoids repeated training sample collection.
0414aa9148ffae8153566af34e1fce4f1fdc0ee2.issues: Machine learning requires site-specific training samples not reusable for dynamic reservoirs; thresholding is sensitive to turbidity.

373d75b78b2474ee2d677e3c5dd9162f1e8498aa.goal: Reviews wind speed and wind power forecasting techniques to support renewable energy integration, scheduling and dispatch.
373d75b78b2474ee2d677e3c5dd9162f1e8498aa.architecture: Review of physical, statistical, artificial intelligence (neural networks and related) and hybrid forecasting methods and their evaluation.
373d75b78b2474ee2d677e3c5dd9162f1e8498aa.data: Literature on wind speed and power forecasting; no new data.
373d75b78b2474ee2d677e3c5dd9162f1e8498aa.result: Summarizes accuracy-improvement techniques, major forecasting problems and evolving trends across forecasting horizons.
373d75b78b2474ee2d677e3c5dd9162f1e8498aa.open_work: Identifies future research directions in advanced and hybrid forecasting applications.
373d75b78b2474ee2d677e3c5dd9162f1e8498aa.issues: Narrative review; no quantitative meta-analysis or common benchmark.
