7bfd60ac7fef9b04454022e470b0041136807082.goal: Derives operation rules for hydropower reservoirs from historical data to improve generation scheduling.
7bfd60ac7fef9b04454022e470b0041136807082.architecture: Class-based evolutionary extreme learning machine: k-means clustering splits inputs into sub-regions and a particle swarm optimized ELM is fitted in each cluster.
7bfd60ac7fef9b04454022e470b0041136807082.data: Historical operation data from two hydropower reservoirs in China.
7bfd60ac7fef9b04454022e470b0041136807082.result: The method gives satisfying operation-rule performance and better generalization than standard approaches; numbers not reported in the abstract.
7bfd60ac7fef9b04454022e470b0041136807082.open_work: Testing on more reservoirs and integrating inflow forecasts.
7bfd60ac7fef9b04454022e470b0041136807082.issues: Two reservoirs only; rules learned from past operation may embed suboptimal historical decisions.

4141fb32c5081708f0ecd7dff459791f021ef353.goal: Improves satellite-based estimation of U.S. corn and soybean yields by adding environmental variables to vegetation-index methods.
4141fb32c5081708f0ecd7dff459791f021ef353.architecture: Random forest regression compared with linear and polynomial regression on a vegetation index at key phenological stages.
4141fb32c5081708f0ecd7dff459791f021ef353.data: MODIS WDRVI, irrigated cropland percentage and reanalysis temperature, precipitation, shortwave radiation and soil moisture, with NASS county yield statistics.
4141fb32c5081708f0ecd7dff459791f021ef353.result: Random forest gives state-level RMSE of 0.539 t/ha for corn and 0.206 t/ha for soybean versus 0.897 and 0.283 for the polynomial method, and captures the 2003 Illinois drought.
4141fb32c5081708f0ecd7dff459791f021ef353.open_work: Extending to within-season forecasting and other regions.
4141fb32c5081708f0ecd7dff459791f021ef353.issues: Models tuned per state and crop; using all variables can overfit; reliance on reanalysis inputs.

c0d100a3d01532ded015f6bfdd5a751e14e18861.goal: Predicts streamflow with machine learning in four U.S. river basins across different climatic zones to assess model suitability.
c0d100a3d01532ded015f6bfdd5a751e14e18861.architecture: Several machine learning algorithms are compared; the specific model types are not specified here.
c0d100a3d01532ded015f6bfdd5a751e14e18861.data: Streamflow and meteorological records for four U.S. river basins; details not reported in the abstract.
c0d100a3d01532ded015f6bfdd5a751e14e18861.open_work: Testing across more basins and climates.
c0d100a3d01532ded015f6bfdd5a751e14e18861.issues: Abstract unavailable; details of data, models and skill cannot be confirmed.

d41e7d09f50eef654c92e97ca22713539553687a.goal: Forecasts monthly streamflow in a semi-arid region for water resources planning.
d41e7d09f50eef654c92e97ca22713539553687a.architecture: Hybrid multivariate adaptive regression spline with differential evolution optimization (MARS-DE), compared with least squares support vector regression and standalone MARS.
d41e7d09f50eef654c92e97ca22713539553687a.data: Monthly streamflow series at Baghdad station on the Tigris River, Iraq.
d41e7d09f50eef654c92e97ca22713539553687a.result: MARS-DE achieves the lowest errors (RMSE 46.64 and MAE 35.25 m3/s) versus LSSVR (57.50, 49.20) and MARS (78.01, 62.65).
d41e7d09f50eef654c92e97ca22713539553687a.open_work: Adding climate inputs and testing at more stations.
d41e7d09f50eef654c92e97ca22713539553687a.issues: Single station; strongly regulated river; univariate lag inputs.

447eed4b58c9eefc5f8185e0eaf394dee1a21a82.goal: Forecasts PM2.5 concentrations over different time intervals in a heavily polluted developing-country setting.
447eed4b58c9eefc5f8185e0eaf394dee1a21a82.architecture: Multiple additive regression trees (gradient boosting), deep feedforward neural network and a hybrid LSTM model.
447eed4b58c9eefc5f8185e0eaf394dee1a21a82.data: PM2.5 concentration time series and related inputs; study site and period not reported in the abstract.
447eed4b58c9eefc5f8185e0eaf394dee1a21a82.result: The LSTM performs best with RMSE 8.91 µg/m3, MAE 6.21 µg/m3, R2 0.8, and correctly predicts 75% of pollution levels.
447eed4b58c9eefc5f8185e0eaf394dee1a21a82.open_work: Testing longer horizons and more sites.
447eed4b58c9eefc5f8185e0eaf394dee1a21a82.issues: Limited description of data and study area; single-region evaluation.

11d9d55c254964d696f3d80b31727342115e7e0e.goal: Predicts electricity consumption of a campus building from occupancy rates and weather and quantifies each input's impact.
11d9d55c254964d696f3d80b31727342115e7e0e.architecture: ANN (MLP) trained with Levenberg–Marquardt backpropagation compared with linear regression, with impact-factor sensitivity analysis.
11d9d55c254964d696f3d80b31727342115e7e0e.data: Hourly electricity use, occupancy rates and local weather (temperature, humidity, solar radiation, cloud type, wind speed) for one campus building.
11d9d55c254964d696f3d80b31727342115e7e0e.result: The ANN is more accurate and stable than linear regression on working days; occupancy dominates consumption; no difference on non-working days.
11d9d55c254964d696f3d80b31727342115e7e0e.open_work: Applying to other building types and real-time control.
11d9d55c254964d696f3d80b31727342115e7e0e.issues: Single building; occupancy data may not be available elsewhere.

981d2085bb690db752f633f26052f4393ab813f9.goal: Improves solar irradiance prediction for solar power planning by learning from surrounding-site meteorology.
981d2085bb690db752f633f26052f4393ab813f9.architecture: Convolutional neural network with hyperparameters optimized by a chaotic GA/PSO hybrid algorithm.
981d2085bb690db752f633f26052f4393ab813f9.data: Meteorological data from surrounding sites at different sampling times; region not reported in the abstract.
981d2085bb690db752f633f26052f4393ab813f9.result: Annual mean MAE drops by 0.1463 MJ/m2 versus a single CNN and by 49.5%, 47.6% and 20.3% versus ANN, K-means-RBF and GBRT.
981d2085bb690db752f633f26052f4393ab813f9.open_work: Extending to multi-step and probabilistic forecasts.
981d2085bb690db752f633f26052f4393ab813f9.issues: Study area and data period not stated; heavy hyperparameter search risks overfitting.

6a065488962169e8f0da874c71d96aeec30dc5d7.goal: Tests whether deep learning improves flood susceptibility mapping over benchmark machine learning models.
6a065488962169e8f0da874c71d96aeec30dc5d7.architecture: Deep belief network built on an extreme learning machine with backpropagation and particle swarm optimization (DEBP), compared with RBF neural network, logistic regression, logistic model tree, functional tree and alternating decision tree.
6a065488962169e8f0da874c71d96aeec30dc5d7.data: 847 flood locations from 2007, 2009 and 2013 and 16 conditioning factors in the Vu Gia-Thu Bon watershed, central Vietnam.
6a065488962169e8f0da874c71d96aeec30dc5d7.result: DEBP has the highest goodness-of-fit (AUC 0.970) and prediction accuracy (AUC 0.967).
6a065488962169e8f0da874c71d96aeec30dc5d7.open_work: Applying the model to other watersheds and dynamic flood hazard.
6a065488962169e8f0da874c71d96aeec30dc5d7.issues: Static susceptibility with a single watershed; inventory-based labels; no temporal validation.

467eb56f1cb14d4944037eb891c3b2043a042ca5.goal: Predicts next-day hourly ozone concentrations as an early-warning tool with low computational cost.
467eb56f1cb14d4944037eb891c3b2043a042ca5.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network using previous-day meteorology and pollutant concentrations.
467eb56f1cb14d4944037eb891c3b2043a042ca5.data: TCEQ meteorological and air pollution data at 21 continuous monitoring stations in Texas, 2014–2017, with 2017 evaluation.
467eb56f1cb14d4944037eb891c3b2043a042ca5.result: Index of agreement exceeds 0.85 at 19 of 21 stations; performance holds at stations with fewer inputs, but daily maximum ozone is mostly underpredicted.
467eb56f1cb14d4944037eb891c3b2043a042ca5.issues: Underprediction of peaks limits exceedance warnings; station-level only.

40c0d9c80d9818f540a34df7a5716d431846bd2a.goal: Improves multi-step-ahead flood forecasts in a basin with non-stationary rainfall-runoff relations due to urbanization and climate change.
40c0d9c80d9818f540a34df7a5716d431846bd2a.architecture: Recurrent adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (R-ANFIS) with parameters optimized by a genetic algorithm and least squares estimator.
40c0d9c80d9818f540a34df7a5716d431846bd2a.data: A benchmark chaotic time series and flood-season inflow series of the Three Gorges Reservoir, China, forecasting t+1 to t+8.
40c0d9c80d9818f540a34df7a5716d431846bd2a.result: R-ANFIS(GL) outperforms static and dynamic ANFIS networks and mitigates time-lag effects in multi-step forecasts.
40c0d9c80d9818f540a34df7a5716d431846bd2a.open_work: Testing in other basins and adding uncertainty estimation.
40c0d9c80d9818f540a34df7a5716d431846bd2a.issues: One real-world case; skill numbers not given in the abstract.

1b3c3cb97b62e97f645af620608ef7043f46a4f3.goal: Estimates farmland soil moisture content in an arid region from UAV hyperspectral imagery.
1b3c3cb97b62e97f645af620608ef7043f46a4f3.architecture: XGBoost (gradient boosting trees) with spectral preprocessing including fractional-order derivatives and optimal multiband indices.
1b3c3cb97b62e97f645af620608ef7043f46a4f3.data: UAV hyperspectral images at 4 cm resolution and 70 soil samples (0–10 cm) from farmland near Fukang, Xinjiang, China.
1b3c3cb97b62e97f645af620608ef7043f46a4f3.result: Fractional-order derivatives with optimal band indices give the best model (validation R2 0.921, RMSEP 1.943, RPD 2.736), best at order 0.4.
1b3c3cb97b62e97f645af620608ef7043f46a4f3.open_work: Testing across sites, dates and soil types.
1b3c3cb97b62e97f645af620608ef7043f46a4f3.issues: Only 70 samples from one field; surface layer only; risk of overfitting with many spectral features.

9230a530a049245e19e69326a6d264ee4df04117.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting for grid dispatch.
9230a530a049245e19e69326a6d264ee4df04117.architecture: XGBoost (gradient boosting trees) per weather-similarity cluster from k-means, with feature engineering; compared with BP neural network, CART, random forest, SVR and single XGBoost.
9230a530a049245e19e69326a6d264ee4df04117.data: Historical wind power and weather data; wind farm and period not reported in the abstract.
9230a530a049245e19e69326a6d264ee4df04117.result: The clustered XGBoost model gives the highest forecasting accuracy among compared models; numbers not given in the abstract.
9230a530a049245e19e69326a6d264ee4df04117.open_work: Testing at more wind farms and with NWP inputs.
9230a530a049245e19e69326a6d264ee4df04117.issues: Single dataset; quantitative gains not stated in the abstract.

e1243f4d05b3d9d345da5effada351748a45a414.goal: Produces spatially explicit flash flood probability maps for planning and early warning.
e1243f4d05b3d9d345da5effada351748a45a414.architecture: Convolutional neural network and recurrent neural network models trained with SWARA factor weights.
e1243f4d05b3d9d345da5effada351748a45a414.data: Geospatial database of historical flood events and geo-environmental factors in Golestan Province, northern Iran.
e1243f4d05b3d9d345da5effada351748a45a414.result: CNN (AUC 0.832, RMSE 0.144) performs slightly better than RNN (AUC 0.814, RMSE 0.181); about 40% of the area has high or very high susceptibility.
e1243f4d05b3d9d345da5effada351748a45a414.open_work: Integrating maps into early warning system design.
e1243f4d05b3d9d345da5effada351748a45a414.issues: Static susceptibility from inventory data; single region; moderate AUC.

ed09b33946691570be55084940d7f6681e216b09.goal: Builds a virtual PM2.5 observation network to reconstruct historical PM2.5 where satellite AOD coverage is incomplete.
ed09b33946691570be55084940d7f6681e216b09.architecture: XGBoost (gradient boosting trees) with high-density surface meteorological observations as predictors.
ed09b33946691570be55084940d7f6681e216b09.data: Meteorological observations at 1180 sites across China and national PM2.5 network data, 2018 for training and cross-validation and 2017 for hindcast testing.
ed09b33946691570be55084940d7f6681e216b09.result: Cross-validated daily R2 0.79 and RMSE 15.75 µg/m3; visibility accounts for 39.3% of importance; 2017 hindcast R2 0.80–0.86 at monthly to annual scales.
ed09b33946691570be55084940d7f6681e216b09.open_work: Reconstructing longer historical records and supporting epidemiological studies.
ed09b33946691570be55084940d7f6681e216b09.issues: Hindcasting assumes stable meteorology–PM2.5 relationships despite changing emissions; relies heavily on visibility.

ca434caf38831e256bd71dc31e5382476f78ff91.goal: Forecasts the daily air pollution index from meteorological conditions as an early-warning tool.
ca434caf38831e256bd71dc31e5382476f78ff91.architecture: Artificial neural networks (MLP) and wavelet neural networks, testing twelve training algorithms and nineteen topologies with Bayesian regularization.
ca434caf38831e256bd71dc31e5382476f78ff91.data: Air pollution index and meteorological variables for Xi'an and Lanzhou, China.
ca434caf38831e256bd71dc31e5382476f78ff91.result: The wavelet network (R 0.885 Xi'an, 0.891 Lanzhou) outperforms the ANN (R 0.804, 0.774) in the forecasting stage.
ca434caf38831e256bd71dc31e5382476f78ff91.open_work: Extending to specific pollutants and longer lead times.
ca434caf38831e256bd71dc31e5382476f78ff91.issues: Composite API rather than individual pollutants; two cities only.

fa0c30c50a3a6fa5596c654db20380bee75b3f5d.goal: Predicts monthly groundwater level and its uncertainty using hybrid optimization-tuned machine learning models.
fa0c30c50a3a6fa5596c654db20380bee75b3f5d.architecture: ANN, ANFIS and support vector machine hybridized with six meta-heuristics (grasshopper, cat swarm, weed, genetic, krill, particle swarm), with PCA input reduction.
fa0c30c50a3a6fa5596c654db20380bee75b3f5d.data: 144 months of groundwater level data from piezometers in the Ardebil plain, Iran.
fa0c30c50a3a6fa5596c654db20380bee75b3f5d.result: ANFIS-GOA performs best (testing RMSE about 1.21–1.23, NSE 0.91–0.93) and hybrids clearly beat standalone models.
fa0c30c50a3a6fa5596c654db20380bee75b3f5d.open_work: Testing other aquifers and adding exogenous drivers.
fa0c30c50a3a6fa5596c654db20380bee75b3f5d.issues: Short record (144 months); many model configurations on little data risk overfitting.

6978f48ea5d0ce690c4deba2981e12e46b88e429.goal: Maps flood inundation susceptibility in a data-scarce urban area.
6978f48ea5d0ce690c4deba2981e12e46b88e429.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP via the R neuralnet package).
6978f48ea5d0ce690c4deba2981e12e46b88e429.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors (elevation, slope, distance from drainage, drainage density, land use) for Emam-Ali township, Mashhad, Iran.
6978f48ea5d0ce690c4deba2981e12e46b88e429.open_work: Adding more conditioning factors and testing in other cities.
6978f48ea5d0ce690c4deba2981e12e46b88e429.issues: Few factors and a small area; static mapping.

c951c8004d598467af7b03465dfa909ea6fed685.goal: Forecasts monthly river flow of the Hunza River, Pakistan, with machine learning for water resources management.
c951c8004d598467af7b03465dfa909ea6fed685.architecture: Several machine learning techniques are compared; the specific model types are not specified here.
c951c8004d598467af7b03465dfa909ea6fed685.data: Monthly river flow records of the Hunza River, Pakistan; details not reported.
c951c8004d598467af7b03465dfa909ea6fed685.open_work: Testing other snow- and glacier-fed basins and climate inputs.
c951c8004d598467af7b03465dfa909ea6fed685.issues: Abstract unavailable; data, models and skill cannot be confirmed.

63bbc26d0e725e01587c579d4459179d290b7f0d.goal: Forecasts short-term daily reference evapotranspiration with limited meteorological inputs for data-scarce irrigation.
63bbc26d0e725e01587c579d4459179d290b7f0d.architecture: Hybrid bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM) recurrent neural network compared with a general Bi-LSTM and adjusted Hargreaves-Samani.
63bbc26d0e725e01587c579d4459179d290b7f0d.data: Daily data 2006–2018 from three stations in semi-arid central Ningxia, China, with Penman-Monteith ET0 as target.
63bbc26d0e725e01587c579d4459179d290b7f0d.result: With maximum and minimum temperature and sunshine duration, RMSE is 0.159, 0.247 and 0.323 mm/day at 1, 4 and 7 days lead; the model is used in an operational irrigation system.
63bbc26d0e725e01587c579d4459179d290b7f0d.open_work: Evaluating across a wide range of climates and regions.
63bbc26d0e725e01587c579d4459179d290b7f0d.issues: Three stations in one region; future input meteorology handling not described in the abstract.

3c1090779ab77265093d742a3f347cf53db6a109.goal: Extends GRACE total water storage anomalies back to 1979 and fills the GRACE/GRACE-FO gap globally.
3c1090779ab77265093d742a3f347cf53db6a109.architecture: Machine learning combined with time series decomposition and statistical decomposition; the learning algorithm type is not specified in the abstract.
3c1090779ab77265093d742a3f347cf53db6a109.data: GRACE TWSA (2002 onward) with climate and hydrological predictors; validated with GRACE-FO, satellite laser ranging and global mean sea level change; 0.5° global land, 1979–2020.
3c1090779ab77265093d742a3f347cf53db6a109.result: The reconstruction fits GRACE-FO over most grids, reproduces strong El Niño signals and is more reliable than earlier products.
3c1090779ab77265093d742a3f347cf53db6a109.open_work: Improving reconstructions in regions with strong human water use and trends.
3c1090779ab77265093d742a3f347cf53db6a109.issues: Pre-GRACE skill cannot be validated directly; predictors may miss anthropogenic storage changes.

c65b68a97b184dafb56bdbc9b9a4a5ef3cc0207c.goal: Predicts crop yield and suitable crops from historical environmental factors to support farmers.
c65b68a97b184dafb56bdbc9b9a4a5ef3cc0207c.data: Historical data with temperature, humidity, pH, rainfall and crop name; source and region not reported.
c65b68a97b184dafb56bdbc9b9a4a5ef3cc0207c.result: Random forest is reported to give accurate crop yield predictions; numbers not reported in the abstract.
c65b68a97b184dafb56bdbc9b9a4a5ef3cc0207c.open_work: Larger and better documented datasets and comparison with other models.
c65b68a97b184dafb56bdbc9b9a4a5ef3cc0207c.issues: Data and evaluation poorly described; no quantitative results or baselines in the abstract.

24cbc379bcf54a9000f88b189198b04274a24add.goal: Improves short-range weather prediction accuracy with machine learning on numerical data.
24cbc379bcf54a9000f88b189198b04274a24add.architecture: Hybrid of k-means clustering and C5.0 decision tree classifier.
24cbc379bcf54a9000f88b189198b04274a24add.result: Reported predictive accuracy of 90.18%, better than compared machine learning approaches.
24cbc379bcf54a9000f88b189198b04274a24add.open_work: Clarifying target variables and testing against operational NWP.
24cbc379bcf54a9000f88b189198b04274a24add.issues: Forecast target and lead time unclear; no comparison with NWP; classification accuracy is hard to interpret.

e58acd97772631d9310251ac30b78607e9445631.goal: Assesses urban flood susceptibility in a catchment using convolutional neural networks.
e58acd97772631d9310251ac30b78607e9445631.architecture: Convolutional neural networks (a simple CNN and LeNet-5) compared with support vector machine and random forest, using point, array and image input strategies.
e58acd97772631d9310251ac30b78607e9445631.data: Nine precipitation, topographic and anthropogenic factors and a 2004–2014 flood inventory for the Dahongmen catchment, Beijing, China.
e58acd97772631d9310251ac30b78607e9445631.result: CNNs reach 0.90 (SCNN) and 0.88 (LeNet-5) accuracy, AUC 0.9 on an independent inventory; the image-based strategy captures upstream pluvial inundation.
e58acd97772631d9310251ac30b78607e9445631.open_work: Applying to other urban catchments and dynamic rainfall scenarios.
e58acd97772631d9310251ac30b78607e9445631.issues: Single catchment; limited flood inventory; static susceptibility.

c22ffe6bca07ca57da4d357c6a3dfb049889e3fe.goal: Classifies sea ice and open water at pixel level from SAR images.
c22ffe6bca07ca57da4d357c6a3dfb049889e3fe.architecture: Dual-attention U-Net with a ResNet-34 encoder (DAU-Net), compared with U-Net and DenseNetFCN.
c22ffe6bca07ca57da4d357c6a3dfb049889e3fe.data: Sentinel-1A dual-polarized SAR images with incidence angle near the Bering Sea; 15 images for training and 3 for testing.
c22ffe6bca07ca57da4d357c6a3dfb049889e3fe.result: DAU-Net improves IoU over U-Net by 0.83–7.48 points and over DenseNetFCN by 2.26–3.04 points on the three test images.
c22ffe6bca07ca57da4d357c6a3dfb049889e3fe.open_work: Extending to multiple ice types and other regions and seasons.
c22ffe6bca07ca57da4d357c6a3dfb049889e3fe.issues: Very small dataset of 18 images from one region; binary classification only.

159630b16d937257966e360012a2852cea376881.goal: Surveys machine learning and deep learning methods for hydrological processes, climate change and Earth systems.
159630b16d937257966e360012a2852cea376881.architecture: Systematic review with a classification of machine learning and deep learning methods, including ensembles and hybrid models.
159630b16d937257966e360012a2852cea376881.data: Published literature on hydrology, climate change and Earth system applications.
159630b16d937257966e360012a2852cea376881.result: Deep learning is still at an early stage, while machine learning is established and improving through ensemble and hybrid methods.
159630b16d937257966e360012a2852cea376881.open_work: Future trends in deep learning and hybrid methods for Earth systems.
159630b16d937257966e360012a2852cea376881.issues: Broad survey without quantitative synthesis; venue not recorded.

246d787faa680bf53ad0bb89376f8a78e3b58f0e.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction for stable power-grid operation despite the stochastic, non-stationary nature of wind speed series.
246d787faa680bf53ad0bb89376f8a78e3b58f0e.architecture: Hybrid model: CEEMDAN decomposes the wind speed series and VMD decomposes the error series; an LSTM network predicts each sub-series, with an error-correction step added to the forecast.
246d787faa680bf53ad0bb89376f8a78e3b58f0e.data: Four real wind speed forecasting cases (site details not reported in the abstract).
246d787faa680bf53ad0bb89376f8a78e3b58f0e.result: The double-decomposition LSTM model outperforms eight comparison models without double decomposition, and VMD of the error series improves the error-correction strategy.
246d787faa680bf53ad0bb89376f8a78e3b58f0e.open_work: Testing on more sites and horizons, probabilistic outputs, and use of meteorological inputs beyond the univariate series.
246d787faa680bf53ad0bb89376f8a78e3b58f0e.issues: Univariate single-site time series only; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if decomposition is applied to the full series; no uncertainty quantification.

59a2d55b11a0b2fc2cd57e21813b31a25b4eba98.goal: Proposes a hybrid deep learning algorithm to improve streamflow prediction, as implied by the title.
59a2d55b11a0b2fc2cd57e21813b31a25b4eba98.architecture: Hybrid deep learning model; the specific network components are not specified here.
59a2d55b11a0b2fc2cd57e21813b31a25b4eba98.data: Not reported in the abstract (no abstract available); streamflow records from an unspecified basin.
59a2d55b11a0b2fc2cd57e21813b31a25b4eba98.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies improved streamflow prediction over the compared baselines.
59a2d55b11a0b2fc2cd57e21813b31a25b4eba98.open_work: Testing on more basins and climates, longer lead times and probabilistic forecasting.
59a2d55b11a0b2fc2cd57e21813b31a25b4eba98.issues: Card based on the title only; data, baselines and gains are unknown and should be checked against the paper.

6a6e030d467dee4d36c56eadf6e8f2d9ba1bf1f1.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in Poyang County, China, to identify areas at risk of flood damage.
6a6e030d467dee4d36c56eadf6e8f2d9ba1bf1f1.architecture: Hybrids of bivariate statistical models (frequency ratio, index of entropy) with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and classification and regression tree (CART); a linear support vector machine ranks factor importance.
6a6e030d467dee4d36c56eadf6e8f2d9ba1bf1f1.data: Flood inventory of Poyang County, China, with 12 flood conditioning factors (e.g., elevation, slope, soil) for training and validation.
6a6e030d467dee4d36c56eadf6e8f2d9ba1bf1f1.result: Elevation, slope and soil are the most predictive factors; 20–50% of the area is rated high or very high susceptibility, and the MLP-probability density hybrid performs best among six methods.
6a6e030d467dee4d36c56eadf6e8f2d9ba1bf1f1.open_work: Transfer to other basins, inclusion of dynamic rainfall drivers, and validation against independent flood events.
6a6e030d467dee4d36c56eadf6e8f2d9ba1bf1f1.issues: Single-county study with static conditioning factors; susceptibility maps depend on inventory completeness and do not give flood probability or depth.

9332c5e2ae95959af04e2a4f623c78691c3da168.goal: Derives hydropower reservoir operation rules from limited streamflow information and compares methods for doing so.
9332c5e2ae95959af04e2a4f623c78691c3da168.architecture: Compares multiple linear regression, an artificial neural network (MLP with sigmoid hidden layer), an extreme learning machine and a support vector machine with RBF kernel.
9332c5e2ae95959af04e2a4f623c78691c3da168.data: Hongjiadu reservoir, China, operation and inflow data from 1952 to 2015.
9332c5e2ae95959af04e2a4f623c78691c3da168.result: ANN, SVM and ELM give better operation rules than multiple linear regression and the conventional scheduling-graph method.
9332c5e2ae95959af04e2a4f623c78691c3da168.open_work: Applying the methods to multi-reservoir systems and coupling them with inflow forecasts and optimization.
9332c5e2ae95959af04e2a4f623c78691c3da168.issues: Single reservoir case; derived rules are fitted to historical behavior and may not generalize under changed inflow regimes or climate.

da72071788704cac5cb438135dfb91f9fddadd0d.goal: Predicts daily reference evapotranspiration (ETo) for irrigation planning across contrasting climates of China.
da72071788704cac5cb438135dfb91f9fddadd0d.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM) optimized by bio-inspired algorithms (genetic algorithm, ant colony optimization, cuckoo search, flower pollination), compared with a grid-search ELM, using five-fold cross-validation.
da72071788704cac5cb438135dfb91f9fddadd0d.data: Daily maximum/minimum temperature, wind speed, relative humidity and global solar radiation, 2001–2015, from eight meteorological stations in China; FAO-56 Penman–Monteith ETo as target.
da72071788704cac5cb438135dfb91f9fddadd0d.result: All models match FAO-56 ETo well (R2 0.977–0.997); ELM-FPA is best (RMSE 0.159 mm/day), ahead of ELM-CSA, ELM-ACO, ELM-GA and standalone ELM (RMSE 0.210 mm/day); gains are largest in monsoon climates.
da72071788704cac5cb438135dfb91f9fddadd0d.open_work: Testing with fewer meteorological inputs, at more stations, and for multi-day ETo forecasting.
da72071788704cac5cb438135dfb91f9fddadd0d.issues: Targets are Penman–Monteith estimates computed from the same inputs, so the task is emulation rather than prediction of measured ET; only eight stations.

1ac08ec562b3b40974711961677a48e9b1eb3cfe.goal: Identifies areas prone to flash floods in the Suha river catchment, Romania, to support hazard mitigation.
1ac08ec562b3b40974711961677a48e9b1eb3cfe.architecture: Alternating Decision Tree ensembles with the Index of Entropy (ADT-IOE) and the Analytical Hierarchy Process (ADT-AHP), compared with standalone IOE and AHP.
1ac08ec562b3b40974711961677a48e9b1eb3cfe.data: 111 torrential and 111 non-torrential points with 8 flash-flood conditioning factors in the Suha catchment, Romania.
1ac08ec562b3b40974711961677a48e9b1eb3cfe.result: ADT-IOE (AUC 0.972) and ADT-AHP (AUC 0.926, accuracy 87.88%, kappa 0.758) outperform the standalone models.
1ac08ec562b3b40974711961677a48e9b1eb3cfe.open_work: Applying the ensembles to other catchments and including dynamic rainfall information.
1ac08ec562b3b40974711961677a48e9b1eb3cfe.issues: Small sample of points in one catchment; static susceptibility only, with no temporal or event-based validation.

18f1d4854996b2b24c29e8ca78b35fe14fd8fa76.goal: Builds fast emulators of hydrodynamic flood inundation models to enable real-time forecasting and uncertainty analysis that need many model runs.
18f1d4854996b2b24c29e8ca78b35fe14fd8fa76.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) based emulation framework that reproduces hydrodynamic model inundation time series.
18f1d4854996b2b24c29e8ca78b35fe14fd8fa76.data: Hydrodynamic model simulations for a river segment in Queensland, Australia.
18f1d4854996b2b24c29e8ca78b35fe14fd8fa76.result: ANNs model the time-series behavior of flood inundation and greatly reduce simulation time relative to the hydrodynamic model.
18f1d4854996b2b24c29e8ca78b35fe14fd8fa76.open_work: The authors discuss challenges and future directions, including generalization to other sites and scenarios and emulating spatially detailed inundation.
18f1d4854996b2b24c29e8ca78b35fe14fd8fa76.issues: Single river segment; emulator accuracy is bounded by the hydrodynamic model it imitates and may degrade for events outside the training range.

070cd5babaf37145d650dd1a87cc65c8c499d55a.goal: Predicts monthly average daily global solar radiation where measurements are unavailable, for solar energy system design and policy.
070cd5babaf37145d650dd1a87cc65c8c499d55a.architecture: Compares a feed-forward neural network (MLP), three Angstrom-type empirical models, Holt-Winters time series and response surface methodology.
070cd5babaf37145d650dd1a87cc65c8c499d55a.data: Turkish State Meteorological Service pressure, humidity, wind speed, temperature and sunshine duration, 2008–2018, at Ankara, Karaman, Kilis and Şirnak; 2018 used for testing.
070cd5babaf37145d650dd1a87cc65c8c499d55a.result: All models reach R2 0.952–0.993; the ANN is best (average R2 0.991, RMSE 0.78 MJ/m2-day, MAPE 4.9%), followed by Holt-Winters, RSM and empirical models.
070cd5babaf37145d650dd1a87cc65c8c499d55a.open_work: Extending to daily or hourly radiation and to more stations and climates.
070cd5babaf37145d650dd1a87cc65c8c499d55a.issues: Only four sites and one test year of monthly means; small samples limit robustness of the model ranking.

1c011be84df8c1ce9f01ea1ab82562ba3de8cd2c.goal: Improves monthly streamflow forecasting by systematically combining factor analysis, decomposition, regression and error correction.
1c011be84df8c1ce9f01ea1ab82562ba3de8cd2c.architecture: Hybrid framework: ACF, PACF and grey correlation analysis for input selection, STL seasonal-trend decomposition, support vector regression and generalized regression neural network, with autoregressive and multi-model error correction.
1c011be84df8c1ce9f01ea1ab82562ba3de8cd2c.data: Monthly streamflow at Shigu and Xiangjiaba stations, China, 1961–2009.
1c011be84df8c1ce9f01ea1ab82562ba3de8cd2c.result: The GCA-STL-SVR model performs best among fourteen models, reducing average error to under one-tenth of an ARIMA benchmark and cutting error standard deviation by over 30%.
1c011be84df8c1ce9f01ea1ab82562ba3de8cd2c.open_work: Testing at other basins, adding climate predictors and extending to probabilistic forecasts.
1c011be84df8c1ce9f01ea1ab82562ba3de8cd2c.issues: Two stations only; decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information if decomposition uses the full series; univariate approach ignores climate drivers.

0ebc2d00e742c743afde458eccee1621cf81230f.goal: Improves wind speed and wind power prediction for grid dispatch under intermittent, stochastic wind generation.
0ebc2d00e742c743afde458eccee1621cf81230f.architecture: Improved GM(1,1) and fractional-order grey models combined through a neural network for wind speed; support vector regression tuned by particle swarm optimization maps wind speed to power.
0ebc2d00e742c743afde458eccee1621cf81230f.data: Actual wind farm operation data with ECMWF and GRAPES-MESO NWP outputs as additional inputs; ARIMA as benchmark.
0ebc2d00e742c743afde458eccee1621cf81230f.result: The grey combination model improves wind speed and power prediction accuracy over single grey models and ARIMA.
0ebc2d00e742c743afde458eccee1621cf81230f.open_work: Extension to probabilistic forecasts and more wind farms and seasons.
0ebc2d00e742c743afde458eccee1621cf81230f.issues: Single case study with limited reporting of error statistics; the speed-power curve fit ignores turbine availability and curtailment.

23d41b388e73a6f17ab5c6f4145cf9592d01e169.goal: Surveys the application of machine learning to ocean data, as implied by the title.
23d41b388e73a6f17ab5c6f4145cf9592d01e169.architecture: Review of machine learning methods applied to ocean data; specific methods covered are not specified here.
23d41b388e73a6f17ab5c6f4145cf9592d01e169.data: Not reported in the abstract (no abstract available).
23d41b388e73a6f17ab5c6f4145cf9592d01e169.open_work: Open directions include better handling of sparse and heterogeneous ocean observations and physically consistent models.
23d41b388e73a6f17ab5c6f4145cf9592d01e169.issues: Card based on the title only; scope and depth of the review are unknown.

4d29928327a802e6f2ea7d49f6aea634704595b6.goal: Compares physically based, data-driven and hybrid approaches for estimating evapotranspiration, as stated in the title.
4d29928327a802e6f2ea7d49f6aea634704595b6.architecture: Comparison of a physical-based model, data-driven machine learning models and hybrid physics-ML models; the specific network types are not specified here.
4d29928327a802e6f2ea7d49f6aea634704595b6.data: Not reported in the abstract (no abstract available).
4d29928327a802e6f2ea7d49f6aea634704595b6.open_work: Testing across more sites and climates and exploring how physical constraints improve generalization of data-driven ET models.
4d29928327a802e6f2ea7d49f6aea634704595b6.issues: Card based on the title only; datasets, sites and model details are unknown.

a59a3263e79848524570d6938d11b216af63d460.goal: Produces interval and probabilistic wind power predictions using numerical weather prediction inputs to support grid integration.
a59a3263e79848524570d6938d11b216af63d460.architecture: EALSTM-QR: an encoder and attention layer extract NWP features, a bidirectional LSTM generates time-series predictions and quantile regression yields prediction intervals.
a59a3263e79848524570d6938d11b216af63d460.data: Historical wind power and NWP data from wind farms in China.
a59a3263e79848524570d6938d11b216af63d460.result: EALSTM-QR shows good accuracy and reliability of prediction intervals and probabilities compared with other neural-network interval and probabilistic models.
a59a3263e79848524570d6938d11b216af63d460.open_work: Testing on more farms and longer horizons and improving calibration of extreme quantiles.
a59a3263e79848524570d6938d11b216af63d460.issues: Quantitative skill scores are not given in the abstract; quantile crossing and dependence on NWP quality are not discussed.

77cb475a0fe93969238d1a747b16ab6af0c7ec4f.goal: Builds a wind farm decision system combining wind energy potential assessment with wind speed forecasting to reduce operating costs.
77cb475a0fe93969238d1a747b16ab6af0c7ec4f.architecture: Weibull distribution parameters fitted by multiple swarm intelligence optimization, plus a wind speed forecasting module with data-preprocessing denoising and an AI forecaster; the forecaster type is not specified in the abstract.
77cb475a0fe93969238d1a747b16ab6af0c7ec4f.data: Wind speed time series from wind farm sites (details not reported in the abstract).
77cb475a0fe93969238d1a747b16ab6af0c7ec4f.result: The system provides effective wind energy assessment and satisfactory wind speed forecasts.
77cb475a0fe93969238d1a747b16ab6af0c7ec4f.open_work: Integrating power forecasting and probabilistic outputs into the decision system.
77cb475a0fe93969238d1a747b16ab6af0c7ec4f.issues: Vague reporting of data and skill in the abstract; single-variable time series forecasting without meteorological drivers.

16bb325797f933f999276eb7605b373a9adee6a3.goal: Predicts direct normal irradiance (DNI) at short lead times from cloud features in sky images.
16bb325797f933f999276eb7605b373a9adee6a3.architecture: 3D convolutional neural network (CNN) extracts texture and temporal features from consecutive ground-based cloud images; a multilayer perceptron (MLP) forecasts DNI from these features.
16bb325797f933f999276eb7605b373a9adee6a3.data: Ground-based cloud images and DNI measurements from January 2013 to December 2014 (site not reported in the abstract).
16bb325797f933f999276eb7605b373a9adee6a3.result: The 3D-CNN with MLP achieves a forecast skill of 17.06% for 10-minute-ahead DNI prediction.
16bb325797f933f999276eb7605b373a9adee6a3.open_work: Longer lead times, multiple sites and probabilistic forecasting.
16bb325797f933f999276eb7605b373a9adee6a3.issues: Single site and short lead time; skill under rapidly changing cloud conditions and generalization to other cameras are not shown.

19df13fa2512c34a842f9018bd38c3bfd7580d5e.goal: Predicts rice yield at pixel scale about two months before harvest across South and North Korea, including inaccessible areas.
19df13fa2512c34a842f9018bd38c3bfd7580d5e.architecture: Satellite-integrated crop model yields serve as labels for deep learning; five architectures are tested, with a hybrid LSTM and 1D-CNN chosen as the best.
19df13fa2512c34a842f9018bd38c3bfd7580d5e.data: Satellite vegetation and water indices, climate (e.g., maximum temperature) and geographic variables over South and North Korea; crop-model reference yields as targets.
19df13fa2512c34a842f9018bd38c3bfd7580d5e.result: The LSTM-1D-CNN model achieves R2 0.859, NSE 0.858 and RMSE 0.605 Mg/ha; water index and maximum temperature dominate in North Korea, vegetation indices and geography in South Korea.
19df13fa2512c34a842f9018bd38c3bfd7580d5e.open_work: Validation against more ground yield data and extension to other crops and regions.
19df13fa2512c34a842f9018bd38c3bfd7580d5e.issues: Labels come from a crop model rather than observed yields, so the deep model inherits crop-model errors; ground validation in North Korea is not possible.

081f694a768fefc816a5a995e58015a5a750d2da.goal: Compares AI models for county-level corn and soybean yield prediction in the Midwestern United States.
081f694a768fefc816a5a995e58015a5a750d2da.architecture: Six AI models compared, including an optimized deep neural network (DNN, MLP-type) tuned for layers, loss, optimizer, activation and dropout.
081f694a768fefc816a5a995e58015a5a750d2da.data: County-level corn and soybean yields and predictor data for the Midwestern US, 2006–2015 (predictor products not detailed in the abstract), with July–August data selected as the best period.
081f694a768fefc816a5a995e58015a5a750d2da.result: The optimized DNN with July–August data is 21–33% (corn) and 17–22% (soybean) more accurate in MAE than the other five models, allowing forecasts in early September.
081f694a768fefc816a5a995e58015a5a750d2da.open_work: Combining the DNN with spatial statistical methods to reduce spatially clustered errors.
081f694a768fefc816a5a995e58015a5a750d2da.issues: Ten-year record; spatially clustered errors remain; the specific input products are not detailed in the abstract.

3520abc1d6f9c02f49133548d3a1da982d21ca66.goal: Tests whether noninterpretable deep learning is needed for hydro-climatological prediction, comparing it with interpretable models.
3520abc1d6f9c02f49133548d3a1da982d21ca66.architecture: Three interpretable models (tree-based ensembles among them) versus three noninterpretable models (deep learning), plus sequential transfer learning for gap filling and an explainable ML framework.
3520abc1d6f9c02f49133548d3a1da982d21ca66.data: Measured climate data and synthetic reference crop ETo with varying missing values from five weather stations in the Edwards aquifer region, south-central Texas.
3520abc1d6f9c02f49133548d3a1da982d21ca66.result: Interpretable tree-based ensembles match deep learning on structured data, impute missing climate data, and reveal variable importance and inflection points controlling ETo.
3520abc1d6f9c02f49133548d3a1da982d21ca66.open_work: Extending the comparison to other hydro-climatic targets, larger datasets and observed rather than synthetic ET.
3520abc1d6f9c02f49133548d3a1da982d21ca66.issues: Five stations and a synthetic ETo target; conclusions apply to tabular data and may not hold for spatial or long-sequence problems.

542aeab358baf441579a293938da70c86ce60cab.goal: Improves short-term daily runoff forecasting for water resource and reservoir flood operation.
542aeab358baf441579a293938da70c86ce60cab.architecture: VMD-DBN-IPSO: variational mode decomposition, PACF input selection, and a deep belief network optimized by improved particle swarm optimization for each sub-series, then reconstructed.
542aeab358baf441579a293938da70c86ce60cab.data: Daily runoff, 1988–2017, at Yangxian and Ankang stations, Han River Basin, China; 1-, 3-, 5- and 7-day lead times.
542aeab358baf441579a293938da70c86ce60cab.result: VMD-DBN-IPSO performs best in training and testing, with NSE above 0.8 and peak-flow errors within 20% for ten peak events.
542aeab358baf441579a293938da70c86ce60cab.open_work: Adding rainfall and other meteorological predictors and testing in other basins.
542aeab358baf441579a293938da70c86ce60cab.issues: Univariate runoff inputs; decomposition-based hybrids risk leakage of future information; only two stations.

4302633381b4ea010702fff7a1dfa4a8f8e38c2f.goal: Forecasts wind speed 1–24 h ahead by learning deep temporal features that account for data uncertainty.
4302633381b4ea010702fff7a1dfa4a8f8e38c2f.architecture: Interval probability distribution learning based on restricted Boltzmann machines and rough sets, stacked into an interval deep belief network with a type-2 fuzzy inference system for regression.
4302633381b4ea010702fff7a1dfa4a8f8e38c2f.data: Western Wind Dataset (NREL) wind speed time series.
4302633381b4ea010702fff7a1dfa4a8f8e38c2f.result: Significant improvement over shallow and deep single models and recent hybrid methods for 1-h to 24-h ahead predictions.
4302633381b4ea010702fff7a1dfa4a8f8e38c2f.open_work: Extension to probabilistic output evaluation and multi-site spatio-temporal forecasting.
4302633381b4ea010702fff7a1dfa4a8f8e38c2f.issues: Evaluated on one dataset; complex architecture with many components makes attribution and reproduction difficult.

9ca14939958cb47141cf15ff2a1e227197c2eabf.goal: Improves multi-step-ahead short-term wind speed forecasting for power system dispatch and safety.
9ca14939958cb47141cf15ff2a1e227197c2eabf.architecture: Composite framework: TVF-EMD decomposition, fuzzy entropy and SSA preprocessing, phase space reconstruction, kernel extreme learning machine for high-frequency components and ConvLSTM for the residual, tuned by a hybrid Harris hawks–grey wolf optimizer.
9ca14939958cb47141cf15ff2a1e227197c2eabf.data: Four wind speed datasets from various sites with two different time intervals; nine comparison models.
9ca14939958cb47141cf15ff2a1e227197c2eabf.result: Preprocessing cuts computation time without loss of skill, SSA and the hybrid optimizer improve accuracy, and the KELM-ConvLSTM combination performs best.
9ca14939958cb47141cf15ff2a1e227197c2eabf.open_work: Testing on more sites and longer horizons and simplifying the framework.
9ca14939958cb47141cf15ff2a1e227197c2eabf.issues: Highly complex pipeline with many tuned components; univariate inputs; decomposition can leak future information if not applied causally.

28696af5508dd042a4584d8a991756c1ddfd5afa.goal: Quantifies how climate and catchment characteristics control hydrological drought characteristics across the continental United States.
28696af5508dd042a4584d8a991756c1ddfd5afa.architecture: Random forest models with an interpretation framework using minimal depth, interactive depth and partial dependence.
28696af5508dd042a4584d8a991756c1ddfd5afa.data: 652 minimally disturbed CONUS catchments, 1979–2010, with climate and catchment attributes.
28696af5508dd042a4584d8a991756c1ddfd5afa.result: Three drought regimes emerge; RF models drought intensity, duration and frequency accurately, with catchment properties dominating regime 1 and both climate and catchment controls in regimes 2 and 3.
28696af5508dd042a4584d8a991756c1ddfd5afa.open_work: Including human-influenced catchments and future climate scenarios.
28696af5508dd042a4584d8a991756c1ddfd5afa.issues: Minimally disturbed catchments only; RF interpretation shows association, not causation.

07ab6647ec68350b7446b7a869d674e027e86a98.goal: Reviews neural network approaches for air temperature forecasting, important for water resources and agriculture.
07ab6647ec68350b7446b7a869d674e027e86a98.architecture: Review of artificial neural network methods, including RNN and LSTM, used for air temperature forecasting from 2005 to 2020.
07ab6647ec68350b7446b7a869d674e027e86a98.data: Published studies from 2005–2020 on air temperature forecasting.
07ab6647ec68350b7446b7a869d674e027e86a98.result: Neural networks are promising for air temperature forecasting, mainly at short term, but no consensus exists on the best method.
07ab6647ec68350b7446b7a869d674e027e86a98.open_work: The authors give future directions and recommendations for longer-range forecasting and method comparison.
07ab6647ec68350b7446b7a869d674e027e86a98.issues: Literature review without a common benchmark, so method comparisons rely on heterogeneous studies.

9bde9102fcae1a9211302d6543576541f407caf8.goal: Assesses pluvial flood hazard and risk in Davao Oriental, Philippines, as a broad-scale screening tool.
9bde9102fcae1a9211302d6543576541f407caf8.architecture: GIS-based analytic hierarchy process (AHP) multi-criteria analysis compared with a maximum entropy (Maxent) model.
9bde9102fcae1a9211302d6543576541f407caf8.data: Slope, elevation, soil type, rainfall, drainage density, distance to main channel and population density; flood records from 70 survey points for verification.
9bde9102fcae1a9211302d6543576541f407caf8.result: Maxent reaches 95.6% accuracy versus 81% for AHP; about 22% of the area and 30% of the population are at high pluvial flood risk.
9bde9102fcae1a9211302d6543576541f407caf8.open_work: Detailed numerical modelling of identified hotspots.
9bde9102fcae1a9211302d6543576541f407caf8.issues: Small verification sample; static factors only; high-level screening rather than physically based inundation estimates.

eac6c35e42ab4c28a169f093362712e13c7571d6.goal: Maps flash-flood potential in the Bâsca Chiojdului River Basin, Romania, one of the most affected areas in the country.
eac6c35e42ab4c28a169f093362712e13c7571d6.architecture: Statistical Index bivariate method and its ensembles with logistic regression, CART, multilayer perceptron (MLP), random forest, support vector machine and decision tree models.
eac6c35e42ab4c28a169f093362712e13c7571d6.data: Torrential areas digitized from orthophotomaps and field observations with equal non-torrential pixels (70/30 split); eight conditioning factors selected by Information Gain.
eac6c35e42ab4c28a169f093362712e13c7571d6.result: About 30% of the basin has high or very high flash-flood potential; the MLP-Statistical Index ensemble is the most efficient.
eac6c35e42ab4c28a169f093362712e13c7571d6.open_work: Applying the ensembles to other basins and adding dynamic precipitation information.
eac6c35e42ab4c28a169f093362712e13c7571d6.issues: Single basin; static susceptibility mapping with validation on the same inventory source.

49d7dc833df0b496b35eb5e2f07b942f4091b18f.goal: Predicts crop yields and assesses climate impacts on agriculture with interpretable machine learning.
49d7dc833df0b496b35eb5e2f07b942f4091b18f.architecture: Decision tree, random forest and LightGBM (gradient boosting) regressors, with SHAP and LIME for explainability.
49d7dc833df0b496b35eb5e2f07b942f4091b18f.data: Climatic and agronomic data including temperature, rainfall and macronutrient levels (dataset source not reported in the abstract).
49d7dc833df0b496b35eb5e2f07b942f4091b18f.result: Models reach R2 up to 0.92 with very low MSE and MAE; temperature is the most important factor, with rainfall-nutrient interactions.
49d7dc833df0b496b35eb5e2f07b942f4091b18f.open_work: Scaling to precision farming and policy applications, and testing under future climate scenarios.
49d7dc833df0b496b35eb5e2f07b942f4091b18f.issues: Dataset provenance and validation design are unclear in the abstract; very low errors may reflect normalized targets or leakage.

e1c378682a2a917f196cd6b399e98f9a709ce61e.goal: Assesses global biogeography of picophytoplankton and their response to ocean warming, which Earth system models represent poorly.
e1c378682a2a917f196cd6b399e98f9a709ce61e.architecture: Neural-network-derived quantitative niche model for picoeukaryotic phytoplankton, combined with earlier niche assessments of Prochlorococcus and Synechococcus.
e1c378682a2a917f196cd6b399e98f9a709ce61e.data: Global abundance dataset of picoeukaryotic phytoplankton, with environmental predictors such as temperature.
e1c378682a2a917f196cd6b399e98f9a709ce61e.result: Picophytoplankton lineages are partitioned into latitudinal niches by cell size, and biomass increases with temperature at low latitudes, suggesting warmer oceans may raise biomass there.
e1c378682a2a917f196cd6b399e98f9a709ce61e.open_work: Integrating diverse phytoplankton niches into Earth system models and testing the role of nutrient recycling.
e1c378682a2a917f196cd6b399e98f9a709ce61e.issues: Statistical niche model extrapolated to future conditions; assumes present-day relationships hold under warming.

a922a64f8f9ded396dc6a2f6714beb266127990a.goal: Downscales GRACE terrestrial water storage anomalies to high-resolution groundwater level anomalies where well data are sparse.
a922a64f8f9ded396dc6a2f6714beb266127990a.architecture: Machine learning-based downscaling model relating GRACE TWSA and land surface and hydro-climatic variables to groundwater level anomalies; the model family is not specified in the abstract.
a922a64f8f9ded396dc6a2f6714beb266127990a.data: GRACE TWSA, vegetation cover, land surface temperature, precipitation, streamflow, soil moisture and 32 monitoring wells (21 training, 11 testing) in a glacial aquifer system.
a922a64f8f9ded396dc6a2f6714beb266127990a.result: Downscaled anomalies reproduce spatial and temporal variation with correlation about 0.76 and NSE about 0.45; GRACE TWSA is the most influential predictor.
a922a64f8f9ded396dc6a2f6714beb266127990a.open_work: Including human impacts such as groundwater abstraction and applying to other aquifers.
a922a64f8f9ded396dc6a2f6714beb266127990a.issues: Modest NSE; geologic heterogeneity and omitted pumping add uncertainty; few test wells.

b74c9ed011c6e8eeeed54e0e239b825a8a1fe409.goal: Predicts rainfall from ground-based weather features, including GPS-derived precipitable water vapor.
b74c9ed011c6e8eeeed54e0e239b825a8a1fe409.architecture: Data-driven machine learning classifier on selected features; the algorithm type is not specified in the abstract.
b74c9ed011c6e8eeeed54e0e239b825a8a1fe409.data: Four years (2012–2015) of ground weather station data (temperature, humidity, dew point, solar radiation) and GPS PWV, with seasonal and diurnal variables.
b74c9ed011c6e8eeeed54e0e239b825a8a1fe409.result: PWV, solar radiation, seasonal and diurnal features matter most; the method achieves 80.4% true detection, 20.3% false alarm and 79.6% accuracy, lowering false alarms versus prior work.
b74c9ed011c6e8eeeed54e0e239b825a8a1fe409.open_work: Extending to rainfall amount prediction and longer lead times.
b74c9ed011c6e8eeeed54e0e239b825a8a1fe409.issues: Single-location dataset; binary rain occurrence only, with no intensity estimation.

146b3dc4eaa4018e0066a1d8ee3f200f8f7262fb.goal: Improves PM10 and PM2.5 prediction in Tehran, where particulate pollution is a major health concern.
146b3dc4eaa4018e0066a1d8ee3f200f8f7262fb.architecture: Support vector regression, geographically weighted regression, an artificial neural network and a nonlinear autoregressive neural network with exogenous input (NARX), improved by a proposed prediction model; genetic algorithm for feature selection.
146b3dc4eaa4018e0066a1d8ee3f200f8f7262fb.data: Day of week, month, topography, meteorology and pollutant levels at the two nearest monitoring stations in Tehran.
146b3dc4eaa4018e0066a1d8ee3f200f8f7262fb.result: The proposed model reduces errors by 57%, 47%, 47% and 94% for the four methods; NARX is best with a one-day error of 1.79 µg/m3.
146b3dc4eaa4018e0066a1d8ee3f200f8f7262fb.open_work: Extension to longer horizons and other pollutants and cities.
146b3dc4eaa4018e0066a1d8ee3f200f8f7262fb.issues: Single city; reliance on neighbor-station pollutant values limits use where monitoring is sparse.

8855d15a7da4311bf5329ec85a8aa45274ab53b5.goal: Improves rainfall-runoff modeling with an LSTM-based sequence-to-sequence design, as stated in the title.
8855d15a7da4311bf5329ec85a8aa45274ab53b5.data: Not reported in the abstract (no abstract available).
8855d15a7da4311bf5329ec85a8aa45274ab53b5.open_work: Testing across more basins and climates and for multi-day lead times.
8855d15a7da4311bf5329ec85a8aa45274ab53b5.issues: Card based on the title only; data, baselines and performance are unknown.

abcede8fd2b7dbaf95a055f239ecfc187eed87a0.goal: Forecasts hourly air quality index (AQI) with both high accuracy and stability.
abcede8fd2b7dbaf95a055f239ecfc187eed87a0.architecture: Analysis-forecast system: sample-entropy complexity analysis, decomposition and optimization-based feature selection, and a modified least squares support vector machine optimized by multi-objective multi-verse optimization.
abcede8fd2b7dbaf95a055f239ecfc187eed87a0.data: Hourly AQI series from eight major cities in China.
abcede8fd2b7dbaf95a055f239ecfc187eed87a0.result: The system simultaneously achieves high accuracy and strong stability in hourly AQI forecasting.
abcede8fd2b7dbaf95a055f239ecfc187eed87a0.open_work: Including meteorological and emission drivers and longer forecast horizons.
abcede8fd2b7dbaf95a055f239ecfc187eed87a0.issues: Univariate time-series approach; skill numbers not given in the abstract.

f21c9df94b64b46690045da62caed22746838e7e.goal: Predicts county-level maize yield in China by combining multi-source satellite and environmental data.
f21c9df94b64b46690045da62caed22746838e7e.architecture: LASSO regression, random forest, XGBoost and an LSTM network compared.
f21c9df94b64b46690045da62caed22746838e7e.data: Optical vegetation indices (e.g., EVI), solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence, thermal satellite data, climate, soil and management data across four agro-ecological zones in China.
f21c9df94b64b46690045da62caed22746838e7e.result: Multi-source data explain over 75% of yield variation; ML and DL outperform LASSO; heat and vapor pressure deficit during reproduction are key climate factors.
f21c9df94b64b46690045da62caed22746838e7e.open_work: Applying the framework to other crops and regions and using higher-resolution SIF.
f21c9df94b64b46690045da62caed22746838e7e.issues: County-level aggregation; coarse SIF resolution limits its benefit; ML is preferred for efficiency over DL.

18fbc93761e1e527982f93f31e79a6ebc285789b.goal: Retrieves soil moisture from spaceborne GNSS reflectometry at high spatio-temporal resolution.
18fbc93761e1e527982f93f31e79a6ebc285789b.architecture: Artificial neural network, random forest and support vector machine compared.
18fbc93761e1e527982f93f31e79a6ebc285789b.data: NASA CYGNSS GNSS-R observations with ancillary remote sensing products, trained and validated against International Soil Moisture Network (ISMN) sites in CONUS.
18fbc93761e1e527982f93f31e79a6ebc285789b.result: RF is best with RMSE 0.052 cm3/cm3 (ANN 0.061, SVM 0.065) in 5-fold cross-validation, and site- and year-based validation show generalization.
18fbc93761e1e527982f93f31e79a6ebc285789b.open_work: Extending retrievals to densely vegetated and heterogeneous areas and global coverage.
18fbc93761e1e527982f93f31e79a6ebc285789b.issues: Accuracy limited to lightly vegetated areas (VWC under 5 kg/m2) with low heterogeneity; point-site validation.

a02f9b9395f911fc794a90ae21cae232a1cb012f.goal: Estimates soil moisture content from soil properties for water and soil resource management.
a02f9b9395f911fc794a90ae21cae232a1cb012f.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system optimized by grey wolf optimizer (ANFIS-GWO), compared with an artificial neural network, support vector regression and standalone ANFIS variants.
a02f9b9395f911fc794a90ae21cae232a1cb012f.data: 1155 soil samples with dielectric constant, bulk density, clay content and organic matter.
a02f9b9395f911fc794a90ae21cae232a1cb012f.result: ANFIS-GWO is best (MAE 1.468%, SI 0.098), improving accuracy by 48% and 50% over ANFIS and SVR and about 77% over ANN in the global performance indicator.
a02f9b9395f911fc794a90ae21cae232a1cb012f.open_work: Testing on samples from other soils and regions.
a02f9b9395f911fc794a90ae21cae232a1cb012f.issues: Pedotransfer-style estimation from laboratory data; generalization beyond the sampled soils is not shown.

2e91812c009aed846fa70a99f194ad54fec6baa6.goal: Provides a near-real-time, quasi-global satellite precipitation dataset to supersede PERSIANN-CCS.
2e91812c009aed846fa70a99f194ad54fec6baa6.architecture: Dataset paper: PERSIANN family neural network infrared rain rate estimation with dynamic infrared-rain rate relationships, building on the PERSIANN-CCS cloud classification approach.
2e91812c009aed846fa70a99f194ad54fec6baa6.data: Geostationary infrared imagery as input; hourly 0.04° quasi-global estimates with 15–60 min latency, evaluated over 2017–2018.
2e91812c009aed846fa70a99f194ad54fec6baa6.result: PDIR-Now improves over PERSIANN-CCS at all time scales, with rain/no-rain CSI 0.53 versus 0.47, and captures Hurricane Harvey (CORR 0.64) and Netherlands thunderstorms (CORR 0.76).
2e91812c009aed846fa70a99f194ad54fec6baa6.open_work: Further improvement of rain-rate estimation and of performance in regions and regimes where infrared signals are weak.
2e91812c009aed846fa70a99f194ad54fec6baa6.issues: Infrared-only retrieval relates cloud-top properties indirectly to surface rain, limiting accuracy for warm-rain and orographic precipitation.

051055b5f2f84c0ab7eca9dd76c7c661219cef88.goal: Introduces normalizing flows for scenario-based probabilistic forecasting of wind, solar power and load in power systems.
051055b5f2f84c0ab7eca9dd76c7c661219cef88.architecture: Normalizing flows compared with other deep generative models: generative adversarial networks (GAN) and variational autoencoders (VAE).
051055b5f2f84c0ab7eca9dd76c7c661219cef88.data: Open data from the Global Energy Forecasting Competition 2014 (GEFCom2014) wind, solar and load tracks.
051055b5f2f84c0ab7eca9dd76c7c661219cef88.result: Normalizing flows are competitive with or better than GANs and VAEs in scenario quality and in forecast value for an energy retailer case study.
051055b5f2f84c0ab7eca9dd76c7c661219cef88.open_work: Application to market bidding, scheduling with high renewable penetration, microgrid energy management and unit commitment.
051055b5f2f84c0ab7eca9dd76c7c661219cef88.issues: Single benchmark dataset; weather inputs come from the competition data rather than operational NWP.

1f02635eff339b3361f091073699e6532fd246b9.goal: Predicts daily streamflow using support vector regression tuned by meta-heuristic optimization algorithms, as stated in the title.
1f02635eff339b3361f091073699e6532fd246b9.architecture: Support vector regression optimized by meta-heuristic algorithms; the specific optimizers are not specified here.
1f02635eff339b3361f091073699e6532fd246b9.data: Not reported in the abstract (no abstract available).
1f02635eff339b3361f091073699e6532fd246b9.open_work: Testing across more catchments and longer lead times.
1f02635eff339b3361f091073699e6532fd246b9.issues: Card based on the title only; study site, inputs and performance are unknown.

f1302841e478e67804fc461f0cf79df48a6a516d.goal: Forecasts daily air temperature in Bandung, Indonesia, comparing deep learning with a decomposable time-series model.
f1302841e478e67804fc461f0cf79df48a6a516d.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network compared with the Facebook Prophet additive time-series model.
f1302841e478e67804fc461f0cf79df48a6a516d.data: Five years of daily air temperature observations in Bandung.
f1302841e478e67804fc461f0cf79df48a6a516d.result: Prophet performs better for maximum temperature and LSTM for minimum temperature, with small RMSE differences.
f1302841e478e67804fc461f0cf79df48a6a516d.open_work: Adding meteorological covariates and testing at more stations.
f1302841e478e67804fc461f0cf79df48a6a516d.issues: Single station and univariate series; differences between methods are not significant.

cfb885fe3b66718089d5bf6264612b47acfaeb72.goal: Maps compound flooding from local to regional scale using deep learning and data fusion, as stated in the title.
cfb885fe3b66718089d5bf6264612b47acfaeb72.architecture: Deep learning model with data fusion techniques; the network type is not specified here.
cfb885fe3b66718089d5bf6264612b47acfaeb72.data: Not reported in the abstract (no abstract available).
cfb885fe3b66718089d5bf6264612b47acfaeb72.open_work: Transfer to other coastal regions and events and near-real-time mapping.
cfb885fe3b66718089d5bf6264612b47acfaeb72.issues: Card based on the title only; data sources, study region and accuracy are unknown.

48d3fa7a17a504c954f659f1a7ee1dd830fac29e.goal: Improves data-driven rainfall-runoff modelling by tackling hyperparameter tuning and overfitting in machine learning runoff predictors.
48d3fa7a17a504c954f659f1a7ee1dd830fac29e.architecture: MLP neural network and least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) tuned with the Harris Hawks Optimization metaheuristic, compared against the same models tuned with particle swarm optimization; inputs chosen via ACF, CCF and PACF scenarios.
48d3fa7a17a504c954f659f1a7ee1dd830fac29e.data: Observed rainfall and runoff time series for a single catchment; record length and location are not reported in the abstract.
48d3fa7a17a504c954f659f1a7ee1dd830fac29e.result: All HHO-tuned models outperform their PSO-tuned counterparts, and LSSVM-HHO gives the most accurate runoff predictions.
48d3fa7a17a504c954f659f1a7ee1dd830fac29e.open_work: Testing on more catchments and climates, longer lead times, and comparison with deep sequence models such as LSTM.
48d3fa7a17a504c954f659f1a7ee1dd830fac29e.issues: Single-catchment case with no uncertainty quantification; gains are relative to another metaheuristic rather than to process-based or modern deep learning baselines.

c51e0d479c12cca8060f1415d40628b252e77624.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration (ET0) from limited climatic inputs, a key quantity for agricultural water management.
c51e0d479c12cca8060f1415d40628b252e77624.architecture: Wavelet extreme learning machine (WELM) combining discrete wavelet transform with ELM, compared with wavelet ANN, single ANN, ELM and online sequential ELM.
c51e0d479c12cca8060f1415d40628b252e77624.data: Daily temperature, solar radiation, relative humidity and wind speed from Ankara and Kirikkale stations in central Anatolia, Turkey, in various input combinations.
c51e0d479c12cca8060f1415d40628b252e77624.result: Four-input models are most accurate, solar radiation is the most influential variable, and WELM is best, improving RMSE of ELM, ANN and WANN by roughly 14–58% across stations.
c51e0d479c12cca8060f1415d40628b252e77624.open_work: Extending to more stations and climates and testing generalization across sites without local training.
c51e0d479c12cca8060f1415d40628b252e77624.issues: Only two stations in one region; targets are FAO-56-type ET0 estimates rather than direct measurements; wavelet decomposition of the full series can leak future information if not done carefully.

8ccd1205519ca836b7e9ee1874acac1ecdd5e960.goal: Forecasts hourly solar radiation for solar energy applications using clustered neuro-fuzzy models.
8ccd1205519ca836b7e9ee1874acac1ecdd5e960.architecture: Adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) whose rule base is built with fuzzy c-means clustering, subtractive clustering or grid partitioning, and the three variants are compared.
8ccd1205519ca836b7e9ee1874acac1ecdd5e960.data: Hourly solar radiation measurements; the station and period are not reported here (no abstract available).
8ccd1205519ca836b7e9ee1874acac1ecdd5e960.result: Not reported in the abstract; the paper compares the three clustering schemes for ANFIS forecasting accuracy.
8ccd1205519ca836b7e9ee1874acac1ecdd5e960.open_work: Comparison with deep sequence models and multi-site testing would clarify the value of the clustered ANFIS approach.
8ccd1205519ca836b7e9ee1874acac1ecdd5e960.issues: No abstract available; site, data period and accuracy cannot be verified from the record, and deterministic point forecasts give no uncertainty.

59a56f1f0122e327a2f25b590f353349062dab3b.goal: Models monthly reference evapotranspiration (ETo) with hybrid machine learning to support irrigation and water resources planning.
59a56f1f0122e327a2f25b590f353349062dab3b.architecture: Artificial neural networks (MLP-type ANN) trained with five metaheuristics: grey wolf optimizer, multi-verse optimizer, particle swarm optimizer, whale optimization and ant lion optimizer; compared with three Valiantzas empirical equations.
59a56f1f0122e327a2f25b590f353349062dab3b.data: Monthly Tmin, Tmax, relative humidity, wind speed and solar radiation at Ranichauri (India) and Dar El Beida (Algeria) stations.
59a56f1f0122e327a2f25b590f353349062dab3b.result: ANN-GWO with five inputs is best at both stations (RMSE 0.059/0.081, NSE 0.997/0.996), outperforming other hybrids and empirical equations.
59a56f1f0122e327a2f25b590f353349062dab3b.open_work: Testing on more stations and climates, cross-station transfer, and fewer-input configurations for data-scarce areas.
59a56f1f0122e327a2f25b590f353349062dab3b.issues: Two stations only; near-perfect scores partly reflect that ETo is itself a deterministic function of the inputs; no uncertainty analysis.

d1cb23396b58ba529803becb44410003115d3432.goal: Improves satellite precipitation retrievals by fusing them with high-quality dual-polarization ground radar rainfall in a machine learning framework.
d1cb23396b58ba529803becb44410003115d3432.architecture: Deep multi-layer perceptron (MLP) mapping geostationary infrared data and low-earth-orbit passive microwave retrievals to rainfall, trained on ground-radar rainfall labels.
d1cb23396b58ba529803becb44410003115d3432.data: Geostationary IR and PMW retrievals preprocessed with CMORPH; targets from the urban X-band dual-polarization radar network over the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex; evaluation against standard CMORPH products.
d1cb23396b58ba529803becb44410003115d3432.result: The fusion system produces accurate precipitation estimates that improve on CMORPH and is proposed as a basis for future satellite retrieval algorithms.
d1cb23396b58ba529803becb44410003115d3432.open_work: Extending the framework beyond one urban domain, to other radar networks and to global retrieval algorithms.
d1cb23396b58ba529803becb44410003115d3432.issues: Single urban demonstration region; radar labels carry their own errors; generalization to areas without radar coverage is untested.

e6e8c98248a0f3f73e4d6bb446ba410ec750fd7c.goal: Estimates power output of every turbine in a wind farm of arbitrary layout and wind conditions, accounting for wake interactions.
e6e8c98248a0f3f73e4d6bb446ba410ec750fd7c.architecture: Physics-induced graph neural network (PGNN) that represents the farm as a graph and uses an engineering wake interaction model as a basis function inside the message passing.
e6e8c98248a0f3f73e4d6bb446ba410ec750fd7c.data: Simulated wind farm data from an engineering wake model across layouts and wind conditions; no field SCADA data reported in the abstract.
e6e8c98248a0f3f73e4d6bb446ba410ec750fd7c.result: PGNN gives accurate, generalizable and physically explainable power estimates and works as a differentiable surrogate for layout optimization.
e6e8c98248a0f3f73e4d6bb446ba410ec750fd7c.open_work: Validation with real SCADA data and higher-fidelity (LES) wake simulations, and use in control and yaw optimization.
e6e8c98248a0f3f73e4d6bb446ba410ec750fd7c.issues: Trained and tested on simulations, so it inherits the simplifications of the engineering wake model; real-farm performance is unverified.

621ab4ed144aa91354f6d9ec9f3550127cab3dd6.goal: Predicts final sugarcane growth from meteorological parameters to support sugar industry management.
621ab4ed144aa91354f6d9ec9f3550127cab3dd6.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM), a single-hidden-layer feedforward network, compared with an artificial neural network and genetic programming.
621ab4ed144aa91354f6d9ec9f3550127cab3dd6.data: Meteorological parameters and sugarcane growth records; the region and data period are not reported in the abstract.
621ab4ed144aa91354f6d9ec9f3550127cab3dd6.result: ELM achieves RMSE 0.8, r 0.47 and R2 0.89 with faster learning and better generalization than ANN and genetic programming.
621ab4ed144aa91354f6d9ec9f3550127cab3dd6.open_work: Applying the model to more regions, varieties and seasons, and adding soil and management inputs.
621ab4ed144aa91354f6d9ec9f3550127cab3dd6.issues: Small, poorly described dataset; reported metrics are internally inconsistent (r 0.47 with R2 0.89); no independent multi-year validation.

1e006584e119eaed98761f0eac5899d7a8c7260a.goal: Surveys machine learning methods for weather forecasting to synthesize progress, trends and open challenges.
1e006584e119eaed98761f0eac5899d7a8c7260a.architecture: Review of ML-based weather forecasting, covering global data-driven forecasting models, downscaling, extreme weather prediction and physics-ML integration.
1e006584e119eaed98761f0eac5899d7a8c7260a.data: Literature review; no new training data. Covers methods trained on reanalysis and observation datasets discussed in the literature.
1e006584e119eaed98761f0eac5899d7a8c7260a.result: Identifies global forecasting, downscaling, extreme event prediction and physics-informed ML as active areas, with interpretability and rare-event prediction as key gaps.
1e006584e119eaed98761f0eac5899d7a8c7260a.open_work: Provides a roadmap toward interpretable models and better prediction of rare and extreme weather events.
1e006584e119eaed98761f0eac5899d7a8c7260a.issues: Survey scope and selection criteria are not stated in the abstract; fast-moving field means coverage may date quickly.

a99212579ffcd6288f6e75d75649d8f9e891e41d.goal: Forecasts daily solar irradiance at two Indian locations using deep learning and data from multiple nearby sites.
a99212579ffcd6288f6e75d75649d8f9e891e41d.architecture: Deep learning time-series models including bidirectional LSTM and attention-based LSTM, in univariate single-site and multi-site configurations, with feature-importance analysis of neighbouring sites.
a99212579ffcd6288f6e75d75649d8f9e891e41d.data: Daily solar radiation from the NASA POWER repository, 1983–2019 (36 years), for two locations in India and nearby sites; rolling-window evaluation.
a99212579ffcd6288f6e75d75649d8f9e891e41d.result: Bidirectional LSTM and attention-based LSTM forecast daily irradiance well, and adding multi-site data improves on single-location univariate forecasts.
a99212579ffcd6288f6e75d75649d8f9e891e41d.open_work: Adding meteorological predictors, longer horizons and probabilistic forecasts.
a99212579ffcd6288f6e75d75649d8f9e891e41d.issues: NASA POWER is a reanalysis/satellite-derived product, not ground measurements; only two target locations; daily resolution limits operational use.

7dc654abbcf0ae69e6bedae7bf57ead0015c94d4.goal: Recommends suitable crops and predicts yield from soil and climate conditions to help Indian farmers maximize profit.
7dc654abbcf0ae69e6bedae7bf57ead0015c94d4.architecture: Hybrid system combining a support vector machine with recurrent neural network and LSTM deep learning models.
7dc654abbcf0ae69e6bedae7bf57ead0015c94d4.data: Soil nutrient (N, P, K), moisture, temperature and precipitation data for Indian agriculture; dataset source and size are not reported in the abstract.
7dc654abbcf0ae69e6bedae7bf57ead0015c94d4.result: Claims better accuracy than an earlier random forest/decision tree/ANN model and also estimates required soil nutrient amounts and costs.
7dc654abbcf0ae69e6bedae7bf57ead0015c94d4.open_work: Validation on larger, documented datasets and field trials.
7dc654abbcf0ae69e6bedae7bf57ead0015c94d4.issues: No quantitative results or data description in the abstract; use of sequence models for static soil inputs is not justified; reproducibility is limited.

8a7dc623a98a16c3afc12b566533af7ccb93def8.goal: Forecasts short-term wind direction to guide wind turbine nacelle yaw control.
8a7dc623a98a16c3afc12b566533af7ccb93def8.architecture: Hybrid pipeline: bilinear transformation of angular data, ICEEMDAN decomposition into subseries, LSTM recurrent neural networks per subseries, and error decomposition correction before inverse transformation.
8a7dc623a98a16c3afc12b566533af7ccb93def8.data: Wind direction data from a wind farm in Huitengxile, Inner Mongolia, China.
8a7dc623a98a16c3afc12b566533af7ccb93def8.result: The hybrid approach outperforms the single models tested for short-horizon nacelle direction prediction.
8a7dc623a98a16c3afc12b566533af7ccb93def8.open_work: Testing at more farms and integrating forecasts into yaw controllers to quantify energy gains.
8a7dc623a98a16c3afc12b566533af7ccb93def8.issues: Single wind farm; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if the series is decomposed before splitting; no probabilistic output.

c28cfc24537592a3355ca94727f9185e9322e7c4.goal: Predicts ground-level ozone concentration for air quality forecasting.
c28cfc24537592a3355ca94727f9185e9322e7c4.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) model, as stated in the title.
c28cfc24537592a3355ca94727f9185e9322e7c4.data: Not reported here (no abstract available); air quality and meteorological monitoring data are implied.
c28cfc24537592a3355ca94727f9185e9322e7c4.open_work: Testing across more sites and longer horizons and comparison with chemical transport models.
c28cfc24537592a3355ca94727f9185e9322e7c4.issues: No abstract available; study region, data and accuracy cannot be verified from the record.

3710d0b6c81334c48b614f089cf505a7cc1702cf.goal: Forecasts wind turbine responses, generated energy and demand, at very short horizons from the spatio-temporal wind field.
3710d0b6c81334c48b614f089cf505a7cc1702cf.architecture: Multi-task deep neural network combining a convolutional network for spatial wind-field features with an LSTM for temporal dynamics.
3710d0b6c81334c48b614f089cf505a7cc1702cf.data: Wind fields from large eddy simulation, with turbine responses simulated by aero-elastic turbine software.
3710d0b6c81334c48b614f089cf505a7cc1702cf.result: The model forecasts two outputs simultaneously with about 5% error at sub-minute lead times.
3710d0b6c81334c48b614f089cf505a7cc1702cf.open_work: Validation on measured lidar or SCADA data and longer forecast horizons.
3710d0b6c81334c48b614f089cf505a7cc1702cf.issues: Entirely simulation-based; sub-minute horizon only; real-world inflow measurements would be far sparser than LES fields.

34dbae2d83197704cb01b232c73f013008639a29.goal: Retrieves surface soil moisture from SMAP observations with a neural network as an alternative to the physically based SMAP retrieval.
34dbae2d83197704cb01b232c73f013008639a29.architecture: Feedforward neural network mapping SMAP brightness temperatures (with ancillary inputs) to surface soil moisture.
34dbae2d83197704cb01b232c73f013008639a29.data: SMAP L-band brightness temperatures; the network is trained against GEOS-5 land model (Catchment) soil moisture and evaluated against in situ measurements and the SMAP Level-2 product.
34dbae2d83197704cb01b232c73f013008639a29.result: The neural network retrievals show skill against in situ data comparable to the official SMAP Level-2 retrievals; detailed numbers are not given here.
34dbae2d83197704cb01b232c73f013008639a29.open_work: Using such retrievals for data assimilation, since their climatology is consistent with the model used for training.
34dbae2d83197704cb01b232c73f013008639a29.issues: Retrievals inherit the climatology and biases of the land model used as training target; no abstract available to confirm details.

57d8a1b3ccecf7f9d8f5c1ea5ebcd8915d9d8180.goal: Nowcasts convective precipitation, whose fast evolution challenges conventional extrapolation.
57d8a1b3ccecf7f9d8f5c1ea5ebcd8915d9d8180.architecture: U-Net convolutional neural network with downsampling, upsampling and skip connections, compared with the recurrent TrajGRU model.
57d8a1b3ccecf7f9d8f5c1ea5ebcd8915d9d8180.data: Radar reflectivity image sequences; five consecutive frames in and a 30-min-ahead reflectivity image out. Radar source and region are not reported in the abstract.
57d8a1b3ccecf7f9d8f5c1ea5ebcd8915d9d8180.result: The CNN-based U-Net performs almost as well as the RNN-based TrajGRU.
57d8a1b3ccecf7f9d8f5c1ea5ebcd8915d9d8180.open_work: Longer lead times, multi-step output and probabilistic or generative nowcasting to reduce blurring.
57d8a1b3ccecf7f9d8f5c1ea5ebcd8915d9d8180.issues: Single 30-min lead time; deterministic CNN nowcasts tend to blur convective cells; no quantitative scores in the abstract.

e0220df5b3ec4223b48d2c3a787cf3fe93154ed5.goal: Compares machine learning algorithms for downscaling coarse microwave soil moisture to 1 km over different land surfaces.
e0220df5b3ec4223b48d2c3a787cf3fe93154ed5.architecture: Six algorithms compared: artificial neural network, Bayesian regression, classification and regression trees, k-nearest neighbours, random forest and support vector machine.
e0220df5b3ec4223b48d2c3a787cf3fe93154ed5.data: ESA CCI ECV soil moisture downscaled with LST, NDVI, albedo, DEM and coordinates; validated against in situ networks: Oklahoma Mesonet, Naqu (Tibetan Plateau), REMEDHUS (Spain) and OzNet (Australia).
e0220df5b3ec4223b48d2c3a787cf3fe93154ed5.result: Random forest performs best; ANN, CART and SVM produce many abnormal values; DEM, daytime LST and NDVI dominate feature importance, and accuracy is highest in single-climate, mild-topography regions.
e0220df5b3ec4223b48d2c3a787cf3fe93154ed5.open_work: Improving robustness of the weaker learners and extending to more climates and terrain types.
e0220df5b3ec4223b48d2c3a787cf3fe93154ed5.issues: Point in situ validation of 1 km pixels involves scale mismatch; optical inputs such as LST and NDVI have cloud gaps.

0c7864522ab1874d6c72ad3834e49dd91b806a8e.goal: Predicts wind speed at a target site using data from a limited set of neighbouring reference stations, useful where local records are missing.
0c7864522ab1874d6c72ad3834e49dd91b806a8e.architecture: Multi-layer perceptron (MLP) neural network optimized with the firefly algorithm (MLP-FFA), as stated in the title.
0c7864522ab1874d6c72ad3834e49dd91b806a8e.data: Wind speed records from neighbouring reference stations; the region and period are not reported here (no abstract available).
0c7864522ab1874d6c72ad3834e49dd91b806a8e.result: Not reported in the abstract; the paper claims improved prediction from the hybrid MLP-firefly model.
