0c7864522ab1874d6c72ad3834e49dd91b806a8e.open_work: Testing with more station configurations and against modern deep learning and reanalysis-based approaches.
0c7864522ab1874d6c72ad3834e49dd91b806a8e.issues: No abstract available; region, station set and accuracy cannot be verified from the record.

12c8aead624e6a86684dabb29bc80f1d1f1ae63f.goal: Predicts barley yield before harvest from multi-source data and examines how the timing of inputs within the season affects accuracy.
12c8aead624e6a86684dabb29bc80f1d1f1ae63f.architecture: Four machine learning regressors compared, with Gaussian process regression performing best; other model types are not named in the abstract.
12c8aead624e6a86684dabb29bc80f1d1f1ae63f.data: Field data, remote sensing data and meteorological data for a major barley production area in Iran, with the growth period split into three parts.
12c8aead624e6a86684dabb29bc80f1d1f1ae63f.result: Gaussian process regression estimates yield with R2 0.84, RMSE 737 kg/ha and MAE 650 kg/ha one month before harvest; accuracy varies with agricultural zone and training period.
12c8aead624e6a86684dabb29bc80f1d1f1ae63f.open_work: Earlier-season prediction and transfer to other regions and crops.
12c8aead624e6a86684dabb29bc80f1d1f1ae63f.issues: Single region and crop; satellite sensor and sample size are not stated in the abstract.

5c958c7a72a6999d10749faad00ba134f73674d8.goal: Predicts drought indices SPI and SPEI across Iran's climates and selects the best lag combinations.
5c958c7a72a6999d10749faad00ba134f73674d8.architecture: Random forest model using 1–12 month lagged index values as predictors.
5c958c7a72a6999d10749faad00ba134f73674d8.data: Monthly precipitation and temperature from Iranian stations, 1960–2019, used to compute SPI and SPEI at 3–48 month time scales.
5c958c7a72a6999d10749faad00ba134f73674d8.result: Prediction accuracy rises with time scale, SPEI is more predictable than SPI, and SPI–SPEI correlation is high in temperate north Iran (0.81–0.95) but low in arid southwest (0.35–0.47).
5c958c7a72a6999d10749faad00ba134f73674d8.open_work: Authors suggest wavelet preprocessing and Penman–Monteith PET where ground data allow.
5c958c7a72a6999d10749faad00ba134f73674d8.issues: Uses only lagged indices with no climate drivers; temperature-based PET simplifies SPEI; long-scale indices are smooth, inflating apparent skill.

97db8a75259489095bd637d8de9bdf86b735c3a9.goal: Forecasts long-term monthly mean air temperature in different climate types of Iran.
97db8a75259489095bd637d8de9bdf86b735c3a9.architecture: Seasonal ARIMA (SARIMA) statistical model compared with support vector regression and SVR tuned by the firefly algorithm (SVR-FA), as stated in the title.
97db8a75259489095bd637d8de9bdf86b735c3a9.data: Monthly mean temperature records from Iranian stations in several climate types; stations and period are not reported here (no abstract available).
97db8a75259489095bd637d8de9bdf86b735c3a9.result: Not reported in the abstract; the paper compares SARIMA, SVR and SVR-FA skill across climate types.
97db8a75259489095bd637d8de9bdf86b735c3a9.open_work: Including large-scale climate predictors and testing longer horizons.
97db8a75259489095bd637d8de9bdf86b735c3a9.issues: No abstract available; monthly temperature is dominated by the seasonal cycle, so skill beyond climatology needs careful assessment.

591ea53d5d0bb9a4b927cf954f81d5b41efde0ea.goal: Explains how meteorology drives variability of PM1 air pollution and high-pollution episodes using explainable machine learning.
591ea53d5d0bb9a4b927cf954f81d5b41efde0ea.architecture: Tree-based gradient boosting model interpreted with SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) values to isolate season-specific meteorological influences.
591ea53d5d0bb9a4b927cf954f81d5b41efde0ea.data: Speciated PM1 measurements at the SIRTA suburban site southwest of Paris, France, with meteorological inputs including mixed layer height, temperature, wind and precipitation.
591ea53d5d0bb9a4b927cf954f81d5b41efde0ea.result: The model explains R2 0.58 of afternoon total PM1; winter episodes are driven by shallow mixed layers (~5 µg/m3), sub-freezing temperatures (up to ~9 µg/m3) and northeasterly inflow; summer by heat, dry spells and weak wind.
591ea53d5d0bb9a4b927cf954f81d5b41efde0ea.open_work: Transfer of the approach to other sites and use to inform policy measures and public warnings.
591ea53d5d0bb9a4b927cf954f81d5b41efde0ea.issues: Single site; moderate R2 leaves much variance unexplained; SHAP attributions are associations, not causal effects, and emissions are not modelled directly.

f5074a176e126f9443ef3fa478599cf5aa2b74f8.goal: Improves spatio-temporal meteorological forecasting on irregular station or grid layouts by better modelling local spatial patterns.
f5074a176e126f9443ef3fa478599cf5aa2b74f8.architecture: Conditional Local Convolution Recurrent Network (CLCRN): a graph neural network convolution whose kernel is approximated by feedforward networks on local cylindrical-tangent coordinates, embedded in a recurrent neural network.
f5074a176e126f9443ef3fa478599cf5aa2b74f8.data: Real-world weather benchmark datasets drawn from WeatherBench (variables such as temperature, cloud cover, humidity and wind).
f5074a176e126f9443ef3fa478599cf5aa2b74f8.result: CLCRN achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the benchmarks with clear improvements over prior spatio-temporal graph models.
f5074a176e126f9443ef3fa478599cf5aa2b74f8.open_work: Scaling to higher resolution and longer lead times and comparison with modern global data-driven weather models.
f5074a176e126f9443ef3fa478599cf5aa2b74f8.issues: Benchmarks are coarse-resolution and short-horizon; deterministic output with no uncertainty; skill relative to NWP is not assessed.

dd415542e51d20521bad69e52c6b9114dad85860.goal: Improves short-term electric load forecasting by accounting for season-specific meteorological influences on demand.
dd415542e51d20521bad69e52c6b9114dad85860.architecture: Support vector machine with hyperparameters tuned by the firefly algorithm, combined with a season-specific similarity concept for selecting training days.
dd415542e51d20521bad69e52c6b9114dad85860.data: Electric load and meteorological variables for Assam, India, with four seasonal case studies.
dd415542e51d20521bad69e52c6b9114dad85860.result: The season-specific approach is more accurate than conventional temperature-only or multi-variable approaches without seasonal consideration in all cases.
dd415542e51d20521bad69e52c6b9114dad85860.open_work: Extension to other regions and probabilistic load forecasting.
dd415542e51d20521bad69e52c6b9114dad85860.issues: Single regional grid; error metrics are not given in the abstract; evaluation limited to four case studies.

1163e5f70a1c97b9af810c78c18ab8db78430589.goal: Maps flash-flood potential to support flash-flood forecasting and warnings in the Prahova catchment, Romania.
1163e5f70a1c97b9af810c78c18ab8db78430589.architecture: Four hybrid models combining logistic regression or support vector machine (RBF kernel) with frequency ratio or weights-of-evidence coefficients; linear SVM used for factor selection.
1163e5f70a1c97b9af810c78c18ab8db78430589.data: Inventory of 260 km2 of torrential-phenomena areas (70% training, 30% validation) and 10 flash-flood conditioning factors for the upper and middle Prahova catchment.
1163e5f70a1c97b9af810c78c18ab8db78430589.result: High and very high flash-flood potential covers about 33% of the area; models are validated with ROC/AUC, sensitivity, specificity and accuracy.
1163e5f70a1c97b9af810c78c18ab8db78430589.open_work: Applying the hybrids in other catchments and linking susceptibility maps to dynamic rainfall forecasts.
1163e5f70a1c97b9af810c78c18ab8db78430589.issues: Static susceptibility only, no event timing; single catchment; AUC values are not stated in the abstract.

9017f4d7c935bea2629a8aecd3f604bc5a4e8a54.goal: Predicts three-dimensional ocean temperature from the surface to about 2000 m, rather than only SST at isolated points.
9017f4d7c935bea2629a8aecd3f604bc5a4e8a54.architecture: Multilayer convolutional LSTM (M-convLSTM) combining CNNs, LSTMs and vertical layer stacking.
9017f4d7c935bea2629a8aecd3f604bc5a4e8a54.data: Argo float-based global ocean temperature data.
9017f4d7c935bea2629a8aecd3f604bc5a4e8a54.result: The model forecasts 3-D ocean temperature with good overall accuracy against Argo data.
9017f4d7c935bea2629a8aecd3f604bc5a4e8a54.open_work: Longer lead times, more variables (salinity, currents) and comparison with ocean reanalysis or dynamical forecasts.
9017f4d7c935bea2629a8aecd3f604bc5a4e8a54.issues: Accuracy metrics and lead times are not stated in the abstract; gridded Argo products are smooth and sparse at depth.

3074102567fb9661099af3ba3f0333949c8c4c3e.goal: Maps flash flood susceptibility in a wadi system in Hurghada, Egypt.
3074102567fb9661099af3ba3f0333949c8c4c3e.architecture: Gradient boosting decision trees LightGBM and CatBoost compared with random forest.
3074102567fb9661099af3ba3f0333949c8c4c3e.data: Inventory of 445 flash flood sites (70% train, 30% test) and fourteen flood conditioning factors.
3074102567fb9661099af3ba3f0333949c8c4c3e.result: All models exceed 97% AUROC; LightGBM is best in classification metrics and processing time; populated areas are most susceptible.
3074102567fb9661099af3ba3f0333949c8c4c3e.open_work: Applying the approach to other arid wadi systems and with dynamic rainfall inputs.
3074102567fb9661099af3ba3f0333949c8c4c3e.issues: Very high AUROC may reflect spatial autocorrelation between random train and test points; static susceptibility only.

22523c794681f4b65292dc7c11d01fb88c8ccb9f.goal: Forecasts 10-day streamflow into the Three Gorges Dam with decomposition-based data-driven models.
22523c794681f4b65292dc7c11d01fb88c8ccb9f.architecture: Fourier-transform decomposition into frequency components each forecast by support vector regression (FT-SVR) or extreme gradient boosting (FT-XGBoost tree ensemble).
22523c794681f4b65292dc7c11d01fb88c8ccb9f.data: 10-day inflow time series of China's Three Gorges Dam, decomposed into 4 or 7 components.
22523c794681f4b65292dc7c11d01fb88c8ccb9f.result: FT-SVR with 7 components gives near-perfect 10-day forecasts, beating other decompositions and FT-XGBoost while calibrating as efficiently.
22523c794681f4b65292dc7c11d01fb88c8ccb9f.open_work: Testing at other reservoirs and lead times and checking robustness of decomposition in real-time settings.
22523c794681f4b65292dc7c11d01fb88c8ccb9f.issues: Near-perfect skill raises concern about information leakage if decomposition uses future data; single site.

bc73de53245da9c94784e107b8b5f2e2586d035f.goal: Models monthly pan evaporation in arid and humid climates for water resources management.
bc73de53245da9c94784e107b8b5f2e2586d035f.architecture: Support vector regression and artificial neural networks, alone and combined with wavelet transforms (WSVR, WANN).
bc73de53245da9c94784e107b8b5f2e2586d035f.data: Monthly meteorological data (air temperatures, relative humidity, solar radiation) and pan evaporation at Tabriz (Iran) and Antalya (Turkey).
bc73de53245da9c94784e107b8b5f2e2586d035f.result: Plain ANN performs best at both stations (Tabriz RMSE 0.701, NSE 0.977; Antalya RMSE 0.923, NSE 0.898); wavelets do not help ANN but improve SVR at Antalya.
bc73de53245da9c94784e107b8b5f2e2586d035f.open_work: Testing on more stations and climates and with additional inputs such as wind speed.
bc73de53245da9c94784e107b8b5f2e2586d035f.issues: Only two stations; wavelet benefits are inconsistent; no uncertainty analysis.

f203ab4215201fc7df5d1b30d28c98ba70262ced.goal: Determines how climate and catchment attributes control the spatial distribution of flood generating processes across the US.
f203ab4215201fc7df5d1b30d28c98ba70262ced.architecture: Random forest model interpreted with accumulated local effects (ALE), alongside a statistics-based comparison of attribute distributions.
f203ab4215201fc7df5d1b30d28c98ba70262ced.data: 671 catchments across the contiguous United States from the CAMELS large-sample dataset, with flood events classified into excess rain, short rain, long rain, snowmelt and rain-on-snow.
f203ab4215201fc7df5d1b30d28c98ba70262ced.result: Climate attributes (snow fraction, aridity, precipitation seasonality, mean precipitation) dominate; catchment attribute influence varies with process and climate; processes are predictable in ungauged catchments (R2 0.45–0.9).
f203ab4215201fc7df5d1b30d28c98ba70262ced.open_work: Incorporating flood processes in climate change impact studies on floods.
f203ab4215201fc7df5d1b30d28c98ba70262ced.issues: Flood process classification is itself rule-based and uncertain; results are limited to US catchments and correlational.

74273f069b96470222e610c119c1c205a8907425.goal: Forecasts monthly rainfall over India with deep learning sequence models to support water resources planning.
74273f069b96470222e610c119c1c205a8907425.architecture: Recurrent neural network (RNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) models applied to raw monthly series.
74273f069b96470222e610c119c1c205a8907425.data: All-India monthly average precipitation 1871–2016, tested on homogeneous rainfall regions of India.
74273f069b96470222e610c119c1c205a8907425.result: Both RNN and LSTM perform well across homogeneous regions using raw data.
74273f069b96470222e610c119c1c205a8907425.open_work: Adding climate drivers such as ENSO and IOD indices and longer lead times.
74273f069b96470222e610c119c1c205a8907425.issues: No quantitative scores or baselines (e.g. climatology, SARIMA) in the abstract; monthly rainfall skill largely reflects the seasonal cycle.

323b2a8e8d3b6c52ab6a4bd7148b78cb9ed9e7b9.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in an arid region of southern Iraq.
323b2a8e8d3b6c52ab6a4bd7148b78cb9ed9e7b9.architecture: Ensemble machine learning classifiers compared, as stated in the title; specific algorithms are not specified in the available record.
323b2a8e8d3b6c52ab6a4bd7148b78cb9ed9e7b9.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors for a region of southern Iraq; details are not reported here (no abstract available).
323b2a8e8d3b6c52ab6a4bd7148b78cb9ed9e7b9.open_work: Validation with independent flood events and extension to other arid basins.
323b2a8e8d3b6c52ab6a4bd7148b78cb9ed9e7b9.issues: No abstract available; static susceptibility mapping with typical risks of spatially autocorrelated train/test splits.

1a21070fde6d4e389aa4f810d80abbc8a2a70134.goal: Reviews machine learning for wind power prediction to guide reliable integration of wind energy into power systems.
1a21070fde6d4e389aa4f810d80abbc8a2a70134.architecture: Review of CNNs, LSTMs, ensemble learning such as XGBoost, and emerging transformers, plus data preprocessing, feature selection and model optimization.
1a21070fde6d4e389aa4f810d80abbc8a2a70134.data: Literature review; no new data. Discusses SCADA, meteorological and numerical weather prediction inputs used in the literature.
1a21070fde6d4e389aa4f810d80abbc8a2a70134.result: Machine learning, especially deep learning and ensembles, handles nonlinearity of wind power data better than physical and statistical models; data acquisition, complex terrain and sensor quality remain challenges.
1a21070fde6d4e389aa4f810d80abbc8a2a70134.open_work: Multi-model fusion, transformer-based models, and smart sensors and IoT for automated prediction systems.
1a21070fde6d4e389aa4f810d80abbc8a2a70134.issues: Review methodology and coverage criteria are not stated; quantitative comparison across studies is limited.

3d5b8b815571e805e321102d95b317635ea4155c.goal: Predicts discharge and maps flood zones in the Kan River Basin, Tehran province, Iran.
3d5b8b815571e805e321102d95b317635ea4155c.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) with 7 inputs and hidden layers of 8 and 16 neurons, integrated with GIS spatial analysis.
3d5b8b815571e805e321102d95b317635ea4155c.data: Slope, curvature, flow accumulation, NDVI, geology, soil type and rainfall from hydrometric and rain-gauge stations, satellite images and thematic layers.
3d5b8b815571e805e321102d95b317635ea4155c.result: The ANN reaches R2 0.82, RMSE 0.18 and MAE 0.13 for discharge prediction and supports flood zonation mapping.
3d5b8b815571e805e321102d95b317635ea4155c.open_work: Use for local environmental planning and risk management, and testing in other basins.
3d5b8b815571e805e321102d95b317635ea4155c.issues: Few stations to train a spatial model; static predictors; limited independent validation of the flood map.

3aa980c8354d0a64bdaabf4302310a5903741866.goal: Reviews machine learning applications in runoff modelling to consolidate progress in hydrological simulation.
3aa980c8354d0a64bdaabf4302310a5903741866.architecture: Review of rainfall-runoff, streamflow and flood modelling with ANFIS, ANN, SVM and integrated (hybrid) machine learning methods.
3aa980c8354d0a64bdaabf4302310a5903741866.result: Summarizes advantages and disadvantages of three widely used ML models for runoff simulation.
3aa980c8354d0a64bdaabf4302310a5903741866.open_work: Wider coverage of deep learning and hybrid physics-ML runoff models.
3aa980c8354d0a64bdaabf4302310a5903741866.issues: Focus on classical models (ANFIS, ANN, SVM) and limited discussion of LSTM-era and large-sample hydrology.

c2e00741fc9f6297935dd3dbfa6519fd2d52a8dd.goal: Improves flood susceptibility mapping with a deep learning hybrid model.
c2e00741fc9f6297935dd3dbfa6519fd2d52a8dd.architecture: Hybrid autoencoder and multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network, compared with a standard MLP.
c2e00741fc9f6297935dd3dbfa6519fd2d52a8dd.data: Flood inventories with nine and twelve conditioning factors for two study areas in Iran and India, from remote sensing and GIS.
c2e00741fc9f6297935dd3dbfa6519fd2d52a8dd.result: Autoencoder-MLP outperforms MLP, with testing AUROC of 91% vs 60% (Iran) and 97% vs 81% (India).
c2e00741fc9f6297935dd3dbfa6519fd2d52a8dd.open_work: Application to other regions and comparison with other deep learning and ensemble models.
c2e00741fc9f6297935dd3dbfa6519fd2d52a8dd.issues: Static susceptibility only; weak MLP baseline; possible spatial autocorrelation between training and testing samples.

8b1fbe955834d8d33bd68e7e3c2bed2af526d818.goal: Maps irrigated cropland across the conterminous US at 30 m resolution where nationwide training data are lacking.
8b1fbe955834d8d33bd68e7e3c2bed2af526d818.architecture: Ecoregion-stratified random forest classifiers trained with samples from a semi-automatic training pool built by thresholding Landsat greenness indices, run on Google Earth Engine.
8b1fbe955834d8d33bd68e7e3c2bed2af526d818.data: Landsat-derived annual maximum greenness and EVI, remote sensing features and climate variables for 2012; an existing coarse-resolution irrigation map for threshold calibration; visually collected samples in the upper Midwest.
8b1fbe955834d8d33bd68e7e3c2bed2af526d818.result: The LANID 2012 map identifies 23.3 million ha of irrigated cropland, with mean Kappa 0.88, overall accuracy 94% and irrigation-class producer's and user's accuracy of 97.3% and 90.5%.
8b1fbe955834d8d33bd68e7e3c2bed2af526d818.open_work: Producing annual irrigation maps and studying field-level spatial and temporal irrigation dynamics.
8b1fbe955834d8d33bd68e7e3c2bed2af526d818.issues: Training labels derive from thresholds and an existing map, so errors can propagate; humid eastern states with supplemental irrigation are harder to map.

cef665d496b526fb860c852820874e057a527eb0.goal: Estimates daily global solar radiation at stations for solar energy deployment.
cef665d496b526fb860c852820874e057a527eb0.architecture: Functional deep belief network (DBN) with embedding clustering that groups days by radiation curve shape, and empirical radiation model outputs as inputs.
cef665d496b526fb860c852820874e057a527eb0.data: Radiation data from 30 stations in China.
cef665d496b526fb860c852820874e057a527eb0.result: Average MAE 1.706 MJ/m2, RMSE 2.352 MJ/m2 and MAPE 13.71% across the 30 stations, improved by including empirical knowledge.
cef665d496b526fb860c852820874e057a527eb0.open_work: Applying to regions with sparser stations and to sub-daily estimation.
cef665d496b526fb860c852820874e057a527eb0.issues: Station-based study in one country; comparison against satellite-derived radiation products is not reported.

850795e562dc86a2a9176b52d048f59da4b649c6.goal: Predicts runoff at 1-, 3- and 6-month lead times with a reliable data-driven model for hydrological decision support.
850795e562dc86a2a9176b52d048f59da4b649c6.architecture: Two-phase hybrid CVEE-ELM: CEEMDAN decomposition with secondary VMD decomposition of the highest-frequency mode, each component modelled by an extreme learning machine.
850795e562dc86a2a9176b52d048f59da4b649c6.data: Monthly runoff and predictor series for the Yingluoxia watershed, northwestern China; benchmarked against single-phase hybrid ELM and ARIMA.
850795e562dc86a2a9176b52d048f59da4b649c6.result: The two-phase hybrid gives the best accuracy at all lead times, with skill highest at 1 month and lower at 3 and 6 months.
850795e562dc86a2a9176b52d048f59da4b649c6.open_work: Use in real-life decision systems and other stochastic hydrological forecasting problems.
850795e562dc86a2a9176b52d048f59da4b649c6.issues: Single watershed; decomposition of full series may leak future information; no uncertainty quantification.

52412a195e700ddd7634c4d703d0d07ed642c0fb.goal: Predicts streamflow by combining artificial intelligence models with time-series decomposition.
52412a195e700ddd7634c4d703d0d07ed642c0fb.architecture: AI models coupled with singular spectrum analysis and seasonal-trend decomposition using Loess (STL); the specific model types are not specified in the available record.
52412a195e700ddd7634c4d703d0d07ed642c0fb.data: Streamflow time series; the basin and period are not reported here (no abstract available).
52412a195e700ddd7634c4d703d0d07ed642c0fb.open_work: Testing across multiple basins and lead times and in real-time operation.
52412a195e700ddd7634c4d703d0d07ed642c0fb.issues: No abstract available; decomposition-based forecasting is prone to information leakage when the full series is decomposed.

e1ba798d4b5fb5354ef8123295e8006b3d43d8a0.goal: Forecasts solar radiation using a decomposition-clustering-ensemble learning framework.
e1ba798d4b5fb5354ef8123295e8006b3d43d8a0.architecture: Decomposition-clustering-ensemble approach: the series is decomposed, components are clustered, and an ensemble of learners forecasts them; the specific learner types are not specified in the available record.
e1ba798d4b5fb5354ef8123295e8006b3d43d8a0.data: Solar radiation time series; sites and period are not reported here (no abstract available).
e1ba798d4b5fb5354ef8123295e8006b3d43d8a0.open_work: Multi-site evaluation, probabilistic forecasting and comparison with deep sequence models.
e1ba798d4b5fb5354ef8123295e8006b3d43d8a0.issues: No abstract available; decomposition-based hybrids risk leakage and are hard to deploy operationally.

72203136db92d74fa205496396c5c954308e7e4d.goal: Predicts daily lake surface water temperature from air temperature, testing whether machine learning models can beat the physically based air2stream/Air2Water model for lake management.
72203136db92d74fa205496396c5c954308e7e4d.architecture: Comparison of extremely randomized trees, random forest, MARS, M5 model tree and a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network against the semi-physical air2stream model, using air temperature and calendar components as inputs.
72203136db92d74fa205496396c5c954308e7e4d.data: Daily air and water temperature records from 25 lakes in northern Poland.
72203136db92d74fa205496396c5c954308e7e4d.result: Air2stream outperforms all machine learning models at all 25 lakes; none of ERT, MARS, M5Tree, RF or MLPNN improves on it in RMSE, MAE, R or NSE.
72203136db92d74fa205496396c5c954308e7e4d.open_work: Adding further predictors (e.g. radiation, wind, lake morphometry) or hybridizing ML with the physical model to correct its residuals.
72203136db92d74fa205496396c5c954308e7e4d.issues: Inputs restricted to air temperature and date; the negative result may reflect limited predictors rather than ML capacity; single region.

07885a0bd1f573e9671754206e48db2ede441ec7.goal: Forecasts gridded spatiotemporal weather fields with a fully convolutional sequence-to-sequence model that respects temporal order and allows different input and output lengths.
07885a0bd1f573e9671754206e48db2ede441ec7.architecture: STConvS2S, a convolutional neural network (CNN) sequence-to-sequence architecture using only convolutional layers with causal temporal convolutions, compared with RNN-based ConvLSTM-type baselines.
07885a0bd1f573e9671754206e48db2ede441ec7.data: Gridded air temperature and rainfall datasets over South America.
07885a0bd1f573e9671754206e48db2ede441ec7.result: Matches or outperforms state-of-the-art architectures; one variant is 23% better at predicting future sequences and five times faster to train than the RNN baseline.
07885a0bd1f573e9671754206e48db2ede441ec7.open_work: Longer lead times, more variables, and probabilistic or physics-informed extensions of the convolutional sequence model.
07885a0bd1f573e9671754206e48db2ede441ec7.issues: Deterministic forecasts that may smooth fine detail; regional evaluation on two variables; skill relative to operational NWP not assessed.

e6445c03ff09a68932ccc900fc3c690478b033c9.goal: Downscales GRACE-derived total water storage and groundwater storage from 1° to 0.25° to make satellite gravimetry useful for regional water management.
e6445c03ff09a68932ccc900fc3c690478b033c9.architecture: Random forest regression relating GRACE water storage to six hydrological variables (precipitation, evapotranspiration, runoff, soil moisture, snow water equivalent, canopy water) applied at finer resolution.
e6445c03ff09a68932ccc900fc3c690478b033c9.data: GRACE total water storage anomalies plus gridded hydrological model/land surface variables; validation against groundwater observation wells in the study area (region not named in the abstract).
e6445c03ff09a68932ccc900fc3c690478b033c9.result: Downscaled groundwater storage correlates with well observations at 0.78 (monthly) and 0.94 (annual), significant at the 0.01 level, and shows finer spatial detail.
e6445c03ff09a68932ccc900fc3c690478b033c9.open_work: Testing in other aquifers, adding human water use variables, and quantifying uncertainty of the downscaled product.
e6445c03ff09a68932ccc900fc3c690478b033c9.issues: Assumes the coarse-scale statistical relationship holds at 0.25°; inherits errors of the hydrological input products; validation limited to available wells.

d2e5b466d7a60ef0a91d1e732543ef8c793b5324.goal: Predicts power and energy output of a hybrid PV-wind system from weather factors to support smart grid operation.
d2e5b466d7a60ef0a91d1e732543ef8c793b5324.architecture: Comparison of machine learning regressors including artificial neural network (MLP) regressors and linear regression, with recursive feature elimination with cross-validation (RFECV) for feature selection.
d2e5b466d7a60ef0a91d1e732543ef8c793b5324.data: Historic hourly data with seven weather factors and hybrid PV-wind output; site not specified in the abstract.
d2e5b466d7a60ef0a91d1e732543ef8c793b5324.result: Linear regression with feature selection performs best: MSE 1.04e-7, MAE 0.00083, R2 99.6%, computation time 0.02 s.
d2e5b466d7a60ef0a91d1e732543ef8c793b5324.open_work: Testing on independent sites and forecast horizons using forecast rather than observed weather inputs.
d2e5b466d7a60ef0a91d1e732543ef8c793b5324.issues: Near-perfect scores suggest an easy or possibly leaky setup (normalized, same-time inputs); no multi-step forecast horizon or independent site validation.

6ab17cf2ba7499fe8b38992f228049b67534938d.goal: Maps groundwater spring potential to support water resources management in a water-scarce region.
6ab17cf2ba7499fe8b38992f228049b67534938d.architecture: Naive Bayes, support vector machine and random forest classifiers, with a genetic algorithm for feature selection and frequency ratio weighting of conditioning factors.
6ab17cf2ba7499fe8b38992f228049b67534938d.data: Groundwater spring inventory and sixteen conditioning factors (lithology, land use, NDVI, terrain indices, rainfall, distances to rivers and roads) for Wuqi County, Shaanxi, China.
6ab17cf2ba7499fe8b38992f228049b67534938d.result: GA-optimized models outperform originals; optimized random forest reaches AUROC 0.9572, SVM 0.9529 and naive Bayes 0.8235, using twelve selected factors.
6ab17cf2ba7499fe8b38992f228049b67534938d.open_work: Transferring the feature-selection framework to other regions and hazards, and testing other optimizers.
6ab17cf2ba7499fe8b38992f228049b67534938d.issues: Single county; susceptibility maps validated only by AUC on spring points; spatial autocorrelation between training and test points may inflate scores.

72986e23168642de9a2df9abd61b7aaec218d5d8.goal: Predicts smallholder maize yield by integrating satellite-derived climatic and vegetation indices with deep learning, addressing yield estimation in fragmented smallholder farming.
72986e23168642de9a2df9abd61b7aaec218d5d8.architecture: Deep learning model, as stated in the title; the specific network type is not specified in the available information.
72986e23168642de9a2df9abd61b7aaec218d5d8.data: Satellite-derived climate variables and vegetation indices with maize yield records; regions and products not reported here.
72986e23168642de9a2df9abd61b7aaec218d5d8.result: Not reported in the available information; the title implies deep learning with combined climatic and vegetation inputs predicts smallholder maize yield usefully.
72986e23168642de9a2df9abd61b7aaec218d5d8.open_work: Within-season forecasting, transfer to other smallholder regions and crops, and finer field-scale inputs.
72986e23168642de9a2df9abd61b7aaec218d5d8.issues: Abstract not available; smallholder yields are noisy and fields are small relative to satellite pixels, so mixed-pixel effects and limited labels are likely constraints.

1d997d5989a0d8a6e69e337670a2402958ac48a6.goal: Improves both the accuracy and stability of wind speed forecasts for wind power integration.
1d997d5989a0d8a6e69e337670a2402958ac48a6.architecture: Hybrid system combining a new hybrid data-preprocessing (decomposition/denoising) strategy with an Elman recurrent neural network tuned by a multi-objective satin bowerbird optimizer.
1d997d5989a0d8a6e69e337670a2402958ac48a6.data: Eight wind speed datasets; sites not specified in the abstract.
1d997d5989a0d8a6e69e337670a2402958ac48a6.result: The hybrid system outperforms benchmark models in forecasting accuracy and stability; specific error values are not reported in the abstract.
1d997d5989a0d8a6e69e337670a2402958ac48a6.open_work: Extending to multi-step and probabilistic forecasts and to wind power rather than speed.
1d997d5989a0d8a6e69e337670a2402958ac48a6.issues: Complex multi-stage pipeline; decomposition-based preprocessing can leak future information if applied to the whole series; single-site point forecasts only.

bbb6d1af56ed986ceb9fc671c78f35cbe34d8619.goal: Predicts wind power for safe dispatch of grids with large wind integration by combining statistical and machine learning models.
bbb6d1af56ed986ceb9fc671c78f35cbe34d8619.architecture: Hybrid of ARMA and a support vector machine (SVM) tuned by particle swarm optimization, weighted by covariance minimization, applied to clusters of time series (C-PSO-SVM-ARMA).
bbb6d1af56ed986ceb9fc671c78f35cbe34d8619.data: Historical wind power, wind speed and temperature data; wind farm not specified in the abstract.
bbb6d1af56ed986ceb9fc671c78f35cbe34d8619.result: The clustered hybrid model gives better wind power prediction with computational efficiency and satisfying precision than individual models; numbers not reported in the abstract.
bbb6d1af56ed986ceb9fc671c78f35cbe34d8619.open_work: Longer horizons, probabilistic outputs and testing at multiple wind farms.
bbb6d1af56ed986ceb9fc671c78f35cbe34d8619.issues: Single case study; no quantitative gains in the abstract; no NWP inputs, limiting skill beyond very short horizons.

c6efe635929a3afa61efaf04b3f9dc4b77af417b.goal: Forecasts daily river runoff by decomposing the flow series into modes before learning, aiming to handle nonstationarity.
c6efe635929a3afa61efaf04b3f9dc4b77af417b.architecture: Hybrid of variational mode decomposition (VMD) with a deep neural network, as stated in the title; network details are not specified in the available information.
c6efe635929a3afa61efaf04b3f9dc4b77af417b.data: Daily runoff records from a river basin; the station and period are not reported here.
c6efe635929a3afa61efaf04b3f9dc4b77af417b.result: Not reported in the available information; the title implies the VMD-deep neural network hybrid improves daily runoff forecasts over undecomposed models.
c6efe635929a3afa61efaf04b3f9dc4b77af417b.open_work: Multi-step forecasting, adding meteorological inputs and testing in other basins.
c6efe635929a3afa61efaf04b3f9dc4b77af417b.issues: Abstract not available; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if the full series is decomposed before splitting.

44e4b163194460a016352c34060d7445baa7619b.goal: Predicts monthly groundwater levels in Bengaluru, a rapidly urbanizing Indian city, and assesses the roles of climate and population growth.
44e4b163194460a016352c34060d7445baa7619b.architecture: Ensemble framework using singular spectrum analysis, mutual information and genetic algorithm input selection feeding an artificial neural network (MLP) and support vector machine.
44e4b163194460a016352c34060d7445baa7619b.data: Groundwater levels from monitored wells in Bengaluru, rainfall, temperature, climate indices (NOI, SOI, NINO3) and monthly population growth rate.
44e4b163194460a016352c34060d7445baa7619b.result: Predictions are accurate (R > 85%); preprocessing improves results for 66% of wells; population growth is linked to declining groundwater levels.
44e4b163194460a016352c34060d7445baa7619b.open_work: Applying to other cities and including pumping and leakage data when available.
44e4b163194460a016352c34060d7445baa7619b.issues: Single city; monthly resolution; population growth as a proxy for abstraction; no uncertainty quantification.

271104ec6dad8cd4260b958c30a02f87cc997814.goal: Improves snow depth retrieval from passive microwave remote sensing, which has large uncertainties with traditional algorithms.
271104ec6dad8cd4260b958c30a02f87cc997814.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) models stratified by three snow cover stages and four land cover types (twelve models), compared with Chang, Spectral Polarization Difference, ANN and linear regression algorithms.
271104ec6dad8cd4260b958c30a02f87cc997814.data: Passive microwave brightness temperatures, location, elevation and land cover, trained and validated against daily snow depth from 1223 stations across Eurasia.
271104ec6dad8cd4260b958c30a02f87cc997814.result: The SVR algorithm outperforms the four alternatives with reduced uncertainty, detects deep snow with high accuracy and reduces saturation effects; numbers not reported in the abstract.
271104ec6dad8cd4260b958c30a02f87cc997814.open_work: Extending to snow water equivalent at larger scales and incorporating grain size and snow density explicitly.
271104ec6dad8cd4260b958c30a02f87cc997814.issues: Station-based validation unevenly distributed; accuracy depends on land cover and snow stage partitioning; preliminary results by the authors' description.

4259a541dae3921483b486a691af48ac0678453b.goal: Bridges the GRACE/GRACE-FO data gap (2017-2018) and reconstructs total water storage change back to 1992 using climate inputs.
4259a541dae3921483b486a691af48ac0678453b.architecture: Comparison of multiple linear regression, artificial neural network (MLP) and autoregressive exogenous (ARX) models, combined with statistical decomposition, plus new robustness metrics.
4259a541dae3921483b486a691af48ac0678453b.data: GRACE gridded total water storage change at 1° with climate inputs, for 26 regions worldwide; hydrological model simulations as reference.
4259a541dae3921483b486a691af48ac0678453b.result: Predicted TWSC correlates more than 0.3 better with observations than hydrological models; reconstructions reproduce ENSO signals; MLR is the most robust despite not best fitting.
4259a541dae3921483b486a691af48ac0678453b.open_work: Global gap-filling and longer reconstructions, and combining data-driven predictions with hydrological models.
4259a541dae3921483b486a691af48ac0678453b.issues: Robustness favors simpler models, suggesting ANNs overfit the short GRACE record; trends from human water use are not captured by climate inputs.

269824433e91bf2266ac0614e023781e71a5ea85.goal: Models reference evapotranspiration across multiple climates and tests whether ensembles of AI and empirical models improve accuracy.
269824433e91bf2266ac0614e023781e71a5ea85.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP), ANFIS and support vector regression versus empirical (Hargreaves-Samani, Makkink, Ritchie) and multilinear regression models, combined by simple, weighted and neural ensembles.
269824433e91bf2266ac0614e023781e71a5ea85.data: Twelve monthly climate parameters at fourteen stations in Turkey, Cyprus, Iraq, Iran and Libya; targets derived from pan evaporation.
269824433e91bf2266ac0614e023781e71a5ea85.result: AI models beat empirical and MLR models; ensembles raise verification performance by up to 22% (AI) and 55% (empirical); dominant inputs are pan evaporation, radiation, temperature and pressure.
269824433e91bf2266ac0614e023781e71a5ea85.open_work: Daily-scale modelling and transfer to stations without pan data.
269824433e91bf2266ac0614e023781e71a5ea85.issues: Pan-derived ET0 targets carry pan-coefficient uncertainty; monthly data; using pan evaporation as an input to predict pan-derived ET0 is partly circular.

bfba15e152b2e43f2360e68106077228f7f0f217.goal: Rapidly segments flooded buildings after disasters from satellite imagery to support first responders and damage assessment.
bfba15e152b2e43f2360e68106077228f7f0f217.architecture: Multi3Net, a multi-stream encoder-decoder convolutional neural network (CNN) fusing multiresolution, multisensor and multitemporal imagery into a segmentation map.
bfba15e152b2e43f2360e68106077228f7f0f217.data: Medium-resolution multitemporal satellite imagery (Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2) and very high-resolution imagery of disaster sites (Hurricane Harvey, Houston); released as an open labeled dataset.
bfba15e152b2e43f2360e68106077228f7f0f217.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art building footprint segmentation and alternative fusion methods; achieves accurate flooded-building maps using only public medium-resolution data.
bfba15e152b2e43f2360e68106077228f7f0f217.open_work: Generalizing to other flood events and regions and to other damage types.
bfba15e152b2e43f2360e68106077228f7f0f217.issues: Evaluated on a single disaster event; label quality and transfer to different urban morphologies are untested.

6bcee583aad8ff53528f702701ab925a559d219c.goal: Assesses flood susceptibility with random naive Bayes and tests sensitivity to how continuous factors are discretized.
6bcee583aad8ff53528f702701ab925a559d219c.architecture: Random naive Bayes (naive Bayes within a random forest structure) with repeated random sampling of negative samples, compared with random forest and naive Bayes, in a GIS framework.
6bcee583aad8ff53528f702701ab925a559d219c.data: Flood inventory and 12 spatial conditioning factors for Wanan County, China; factors discretized by natural breaks and quantiles.
6bcee583aad8ff53528f702701ab925a559d219c.result: Maps from different discretizations are similar; classification ranks RF > RNB > NB, so RNB improves on NB but not on RF.
6bcee583aad8ff53528f702701ab925a559d219c.open_work: Testing in other regions and hazards and alternative ensemble structures for naive Bayes.
6bcee583aad8ff53528f702701ab925a559d219c.issues: Single county; RNB underperforms random forest; susceptibility rather than flood forecasting; validation on inventory points only.

0e30b28e915417942de8705b5119df0bc76b56a5.goal: Estimates daily global solar radiation at sites without radiation sensors for solar energy planning.
0e30b28e915417942de8705b5119df0bc76b56a5.architecture: Comparison of a GMDH-type neural network, multilayer feed-forward neural network (MLP), ANFIS and ANFIS optimized with PSO, genetic algorithm and ant colony optimization.
0e30b28e915417942de8705b5119df0bc76b56a5.data: Meteorological and geographic inputs (temperatures, pressure, humidity, wind, top-of-atmosphere insolation, latitude, longitude) from 12 stations in different climate zones of Iran.
0e30b28e915417942de8705b5119df0bc76b56a5.result: GMDH performs best with RMSE 0.2466 kWh/m2/day, R2 0.9886 and MSE 0.0608.
0e30b28e915417942de8705b5119df0bc76b56a5.open_work: Testing spatial generalization to unseen stations and adding satellite cloud information.
0e30b28e915417942de8705b5119df0bc76b56a5.issues: Station-based study in one country; unclear whether test stations were independent; no comparison to satellite radiation products.

e8b08b753f33b401c3d5ce2e482e44e45722a556.goal: Forecasts NO2 and SO2 emitted by a combined cycle power plant to support air pollution management.
e8b08b753f33b401c3d5ce2e482e44e45722a556.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network whose parameters are tuned by the multi-verse optimization algorithm, compared with ENN-PSO, ENN-MVO and LSTM-PSO hybrids.
e8b08b753f33b401c3d5ce2e482e44e45722a556.data: Wind speed, air temperature, NO2 and SO2 at 3-hour steps from a combined cycle power plant in Kerman, Iran, May-September 2019.
e8b08b753f33b401c3d5ce2e482e44e45722a556.result: LSTM-MVO yields higher accuracy than the benchmark hybrids for both input configurations; numbers not reported in the abstract.
e8b08b753f33b401c3d5ce2e482e44e45722a556.open_work: Longer records spanning all seasons and more sites and pollutants.
e8b08b753f33b401c3d5ce2e482e44e45722a556.issues: Only five months of data from one plant; small dataset for an LSTM; seasonal generalization untested.

545d37aa324f90d4957eba8208b1cebfafc11524.goal: Models rainfall at multiple stations with hybrid data-intelligence algorithms to improve rainfall prediction for water resources management.
545d37aa324f90d4957eba8208b1cebfafc11524.architecture: Hybrid data-intelligence models combining machine learning with optimization algorithms, per the title; the specific model types are not specified in the available information.
545d37aa324f90d4957eba8208b1cebfafc11524.data: Multi-station rainfall records; the study region and period are not reported here.
545d37aa324f90d4957eba8208b1cebfafc11524.result: Not reported in the available information; the title implies hybrid models perform well for multi-station rainfall modelling.
545d37aa324f90d4957eba8208b1cebfafc11524.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates and adding large-scale climate predictors.
545d37aa324f90d4957eba8208b1cebfafc11524.issues: Abstract not available; rainfall is intermittent and skewed, and station-based hybrid ML studies often lack independent temporal or spatial validation.

a91405995d49ba866907aa33a2dc69319a29b74a.goal: Maps groundwater potential in a semi-arid Iranian basin to support sustainable groundwater management.
a91405995d49ba866907aa33a2dc69319a29b74a.architecture: Hybrid ensembles combining random subspace with a multilayer perceptron (MLP), naive Bayes tree and classification and regression tree (CART).
a91405995d49ba866907aa33a2dc69319a29b74a.data: 205 spring locations (70:30 split) and fourteen groundwater conditioning factors for the Tabriz River basin (5397 km2), north-western Iran.
a91405995d49ba866907aa33a2dc69319a29b74a.result: All models achieve AUC > 0.8; MLP-RS performs best with validation AUC 0.935; slope, elevation, TRI and HAND are the most important predictors.
a91405995d49ba866907aa33a2dc69319a29b74a.open_work: Transfer to other basins and incorporating subsurface hydrogeological data.
a91405995d49ba866907aa33a2dc69319a29b74a.issues: Springs as a proxy for groundwater presence; single basin; random point split may overstate skill due to spatial autocorrelation.

09849ba41d5a32e0837f834293279877de0337ee.goal: Reconstructs monthly surface ocean pCO2 globally to estimate sea-air CO2 fluxes from sparse observations.
09849ba41d5a32e0837f834293279877de0337ee.architecture: LSCE-FFNN, a two-step feed-forward neural network (MLP): first reconstructing pCO2 climatology, then anomalies relative to it.
09849ba41d5a32e0837f834293279877de0337ee.data: SOCAT pCO2 observations and a gridded climatology as targets; SSS, SST, SSH, chlorophyll a, mixed layer depth and position as predictors; 1°x1° monthly, 2001-2016.
09849ba41d5a32e0837f834293279877de0337ee.result: Reconstructs global pCO2 with satisfying accuracy against independent SOCAT data and captures ENSO-driven equatorial Pacific variability; agrees with SOCOM methods on seasonal and interannual variability.
09849ba41d5a32e0837f834293279877de0337ee.open_work: Reducing regional uncertainty in poorly sampled regions and improving flux and trend estimates.
09849ba41d5a32e0837f834293279877de0337ee.issues: Larger errors in poorly observed regions (Indian Ocean, Southern Ocean, subpolar Pacific); regional differences with other methods remain large.

74ade60600518d285134c327c3806046b79d1c0f.goal: Improves radar echo extrapolation for precipitation nowcasting, reducing the blurring of ConvGRU predictions.
74ade60600518d285134c327c3806046b79d1c0f.architecture: GA-ConvGRU, a generative adversarial network (GAN) with a convolutional gated recurrent unit (ConvGRU) generator and a convolutional neural network discriminator.
74ade60600518d285134c327c3806046b79d1c0f.data: Real radar echo map datasets; sources not specified in the abstract.
74ade60600518d285134c327c3806046b79d1c0f.result: GA-ConvGRU significantly outperforms ConvGRU and optical flow extrapolation, producing more realistic and accurate predictions.
74ade60600518d285134c327c3806046b79d1c0f.open_work: Longer lead times, ensemble or probabilistic outputs and operational testing.
74ade60600518d285134c327c3806046b79d1c0f.issues: Datasets and scores not detailed in the abstract; GAN training instability; deterministic single realization.

58fc9261533e8e212ed2668c355ea8c75a08ebc2.goal: Forecasts daily air quality index while correcting outliers and avoiding random model initialization.
58fc9261533e8e212ed2668c355ea8c75a08ebc2.architecture: Hybrid of outlier detection and correction, series decomposition preprocessing and an extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer neural network) optimized by a heuristic algorithm.
58fc9261533e8e212ed2668c355ea8c75a08ebc2.data: Daily air quality index time series; cities not specified in the abstract.
58fc9261533e8e212ed2668c355ea8c75a08ebc2.result: The hybrid model outperforms comparison models; specific values are not reported in the abstract.
58fc9261533e8e212ed2668c355ea8c75a08ebc2.open_work: Multi-step forecasting and inclusion of meteorological and emission predictors.
58fc9261533e8e212ed2668c355ea8c75a08ebc2.issues: Univariate approach without meteorology; no numbers in the abstract; possible leakage from decomposing the full series.

618cb17b8036e685b385f61a04eaf6c77ec5b731.goal: Reviews machine learning advances for forecasting harmful algal blooms and shellfish biotoxin contamination to support the shellfish industry.
618cb17b8036e685b385f61a04eaf6c77ec5b731.architecture: Review of statistical and machine learning forecasting methods: autoregressive models, support vector machines, random forest, probabilistic graphical models and artificial neural networks.
618cb17b8036e685b385f61a04eaf6c77ec5b731.data: Literature on HAB and shellfish contamination forecasting using multi-source environmental, oceanographic and monitoring data.
618cb17b8036e685b385f61a04eaf6c77ec5b731.result: Models have grown in complexity with more multi-source data, with artificial neural networks at the forefront of HAB forecasting.
618cb17b8036e685b385f61a04eaf6c77ec5b731.open_work: Defining ML strategies for operational harvest management and agency decision support.
618cb17b8036e685b385f61a04eaf6c77ec5b731.issues: Synoptic review rather than systematic meta-analysis; no quantitative comparison of methods across studies.

5eb698f6137aef662672a5c0560fde33b52ee6a3.goal: Classifies sea ice types in Sentinel-1 SAR imagery automatically for ice charting.
5eb698f6137aef662672a5c0560fde33b52ee6a3.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) classifier trained on expert ice charts, compared with a texture-feature random forest classifier.
5eb698f6137aef662672a5c0560fde33b52ee6a3.data: Sentinel-1 SAR scenes with reference ice charts from 2018 and 2020 for four classes: ice free, young ice, first-year ice and old ice.
5eb698f6137aef662672a5c0560fde33b52ee6a3.result: Accuracy is 90.5% (2018) and 91.6% (2020); young ice 85%/76% and first-year ice 86%/84%; outperforms random forest for every type and is faster and less noise-sensitive.
5eb698f6137aef662672a5c0560fde33b52ee6a3.open_work: More ice classes, multi-sensor fusion and pixel-level ice chart labels.
5eb698f6137aef662672a5c0560fde33b52ee6a3.issues: Ice chart labels are coarse polygons with human uncertainty; young ice remains harder to classify; regional coverage limited.

91f1bd1e807f7cdb2d9a61575b730b00e7ccdeb8.goal: Develops a low-cost IoT air pollution sensor node and calibrates it with machine learning for dense urban monitoring.
91f1bd1e807f7cdb2d9a61575b730b00e7ccdeb8.architecture: Hardware sensor node with LoRaWAN/Wi-Fi connectivity; calibration with multiple linear regression and an artificial neural network (MLP).
91f1bd1e807f7cdb2d9a61575b730b00e7ccdeb8.data: Co-location of low-cost CO, NO2 and PM sensors with a reference CO sensor in the field.
91f1bd1e807f7cdb2d9a61575b730b00e7ccdeb8.result: MLR temperature-humidity correction gives MAPE 48.71% and R2 0.607; ANN calibration improves to MAPE 38.89% and R2 0.78 under leave-one-out cross-validation.
91f1bd1e807f7cdb2d9a61575b730b00e7ccdeb8.open_work: Longer deployments, calibration of other pollutants and network-scale validation.
91f1bd1e807f7cdb2d9a61575b730b00e7ccdeb8.issues: Calibration errors remain large; validated only for CO against one reference; sensor drift over time untested.

8a923538a58f50b755365c51ccfcb7d71aed5b4f.goal: Explores the potential of machine learning for climate change risk assessment, covering hazards, exposure and vulnerability.
8a923538a58f50b755365c51ccfcb7d71aed5b4f.architecture: Review of machine learning methods applied in climate change risk assessment studies.
8a923538a58f50b755365c51ccfcb7d71aed5b4f.data: Published literature on ML applications to climate-related hazards and risks; selection criteria not reported here.
8a923538a58f50b755365c51ccfcb7d71aed5b4f.result: Not reported in the available information; the title implies ML shows promise for climate change risk assessment.
8a923538a58f50b755365c51ccfcb7d71aed5b4f.open_work: Integrating multi-hazard and future climate scenarios into ML-based risk assessment.
8a923538a58f50b755365c51ccfcb7d71aed5b4f.issues: Abstract not available; reviews of this kind typically note limited interpretability, data scarcity and difficulty projecting under nonstationary future climate.

43a0b8e88a3936873f372a23be59ea07a58a817d.goal: Develops a fast quantitative precipitation estimation algorithm for the geostationary Himawari-8 satellite.
43a0b8e88a3936873f372a23be59ea07a58a817d.architecture: Random forest classification (rain/no-rain) and regression (rain rate) with sample balancing.
43a0b8e88a3936873f372a23be59ea07a58a817d.data: Himawari-8 multiband infrared brightness temperatures and GFS NWP fields as predictors; GPM precipitation as training target; summertime.
43a0b8e88a3936873f372a23be59ea07a58a817d.result: Rain area classification accuracy is 0.87; rain rate MAE 0.51 mm/h and RMSE 2.0 mm/h; total precipitable water and K-index rank highest; better over ocean than land.
43a0b8e88a3936873f372a23be59ea07a58a817d.open_work: Improving heavy rainfall estimation and extending beyond summer.
43a0b8e88a3936873f372a23be59ea07a58a817d.issues: Underestimates rain rate, especially heavy rain; trained on GPM so inherits its errors; lower detection over land.

e5bcb8d05eba6673985a787b1f023813d3536b1a.goal: Forecasts short-term (under 1 h) wind farm power where met-tower and NWP data are inadequate.
e5bcb8d05eba6673985a787b1f023813d3536b1a.architecture: Temporal convolutional network (TCN) with hyperparameters tuned by Taguchi orthogonal array design.
e5bcb8d05eba6673985a787b1f023813d3536b1a.data: Twelve months of data from a 130 MW utility-scale wind farm with 86 turbines.
e5bcb8d05eba6673985a787b1f023813d3536b1a.result: TCN power curves show consistent improvements over existing methods at all wind speeds; numbers not reported in the abstract.
e5bcb8d05eba6673985a787b1f023813d3536b1a.open_work: Longer horizons, probabilistic forecasts and testing at other farms.
e5bcb8d05eba6673985a787b1f023813d3536b1a.issues: Single wind farm and one year; no quantitative results in the abstract.

0cb72b0e72157213c0b9cbf3d1e2787b20175a95.goal: Models urban NO2 concentrations from traffic flow and meteorology, with separate models for low and high concentrations.
0cb72b0e72157213c0b9cbf3d1e2787b20175a95.architecture: Partition model of two random forest models for lower and upper concentrations, with an iteratively optimized boundary concentration.
0cb72b0e72157213c0b9cbf3d1e2787b20175a95.data: Traffic flow, meteorological data and NO2 measurements in Wroclaw, Poland, 2015-2017.
0cb72b0e72157213c0b9cbf3d1e2787b20175a95.result: Partition model reaches R2 0.82 versus 0.60 for a single random forest; traffic dominates both, with temperature and humidity nearly as important for high concentrations.
0cb72b0e72157213c0b9cbf3d1e2787b20175a95.open_work: Applying the partition approach to other pollutants and cities and to forecasting.
0cb72b0e72157213c0b9cbf3d1e2787b20175a95.issues: Single city and station network; diagnostic rather than predictive setup; boundary selected on the same data.

25f0b9c71d11bc57cbef9f43c88801e01926b48a.goal: Estimates surface ocean pCO2 from satellites in the Gulf of Mexico, where multiple processes complicate remote estimation.
25f0b9c71d11bc57cbef9f43c88801e01926b48a.architecture: Random forest based regression ensemble (RFRE), selected after comparing MLR, nonlinear regression, PCR, decision tree, SVM and multilayer perceptron neural network.
25f0b9c71d11bc57cbef9f43c88801e01926b48a.data: 16 years of cruise pCO2 measurements with MODIS-estimated SST, SSS, chlorophyll and Kd; independent cruise datasets; also applied to the Gulf of Maine.
25f0b9c71d11bc57cbef9f43c88801e01926b48a.result: RFRE gives RMSD 9.1 uatm and R2 0.95 for 145-550 uatm; independent tests yield RMSD up to about 10 uatm offshore and 25 uatm in coastal waters.
25f0b9c71d11bc57cbef9f43c88801e01926b48a.open_work: Applying to other regions once enough in situ pCO2 is available, as done for the Gulf of Maine.
25f0b9c71d11bc57cbef9f43c88801e01926b48a.issues: Requires local retraining; valid range 145-550 uatm; sensitive to satellite SST and SSS errors.

bdf90585ef138e265d1f595e6d17ee18ed36a1ca.goal: Reviews two decades of neurocomputing in surface water hydrology and hydraulics to guide method choice.
bdf90585ef138e265d1f595e6d17ee18ed36a1ca.architecture: Review of more than 800 papers on conventional neural networks and modern neurocomputing models.
bdf90585ef138e265d1f595e6d17ee18ed36a1ca.data: Literature on water levels, floods and risk, sediment transport, urban water demand, flow through hydro-structures and sewer hydraulics.
bdf90585ef138e265d1f595e6d17ee18ed36a1ca.result: Summarizes prevailing neurocomputing methods per subfield and their trends, providing a practical guideline for researchers.
bdf90585ef138e265d1f595e6d17ee18ed36a1ca.open_work: Future prospects for modern deep learning and hybrid approaches in hydrology and hydraulics.
bdf90585ef138e265d1f595e6d17ee18ed36a1ca.issues: Narrative review; no quantitative meta-analysis of performance across studies.

76155844f6242aa810c6f329081fe0e4db43b071.goal: Improves field-level predictions of agricultural N2O emissions, which process-based models predict poorly.
76155844f6242aa810c6f329081fe0e4db43b071.architecture: Machine learning model (type not specified in the abstract) coupled with a cropping systems model that simulates unmeasured soil nitrogen availability.
76155844f6242aa810c6f329081fe0e4db43b071.data: Six years of sub-daily automated chamber N2O fluxes (about 3000) and manual chamber fluxes (about 1100) in continuous corn in the US Midwest; an independent long-term test site.
76155844f6242aa810c6f329081fe0e4db43b071.result: Explains 65-89% of daily flux variance; at the independent site 38% alone and 51% when coupled with the crop model, two to three times better than process models.
76155844f6242aa810c6f329081fe0e4db43b071.open_work: Extending to more sites and crops for regional and global N2O inventories.
76155844f6242aa810c6f329081fe0e4db43b071.issues: Training data from a single crop system and region; transfer skill drops substantially at the independent site.

8e996b1350c1e21ef117dd328cfd703efc414424.goal: Forecasts Dongting Lake daily water levels and quantifies the Three Gorges Dam's influence on them.
8e996b1350c1e21ef117dd328cfd703efc414424.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network compared with a support vector machine, used counterfactually to simulate no-dam conditions.
8e996b1350c1e21ef117dd328cfd703efc414424.data: Seven daily input factors, 2003-2012 training and 2011-2013 testing, for Dongting Lake, China.
8e996b1350c1e21ef117dd328cfd703efc414424.result: LSTM is more accurate than SVM; the dam lowers lake levels in September-November during impoundment, raises them slightly in dry season and reduces flood peaks.
8e996b1350c1e21ef117dd328cfd703efc414424.open_work: Use for flood forecasting and reservoir regulation; longer records.
8e996b1350c1e21ef117dd328cfd703efc414424.issues: Counterfactual no-dam simulation extrapolates outside training conditions; overlapping train and test years.

92c8bcc71dc1691ce1af160c49257bf51b07d367.goal: Forecasts monthly rainfall with a hybrid of support vector regression and the firefly algorithm.
92c8bcc71dc1691ce1af160c49257bf51b07d367.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) with hyperparameters optimized by the firefly algorithm, per the title.
92c8bcc71dc1691ce1af160c49257bf51b07d367.data: Monthly rainfall records; stations and period are not reported here.
92c8bcc71dc1691ce1af160c49257bf51b07d367.result: Not reported in the available information; the title implies the SVR-firefly hybrid improves monthly rainfall forecasts over standalone models.
92c8bcc71dc1691ce1af160c49257bf51b07d367.open_work: Testing other stations and climates and adding climate indices as predictors.
92c8bcc71dc1691ce1af160c49257bf51b07d367.issues: Abstract not available; station-based monthly forecasting with limited samples risks overfitting.

c72316c3a420fa955c8dc978659b8fa33863920f.goal: Reviews image processing and machine learning technologies for flood management across prediction, detection, mapping, evacuation and relief.
c72316c3a420fa955c8dc978659b8fa33863920f.architecture: Review with a classification framework categorizing techniques and phases of flood management systems.
c72316c3a420fa955c8dc978659b8fa33863920f.data: Recent literature on remote sensing, machine learning, image processing and data analysis for floods.
c72316c3a420fa955c8dc978659b8fa33863920f.result: Finds a lack of hybrid image processing and ML models and limited ML use in post-disaster scenarios.
c72316c3a420fa955c8dc978659b8fa33863920f.open_work: Combining disaster management knowledge, image processing and ML across all flood management phases.
c72316c3a420fa955c8dc978659b8fa33863920f.issues: Narrative review; framework-based categorization without quantitative comparison.

da83e96e9568f4787571fa8e596844220d58aa1f.goal: Introduces machine learning applications in hydrology as an overview of methods and use cases, as implied by the title.
da83e96e9568f4787571fa8e596844220d58aa1f.architecture: Review/overview of machine learning methods applied in hydrology.
da83e96e9568f4787571fa8e596844220d58aa1f.data: Not reported in the available information.
da83e96e9568f4787571fa8e596844220d58aa1f.result: Not reported in the available information.
da83e96e9568f4787571fa8e596844220d58aa1f.open_work: Not reported in the available information; overviews typically point to physics-aware and interpretable ML.
da83e96e9568f4787571fa8e596844220d58aa1f.issues: Abstract and venue not available; scope and depth cannot be verified.

9c23ce8eb8dbde276c0e7b679b082b95ae67fe91.goal: Estimates end-of-season crop yield from climate, irrigation and soil water data to support farm management.
9c23ce8eb8dbde276c0e7b679b082b95ae67fe91.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM), gated recurrent unit (GRU) and their bidirectional variants, compared with a convolutional neural network, MLP and random forest.
9c23ce8eb8dbde276c0e7b679b082b95ae67fe91.data: Historical climate data, irrigation scheduling and soil water content for tomato and potato at a site in Portugal.
9c23ce8eb8dbde276c0e7b679b082b95ae67fe91.result: Bidirectional LSTM performs best with MSE 0.017-0.039 and R2 0.97-0.99; CNN is second best.
9c23ce8eb8dbde276c0e7b679b082b95ae67fe91.open_work: More sites and crops and in-season prediction.
9c23ce8eb8dbde276c0e7b679b082b95ae67fe91.issues: Single site with a small dataset; very high R2 may reflect limited variability; no independent years or locations.

eef1eccd6cf2530e81d1a33b18cb78ec01f5b187.goal: Projects the future water footprint of wheat and maize in the Nile Delta under climate change.
eef1eccd6cf2530e81d1a33b18cb78ec01f5b187.architecture: Deep neural network (MLP) predicting crop evapotranspiration and yield, driven by RCP scenario climate data.
eef1eccd6cf2530e81d1a33b18cb78ec01f5b187.data: Historical data 2006-2014 for calibration and 2015-2017 for validation; future climate 2022-2040 under RCP2.6, 4.5 and 8.5 for the Nile Delta, Egypt.
eef1eccd6cf2530e81d1a33b18cb78ec01f5b187.result: Crop ET prediction R2 0.92-0.97; yield errors within about +/-6%; projected precipitation changes reduce green water footprint of wheat, and eastern delta use could save 16.6-40.3% of blue water.
eef1eccd6cf2530e81d1a33b18cb78ec01f5b187.open_work: Optimizing water allocation across the delta and including more crops.
eef1eccd6cf2530e81d1a33b18cb78ec01f5b187.issues: Short training record; extrapolating a DNN to future climates is uncertain; some reported percentage changes are hard to interpret.

dbf4c2989d64ff74cd751d6a51e2e9fb4f7a6a9a.goal: Projects future drought over South Asia and its impact on crop yield loss risk.
dbf4c2989d64ff74cd751d6a51e2e9fb4f7a6a9a.architecture: Nonlinear ensemble of random forest and gradient boosting machine relating SPEI drought to simulated yield.
dbf4c2989d64ff74cd751d6a51e2e9fb4f7a6a9a.data: CMIP6 climate models for SPEI drought metrics; ISIMIP crop model yields for rice, wheat and maize over South Asia.
dbf4c2989d64ff74cd751d6a51e2e9fb4f7a6a9a.result: Ensemble beats standalone RF and GBM (R2 0.705-0.918); projected yield losses under extreme drought of 54.15% rice, 29.30% wheat and 50.66% maize.
dbf4c2989d64ff74cd751d6a51e2e9fb4f7a6a9a.open_work: Including adaptation and irrigation and observed yields.
dbf4c2989d64ff74cd751d6a51e2e9fb4f7a6a9a.issues: Learns from simulated crop model yields, inheriting ISIMIP and CMIP6 biases; drought is the only stressor considered.

78a88b66a1bb09ff7199ed8a6fbbc24601c74941.goal: Predicts daily groundwater level fluctuations in coastal karst aquifers of Apulia, southern Italy, under heavy exploitation.
78a88b66a1bb09ff7199ed8a6fbbc24601c74941.architecture: NARX recurrent neural network trained with Bayesian regularization (NARX-BR), with sensitivity tests on inputs, training algorithm and time delay.
78a88b66a1bb09ff7199ed8a6fbbc24601c74941.data: Daily groundwater levels from 76 monitored wells in Apulia with rainfall and evapotranspiration inputs.
78a88b66a1bb09ff7199ed8a6fbbc24601c74941.result: NARX-BR reliably predicts groundwater levels across wells in different hydrogeological structures at regional and sub-regional scales; numbers not reported in the abstract.
78a88b66a1bb09ff7199ed8a6fbbc24601c74941.open_work: Applying to other aquifers with management issues and longer horizons.
78a88b66a1bb09ff7199ed8a6fbbc24601c74941.issues: No pumping data; one-step daily prediction using past levels may be easy; no quantitative scores in the abstract.

92a506d57909649b41b608b7e9f3b8bd1ef95298.goal: Forecasts daily and monthly air temperature and relative humidity at a Malaysian station to support air quality management.
92a506d57909649b41b608b7e9f3b8bd1ef95298.architecture: Compares gradient boosting trees, random forest, linear regression and two artificial neural network types: an MLP and a radial basis function network.
92a506d57909649b41b608b7e9f3b8bd1ef95298.data: 24 years of daily station observations at Kuala Terengganu from the Malaysian Meteorological Department, with an unseen observational set for validation.
92a506d57909649b41b608b7e9f3b8bd1ef95298.result: The MLP gives the best daily skill (R 0.71 for temperature, 0.63 for humidity) and monthly temperature (R 0.85); the RBF network is best for monthly humidity (R 0.71).
92a506d57909649b41b608b7e9f3b8bd1ef95298.open_work: Extending to more stations and variables and adding exogenous predictors such as large-scale circulation indices would test generality.
92a506d57909649b41b608b7e9f3b8bd1ef95298.issues: Single station; correlations around 0.6–0.7 for daily values are modest, and the inputs and forecast lead time are not clearly described.

cad81bd2cdab26eb9d15657c3e968a8df7855bc1.goal: Compares data-driven models for monthly streamflow forecasting and examines how they behave under linear versus nonlinear streamflow conditions.
cad81bd2cdab26eb9d15657c3e968a8df7855bc1.architecture: Compares an artificial neural network (feed-forward MLP-type), a generalized regression neural network, least-squares support vector regression and k-nearest neighbor regression.
cad81bd2cdab26eb9d15657c3e968a8df7855bc1.data: Monthly streamflow records; the basin, stations and period are not reported here.
cad81bd2cdab26eb9d15657c3e968a8df7855bc1.result: Relative ranking of the four models under linear and nonlinear conditions; quantitative skill is not reported here.
cad81bd2cdab26eb9d15657c3e968a8df7855bc1.open_work: Testing on more basins and with additional climatic predictors would clarify when each method is preferable.
cad81bd2cdab26eb9d15657c3e968a8df7855bc1.issues: Abstract unavailable; results likely depend on a single case study and on hyperparameter choices, and uncertainty is not addressed.

0325fed12900621a462e0706021aafe4bb42de5e.goal: Assesses machine learning for deterministic and probabilistic intra-hour forecasts of global horizontal and direct normal irradiance for solar power.
0325fed12900621a462e0706021aafe4bb42de5e.architecture: Compares k-nearest neighbors and gradient boosting regression, producing point forecasts and prediction intervals, with features from irradiance history and sky images.
0325fed12900621a462e0706021aafe4bb42de5e.data: Pyranometer measurements of GHI and DNI and ground-based sky images at a single site.
0325fed12900621a462e0706021aafe4bb42de5e.result: RMSE skill over the reference of 8–24% for GHI and 10–30% for DNI, and CRPS skill of 42% and 62%; gradient boosting is best for point forecasts with sky-image features, kNN for probabilistic forecasts.
0325fed12900621a462e0706021aafe4bb42de5e.open_work: Testing other climates and sites and combining satellite information for longer horizons are natural extensions.
0325fed12900621a462e0706021aafe4bb42de5e.issues: Single-site evaluation; sky-image features are handcrafted and skill depends on local cloud regimes.

8c81e08b226de64ae4337a5a2e8aca3bf4449fae.goal: Quantifies how well observation-based reconstructions of air-sea CO2 flux capture spatiotemporal variability of the ocean carbon sink, given sparse pCO2 sampling.
8c81e08b226de64ae4337a5a2e8aca3bf4449fae.architecture: Large Ensemble Testbed: model pCO2 fields are subsampled like real observations and reconstructed with a neural network approach (SOM-FFN-type), then compared with the known truth.
8c81e08b226de64ae4337a5a2e8aca3bf4449fae.data: pCO2 fields from 25 members each of four Earth system model large ensembles, subsampled at real-world SOCAT observation locations.
8c81e08b226de64ae4337a5a2e8aca3bf4449fae.result: Fluxes are well reconstructed globally and in the Northern Hemisphere, but Southern Ocean decadal amplitude is overestimated by 31% (r = 0.54) and global decadal amplitude by 21%.
8c81e08b226de64ae4337a5a2e8aca3bf4449fae.open_work: More sampling in the Southern Ocean and testing other reconstruction methods in the testbed are needed to constrain decadal variability.
8c81e08b226de64ae4337a5a2e8aca3bf4449fae.issues: Testbed skill depends on how realistic the Earth system models' variability is; data sparsity remains the fundamental limit.

31619300836f22cbaed1c252253ce0f3b1b059ef.goal: Compares deep learning models for daily river streamflow forecasting in a basin affected by upstream dams and reservoirs.
31619300836f22cbaed1c252253ce0f3b1b059ef.architecture: Compares a feed-forward neural network, a CNN and four recurrent models: LSTM, GRU, stacked LSTM and bidirectional LSTM.
31619300836f22cbaed1c252253ce0f3b1b059ef.data: Observed discharge and water level at seven hydrological stations on three branches of the Red River system, northern Vietnam.
31619300836f22cbaed1c252253ce0f3b1b059ef.result: LSTM-based models clearly outperform FFNN and CNN; stacked and bidirectional LSTMs bring no gain over single-layer LSTM and GRU, which are sufficient and cheaper.
31619300836f22cbaed1c252253ce0f3b1b059ef.open_work: Adding rainfall and reservoir operation inputs and testing longer lead times would extend the study.
31619300836f22cbaed1c252253ce0f3b1b059ef.issues: Single basin and station-only inputs; reservoir regulation is implicit, and generalization to other basins is untested.

2d141b7b78dff2b6c21084bfe1a2b5716c36caab.goal: Identifies the weather drivers of recent crop yield failures in Germany to inform adaptation and risk models.
2d141b7b78dff2b6c21084bfe1a2b5716c36caab.architecture: Combines machine learning analysis of weather predictors of yield with process-based crop modelling; the specific ML algorithm is not specified in the abstract.
2d141b7b78dff2b6c21084bfe1a2b5716c36caab.data: Yields of four major crops in Germany over about 20 years with weather data; dataset names are not reported in the abstract.
2d141b7b78dff2b6c21084bfe1a2b5716c36caab.result: Widespread failures coincide with severe drought (2018, less so 2003), but localized failures have no single weather driver, and large unexplained residuals point to management factors.
2d141b7b78dff2b6c21084bfe1a2b5716c36caab.open_work: Models should account for cumulative resource capture and extreme events, which process-based models largely miss.
2d141b7b78dff2b6c21084bfe1a2b5716c36caab.issues: Novel weather combinations under climate change may limit data-driven methods; non-weather factors are not observed.

feabaa6bb95605d7f2d951028478e90306490fac.goal: Improves ultra-short-term wind speed forecasting for wind power utilization.
feabaa6bb95605d7f2d951028478e90306490fac.architecture: Hybrid: wavelet transform decomposition, a deep belief network for feature extraction on each subseries, then LightGBM or random forest regression for the forecast.
feabaa6bb95605d7f2d951028478e90306490fac.data: Wind speed time series; the site and record length are not reported in the abstract.
feabaa6bb95605d7f2d951028478e90306490fac.result: Both hybrids beat persistence, Elman network, DBN, LightGBM and RF alone; the RF hybrid is slightly more accurate while the LightGBM hybrid is more stable.
feabaa6bb95605d7f2d951028478e90306490fac.open_work: Testing at more sites and multi-step horizons and adding probabilistic output are natural next steps.
feabaa6bb95605d7f2d951028478e90306490fac.issues: Wavelet decomposition of the full series can leak future information if not done causally; single-series evaluation.

5139efcf2b135277bf2527ffb7ced43e13ddb59f.goal: Develops a wind speed prediction strategy for centralized wind power control centers, using transfer learning to handle multiple farms.
5139efcf2b135277bf2527ffb7ced43e13ddb59f.architecture: Bidirectional LSTM combined with a MOOFADA multi-objective optimization algorithm and transfer learning, as named in the title.
5139efcf2b135277bf2527ffb7ced43e13ddb59f.data: Wind speed records from wind farms; the sites and period are not reported here.
5139efcf2b135277bf2527ffb7ced43e13ddb59f.result: Not reported in the abstract; the strategy is presented as improving prediction accuracy.
5139efcf2b135277bf2527ffb7ced43e13ddb59f.open_work: Assessing transfer across farms with different climates and adding probabilistic forecasts would be useful.
5139efcf2b135277bf2527ffb7ced43e13ddb59f.issues: Abstract unavailable; complex hybrid pipelines risk overfitting and the evaluation scope is unknown.

a2d3f4c1b68153406e2edc259d888295c5419a9d.goal: Evaluates whether machine learning with small data improves within-season national crop yield forecasts for food security early warning.
a2d3f4c1b68153406e2edc259d888295c5419a9d.architecture: Automated machine learning pipeline that selects features and models (several regression algorithms) and compares them with simple benchmark models.
a2d3f4c1b68153406e2edc259d888295c5419a9d.data: Climate records and remote sensing indicators with national yield statistics for barley, soft wheat and durum wheat in Algeria.
a2d3f4c1b68153406e2edc259d888295c5419a9d.result: Within-season errors of 0.16–0.2 t/ha (13–14% of mean yield); the best ML models beat benchmarks, including in low-yield years, but benchmarks beat up to 60% of tested ML models.
a2d3f4c1b68153406e2edc259d888295c5419a9d.open_work: Careful calibration and model selection are needed; extending to other countries and subnational yields is suggested.
a2d3f4c1b68153406e2edc259d888295c5419a9d.issues: Small sample of national yields limits training; gains over benchmarks are not always practically significant.

578450a6bd4890d47e9c67fdf71dfa45d93eaf15.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for wind energy by combining signal decomposition with an optimized learner.
578450a6bd4890d47e9c67fdf71dfa45d93eaf15.architecture: Hybrid: empirical wavelet transform decomposition, grey wolf optimizer, a regularized extreme learning machine (single-hidden-layer network) and inverse EWT reconstruction.
578450a6bd4890d47e9c67fdf71dfa45d93eaf15.data: Wind speed time series; the sites and sampling interval are not reported here.
578450a6bd4890d47e9c67fdf71dfa45d93eaf15.result: Not reported in the abstract; the hybrid is presented as outperforming its component and benchmark models.
578450a6bd4890d47e9c67fdf71dfa45d93eaf15.open_work: Probabilistic and multi-site extensions would broaden applicability.
578450a6bd4890d47e9c67fdf71dfa45d93eaf15.issues: Abstract unavailable; decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information if decomposition is not causal.

7f3078fcd59eb2f3361979e4357434e2ccd3490b.goal: Maps flood potential in the Trotuș river basin, Romania, to help authorities identify highly susceptible areas.
7f3078fcd59eb2f3361979e4357434e2ccd3490b.architecture: Six ensembles combining bivariate and multicriteria methods (AHP, certainty factor, weights of evidence) with gradient boosting trees or a multilayer perceptron (MLP).
7f3078fcd59eb2f3361979e4357434e2ccd3490b.data: 12 flood predictors with 172 flood and 172 non-flood locations, split 70/30 for training and validation.
7f3078fcd59eb2f3361979e4357434e2ccd3490b.result: MLP-CF is most accurate (training 0.899, testing 0.889) and ROC validation confirms it; 21.9–36.3% of the basin has high or very high flood potential.
7f3078fcd59eb2f3361979e4357434e2ccd3490b.open_work: Applying the hybrids to other basins and using dynamic predictors would test transferability.
7f3078fcd59eb2f3361979e4357434e2ccd3490b.issues: Small inventory of flood points; susceptibility maps are static and do not represent flood frequency or depth.

3d3eee83478fb518dc69bc5e98b3fede1e2ce4b0.goal: Maps flood and soil erosion susceptibility in mountainous watersheds and prioritizes sub-basins for mitigation.
3d3eee83478fb518dc69bc5e98b3fede1e2ce4b0.architecture: Compares a generalized linear model, flexible discriminant analysis, MARS, random forest and their ensemble.
3d3eee83478fb518dc69bc5e98b3fede1e2ce4b0.data: Flood and erosion inventories with conditioning factors for a mountainous watershed; the location is not given in the abstract.
3d3eee83478fb518dc69bc5e98b3fede1e2ce4b0.result: The ensemble achieves the highest AUC (0.94 for floods, 0.97 for erosion); sub-basins SW3 and SW5 are most sensitive to flood and erosion respectively.
3d3eee83478fb518dc69bc5e98b3fede1e2ce4b0.open_work: Testing in other watersheds and adding dynamic climate drivers would strengthen planning use.
3d3eee83478fb518dc69bc5e98b3fede1e2ce4b0.issues: High AUC from point-based inventories may overstate skill through spatial autocorrelation; maps are static.

5f5bd966b0389a4573558da238a3d1e7b2ce6be2.goal: Detects sea ice and estimates sea ice concentration from spaceborne GNSS reflectometry.
5f5bd966b0389a4573558da238a3d1e7b2ce6be2.architecture: Two convolutional neural networks (CNN): a classifier for sea ice detection and a regression CNN for concentration, compared with an earlier MLP-type neural network.
5f5bd966b0389a4573558da238a3d1e7b2ce6be2.data: TechDemoSat-1 GNSS-R delay-Doppler maps as input; sea ice concentration targets from Nimbus-7 SMMR and DMSP SSM/I-SSMIS passive microwave.
5f5bd966b0389a4573558da238a3d1e7b2ce6be2.result: With full-size DDMs the CNN beats the existing neural network; with preprocessed DDMs both perform similarly, so CNNs are more tolerant to input format.
5f5bd966b0389a4573558da238a3d1e7b2ce6be2.open_work: Applying to newer GNSS-R missions and finer-resolution ice references are natural next steps.
5f5bd966b0389a4573558da238a3d1e7b2ce6be2.issues: Targets come from coarse passive microwave products with their own errors; limited TDS-1 coverage.

8bad1c72a8f037ecbc09077500d2b4428c39fafe.goal: Predicts urban pluvial flooding from rainfall thresholds as a cheaper alternative to hydraulic models for early warning in Shenzhen, China.
8bad1c72a8f037ecbc09077500d2b4428c39fafe.architecture: Machine learning classifiers, including subspace discriminant analysis, separate flood and non-flood events in a plane of two principal components of multi-resolution rainfall intensity.
8bad1c72a8f037ecbc09077500d2b4428c39fafe.data: Rainfall events and recorded flood occurrences in Shenzhen; specific rain gauge networks are not detailed in the abstract.
8bad1c72a8f037ecbc09077500d2b4428c39fafe.result: Subspace discriminant analysis reaches 96.5% accuracy with a 25% false alert rate; accuracy and true positive rate are 5–15% higher than the critical rainfall curve.
8bad1c72a8f037ecbc09077500d2b4428c39fafe.open_work: Transfer to other urban catchments and coupling with rainfall forecasts for operational warning.
8bad1c72a8f037ecbc09077500d2b4428c39fafe.issues: Binary flood/no-flood output with no location or depth; a 25% false alert rate remains.
