41c658bed3f7eab14b0a668ddb22f5756ee26c68.goal: Forecasts monthly rainfall at a location in eastern Australia for agricultural use.
41c658bed3f7eab14b0a668ddb22f5756ee26c68.architecture: One-dimensional deep convolutional neural network (CNN), compared with an MLP and the ACCESS-S seasonal dynamical prediction system.
41c658bed3f7eab14b0a668ddb22f5756ee26c68.data: Monthly rainfall and climate predictors for one eastern Australian location; ACCESS seasonal forecasts from the Bureau of Meteorology as benchmark.
41c658bed3f7eab14b0a668ddb22f5756ee26c68.result: The CNN has lower error than ACCESS (RMSE 37 mm better) and the MLP (15.9 mm better); it does better in wetter months while ACCESS does better in dry months.
41c658bed3f7eab14b0a668ddb22f5756ee26c68.open_work: Extending to more locations and lead times is suggested.
41c658bed3f7eab14b0a668ddb22f5756ee26c68.issues: Single location; a point model is compared with a gridded dynamical forecast, which is not like-for-like.

b76830edad587fc86af9bbaa1a45565bd62e7df0.goal: Improves multi-step-ahead wind speed forecasting for wind energy.
b76830edad587fc86af9bbaa1a45565bd62e7df0.architecture: Hybrid forecaster with optimal feature selection and a modified bat algorithm with a cognition strategy for optimization; the underlying predictor type is not specified here.
b76830edad587fc86af9bbaa1a45565bd62e7df0.data: Wind speed time series; the sites and intervals are not reported here.
b76830edad587fc86af9bbaa1a45565bd62e7df0.result: Not reported in the abstract; the hybrid is presented as improving multi-step accuracy over benchmarks.
b76830edad587fc86af9bbaa1a45565bd62e7df0.open_work: Probabilistic outputs and validation across more sites would be useful.
b76830edad587fc86af9bbaa1a45565bd62e7df0.issues: Abstract unavailable; metaheuristic-tuned hybrids are hard to reproduce and may overfit single series.

211707013b5e9cd1a9a8a334c85d495e96fc9062.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting by exploiting the coupling between wind speed and other meteorological variables in time and frequency.
211707013b5e9cd1a9a8a334c85d495e96fc9062.architecture: Singular spectrum analysis denoising, multivariate empirical mode decomposition, then a CNN with an attention mechanism combined with a bidirectional LSTM.
211707013b5e9cd1a9a8a334c85d495e96fc9062.data: Multivariate meteorological series including wind speed; the site and period are not reported in the abstract.
211707013b5e9cd1a9a8a334c85d495e96fc9062.result: Across three experiments the hybrid outperforms baseline models in accuracy and effectiveness; numbers are not given in the abstract.
211707013b5e9cd1a9a8a334c85d495e96fc9062.open_work: Testing at additional sites and longer horizons, and adding uncertainty estimates.
211707013b5e9cd1a9a8a334c85d495e96fc9062.issues: Complex multi-stage pipeline; decomposition over full series may leak information; no probabilistic output.

cb1b7656c5e69c322f2bbc6da682dd75fd5deae1.goal: Forecasts groundwater levels and assesses the relative influence of driving factors such as rainfall and pumping.
cb1b7656c5e69c322f2bbc6da682dd75fd5deae1.architecture: Artificial neural network models with an input-importance analysis; the specific network configuration is not specified here.
cb1b7656c5e69c322f2bbc6da682dd75fd5deae1.data: Groundwater level records and influencing variables; the aquifer and period are not reported here.
cb1b7656c5e69c322f2bbc6da682dd75fd5deae1.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title indicates the ANN forecasts levels and ranks influencing factors.
cb1b7656c5e69c322f2bbc6da682dd75fd5deae1.open_work: Comparing with physically based groundwater models and testing other aquifers would clarify transferability.
cb1b7656c5e69c322f2bbc6da682dd75fd5deae1.issues: Abstract unavailable; neural network importance measures can be unstable and site-specific.

aaa48e29c105cc0070b7c575a180b6afe107a1a5.goal: Examines how digital elevation model resolution affects machine learning performance for flood probability mapping.
aaa48e29c105cc0070b7c575a180b6afe107a1a5.architecture: Machine learning flood susceptibility models run with DEMs of different resolution; the specific algorithms are not specified here.
aaa48e29c105cc0070b7c575a180b6afe107a1a5.data: Flood inventory and DEM-derived conditioning factors at several resolutions; the study area and DEM products are not reported here.
aaa48e29c105cc0070b7c575a180b6afe107a1a5.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies DEM resolution measurably changes flood map accuracy.
aaa48e29c105cc0070b7c575a180b6afe107a1a5.open_work: Testing more resolutions, DEM sources and regions would generalize the conclusion.
aaa48e29c105cc0070b7c575a180b6afe107a1a5.issues: Abstract unavailable; results depend on the study area's topography and the inventory size.

f52b7da84d0307511e173aa6c7b60a09de4349c3.goal: Predicts monthly rainfall at Simtokha, Thimphu, Bhutan, where agriculture depends on rainfall.
f52b7da84d0307511e173aa6c7b60a09de4349c3.architecture: Proposes a combined bidirectional LSTM-GRU recurrent network, compared with linear regression, MLP, CNN, LSTM, GRU and BLSTM.
f52b7da84d0307511e173aa6c7b60a09de4349c3.data: Automatic weather station records from Bhutan's National Center of Hydrology and Meteorology for Simtokha.
f52b7da84d0307511e173aa6c7b60a09de4349c3.result: The BLSTM-GRU reaches MSE 0.0075 on normalized data, 41.1% lower than the best baseline LSTM (0.0128).
f52b7da84d0307511e173aa6c7b60a09de4349c3.open_work: Testing at more stations and longer horizons would show whether the gain is robust.
f52b7da84d0307511e173aa6c7b60a09de4349c3.issues: Single station and short monthly record; errors on normalized data are hard to interpret physically.

23f949addb41666c3810684320bbc8fb8e462f55.goal: Predicts rice yield from weather parameters for the west coast of India to support yield forecasting.
23f949addb41666c3810684320bbc8fb8e462f55.architecture: Compares multiple linear regression, artificial neural networks and penalized regression (such as LASSO, ridge or elastic net).
23f949addb41666c3810684320bbc8fb8e462f55.data: Historical rice yields and weather parameters for west coast India districts; specific stations and periods are not reported here.
23f949addb41666c3810684320bbc8fb8e462f55.result: Not reported in the abstract; the study ranks the regression and neural network models by yield prediction skill.
23f949addb41666c3810684320bbc8fb8e462f55.open_work: Adding remote sensing indicators and testing other regions and crops.
23f949addb41666c3810684320bbc8fb8e462f55.issues: Abstract unavailable; small yield samples limit neural network training and trend effects may confound weather signals.

97bee020c7c7a229de595e0987f10321d138e3a8.goal: Predicts daily groundwater levels at five wells in Malaysia to support sustainable groundwater management.
97bee020c7c7a229de595e0987f10321d138e3a8.architecture: Deep learning model and an ensemble deep learning approach; the network family is not specified in the abstract.
97bee020c7c7a229de595e0987f10321d138e3a8.data: Daily groundwater level records at five Malaysian wells; one scenario uses neighboring wells, another uses lags up to 20 days.
97bee020c7c7a229de595e0987f10321d138e3a8.result: Ensemble deep learning generally outperforms single deep learning, reducing RMSE by 11.6% and RRMSE by 22.3%, with best lags of 2–4 days.
97bee020c7c7a229de595e0987f10321d138e3a8.open_work: Adding meteorological and pumping drivers and longer horizons would extend use.
97bee020c7c7a229de595e0987f10321d138e3a8.issues: Only groundwater levels as inputs; few wells and no physical drivers.

905ee863af32fca253278969a6e96425777b6ae3.goal: Provides day-ahead wind speed forecasts at an offshore wind farm to support power system dispatch.
905ee863af32fca253278969a6e96425777b6ae3.architecture: Image-based convolutional neural network (CNN) whose layers, kernels and dropout are chosen with a Taguchi orthogonal-array robust design.
905ee863af32fca253278969a6e96425777b6ae3.data: Historical wind speeds at seven sites in Taiwan, China, South Korea and the Philippines; target is the Fuhai offshore wind farm near Taiwan.
905ee863af32fca253278969a6e96425777b6ae3.result: The robust-design CNN outperforms existing methods; numbers are not given in the abstract.
905ee863af32fca253278969a6e96425777b6ae3.open_work: Including NWP inputs and extending to wind power output.
905ee863af32fca253278969a6e96425777b6ae3.issues: Uses only historical observations without NWP forecasts; single target farm.

72a1577305168f5554455bad591ec6e7af54575b.goal: Maps flash flood susceptibility in part of Nghe An province, Vietnam, to support flood risk management.
72a1577305168f5554455bad591ec6e7af54575b.architecture: Compares kernel logistic regression, a radial basis function classifier, multinomial naive Bayes and a logistic model tree.
72a1577305168f5554455bad591ec6e7af54575b.data: Flash flood inventory with ten conditioning factors (soil, slope, curvature, river density, flow direction, distance to rivers, elevation, aspect, land use, geology).
72a1577305168f5554455bad591ec6e7af54575b.result: All models score AUC 0.983–0.988; the logistic model tree is best (AUC 0.988).
72a1577305168f5554455bad591ec6e7af54575b.open_work: Testing in other regions and adding rainfall drivers.
72a1577305168f5554455bad591ec6e7af54575b.issues: Near-saturated AUCs suggest easy discrimination or optimistic validation; static map with no event probability.

0147e57fec61727515bb51412c40678d77125126.goal: Predicts millet crop yield in India from soil and weather inputs to help farmers anticipate crop losses.
0147e57fec61727515bb51412c40678d77125126.data: Inputs such as soil, minimum and maximum temperature, humidity and rainfall; dataset source and size are not reported.
0147e57fec61727515bb51412c40678d77125126.result: Reports 99.74% classification accuracy for millet yield prediction.
0147e57fec61727515bb51412c40678d77125126.open_work: Authors plan to compare with support vector machines and linear regression.
0147e57fec61727515bb51412c40678d77125126.issues: Very high accuracy without described validation suggests overfitting or leakage; yield treated as classes; methodology thinly reported.

5e5527013550899199313d0401578adfaa24ff0c.goal: Builds a flood forecasting system that fuses big and crowdsourced data for early warning in monsoon-affected cities.
5e5527013550899199313d0401578adfaa24ff0c.architecture: Adaptive machine learning framework comparing several learners; an MLP artificial neural network gives the best results.
5e5527013550899199313d0401578adfaa24ff0c.data: Meteorological, hydrological, geospatial and crowdsourced data; specific products and region are not detailed in the abstract.
5e5527013550899199313d0401578adfaa24ff0c.result: The MLP configuration reaches 97.93% correct, kappa 0.89, MAE 0.01 and RMSE 0.10 for flood incident prediction.
5e5527013550899199313d0401578adfaa24ff0c.open_work: Operational deployment and testing in other regions.
5e5527013550899199313d0401578adfaa24ff0c.issues: Data sources and validation design are not detailed; crowdsourced data quality and representativeness are uncertain.

5b25284cb0b67de9d9777cca3b93314093770b14.goal: Develops short-term flash-flood forecasting for an Andean mountain catchment where process-based models are hard to implement.
5b25284cb0b67de9d9777cca3b93314093770b14.architecture: Step-wise random forest methodology with sensitivity analysis, dimension reduction and optimal input selection.
5b25284cb0b67de9d9777cca3b93314093770b14.data: Precipitation and runoff observations from a catchment representative of the Ecuadorian Andes.
5b25284cb0b67de9d9777cca3b93314093770b14.result: Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency ranges from 0.761 at 4 h to 0.384 at 24 h lead; including precipitation improves extreme peak flow prediction over autoregressive models.
5b25284cb0b67de9d9777cca3b93314093770b14.open_work: Using precipitation forecasts or radar to extend useful lead time.
5b25284cb0b67de9d9777cca3b93314093770b14.issues: Skill drops sharply with lead time; single catchment; random forests cannot extrapolate beyond observed peaks.

f48bac7fee7393715f284e8a38c0781d67260390.goal: Identifies the best combination of meteorological inputs for estimating monthly mean daily global solar radiation with neural networks.
f48bac7fee7393715f284e8a38c0781d67260390.architecture: Artificial neural networks (feed-forward) trained with 32 input combinations of one to six parameters, compared with empirical sunshine and temperature models.
f48bac7fee7393715f284e8a38c0781d67260390.data: Two years of daily global solar radiation, temperature, sunshine hours and extraterrestrial radiation at one Indian site.
f48bac7fee7393715f284e8a38c0781d67260390.result: Inputs of temperature range and extraterrestrial radiation give the lowest RRMSE (3.96%); the ANNs outperform empirical models.
f48bac7fee7393715f284e8a38c0781d67260390.open_work: Validation over more sites and longer records.
f48bac7fee7393715f284e8a38c0781d67260390.issues: Only two years at one location; monthly means smooth day-to-day variability.

7676b3fbdfed6cc6adcdf1fe342e010e2c834f37.goal: Predicts flood-susceptible areas in the Buzău river catchment, Romania, for flood warning and risk reduction.
7676b3fbdfed6cc6adcdf1fe342e010e2c834f37.architecture: Hybrids of fuzzy AHP, index of entropy and a support vector machine (SVM).
7676b3fbdfed6cc6adcdf1fe342e010e2c834f37.data: 205 flood and 205 non-flood locations with 12 flood predictors.
7676b3fbdfed6cc6adcdf1fe342e010e2c834f37.result: SVM-IoE performs best (AUC 0.979), ahead of FAHP-IoE, IoE, SVM and FAHP; 12.5–21.2% of the catchment is highly exposed.
7676b3fbdfed6cc6adcdf1fe342e010e2c834f37.open_work: Applying the hybrids to other catchments.
7676b3fbdfed6cc6adcdf1fe342e010e2c834f37.issues: Static susceptibility; limited inventory; possible spatial autocorrelation between training and test points.

f0e9ec77e15cb2879e04df6105f3fb7d6f433fdc.goal: Reconstructs the full spatiotemporal wind field upstream of a wind turbine from sparse lidar measurements for monitoring and control.
f0e9ec77e15cb2879e04df6105f3fb7d6f433fdc.architecture: Physics-informed neural network: a deep MLP-type network constrained by the Navier–Stokes equations.
f0e9ec77e15cb2879e04df6105f3fb7d6f433fdc.data: Simulated line-of-sight lidar measurements of a turbulent inflow in front of a wind turbine (numerical experiments).
f0e9ec77e15cb2879e04df6105f3fb7d6f433fdc.result: Downwind and crosswind velocity are predicted well across measurement noise, resolution, look directions and turbulence levels.
f0e9ec77e15cb2879e04df6105f3fb7d6f433fdc.open_work: Validation with real lidar field data and real-time implementation.
f0e9ec77e15cb2879e04df6105f3fb7d6f433fdc.issues: Evaluated on numerical simulations only; PINN training cost may limit real-time use.

2af7b1da7aac431242c3e9967a0d7f01d4988a08.goal: Detects flooded areas in UAV aerial imagery for rapid disaster response.
2af7b1da7aac431242c3e9967a0d7f01d4988a08.architecture: Haar cascade classifier to detect landmarks (roads, buildings), followed by a deep learning classifier (network type not specified) for flooded versus non-flooded regions.
2af7b1da7aac431242c3e9967a0d7f01d4988a08.data: UAV aerial images of pre- and post-flood case study areas.
2af7b1da7aac431242c3e9967a0d7f01d4988a08.result: Buildings and roads detected with 91% and 94% accuracy; overall 91% accuracy for flooded versus non-flooded classification.
2af7b1da7aac431242c3e9967a0d7f01d4988a08.open_work: Real-time deployment in operational disaster management.
2af7b1da7aac431242c3e9967a0d7f01d4988a08.issues: Small case-study dataset; generalization to other regions and flood types is unclear.

3297e1493e077635b26651f135e4ac8bab236712.goal: Compares artificial intelligence paradigms for flood prediction.
3297e1493e077635b26651f135e4ac8bab236712.architecture: Compares artificial neural networks, fuzzy logic and an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS).
3297e1493e077635b26651f135e4ac8bab236712.data: Hydrological records for flood prediction; the basin and variables are not reported here.
3297e1493e077635b26651f135e4ac8bab236712.result: Not reported in the abstract; the study ranks the three paradigms for flood prediction.
3297e1493e077635b26651f135e4ac8bab236712.open_work: Testing on other basins and with longer lead times.
3297e1493e077635b26651f135e4ac8bab236712.issues: Abstract unavailable; results are likely single-basin and evaluation details are unknown.

07f5f6b6a875e7bc4970c8cba5d45c17a5949d17.goal: Predicts sea surface temperature at daily, weekly and monthly scales, addressing long-range temporal dependence.
07f5f6b6a875e7bc4970c8cba5d45c17a5949d17.architecture: GRU encoder-decoder with an attention mechanism (SST codes) and a dynamic influence link.
07f5f6b6a875e7bc4970c8cba5d45c17a5949d17.data: SST datasets for the Bohai Sea and South China Sea.
07f5f6b6a875e7bc4970c8cba5d45c17a5949d17.result: Outperforms FC-LSTM and support vector regression, especially for long-scale predictions; Bohai Sea daily SST is most related to values 27–29 days earlier.
07f5f6b6a875e7bc4970c8cba5d45c17a5949d17.open_work: Adding spatial context and other ocean-atmosphere variables.
07f5f6b6a875e7bc4970c8cba5d45c17a5949d17.issues: Point time series only; no physical drivers; data source not specified in the abstract.

35e72f6204d12573cbefbeb0d93562ebc20ce62b.goal: Estimates urban air pollution levels from camera images combined with weather data.
35e72f6204d12573cbefbeb0d93562ebc20ce62b.architecture: Four deep neural network architectures (convolutional image classifiers) with generative adversarial network augmentation for class imbalance.
35e72f6204d12573cbefbeb0d93562ebc20ce62b.data: Camera images and weather data with air pollution classes; the city and image source are not detailed in the abstract.
35e72f6204d12573cbefbeb0d93562ebc20ce62b.result: Accuracy up to 0.88, comparable to sequence models that use pollution data.
35e72f6204d12573cbefbeb0d93562ebc20ce62b.open_work: Extending to forecasting and other cities.
35e72f6204d12573cbefbeb0d93562ebc20ce62b.issues: Classifies discrete pollution levels; visibility is affected by fog and lighting, limiting generalization.

b8c20abfc04065b3709e36ba9430cb77a595bcb3.goal: Improves surface solar irradiance estimates at high latitudes, where reanalysis and satellite products are biased.
b8c20abfc04065b3709e36ba9430cb77a595bcb3.architecture: Random forest regression combining ERA5 and CLARA-A2 irradiance estimates.
b8c20abfc04065b3709e36ba9430cb77a595bcb3.data: ERA5 and CLARA-A2 daily GHI with pyranometer observations at Norwegian sites; tested at five Swedish sites.
b8c20abfc04065b3709e36ba9430cb77a595bcb3.result: Reduces RMSD to 16.2 W/m2 (CLARA-A2 17.9, ERA5 27.1) and bias to 0.0, with largest gains in intermediate cloudiness; similar gains in Sweden.
b8c20abfc04065b3709e36ba9430cb77a595bcb3.open_work: Extending to other regions and higher temporal resolution.
b8c20abfc04065b3709e36ba9430cb77a595bcb3.issues: Depends on station density for training; daily means only.

e606756cde6d3c98cf5372734b927233339975be.goal: Forecasts wind power generation for reliable grid integration.
e606756cde6d3c98cf5372734b927233339975be.architecture: Hybrid recurrent neural network: an echo state network with LSTM blocks as hidden units, autoencoder-style pretraining and quantile regression output.
e606756cde6d3c98cf5372734b927233339975be.data: Wind farm power and related data; the farm is not named in the abstract.
e606756cde6d3c98cf5372734b927233339975be.result: LSTM+ESN with autoencoder and quantile regression outperforms the Wind Power Prediction Tool on all global metrics.
e606756cde6d3c98cf5372734b927233339975be.open_work: Applying to more farms and longer horizons.
e606756cde6d3c98cf5372734b927233339975be.issues: Single benchmark comparison; numbers not given in the abstract.

74681ed79b9151ef234668ac6a08efd9188bc17b.goal: Demonstrates the value of hyperspectral remote sensing for retrieving phytoplankton absorption and chlorophyll-a in inland and coastal waters.
74681ed79b9151ef234668ac6a08efd9188bc17b.architecture: Mixture density networks (a neural network outputting probability mixtures) applied to hyperspectral reflectance.
74681ed79b9151ef234668ac6a08efd9188bc17b.data: In situ hyperspectral reflectance (409–800 nm, ~5 nm) with aph and Chla measurements; independent HICO image matchups.
74681ed79b9151ef234668ac6a08efd9188bc17b.result: aph median errors reduced two- to three-fold (20–30%) versus heritage ocean color algorithms; Chla errors more than halved; reduced but good performance on HICO.
74681ed79b9151ef234668ac6a08efd9188bc17b.open_work: Simultaneous retrieval of multiple in-water parameters and expanding the training dataset.
74681ed79b9151ef234668ac6a08efd9188bc17b.issues: Atmospheric correction uncertainty degrades satellite performance; generalizability limited by training data.

382aafb6f200668c94d231c994b92563aff74e02.goal: Forecasts monthly rainfall one and two months ahead in northern India for drought and flood preparedness.
382aafb6f200668c94d231c994b92563aff74e02.architecture: Feed-forward neural network (MLP) trained with backpropagation and Levenberg–Marquardt.
382aafb6f200668c94d231c994b92563aff74e02.data: Monthly rainfall records for northern India.
382aafb6f200668c94d231c994b92563aff74e02.result: The one-month-ahead model outperforms the two-month model; quantitative values are not given in the abstract.
382aafb6f200668c94d231c994b92563aff74e02.open_work: Authors outline future directions for rainfall time-series prediction.
382aafb6f200668c94d231c994b92563aff74e02.issues: Rainfall-only inputs; no comparison with climatology or other methods.

aad6b22cbae6c7907d27332f6b636c1d18b3d2f2.goal: Reviews AI applications in the water domain and what responsible AI could mean there.
aad6b22cbae6c7907d27332f6b636c1d18b3d2f2.architecture: Review of AI applications in modeling, forecasting, decision support and optimization in water management, with an ethical perspective.
aad6b22cbae6c7907d27332f6b636c1d18b3d2f2.data: Literature on AI in the water sector.
aad6b22cbae6c7907d27332f6b636c1d18b3d2f2.result: Identifies four application categories and insights on many-objective optimization, theory-guided data science and participatory decision-making.
aad6b22cbae6c7907d27332f6b636c1d18b3d2f2.open_work: Responsible AI in water requires collaboration among water professionals, data scientists and social scientists.
aad6b22cbae6c7907d27332f6b636c1d18b3d2f2.issues: Conceptual review; no quantitative comparison of methods.

1b153a146a5917673e6fc5eaadea2401cabca328.goal: Evaluates AI models for estimating actual maize evapotranspiration under mulched and non-mulched conditions.
1b153a146a5917673e6fc5eaadea2401cabca328.architecture: Support vector machine and an artificial neural network optimized by a genetic algorithm.
1b153a146a5917673e6fc5eaadea2401cabca328.data: Field measurements of ET, meteorological variables, leaf area index and plant height in a rainfed maize field, 2011–2013 (2011–2012 training, 2013 validation).
1b153a146a5917673e6fc5eaadea2401cabca328.result: Models with meteorological and crop inputs estimate ET accurately; the GA-optimized ANN performs slightly better than SVM under both treatments.
1b153a146a5917673e6fc5eaadea2401cabca328.open_work: Testing at other sites and with remote sensing crop inputs.
1b153a146a5917673e6fc5eaadea2401cabca328.issues: Single site and three seasons; crop inputs require field measurements.

866d5768b17ab3b1f86c786243c1ed09baffd3b7.goal: Forecasts monthly streamflow at a major Yangtze River station, aiming to capture flood peaks and long continuous rolling forecasts that traditional statistical models miss.
866d5768b17ab3b1f86c786243c1ed09baffd3b7.architecture: Hybrid of Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) and an encoder-decoder LSTM (En-De-LSTM) recurrent neural network, with each frequency component of the decomposed series fed to the network.
866d5768b17ab3b1f86c786243c1ed09baffd3b7.data: Monthly streamflow at Hankou Hydrological Station, Yangtze River, January 1952 to December 2008; tests on two catastrophic flood years and a ten-year rolling forecast.
866d5768b17ab3b1f86c786243c1ed09baffd3b7.result: The EMD-En-De-LSTM gives reliable predictions in catastrophic flood years and over long rolling forecasts, judged by RMSE, R2, Willmott index and Legates-McCabe index.
866d5768b17ab3b1f86c786243c1ed09baffd3b7.open_work: Extending to daily or sub-monthly data, adding meteorological predictors, and testing at other stations and basins.
866d5768b17ab3b1f86c786243c1ed09baffd3b7.issues: Single station and univariate monthly series; EMD applied to the full record can leak future information into decomposed inputs; no uncertainty quantification.

163beee58e1f16dc31f7a1caf69c9de43407a349.goal: Accelerates wave forecasting in Lake Michigan by replacing the physics-based SWAN wave model with a fast machine learning surrogate that accounts for wind and ice cover.
163beee58e1f16dc31f7a1caf69c9de43407a349.architecture: Multi-layer perceptron (MLP) regressor with two hidden layers of 300 neurons, structure tuned by cross-validated hyperparameter search, predicting significant wave height and peak period.
163beee58e1f16dc31f7a1caf69c9de43407a349.data: SWAN wave simulations for Lake Michigan, 2005–2014, for training and validation; NOAA buoy observations from 2015 for testing.
163beee58e1f16dc31f7a1caf69c9de43407a349.result: Accuracy is comparable to SWAN while running in 1/20,000 to 1/10,000 of the computational time; sensitivity tests on hyperparameters and regularization show robustness.
163beee58e1f16dc31f7a1caf69c9de43407a349.open_work: Applying the surrogate to larger spatial and temporal domains and to other lakes or coastal seas.
163beee58e1f16dc31f7a1caf69c9de43407a349.issues: Trained on SWAN output, so it inherits SWAN biases; single lake and single test year; no uncertainty estimate.

c693ca9c133f5388e8d0119421ddafbcdd383315.goal: Reconstructs and predicts long-term daily rainfall in a semi-arid climate from atmospheric synoptic patterns, for water resources applications.
c693ca9c133f5388e8d0119421ddafbcdd383315.architecture: Comparison of eight statistical and machine learning methods, including neural networks and generalized linear models with gamma errors, trained independently for each gauge.
c693ca9c133f5388e8d0119421ddafbcdd383315.data: 36 years of daily rainfall at 17 gauges in Tenerife, Spain, with atmospheric synoptic-pattern predictors; cross-validated reconstruction.
c693ca9c133f5388e8d0119421ddafbcdd383315.result: Neural networks perform best for rainfall occurrence and intensity; gamma GLMs best for extremes; all methods underestimate daily variance, and skill improves at monthly and annual aggregation.
c693ca9c133f5388e8d0119421ddafbcdd383315.open_work: Better representing daily variance and extremes, and reducing sensitivity to hyperparameter choice.
c693ca9c133f5388e8d0119421ddafbcdd383315.issues: Machine learning skill is very sensitive to hyperparameters; single island; daily variance and extremes poorly reproduced.

896945c22f1be335135b1d12a38195f1c1341958.goal: Maps flood extent from UAV optical imagery, including flooded areas hidden beneath vegetation canopy, to support emergency response.
896945c22f1be335135b1d12a38195f1c1341958.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) classifier for visible flooded areas combined with a region growing algorithm on a digital elevation model for flooding under vegetation; data augmentation for training.
896945c22f1be335135b1d12a38195f1c1341958.data: UAV optical imagery and a digital elevation model of a flood event; specific site and sample sizes not reported in the abstract.
896945c22f1be335135b1d12a38195f1c1341958.result: Data augmentation improves classification accuracy, and the integrated method detects floods in both visible and vegetated areas.
896945c22f1be335135b1d12a38195f1c1341958.open_work: Testing on more flood events and sensors, and validating the under-canopy estimates with field data.
896945c22f1be335135b1d12a38195f1c1341958.issues: Under-canopy extent depends on DEM accuracy and region growing assumptions; limited, event-specific evaluation; no numbers given in the abstract.

4d0229cb6677e1386f3200f29bad666cf17ebed2.goal: Forecasts aquifer groundwater levels using only in-situ piezometric observations, rather than the many meteorological inputs used by earlier neural network studies.
4d0229cb6677e1386f3200f29bad666cf17ebed2.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network for groundwater level time-series forecasting.
4d0229cb6677e1386f3200f29bad666cf17ebed2.data: In-situ piezometric (groundwater level) observations; the aquifer, record length and sampling interval are not reported in the available abstract.
4d0229cb6677e1386f3200f29bad666cf17ebed2.result: Not reported in the available (truncated) abstract.
4d0229cb6677e1386f3200f29bad666cf17ebed2.open_work: Testing transferability to other aquifers and adding exogenous drivers such as pumping or recharge where available.
4d0229cb6677e1386f3200f29bad666cf17ebed2.issues: Abstract truncated, so details are uncertain; univariate forecasts cannot represent changes in pumping or climate forcing.

9c964781f81b0b421711505c854116d5fd21a3c1.goal: Detects and quantifies pelagic Sargassum macroalgae from satellites, showing the value of high spatial resolution imagery and deep learning over coarse-resolution detection.
9c964781f81b0b421711505c854116d5fd21a3c1.architecture: Deep learning image segmentation of Sargassum features in high-resolution multispectral imagery; network details not reported here.
9c964781f81b0b421711505c854116d5fd21a3c1.data: High-resolution multispectral satellite imagery (Sentinel-2 MSI and Landsat-8 OLI) over Sargassum-affected waters; sample sizes not reported here.
9c964781f81b0b421711505c854116d5fd21a3c1.result: High resolution imagery with deep learning detects small Sargassum features that coarse sensors miss, improving detection and abundance estimates.
9c964781f81b0b421711505c854116d5fd21a3c1.open_work: Operational, large-scale application and combination with frequent coarse-resolution observations.
9c964781f81b0b421711505c854116d5fd21a3c1.issues: Revisit frequency of high-resolution sensors is limited and clouds, glint and other floating matter can confound detection.

6fa1d51ac02af91565d2d0e3b601a59d83830435.goal: Improves multistep forecasting of diurnal wind speed, which is intermittent and hard to predict with single or shallow models.
6fa1d51ac02af91565d2d0e3b601a59d83830435.architecture: Hybrid ISSD-LSTM-GOASVM: improved singular spectrum decomposition splits the series; LSTM predicts low-frequency parts and a three-layer deep belief network tuned by grasshopper optimization predicts high-frequency parts.
6fa1d51ac02af91565d2d0e3b601a59d83830435.data: Measured wind speed data from three regions; locations and periods not reported in the abstract.
6fa1d51ac02af91565d2d0e3b601a59d83830435.result: The hybrid model outperforms single models and other hybrid models in multistep diurnal wind speed forecasting.
6fa1d51ac02af91565d2d0e3b601a59d83830435.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and testing over longer horizons and more sites.
6fa1d51ac02af91565d2d0e3b601a59d83830435.issues: Complex multi-stage pipeline with metaheuristic tuning; decomposition can leak future information; no quantitative scores in the abstract.

913e246b0349973726512245fda12b5b62463956.goal: Assesses how the choice of meteorological input variables affects deep recurrent network predictions of daily runoff.
913e246b0349973726512245fda12b5b62463956.architecture: LSTM and GRU recurrent neural networks compared, with principal component analysis (PCA) used to reduce input dimensionality and redundancy.
913e246b0349973726512245fda12b5b62463956.data: Rainfall and multiple meteorological variables with daily runoff for the Muskegon River and the Pearl River.
913e246b0349973726512245fda12b5b62463956.result: Input selection strongly affects predictions; multiple meteorological inputs beat rainfall alone, and PCA-reduced inputs further improve accuracy.
913e246b0349973726512245fda12b5b62463956.open_work: Testing on more basins and exploring automated input selection.
913e246b0349973726512245fda12b5b62463956.issues: Only two basins; quantitative scores not given in the abstract; PCA components are harder to interpret physically.

5533cdc1fc343557e366ef6b9668bd277314e35d.goal: Develops a cloud detection method for MODIS imagery whose behavior can be adjusted to different scene conditions.
5533cdc1fc343557e366ef6b9668bd277314e35d.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) classifier for cloud/clear discrimination.
5533cdc1fc343557e366ef6b9668bd277314e35d.data: MODIS radiances; training and validation data not reported here.
5533cdc1fc343557e366ef6b9668bd277314e35d.result: Not reported here; the title implies an SVM-based MODIS cloud mask adjustable to various conditions.
5533cdc1fc343557e366ef6b9668bd277314e35d.open_work: Application to other sensors and validation against active sensors such as lidar.
5533cdc1fc343557e366ef6b9668bd277314e35d.issues: Depends on representativeness of training samples; difficult scenes such as bright surfaces, snow and thin cloud are typically challenging.

b93686a919ab3ac716dbb3beae0ffc57e2502b7b.goal: Predicts urban ozone concentrations from routine meteorological data to support public health warnings in Jinan, northern China.
b93686a919ab3ac716dbb3beae0ffc57e2502b7b.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type ANN) with inputs chosen by forward selection, plus Monte Carlo simulation for uncertainty and sensitivity analysis.
b93686a919ab3ac716dbb3beae0ffc57e2502b7b.data: Routinely monitored meteorological parameters and ozone observations in urban Jinan, China, with a day-category covariate.
b93686a919ab3ac716dbb3beae0ffc57e2502b7b.result: A parsimonious ANN with 6 meteorological inputs and day type performs acceptably versus a 9-input benchmark; maximum temperature, pressure, sunshine duration and wind speed dominate.
b93686a919ab3ac716dbb3beae0ffc57e2502b7b.open_work: Including emission and photochemical precursor information and testing in other cities.
b93686a919ab3ac716dbb3beae0ffc57e2502b7b.issues: Single city; meteorology-only inputs ignore emissions changes; network architecture found to matter little.

331c6a34c21d1240d6b10c6d4da92cb5b8c9792d.goal: Improves monthly streamflow forecasting by training neural networks with recent physics-inspired metaheuristic optimizers that avoid overfitting and local optima.
331c6a34c21d1240d6b10c6d4da92cb5b8c9792d.architecture: MLP hybridized with metaheuristics (Equilibrium Optimization, Henry Gas Solubility Optimization, Nuclear Reaction Optimization), compared with plain MLP, RNN and nine other hybrid MLP models.
331c6a34c21d1240d6b10c6d4da92cb5b8c9792d.data: About 130 years of monthly streamflow at the High Aswan Dam, Nile River.
331c6a34c21d1240d6b10c6d4da92cb5b8c9792d.result: Physics-inspired hybrids are most reliable; NRO-MLP is best with RMSE 2.35, MAE 1.356, MAPE 16.747, WI 0.957 and R 0.924.
331c6a34c21d1240d6b10c6d4da92cb5b8c9792d.open_work: Testing on other rivers and on daily data, and comparing with deep learning baselines.
331c6a34c21d1240d6b10c6d4da92cb5b8c9792d.issues: Single station; gains among metaheuristics can be small relative to tuning effort; no uncertainty quantification.

c2ff951183f6e63678876428a17d12062d99f846.goal: Forecasts significant wave height for ocean and wave energy applications using a decomposition-based hybrid deep learning model.
c2ff951183f6e63678876428a17d12062d99f846.architecture: STL (seasonal-trend decomposition using Loess) combined with a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D CNN) with positional encoding.
c2ff951183f6e63678876428a17d12062d99f846.data: Not reported here; wave height time series whose source and location are not specified.
c2ff951183f6e63678876428a17d12062d99f846.result: Not reported here; the title implies improved significant wave height forecasts from the hybrid.
c2ff951183f6e63678876428a17d12062d99f846.open_work: Testing at more sites and horizons, and adding meteorological forcing such as wind.
c2ff951183f6e63678876428a17d12062d99f846.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information if applied to the whole series; details are unknown without the abstract.

e6acc033626394d4f00966cf47838f052010a4c9.goal: Improves the accuracy of integrated low-cost air quality sensors through machine learning calibration and virtual sensors, enabling scalable urban pollution mapping.
e6acc033626394d4f00966cf47838f052010a4c9.architecture: Linear dynamic models for meteorological variables, non-linear machine learning calibration for PM2.5, and mathematical virtual sensor models for CO2 and black carbon; model types not specified.
e6acc033626394d4f00966cf47838f052010a4c9.data: Low-cost sensor measurements co-located with reference instruments at two reference stations.
e6acc033626394d4f00966cf47838f052010a4c9.result: Calibrated sensors reach improved accuracy, and virtual sensors estimate CO2 and black carbon when physical sensors fail or are absent.
e6acc033626394d4f00966cf47838f052010a4c9.open_work: Long-term field deployment and handling sensor drift across many units.
e6acc033626394d4f00966cf47838f052010a4c9.issues: Sensor drift and faults (e.g. CO2) limit calibration; models depend on reference stations; generalization to other climates is untested.

3c04dce4bd060c315a34e4234ad1400b401a8609.goal: Improves wind speed prediction by combining linear models, shallow neural networks and deep learning in one combined forecast.
3c04dce4bd060c315a34e4234ad1400b401a8609.architecture: Combined model of a linear model, shallow neural networks and a deep learning model; the specific deep network type and combination weights are not specified here.
3c04dce4bd060c315a34e4234ad1400b401a8609.data: Not reported here; wind speed time series of unspecified sites.
3c04dce4bd060c315a34e4234ad1400b401a8609.result: Not reported here; the title implies the combined model beats its individual components.
3c04dce4bd060c315a34e4234ad1400b401a8609.open_work: Probabilistic forecasting and evaluation across more sites and horizons.
3c04dce4bd060c315a34e4234ad1400b401a8609.issues: Details unknown without the abstract; combined models add complexity and risk overfitting the weighting scheme.

47acded2044362b49f4ff2ed7ac94e125f0f1ec0.goal: Retrieves cloud-top height from Himawari-8 AHI imagery more accurately than the traditional physical algorithm, for high-resolution cloud records.
47acded2044362b49f4ff2ed7ac94e125f0f1ec0.architecture: Four machine learning algorithms trained on AHI radiances against CALIPSO lidar targets, plus a joint scheme combining the best ML model with the physical retrieval.
47acded2044362b49f4ff2ed7ac94e125f0f1ec0.data: Himawari-8/-9 Advanced Himawari Imager 16-band measurements collocated with CALIPSO cloud-top heights.
47acded2044362b49f4ff2ed7ac94e125f0f1ec0.result: ML reduces cloud-top height MAE from about 3.24 km (physical method) to 1.54–2.72 km, especially for high thin clouds; the joint algorithm reaches 1.53 km.
47acded2044362b49f4ff2ed7ac94e125f0f1ec0.open_work: Extension to other geostationary imagers and to multilayer clouds.
47acded2044362b49f4ff2ed7ac94e125f0f1ec0.issues: CALIPSO sampling is sparse along-track; performance tied to collocation statistics; transfer to other sensors untested.

9c5a552f05e0027771aeea30b9a664ec05b5464e.goal: Provides reliable solar irradiance forecasts to support high photovoltaic penetration in smart grids.
9c5a552f05e0027771aeea30b9a664ec05b5464e.architecture: Several LSTM recurrent neural network forecasters aggregated with a Choquet integral based on a fuzzy measure that models interaction between inputs.
9c5a552f05e0027771aeea30b9a664ec05b5464e.data: Six solar irradiance datasets from different sites in Finland.
9c5a552f05e0027771aeea30b9a664ec05b5464e.result: The Choquet-aggregated LSTM ensemble is more reliable than individual models and weighted-average ensembles across sites and solar profiles.
9c5a552f05e0027771aeea30b9a664ec05b5464e.open_work: Probabilistic forecasts and testing in other climates.
9c5a552f05e0027771aeea30b9a664ec05b5464e.issues: High-latitude sites only; quantitative gains not stated in the abstract; added complexity of fuzzy measure identification.

76aca2ac6f5722d2bef347b82919fbd3d5c46407.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the Wadi Qena Basin, Egypt, comparing four machine learning techniques for flood-prone area identification.
76aca2ac6f5722d2bef347b82919fbd3d5c46407.architecture: Four machine learning classifiers for susceptibility mapping; specific methods not reported here.
76aca2ac6f5722d2bef347b82919fbd3d5c46407.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors for the Wadi Qena Basin, Egypt; details not reported here.
76aca2ac6f5722d2bef347b82919fbd3d5c46407.result: Not reported here; the title implies a performance comparison of the four techniques.
76aca2ac6f5722d2bef347b82919fbd3d5c46407.open_work: Validating with independent flood events and adding hydrological modelling.
76aca2ac6f5722d2bef347b82919fbd3d5c46407.issues: Susceptibility maps depend on inventory quality and conditioning factors; single arid basin.

80421df43e4c2abcdb7fe0c13c4b1491ffbb71a9.goal: Improves mass transfer-based reference evapotranspiration (ETo) estimates, which rely only on temperature and wind speed and need local calibration.
80421df43e4c2abcdb7fe0c13c4b1491ffbb71a9.architecture: Coupled wavelet-random forest (WRF) model: wavelet transform of inputs followed by random forest regression, compared with single random forest and empirical equations.
80421df43e4c2abcdb7fe0c13c4b1491ffbb71a9.data: Temperature and wind speed records from meteorological stations with cross-validation at local and cross-station scales; stations not reported in the abstract.
80421df43e4c2abcdb7fe0c13c4b1491ffbb71a9.result: Wavelet-random forest gives minimum scatter index of 0.150 locally and 0.192 for external stations, clearly beating single RF and empirical equations.
80421df43e4c2abcdb7fe0c13c4b1491ffbb71a9.open_work: Testing in other climates and combining with other input sets.
80421df43e4c2abcdb7fe0c13c4b1491ffbb71a9.issues: Station set and climate not described in the abstract; wavelet decomposition can leak future information.

f48ff2b69c9f30916981aeb94bd94645977dbc85.goal: Predicts ocean temperature at multiple depths by exploiting its closeness, period and trend temporal dependence.
f48ff2b69c9f30916981aeb94bd94645977dbc85.architecture: TD-LSTM: LSTM recurrent neural network with a temporal-dependence parameter matrix fusing historical observations.
f48ff2b69c9f30916981aeb94bd94645977dbc85.data: Argo float observations of ocean temperature at various depths and regions.
f48ff2b69c9f30916981aeb94bd94645977dbc85.result: TD-LSTM predicts sea surface and subsurface temperature better than other methods across depths and regions.
f48ff2b69c9f30916981aeb94bd94645977dbc85.open_work: Extending to spatial fields and longer lead times.
f48ff2b69c9f30916981aeb94bd94645977dbc85.issues: No quantitative scores in the abstract; point time series rather than spatial fields; sparse, irregular Argo sampling.

fa5f6f03241b09a6183ff65921dac66b4ec2b68b.goal: Predicts rainfall and runoff trends in a scarcely gauged basin using satellite-based meteorological data.
fa5f6f03241b09a6183ff65921dac66b4ec2b68b.architecture: LSTM recurrent neural network and wavelet neural network (WNN), both with four hidden layers of 30 neurons.
fa5f6f03241b09a6183ff65921dac66b4ec2b68b.data: 1980–2009 data from ten rain gauges and three discharge stations in the Nzoia River basin, Kenya, with satellite-based precipitation, temperature, humidity, wind and radiation.
fa5f6f03241b09a6183ff65921dac66b4ec2b68b.result: Runoff R2 is 0.8967 (LSTM) and 0.8820 (WNN) with MAE/RMSE of 11–13 m3/s; monthly rainfall R2 is 0.861 (LSTM) versus 0.7825 (WNN).
fa5f6f03241b09a6183ff65921dac66b4ec2b68b.open_work: Daily-scale prediction and use in other data-scarce basins.
fa5f6f03241b09a6183ff65921dac66b4ec2b68b.issues: Monthly means only; single basin; satellite products carry their own biases.

b874a03de0014591701569ee722c95ad7e68ea99.goal: Separates permanent and temporary water in flood disasters from post-event imagery alone, by fusing radar and optical data.
b874a03de0014591701569ee722c95ad7e68ea99.architecture: Convolutional neural network for semantic segmentation shared across surface, permanent and temporary water tasks, trained with focal loss for class imbalance.
b874a03de0014591701569ee722c95ad7e68ea99.data: Sen1Floods11 benchmark: about 4,831 labelled Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical chips from global flood events, including a Bolivia hold-out set.
b874a03de0014591701569ee722c95ad7e68ea99.result: mIoU 52.99%, IoU 52.30% and OA 92.81% on the Sen1Floods11 test set; on Bolivia mIoU 47.88%, IoU 76.74%, OA 95.59%.
b874a03de0014591701569ee722c95ad7e68ea99.open_work: Improving temporary-water accuracy and handling missing optical data due to clouds.
b874a03de0014591701569ee722c95ad7e68ea99.issues: Modest mIoU; optical data are often cloudy during floods; labels are limited to the benchmark events.

d61bb51f9b10834dfc15fefcb053429ff187c552.goal: Provides deterministic and probabilistic multistep short-term wind speed forecasts for power system dispatch.
d61bb51f9b10834dfc15fefcb053429ff187c552.architecture: Secondary decomposition with phase space reconstruction and a bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BiGRU) network, with parameters tuned by chicken swarm optimization.
d61bb51f9b10834dfc15fefcb053429ff187c552.data: Wind speed data from two wind farms; locations and periods not reported in the abstract.
d61bb51f9b10834dfc15fefcb053429ff187c552.result: The hybrid outperforms other hybrid models in both deterministic and probabilistic forecasts without assuming an error distribution.
d61bb51f9b10834dfc15fefcb053429ff187c552.open_work: Testing on more farms and longer horizons and integrating NWP inputs.
d61bb51f9b10834dfc15fefcb053429ff187c552.issues: Complex pipeline; decomposition may leak future information; only two farms and no numbers in the abstract.

8d3b7d037452997c98155a978b58179857f1ca6e.goal: Reviews hybrid support vector machine models with search optimization algorithms for predicting solar radiation from meteorological variables.
8d3b7d037452997c98155a978b58179857f1ca6e.architecture: Review of support vector machine (SVM) models optimized with genetic algorithms, particle swarm optimization and other search algorithms, covering articles from the previous five years.
8d3b7d037452997c98155a978b58179857f1ca6e.data: Published studies on solar radiation prediction; no new data.
8d3b7d037452997c98155a978b58179857f1ca6e.result: SVM tuned with genetic algorithms performs better than classical SVM with radial basis function kernels.
8d3b7d037452997c98155a978b58179857f1ca6e.open_work: Systematic benchmarking on common datasets and comparison with deep learning methods.
8d3b7d037452997c98155a978b58179857f1ca6e.issues: Narrow scope (SVM only) and short time window; review comparisons across heterogeneous datasets are not like-for-like.

872f4345e136136f3f244720c8ca779fbc68bb33.goal: Predicts meteorological drought by comparing support vector regression tuned with Harris hawks optimization (HHO) versus particle swarm optimization (PSO).
872f4345e136136f3f244720c8ca779fbc68bb33.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) hybridized with HHO or PSO metaheuristics for hyperparameter tuning.
872f4345e136136f3f244720c8ca779fbc68bb33.data: Not reported here; drought index series for unspecified stations.
872f4345e136136f3f244720c8ca779fbc68bb33.result: Not reported here; the title implies a comparison of SVR-HHO and SVR-PSO skill.
872f4345e136136f3f244720c8ca779fbc68bb33.open_work: Longer lead times and testing in other climate zones.
872f4345e136136f3f244720c8ca779fbc68bb33.issues: Details unknown without the abstract; gains from metaheuristic choice are often small and site-specific.

b6a054829e571514ec8fc0b3d9cec706f175ed8d.goal: Forecasts daily river water temperature and quantifies thermal regime changes due to climate and dam construction.
b6a054829e571514ec8fc0b3d9cec706f175ed8d.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network compared with several other models.
b6a054829e571514ec8fc0b3d9cec706f175ed8d.data: Daily water temperature at nine river gauges worldwide, with detailed analysis at Yichang on the Yangtze River to assess the Three Gorges Reservoir.
b6a054829e571514ec8fc0b3d9cec706f175ed8d.result: LSTM outperforms other methods; the Three Gorges Reservoir cools Yichang most in mid-April to mid-May and warms it most in late December to early January.
b6a054829e571514ec8fc0b3d9cec706f175ed8d.open_work: Using the model for ecological management and projecting thermal regimes under future climate.
b6a054829e571514ec8fc0b3d9cec706f175ed8d.issues: Reconstructed natural regime depends on the model extrapolating pre-dam relationships; no quantitative scores in the abstract.

daaa7e63719d4d289956acc7119d23c458cb6ee9.goal: Evaluates whether air pollution inputs improve daily global and diffuse solar radiation prediction in a polluted city.
daaa7e63719d4d289956acc7119d23c458cb6ee9.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) regression based on sunshine duration or air temperature, with combinations of one to three air pollution inputs.
daaa7e63719d4d289956acc7119d23c458cb6ee9.data: Daily meteorological and air pollution data (PM2.5, PM10, SO2, NO2, CO, O3, AQI) for Beijing, 2014–2015 for training and 2016 for testing.
daaa7e63719d4d289956acc7119d23c458cb6ee9.result: AQI is the most relevant single pollutant input; the best three-pollutant combinations reduce RMSE by about 22–25% compared with SVM without pollution inputs.
daaa7e63719d4d289956acc7119d23c458cb6ee9.open_work: Testing in other polluted regions and with longer records.
daaa7e63719d4d289956acc7119d23c458cb6ee9.issues: Single city and short record (three years); pollution measurements may not be available where radiation stations are missing.

4235d8dd21f2d4792298496d14ae396de83a9192.goal: Compares physical and machine learning models for estimating solar irradiance and photovoltaic power output.
4235d8dd21f2d4792298496d14ae396de83a9192.architecture: Physical irradiance and PV models compared with machine learning models; the machine learning model types are not specified here.
4235d8dd21f2d4792298496d14ae396de83a9192.result: Not reported here; the title implies a head-to-head comparison of accuracy.
4235d8dd21f2d4792298496d14ae396de83a9192.open_work: Hybrid physics-ML approaches and testing across climates.
4235d8dd21f2d4792298496d14ae396de83a9192.issues: Details unknown without the abstract; conclusions may be site-specific.

4480cec2b0096eace9a7745de8a3d44288892743.goal: Tests how robust LSTM networks are for runoff simulation under changing climatic conditions compared with conceptual hydrologic models.
4480cec2b0096eace9a7745de8a3d44288892743.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network compared with two conceptual hydrologic models, using differential split-sample tests between wet and dry periods.
4480cec2b0096eace9a7745de8a3d44288892743.data: 278 MOPEX (Model Parameter Estimation Experiment) basins in the United States.
4480cec2b0096eace9a7745de8a3d44288892743.result: All models degrade most when calibrated wet and validated dry; LSTM losses depend on climate contrast, and LSTM benefits more from longer calibration records.
4480cec2b0096eace9a7745de8a3d44288892743.open_work: Improving LSTM robustness under climate shifts and with limited training data.
4480cec2b0096eace9a7745de8a3d44288892743.issues: Conceptual models may be preferable when calibration data are short; basin-wise training of LSTM may understate the benefit of regional training.

5f89b23bfb05e88d2ab40328ff8652223159c2e4.goal: Forecasts crop yields across China from multi-source environmental data and identifies the optimum lead time for forecasts.
5f89b23bfb05e88d2ab40328ff8652223159c2e4.architecture: Machine learning yield forecasting models; specific algorithms not reported here.
5f89b23bfb05e88d2ab40328ff8652223159c2e4.data: Multi-source environmental data (e.g. climate and satellite-derived variables) and yield statistics across China; details not reported here.
5f89b23bfb05e88d2ab40328ff8652223159c2e4.result: Not reported here; the title implies yield forecasts with an identified optimum lead time before harvest.
5f89b23bfb05e88d2ab40328ff8652223159c2e4.open_work: Integrating seasonal climate forecasts and extending to other crops and regions.
5f89b23bfb05e88d2ab40328ff8652223159c2e4.issues: Details unknown without the abstract; statistical yield models may not capture management changes.

0526197d3db239aedcf93eb5a3f8d2dc207032bf.goal: Predicts ocean wave height using an ensemble of extreme learning machines.
0526197d3db239aedcf93eb5a3f8d2dc207032bf.architecture: Ensemble of extreme learning machines (ELM), single-hidden-layer feedforward neural networks with randomly assigned input weights.
0526197d3db239aedcf93eb5a3f8d2dc207032bf.data: Not reported here; wave height observations of unspecified sites.
0526197d3db239aedcf93eb5a3f8d2dc207032bf.result: Not reported here; the title implies the ensemble improves on single ELM predictions.
0526197d3db239aedcf93eb5a3f8d2dc207032bf.open_work: Longer lead times and evaluation at more locations.
0526197d3db239aedcf93eb5a3f8d2dc207032bf.issues: Details unknown without the abstract; ELM ensembles may be sensitive to random initialization and input choices.

25384ba7dd9e2379978194bbd9859f26a7de8a94.goal: Monitors agricultural drought over South Asia using deep learning with remote sensing data across crop phenology stages.
25384ba7dd9e2379978194bbd9859f26a7de8a94.architecture: Deep feedforward neural network (DFNN, an MLP) compared with distributed random forest and gradient boosting machine.
25384ba7dd9e2379978194bbd9859f26a7de8a94.data: Remote sensing precipitation, vegetation and soil variables over South Asia, 2001–2016; soil moisture deficit index (SMDI) target; in-situ SPEI for comparison.
25384ba7dd9e2379978194bbd9859f26a7de8a94.result: DFNN outperforms DRF and GBM, with R2 of 0.57–0.90, 0.52–0.94 and 0.49–0.82 at start, length and end of season; estimated SMDI agrees with in-situ SPEI.
25384ba7dd9e2379978194bbd9859f26a7de8a94.open_work: Drought forecasting rather than monitoring and finer-resolution inputs.
25384ba7dd9e2379978194bbd9859f26a7de8a94.issues: SMDI target is itself model-derived; wide range of R2 across regions; limited ground validation.

1b490acfc1f7eb433bb00cd8a506602d606c89c7.goal: Classifies and estimates tropical cyclone intensity from infrared geostationary satellite imagery in the northwest Pacific.
1b490acfc1f7eb433bb00cd8a506602d606c89c7.architecture: TCICENet: cascading deep convolutional neural network (CNN) with a classification module into three intensity classes followed by class-specific CNN regression modules.
1b490acfc1f7eb433bb00cd8a506602d606c89c7.data: Infrared geostationary images and best track data for 1001 northwest Pacific TCs, 1981–2013 training, 2014–2016 validation, 2017–2019 testing.
1b490acfc1f7eb433bb00cd8a506602d606c89c7.result: With 170×170 pixel inputs the model reaches RMSE 8.60 kt and MAE 6.67 kt against best track.
1b490acfc1f7eb433bb00cd8a506602d606c89c7.open_work: Adding other channels such as microwave and extending to other basins.
1b490acfc1f7eb433bb00cd8a506602d606c89c7.issues: Best track intensities are themselves uncertain; single basin; classification errors propagate to estimation.

e1f7f6750c82d26faf033de0058decd75dd4fdca.goal: Reconstructs the full 3-D spatiotemporal wind field in front of a wind turbine from sparse scanning lidar measurements.
e1f7f6750c82d26faf033de0058decd75dd4fdca.architecture: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) combining 3-D Navier–Stokes equations with line-of-sight lidar measurements.
e1f7f6750c82d26faf033de0058decd75dd4fdca.data: High-fidelity large eddy simulations providing synthetic scanning lidar measurements and reference wind fields.
e1f7f6750c82d26faf033de0058decd75dd4fdca.result: Baseline errors are 0.263, 0.397 and 0.361 m/s for streamwise, spanwise and vertical velocities, and 2.84° and 2.58° for horizontal and vertical directions.
e1f7f6750c82d26faf033de0058decd75dd4fdca.open_work: Validation with real lidar field data and use in turbine control and power forecasting.
e1f7f6750c82d26faf033de0058decd75dd4fdca.issues: Evaluated only on LES, not real measurements; computational cost of real-time PINN training is not discussed.

e1a857e4f5ed16e3471962bb9f1ecd8ff4b3cbf4.goal: Quantifies global and regional PM2.5 exposure and health impacts from the 2023 Canadian wildfires.
e1a857e4f5ed16e3471962bb9f1ecd8ff4b3cbf4.architecture: Combination of satellite observations, machine learning and a chemical transport model for PM2.5 estimation; ML method type not specified in the abstract.
e1a857e4f5ed16e3471962bb9f1ecd8ff4b3cbf4.data: Satellite observations and chemical transport model simulations for 2023; product names not given in the abstract.
e1a857e4f5ed16e3471962bb9f1ecd8ff4b3cbf4.result: Fires raised global annual PM2.5 exposure by 0.17 μg m–3, Canada by 3.82 and USA by 1.49; about 5,400 acute and 64,300 chronic deaths attributed.
e1a857e4f5ed16e3471962bb9f1ecd8ff4b3cbf4.open_work: Attributing future large wildfire seasons and refining concentration-response functions for smoke.
e1a857e4f5ed16e3471962bb9f1ecd8ff4b3cbf4.issues: Health estimates depend on concentration-response assumptions treating smoke like generic PM2.5; wide confidence intervals.

76075ecc7a312b253b1047930216e5312d3963d0.goal: Rapidly predicts peak storm surge over an extensive coastal region from tropical cyclone track time series, as a surrogate for costly hydrodynamic models.
76075ecc7a312b253b1047930216e5312d3963d0.architecture: C1PKNet: one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D CNN) combined with principal component analysis and k-means clustering.
76075ecc7a312b253b1047930216e5312d3963d0.data: 1031 high-fidelity synthetic storm surge simulations for Chesapeake Bay, USA; evaluation on Hurricanes Isabel (2003), Irene (2011) and Sandy (2012).
76075ecc7a312b253b1047930216e5312d3963d0.result: C1PKNet is computationally efficient and predicts peak surges from realistic track time series, including landfalling and bypassing storms.
76075ecc7a312b253b1047930216e5312d3963d0.open_work: Extending to time-varying surge and other coastal regions.
76075ecc7a312b253b1047930216e5312d3963d0.issues: Trained on synthetic simulations so it inherits their biases; peak surge only; no quantitative error in the abstract.

8235e8b794e0d88960ea4219649ff501470113ea.goal: Segments clouds in multispectral geostationary satellite imagery quickly and robustly using spatial context rather than pixel-wise classification.
8235e8b794e0d88960ea4219649ff501470113ea.architecture: CS-CNN: convolutional neural network (CNN) for image segmentation, compared with random forest.
8235e8b794e0d88960ea4219649ff501470113ea.data: Meteosat Second Generation (MSG) SEVIRI multispectral data with the CLAAS-2 cloud mask as reference over Europe.
8235e8b794e0d88960ea4219649ff501470113ea.result: Accuracy 0.94 and Heidke Skill Score 0.90 against CLAAS-2; robust at coastlines and bright sand; 25 ms per 508×508 image on GPU.
8235e8b794e0d88960ea4219649ff501470113ea.open_work: Cloud type classification and application to newer geostationary sensors.
8235e8b794e0d88960ea4219649ff501470113ea.issues: Trained and evaluated against an existing cloud product, so it learns that product's errors.

39f5ff597eeb734e0495c573ca8ce392c90a61e0.goal: Predicts air pollution levels in Indian cities using an ensemble combining differential evolution with random forest.
39f5ff597eeb734e0495c573ca8ce392c90a61e0.architecture: Heterogeneous ensemble of differential evolution strategies with random forest, compared with independent Bayesian network and multi-label classifiers.
39f5ff597eeb734e0495c573ca8ce392c90a61e0.data: Daily average concentrations of C6H6, NO2, O3, SO2, CO, PM2.5 and PM10 from Central Pollution Control Board stations in Delhi and Patna.
39f5ff597eeb734e0495c573ca8ce392c90a61e0.result: The proposed approach yields performance gains over existing independent and multi-label classifiers; numbers not reported in the abstract.
39f5ff597eeb734e0495c573ca8ce392c90a61e0.open_work: Adding meteorological predictors and extending to more cities.
39f5ff597eeb734e0495c573ca8ce392c90a61e0.issues: Only two cities; no meteorological inputs mentioned; no quantitative results in the abstract.

26355dab0b1c8c768944da6c0d589219c05a6c02.goal: Maps flood inundation rapidly over large areas from SAR without manual tuning or labelled data.
26355dab0b1c8c768944da6c0d589219c05a6c02.architecture: Felz-CNN: unsupervised segmentation combining Felzenszwalb super-pixels, convolutional neural network featurization and super-pixel aggregation.
26355dab0b1c8c768944da6c0d589219c05a6c02.data: Sentinel-1 SAR for the 2020 Yangtze River flood over 1,140,300 km2; validation on Planet imagery; FROM-GLC10 land cover for damage assessment.
26355dab0b1c8c768944da6c0d589219c05a6c02.result: Producer and user accuracies of 93% and 94%; cropland (9,430 km2) and residential areas (1,398 km2) were most inundated, consistent with agency statistics.
26355dab0b1c8c768944da6c0d589219c05a6c02.open_work: Global operational deployment on cloud platforms and handling urban flooding.
26355dab0b1c8c768944da6c0d589219c05a6c02.issues: SAR has known difficulties in urban and vegetated areas; single event evaluation.

4c696d41719934964075e46e7898b28b25607a8c.goal: Forecasts ultra-short-term photovoltaic power output for dispatch and operational security of solar plants.
4c696d41719934964075e46e7898b28b25607a8c.architecture: Non-linear auto-regressive recurrent neural network with exogenous inputs (NARX) optimized by a genetic algorithm.
4c696d41719934964075e46e7898b28b25607a8c.data: PV power and meteorological inputs at five sites in Algeria and Australia (arid desert climate); horizons of 5–60 minutes.
4c696d41719934964075e46e7898b28b25607a8c.result: Relative RMSE of about 10–20% and R2 above 91%; exogenous inputs improve endogenous models by up to 22.3%, and gains over persistence reach 58.4%.
4c696d41719934964075e46e7898b28b25607a8c.open_work: Using sky imagery or satellite inputs for longer horizons and other climates.
4c696d41719934964075e46e7898b28b25607a8c.issues: Arid sites only; no probabilistic output; skill degrades with horizon.

17aa6fbc61d41a6090bb70ce826371a2eb76d255.goal: Maps hourly near-surface NO2 at 100 m resolution for health exposure studies and quantifies the importance of satellite observations.
17aa6fbc61d41a6090bb70ce826371a2eb76d255.architecture: Extreme gradient-boosted tree ensemble (XGBoost) with feature importance analysis.
17aa6fbc61d41a6090bb70ce826371a2eb76d255.data: Airbase in situ NO2 observations for training; TROPOMI NO2, land use, meteorological and topographic covariates; Switzerland and northern Italy.
17aa6fbc61d41a6090bb70ce826371a2eb76d255.result: Independent evaluation gives R2 0.59 and MAE 7.69 μg/m3; TROPOMI is the leading covariate, especially during COVID-19 lockdown reductions.
17aa6fbc61d41a6090bb70ce826371a2eb76d255.open_work: Extension to other European regions and worldwide using public data.
17aa6fbc61d41a6090bb70ce826371a2eb76d255.issues: Moderate R2; TROPOMI resolution is coarse and daily; performance depends on station density.

b6b1500007b986c89cb46bf6abcad6c456462aad.goal: Maps the 2020 summer flood inundation around Poyang Lake, China, from radar imagery to support flood monitoring when clouds block optical sensors.
b6b1500007b986c89cb46bf6abcad6c456462aad.architecture: Several convolutional neural network (CNN) models are applied and compared for water/flood segmentation of SAR images; the specific CNN variants are not specified here.
b6b1500007b986c89cb46bf6abcad6c456462aad.data: Sentinel-1 SAR imagery over the Poyang Lake area during the 2020 summer flood; details of labels and periods are not reported here.
b6b1500007b986c89cb46bf6abcad6c456462aad.result: Not reported here; the title indicates CNN-based mapping of the 2020 flood extent from Sentinel-1 data.
b6b1500007b986c89cb46bf6abcad6c456462aad.open_work: Transfer to other flood events and basins, and fusion with optical data or hydrological models for depth and impact estimates.
b6b1500007b986c89cb46bf6abcad6c456462aad.issues: Single event and region; SAR water mapping is confounded by vegetation, urban areas and wind-roughened water; performance details unverified.

091daa63f7406d8142202dd7389fd1af78f2a488.goal: Improves global ocean color retrievals, especially in turbid coastal and inland waters and under heavy aerosol loading, where heritage atmospheric correction fails.
091daa63f7406d8142202dd7389fd1af78f2a488.architecture: Multi-sensor platform (OC-SMART) whose atmospheric correction and inherent-optical-property algorithms are machine learning models (neural networks) trained on coupled atmosphere-ocean radiative transfer simulations, plus a cloud screening algorithm.
091daa63f7406d8142202dd7389fd1af78f2a488.data: About 13 million radiative transfer simulations per sensor; applied to SeaWiFS, Aqua/MODIS, SNPP/VIIRS, HICO, Landsat-8/OLI, DSCOVR/EPIC, Sentinel-2/MSI, Sentinel-3/OLCI, GOCI, SGLI and FY-3D/MERSI-2.
091daa63f7406d8142202dd7389fd1af78f2a488.result: Improves retrieved water products, removes negative water-leaving radiances, recovers data discarded by SeaDAS in coastal areas and runs about 10 times faster than SeaDAS.
091daa63f7406d8142202dd7389fd1af78f2a488.open_work: Further validation against in situ matchups across water types and extension to future hyperspectral missions.
091daa63f7406d8142202dd7389fd1af78f2a488.issues: Training relies on simulated radiances, so performance depends on how well the radiative transfer and bio-optical models span real conditions; quantitative accuracy not given in the abstract.

e7e43656ff6130c6f4f5a28c98f63e51147a3ccd.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power and analyses how dataset length and abrupt weather changes affect forecast accuracy.
e7e43656ff6130c6f4f5a28c98f63e51147a3ccd.architecture: Hybrid model: variational mode decomposition (VMD) of the series, a transformer forecaster, and sparrow search algorithm (SSA) hyperparameter optimization.
e7e43656ff6130c6f4f5a28c98f63e51147a3ccd.data: PV plant power and weather data; site and period not reported here.
e7e43656ff6130c6f4f5a28c98f63e51147a3ccd.result: Not reported here; the title indicates the hybrid is evaluated across dataset lengths and weather-mutation conditions.
e7e43656ff6130c6f4f5a28c98f63e51147a3ccd.open_work: Test on more plants and climates and add probabilistic output.
e7e43656ff6130c6f4f5a28c98f63e51147a3ccd.issues: Decomposition-based forecasting can leak future information if applied to the whole series; details unverified without the abstract.

12e4b7fe8b4a15c82f9a84c4a208dbc550f46b6d.goal: Forecasts regional air quality across monitoring stations by capturing spatiotemporal correlations in pollutant data.
12e4b7fe8b4a15c82f9a84c4a208dbc550f46b6d.architecture: Hierarchical deep learning model DL-Air: an encoder for spatial relations, a spatiotemporal attention LSTM variant (STAA-LSTM) operating in latent space, and a decoder.
12e4b7fe8b4a15c82f9a84c4a208dbc550f46b6d.data: Real-world air quality monitoring station data for Delhi, India.
12e4b7fe8b4a15c82f9a84c4a208dbc550f46b6d.result: About 30% lower RMSE and MAE, 37% lower AAD, 11% higher R2 and 8% better AQI category accuracy than the best baselines, consistent across seasons.
12e4b7fe8b4a15c82f9a84c4a208dbc550f46b6d.open_work: Add meteorological and emission drivers and test transfer to other cities.
12e4b7fe8b4a15c82f9a84c4a208dbc550f46b6d.issues: Single city; forecast horizons and baselines are not detailed in the abstract; no uncertainty estimates.

75f80284c89a2bb3065c5b6e1c1f595e03921b5d.goal: Delineates susceptibility to multiple flood types in Bangladesh for hazard management.
75f80284c89a2bb3065c5b6e1c1f595e03921b5d.architecture: Stacking ensemble combining several machine learning base learners; the individual algorithms are not specified here.
75f80284c89a2bb3065c5b6e1c1f595e03921b5d.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors for Bangladesh; details not reported here.
75f80284c89a2bb3065c5b6e1c1f595e03921b5d.result: Not reported here; the title indicates the stacking hybrid is used to map multi-type flooding.
75f80284c89a2bb3065c5b6e1c1f595e03921b5d.open_work: Validate with independent flood events and dynamic, climate-change-aware conditioning factors.
75f80284c89a2bb3065c5b6e1c1f595e03921b5d.issues: Susceptibility maps are static and depend on inventory quality; specifics unverified without the abstract.

681a411cff0e3111067db6e48e8b5ff6a6bcef62.goal: Forecasts the standardized precipitation index (SPI) at several accumulation scales to support drought mitigation in Bangladesh.
681a411cff0e3111067db6e48e8b5ff6a6bcef62.architecture: Comparison of random forest, minimum probability machine regression, M5 model tree, extreme learning machine (ELM) and online sequential ELM, with correlation-based input selection.
681a411cff0e3111067db6e48e8b5ff6a6bcef62.data: Monthly rainfall 1949–2013 at four Bangladesh stations: Barisal, Bogra, Faridpur and Mymensingh; SPI at 1, 3, 6 and 12 months.
681a411cff0e3111067db6e48e8b5ff6a6bcef62.result: ELM is best for most SPI scales (RMSE roughly 0.04–0.85); random forest is best for SPI-1 (RMSE 0.42–0.59).
681a411cff0e3111067db6e48e8b5ff6a6bcef62.open_work: Add climate predictors such as ENSO indices and test longer lead times and more stations.
681a411cff0e3111067db6e48e8b5ff6a6bcef62.issues: Long SPI scales are smooth and autocorrelated, inflating skill; station-only, univariate inputs; no comparison with persistence.

c091af58a0c0cada294ea9ce0ab91afc6f73bb91.goal: Predicts wind turbine power output from environmental variables and compares machine learning against deep learning models.
c091af58a0c0cada294ea9ce0ab91afc6f73bb91.architecture: Benchmark of linear regression, SVR, random forest, extra trees, AdaBoost, CatBoost, XGBoost and LightGBM against ANN (MLP), LSTM, RNN and CNN.
c091af58a0c0cada294ea9ce0ab91afc6f73bb91.data: Dataset of 40,000 observations of temperature, humidity, wind speed, wind direction and turbine power; site not reported in the abstract.
c091af58a0c0cada294ea9ce0ab91afc6f73bb91.result: ANN is best overall (R2 0.7248, RMSE 0.1516), marginally ahead of extra trees (R2 0.7231, RMSE 0.1512).
c091af58a0c0cada294ea9ce0ab91afc6f73bb91.open_work: Use multi-turbine data, forecast inputs from NWP and probabilistic outputs.
c091af58a0c0cada294ea9ce0ab91afc6f73bb91.issues: Differences between models are negligible; R2 near 0.72 is modest for a power-curve problem; single dataset with no temporal forecasting setup.

1d918c011e01981818aa467e44211340df6945fc.goal: Estimates winter wheat yield in the Guanzhong Plain, China, from remotely sensed indices to support food security.
1d918c011e01981818aa467e44211340df6945fc.architecture: LSTM with an attention mechanism (ALSTM) taking stage-wise inputs, compared with a plain LSTM; stepwise sensitivity analysis for variable importance.
1d918c011e01981818aa467e44211340df6945fc.data: Meteorological data plus Vegetation Temperature Condition Index (VTCI) and Leaf Area Index (LAI) at main growth stages, with yield at sampling sites in the Guanzhong Plain.
1d918c011e01981818aa467e44211340df6945fc.result: ALSTM reaches R2 0.63, RMSE 502.71 kg/ha, NRMSE 11.15%, versus R2 0.55 for LSTM; leave-one-year-out NRMSE 13.63%. Heading-filling and milk-stage LAI matter most.
1d918c011e01981818aa467e44211340df6945fc.open_work: Extend to other crops and regions and to in-season forecasting.
1d918c011e01981818aa467e44211340df6945fc.issues: Moderate R2; single region; limited sample size typical of yield data.

7fec7543697bb068bd76ac5d8299350fe7b90daf.goal: Predicts ultra-short-term wind speed to improve wind farm generation efficiency.
7fec7543697bb068bd76ac5d8299350fe7b90daf.architecture: Decomposition-ensemble model: empirical mode decomposition, a reinforced LSTM per component, and an improved sparrow search algorithm tuning LSTM hyperparameters.
7fec7543697bb068bd76ac5d8299350fe7b90daf.data: Actual ultra-short-term wind speed measurements; site and period not reported in the abstract.
7fec7543697bb068bd76ac5d8299350fe7b90daf.result: The proposed model outperforms standard LSTM, EMD-LSTM, EMD-SSA-LSTM and other state-of-the-art models across many error metrics; numbers not given in the abstract.
7fec7543697bb068bd76ac5d8299350fe7b90daf.open_work: Multi-step and probabilistic forecasting, and tests at more sites.
7fec7543697bb068bd76ac5d8299350fe7b90daf.issues: EMD applied over the whole series can leak future information; univariate inputs; few datasets.

6343b1331534e121e36f0a4fc7554a5fe794ba2b.goal: Predicts daily runoff in the upper Huai River basin, China, with an improved LSTM.
6343b1331534e121e36f0a4fc7554a5fe794ba2b.architecture: Enhanced long short-term memory (LSTM) network; the specific enhancement is not reported here.
6343b1331534e121e36f0a4fc7554a5fe794ba2b.data: Daily hydrometeorological and runoff data for the upper Huai River basin; details not reported here.
6343b1331534e121e36f0a4fc7554a5fe794ba2b.result: Not reported here; the title indicates the enhanced LSTM improves daily runoff prediction.
6343b1331534e121e36f0a4fc7554a5fe794ba2b.open_work: Test on other basins and in flood-peak conditions.
6343b1331534e121e36f0a4fc7554a5fe794ba2b.issues: Single basin; details unverified without the abstract.

b422a22b21ff4d0f8421172face0dfc710c371ea.goal: Forecasts seasonal summer monsoon and post-monsoon rainfall for Kerala, India.
b422a22b21ff4d0f8421172face0dfc710c371ea.architecture: Comparison of k-nearest neighbour, artificial neural network (MLP) and extreme learning machine (ELM).
b422a22b21ff4d0f8421172face0dfc710c371ea.data: Kerala rainfall records; forecasts evaluated for 2011–2016 summer monsoon (June–September) and post-monsoon (October–December).
b422a22b21ff4d0f8421172face0dfc710c371ea.result: ELM performs best, with MAPE 3.075 (monsoon) and 3.149 (post-monsoon); an 8-15-1 ELM architecture works best.
b422a22b21ff4d0f8421172face0dfc710c371ea.open_work: Include large-scale climate predictors and test on longer independent periods.
b422a22b21ff4d0f8421172face0dfc710c371ea.issues: Only six test years; predictor set unclear; no comparison with climatology or dynamical seasonal forecasts.

0a77aab68b37a8c68e5006c91a2b362f3e25123b.goal: Produces short-term probabilistic wind power forecasts that select relevant inputs from multiple NWP sources.
0a77aab68b37a8c68e5006c91a2b362f3e25123b.architecture: Multi-Source and Temporal Attention Network (MSTAN): variable attention over multi-source NWP, temporal attention over history, and residual modules, outputting density forecasts.
0a77aab68b37a8c68e5006c91a2b362f3e25123b.data: Operation data from 3 wind farms plus multi-source NWP forecasts.
0a77aab68b37a8c68e5006c91a2b362f3e25123b.result: MSTAN outperforms state-of-the-art machine learning schemes in deterministic and probabilistic 48-hour forecasts.
0a77aab68b37a8c68e5006c91a2b362f3e25123b.open_work: Extend to regional aggregation and more farms.
0a77aab68b37a8c68e5006c91a2b362f3e25123b.issues: Only three farms; numbers not given in the abstract; dependent on NWP availability.

79a0236957472eeb42fb73eaa809fc8dead8afd8.goal: Assesses how climatic variables affect ground-level ozone in Malaysia.
79a0236957472eeb42fb73eaa809fc8dead8afd8.architecture: Correlation analysis plus random forest, decision tree regression, linear regression and support vector regression.
79a0236957472eeb42fb73eaa809fc8dead8afd8.data: Ozone and meteorological data from ten air monitoring stations in Malaysia during the southwest monsoon.
79a0236957472eeb42fb73eaa809fc8dead8afd8.result: Temperature correlates strongly with ozone, wind speed moderately, humidity negatively; random forest is best (R2 0.970, RMSE 2.737, MAE 1.824).
79a0236957472eeb42fb73eaa809fc8dead8afd8.open_work: Include precursor emissions and multi-season analysis.
79a0236957472eeb42fb73eaa809fc8dead8afd8.issues: Single season; omits NOx and VOC precursors; correlation does not establish climate-change attribution.

a0200da98a4579daf3298ccd7a0ed98c34197f75.goal: Reviews data-driven models for univariate streamflow forecasting and tests them in a case study.
a0200da98a4579daf3298ccd7a0ed98c34197f75.architecture: Review plus case-study comparison of commonly used data-driven models; the specific models are not reported here.
a0200da98a4579daf3298ccd7a0ed98c34197f75.data: Streamflow series for the case-study catchment(s); details not reported here.
a0200da98a4579daf3298ccd7a0ed98c34197f75.result: Not reported here; quantitative results are unknown without the abstract.
a0200da98a4579daf3298ccd7a0ed98c34197f75.open_work: Guidance on model selection and multivariate extensions.
a0200da98a4579daf3298ccd7a0ed98c34197f75.issues: Univariate setting omits meteorological drivers; details unverified without the abstract.

60c8b260c9f63a278c2555a8753488da36ecc800.goal: Fills the roughly one-year gap in terrestrial water storage anomalies (TWSA) between GRACE and GRACE-FO.
60c8b260c9f63a278c2555a8753488da36ecc800.architecture: Bayesian convolutional neural network (BCNN) with attention mechanisms and residual and dense connections, driven by climatic inputs, giving predictive uncertainty.
60c8b260c9f63a278c2555a8753488da36ecc800.data: GRACE and GRACE-FO TWSA with multi-source climatic inputs; compared with hydrological model outputs and three TWSA reconstruction products.
60c8b260c9f63a278c2555a8753488da36ecc800.result: BCNN outperforms other products during the gap, especially in arid regions, and captures extreme dry and wet events consistent with precipitation, drought indices and water levels.
60c8b260c9f63a278c2555a8753488da36ecc800.open_work: Extend to reconstruct pre-GRACE periods and improve performance in human-impacted basins.
60c8b260c9f63a278c2555a8753488da36ecc800.issues: No direct observations in the gap for validation; groundwater pumping is not captured by climate inputs alone.

9417aba3bea0440b625bc94efd9bdb4a99c676dc.goal: Models monthly reference evapotranspiration across Turkey with machine learning.
9417aba3bea0440b625bc94efd9bdb4a99c676dc.architecture: Machine learning regression methods; the specific models are not reported here.
9417aba3bea0440b625bc94efd9bdb4a99c676dc.data: Monthly meteorological station data from Turkey; details not reported here.
9417aba3bea0440b625bc94efd9bdb4a99c676dc.result: Not reported here; quantitative results are unknown without the abstract.
9417aba3bea0440b625bc94efd9bdb4a99c676dc.open_work: Test with reduced input sets and spatial transfer to ungauged sites.
9417aba3bea0440b625bc94efd9bdb4a99c676dc.issues: Targets are usually computed with FAO-56 Penman-Monteith, so the task emulates a formula; details unverified.

dc251491c438a0ebf01e6b1f3b05ec5e00e96e6f.goal: Retrieves plot-scale soil moisture in vegetated areas by combining SAR and optical data.
dc251491c438a0ebf01e6b1f3b05ec5e00e96e6f.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) on selected features, comparing pixel-based, object-based and combined approaches.
dc251491c438a0ebf01e6b1f3b05ec5e00e96e6f.data: Sentinel-1 C-band VV SAR and Sentinel-2 optical data at five vegetated sites in Kenya, with in situ soil moisture.
