dc251491c438a0ebf01e6b1f3b05ec5e00e96e6f.result: The combined pixel- and object-based approach gives RMSE 4.94% and R2 0.89, versus 6.41% and 0.62 otherwise.
dc251491c438a0ebf01e6b1f3b05ec5e00e96e6f.open_work: Test dual polarization and other land covers and climates.
dc251491c438a0ebf01e6b1f3b05ec5e00e96e6f.issues: Few sites; single polarization; limited ground samples.

423b6341ecb121a141abbde89a9bef74942eb2db.goal: Forecasts PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations several hours ahead for early warning.
423b6341ecb121a141abbde89a9bef74942eb2db.architecture: Residual convolutional neural network with spatial-temporal attention (STA-ResCNN) after correlation-based selection of neighbouring pollution and meteorological inputs.
423b6341ecb121a141abbde89a9bef74942eb2db.data: Pollution and meteorological data for three major Yangtze River Delta cities, extended to 23 other cities in the region.
423b6341ecb121a141abbde89a9bef74942eb2db.result: Reduces 1–4 h average RMSE by 5.6–15.2% (PM2.5) and 6.8–16.9% (PM10) against baselines.
423b6341ecb121a141abbde89a9bef74942eb2db.open_work: Longer lead times and probabilistic forecasts.
423b6341ecb121a141abbde89a9bef74942eb2db.issues: Short horizons only; station data; no use of chemical transport model forecasts.

87dc02c2c1e79a6df4bdbc3302f0155373b80dc1.goal: Statistically downscales GCM-scale predictors to daily station temperature for hydrological impact studies.
87dc02c2c1e79a6df4bdbc3302f0155373b80dc1.architecture: Random forest compared with multiple linear regression, artificial neural network and support vector machine (PCA and partial correlation predictor selection for the latter).
87dc02c2c1e79a6df4bdbc3302f0155373b80dc1.data: Daily mean temperature at 61 stations in the Pearl River basin, China; NCEP-NCAR reanalysis predictors.
87dc02c2c1e79a6df4bdbc3302f0155373b80dc1.result: Random forest achieves the highest efficiency on five criteria and selects predictors without PCA.
87dc02c2c1e79a6df4bdbc3302f0155373b80dc1.open_work: Apply to GCM future scenarios and to precipitation.
87dc02c2c1e79a6df4bdbc3302f0155373b80dc1.issues: Trained on reanalysis; stationarity of relationships under climate change untested.

f2ff748cb7ee79e6128c0020c8c2feaac402487d.goal: Predicts sea level variation along the West Peninsular Malaysia coast using ocean and atmospheric drivers.
f2ff748cb7ee79e6128c0020c8c2feaac402487d.architecture: ARIMA, support vector regression and LSTM trained on four input scenarios.
f2ff748cb7ee79e6128c0020c8c2feaac402487d.data: Tide-gauge sea level with sea surface temperature, salinity, density, surface pressure, wind speed, cloud cover and precipitation.
f2ff748cb7ee79e6128c0020c8c2feaac402487d.result: Atmospheric variables matter more than ocean ones; mean R of 0.853 (LSTM), 0.748 (SVR), 0.710 (ARIMA); ARIMA best at tide-dominated Pulau Langkawi.
f2ff748cb7ee79e6128c0020c8c2feaac402487d.open_work: Separate tidal and non-tidal components and test longer leads.
f2ff748cb7ee79e6128c0020c8c2feaac402487d.issues: Few stations; tides dominate variance; forecast horizon unclear.

ffd769de295f558e20dbe8af8825a8f748195fb1.goal: Forecasts wind power at multiple horizons for grid operations.
ffd769de295f558e20dbe8af8825a8f748195fb1.architecture: Deep sequence-to-sequence LSTM regression (STSR-LSTM) with a gated recurrent neural network component.
ffd769de295f558e20dbe8af8825a8f748195fb1.data: Belgian wind power data (Elia, DSO-connected), with week-ahead, day-ahead and most-recent forecast classes.
ffd769de295f558e20dbe8af8825a8f748195fb1.result: Higher accuracy than two existing models across seasons and classes; numbers not given in the abstract.
ffd769de295f558e20dbe8af8825a8f748195fb1.open_work: Include NWP inputs and probabilistic outputs.
ffd769de295f558e20dbe8af8825a8f748195fb1.issues: Weak baselines; claimed gains lack quantitative support in the abstract.

2e7ba16993937eb6f543704e02c873da117459dc.goal: Produces complete-coverage daily 1 km PM2.5 across China from 2000 to present for exposure assessment.
2e7ba16993937eb6f543704e02c873da117459dc.architecture: Random forest fusing 10 km TAP PM2.5 predictions, 1 km satellite AOD and land use parameters.
2e7ba16993937eb6f543704e02c873da117459dc.data: National and local PM2.5 monitoring stations, 1 km AOD, road maps and gridded population, China 2000–2021.
2e7ba16993937eb6f543704e02c873da117459dc.result: Out-of-bag R2 0.80–0.84 annually; hindcast by-year cross-validation R2 0.76.
2e7ba16993937eb6f543704e02c873da117459dc.open_work: Extend to finer temporal resolution and PM2.5 components.
2e7ba16993937eb6f543704e02c873da117459dc.issues: Hindcast skill for early years is lower with sparse monitors; AOD gaps.

3440d702efef0388deb6995adb340078b0ddf7af.goal: Classifies ground-based sky images into cloud types for automated cloud observation.
3440d702efef0388deb6995adb340078b0ddf7af.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network features from pretrained layers, encoded (with pattern mining and Fisher vector) and classified with an SVM.
3440d702efef0388deb6995adb340078b0ddf7af.data: Ground-based cloud image datasets; specific datasets not reported here.
3440d702efef0388deb6995adb340078b0ddf7af.result: Reported higher accuracy than hand-crafted texture features on ground-based cloud classification benchmarks.
3440d702efef0388deb6995adb340078b0ddf7af.open_work: End-to-end training on larger labelled cloud datasets.
3440d702efef0388deb6995adb340078b0ddf7af.issues: Small datasets; class definitions vary between datasets.

2ae6e8558272f7d63b66972633b93366714fbcfb.goal: Simulates and predicts groundwater level fluctuations in the Miandarband plain, Iran.
2ae6e8558272f7d63b66972633b93366714fbcfb.architecture: ANFIS and hybrid wavelet-ANFIS models with fuzzy C-means clustering.
2ae6e8558272f7d63b66972633b93366714fbcfb.data: Observation-well groundwater levels and hydrological inputs for the Miandarband plain; details not reported here.
2ae6e8558272f7d63b66972633b93366714fbcfb.result: Not reported here; the title indicates hybrid wavelet-ANFIS and fuzzy C-means clustering models are compared with ANFIS.
2ae6e8558272f7d63b66972633b93366714fbcfb.open_work: Extend to other aquifers and longer leads.
2ae6e8558272f7d63b66972633b93366714fbcfb.issues: Single aquifer; details unverified without abstract.

02c7c1be8812252607ae932cb1e1b9038f517fdb.goal: Improves Europe-wide land-use regression models of annual air pollution 2000–2019 by allowing spatially varying relationships.
02c7c1be8812252607ae932cb1e1b9038f517fdb.architecture: Geographically weighted regression (GWR) and geographically and temporally weighted regression (GTWR), compared with supervised linear regression and random forest.
02c7c1be8812252607ae932cb1e1b9038f517fdb.data: Annual monitoring of NO2, O3, PM2.5, PM10 across Europe; satellite, CTM and land-use predictors.
02c7c1be8812252607ae932cb1e1b9038f517fdb.result: GWR/GTWR R2: NO2 0.66, O3 0.58, PM10 0.62, PM2.5 0.77, better than SLR and random forest.
02c7c1be8812252607ae932cb1e1b9038f517fdb.open_work: Higher temporal resolution and finer scales.
02c7c1be8812252607ae932cb1e1b9038f517fdb.issues: Modest gains; annual means only; sparse early-year monitoring.

4b0fc72ff7341ef18f36bacf5caf94a9b4205b0d.goal: Forecasts monthly streamflow with a hybrid wavelet and genetic programming approach.
4b0fc72ff7341ef18f36bacf5caf94a9b4205b0d.architecture: Wavelet-linear genetic programming (WLGP): wavelet decomposition of inputs combined with linear genetic programming.
4b0fc72ff7341ef18f36bacf5caf94a9b4205b0d.data: Monthly streamflow records; stations not reported here.
4b0fc72ff7341ef18f36bacf5caf94a9b4205b0d.result: Not reported here; the title indicates WLGP improves on standalone models.
4b0fc72ff7341ef18f36bacf5caf94a9b4205b0d.open_work: Test on other basins and multi-step leads.
4b0fc72ff7341ef18f36bacf5caf94a9b4205b0d.issues: Wavelet decomposition can leak future data; details unverified.

4251cd744191a6336ae55673e9e1f763999e2add.goal: Forecasts wind speed with combined deep learning, decomposition and multi-objective parameter optimization.
4251cd744191a6336ae55673e9e1f763999e2add.architecture: Hybrid time series decomposition, deep learning forecaster (network type not specified here) and multi-objective optimization of parameters.
4251cd744191a6336ae55673e9e1f763999e2add.data: Wind speed series; sites not reported here.
4251cd744191a6336ae55673e9e1f763999e2add.result: Not reported here; quantitative results are unknown without the abstract.
4251cd744191a6336ae55673e9e1f763999e2add.open_work: Extend to probabilistic and multi-step forecasts and test at more wind farm sites.
4251cd744191a6336ae55673e9e1f763999e2add.issues: Decomposition applied over the full series can leak future information; details are unverified without the abstract.

166227bbb359b0196a7abe26f0009a0e1fbef59d.goal: Predicts monthly oxygen and hydrogen isotope values of precipitation across Europe, where measurements are sparse, for hydrological, ecological and paleoclimate applications.
166227bbb359b0196a7abe26f0009a0e1fbef59d.architecture: Machine learning framework (Piso.AI) mapping climate and location predictors to monthly isotope values; the model type is not specified in the abstract.
166227bbb359b0196a7abe26f0009a0e1fbef59d.data: Measured precipitation isotope records in Europe with routinely updated gridded climate predictors; predictions cover any European location for 1950–2019.
166227bbb359b0196a7abe26f0009a0e1fbef59d.result: Prediction errors against measurements are substantially lower than those of other available isotope models, good enough to study interannual and long-term variability.
166227bbb359b0196a7abe26f0009a0e1fbef59d.open_work: Extend coverage beyond Europe and keep the product updated as climate data and new isotope measurements become available.
166227bbb359b0196a7abe26f0009a0e1fbef59d.issues: Accuracy depends on the density of isotope stations; error statistics and the learning algorithm are not given in the abstract.

5701c8ffa4fb8f0776915c693203ca0dfd4fb9c5.goal: Estimates global solar radiation and wind speed for Tamil Nadu, India, to avoid installing costly measuring instruments at every potential site.
5701c8ffa4fb8f0776915c693203ca0dfd4fb9c5.architecture: Random forest regression, compared with statistical regression models and a support vector machine (SVM).
5701c8ffa4fb8f0776915c693203ca0dfd4fb9c5.data: Measured wind speed and solar radiation data from the India Meteorological Department (IMD), Pune, for Tamil Nadu stations.
5701c8ffa4fb8f0776915c693203ca0dfd4fb9c5.result: Random forest gives the lowest error, with MSE 0.750 and R2 0.97, ahead of the regression and SVM models.
5701c8ffa4fb8f0776915c693203ca0dfd4fb9c5.open_work: Test true lead-time forecasting, more stations and spatial transfer to unmonitored sites.
5701c8ffa4fb8f0776915c693203ca0dfd4fb9c5.issues: Despite the title it is an estimation task rather than weather forecasting; inputs, period and validation split are not described.

d8215148d5ee8254a76ca79609e48343c045ea9e.goal: Predicts groundwater storage change in an overdrafted agricultural region while quantifying model uncertainty, as a cheap alternative to physical groundwater models.
d8215148d5ee8254a76ca79609e48343c045ea9e.architecture: Ensemble of an artificial neural network, a support vector machine and response surface regression, combined by Bayesian model averaging into a forecast distribution.
d8215148d5ee8254a76ca79609e48343c045ea9e.data: Agricultural water demand, groundwater extraction, surface water delivery and climate data for the San Joaquin River Basin, California, at subregional and regional scales.
d8215148d5ee8254a76ca79609e48343c045ea9e.result: Machine learning models predict well at low cost; the ensemble is consistently reliable but not always better than its best member; irrigation pumping drives storage change.
d8215148d5ee8254a76ca79609e48343c045ea9e.open_work: Apply the framework to other data-scarce agricultural basins and to scenario analysis of pumping and water deliveries.
d8215148d5ee8254a76ca79609e48343c045ea9e.issues: Data-driven surrogate without physical constraints; extrapolation to unprecedented pumping or drought conditions is untested.

875014ea3100b8fd12fff9890823a901160b8ce7.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed for wind energy by combining signal decomposition with a fast neural learner and error correction.
875014ea3100b8fd12fff9890823a901160b8ce7.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet decomposition, extreme learning machine (ELM) forecasting and an outlier correction algorithm.
875014ea3100b8fd12fff9890823a901160b8ce7.data: Measured wind speed series; sites and periods are not reported here.
875014ea3100b8fd12fff9890823a901160b8ce7.result: Not reported here; the title indicates the hybrid improves wind speed forecasts over simpler models.
875014ea3100b8fd12fff9890823a901160b8ce7.open_work: Extend to multi-step, probabilistic and multi-site forecasting.
875014ea3100b8fd12fff9890823a901160b8ce7.issues: Wavelet decomposition over the full series can leak future information; details are unverified without the abstract.

7ddcdb4e807a37a2d22f16e6836be50a86a92c52.goal: Estimates meteorological drought from satellite and reanalysis precipitation products where ground observations are limited.
7ddcdb4e807a37a2d22f16e6836be50a86a92c52.architecture: MLP, ANFIS, M5P model tree, GMDH and support vector regression trained per K-means cluster, then fused with ordered weighted averaging (ORNESS, ORLIKE) or k-nearest neighbours, with genetic-algorithm weights.
7ddcdb4e807a37a2d22f16e6836be50a86a92c52.data: GPCP, CMAP, CHOMPS, PERSIANN-CDR, TRMM, MERRA-2 and GLDAS-2 precipitation versus ground stations in Fars province, Iran, used to compute nonparametric SPI.
7ddcdb4e807a37a2d22f16e6836be50a86a92c52.result: ORNESS-OWA fusion performs best, with MARE 2.51% and R2 0.95, better than all individual models and other fusion schemes.
7ddcdb4e807a37a2d22f16e6836be50a86a92c52.open_work: Test the framework in other climates and for other drought indices and timescales.
7ddcdb4e807a37a2d22f16e6836be50a86a92c52.issues: Single province; the multi-stage pipeline with many tuned components risks overfitting; validation design is not detailed in the abstract.

c7ff33b947427ddbe7094ab86fa11c8709d919b1.goal: Maps urban flood risk for Rasht City, Iran, where hydrological data are too scarce for detailed hydraulic modelling.
c7ff33b947427ddbe7094ab86fa11c8709d919b1.architecture: Hazard mapping with CART, random forest, boosted regression trees, MARS, multivariate discriminant analysis and SVM; vulnerability from the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP).
c7ff33b947427ddbe7094ab86fa11c8709d919b1.data: 93 flood locations from the Gilan regional water company and field surveys, with elevation, slope, rainfall, drainage, soil, curve number and land-use factors.
c7ff33b947427ddbe7094ab86fa11c8709d919b1.result: CART is most accurate (AUC 0.947, accuracy 0.892, POD 0.867, FAR 0.071); distance to river and urban drainage dominate hazard, population density dominates vulnerability.
c7ff33b947427ddbe7094ab86fa11c8709d919b1.open_work: Add rainfall-scenario or hydraulic modelling to produce event-based, time-varying risk maps.
c7ff33b947427ddbe7094ab86fa11c8709d919b1.issues: Small flood inventory; static susceptibility map; AHP weights are subjective.

b51b68a68c719d2be8fd3c291780a85a1f73ac4c.goal: Predicts wheat crop yield in the Punjab region of north India to support planning by policy makers and farmers.
b51b68a68c719d2be8fd3c291780a85a1f73ac4c.architecture: Recurrent neural network with LSTM units (RNN-LSTM), compared with an artificial neural network, random forest and multivariate linear regression.
b51b68a68c719d2be8fd3c291780a85a1f73ac4c.data: A 43-year benchmark dataset for the Punjab region; predictor variables are not detailed in the abstract.
b51b68a68c719d2be8fd3c291780a85a1f73ac4c.result: RNN-LSTM gives RMSE 147.12 and MAE 60.50, against RMSE 540.88 (random forest), 732.14 (ANN) and 915.64 (linear regression).
b51b68a68c719d2be8fd3c291780a85a1f73ac4c.open_work: Add remote sensing and finer spatial units, and test year-ahead forecasting.
b51b68a68c719d2be8fd3c291780a85a1f73ac4c.issues: About 43 annual samples is very small for an LSTM; risk of overfitting and of a non-independent test split.

67745f24a3a5541db6cb311430c7a10b0b375b0b.goal: Produces a high-resolution monthly evapotranspiration (ET) product for China and analyses its spatiotemporal changes over three decades.
67745f24a3a5541db6cb311430c7a10b0b375b0b.architecture: Model tree ensemble (MTE) machine learning upscaling of eddy covariance ET using remote sensing and meteorological drivers.
67745f24a3a5541db6cb311430c7a10b0b375b0b.data: Eddy covariance flux tower ET observations and remote sensing data over China, 1982–2015; compared with other MTE, global and land-surface-model ET products.
67745f24a3a5541db6cb311430c7a10b0b375b0b.result: Mean annual ET is 552 ± 14 mm/yr and increased by 10.7 mm/yr per decade; about 22% of the area shows decreasing ET.
67745f24a3a5541db6cb311430c7a10b0b375b0b.open_work: Reconcile regional ET trends across products and add more flux sites in underrepresented regions.
67745f24a3a5541db6cb311430c7a10b0b375b0b.issues: Sparse flux towers limit upscaling; products agree on the national trend but disagree regionally.

bb09ffbbbcf4263f99ea969dbeada648d05059bd.goal: Solves ill-posed inverse problems for strongly nonlinear, weakly dispersive surface water waves governed by the Serre-Green-Naghdi equations.
bb09ffbbbcf4263f99ea969dbeada648d05059bd.architecture: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) trained with multi-fidelity data to infer unobserved velocity fields and initial states.
bb09ffbbbcf4263f99ea969dbeada648d05059bd.data: Experimental and synthetic (numerical) data of free-surface elevation and water depth.
bb09ffbbbcf4263f99ea969dbeada648d05059bd.result: PINNs recover depth-averaged velocity and initial states from surface elevation data and estimate wave impact on solid obstacles.
bb09ffbbbcf4263f99ea969dbeada648d05059bd.open_work: Extend to two-dimensional and field-scale coastal problems and to offshore structure design.
bb09ffbbbcf4263f99ea969dbeada648d05059bd.issues: Mostly idealized one-dimensional settings; PINN training cost and accuracy for long, complex time series are not quantified in the abstract.

4b82f6d50c98091f6b2868fed77edd37a75ec4de.goal: Forecasts long-term (two-year) PM2.5 and PM10 trends in Kolkata, India, to inform environmental policy.
4b82f6d50c98091f6b2868fed77edd37a75ec4de.architecture: Comparison of statistical models (AR, SARIMA, Holt-Winters) with deep learning models (stacked, bidirectional, autoencoder and convolutional LSTM).
4b82f6d50c98091f6b2868fed77edd37a75ec4de.data: Historical PM2.5 and PM10 data from government monitoring stations in Kolkata.
4b82f6d50c98091f6b2868fed77edd37a75ec4de.result: Statistical methods outperform the LSTM variants given the limited data available.
4b82f6d50c98091f6b2868fed77edd37a75ec4de.open_work: Use longer records and exogenous meteorological and emission drivers.
4b82f6d50c98091f6b2868fed77edd37a75ec4de.issues: Small dataset; single city; no error numbers given in the abstract.

2bb440e452a6f78a20aa3babe1032f5955184b57.goal: Forecasts photovoltaic power output 24 hours ahead to support grid scheduling.
2bb440e452a6f78a20aa3babe1032f5955184b57.architecture: Back propagation neural network (MLP) with a 28-20-11 structure, inputs chosen by correlation analysis.
2bb440e452a6f78a20aa3babe1032f5955184b57.data: Hourly solar irradiance, daily maximum, minimum and mean temperature and hourly power from a PV system in Ashland.
2bb440e452a6f78a20aa3babe1032f5955184b57.result: MAPE analysis indicates good accuracy and efficiency; specific error values are not given in the abstract.
2bb440e452a6f78a20aa3babe1032f5955184b57.open_work: Use numerical weather prediction forecasts as inputs and test other sites.
2bb440e452a6f78a20aa3babe1032f5955184b57.issues: Single site; uses observed rather than forecast weather; no baseline comparison.

0867d3a98b425084058fb248ded26e1bd367c3c2.goal: Generates weekly photovoltaic power scenarios from weather forecasts and historical output for power system planning.
0867d3a98b425084058fb248ded26e1bd367c3c2.architecture: BiLSTM-based super-resolution with bicubic interpolation (3-hourly to hourly forecasts), weather-process classification, and a GRU-CNN scenario generator.
0867d3a98b425084058fb248ded26e1bd367c3c2.data: PV power, weather observations and weather forecasts from five PV plants in Northeast Asia.
0867d3a98b425084058fb248ded26e1bd367c3c2.result: The method generates good-quality weekly scenarios by the proposed evaluation indices; numbers are not given in the abstract.
0867d3a98b425084058fb248ded26e1bd367c3c2.open_work: Extend to longer horizons and larger plant fleets.
0867d3a98b425084058fb248ded26e1bd367c3c2.issues: Few plants; quantitative skill and baseline comparisons are not reported in the abstract.

d62cb2d68d0515dc18db87aaba0de3ebc312a4e6.goal: Quantifies the seasonality of lake surface extent globally, which single-source satellite records cannot resolve.
d62cb2d68d0515dc18db87aaba0de3ebc312a4e6.architecture: Deep-learning-based spatiotemporal fusion of MODIS and Landsat-based datasets, run on high-performance computing.
d62cb2d68d0515dc18db87aaba0de3ebc312a4e6.data: MODIS and Landsat-based surface water datasets for 1.4 million lakes, monthly 2001–2023; validated against the Global Surface Water dataset.
d62cb2d68d0515dc18db87aaba0de3ebc312a4e6.result: Median user's and producer's accuracies are 93% and 96%; seasonality-dominated lakes make up 66% of global lake area and about 60% of lake counts.
d62cb2d68d0515dc18db87aaba0de3ebc312a4e6.open_work: Incorporate lake seasonality into climate models and extend fusion approaches to other water bodies.
d62cb2d68d0515dc18db87aaba0de3ebc312a4e6.issues: Fusion accuracy for small or persistently cloudy lakes is uncertain; validation is against another satellite product.

2dcd84b81e3c5bf4d1697b238f63a67b4baebe7c.goal: Compares machine learning and deep learning models for hourly global and diffuse solar radiation prediction to identify the most suitable algorithm for solar energy applications.
2dcd84b81e3c5bf4d1697b238f63a67b4baebe7c.architecture: Comparison of deep learning models (artificial neural network, convolutional neural network, recurrent neural network) against polynomial regression, support vector regression and random forest.
2dcd84b81e3c5bf4d1697b238f63a67b4baebe7c.data: Hourly typical meteorological year data covering 12 years at four locations in Nigeria for training and testing.
2dcd84b81e3c5bf4d1697b238f63a67b4baebe7c.result: Deep learning models give higher accuracy for both global and diffuse radiation; the RNN for global radiation at Yobe performs best (r 0.9546, RMSE 82.22 W/m2, MAE 36.52 W/m2), while most classical models train faster.
2dcd84b81e3c5bf4d1697b238f63a67b4baebe7c.open_work: Testing on more sites and climates, multi-step forecasting horizons, and hybrid models balancing accuracy and computational cost.
2dcd84b81e3c5bf4d1697b238f63a67b4baebe7c.issues: Only four Nigerian sites; typical meteorological year data are synthetic composites rather than actual time series; no uncertainty estimates or physical baselines.

8ff63f485071ce8bcf74d2a6a1c94a8a3b59345a.goal: Predicts short-term groundwater levels where on-site input data are scarce and low-dimensional.
8ff63f485071ce8bcf74d2a6a1c94a8a3b59345a.architecture: Canonical correlation forest with a combination of random features, an improved random forest regression variant, compared with two other regressors.
8ff63f485071ce8bcf74d2a6a1c94a8a3b59345a.data: Groundwater level and meteorological data (precipitation, temperature) from the Daguhe River groundwater source field, Qingdao, China.
8ff63f485071ce8bcf74d2a6a1c94a8a3b59345a.result: The proposed forest outperforms the compared regressors in accuracy, training time and tuning effort; best inputs are precipitation P(t-2), temperature T(t) and groundwater level H(t).
8ff63f485071ce8bcf74d2a6a1c94a8a3b59345a.open_work: Testing at other aquifers, longer horizons and with additional drivers such as pumping.
8ff63f485071ce8bcf74d2a6a1c94a8a3b59345a.issues: Single site with few inputs; no quantitative metrics in the abstract; short-term horizon only; no uncertainty quantification.

17aac69f3fb0c8f4fa8d90a6c9fe6c6e2bc7c580.goal: Compares deterministic (empirical or physical) and data-driven models for estimating solar radiation across China, where radiation stations are sparse.
17aac69f3fb0c8f4fa8d90a6c9fe6c6e2bc7c580.architecture: Comparison of deterministic solar radiation models with data-driven machine learning models; the specific network or learner types are not specified here.
17aac69f3fb0c8f4fa8d90a6c9fe6c6e2bc7c580.data: Station observations of solar radiation and meteorological variables in China; exact stations and periods not reported here.
17aac69f3fb0c8f4fa8d90a6c9fe6c6e2bc7c580.open_work: Identifying which model families transfer best across Chinese climate zones and combining physical and data-driven approaches.
17aac69f3fb0c8f4fa8d90a6c9fe6c6e2bc7c580.issues: Card based on the title only; conclusions depend on station coverage and input availability.

1be08f2864ddebe12e9bd47eabfbbcbe4c0087da.goal: Predicts solar radiation in Malaysia with a boosted decision tree regression model to support solar energy planning.
1be08f2864ddebe12e9bd47eabfbbcbe4c0087da.architecture: Boosted decision tree regression (gradient-boosted tree ensemble); comparison models not specified here.
1be08f2864ddebe12e9bd47eabfbbcbe4c0087da.data: Meteorological records from Malaysia; stations and period not reported here.
1be08f2864ddebe12e9bd47eabfbbcbe4c0087da.open_work: Testing at more sites and climates and longer forecast horizons.
1be08f2864ddebe12e9bd47eabfbbcbe4c0087da.issues: Card based on the title only; single-country case study; generalization untested.

2ff3be754d8f331d00680e8ea79208b76c9c42ec.goal: Intercompares 13 hydrologic models of different types over the Great Lakes region in a standardized setup to assess streamflow and other water-cycle variables.
2ff3be754d8f331d00680e8ea79208b76c9c42ec.architecture: Model intercomparison including a machine-learning model (an LSTM network) alongside lumped, subbasin-based and gridded physically based models with local, regional or global calibration.
2ff3be754d8f331d00680e8ea79208b76c9c42ec.data: Common geophysical datasets, forcings and routing product over the 1x10^6 km2 Great Lakes domain; streamflow gauges plus gridded references for actual evapotranspiration, surface soil moisture and snow water equivalent.
2ff3be754d8f331d00680e8ea79208b76c9c42ec.result: The machine-learning model gives the best streamflow in all experiments, including spatiotemporal validation; locally calibrated models degrade when transferred; grid-scale and basin-aggregated evaluation can give different conclusions.
2ff3be754d8f331d00680e8ea79208b76c9c42ec.open_work: Better spatial transfer strategies for locally calibrated models and extending the ML model to simulate AET, soil moisture and SWE.
2ff3be754d8f331d00680e8ea79208b76c9c42ec.issues: The ML model simulates only streamflow, so it is excluded from the multi-variable comparison; regionally calibrated models struggle in regulated, urban and agricultural basins.

e3725d5e3c7fe6e594402ab3d91c392aa9bedb08.goal: Assesses flood disaster risk with a random forest algorithm to support flood management.
e3725d5e3c7fe6e594402ab3d91c392aa9bedb08.architecture: Random forest classifier or regressor for flood risk assessment.
e3725d5e3c7fe6e594402ab3d91c392aa9bedb08.data: Flood risk indicators for the study region; data sources not reported here.
e3725d5e3c7fe6e594402ab3d91c392aa9bedb08.open_work: Validation in other regions and integration with hydrodynamic flood simulations.
e3725d5e3c7fe6e594402ab3d91c392aa9bedb08.issues: Card based on the title only; risk labels and evaluation design unknown.

0b3ee7cf3bfa263147a4186f849d3c8d0cf77770.goal: Estimates sea surface salinity in the river-influenced northern Gulf of Mexico from satellite ocean color, where salinity missions have coarse resolution and coastal problems.
0b3ee7cf3bfa263147a4186f849d3c8d0cf77770.architecture: Multilayer perceptron neural network mapping satellite remote-sensing reflectance and sea surface temperature to salinity.
0b3ee7cf3bfa263147a4186f849d3c8d0cf77770.data: MODIS/Aqua ocean color reflectance and SST matched with in situ salinity measurements in the northern Gulf of Mexico.
0b3ee7cf3bfa263147a4186f849d3c8d0cf77770.result: Produces salinity maps at ocean-color resolution that capture river plume structure; specific error statistics not reproduced here.
0b3ee7cf3bfa263147a4186f849d3c8d0cf77770.open_work: Extending to other river-dominated coastal regions and combining with SMAP or SMOS salinity retrievals.
0b3ee7cf3bfa263147a4186f849d3c8d0cf77770.issues: Relies on a regional empirical link between optically active constituents and salinity, which can break down where CDOM and salinity decouple; cloud gaps limit coverage.

24c8b758ee3d4ceb91e28a61eb1f9ddfdd5f5343.goal: Tests whether interannual variability in agricultural productivity in Chile can be predicted early in the season from freely available near-real-time data to support drought early warning.
24c8b758ee3d4ceb91e28a61eb1f9ddfdd5f5343.architecture: Optimal linear regression per census unit compared with a multilayer feedforward neural network (MLP, termed deep learning) combining all predictors and units.
24c8b758ee3d4ceb91e28a61eb1f9ddfdd5f5343.data: MODIS NDVI 2000–2017 (seasonal cumulative zcNDVI), satellite-rainfall standardized precipitation indices, PDO and MEI indices, growing season length and location for 758 census units.
24c8b758ee3d4ceb91e28a61eb1f9ddfdd5f5343.result: Leave-one-year-out R2 for the neural network is 0.96, 0.84, 0.65, 0.54, 0.46 and 0.38 at one to six months lead, nearly identical to optimal linear regression.
24c8b758ee3d4ceb91e28a61eb1f9ddfdd5f5343.open_work: Applying the approach to other regions and adding further predictors to improve skill at longer leads.
24c8b758ee3d4ceb91e28a61eb1f9ddfdd5f5343.issues: Only 17 seasons per unit; skill drops sharply beyond two months; the neural network adds little over linear regression; NDVI is only a proxy for productivity.

a2dfcd94c0a4c1a4c4828a10f769c19375f40da8.goal: Improves 10- and 30-minute wind speed forecasts for wind farm scheduling and grid integration using only historical wind speed.
a2dfcd94c0a4c1a4c4828a10f769c19375f40da8.architecture: Hybrid model: complementary ensemble empirical mode decomposition (CEEMD), back-propagation neural network (MLP) per component, with weights optimized by a modified wind driven optimization combined with the Broyden family.
a2dfcd94c0a4c1a4c4828a10f769c19375f40da8.data: 10-min and 30-min wind speed series from Shandong province, China.
a2dfcd94c0a4c1a4c4828a10f769c19375f40da8.result: The hybrid model improves forecasting accuracy and stability over the compared models; specific error values not given in the abstract.
a2dfcd94c0a4c1a4c4828a10f769c19375f40da8.open_work: Adding meteorological inputs and probabilistic outputs, and testing longer horizons and other sites.
a2dfcd94c0a4c1a4c4828a10f769c19375f40da8.issues: Univariate input only; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if decomposition uses the full series; single region.

18e20fdbca8ff2695ba07a01843f0e10e6f65086.goal: Forecasts streamflow over multiple time horizons with a hybrid artificial neural network to improve water resources management.
18e20fdbca8ff2695ba07a01843f0e10e6f65086.architecture: Artificial neural network coupled with a rolling mechanism and grey model algorithm (hybrid ANN-grey model).
18e20fdbca8ff2695ba07a01843f0e10e6f65086.data: Streamflow records from the study river; location and period not reported here.
18e20fdbca8ff2695ba07a01843f0e10e6f65086.open_work: Testing on more catchments and comparing with modern deep learning baselines.
18e20fdbca8ff2695ba07a01843f0e10e6f65086.issues: Card based on the title only; catchments, inputs and generalization not known.

29c0f51ac62469d53f40d65984abce8d32c9de20.goal: Discovers and forecasts rare extreme events in complex infinite-dimensional systems with very few samples, for problems such as rogue waves, pandemic spikes and structural failure.
29c0f51ac62469d53f40d65984abce8d32c9de20.architecture: Ensemble of deep neural operators (DeepONet) combined with output-weighted Bayesian experimental design (active learning) that selects samples informative about extremes.
29c0f51ac62469d53f40d65984abce8d32c9de20.data: Synthetic test problems from physical and societal systems, including nonlinear wave (rogue wave) and pandemic models.
29c0f51ac62469d53f40d65984abce8d32c9de20.result: Outperforms Gaussian processes; ensembles of two members work best; extremes are found regardless of initial data; double descent is eliminated; batched and Monte Carlo acquisition remain effective in high dimensions.
29c0f51ac62469d53f40d65984abce8d32c9de20.open_work: Applying the framework to real experimental or observational campaigns and larger climate and ocean models.
29c0f51ac62469d53f40d65984abce8d32c9de20.issues: Demonstrated on idealized model problems; requires a simulator or experiment that can be queried; real-world extremes may be harder to parameterize.

0497c53a405de2708549f452f78d2418591c7a40.goal: Estimates daily global solar radiation in Queensland, Australia, for solar energy assessment with an efficient hybrid machine learning scheme.
0497c53a405de2708549f452f78d2418591c7a40.architecture: Neuro-evolutionary hybrid: an evolutionary algorithm (coral reefs optimization) for predictor selection combined with an extreme learning machine neural network.
0497c53a405de2708549f452f78d2418591c7a40.data: Atmospheric predictor variables and solar radiation records at sites in Queensland; exact products and periods not reproduced here.
0497c53a405de2708549f452f78d2418591c7a40.result: The hybrid improves on the stand-alone learner in the authors' tests; specific metrics not reproduced here.
0497c53a405de2708549f452f78d2418591c7a40.open_work: Extending to other regions and forecasting rather than estimation, and adding uncertainty estimates.
0497c53a405de2708549f452f78d2418591c7a40.issues: No abstract available; details recalled from knowledge of the paper; limited number of sites.

6899c4168fe6efcff5b6dc2997d4d251616994f4.goal: Models daily river water temperature from air temperature for the Missouri River, since water temperature controls aquatic ecosystem health.
6899c4168fe6efcff5b6dc2997d4d251616994f4.architecture: Comparison of artificial neural network (MLP), Gaussian process regression and bootstrap aggregated decision trees against linear, nonlinear and stochastic standard models.
6899c4168fe6efcff5b6dc2997d4d251616994f4.data: Daily air and water temperature at three stations on the Missouri River.
6899c4168fe6efcff5b6dc2997d4d251616994f4.result: All three machine learning models perform comparably and beat the stochastic model, which beats the linear and nonlinear models; GPR is best at two stations, bagged trees at one.
6899c4168fe6efcff5b6dc2997d4d251616994f4.open_work: Adding inputs such as discharge and testing under climate change scenarios.
6899c4168fe6efcff5b6dc2997d4d251616994f4.issues: Air temperature is the main predictor, so effects of flow regulation and other drivers are ignored; only three stations.

06ac4d4f2137100066aa6a4b35bfadbe5333c0d9.goal: Estimates daily maximum 8-hour ground-level ozone at 10 km resolution in California for exposure and vegetation impact studies, using satellite ozone despite low boundary-layer sensitivity.
06ac4d4f2137100066aa6a4b35bfadbe5333c0d9.architecture: Machine learning regression model; the specific algorithm type is not specified in the abstract.
06ac4d4f2137100066aa6a4b35bfadbe5333c0d9.data: TROPOMI total ozone column, OMI ozone profile information, HRRR 3 km meteorology and land-use predictors, with ground monitor ozone as target.
06ac4d4f2137100066aa6a4b35bfadbe5333c0d9.result: 10-fold cross-validation R2 of 0.84 and RMSE 0.0059 ppm; TROPOMI improves estimation of extreme values; highest ozone in Los Angeles suburbs, lowest on Bay Area and Pacific coast.
06ac4d4f2137100066aa6a4b35bfadbe5333c0d9.open_work: Using a TROPOMI ozone profile product once released and extending to other regions and years.
06ac4d4f2137100066aa6a4b35bfadbe5333c0d9.issues: Random cross-validation may overstate spatial skill; satellite ozone has weak boundary-layer sensitivity; single state.

33e3034effe7f14bffee15468897d12cb89908d1.goal: Predicts monthly rainfall in the Taihu Basin, China, for water resources and flood planning using ensemble learning.
33e3034effe7f14bffee15468897d12cb89908d1.architecture: Stacking ensemble combining multiple base machine learning learners with a meta-learner; base learner types not specified here.
33e3034effe7f14bffee15468897d12cb89908d1.data: Monthly rainfall and predictor data for the Taihu Basin; predictors and period not reported here.
33e3034effe7f14bffee15468897d12cb89908d1.open_work: Testing at other basins and with large-scale climate indices as predictors.
33e3034effe7f14bffee15468897d12cb89908d1.issues: Card based on the title only; monthly rainfall skill typically limited; single basin.

3a0f189a60a84f92dd5efdc3e791e12424d6de8f.goal: Predicts river water level for flood warning to reduce economic and human losses.
3a0f189a60a84f92dd5efdc3e791e12424d6de8f.architecture: Hybrid recurrent neural network combining LSTM and GRU layers, compared with other model structures.
3a0f189a60a84f92dd5efdc3e791e12424d6de8f.data: Upstream and downstream water levels plus ASOS meteorological data (temperature, humidity, precipitation) in a Korean study area.
3a0f189a60a84f92dd5efdc3e791e12424d6de8f.result: The LSTM-GRU with ASOS inputs performs best: MSE 3.92, NSE 0.942, MAE 2.22, with a 55.49 cm error at the record maximum water level of 3552.38 cm.
3a0f189a60a84f92dd5efdc3e791e12424d6de8f.open_work: Building a flood risk management system that uses predicted water levels for evacuation decisions.
3a0f189a60a84f92dd5efdc3e791e12424d6de8f.issues: Single site; lead time not stated in the abstract; few extreme events for evaluation.

2506738f98b53aeda56e263ebfe52041da4f3329.goal: Models daily river water temperature, a key control on aquatic ecosystems, comparing fuzzy and neural approaches.
2506738f98b53aeda56e263ebfe52041da4f3329.architecture: Comparison of adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference systems (ANFIS) and artificial neural network models.
2506738f98b53aeda56e263ebfe52041da4f3329.data: Daily water temperature and meteorological inputs for river stations; locations not reported here.
2506738f98b53aeda56e263ebfe52041da4f3329.open_work: Adding hydrological inputs such as discharge and testing transfer across rivers.
2506738f98b53aeda56e263ebfe52041da4f3329.issues: Card based on the title only; station-specific empirical models with limited physical interpretability.

2a277eda43ea24d98e5639b3cadaacb449767485.goal: Organizes post-processing of solar forecasts into a goal-driven framework instead of method-based roster reviews.
2a277eda43ea24d98e5639b3cadaacb449767485.architecture: Review that classifies post-processing into deterministic-to-deterministic, probabilistic-to-deterministic, deterministic-to-probabilistic and probabilistic-to-probabilistic, with ten thinking tools such as regression, filtering, analog ensemble and ensemble calibration.
2a277eda43ea24d98e5639b3cadaacb449767485.data: Literature on solar forecast post-processing, including NWP, statistical and machine learning methods.
2a277eda43ea24d98e5639b3cadaacb449767485.result: Maps many post-processing methods onto ten thinking tools, letting forecasters enumerate possible adjustments; emphasizes the value of post-processing and applicability to wind.
2a277eda43ea24d98e5639b3cadaacb449767485.open_work: Outlook on future post-processing research, including combining and calibrating probabilistic forecasts.
2a277eda43ea24d98e5639b3cadaacb449767485.issues: Conceptual review without new quantitative benchmarks; focus is solar, with other domains discussed only briefly.

4d22a803634626de04c4dd0906b3b3a074a350a9.goal: Estimates yearly mean daily horizontal global solar radiation for solar investment decisions, robust to outliers and overfitting.
4d22a803634626de04c4dd0906b3b3a074a350a9.architecture: Fuzzy regression functions with support vector machine (FRF-SVM) using several kernels, compared with an adaptive neuro-fuzzy system and coplot-supported genetic programming.
4d22a803634626de04c4dd0906b3b3a074a350a9.data: Solar radiation dataset collected in Turkey.
4d22a803634626de04c4dd0906b3b3a074a350a9.result: FRF-SVM with a Gaussian kernel gives the most accurate estimates and is unaffected by outliers and overfitting.
4d22a803634626de04c4dd0906b3b3a074a350a9.open_work: Applying to other regions and finer temporal resolutions.
4d22a803634626de04c4dd0906b3b3a074a350a9.issues: Yearly mean targets give few samples; no metrics in the abstract; single country.

059e79472d50e0bb1f03e78ac149286ced296490.goal: Predicts rainfall with a random forest to help anticipate flooding.
059e79472d50e0bb1f03e78ac149286ced296490.data: Weather data from an unspecified Indonesian location; details not reported in the abstract.
059e79472d50e0bb1f03e78ac149286ced296490.result: Training-set evaluation gives 71.09% accuracy; 10-fold cross-validation gives 99.45% accuracy, kappa 0.99 and ROC area 1.
059e79472d50e0bb1f03e78ac149286ced296490.open_work: Testing on independent periods and stations and comparing with other classifiers.
059e79472d50e0bb1f03e78ac149286ced296490.issues: Near-perfect cross-validation scores exceeding training scores suggest leakage or an evaluation flaw; dataset and target definition unclear.

30e588cab83831530f57a4975dcc296ed0a1371d.goal: Estimates tropical cyclone intensity over the Northwest Pacific from geostationary infrared imagery.
30e588cab83831530f57a4975dcc296ed0a1371d.architecture: Deep convolutional neural networks with attention layers after the input, trained with focal loss to handle class imbalance; multi-class and binary classification variants.
30e588cab83831530f57a4975dcc296ed0a1371d.data: Himawari-8 AHI infrared brightness temperatures for 97 tropical cyclones (2015–2018) with best-track maximum sustained wind as reference.
30e588cab83831530f57a4975dcc296ed0a1371d.result: Best four-channel multi-class CNN: 84.8% accuracy, RMSE 5.24 m/s, bias -2.15 m/s; binary reformulation raises accuracy to 88.9% with RMSE 4.62 m/s and bias -0.76 m/s.
30e588cab83831530f57a4975dcc296ed0a1371d.open_work: Extending to other basins, more cases and regression of intensity rather than categories.
30e588cab83831530f57a4975dcc296ed0a1371d.issues: Small sample of 97 storms; rare intense categories underrepresented; best-track labels carry their own uncertainty.

b7417b3180cabda73558dcebdcb6eb975c56f19d.goal: Produces optimal prediction intervals for solar radiation forecasts, balancing coverage probability and interval width.
b7417b3180cabda73558dcebdcb6eb975c56f19d.architecture: Multi-objective evolutionary algorithm training neural networks (MLP) whose outputs are lower and upper interval bounds, compared with single-objective training and gradient-boosting quantile estimation.
b7417b3180cabda73558dcebdcb6eb975c56f19d.data: Solar radiation data; site and period not reported in the abstract.
b7417b3180cabda73558dcebdcb6eb975c56f19d.result: The multi-objective approach gives the best results and a single run yields intervals for any target coverage.
b7417b3180cabda73558dcebdcb6eb975c56f19d.open_work: Extending to other renewables and multi-step horizons.
b7417b3180cabda73558dcebdcb6eb975c56f19d.issues: Dataset details and numeric results not given in the abstract; evaluation scope unclear.

e0a362079f7289f714dbcd1e253c485b4d2a1059.goal: Estimates hourly PM2.5 at neighborhood scale (500 m) in Los Angeles County using low-cost sensors for exposure and environmental justice studies.
e0a362079f7289f714dbcd1e253c485b4d2a1059.architecture: Random forest with random oversampling of high concentrations and spatially and temporally varying predictors, plus a quality control scheme for sensor data.
e0a362079f7289f714dbcd1e253c485b4d2a1059.data: PurpleAir low-cost sensor network data with regulatory monitors and spatiotemporal predictors for Los Angeles County.
e0a362079f7289f714dbcd1e253c485b4d2a1059.result: 10-fold CV R2 0.93 (RMSE 3.23 ug/m3), spatial CV R2 0.88, temporal CV R2 0.90; captures diurnal and weekday patterns and holiday and wildfire days.
e0a362079f7289f714dbcd1e253c485b4d2a1059.open_work: Combining predictions with time-activity diaries for acute exposure and environmental justice studies.
e0a362079f7289f714dbcd1e253c485b4d2a1059.issues: Low-cost sensor biases depend on quality control; single metropolitan area; random CV may overstate skill.

28b9c727b55522a525b6fb36b927349ef0b95e02.goal: Builds a global observation-based monthly runoff reanalysis by upscaling sparse river discharge measurements to fill gaps in global freshwater maps.
28b9c727b55522a525b6fb36b927349ef0b95e02.architecture: Machine learning algorithm trained on in situ discharge and historical weather; the specific algorithm type is not specified in the abstract.
28b9c727b55522a525b6fb36b927349ef0b95e02.data: In situ river discharge measurements and 21 atmospheric forcing datasets, giving up to 525 ensemble members at 0.5° over up to a century; evaluated on large basins 1981–2010.
28b9c727b55522a525b6fb36b927349ef0b95e02.result: Accuracy on basins not used in calibration compares favourably with global hydrological models; global mean runoff estimated at 3.2–3.8x10^4 km3/yr; dataset publicly released.
28b9c727b55522a525b6fb36b927349ef0b95e02.open_work: Use for water resources assessment, attribution and calibration of global hydrological models.
28b9c727b55522a525b6fb36b927349ef0b95e02.issues: No representation of human water use or routing; quality limited in poorly gauged regions and by forcing errors.

ee31583b8f8f88104b12bcf97752dfc902679a07.goal: Forecasts 2D significant wave height in the South and East China Seas more cheaply than numerical wave models.
ee31583b8f8f88104b12bcf97752dfc902679a07.architecture: Convolutional LSTM (ConvLSTM) spatiotemporal network, with a variant trained specifically on extreme (typhoon) conditions.
ee31583b8f8f88104b12bcf97752dfc902679a07.data: WaveWatch III (WW3) reanalysis significant wave height fields for the South and East China Seas.
ee31583b8f8f88104b12bcf97752dfc902679a07.result: Normal conditions: correlation 0.98, 0.93, 0.83 and MAPE 15, 29, 61% at 6, 12, 24 h; typhoon conditions: correlation 0.98 and 0.94, MAPE 19 and 40% at 6 and 12 h.
ee31583b8f8f88104b12bcf97752dfc902679a07.open_work: Adding wind forcing inputs and extending lead times.
ee31583b8f8f88104b12bcf97752dfc902679a07.issues: Trained and evaluated on WW3 reanalysis rather than observations; errors grow rapidly with lead time; no wind forcing input mentioned.

be9e368c81883953f99d7aa1808f8a6769977799.goal: Improves multi-step short-term wind speed forecasting to reduce wind farm impacts on power systems.
be9e368c81883953f99d7aa1808f8a6769977799.architecture: Hybrid of two-layer signal decomposition, phase space reconstruction and kernel extreme learning machine (KELM), with parameters tuned by improved hybrid differential evolution-Harris hawks optimization.
be9e368c81883953f99d7aa1808f8a6769977799.data: Three wind speed datasets from Sotavento Galicia wind farm, Spain.
be9e368c81883953f99d7aa1808f8a6769977799.result: Outperforms six related models across several prediction horizons; specific metrics not in the abstract.
be9e368c81883953f99d7aa1808f8a6769977799.open_work: Probabilistic forecasts and inclusion of NWP inputs.
be9e368c81883953f99d7aa1808f8a6769977799.issues: Single wind farm; complex hybrid pipeline with many tuned parameters; decomposition may leak future information.

ad5cc18a51bb0cd1357faec2ff746c7f8d891317.goal: Simulates and forecasts groundwater levels efficiently without building detailed flow models, for water resource management.
ad5cc18a51bb0cd1357faec2ff746c7f8d891317.architecture: Wavelet transform combined with a multivariate LSTM network (WT-MLSTM) that models external-control terms from factors such as river stage.
ad5cc18a51bb0cd1357faec2ff746c7f8d891317.data: Groundwater level and river stage records from the Liangshui River Basin, Beijing, China, and the Cibola National Wildlife Refuge on the lower Colorado River, USA.
ad5cc18a51bb0cd1357faec2ff746c7f8d891317.result: WT-MLSTM is more accurate than LSTM, MLSTM, WT-LSTM and SVM; applicability decreases with distance from the river and with more complex groundwater patterns.
ad5cc18a51bb0cd1357faec2ff746c7f8d891317.open_work: Including additional controlling factors such as pumping for wells far from rivers.
ad5cc18a51bb0cd1357faec2ff746c7f8d891317.issues: Predictability limited to short horizons; performance depends on proximity to the river; few sites.

b37d0f41eda1d345f62cdbb7134d27313005397d.goal: Forecasts solar radiation for photovoltaic energy management using deep learning and ensemble learning.
b37d0f41eda1d345f62cdbb7134d27313005397d.architecture: Convolutional neural network combined with ensemble learning methods; exact configuration not reported here.
b37d0f41eda1d345f62cdbb7134d27313005397d.data: Solar radiation and meteorological time series; site and period not reported here.
b37d0f41eda1d345f62cdbb7134d27313005397d.open_work: Testing over multiple sites and horizons and adding probabilistic outputs.
b37d0f41eda1d345f62cdbb7134d27313005397d.issues: Card based on the title only; generalization and baselines unknown.

afe1e8595ad022e56ebf13991767e05c34e50eae.goal: Provides fine-grained city-wide air pollution estimation and station-level forecasts that capture spatio-temporal interactions with urban dynamics.
afe1e8595ad022e56ebf13991767e05c34e50eae.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM (Deep-AIR) with 1x1 convolution layers for spatial-temporal interaction, plus saliency analysis.
afe1e8595ad022e56ebf13991767e05c34e50eae.data: Air pollution, weather, urban morphology, transport and time features for Hong Kong and Beijing.
afe1e8595ad022e56ebf13991767e05c34e50eae.result: Beats baselines by 1.5, 2.7 and 2.3% (Hong Kong) and 1.4, 1.4 and 3.3% (Beijing) for 1-h estimation and 1-h and 24-h forecasts; street canyon and road density drive NO2 in Hong Kong.
afe1e8595ad022e56ebf13991767e05c34e50eae.open_work: Extending to more cities and longer horizons.
afe1e8595ad022e56ebf13991767e05c34e50eae.issues: Accuracy gains over baselines are small; fine-grained estimation validated only at stations.

3167b994e87e53b0a64ea22897e52423975f20fe.goal: Evaluates the medium-term field performance and calibration of low-cost electrochemical NO and NO2 sensors for urban monitoring.
3167b994e87e53b0a64ea22897e52423975f20fe.architecture: Comparison of multivariate linear regression, support vector regression and random forest field calibration models.
3167b994e87e53b0a64ea22897e52423975f20fe.data: Sensors co-located for 4 months at a rural regulatory site in Switzerland, then deployed 4 months at two urban regulatory sites (traffic and background), with hourly reference data.
3167b994e87e53b0a64ea22897e52423975f20fe.result: Nonlinear models reach RMSE below 5 ppb, R2 0.74–0.95 and MAE 2–4 ppb; drift 5–10 ppb for random forest and 15 ppb for linear regression; NO differences of 5–10 ppb resolvable at 90% confidence.
3167b994e87e53b0a64ea22897e52423975f20fe.open_work: Applying the methodology to other sensor types and pollutants and addressing drift with recalibration.
3167b994e87e53b0a64ea22897e52423975f20fe.issues: Single sensor model; calibration drifts over the deployment; lowest reliably estimated concentration around 15–20 ppb.

6759db13a9d8bcbd2da4f124e4c185639f0d85b3.goal: Compares a deep learning model with a physically based model for simulating and projecting runoff extremes and uncertainty under CMIP6 scenarios.
6759db13a9d8bcbd2da4f124e4c185639f0d85b3.architecture: LSTM network versus the SWAT hydrological model, with Bayesian model averaging and reliability ensemble averaging for uncertainty, and GEV analysis of extremes.
6759db13a9d8bcbd2da4f124e4c185639f0d85b3.data: 11 CMIP6 GCMs bias-corrected by quantile mapping against 6 weather stations (1985–2014), SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5 to 2100, runoff gauges in the Yeongsan Basin, South Korea.
6759db13a9d8bcbd2da4f124e4c185639f0d85b3.result: LSTM reproduces observed extreme runoff better than SWAT; SWAT projects a 17.7% increase while LSTM projects a 13.6% decrease; LSTM has lower historical but higher future uncertainty.
6759db13a9d8bcbd2da4f124e4c185639f0d85b3.open_work: Understanding why data-driven and process models diverge under future climate and constraining LSTM extrapolation.
6759db13a9d8bcbd2da4f124e4c185639f0d85b3.issues: Opposite projected trends reveal LSTM extrapolation risk outside the training climate; single basin.

982ccc1f9e0d1be0ca230ca6a223f15f9900eeb3.goal: Statistically downscales climatic parameters from large-scale model outputs to local scale for climate impact studies.
982ccc1f9e0d1be0ca230ca6a223f15f9900eeb3.architecture: Artificial neural network downscaling with a decision tree method used to screen and select predictors.
982ccc1f9e0d1be0ca230ca6a223f15f9900eeb3.data: Large-scale climate predictors and local station observations; specific GCM and stations not reported here.
982ccc1f9e0d1be0ca230ca6a223f15f9900eeb3.open_work: Applying to future scenarios and comparing with other downscaling approaches.
982ccc1f9e0d1be0ca230ca6a223f15f9900eeb3.issues: Card based on the title only; station-based downscaling assumes stationary predictor-predictand relationships.

dc5f8a79d93a515c711a12a568a8751a53b334ed.goal: Reviews intra-hour solar irradiance forecasting methods that help grids cope with solar power variability.
dc5f8a79d93a515c711a12a568a8751a53b334ed.architecture: Review of regressive, stochastic learning, deep learning and genetic algorithm tools, and of data-driven, local-sensing (e.g., sky imager), hybrid, probabilistic and spatial forecasting methods.
dc5f8a79d93a515c711a12a568a8751a53b334ed.result: Summarizes the theories and application of intra-hour forecasting methodologies and gives suggestions for future development.
dc5f8a79d93a515c711a12a568a8751a53b334ed.open_work: Accelerating development of intra-hour methods, including probabilistic and spatial forecasts.
dc5f8a79d93a515c711a12a568a8751a53b334ed.issues: Narrative review without new benchmark comparisons.

903486b69be26a91a29f38f05e65498d97882431.goal: Forecasts soil moisture to support smart irrigation decisions, arguing machine learning is now ready for this task.
903486b69be26a91a29f38f05e65498d97882431.architecture: Machine learning models for soil moisture forecasting; the specific model types are not specified here.
903486b69be26a91a29f38f05e65498d97882431.data: Soil moisture and weather data for irrigated fields; sources not reported here.
903486b69be26a91a29f38f05e65498d97882431.open_work: Operational integration into irrigation scheduling and testing across soils and crops.
903486b69be26a91a29f38f05e65498d97882431.issues: Card based on the title only; site-specific data may limit transfer.

0ae04c8ff866591515785e70c6ab7f3c7b7736d6.goal: Predicts evapotranspiration of drip-irrigated greenhouse tomatoes, where Penman-Monteith based methods are often inaccurate.
0ae04c8ff866591515785e70c6ab7f3c7b7736d6.architecture: XGBoost regression (XGBR-ET) compared with linear regression, SVR, k-nearest neighbors, random forest, AdaBoost, bagging and gradient boosting regression.
0ae04c8ff866591515785e70c6ab7f3c7b7736d6.data: Greenhouse experiment data 2019–2021 with eight meteorological factors (net radiation, temperatures, humidities, wind speed) and measured ET.
0ae04c8ff866591515785e70c6ab7f3c7b7736d6.result: XGBR-ET is best (RMSE 0.163, MAPE 4.47%, R2 0.981); net radiation is the most important factor; a five-variable input set keeps accuracy (MSE 0.047).
0ae04c8ff866591515785e70c6ab7f3c7b7736d6.open_work: Simplifying ET calculation for irrigation programs and testing other crops and greenhouses.
0ae04c8ff866591515785e70c6ab7f3c7b7736d6.issues: Single greenhouse and crop over three years; random forest ranking last is unusual and may reflect tuning.

6472ee0d5047e615021788d8127e7239750da6e0.goal: Predicts rainfall-runoff in real time for flood forecasting with a fast gradient boosting model.
6472ee0d5047e615021788d8127e7239750da6e0.architecture: Light gradient boosting machine (LightGBM) coupled with singular spectrum analysis for signal decomposition.
6472ee0d5047e615021788d8127e7239750da6e0.data: Rainfall and runoff records for the study catchment; details not reported here.
6472ee0d5047e615021788d8127e7239750da6e0.open_work: Testing on more catchments and longer lead times.
6472ee0d5047e615021788d8127e7239750da6e0.issues: Card based on the title only; decomposition-based preprocessing can leak future information if applied to the full series.

ebd55f5b5d0ea26a3d5364835ec6765035bd48d4.goal: Builds multi-variable flood damage models with limited data, improving on depth-only damage curves.
ebd55f5b5d0ea26a3d5364835ec6765035bd48d4.architecture: Supervised learning: regression trees, bagged regression trees, random forest and a Bayesian network.
ebd55f5b5d0ea26a3d5364835ec6765035bd48d4.data: Residential building and contents damage from the 1993 Meuse flood (Netherlands), enriched with 2-D flood simulation (velocity, duration, return period) and cadastre building data.
ebd55f5b5d0ea26a3d5364835ec6765035bd48d4.result: The enriched data with supervised learning reduce mean absolute error by 20% versus a depth-only model; tree-based methods beat the Bayesian network.
ebd55f5b5d0ea26a3d5364835ec6765035bd48d4.open_work: Collecting richer damage datasets and testing transfer to other floods.
ebd55f5b5d0ea26a3d5364835ec6765035bd48d4.issues: Single historical flood; enriched variables come from simulations with their own errors; transferability untested.

53848b670d93f27e4dc8c140ecc31a7d258639e7.goal: Forecasts monthly river flow in a semi-arid environment with a reliable data-intelligence model.
53848b670d93f27e4dc8c140ecc31a7d258639e7.architecture: Wavelet-preprocessed extreme learning machine (WA-ELM) compared with a stand-alone ELM neural network.
53848b670d93f27e4dc8c140ecc31a7d258639e7.data: Monthly river flow 1991–2010 at a semi-arid site, using antecedent flow as predictor.
53848b670d93f27e4dc8c140ecc31a7d258639e7.result: WA-ELM reduces RMSE by 65% and MAE by 67% relative to ELM and better reproduces the flow distribution across regimes.
53848b670d93f27e4dc8c140ecc31a7d258639e7.open_work: Adding climate predictors and testing other rivers.
53848b670d93f27e4dc8c140ecc31a7d258639e7.issues: Single river and antecedent-flow-only inputs; wavelet preprocessing may leak future information; only a weak ELM baseline.

de8ac5752362608da615bc695792a9839422d5c9.goal: Detects forest fires early from geostationary imagery to reduce detection latency compared with threshold-based contextual methods.
de8ac5752362608da615bc695792a9839422d5c9.architecture: Random forest and convolutional neural network models using spatial and temporal input features, with data augmentation.
de8ac5752362608da615bc695792a9839422d5c9.data: Himawari-8 AHI 10-minute imagery and recorded forest fire cases (South Korea).
de8ac5752362608da615bc695792a9839422d5c9.result: Best CNN: accuracy 0.98, precision 0.91, recall 0.63, F1 0.74 versus RF F1 0.54; detects all test fires within 12 min on average and outperforms operational active-fire products.
de8ac5752362608da615bc695792a9839422d5c9.open_work: Improving recall and extending to other regions and sensors.
de8ac5752362608da615bc695792a9839422d5c9.issues: Recall remains moderate; limited number of fire cases; small fires below pixel resolution may be missed.

5f3ddc1828db6ce3d9034c370ece24a71ebc54fd.goal: Provides probabilistic precipitation forecasts in complex terrain while selecting variables and interactions automatically.
5f3ddc1828db6ce3d9034c370ece24a71ebc54fd.architecture: Distributional regression trees and forests blending random forests with GAMLSS distributions, including censored and truncated variants, compared with GAMLSS and boosting.
5f3ddc1828db6ce3d9034c370ece24a71ebc54fd.data: Numerical weather prediction ensemble quantities (GEFS reforecasts) and precipitation observations at numerous stations in Tyrol, Austria.
5f3ddc1828db6ce3d9034c370ece24a71ebc54fd.result: Distributional forests select variables and interactions automatically and perform on par or better than GAMLSS based on meteorological knowledge or boosting.
5f3ddc1828db6ce3d9034c370ece24a71ebc54fd.open_work: Extension to other variables, spatial modeling and larger predictor sets.
5f3ddc1828db6ce3d9034c370ece24a71ebc54fd.issues: Station-wise models; evaluated in one mountainous region; computational cost and interpretability of forests.

7c09d99779cd51a48a36b9fe28e715289f8acd06.goal: Retrieves global ocean surface wind speed from CYGNSS GNSS reflectometry observations with deep learning, aiming to beat the operational empirical geophysical model function retrieval.
7c09d99779cd51a48a36b9fe28e715289f8acd06.architecture: CyGNSSnet, a deep learning model that combines a convolutional neural network (CNN) on delay-Doppler maps with fully connected layers for ancillary scalar inputs.
7c09d99779cd51a48a36b9fe28e715289f8acd06.data: CYGNSS Level-1 delay-Doppler maps and metadata, with ERA5 reanalysis winds as the reference target; exact period and splits not reported here.
7c09d99779cd51a48a36b9fe28e715289f8acd06.result: CyGNSSnet reduces wind speed retrieval error relative to the operational CYGNSS Level-2 product; exact figures not restated here.
7c09d99779cd51a48a36b9fe28e715289f8acd06.open_work: Improving high-wind retrievals, extending to newer CYGNSS data versions and other GNSS-R missions, and adding uncertainty estimates.
7c09d99779cd51a48a36b9fe28e715289f8acd06.issues: Trained against ERA5 winds, so it inherits reanalysis biases; high winds are rare in training and remain hard to retrieve accurately.

418305b7387cc454378e49b2c74b42519c84b8f5.goal: Builds a long, gap-free global surface soil moisture record by calibrating and fusing multiple microwave satellite products, since existing long-term products have limited accuracy.
418305b7387cc454378e49b2c74b42519c84b8f5.architecture: Large ensemble of neural networks (67 independent networks, over 1 million localized subnetworks, five rounds of iterative simulation) that calibrates 11 microwave products toward SMAP using nine quality factors.
418305b7387cc454378e49b2c74b42519c84b8f5.data: Eleven microwave soil moisture products since 2003 with SMAP as the training target; validation against International Soil Moisture Network (ISMN) in situ sites; output 0.1 degree, about 10-day, 2003-2018.
418305b7387cc454378e49b2c74b42519c84b8f5.result: Training R2 is 0.95; against ISMN sites RSSSM gives R2 0.42 and RMSE 0.087 m3/m3 versus 0.31-0.41 and 0.095-0.142 for other products, performing best in arid and cold regions.
418305b7387cc454378e49b2c74b42519c84b8f5.open_work: Extending the record as new microwave sensors become available, and improving accuracy in humid, frozen and densely vegetated areas.
418305b7387cc454378e49b2c74b42519c84b8f5.issues: Training target is SMAP, so earlier years rely on extrapolation of a SMAP-like climatology; in situ agreement is still modest (R2 0.42) and temporal resolution is only about 10 days.

d83d450ea3dd35df24c09be4114eaf5e1f41684b.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction by using several local meteorological measurements together rather than wind speed alone.
d83d450ea3dd35df24c09be4114eaf5e1f41684b.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN, multilayer perceptron) models with univariate and multivariable inputs (wind speed, temperature, pressure), compared with the persistence method.
d83d450ea3dd35df24c09be4114eaf5e1f41684b.data: High-frequency local measurements of wind speed, wind direction, temperature and pressure from a monitoring system in Eskisehir, Turkey.
d83d450ea3dd35df24c09be4114eaf5e1f41684b.result: Multivariable ANN models improve wind speed prediction RMSE and MAE over wind-speed-only models and persistence for various cases; exact numbers not given in the abstract.
d83d450ea3dd35df24c09be4114eaf5e1f41684b.open_work: Testing at more sites, longer horizons and with modern sequence models.
d83d450ea3dd35df24c09be4114eaf5e1f41684b.issues: Single-site study with limited data; skill gains are case-dependent and no uncertainty quantification is provided.

bf532f63091f1f9d03866df324fd532ed3c45c21.goal: Quantifies long-term trends in snow cover extent and duration over global mountain regions, where a consistent multi-decadal picture was lacking.
bf532f63091f1f9d03866df324fd532ed3c45c21.architecture: Artificial neural networks used to harmonize model data and satellite images into a consistent snow cover time series, followed by trend analysis.
bf532f63091f1f9d03866df324fd532ed3c45c21.data: Model snow data combined with satellite imagery over global mountain areas, 1982-2020; specific products not named in the abstract.
bf532f63091f1f9d03866df324fd532ed3c45c21.result: Overall negative trends of -3.6% +/- 2.7% in yearly snow cover extent and -15.1 +/- 11.6 days in duration; winter shows the largest decline, spring increases mostly in High Mountain Asia; a regime shift appears in the 1980s-1990s.
bf532f63091f1f9d03866df324fd532ed3c45c21.open_work: Linking the snow trends to water resources impacts for mountain communities and attributing the regime shift.
bf532f63091f1f9d03866df324fd532ed3c45c21.issues: The harmonized record depends on the neural network merging of heterogeneous sources, which may introduce inhomogeneities; uncertainty ranges are wide.

5d8eb3f7e89bf1bb746b4720566aaf3ff2944b49.goal: Improves both the accuracy and interpretability of satellite-based PM2.5 estimation, which current machine learning methods lack.
5d8eb3f7e89bf1bb746b4720566aaf3ff2944b49.architecture: Spatial-Temporal Interpretable Deep Learning Model (SIDLM), a wide-and-deep neural network that extracts spatial and temporal features interpretably.
5d8eb3f7e89bf1bb746b4720566aaf3ff2944b49.data: Satellite top-of-atmosphere (TOA) reflectance or aerosol optical depth (AOD), with or without meteorological data, against ground PM2.5 stations in China at 10 km, 3 km and 250 m (Beijing).
5d8eb3f7e89bf1bb746b4720566aaf3ff2944b49.result: TOA-based SIDLM reaches RMSE 15.30 and 15.96 ug/m3 (R2 0.70 and 0.66) at 10 and 3 km, and RMSE 16.01 ug/m3 (R2 0.62) at 250 m over Beijing, beating five other machine learning methods.
5d8eb3f7e89bf1bb746b4720566aaf3ff2944b49.open_work: Applying SIDLM to other Earth observation retrieval tasks and spatiotemporal analyses.
5d8eb3f7e89bf1bb746b4720566aaf3ff2944b49.issues: R2 around 0.6-0.7 leaves substantial unexplained variance; evaluation is confined to China, and the interpretability claims are qualitative.

ef85c69b9ddac79c2e4cb1048c81d9dd59c45e12.goal: Estimates the maize crop coefficient Kc at high spatial and temporal resolution for field-scale evapotranspiration and precision irrigation.
ef85c69b9ddac79c2e4cb1048c81d9dd59c45e12.architecture: Random forest regression (RFR) compared with multiple linear regression (MLR), using ground LAI and six UAV multispectral vegetation indices as predictors.
ef85c69b9ddac79c2e4cb1048c81d9dd59c45e12.data: Ground-based LAI and UAV multispectral indices (NDVI, SAVI, EVI, TCARI, GNDVI, VARI) for a maize field under multiple irrigation treatments over a full season; ET compared with soil water balance and FAO-56.
ef85c69b9ddac79c2e4cb1048c81d9dd59c45e12.result: RFR estimates daily Kc with R2 of 0.65; red-edge/red and green/red indices plus LAI are the best predictors, enabling centimeter-scale Kc maps.
ef85c69b9ddac79c2e4cb1048c81d9dd59c45e12.open_work: Testing transferability to other crops, sites and seasons and fully replacing ground LAI with UAV-derived estimates.
ef85c69b9ddac79c2e4cb1048c81d9dd59c45e12.issues: Single field and season; moderate accuracy (R2 0.65), and the model depends on ground LAI measurements.

2b5201edddcc57d4ef0f69ac24aa9a739e1de1b1.goal: Forecasts solar radiation and photovoltaic energy production to support PV plant participation in energy markets and resource planning.
2b5201edddcc57d4ef0f69ac24aa9a739e1de1b1.architecture: ARIMA statistical time series model compared with an artificial neural network (ANN), plus a GMDH (group method of data handling) model proposed for PV production calculation.
2b5201edddcc57d4ef0f69ac24aa9a739e1de1b1.data: Measured historical data from a laboratory BIPV system at the Polytechnic University of Bucharest and a large PV park in southern Romania.
2b5201edddcc57d4ef0f69ac24aa9a739e1de1b1.result: ARIMA is found more efficient than the ANN for these cases; a solar radiation variability index improves the models.
2b5201edddcc57d4ef0f69ac24aa9a739e1de1b1.open_work: Developing the GMDH-based software tool and testing modern deep learning forecasters.
2b5201edddcc57d4ef0f69ac24aa9a739e1de1b1.issues: Two Romanian case studies only; the ANN baseline is simple, so the ARIMA advantage may not generalize.

49db1150e02c1d1092a0639c9dc8b6494a2a9d75.goal: Maps regional flood susceptibility and compares an expert-driven multi-criteria approach with machine learning to support flood risk assessment under the EU Floods Directive.
49db1150e02c1d1092a0639c9dc8b6494a2a9d75.architecture: Multi-criteria decision analysis with analytical hierarchy process (MCDA-AHP) compared with boosted classification trees (BCT) and boosted regression trees (BRT).
49db1150e02c1d1092a0639c9dc8b6494a2a9d75.data: 107 flood locations and seven conditioning factors (elevation, slope, river network density, distance from river, flow accumulation, curve number, lithology) in the Topla river basin, Slovakia.
49db1150e02c1d1092a0639c9dc8b6494a2a9d75.result: Machine learning models are more accurate: 87.70% (BCT) and 91.42% (BRT) versus 81.33% for MCDA-AHP; about 38-45% of the basin is classed as high to very high susceptibility.
49db1150e02c1d1092a0639c9dc8b6494a2a9d75.open_work: Adding more conditioning factors and flood events, and linking susceptibility to hazard and risk mapping.
49db1150e02c1d1092a0639c9dc8b6494a2a9d75.issues: Small flood inventory in one basin; susceptibility maps are static and do not represent flood magnitude or frequency.

2d930bb96f0479d569d618202cc4f881e327dc3b.goal: Improves cloud detection in satellite imagery, including discrimination of thin and thick cloud and snow/ice, by using both spectral and textural features.
2d930bb96f0479d569d618202cc4f881e327dc3b.architecture: Two random forest classifiers: feature-level fusion (FLFRF) of visible, infrared and thermal spectral and textural features (GLCM, RELBP_CI), and decision-level fusion (DLFRF) by majority vote.
2d930bb96f0479d569d618202cc4f881e327dc3b.data: 10 Terra MODIS and 15 Landsat 8 OLI/TIRS images with manually selected ground truth; compared with LDA, CART, KNN, SVM and Fmask.
2d930bb96f0479d569d618202cc4f881e327dc3b.result: Average cloud kappa reaches 1 and 0.99 on MODIS (versus 0.96 for other methods) with higher snow/ice kappa; on Landsat 8 the models separate thin and thick cloud, unlike Fmask.
2d930bb96f0479d569d618202cc4f881e327dc3b.open_work: Testing on larger and more diverse image sets and other sensors.
2d930bb96f0479d569d618202cc4f881e327dc3b.issues: Small number of scenes and manually selected ground truth, so near-perfect kappa values may be optimistic.

b1699907aa639fe3f6674754d71142305d5cfe7c.goal: News feature discussing how machine learning could help improve climate models and climate forecasts.
b1699907aa639fe3f6674754d71142305d5cfe7c.architecture: News/review-style article on machine learning for climate modelling, such as learning sub-grid processes like clouds from data or high-resolution simulations; not a primary research method.
b1699907aa639fe3f6674754d71142305d5cfe7c.data: Not applicable; journalistic overview of ongoing research efforts.
b1699907aa639fe3f6674754d71142305d5cfe7c.result: Describes the promise of machine learning for climate prediction alongside skepticism among climate scientists; no quantitative results.
b1699907aa639fe3f6674754d71142305d5cfe7c.open_work: Demonstrating that machine-learned components work stably inside climate models and improve projections.
b1699907aa639fe3f6674754d71142305d5cfe7c.issues: Journalistic piece without new results; details of the projects covered are not summarized here.

812371378a121b1285a67fc71dfeb225d24cc944.goal: Maps drought sensitivity of vegetation cover by linking meteorological drought indicators to vegetation response.
812371378a121b1285a67fc71dfeb225d24cc944.architecture: Two one-class support vector machine (OC-SVM) algorithms using elevation, slope, aspect and geomorphic classes as criteria.
812371378a121b1285a67fc71dfeb225d24cc944.data: SPI from synoptic stations (1978-2008) and EVI from MODIS (2001-2010) in Kermanshah province, Iran.
812371378a121b1285a67fc71dfeb225d24cc944.result: Distinct spatio-temporal patterns of drought impacts on vegetation are found; the drought sensitivity map reaches AUC of 0.80.
812371378a121b1285a67fc71dfeb225d24cc944.open_work: Adding further predictors such as soil and land use, and testing in other regions.
812371378a121b1285a67fc71dfeb225d24cc944.issues: Single province, coarse station network and short MODIS record; the accuracy assessment is limited.

162d8f5f3052fc1bc711a86cefa7bef177794e0c.goal: Detects tropical cyclones and their precursors in global cloud-resolving simulations to explore early identification of TC genesis.
162d8f5f3052fc1bc711a86cefa7bef177794e0c.architecture: Ensemble of two-dimensional deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for binary TC/non-TC classification.
162d8f5f3052fc1bc711a86cefa7bef177794e0c.data: Simulated outgoing longwave radiation from a cloud-resolving global nonhydrostatic model (NICAM): 20 years for training (50,000 TC and precursor samples, 500,000 non-TC), 10 independent years for testing.
162d8f5f3052fc1bc711a86cefa7bef177794e0c.result: In the western North Pacific (July-November) POD is 79.9-89.1% and FAR 32.8-53.4%; 91.2%, 77.8% and 74.8% of precursors are detected 2, 5 and 7 days before formation.
162d8f5f3052fc1bc711a86cefa7bef177794e0c.open_work: Applying the approach to satellite observations and operational forecasts, and improving detection in data-sparse basins.
162d8f5f3052fc1bc711a86cefa7bef177794e0c.issues: Trained and tested on model simulations only; false alarm ratios are high and performance depends on training sample size.

db5eb5a7bb0bd94bb17f18fa7eb52416527f96ab.goal: Reviews recent applications of artificial intelligence in oceanography to introduce the methods to beginners and experts.
db5eb5a7bb0bd94bb17f18fa7eb52416527f96ab.architecture: Review of AI for identifying ocean phenomena (eddies, internal waves, oil spills, sea ice, algae), forecasting (waves, ENSO, storm surge), parameterization, physics-informed neural networks and ocean digital twins.
db5eb5a7bb0bd94bb17f18fa7eb52416527f96ab.data: Not applicable; literature review covering ocean observations and numerical model simulations.
db5eb5a7bb0bd94bb17f18fa7eb52416527f96ab.result: Summarizes progress across identification, forecasting and parameterization and highlights physics-informed and Fourier neural networks as promising.
db5eb5a7bb0bd94bb17f18fa7eb52416527f96ab.open_work: Developing causality-adherent physics-informed neural networks, Fourier neural operators and ocean digital twins.
db5eb5a7bb0bd94bb17f18fa7eb52416527f96ab.issues: Narrative review without systematic quantitative comparison of methods.

43b19f3ec438f331978996e58f56a37cbfd82ca9.goal: Predicts air pollution with a hybrid machine learning model designed to be both accurate and interpretable.
43b19f3ec438f331978996e58f56a37cbfd82ca9.architecture: Hybrid interpretable predictive machine learning model; the specific model families combined are not specified in the title.
43b19f3ec438f331978996e58f56a37cbfd82ca9.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
43b19f3ec438f331978996e58f56a37cbfd82ca9.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
43b19f3ec438f331978996e58f56a37cbfd82ca9.open_work: Testing transferability to other sites and pollutants.
43b19f3ec438f331978996e58f56a37cbfd82ca9.issues: Details unknown from the available metadata; card based on the title only.

2342f2822a3b1160b12fbf07843d7d6489fa07de.goal: Solves groundwater flow equations with deep learning as an alternative to conventional numerical solvers.
2342f2822a3b1160b12fbf07843d7d6489fa07de.architecture: GW-PINN, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) that embeds the groundwater flow equation in the loss function.
2342f2822a3b1160b12fbf07843d7d6489fa07de.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); test cases are not specified here.
2342f2822a3b1160b12fbf07843d7d6489fa07de.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
2342f2822a3b1160b12fbf07843d7d6489fa07de.open_work: Extending to more complex, heterogeneous aquifers and real-world field cases.
2342f2822a3b1160b12fbf07843d7d6489fa07de.issues: Details unknown from the available metadata; PINNs generally face training difficulties for complex boundary conditions and heterogeneity.

95491aea8071c33596ffbcf9172929f212a4b07b.goal: Maps soil moisture at 2 m resolution across the Swedish forest landscape for forestry and land management.
95491aea8071c33596ffbcf9172929f212a4b07b.architecture: Extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) compared with artificial neural network, random forest, support vector machine and naive Bayes classifiers.
95491aea8071c33596ffbcf9172929f212a4b07b.data: About 20,000 field sites across Sweden; predictors from national LIDAR DEM terrain indices plus surficial geology, climate and land use.
95491aea8071c33596ffbcf9172929f212a4b07b.result: XGBoost performs best: Cohen's Kappa 0.69 and MCC 0.68 for a 2-class model, 0.58 for a 3-class model; depth to water index, topographic wetness index and wetland class are top predictors.
95491aea8071c33596ffbcf9172929f212a4b07b.open_work: Using class probabilities as a continuous 0-100% wetness index and refining regional adjustment.
95491aea8071c33596ffbcf9172929f212a4b07b.issues: Produces categorical moisture classes rather than volumetric values; static maps that do not capture temporal variability.

bfbcb5c1c68e109b7c37fceeb0de27cc86c819f5.goal: Provides probabilistic wind speed forecasts for the next hours to support power system operation and planning under uncertainty.
bfbcb5c1c68e109b7c37fceeb0de27cc86c819f5.architecture: Deep learning model combining a convolutional neural network (CNN) for spatial features and a gated recurrent unit (GRU) for temporal features, with a gradient-based loss to directly construct PDFs.
bfbcb5c1c68e109b7c37fceeb0de27cc86c819f5.data: Two observed wind datasets from London, England and Shiraz, Iran.
bfbcb5c1c68e109b7c37fceeb0de27cc86c819f5.result: The approach outperforms several state-of-the-art and prior methods in sharpness, accuracy and reliability; exact numbers not given in the abstract.
bfbcb5c1c68e109b7c37fceeb0de27cc86c819f5.open_work: Extending to wind power and multi-site probabilistic forecasting.
bfbcb5c1c68e109b7c37fceeb0de27cc86c819f5.issues: Only two sites; reliance on raw local data without numerical weather prediction inputs limits longer horizons.
