84a036fb9e131904a87c6b7867523696c08ae084.goal: Estimates wind speed fluctuation, which causes instability in wind energy systems, using fractal interpolation.
84a036fb9e131904a87c6b7867523696c08ae084.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) trained with different training algorithms on fractal-interpolated wind speed data.
84a036fb9e131904a87c6b7867523696c08ae084.data: Wind speed measurements; site and period not reported in the abstract.
84a036fb9e131904a87c6b7867523696c08ae084.result: Fractal interpolation is reported to improve wind speed fluctuation estimation; no quantitative results given in the abstract.
84a036fb9e131904a87c6b7867523696c08ae084.open_work: Comparing with other soft computing methods and validating on more sites.
84a036fb9e131904a87c6b7867523696c08ae084.issues: Abstract gives no data description or metrics, so the generality of the result is unclear.

40c5258feb07e51490b38a3b8827dd9a81dbff65.goal: Improves wind speed and power forecasting for power system safety by optimizing deep learning hyperparameters.
40c5258feb07e51490b38a3b8827dd9a81dbff65.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network whose hyperparameters are tuned by a hybrid adaptive dynamic particle swarm and guided whale optimization algorithm (AD-PSO-Guided WOA), used for ensemble forecasting.
40c5258feb07e51490b38a3b8827dd9a81dbff65.data: Kaggle Global Energy Forecasting Competition 2012 wind dataset: hourly power at seven wind farms, forecasts up to 48 hours ahead.
40c5258feb07e51490b38a3b8827dd9a81dbff65.result: The optimized LSTM outperforms several optimization and deep learning baselines, confirmed by Wilcoxon and ANOVA tests.
40c5258feb07e51490b38a3b8827dd9a81dbff65.open_work: Applying to other wind datasets and operational settings.
40c5258feb07e51490b38a3b8827dd9a81dbff65.issues: Single benchmark dataset; gains come mainly from metaheuristic tuning, and no probabilistic skill is assessed.

5019c7b50762d90265368d747236349720ca4f95.goal: Provides real-time multi-step-ahead regional flood inundation forecasts for early warning in a monsoon flood-prone area.
5019c7b50762d90265368d747236349720ca4f95.architecture: Hybrid of a self-organizing map (SOM) for clustering inundation depths and recurrent nonlinear autoregressive with exogenous inputs (RNARX) neural networks for forecasting.
5019c7b50762d90265368d747236349720ca4f95.data: Storm events in the downstream Kemaman River Basin, Malaysia (about 100 km2); the source of inundation depth training data is not detailed in the abstract.
5019c7b50762d90265368d747236349720ca4f95.result: A 4x4 SOM clusters inundation depths effectively, RNARX forecasts regional average depths 3-12 h ahead accurately, and the hybrid produces adequate real-time inundation maps.
5019c7b50762d90265368d747236349720ca4f95.open_work: Operational deployment and testing on other basins and extreme events.
5019c7b50762d90265368d747236349720ca4f95.issues: Single small study area; accuracy for unprecedented events beyond the training set is uncertain.

53d39d58162c40dbe53752cb3eef98989d862220.goal: Retrieves wind speed in coastal areas from CYGNSS GNSS reflectometry, where standard retrievals are less reliable.
53d39d58162c40dbe53752cb3eef98989d862220.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) mapping CYGNSS observables to coastal wind speed; detailed network design not specified here.
53d39d58162c40dbe53752cb3eef98989d862220.data: CYGNSS observations in coastal regions; reference wind data not reported here (abstract unavailable).
53d39d58162c40dbe53752cb3eef98989d862220.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
53d39d58162c40dbe53752cb3eef98989d862220.open_work: Extending to more coastal regions and validating against independent in situ winds.
53d39d58162c40dbe53752cb3eef98989d862220.issues: Details unknown from the available metadata; card based mainly on the title.

a32411b5dbbbbd216fcacc26dbbb9af3be8edbda.goal: Predicts river flood depth and inundation extent quickly with deep learning as a surrogate for slower hydraulic modelling.
a32411b5dbbbbd216fcacc26dbbb9af3be8edbda.architecture: Deep learning model; the specific network type is not specified in the title.

e40ace492e5cd2fa2726bdab0a1afddf066d7fa2.goal: Estimates tropical cyclone intensity from satellite images and provides an open benchmark dataset to foster joint meteorology and data science research.
e40ace492e5cd2fa2726bdab0a1afddf066d7fa2.architecture: Benchmark dataset plus a rotation-blended convolutional neural network (CNN) that builds TC rotation invariance into the model.
e40ace492e5cd2fa2726bdab0a1afddf066d7fa2.data: New open dataset of satellite remote sensing TC images paired with intensity labels (TCIR); specific channels and period not detailed in the abstract.
e40ace492e5cd2fa2726bdab0a1afddf066d7fa2.result: The rotation-blended CNN is among the most accurate TC intensity estimators on the benchmark and is relatively stable across situations.
e40ace492e5cd2fa2726bdab0a1afddf066d7fa2.open_work: Expanding the dataset and incorporating further meteorological knowledge and temporal information.
e40ace492e5cd2fa2726bdab0a1afddf066d7fa2.issues: Evaluated on its own new benchmark; abstract gives no error numbers or comparison with operational Dvorak-based estimates.

78e0ee7f044a811a8d307bc7f7c5e103c47332e7.goal: Estimates fine-grained metropolitan air pollution by combining sparse fixed monitoring stations with mobile sensor data.
78e0ee7f044a811a8d307bc7f7c5e103c47332e7.architecture: HazeEst, a machine learning regression framework fusing fixed-station and mobile sensor data; the specific model family is not specified here.
78e0ee7f044a811a8d307bc7f7c5e103c47332e7.data: Fixed air quality monitoring stations and mobile sensors in a metropolitan area; details not reported here (abstract unavailable).
78e0ee7f044a811a8d307bc7f7c5e103c47332e7.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).

c1014fe404ea119f0738f21770807f8d05090eb5.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed over complex mountain terrain in the Andes of Ecuador for wind energy applications.
c1014fe404ea119f0738f21770807f8d05090eb5.architecture: Linear regression models compared with multivariable long short-term memory (LSTM) and nonlinear autoregressive with exogenous inputs (NARX) neural networks.
c1014fe404ea119f0738f21770807f8d05090eb5.data: Wind and meteorological measurements in the Andes, Ecuador; sites and period not reported here (abstract unavailable).

93bf3a4f250bf64e33f17fc85ebec4c6c5a169a3.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting by decomposing the signal and using data mining to assist a neural network forecaster.
93bf3a4f250bf64e33f17fc85ebec4c6c5a169a3.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet packet decomposition, data mining-based preprocessing and an Elman recurrent neural network.
93bf3a4f250bf64e33f17fc85ebec4c6c5a169a3.data: Wind speed observations; site and period not reported here (abstract unavailable).
93bf3a4f250bf64e33f17fc85ebec4c6c5a169a3.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
93bf3a4f250bf64e33f17fc85ebec4c6c5a169a3.open_work: Testing the hybrid on more sites and longer horizons.
93bf3a4f250bf64e33f17fc85ebec4c6c5a169a3.issues: Details unknown from the available metadata; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if decomposition uses future data.

f6f1ec75ba37d9a5fadae32b00f71f5b1c2b3e8c.goal: Predicts air quality where no monitoring stations exist by fusing satellite data with ground measurements.
f6f1ec75ba37d9a5fadae32b00f71f5b1c2b3e8c.architecture: AQNet, a multimodal deep learning network fusing Sentinel-5P satellite data, imagery and tabular supporting features to predict multiple pollutants.
f6f1ec75ba37d9a5fadae32b00f71f5b1c2b3e8c.data: New dataset of European monitoring station measurements with features such as altitude and population, plus ESA Copernicus Sentinel-5P data; out-of-sample test over the UK and Ireland.
f6f1ec75ba37d9a5fadae32b00f71f5b1c2b3e8c.result: AQNet predicts NO2, O3 and PM10 successfully and beats an imagery-only model; supporting data improve predictions, but UK and Ireland estimates are overestimated by about 20% on average.
f6f1ec75ba37d9a5fadae32b00f71f5b1c2b3e8c.open_work: Improving generalization to unseen regions and producing an air quality index map.
f6f1ec75ba37d9a5fadae32b00f71f5b1c2b3e8c.issues: Systematic overestimation out of sample; station-based training limits coverage in unmonitored areas.

5184eaf190e76af8fe278b1dfa86923fc1f902ea.goal: Predicts reservoir water level to support water release planning for the Red Hills Reservoir, a key drinking and irrigation supply.
5184eaf190e76af8fe278b1dfa86923fc1f902ea.architecture: Hybrid SARIMA-ANN time series model in which an artificial neural network models residuals of a SARIMA(0,0,1)(0,3,2)12 model.
5184eaf190e76af8fe278b1dfa86923fc1f902ea.data: Average monthly reservoir water level, January 2004 to November 2020, Red Hills Reservoir, Tamil Nadu, India.
5184eaf190e76af8fe278b1dfa86923fc1f902ea.result: The SARIMA-ANN hybrid outperforms standalone SARIMA and ANN on all performance criteria; exact scores not given in the abstract.
5184eaf190e76af8fe278b1dfa86923fc1f902ea.open_work: Adding climate and inflow predictors and assessing future climate change impacts.
5184eaf190e76af8fe278b1dfa86923fc1f902ea.issues: Single reservoir, monthly data with a short record; univariate model ignores hydrometeorological drivers.

8fd55b9f934b357644423c32844f8b4df5663432.goal: Discusses the role and limits of machine learning in crop yield modelling, arguing that it complements but cannot replace process understanding.
8fd55b9f934b357644423c32844f8b4df5663432.architecture: Perspective/review on machine learning approaches for crop yield modelling and their relation to process-based crop models; not a single new method.
8fd55b9f934b357644423c32844f8b4df5663432.data: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
8fd55b9f934b357644423c32844f8b4df5663432.result: Argues that machine learning is powerful for yield modelling but no surrogate for scientific understanding, per the title.
8fd55b9f934b357644423c32844f8b4df5663432.open_work: Combining machine learning with process-based crop models and scientific hypothesis testing.
8fd55b9f934b357644423c32844f8b4df5663432.issues: Details unknown from the available metadata; card based on the title only.

9d860951b20eed7a6147f1c048ce5b6c65d7011a.goal: Calibrates low-cost electrochemical sensors for CO, NO2, O3 and SO2 to make them a reliable complement to regulatory instruments.
9d860951b20eed7a6147f1c048ce5b6c65d7011a.architecture: Single and multiple linear regression compared with random forest regression (RFR) and long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network calibration.
9d860951b20eed7a6147f1c048ce5b6c65d7011a.data: 12-month field evaluation of four Alphasense sensors in Beijing co-located with nearby national monitoring station reference measurements.
9d860951b20eed7a6147f1c048ce5b6c65d7011a.result: RFR and LSTM raise R2 for O3 and NO2 from 0.3-0.5 to above 0.7 and reduce NO2 RMSE from 20.4 to 13.2 ppb; LSTM keeps mean relative bias near zero (<5%) and performs best.
9d860951b20eed7a6147f1c048ce5b6c65d7011a.open_work: Applying the methodology to other low-cost sensors and testing calibration transfer over time and locations.
9d860951b20eed7a6147f1c048ce5b6c65d7011a.issues: Single city and sensor type; SO2 performance remains poor and calibration drift beyond one year is untested.

e0560c2f28c77938c4bff6b9a705cc3919c8b8d4.goal: Forecasts daily river discharge and flood events on the Mohawk River, New York, using time series decomposition and machine learning.
e0560c2f28c77938c4bff6b9a705cc3919c8b8d4.architecture: Kolmogorov-Zurbenko low-pass filter decomposition followed by multiple linear regression (MLR) and artificial neural network (ANN) models of each component.
e0560c2f28c77938c4bff6b9a705cc3919c8b8d4.data: Daily water discharge with hydrogeological and climatic predictors for the Mohawk River, New York; period not reported in the abstract.
e0560c2f28c77938c4bff6b9a705cc3919c8b8d4.result: Decomposition is essential; the ANN applied to decomposed components forecasts best, explaining up to 96% of discharge variance.
e0560c2f28c77938c4bff6b9a705cc3919c8b8d4.open_work: Extending to other rivers and longer lead times.
e0560c2f28c77938c4bff6b9a705cc3919c8b8d4.issues: Single river; filter-based decomposition can leak future information, and extreme-event skill is not isolated.

c7377d0501a2be9c2beda0811e099c2401eca756.goal: Detects sea ice and retrieves sea ice concentration from spaceborne GNSS reflectometry delay-Doppler maps.
c7377d0501a2be9c2beda0811e099c2401eca756.architecture: Neural networks (multilayer perceptron type) taking delay-Doppler map values as input for sea ice classification and concentration regression.
c7377d0501a2be9c2beda0811e099c2401eca756.data: TechDemoSat-1 (TDS-1) GNSS-R delay-Doppler maps with reference sea ice data; reference products not detailed here.
c7377d0501a2be9c2beda0811e099c2401eca756.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); the neural network approach is presented as effective for both detection and concentration retrieval.
c7377d0501a2be9c2beda0811e099c2401eca756.open_work: Applying to newer GNSS-R missions and testing convolutional architectures on full DDMs.
c7377d0501a2be9c2beda0811e099c2401eca756.issues: Limited TDS-1 coverage and reliance on passive microwave reference data; details unknown from the available metadata.

56fe5902b94b839e424a3ddb624c92972827747b.goal: Forecasts monthly groundwater level in an arid plain to support water management.
56fe5902b94b839e424a3ddb624c92972827747b.architecture: Support vector regression (SVR) and Gaussian process regression (GPR), alone and combined with Haar, db4 and Symlet wavelet transforms (W-SVR, W-GPR).
56fe5902b94b839e424a3ddb624c92972827747b.data: Groundwater level records for the Semnan plain, Iran (arid), one-month-ahead forecasting; period not reported in the abstract.
56fe5902b94b839e424a3ddb624c92972827747b.result: SVR (RMSE 0.048 m) outperforms GPR (RMSE 0.554 m); the Symlet W-SVR hybrid is best with RMSE 0.0129 m and R2 and NSE of 0.99999.
56fe5902b94b839e424a3ddb624c92972827747b.open_work: Testing in other aquifers and longer horizons.
56fe5902b94b839e424a3ddb624c92972827747b.issues: Near-perfect scores suggest strong persistence or possible leakage from wavelet decomposition; single study area.

0d82ad79d876d2ffdcfec5f725318d000590a34d.goal: Bias-corrects and downscales simulations from multiple climate models with deep learning to provide finer, more accurate climate information.
0d82ad79d876d2ffdcfec5f725318d000590a34d.architecture: Deep learning approach for joint bias correction and downscaling; the specific network type is not specified in the title.
0d82ad79d876d2ffdcfec5f725318d000590a34d.data: Multiple climate model simulations with observational references; datasets and region not reported here (abstract unavailable).
0d82ad79d876d2ffdcfec5f725318d000590a34d.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
0d82ad79d876d2ffdcfec5f725318d000590a34d.open_work: Assessing performance under future climate and for extremes.
0d82ad79d876d2ffdcfec5f725318d000590a34d.issues: Details unknown from the available metadata; statistical downscaling assumes stationary relationships under climate change.

c17b94fc8ec47a116f967afae955cc55739e128c.goal: Maps flash-flood susceptibility in the monsoon-affected Kangsabati River Basin, India, to support flood mitigation and risk management.
c17b94fc8ec47a116f967afae955cc55739e128c.architecture: Particle swarm optimization (PSO), artificial neural network (ANN) and deep learning neural network (DLNN) models within a remote sensing and GIS framework.
c17b94fc8ec47a116f967afae955cc55739e128c.data: Flood inventory and environmental, topographical, hydrological and geological conditioning factors for the Kangsabati River Basin, India.
c17b94fc8ec47a116f967afae955cc55739e128c.result: Training AUC is 0.914 (ANN), 0.920 (DLNN) and 0.942 (PSO); PSO performs best.
c17b94fc8ec47a116f967afae955cc55739e128c.open_work: Applying the approach across eastern India and adding dynamic rainfall drivers.
c17b94fc8ec47a116f967afae955cc55739e128c.issues: Reported AUCs are for training data; static susceptibility maps from a single basin.

7ee55b01c4067fd02a250ca702e523a42f0fc5f1.goal: Forecasts hourly day-ahead wind speed with a hybrid decomposition and deep learning model.
7ee55b01c4067fd02a250ca702e523a42f0fc5f1.architecture: Ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) with a CNN-bidirectional LSTM (convolutional neural network plus Bi-LSTM) network whose hyperparameters are optimized by a genetic algorithm (GA).
7ee55b01c4067fd02a250ca702e523a42f0fc5f1.data: Wind speed observations; site and period not reported here (abstract unavailable).
7ee55b01c4067fd02a250ca702e523a42f0fc5f1.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable).
7ee55b01c4067fd02a250ca702e523a42f0fc5f1.open_work: Testing on more sites and comparing with NWP-based forecasts.
7ee55b01c4067fd02a250ca702e523a42f0fc5f1.issues: Details unknown from the available metadata; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage.

e442c4b4a9840d3d92d73887ca7c35edd0bc129a.goal: Estimates 1 km PM2.5 concentrations across China at multiple temporal scales for exposure and epidemiological studies.
e442c4b4a9840d3d92d73887ca7c35edd0bc129a.data: Ground-level PM2.5 monitoring data, satellite aerosol optical depth (AOD), meteorological and auxiliary data across China in 2017.
e442c4b4a9840d3d92d73887ca7c35edd0bc129a.result: Sample-based cross-validation gives R2 0.74, RMSE 16.29 ug/m3 and MPE -0.282 ug/m3; high pollution in North China, Chengyu and northwest China, especially in the heating season.
e442c4b4a9840d3d92d73887ca7c35edd0bc129a.open_work: Extending to multiple years and improving performance in poorly fit regions such as Chengyu.
e442c4b4a9840d3d92d73887ca7c35edd0bc129a.issues: Single year; spatial cross-validation skill is lower than sample-based and AOD gaps limit coverage.

8caa7e240f95d29b92f0a987d30cf29934c3188c.goal: Downscales coarse groundwater storage estimates to 1 km over China for local hydrological studies and water management.
8caa7e240f95d29b92f0a987d30cf29934c3188c.architecture: Random forest (RF) and extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) regression for statistical downscaling.
8caa7e240f95d29b92f0a987d30cf29934c3188c.data: GRACE (1 degree) and GLDAS (0.25 degree) data downscaled to 1 km for China, 2004-2016; validated against in situ groundwater measurements.
8caa7e240f95d29b92f0a987d30cf29934c3188c.result: XGBoost gives R2 0.77-0.89 (RF 0.74-0.86) for GRACE and 0.64-0.82 for GLDAS; downscaled products preserve the original accuracy and basin-scale interannual changes.
8caa7e240f95d29b92f0a987d30cf29934c3188c.open_work: Using the 1 km products for local groundwater change studies and policy.
8caa7e240f95d29b92f0a987d30cf29934c3188c.issues: Downscaling cannot add true sub-grid GRACE information; validation with in situ wells is limited.

dce076c388b0e736f70f8c8c0f5f20bf5ff445d5.goal: Forecasts day-ahead photovoltaic power to manage intermittency of PV generation in the grid.
dce076c388b0e736f70f8c8c0f5f20bf5ff445d5.architecture: Two-stage attention mechanism over a long short-term memory (LSTM) network, with Bayesian optimization of hyperparameters.
dce076c388b0e736f70f8c8c0f5f20bf5ff445d5.data: Data from 21 PV installations at different locations in Germany, with inputs such as solar radiation, temperature, humidity, snowfall and albedo.
dce076c388b0e736f70f8c8c0f5f20bf5ff445d5.result: Forecast skill score is 0.4813 versus 0.4427 for the best ensemble baseline; RMSE 0.0638 and MAE 0.0324 versus 0.0685 and 0.0369.
dce076c388b0e736f70f8c8c0f5f20bf5ff445d5.open_work: Extending to probabilistic forecasting and other regions.
dce076c388b0e736f70f8c8c0f5f20bf5ff445d5.issues: Deterministic forecasts only; improvements over the best baseline are modest.

c637b497ec1394a2b32ce93ce912a85f3bd654a3.goal: Compares machine learning regression models and ensemble strategies for air quality prediction in a polluted urban area.
c637b497ec1394a2b32ce93ce912a85f3bd654a3.architecture: Ten regressors (XGBoost, LightGBM, random forest, gradient boosting, CatBoost, SVR, decision tree, KNN, elastic net, Bayesian ridge) with Bayesian optimization and stacking ensembles.
c637b497ec1394a2b32ce93ce912a85f3bd654a3.data: Kaggle (UCI) Air Quality dataset: 9,357 hourly records from five metal oxide sensors and a certified analyzer, March 2004 to February 2005.
c637b497ec1394a2b32ce93ce912a85f3bd654a3.result: Bayesian-optimized SVR performs best with R2 of 99.94%, MAE 0.0120 and MSE 0.0005; optimization and stacking improve accuracy.
c637b497ec1394a2b32ce93ce912a85f3bd654a3.open_work: Testing on multi-site, multi-year datasets and true forecasting horizons.
c637b497ec1394a2b32ce93ce912a85f3bd654a3.issues: Single old one-year dataset; near-perfect R2 suggests a contemporaneous estimation setup rather than forecasting, and no spatial component despite claims.

716710d046271e0f2585215d483083f8767102d9.goal: Develops daily streamflow forecasting tools for Canadian watersheds to support regional water management and flood forecasting.
716710d046271e0f2585215d483083f8767102d9.architecture: Standard and attention-based encoder-decoder long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural networks, forced with past hydro-meteorological states and daily meteorology over a multi-day look-back window.
716710d046271e0f2585215d483083f8767102d9.data: Daily meteorological and streamflow observations for 10 watersheds of the Ottawa River basin, Great Lakes-Saint-Lawrence region, Canada.
716710d046271e0f2585215d483083f8767102d9.result: The attention LSTM outperforms the standard LSTM in all watersheds, with mean test NSE 0.985 and KGE 0.954, and remains skilful for lead times up to 5 days.
716710d046271e0f2585215d483083f8767102d9.open_work: Testing on more diverse and ungauged basins, longer lead times, and probabilistic forecasts driven by weather forecasts rather than observed meteorology.
716710d046271e0f2585215d483083f8767102d9.issues: Very high NSE partly reflects using past observed streamflow as input; one region; future meteorology appears taken as known, so operational skill may be overstated.

148dd6a817b6e4733c30e590d9410f2e19bf6083.goal: Forecasts daily streamflow into the Sobradinho Reservoir on the São Francisco River, Brazil, to support reservoir operation.
148dd6a817b6e4733c30e590d9410f2e19bf6083.architecture: Machine learning models (specific types not specified in the available information) combined with wavelet transform decomposition of inputs and bootstrapping.
148dd6a817b6e4733c30e590d9410f2e19bf6083.data: Daily streamflow records for the Sobradinho Reservoir; period and predictors not reported in the available information.
148dd6a817b6e4733c30e590d9410f2e19bf6083.result: Not reported in the available information; the title implies wavelet preprocessing and bootstrapping improve the machine learning forecasts.
148dd6a817b6e4733c30e590d9410f2e19bf6083.open_work: Extending lead time and testing on other reservoirs.
148dd6a817b6e4733c30e590d9410f2e19bf6083.issues: Abstract unavailable; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if not applied causally; single reservoir.

53ad0b877587ed6973af04d1cd4164688d42ac4a.goal: Reduces structural and parameter uncertainty of CMIP6 GCM projections at river-basin scale by building a machine learning multimodel ensemble for the Damodar River basin, India.
53ad0b877587ed6973af04d1cd4164688d42ac4a.architecture: Multimodel ensemble of the five best-rated CMIP6 GCMs combined with artificial neural network (ANN), random forest (RF) and support vector machine (SVM), compared with simple arithmetic mean.
53ad0b877587ed6973af04d1cd4164688d42ac4a.data: CMIP6 GCM simulations of precipitation, Tmax and Tmin; IMD gridded observations for training and evaluation; SSP245 and SSP585 projections.
53ad0b877587ed6973af04d1cd4164688d42ac4a.result: SVM and RF ensembles beat simple averaging and ANN; projections show annual precipitation rising 1.4–15% (SSP245) and 6.8–39% (SSP585) with warming and a drier southwest basin.
53ad0b877587ed6973af04d1cd4164688d42ac4a.open_work: Extending to more variables, other basins and hydrological impact modelling driven by the ML ensemble.
53ad0b877587ed6973af04d1cd4164688d42ac4a.issues: Statistical relationships trained on historical period assumed stationary under future forcing; single basin; ensemble weighting may not preserve physical consistency between variables.

61fda059177893b1becd310662904f8cf011078a.goal: Produces very short-term (micro) solar radiation forecasts by fusing infrared sky or cloud images with measured radiation data.
61fda059177893b1becd310662904f8cf011078a.architecture: Deep learning model fusing image and radiation time-series inputs; the specific network type is not specified in the available information.
61fda059177893b1becd310662904f8cf011078a.data: Infrared cloud images and ground radiation measurements; site and period not reported in the available information.
61fda059177893b1becd310662904f8cf011078a.result: Not reported in the available information.
61fda059177893b1becd310662904f8cf011078a.open_work: Testing across sites and seasons and extending forecast horizons.
61fda059177893b1becd310662904f8cf011078a.issues: Abstract unavailable; site coverage and generalization across sky conditions cannot be judged.

9c95a754daf7b97e10674847fa1fb1926abebedb.goal: Estimates ground-level PM2.5 from satellite aerosol optical depth while capturing both nonlinearity and spatiotemporal heterogeneity of the AOD-PM2.5 relationship.
9c95a754daf7b97e10674847fa1fb1926abebedb.architecture: Geographically and temporally weighted neural networks (GTWNN), combining geographically weighted regression principles with neural networks.
9c95a754daf7b97e10674847fa1fb1926abebedb.data: Satellite AOD products, NDVI and meteorological factors over China, trained against station PM2.5 measurements; 0.1° output maps.
9c95a754daf7b97e10674847fa1fb1926abebedb.result: GTWNN beats daily GWR and GTWR, with sample-based and site-based cross-validation R2 of 0.80 and 0.79.
9c95a754daf7b97e10674847fa1fb1926abebedb.open_work: Filling AOD gaps from clouds and extending to longer periods and other pollutants.
9c95a754daf7b97e10674847fa1fb1926abebedb.issues: Coverage limited by AOD retrieval gaps; performance tied to station density; single country.

9cdd03c1d81f0f08a7f55337669d2c4b68f1f599.goal: Predicts the Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI) to support drought planning in a drought-prone region of eastern Australia.
9cdd03c1d81f0f08a7f55337669d2c4b68f1f599.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM) compared with multiple linear regression, an artificial neural network (MLP) and least squares support vector regression, with input selection.
9cdd03c1d81f0f08a7f55337669d2c4b68f1f599.data: SPEI derived from six weather stations in eastern Australia, January 1915–December 2012.
9cdd03c1d81f0f08a7f55337669d2c4b68f1f599.result: ELM and ANN outperform MLR and LSSVR; all models are more accurate at 12-month than 3-month SPEI, with 12-month r2 from 0.668 (LSSVR) to 0.894 (ANN).
9cdd03c1d81f0f08a7f55337669d2c4b68f1f599.open_work: Using climate indices as predictors and testing at more stations and lead times.
9cdd03c1d81f0f08a7f55337669d2c4b68f1f599.issues: Six stations only; 12-month SPEI is highly autocorrelated, inflating apparent skill; no uncertainty estimates.

27cdb77bc64c5f43cbf2dabf9a07981de91ad58b.goal: Predicts daily diffuse solar radiation, which is rarely measured, from routinely observed meteorological variables.
27cdb77bc64c5f43cbf2dabf9a07981de91ad58b.architecture: Artificial neural networks; specific variants and optimization are not specified in the available information.
27cdb77bc64c5f43cbf2dabf9a07981de91ad58b.data: Daily meteorological and radiation measurements; stations and period not reported in the available information.
27cdb77bc64c5f43cbf2dabf9a07981de91ad58b.result: Not reported in the available information.
27cdb77bc64c5f43cbf2dabf9a07981de91ad58b.open_work: Testing at more stations and climates.
27cdb77bc64c5f43cbf2dabf9a07981de91ad58b.issues: Abstract unavailable; station-based empirical model with uncertain transferability.

ddffe405b222f3fcef5b4b3e8b4164030ff32e72.goal: Forecasts late spring to early summer (May–June) rainfall in the Geum River Basin, South Korea, from lagged global climate indices for water management.
ddffe405b222f3fcef5b4b3e8b4164030ff32e72.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) with input selection by lagged correlation and relative importance analysis.
ddffe405b222f3fcef5b4b3e8b4164030ff32e72.data: Lagged climate indices (EA, NAO, PDO, EP/NP, TNA) and observed May–June rainfall for the Geum River Basin.
ddffe405b222f3fcef5b4b3e8b4164030ff32e72.result: Five-input ANN gives relative RMSE of 25.84%, 32.72% and 34.75% for training, validation and testing and a hit score above 60%.
ddffe405b222f3fcef5b4b3e8b4164030ff32e72.open_work: Extending to other seasons and basins and to probabilistic seasonal forecasts.
ddffe405b222f3fcef5b4b3e8b4164030ff32e72.issues: Short annual record gives few samples; risk of overfitting and spurious teleconnection predictors; skill only moderate.

24fda021647dc4868934df0cdcc311b421d45158.goal: Predicts low-visibility fog events, which strongly affect air and road transport, using machine learning.
24fda021647dc4868934df0cdcc311b421d45158.architecture: Machine learning regression and classification methods for visibility and fog occurrence; specific algorithms are not specified in the available abstract.
24fda021647dc4868934df0cdcc311b421d45158.data: Not reported in the available abstract.
24fda021647dc4868934df0cdcc311b421d45158.result: Not reported in the available abstract.
24fda021647dc4868934df0cdcc311b421d45158.open_work: Comparing regression and classification formulations at more sites and lead times.
24fda021647dc4868934df0cdcc311b421d45158.issues: Abstract truncated; fog events are rare, so class imbalance likely affects evaluation.

6faa2d6b56f7a83ce06be2300fb7b08f79d97872.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting despite strong fluctuations, to support wind energy integration.
6faa2d6b56f7a83ce06be2300fb7b08f79d97872.architecture: Hybrid deep model with decomposition-based preprocessing, a multi-learner ensemble and adaptive multiple error correction modules; specific learners not detailed in the abstract.
6faa2d6b56f7a83ce06be2300fb7b08f79d97872.data: Four real wind speed series from Xinjiang, China.
6faa2d6b56f7a83ce06be2300fb7b08f79d97872.result: Beats several state-of-the-art models in accuracy and stability; at site 1, multi-step MAEs are 0.0250, 0.0417 and 0.0570 m/s.
6faa2d6b56f7a83ce06be2300fb7b08f79d97872.open_work: Testing on more sites and longer horizons and adding probabilistic outputs.
6faa2d6b56f7a83ce06be2300fb7b08f79d97872.issues: Very low MAEs suggest possible leakage from decomposing the full series; four series from one region; complex pipeline.

bc2da5b4ad00b73556343dbdc52448e080888c45.goal: Estimates solar radiation in Kuwait with artificial neural networks for solar energy assessment.
