cdf0500e20561330b6390d33e2030be4e2e45eb6.data: Ground eddy-covariance flux observations combined with global meteorological drivers over recent decades; specific products not named in the abstract.
cdf0500e20561330b6390d33e2030be4e2e45eb6.result: Global land ET has increased significantly in recent decades, driven mainly by rising temperature, with the increase concentrated in humid regions such as the tropics.
cdf0500e20561330b6390d33e2030be4e2e45eb6.open_work: Using the observation-driven ET record to constrain land surface and climate models and to attribute water-cycle changes.
cdf0500e20561330b6390d33e2030be4e2e45eb6.issues: Machine learning upscaling may not extrapolate to undersampled regions or non-stationary conditions; trend attribution depends on the forcing datasets used.

fa4b97cab5c5a15a81d671cbbc840aa731144855.goal: Improves short-term photovoltaic power forecasting under complex weather by modelling interconnections among meteorological input factors.
fa4b97cab5c5a15a81d671cbbc840aa731144855.architecture: Graph neural network with spectral graph convolution, multiple graphical edges and hierarchical output; meteorological factors form graph nodes with message passing and readout.
fa4b97cab5c5a15a81d671cbbc840aa731144855.data: PV power generation and meteorological measurements from PV plants; site details not reported in the abstract.
fa4b97cab5c5a15a81d671cbbc840aa731144855.result: The multi-graph model outperforms benchmark models in day-ahead forecasting, and the single-graph variant trains faster than deep learning benchmarks.
fa4b97cab5c5a15a81d671cbbc840aa731144855.open_work: Testing across more plants and climates and incorporating numerical weather prediction inputs.
fa4b97cab5c5a15a81d671cbbc840aa731144855.issues: Accuracy gains are reported qualitatively; generalization across sites and seasons is not demonstrated in the abstract.

7e01212f7aa03c5497eca44e95dffa72e8129579.goal: Optimizes hydropower operations while respecting water quality constraints, where running a high-fidelity hydrodynamics and water quality model inside an optimizer is too costly.
7e01212f7aa03c5497eca44e95dffa72e8129579.architecture: Artificial neural network surrogate models emulating a high-fidelity hydrodynamics and water quality model, coupled to an optimization routine for release scheduling.
7e01212f7aa03c5497eca44e95dffa72e8129579.data: Not reported in the abstract. Training data come from simulations of the high-fidelity reservoir model.
7e01212f7aa03c5497eca44e95dffa72e8129579.result: Not reported here; the title implies the ANN surrogates make water-quality-constrained hydropower optimization computationally feasible.
7e01212f7aa03c5497eca44e95dffa72e8129579.open_work: Testing on other reservoirs and real-time operational use with updated forecasts.
7e01212f7aa03c5497eca44e95dffa72e8129579.issues: Surrogate accuracy is bounded by the training simulations and may degrade outside the sampled operating range.

41518e01b0d52e9c6004ae480aeba9a3ef68d27f.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in a Himalayan foreland basin to support flood risk management.
41518e01b0d52e9c6004ae480aeba9a3ef68d27f.architecture: Advanced ensemble machine learning models for susceptibility zonation; the specific ensemble members are not specified in the available metadata.
41518e01b0d52e9c6004ae480aeba9a3ef68d27f.data: Not reported in the abstract. Typically flood inventory points and geospatial conditioning factors.
41518e01b0d52e9c6004ae480aeba9a3ef68d27f.open_work: Validation with independent flood events and transfer to neighbouring basins.
41518e01b0d52e9c6004ae480aeba9a3ef68d27f.issues: Susceptibility mapping depends on inventory quality and conditioning factor selection; the static maps carry no temporal forecast information.

4be2640a0bf479d5405b8aace83c64515509dbb0.goal: Maps urban flood hazard using machine learning to identify flood-prone areas in a city.
4be2640a0bf479d5405b8aace83c64515509dbb0.architecture: Comparison of four models named in the title: genetic algorithm rule-set production (GARP), random forest, maximum entropy (MaxEnt) and naive Bayes.
4be2640a0bf479d5405b8aace83c64515509dbb0.open_work: Integration with hydraulic modelling and drainage network data for urban flood planning.
4be2640a0bf479d5405b8aace83c64515509dbb0.issues: Static susceptibility approach with no explicit representation of drainage or rainfall dynamics; results are site-specific.

207d6d83c51b1862a639e1e92aee64bdc52987d0.goal: Forecasts air pollutant concentrations while addressing missing values, input variable selection, spatial dependency on surrounding stations and model optimization.
207d6d83c51b1862a639e1e92aee64bdc52987d0.architecture: Hybrid spatiotemporal deep model with a 2D convolutional neural network followed by LSTM layers; a genetic algorithm selects inputs and architecture hyperparameters, and ensembles of the best models are built.
207d6d83c51b1862a639e1e92aee64bdc52987d0.data: Beijing Multi-Site Air-Quality Data Set (multiple stations with pollutant and meteorological records).
207d6d83c51b1862a639e1e92aee64bdc52987d0.result: The model gives good, consistent predictions, best MAE 16.753 ± 0.384 at Wanliu; ensembles of the k best models and spatial neighbour information further improve MAE and RMSE.
207d6d83c51b1862a639e1e92aee64bdc52987d0.open_work: Testing on other cities and adding more surrounding stations and longer histories.
207d6d83c51b1862a639e1e92aee64bdc52987d0.issues: Evaluated on a single public dataset; genetic algorithm search is computationally costly; no meteorological forecast inputs.

c5a245c9a825053aa98544668fad15915ec475e5.goal: Maps surface water from Sentinel-1 SAR with deep learning at scale, reducing labelling burden through automatic data labelling.
c5a245c9a825053aa98544668fad15915ec475e5.architecture: U-Net convolutional neural network trained on Google AI Platform with Google Earth Engine; labels from JRC surface water maps or an Edge-Otsu threshold, with tuned learning rates and loss functions.
c5a245c9a825053aa98544668fad15915ec475e5.data: Sentinel-1 SAR imagery; JRC Global Surface Water labels and Edge-Otsu labels; independent high-resolution validation dataset.
c5a245c9a825053aa98544668fad15915ec475e5.result: JRC-labelled models score F1 0.972–0.986 on test/validation and 0.913–0.922 on independent data; the binary cross-entropy Dice model performs best, comparable to conventional methods.
c5a245c9a825053aa98544668fad15915ec475e5.open_work: Broader validation across regions and using the pipeline for operational surface water monitoring.
c5a245c9a825053aa98544668fad15915ec475e5.issues: Automatic labels carry errors of their source products; performance drops on independent validation; region of study limited.

8e0aa323101623155a661b10847d48f4137be661.goal: Improves monthly streamflow forecasting through data pre-analysis and ensembles of neural networks.
8e0aa323101623155a661b10847d48f4137be661.architecture: Radial basis function network, extreme learning machine and Elman network combined via simple, weighted and general regression neural network (GNE) ensembles; empirical wavelet transform denoising and chaos phase-space input selection.
8e0aa323101623155a661b10847d48f4137be661.data: Mean monthly streamflow observations at Wudongde hydrological station, Jinsha River Basin, China.
8e0aa323101623155a661b10847d48f4137be661.result: Wavelet denoising reduces disorder in the series and the GNE ensemble outperforms the other ensemble techniques.
8e0aa323101623155a661b10847d48f4137be661.open_work: Applying to other stations and including climate predictors.
8e0aa323101623155a661b10847d48f4137be661.issues: Single station; decomposition of the full series can leak future information if not applied causally; no quantitative skill in the abstract.

5e5d752732d197b1e733d62c3e48c413c96b58e3.goal: Predicts solar radiation robustly in the presence of outliers and non-stationarity for solar energy applications.
5e5d752732d197b1e733d62c3e48c413c96b58e3.architecture: Hybrid of wavelet transform and CEEMDAN decomposition with an outlier-robust extreme learning machine tuned by an improved atom search optimization (IASO) algorithm.
5e5d752732d197b1e733d62c3e48c413c96b58e3.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids are complex and may leak future information; site-specific evaluation.

38c9a21044db7a3eb9e46c39198e3d895a25ad79.goal: Delineates floods rapidly and accurately from satellite imagery to support disaster relief.
38c9a21044db7a3eb9e46c39198e3d895a25ad79.architecture: OmbriaNet, a convolutional neural network for bitemporal multimodal change detection between permanent and flooded water; also introduces the OMBRIA benchmark dataset.
38c9a21044db7a3eb9e46c39198e3d895a25ad79.data: OMBRIA dataset: 3,376 Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral images from 23 flood events (2017–2021) with Copernicus Emergency Management Service ground truth, prepared in Google Earth Engine.
38c9a21044db7a3eb9e46c39198e3d895a25ad79.result: OmbriaNet produces high-quality flood maps and outperforms several state-of-the-art segmentation techniques on OMBRIA.
38c9a21044db7a3eb9e46c39198e3d895a25ad79.open_work: Extending the dataset to more events and sensors and testing in near-real-time operations.
38c9a21044db7a3eb9e46c39198e3d895a25ad79.issues: Limited number of flood events; binary labels from expert maps may be imperfect; Sentinel-2 is cloud-limited during floods.

fe11f8b9de5fda942dbea3576d546635bf89964b.goal: Estimates COVID-19 lockdown-induced NO2 changes in European cities while accounting for weather variability between reference and lockdown periods.
fe11f8b9de5fda942dbea3576d546635bf89964b.architecture: Gradient boosting machine learning for weather normalization of satellite and surface NO2, compared with an ensemble of air quality models.
fe11f8b9de5fda942dbea3576d546635bf89964b.data: TROPOMI Sentinel-5P NO2 retrievals, surface station measurements and the CAMS regional ensemble of 11 air quality models.
fe11f8b9de5fda942dbea3576d546635bf89964b.result: Average reductions of −23% (satellite), −43% (surface) and −32% (models); stricter lockdowns gave stronger reductions, and ignoring weather biases the estimates.
fe11f8b9de5fda942dbea3576d546635bf89964b.open_work: Refining emission reduction estimates and reconciling vertical and temporal sampling differences between products.
fe11f8b9de5fda942dbea3576d546635bf89964b.issues: Weather normalization relies on statistical relationships from limited baseline periods; satellite and surface estimates differ due to sampling.

b33adf556fccb604f8281ea7bc0eaf31702cee60.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction for wind engineering applications.
b33adf556fccb604f8281ea7bc0eaf31702cee60.architecture: Hybrid of correlation-aided discrete wavelet transform, least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) and GARCH error modelling.
b33adf556fccb604f8281ea7bc0eaf31702cee60.open_work: Testing at more sites and multi-step horizons.
b33adf556fccb604f8281ea7bc0eaf31702cee60.issues: Site-specific evaluation; wavelet decomposition may introduce boundary effects in real-time use.

54058fd09566c7d21fc261d58713086db481f57a.goal: Models rainfall-runoff processes using Markovian and seasonal inputs to improve runoff simulation.
54058fd09566c7d21fc261d58713086db481f57a.architecture: Emotional artificial neural network (EANN) and wavelet-ANN (WANN) compared for rainfall-runoff modelling.
54058fd09566c7d21fc261d58713086db481f57a.open_work: Applying to more catchments and longer horizons.
54058fd09566c7d21fc261d58713086db481f57a.issues: Study catchments and data length are not available here, so generalization cannot be judged.

3163e712eb7c36cdf936586f11a0e8769eba6b4d.goal: Assesses the predictability of droughts in China using statistical, dynamical and hybrid forecasts.
3163e712eb7c36cdf936586f11a0e8769eba6b4d.architecture: Statistical models (including ensemble streamflow prediction and wavelet machine learning), NMME dynamical forecasts, and a hybrid combining them by Bayesian model averaging.
3163e712eb7c36cdf936586f11a0e8769eba6b4d.data: Station precipitation in China for SPI6, and North American Multi-Model Ensemble (NMME) seasonal forecasts.
3163e712eb7c36cdf936586f11a0e8769eba6b4d.result: Statistical models beat dynamical ones for SPI6; the BMA hybrid improves skill and balances detection, reaching POD about 20% and POF about 50% for drought onset.
3163e712eb7c36cdf936586f11a0e8769eba6b4d.open_work: Improving drought onset detection, which remains poor, and using high-ETS stations for early warning.
3163e712eb7c36cdf936586f11a0e8769eba6b4d.issues: Low overall predictability; fewer than 40% of onsets detected with many false alarms.

9c98958ff959f74083a1098ec7554f18c161b46d.goal: Forecasts monthly precipitation and drought events in Northeast China, an important grain region with limited prior analysis.
9c98958ff959f74083a1098ec7554f18c161b46d.architecture: Hybrid wavelet-ARIMA-LSTM (W-AL) for monthly precipitation, with grey models GM(1,1) and DGM(1,1) of the China Z-Index for drought forecasting.
9c98958ff959f74083a1098ec7554f18c161b46d.data: Monthly and annual precipitation, 1967–2017, at three meteorological sites (Changchun, Linjiang, Qian Gorlos).
9c98958ff959f74083a1098ec7554f18c161b46d.result: W-AL is more accurate than ARIMA and LSTM alone; GM(1,1) outperforms DGM(1,1) for drought forecasting.
9c98958ff959f74083a1098ec7554f18c161b46d.open_work: Extending to more stations and to multi-month lead times.
9c98958ff959f74083a1098ec7554f18c161b46d.issues: Only three sites; quantitative skill not reported in the abstract; wavelet preprocessing may leak future information.

5c8f635c6f405288e5691378774d3f273389cf4f.goal: Forecasts floods with deep learning to improve over shallow neural networks.
5c8f635c6f405288e5691378774d3f273389cf4f.architecture: Stacked autoencoders integrated with a backpropagation (BP) neural network.
5c8f635c6f405288e5691378774d3f273389cf4f.open_work: Evaluating on more basins and longer lead times.
5c8f635c6f405288e5691378774d3f273389cf4f.issues: Early deep learning study; details of data and evaluation not available here.

f4f8592b363252ff5bef3215bd881d987f146dc0.goal: Forecasts urban flash floods quickly, where numerical simulation alone is too slow for warning.
f4f8592b363252ff5bef3215bd881d987f146dc0.architecture: Support vector machine combined with numerical flood simulation, which provides training data.
f4f8592b363252ff5bef3215bd881d987f146dc0.open_work: Validation against observed flood events and real-time deployment.
f4f8592b363252ff5bef3215bd881d987f146dc0.issues: Trained on simulated scenarios, so it inherits the hydraulic model's errors.

bc79ecce47a8fcd9fa0fbaa9307e885bf764caff.goal: Predicts monthly rainfall in a tropical climate more accurately by combining linear and nonlinear models.
bc79ecce47a8fcd9fa0fbaa9307e885bf764caff.architecture: Hybrid of a linear stochastic model with an extreme learning machine, with stationarization and normality-transform preprocessing scenarios (11,013 models evaluated).
bc79ecce47a8fcd9fa0fbaa9307e885bf764caff.data: Monthly rainfall records from a tropical-climate station; location not detailed in the abstract.
bc79ecce47a8fcd9fa0fbaa9307e885bf764caff.result: Johnson transform plus seasonal standardization gives R2 0.99, RMSE 0.6; hybrids beat ANFIS-firefly and uncertainty analysis shows good performance (d-factor 0.27).
bc79ecce47a8fcd9fa0fbaa9307e885bf764caff.open_work: Testing at other sites and climates.
bc79ecce47a8fcd9fa0fbaa9307e885bf764caff.issues: Very high R2 suggests possible overfitting from extensive preprocessing search; single-region evaluation.

89ea5dc61765405fdb98205272ba1dcae026ae09.goal: Reviews machine learning approaches for drought modelling, monitoring and prediction.
89ea5dc61765405fdb98205272ba1dcae026ae09.architecture: Review of machine learning methods for drought modelling.
89ea5dc61765405fdb98205272ba1dcae026ae09.data: Review of literature; no new data.
89ea5dc61765405fdb98205272ba1dcae026ae09.issues: Scope and coverage of the review cannot be assessed without the abstract.

9109c21ed9d4e03891d8600fdd611377a4d082d2.goal: Forecasts ambient air pollutant concentrations accurately to support prevention planning and health protection.
9109c21ed9d4e03891d8600fdd611377a4d082d2.architecture: Integrated multiple directed attention variational autoencoder (IMDA-VAE), a deep learning model combining a VAE with attention mechanisms.
9109c21ed9d4e03891d8600fdd611377a4d082d2.data: Air pollution monitoring data from four US states.
9109c21ed9d4e03891d8600fdd611377a4d082d2.result: IMDA-VAE outperforms VAE, LSTM, GRU, BiLSTM, BiGRU, ConvLSTM and attention-based LSTM/GRU on six statistical indicators.
9109c21ed9d4e03891d8600fdd611377a4d082d2.open_work: Adding meteorological forecast inputs and longer horizons.
9109c21ed9d4e03891d8600fdd611377a4d082d2.issues: Purely data-driven; quantitative gains not given in the abstract; no uncertainty assessment despite the VAE.

05b5e640dbbe1306cc7787e8eff7ca6843d742dc.goal: Predicts daily sea surface temperature with neural networks.
05b5e640dbbe1306cc7787e8eff7ca6843d742dc.architecture: Artificial neural network for daily SST prediction.
05b5e640dbbe1306cc7787e8eff7ca6843d742dc.open_work: Extending to longer lead times and larger regions.
05b5e640dbbe1306cc7787e8eff7ca6843d742dc.issues: Study region, inputs and lead times are not available here, so skill cannot be judged.

ef9c72dede66b7fe7097ca1ae6c391b70a6a1d2f.goal: Improves separation of global horizontal irradiance into direct and diffuse components, needed for solar energy applications.
ef9c72dede66b7fe7097ca1ae6c391b70a6a1d2f.architecture: Gradient boosting machine learning for global-to-diffuse/direct separation.
ef9c72dede66b7fe7097ca1ae6c391b70a6a1d2f.open_work: Testing across more climates and comparing with recent separation models.
ef9c72dede66b7fe7097ca1ae6c391b70a6a1d2f.issues: Performance may depend on training sites and climate representativeness.

9b1ac21c9f07a936488ed3f2d3806673df01b1a2.goal: Predicts 3D spatio-temporal wind fields for wind turbine applications accurately and efficiently.
9b1ac21c9f07a936488ed3f2d3806673df01b1a2.open_work: Validation against field measurements and integration with turbine load analysis.
9b1ac21c9f07a936488ed3f2d3806673df01b1a2.issues: Physics constraints and frequency-domain formulation may limit applicability to non-stationary wind.

a3dd8f5cdd689c2397b4516d44a2d68da963421c.goal: Generates localized weather data for building energy modelling, since standard weather files miss local effects like heat islands.
a3dd8f5cdd689c2397b4516d44a2d68da963421c.architecture: Recurrent neural networks mapping public airport weather data to on-site conditions.
a3dd8f5cdd689c2397b4516d44a2d68da963421c.data: Public airport weather station data and on-site measurements; standard weather files (TMY, WYEC2) as baselines.
a3dd8f5cdd689c2397b4516d44a2d68da963421c.result: MSE of 2.96 and over 100% improvement in test accuracy compared with standard weather files and nearest airport data.
a3dd8f5cdd689c2397b4516d44a2d68da963421c.open_work: Morphing generic weather files and extending short on-site records for urban analysis and climate resilience.
a3dd8f5cdd689c2397b4516d44a2d68da963421c.issues: Requires on-site measurements for training; single-site evaluation; accuracy metrics loosely defined.

a4515a337658498cabeac3249f0f73de84f23fd9.goal: Predicts PM2.5 over the Los Angeles area days in advance to mitigate health effects.
a4515a337658498cabeac3249f0f73de84f23fd9.architecture: Graph convolutional network for interpolating meteorological graphs combined with ConvLSTM for spatiotemporal PM2.5 prediction.
a4515a337658498cabeac3249f0f73de84f23fd9.data: Government ground-based PM2.5 sensors, meteorological data and remote-sensing satellite imagery of atmospheric pollutants over greater Los Angeles County.
a4515a337658498cabeac3249f0f73de84f23fd9.result: Predicts PM2.5 about 10 days ahead from 10 past days, with significant error improvement over prior spatiotemporal deep learning work.
a4515a337658498cabeac3249f0f73de84f23fd9.open_work: Extending to other regions and providing uncertainty estimates.
a4515a337658498cabeac3249f0f73de84f23fd9.issues: Quantitative errors not given in the abstract; single region; long-lead skill claims need careful verification.

9165129cca58c13effd1cff7854f115d16d106d3.goal: Assesses random forests and Prophet for daily streamflow forecasting up to seven days ahead.
9165129cca58c13effd1cff7854f115d16d106d3.architecture: Random forests and Prophet compared with a naive method and multiple linear regression.
9165129cca58c13effd1cff7854f115d16d106d3.data: Daily streamflow and precipitation for a single US river.
9165129cca58c13effd1cff7854f115d16d106d3.result: Random forests perform best overall and capture abrupt fluctuations better; Prophet beats the naive method beyond three days.
9165129cca58c13effd1cff7854f115d16d106d3.issues: Single river; Prophet uses no precipitation input, making comparison uneven.

f5ddefe4b912e099dc6e738a85ef5b3b077b6d78.goal: Imputes missing PM2.5 data and forecasts concentrations in a single training process.
f5ddefe4b912e099dc6e738a85ef5b3b077b6d78.architecture: Multi-directional temporal convolutional artificial neural network (MTCAN), a temporal convolutional network performing imputation and forecasting jointly.
f5ddefe4b912e099dc6e738a85ef5b3b077b6d78.data: PM2.5, other pollutant and meteorological measurements; location not detailed in the abstract.
f5ddefe4b912e099dc6e738a85ef5b3b077b6d78.result: MTCAN outperforms baseline pollution forecasting models.
f5ddefe4b912e099dc6e738a85ef5b3b077b6d78.open_work: Testing on other stations and pollutants.
f5ddefe4b912e099dc6e738a85ef5b3b077b6d78.issues: Quantitative results not given; dataset details unclear.

98e42442856cfd2f0542e263247ad3095ea9da18.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting accuracy for wind energy management by better extracting temporal information.
98e42442856cfd2f0542e263247ad3095ea9da18.architecture: Hybrid system: decomposition into subseries, GRU recurrent network corrected by a convolutional spiking neural network, and optimized linear combination of subseries forecasts.
98e42442856cfd2f0542e263247ad3095ea9da18.data: Four wind speed datasets from the Liaotung Peninsula, China; only past wind observations as inputs.
98e42442856cfd2f0542e263247ad3095ea9da18.result: MAPE of 1.43%, 1.40%, 1.49% and 2.56% at the four sites.
98e42442856cfd2f0542e263247ad3095ea9da18.open_work: Including exogenous meteorological inputs and longer horizons.
98e42442856cfd2f0542e263247ad3095ea9da18.issues: Univariate approach; decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information; complex system.

396b9f2ce7f42c922e49e106aaac30aec257d683.goal: Forecasts nationwide city air quality, capturing dependencies between geographically distant but correlated cities.
396b9f2ce7f42c922e49e106aaac30aec257d683.architecture: Group-aware graph neural network (GAGNN) with city graph and city group graph, differentiable grouping and message passing.
396b9f2ce7f42c922e49e106aaac30aec257d683.data: Two nationwide city air quality datasets for China and the US.
396b9f2ce7f42c922e49e106aaac30aec257d683.result: GAGNN outperforms existing forecasting models on both datasets.
396b9f2ce7f42c922e49e106aaac30aec257d683.open_work: Incorporating meteorological forecasts and interpreting learned groups.
396b9f2ce7f42c922e49e106aaac30aec257d683.issues: Quantitative gains not given in the abstract.

a0c4e039a662b964d3bc94b041f60db38c83ddba.goal: Forecasts multi-step daily streamflow using spatial relationships among stations.
a0c4e039a662b964d3bc94b041f60db38c83ddba.architecture: Directed graph deep neural network (graph neural network) for multi-step forecasting.
a0c4e039a662b964d3bc94b041f60db38c83ddba.issues: Details unavailable; generalization not assessed here.

45856c5d548300000d8eab694de0ab11fe230fb1.goal: Assesses flash flood susceptibility in the Dadu River Basin using hybrid statistical and machine learning models.
45856c5d548300000d8eab694de0ab11fe230fb1.architecture: Hybrids of fuzzy membership value bivariate statistics with SVM, CART decision trees and a convolutional neural network.
45856c5d548300000d8eab694de0ab11fe230fb1.data: Geospatial database of nine conditioning factors from remote sensing, 485 flood and 485 non-flood locations.
45856c5d548300000d8eab694de0ab11fe230fb1.result: CNN-FMV performs best with AUC 0.935 (success) and 0.912 (prediction); hybrids beat their single models; 13–22% of the area is high/very high susceptibility.
45856c5d548300000d8eab694de0ab11fe230fb1.open_work: Applying the hybrids to other areas.
45856c5d548300000d8eab694de0ab11fe230fb1.issues: Static susceptibility maps; balanced sampling of non-flood points affects results.

626e475d997393af312e6c38dbd82e879b6d5a65.goal: Forecasts daily global and direct solar radiation multiple steps ahead in a Saharan climate for solar energy applications.
626e475d997393af312e6c38dbd82e879b6d5a65.architecture: Weighted Gaussian process regression (WGPR) in parallel and cascade architectures; includes a review.
626e475d997393af312e6c38dbd82e879b6d5a65.data: Global and direct radiation measurements, 2013–2015, Ghardaia, Algeria.
626e475d997393af312e6c38dbd82e879b6d5a65.result: WGPR-CFA gives RMSE 3.18 MJ/m2 (r2 85.85%) for 10-day global and 5.23 MJ/m2 (r2 56.21%) for direct radiation, better than basic GPR.
626e475d997393af312e6c38dbd82e879b6d5a65.issues: Single site, three years; direct radiation forecasts remain weak.

86c19f834cc15598b6590ff48cc699cee82ae009.goal: Maps quasi-global soil moisture at high spatio-temporal resolution from GNSS reflectometry.
86c19f834cc15598b6590ff48cc699cee82ae009.architecture: Machine learning retrieval from CYGNSS reflectivity plus land surface parameters, trained on SMAP soil moisture; model family not specified in the abstract.
86c19f834cc15598b6590ff48cc699cee82ae009.data: CYGNSS GNSS-R observations, SMAP enhanced retrievals at 9 km, ancillary land surface products, over 100 in-situ sites.
86c19f834cc15598b6590ff48cc699cee82ae009.result: ubRMSD 0.0395 cm3/cm3 against SMAP and ubRMSE 0.0543 cm3/cm3 against in-situ; triple collocation correlations 0.4–0.8 in moderate vegetation.
86c19f834cc15598b6590ff48cc699cee82ae009.open_work: Improving retrievals in dense vegetation and supplementing global soil moisture records.
86c19f834cc15598b6590ff48cc699cee82ae009.issues: Trained on SMAP so it inherits SMAP errors; degraded accuracy under dense vegetation.

423d40e0b7b98762ae815cd58e6621f79f484b5b.goal: Improves daily runoff forecasting for non-stationary nonlinear series.
423d40e0b7b98762ae815cd58e6621f79f484b5b.architecture: VMD-LSTM-PSO: variational mode decomposition, LSTM per component, particle swarm optimization of hyperparameters.
423d40e0b7b98762ae815cd58e6621f79f484b5b.data: Daily runoff at three stations on the Yellow River, China.
423d40e0b7b98762ae815cd58e6621f79f484b5b.result: Outperforms CEEMD-LSTM-PSO, WT-LSTM-PSO and LSTM-PSO in accuracy and stability.
423d40e0b7b98762ae815cd58e6621f79f484b5b.issues: Quantitative metrics not in the abstract; decomposition of whole series risks information leakage.

1393fd3f199927b2bccf3d4d543804f4262d711a.goal: Predicts groundwater levels using meteorological inputs.
1393fd3f199927b2bccf3d4d543804f4262d711a.architecture: Gated recurrent unit (GRU) neural networks with meteorological inputs.
1393fd3f199927b2bccf3d4d543804f4262d711a.open_work: Testing at more wells and aquifers.

88e846ff9b2caaa08bfc54fc10ac385b553ea480.goal: Forecasts solar ultraviolet index at very short horizons for sun exposure warnings.
88e846ff9b2caaa08bfc54fc10ac385b553ea480.architecture: Extreme learning machine integrated with solar zenith angle.
88e846ff9b2caaa08bfc54fc10ac385b553ea480.open_work: Testing under varied cloud conditions and locations.
88e846ff9b2caaa08bfc54fc10ac385b553ea480.issues: Site-specific; cloud effects may limit accuracy.

1af66d6e319113c1aabc6ac6e8847c4c73098afd.goal: Improves runoff forecasts by predicting and correcting model errors.
1af66d6e319113c1aabc6ac6e8847c4c73098afd.architecture: Deep learning error-prediction approach applied to runoff forecasts; network type not specified in the available metadata.
1af66d6e319113c1aabc6ac6e8847c4c73098afd.open_work: Applying to other basins and models.

3d84b58f3a319eaa0fb124773107d3a6a4fdd5f2.goal: Quantifies global benefits of non-continuous flooding in rice for GHG reduction and irrigation savings without yield loss.
3d84b58f3a319eaa0fb124773107d3a6a4fdd5f2.architecture: Random forest regression models identifying drivers of effects and mapping optimal strategies.
3d84b58f3a319eaa0fb124773107d3a6a4fdd5f2.data: 636 field trials at 105 georeferenced sites globally.
3d84b58f3a319eaa0fb124773107d3a6a4fdd5f2.result: Non-continuous flooding feasible on 76% of rice area, cutting CH4+N2O GWP by 47% or irrigation by 25% without yield penalty; unflooded days ratio is the key driver.
3d84b58f3a319eaa0fb124773107d3a6a4fdd5f2.open_work: Implementation in South and Southeast Asia.
3d84b58f3a319eaa0fb124773107d3a6a4fdd5f2.issues: Extrapolation from limited field trials; does not model socioeconomic barriers.

801d822d5de96be73130baa06b3341b6b6b4725c.goal: Shows how data splitting for calibration and evaluation affects robustness of hydrological data-driven models.
801d822d5de96be73130baa06b3341b6b6b4725c.architecture: Data-driven models (artificial neural networks) developed with different calibration/evaluation splits.

2b69058682edd9454908be52d05f4941f6d167cb.goal: Predicts daily groundwater levels and tests whether classifying inputs by season improves data-driven forecasts for aquifer management.
2b69058682edd9454908be52d05f4941f6d167cb.architecture: Nonlinear autoregressive network with exogenous inputs (NARX, a recurrent neural network) compared with support vector machines (SVM), using seasonally classified inputs.
2b69058682edd9454908be52d05f4941f6d167cb.data: Daily groundwater level and related hydro-meteorological records from observation wells; site and period not reported here.
2b69058682edd9454908be52d05f4941f6d167cb.result: No abstract available; specific findings are not reported here. The title implies a comparison of NARX and SVM skill with seasonal versus unclassified inputs.
2b69058682edd9454908be52d05f4941f6d167cb.open_work: Testing across more aquifers and longer lead times, and adding uncertainty estimates, would follow naturally.
2b69058682edd9454908be52d05f4941f6d167cb.issues: Point-scale well data; generalization to other aquifers and climate regimes is unclear; details of evaluation are not available here.

dc9bbec761e550d4ed181d04e99c29ee79f57b58.goal: Estimates reference evapotranspiration in South Korea from temperature data alone, for situations where full meteorological inputs for FAO56 Penman–Monteith are unavailable.
dc9bbec761e550d4ed181d04e99c29ee79f57b58.architecture: Multiple linear regression and polynomial regression (twelve model variants) using mean temperature, daily temperature range and extraterrestrial radiation; compared with Hargreaves, Blaney–Criddle and Thornthwaite empirical equations.
dc9bbec761e550d4ed181d04e99c29ee79f57b58.data: FAO56 Penman–Monteith ET0 computed from 62 KMA meteorological stations, 1981–2021, at daily, monthly and annual scales; 2017–2021 used for evaluation.
dc9bbec761e550d4ed181d04e99c29ee79f57b58.result: Polynomial regression with extraterrestrial radiation performs best, with RMSE of 0.72 mm/day, 11.3 mm/month and 40.5 mm/year, outperforming the temperature-based empirical equations.
dc9bbec761e550d4ed181d04e99c29ee79f57b58.open_work: Testing nonlinear ML methods and transfer to other climates or data-scarce regions would extend the approach.
dc9bbec761e550d4ed181d04e99c29ee79f57b58.issues: Simple regression forms; labels are themselves computed ET0 rather than measured evapotranspiration; evaluation limited to South Korean stations.

bd7e36a8f434a9d43f1685ed78dd75488261df50.goal: Forecasts reference evapotranspiration multiple steps ahead to support irrigation scheduling and water resources planning.
bd7e36a8f434a9d43f1685ed78dd75488261df50.architecture: Hybrid wavelet transform plus Gaussian process regression (wavelet-GPR), where wavelet decomposition preprocesses inputs for the GPR model.
bd7e36a8f434a9d43f1685ed78dd75488261df50.data: Reference evapotranspiration time series from meteorological station(s); location and period not reported here.
bd7e36a8f434a9d43f1685ed78dd75488261df50.result: No abstract available; specific findings are not reported here. The title implies the wavelet-GPR hybrid is assessed for multi-step-ahead ET0 forecasting.
bd7e36a8f434a9d43f1685ed78dd75488261df50.open_work: Comparison with deep learning sequence models and testing at more stations would follow naturally.
bd7e36a8f434a9d43f1685ed78dd75488261df50.issues: Wavelet decomposition in hybrid forecasting can leak future information if not applied causally; single-region evaluation likely limits generality.

ce93080dddd032da7b911d7884fcb08d53475514.goal: Improves short-term wind speed prediction as the basis for wind power forecasting and grid dispatching.
ce93080dddd032da7b911d7884fcb08d53475514.architecture: Back-propagation MLP neural network with weights and thresholds optimized by improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO-BP), PCA input selection, and a Lorenz-system disturbance correction of initial predictions.
ce93080dddd032da7b911d7884fcb08d53475514.data: Wind farm measurements from Spain and Chang Ma, China.
ce93080dddd032da7b911d7884fcb08d53475514.result: IPSO speeds convergence of the BP network, and the Lorenz disturbance correction reduces the random volatility and improves prediction accuracy; no headline numbers are given in the abstract.
ce93080dddd032da7b911d7884fcb08d53475514.open_work: Extending to multi-step and probabilistic forecasts and testing at more wind farms would follow naturally.
ce93080dddd032da7b911d7884fcb08d53475514.issues: Physical justification of the Lorenz correction is loose; evaluation on two sites only; no uncertainty quantification.

ffd3b9da5f0e91360e1d2143ec72ef5478d6f220.goal: Predicts floods from hydrological time series collected by a wireless sensor network, as a basis for early warning.
ffd3b9da5f0e91360e1d2143ec72ef5478d6f220.architecture: Multilayer perceptron (MLP) deep learning model applied to sensor time series data mining.
ffd3b9da5f0e91360e1d2143ec72ef5478d6f220.data: Hydrology time series (e.g. water level, rainfall) from a wireless sensor network; site and period not reported here.
ffd3b9da5f0e91360e1d2143ec72ef5478d6f220.result: No abstract available; specific findings are not reported here.
ffd3b9da5f0e91360e1d2143ec72ef5478d6f220.open_work: Comparison with recurrent sequence models and longer lead times would follow naturally.
ffd3b9da5f0e91360e1d2143ec72ef5478d6f220.issues: Conference study with likely small, local datasets; generalization and operational robustness are unclear.

8dbd2fc4a0f6c1882bdc0b0c1bdc80eb850d9451.goal: Improves one-month-ahead streamflow forecasting, which is hard for data-driven models without preprocessing, for water supply and drought and flood management.
8dbd2fc4a0f6c1882bdc0b0c1bdc80eb850d9451.architecture: Continuous wavelet transform with multigene genetic programming (MGGP) selecting important wavelet scales that feed an artificial neural network (ANN, MLP); compared with standalone and best-scale ANN and MGGP layouts.
8dbd2fc4a0f6c1882bdc0b0c1bdc80eb850d9451.data: Monthly downstream and upstream flow, rainfall, temperature and potential evapotranspiration with lags for a basin in southeastern Turkey; wavelet coherence analysis of predictors.
8dbd2fc4a0f6c1882bdc0b0c1bdc80eb850d9451.result: Standalone models perform poorly and best-scale models slightly better, while the CWT-MGGP-ANN model improves performance dramatically, especially for peak flows; adding meteorological variables also helps.
8dbd2fc4a0f6c1882bdc0b0c1bdc80eb850d9451.open_work: Testing in other basins and at different lead times would show whether scale selection transfers.
8dbd2fc4a0f6c1882bdc0b0c1bdc80eb850d9451.issues: Single basin; wavelet preprocessing may introduce boundary effects for real-time forecasting; no numerical skill given in the abstract.

4db0a7027efad057eda855922f17b148172812d0.goal: Separates meteorological and emission-driven contributions to the 2015–2021 surface ozone trend in Tianjin, China, to inform O3 control.
4db0a7027efad057eda855922f17b148172812d0.architecture: Seasonal-Trend decomposition based on Loess (STL) combined with random forest meteorological normalization to remove weather-driven variability.
4db0a7027efad057eda855922f17b148172812d0.data: Observed surface O3 and meteorological data for Tianjin, 2015–2021.
4db0a7027efad057eda855922f17b148172812d0.result: O3 variation is largely emission-driven; meteorology was unfavorable in 2015–2016 and favorable 2017–2021, adding 9.3 µg/m3 (13%) in 2019. Temperature and humidity dominate; exceedances occur at RH 40–50% and T > 31 °C.
4db0a7027efad057eda855922f17b148172812d0.open_work: Apply the decomposition to forecasting and to other cities, and attribute emission effects to specific precursors.
4db0a7027efad057eda855922f17b148172812d0.issues: Single city; random forest attribution is statistical and cannot separate NOx and VOC effects; residual trend attributed to emissions by assumption.

223d225a9f3599a626a11dd2c0ea93110f47e252.goal: Compares neural network approaches for very short-term solar irradiance forecasting to support PV power prediction and grid stability.
223d225a9f3599a626a11dd2c0ea93110f47e252.architecture: Feed-forward artificial neural network (ANN, MLP) versus long short-term memory (LSTM) network, with two sets of exogenous meteorological inputs and 1, 15 and 60 min horizons.
223d225a9f3599a626a11dd2c0ea93110f47e252.data: Irradiance and meteorological measurements from a controlled experimental site; location details not reported in the abstract.
223d225a9f3599a626a11dd2c0ea93110f47e252.result: LSTM is significantly more accurate overall (MAPE 19.5%, p < 0.001) except at 60 min; the gap shrinks with horizon and input set choice has no significant effect.
223d225a9f3599a626a11dd2c0ea93110f47e252.open_work: Longer horizons, sky imagery or satellite inputs, and probabilistic forecasts would extend the comparison.
223d225a9f3599a626a11dd2c0ea93110f47e252.issues: Single site; short horizons only; MAPE is unstable at low irradiance; no uncertainty quantification.

69f3200b8339ea5276399d14350873deb9906e2e.goal: Builds a short-term wind speed forecasting system that selects and combines multivariate predictors for wind power operations.
69f3200b8339ea5276399d14350873deb9906e2e.architecture: Convolutional-recurrent neural network (CNN-RNN) forecasters combined through a multi-objective chameleon swarm optimization algorithm in a selection-combination framework.
69f3200b8339ea5276399d14350873deb9906e2e.data: Wind speed and related meteorological time series from wind sites; specifics not reported here.
69f3200b8339ea5276399d14350873deb9906e2e.result: No abstract available; specific findings are not reported here. The title implies the combined system improves on individual forecasters.
69f3200b8339ea5276399d14350873deb9906e2e.open_work: Probabilistic extensions and tests across more sites and seasons would follow naturally.
69f3200b8339ea5276399d14350873deb9906e2e.issues: Complex hybrid with metaheuristic tuning risks overfitting; evaluation details are unknown here.

5dc18f949f644faa3f5959f7201d1c1fe491ec59.goal: Develops a fast data-driven flood prediction mapping model that generalizes to unseen catchments, replacing slow physically based simulations.
5dc18f949f644faa3f5959f7201d1c1fe491ec59.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) mapping terrain to flood water depth and flow velocity, with patch-based and resizing-based options for catchments of different size and shape.
5dc18f949f644faa3f5959f7201d1c1fe491ec59.data: Simulations from a physically based flood model over multiple catchments with different topography; specific catchments not reported in the abstract.
5dc18f949f644faa3f5959f7201d1c1fe491ec59.result: The CNN predicts accurately on unseen catchments at much lower computational cost; patch-based processing beats resizing, and velocity is predicted more accurately than water depth.
5dc18f949f644faa3f5959f7201d1c1fe491ec59.open_work: Incorporate global elevation context for depth prediction and test on varied rainfall events and real observations.
5dc18f949f644faa3f5959f7201d1c1fe491ec59.issues: Trained and evaluated against simulator output, not observed floods; water depth sensitive to global context missing from patches.

ac2f9b68616e812479d13f6695c47c1961bf8560.goal: Predicts tea yield and compares a calibrated crop simulation model with machine learning regressors for timely yield estimation.
ac2f9b68616e812479d13f6695c47c1961bf8560.architecture: FAO AquaCrop crop simulation model compared with ten machine learning regression algorithms, with XGBoost (gradient boosting) best; hybrid combination of simulation and ML.
ac2f9b68616e812479d13f6695c47c1961bf8560.data: Weather, soil, crop and agro-management data, 2016–2019, from tea fields of the National Tea and High-Value Crop Research Institute, Pakistan.
ac2f9b68616e812479d13f6695c47c1961bf8560.result: AquaCrop calibration gives RMSE 0.48 t/ha, while XGBoost reaches RMSE 0.120 t/ha (10-fold CV) and 0.154 t/ha (train-test split), outperforming the simulation model with less data.
ac2f9b68616e812479d13f6695c47c1961bf8560.open_work: Validate over more years and sites and integrate simulation outputs as ML features more systematically.
ac2f9b68616e812479d13f6695c47c1961bf8560.issues: Very small dataset of four seasons at one institute; risk of overfitting; cross-validation may not reflect interannual extrapolation.

128deccab56fa3fe0f09e457a73b134ac86d11e4.goal: Provides accurate, interpretable ultra-short-term spatiotemporal forecasts of renewable resources using off-site information for power system operation.
128deccab56fa3fe0f09e457a73b134ac86d11e4.architecture: Attention temporal convolutional network: stacked dilated causal convolutions (temporal convolutional network, CNN) with attention mechanisms, producing point and probabilistic forecasts.
128deccab56fa3fe0f09e457a73b134ac86d11e4.data: National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) solar generation and wind speed datasets.
128deccab56fa3fe0f09e457a73b134ac86d11e4.result: Outperforms five baselines in skill scores, with average accuracy improvements of 15.08% for point and 15.85% for probabilistic forecasts.
128deccab56fa3fe0f09e457a73b134ac86d11e4.open_work: Extend to longer horizons and integrate numerical weather prediction inputs.
128deccab56fa3fe0f09e457a73b134ac86d11e4.issues: Ultra-short horizons only; evaluated on NREL synthetic or curated datasets; attention-based interpretability is qualitative.

1b61c54bb05559a0ccbeb673f5a03ebfcbc6341e.goal: Improves multi-step short-term wind speed forecasting and addresses the difficulty of decomposition-ensemble models when new data arrive.
1b61c54bb05559a0ccbeb673f5a03ebfcbc6341e.architecture: Adaptive secondary decomposition (EEMD plus adaptive variational mode decomposition with sample entropy) with a leave-one-out regularized extreme learning machine optimized by the backtracking search algorithm.
1b61c54bb05559a0ccbeb673f5a03ebfcbc6341e.data: Several real wind speed series; sites not reported in the abstract.
1b61c54bb05559a0ccbeb673f5a03ebfcbc6341e.result: Outperforms thirteen benchmark models across lead times in reliability, sharpness and overall skill; no headline numbers given in the abstract.
1b61c54bb05559a0ccbeb673f5a03ebfcbc6341e.open_work: Testing on more sites and in operational real-time settings would follow naturally.
1b61c54bb05559a0ccbeb673f5a03ebfcbc6341e.issues: Complex hybrid pipeline; decomposition-based forecasting is prone to look-ahead leakage if not handled carefully, which the adaptive scheme targets.

4c2a46c096fafeca82c30715d70ee18aa44c95dc.goal: Assesses data-driven and empirical models for pan evaporation estimation across China's climatic zones for water resources management.
4c2a46c096fafeca82c30715d70ee18aa44c95dc.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM) and MLP artificial neural networks optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO-ANN) and genetic algorithm (GA-ANN), with nine input combinations, versus Stephens–Stewart and PenPan models.
4c2a46c096fafeca82c30715d70ee18aa44c95dc.data: Pan evaporation and climate variables from 178 meteorological stations across four climatic zones of China.
4c2a46c096fafeca82c30715d70ee18aa44c95dc.result: ELM with full inputs is best (RRMSE 12.5–15.2%, NS 0.909–0.936); temperature is the most influential input; temperature-based PSO-ANN or GA-ANN are recommended per zone when data are missing.
4c2a46c096fafeca82c30715d70ee18aa44c95dc.open_work: Spatial transfer to ungauged stations and extension to actual evaporation would follow naturally.
4c2a46c096fafeca82c30715d70ee18aa44c95dc.issues: Station-based models; pan evaporation differs from actual evaporation; zone-wise recommendations depend on available inputs.

fd7a06ceaf38f5c4987d1268b456029b001e5929.goal: Retrieves oceanic internal wave amplitudes from satellite imagery, a quantity hard to obtain from images directly.
fd7a06ceaf38f5c4987d1268b456029b001e5929.architecture: Data-driven transfer learning model (deep neural network pretrained then adapted); exact network type not specified here.
fd7a06ceaf38f5c4987d1268b456029b001e5929.data: Satellite images of oceanic internal waves with amplitude reference data; sources not reported here.
fd7a06ceaf38f5c4987d1268b456029b001e5929.result: No abstract available; specific findings are not reported here.
fd7a06ceaf38f5c4987d1268b456029b001e5929.open_work: Broader validation against in situ moorings and other regions would follow naturally.
fd7a06ceaf38f5c4987d1268b456029b001e5929.issues: Limited labeled amplitude data motivates transfer learning; details of training data and accuracy are unknown here.

c0ee1c988f08771042692d16e6ee642b53745030.goal: Couples conceptual rainfall-runoff models with machine learning to combine physical representation and data-driven accuracy in a snow-covered basin.
c0ee1c988f08771042692d16e6ee642b53745030.architecture: IHACRES, GR4J and MISD conceptual models whose outputs, with meteorological variables, feed MLP and support vector machine models, fused via a fusion MLP and MLP with whale optimization algorithm (MLP-WOA).
c0ee1c988f08771042692d16e6ee642b53745030.data: Runoff and hydro-meteorological data (precipitation, wind, humidity, temperature, snow depth) for a snow-covered catchment in Switzerland.
c0ee1c988f08771042692d16e6ee642b53745030.result: IHACRES outperforms GR4J and MISD; the IHACRES-based MLP-WOA reaches RMSE 8.49 m3/s, about 27% better than IHACRES alone; adding meteorological variables improves accuracy.
c0ee1c988f08771042692d16e6ee642b53745030.open_work: Apply the coupled framework to other catchments and hydrological variables.
c0ee1c988f08771042692d16e6ee642b53745030.issues: Single catchment; multi-stage stacking risks overfitting; no uncertainty estimates.

cb094967cefd79fe2f54b316b2aace2446486dad.goal: Forecasts daily runoff and examines what a hybrid deep learning model learns for streamflow prediction.
cb094967cefd79fe2f54b316b2aace2446486dad.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM: convolutional neural network feature extraction followed by long short-term memory network.
cb094967cefd79fe2f54b316b2aace2446486dad.data: Daily runoff and meteorological records for a study basin; not reported here.
cb094967cefd79fe2f54b316b2aace2446486dad.result: No abstract available; specific findings are not reported here.
cb094967cefd79fe2f54b316b2aace2446486dad.open_work: Testing across multiple basins and longer lead times would follow naturally.
cb094967cefd79fe2f54b316b2aace2446486dad.issues: Likely single-basin evaluation; interpretability claims and generalization cannot be verified here.

4e7d35e6d625efc9deeeb1f5802a4e02b1cafc7a.goal: Produces scalable pre-season soybean and maize yield forecasts without relying on NDVI, which is only available after the season starts.
4e7d35e6d625efc9deeeb1f5802a4e02b1cafc7a.architecture: Scalable machine learning system combining multiple data sources; the specific model type is not specified in the abstract.
4e7d35e6d625efc9deeeb1f5802a4e02b1cafc7a.data: Satellite-derived precipitation, soil property datasets and seasonal climate forecasts from physical models for Brazil and the USA.
4e7d35e6d625efc9deeeb1f5802a4e02b1cafc7a.result: Pre-season errors for soybean and maize are comparable to systems that forecast only in the first weeks to months of the crop cycle.
4e7d35e6d625efc9deeeb1f5802a4e02b1cafc7a.open_work: Update forecasts in-season and extend to other crops and countries.
4e7d35e6d625efc9deeeb1f5802a4e02b1cafc7a.issues: Depends on seasonal forecast skill; aggregation-level and quantitative errors not reported in the abstract.

b147414d7b6be9cf662eb75c67efbc40bb3f8619.goal: Predicts daily solar radiation efficiently for solar energy planning.
b147414d7b6be9cf662eb75c67efbc40bb3f8619.architecture: Hybrid CNN-REGST: four-phase convolutional neural network (CNN) feature extraction, dual-stage stacked regression and support vector machine (support vector regression).
b147414d7b6be9cf662eb75c67efbc40bb3f8619.data: Daily solar radiation and predictors for study sites; not reported here.
b147414d7b6be9cf662eb75c67efbc40bb3f8619.result: No abstract available; specific findings are not reported here. The title implies the hybrid outperforms its components and benchmarks.
b147414d7b6be9cf662eb75c67efbc40bb3f8619.open_work: Testing at more sites and adding uncertainty estimates would follow naturally.
b147414d7b6be9cf662eb75c67efbc40bb3f8619.issues: Complex stacked hybrid; generality beyond the study sites is unclear.

44e322464e39f851d306916384c7ccbe2896d99f.goal: Maps flash-flood hazard by combining deep learning with multicriteria decision analysis.
44e322464e39f851d306916384c7ccbe2896d99f.architecture: Deep learning neural network (MLP-type) from the H2O R package combined with fuzzy multicriteria decision-making analysis.
44e322464e39f851d306916384c7ccbe2896d99f.data: Flash-flood inventory and conditioning factors (e.g. slope, land use, soil) for a study catchment; not reported here.
44e322464e39f851d306916384c7ccbe2896d99f.result: No abstract available; specific findings are not reported here.
44e322464e39f851d306916384c7ccbe2896d99f.open_work: Validation in other catchments and under changing climate would follow naturally.
44e322464e39f851d306916384c7ccbe2896d99f.issues: Susceptibility mapping depends on inventory quality; static factors ignore event dynamics; details unknown here.

b4f8206361ca9e0a9ff25e55292826c2a490c2d3.goal: Forecasts direct normal irradiance to assess solar potential in Ghardaia, Algeria.
b4f8206361ca9e0a9ff25e55292826c2a490c2d3.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM (convolutional neural network with long short-term memory) compared with feed-forward back-propagation (MLP), convolutional feed-forward back-propagation and support vector regression.
b4f8206361ca9e0a9ff25e55292826c2a490c2d3.data: Measured irradiance from an experimental station in Ghardaia, Algeria; period not reported in the abstract.
b4f8206361ca9e0a9ff25e55292826c2a490c2d3.result: CNN-LSTM is most accurate and reliable, with R2 = 0.99925 and lowest errors.

0ca0d60726160db4f2bc895faad5ce2256728daf.architecture: Support vector machine (SVM) empirical hydrological model links climate to groundwater level; multiple linear regression estimates irrigation cost; driven by a GCM ensemble.

0ca0d60726160db4f2bc895faad5ce2256728daf.result: Groundwater level declines by 0.45–1.19, 0.55–1.79 and 0.76–2.71 m under the three RCPs, raising irrigation cost by 1.61–9.82 USD/ha on average; up to 4.12 m decline in the northeast.
0ca0d60726160db4f2bc895faad5ce2256728daf.open_work: Including abstraction and land-use changes and other cost components in future projections.
0ca0d60726160db4f2bc895faad5ce2256728daf.issues: Empirical SVM extrapolated to future climates; ignores changes in pumping and management; GCM downscaling uncertainty.

37bc898276d009429efb4aa7834a1a691fa40f92.goal: Improves short-term runoff prediction with a deep learning multi-dimensional ensemble method.
37bc898276d009429efb4aa7834a1a691fa40f92.architecture: Deep learning ensemble combining models across multiple dimensions; the component network types are not specified in the available metadata.

d8ac58adb58cba058d725621e925e80b2cf4abb3.goal: Improves short-term solar radiation forecasting for power systems with high photovoltaic shares by better input and lag selection.
d8ac58adb58cba058d725621e925e80b2cf4abb3.architecture: Support vector regression, XGBoost, CatBoost and a voting-average ensemble; ensemble feature selection combining Pearson correlation, random forest importance, mutual information and Relief.
d8ac58adb58cba058d725621e925e80b2cf4abb3.data: Real meteorological and solar radiation database from Salvador, Brazil; 1, 2 and 3 h ahead horizons.
d8ac58adb58cba058d725621e925e80b2cf4abb3.result: The ensemble feature selection improves accuracy, and the voting-average ensemble performs best at all horizons.
d8ac58adb58cba058d725621e925e80b2cf4abb3.open_work: Extending to more sites, longer horizons and probabilistic forecasts.
d8ac58adb58cba058d725621e925e80b2cf4abb3.issues: Single site; skill numbers and comparison with persistence or NWP not reported in the abstract.

e2111cf7e8d2fcb2fd548469488da69466cec8c7.goal: Improves wind speed prediction by handling missing data and nonstationarity before deep learning forecasting.
e2111cf7e8d2fcb2fd548469488da69466cec8c7.architecture: Integrated approach of missing-data imputation and signal decomposition algorithms feeding a bidirectional LSTM neural network.
e2111cf7e8d2fcb2fd548469488da69466cec8c7.data: Not reported in the available metadata. Measured wind speed time series are implied.
e2111cf7e8d2fcb2fd548469488da69466cec8c7.result: Not reported in the available metadata. The integrated approach is presented as more accurate than benchmarks.
e2111cf7e8d2fcb2fd548469488da69466cec8c7.open_work: Multi-step and probabilistic forecasting and testing at more sites.
e2111cf7e8d2fcb2fd548469488da69466cec8c7.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified. Decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information if decomposition is applied to the whole series.

13cbc535325741be1918e90ebaca3b9f4089e186.goal: Predicts daily river water level to support flood risk planning on the Durian Tunggal river, Malaysia.
13cbc535325741be1918e90ebaca3b9f4089e186.architecture: Six machine learning regression algorithms compared, with exponential Gaussian process regression (GPR) selected as best.
13cbc535325741be1918e90ebaca3b9f4089e186.data: Daily water level data for the Durian Tunggal river, Malaysia, 1990–2019, with several input combinations.
13cbc535325741be1918e90ebaca3b9f4089e186.result: Exponential GPR is most accurate, captures 10-day maxima and minima, and yields 95PPU of 98.276 and d-factor of 0.000525.
13cbc535325741be1918e90ebaca3b9f4089e186.open_work: Multi-day lead forecasting and including rainfall inputs for flood early warning.
13cbc535325741be1918e90ebaca3b9f4089e186.issues: Single river; daily prediction from antecedent levels may mostly exploit persistence; skill metrics beyond uncertainty indices not given in the abstract.

78c113c0d09a11e2091f5234355a73d6ade3c615.goal: Reviews how AI can better quantify climate change-induced hazards, impacts and risks, using flood risk as the main example.
78c113c0d09a11e2091f5234355a73d6ade3c615.architecture: Review of AI for climate impacts covering data-driven modelling, uncertainty quantification and geospatial big data, with flood applications and a technology framework.
78c113c0d09a11e2091f5234355a73d6ade3c615.data: Review; draws on flood-related examples using weather, climate and geospatial data.
78c113c0d09a11e2091f5234355a73d6ade3c615.result: AI can streamline translating weather and climate data into actionable risk information and help build climate resilience, while having limitations.
78c113c0d09a11e2091f5234355a73d6ade3c615.open_work: Better uncertainty quantification, trustworthy deployment and integration frameworks for climate risk assessment.
78c113c0d09a11e2091f5234355a73d6ade3c615.issues: Perspective-style review focused on floods; limited quantitative comparison of methods.

c257064f67c5edae64259369e68195114aff9d9b.goal: Provides high temporal resolution urban flood prediction as a fast alternative to hydrodynamic simulation.
c257064f67c5edae64259369e68195114aff9d9b.architecture: Attention-based LSTM recurrent neural network models.
c257064f67c5edae64259369e68195114aff9d9b.data: Not reported in the available metadata. Rainfall inputs and simulated or observed urban inundation are implied.
c257064f67c5edae64259369e68195114aff9d9b.result: Not reported in the available metadata. The attention-LSTM is presented as accurate at high temporal resolution.
c257064f67c5edae64259369e68195114aff9d9b.open_work: Transfer to other urban catchments and real-time operational testing.
c257064f67c5edae64259369e68195114aff9d9b.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified. Surrogates trained on hydrodynamic simulations inherit their errors.

dffc1cf1ba0bc8ce5b30ab31dedce15343a1b5e1.goal: Updates rainfall intensity-duration-frequency (IDF) curves for Peninsular Malaysia under climate change with uncertainty estimates.
dffc1cf1ba0bc8ce5b30ab31dedce15343a1b5e1.architecture: Model output statistics (MOS) downscaling of GCM daily rainfall and an artificial neural network (ANN) to disaggregate daily to hourly maximum rainfall.
dffc1cf1ba0bc8ce5b30ab31dedce15343a1b5e1.data: Eight CMIP5 GCM simulations under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5; hindcast base period 1971–2005 and projections 2006–2099 for Peninsular Malaysia.
dffc1cf1ba0bc8ce5b30ab31dedce15343a1b5e1.result: Annual rainfall increases; short-duration intensities rise and long-duration ones fall; uncertainty for short durations is 2–6 times larger than for long durations.
dffc1cf1ba0bc8ce5b30ab31dedce15343a1b5e1.open_work: Reducing uncertainty in short-duration extremes, for example with convection-permitting models.
dffc1cf1ba0bc8ce5b30ab31dedce15343a1b5e1.issues: Daily-to-hourly ANN disaggregation assumes a stationary relationship; GCM-driven short-duration projections are highly uncertain.

07e659b586f801f47e6d6b4ae72c4524093aa739.goal: Predicts frost events for agriculture within an IoT-enabled system, using neighbouring stations' thermodynamic conditions.
07e659b586f801f47e6d6b4ae72c4524093aa739.architecture: Regression and classification models including random forest and logistic regression, with automatic neighbour-station feature selection and SMOTE oversampling.
07e659b586f801f47e6d6b4ae72c4524093aa739.data: Temperature and humidity readings from five meteorological stations in Mendoza Province, Argentina.
07e659b586f801f47e6d6b4ae72c4524093aa739.result: Neighbour selection with SMOTE reduces regression errors at all five locations and improves random forest classification at four; logistic regression results are inconclusive.
07e659b586f801f47e6d6b4ae72c4524093aa739.open_work: Deployment on low-cost IoT sensor networks and longer lead times.
07e659b586f801f47e6d6b4ae72c4524093aa739.issues: Few stations and rare frost events; SMOTE-generated samples may distort class balance at evaluation.

587c9ea4a21985e5e70f71655d731b1f1867bdc6.goal: Forecasts daily air temperature with hybrid deep learning models.
587c9ea4a21985e5e70f71655d731b1f1867bdc6.architecture: Hybrid LSTM-CNN and GRU-CNN models combining recurrent neural networks with convolutional neural network layers.
587c9ea4a21985e5e70f71655d731b1f1867bdc6.data: Not reported in the available metadata. Station daily air temperature series are implied.

ef26f8919a45b001b9a906f2913b58c8aea27af4.goal: Reviews artificial intelligence applications for dam and reservoir hydro-environment modelling.
