ef26f8919a45b001b9a906f2913b58c8aea27af4.result: Not reported in the available metadata. The review summarizes reported AI performance in reservoir applications.
ef26f8919a45b001b9a906f2913b58c8aea27af4.open_work: Hybrid and physically consistent AI models and operational adoption for reservoir management.
ef26f8919a45b001b9a906f2913b58c8aea27af4.issues: Abstract unavailable; scope and conclusions could not be verified.

32b57323ce5804a9df98f8acf56f16b4795ec995.goal: Predicts short-term hub-height vector wind speed on a fine grid for wind power operation.
32b57323ce5804a9df98f8acf56f16b4795ec995.architecture: Multivariate meteorological data fusion wind prediction network (MFWPN) with a CNN-Transformer architecture.
32b57323ce5804a9df98f8acf56f16b4795ec995.data: Meteorological data over Northeast China, benchmarked against ECMWF HRES; transfer experiments to other regions.
32b57323ce5804a9df98f8acf56f16b4795ec995.result: MFWPN beats ECMWF-HRES vector wind accuracy in the first 6 h, transfers to offsite regions, and predicts a 24-hour fine grid in 18 ms.
32b57323ce5804a9df98f8acf56f16b4795ec995.open_work: Extending skill beyond 6 h and to probabilistic forecasts for wind farm scheduling.
32b57323ce5804a9df98f8acf56f16b4795ec995.issues: Advantage over HRES limited to the first hours; training data and verification reference details not given in the abstract.

80487384452915131a51dd854780ef23cb320f3b.goal: Predicts monthly mean daily global solar radiation for solar energy feasibility studies in solar-rich Australian cities.
80487384452915131a51dd854780ef23cb320f3b.architecture: Self-adaptive differential evolution extreme learning machine (SaDE-ELM) with ant colony optimization feature selection, benchmarked against ELM variants, genetic programming, and PSO/GA-optimized ANN and SVR.
80487384452915131a51dd854780ef23cb320f3b.data: MODIS satellite products and ECMWF reanalysis predictors with measured solar radiation for Brisbane and Townsville, Australia.
80487384452915131a51dd854780ef23cb320f3b.result: SaDE-ELM outperforms nine benchmarks with RRMSE of 2.3% (Brisbane) and 0.7% (Townsville) monthly; daily RRMSE about 10.5%; robust across ENSO and IOD phases.
80487384452915131a51dd854780ef23cb320f3b.open_work: Applying to other data-sparse regions and to daily operational forecasting.
80487384452915131a51dd854780ef23cb320f3b.issues: Two sites only; very low monthly errors may reflect smooth targets; reanalysis-based inputs inherit their biases.

45ebf4683a63372a376f2ae6c3c81fef0bd10cc6.goal: Predicts drought via the SPEI index at 1- and 3-month scales in Cholistan, Pakistan.
45ebf4683a63372a376f2ae6c3c81fef0bd10cc6.architecture: Random forest regression using climate predictors.
45ebf4683a63372a376f2ae6c3c81fef0bd10cc6.data: Climate variables (PET, rainfall, vapour pressure, cloud cover, temperature) 1980–2020; training 1980–2010, testing 2011–2015, validation 2016–2020.
45ebf4683a63372a376f2ae6c3c81fef0bd10cc6.result: Random forest reaches R2 of 0.80 (SPEI-1) and 0.78 (SPEI-3), with validation ROC-AUC of 0.87 and 0.85.
45ebf4683a63372a376f2ae6c3c81fef0bd10cc6.open_work: Larger, multi-region datasets for better generalization over longer periods, as the authors suggest.
45ebf4683a63372a376f2ae6c3c81fef0bd10cc6.issues: Single region; predictors overlap with SPEI inputs so the task is close to reconstruction rather than forecasting.

3f00da4a8fca321a820947db155fecafa3404635.goal: Reviews drought forecasting with emphasis on hybrid machine learning models and data pre-processing.
3f00da4a8fca321a820947db155fecafa3404635.architecture: Review of data pre-processing, univariate and multivariate strategies, machine learning algorithms, and preprocessing-, optimisation- and combination-based hybrid models.
3f00da4a8fca321a820947db155fecafa3404635.data: Review; covers studies forecasting drought indices from hydro-meteorological data.
3f00da4a8fca321a820947db155fecafa3404635.result: Hybrid models have become the dominant approach for drought prediction; standard metrics such as RMSE, MAE, NSE, AIC and BIC are recommended.
3f00da4a8fca321a820947db155fecafa3404635.open_work: Systematic benchmarking of hybrid models and better handling of nonstationarity.
3f00da4a8fca321a820947db155fecafa3404635.issues: Narrative review without a quantitative meta-analysis.

0996743d4d386cb3f8ebd267b6081c3389aa59a0.goal: Forecasts daily reference evapotranspiration (ET0) for crop water requirement planning, including multi-step-ahead forecasts.
0996743d4d386cb3f8ebd267b6081c3389aa59a0.architecture: LSTM and bidirectional LSTM compared with SVR, M5 tree, MARS, probabilistic linear regression, ANFIS, GPR and sequence-to-sequence LSTM.
0996743d4d386cb3f8ebd267b6081c3389aa59a0.data: Station ET0 time series in Bangladesh, with an independent test station (Ishurdi) for 2015–2020.
0996743d4d386cb3f8ebd267b6081c3389aa59a0.result: LSTM is best for daily prediction and Bi-LSTM for one-step and 5-day-ahead forecasting; both generalize to the unseen station.
0996743d4d386cb3f8ebd267b6081c3389aa59a0.open_work: Longer horizons and inclusion of weather forecasts as inputs.
0996743d4d386cb3f8ebd267b6081c3389aa59a0.issues: Few stations in one country; error statistics not given in the abstract.

f27ac13487c87933753baec7944f849e80010201.goal: Compares machine learning methods for daily and weekly rainfall forecasting in urban metropolitan cities.
f27ac13487c87933753baec7944f849e80010201.architecture: Gradient boosting (CatBoost, XGBoost, LightGBM) compared with Lasso, Ridge and linear regression.
f27ac13487c87933753baec7944f849e80010201.data: Rainfall time series for urban metropolitan cities split into training, validation and test sets; specific cities not named in the abstract.
f27ac13487c87933753baec7944f849e80010201.result: CatBoost is best with R2 of 0.99 and RMSE 0.0010 for daily data; XGBoost reaches MAE 0.02 and RMSE 0.10 for weekly data.
f27ac13487c87933753baec7944f849e80010201.open_work: Validation on independent cities and extreme-rainfall events.
f27ac13487c87933753baec7944f849e80010201.issues: Near-perfect R2 for daily rainfall suggests possible leakage or normalization effects; no comparison with NWP.

d924424c3efed9558a0b5c62c95da577ba7102b4.goal: Downscales near-surface wind fields to 50 m resolution over highly complex Alpine terrain for snow modelling and wind energy assessment.
d924424c3efed9558a0b5c62c95da577ba7102b4.architecture: Wind-Topo: custom convolutional neural network architecture analysing the atmosphere at multiple scales and associating it with high-resolution topography, trained with a dedicated loss function.
d924424c3efed9558a0b5c62c95da577ba7102b4.data: COSMO-1 NWP predictors and high-resolution topography; many Swiss measurement stations for training and 60 independent stations for validation.
d924424c3efed9558a0b5c62c95da577ba7102b4.result: At alpine validation stations bias drops from 0.72 to -0.07 m/s and MAE from 1.77 to 1.21 m/s relative to COSMO-1, with realistic orographic effects.
d924424c3efed9558a0b5c62c95da577ba7102b4.open_work: Extending to other mountain regions and to other variables or vertical levels.
d924424c3efed9558a0b5c62c95da577ba7102b4.issues: Trained on point stations, so gridded 50 m fields are only validated at sites; depends on COSMO-1 inputs.

19ed8fce883b3659a54e0aa68f37072889ce1b92.goal: Forecasts solar irradiation in Bangladesh, where AI-based irradiance studies are limited.
19ed8fce883b3659a54e0aa68f37072889ce1b92.architecture: Ensemble regressors: AdaBoost, gradient boosting, random forest and bagging; gradient boosting tuned by grid search.
19ed8fce883b3659a54e0aa68f37072889ce1b92.data: Meteorological data from 32 stations in Bangladesh (temperature, rain, humidity, sunshine, wind, cloud cover, irradiance).
19ed8fce883b3659a54e0aa68f37072889ce1b92.result: Tuned gradient boosting performs best with test R2 of 0.9995 and RMSE 0.0007 (normalized).
19ed8fce883b3659a54e0aa68f37072889ce1b92.open_work: Out-of-sample spatial testing and true forecasting at operational lead times.
19ed8fce883b3659a54e0aa68f37072889ce1b92.issues: Extremely high R2 indicates estimation from concurrent variables rather than forecasting, and possible leakage.

5bff8d6525686c1a7a1867e87c9c246d01f00abd.goal: Improves daily streamflow and peak-flow simulation in a tropical basin and assesses climate change impacts.
5bff8d6525686c1a7a1867e87c9c246d01f00abd.architecture: Hybrid of the SWAT process-based hydrological model with a bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM), with default or partially calibrated SWAT parameters.
5bff8d6525686c1a7a1867e87c9c246d01f00abd.data: Kelantan River Basin, Peninsular Malaysia, observed streamflow; five CMIP6 GCMs under SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5.
5bff8d6525686c1a7a1867e87c9c246d01f00abd.result: SWAT-T-LSTM outperforms SWAT-D-LSTM, standalone SWAT and Bi-LSTM, especially for peaks; projections show increased mean and extreme flow in the northeast monsoon.
5bff8d6525686c1a7a1867e87c9c246d01f00abd.open_work: Testing in other tropical basins and propagating GCM and model uncertainty.
5bff8d6525686c1a7a1867e87c9c246d01f00abd.issues: Single basin; using an LSTM under future climates assumes learned relations remain valid out of sample.

0879fa2a287bc75facfdcf4c9299f0fb3aa64ed5.goal: Maps flood susceptibility using SAR-derived flood inventories and hybrid machine learning.
0879fa2a287bc75facfdcf4c9299f0fb3aa64ed5.architecture: Radial basis function (RBF) neural network and hybrids with bagging, random committee and random subspace ensembles; mutual information for factor importance.
0879fa2a287bc75facfdcf4c9299f0fb3aa64ed5.data: Sentinel-1 SAR flood inventory, CHIRPS rainfall and 12 conditioning factors (elevation, NDVI, TWI, LULC, soil etc.) in the Goorganrood watershed, Iran.
0879fa2a287bc75facfdcf4c9299f0fb3aa64ed5.result: All hybrids beat standalone RBF; RC-RBF is best (AUC 0.997), then BA-RBF (0.996), RSS-RBF (0.992) and RBF (0.975); about 12% of the area is highly susceptible.
0879fa2a287bc75facfdcf4c9299f0fb3aa64ed5.open_work: Transferring to other watersheds and incorporating temporal dynamics of flooding.
0879fa2a287bc75facfdcf4c9299f0fb3aa64ed5.issues: Very high AUC may reflect spatial autocorrelation between training and test points; static susceptibility only.

d4d30fc57feb4ed26339d628a09dccdca57b4d7e.goal: Analyses and forecasts drought indicators for the arid Jaisalmer region, India, with data-driven models.
d4d30fc57feb4ed26339d628a09dccdca57b4d7e.architecture: Data-driven machine learning models; the specific algorithm types are not specified in the available metadata.
d4d30fc57feb4ed26339d628a09dccdca57b4d7e.data: Not reported in the available metadata. Climate records for Jaisalmer used to compute drought indices are implied.
d4d30fc57feb4ed26339d628a09dccdca57b4d7e.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
d4d30fc57feb4ed26339d628a09dccdca57b4d7e.open_work: Multi-site evaluation and longer forecast horizons.
d4d30fc57feb4ed26339d628a09dccdca57b4d7e.issues: Abstract unavailable; indices, models and skill could not be verified. Single-site case study.

e4cd6ee7cd1ba330b047c123f0819e3687a851d7.goal: Improves subseasonal (weeks 3–6) temperature and precipitation forecasts by correcting systematic errors of dynamical models.
e4cd6ee7cd1ba330b047c123f0819e3687a851d7.architecture: Adaptive bias correction (ABC) combining dynamical forecasts with observations via machine learning (ensemble of learned bias-correction models), with an explanation workflow for windows of opportunity.
e4cd6ee7cd1ba330b047c123f0819e3687a851d7.data: ECMWF subseasonal reforecasts/forecasts and gridded observations over the contiguous U.S.
e4cd6ee7cd1ba330b047c123f0819e3687a851d7.result: ABC improves ECMWF temperature skill by 60–90% (baseline 0.18–0.25) and precipitation skill by 40–69% (baseline 0.11–0.15).
e4cd6ee7cd1ba330b047c123f0819e3687a851d7.open_work: Extending to other regions, variables and models and exploiting identified windows of opportunity.
e4cd6ee7cd1ba330b047c123f0819e3687a851d7.issues: Evaluated over the contiguous U.S. only; absolute skill remains modest at subseasonal leads.

d7d433c7f52436d2331d53471c5e1f16d20f12e1.goal: Enables long-term prediction of sea surface chlorophyll-a to support early warning of harmful algal blooms in the South China Sea.
d7d433c7f52436d2331d53471c5e1f16d20f12e1.architecture: CNN-LSTM hybrid combining convolutional neural network spatial features with LSTM temporal modelling.
d7d433c7f52436d2331d53471c5e1f16d20f12e1.data: NASA satellite Chl-a data for the Reed Tablemount, South China Sea, January 2002–June 2020.
d7d433c7f52436d2331d53471c5e1f16d20f12e1.result: CNN-LSTM beats LSTM and SARIMA; five-year rolling predictions reach Pearson correlation of 0.5 over three years and reproduce the upward trend of 2015–2020.
d7d433c7f52436d2331d53471c5e1f16d20f12e1.open_work: Adding physical drivers and extending to other regions and bloom events.
d7d433c7f52436d2331d53471c5e1f16d20f12e1.issues: Modest correlation at long leads; trained on a short satellite record at a single site.

e155444834cd9d49c7c0e1ce3cce106a540f1369.goal: Reviews machine learning for soil moisture estimation from remote sensing, synthesizing algorithms, inputs and challenges.
e155444834cd9d49c7c0e1ce3cce106a540f1369.architecture: Review of 144 articles (2010–2024) on ML algorithms such as random forest, support vector regression and neural networks for surface and root-zone soil moisture.
e155444834cd9d49c7c0e1ce3cce106a540f1369.data: Review; covers reflectance, brightness temperature, SAR backscatter and biophysical predictors from multi-source remote sensing.
e155444834cd9d49c7c0e1ce3cce106a540f1369.result: Random forest most often performs best (40 of 67 studies); multi-source data beat single-source; L-band SAR, semi-empirical models and transfer learning are promising.
e155444834cd9d49c7c0e1ce3cce106a540f1369.open_work: Improving transferability and root-zone estimation and mitigating vegetation effects.
e155444834cd9d49c7c0e1ce3cce106a540f1369.issues: Literature comparisons rely on heterogeneous study designs and metrics.

1b10e912bf9dda95e696561abb4a7f63f44591b3.goal: Quantifies global canopy rainfall interception loss and its recent changes, an underexplored water cycle component.
1b10e912bf9dda95e696561abb4a7f63f44591b3.architecture: Physics-informed hybrid machine learning models trained under wet versus dry conditions to infer interception from flux tower evapotranspiration.
1b10e912bf9dda95e696561abb4a7f63f44591b3.data: Flux tower evapotranspiration measurements; forced globally by satellite and reanalysis data, 2000–2020.
1b10e912bf9dda95e696561abb4a7f63f44591b3.result: Interception averages 84.1 ± 1.8 mm/yr (8.6% of rainfall); fewer, more intense rain events drive a 4.9% decline in interception since 2000.
1b10e912bf9dda95e696561abb4a7f63f44591b3.open_work: Better constraints on interception in under-sampled biomes and coupling to land surface models.
1b10e912bf9dda95e696561abb4a7f63f44591b3.issues: Inferred rather than directly measured interception; flux tower coverage is uneven; inherits forcing-data biases.

96631f263cbea882b6fe2f472d2b93b9b028a431.goal: Improves winter wheat and oilseed rape yield prediction by coupling crop modelling with machine learning.
96631f263cbea882b6fe2f472d2b93b9b028a431.architecture: Random forest models with NDVI, climate and Light Use Efficiency (LUE) model biomass inputs, compared with the LUE model alone.
96631f263cbea882b6fe2f472d2b93b9b028a431.data: Bavaria, Germany, 2019; NDVI from Sentinel-2/MODIS (MOD13Q1), Landsat/MODIS fusions and MODIS alone, plus climate variables.
96631f263cbea882b6fe2f472d2b93b9b028a431.result: LUE+RF improves R2 by 14.3% over LUE alone; Sentinel-2-MODIS inputs give mean R2 of 0.80 (wheat) and 0.69 (rape).
96631f263cbea882b6fe2f472d2b93b9b028a431.open_work: Multi-year evaluation and testing in other regions and crops.
96631f263cbea882b6fe2f472d2b93b9b028a431.issues: Single growing season, so interannual robustness is untested.

885de86530dc8d5d683cf2545f73c9f19e48815f.goal: Produces a 1-km monthly mean air temperature dataset over the Tibetan Plateau where stations are sparse.
885de86530dc8d5d683cf2545f73c9f19e48815f.architecture: Ten machine learning algorithms compared; Cubist rule-based regression selected with forward variable selection.
885de86530dc8d5d683cf2545f73c9f19e48815f.data: MODIS land surface temperature and other products, SRTM DEM and topographic indices with station air temperature, 2001–2015.
885de86530dc8d5d683cf2545f73c9f19e48815f.result: Cubist performs best (overall RMSE 1.00 °C, MAE 0.73 °C), with winter R2 0.98 and summer R2 0.91; nighttime LST is the top predictor.
885de86530dc8d5d683cf2545f73c9f19e48815f.open_work: Daily-scale estimation and better handling of cloud gaps.
885de86530dc8d5d683cf2545f73c9f19e48815f.issues: Stations are sparse and uneven, so high-elevation validation is limited; cloud gaps are filled by interpolation.

19b758d14b6ff537593108615c609dd821d0efc8.goal: Forecasts solar intensity with an adaptive learning hybrid model for solar power applications.
19b758d14b6ff537593108615c609dd821d0efc8.architecture: Adaptive learning hybrid model; the specific component model types are not specified in the available metadata.
19b758d14b6ff537593108615c609dd821d0efc8.data: Not reported in the available metadata. Measured solar intensity and meteorological data are implied.
19b758d14b6ff537593108615c609dd821d0efc8.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
19b758d14b6ff537593108615c609dd821d0efc8.open_work: Testing across climates and forecast horizons.
19b758d14b6ff537593108615c609dd821d0efc8.issues: Abstract unavailable; method details, data and skill could not be verified.

7dd1d78e52193fb1e7c94f252feb613e5da4e68e.goal: Provides short-term wind speed interval (uncertainty) predictions with a simple approach.
7dd1d78e52193fb1e7c94f252feb613e5da4e68e.architecture: Independently recurrent neural network (IndRNN) point forecasts combined with an error probability distribution to form prediction intervals.
7dd1d78e52193fb1e7c94f252feb613e5da4e68e.data: Not reported in the available metadata. Measured wind speed series are implied.
7dd1d78e52193fb1e7c94f252feb613e5da4e68e.result: Not reported in the available metadata.
7dd1d78e52193fb1e7c94f252feb613e5da4e68e.open_work: Testing interval reliability across sites and seasons.
7dd1d78e52193fb1e7c94f252feb613e5da4e68e.issues: Abstract unavailable; data and skill could not be verified. Fitted error distributions may not capture regime-dependent uncertainty.

78f0f5ace8a395a6a9fafd7ccbbb152b39ab3e03.goal: Predicts significant wave height and wave energy flux at a marine facility using neighbouring buoy data.
78f0f5ace8a395a6a9fafd7ccbbb152b39ab3e03.architecture: Grouping genetic algorithm feature selection with an extreme learning machine (GGA-ELM), with parameters tuned by Bayesian optimization.
78f0f5ace8a395a6a9fafd7ccbbb152b39ab3e03.data: Buoy observations off the western coast of the USA.
78f0f5ace8a395a6a9fafd7ccbbb152b39ab3e03.result: Bayesian optimization improves GGA-ELM performance compared with the untuned system.
78f0f5ace8a395a6a9fafd7ccbbb152b39ab3e03.open_work: Applying to other coasts and longer prediction horizons.
78f0f5ace8a395a6a9fafd7ccbbb152b39ab3e03.issues: Specific skill numbers not given in the abstract; buoy-only predictors.

3b62f9489d4958aaf7513fdf53301caa3f739dc8.goal: Improves daily rainfall-runoff modeling for nonlinear, nonstationary hydrologic series by combining signal decomposition with machine learning regressors.
3b62f9489d4958aaf7513fdf53301caa3f739dc8.architecture: Hybrid models coupling variational mode decomposition (VMD) with an extreme learning machine (ELM) and least squares support vector regression (LSSVR); compared with VMD-ANN, wavelet (DWT) hybrids and single ELM, LSSVR and ANN models.
3b62f9489d4958aaf7513fdf53301caa3f739dc8.data: Daily rainfall and runoff time series from a gauged catchment; the specific basin and period are not reported in the abstract.
3b62f9489d4958aaf7513fdf53301caa3f739dc8.result: VMD-based models outperform single models and slightly outperform DWT-based hybrids; VMD-ELM and VMD-LSSVR give the best efficiency and effectiveness scores.
3b62f9489d4958aaf7513fdf53301caa3f739dc8.open_work: Test on more basins and longer forecast horizons, and examine decomposition in a strictly forecasting setting without future information.
3b62f9489d4958aaf7513fdf53301caa3f739dc8.issues: Decomposing full input and target series can leak future information into training; single-catchment evaluation limits generality; no uncertainty estimates.

c7e8307ebde64e8acc8cf31967945b90c6ccbaed.goal: Forecasts mean monthly groundwater level in the Qoşaçay plain, Iran, where meteorological records are lacking, using only past water-table data.
c7e8307ebde64e8acc8cf31967945b90c6ccbaed.architecture: Gated recurrent unit (GRU) deep networks with one to three layers, including a double-GRU with a multiplication layer (GRU2×), and a hybrid VMD-GRU; a single-layer LSTM is the baseline; sequence-to-one setup.
c7e8307ebde64e8acc8cf31967945b90c6ccbaed.data: 216 monthly water-table depth records averaged over 33 piezometers, April 2002 to March 2020.
c7e8307ebde64e8acc8cf31967945b90c6ccbaed.result: GRU2× reaches R² 0.86 and RMSE 0.18 m in validation; the hybrid VMD-GRU yields RMSE 0.16 m and R² 0.92 but needs about twice the training time.
c7e8307ebde64e8acc8cf31967945b90c6ccbaed.open_work: Add meteorological and pumping drivers when available and test multi-step forecasts and transfer to other aquifers.
c7e8307ebde64e8acc8cf31967945b90c6ccbaed.issues: Very short univariate series (216 samples) with a 3.78 m range; trial-and-error tuning risks overfitting; decomposition may leak future information; single site.

c54f78f662d34c0624983ab4ea39deefc7b3e76f.goal: Estimates inundation depth and debris-flow-induced topographic deformation from remote sensing imagery to support rapid disaster response, beyond what imagery alone reveals.
c54f78f662d34c0624983ab4ea39deefc7b3e76f.architecture: Regression CNNs based on Attention U-Net and LinkNet architectures trained on synthetic scenarios from a water and debris-flow numerical simulator, with inpainting capability to reduce false negatives.
c54f78f662d34c0624983ab4ea39deefc7b3e76f.data: Synthetic training data from simulated disaster scenarios; inputs are remote sensing change-detection maps and a digital elevation model; tested on synthetic and real data from two flood and debris-flow events in Japan.
c54f78f662d34c0624983ab4ea39deefc7b3e76f.result: Models trained only on simulated data predict maximum water level and topographic deformation for real events, with quantitative and qualitative gains; code and data are public.
c54f78f662d34c0624983ab4ea39deefc7b3e76f.open_work: Extend scenario diversity and simulator physics, and test on more events and sensor types for operational use.
c54f78f662d34c0624983ab4ea39deefc7b3e76f.issues: Performance depends on the realism of the simulator and on the quality of change-detection inputs; only two real events evaluated; sim-to-real gap remains.

efee4c670494e8fe4e290acb2a45ae062ea74593.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration (ETo) under arid conditions with few meteorological inputs, using the gamma test to select input variables.
efee4c670494e8fe4e290acb2a45ae062ea74593.architecture: Least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) with RBF, linear and polynomial kernels coupled with the gamma test, compared with ANN, ANFIS and empirical equations (Blaney–Criddle, Hargreaves–Samani).
efee4c670494e8fe4e290acb2a45ae062ea74593.data: Daily meteorological data from Zahedan station, Iran, with FAO-56 Penman–Monteith ETo as target.
efee4c670494e8fe4e290acb2a45ae062ea74593.result: LSSVM-GT performs best (RMSE 0.1 mm/day, MAE 0.13 mm/day, R² 0.99); minimum and maximum temperature and wind speed are the key inputs; all ML models beat the empirical equations.
efee4c670494e8fe4e290acb2a45ae062ea74593.open_work: Test spatial transfer to other arid stations and longer records, and assess performance under climate change.
efee4c670494e8fe4e290acb2a45ae062ea74593.issues: Single station; target is itself a Penman–Monteith computation from the same inputs, so skill reflects emulation of a formula rather than measured ET.

d443cdf98094367210d20c1285f526d996002ccf.goal: Forecasts multi-scale drought (SPI-3, SPI-6, SPI-12) in the semi-arid upper Godavari basin, India, to support water management.
d443cdf98094367210d20c1285f526d996002ccf.architecture: Support vector machine trained with sequential minimal optimization (SVM-SMO) using polynomial, normalized polynomial, Pearson universal (PUK) and RBF kernels; best-subset regression and sensitivity analysis for input selection.
d443cdf98094367210d20c1285f526d996002ccf.data: SPI series 2000–2019 at Paithan and Silload stations, split 75% training and 25% testing, with ten input combinations.
d443cdf98094367210d20c1285f526d996002ccf.result: Polynomial-kernel SVM best predicts SPI-3 (R² 0.82 Paithan, 0.74 Silload); PUK kernel best for SPI-6 at Paithan (R² 0.85) and SPI-12 at Silload (R² 0.98).
d443cdf98094367210d20c1285f526d996002ccf.open_work: Compare against deep learning models and extend to longer lead times and more stations.
d443cdf98094367210d20c1285f526d996002ccf.issues: Two stations and short record; lagged SPI inputs share overlapping accumulation windows, inflating skill at long timescales; lead time not clearly stated.

abd573e4fa161ffaeea9e5000a3607fb070d423a.goal: Compares machine learning models for fast ozone concentration prediction where a process-based chemistry model is unavailable.
abd573e4fa161ffaeea9e5000a3607fb070d423a.architecture: Nineteen machine learning models, including random forest-based feature selection and static, reduced and dynamic (time-lagged) model variants; Diebold–Mariano test for forecast comparison.
abd573e4fa161ffaeea9e5000a3607fb070d423a.data: Air pollution and meteorological measurements collected at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), Saudi Arabia.
abd573e4fa161ffaeea9e5000a3607fb070d423a.result: Dynamic models with time-lagged data outperform static and reduced models, improving RMSE-based accuracy by about 300% and 200% respectively; the best model needs about 0.01 s per prediction.
abd573e4fa161ffaeea9e5000a3607fb070d423a.open_work: Extend to multi-site and multi-step forecasting and to deep sequence models.
abd573e4fa161ffaeea9e5000a3607fb070d423a.issues: Single monitoring site; one-step-ahead skill benefits strongly from persistence via lagged ozone; limited physical interpretability.

283b59d9e17d9a38236f1cde9ddf98c8aaa91150.goal: Reconstructs gaps in satellite ocean observations (clouds, between-track gaps) and provides per-pixel error estimates, including for irregularly sampled data.
283b59d9e17d9a38236f1cde9ddf98c8aaa91150.architecture: DINCAE 2.0: a convolutional auto-encoder of U-Net type trained with a Gaussian negative log-likelihood to output mean and error variance, with a new skip connection, multivariate inputs and a first layer adapted to unstructured observations; rewritten in Julia; Bayesian hyperparameter optimization.
283b59d9e17d9a38236f1cde9ddf98c8aaa91150.data: Satellite sea surface temperature, chlorophyll concentration and wind fields in the Adriatic Sea; along-track satellite altimetry in the Mediterranean Sea with a 20-year reconstruction.
283b59d9e17d9a38236f1cde9ddf98c8aaa91150.result: The new skip connections improve on DINCAE 1; multivariate inputs help SST reconstruction; along-track altimetry is successfully gridded and validated against independent data.
283b59d9e17d9a38236f1cde9ddf98c8aaa91150.open_work: Extend to other variables and regions, and to higher resolution and time-aware architectures.
283b59d9e17d9a38236f1cde9ddf98c8aaa91150.issues: Gaussian error assumption may misrepresent non-Gaussian errors; validation is regional; reconstruction skill degrades for large persistent gaps.

fcb78c7ae4ef7ae82b4924ad9f7cc3aee3fa52cf.goal: Improves short-term wind speed forecasting for wind energy at North Aegean islands sites.
fcb78c7ae4ef7ae82b4924ad9f7cc3aee3fa52cf.architecture: Quaternion convolutional long short-term memory (ConvLSTM) neural network combined with an adaptive signal decomposition method, as stated in the title; other details not reported.
fcb78c7ae4ef7ae82b4924ad9f7cc3aee3fa52cf.data: Wind speed records from North Aegean islands case studies; data sources, resolution and period not reported.
fcb78c7ae4ef7ae82b4924ad9f7cc3aee3fa52cf.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the hybrid model is presented as improving wind speed forecast accuracy over compared methods.
fcb78c7ae4ef7ae82b4924ad9f7cc3aee3fa52cf.open_work: Evaluate on other sites and longer horizons and quantify forecast uncertainty.
fcb78c7ae4ef7ae82b4924ad9f7cc3aee3fa52cf.issues: Abstract unavailable; decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information if decomposition is applied before data splitting; site-specific evaluation.

8ed33b23a52d742e3dfa903674503e0dc5148a3b.goal: Builds a smart weather data management system for precision agriculture that turns raw station data into actionable products such as forecasts and reference evapotranspiration.
8ed33b23a52d742e3dfa903674503e0dc5148a3b.architecture: Four-layer system (acquisition, storage, processing, application) with MongoDB storage; deep learning gap-filling using ERA5-Land; XGBoost to estimate ET0 from air temperature and global solar radiation; statistical, machine learning and deep learning forecasting services.
8ed33b23a52d742e3dfa903674503e0dc5148a3b.data: Half-hourly meteorological station data from a study area in Morocco, 2013–2020; ERA5-Land reanalysis for quality control and gap filling.
8ed33b23a52d742e3dfa903674503e0dc5148a3b.result: Gap-filling yields R² 0.96 and RMSE 0.04 for scaled air temperature; XGBoost reproduces Penman–Monteith ET0 with R² 0.97 and RMSE 0.07 using only two inputs.
8ed33b23a52d742e3dfa903674503e0dc5148a3b.open_work: Integrate more IoT sensors and stations and connect services to irrigation decision tools in operation.
8ed33b23a52d742e3dfa903674503e0dc5148a3b.issues: Single-station evaluation; scaled-error metrics are hard to interpret physically; system-level validation by users is not reported.

4d4dcf9ff3b3e7be572f5a7d27be160849184ff7.goal: Improves flood water level prediction on the Red River of the North to support flood-loss reduction planning.
4d4dcf9ff3b3e7be572f5a7d27be160849184ff7.architecture: Comparison of a statistical SARIMA model, random forest and a long short-term memory (LSTM) network.
4d4dcf9ff3b3e7be572f5a7d27be160849184ff7.data: Hourly USGS water level records at Pembina, Drayton and Grand Forks, 2007–2019; forecasts at 6 h, 12 h, 1 day, 3 days and 1 week ahead.
4d4dcf9ff3b3e7be572f5a7d27be160849184ff7.result: LSTM outperforms SARIMA and random forest; one-week-ahead RMSE is 0.190, 0.151 and 0.107 at Pembina, Drayton and Grand Forks.
4d4dcf9ff3b3e7be572f5a7d27be160849184ff7.open_work: Add precipitation, snowmelt and upstream forcing and test on extreme flood events specifically.
4d4dcf9ff3b3e7be572f5a7d27be160849184ff7.issues: Water-level-only inputs; few large flood events in the record; units and normalization of RMSE not specified in the abstract.

58c9dc2636dac228f0dc1a9536c991482fc1c698.goal: Predicts solar radiation for solar energy applications by combining convolutional feature extraction with dense regression.
58c9dc2636dac228f0dc1a9536c991482fc1c698.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network and multilayer perceptron (CNN-MLP), as stated in the title; other design details not reported.
58c9dc2636dac228f0dc1a9536c991482fc1c698.data: Not reported in the available metadata.
58c9dc2636dac228f0dc1a9536c991482fc1c698.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the hybrid model is presented as improving solar radiation prediction over compared models.
58c9dc2636dac228f0dc1a9536c991482fc1c698.open_work: Test across climates and forecast horizons and add probabilistic outputs.
58c9dc2636dac228f0dc1a9536c991482fc1c698.issues: Abstract unavailable; data, horizon and baselines cannot be verified; likely site-specific evaluation.

f05a0aece49d45c9e02ea2258a0c3ece7f0b2604.goal: Forecasts surface temperature while capturing spatial and temporal relations among meteorological variables and offering feature interpretability.
f05a0aece49d45c9e02ea2258a0c3ece7f0b2604.architecture: Spatial Feature Attention LSTM (SFA-LSTM): an encoder-decoder with LSTM layers learning temporal dependencies and a spatial feature attention mechanism weighting input variables.
f05a0aece49d45c9e02ea2258a0c3ece7f0b2604.data: Historical multivariate meteorological time series; the specific station or dataset is not reported in the abstract.
f05a0aece49d45c9e02ea2258a0c3ece7f0b2604.result: SFA-LSTM matches state-of-the-art accuracy against baselines while giving interpretable feature attention weights that agree with correlations to the target.
f05a0aece49d45c9e02ea2258a0c3ece7f0b2604.open_work: Extend to multiple target variables, longer horizons and multiple sites.
f05a0aece49d45c9e02ea2258a0c3ece7f0b2604.issues: Accuracy numbers, horizon and dataset not given in the abstract; attention weights are validated only against simple correlations.

c741af9b212d48c773700c890a115dfa3bd95f36.goal: Forecasts daily lake surface water temperature several days ahead with a simple model using air temperature only.
c741af9b212d48c773700c890a115dfa3bd95f36.architecture: Stacked ensemble of a multilayer perceptron and random forest (MLP-RF) with Bayesian optimization of hyperparameters; compared with MLP, wavelet-MLP, nonlinear regression and the air2water model.
c741af9b212d48c773700c890a115dfa3bd95f36.data: Long-term daily observed lake surface water temperature and air temperature for eight Polish lakes.
c741af9b212d48c773700c890a115dfa3bd95f36.result: MLP-RF outperforms all baselines across lakes and horizons; at 7 days ahead testing R² is 0.932–0.990, RMSE 0.77–1.83 °C and MAE 0.55–1.38 °C; skill decreases with horizon.
c741af9b212d48c773700c890a115dfa3bd95f36.open_work: Test on lakes in other climates and under climate change projections with forecast air temperature as input.
c741af9b212d48c773700c890a115dfa3bd95f36.issues: Uses observed future air temperature rather than forecasts, overstating operational skill; only air temperature as driver; regional lake set.

6a969207a5083a2eb718d962604827dbc8c1e3e8.goal: Estimates root-zone soil moisture, which satellites cannot observe below a few centimetres, from remote sensing variables at large scale.
6a969207a5083a2eb718d962604827dbc8c1e3e8.architecture: Convolutional long short-term memory (ConvLSTM) network trained on outputs of the Hydrus-1D physical soil water model, using NDVI and other remote sensing predictors.
6a969207a5083a2eb718d962604827dbc8c1e3e8.data: Hydrus-1D simulated vertical soil moisture profiles as training targets; remote sensing predictors including NDVI; comparison with GLDAS products.
6a969207a5083a2eb718d962604827dbc8c1e3e8.result: ConvLSTM substantially improves R² over GLDAS, especially in deep layers, for example from 0.02 to 0.60 at 40 cm depth.
6a969207a5083a2eb718d962604827dbc8c1e3e8.open_work: Validate with more in situ profile observations and test transfer to other regions and climates.
6a969207a5083a2eb718d962604827dbc8c1e3e8.issues: Training targets are simulated, so errors of Hydrus-1D propagate; limited in situ validation; study region and period not detailed in the abstract.

02fc9e90fd2b889392e3a5623587e3dc78d4ad21.goal: Predicts long-term average ozone concentrations at monitoring sites worldwide and identifies the most informative geographic and environmental features.
02fc9e90fd2b889392e3a5623587e3dc78d4ad21.architecture: BO-XGBoost-RFE: recursive feature elimination based on XGBoost with Bayesian optimization of hyperparameters, followed by several predictors including random forest and XGBoost.
02fc9e90fd2b889392e3a5623587e3dc78d4ad21.data: Geographic and environmental information for monitoring sites in 5577 regions worldwide, 2010–2014.
02fc9e90fd2b889392e3a5623587e3dc78d4ad21.result: Feature subsets from BO-XGBoost-RFE give higher accuracy than all features or Pearson-based selection; random forest is most accurate and XGBoost gains most.
02fc9e90fd2b889392e3a5623587e3dc78d4ad21.open_work: Extend to temporally resolved ozone and to regions with sparse monitoring.
02fc9e90fd2b889392e3a5623587e3dc78d4ad21.issues: Targets are multi-year averages, not forecasts; spatial cross-validation and transfer to unmonitored regions are not described in the abstract.

be6dc44ec92a67c695fca220d5dcd457a9cee9f3.goal: Compares modern deep learning methods for downscaling coarse precipitation to local scales over India, validated against station observations.
be6dc44ec92a67c695fca220d5dcd457a9cee9f3.architecture: Super-resolution generative adversarial network (SR-GAN) with a custom VGG perceptual loss network, compared with DeepSD, ConvLSTM and U-Net.
be6dc44ec92a67c695fca220d5dcd457a9cee9f3.data: Gridded India Meteorological Department (IMD) precipitation data; validation against IMD ground station precipitation.
be6dc44ec92a67c695fca220d5dcd457a9cee9f3.result: SR-GAN performs best (correlation 0.88 vs 0.84 U-Net, 0.83 ConvLSTM, 0.80 DeepSD); the perceptual loss reduces smoothing and preserves fine-scale detail.
be6dc44ec92a67c695fca220d5dcd457a9cee9f3.open_work: Apply to climate model outputs and assess extremes and probabilistic downscaling.
be6dc44ec92a67c695fca220d5dcd457a9cee9f3.issues: Perfect-prognosis style tests on coarsened observations; GAN training can be unstable; extreme precipitation skill not specifically evaluated.

2bc9f3d247328560c8dc96153726d68b96d8ffd6.goal: Predicts and interprets rice yield across India's Indo-Gangetic Plains to support food security, and explains what deep models learn.
2bc9f3d247328560c8dc96153726d68b96d8ffd6.architecture: Transformer-based Informer model compared with four machine learning and deep learning models including attention-based LSTM (AtLSTM); feature importance and hidden-state analysis for interpretation.
2bc9f3d247328560c8dc96153726d68b96d8ffd6.data: Time-series satellite data (including NIRv), environmental variables and district rice yield records, 2001–2016.
2bc9f3d247328560c8dc96153726d68b96d8ffd6.result: Informer gives R² 0.81 and RMSE 0.41 t/ha end of season and about 0.78 R² from late September, two months before maturity; NIRv and mid-August and mid-November are most important.
2bc9f3d247328560c8dc96153726d68b96d8ffd6.open_work: Extend to other crops and regions and to longer records with more yield data.
2bc9f3d247328560c8dc96153726d68b96d8ffd6.issues: Only 16 years of yield data limits training for a transformer; district-level yields mask within-field variability.

689f40ce0376e3dce32db9578d67e55ce6b88e3f.goal: Forecasts hourly rainfall from sequences of radar echo images for nowcasting and hydrological use.
689f40ce0376e3dce32db9578d67e55ce6b88e3f.architecture: Spatiotemporal deep learning model ST-LSTM-SA, combining spatiotemporal LSTM cells with self-attention as indicated by the title; details not reported.
689f40ce0376e3dce32db9578d67e55ce6b88e3f.data: Radar echo image sequences; region, radar product and period not reported in the available metadata.
689f40ce0376e3dce32db9578d67e55ce6b88e3f.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the model is presented as improving hourly rainfall forecasts over compared models.
689f40ce0376e3dce32db9578d67e55ce6b88e3f.open_work: Evaluate on heavy rainfall events and longer lead times, and couple with hydrological models.
689f40ce0376e3dce32db9578d67e55ce6b88e3f.issues: Abstract unavailable; radar-only extrapolation models typically blur and lose skill for convective initiation at longer leads.

1a7c5ee307f5d2975e0596e5f92a4ee6591b81c5.goal: Improves monthly runoff time series prediction by combining signal decomposition with an optimized learning model.
1a7c5ee307f5d2975e0596e5f92a4ee6591b81c5.architecture: Extreme learning machine (ELM) optimized by the salp swarm algorithm, applied to components from time varying filtering based empirical mode decomposition (TVF-EMD), as stated in the title.
1a7c5ee307f5d2975e0596e5f92a4ee6591b81c5.data: Monthly runoff records; stations and period not reported in the available metadata.
1a7c5ee307f5d2975e0596e5f92a4ee6591b81c5.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the hybrid is presented as improving monthly runoff prediction over compared models.
1a7c5ee307f5d2975e0596e5f92a4ee6591b81c5.open_work: Test on more basins and in a strictly out-of-sample decomposition setting.
1a7c5ee307f5d2975e0596e5f92a4ee6591b81c5.issues: Abstract unavailable; decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage; metaheuristic tuning adds complexity without clear physical insight.

53b41eb96a4777f3b03f91989336ee7d6dd98fa2.goal: Predicts reference evapotranspiration (ETo) and its uncertainty under climate change and COVID-19 recovery scenarios for 2021–2050 in the Lake Urmia and Sefidrood basins, Iran.
53b41eb96a4777f3b03f91989336ee7d6dd98fa2.architecture: Six machine learning models (multiple linear and nonlinear regression, MARS, M5 model tree, random forest, LSBoost) ranked with TOPSIS; delta change factor downscaling; Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis.
53b41eb96a4777f3b03f91989336ee7d6dd98fa2.data: Meteorological data at nine stations with FAO-56 Penman–Monteith ETo; CMIP6 models ACCESS-ESM1-5, CanESM5 and MRI-ESM2-0 under SSP245 COVID recovery scenarios.
53b41eb96a4777f3b03f91989336ee7d6dd98fa2.result: LSBoost performs best; temperature and, at most stations, precipitation increase; ETo increases at all stations and scenarios; lowest uncertainty at Mianeh with MRI-ESM2-0 and the strong-green scenario.
53b41eb96a4777f3b03f91989336ee7d6dd98fa2.open_work: Use more climate models and variables beyond temperature and precipitation for projections.
53b41eb96a4777f3b03f91989336ee7d6dd98fa2.issues: Projections rely only on downscaled temperature and precipitation; simple delta-change downscaling; three GCMs limit uncertainty sampling.

c9c372bdce539cee12411749875d6b5357d68972.goal: Improves short-term wind power prediction by coupling multiscale numerical weather simulation with deep learning.
c9c372bdce539cee12411749875d6b5357d68972.architecture: Deep learning model coupled with multiscale numerical simulation, as stated in the title; the network type is not specified in the available metadata.
c9c372bdce539cee12411749875d6b5357d68972.data: Numerical simulation outputs and wind farm data; sources, sites and period not reported.
c9c372bdce539cee12411749875d6b5357d68972.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the coupled approach is presented as improving short-term wind power forecasts.
c9c372bdce539cee12411749875d6b5357d68972.open_work: Test across wind farms and terrain types and quantify forecast uncertainty.
c9c372bdce539cee12411749875d6b5357d68972.issues: Abstract unavailable; computational cost of multiscale simulation and site-specific evaluation are likely constraints.

6ed9233f738a14f2c0af8544fed871ddc9f59a72.goal: Maps flood-susceptible areas across Nigeria to guide flood mitigation planning.
6ed9233f738a14f2c0af8544fed871ddc9f59a72.architecture: Artificial neural network (ANN) compared with logistic regression in a GIS framework.
6ed9233f738a14f2c0af8544fed871ddc9f59a72.data: Historical flood records 1985–2020 and fifteen climatic, topographic, land use and proximity conditioning factors for Nigeria.
6ed9233f738a14f2c0af8544fed871ddc9f59a72.result: ANN achieves a higher prediction rate than logistic regression (76.4% vs 62.5%); low-lying southern areas and areas near water are most susceptible.
6ed9233f738a14f2c0af8544fed871ddc9f59a72.open_work: Add higher-resolution inputs and more advanced models, and incorporate climate change scenarios.
6ed9233f738a14f2c0af8544fed871ddc9f59a72.issues: Moderate accuracy; flood inventory quality and absence-point sampling are uncertain; static susceptibility, not event forecasting.

5c85b3316d01720fb2a8a83c961676e0d03f3893.goal: Selects the best meteorological inputs and backpropagation training algorithm for ANN-based solar radiation prediction.
5c85b3316d01720fb2a8a83c961676e0d03f3893.architecture: Artificial neural network (multilayer perceptron) trained with Levenberg–Marquardt, scaled conjugate gradient and Bayesian regularization backpropagation.
5c85b3316d01720fb2a8a83c961676e0d03f3893.data: Temperature, relative humidity and wind speed from a meteorological station in Kuala Terengganu, Malaysia.
5c85b3316d01720fb2a8a83c961676e0d03f3893.result: Temperature and relative humidity correlate strongly with solar radiation; Bayesian regularization gives the best ANN with R 0.81 and RMSE 0.258.
5c85b3316d01720fb2a8a83c961676e0d03f3893.open_work: Add other predictors such as cloud cover or sunshine duration and test at more stations.
5c85b3316d01720fb2a8a83c961676e0d03f3893.issues: Single station; modest accuracy; no comparison with physical or satellite-based estimates.

e91b3ef8b75ac3b93fa093a7e6738d9a27859316.goal: Predicts wind direction, which is hard to forecast directly, for structural health monitoring of a bridge.
e91b3ef8b75ac3b93fa093a7e6738d9a27859316.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) network with empirical mode decomposition (EMD); indirect strategy predicts crosswind and alongwind components and reconstructs direction, compared with direct prediction.
e91b3ef8b75ac3b93fa093a7e6738d9a27859316.data: One month of wind monitoring data from the structural health monitoring system of a bridge.
e91b3ef8b75ac3b93fa093a7e6738d9a27859316.result: The indirect component-based strategy is shown to be effective for multistep wind speed and direction prediction; numbers are not given in the abstract.
e91b3ef8b75ac3b93fa093a7e6738d9a27859316.open_work: Test with longer records, multiple seasons and other structures.
e91b3ef8b75ac3b93fa093a7e6738d9a27859316.issues: Only one month of data; decomposition may leak future information; quantitative gains not stated in the abstract.

53dd1b9c539d1db4a00932a48a3894d1a686e555.goal: Predicts drought indices with a hybrid machine learning model for water resources management.
53dd1b9c539d1db4a00932a48a3894d1a686e555.architecture: Hybrid support vector regression with response surface methodology (SVR-RSM), as stated in the title; other details not reported.
53dd1b9c539d1db4a00932a48a3894d1a686e555.data: Not reported in the available metadata.
53dd1b9c539d1db4a00932a48a3894d1a686e555.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the hybrid is presented as outperforming compared models for drought index prediction.
53dd1b9c539d1db4a00932a48a3894d1a686e555.open_work: Test across climates and lead times and compare with deep learning methods.
53dd1b9c539d1db4a00932a48a3894d1a686e555.issues: Abstract unavailable; drought indices with overlapping accumulation windows can inflate apparent skill.

b131fc005a06742c31211874854116251924002c.goal: Predicts runoff in newly gauged basins with short records, where conventional data-driven models lack training data.
b131fc005a06742c31211874854116251924002c.architecture: Two transformer-based models, as stated in the title; architectural details not reported in the available metadata.
b131fc005a06742c31211874854116251924002c.data: Not reported in the available metadata.
b131fc005a06742c31211874854116251924002c.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the transformer models are presented as giving useful runoff predictions in new-gauged basins.
b131fc005a06742c31211874854116251924002c.open_work: Compare with LSTM regional models and transfer learning approaches across diverse basins.
b131fc005a06742c31211874854116251924002c.issues: Abstract unavailable; generalization depends on similarity between donor and target basins.

105a79ff711aff0e332943a20a016ec9ea05f5e1.goal: Assesses whether Europe could become self-sufficient in soybean under current and future climate by projecting yields from climate data.
105a79ff711aff0e332943a20a016ec9ea05f5e1.architecture: Machine learning models relating climate to soybean yield, selected by cross-validation; the specific algorithm is not stated in the abstract.
105a79ff711aff0e332943a20a016ec9ea05f5e1.data: Observed soybean yields and climate data for Europe; projections under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5 for the 2050s and 2090s.
105a79ff711aff0e332943a20a016ec9ea05f5e1.result: The selected model has R² above 0.9 and RMSE 0.35 t/ha; 50% (100%) self-sufficiency is achievable if 4–5% (9–11%) of current European cropland grows soybean.
105a79ff711aff0e332943a20a016ec9ea05f5e1.open_work: Study environmental benefits and side effects and land-use change impacts of soybean expansion.
105a79ff711aff0e332943a20a016ec9ea05f5e1.issues: Statistical yield-climate relations may not extrapolate to novel climates; management, CO2 fertilization and economics are simplified.

68eaa69d472a18e9821b319de261033919f538f4.goal: Enables near-real-time flood detection and mapping from SAR imagery when high-quality labeled flood datasets are scarce.
68eaa69d472a18e9821b319de261033919f538f4.architecture: Several classic convolutional neural network segmentation models compared with a threshold method, plus a dataset-generation methodology with strong and weak labels.
68eaa69d472a18e9821b319de261033919f538f4.data: Sentinel-1 SAR (VV and VH) images and a DEM for 16 flood events in the Yangtze River Basin; 5296 strong-label tiles from eight events.
68eaa69d472a18e9821b319de261033919f538f4.result: CNNs are clearly more accurate and efficient than thresholding; VH polarization is more useful than VV; adding DEM has limited effect; weak labels give consistent conclusions.
68eaa69d472a18e9821b319de261033919f538f4.open_work: Expand datasets to other basins and test semi-supervised learning with weak labels.
68eaa69d472a18e9821b319de261033919f538f4.issues: Single basin; specific CNN performance numbers not given in the abstract; SAR limitations in urban and vegetated areas.

31c4f3327fc18a0dd04a37a2d05dea358d29a710.goal: Reduces spatial disagreement among machine learning flood susceptibility models, an often ignored source of uncertainty.
31c4f3327fc18a0dd04a37a2d05dea358d29a710.architecture: Random forest, k-nearest neighbor, multilayer perceptron and a genetic algorithm-optimized RBF support vector regression, combined into an optimized ensemble model.
31c4f3327fc18a0dd04a37a2d05dea358d29a710.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors for the southwest coastal region of Bangladesh.
31c4f3327fc18a0dd04a37a2d05dea358d29a710.result: All models flag about 60% of land as flood-prone but pixel-wise correlations between models range 0.62–0.91; the optimized model improves accuracy and spatial agreement.
31c4f3327fc18a0dd04a37a2d05dea358d29a710.open_work: Apply the framework to other regions and integrate it into early warning and risk-based planning.
31c4f3327fc18a0dd04a37a2d05dea358d29a710.issues: Static susceptibility only; ensemble agreement does not guarantee correctness; inventory quality uncertain.

c34105c429936d1720d0b8dbdc39fccc2fe99f45.goal: Reviews hybrid machine learning models used to improve rainfall prediction.
c34105c429936d1720d0b8dbdc39fccc2fe99f45.architecture: Review of hybrid machine learning approaches for rainfall prediction, such as models combining decomposition, optimization or multiple learners.
c34105c429936d1720d0b8dbdc39fccc2fe99f45.data: Literature review; the covered studies and datasets are not reported in the available metadata.
c34105c429936d1720d0b8dbdc39fccc2fe99f45.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the review is presented as finding hybrid models generally improve rainfall prediction over standalone models.
c34105c429936d1720d0b8dbdc39fccc2fe99f45.open_work: Standardized benchmarks and comparisons with numerical weather prediction would strengthen conclusions.
c34105c429936d1720d0b8dbdc39fccc2fe99f45.issues: Abstract unavailable; reviews of hybrid models often compare studies with inconsistent data and metrics.

807b5e2227f35517ebc66345670a8f1a32f52291.goal: Improves rainfall-runoff simulation and multi-step runoff prediction with a metaheuristic-optimized deep learning model.
807b5e2227f35517ebc66345670a8f1a32f52291.architecture: Temporal convolutional network (TCN) tuned by an improved Aquila optimizer combined with random forest, as stated in the title.
807b5e2227f35517ebc66345670a8f1a32f52291.data: Not reported in the available metadata.
807b5e2227f35517ebc66345670a8f1a32f52291.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the model is presented as improving multi-step runoff prediction over compared models.
807b5e2227f35517ebc66345670a8f1a32f52291.open_work: Test on more basins and longer horizons and compare with physically based models.
807b5e2227f35517ebc66345670a8f1a32f52291.issues: Abstract unavailable; metaheuristic tuning adds cost and overfitting risk; generality across basins unknown.

35bccf4f649abdcf6e614e8e9c1fd53f51e9edb0.goal: Forecasts the air quality index (AQI) by predicting criteria pollutant concentrations with careful handling of missing data.
35bccf4f649abdcf6e614e8e9c1fd53f51e9edb0.architecture: Artificial neural networks for hourly pollutant forecasting, with random forest-based missForest imputation and feature selection in pre-processing.
35bccf4f649abdcf6e614e8e9c1fd53f51e9edb0.data: Ambient air quality observations of PM2.5, PM10, O3, SO2, NO2 and CO and meteorology for Al-Jahra, Kuwait.
35bccf4f649abdcf6e614e8e9c1fd53f51e9edb0.result: Models trained on missForest-imputed data forecast AQI with 92.41% accuracy on unseen data, better than linear imputation and earlier findings.
35bccf4f649abdcf6e614e8e9c1fd53f51e9edb0.open_work: Extend to other cities and longer lead times.
35bccf4f649abdcf6e614e8e9c1fd53f51e9edb0.issues: Single city; accuracy metric definition unclear in the abstract; imputation may bias extremes.

bf2e0d0a99d38ac0a1690036f5ddc361271a494b.goal: Maps urban pluvial flood susceptibility in Berlin with data-driven models as an alternative to costly 2D hydrodynamic modeling.
bf2e0d0a99d38ac0a1690036f5ddc361271a494b.architecture: Convolutional neural network, artificial neural network, random forest and support vector machine compared at 30, 10, 5 and 2 m resolutions.
bf2e0d0a99d38ac0a1690036f5ddc361271a494b.data: Flood inventory of 4333 flooded locations in Berlin and 11 potential hazard factors.
bf2e0d0a99d38ac0a1690036f5ddc361271a494b.result: All models perform well (minimum test AUC 0.87); random forest is best at all resolutions, especially 2 m; spatial transfer is moderate (Kappa-based, minimum AUC 0.8).
bf2e0d0a99d38ac0a1690036f5ddc361271a494b.open_work: Apply to other cities and include rainfall characteristics for event-based prediction.
bf2e0d0a99d38ac0a1690036f5ddc361271a494b.issues: Depends on a reliable flood inventory; static susceptibility; moderate transferability outside the training area.

613dcfb04422807cc1e783706c1f69afa200b539.goal: Predicts ozone concentration by combining local feature extraction and long-range temporal dependencies.
613dcfb04422807cc1e783706c1f69afa200b539.architecture: Hybrid convolutional neural network and transformer (CNN-Transformer), as stated in the title; details not reported.
613dcfb04422807cc1e783706c1f69afa200b539.data: Not reported in the available metadata.
613dcfb04422807cc1e783706c1f69afa200b539.result: Not reported in the available metadata; the hybrid is presented as improving ozone prediction over compared models.
613dcfb04422807cc1e783706c1f69afa200b539.open_work: Test across sites and seasons and for high-ozone episodes.
613dcfb04422807cc1e783706c1f69afa200b539.issues: Abstract unavailable; data, horizon and baselines cannot be verified.

452689b57e7aead4c1ce68f9eb932069cdee4151.goal: Downscales GRACE groundwater storage changes to 5 km over California's Central Valley to support water resources management.
452689b57e7aead4c1ce68f9eb932069cdee4151.architecture: Random forest regression linking GRACE-derived groundwater storage to in situ groundwater level variations.
452689b57e7aead4c1ce68f9eb932069cdee4151.data: GRACE satellite gravimetry and in situ groundwater levels, 2002–2016; validation with GPS vertical displacement and CryoSat-2 altimetry.
452689b57e7aead4c1ce68f9eb932069cdee4151.result: Modeled groundwater levels give NSE 0.94–0.97; about 30 km³ loss 2002–2016, with peak loss rates of −5.7 and −9.8 km³/yr during 2007–2009 and 2011–2015 droughts.
452689b57e7aead4c1ce68f9eb932069cdee4151.open_work: Extend to other stressed aquifers and to GRACE-FO era for continuity.
452689b57e7aead4c1ce68f9eb932069cdee4151.issues: Relies on dense in situ wells for training; downscaled fields inherit GRACE leakage and model errors; validation partly in-sample.

2a0910bf81ef7d148f055118625dbbdbc98cc1d2.goal: Projects how the large-fire season in southern California responds to anthropogenic climate change.
2a0910bf81ef7d148f055118625dbbdbc98cc1d2.architecture: Random forest classifiers estimating daily large-fire probability at station scale, driven by downscaled earth system model simulations.
2a0910bf81ef7d148f055118625dbbdbc98cc1d2.data: Historical fire and meteorological station data in coastal southern California; downscaled earth system model projections under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5.
2a0910bf81ef7d148f055118625dbbdbc98cc1d2.result: Large fire days increase from 36 per year (1970–1999) to 58 (RCP4.5) and 71 (RCP8.5) by 2070–2099, with earlier onset and later end of the season.
2a0910bf81ef7d148f055118625dbbdbc98cc1d2.open_work: Include changes in fuels, ignitions and human factors in projections.
2a0910bf81ef7d148f055118625dbbdbc98cc1d2.issues: Assumes stationary fire-weather relations; fuel, vegetation and human ignition changes not modeled; inherits downscaling biases.

c7507dc282e5a3bc7eed0b4750db7ab6ab83577b.goal: Reviews deep learning models for drought prediction and their supporting information systems.
c7507dc282e5a3bc7eed0b4750db7ab6ab83577b.architecture: Review of deep learning for drought forecasting, covering deep neural networks, multilayer perceptrons, convolutional neural networks and hybrid models, with comparative tables.
c7507dc282e5a3bc7eed0b4750db7ab6ab83577b.data: Literature review of drought types, information systems and deep learning studies.
c7507dc282e5a3bc7eed0b4750db7ab6ab83577b.result: Deep neural networks, MLP, CNN and hybrid models are identified as most pertinent; success depends strongly on data availability and quality.
c7507dc282e5a3bc7eed0b4750db7ab6ab83577b.open_work: Address data scarcity and quality, and the specific characteristics of drought events, as open challenges.
c7507dc282e5a3bc7eed0b4750db7ab6ab83577b.issues: Mostly descriptive; no quantitative meta-analysis; drought index definitions vary across reviewed studies.

9b7afe7ee0644b9bbf19adda4fb91706b7b4ff42.goal: Improves rice yield prediction by combining UAV multispectral imagery with weather data through multimodal deep learning.
9b7afe7ee0644b9bbf19adda4fb91706b7b4ff42.architecture: Multimodal deep learning with convolutional neural network feature extractors for UAV imagery fused with weather data; CNN architectures, depths and fusion methods are compared.
9b7afe7ee0644b9bbf19adda4fb91706b7b4ff42.data: UAV multispectral images at heading stage and weather data at different temporal aggregations; specific fields and years not reported in the abstract.
9b7afe7ee0644b9bbf19adda4fb91706b7b4ff42.result: Integrating weather data improves yield prediction; weekly weather inputs work best; a simple CNN extractor is sufficient, but within-field yield maps differ between equally accurate models.
9b7afe7ee0644b9bbf19adda4fb91706b7b4ff42.open_work: Assess robustness of within-field yield maps, not only overall accuracy.
9b7afe7ee0644b9bbf19adda4fb91706b7b4ff42.issues: Quantitative accuracies not given in the abstract; limited sites and seasons likely constrain generalization.

f43d229ce7b54322d33307b939563a02d6e36229.goal: Benchmarks convolutional neural networks against an operational rule-based processor for Sentinel-1 water and flood mapping at global scale.
f43d229ce7b54322d33307b939563a02d6e36229.architecture: Convolutional segmentation networks AlbuNet-34, FCN, DeepLabV3+, U-Net and U-Net++, with weighted cross entropy plus Lovász loss and data augmentation, compared with the rule-based S-1FS processor.
f43d229ce7b54322d33307b939563a02d6e36229.data: Globally distributed Sentinel-1 amplitude scenes with Sentinel-2-derived water masks as ground truth; two flood events and the Sen1Floods11 dataset for testing.
f43d229ce7b54322d33307b939563a02d6e36229.result: Dual-polarized AlbuNet-34 beats S-1FS by 5% IoU, Lovász loss adds 2%; architectures perform similarly; IoU 0.96 and 0.94 on two flood events.
f43d229ce7b54322d33307b939563a02d6e36229.open_work: Improve generalization to diverse flood conditions and combine with ancillary data.
f43d229ce7b54322d33307b939563a02d6e36229.issues: Sentinel-2-derived labels have their own errors and timing mismatches; geometric augmentation harms performance; few flood events tested.

fe86624126e24d7d8c6a1b42b1284e9e8d994b5b.goal: Reviews deep learning research and applications in wind and wave energy.
fe86624126e24d7d8c6a1b42b1284e9e8d994b5b.architecture: Review of deep learning models and methods applied to wind and wave energy forecasting, optimization, harvesting, management and identification.
fe86624126e24d7d8c6a1b42b1284e9e8d994b5b.data: Literature review of published wind and wave energy deep learning studies.
fe86624126e24d7d8c6a1b42b1284e9e8d994b5b.result: Deep learning shows large potential for energy optimization, harvesting, management, forecasting and behavior identification; methods are compared on similar applications.
fe86624126e24d7d8c6a1b42b1284e9e8d994b5b.open_work: Wave energy applications remain less developed than wind and need more data and benchmarks.
fe86624126e24d7d8c6a1b42b1284e9e8d994b5b.issues: Comparison across studies with different data and metrics limits conclusions; no quantitative meta-analysis.

51b5ff8a9d2f9e308282cfb5b3dc32bd23f2357d.goal: Characterizes 2014–2021 spatiotemporal variations of six air pollutants in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and predicts ozone with machine learning to support ozone control.
51b5ff8a9d2f9e308282cfb5b3dc32bd23f2357d.architecture: Random forest and decision tree regression with meteorological predictors; variable importance analysis used for interpretation.
51b5ff8a9d2f9e308282cfb5b3dc32bd23f2357d.data: Surface monitoring data of CO, PM10, PM2.5, SO2, NO2 and O3 in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, 2014–2021, with meteorological variables; 10-fold cross-validation.
51b5ff8a9d2f9e308282cfb5b3dc32bd23f2357d.result: Random forest predicts ozone with daily R2 0.83 (RMSE 30.0 μg/m3) and monthly R2 0.93 (RMSE 12.1 μg/m3), beating the decision tree; radiation and temperature dominate daily, sea level pressure monthly.
51b5ff8a9d2f9e308282cfb5b3dc32bd23f2357d.open_work: Improving capture of ozone extremes and separating meteorological from emission-driven (e.g. COVID-19) influences on predictor importance.
51b5ff8a9d2f9e308282cfb5b3dc32bd23f2357d.issues: Random forest may miss ozone extremes; performance relies mostly on spatial rather than temporal patterns; random cross-validation can overstate skill.

151405fe285be2a19cee0ed3744376a9e0b8deb8.goal: Forecasts hourly NO2, SO2, O3 and CO concentrations in Ho Chi Minh City with a single global model instead of one model per pollutant, easing deployment.
151405fe285be2a19cee0ed3744376a9e0b8deb8.architecture: Multi-step, multi-output multivariate machine learning forecasting model; the specific model family is not specified in the abstract.
151405fe285be2a19cee0ed3744376a9e0b8deb8.data: Six HealthyAir monitoring sites in Ho Chi Minh City, February 2021–August 2022, with hourly Darksky weather data, urban space information and time features.
151405fe285be2a19cee0ed3744376a9e0b8deb8.result: The global model forecasts 1–24 h concentrations of four pollutants simultaneously and outperforms earlier pollutant-specific models in the city by RMSE, MAPE and correlation.

b8e8ed1ba3250c0c7d67ef14a7d1ead39562478f.issues: Data sources, location and validation design not reported; reported metric ordering is inconsistent.

e46e4c061e693ee2afe9eb96c364654f84e54b0f.goal: Maps flood hazard zones in Assam, India with machine learning on flood-causative factors.
e46e4c061e693ee2afe9eb96c364654f84e54b0f.architecture: Random forest, support vector machine, gradient boosting, naive Bayes, decision tree and a hybrid ensemble, with VIF and Boruta feature selection.
e46e4c061e693ee2afe9eb96c364654f84e54b0f.data: 22 morphometric, hydrological, soil, terrain and anthropogenic factors; 400 flood and non-flood locations with 70/30 training/validation split.
e46e4c061e693ee2afe9eb96c364654f84e54b0f.result: AUROC of 97% for random forest, gradient boosting and the hybrid model, 96% naive Bayes, 91% SVM and 88% decision tree.
e46e4c061e693ee2afe9eb96c364654f84e54b0f.open_work: Incorporating dynamic factors and validating with independent flood events.
e46e4c061e693ee2afe9eb96c364654f84e54b0f.issues: Small inventory of 400 points; susceptibility mapping without temporal validation; spatial autocorrelation can inflate AUROC.

b66c1b20555aa4515ff6e9d10aeec35abe5c430e.goal: Produces annual 500 m irrigated cropland maps across China for 2000–2019 to support water allocation and agricultural management.
b66c1b20555aa4515ff6e9d10aeec35abe5c430e.architecture: Locally adaptive random forest classifiers in 511 1°×1° grid cells on Google Earth Engine.
b66c1b20555aa4515ff6e9d10aeec35abe5c430e.data: MODIS vegetation indices, climatic factors and topography; training samples screened from existing irrigation maps downscaled from statistics; over 3000 ground truth points for validation.
b66c1b20555aa4515ff6e9d10aeec35abe5c430e.result: Accuracies of 77.2–85.9%; irrigated area expands in Xinjiang and Heilongjiang and declines in Sichuan, Jiangsu, Hebei and the North China Plain.
b66c1b20555aa4515ff6e9d10aeec35abe5c430e.open_work: Finer-resolution mapping and use in Earth system models and water management.
b66c1b20555aa4515ff6e9d10aeec35abe5c430e.issues: Training labels derived from statistics-based maps carry their errors; 500 m pixels mix irrigated and rainfed fields.

43225cdd41775d79bae56e9004200d9b2d338e9d.goal: Forecasts PM10 in two urban areas of Sri Lanka, Battaramulla and Kandy, where air quality forecasting is lacking.
43225cdd41775d79bae56e9004200d9b2d338e9d.architecture: XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM, LSTM and GRU models compared.
43225cdd41775d79bae56e9004200d9b2d338e9d.data: Twelve air quality parameters from monitoring in Battaramulla (Colombo) and Kandy; period not reported in the abstract.
43225cdd41775d79bae56e9004200d9b2d338e9d.result: LightGBM performs best in both areas with R2 0.99 and NSE 0.99.
43225cdd41775d79bae56e9004200d9b2d338e9d.open_work: Developing location-specific models for other areas and analyzing seasonal PM10 changes.
43225cdd41775d79bae56e9004200d9b2d338e9d.issues: Near-perfect scores suggest possible leakage or very short horizons; only two sites.

aa8d831c7f2f5573c06d8bb8af114728806d49b3.goal: Generalizes rapid deep learning flood predictions to urban catchments unseen in training, as a fast alternative to 2D hydrodynamic models.
aa8d831c7f2f5573c06d8bb8af114728806d49b3.architecture: cGAN-Flood: two conditional generative adversarial networks, one identifying wet cells and one estimating water depths in a rain-on-grid setup.
aa8d831c7f2f5573c06d8bb8af114728806d49b3.data: HEC-RAS rain-on-grid simulations as ground truth; trained on ten and tested on five urban catchments; compared with HEC-RAS and WCA2D.
aa8d831c7f2f5573c06d8bb8af114728806d49b3.result: Predicts water depths in unseen catchments and is 50 and 250 times faster than WCA2D and HEC-RAS, though it underestimates channel depths for low-intensity events.
aa8d831c7f2f5573c06d8bb8af114728806d49b3.open_work: Application to large-scale watershed flood forecasting.
aa8d831c7f2f5573c06d8bb8af114728806d49b3.issues: Requires a target flood volume from hydrological simulation; trained on HEC-RAS output so inherits its assumptions; channel depth underestimation.

be25d5baf97b99f4a379cd04d4727b743fce7e71.goal: Forecasts 10-minute-ahead photovoltaic output power prediction intervals to reduce uncertainty for smart grid control.
be25d5baf97b99f4a379cd04d4727b743fce7e71.architecture: Deep learning model combined with probability density functions for interval forecasts; the network type is not specified in the abstract.
be25d5baf97b99f4a379cd04d4727b743fce7e71.data: Meteorological parameters from Spanish meteorological stations.
be25d5baf97b99f4a379cd04d4727b743fce7e71.result: Prediction interval coverage exceeds the 95% nominal confidence level, with skill scores reported.
be25d5baf97b99f4a379cd04d4727b743fce7e71.open_work: Longer horizons and testing at more PV plants.
be25d5baf97b99f4a379cd04d4727b743fce7e71.issues: Coverage alone does not measure interval sharpness; data details and baselines not given in the abstract.

4da304b19438cab11b2c8a53264e45a23479498a.goal: Explains why surface ozone in South Korea and the Seoul metropolitan area is high and rising despite emission controls.
4da304b19438cab11b2c8a53264e45a23479498a.architecture: Random forest to remove meteorological variability from ozone and NO2 trends, combined with a global 3-D atmospheric chemistry model (GEOS-Chem) for attribution.
4da304b19438cab11b2c8a53264e45a23479498a.data: South Korean surface ozone and NO2 observations 2015–2019 with meteorological data; free-tropospheric ozone observations; GEOS-Chem simulations.
4da304b19438cab11b2c8a53264e45a23479498a.result: Meteorology-corrected 90th-percentile MDA8 ozone rises up to 1.5 ppb per year in April–May while NO2 falls 22%; NOx reductions drive the rise, and background ozone external to East Asia is about 56 ppb.
4da304b19438cab11b2c8a53264e45a23479498a.open_work: Reducing VOC emissions and addressing hemispheric background ozone.
4da304b19438cab11b2c8a53264e45a23479498a.issues: Machine learning is used only for meteorological detrending; attribution depends on the chemistry model's emissions and chemistry.

42a1bc6e3e1bc847d242e22c441369fb0f741d13.goal: Forecasts the air quality index at seven sites in Bangladesh with a hybrid deep learning model using satellite-derived predictors.
42a1bc6e3e1bc847d242e22c441369fb0f741d13.architecture: CLSTM-BiGRU hybrid combining a convolutional neural network, LSTM and bidirectional GRU, with grey wolf optimization for tuning.
42a1bc6e3e1bc847d242e22c441369fb0f741d13.data: Nineteen remotely sensed hydro-climatological predictor variables and AQI at seven sub-tropical sites in Bangladesh.
42a1bc6e3e1bc847d242e22c441369fb0f741d13.result: The hybrid model outperforms benchmark models with lower errors and correlation near 1.
42a1bc6e3e1bc847d242e22c441369fb0f741d13.open_work: Applying the model to air quality monitoring and public health risk mitigation in other urban environments.
42a1bc6e3e1bc847d242e22c441369fb0f741d13.issues: Correlation near 1 suggests possible leakage or optimistic evaluation; forecast horizon and data periods not reported in the abstract.

76e2412792348d846410d61b664a6ff2a367bc07.goal: Hybridizes the conceptual GR4J rainfall-runoff model with deep learning to combine process knowledge with data-driven skill.
76e2412792348d846410d61b664a6ff2a367bc07.architecture: DeepGR4J: GR4J production storage coupled with deep learning routing using CNN or LSTM networks.
76e2412792348d846410d61b664a6ff2a367bc07.result: The hybrid improves on GR4J and is competitive with or better than standalone deep learning, notably in arid catchments.
76e2412792348d846410d61b664a6ff2a367bc07.open_work: Testing other conceptual models and regional or ungauged settings.
76e2412792348d846410d61b664a6ff2a367bc07.issues: Evaluated in Australian catchments only; per-catchment skill details not given in this record.

38106ed45abc933b7905b94e789f95bbca01aaf7.goal: Predicts daily intra-urban PM2.5 at 30-m resolution to expose pollution inequality, overcoming sparse reference stations and multi-source data mismatch.
38106ed45abc933b7905b94e789f95bbca01aaf7.architecture: Multi-scale, attention-enhanced convolutional neural network (CNN) on Kriging baseline plus multi-scale residuals; low-cost sensors calibrated with an optimized neural network; permutation feature importance.
38106ed45abc933b7905b94e789f95bbca01aaf7.data: Dense calibrated low-cost PM2.5 sensor network, gap-filled satellite aerosol optical depth, airborne LiDAR-derived 3D urban form and other raster predictors.
38106ed45abc933b7905b94e789f95bbca01aaf7.result: The model reconciles sensor and raster predictors to produce 30-m daily PM2.5 maps that reveal inequality across and within urbanization levels; quantitative skill is not given in the abstract.
38106ed45abc933b7905b94e789f95bbca01aaf7.open_work: Transfer to other cities and longer periods, and propagation of sensor calibration uncertainty into the maps.
38106ed45abc933b7905b94e789f95bbca01aaf7.issues: Depends on low-cost sensor calibration quality; single study area; no quantitative accuracy or uncertainty reported in the abstract.

eb7f764cb6fa1e4258d8653a78adf9a57ac2d3c2.goal: Downscales coarse (~300 km) GRACE groundwater storage anomalies to 0.25° in the Urmia Lake catchment to identify drivers of the lake's decline.
eb7f764cb6fa1e4258d8653a78adf9a57ac2d3c2.architecture: Random forest, support vector regression and multilayer perceptron (MLP) regressing GRACE-derived GWSA on hydro-climatic predictors.
eb7f764cb6fa1e4258d8653a78adf9a57ac2d3c2.data: GRACE total water storage, precipitation, evapotranspiration, land surface temperature and NDVI; in-situ well data for validation.
eb7f764cb6fa1e4258d8653a78adf9a57ac2d3c2.result: Random forest performs best (R 0.98, NSE 0.96, RMSE 18.36 mm); downscaled GWSA shows a significant negative trend driven mainly by groundwater exploitation rather than climate.
eb7f764cb6fa1e4258d8653a78adf9a57ac2d3c2.open_work: Explicit representation of human withdrawals and dam operations, and extension to GRACE-FO periods.
eb7f764cb6fa1e4258d8653a78adf9a57ac2d3c2.issues: Statistical downscaling assumes coarse-scale relations hold at finer scale; negative correlations with wells near dams show local mismatch; regional study.

3d0d3f417870fb1430a5e216c2e36a2ee996d118.goal: Builds a precipitation forecasting and classification system to support early flood warning.
3d0d3f417870fb1430a5e216c2e36a2ee996d118.architecture: Exponential smoothing-LSTM (ES-LSTM) and recurrent neural network (RNN) for forecasting; artificial neural network (MLP) and decision tree for rainfall classification.
3d0d3f417870fb1430a5e216c2e36a2ee996d118.data: Australian Bureau of Meteorology Historical Daily Weather dataset.
3d0d3f417870fb1430a5e216c2e36a2ee996d118.result: ES-LSTM reaches MAPE 3.17 versus 6.42 for RNN; ANN classification accuracy 96.65% versus 84.0% for the decision tree.
3d0d3f417870fb1430a5e216c2e36a2ee996d118.open_work: Linking rainfall forecasts to hydrological flood models and testing the alert system operationally.
3d0d3f417870fb1430a5e216c2e36a2ee996d118.issues: Flood forecasting is inferred from rainfall alone without hydrological modelling; station time series only; MAPE on precipitation is hard to interpret.

e8a16c041e0d9790db26439d610a87648c4049c3.goal: Reviews machine learning use in atmospheric pollution research, mainly particulate matter prediction, source apportionment and health effects.
e8a16c041e0d9790db26439d610a87648c4049c3.architecture: Review of 105 articles covering ML prediction principles, influencing factors, interpretable ML, source apportionment and health applications.
e8a16c041e0d9790db26439d610a87648c4049c3.data: Literature corpus of 105 ML and atmospheric pollution studies.
e8a16c041e0d9790db26439d610a87648c4049c3.result: Accuracy improves by adding geographic features, pollutant physical characteristics and optimized ML models; source apportionment and health applications remain scarce.
e8a16c041e0d9790db26439d610a87648c4049c3.open_work: Standardized methods and specialized ML approaches to connect source apportionment and health research.
e8a16c041e0d9790db26439d610a87648c4049c3.issues: Modest corpus size; qualitative synthesis without quantitative meta-analysis.

9ca04e6837635f1c3476117cc2e0b4b9f07d8aae.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in Sulaymaniyah province, Iraq, to support flood management.
9ca04e6837635f1c3476117cc2e0b4b9f07d8aae.architecture: Random forest and bagging ensembles tuned with a genetic algorithm (RF-GA, Bagging-GA), with frequency ratio, multicollinearity and Geodetector preprocessing.
9ca04e6837635f1c3476117cc2e0b4b9f07d8aae.data: Sentinel-1 SAR flood inventory (160 locations, 70/30 split), rainfall, NDVI, land cover, topographic indices and geology.
9ca04e6837635f1c3476117cc2e0b4b9f07d8aae.result: Bagging-GA performs best (AUC 0.935, test RMSE 0.454), followed by RF-GA (AUC 0.904), Bagging (0.872) and RF (0.847).
9ca04e6837635f1c3476117cc2e0b4b9f07d8aae.open_work: Testing transferability to other regions and dynamic, event-based susceptibility.
9ca04e6837635f1c3476117cc2e0b4b9f07d8aae.issues: Small inventory of 160 points; static susceptibility without temporal forcing; single region.

18082de240e8951420c62bf872135a69e60ab457.goal: Improves rainfall-runoff simulation in data-poor watersheds by integrating remote sensing inputs with hybrid signal decomposition, as the title states.
18082de240e8951420c62bf872135a69e60ab457.architecture: Hybrid decomposition combined with a data-driven hydrologic model; the specific ML model type is not specified in the available metadata.
18082de240e8951420c62bf872135a69e60ab457.data: Remote sensing products and limited gauge data; specific datasets not reported.
18082de240e8951420c62bf872135a69e60ab457.result: Not reported; the title implies improved runoff simulation over non-decomposed baselines.
18082de240e8951420c62bf872135a69e60ab457.open_work: Testing across more ungauged basins and quantifying remote-sensing input uncertainty.
18082de240e8951420c62bf872135a69e60ab457.issues: Abstract unavailable; decomposition-based hybrids can leak future information if applied to the full series before splitting.

0fc5c7d1d5bbabc254656a91099f004544d8054b.goal: Improves wind power forecasting by correcting errors in forecast wind speed inputs.
0fc5c7d1d5bbabc254656a91099f004544d8054b.architecture: LSTM with adaptive wind speed calibration (C-LSTM) that fuses historical and forecast wind speed with learnable weights trained jointly with the network.
0fc5c7d1d5bbabc254656a91099f004544d8054b.data: Data from 25 wind turbines with historical and forecast wind speed; source not reported in the abstract.
0fc5c7d1d5bbabc254656a91099f004544d8054b.result: C-LSTM significantly outperforms LSTM using forecast or historical wind speed directly, in MSE and accuracy, across all 25 turbines.
0fc5c7d1d5bbabc254656a91099f004544d8054b.open_work: Extending calibration to other meteorological inputs and to farm-level or probabilistic forecasts.
0fc5c7d1d5bbabc254656a91099f004544d8054b.issues: Exact gains and horizons not given in the abstract; deterministic forecasts only; baselines limited to plain LSTM.

d38374af95f9643de905c3efa144d33a828812b6.goal: Improves streamflow simulation in a semi-arid basin of the Chinese Loess Plateau using hybridized machine learning models.
d38374af95f9643de905c3efa144d33a828812b6.architecture: Hybrid machine learning models; the specific model types are not specified in the available metadata.
d38374af95f9643de905c3efa144d33a828812b6.data: Hydrometeorological data from a semi-arid Loess Plateau basin; details not reported.
