d38374af95f9643de905c3efa144d33a828812b6.result: Not reported; the title implies hybrid models outperform standalone ones.
d38374af95f9643de905c3efa144d33a828812b6.open_work: Transfer to other semi-arid basins and integration with process-based models.
d38374af95f9643de905c3efa144d33a828812b6.issues: Abstract unavailable; single-basin study; semi-arid low-flow regimes are hard to evaluate.

e44c35cac1192bade596e2ba23915f7026bfeabe.goal: Quantifies the relative roles of soil moisture and vapor pressure deficit in forest productivity decline during China's 2022 compound drought-heatwave.
e44c35cac1192bade596e2ba23915f7026bfeabe.architecture: Machine learning attribution of productivity variations to soil moisture and VPD; the model type is not specified in the abstract.
e44c35cac1192bade596e2ba23915f7026bfeabe.data: Satellite remote sensing of forest productivity and soil moisture plus meteorological data for summer 2022 in China.
e44c35cac1192bade596e2ba23915f7026bfeabe.result: Soil moisture, not VPD, dominates the productivity decline, with a possible tipping point below which productivity drops rapidly.
e44c35cac1192bade596e2ba23915f7026bfeabe.open_work: Testing whether the soil moisture threshold holds for other events and forest types.
e44c35cac1192bade596e2ba23915f7026bfeabe.issues: Single event; correlational ML attribution with collinear SM and VPD; satellite productivity proxies carry their own errors.

5a6b796735e2cb0abdf09960e6d2205f6d5c2cc1.goal: Reviews how machine learning can address deficiencies of numerical storm surge prediction.
5a6b796735e2cb0abdf09960e6d2205f6d5c2cc1.architecture: Review of ML workflow for storm surges (problem formulation, input features, model selection, evaluation), hybrid data-physics methods and physics-informed ML.
5a6b796735e2cb0abdf09960e6d2205f6d5c2cc1.data: Literature on ML storm surge prediction; no new data.
5a6b796735e2cb0abdf09960e6d2205f6d5c2cc1.result: Identifies strengths, limitations and research gaps, and outlines a vision for trustworthy forecasting using physics-informed ML.
5a6b796735e2cb0abdf09960e6d2205f6d5c2cc1.open_work: Physics-informed ML and hybrid systems for reliable operational surge forecasting.
5a6b796735e2cb0abdf09960e6d2205f6d5c2cc1.issues: Qualitative review; no quantitative benchmark across methods.

9d725b70c61f41bc04eb18556fa1d4c02d627c6f.goal: Predicts wind speed intervals (uncertainty bounds) from multidimensional time series.
9d725b70c61f41bc04eb18556fa1d4c02d627c6f.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) on multidimensional time series for interval prediction, as the title states.
9d725b70c61f41bc04eb18556fa1d4c02d627c6f.data: Wind speed and related time series; sites not reported.
9d725b70c61f41bc04eb18556fa1d4c02d627c6f.open_work: Calibration of intervals across sites and seasons and use in power dispatch.
9d725b70c61f41bc04eb18556fa1d4c02d627c6f.issues: Abstract unavailable; interval coverage and baselines not known.

ec72dda1153dcb9738202c5ff61ce34580d66cea.goal: Forecasts short-term dense (gridded) wind speed from weather images.
ec72dda1153dcb9738202c5ff61ce34580d66cea.architecture: ConvLSTM-LSTM deep learning model, as the title states.
ec72dda1153dcb9738202c5ff61ce34580d66cea.data: Weather image data; source and region not reported.
ec72dda1153dcb9738202c5ff61ce34580d66cea.open_work: Longer lead times and comparison with NWP-based wind forecasts.
ec72dda1153dcb9738202c5ff61ce34580d66cea.issues: Abstract unavailable; SSRN preprint, not peer reviewed; evaluation details unknown.

eb8d7c26359ad0387bb84bc863f6a04be4381339.goal: Predicts daily sediment transport in the Johor river, Malaysia, comparing deep learning and classical ML.
eb8d7c26359ad0387bb84bc863f6a04be4381339.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) compared with artificial neural network (MLP) and support vector machine; lagged inputs chosen by autocorrelation.
eb8d7c26359ad0387bb84bc863f6a04be4381339.data: Daily sediment transport records, January 2008 to December 2018, Johor river.
eb8d7c26359ad0387bb84bc863f6a04be4381339.result: LSTM outperforms ANN and SVM (RMSE 11.395, MAE 18.094, R2 0.914); ANN shows signs of overfitting.
eb8d7c26359ad0387bb84bc863f6a04be4381339.open_work: Adding hydrological covariates such as discharge and rainfall and testing multi-step forecasts.
eb8d7c26359ad0387bb84bc863f6a04be4381339.issues: Univariate autoregressive setup; single river; reported MAE larger than RMSE suggests a reporting inconsistency.

5d850578fc54c633d2ce3fa9dcb2af7130669302.goal: Reviews photovoltaic power forecasting methods to support solar integration into power systems.
5d850578fc54c633d2ce3fa9dcb2af7130669302.architecture: Review with a new taxonomy by horizon, architecture and application, covering physical, statistical, machine learning, deep learning and hybrid models plus evolutionary and swarm optimization.
5d850578fc54c633d2ce3fa9dcb2af7130669302.data: Literature on PV power forecasting; no new data.
5d850578fc54c633d2ce3fa9dcb2af7130669302.result: Synthesizes advantages and disadvantages of methods, metrics, weather impacts and economics; highlights deep learning and diverse data sources.
5d850578fc54c633d2ce3fa9dcb2af7130669302.open_work: Improved model adaptability, data quality and computational efficiency for large-scale PV integration.
5d850578fc54c633d2ce3fa9dcb2af7130669302.issues: Broad narrative review; no quantitative comparison on common benchmarks.

c018e08c8fc0e5bda58b34e9ee03d089643be825.goal: Reviews AI in surface water management, linking techniques to operational, ethical and governance dimensions.
c018e08c8fc0e5bda58b34e9ee03d089643be825.architecture: Review covering LSTM, CNN, graph neural networks, transformers, reinforcement learning, IoT, remote sensing and hybrid AI-physics models.
c018e08c8fc0e5bda58b34e9ee03d089643be825.data: Over two decades of interdisciplinary literature on streamflow, sediment, flood, water quality and infrastructure operations.
c018e08c8fc0e5bda58b34e9ee03d089643be825.result: Provides a systems-level roadmap including explainable AI, algorithmic bias, cybersecurity and institutional readiness for data-scarce regions.
c018e08c8fc0e5bda58b34e9ee03d089643be825.open_work: Equitable, resilient AI adoption and better methods for data-scarce, climate-uncertain regions.
c018e08c8fc0e5bda58b34e9ee03d089643be825.issues: Broad scope limits technical depth; no quantitative synthesis.

2b23a3acdd09fc9c37d18a60b4ec7556c8992ef4.goal: Improves lake water level forecasts at 1-, 3- and 7-day leads and quantifies uncertainty for Poyang Lake.
2b23a3acdd09fc9c37d18a60b4ec7556c8992ef4.architecture: LSTM, GRU and temporal convolutional network (TCN) combined by Bayesian model averaging, with Monte Carlo sampling for 90% intervals.
2b23a3acdd09fc9c37d18a60b4ec7556c8992ef4.data: Water level records at five Poyang Lake stations; period not reported in the abstract.
2b23a3acdd09fc9c37d18a60b4ec7556c8992ef4.result: GRU is best in most scenarios; BMA improves NSE and R2 in 80% of scenarios and ranks top two in all; interval containing ratio exceeds 84%.
2b23a3acdd09fc9c37d18a60b4ec7556c8992ef4.open_work: Applying the BMA framework to other hydrological variables and adding exogenous drivers.
2b23a3acdd09fc9c37d18a60b4ec7556c8992ef4.issues: Single lake; skill at longer leads and in extremes not detailed; BMA weights fixed from training period.

7ad8acf0bdd2b7df9e6cdd3cb0427c79b9f4bf96.goal: Constrains uncertainty in maize and soybean yield projections under climate change in China by combining crop models with statistical learning.
7ad8acf0bdd2b7df9e6cdd3cb0427c79b9f4bf96.architecture: Random forest and a dynamic linear model each coupled with nine global gridded crop models (GGCM+RF, GGCM+DLM).
7ad8acf0bdd2b7df9e6cdd3cb0427c79b9f4bf96.data: Nine GGCM outputs, environmental variables (chilling days, pests and diseases, drought, hot days) and observed yields across China's maize and soybean belt; GCM climate scenarios for 2040–2099.
7ad8acf0bdd2b7df9e6cdd3cb0427c79b9f4bf96.result: GGCM+RF raises maize r from 0.15 to 0.61–0.77 and soybean r from 0.37 to 0.54–0.70, and cuts projection uncertainty by 33–78% (maize) and 56–68% (soybean).
7ad8acf0bdd2b7df9e6cdd3cb0427c79b9f4bf96.open_work: Applying the framework to other crops and regions and to new ensemble generations.
7ad8acf0bdd2b7df9e6cdd3cb0427c79b9f4bf96.issues: Random forest extrapolation into future climates is uncertain; pest and disease predictors are hard to project.

71bb49d1723adc185f0961c87b457b2d60fe3667.goal: Predicts wheat grain yield from drone multispectral imagery to support food security decisions.
71bb49d1723adc185f0961c87b457b2d60fe3667.architecture: Random forest, XGBoost and LASSO regression compared across growth stages.
71bb49d1723adc185f0961c87b457b2d60fe3667.data: Drone-based multispectral data over three experimental wheat fields with three sowing dates.
71bb49d1723adc185f0961c87b457b2d60fe3667.result: LASSO performs best in April (R2 0.93, MAE 21.72); predicted yields 260.54, 201.64 and 47.29 g/m2 for the three sowing dates.
71bb49d1723adc185f0961c87b457b2d60fe3667.open_work: Scaling to larger areas, more seasons and satellite imagery.
71bb49d1723adc185f0961c87b457b2d60fe3667.issues: Small experimental fields and one site; limited samples risk overfitting.

7619d9395a5df009eeb438df95174bfd01b57822.goal: Improves monthly streamflow prediction in a mountainous region using hydroclimatic inputs.
7619d9395a5df009eeb438df95174bfd01b57822.architecture: Deep learning and machine learning models tuned by metaheuristic optimizers, as the title states; specific network types not specified in the available metadata.
7619d9395a5df009eeb438df95174bfd01b57822.data: Hydroclimatic data from a mountainous basin; details not reported.
7619d9395a5df009eeb438df95174bfd01b57822.result: Not reported; the title implies metaheuristic tuning improves accuracy.
7619d9395a5df009eeb438df95174bfd01b57822.open_work: Testing across more basins and at finer time steps.
7619d9395a5df009eeb438df95174bfd01b57822.issues: Abstract unavailable; monthly data give few samples; benefit of metaheuristic tuning over standard tuning unclear.

b381e5a4797e7104d3329797bb57b7b03deecadc.goal: Estimates solar radiation and studies how feature selection affects multivariate prediction.
b381e5a4797e7104d3329797bb57b7b03deecadc.architecture: Recursive feature elimination with decision tree, logistic regression, gradient boosting and random forest, plus Pearson correlation, in a multivariate time series framework.
b381e5a4797e7104d3329797bb57b7b03deecadc.data: Meteorological variables (temperature, precipitation, wind speed, humidity); station and period not reported in the abstract.
b381e5a4797e7104d3329797bb57b7b03deecadc.result: All models show low error (RMSE 0.003–0.007); selected features vary by model and month.
b381e5a4797e7104d3329797bb57b7b03deecadc.open_work: Testing on more sites and against physical radiation models.
b381e5a4797e7104d3329797bb57b7b03deecadc.issues: Reported metrics are inconsistent (R2 0.002 called best); logistic regression for continuous radiation is unusual; data details missing.

b309f6ed390132f8b8e0387277f3fb1242a2535a.goal: Surveys published reviews on machine learning for hydrological process modelling to identify gaps and directions.
b309f6ed390132f8b8e0387277f3fb1242a2535a.architecture: Review of reviews on ML models in hydrology.
b309f6ed390132f8b8e0387277f3fb1242a2535a.data: Published review articles on ML for hydrological processes.
b309f6ed390132f8b8e0387277f3fb1242a2535a.result: ML models beat traditional models in forecastability and flexibility, but interpretability, practicality and physical explanation remain limiting.
b309f6ed390132f8b8e0387277f3fb1242a2535a.open_work: Interpretable, physically consistent ML and practical watershed-management deployment.
b309f6ed390132f8b8e0387277f3fb1242a2535a.issues: Despite the title, no new quantitative benchmark; qualitative synthesis.

c7c405a48d7b73845eb848a560d1fb17121ab67c.goal: Estimates global human exposure to landscape fire-sourced PM2.5 and ozone over 2000–2019.
c7c405a48d7b73845eb848a560d1fb17121ab67c.architecture: Machine learning combined with chemical transport model output; the ML model type is not specified in the abstract.
c7c405a48d7b73845eb848a560d1fb17121ab67c.data: Chemical transport model simulations and observations at 0.25° daily resolution, 2000–2019; specific products not reported in the abstract.
c7c405a48d7b73845eb848a560d1fb17121ab67c.result: Population-weighted fire PM2.5 is 2.5 µg/m3 and ozone 3.2 µg/m3 in 2010–2019; 2.18 billion people exposed at least one day per year; levels four times higher in low-income countries.
c7c405a48d7b73845eb848a560d1fb17121ab67c.open_work: Health burden attribution and projections of fire pollution under climate change.
c7c405a48d7b73845eb848a560d1fb17121ab67c.issues: Depends on fire emission inventories and CTM partitioning of fire contributions; sparse monitoring in high-fire regions.

15bae91a9ad0c570dbde9f30d8bbbb6eb3885c33.goal: Predicts the Air Quality Index for ten Chinese cities and compares ML and deep learning.
15bae91a9ad0c570dbde9f30d8bbbb6eb3885c33.architecture: RNN, Bi-GRU, BiLSTM, CNN-BiLSTM and Conv1D-BiLSTM compared with XGBoost (gradient boosting).
15bae91a9ad0c570dbde9f30d8bbbb6eb3885c33.data: AQI records for ten major Chinese cities; period not reported in the abstract.
15bae91a9ad0c570dbde9f30d8bbbb6eb3885c33.result: XGBoost outperforms all deep learning models; Conv1D-BiLSTM and CNN-BiLSTM are best among neural networks, RNN and Bi-GRU worst.
15bae91a9ad0c570dbde9f30d8bbbb6eb3885c33.open_work: Adding meteorological and emission predictors and multi-step forecasts.
15bae91a9ad0c570dbde9f30d8bbbb6eb3885c33.issues: Quantitative scores not in the abstract; city-level time series only.

f52d48cd926d8be72552b76b582ee0a9dfd55ea4.goal: Forecasts monthly flood discharge in the Barak River basin, India.
f52d48cd926d8be72552b76b582ee0a9dfd55ea4.architecture: Support vector machine tuned by particle swarm optimization (PSO-SVM), compared with SVM and backpropagation neural network (MLP).
f52d48cd926d8be72552b76b582ee0a9dfd55ea4.data: Monthly discharge 1969–2018 at BP Ghat and Fulertal gauges, with precipitation, temperature, solar radiation, humidity and evapotranspiration.
f52d48cd926d8be72552b76b582ee0a9dfd55ea4.result: PSO-SVM performs best (RMSE 0.0496, NSE 0.993); including all five meteorological inputs improves accuracy.
f52d48cd926d8be72552b76b582ee0a9dfd55ea4.open_work: Daily or event-scale flood forecasting and other basins.
f52d48cd926d8be72552b76b582ee0a9dfd55ea4.issues: Monthly flows are not flood peaks; near-perfect NSE suggests possible optimistic evaluation.

c012d50eeb70adb2e33136b1b4facd026e08a671.goal: Estimates soil moisture over vegetated agricultural areas from Sentinel-2 to support irrigation management.
c012d50eeb70adb2e33136b1b4facd026e08a671.architecture: Convolutional neural network (CNN) with six convolutional, one pooling and two fully connected layers, tested with band and index input combinations.
c012d50eeb70adb2e33136b1b4facd026e08a671.data: Sentinel-2 bands and indices (NDVI, NDWI) with in-situ soil moisture measurements.
c012d50eeb70adb2e33136b1b4facd026e08a671.result: Best combination of red and red-edge/NIR bands gives R2 0.709, RMSE 0.042; band combinations beat single indices.
c012d50eeb70adb2e33136b1b4facd026e08a671.open_work: Fusion with SAR such as Sentinel-1 and testing on other crops and regions.
c012d50eeb70adb2e33136b1b4facd026e08a671.issues: Optical data limited by clouds; moderate R2; small single-region sample.

3f8b2def9d1a775c32c79712255ae91cbfffe3be.goal: Forecasts a drought index with a hybrid online learning model.
3f8b2def9d1a775c32c79712255ae91cbfffe3be.architecture: Wavelet-decomposed Kalman online sequential extreme learning machine with Boruta-random forest feature selection, as the title states.
3f8b2def9d1a775c32c79712255ae91cbfffe3be.data: Drought index and hydroclimatic predictors; region and index not reported.
3f8b2def9d1a775c32c79712255ae91cbfffe3be.open_work: Testing across climates and lead times.
3f8b2def9d1a775c32c79712255ae91cbfffe3be.issues: Abstract unavailable; wavelet decomposition can leak future information if applied before splitting.

335398ef955301900f902d86878f85d202b910ca.goal: Identifies drivers of China's 2022 ground-level ozone rebound with causal inference to guide mitigation.
335398ef955301900f902d86878f85d202b910ca.architecture: Explainable machine learning combined with causal inference; the ML model type is not specified in the abstract.
335398ef955301900f902d86878f85d202b910ca.data: Ground ozone monitoring, satellite observations (formaldehyde-to-NO2 ratio) and meteorological reanalysis, 2021–2022 China.
335398ef955301900f902d86878f85d202b910ca.result: Higher temperature and solar radiation explain 57% of the ozone increase; 90% of stations show rising HCHO/NO2 ratio, indicating stronger NOx sensitivity.
335398ef955301900f902d86878f85d202b910ca.open_work: Region-specific strategies accounting for anthropogenic emissions and rising biogenic VOCs.
335398ef955301900f902d86878f85d202b910ca.issues: Causal claims rely on observational confounder adjustment; two-year comparison; emissions represented indirectly.

00c07888b2a4a9ad68a95d05ecc1a0c43793d866.goal: Improves typhoon intensity forecasts, which global AI weather models underpredict.
00c07888b2a4a9ad68a95d05ecc1a0c43793d866.architecture: Regional WRF numerical model (non-ML) driven by Pangu-Weather, a transformer-based AI global forecast model, with dynamic vortex initialization.
00c07888b2a4a9ad68a95d05ecc1a0c43793d866.data: Pangu-Weather forecasts as boundary and initial conditions for WRF; typhoon cases and best-track data, details not in the abstract.
00c07888b2a4a9ad68a95d05ecc1a0c43793d866.result: Pangu-Weather alone underestimates intensity; AI-driven WRF gives more accurate intensity and wind structure, comparable to global NWP-driven WRF.
00c07888b2a4a9ad68a95d05ecc1a0c43793d866.open_work: More cases and fully coupling AI forecasts with regional data assimilation.
00c07888b2a4a9ad68a95d05ecc1a0c43793d866.issues: Limited case sample; regional model cost remains; AI fields may lack variables needed by WRF.

84f497de934f3d05a6bdb49f573e9eb9dbcfcbb6.goal: Reviews PM2.5 concentration prediction with a bibliometric and methodological lens.
84f497de934f3d05a6bdb49f573e9eb9dbcfcbb6.architecture: Review and bibliometric analysis covering CNN, RNN, LSTM and transformer models, plus graph neural networks and meta-learning.
84f497de934f3d05a6bdb49f573e9eb9dbcfcbb6.result: Output grows rapidly led by China and the US; transformers stand out for long sequences; data integration, interpretability and cost remain challenges.
84f497de934f3d05a6bdb49f573e9eb9dbcfcbb6.open_work: Meta-learning, graph neural networks, multi-scale modelling and smart-city deployment.
84f497de934f3d05a6bdb49f573e9eb9dbcfcbb6.issues: Bibliometric breadth over depth; no quantitative performance comparison.

8bc5abcd2b0f11e8139084905135631e3b170ed9.goal: Forecasts wind speed with a decomposition-based deep learning model.
8bc5abcd2b0f11e8139084905135631e3b170ed9.architecture: Signal decomposition with a causal convolutional network (temporal CNN) and attention mechanism, as the title states.
8bc5abcd2b0f11e8139084905135631e3b170ed9.data: Wind speed time series; sites not reported.
8bc5abcd2b0f11e8139084905135631e3b170ed9.issues: Abstract unavailable; decomposition hybrids risk leakage if decomposed before splitting.

7602f653c4132f8496fbe00fa677dc246992a213.goal: Predicts next-day rainfall occurrence with machine learning and explores regional patterns.
7602f653c4132f8496fbe00fa677dc246992a213.architecture: Naive Bayes, decision tree, SVM, random forest, logistic regression and an artificial neural network (MLP), with feature selection; k-means and PCA for regional patterns; Flask web app.
7602f653c4132f8496fbe00fa677dc246992a213.result: The ANN reaches 90% accuracy before and 91% after feature selection.
7602f653c4132f8496fbe00fa677dc246992a213.open_work: Operational deployment and inclusion of NWP or satellite predictors.
7602f653c4132f8496fbe00fa677dc246992a213.issues: Accuracy on imbalanced rain/no-rain classes can mislead; tabular station data only.

071c02d2c1862bcc70b151d33d89b4246a270f42.goal: Downscales and bias-corrects NWP 2-m temperature and 10-m wind speed forecasts using transformer super-resolution models.
071c02d2c1862bcc70b151d33d89b4246a270f42.architecture: Transformer models SwinIR and Uformer compared with U-Net and RCAN CNNs; topography feature extraction and multiscale fusion module added to Uformer.
071c02d2c1862bcc70b151d33d89b4246a270f42.data: ECMWF IFS HRES 0.1° forecasts as input; CMA CLDAS 0.01° gridded observations as target over Eastern Inner Mongolia.
071c02d2c1862bcc70b151d33d89b4246a270f42.result: SwinIR and Uformer outperform U-Net and RCAN; topography and multiscale fusion further improve Uformer.
071c02d2c1862bcc70b151d33d89b4246a270f42.open_work: Extension to more variables, regions and lead-time-dependent errors.
071c02d2c1862bcc70b151d33d89b4246a270f42.issues: Single region; CLDAS target is itself an analysis with errors; deterministic outputs only.

90a2aa924776decbc094ca39cfa58970fb0b0f10.goal: Compares models for long-term daily streamflow forecasting of the Colorado River.
90a2aa924776decbc094ca39cfa58970fb0b0f10.architecture: ANFIS, artificial neural network (MLP), BiLSTM and hybrid CNN-GRU-LSTM with lags from partial autocorrelation.
90a2aa924776decbc094ca39cfa58970fb0b0f10.data: Colorado River daily streamflow; 1921–1981 training, 1981–2021 testing.
90a2aa924776decbc094ca39cfa58970fb0b0f10.result: ANFIS is most accurate (NRMSE 0.118, r 0.966, NSE 0.933); BiLSTM and CNN-GRU-LSTM do not outperform simpler models.
90a2aa924776decbc094ca39cfa58970fb0b0f10.open_work: Adding climate and regulation inputs and testing other basins.
90a2aa924776decbc094ca39cfa58970fb0b0f10.issues: Heavily regulated river with univariate inputs; single basin.

6e85986ae8be588f9386f8e5a8cf126e28467edd.goal: Reviews integration of AI and remote sensing in climate-smart agriculture for food security.
6e85986ae8be588f9386f8e5a8cf126e28467edd.architecture: Review of AI predictive analytics, crop modelling, precision agriculture and remote sensing strategies.
6e85986ae8be588f9386f8e5a8cf126e28467edd.data: Literature on AI and remote sensing in agriculture.
6e85986ae8be588f9386f8e5a8cf126e28467edd.result: Shows how AI and remote sensing improve resilience, productivity and resource use, and identifies policy, capacity and access barriers.
6e85986ae8be588f9386f8e5a8cf126e28467edd.open_work: Policy frameworks, capacity building and accessible technologies for adoption.
6e85986ae8be588f9386f8e5a8cf126e28467edd.issues: Broad narrative review; limited technical or quantitative detail.

950ad191fc8c20ceab5ba804f5810a8a3dae7fa9.goal: Forecasts short-term wind speed and power for smart-city grid integration.
950ad191fc8c20ceab5ba804f5810a8a3dae7fa9.architecture: EMD and k-means grouping with support vector regression, XGBoost and Lasso for wind speed; two-stage power model using wind power curve then an artificial neural network (MLP).
950ad191fc8c20ceab5ba804f5810a8a3dae7fa9.data: Historical wind speed, environmental factors and wind power system status data; site not reported in the abstract.
950ad191fc8c20ceab5ba804f5810a8a3dae7fa9.result: The models outperform benchmarks for 10–40 min horizons in wind speed and power forecasting.
950ad191fc8c20ceab5ba804f5810a8a3dae7fa9.issues: Very short horizons only; quantitative gains not in the abstract; EMD on full series may leak information.

27cf76ba1b399965fc408be4791d891f4338b578.goal: Predicts hourly streamflow by exploiting temporal and feature dependencies in rainfall-runoff series.
27cf76ba1b399965fc408be4791d891f4338b578.architecture: SA-CNN-LSTM: self-attention with convolutional neural network and LSTM, compared with LSTM, CNN, ANN, random forest, SA-LSTM and SA-CNN.
27cf76ba1b399965fc408be4791d891f4338b578.data: Hourly rainfall-runoff data from the Mazhou Basin, China.
27cf76ba1b399965fc408be4791d891f4338b578.result: SA-CNN-LSTM is robust across flood magnitudes and lead times, especially 1–5 h, and more stable than single-component attention models.
27cf76ba1b399965fc408be4791d891f4338b578.open_work: Longer lead times and other basins.
27cf76ba1b399965fc408be4791d891f4338b578.issues: Single basin; skill degrades beyond short leads; quantitative metrics not given in the abstract.

4c031b05f4634c95814e6a867b970e04ec4f76c8.goal: Estimates crop evapotranspiration and crop water stress index with AI and sensor data assimilation for irrigation management.
4c031b05f4634c95814e6a867b970e04ec4f76c8.architecture: AI/machine learning algorithms with sensor data assimilation, as the title states; specific model types not specified in the available metadata.
4c031b05f4634c95814e6a867b970e04ec4f76c8.data: Field sensor data; crop and site not reported.
4c031b05f4634c95814e6a867b970e04ec4f76c8.open_work: Real-time irrigation scheduling tests across seasons.
4c031b05f4634c95814e6a867b970e04ec4f76c8.issues: Abstract unavailable; field-scale sensor studies typically cover few seasons and sites, limiting generality.

29efba409a454aa4eb89e8e7f8036c55e248a615.architecture: Time residual LSTM, a residual-connected long short-term memory network, as the title states.
29efba409a454aa4eb89e8e7f8036c55e248a615.data: Hydrological time series; basin not reported.
29efba409a454aa4eb89e8e7f8036c55e248a615.open_work: Uncertainty quantification and transfer to other basins.

3e168334d2caa6fb9377619ba261002acd3a06ae.goal: Forecasts rainfall from historical climate records of Bangladesh to support flood mitigation.
3e168334d2caa6fb9377619ba261002acd3a06ae.architecture: Eight machine learning and deep learning models including polynomial regression, random forest and LSTM.
3e168334d2caa6fb9377619ba261002acd3a06ae.data: Bangladesh Meteorological Department historical climate records.
3e168334d2caa6fb9377619ba261002acd3a06ae.result: Polynomial and random forest regression reach R2 0.76; LSTM validation loss 0.09.
3e168334d2caa6fb9377619ba261002acd3a06ae.open_work: Coupling rainfall forecasts with hydraulic flood models.
3e168334d2caa6fb9377619ba261002acd3a06ae.issues: Floods are not modelled directly despite the title; moderate skill; metrics differ across models.

a27054145b9e7756bf9ed52e548cf59a7897ebf7.goal: Reviews deep learning and machine learning techniques for hydrological inflow (reservoir/streamflow) forecasting.
a27054145b9e7756bf9ed52e548cf59a7897ebf7.architecture: Review of ML and deep learning methods for inflow forecasting.
a27054145b9e7756bf9ed52e548cf59a7897ebf7.open_work: Hybrid physics-ML models and uncertainty-aware inflow forecasting.
a27054145b9e7756bf9ed52e548cf59a7897ebf7.issues: Abstract unavailable; scope and corpus size unknown.

265365d41fd95ca1a10412679a23f2ccb9b3791b.goal: Assesses flood risk by combining machine learning with multi-criteria decision-making methods, aiming at a new mapping approach for flood-prone areas.
265365d41fd95ca1a10412679a23f2ccb9b3791b.architecture: Machine learning combined with multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) methods; the specific machine learning model type is not specified in the available metadata.
265365d41fd95ca1a10412679a23f2ccb9b3791b.open_work: Testing transferability to other regions and comparing alternative ML and MCDM combinations would clarify generality.
265365d41fd95ca1a10412679a23f2ccb9b3791b.issues: Card based on title only; study area, data, model and accuracy cannot be verified. Susceptibility-style flood mapping typically depends on inventory quality and static predictors.

ccbab286a26c6f01b59e6b6177a3e59dc09a2fd1.goal: Forecasts solar radiation and air temperature with an interpretable, flexible neural network, addressing the opacity of standard deep learning forecasters for energy applications.
ccbab286a26c6f01b59e6b6177a3e59dc09a2fd1.architecture: Kolmogorov–Arnold network (KAN) based neural network architecture designed for interpretability and flexibility.
ccbab286a26c6f01b59e6b6177a3e59dc09a2fd1.open_work: Comparing KAN-based forecasters against strong transformer and recurrent baselines across climates and horizons remains to be established.
ccbab286a26c6f01b59e6b6177a3e59dc09a2fd1.issues: Card based on title only; datasets, horizons and gains are unknown. Interpretability claims of KANs need careful physical validation.

6252cc86a3331e6c16a63fef9750e8937e0f047a.goal: Classifies PM2.5 concentration levels in Jakarta from meteorological parameters, handling the strongly unbalanced distribution of pollution classes.
6252cc86a3331e6c16a63fef9750e8937e0f047a.architecture: Boosting ensembles of decision trees: AdaBoost, XGBoost, CatBoost and LightGBM, compared for unbalanced multiclass classification.
6252cc86a3331e6c16a63fef9750e8937e0f047a.data: BMKG Kemayoran station observations of PM2.5 and meteorology in Jakarta, 1 January 2015 to 7 July 2022.
6252cc86a3331e6c16a63fef9750e8937e0f047a.result: Boosting reduces bias and variance under class imbalance; reported class-wise values are good 62%, moderate 34% and unhealthy 59%.
6252cc86a3331e6c16a63fef9750e8937e0f047a.open_work: Adding emission, chemistry or multi-station predictors and resampling strategies could improve minority-class skill.
6252cc86a3331e6c16a63fef9750e8937e0f047a.issues: Single station; modest class-wise scores; meteorology-only predictors ignore emissions; metric definitions for class percentages are unclear in the abstract.

99f4ef997889c2270faa93bf43e50dce8dbbb96f.goal: Develops a rapid district-level rice yield estimation workflow for Nepal to support pre-harvest food security decisions.
99f4ef997889c2270faa93bf43e50dce8dbbb96f.architecture: Stacking ensemble of multiple tree-based regression models, compared with linear regression and standalone ML models.
99f4ef997889c2270faa93bf43e50dce8dbbb96f.data: Remote sensing NDVI plus meteorological variables (rainfall, soil moisture, evapotranspiration) with historical district rice yields in Nepal.
99f4ef997889c2270faa93bf43e50dce8dbbb96f.result: NDVI alone is insufficient; adding meteorology improves accuracy markedly; the stacked model reaches about 92% average accuracy with RMSE 328.06 kg/ha and MAE 317.21 kg/ha.
99f4ef997889c2270faa93bf43e50dce8dbbb96f.open_work: Replicating the workflow in other regions and crops, and finer spatial units, is suggested.
99f4ef997889c2270faa93bf43e50dce8dbbb96f.issues: Short yield time series limit training; accuracy varies by district; district-level aggregation hides within-district variability.

9b85b15228da72b0bfc3f5850fc6bba66abb2572.goal: Estimates precipitation from mesoscale convective systems with geostationary satellite data and interprets the machine learning model to guide predictor selection.
9b85b15228da72b0bfc3f5850fc6bba66abb2572.architecture: Random forest regression for satellite QPE, interpreted with SHAP (Shapley additive explanations).
9b85b15228da72b0bfc3f5850fc6bba66abb2572.data: Himawari-8 spectral data, dense automatic weather station observations and reanalysis data over the North China Plain.
9b85b15228da72b0bfc3f5850fc6bba66abb2572.result: Predicted versus observed rain rate correlation is 0.64 with RMSE 0.27 mm/h; SHAP rankings match random forest importance, highlighting current precipitation, column water vapor, brightness temperature and cloud base height.
9b85b15228da72b0bfc3f5850fc6bba66abb2572.open_work: Extending to other regions and convective regimes and testing deep learning models with the same interpretability analysis.
9b85b15228da72b0bfc3f5850fc6bba66abb2572.issues: Moderate correlation; regional study; performance for heavy rain rates is not reported separately; SHAP explains the model rather than physical causality.

d839519477bd2f2055ec189f796bce578c578102.goal: Surveys foundation and large data-driven models for understanding weather and climate data, focusing on time series and text.
d839519477bd2f2055ec189f796bce578c578102.architecture: Review of model architectures (including transformers and large language models), applications and datasets for weather and climate foundation models.
d839519477bd2f2055ec189f796bce578c578102.data: Review; catalogs weather and climate data types and benchmark datasets rather than training models.
d839519477bd2f2055ec189f796bce578c578102.result: Organizes the field into data types, principal architectures, model scopes and applications, and datasets, and identifies challenges for weather and climate foundation models.
d839519477bd2f2055ec189f796bce578c578102.open_work: Proposes research avenues for building general foundation models for weather and climate, including multimodal and text integration.
d839519477bd2f2055ec189f796bce578c578102.issues: Fast-moving field so coverage dates quickly; survey emphasis on time series and text underrepresents gridded field models.

398a9832ab47cd5fdfb25222363212f8527bbebe.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in the Sylhet division of Bangladesh to support flood risk management.
398a9832ab47cd5fdfb25222363212f8527bbebe.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP-type ANN) classifier of flood versus non-flood locations, mapped in ArcGIS.
398a9832ab47cd5fdfb25222363212f8527bbebe.data: 1280 flood and non-flood sample points (75% training, 25% testing) with eight factors: elevation, slope, aspect, curvature, TWI, SPI, roughness and land use/land cover.
398a9832ab47cd5fdfb25222363212f8527bbebe.result: About 41% of the area falls in very high and 37% in high susceptibility; prediction rate about 89% and success rate about 98%.
398a9832ab47cd5fdfb25222363212f8527bbebe.open_work: Including rainfall and hydrological drivers and comparing with other ML models would strengthen the mapping.
398a9832ab47cd5fdfb25222363212f8527bbebe.issues: Static topographic predictors only; a high success rate versus lower prediction rate suggests overfitting; single region; very large high-risk fraction limits discrimination.

396077a861f7af3c176c83ff88d8e658721a3035.goal: Produces a four-dimensional gridded product of ocean interior dissolved oxygen to constrain oxygen trends and variability.
396077a861f7af3c176c83ff88d8e658721a3035.architecture: Random forest regressions and feed-forward neural networks (MLP) mapping temperature, salinity and location to dissolved oxygen.
396077a861f7af3c176c83ff88d8e658721a3035.data: Argo float oxygen sensors and ship-based discrete measurements for training, applied to Argo temperature and salinity fields; evaluated with Earth system model simulated observations, World Ocean Atlas, GLODAP and hydrographic cruises. 1°, monthly, 2004–2022, 0–2 km.
396077a861f7af3c176c83ff88d8e658721a3035.result: GOBAI-O2 covers 86% of the global ocean area and indicates an upper-2-km oxygen inventory decline of 0.79 ± 0.04% per decade over 2004–2022.
396077a861f7af3c176c83ff88d8e658721a3035.open_work: Extending to other biogeochemical variables and comparing ML gap filling with statistical interpolation approaches.
396077a861f7af3c176c83ff88d8e658721a3035.issues: Sparse oxygen observations in early years and some regions; Argo oxygen sensor calibration uncertainty; coverage excludes marginal seas and deep ocean below 2 km.

88c913ab5b555c999dc56885a1b7cbd46f0f1d67.goal: Reviews AI and remote sensing methods for evaluating crop water stress under climate-driven precipitation variability.
88c913ab5b555c999dc56885a1b7cbd46f0f1d67.architecture: Review of machine learning, deep learning, ensemble methods, GAN and explainable AI combined with RGB, thermal and hyperspectral sensing.
88c913ab5b555c999dc56885a1b7cbd46f0f1d67.data: Review; covers non-destructive remote sensing platforms (RGB, thermal, hyperspectral) used in crop water stress studies.
88c913ab5b555c999dc56885a1b7cbd46f0f1d67.result: Assesses effectiveness of sensing platforms and AI techniques and discusses strategies for data-limited conditions.
88c913ab5b555c999dc56885a1b7cbd46f0f1d67.open_work: Calls for combining sensing modalities and AI under limited data to support sustainable irrigation.
88c913ab5b555c999dc56885a1b7cbd46f0f1d67.issues: Abstract gives no quantitative synthesis; review scope and selection criteria are not detailed in the abstract.

cd61c4a6212a13b55155881de26b4c872934197e.goal: Identifies which ocean, terrestrial and meteorological factors dominate agricultural drought characteristics and their dynamics in China.
cd61c4a6212a13b55155881de26b4c872934197e.architecture: Extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) regression interpreted with SHAP values to attribute drought characteristics to drivers.
cd61c4a6212a13b55155881de26b4c872934197e.data: ERA5 soil moisture used to compute the standardized soil moisture index (SSI); meteorological, terrestrial and climate index drivers (e.g., AMO, NAO) over China.
cd61c4a6212a13b55155881de26b4c872934197e.result: Potential evapotranspiration is the leading basin-scale driver; precipitation and evapotranspiration dominate about 35% and 31–33% of grid points for duration and severity; AMO worsens severity in Yangtze and Pearl basins.
cd61c4a6212a13b55155881de26b4c872934197e.open_work: Using attribution for agricultural drought early warning and examining causal mechanisms.
cd61c4a6212a13b55155881de26b4c872934197e.issues: Relies on ERA5 soil moisture and inherits its biases; SHAP attribution is correlational, not causal.

e8301b9988814311fd739e41f2abf597aa547573.goal: Improves accuracy and computational efficiency of deep learning flood water-level forecasting.
e8301b9988814311fd739e41f2abf597aa547573.architecture: Spatiotemporal attention gated recurrent unit (STA-GRU) with lag-time preprocessing, compared with LSTM, CNN-LSTM, ConvLSTM, STA-LSTM, GRU and CNN-GRU.
e8301b9988814311fd739e41f2abf597aa547573.data: Water level and related hydrological time series for a river basin; site details not reported in the abstract.
e8301b9988814311fd739e41f2abf597aa547573.result: With lag-time preprocessing, STA-GRU R2 rises from 0.8125 to 0.9215 at 12 h and from 0.6181 to 0.7283 at 24 h, with lower RMSE and MAE.
e8301b9988814311fd739e41f2abf597aa547573.open_work: Testing longer leads and other basins and extreme events.
e8301b9988814311fd739e41f2abf597aa547573.issues: Skill degrades markedly at 24 h; single study region; peak-flow performance not separately reported in the abstract.

c22891695d0988062b0010435284da2dd27c2453.goal: Predicts photovoltaic energy production from weather variables and tests metaheuristic hyperparameter tuning.
c22891695d0988062b0010435284da2dd27c2453.architecture: Multiple linear regression, decision tree, random forest, support vector regression and MLP, tuned with the chimp optimization algorithm.
c22891695d0988062b0010435284da2dd27c2453.data: Wind speed, relative humidity, ambient temperature and solar irradiation with output from a 264 kWp PV system at Applied Science University, Amman, Jordan.
c22891695d0988062b0010435284da2dd27c2453.result: MLP performs best with RMSE 0.503, MAE 0.397 and R2 0.99.
c22891695d0988062b0010435284da2dd27c2453.open_work: Comparison with other optimizers and extension to forecasting with predicted rather than observed weather.
c22891695d0988062b0010435284da2dd27c2453.issues: Uses observed concurrent weather, so it is nowcasting/estimation rather than forecasting; single site; very high R2 driven by irradiance.

7a2c599536512f9c60eaf23a2e5b40a90178e12f.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting by integrating physics-informed power curve modeling with transformer architectures.
7a2c599536512f9c60eaf23a2e5b40a90178e12f.architecture: Temporal Fusion Transformer (transformer) combined with theoretical power curve and physics-informed equations as inputs.
7a2c599536512f9c60eaf23a2e5b40a90178e12f.data: Numerical weather prediction data, manufacturer specifications and measurements from two wind turbines in different locations.
7a2c599536512f9c60eaf23a2e5b40a90178e12f.result: Up to 60% RMSE reduction versus conventional models and R2 up to 99.47%; introduces FSI-WPF skill index benchmarked against the theoretical power curve.
7a2c599536512f9c60eaf23a2e5b40a90178e12f.open_work: Extending to wind farms and probabilistic forecasting.
7a2c599536512f9c60eaf23a2e5b40a90178e12f.issues: Only two turbines; benchmarking against the power curve rather than persistence complicates comparison with other studies.

71fafadccde7f81fb209217ea2487883c52ca017.goal: Forecasts solar radiation in Korea, which is not predicted operationally by the Korea Meteorological Administration, to support solar power.
71fafadccde7f81fb209217ea2487883c52ca017.architecture: Hybrid CNN-CatBoost model combining a convolutional neural network with gradient boosting (CatBoost), compared with single models.
71fafadccde7f81fb209217ea2487883c52ca017.data: Extra-atmospheric radiation plus temperature, relative humidity and total cloud amount (with wind speed and precipitation tested) at 18 Korean locations.
71fafadccde7f81fb209217ea2487883c52ca017.result: The hybrid model gives the best performance among compared models; adding wind speed and precipitation improves results at 15 of 18 locations.
71fafadccde7f81fb209217ea2487883c52ca017.open_work: Use of forecast rather than observed inputs and more stations.
71fafadccde7f81fb209217ea2487883c52ca017.issues: Quantitative error values not given in the abstract; benefit of extra variables is site dependent.

bcfe8c4b6918a6b037e5d53eab17796adf245ff7.goal: Provides a labeled high-resolution multi-source dataset to train deep learning models for flood area extraction.
bcfe8c4b6918a6b037e5d53eab17796adf245ff7.architecture: Benchmark dataset with active-learning-based sample selection and annotation, validated with several deep learning segmentation models.
bcfe8c4b6918a6b037e5d53eab17796adf245ff7.data: 13,388 samples from Gaofen-3 SAR and Gaofen-2 optical images, up to 1.5 m resolution, with pixel-level labels.
bcfe8c4b6918a6b037e5d53eab17796adf245ff7.result: Multi-source data improves flood extraction; an optimal training boundary appears near 4824 samples.
bcfe8c4b6918a6b037e5d53eab17796adf245ff7.open_work: Extending to more regions, sensors and flood types and testing newer architectures.
bcfe8c4b6918a6b037e5d53eab17796adf245ff7.issues: Limited to Gaofen sensors; geographic diversity is not described in the abstract.

5631e5695ef6e8dbb08d3819fe4712e32a390919.goal: Predicts daily pan-Arctic sea ice concentration up to 90 days ahead during the melting season.
5631e5695ef6e8dbb08d3819fe4712e32a390919.architecture: SICNet90 deep learning model (network type not specified in the abstract) with a physically constrained normalized integrated ice-edge error loss.
5631e5695ef6e8dbb08d3819fe4712e32a390919.data: Satellite-observed sea ice concentration, training 1991–2011/1997–2017 and testing 2012/2018–2020; also tested 2-m air temperature, SST and 500 hPa geopotential height.
5631e5695ef6e8dbb08d3819fe4712e32a390919.result: Outperforms climatology by 5.41% in binary accuracy and 1.35% MAE; NIIEE loss raises accuracy by 4% around the late-spring predictability barrier.
5631e5695ef6e8dbb08d3819fe4712e32a390919.open_work: Better incorporating atmospheric and oceanic predictors and overcoming the predictability barrier.
5631e5695ef6e8dbb08d3819fe4712e32a390919.issues: Modest gains over climatology; few test years; additional atmospheric predictors sometimes degrade skill.

1016318e64ac74b6282b3951dbf2c429ef176625.goal: Applies time-series generative adversarial networks to flood forecasting.
1016318e64ac74b6282b3951dbf2c429ef176625.open_work: Evaluating GAN-based flood forecasts against standard recurrent models and for extreme events.
1016318e64ac74b6282b3951dbf2c429ef176625.issues: Card based on title only; study basin, data and skill are unknown. GAN training instability is a common concern.

a60ffb11cd4646e2d98fd3457f0d047eb5625dc8.goal: Monitors and predicts multi-timescale drought (SPI) in Peru at a data-scarce station using neighboring stations.
a60ffb11cd4646e2d98fd3457f0d047eb5625dc8.architecture: Artificial neural network (MLP) coupled with the firefly metaheuristic algorithm (ANN-FA).
a60ffb11cd4646e2d98fd3457f0d047eb5625dc8.data: SPI3, SPI6, SPI18 and SPI24 from Peruvian meteorological stations, 1990–2015, targeting Lima.
a60ffb11cd4646e2d98fd3457f0d047eb5625dc8.result: Best (SPI3) testing performance: MAE 0.22, RMSE 0.29, Pearson r 0.94, index of agreement 0.97.
a60ffb11cd4646e2d98fd3457f0d047eb5625dc8.open_work: Applying the multi-station strategy to other data-scarce regions and forecast horizons.
a60ffb11cd4646e2d98fd3457f0d047eb5625dc8.issues: Single target station; estimates SPI from concurrent neighbor SPI rather than true lead-time forecasts.

52bfe4cd7e9b65b9cea6ba56ecd825aefcfebfa9.goal: Forecasts power in hybrid renewable microgrids with photovoltaic, solar thermal and wind generation.
52bfe4cd7e9b65b9cea6ba56ecd825aefcfebfa9.architecture: K-means clustering with a gated recurrent unit (GRU) recurrent neural network in a hybrid deep learning framework.
52bfe4cd7e9b65b9cea6ba56ecd825aefcfebfa9.data: Historical power and atmospheric data from diverse plants; details not reported in the abstract.
52bfe4cd7e9b65b9cea6ba56ecd825aefcfebfa9.result: The GRU-based model outperforms traditional algorithms with lower errors; correlations among generation types support cluster forecasting.
52bfe4cd7e9b65b9cea6ba56ecd825aefcfebfa9.open_work: Testing on more plants and incorporating NWP inputs.
52bfe4cd7e9b65b9cea6ba56ecd825aefcfebfa9.issues: No quantitative metrics in the abstract; dataset and horizons are unclear.

62c3a971e8481395d4626f8ffc7a19ac59d4a569.goal: Improves seasonal drought monitoring by combining machine learning with remote sensing data.
62c3a971e8481395d4626f8ffc7a19ac59d4a569.architecture: Stacking ensemble of machine learning models; base learners are not specified in the available metadata.
62c3a971e8481395d4626f8ffc7a19ac59d4a569.data: Remote sensing data per title; specific products and region not reported (no abstract).
62c3a971e8481395d4626f8ffc7a19ac59d4a569.open_work: Testing the stacking approach across climate zones and drought types.
62c3a971e8481395d4626f8ffc7a19ac59d4a569.issues: Card based on title only; data, drought index and accuracy unknown.

6110f21192470665165799573627bd8091534346.goal: Predicts sea surface temperature and marine heatwave occurrence in the Mediterranean Sea up to 7 days ahead.
6110f21192470665165799573627bd8091534346.architecture: Random forest, long short-term memory (LSTM) and convolutional neural network (CNN), compared region by region.
6110f21192470665165799573627bd8091534346.data: ESA CCI SST v2.1 and ERA5 reanalysis, 1981–2021, in 16 Mediterranean regions, with sliding 4-year training/testing windows; compared to Copernicus MedFS.
6110f21192470665165799573627bd8091534346.result: RMSE about 0.1 °C at 1 day and 0.8 °C at 7 days; random forest and LSTM beat CNN; LSTM is best in 11 regions; ML matches MedFS up to about 3 days for MHWs.
6110f21192470665165799573627bd8091534346.open_work: Extending lead times and coupling with dynamical forecasts.
6110f21192470665165799573627bd8091534346.issues: Regional time-series models; skill degrades beyond 3 days relative to MedFS; observed atmospheric predictors would not be available in real forecasting.

7435e6424dadfd0da15058d7746850af4747d3f0.goal: Predicts runoff using secondary mode decomposition with machine learning and recurrent networks.
7435e6424dadfd0da15058d7746850af4747d3f0.architecture: Support vector machine and gated recurrent unit (GRU) recurrent neural network combined with secondary signal mode decomposition.
7435e6424dadfd0da15058d7746850af4747d3f0.open_work: Testing across basins and forecast horizons.
7435e6424dadfd0da15058d7746850af4747d3f0.issues: Card based on title only. Decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if decomposition is applied to the full series before splitting.

b76850bf79e011bf2aa96dc8248180ea9f8f2d63.goal: Reviews AI and machine learning for air pollution management in India and forecasts PM2.5 from aerosol composition.
b76850bf79e011bf2aa96dc8248180ea9f8f2d63.architecture: Review combined with a convolutional autoencoder model for spatial PM2.5 forecasting.
b76850bf79e011bf2aa96dc8248180ea9f8f2d63.data: PM2.5 computed from surface mass concentrations of black carbon, dust, organic carbon, sea salt and sulfate over India; source product not named in the abstract.
b76850bf79e011bf2aa96dc8248180ea9f8f2d63.result: Identifies vulnerable regions (Indo-Gangetic Plains, western India, northeast); model achieves SSIM above 0.60, PSNR 28–30 dB and MSE below 10 μg/m3.
b76850bf79e011bf2aa96dc8248180ea9f8f2d63.open_work: Policy recommendations: regional control strategies, AI integration and stronger regulatory frameworks.
b76850bf79e011bf2aa96dc8248180ea9f8f2d63.issues: Image-similarity metrics are not standard air-quality skill scores; PM2.5 derived from aerosol reanalysis-type data rather than ground monitors.

2b7137fa1815eabe21a55f117338051843e351ce.goal: Retrieves global sea surface wind speed from GNSS-R data, addressing underestimation at high winds caused by imbalanced data.
2b7137fa1815eabe21a55f117338051843e351ce.architecture: Hybrid CNN-transformer network with a feature fusion module and weighted MSE loss.
2b7137fa1815eabe21a55f117338051843e351ce.data: CYGNSS GNSS-R data with ECMWF reanalysis winds and NDBC buoy observations as references.
2b7137fa1815eabe21a55f117338051843e351ce.result: RMSD of 1.417 m/s versus ECMWF and 1.620 m/s versus buoys; 20.3% RMSD improvement for winds above 15 m/s.
2b7137fa1815eabe21a55f117338051843e351ce.open_work: Further improving extreme wind retrieval and tropical cyclone conditions.
2b7137fa1815eabe21a55f117338051843e351ce.issues: Reference winds from reanalysis carry their own biases at high winds; few high-wind samples.

08cbf1e6d771c01b87dbfe441242a090d2f477d6.goal: Improves accuracy and efficiency of hourly rainfall-runoff modeling by reducing long input sequences.
08cbf1e6d771c01b87dbfe441242a090d2f477d6.architecture: Serial coupling of a one-dimensional CNN and LSTM (CNNsLSTM), compared with 1D-CNN, parallel CNN-LSTM and LSTM variants.
08cbf1e6d771c01b87dbfe441242a090d2f477d6.data: Hourly precipitation, air temperature, evapotranspiration, longwave and shortwave radiation, and runoff in the Ishikari River watershed, Japan.
08cbf1e6d771c01b87dbfe441242a090d2f477d6.result: Median test NSE 0.865–0.873 versus 0.455–0.831 for alternatives; better high and peak flows; 6.9–7.9 times faster than hourly LSTM.
08cbf1e6d771c01b87dbfe441242a090d2f477d6.open_work: Application to flood management and climate change scenarios.
08cbf1e6d771c01b87dbfe441242a090d2f477d6.issues: Single watershed; slower than the daily-plus-hourly LSTM.

a71e2bca419e844979dd83192d5f6980d5c04135.goal: Creates a high-resolution downscaled daily meteorological dataset for East Asia for historical and future climates.
a71e2bca419e844979dd83192d5f6980d5c04135.architecture: Bias correction followed by U-Net convolutional neural network downscaling.
a71e2bca419e844979dd83192d5f6980d5c04135.data: 19 CMIP6 models and MSWX dataset; 0.1° daily, nine variables, 1950–2014 and SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5, SSP5-8.5 for 2015–2100.
a71e2bca419e844979dd83192d5f6980d5c04135.result: CLIMEA-BCUD reproduces climatology and seasonal cycles reasonably against MSWX and captures future changes.
a71e2bca419e844979dd83192d5f6980d5c04135.open_work: Use in climate impact and hydrological studies.
a71e2bca419e844979dd83192d5f6980d5c04135.issues: Validation against the same MSWX target used for training; stationarity assumption in future downscaling.

094daa1a3be532dcf84e25ccd771aaf0fc76bee7.goal: Predicts soil moisture in soybean fields to schedule irrigation.
094daa1a3be532dcf84e25ccd771aaf0fc76bee7.architecture: Recurrent neural network long short-term memory (LSTM).
094daa1a3be532dcf84e25ccd771aaf0fc76bee7.data: In situ soil moisture and soil temperature at 10, 20 and 30 cm with weather data.
094daa1a3be532dcf84e25ccd771aaf0fc76bee7.result: R2 of 0.999 at 10 and 20 cm and 0.956 at 30 cm.
094daa1a3be532dcf84e25ccd771aaf0fc76bee7.issues: Single field; very high R2 suggests strong persistence; large validation loss at 30 cm.

afcb91957fd29d4bdc18ab3ba53eb0ffdd27f26a.goal: Analyzes power flow in distribution networks under weather variability affecting photovoltaic generation and loads.
afcb91957fd29d4bdc18ab3ba53eb0ffdd27f26a.architecture: Stochastic weather generator based on generative adversarial networks (GAN) with probability and information theory.
afcb91957fd29d4bdc18ab3ba53eb0ffdd27f26a.data: Hourly weather data and a real distribution network in Guangdong, China.
afcb91957fd29d4bdc18ab3ba53eb0ffdd27f26a.result: GAN-based generator surpasses shallow ML in accuracy and realism of simulated weather.
afcb91957fd29d4bdc18ab3ba53eb0ffdd27f26a.open_work: Extending to multi-site and climate change scenarios.
afcb91957fd29d4bdc18ab3ba53eb0ffdd27f26a.issues: Quantitative metrics not given in the abstract; single network.

e0a8ac580b1ed7de78e662e08250f3a60ec4d952.goal: Automatically detects and classifies ocean mesoscale eddies from sea surface temperature maps.
e0a8ac580b1ed7de78e662e08250f3a60ec4d952.architecture: EddyNet encoder-decoder U-Net segmentation with VGG16, VGG19, DenseNet121 and MobileNetV2 CNN backbones.
e0a8ac580b1ed7de78e662e08250f3a60ec4d952.data: CMEMS sea surface temperature data in the Atlantic Ocean.
e0a8ac580b1ed7de78e662e08250f3a60ec4d952.result: Good balance between efficiency and segmentation accuracy; suitable for real-time application.
e0a8ac580b1ed7de78e662e08250f3a60ec4d952.open_work: Adding sea surface height data and quantitative benchmarking.
e0a8ac580b1ed7de78e662e08250f3a60ec4d952.issues: No quantitative metrics in abstract; SST-only detection may miss eddies lacking a thermal signature.

ff3900344bb26b5820f482fe889f59787da01fed.goal: Tests random forest as an alternative to the SWAT process-based model for streamflow in a snowmelt-driven watershed.
ff3900344bb26b5820f482fe889f59787da01fed.architecture: Random forest regression compared with the process-based SWAT hydrologic model.
ff3900344bb26b5820f482fe889f59787da01fed.data: Remotely sensed data and streamflow for Rio Grande Headwaters near Del Norte, training periods 1991–2010, 1996–2010 and 2001–2010.
ff3900344bb26b5820f482fe889f59787da01fed.result: Random forest outperforms SWAT; longer training improves accuracy; snow depth and minimum temperature are top predictors.
ff3900344bb26b5820f482fe889f59787da01fed.open_work: Improving SWAT snowmelt routines and including dust-driven sublimation.
ff3900344bb26b5820f482fe889f59787da01fed.issues: Single watershed; random forest cannot extrapolate beyond training conditions.

d804444d37978f440e79764394227a80f0ac86f9.goal: Provides rapid urban flooding prediction to meet emergency response needs, replacing slow numerical models.
d804444d37978f440e79764394227a80f0ac86f9.architecture: LSTM neural network trained on numerical urban flood model simulations (surrogate).
d804444d37978f440e79764394227a80f0ac86f9.data: Simulation results of a numerical urban flood model at waterlogging points.
d804444d37978f440e79764394227a80f0ac86f9.result: High prediction accuracy and fast computation.
d804444d37978f440e79764394227a80f0ac86f9.open_work: Validation against observed flooding and more locations.
d804444d37978f440e79764394227a80f0ac86f9.issues: Trained on model output so it inherits numerical model biases; no metrics in abstract.

6892e51269341469d6215b192a66d56dbc516cf6.goal: Systematically reviews deep learning approaches for solar and photovoltaic power forecasting.
6892e51269341469d6215b192a66d56dbc516cf6.architecture: Systematic review of deep learning methods for solar irradiance and PV power forecasting.

1900b1ea19d561b399a19a15d8226d135bd58075.goal: Solves transient unconfined groundwater flow with physics-informed neural networks.
1900b1ea19d561b399a19a15d8226d135bd58075.open_work: Extending to heterogeneous aquifers and inverse problems.

3180ac0abacba6d93998925d766173cd3a030168.goal: Improves real-time flood forecasting by coupling process-driven and data-driven models.
3180ac0abacba6d93998925d766173cd3a030168.architecture: Hybrid coupling of a process-driven hydrological model and a data-driven model; the data-driven model type is not specified in the available metadata.
3180ac0abacba6d93998925d766173cd3a030168.open_work: Testing across basins and lead times.

53d3d6eb19f4b2ca84821d134ce2ef81e6e67d62.goal: Compares deep learning techniques for daily global solar irradiance forecasting.
53d3d6eb19f4b2ca84821d134ce2ef81e6e67d62.architecture: MLP, LSTM and GRU networks optimized with grid search.
53d3d6eb19f4b2ca84821d134ce2ef81e6e67d62.data: Eleven years of NASA satellite data.
53d3d6eb19f4b2ca84821d134ce2ef81e6e67d62.result: All models reach MSE near 0.017 kWh/m2/day; MLP is most efficient with 49,281 parameters versus 1,025,793 for GRU.
53d3d6eb19f4b2ca84821d134ce2ef81e6e67d62.open_work: Applying to other locations and horizons.

547cc16995516a4e2c33ab756c886bdc21318122.goal: Forecasts wind speed with deep learning using selected input features.

f7424c2605b86915c5d919e1c364acf683ebad72.goal: Provides point and interval wind speed forecasts from multivariate time series.
f7424c2605b86915c5d919e1c364acf683ebad72.architecture: Dual-layer LSTM for point and interval forecasting.

c1f67f93c5f99b3f8985d64479c5aa482660df65.goal: Forecasts water levels for flood prediction while visualizing impacts for decision making.
c1f67f93c5f99b3f8985d64479c5aa482660df65.architecture: Graph neural network (LocalFloodNet) with a graph learning module, plus a digital twin visualization prototype.
c1f67f93c5f99b3f8985d64479c5aa482660df65.data: Decades of historical water level data for the Greater Montreal Area, focusing on Terrebonne, Quebec.
c1f67f93c5f99b3f8985d64479c5aa482660df65.result: Demonstrates water level prediction and interactive flood scenario simulation; quantitative skill not given in the abstract.
c1f67f93c5f99b3f8985d64479c5aa482660df65.issues: No metrics in the abstract; regional focus.

cfe31a27084d723d2a54ac545866af4d0e81bbef.goal: Predicts sea surface temperature with a hybrid LSTM-Transformer model.

04eb2da73c44cfb2b136cac78937a104192d7a2b.goal: Forecasts city-level PM2.5 using a spatially attentive cluster-based graph neural network.
04eb2da73c44cfb2b136cac78937a104192d7a2b.architecture: Spatially attentive cluster-based graph neural network (GNN).

1f32c224617cf033628f6dbea49b865e798cb97d.goal: Improves daily precipitation forecasting in tropical central Thailand to support water resource management under climate change.
1f32c224617cf033628f6dbea49b865e798cb97d.architecture: Hybrid models coupling biorthogonal wavelet transform with radial basis function neural networks (BWT-RBFNN) and LSTM recurrent neural networks (BWT-LSTM-RNN), compared with a deep LSTM and an MLP.
1f32c224617cf033628f6dbea49b865e798cb97d.data: Daily precipitation and input records from multiple observation stations in central Thailand; periods and input variables are not reported in the abstract.
1f32c224617cf033628f6dbea49b865e798cb97d.result: Wavelet-LSTM hybrids consistently outperform standalone LSTM and MLP models; the LSTM reaches R2 of 0.96 in one input configuration and the DPFH-3 hybrid performs best across stations.
1f32c224617cf033628f6dbea49b865e798cb97d.open_work: Testing on other climates and longer lead times, and checking that wavelet decomposition is applied without using future information in operational settings.
1f32c224617cf033628f6dbea49b865e798cb97d.issues: Station-level study in one region; very high R2 for daily rainfall suggests possible wavelet boundary leakage, and extremes and lead times are not analysed in the abstract.

37bd07e4131e6e9906a878dec1bfcf06250a8229.goal: Provides accurate multi-step water level forecasts at an urban pumping station to support proactive flood mitigation under climate change.
37bd07e4131e6e9906a878dec1bfcf06250a8229.architecture: Hybrid transformer-LSTM model: a transformer module relates input factors and an LSTM module links consecutive time steps, compared against benchmark models.
37bd07e4131e6e9906a878dec1bfcf06250a8229.data: 19,647 ten-minute records (2014–2020) of pumping operation, storm sewer, flood storage pond and river water levels at the Zhongshan pumping station, Taipei; 70/10/20% train/validation/test split.
37bd07e4131e6e9906a878dec1bfcf06250a8229.result: The transformer-LSTM clearly outperforms benchmark models for 10- to 60-minute (T+1 to T+6) forecasts of flood storage pond and river water levels.
37bd07e4131e6e9906a878dec1bfcf06250a8229.open_work: Extending to other pumping stations, longer horizons and coupling forecasts with pump control decisions.
37bd07e4131e6e9906a878dec1bfcf06250a8229.issues: Single station, very short horizons (up to one hour) and no rainfall forecast input described; generalisation to unseen extreme storms is untested.

b67a9283d25834c1daafebcb1a6dc9dc67e8ea8d.goal: Compares machine learning algorithms for daily river water level forecasting in the Muda River, Malaysia, for flood warning and water management.
b67a9283d25834c1daafebcb1a6dc9dc67e8ea8d.architecture: Multi-layer perceptron (MLP), LSTM neural network and XGBoost gradient boosting with several input scenarios.
b67a9283d25834c1daafebcb1a6dc9dc67e8ea8d.data: Limited daily water level and meteorological data from the Muda River, 2016–2018.
b67a9283d25834c1daafebcb1a6dc9dc67e8ea8d.result: MLP scores best overall (0.871 vs 0.865 for LSTM and 0.831 for XGBoost); meteorological inputs add little, and LSTM is most accurate at 7-day lead time while XGBoost is fastest.
b67a9283d25834c1daafebcb1a6dc9dc67e8ea8d.open_work: Using longer records and more stations to establish which model suits which horizon, as the authors note performance is data dependent.
b67a9283d25834c1daafebcb1a6dc9dc67e8ea8d.issues: Only three years of data at a single river; small differences between models may not be robust.

f7012f36e68d3dafba1b61d4e162c8b8ba5b7a66.goal: Improves flash flood forecasting by tuning LSTM hyperparameters automatically rather than by trial and error.
f7012f36e68d3dafba1b61d4e162c8b8ba5b7a66.architecture: LSTM recurrent neural network whose parameters are optimized with a genetic algorithm.
f7012f36e68d3dafba1b61d4e162c8b8ba5b7a66.data: Not reported (no abstract available); the title implies hydrometeorological time series from a flash-flood-prone catchment.
f7012f36e68d3dafba1b61d4e162c8b8ba5b7a66.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the genetic-algorithm-tuned LSTM improves flash flood forecasts over a manually configured baseline.
f7012f36e68d3dafba1b61d4e162c8b8ba5b7a66.open_work: Testing transferability to other catchments and longer lead times.
f7012f36e68d3dafba1b61d4e162c8b8ba5b7a66.issues: Details unavailable; evolutionary tuning is computationally costly and gains may be specific to the study basin.

903663c058b7b394aa04d4fc14f9a21d9f9d9473.goal: Segments urban flood extent from real-world surveillance camera images to provide low-cost, near-real-time flood monitoring.
903663c058b7b394aa04d4fc14f9a21d9f9d9473.architecture: Deep convolutional neural network for semantic segmentation of flooded areas; the specific network is not stated in the available metadata.
903663c058b7b394aa04d4fc14f9a21d9f9d9473.data: Real-world urban surveillance camera images; dataset size and location not reported (no abstract available).
903663c058b7b394aa04d4fc14f9a21d9f9d9473.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title indicates flood extent is segmented and evaluated on camera imagery.
903663c058b7b394aa04d4fc14f9a21d9f9d9473.open_work: Converting segmented extent into water depth and handling night, rain and occlusion conditions.
903663c058b7b394aa04d4fc14f9a21d9f9d9473.issues: Camera views are fixed and local; performance under varied lighting and weather and transfer to new cameras are uncertain.

7ebba1a1f23451c07ed105956a2d77f823b484d8.goal: Predicts groundwater levels across a monitoring network, capturing nonlinear, non-stationary and spatially connected groundwater dynamics.
7ebba1a1f23451c07ed105956a2d77f823b484d8.architecture: Spatial-temporal graph neural network: a modified Multivariate Time Graph Neural Network (MTGNN) with a learned graph linking wells.
7ebba1a1f23451c07ed105956a2d77f823b484d8.data: 395 groundwater level time series in the Overbetuwe area, Netherlands, with precipitation, evaporation, river stage and pumping well data; synthetic data from numerical models also used.
7ebba1a1f23451c07ed105956a2d77f823b484d8.result: The ST-GNN improves over traditional methods, handles missing data and forecasts with minimal bias, outperforming numerical models in long-term forecasting.
7ebba1a1f23451c07ed105956a2d77f823b484d8.open_work: Applying the approach to other aquifers and adding physical constraints or uncertainty estimates.
7ebba1a1f23451c07ed105956a2d77f823b484d8.issues: Single study area; comparison with numerical models depends on their calibration, and quantitative scores are not given in the abstract.

d40b0f66835a0b59a64758752d6bda3f3adedf7d.goal: Produces flood susceptibility maps for the Haraz watershed in northern Iran to identify flood-prone areas for land-use planning.
d40b0f66835a0b59a64758752d6bda3f3adedf7d.architecture: Support vector regression variants: SVR with linear kernel, a base classifier ensemble and hyper-parameter optimization (SVR-HPO).
d40b0f66835a0b59a64758752d6bda3f3adedf7d.data: Inventory of 201 past floods (151 training, 50 validation) and 10 conditioning factors such as slope and distance to river.
d40b0f66835a0b59a64758752d6bda3f3adedf7d.result: SVR-HPO performs best with AUC of 0.986 (training) and 0.951 (testing); slope, distance to river and river are the most important factors.
d40b0f66835a0b59a64758752d6bda3f3adedf7d.open_work: Comparing with other ensemble learners and testing in other watersheds.
d40b0f66835a0b59a64758752d6bda3f3adedf7d.issues: Static susceptibility without event dynamics; limited inventory and possible spatial autocorrelation between training and validation points.

033404a11042e1a37f642a5218f4e0bff9814dc2.goal: Reviews artificial intelligence techniques for estimating reference evapotranspiration (ET0), which is key for irrigation scheduling.
033404a11042e1a37f642a5218f4e0bff9814dc2.architecture: Review of AI-based ET0 models, such as artificial neural networks, tree-based and kernel methods, hybrid and deep learning approaches, with current trends and perspectives.
033404a11042e1a37f642a5218f4e0bff9814dc2.data: Published studies on AI-based ET0 estimation; the number and selection of studies are not reported (no abstract available).
033404a11042e1a37f642a5218f4e0bff9814dc2.result: Not reported in the abstract; the review summarises trends in AI methods for ET0 estimation and future perspectives.
033404a11042e1a37f642a5218f4e0bff9814dc2.open_work: Generalisation across climates, use of limited meteorological inputs and integration with remote sensing are natural directions.
033404a11042e1a37f642a5218f4e0bff9814dc2.issues: Details of review scope and method are unavailable; review conclusions depend on heterogeneous, site-specific studies.

31f901f7a9969b918e1822a8486464675229df91.goal: Models and forecasts rainfall patterns in India using a gradient boosting time series approach.
31f901f7a9969b918e1822a8486464675229df91.architecture: XGBoost gradient boosted trees applied to rainfall time series.
31f901f7a9969b918e1822a8486464675229df91.data: Indian rainfall time series; spatial and temporal coverage not reported (no abstract available).
31f901f7a9969b918e1822a8486464675229df91.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title indicates XGBoost is used for rainfall forecasting in India.
31f901f7a9969b918e1822a8486464675229df91.open_work: Comparison with deep learning and statistical baselines and evaluation of extremes are natural next steps.
31f901f7a9969b918e1822a8486464675229df91.issues: Details unavailable; tree models extrapolate poorly beyond observed ranges.

28afaef498b758637399f1a745898ab47e35b5c5.goal: Forecasts daily water levels of Poyang Lake, China, and assesses the influence of Yangtze River inflow, hyperparameters and lead time.
28afaef498b758637399f1a745898ab47e35b5c5.architecture: Transformer neural network with attention mechanism for lake water level time series.
28afaef498b758637399f1a745898ab47e35b5c5.data: Daily water level and inflow records for Poyang Lake including Yangtze River inflow; period not stated in the abstract.
28afaef498b758637399f1a745898ab47e35b5c5.result: Testing RMSE 0.26–0.70 m and NSE above 0.94; Yangtze inflow strongly controls levels; window 90 days and 6 layers work best; RMSE rises to 1.37 m and 1.82 m at 15- and 30-day leads.
28afaef498b758637399f1a745898ab47e35b5c5.open_work: Testing the transformer on other lakes and on long-sequence hydrological forecasting.
28afaef498b758637399f1a745898ab47e35b5c5.issues: Single lake; accuracy degrades quickly beyond a week, and observed inflows used as inputs may not be available operationally.

8e354c74ee9ba52097112195d1fe724558e06404.goal: Forecasts root-zone soil moisture content to improve agricultural irrigation management and water conservation.
8e354c74ee9ba52097112195d1fe724558e06404.architecture: Hybrid GRU-transformer model, compared with SVR, KNN, GBDT, XGBoost, random forest, DNN, CNN and standalone GRU and transformer branches.
8e354c74ee9ba52097112195d1fe724558e06404.data: Meteorological and soil moisture data from eight monitoring stations in Hebei Province, China, 2011–2018.
8e354c74ee9ba52097112195d1fe724558e06404.result: Best at 1–2 day leads (MSE 5.22% for 1 day, R2 about 0.90) and better at deeper soil layers; with six soil moisture inputs, 3-day MSE is 0.59% and R2 0.99; outperforms baselines at 5 days.
8e354c74ee9ba52097112195d1fe724558e06404.open_work: Testing in other regions and soils, and linking forecasts to irrigation decisions.
8e354c74ee9ba52097112195d1fe724558e06404.issues: Station-level study in one province; errors grow with lead time and metrics are reported somewhat inconsistently.

f28ac3cf8a791a026604df1fb65bdd7da6354cb8.goal: Provides rapid urban flood depth prediction for emergency flood control as a fast surrogate for hydrodynamic modelling.
f28ac3cf8a791a026604df1fb65bdd7da6354cb8.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM neural network trained on hydrodynamic model outputs, using rainfall, geographic data and drainage network distribution.
f28ac3cf8a791a026604df1fb65bdd7da6354cb8.data: Hydrodynamic model simulations for the central city of Zhoukou, China, with comparison to measured flood depths.
f28ac3cf8a791a026604df1fb65bdd7da6354cb8.result: Predicts urban flood depth in under 10 seconds with average error not exceeding 6.5% relative to measured depths.
f28ac3cf8a791a026604df1fb65bdd7da6354cb8.open_work: Extending to other cities and rainfall patterns beyond the simulated scenarios.
f28ac3cf8a791a026604df1fb65bdd7da6354cb8.issues: Surrogate inherits hydrodynamic model errors and is limited to training scenarios; validation against measurements appears limited.

d1f897bded125dfd0a5890f68342a0f89eb961f3.goal: Provides interpretable multi-step-ahead forecasts of global solar radiation for solar energy and hydrogen production planning.
d1f897bded125dfd0a5890f68342a0f89eb961f3.architecture: Attention-based transformer model with an interpretable attention mechanism for multi-step forecasting.
d1f897bded125dfd0a5890f68342a0f89eb961f3.data: Not reported (no abstract available); the title implies solar radiation time series.
d1f897bded125dfd0a5890f68342a0f89eb961f3.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title indicates the transformer delivers multi-step solar radiation predictions with interpretability.
d1f897bded125dfd0a5890f68342a0f89eb961f3.open_work: Testing across climates and coupling with probabilistic forecasts.
d1f897bded125dfd0a5890f68342a0f89eb961f3.issues: Details unavailable; attention weights are only a partial form of interpretability.

8e023c8d232558f56072fae2ed69b86025c3c164.goal: Predicts temperature and humidity time series for smart agriculture, balancing accuracy and learning efficiency on large weather data.
8e023c8d232558f56072fae2ed69b86025c3c164.architecture: BMAE-Net: encoder-decoder of Bayesian gated recurrent units (Bayesian-GRU) with multi-head attention and Bayesian hyperparameter optimization.
8e023c8d232558f56072fae2ed69b86025c3c164.data: Weather time series (temperature and humidity) from three locations; sources and periods not reported in the abstract.
8e023c8d232558f56072fae2ed69b86025c3c164.result: Temperature prediction R of 0.90, 0.80 and 0.89 and RMSE of 2.90, 3.01 and 1.48 at the three locations, outperforming compared models.
8e023c8d232558f56072fae2ed69b86025c3c164.open_work: Extending to more variables, longer horizons and uncertainty-aware agricultural decisions.
8e023c8d232558f56072fae2ed69b86025c3c164.issues: Few locations and unclear baselines; station time series only, without NWP inputs.

94e7ab5155fba59abfd1c62b72ec33a0d6b1c826.goal: Improves monthly runoff prediction for reservoir scheduling and water resources management.
94e7ab5155fba59abfd1c62b72ec33a0d6b1c826.architecture: Hybrid of CEEMDAN and VMD signal decomposition with an LSTM network optimized by a CABES (improved bald eagle search) metaheuristic.
94e7ab5155fba59abfd1c62b72ec33a0d6b1c826.data: Monthly runoff at the Xiajiang and Yingluoxia hydrological stations, China.
94e7ab5155fba59abfd1c62b72ec33a0d6b1c826.result: The CEEMDAN-VMD-CABES-LSTM reduces RMSE by 71.1% and 65.1% and MAPE by 65.3% and 40.4% relative to a single LSTM, with R and NSE near 1.
94e7ab5155fba59abfd1c62b72ec33a0d6b1c826.open_work: Testing in real forecasting mode and at other stations.
94e7ab5155fba59abfd1c62b72ec33a0d6b1c826.issues: Decomposition applied to full series can leak future information; only two stations; very high skill may not transfer operationally.

be7fe3a8c5839270ffa8aace0394404eab7077ee.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting by combining NWP-to-power relations with the temporal autocorrelation of wind power.
be7fe3a8c5839270ffa8aace0394404eab7077ee.architecture: Continuous conditional random field with a bidirectional LSTM unary potential and Gaussian kernel pairwise potentials, trained with mean-field theory.
be7fe3a8c5839270ffa8aace0394404eab7077ee.data: High-resolution NWP from a WRF model configuration as inputs, with wind farm power observations; sites and periods not reported in the abstract.
be7fe3a8c5839270ffa8aace0394404eab7077ee.result: The CCRF model's forecasting accuracy exceeds all selected benchmark models in case studies.
be7fe3a8c5839270ffa8aace0394404eab7077ee.open_work: Probabilistic extensions and testing on more wind farms and seasons.
be7fe3a8c5839270ffa8aace0394404eab7077ee.issues: No quantitative scores in the abstract; skill depends on the quality of the WRF forecasts used as inputs.

1e6f75075769387c26f17ad8698ab115530d8cc1.goal: Estimates soil moisture from optical satellite and UAV hyperspectral data for agricultural and climate applications.
1e6f75075769387c26f17ad8698ab115530d8cc1.architecture: Random forest regression with feature importance and spectral indices (perpendicular, ratio, difference and normalized difference indices).
1e6f75075769387c26f17ad8698ab115530d8cc1.data: Sentinel-2 (11 bands), Landsat-8/9 (9 bands) and UAV CoSpectroCam hyperspectral data (1252 bands, 420–850 nm) with soil moisture measurements in Iran.
1e6f75075769387c26f17ad8698ab115530d8cc1.result: UAV hyperspectral data give R2 = 0.87 versus 0.49 for Sentinel-2 and 0.66 for Landsat-8/9; the perpendicular index is most sensitive to soil moisture.
1e6f75075769387c26f17ad8698ab115530d8cc1.open_work: Combining UAV and satellite data for upscaling and testing under vegetation cover and other soils.
1e6f75075769387c26f17ad8698ab115530d8cc1.issues: Single study site with limited samples; optical data only sense the surface and depend on clear skies.

b91593740e2b1233d48a5fba8a33f1eb66b6c4d3.goal: Reviews artificial intelligence approaches for wind power forecasting to support grid integration of wind energy.
b91593740e2b1233d48a5fba8a33f1eb66b6c4d3.architecture: Review of AI-based wind power forecasting methods, such as neural networks, deep learning and hybrid models.
b91593740e2b1233d48a5fba8a33f1eb66b6c4d3.data: Published wind power forecasting studies; scope and selection not reported (no abstract available).
b91593740e2b1233d48a5fba8a33f1eb66b6c4d3.result: Not reported in the abstract; the review summarises advances in AI-based wind power forecasting.
b91593740e2b1233d48a5fba8a33f1eb66b6c4d3.open_work: Not reported in the abstract; typical open issues include extreme events, probabilistic forecasting and transferability.
b91593740e2b1233d48a5fba8a33f1eb66b6c4d3.issues: Details of the review method and coverage are unavailable.

b86f3a4a80686ef155d823213ee329854ddbbc62.goal: Evaluates machine learning and deep learning for predicting groundwater level changes in the West Coast Aquifer System, South Africa.
b86f3a4a80686ef155d823213ee329854ddbbc62.architecture: Random forest, support vector machine, simple recurrent neural network and LSTM.
b86f3a4a80686ef155d823213ee329854ddbbc62.data: Groundwater level time series from wells in the West Coast Aquifer System, South Africa; period not reported in the abstract.
b86f3a4a80686ef155d823213ee329854ddbbc62.result: SVM gives the lowest RMSE and the highest accuracy (MAE 0.356 m, RMSE 0.372 m), while random forest is best by MAE in the error-metric comparison; all methods are judged effective.
b86f3a4a80686ef155d823213ee329854ddbbc62.open_work: Incorporating detailed geological information for improved interpretation, as the authors suggest.
b86f3a4a80686ef155d823213ee329854ddbbc62.issues: Limited inputs and site-specific; small differences between models.

2510ae582a995644215261e54309c842f1d2bac6.goal: Reviews machine learning techniques for wind power forecasting from 2006 to 2025 to guide accurate, robust grid integration.
2510ae582a995644215261e54309c842f1d2bac6.architecture: Review covering physical, statistical, classical ML, deep learning (LSTM, CNN, graph neural network, CNN-LSTM), ensemble and hybrid models plus PSO and fruit fly optimizers.
2510ae582a995644215261e54309c842f1d2bac6.result: Compares models on temporal dependence, nonlinearity, scalability and interpretability, and identifies data quality, compute and extreme weather as main obstacles.
2510ae582a995644215261e54309c842f1d2bac6.open_work: IoT sensor networks, multi-model fusion, physics-informed learning and transformers for future wind power forecasting.
2510ae582a995644215261e54309c842f1d2bac6.issues: Narrative review; comparisons across studies with different data and metrics are not quantitative.

69680d37c8c1be9bbff66f69aa90fcce04d93a30.goal: Evaluates nationwide land use and economic benefits of wake steering in wind plants, which would be expensive to assess with conventional optimization.
69680d37c8c1be9bbff66f69aa90fcce04d93a30.architecture: Artificial-intelligence-aided wind plant layout and wake steering optimization; the specific network type is not specified in the available metadata.
69680d37c8c1be9bbff66f69aa90fcce04d93a30.data: Not reported (no abstract available); a nationwide set of potential wind plant sites is implied by the title.
69680d37c8c1be9bbff66f69aa90fcce04d93a30.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies AI enables a nationwide assessment of wake steering benefits for land use and economics.
69680d37c8c1be9bbff66f69aa90fcce04d93a30.open_work: Validation of wake steering gains in field operation and in varied atmospheric stability conditions.
