69680d37c8c1be9bbff66f69aa90fcce04d93a30.issues: Details unavailable; results depend on the engineering wake models underlying the optimization.

845d5eebce81b7f4fb6a3a991e5b51b105fa4c74.goal: Forecasts short-term (1-month lead) hydrological drought in the semi-arid Yesilirmak basin, Turkey.
845d5eebce81b7f4fb6a3a991e5b51b105fa4c74.architecture: Support vector regression, Gaussian process regression, regression tree and ensemble tree models, standalone and combined with discrete wavelet transform.
845d5eebce81b7f4fb6a3a991e5b51b105fa4c74.data: Streamflow drought index from Yesilirmak basin stations; 1969–1998 training and 1999–2011 testing.
845d5eebce81b7f4fb6a3a991e5b51b105fa4c74.result: Wavelet hybrids perform best; db10 wavelet with Gaussian process regression reaches R2 0.99 (RMSE 0.08) at station 1413, while standalone SVR is weakest (R2 0.14).
845d5eebce81b7f4fb6a3a991e5b51b105fa4c74.open_work: Testing longer lead times and other basins.
845d5eebce81b7f4fb6a3a991e5b51b105fa4c74.issues: Wavelet decomposition over full series can leak future information; one-month lead only.

76a24a91c14f4fb14fd055d6943897fb79d4488f.goal: Predicts wheat yield in Punjab, Pakistan, and projects climate change impacts on yield to 2052.
76a24a91c14f4fb14fd055d6943897fb79d4488f.architecture: Multiple linear regression, boosted trees, random forest, ensemble models and several ANN types (MLP, probabilistic, generalized feed-forward, linear).
76a24a91c14f4fb14fd055d6943897fb79d4488f.data: Yield and weather data for three Punjab regions (1991–2021) and downscaled CMIP3 GCM projections under SRA2, B1 and A1B scenarios.
76a24a91c14f4fb14fd055d6943897fb79d4488f.result: Ensemble model best (R = 0.988, nRMSE 8%); maximum temperature is the main climate factor; projected yield in 2052 is 5.5% lower than the highest recorded average yield.
76a24a91c14f4fb14fd055d6943897fb79d4488f.open_work: Using newer CMIP6 scenarios and including management and CO2 effects.
76a24a91c14f4fb14fd055d6943897fb79d4488f.issues: Short yield record, outdated CMIP3 projections and statistical extrapolation beyond observed climate.

4b449f6fb5fd5f3b1ae11fc2b78268dead2d51bc.goal: Improves short-term hydrological (water level and runoff) prediction while checking statistical properties of the time series.
4b449f6fb5fd5f3b1ae11fc2b78268dead2d51bc.architecture: LSTM sequence-to-sequence encoder-decoder with attention (LSTM-seq2seq), compared with other models including LSTM-BP.
4b449f6fb5fd5f3b1ae11fc2b78268dead2d51bc.data: Water level data of the Chu River and flow data at Runcheng, Wuzhi, Baima Temple, Longmen Town, Dongwan, Lu's and Tongguan stations.
4b449f6fb5fd5f3b1ae11fc2b78268dead2d51bc.result: LSTM-seq2seq and LSTM-BP achieve the highest accuracy (RMSE, NSE), and LSTM-seq2seq converges fastest; data with normality, smoothness and homogeneity are predicted better.
4b449f6fb5fd5f3b1ae11fc2b78268dead2d51bc.open_work: Testing longer lead times and other basins.
4b449f6fb5fd5f3b1ae11fc2b78268dead2d51bc.issues: No quantitative scores in the abstract; a regional study with short-term horizons only.

8cda641854e76cd1575860f2f5810f8af53c0ce3.goal: Forecasts solar irradiance one hour ahead for photovoltaic power scheduling and grid security.
8cda641854e76cd1575860f2f5810f8af53c0ce3.architecture: Quantum LSTM: variational quantum circuits embedded in LSTM gates, compared with SARIMA, CNN, RNN, GRU and LSTM.
8cda641854e76cd1575860f2f5810f8af53c0ce3.data: Five solar radiation observatories in China, evaluated across seasons and months.
8cda641854e76cd1575860f2f5810f8af53c0ce3.result: Annual mean RMSE 61.8 W/m2 and MAE 24.3 W/m2, 3.4–10.7% and 12.2–28.9% lower than baselines; R2 0.946.
8cda641854e76cd1575860f2f5810f8af53c0ce3.open_work: Running on real quantum hardware and extending to longer lead times.
8cda641854e76cd1575860f2f5810f8af53c0ce3.issues: Gains over a classical LSTM are modest (about 3% RMSE); whether quantum circuits run on hardware or in simulation is not stated, and only one-hour lead is tested.

c6c4c9f798baff37b62af18ba532db5686c215a5.goal: Assesses storm flood susceptibility in rapidly urbanizing Shenzhen, China, with explainable machine learning.
c6c4c9f798baff37b62af18ba532db5686c215a5.architecture: Five machine learning algorithms including XGBoost, with SHAP used for feature selection and interpretation.
c6c4c9f798baff37b62af18ba532db5686c215a5.data: Three types of data sources for Shenzhen in five experimental scenarios; specific datasets not reported in the abstract.
c6c4c9f798baff37b62af18ba532db5686c215a5.result: SHAP-based feature optimization greatly improves performance; XGBoost with the optimal feature combination achieves the highest AUC.
c6c4c9f798baff37b62af18ba532db5686c215a5.open_work: Dynamic, event-based assessment and transfer of the framework to other cities.
c6c4c9f798baff37b62af18ba532db5686c215a5.issues: AUC values are not given in the abstract; static susceptibility only, with no rainfall event dynamics.

a192636e6e765b96639e5c23e6907a9120d5a182.goal: Analyses decomposition methods for short-term wind speed forecasting with LSTM and proposes a new hybrid deep learning model.
a192636e6e765b96639e5c23e6907a9120d5a182.architecture: Signal decomposition methods combined with LSTM, plus a novel hybrid deep learning model; components not specified in the available metadata.
a192636e6e765b96639e5c23e6907a9120d5a182.data: Not reported (no abstract available); the title implies wind speed time series.
a192636e6e765b96639e5c23e6907a9120d5a182.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies a comparison of decomposition methods and improved accuracy from the hybrid model.
a192636e6e765b96639e5c23e6907a9120d5a182.open_work: Operational testing without decomposition leakage and over more sites.
a192636e6e765b96639e5c23e6907a9120d5a182.issues: Details unavailable; decomposition-based hybrids risk using future information.

85916114e93ee90ab1cb6b67964b54e363b8775c.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting from meteorological data in desert regions.
85916114e93ee90ab1cb6b67964b54e363b8775c.architecture: Hybrid convolutional dual-attention LSTM (Conv-DA-LSTM) with hyperparameter optimization, compared with LSTM and classical machine learning.
85916114e93ee90ab1cb6b67964b54e363b8775c.data: One year of meteorological and wind power data from a desert region, grouped by wind speed category.
85916114e93ee90ab1cb6b67964b54e363b8775c.result: Conv-DA-LSTM performs best (RMSE 71.866, R2 0.93), improving by 22.9% at higher wind speeds with monthly RRMSE reductions of 1.6–10.2%.
85916114e93ee90ab1cb6b67964b54e363b8775c.open_work: Using multi-year data and testing at other desert sites.
85916114e93ee90ab1cb6b67964b54e363b8775c.issues: Only one year of data, apparently at a single site; seasonal and interannual robustness is untested.

4d82ca6ac919b8934000b267680245a445f6963b.goal: Predicts offshore wind speed by fusing spatial and temporal features across multiple sites.
4d82ca6ac919b8934000b267680245a445f6963b.architecture: GAOformer: transformer combined with graph attention network (GAT) and optimizable graph adjacency matrices for adaptive spatiotemporal fusion.
4d82ca6ac919b8934000b267680245a445f6963b.data: Not reported (no abstract available); offshore wind speed observations from multiple sites are implied.
4d82ca6ac919b8934000b267680245a445f6963b.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies improved offshore wind speed prediction.
4d82ca6ac919b8934000b267680245a445f6963b.open_work: Extending to longer horizons and probabilistic outputs for offshore wind energy planning.
4d82ca6ac919b8934000b267680245a445f6963b.issues: Details unavailable; site, data period and baselines cannot be checked from the available metadata.

3a559fbb6235d74fa3c2f9169714cbec779db927.goal: Produces realistic, sharp precipitation nowcasts quickly, overcoming blurry deterministic forecasts and slow diffusion sampling.
3a559fbb6235d74fa3c2f9169714cbec779db927.architecture: Conditional denoising diffusion model with a spatiotemporal transformer denoiser and adversarial mapping-based rapid diffusion strategy.
3a559fbb6235d74fa3c2f9169714cbec779db927.data: Radar precipitation sequences; specific dataset not reported in the abstract.
3a559fbb6235d74fa3c2f9169714cbec779db927.result: Generates sharper and more precise nowcasts than baselines while keeping satisfactory CSI and other meteorological metrics, including thunderstorm cases.
3a559fbb6235d74fa3c2f9169714cbec779db927.open_work: Extending lead times, calibrating ensembles of samples and testing real-time operational deployment.
3a559fbb6235d74fa3c2f9169714cbec779db927.issues: No quantitative scores in the abstract; dataset and region are not stated, and generative samples may hallucinate small-scale structure.

5ec30406f89274e60c05d2a6dc0385a46bba046a.goal: Improves solar radiation prediction with a new LSTM variant.
5ec30406f89274e60c05d2a6dc0385a46bba046a.architecture: Read-First LSTM, a modified long short-term memory recurrent neural network.
5ec30406f89274e60c05d2a6dc0385a46bba046a.data: Not reported (no abstract available); solar radiation time series are implied.
5ec30406f89274e60c05d2a6dc0385a46bba046a.result: Not reported in the abstract; the title implies the Read-First LSTM improves solar radiation prediction.
5ec30406f89274e60c05d2a6dc0385a46bba046a.open_work: Testing across climates and comparing against other recurrent and attention-based models.
5ec30406f89274e60c05d2a6dc0385a46bba046a.issues: Details unavailable; site, data period and baselines cannot be checked from the available metadata.

dbca13be14b994c7ed236e4f6e6e740f349fd0d3.goal: Develops new AI-based meteorological drought indices for drought monitoring and forecasting.
dbca13be14b994c7ed236e4f6e6e740f349fd0d3.architecture: Decision tree, generalized linear model, support vector machine, artificial neural network, deep learning and random forest models used to build drought indices.
dbca13be14b994c7ed236e4f6e6e740f349fd0d3.data: Climate data from Alice Springs, Australia, with runoff and multi-layer soil moisture as drought indicators, compared with nine conventional indices.
dbca13be14b994c7ed236e4f6e6e740f349fd0d3.result: AI indices outperform conventional ones; the GLM-based index correlates 0.78 with upper soil moisture versus 0.718 for the best conventional index (rainfall anomaly index).
dbca13be14b994c7ed236e4f6e6e740f349fd0d3.open_work: Validating the AI-based indices at other climates and sites and testing their forecasting lead time.
dbca13be14b994c7ed236e4f6e6e740f349fd0d3.issues: Single location (Alice Springs); evaluation relies on correlations with indicators rather than forecast skill.

4e37f789bae3277fa581142226ce27da20628798.goal: Forecasts storm surge when observation data are scarce.
4e37f789bae3277fa581142226ce27da20628798.architecture: Spatio-temporal graph neural network with causal inference for selecting relationships between stations.
4e37f789bae3277fa581142226ce27da20628798.data: Not reported (no abstract available); scarce tide gauge observations are implied by the title.
4e37f789bae3277fa581142226ce27da20628798.open_work: Testing on more storms and coastlines, and comparing against hydrodynamic surge models and other graph-based approaches.
4e37f789bae3277fa581142226ce27da20628798.issues: Details unavailable; storm surge records contain few extreme events, which limits training and evaluation of rare high surges.

f6204bf884b935ba64712c120fa65818ceb7c541.goal: Forecasts electricity production of a solar power plant considering meteorology, pollution and environmental impacts.
f6204bf884b935ba64712c120fa65818ceb7c541.architecture: Random forest regression and LSTM neural networks.
f6204bf884b935ba64712c120fa65818ceb7c541.data: 119,808 data points from an operating 180 kWe solar power plant and measurement station: irradiation, sunshine, temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind speed, pollution and production.
f6204bf884b935ba64712c120fa65818ceb7c541.open_work: Validating on multiple plants and specifying forecast horizons for operational use.
f6204bf884b935ba64712c120fa65818ceb7c541.issues: Single 180 kWe plant; forecast horizon and train/test split are unclear, so operational skill is uncertain.

043cc967c18a5c970313ccb6d19f3b6ccf6fde45.goal: Assesses susceptibility to riverine, urban and flash floods in Peshawar, Pakistan.
043cc967c18a5c970313ccb6d19f3b6ccf6fde45.architecture: GIS-based analytical hierarchy process combined with random forest and XGBoost.
043cc967c18a5c970313ccb6d19f3b6ccf6fde45.data: Remote sensing and GIS factors for Peshawar, Pakistan; specific products not reported in the abstract.
043cc967c18a5c970313ccb6d19f3b6ccf6fde45.result: XGBoost performs best (AUC 0.87 vs 0.86 RF and 0.70 AHP); 20.9%, 30.3% and 48.7% of the area is susceptible to riverine, urban and flash flooding.
043cc967c18a5c970313ccb6d19f3b6ccf6fde45.open_work: Moving toward dynamic flood risk assessment and including climate change and land-use scenarios.
043cc967c18a5c970313ccb6d19f3b6ccf6fde45.issues: Static susceptibility only, with modest R2 at the lower end (0.561); AHP weights involve subjective judgments.

f409303235fa1cd5f673b16e433f72af9b61d134.goal: Improves flash flood prediction by capturing spatial relationships among hydrometeorological inputs.
f409303235fa1cd5f673b16e433f72af9b61d134.architecture: Convolutional LSTM (ConvLSTM) network predicting stream stage heights.
f409303235fa1cd5f673b16e433f72af9b61d134.data: Multi-modal hydrometeorological remote sensing and in-situ inputs for a flash-flood-prone catchment.
f409303235fa1cd5f673b16e433f72af9b61d134.result: Roughly 26% lower error for elevated stream conditions than the current state of the art.
f409303235fa1cd5f673b16e433f72af9b61d134.open_work: Extending warning times and supporting local operational decision making, as the authors suggest.
f409303235fa1cd5f673b16e433f72af9b61d134.issues: Evaluated on a single catchment; transfer to other basins and performance for rare extreme floods are not shown.

40303a3cddc585792f8861e5a20a554960525e85.goal: Automates flood detection in Sentinel-1 SAR imagery, improving on threshold methods.
40303a3cddc585792f8861e5a20a554960525e85.architecture: Nested U-Net (UNet++) with EfficientNet-B7 backbone, compared with other U-Net based CNNs; Shapley scores for polarization bands.
40303a3cddc585792f8861e5a20a554960525e85.data: NASA and IEEE GRSS Sentinel-1 flood dataset (Nebraska, North Alabama, Bangladesh, Florence) with transfer tests in Spain, India and Vietnam.
40303a3cddc585792f8861e5a20a554960525e85.result: U-Net variants perform comparably to UNet++ and transfer across regions; VV, VH and polarization ratio combination is best.
40303a3cddc585792f8861e5a20a554960525e85.open_work: Understanding why polarization effects vary across regions and extending training to more diverse flood events.
40303a3cddc585792f8861e5a20a554960525e85.issues: Polarization effects vary by region, and the training set covers few flood events; urban and vegetated flooding remain hard for SAR.

6ddc78e3827805b4c763e1f949f3771233042aab.goal: Improves short-term wind power prediction by selecting the best model for each wind process.
6ddc78e3827805b4c763e1f949f3771233042aab.architecture: Similarity-based wind process matching with weighted-voting selection among LSTM, BLSTM, CNN, CNN-LSTM, CNN-BLSTM and stacked denoising autoencoder.
6ddc78e3827805b4c763e1f949f3771233042aab.data: Wind farm power and NWP-related data in 96-hour samples; sites not reported in the abstract.
6ddc78e3827805b4c763e1f949f3771233042aab.result: RMSE decreases by 0.69–1.7% (24 h day-ahead) and 1.15–2.2% (96 h) compared with single deep learning models.
6ddc78e3827805b4c763e1f949f3771233042aab.open_work: Extending to probabilistic outputs and testing on more wind farms and climates.
6ddc78e3827805b4c763e1f949f3771233042aab.issues: Gains over single deep learning models are modest (about 1–2% RMSE), and the multi-model approach adds computational cost.

6b93ea066ccddca9824c8652f303a3aa895c7a9f.goal: Optimizes multiobjective operation of multiple hydropower reservoirs.
6b93ea066ccddca9824c8652f303a3aa895c7a9f.data: Not reported (no abstract available); a multi-reservoir hydropower system is implied.
6b93ea066ccddca9824c8652f303a3aa895c7a9f.open_work: Handling uncertain inflow forecasts and testing scalability to larger reservoir systems are natural next steps.
6b93ea066ccddca9824c8652f303a3aa895c7a9f.issues: Details unavailable; site, data period and baselines cannot be checked from the available metadata.

5ebf46815e16a45b451e5d40f9d2ae1c90c3e218.goal: Predicts wind turbine power at 30-second resolution in an offshore wind farm and detects power loss events.
5ebf46815e16a45b451e5d40f9d2ae1c90c3e218.architecture: Spatio-temporal graph neural network with LSTM over turbine time series, within a normal behavior model framework, compared with power curve and MLP.
5ebf46815e16a45b451e5d40f9d2ae1c90c3e218.data: SCADA data from an offshore wind farm.
5ebf46815e16a45b451e5d40f9d2ae1c90c3e218.result: Spatio-temporal GNN reduces MAE by about 30.3% and MAPE by 30.5% versus power curve methods; undetected power loss events drop from 12.6% to 0.02%.
5ebf46815e16a45b451e5d40f9d2ae1c90c3e218.open_work: Applying the model to other wind farms and using it for operational monitoring and wake-aware control.
5ebf46815e16a45b451e5d40f9d2ae1c90c3e218.issues: Evaluated on a single offshore wind farm; transfer to farms with different layouts and turbines is untested.

3759c4985df03de99012ab1e287be624d6de09a4.goal: Assesses building-level urban flood risk in Guangzhou by combining flood susceptibility with the functional vulnerability of buildings, to support resilience planning.
3759c4985df03de99012ab1e287be624d6de09a4.architecture: Random forest predicts flood susceptibility from conditioning factors; a CatBoost gradient-boosting classifier identifies building functions from POI and AOI data.
3759c4985df03de99012ab1e287be624d6de09a4.data: Historical flood records with hydrological, topographic and anthropogenic features for Guangzhou; points-of-interest (POI) and areas-of-interest (AOI) data for building functions.
3759c4985df03de99012ab1e287be624d6de09a4.result: Central districts show higher flood susceptibility than the periphery; over half of buildings are moderately vulnerable; the city is classed into central, intermediate and suburban/rural district types.
3759c4985df03de99012ab1e287be624d6de09a4.open_work: Extend to dynamic, scenario-based hazard (rainfall return periods, climate change) and validate risk classes against observed losses.
3759c4985df03de99012ab1e287be624d6de09a4.issues: Susceptibility is static and depends on flood inventory completeness; no model accuracy figures are given in the abstract; single-city study.

1f0ebc04ab1c33f9fd13ffe902716c5b6d8d1793.goal: Improves multi-step PM2.5 concentration prediction by handling redundant spatial inputs and the loss of accuracy at longer horizons.
1f0ebc04ab1c33f9fd13ffe902716c5b6d8d1793.architecture: KSC-ConvLSTM: k-nearest-neighbour selection of correlated neighbouring sites, a residual CNN block with spatio-temporal attention, and a ConvLSTM recurrent network.
1f0ebc04ab1c33f9fd13ffe902716c5b6d8d1793.data: PM2.5 monitoring data for Beijing and its surrounding urban agglomeration with meteorological inputs; exact period not reported in the abstract.
1f0ebc04ab1c33f9fd13ffe902716c5b6d8d1793.result: Outperforms benchmark models in single-step, multi-step and trend prediction, reducing RMSE by 4.216–8.458 for 1–12 h average PM2.5 predictions in Beijing.
1f0ebc04ab1c33f9fd13ffe902716c5b6d8d1793.open_work: Test transferability to other regions and pollutants and longer lead times; add emission or chemical transport model information.
1f0ebc04ab1c33f9fd13ffe902716c5b6d8d1793.issues: Single-region evaluation; gains reported relative to chosen benchmarks only; no uncertainty quantification; black-box attention model.

e1946fbcce40b0b8131602c0bd4e8f0574f0f4a2.goal: Produces probabilistic wind power forecasts that remain reliable under extreme weather events, where conventional data-driven forecasters degrade.
e1946fbcce40b0b8131602c0bd4e8f0574f0f4a2.architecture: Physics-informed reinforcement learning framework for probabilistic forecasting, per the title; the specific network and physics constraints are not specified here.
e1946fbcce40b0b8131602c0bd4e8f0574f0f4a2.open_work: Test on more wind farms and event types and compare against established probabilistic benchmarks.
e1946fbcce40b0b8131602c0bd4e8f0574f0f4a2.issues: Abstract unavailable; extreme events are rare, so training and evaluation samples are typically small and calibration under extremes is hard to verify.

0014109bf6b855a86e01f9d8ff1167f951b81c3a.goal: Estimates daily reference evapotranspiration where full FAO-56 Penman-Monteith inputs are unavailable, comparing shallow and deep learning models in a data-limited coastal region.
0014109bf6b855a86e01f9d8ff1167f951b81c3a.architecture: CatBoost gradient-boosting regressor versus 1D CNN, LSTM and GRU networks, each coupled with semi-supervised pseudo-labeling; six input-combination scenarios.
0014109bf6b855a86e01f9d8ff1167f951b81c3a.data: Station meteorological data (Tmin, Tmax, Tmean, wind speed, RH, sunshine hours, net radiation, vapour pressure deficit) from the Red Sea coast of Sudan; FAO-56 PM ETo as target.
0014109bf6b855a86e01f9d8ff1167f951b81c3a.result: Pseudo-labeling reduces systematic error for all models; Tmin, Tmax, Tmean and RH is the best input set; CatBoost with pseudo-labeling is best overall with lower computational cost than the deep models.
0014109bf6b855a86e01f9d8ff1167f951b81c3a.open_work: Test at more coastal stations worldwide and with other limited-input configurations.
0014109bf6b855a86e01f9d8ff1167f951b81c3a.issues: Target is the FAO-56 PM estimate rather than measured ET; few stations in one region; generalization claims beyond the study area are untested.

095e46b9e0a3b5b1b7d3c7fc2321054dcb606757.goal: Provides the first 1 km monthly near-surface atmospheric moisture dataset for China, filling a gap in high-resolution humidity data for fine-scale studies.
095e46b9e0a3b5b1b7d3c7fc2321054dcb606757.architecture: Dataset paper; LightGBM gradient-boosting regression maps station moisture indices from satellite and geographic covariates.
095e46b9e0a3b5b1b7d3c7fc2321054dcb606757.data: Observations from 2,419 weather stations with land surface temperature, vapour pressure, land cover, impervious surface, population density and topography covariates; 2003–2020, six moisture indices.
095e46b9e0a3b5b1b7d3c7fc2321054dcb606757.result: R2 exceeds 0.96 for all six moisture indices with reasonable RMSE and MAE, and good consistency with in situ observations across regimes.
095e46b9e0a3b5b1b7d3c7fc2321054dcb606757.open_work: Extend to daily resolution and beyond 2020, and use the product for urban humidity and heat-stress studies.
095e46b9e0a3b5b1b7d3c7fc2321054dcb606757.issues: Accuracy is evaluated against the same station network type used for training; sparse stations in western China may limit reliability there.

ceaf2f42fe8e7d7a4d45239b9c2804ffe25760ce.goal: Provides high-quality labelled training data for deep-learning flood mapping, especially for difficult inundated-vegetation areas.
ceaf2f42fe8e7d7a4d45239b9c2804ffe25760ce.architecture: Benchmark dataset of aerial and SAR imagery with flood labels; several CNN semantic segmentation architectures are evaluated as baselines.
ceaf2f42fe8e7d7a4d45239b9c2804ffe25760ce.data: High-resolution manned and unmanned aerial imagery plus Synthetic Aperture Radar imagery with detailed labels including inundated vegetation; sites not reported in the abstract.
ceaf2f42fe8e7d7a4d45239b9c2804ffe25760ce.result: Baseline segmentation models demonstrate the dataset's usability for post-disaster flood mapping; quantitative scores not reported in the abstract.
ceaf2f42fe8e7d7a4d45239b9c2804ffe25760ce.open_work: Develop multi-modal fusion models and extend coverage to more flood events and landscapes.
ceaf2f42fe8e7d7a4d45239b9c2804ffe25760ce.issues: Geographic and event diversity is limited to the collected events; label quality for inundated vegetation is inherently uncertain.

eb17a9a0aa8b47e992f38b89a2eb6c062db6e7ca.goal: Automates rapid flood inundation mapping from SAR imagery while providing uncertainty estimates for emergency response.
eb17a9a0aa8b47e992f38b89a2eb6c062db6e7ca.architecture: Deep ensembles of Vision Transformer-based segmentation models, per the title, with ensemble spread used for uncertainty estimation.
eb17a9a0aa8b47e992f38b89a2eb6c062db6e7ca.data: SAR imagery; specific sensors, sites and labels not reported (abstract unavailable).
eb17a9a0aa8b47e992f38b89a2eb6c062db6e7ca.open_work: Validate across more flood events and regions and assess calibration of the uncertainty estimates.
eb17a9a0aa8b47e992f38b89a2eb6c062db6e7ca.issues: Abstract unavailable; SAR flood mapping struggles in urban and vegetated areas; ensembles raise computational cost.

018466d195767dad7fb6fd338c399a7b5003ea28.goal: Predicts flood risk with an explainable hybrid machine learning model to support urban planning decisions.
018466d195767dad7fb6fd338c399a7b5003ea28.architecture: Hybrid machine learning model combined with explainability analysis, per the title; the model type is not specified here.
018466d195767dad7fb6fd338c399a7b5003ea28.open_work: Test transferability to other cities and validate explanations against physical flood drivers.
018466d195767dad7fb6fd338c399a7b5003ea28.issues: Abstract unavailable; flood-risk ML models depend on inventory quality and post-hoc explanations may not reflect causal drivers.

dee7087ab1259fb2ccd399d7bc7807da4a52c132.goal: Reviews machine learning and AI methods for assessing climate change impacts on groundwater levels, discharge, storage and quality.
dee7087ab1259fb2ccd399d7bc7807da4a52c132.architecture: Review of 65 papers (2017–2023) covering neural networks, random forest, decision trees, SVM and hybrid and ensemble ML approaches.
dee7087ab1259fb2ccd399d7bc7807da4a52c132.data: Literature corpus of 65 studies using varied historical and observational groundwater and climate data; includes a focus on the Irish context.
dee7087ab1259fb2ccd399d7bc7807da4a52c132.result: Neural networks, random forest, decision trees and SVM predict groundwater changes accurately; hybrid and ensemble methods improve accuracy; Irish groundwater faces climate risks with little research.
dee7087ab1259fb2ccd399d7bc7807da4a52c132.open_work: More ML studies on climate impacts on groundwater in under-studied regions such as Ireland, and better handling of data resolution and scale.
dee7087ab1259fb2ccd399d7bc7807da4a52c132.issues: Small, recent corpus; performance comparisons across studies with different data are not standardized.

01c3dd09594c1dcbad5b2913f0fd174a80f9b7d3.goal: Forecasts urban flood inundation rapidly, as a fast alternative to computationally expensive hydrodynamic simulation.
01c3dd09594c1dcbad5b2913f0fd174a80f9b7d3.architecture: Physics-informed deep learning approach, per the title; the network family is not specified here.
01c3dd09594c1dcbad5b2913f0fd174a80f9b7d3.data: Not reported (abstract unavailable); training data for such surrogates typically come from hydrodynamic model simulations.
01c3dd09594c1dcbad5b2913f0fd174a80f9b7d3.open_work: Test on unseen rainfall events and other urban catchments, and compare with full hydrodynamic models in operation.
01c3dd09594c1dcbad5b2913f0fd174a80f9b7d3.issues: Abstract unavailable; surrogate accuracy is bounded by the simulator it learns from and by the range of training storms.

813b3e8267664e995ec188b3c0abcc9d3b87d717.goal: Retrieves hourly, 1 km, gap-free surface ozone across China from space to study its diurnal variation and impacts on air quality and vegetation.
813b3e8267664e995ec188b3c0abcc9d3b87d717.architecture: Artificial-intelligence retrieval model, per the title; the specific ML method is not specified in the available text.
813b3e8267664e995ec188b3c0abcc9d3b87d717.data: Satellite observations with ground monitoring of surface O3 in China; exact inputs not reported in the truncated abstract.
813b3e8267664e995ec188b3c0abcc9d3b87d717.result: Not reported in the truncated abstract; the product resolves 24-hourly surface ozone at 1 km and is used to examine diurnal cycles and phytotoxicity.
813b3e8267664e995ec188b3c0abcc9d3b87d717.open_work: Extend the record in time and evaluate in regions with sparse ground monitoring.
813b3e8267664e995ec188b3c0abcc9d3b87d717.issues: Abstract is truncated; night-time hours lack direct satellite signal, so gap-free hourly values rely heavily on model inference.

0fb2e27d9111de48b39bc4ecd96c857660d3f4c4.goal: Quantifies changes in compound hot-dry and hot-wet events in China and their contribution to cropland productivity losses.
0fb2e27d9111de48b39bc4ecd96c857660d3f4c4.architecture: XGBoost gradient-boosting model with SHAP explanations attributes cropland NPP losses to compound extreme event types.
0fb2e27d9111de48b39bc4ecd96c857660d3f4c4.data: Meteorological observations from 686 stations in China, 1985–2019; cropland net primary productivity (CNPP).
0fb2e27d9111de48b39bc4ecd96c857660d3f4c4.result: Compound extremes became more frequent, persistent and severe; CNPP losses are larger in the north, peak in summer and are dominated by compound hot-dry events, shifting from daytime to nighttime types from north to south.
0fb2e27d9111de48b39bc4ecd96c857660d3f4c4.open_work: Link to crop-specific yields and future scenarios to inform climate-adaptive agriculture.
0fb2e27d9111de48b39bc4ecd96c857660d3f4c4.issues: CNPP is a model or satellite-derived proxy for production; SHAP attribution is associative, not causal; station interpolation adds uncertainty.

dc2b6ccd7c5480aa07e063bdc61aa2adc52f8f8f.goal: Improves spatiotemporal flood forecasting by capturing dynamic spatial relationships and multi-variable heterogeneity in flood data.
dc2b6ccd7c5480aa07e063bdc61aa2adc52f8f8f.architecture: HD-TGCN: heterogeneous dynamic temporal graph convolutional network, using multihead self-attention to build dynamic adjacency matrices and parallel graph modules fused across variables.
dc2b6ccd7c5480aa07e063bdc61aa2adc52f8f8f.data: Real meteorological and hydrological dataset for Wuyuan County, Jiangxi Province, China; period not reported in the abstract.
dc2b6ccd7c5480aa07e063bdc61aa2adc52f8f8f.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art flood prediction models, with reported improvements of 80.32% in MAE, 0.15% in NSE and 73.99% in RMSE.
dc2b6ccd7c5480aa07e063bdc61aa2adc52f8f8f.open_work: Test on other basins and longer lead times, and quantify forecast uncertainty.
dc2b6ccd7c5480aa07e063bdc61aa2adc52f8f8f.issues: Single small study area; the very large MAE and RMSE gains with a tiny NSE gain suggest metrics need careful interpretation.

de07a53a28f7f9016eff388be481f84da04703ec.goal: Evaluates transformer models for groundwater level prediction.
de07a53a28f7f9016eff388be481f84da04703ec.architecture: Transformer-based deep learning model for groundwater level time series, per the title; comparison models not specified here.
de07a53a28f7f9016eff388be481f84da04703ec.open_work: Test across more aquifers and longer horizons and assess interpretability of attention.
de07a53a28f7f9016eff388be481f84da04703ec.issues: Abstract unavailable; groundwater records are often short, which can limit data-hungry transformer models.

ea348b7712875bc2b811dbbc5489175b267b027d.goal: Overcomes the loss of spatial information in lumped LSTM streamflow models by applying them at subbasin scale with physical routing.
ea348b7712875bc2b811dbbc5489175b267b027d.architecture: Spatially Recursive model: a lumped LSTM network applied to subbasins, with outputs routed to the outlet by a physics-based hydrological routing model.
ea348b7712875bc2b811dbbc5489175b267b027d.data: Basin-averaged meteorological and hydrological variables from 141 gauged basins in the Great Lakes region for training; evaluation at 224 gauges.
ea348b7712875bc2b811dbbc5489175b267b027d.result: Matches the lumped LSTM in training basins, is more accurate in large basins (above 2000 km2) and outperforms it in pseudo-ungauged basins.
ea348b7712875bc2b811dbbc5489175b267b027d.open_work: Train the LSTM directly in the coupled system and test in other regions and for regulated rivers.
ea348b7712875bc2b811dbbc5489175b267b027d.issues: LSTM is trained at basin scale but applied at subbasin scale, a scale mismatch; routing parameters add uncertainty.

13ba43bbd70cf0a939d0d9b43316ae54621319af.goal: Forecasts compound coastal-fluvial flooding in near real time, avoiding the computational cost of running hydrodynamic models operationally.
13ba43bbd70cf0a939d0d9b43316ae54621319af.architecture: Two-step hydrodynamic-ML system: a hydrodynamic model simulates inundation, then per-pixel ML models (SVR, SVM, RBF, linear regression, Gaussian process regression, decision tree, ANN) emulate it.
13ba43bbd70cf0a939d0d9b43316ae54621319af.data: Hydrodynamic simulations for Cork City, Ireland, driven by upstream river discharges and downstream ocean water levels.
13ba43bbd70cf0a939d0d9b43316ae54621319af.result: Models reliably estimate inundation and water depth; the RBF model performs best; the trained system forecasts in near real time with limited inputs.
13ba43bbd70cf0a939d0d9b43316ae54621319af.open_work: Integrate into a flood early warning system and add pluvial drivers.
13ba43bbd70cf0a939d0d9b43316ae54621319af.issues: Trained on simulations, so inherits hydrodynamic model errors; per-pixel models ignore spatial coherence; single city.

d701c9c402f4f571c3002511d3e22b4324ea902b.goal: Forecasts wind speed across multiple sites by exploiting spatio-temporal correlations for wind energy applications.
d701c9c402f4f571c3002511d3e22b4324ea902b.architecture: Mixformer: a mixture transformer with hierarchical context for spatio-temporal forecasting, per the title.
d701c9c402f4f571c3002511d3e22b4324ea902b.open_work: Test across more wind farms, horizons and seasons and add probabilistic outputs.
d701c9c402f4f571c3002511d3e22b4324ea902b.issues: Abstract unavailable; deterministic forecasts may smooth ramps and extremes.

5ca8624de1e9e8f000cb5ac010c5723be1165942.goal: Reviews recent deep learning applications in physical oceanography to summarize progress, bottlenecks and future directions.
5ca8624de1e9e8f000cb5ac010c5723be1165942.architecture: Review organized by surface elements, subsurface elements, ocean phenomena and weather and climate phenomena, covering CNN, RNN and GAN model types.
5ca8624de1e9e8f000cb5ac010c5723be1165942.data: Literature from roughly the preceding three years on ocean circulation, dynamics, climate, remote sensing and geophysics.
5ca8624de1e9e8f000cb5ac010c5723be1165942.result: Deep learning matches or exceeds traditional methods in many tasks; CNNs suit spatial data, RNNs temporal data and GANs data generation.
5ca8624de1e9e8f000cb5ac010c5723be1165942.open_work: Address bottlenecks such as interpretability, physical consistency and sparse subsurface data.
5ca8624de1e9e8f000cb5ac010c5723be1165942.issues: Short review window; newer architectures such as transformers and diffusion models receive limited coverage per the abstract.

e067e5e6e975cf1713434bbb38c9c5ed099c90f0.goal: Automates detection and quantification of methane point-source plumes in high-resolution satellite imagery, replacing labor-intensive manual analysis.
e067e5e6e975cf1713434bbb38c9c5ed099c90f0.architecture: Two-step U-Plume: U-Net segmentation for plume masking, then source-rate quantification from the mask with wind speed using either a CNN or the physics-based integrated mass enhancement method.
e067e5e6e975cf1713434bbb38c9c5ed099c90f0.data: Large-eddy simulations of methane plumes superimposed on GHGSat-C1 satellite background scenes.
e067e5e6e975cf1713434bbb38c9c5ed099c90f0.result: Detects sources as small as 100 kg/h over low-noise surfaces; IME is unbiased while the CNN is biased toward its training mean; 2–4 m/s winds are optimal; 62 images per second on a CPU.
e067e5e6e975cf1713434bbb38c9c5ed099c90f0.open_work: Apply to real GHGSat and other point-source imager data and extend the observability metric to other instruments.
e067e5e6e975cf1713434bbb38c9c5ed099c90f0.issues: Trained on synthetic plumes; quantification error is dominated by wind speed uncertainty at low winds.

91119fc691b7ec0d46b10599c5fba88bfb834e48.goal: Reconstructs the September 2023 Derna, Libya flood caused by Storm Daniel to assess the role of cascading dam failures.
91119fc691b7ec0d46b10599c5fba88bfb834e48.architecture: Integrated modeling combining hydrologic, hydraulic and geotechnical simulations with machine learning and satellite analysis; the ML method type is not specified in the abstract.
91119fc691b7ec0d46b10599c5fba88bfb834e48.data: Satellite imagery, digital elevation data, eyewitness accounts and rainfall from Storm Daniel over the Wadi Derna watershed.
91119fc691b7ec0d46b10599c5fba88bfb834e48.result: Dams would have given minimal protection against the extreme runoff even if sound, but their failure released a destructive surge that greatly amplified the disaster.
91119fc691b7ec0d46b10599c5fba88bfb834e48.open_work: Systematic dam safety evaluations, improved flood forecasting and adaptive risk management for climate extremes.
91119fc691b7ec0d46b10599c5fba88bfb834e48.issues: Event reconstruction relies on sparse observations and eyewitness data; ML plays a supporting role.

398f65dccb70e54f4a790868659516fddca91f78.goal: Predicts canola and soybean yields across Canada with ensemble machine learning and assesses climate change impacts.
398f65dccb70e54f4a790868659516fddca91f78.architecture: Ensemble tree models compared: AdaBoost, gradient boosting machine, XGBoost, LightGBM and random forest.
398f65dccb70e54f4a790868659516fddca91f78.data: Interpolated climate variables, satellite vegetation indices, soil characteristics and honeybee census data at Census Consolidated Subdivision level across Canada; climate change scenarios.
398f65dccb70e54f4a790868659516fddca91f78.result: XGBoost is best (R2 0.95 canola, 0.96 soybean; RMSE 119.48 and 102.39); climate scenarios show negative yield impacts; honeybee colonies are the most influential factor.
398f65dccb70e54f4a790868659516fddca91f78.open_work: Add more crops and finer-scale management data and test temporal extrapolation.
398f65dccb70e54f4a790868659516fddca91f78.issues: Dominance of honeybee counts may reflect confounding with cropping area; random test splits may overstate skill under climate change.

9cc05fcd1189588f33049dee595bd44f4bdab7fc.goal: Predicts storm characteristics and occurrence in Western France, a hard task because storms are infrequent.
9cc05fcd1189588f33049dee595bd44f4bdab7fc.architecture: LSTM recurrent network for storm characteristics and an XGBoost gradient-boosting classifier for storm occurrence.
9cc05fcd1189588f33049dee595bd44f4bdab7fc.data: Buoy observations and a storm database for Western France; training 1996–2015, testing 2016–2020.
9cc05fcd1189588f33049dee595bd44f4bdab7fc.result: LSTM forecasts temperature and pressure accurately but misses extremes of wave height and wind speed; XGBoost predicts storm occurrence very well.
9cc05fcd1189588f33049dee595bd44f4bdab7fc.open_work: Improve extreme-value prediction and include atmospheric model fields.
9cc05fcd1189588f33049dee595bd44f4bdab7fc.issues: Rare-event imbalance; extremes underestimated; point buoy data limit spatial generality.

4efe7d51bf4c7a0f28af43de87a60b1d376719ee.goal: Identifies influential weather drivers and predicts seasonal drought across Bangladesh's agroclimatic regions.
4efe7d51bf4c7a0f28af43de87a60b1d376719ee.architecture: Comparison of 24 ML classifiers, with ranger, bagEarth, support vector machine and random forest best; Boruta feature selection.
4efe7d51bf4c7a0f28af43de87a60b1d376719ee.data: Weather data for 35 agroclimatic regions of Bangladesh, 1981–2020, nine parameters; SPEI drought classes.
4efe7d51bf4c7a0f28af43de87a60b1d376719ee.result: Water balance, precipitation and maximum and minimum temperature dominate drought; drought intensity has decreased but return time increased, shifting from northern to central and southern zones.
4efe7d51bf4c7a0f28af43de87a60b1d376719ee.open_work: Integrate predictions into stakeholder adaptation and drought monitoring.
4efe7d51bf4c7a0f28af43de87a60b1d376719ee.issues: SPEI is computed from the same weather variables used as predictors, risking circularity; no skill numbers in the abstract.

84af7a0e107337f8f6fa700a7d6f78759959b471.goal: Improves streamflow forecasting in glacier- and snow-fed high-mountain basins by combining glacio-hydrological model outputs with deep learning.
84af7a0e107337f8f6fa700a7d6f78759959b471.architecture: Hybrid CNN-LSTM models fed with GSM-SOCONT glacio-hydrological outputs, plus wavelet transformation for multi-scale features.
84af7a0e107337f8f6fa700a7d6f78759959b471.data: Meteorological data and GSM-SOCONT snow and ice melt outputs for a high-mountain river basin; basin not named in the abstract.
84af7a0e107337f8f6fa700a7d6f78759959b471.result: Best hybrid with glacier features reaches validation NSE 0.83 and KGE 0.88; adding wavelet features raises NSE to 0.97 and cuts RMSE from 892 to 442.
84af7a0e107337f8f6fa700a7d6f78759959b471.open_work: Test in other glacierized basins and under climate projections.
84af7a0e107337f8f6fa700a7d6f78759959b471.issues: Wavelet decomposition can leak future information if not applied causally; single basin; many model variants raise overfitting risk.

d0315ff2ebf700823c3f902ada3569144b04adc7.goal: Assesses climate change impacts on streamflow in the Ganjiang River catchment using LSTM-based models.
d0315ff2ebf700823c3f902ada3569144b04adc7.architecture: LSTM-based deep learning models, per the title, driven by climate inputs.
d0315ff2ebf700823c3f902ada3569144b04adc7.open_work: Compare with process-based projections and quantify uncertainty across climate models.
d0315ff2ebf700823c3f902ada3569144b04adc7.issues: Abstract unavailable; data-driven models may extrapolate poorly to climates outside the training range.

b0608d745cfa9d5042e73c81c59ee7bb062522da.goal: Reviews AI/ML, IoT, cloud computing and robotics for flash flood early warning and susceptibility prediction.
b0608d745cfa9d5042e73c81c59ee7bb062522da.architecture: Review of 2010–2023 literature from Google Scholar, Scopus and Web of Science on emerging flash-flood technologies.
b0608d745cfa9d5042e73c81c59ee7bb062522da.data: Literature corpus; studies use topographic, geological and hydrological conditioning variables.
b0608d745cfa9d5042e73c81c59ee7bb062522da.result: AI/ML appears in 64% of papers, IoT 19%, cloud 6%, robotics 2%; random forest and SVM are most common, with AUC above 0.90.
b0608d745cfa9d5042e73c81c59ee7bb062522da.open_work: Larger test datasets, computer vision, sociodemographic data and climate change scenarios for susceptibility mapping.
b0608d745cfa9d5042e73c81c59ee7bb062522da.issues: Variable selection in reviewed studies lacks theoretical basis; early warning systems face connectivity and data loss issues.

968b83ef0ee879e26894aecfb59dfda0b9004b86.goal: Downscales coarse GRACE-derived groundwater storage changes to finer resolution across diverse climates and human-intervention settings.
968b83ef0ee879e26894aecfb59dfda0b9004b86.architecture: Random forest regression for statistical downscaling, per the title.
968b83ef0ee879e26894aecfb59dfda0b9004b86.data: GRACE terrestrial water storage-derived groundwater storage changes; covariates and region not reported (abstract unavailable).
968b83ef0ee879e26894aecfb59dfda0b9004b86.open_work: Validate against in situ well observations and apply in other aquifers.
968b83ef0ee879e26894aecfb59dfda0b9004b86.issues: Abstract unavailable; downscaled fields cannot add information beyond predictors and GRACE's coarse signal.

ed073cb4bebcd25d735b1e067188cdfc3857d5a1.goal: Maps long-term average groundwater recharge across Africa at higher resolution than a previous linear mixed model.
ed073cb4bebcd25d735b1e067188cdfc3857d5a1.architecture: Random forest regression with residual kriging, compared with the linear mixed model of MacDonald et al. (2021).
ed073cb4bebcd25d735b1e067188cdfc3857d5a1.data: 134 ground-based recharge studies; precipitation, potential evapotranspiration, soil moisture, NDVI and aridity index at 0.1°.
ed073cb4bebcd25d735b1e067188cdfc3857d5a1.result: Random forest reaches R2 0.83 (0.88 with residual kriging) versus 0.86 for the linear mixed model, and preserves more small-scale spatial variability.
ed073cb4bebcd25d735b1e067188cdfc3857d5a1.open_work: Add recharge studies in humid equatorial Africa and represent focused recharge.
ed073cb4bebcd25d735b1e067188cdfc3857d5a1.issues: Few observations in high-precipitation humid regions cause large uncertainty; focused recharge poorly represented.

34c4564126da9a4cfb3cdfb9284458032e716928.goal: Compares deep learning models for hourly streamflow forecasting in small, fast-responding basins.
34c4564126da9a4cfb3cdfb9284458032e716928.architecture: Six models: LSTM, GRU, CNN and hybrids CNN-LSTM, CNN-GRU and CNN-RNN.
34c4564126da9a4cfb3cdfb9284458032e716928.data: Ten years of hourly data for the Groba and Anllóns catchments in Northwest Spain.
34c4564126da9a4cfb3cdfb9284458032e716928.result: GRU is best (NSE about 0.96 and 0.98 at 1 h); hybrids do not help; skill drops at longer leads (0.969 to 0.24 in Groba), and adding future rainfall raises 12 h NSE to 0.70 and 0.92.
34c4564126da9a4cfb3cdfb9284458032e716928.open_work: Explore other data sources and model structures.
34c4564126da9a4cfb3cdfb9284458032e716928.issues: Only two basins; future rainfall input uses observed rather than forecast rainfall, overstating operational skill.

405c254f9588033c17c7241667e2f539ed28e3cd.goal: Forecasts hydrological time series using a fused recurrent model with attention.
405c254f9588033c17c7241667e2f539ed28e3cd.architecture: Multimodal fusion of optimized GRU and LSTM recurrent networks with a self-attention layer, per the title.
405c254f9588033c17c7241667e2f539ed28e3cd.open_work: Test on more stations and variables and compare with standard benchmarks.
405c254f9588033c17c7241667e2f539ed28e3cd.issues: Abstract unavailable; hyperparameter optimization on small datasets risks overfitting.

22ad0a7463d7c76cd3bcfa27d8659ae0d6dcd0d4.goal: Forecasts ocean wave parameters by modeling their spatio-temporal dynamics with physics guidance.
22ad0a7463d7c76cd3bcfa27d8659ae0d6dcd0d4.architecture: Hybrid physics-informed neural network (PINN) combined with LSTM, per the title.
22ad0a7463d7c76cd3bcfa27d8659ae0d6dcd0d4.open_work: Evaluate across locations and sea states and compare with numerical wave models.
22ad0a7463d7c76cd3bcfa27d8659ae0d6dcd0d4.issues: Abstract unavailable; physics constraints and extreme-wave performance cannot be assessed from the title.

6c22d4f6382b087e7375925b2cc3f6cd6c59f9aa.goal: Extends LSTM discharge estimation from selected gauges to every river reach worldwide.
6c22d4f6382b087e7375925b2cc3f6cd6c59f9aa.architecture: Grid LSTM-RAPID: LSTM runoff estimation on 0.25° grid cells, routed through a global river network with the RAPID routing model.
6c22d4f6382b087e7375925b2cc3f6cd6c59f9aa.data: Global gauged discharge with gridded forcing at 0.25°; produces the GRADES-hydroDL reach-level daily dataset from 1980 to near present.
6c22d4f6382b087e7375925b2cc3f6cd6c59f9aa.result: Median KGE 0.653 for small basins out of sample in time and space and 0.592 for larger basins; loses about 0.03 KGE versus Basin LSTM but beats a calibrated process-based model.
6c22d4f6382b087e7375925b2cc3f6cd6c59f9aa.open_work: Improve performance in large, data-poor basins and include human regulation.
6c22d4f6382b087e7375925b2cc3f6cd6c59f9aa.issues: Reservoirs and withdrawals not explicitly represented; skill lower in large basins with poor data.

6c9d02f754a83ac2f7dbefe7623fb8f771ce7b7b.goal: Updates the flood inventory and maps flood susceptibility, now and under future climate, in the Mahananda River basin, India.
6c9d02f754a83ac2f7dbefe7623fb8f771ce7b7b.architecture: U-Net transfer learning on SAR for water mapping; Fuzzy AHP combined with random forest, XGBoost, GBM, avNNet, AdaBoost and PLS; SHAP explanations.
6c9d02f754a83ac2f7dbefe7623fb8f771ce7b7b.data: Sentinel-1 SAR (2020–2022), Global Flood Dataset (2000–2018), eleven geospatial conditioning factors; CMIP6 MIROC6 and EC-Earth3 under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5.
6c9d02f754a83ac2f7dbefe7623fb8f771ce7b7b.result: FuzzyAHP-XGB is best (AUC 0.970); 31.10% of the basin is highly susceptible; LULC, NDVI and soil type contribute over 60%; future high susceptibility about 30.69%.
6c9d02f754a83ac2f7dbefe7623fb8f771ce7b7b.open_work: Extend to dynamic hazard modelling and validate projections with new flood events.
6c9d02f754a83ac2f7dbefe7623fb8f771ce7b7b.issues: Static susceptibility; future projections depend on only two CMIP6 models; SAR inventory may miss short or vegetated floods.

99045e59a9d48a32b55bdff01fd9ae9db759f1f7.goal: Synthesizes the solar radiation forecasting literature through a meta-review and proposes a new typology of methods.
99045e59a9d48a32b55bdff01fd9ae9db759f1f7.architecture: Systematic meta-review of reviews covering statistical, physical, AI/ML, hybrid and ensemble solar forecasting methods.
99045e59a9d48a32b55bdff01fd9ae9db759f1f7.data: Literature corpus of solar forecasting reviews; bibliometric procedure described.
99045e59a9d48a32b55bdff01fd9ae9db759f1f7.result: AI and ML play a growing role; hybrid and ensemble models are prominent; a synthetic typology of forecasting methods is proposed.
99045e59a9d48a32b55bdff01fd9ae9db759f1f7.open_work: Big data integration, advanced computational tools and best practices for meta-reviews.
99045e59a9d48a32b55bdff01fd9ae9db759f1f7.issues: Meta-review level; no quantitative comparison of method accuracy.

cbfba3405729fc472a2a46f220ca7e97aa2e5ccf.goal: Reviews physics-informed neural networks for groundwater flow modeling, discussing advantages and future directions.
cbfba3405729fc472a2a46f220ca7e97aa2e5ccf.architecture: Review of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) applied to groundwater flow equations.
cbfba3405729fc472a2a46f220ca7e97aa2e5ccf.data: Literature corpus; no new data (abstract unavailable).
cbfba3405729fc472a2a46f220ca7e97aa2e5ccf.open_work: Scaling PINNs to heterogeneous, three-dimensional real aquifers and inverse problems.
cbfba3405729fc472a2a46f220ca7e97aa2e5ccf.issues: Abstract unavailable; PINNs often face training difficulties and cost on complex domains.

f46c2ec6762c572ba0c918e9dda9b6ead1906fc1.goal: Reviews ML applications in hydrology that use large datasets, highlighting successes, challenges and future directions.
f46c2ec6762c572ba0c918e9dda9b6ead1906fc1.architecture: Review of ML methods in hydrology organized around major hydrological datasets.
f46c2ec6762c572ba0c918e9dda9b6ead1906fc1.data: CAMELS, Caravan, GRDC, CHIRPS, PERSIANN, NLDAS, GLDAS and GRACE datasets as surveyed.
f46c2ec6762c572ba0c918e9dda9b6ead1906fc1.result: Large datasets enable improved prediction of streamflow, precipitation, groundwater and floods, especially in data-scarce regions.
f46c2ec6762c572ba0c918e9dda9b6ead1906fc1.open_work: Real-time data integration, uncertainty quantification, citizen science and IoT data collection.
f46c2ec6762c572ba0c918e9dda9b6ead1906fc1.issues: Data heterogeneity, spatio-temporal inconsistencies, downscaling issues and missing human activities remain unresolved.

85d38a81365df9a0dd13cb3074bfa01678e2502a.goal: Estimates crop water requirements and optimizes irrigation scheduling from multi-source remote sensing imagery.
85d38a81365df9a0dd13cb3074bfa01678e2502a.architecture: Pipeline with GWO-optimized non-local means denoising, Vision Transformer plus Fourier, entropy and Gabor features, DEHO feature selection, a Deep Dyna-Q graph convolutional network classifier and VARMAX.
85d38a81365df9a0dd13cb3074bfa01678e2502a.data: Multi-domain remote sensing images for mango, rice and cotton across different geographies; specific sensors not reported in the abstract.
85d38a81365df9a0dd13cb3074bfa01678e2502a.result: Reports 8.5% higher precision, 8.3% accuracy, 4.9% recall and 5.5% AUC over existing methods, with 3.5% lower delay.
85d38a81365df9a0dd13cb3074bfa01678e2502a.open_work: Validate against measured evapotranspiration and field water use.
85d38a81365df9a0dd13cb3074bfa01678e2502a.issues: Very complex pipeline with metaheuristics; evaluation framed as classification metrics without physical water-requirement validation.

34f075a06177f7854efb82406cd53d895a5f3c27.goal: Reviews the development of data-driven weather forecasting and climate modeling as an alternative to NWP.
34f075a06177f7854efb82406cd53d895a5f3c27.architecture: Review of data-driven weather and climate models covering datasets, model design, training, computational acceleration and skill.
34f075a06177f7854efb82406cd53d895a5f3c27.data: Models surveyed are mainly trained on reanalysis such as ERA5 at 0.25°.
34f075a06177f7854efb82406cd53d895a5f3c27.result: Data-driven models reach ACC above 0.6 up to 15 days at 0.25°, matching or beating NWP for 90% of variables; climate emulators simulate decades to 100 years.
34f075a06177f7854efb82406cd53d895a5f3c27.open_work: Larger models, more physical constraints and better evaluation methods.
34f075a06177f7854efb82406cd53d895a5f3c27.issues: Poor interpretability, hard uncertainty evaluation and conservative predictions of extremes.

4d6eb952218242b4527c4d88c8120fbc8e6308b6.goal: Improves national-scale streamflow estimation in Denmark by combining a physically based hydrological model with LSTM.
4d6eb952218242b4527c4d88c8120fbc8e6308b6.architecture: Hybrid schemes coupling the Danish National Water Resources Model with LSTM networks, including serial input (LSTM-q) and residual-correction variants.
4d6eb952218242b4527c4d88c8120fbc8e6308b6.data: Danish gauged catchments with climate forcings and DKM simulated outputs; evaluation in gauged and ungauged basins.
4d6eb952218242b4527c4d88c8120fbc8e6308b6.result: LSTM-q improves mean NSE by 0.22 in gauged and 0.12 in ungauged basins over DKM; standalone LSTM struggles in groundwater-dependent catchments.
4d6eb952218242b4527c4d88c8120fbc8e6308b6.open_work: Integrate hybrid models into operational forecasting.
4d6eb952218242b4527c4d88c8120fbc8e6308b6.issues: Relies on DKM outputs, so inherits its biases; tested only in Denmark.

1e6f4046eeb3395ce79a787c340f944017be6aa8.goal: Predicts and visualizes urban flood depth with interpretable machine learning.
1e6f4046eeb3395ce79a787c340f944017be6aa8.architecture: XGBoost gradient-boosting model with SHAP explanations, per the title.
1e6f4046eeb3395ce79a787c340f944017be6aa8.open_work: Test on additional cities and events and couple with real-time rainfall forecasts.
1e6f4046eeb3395ce79a787c340f944017be6aa8.issues: Abstract unavailable; the source of flood-depth labels is unknown, so generality cannot be judged.

e5ad210552bc8059701a6e0b081364b985874478.goal: Forecast the daily air quality index (AQI) in Delhi, India, a city with severe winter pollution, to support air pollution control decisions.
e5ad210552bc8059701a6e0b081364b985874478.architecture: Compares recurrent neural networks: LSTM, bidirectional LSTM and bidirectional RNN, against kernel ridge regression as a classical machine learning baseline.
e5ad210552bc8059701a6e0b081364b985874478.data: Daily AQI records for Delhi, India; period and predictors not reported in the abstract.
e5ad210552bc8059701a6e0b081364b985874478.result: The Bi-RNN performs best in training and testing (R2 = 0.954, RMSE = 25.755), while kernel ridge regression is weakest.
e5ad210552bc8059701a6e0b081364b985874478.open_work: Test the models in other Indian cities and with multi-day lead times and meteorological predictors.
e5ad210552bc8059701a6e0b081364b985874478.issues: Single city, single-step daily forecasts; no uncertainty estimates; the authors note dependence on adequate training data.

11f8701f9a6f0bd22623a00a7cb04c59a6fedacf.goal: Improve day-ahead photovoltaic power forecasting by automatically finding similar historical power sequences and cloud-driven neighbour-site patterns instead of manual similar-day selection.
11f8701f9a6f0bd22623a00a7cb04c59a6fedacf.architecture: Encoder-decoder transformer with a modified attention scoring: fine-grained temporal attention over similar historical PV sequences and cloud-coverage spatial attention over neighbouring sites.
11f8701f9a6f0bd22623a00a7cb04c59a6fedacf.data: A real PV power dataset with neighbouring sites; plant locations and period not reported in the abstract.
11f8701f9a6f0bd22623a00a7cb04c59a6fedacf.result: Root mean square error is reduced by 21.34% on average relative to the baseline model.
11f8701f9a6f0bd22623a00a7cb04c59a6fedacf.open_work: Extend to probabilistic day-ahead forecasts and test transfer to other PV fleets and climates.
11f8701f9a6f0bd22623a00a7cb04c59a6fedacf.issues: Evaluated on one real dataset; baseline choice and robustness under rapidly changing cloud conditions are not detailed in the abstract.

0f215c13ab1490266826196280f49766e769a965.goal: Predict internal tides with deep learning using ocean reanalysis data, as a faster alternative to numerical internal tide modelling.
0f215c13ab1490266826196280f49766e769a965.architecture: Deep learning model; the network type is not specified in the available metadata.
0f215c13ab1490266826196280f49766e769a965.data: China Ocean Reanalysis (CORA) data, as stated in the title; region and period not reported.
0f215c13ab1490266826196280f49766e769a965.result: Not reported; the abstract is unavailable.
0f215c13ab1490266826196280f49766e769a965.open_work: Validate against in-situ mooring and satellite altimetry observations and test other regions.
0f215c13ab1490266826196280f49766e769a965.issues: Trained on reanalysis, so it inherits the reanalysis representation of internal tides; details of skill and generalization are unknown.

7c0281e8e5ecc1a365b4010505f25e589a691769.goal: Forecast solar radiation time series by fusing a recurrent model with a feed-forward network for higher accuracy.
7c0281e8e5ecc1a365b4010505f25e589a691769.architecture: Hybrid of an MTM-LSTM (an LSTM variant) and an MLP, fused for time series forecasting, as stated in the title.
7c0281e8e5ecc1a365b4010505f25e589a691769.data: Solar radiation time series; sites and period not reported.
7c0281e8e5ecc1a365b4010505f25e589a691769.result: Not reported; the abstract is unavailable.
7c0281e8e5ecc1a365b4010505f25e589a691769.open_work: Test across climates and forecast horizons and add probabilistic outputs.
7c0281e8e5ecc1a365b4010505f25e589a691769.issues: Details of evaluation, baselines and generalization are unknown without the abstract.

ab350b2a9fb5889c6175313a9f708bdb626611b5.goal: Delineate groundwater potential zones in the drought-prone, agricultural Bankura district of West Bengal, India, to support sustainable groundwater management.
ab350b2a9fb5889c6175313a9f708bdb626611b5.architecture: Ensemble machine learning: random forest, AdaBoost, XGBoost (gradient boosting) and a voting ensemble classifier of groundwater presence or absence.
ab350b2a9fb5889c6175313a9f708bdb626611b5.data: 161 groundwater presence/absence points with a 70% training split, plus conditioning factors for the Bankura district; factor sources not detailed in the abstract.
ab350b2a9fb5889c6175313a9f708bdb626611b5.result: XGBoost and the voting ensemble score best (accuracy 0.957, F1 0.958); 41.81% of the district has very low and 24.35% very high potential.
ab350b2a9fb5889c6175313a9f708bdb626611b5.open_work: Apply the approach to other regions with similar hydrogeology and refine uncertainty-aware management zoning.
ab350b2a9fb5889c6175313a9f708bdb626611b5.issues: Very small sample of 161 points; potential mapping is a static classification without groundwater level dynamics; prediction uncertainty reaches 0.75 in places.

cb334d7337293cb31dff9e36052673639c08932a.goal: Forecast groundwater levels in the over-exploited Ergene River Basin, Türkiye, for sustainable aquifer management.
cb334d7337293cb31dff9e36052673639c08932a.architecture: Ensemble combining shallow machine learning and deep learning models, tuned with the coronavirus herd immunity optimizer (CHIO) metaheuristic; input lags chosen by partial autocorrelation and gamma test.
cb334d7337293cb31dff9e36052673639c08932a.data: Weekly groundwater levels from four wells, 1966–2023, split 70% training and 30% testing under short- and long-term scenarios.
cb334d7337293cb31dff9e36052673639c08932a.result: Deep models beat shallow ones (R2 about 0.99, RMSE about 0.5 m), and the ensemble outperforms all individual models.
cb334d7337293cb31dff9e36052673639c08932a.open_work: Apply the ensemble to other aquifers and include climate and pumping drivers.
cb334d7337293cb31dff9e36052673639c08932a.issues: Only four wells; near-perfect R2 from autoregressive inputs may overstate skill; univariate lag inputs ignore external forcing.

8a2c9d32f6d560b06857a13b3c37c503e0eb3227.goal: Resolve local terrestrial and groundwater storage decline across the Indus Basin, which coarse GRACE data cannot show, and attribute it to climatic versus human stressors.
8a2c9d32f6d560b06857a13b3c37c503e0eb3227.architecture: Statistical downscaling with a geographically weighted random forest to 1 km, followed by a generalized additive model for attribution.
8a2c9d32f6d560b06857a13b3c37c503e0eb3227.data: GRACE terrestrial water storage, 2002–2023, downscaled to 1 km; in-situ groundwater storage from 2,200 monitoring wells for validation.
8a2c9d32f6d560b06857a13b3c37c503e0eb3227.result: Downscaling improves agreement with wells (KGE 0.50–0.85, r 0.60–0.95); Delhi Doab declines at -442/-585 mm/year (TWS/GWS); 47–83% of decline is anthropogenic in hotspots.
8a2c9d32f6d560b06857a13b3c37c503e0eb3227.open_work: Use the 1 km storage maps for place-based water management and extend attribution to more stressors.
8a2c9d32f6d560b06857a13b3c37c503e0eb3227.issues: Downscaled values cannot add information beyond GRACE's native signal; attribution with an additive model is correlative, not causal.

e6b9392ff2c5f48e571288b701b5d98a902f8beb.goal: Predict river water levels and floods 12 h ahead, with emphasis on extreme events, for flood warning.
e6b9392ff2c5f48e571288b701b5d98a902f8beb.architecture: Hydro-Informer: a hybrid of recurrent neural network, convolutional neural network and multi-head attention layers, trained with a ladder technique and a custom extreme-focused loss.
e6b9392ff2c5f48e571288b701b5d98a902f8beb.data: Slovak Hydrometeorological Institute (SHMI) precipitation, water level and discharge data, 2008–2020.
e6b9392ff2c5f48e571288b701b5d98a902f8beb.result: Reaches R2 = 0.88 and predicts extreme water levels 12 h in advance on an unregulated river.
e6b9392ff2c5f48e571288b701b5d98a902f8beb.open_work: Integrate more data sources to build an operational flood warning system.
e6b9392ff2c5f48e571288b701b5d98a902f8beb.issues: Single unregulated river setting; not tested where dams or structures modify flow; few extreme events available.

14bd87f5dbb19b37a800e98dc2d31cad5cda6624.goal: Forecast daily streamflow in river source regions of the eastern Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and explain which drivers control skill under climate change.
14bd87f5dbb19b37a800e98dc2d31cad5cda6624.architecture: Hybrid explainable CNN-LSTM-Attention model (convolutional neural network, LSTM and attention), compared with a plain LSTM.
14bd87f5dbb19b37a800e98dc2d31cad5cda6624.data: Daily hydrometeorological data and base flow for five typical basins of the eastern Qinghai-Tibet Plateau; period not reported in the abstract.
14bd87f5dbb19b37a800e98dc2d31cad5cda6624.result: NSE 0.79–0.92 and R2 0.81–0.93, better than LSTM; adding base flow as input clearly improves high flows, especially in mixed-flow basins.
14bd87f5dbb19b37a800e98dc2d31cad5cda6624.open_work: Extend to longer lead times and other cold-region basins with snow and glacier melt.
14bd87f5dbb19b37a800e98dc2d31cad5cda6624.issues: Five basins only; interpretability of attention is limited; base flow input requires prior separation.

75e22d9dd4c6ca30ee52bcd8571723957bf8e3d8.goal: Build a fast, transferable flood surrogate that overcomes limits of hydraulic graph neural networks: varying propagation speeds, deep-layer instability, time-varying boundaries and solver-provided initial conditions.
75e22d9dd4c6ca30ee52bcd8571723957bf8e3d8.architecture: Multi-scale hydraulic-based graph neural network (mSWE-GNN) inspired by shallow water equations, with ghost cells for time-varying boundary conditions and rotation-invariant inputs.
75e22d9dd4c6ca30ee52bcd8571723957bf8e3d8.data: Numerical dike-breach flood simulations on irregular meshes and topographies; a realistic case study in the Netherlands.
75e22d9dd4c6ca30ee52bcd8571723957bf8e3d8.result: Water depth MAE 0.05 m on unseen meshes; in the Dutch case, MAE 0.12 m, CSI 87.68% at 0.05 m, with one fine-tuning sample and over 700x speed-up.
75e22d9dd4c6ca30ee52bcd8571723957bf8e3d8.open_work: Use the model for probabilistic analyses of realistic configurations and flood scenarios.
75e22d9dd4c6ca30ee52bcd8571723957bf8e3d8.issues: Trained on numerical simulations, so it inherits their assumptions; limited to dike-breach floods; not validated against observed floods.

e026732686944c9438ac0ec7ce9461c1061ca51d.goal: Provide accurate, continuous, high-resolution global crop yield data for maize, rice, wheat and soybean to assess risks to food systems.
e026732686944c9438ac0ec7ce9461c1061ca51d.architecture: Dataset paper (GlobalCropYield5min): three machine learning models per country and crop with predictor selection; specific model types not named in the abstract.
e026732686944c9438ac0ec7ce9461c1061ca51d.data: Crop statistics from about 12,000 administrative units with satellite data, climate variables, soil properties, agricultural practices and climate modes; 1982–2015, 5 arc-minutes.
e026732686944c9438ac0ec7ce9461c1061ca51d.result: R2 0.70–0.95 and RMSE 0.16–1.1 t/ha (NRMSE 5–20%); outperforms other global yield datasets in resolution, coverage and accuracy.
e026732686944c9438ac0ec7ce9461c1061ca51d.open_work: Extend beyond 2015 and use the data to study climate-crop yield interactions and disaster risk.
e026732686944c9438ac0ec7ce9461c1061ca51d.issues: Grid-cell yields are model estimates calibrated on administrative statistics, so within-unit patterns are not directly validated; accuracy varies by country.

ab80c7a1008f7fbf2163dd7609455deb6628878f.goal: Forecast hourly solar irradiance for solar energy integration.
ab80c7a1008f7fbf2163dd7609455deb6628878f.architecture: U-LSTM-AFT hybrid model built around an LSTM, per the title; the other components are not specified in the available metadata.
ab80c7a1008f7fbf2163dd7609455deb6628878f.data: Hourly solar irradiance data; sites and period not reported.
ab80c7a1008f7fbf2163dd7609455deb6628878f.result: Not reported; the abstract is unavailable.
ab80c7a1008f7fbf2163dd7609455deb6628878f.open_work: Test across climates and seasons and add probabilistic forecasts.
ab80c7a1008f7fbf2163dd7609455deb6628878f.issues: Details of evaluation, baselines and generalization are unknown without the abstract.

f32448fed3a013951f3f0c2847db63e78ba22796.goal: Improve short-term wind power prediction by combining numerical weather predictions with deep learning.
f32448fed3a013951f3f0c2847db63e78ba22796.architecture: Residual convolutional LSTM attention network (convolutional neural network, LSTM and attention), as stated in the title.
f32448fed3a013951f3f0c2847db63e78ba22796.data: Numerical weather prediction inputs and wind power records; farms and period not reported.
f32448fed3a013951f3f0c2847db63e78ba22796.result: Not reported; the abstract is unavailable.
f32448fed3a013951f3f0c2847db63e78ba22796.open_work: Test transfer across wind farms and add uncertainty quantification.
f32448fed3a013951f3f0c2847db63e78ba22796.issues: Skill depends on NWP input quality; evaluation details are unknown without the abstract.

8de8cb73156fbbc182f4685bdf414e4c12c4e635.goal: Overcome scarce measured data for flood forecasting by training LSTM networks on a mix of measured and physically simulated flood data.
8de8cb73156fbbc182f4685bdf414e4c12c4e635.architecture: Multi-layer LSTM trained on measured, simulated or mixed data; simulations from the NAM hydrological model and the HD hydraulic model (MIKE suite, non-ML).
8de8cb73156fbbc182f4685bdf414e4c12c4e635.data: Measured and NAM/HD-simulated flood series for the Jinhua basin, a plains river area in China; period not reported in the abstract.
8de8cb73156fbbc182f4685bdf414e4c12c4e635.result: LSTMs trained on mixed data with a simulated-to-measured ratio below 2:1 achieve the lowest RMSE and MAE, outperforming larger simulated ratios.
8de8cb73156fbbc182f4685bdf414e4c12c4e635.open_work: Apply the approach to real-time flood prediction in other flood-prone regions.
8de8cb73156fbbc182f4685bdf414e4c12c4e635.issues: Depends on the quality of simulated data and adds computational complexity, as the authors note; single basin.

35456334db4ed3cced3933cc0450478b9d904d96.goal: Predict winter wheat yield across climatic zones of the USA where training data are scarce, using transfer learning.
35456334db4ed3cced3933cc0450478b9d904d96.architecture: Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) with deep transfer learning strategies: TrAdaBoost.R2 (and two-stage version), fine-tuning and a domain-adversarial neural network.
35456334db4ed3cced3933cc0450478b9d904d96.data: Climate records and satellite image time series with US winter wheat yields; specific products not named in the abstract.
35456334db4ed3cced3933cc0450478b9d904d96.result: Transfer learning reduces MAE by 9–28% versus the baseline; two-stage TrAdaBoost.R2 with fine-tuning performs best.
35456334db4ed3cced3933cc0450478b9d904d96.open_work: Extend the transfer strategies to other crops and regions with sparse data.
35456334db4ed3cced3933cc0450478b9d904d96.issues: Transfer tested within the USA only; benefits outside similar agricultural systems are untested.

39d80f849cbc806a14c07e4bd3cc7c44db68cc51.goal: Predict wind speed across China with deep learning for wind energy applications.
39d80f849cbc806a14c07e4bd3cc7c44db68cc51.architecture: Fully convolutional deep neural network, as stated in the title.
39d80f849cbc806a14c07e4bd3cc7c44db68cc51.data: Wind speed data over China; sources and period not reported.
39d80f849cbc806a14c07e4bd3cc7c44db68cc51.result: Not reported; the abstract is unavailable.
39d80f849cbc806a14c07e4bd3cc7c44db68cc51.open_work: Extend lead times and evaluate for wind power applications.
39d80f849cbc806a14c07e4bd3cc7c44db68cc51.issues: Details of evaluation and baselines are unknown without the abstract.

c82f0fa77e41c848f9adeb96b94fa5c0ac5fabe7.goal: Forecast groundwater levels by combining signal decomposition with recurrent neural networks.
c82f0fa77e41c848f9adeb96b94fa5c0ac5fabe7.architecture: Empirical mode decomposition and wavelet transform preprocessing combined with LSTM networks, as stated in the title.
c82f0fa77e41c848f9adeb96b94fa5c0ac5fabe7.data: Groundwater level records; wells, region and period not reported.
c82f0fa77e41c848f9adeb96b94fa5c0ac5fabe7.result: Not reported; the abstract is unavailable.
c82f0fa77e41c848f9adeb96b94fa5c0ac5fabe7.open_work: Test at more wells and with climate and pumping inputs.
c82f0fa77e41c848f9adeb96b94fa5c0ac5fabe7.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if decomposition uses future data; evaluation details are unknown without the abstract.

2dd550f7f1a0600575140bbfa3ca51bc1ac6caae.goal: Forecast streamflow 24 h ahead and test whether transformers, rarely used for this task, beat recurrent models.
2dd550f7f1a0600575140bbfa3ca51bc1ac6caae.architecture: Compares persistence, LSTM, Seq2Seq, GRU and transformer models, with zero-padding and persistence data extension methods.
2dd550f7f1a0600575140bbfa3ca51bc1ac6caae.data: Streamflow data from four regions; gauges and period not reported in the abstract.
2dd550f7f1a0600575140bbfa3ca51bc1ac6caae.result: The transformer outperforms all other models, improving NSE by up to 20%.
2dd550f7f1a0600575140bbfa3ca51bc1ac6caae.open_work: Apply transformers more widely in hydrological forecasting for water management and flood prediction.
2dd550f7f1a0600575140bbfa3ca51bc1ac6caae.issues: Only four regions; extreme-flow performance and uncertainty are not reported.

bce78b4ce12e0ba063f0337dfbafd4425ad7398c.goal: Downscale satellite soil moisture to 1 km in the water-scarce Urmia basin, Iran, for local-scale studies.
bce78b4ce12e0ba063f0337dfbafd4425ad7398c.architecture: Stacking ensemble of random forest, gradient boosting and XGBoost base learners selected from ten models via COPRAS, with XGBoost or gradient boosting meta-models; SHAP for interpretation.
bce78b4ce12e0ba063f0337dfbafd4425ad7398c.data: SMAP and AMSR2 soil moisture, MODIS land surface temperature and vegetation indices, precipitation, topography, and in-situ TDR soil moisture.
bce78b4ce12e0ba063f0337dfbafd4425ad7398c.result: The stacking ensemble reaches ubRMSE 1.23% m3/m3 and R2 0.97 in testing, beating individual models.
bce78b4ce12e0ba063f0337dfbafd4425ad7398c.open_work: Apply the framework to other water-stressed regions and longer periods.
bce78b4ce12e0ba063f0337dfbafd4425ad7398c.issues: Single basin with limited in-situ sites; R2 of 0.97 may reflect spatial autocorrelation between training and test points.

3b4dd6adc1f6dc17412b2c6cab506aab86ac6abe.goal: Project how climate change alters flood susceptibility in six South Asian countries under SSP scenarios.
3b4dd6adc1f6dc17412b2c6cab506aab86ac6abe.architecture: Machine learning classifiers: K-nearest neighbor, conditional inference random forest and regularized random forest.
3b4dd6adc1f6dc17412b2c6cab506aab86ac6abe.data: 2,452 historical flood events with monthly, seasonal and annual climatic variables (eight precipitation factors); SSP1-2.6 and SSP5-8.5 projections for 2041–2060 and 2081–2100.
3b4dd6adc1f6dc17412b2c6cab506aab86ac6abe.result: Regularized random forest is most accurate (AUC 0.94); warmest-quarter, annual and wettest-month precipitation dominate; high-susceptibility areas shift by scenario and period.
3b4dd6adc1f6dc17412b2c6cab506aab86ac6abe.open_work: Use the maps for regional flood risk management and add land use and socioeconomic change.
3b4dd6adc1f6dc17412b2c6cab506aab86ac6abe.issues: Susceptibility is statistical, not hydrodynamic; assumes present relationships hold under future climate; inherits climate model biases.

bd51e0f12090103b23eb3649241ad804571e9dca.goal: Detect and map floods precisely from multi-temporal SAR imagery through change analysis.
bd51e0f12090103b23eb3649241ad804571e9dca.architecture: Semantic token-based transformer for change detection, as stated in the title.
bd51e0f12090103b23eb3649241ad804571e9dca.data: Multi-temporal synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery; sensors and sites not reported.
bd51e0f12090103b23eb3649241ad804571e9dca.result: Not reported; the abstract is unavailable.
bd51e0f12090103b23eb3649241ad804571e9dca.open_work: Extend to urban and vegetated floods and operational rapid mapping.
bd51e0f12090103b23eb3649241ad804571e9dca.issues: Details of evaluation and generalization are unknown without the abstract.

dd11cc3f68c1f8576a83172bdbbc1532e553c853.goal: Review machine learning approaches for flood depth estimation, as traditional methods fall short of current needs.
dd11cc3f68c1f8576a83172bdbbc1532e553c853.architecture: Review of 108 studies on single and hybrid machine learning models for flood depth estimation, including links to smart cities and large AI models.
dd11cc3f68c1f8576a83172bdbbc1532e553c853.data: Literature corpus of 108 studies, with statistics on models and main data sources.
dd11cc3f68c1f8576a83172bdbbc1532e553c853.result: Machine learning handles large, nonlinear data well and hybrid models improve accuracy, but data dependency, interpretability and transferability remain challenges.
dd11cc3f68c1f8576a83172bdbbc1532e553c853.open_work: Integrate machine learning with smart city frameworks and large AI models for flood depth calculation.
dd11cc3f68c1f8576a83172bdbbc1532e553c853.issues: Review scope; quantitative comparison across studies is limited by heterogeneous data and metrics.

8e3f784b41295cd8321016f33508f82194570764.goal: Improve monthly precipitation prediction in Rabat, Morocco, with machine learning.
8e3f784b41295cd8321016f33508f82194570764.architecture: Decision tree, random forest, KNN, AdaBoost, XGBoost and LSTM, plus a multi-view stacking ensemble with XGBoost as the second-level learner.
8e3f784b41295cd8321016f33508f82194570764.data: Monthly lagged meteorological variables and rainfall for Rabat, 1993–2018.
8e3f784b41295cd8321016f33508f82194570764.result: XGBoost is the best single model (RMSE 40.8 mm); stacking decision tree, KNN and LSTM with XGBoost lowers RMSE to 17.5 mm.
8e3f784b41295cd8321016f33508f82194570764.open_work: Test the stacking approach at other stations and for seasonal lead times.
8e3f784b41295cd8321016f33508f82194570764.issues: Single station with a short record; the large stacking gain may reflect overfitting and needs independent validation.

6b9ac0424117863f9126695c67fe792b516dc16e.goal: Improve short-term sea surface temperature prediction by capturing complex spatial relationships beyond local convolution.
6b9ac0424117863f9126695c67fe792b516dc16e.architecture: DatLSTM: ConvLSTM with an integrated deformable attention transformer module.
6b9ac0424117863f9126695c67fe792b516dc16e.data: SST data for the Bohai Sea; product and period not reported in the abstract.
6b9ac0424117863f9126695c67fe792b516dc16e.result: Outperforms ConvLSTM, PredRNN, TCTN and SwinLSTM for 1–10 day SST forecasts on multiple metrics.
6b9ac0424117863f9126695c67fe792b516dc16e.open_work: Apply the method to other spatiotemporal prediction tasks in meteorology, oceanography and climate.
6b9ac0424117863f9126695c67fe792b516dc16e.issues: Single semi-enclosed sea; no quantitative skill given in the abstract; no comparison with ocean model forecasts.

71d68d23c5398f61f0ccdb8ecabdc2a5e6908a27.goal: Build an accurate, physically consistent surrogate of river channel flow for real-time flood control and reservoir management.
71d68d23c5398f61f0ccdb8ecabdc2a5e6908a27.architecture: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) constrained by the Saint-Venant equations, also used for parameter identification.
71d68d23c5398f61f0ccdb8ecabdc2a5e6908a27.data: Simulated environment from a Saint-Venant equation configuration of a river channel.
71d68d23c5398f61f0ccdb8ecabdc2a5e6908a27.result: PINNs give promising prediction accuracy and parameter identification for hydrological modelling.
71d68d23c5398f61f0ccdb8ecabdc2a5e6908a27.open_work: Use the surrogate in real-time optimal control and assimilate real measurements.
71d68d23c5398f61f0ccdb8ecabdc2a5e6908a27.issues: Evaluated only in a simulated setting; no quantitative results in the abstract.
