26ace663fb51d99c01a2469f283fa06f53261c46.architecture: Systematic review comparing statistical (linear, regularized, nonlinear regression) and machine learning models (mainly random forest and other tree-based methods).
26ace663fb51d99c01a2469f283fa06f53261c46.data: 38 studies with 46 model comparisons (30 NO2, 8 UFP, 8 BC) from Web of Science and Scopus up to June 2024.
26ace663fb51d99c01a2469f283fa06f53261c46.result: ML outperforms statistical models in 34 of 46 comparisons, with mean R2 gain 0.12 and RMSE reduction 20%; tree-based methods are best in 12 of 17 multi-model comparisons.
26ace663fb51d99c01a2469f283fa06f53261c46.open_work: More comparisons with nonlinear, regularized and wider ML methods, and standardized reporting of methods and results.
26ace663fb51d99c01a2469f283fa06f53261c46.issues: Nonlinear and regularized regressions were rare and performed similarly to ML; heterogeneous study designs limit pooled conclusions.

38958c8e2d362255c56188693ed4c30d1ec3260b.goal: Produces high-resolution groundwater storage anomalies from coarse GRACE/GRACE-FO data to study local drought effects in a data-scarce region.
38958c8e2d362255c56188693ed4c30d1ec3260b.architecture: Random forest and XGBoost downscaling models with data normalization, hydrometeorological interaction features and time-series split cross-validation.
38958c8e2d362255c56188693ed4c30d1ec3260b.data: GRACE/GRACE-FO terrestrial water storage anomalies, vegetation cover, land surface temperature, precipitation, evapotranspiration and in-situ groundwater levels, downscaled to 5 km.
38958c8e2d362255c56188693ed4c30d1ec3260b.result: NSE 0.867 (random forest) and 0.791 (XGBoost); downscaled GWSA shows declining storage, and El Nino droughts lengthen groundwater recovery.
38958c8e2d362255c56188693ed4c30d1ec3260b.open_work: Using projected drought severity to assess future groundwater recovery and adaptation strategies.
38958c8e2d362255c56188693ed4c30d1ec3260b.issues: Downscaling skill limited by sparse well data; the coarse GRACE signal constrains true resolvable detail.

5a260f4983192dc9daa5e8d2f1f0dcec3e16e374.goal: Maps flooded areas with multi-source remote sensing and assesses the robustness of predictor variables.
5a260f4983192dc9daa5e8d2f1f0dcec3e16e374.architecture: Random forest classification using multi-source predictors with analysis of variable importance and robustness.
5a260f4983192dc9daa5e8d2f1f0dcec3e16e374.data: Multi-source remote sensing inputs (sensors and sites not available, no abstract).
5a260f4983192dc9daa5e8d2f1f0dcec3e16e374.result: Not reported; the study evaluates which predictors are robust for flood mapping.
5a260f4983192dc9daa5e8d2f1f0dcec3e16e374.open_work: Transferring the classifier to other flood events and sensors.
5a260f4983192dc9daa5e8d2f1f0dcec3e16e374.issues: Card based on the title only; random forest importance can be unstable with correlated predictors.

8c5436d84959221820030bb05dc6ea9a9c86f809.goal: Provides a global 10 km gridded crop production dataset (GGCP10) for maize, wheat, rice and soybean, 2010-2020, to overcome coarse and discontinuous existing products.
8c5436d84959221820030bb05dc6ea9a9c86f809.architecture: Dataset produced by adaptively trained data-driven crop production estimation models per agroecological zone, calibrated to regional statistics; model type is not specified in the abstract.
8c5436d84959221820030bb05dc6ea9a9c86f809.data: Statistical and gridded production data, agroclimatic and agronomic indicators, global land surface satellite products and ground data.
8c5436d84959221820030bb05dc6ea9a9c86f809.result: Cross-validation and evaluation against gridded, survey and statistical data show good accuracy; the dataset reveals spatiotemporal patterns of global crop production.
8c5436d84959221820030bb05dc6ea9a9c86f809.open_work: Extending the record beyond 2020 and to more crops.
8c5436d84959221820030bb05dc6ea9a9c86f809.issues: Calibration to statistics propagates errors in census data; accuracy in regions with poor statistics is uncertain.

aa13592e3a617399b9f23c727e96197a3a6133e6.goal: Provides a CAMELS-style large-sample hydrology dataset for Peninsular India to enable data-driven and comparative hydrological studies.
aa13592e3a617399b9f23c727e96197a3a6133e6.architecture: Benchmark dataset of catchment attributes and hydrometeorological time series, including streamflow simulated by a regionally trained LSTM.
aa13592e3a617399b9f23c727e96197a3a6133e6.data: 472 catchments (228 with observed streamflow over 30% of 1980-2020), 19 meteorological forcings, 211 attributes from ground, remote sensing and reanalysis sources, India-WRIS streamflow.
aa13592e3a617399b9f23c727e96197a3a6133e6.result: The dataset follows CAMELS standards and includes human-influence attributes such as dams and land-use change, plus LSTM streamflow for gap filling and benchmarking.
aa13592e3a617399b9f23c727e96197a3a6133e6.open_work: Community studies of Indian catchment hydrology, extremes and climate change impacts.
aa13592e3a617399b9f23c727e96197a3a6133e6.issues: Many gauges have gaps and strong regulation by dams; LSTM-simulated streamflow should not be treated as observations.

b637a445d1c2fb3bb4741391c6dbfc8fabdf17ae.goal: Identifies controlling factors of watershed streamflow variability and separates climate and land-use contributions.
b637a445d1c2fb3bb4741391c6dbfc8fabdf17ae.architecture: XGBoost and random forest built on SWAT inputs and outputs, interpreted with SHAP, plus scenario simulations.
b637a445d1c2fb3bb4741391c6dbfc8fabdf17ae.data: SWAT model inputs and outputs for a watershed; location and period are not reported in the abstract.
b637a445d1c2fb3bb4741391c6dbfc8fabdf17ae.result: XGBoost beats random forest; area and precipitation dominate, with threshold effects of land use; land-use change explains 55.71% and climate 44.27% of streamflow change.
b637a445d1c2fb3bb4741391c6dbfc8fabdf17ae.open_work: Testing thresholds in other watersheds and with observed rather than simulated data.
b637a445d1c2fb3bb4741391c6dbfc8fabdf17ae.issues: ML learns from SWAT outputs, so conclusions inherit SWAT structure and calibration; SHAP interactions are not causal.

fe268f7feab07c94397fd1eabcc67e8631fb59fc.goal: Reviews the development of ensemble machine learning approaches in water resources management.
fe268f7feab07c94397fd1eabcc67e8631fb59fc.architecture: Review of ensemble ML methods (e.g. bagging, boosting, stacking) applied to water resources problems.
fe268f7feab07c94397fd1eabcc67e8631fb59fc.data: Literature on ensemble ML in hydrology and water management; details are not available (no abstract).
fe268f7feab07c94397fd1eabcc67e8631fb59fc.open_work: Not reported; likely includes uncertainty quantification and physically informed ensembles.
fe268f7feab07c94397fd1eabcc67e8631fb59fc.issues: Card based on the title only; coverage and conclusions are unknown.

f19d1010dc8dd0d338ca0e543d47f3e21919970e.goal: Refines CMIP6 projections of maximum and minimum temperature and precipitation over the Middle East.
f19d1010dc8dd0d338ca0e543d47f3e21919970e.architecture: Stacking-EML: stacking ensemble combining five machine learning base models with three meta-learners.
f19d1010dc8dd0d338ca0e543d47f3e21919970e.data: CMIP6 simulations under SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5 with observational references for the Middle East.
f19d1010dc8dd0d338ca0e543d47f3e21919970e.result: R2 rises to 0.99 for Tmax, 0.98 for Tmin and 0.82 for precipitation; under SSP5-8.5 southern summer temperatures exceed 45 C, with the largest heat and drought impacts in Saudi Arabia, Oman, Yemen and Iran.
f19d1010dc8dd0d338ca0e543d47f3e21919970e.open_work: Evaluating extremes and non-stationarity of the learned corrections in future climates.
f19d1010dc8dd0d338ca0e543d47f3e21919970e.issues: Statistical corrections trained on historical period assume stationarity; high R2 may reflect seasonal cycle; extremes not assessed.

fbfab6d16e3126719cecd817b81970f9fa9fa969.goal: Improves oil spill drift prediction by correcting numerically forecasted sea surface dynamic fields toward more accurate but delayed reanalyses.
fbfab6d16e3126719cecd817b81970f9fa9fa969.architecture: Adversarial temporal convolutional network (ATCN): a TCN-based corrector trained with a discriminator in a GAN-style setup.
fbfab6d16e3126719cecd817b81970f9fa9fa969.data: Numerical forecasts and reanalyses of sea surface dynamic fields, plus a new oil spill drift dataset from the Symphony and Sanchi accidents with remote sensing observations.
fbfab6d16e3126719cecd817b81970f9fa9fa969.result: Corrected fields improve oil spill drift prediction on the Symphony and Sanchi cases.
fbfab6d16e3126719cecd817b81970f9fa9fa969.open_work: Testing on more spill events and regions and propagating correction uncertainty into drift ensembles.
fbfab6d16e3126719cecd817b81970f9fa9fa969.issues: Only two accidents for evaluation; targets are reanalyses, not observations of currents and winds.

8d77a200dfb970a0139f221a2487dc778417307f.goal: Speeds up urban flood modeling at metropolitan scales with a machine learning surrogate of hydrodynamic models.
8d77a200dfb970a0139f221a2487dc778417307f.architecture: Machine learning surrogate of a physics-based flood model; the ML model type is not specified here.
8d77a200dfb970a0139f221a2487dc778417307f.data: Simulations from a hydrodynamic urban flood model for a metropolitan area; details are not available (no abstract).
8d77a200dfb970a0139f221a2487dc778417307f.result: Not reported; the title implies large computational savings with acceptable accuracy.
8d77a200dfb970a0139f221a2487dc778417307f.open_work: Extending to real-time forecasting and unseen storm types.
8d77a200dfb970a0139f221a2487dc778417307f.issues: Card based on the title only; surrogates inherit the physics model's errors and may fail outside the training scenarios.

0e095632929fc70134330978ae90262db1a7926e.goal: Automates identification of flood-prone areas in a data-scarce mountainous watershed.
0e095632929fc70134330978ae90262db1a7926e.architecture: Random forest, gradient boosting, AdaBoost and an RF-GB ensemble for flood susceptibility, with SHAP explanations; flood inventory from NDFI in Google Earth Engine.
0e095632929fc70134330978ae90262db1a7926e.data: NDFI-derived flood inventory and 17 conditioning factors (topographic indices, rainfall, lithology, NDVI, land use, distances to rivers and roads).
0e095632929fc70134330978ae90262db1a7926e.result: Random forest reaches AUC of 1, RF-GB 0.96, gradient boosting 0.95 and AdaBoost 0.83; SHAP identifies the main contributing factors.
0e095632929fc70134330978ae90262db1a7926e.open_work: Validating the NDFI inventory against field data and applying it to other basins.
0e095632929fc70134330978ae90262db1a7926e.issues: AUC of 1 suggests overfitting or spatial autocorrelation between training and test points; single watershed.

95e830906563cbd07cfda415beac2d6072130393.goal: Improves PV power prediction by integrating meteorological data and feature selection into regression models.
95e830906563cbd07cfda415beac2d6072130393.architecture: Feature selection (Pearson, VIF, mutual information, sequential selection, RFE, embedded) combined with linear, ridge, LASSO, Elastic Net, extra trees, random forest, gradient boosting and XGBoost regressors and a hybrid ensemble.
95e830906563cbd07cfda415beac2d6072130393.data: DKASC Hanwha Solar dataset (Desert Knowledge Australia Solar Centre) with PV power and sensor meteorological variables.
95e830906563cbd07cfda415beac2d6072130393.result: The XGBoost + extra trees + gradient boosting hybrid is best, with RMSE 0.1087 and R2 0.996.
95e830906563cbd07cfda415beac2d6072130393.open_work: Extending to forecast (not nowcast) horizons using NWP inputs and other sites.
95e830906563cbd07cfda415beac2d6072130393.issues: Single site; uses concurrent measured meteorology, so it estimates rather than forecasts power.

d529fc8f8732aa38aa8bfba7b50b28974b233b04.goal: Evaluates accuracy and scalability of machine learning for flood susceptibility mapping in high-risk regions of Pakistan.
d529fc8f8732aa38aa8bfba7b50b28974b233b04.architecture: Comparison of 14 ML models including LightGBM, XGBoost and random forest, with explainable AI to identify conditioning factors.
d529fc8f8732aa38aa8bfba7b50b28974b233b04.data: Flood inventory and conditioning factors for high-risk areas of Pakistan; specific sources are not reported in the abstract.
d529fc8f8732aa38aa8bfba7b50b28974b233b04.result: LightGBM and XGBoost are most accurate; XGBoost scales best with about 18 s prediction time versus 22 s for LightGBM and 31 s for random forest.
d529fc8f8732aa38aa8bfba7b50b28974b233b04.open_work: Applying the framework to other flood-prone regions and larger domains.
d529fc8f8732aa38aa8bfba7b50b28974b233b04.issues: Accuracy metrics are not given in the abstract; susceptibility maps depend on inventory quality and spatial sampling.

677f01090daf5ded8e1af6c39787d7866f676d57.goal: Improves day-ahead PV power forecasts beyond NWP limits by classifying weather patterns and building class-specific models.
677f01090daf5ded8e1af6c39787d7866f676d57.architecture: Weather classification by K-means, SOM, time-based, PSO/GWO threshold-based and season-based clustering, followed by XGBoost, GRU and transformer forecasters.
677f01090daf5ded8e1af6c39787d7866f676d57.data: PV power and weather data from a case study in Taiwan; details are not reported in the abstract.
677f01090daf5ded8e1af6c39787d7866f676d57.result: Weather classification with a transformer model gives the best deterministic and probabilistic day-ahead forecasts; time- and season-based classes capture specific climate characteristics.
677f01090daf5ded8e1af6c39787d7866f676d57.open_work: Extending to more plants and combining classifications with improved NWP inputs.
677f01090daf5ded8e1af6c39787d7866f676d57.issues: Single-region case study; gains from classification may shrink with larger training sets.

fcbbf9f21c2ca7a74f27fe7364d6ed36acc53417.goal: Improves runoff prediction by combining signal decomposition with deep sequence models.
fcbbf9f21c2ca7a74f27fe7364d6ed36acc53417.architecture: Singular spectrum analysis preprocessing with a bidirectional temporal convolutional network (BiTCN) and self-attention.
fcbbf9f21c2ca7a74f27fe7364d6ed36acc53417.data: Runoff records for the study basin(s); details are not available (no abstract).
fcbbf9f21c2ca7a74f27fe7364d6ed36acc53417.result: Not reported; the title implies the SSA-enhanced BiTCN-self-attention model outperforms baselines.
fcbbf9f21c2ca7a74f27fe7364d6ed36acc53417.open_work: Testing on more basins and multi-step horizons.
fcbbf9f21c2ca7a74f27fe7364d6ed36acc53417.issues: Card based on the title only; decomposition over the whole series can leak future information if not applied in a causal way.

fffee82835eb8fd56121c3b524389fabbdd26600.goal: Improves flood forecasting by representing spatiotemporal inputs.
fffee82835eb8fd56121c3b524389fabbdd26600.architecture: Time-distributed CNN-LSTM network applying a CNN at each time step before LSTM sequence modeling.
fffee82835eb8fd56121c3b524389fabbdd26600.data: Hydrometeorological data for the study basin; details are not available (no abstract).
fffee82835eb8fd56121c3b524389fabbdd26600.result: Not reported; the title implies improved flood forecasts over standard models.
fffee82835eb8fd56121c3b524389fabbdd26600.open_work: Testing at longer lead times and on extreme events.
fffee82835eb8fd56121c3b524389fabbdd26600.issues: Card based on the title only; few extreme floods typically limit training.

bfe6a9934ae04aab279aa74df642ff7ca09af460.goal: Balances hydropower and downstream ecological flow and water temperature needs in reservoir operation.
bfe6a9934ae04aab279aa74df642ff7ca09af460.architecture: Hybrid LSTM and 1D CNN (LSTM_1DCNN) to simulate dam discharge temperature within a multi-objective simulation-optimization framework using an improved epsilon multi-objective ant colony optimizer.
bfe6a9934ae04aab279aa74df642ff7ca09af460.data: Operations and water temperature data from the Three Gorges Reservoir; periods are not reported in the abstract.
bfe6a9934ae04aab279aa74df642ff7ca09af460.result: LSTM_1DCNN outperforms competing models for discharge temperature; the optimizer yields Pareto solutions for dry, normal and wet years, revealing strong economic-ecological conflicts.
bfe6a9934ae04aab279aa74df642ff7ca09af460.open_work: Incorporating inflow forecast uncertainty and other ecological targets.
bfe6a9934ae04aab279aa74df642ff7ca09af460.issues: Single reservoir; the temperature surrogate may extrapolate poorly under operating policies far from historical ones.

64324b1134c232928b219ab2c8f99f9501c24972.goal: Improves short-term wind power forecasting by predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of wind field images.
64324b1134c232928b219ab2c8f99f9501c24972.architecture: Physics-constrained recurrent framework with a PhyCell learning PDE-like convection, diffusion and circulation terms, plus guided attention mapping wind field forecasts to power.
64324b1134c232928b219ab2c8f99f9501c24972.data: Wind field images and wind farm power data; sources are not reported in the abstract.
64324b1134c232928b219ab2c8f99f9501c24972.result: Wind field image forecast MAE drops by 9.23% on average and wind power normalized MAE by 5.23% relative to state-of-the-art methods.
64324b1134c232928b219ab2c8f99f9501c24972.open_work: Extending to longer horizons and multiple wind farms.
64324b1134c232928b219ab2c8f99f9501c24972.issues: Physical constraints are approximate; data sources and test periods are not described in the abstract.

c5114b1e558cb990e0ccdc113fedd89222e2036b.goal: Improves urban flood modeling by downscaling coarse global digital elevation models with deep learning.
c5114b1e558cb990e0ccdc113fedd89222e2036b.architecture: Deep learning super-resolution of DEMs; the network type is not specified here.
c5114b1e558cb990e0ccdc113fedd89222e2036b.data: Global DEMs and higher-resolution reference elevation for an urban area; sources are not available (no abstract).
c5114b1e558cb990e0ccdc113fedd89222e2036b.result: Not reported; the title implies downscaled DEMs improve flood model results relative to raw global DEMs.
c5114b1e558cb990e0ccdc113fedd89222e2036b.open_work: Testing transfer to other cities and data-poor regions.
c5114b1e558cb990e0ccdc113fedd89222e2036b.issues: Card based on the title only; urban features such as buildings and drainage are hard to recover from coarse DEMs.

04e95c3eb447b6cc9f9890c01cec277758a15629.goal: Tests whether AI weather models can forecast unprecedented, record-breaking heat, cold and wind extremes.
04e95c3eb447b6cc9f9890c01cec277758a15629.architecture: Verification study (not a new model) comparing ECMWF HRES with GraphCast, GraphCast operational, Pangu-Weather, Pangu-Weather operational and FuXi.
04e95c3eb447b6cc9f9890c01cec277758a15629.data: Forecasts from HRES and the AI models evaluated on record-breaking heat, cold and wind events; verification period details are not reported in the abstract.
04e95c3eb447b6cc9f9890c01cec277758a15629.result: HRES consistently outperforms all AI models for records at nearly all lead times; AI models underestimate record frequency and intensity, underpredicting hot and overestimating cold records with errors growing with exceedance.
04e95c3eb447b6cc9f9890c01cec277758a15629.open_work: Rigorous verification and model development to improve extrapolation before AI models are relied on for early warning.
04e95c3eb447b6cc9f9890c01cec277758a15629.issues: AI models trained on reanalysis cannot extrapolate beyond training range; newer probabilistic AI models are not included.

0da9a710f7896d44ebacd872c138f96f3d8955e0.goal: Reviews machine learning applications in ocean color remote sensing.
0da9a710f7896d44ebacd872c138f96f3d8955e0.architecture: Review of neural networks, deep learning and other ML applied to atmospheric correction, ocean color inversion, carbon cycle analysis and data reconstruction.
0da9a710f7896d44ebacd872c138f96f3d8955e0.data: Literature using ocean color satellite data and in-situ optical and biogeochemical measurements.
0da9a710f7896d44ebacd872c138f96f3d8955e0.result: ML improves accuracy, resolution and prediction of ocean properties across these tasks.
0da9a710f7896d44ebacd872c138f96f3d8955e0.open_work: Better generalization, efficient models and integration with real-time monitoring and climate models.
0da9a710f7896d44ebacd872c138f96f3d8955e0.issues: Model generalization and computational complexity remain challenges.

d36863a35eddcb7a554417abbefed5f2f63b2f41.goal: Reviews four decades of remote-sensing-based crop yield forecasting methods.
d36863a35eddcb7a554417abbefed5f2f63b2f41.architecture: Review of regression models, machine learning, semi-empirical models, crop model data assimilation and deep learning, with a method selection strategy.
d36863a35eddcb7a554417abbefed5f2f63b2f41.data: Literature using satellite observations for local to global yield estimation.
d36863a35eddcb7a554417abbefed5f2f63b2f41.result: Each approach has strengths and limits; integrating AI and remote sensing with process-based crop models via data assimilation is the most promising direction.
d36863a35eddcb7a554417abbefed5f2f63b2f41.open_work: Addressing spatiotemporal variability, environmental stresses and scalability for regional and global forecasts.

b80e3879a0e4c2c370ffd7ac3874c8e8c5215ad5.goal: Maps soil moisture at field scale by fusing drone-based sensors.
b80e3879a0e4c2c370ffd7ac3874c8e8c5215ad5.architecture: Deep learning fusion of drone ground-penetrating radar with RGB and thermal imagery; the network type is not specified here.
b80e3879a0e4c2c370ffd7ac3874c8e8c5215ad5.data: Drone GPR, RGB and thermal imagery with soil moisture reference data; site details are not available (no abstract).
b80e3879a0e4c2c370ffd7ac3874c8e8c5215ad5.result: Not reported; the title implies multi-modal fusion improves soil moisture mapping.
b80e3879a0e4c2c370ffd7ac3874c8e8c5215ad5.open_work: Testing across soils, crops and seasons.
b80e3879a0e4c2c370ffd7ac3874c8e8c5215ad5.issues: Card based on the title only; likely limited to a few fields and dates.

de33d8ec305e2e9386f9efabd279c9b7c6431adb.goal: Reviews foundation models for renewable generation and demand forecasting, mainly wind and solar.
de33d8ec305e2e9386f9efabd279c9b7c6431adb.architecture: Review of foundation model architectures (large-scale, domain-specific transformers), pretraining and finetuning strategies and data types.
de33d8ec305e2e9386f9efabd279c9b7c6431adb.data: Literature on foundation models for energy time series forecasting.
de33d8ec305e2e9386f9efabd279c9b7c6431adb.result: FMs advance multi-scale reconciliation and uncertainty quantification, but a gap remains between theory and practice.
de33d8ec305e2e9386f9efabd279c9b7c6431adb.open_work: Long-term and multivariate forecasting, embedding domain knowledge and handling intermittency.
de33d8ec305e2e9386f9efabd279c9b7c6431adb.issues: Field is young with few operational evaluations; comparisons across studies are limited.

75ef916853050918ca6815b125251471a685a24e.goal: Improves crop yield prediction with ensemble machine learning.
75ef916853050918ca6815b125251471a685a24e.architecture: Stacked ensemble with a decision tree meta-model over linear regression, Elastic Net, XGBoost, k-nearest neighbors, AdaBoost and random forest base learners.
75ef916853050918ca6815b125251471a685a24e.data: Crop yield data with agricultural, land and climatic predictors; source and region are not reported in the abstract.
75ef916853050918ca6815b125251471a685a24e.result: R2 of 0.98, MAE 7.20 t/ha and RMSE 124.78 t/ha, outperforming individual ML models.
75ef916853050918ca6815b125251471a685a24e.open_work: Validating on independent years and regions.
75ef916853050918ca6815b125251471a685a24e.issues: Large gap between MAE and RMSE suggests heavy outliers; data provenance and validation scheme are unclear.

d2b77e7e1bb5e3ebfacbd722d8ae2e65d4b3799e.goal: Tests satellite foundation-model embeddings for mapping urban air pollutants in a data-scarce Global South city.
d2b77e7e1bb5e3ebfacbd722d8ae2e65d4b3799e.architecture: Five ML regressors including support vector regression applied to 64-dimensional AlphaEarth Foundations embeddings, with SHAP analysis.
d2b77e7e1bb5e3ebfacbd722d8ae2e65d4b3799e.data: AlphaEarth embeddings (Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Landsat, ERA5-Land, GRACE, GEDI) and annual NO2, SO2, PM2.5, CO, O3 from Quito's REEMAQ network, 2017-2024.
d2b77e7e1bb5e3ebfacbd722d8ae2e65d4b3799e.result: SVR reaches R2 0.71 for NO2 and SO2, capturing COVID-19 reductions; PM2.5 and CO are moderate and O3 poor; few embedding bands dominate.
d2b77e7e1bb5e3ebfacbd722d8ae2e65d4b3799e.open_work: Applying to other cities and finer temporal resolution.
d2b77e7e1bb5e3ebfacbd722d8ae2e65d4b3799e.issues: Few monitoring stations and annual aggregation; embeddings are hard to interpret physically.

1d56384eceab0897beb072b12b190e682a7f6639.goal: Reviews AI models for estimating evapotranspiration as alternatives to data-hungry Penman-Monteith.
1d56384eceab0897beb072b12b190e682a7f6639.architecture: Review of neuron-based (neural networks), tree-based, kernel-based and hybrid ML models for ET.
1d56384eceab0897beb072b12b190e682a7f6639.data: Literature on AI-based ET estimation with meteorological inputs.
1d56384eceab0897beb072b12b190e682a7f6639.result: AI models capture nonlinear relationships and are promising, but face overfitting, interpretability and input selection issues.
1d56384eceab0897beb072b12b190e682a7f6639.open_work: Standardized inputs, better preprocessing and integration of hydrological, remote sensing and physical ET processes.

9e31cbb914a7883ab24c1d83b13e706348709744.goal: Reviews machine learning models for drought monitoring and forecasting.

b656918cba7a0cd29d0ba42aaaf41ac44c5ac136.architecture: Hybrid of machine learning and physics-based PV models; the ML model type is not specified here.
b656918cba7a0cd29d0ba42aaaf41ac44c5ac136.data: Climate projections and PV system data; details are not available (no abstract).

6d928bbf564c289c6f81da634b9f1352cd7cb68d.goal: Fills gaps in global precipitation fields and corrects satellite precipitation where rain-gauge networks are sparse, to improve gauge-adjusted estimates in the GPM era.
6d928bbf564c289c6f81da634b9f1352cd7cb68d.architecture: End-to-end neural network combined with regional-scale intelligent optimization and topographic analysis to merge multi-source precipitation data; the specific network type is not specified in the abstract.
6d928bbf564c289c6f81da634b9f1352cd7cb68d.data: Multi-source precipitation products including GPM-era satellite estimates and ground rain-gauge observations, with topographic information; exact products and periods are not reported in the abstract.
6d928bbf564c289c6f81da634b9f1352cd7cb68d.result: Raises the correlation of satellite precipitation with reference data from 0.66 to 0.77, with marked gains at high rain rates and over complex terrain.
6d928bbf564c289c6f81da634b9f1352cd7cb68d.open_work: Applying the reconstructed fields to storm monitoring and flood forecasting, especially in data-sparse mountainous regions.
6d928bbf564c289c6f81da634b9f1352cd7cb68d.issues: Validation relies on the same sparse gauges the method tries to compensate for; network design and uncertainty estimates are not described in the abstract.

2fc650371f0a9f3b800da30f0d56a9169e732971.goal: Reviews how urban PM2.5 concentrations are monitored by combining ground-based instruments, satellite retrievals, atmospheric models and machine learning.

2fc650371f0a9f3b800da30f0d56a9169e732971.data: Literature on ground stations, satellite aerosol products and model output used for urban PM2.5; specific datasets covered are not reported (no abstract).
2fc650371f0a9f3b800da30f0d56a9169e732971.result: Not reported (no abstract available); the title indicates a synthesis of recent advances in multi-source integration.

e005939e2342eb05ef11b93d6652ca634be7e83a.goal: Provides real-world benchmarking for causal discovery on time series, which is usually evaluated on synthetic data or few real examples.
e005939e2342eb05ef11b93d6652ca634be7e83a.architecture: Benchmark dataset: river discharge networks with causal ground-truth graphs built from station metadata and river topology; several causal discovery methods are evaluated on sampled subgraphs.
e005939e2342eb05ef11b93d6652ca634be7e83a.data: River discharge at 15-minute resolution, 2019–2023, from 666 stations in eastern Germany and 494 in Bavaria, plus an Elbe River flood event representing distribution shift.
e005939e2342eb05ef11b93d6652ca634be7e83a.result: Builds the largest in-the-wild causal discovery benchmark for time series to date and shows that existing causal discovery methods leave clear room for improvement on it.
e005939e2342eb05ef11b93d6652ca634be7e83a.open_work: Using the benchmark to drive new causal discovery methods and for related tasks such as time-series forecasting and anomaly detection.
e005939e2342eb05ef11b93d6652ca634be7e83a.issues: Ground-truth graphs come from river topology and may miss indirect or human-controlled links; limited to one region, one variable type and five years.

6842f0acd12e717bf930fc15b5770f1697c30bd6.goal: Improves the effective resolution of SMOS sea surface salinity so that mesoscale eddies and fronts can be resolved.
6842f0acd12e717bf930fc15b5770f1697c30bd6.architecture: S5R2 super-resolution network: a hybrid transformer-CNN with a land-filtering mechanism, plus a prior-knowledge-guided search for the best subset of input variables.
6842f0acd12e717bf930fc15b5770f1697c30bd6.data: SMOS L3 SSS at 1/4° fused with multivariate satellite observations, super-resolved to 1/12°; evaluated against L3/L4 SSS products, notably in the Kuroshio Extension and Gulf Stream.
6842f0acd12e717bf930fc15b5770f1697c30bd6.result: Beats existing L3 and L4 SSS products and standard super-resolution methods; RMSE drops 20% (Kuroshio Extension) and 60% (Gulf Stream) versus SMOS L3, and effective resolution improves from 100 km to 20–30 km.
6842f0acd12e717bf930fc15b5770f1697c30bd6.open_work: Near-real-time operational use and extension to other salinity missions and regions.
6842f0acd12e717bf930fc15b5770f1697c30bd6.issues: High-resolution targets and validation sources are not detailed in the abstract; regional evaluation focuses on two western boundary currents.

c24cec7059e6c33a71494668f732f26eb64550ea.goal: Captures multi-scale spatial and long-range temporal dependencies in weather data that local-smoothness spatio-temporal networks miss.
c24cec7059e6c33a71494668f732f26eb64550ea.architecture: Spatio-temporal transformer: a spatial transformer on meteorological graphs with global and local position encodings from geographic coordinates and geodesic distances, followed by a temporal transformer.
c24cec7059e6c33a71494668f732f26eb64550ea.data: Real weather station datasets; names, regions and periods are not reported in the abstract.
c24cec7059e6c33a71494668f732f26eb64550ea.result: Extensive experiments show the framework is effective and outperforms existing spatio-temporal baselines; no numbers are given in the abstract.
c24cec7059e6c33a71494668f732f26eb64550ea.open_work: Scaling to larger grids and longer lead times and comparing with global data-driven weather models.
c24cec7059e6c33a71494668f732f26eb64550ea.issues: Datasets, variables and lead times unspecified; no probabilistic output or physical consistency analysis mentioned.

54bf49862de36fde0e79adbedfb8318f2f7fb4f9.goal: Downscales GCM projections for climate impact and water resources assessment in Oman.
54bf49862de36fde0e79adbedfb8318f2f7fb4f9.architecture: Hybrid sequence-to-sequence deep learning model with a temporal convolutional network encoder and a transformer decoder, tuned with particle swarm optimization; compared with quantile mapping, random forest, LSTM and TCN. Downscaled outputs drive an HEC-HMS hydrological model.
54bf49862de36fde0e79adbedfb8318f2f7fb4f9.data: Fourteen CMIP6 GCMs ranked by Taylor diagram (IITM-ESM selected); station precipitation and temperature; HEC-HMS calibrated 1992–2006 and validated 2007–2011 for the Wadi Dayqah basin; SSP126, SSP245, SSP585.
54bf49862de36fde0e79adbedfb8318f2f7fb4f9.result: The hybrid model achieves NSE 0.907, RMSE 2.10, bias 0.63; SSP585 projects peak flows up to seven times the historical average while SSP126/245 project lower maximum streamflow.
54bf49862de36fde0e79adbedfb8318f2f7fb4f9.open_work: Using multi-GCM ensembles instead of a single model and extending to other arid basins.
54bf49862de36fde0e79adbedfb8318f2f7fb4f9.issues: Relies on one GCM, so projection uncertainty is underestimated; short calibration record; the stated far-future period appears to duplicate the mid-future one.

6896060f101b8ef76626cd7b4b6a133260d73f34.goal: Tests whether hybrid hydrological models that combine neural networks with process-based structures generalize better than pure LSTMs to extreme events.
6896060f101b8ef76626cd7b4b6a133260d73f34.architecture: Hybrid models coupling a data-driven network (LSTM) with a conceptual process-based rainfall–runoff structure, compared with a stand-alone LSTM network and process-based models.
6896060f101b8ef76626cd7b4b6a133260d73f34.data: Rainfall–runoff data with extreme hydrological events held out for testing; catchment dataset details are not given in the abstract.
6896060f101b8ef76626cd7b4b6a133260d73f34.result: Hybrid models perform similarly to the LSTM in most cases but give slightly lower errors in the most extreme cases and produce higher peak discharges.
6896060f101b8ef76626cd7b4b6a133260d73f34.open_work: Further tests of extrapolation under other conditions and of the interpretability of the hybrid internal states.
6896060f101b8ef76626cd7b4b6a133260d73f34.issues: Gains on extremes are small; extreme events are rare, so conclusions rest on few samples.

a146a6ffc3f5240104e33e2d78706081a1d51e4c.goal: Produces robust multi-step ultra-short-term photovoltaic power forecasts directly from satellite images and PV time series rather than pixel-level predictions.
a146a6ffc3f5240104e33e2d78706081a1d51e4c.architecture: Multimodal deep learning: ConvLSTM-RICNN (convolutional LSTM with region-of-interest CNN) encodes satellite images, fused with PV time series through deep canonical correlation analysis in a late-fusion scheme (DCCA-LF).
a146a6ffc3f5240104e33e2d78706081a1d51e4c.data: Himawari-8 satellite images and public BP Solar PV power data from Alice Springs, Australia, January 2020 to October 2022.
a146a6ffc3f5240104e33e2d78706081a1d51e4c.result: Achieves the best RMSE and MAE among compared state-of-the-art methods across cloud conditions with low complexity, and stays robust to noise and missing data.
a146a6ffc3f5240104e33e2d78706081a1d51e4c.open_work: Testing at more sites and climates and with other geostationary sensors.
a146a6ffc3f5240104e33e2d78706081a1d51e4c.issues: Single PV site; short horizons only; transferability to other regions not shown.

7ac326b467e56b25459f3466bcd4a09c5d9cccb4.goal: Systematically reviews machine learning methods used to forecast drought.
7ac326b467e56b25459f3466bcd4a09c5d9cccb4.architecture: Systematic literature review of machine learning drought forecasting studies; no new model is proposed.
7ac326b467e56b25459f3466bcd4a09c5d9cccb4.data: Published drought forecasting studies; the corpus size and selection criteria are not reported (no abstract).
7ac326b467e56b25459f3466bcd4a09c5d9cccb4.open_work: Not reported; natural open questions include lead-time skill, drought index choice and transferability.
7ac326b467e56b25459f3466bcd4a09c5d9cccb4.issues: Card based on the title only; findings and coverage could not be checked.

637d568aa271fb436bfe4af6d639bf947285ffcc.goal: Separates meteorological effects from emission effects on urban ozone in China to evaluate how well emission controls work.
637d568aa271fb436bfe4af6d639bf947285ffcc.architecture: Machine learning model for meteorological normalization combined with an observation-based box model for ozone formation sensitivity and positive matrix factorization for VOC source apportionment; the ML model type is not specified in the abstract.
637d568aa271fb436bfe4af6d639bf947285ffcc.data: Four years of continuous observations of ozone, NOx, VOCs and meteorology at a typical urban site in China.
637d568aa271fb436bfe4af6d639bf947285ffcc.result: Dispersion and transport contribute 12.9–24.0% to warm-season ozone; after normalization, ozone sensitivity shifts toward the transition regime and vehicle exhaust becomes the main VOC source (41.8%) while combustion drops from 33.7% to 25.1%.
637d568aa271fb436bfe4af6d639bf947285ffcc.open_work: Applying the decoupling to more cities to guide VOC and NOx control strategies.
637d568aa271fb436bfe4af6d639bf947285ffcc.issues: Single urban site; results depend on the normalization model and PMF assumptions.

6cf9a887c23c87cb5c54500b79cc8be4757d9dc9.goal: Predicts daily average global horizontal irradiance to support grid integration of solar PV.
6cf9a887c23c87cb5c54500b79cc8be4757d9dc9.architecture: Hybrid CNN with stacked LSTM (CNN-SLSTM), features chosen by recursive feature elimination and hyperparameters tuned with Slime Mould optimization; compared with GRU, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, SLSTM, SVM, decision tree and random forest.
6cf9a887c23c87cb5c54500b79cc8be4757d9dc9.data: Meteorological parameters and daily solar irradiance recorded at a single study site; 14 selected features; tenfold cross-validation.
6cf9a887c23c87cb5c54500b79cc8be4757d9dc9.result: CNN-SLSTM outperforms all baselines with MSE 0.0359, R2 0.9790 and adjusted R2 0.9789.
6cf9a887c23c87cb5c54500b79cc8be4757d9dc9.open_work: Testing at other sites and for multi-step or intra-day forecasting.
6cf9a887c23c87cb5c54500b79cc8be4757d9dc9.issues: Single site; random tenfold cross-validation on time series may leak information and inflate skill.

610ba7546c6eefa657ef5105b9df516f6e078f5a.goal: Forecasts solar radiation using a CNN-LSTM model whose settings are tuned by hybrid metaheuristic optimization.

c5e5f59bc46928582bf45e718ae08c34045f639b.issues: Card based on the title only; results could not be checked.

415e88e5e3bafaa00888a360d43edeefc87b155a.goal: Nowcasts solar energy from geostationary satellite data using a transformer approach.
415e88e5e3bafaa00888a360d43edeefc87b155a.architecture: Transformer-based deep learning model applied to geostationary satellite imagery (per the title); further design details are not known.

8907595c8c427976a1d141b2458aa69b5d809299.goal: Closes the gap between hydrogeological concepts and executable simulation codes in groundwater inverse modeling, while keeping physical consistency that pure data-driven ML lacks.
8907595c8c427976a1d141b2458aa69b5d809299.architecture: Hydro-Agent: a multi-agent framework of large language models (a reasoning agent, HydroCoder, and an Executor) that writes, debugs and configures optimization for process-based groundwater solvers in a code-as-policy approach.
8907595c8c427976a1d141b2458aa69b5d809299.data: Three test tiers: heterogeneous media, kinetic transport experiments with added noise, and the field-scale Aquia Aquifer (18 parameters, 96 km flow path).
8907595c8c427976a1d141b2458aa69b5d809299.result: Identifies structural controls in heterogeneous media, retrieves parameters robustly under noise, and reproduces chromatographic separation trends in the Aquia Aquifer while matching the rigor of direct-coupling baselines.
8907595c8c427976a1d141b2458aa69b5d809299.open_work: Broader field tests and use by hydrogeologists without coding expertise.
8907595c8c427976a1d141b2458aa69b5d809299.issues: LLM behaviour can be non-deterministic and costly; limited number of cases; dependent on the underlying solvers and LLM versions.

56b86b45e5c2f83a4ad5114ce6356e78e5efc56a.goal: Improves and interprets streamflow estimates in arid and semi-arid watersheds by coupling a process-based model with deep learning, tested in the Tagus headwaters, Spain.
56b86b45e5c2f83a4ad5114ce6356e78e5efc56a.architecture: Hybrid of the SWAT+ process-based hydrological model and an LSTM network (per the title), with an interpretability analysis.
56b86b45e5c2f83a4ad5114ce6356e78e5efc56a.data: Tagus Headwaters River Basin, Spain; inputs and periods are not reported (no abstract).
56b86b45e5c2f83a4ad5114ce6356e78e5efc56a.open_work: Not reported; transfer to other dryland basins would follow naturally.
56b86b45e5c2f83a4ad5114ce6356e78e5efc56a.issues: Card based on the title only; single basin; results could not be checked.

4c099254728c1ce1839d6ac0f7337ac52086c481.goal: Improves drought monitoring and projects future drought in the Middle East.
4c099254728c1ce1839d6ac0f7337ac52086c481.architecture: Ensemble machine learning with a new spatially adaptive Geographically Weighted Temperature Vegetation Dryness Index built from local (geographically weighted) regression and trend analysis; ensemble members not specified in the abstract.
4c099254728c1ce1839d6ac0f7337ac52086c481.data: Temperature and vegetation signals plus climate model projections under three socioeconomic scenarios; specific products are not reported in the abstract.
4c099254728c1ce1839d6ac0f7337ac52086c481.result: Improves prediction accuracy over earlier indices and projects 25–35% intensification of drought under high emissions, concentrated in central and southern Middle East, with local hotspots.
4c099254728c1ce1839d6ac0f7337ac52086c481.open_work: Using the index for targeted water resource planning and adaptation.
4c099254728c1ce1839d6ac0f7337ac52086c481.issues: Projections inherit climate-model biases; the vegetation-temperature index may not capture all drought types.

acab6966b48fc2bd1c57a212f18a3ebeb39353c6.goal: Quantifies how meteorological and emission factors drive PM2.5 concentrations to inform pollution management.
acab6966b48fc2bd1c57a212f18a3ebeb39353c6.architecture: Positive matrix factorization for source apportionment combined with LightGBM gradient boosting, interpreted with SHAP and partial dependence plots.
acab6966b48fc2bd1c57a212f18a3ebeb39353c6.data: PM2.5 composition and meteorological observations at a study location in China; site and period are not detailed in the abstract.
acab6966b48fc2bd1c57a212f18a3ebeb39353c6.result: Emission sources explain 83.4% (26.8 μg/m3) of PM2.5, dominated by secondary particles, and meteorology 16.6% (5.3 μg/m3), led by humidity; source influence varies by quarter.
acab6966b48fc2bd1c57a212f18a3ebeb39353c6.open_work: Extending to more sites and linking to emission control scenarios.
acab6966b48fc2bd1c57a212f18a3ebeb39353c6.issues: Single location; SHAP attributions are associative and depend on PMF factor definitions.

cd28b02ed85a23d76383833c6b8ca202e3e2a525.goal: Detects multiple climate hazards affecting agriculture in Europe for multi-hazard early warning.
cd28b02ed85a23d76383833c6b8ca202e3e2a525.architecture: Expert-driven explainable AI models trained on expert hazard labels that give probabilistic detections, driver attribution and uncertainty estimates; the model family is not specified in the abstract.
cd28b02ed85a23d76383833c6b8ca202e3e2a525.data: Decades of operational agro-climatic expert hazard identifications in Europe with spatio-temporal climate data; products are not named in the abstract.
cd28b02ed85a23d76383833c6b8ca202e3e2a525.result: Models detect multiple agriculture-related hazards probabilistically, identify their main drivers and handle large datasets with uncertainty estimates.
cd28b02ed85a23d76383833c6b8ca202e3e2a525.open_work: Integration into early warning systems and sectoral climate services.
cd28b02ed85a23d76383833c6b8ca202e3e2a525.issues: Labels inherit the subjectivity of expert judgement; quantitative skill is not reported in the abstract.

764b929afc6e2deed75f7e04ad6f79a9473cd78f.goal: Reviews machine learning methods for estimating soil moisture, an alternative to costly measurements and complex physical models.
764b929afc6e2deed75f7e04ad6f79a9473cd78f.architecture: Review of ML methods for soil moisture, including deep learning, support vector machines and hybrid physical-AI models.
764b929afc6e2deed75f7e04ad6f79a9473cd78f.data: Literature on soil moisture estimation from in situ, remote sensing and satellite data.
764b929afc6e2deed75f7e04ad6f79a9473cd78f.result: Deep learning captures spatiotemporal complexity but needs much data, SVMs are robust for sparse or noisy data, and hybrid models improve flexibility and accuracy.
764b929afc6e2deed75f7e04ad6f79a9473cd78f.open_work: Explainable AI for trust, transferability across environments and fusion with remote sensing.
764b929afc6e2deed75f7e04ad6f79a9473cd78f.issues: Narrative overview; no quantitative meta-analysis is reported.

cd0cc8acb7a3f1f61cf1bb03cf0f297233377a2c.goal: Forecasts monthly runoff one month ahead in a glacierized catchment affected by climate change.
cd0cc8acb7a3f1f61cf1bb03cf0f297233377a2c.architecture: XGBoost gradient boosting compared with LSTM and random forest models, with a statistical test of turning-point detection.
cd0cc8acb7a3f1f61cf1bb03cf0f297233377a2c.data: Monthly runoff for the Lötschental catchment, Switzerland, 2002–2021 (2002–2015 training, 2016–2021 testing).
cd0cc8acb7a3f1f61cf1bb03cf0f297233377a2c.result: XGBoost performs best (R2 0.904, RMSE 1.554 m3/s, NSE 0.797, d 0.972) and predicts turning points 22–34% better than LSTM and RF.
cd0cc8acb7a3f1f61cf1bb03cf0f297233377a2c.open_work: Testing in other glacierized catchments and under climate change scenarios.
cd0cc8acb7a3f1f61cf1bb03cf0f297233377a2c.issues: Single small catchment; short monthly record limits deep learning; runoff autocorrelation can inflate skill.

c58fd4a4090c67652050ce136bfe5dd8f9988a1a.goal: Provides low-cost very short-term solar irradiance forecasts from sky images for regions with scarce historical data.
c58fd4a4090c67652050ce136bfe5dd8f9988a1a.architecture: CNN-LSTM model fed by images from the KALiSI open-source low-cost all-sky imager (under 600 euros).
c58fd4a4090c67652050ce136bfe5dd8f9988a1a.data: KALiSI and a commercial sky imager installed in Karlsruhe, Germany, with GHI measurements; 15-minute-ahead forecasts.
c58fd4a4090c67652050ce136bfe5dd8f9988a1a.result: RMSE 19–206 W/m2 versus 33–257 W/m2 for persistence; KALiSI-based forecasts are only 6–7% worse in normalized errors than those from a commercial imager.
c58fd4a4090c67652050ce136bfe5dd8f9988a1a.open_work: Deployment in African and other developing regions.
c58fd4a4090c67652050ce136bfe5dd8f9988a1a.issues: Single site in Germany; discrepancies on clear days; not tested in the target regions.

873fcafe203bc25dd1bfad87b786fc6aac09c1c6.goal: Tests whether entity-aware deep learning hydrology models actually use static catchment attributes to generalize.
873fcafe203bc25dd1bfad87b786fc6aac09c1c6.architecture: LSTM networks with static physiographic attributes compared with ablated LSTM variants without static inputs.
873fcafe203bc25dd1bfad87b786fc6aac09c1c6.result: The advantage of entity-aware models comes mainly from meteorological forcings, with limited contribution from physiographic static features, particularly out of sample.
873fcafe203bc25dd1bfad87b786fc6aac09c1c6.open_work: New approaches that make static information drive robust generalization.
873fcafe203bc25dd1bfad87b786fc6aac09c1c6.issues: Restricted to LSTMs and CAMELS-US attributes; conclusions may differ for other architectures or attribute sets.

7d700db692a4c97d2291e2e3ae79c81efe943c6b.goal: Rapidly maps flood depth and velocity for rainfall events of different durations by super-resolving coarse-grid hydrodynamic simulations.
7d700db692a4c97d2291e2e3ae79c81efe943c6b.architecture: DenseUNet (U-Net variant with dense blocks) image super-resolution model using catchment characteristics, compared with ResUNet and U-Net.
7d700db692a4c97d2291e2e3ae79c81efe943c6b.data: Coarse- and fine-grid hydrodynamic simulations of rainfall events for the rural-urban Shenzhen River catchment, southern China.
7d700db692a4c97d2291e2e3ae79c81efe943c6b.result: RMSE below 0.06 m for maximum depth and 0.07 m/s for velocity, bias within ±5%, NSE above 0.99 for depth and 0.94 for velocity, over 2800 times faster than the fine-grid model.
7d700db692a4c97d2291e2e3ae79c81efe943c6b.open_work: Testing on other catchments and on time-varying flood dynamics.
7d700db692a4c97d2291e2e3ae79c81efe943c6b.issues: Trained and evaluated on simulations from one catchment; still requires a coarse hydrodynamic run.

e58b52f46ab02748ef90f29c9b9bdf3dcc33fb45.goal: Forecasts heatwave warnings from daily temperature time series in Rajshahi, Bangladesh.
e58b52f46ab02748ef90f29c9b9bdf3dcc33fb45.architecture: Seasonal-adjusted hybrid models combining STL decomposition with time series and ML models (best: STL-ARIMA-LSTM), compared with ARIMA, ETS, TBATS, ANN, SVR, Prophet, random forest and LSTM.
e58b52f46ab02748ef90f29c9b9bdf3dcc33fb45.data: 42 years of daily historical data for Rajshahi, Bangladesh.
e58b52f46ab02748ef90f29c9b9bdf3dcc33fb45.result: STL-ARIMA-LSTM performs best (MAE 0.8974, RMSE 1.1794, MAPE 2.9232, MASE 0.3814).
e58b52f46ab02748ef90f29c9b9bdf3dcc33fb45.open_work: Extending to other districts and using meteorological predictors.
e58b52f46ab02748ef90f29c9b9bdf3dcc33fb45.issues: Single station; univariate statistical forecasting with no physical predictors; forecast horizon unclear.

ed8415122d4c8eacaa66b76af1a2d85d75cb2dca.goal: Improves short-term rainfall–runoff forecasting at 1–24 hour horizons.
ed8415122d4c8eacaa66b76af1a2d85d75cb2dca.architecture: Gaussian process regression combined with K-means clustering (GPR-K-means), compared with standalone GPR and principal component regression.
ed8415122d4c8eacaa66b76af1a2d85d75cb2dca.data: Hourly precipitation and streamflow for the Orgeval watershed, France, 1970–2012.
ed8415122d4c8eacaa66b76af1a2d85d75cb2dca.result: NSE about 0.999, 0.942, 0.891 and 0.859 at 1, 6, 12 and 24 hours, outperforming GPR, PCR and literature results for LSTM, SVM and random forest.
ed8415122d4c8eacaa66b76af1a2d85d75cb2dca.open_work: Application to other watersheds and flood forecasting systems.
ed8415122d4c8eacaa66b76af1a2d85d75cb2dca.issues: Single watershed; comparison with LSTM, SVM and RF relies on literature values rather than the same setup.

16138a2486c855f8570fd1db772c4bcacbc7446d.goal: Improves local streamflow predictions, including extremes, from large-scale process-based hydrological models across Europe.
16138a2486c855f8570fd1db772c4bcacbc7446d.architecture: Hybrid approach: process-based model output post-processed with random forest, LSTM, quantile mapping and generalised linear models.
16138a2486c855f8570fd1db772c4bcacbc7446d.data: Streamflow simulations and observations across European basins spanning the hydro-climatic gradient; model and dataset names are not given in the abstract.
16138a2486c855f8570fd1db772c4bcacbc7446d.result: All post-processors reduce errors in volume and extremes; gains depend on hydrologic similarity, precipitation and temperature, and no single method is best everywhere.
16138a2486c855f8570fd1db772c4bcacbc7446d.open_work: Multi-model averaging of post-processors in hybrid hydrological modelling.
16138a2486c855f8570fd1db772c4bcacbc7446d.issues: Post-processing corrects outputs without fixing model structure; requires observed streamflow at each site.

1b4fde47f5989f1e0038a3b87d06ff42d90cdbb9.goal: Assesses consistency and uncertainty of ML feature-importance methods for attributing climate signals.
1b4fde47f5989f1e0038a3b87d06ff42d90cdbb9.architecture: Comparison of SHAP, partial dependence plots and XGBoost gain-based importance, with SHAP on feed-forward neural networks (MLP) and XGBoost; proposes an ensemble framework.
1b4fde47f5989f1e0038a3b87d06ff42d90cdbb9.data: Winter precipitation at Ohio, USA, stations with global warming and Interdecadal Pacific Oscillation indices as predictors.
1b4fde47f5989f1e0038a3b87d06ff42d90cdbb9.result: Global warming ranks above IPO in at least 60% of stations; SHAP and PDP agree in 89% of stations and FFNN/XGBoost SHAP in 82%; warming explains about 70% of multi-decadal variability.
1b4fde47f5989f1e0038a3b87d06ff42d90cdbb9.open_work: Ensemble feature-importance approaches for robust attribution in climate modelling.
1b4fde47f5989f1e0038a3b87d06ff42d90cdbb9.issues: Only two predictors and one region; collinearity is acknowledged; feature importance is not causal attribution.

d3cfa2a576bf65c2a970cd81226b94f6621d9f81.architecture: Uses the Pangu-Weather data-driven weather model (a 3D Earth-specific transformer) to supply atmospheric profiles for weighted mean temperature estimation.

712ab7ae03f329ee0eb09e464c4620417928a9e4.goal: Attributes the 1995–2019 increase in tropospheric and surface ozone over East and Southeast Asia to anthropogenic emissions versus climate.
712ab7ae03f329ee0eb09e464c4620417928a9e4.architecture: Integrated assessment with a statistical model, two machine learning models and three chemical transport models; ML model types are not specified in the abstract.
712ab7ae03f329ee0eb09e464c4620417928a9e4.data: Ozone observations over East and Southeast Asia, 1995–2019, with multiple emission inventories.
712ab7ae03f329ee0eb09e464c4620417928a9e4.result: Emissions explain 53–59% of the tropospheric ozone burden increase and 69–75% at the surface; climate change contributes 41–47% (summer troposphere) and 25–31% (surface); post-2013 Chinese cuts lowered tropospheric but raised surface ozone.
712ab7ae03f329ee0eb09e464c4620417928a9e4.open_work: Longer observations, better emission inventories and improved modelling frameworks.
712ab7ae03f329ee0eb09e464c4620417928a9e4.issues: Attribution spread across models and inventories; ML attribution is statistical rather than mechanistic.

7ec1a3a7fec2e8e0b770c3fa68f2970cb84f42c4.open_work: Application to real ocean wave fields and operational wave prediction.
7ec1a3a7fec2e8e0b770c3fa68f2970cb84f42c4.issues: Validated in a wave flume and idealized cases only; field conditions untested.

8cf32636db68e9a25d76ddea06bcce9510c1ec3e.goal: Tests how training-record length affects LSTM and conceptual models for hourly rainfall–runoff simulation.
8cf32636db68e9a25d76ddea06bcce9510c1ec3e.architecture: Two LSTM approaches: one fed with conceptual model outputs (hybrid) and a stand-alone LSTM combining coarse and fine temporal inputs, compared with conceptual models.

635621e98b7335752818289149dac62bdddad3cf.goal: Reviews data-driven detection and prediction of wind and solar photovoltaic power ramp events, which threaten power-system safety as extreme weather becomes more frequent.
635621e98b7335752818289149dac62bdddad3cf.architecture: Review of ramp-event definitions and detection algorithms, predictive model architectures including AI and machine learning models, and precision-optimization and error-correction strategies.

e7c2442b88a38b84e912f84aa25bff35ccd9c25c.architecture: Review of soil moisture downscaling of passive microwave products using AI and optical, thermal and SAR sensors, and of remotely sensed ET retrieval from MODIS to ECOSTRESS and Hydrosat.
e7c2442b88a38b84e912f84aa25bff35ccd9c25c.data: Satellite soil moisture and ET products (passive microwave, MODIS, ECOSTRESS, Hydrosat, SAR, visible/NIR/thermal sensors) discussed from the literature.

9aed10a73b9d19b3b8f477f2faa57946dd07a45d.goal: Quantifies long-term changes in Antarctic phytoplankton community composition and their links to sea ice, given implications for food webs and the biological carbon pump.
9aed10a73b9d19b3b8f477f2faa57946dd07a45d.architecture: Machine learning framework relating phytoplankton pigment composition to environmental variables; the specific model type is not specified in the abstract.
9aed10a73b9d19b3b8f477f2faa57946dd07a45d.data: In situ pigment samples and environmental data from austral summers 1997–2023 across the Antarctic continental shelf.
9aed10a73b9d19b3b8f477f2faa57946dd07a45d.result: Diatom chl-a declined by 0.32 mg m−3 (~33% of climatology) while haptophytes and cryptophytes increased by 0.08 and 0.23 mg m−3; trends linked to sea-ice increase reversed after 2016 with sea-ice loss.
9aed10a73b9d19b3b8f477f2faa57946dd07a45d.open_work: Assess consequences for krill-centred food webs and carbon export, and extend analysis beyond summer and shelf regions.
9aed10a73b9d19b3b8f477f2faa57946dd07a45d.issues: Summer-only, shipboard sampling with uneven coverage; links to sea ice and carbon export are inferred rather than directly measured.

286aa2932cea64f8211944d07f15106869e9cd52.goal: Provides a CAMELS-style large-sample hydrology dataset for Denmark covering lowland, groundwater-dominated small catchments, including ungauged ones.
286aa2932cea64f8211944d07f15106869e9cd52.architecture: Benchmark dataset of hydrometeorological time series and static catchment attributes, plus simulations from a national distributed process-based hydrological model.
286aa2932cea64f8211944d07f15106869e9cd52.data: 3330 Danish catchments, 304 with observed streamflow; daily data 1989–2019 from meteorological observations, hydrogeological datasets, national model simulations, groundwater abstraction and irrigation.
286aa2932cea64f8211944d07f15106869e9cd52.result: First CAMELS dataset with both gauged and ungauged catchments and detailed groundwater information, with simulated streamflow for all 3330 catchments.

286aa2932cea64f8211944d07f15106869e9cd52.issues: Simulated streamflow for ungauged catchments carries the national model's errors; coverage is limited to Denmark's lowland conditions.

a5ec68397debea6271d48b3ab63f96041f9cdc3a.goal: Estimates the eddy-resolving surface ocean state, including unobserved surface currents, from sparse multi-modal satellite observations, where dynamical data assimilation struggles.
a5ec68397debea6271d48b3ab63f96041f9cdc3a.architecture: Score-based diffusion model (GenDA) trained on a simulation as a generative prior, then used in Bayesian posterior sampling to assimilate sparse observations.
a5ec68397debea6271d48b3ab63f96041f9cdc3a.data: Training on an ocean simulation; satellite sea surface height, SST and SSS observations for application to real data.
a5ec68397debea6271d48b3ab63f96041f9cdc3a.result: Produces coherent multivariate reconstructions, sharpens SSS using high-resolution SST, infers surface currents from satellite observables, and outperforms regression-based deep learning and state-of-the-art dynamical DA on real observations.
a5ec68397debea6271d48b3ab63f96041f9cdc3a.open_work: Extend to subsurface fields, longer time windows and operational use, and validate current inference against in situ measurements.
a5ec68397debea6271d48b3ab63f96041f9cdc3a.issues: Prior learned from a single simulation may carry model biases; surface-only estimation does not enforce full dynamical consistency.
