db7b2cd0818b67886b8a27d1e5ed85110c2491d3.issues: Single-site camera data limit generalization; very short-term horizon only.

cc3d5abc852c411037408c44848dd3f2f4fcf210.goal: Jointly predicts wind speed and the time-varying wind shear coefficient, both needed for wind turbine design and wind energy assessment.
cc3d5abc852c411037408c44848dd3f2f4fcf210.architecture: Dynamic graph interactive neural network for multi-task learning of wind speed and wind shear coefficient.
cc3d5abc852c411037408c44848dd3f2f4fcf210.data: Wind measurements at multiple heights; specific site and dataset not reported.
cc3d5abc852c411037408c44848dd3f2f4fcf210.open_work: Extend to more sites and longer forecast horizons and to offshore conditions.
cc3d5abc852c411037408c44848dd3f2f4fcf210.issues: Evaluation details are not available; transfer to other sites and stability regimes is uncertain.

d029c794c30ad0237d63fc9e25c3813a2aee082a.goal: Estimates several air pollutants jointly over China, accounting for their interactions and improving interpretability and physical consistency.
d029c794c30ad0237d63fc9e25c3813a2aee082a.architecture: Interpretable physics-informed deep neural network (IPMDNN) with tanh-based self-attention over grouped inputs, a deep interaction module, a physics-constrained loss, and layer-wise relevance propagation.
d029c794c30ad0237d63fc9e25c3813a2aee082a.data: Inputs categorized by prior atmospheric knowledge (including formaldehyde, CO, OH, temperature); ground pollutant observations across China, 2019–2020.
d029c794c30ad0237d63fc9e25c3813a2aee082a.result: Sample-based cross-validation R² of 0.92, 0.90 and 0.87 for O3, PM2.5 and PM10, higher than separate models, with more than twice the efficiency; severe O3 in summer and PM in winter over East, Central and North China.
d029c794c30ad0237d63fc9e25c3813a2aee082a.open_work: Extend to more pollutants, years and spatial cross-validation, and use for coordinated control policy.
d029c794c30ad0237d63fc9e25c3813a2aee082a.issues: Sample-based cross-validation can overstate skill at unmonitored locations; only two years evaluated.

0d7ca4f24a957924e3363dc202742cccc2dfa3fe.goal: Corrects biases in satellite precipitation estimates over arid regions using machine learning and topographic information.
0d7ca4f24a957924e3363dc202742cccc2dfa3fe.architecture: Machine learning bias-correction models using topographic predictors; specific algorithms are not specified in the available metadata.
0d7ca4f24a957924e3363dc202742cccc2dfa3fe.data: Satellite precipitation products and gauge observations in arid regions; specific products and regions not reported.
0d7ca4f24a957924e3363dc202742cccc2dfa3fe.open_work: Test transferability to other arid regions and extreme events.
0d7ca4f24a957924e3363dc202742cccc2dfa3fe.issues: Sparse gauges in arid regions limit training and validation; correction of rare heavy rainfall is uncertain.

237c726355e7dec8fa03618c1056af03de589716.goal: Improves ultra-short-term regional solar irradiance forecasting by selecting and fusing multi-modal satellite and meteorological features automatically.
237c726355e7dec8fa03618c1056af03de589716.architecture: SolarFusionNet: automatic variable feature-selection units, three recurrent branches including a Gaussian kernel-injected ConvLSTM on optical-flow cloud motion, and hierarchical multi-head cross-modal self-attention.
237c726355e7dec8fa03618c1056af03de589716.data: Multichannel satellite images, optical-flow cloud motion fields and multivariate meteorological data; specific satellite and region not reported.
237c726355e7dec8fa03618c1056af03de589716.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art models with forecast skill of 37.4–47.6% against smart persistence at 4 hours ahead.
237c726355e7dec8fa03618c1056af03de589716.open_work: Extend to longer horizons, other regions, and probabilistic forecasts.
237c726355e7dec8fa03618c1056af03de589716.issues: Single-region evaluation; architecture complexity and computational cost not discussed in the abstract.

92f4c32198ea21195c5b8ccde442ab7c05b171fb.goal: Reviews artificial intelligence approaches to wind speed forecasting, focusing on multi-scale signal decomposition and fusion strategies.
92f4c32198ea21195c5b8ccde442ab7c05b171fb.architecture: Review of decomposition-based hybrid forecasting (e.g., wavelet and mode decomposition) combined with machine learning and deep learning predictors and intelligent fusion strategies.
92f4c32198ea21195c5b8ccde442ab7c05b171fb.data: Literature on wind speed forecasting; no new dataset.
92f4c32198ea21195c5b8ccde442ab7c05b171fb.open_work: Standardized benchmarks and treatment of decomposition-induced information leakage in hybrid models.
92f4c32198ea21195c5b8ccde442ab7c05b171fb.issues: Review scope and quantitative comparisons are not available from metadata; content inferred from the title.

a4081a477c3e2aca73d710fb4fad62245e58b7eb.goal: Improves runoff simulation in cold regions by integrating machine learning with a process-based glacio-hydrological model.
a4081a477c3e2aca73d710fb4fad62245e58b7eb.architecture: Hybrid of a process-based glacio-hydrological model and machine learning; the specific ML algorithm is not specified in the available metadata.
a4081a477c3e2aca73d710fb4fad62245e58b7eb.data: Runoff and meteorological data from cold-region catchments; specific basins not reported.
a4081a477c3e2aca73d710fb4fad62245e58b7eb.open_work: Test under climate change scenarios and in other glacierized basins.
a4081a477c3e2aca73d710fb4fad62245e58b7eb.issues: Hybrid gains may reflect bias correction rather than improved process representation; data scarcity in cold regions limits validation.

c04a83303a0fb14bb46402193d7bda7541020510.goal: Predicts sugar beet yield and quality parameters before harvest by combining UAV time series with meteorological factors.
c04a83303a0fb14bb46402193d7bda7541020510.architecture: Stacked long short-term memory (LSTM) network on time series features.
c04a83303a0fb14bb46402193d7bda7541020510.data: Pre-harvest UAV image time series and meteorological factors for sugar beet fields; location and season count not reported.
c04a83303a0fb14bb46402193d7bda7541020510.open_work: Validate across seasons, varieties and sites.
c04a83303a0fb14bb46402193d7bda7541020510.issues: Number of field seasons and sites is not reported, so generalization is uncertain.

b25c95c60fe486701cb96f6ef13cdc4320d2460b.goal: Systematically reviews machine learning models used for groundwater level prediction.
b25c95c60fe486701cb96f6ef13cdc4320d2460b.architecture: Systematic review of machine learning models for groundwater level forecasting.
b25c95c60fe486701cb96f6ef13cdc4320d2460b.data: Published studies on groundwater level prediction; no new dataset.
b25c95c60fe486701cb96f6ef13cdc4320d2460b.open_work: Standardized benchmarks, uncertainty quantification and physically consistent models for groundwater.
b25c95c60fe486701cb96f6ef13cdc4320d2460b.issues: Content inferred from the title; review coverage and conclusions not available.

c132028f1aaa90a299bab70f7fe33fa425544649.goal: Improves solar radiation forecasting accuracy with a hybrid deep recurrent model.
c132028f1aaa90a299bab70f7fe33fa425544649.architecture: Hybrid of self-attention, bidirectional LSTM and bidirectional GRU recurrent networks (SA-Bi-LSTM-Bi-GRU).
c132028f1aaa90a299bab70f7fe33fa425544649.data: Solar radiation and meteorological time series; site and period not reported.
c132028f1aaa90a299bab70f7fe33fa425544649.open_work: Test across sites, horizons and seasons with probabilistic outputs.
c132028f1aaa90a299bab70f7fe33fa425544649.issues: Evaluation details unavailable; single-site results may not generalize.

f72e50f110f0eb8cb1ce3663ee930787e6aedfb9.goal: Simulates soil moisture across multiple spatial or temporal scales using a transformer-based approach.
f72e50f110f0eb8cb1ce3663ee930787e6aedfb9.architecture: Transformer-based deep learning model for multi-scale soil moisture simulation.
f72e50f110f0eb8cb1ce3663ee930787e6aedfb9.data: Soil moisture observations or products with meteorological and land-surface predictors; specific datasets not reported.
f72e50f110f0eb8cb1ce3663ee930787e6aedfb9.open_work: Extend to other regions and integrate with land surface models.
f72e50f110f0eb8cb1ce3663ee930787e6aedfb9.issues: Dependence on training data quality and coverage; details of scales and validation unavailable.

b74a949828e536bff2f4e35151f43ebe23beb78c.goal: Reviews AI techniques for crop yield prediction under abnormal climate conditions to support precision agriculture and policy.
b74a949828e536bff2f4e35151f43ebe23beb78c.architecture: Review of machine learning (random forest, SVM), deep learning (ANN, CNN), stacking ensembles and explainable AI for crop yield prediction.
b74a949828e536bff2f4e35151f43ebe23beb78c.data: Literature using remote sensing, hyperspectral and multispectral imaging (often from drones), and environmental factors.
b74a949828e536bff2f4e35151f43ebe23beb78c.result: RF and SVM, ANNs and CNNs, and stacking ensembles dominate; stepwise feature selection beats adding features; XAI is early but promising; key yield-loss factors are atmospheric and soil conditions, pests, fertility and economics.
b74a949828e536bff2f4e35151f43ebe23beb78c.open_work: Wider adoption of explainable AI and data-informed agricultural policy frameworks.
b74a949828e536bff2f4e35151f43ebe23beb78c.issues: Heterogeneous input features and study designs hinder comparison; no quantitative meta-analysis.

63a682e9ce799d55be0e9c6849262997aea47a80.goal: Improves short-term (0–120 h) typhoon forecasts by combining a machine-learning global model with a physics-based mesoscale model and targeted observations.
63a682e9ce799d55be0e9c6849262997aea47a80.architecture: Hybrid of the FuXi machine-learning weather model and the physics-based Shanghai Typhoon Model via spectral nudging, with Conditional Nonlinear Optimal Perturbation (CNOP) to identify sensitive regions for satellite assimilation.
63a682e9ce799d55be0e9c6849262997aea47a80.data: FuXi large-scale forecasts, SHTM simulations and satellite observations for super typhoons Yagi (2024) and Krathon (2024).
63a682e9ce799d55be0e9c6849262997aea47a80.result: Hybrid FuXi-SHTM improves track, intensity and precipitation forecasts; dense assimilation in CNOP-identified sensitive regions further improves forecasts.
63a682e9ce799d55be0e9c6849262997aea47a80.open_work: Evaluation over many more typhoon cases and operational implementation.
63a682e9ce799d55be0e9c6849262997aea47a80.issues: Only two case studies; constrained by FuXi large-scale fields, so errors there propagate.

557e0e5bb4be74557ba175f745066b38366cb02b.goal: Reviews machine learning techniques for agricultural water management under water scarcity.
557e0e5bb4be74557ba175f745066b38366cb02b.architecture: Review of neural networks, decision trees, support vector machines and ensemble methods including random forest.
557e0e5bb4be74557ba175f745066b38366cb02b.data: Studies using satellite imagery, climatic variables, soil properties and crop yield data.
557e0e5bb4be74557ba175f745066b38366cb02b.result: Random forest is frequently used with superior accuracy; ANNs and SVMs perform well for evapotranspiration estimation and water stress prediction.
557e0e5bb4be74557ba175f745066b38366cb02b.open_work: Integration with real-time data streams and explainable AI to build trust in automated decisions.
557e0e5bb4be74557ba175f745066b38366cb02b.issues: Qualitative review; performance claims depend on heterogeneous studies without standardized benchmarks.

7e17626fabb4a19d4ebf32b0c9fb81feac493cca.goal: Provides a curated, deep learning-ready dataset for flood extent mapping from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery.
7e17626fabb4a19d4ebf32b0c9fb81feac493cca.architecture: Benchmark dataset with baseline U-Net segmentation models for each sensor.
7e17626fabb4a19d4ebf32b0c9fb81feac493cca.data: 21,602 Sentinel-1 and 2,675 Sentinel-2 tiles (128×128 px, 10 m) with water masks from Copernicus Emergency Management Service covering 60 flood events globally.
7e17626fabb4a19d4ebf32b0c9fb81feac493cca.result: U-Net baselines reach 83.61% accuracy and weighted F1 0.8327 for Sentinel-1, and 92.75% accuracy and F1 0.9243 for Sentinel-2.
7e17626fabb4a19d4ebf32b0c9fb81feac493cca.open_work: Expand events and data sources and refine approaches for broader applications.
7e17626fabb4a19d4ebf32b0c9fb81feac493cca.issues: Limited number of events and fewer optical tiles due to clouds; accuracy-type metrics can be inflated by class imbalance.

7ab214ff202fa54e44dc2e1e35b9e1a96d5cc0cd.goal: Reconstructs three-dimensional eddy-resolving ocean physical parameters from satellite surface observations.
7ab214ff202fa54e44dc2e1e35b9e1a96d5cc0cd.architecture: Dual U-Vision-Transformer combining U-Net structure with vision transformer blocks.
7ab214ff202fa54e44dc2e1e35b9e1a96d5cc0cd.data: Satellite surface observations as inputs; subsurface targets from reanalysis or model data; specific products not reported.
7ab214ff202fa54e44dc2e1e35b9e1a96d5cc0cd.open_work: Validate against in situ profiles such as Argo and extend to other regions and depths.
7ab214ff202fa54e44dc2e1e35b9e1a96d5cc0cd.issues: Subsurface training targets may inherit model biases; skill at depth is uncertain.

c3620ff54231bf0610e3a17bd7468870306ed30f.goal: Maps flood susceptibility in arid, rapidly urbanizing Jeddah, where flood records and monitoring are scarce.
c3620ff54231bf0610e3a17bd7468870306ed30f.architecture: Stacked ensemble of XGBoost, CatBoost and histogram-based gradient boosting, with SHAP explanations; random forest excluded for inferior performance.
c3620ff54231bf0610e3a17bd7468870306ed30f.data: DEM, slope, flow direction, Curve Number, topographic indices and ESRI Sentinel-2 LULC; 92 flooded and 198 non-flooded validation points; road network data.
c3620ff54231bf0610e3a17bd7468870306ed30f.result: AUC 0.92 and accuracy 0.82; 8.7% of area very high and 20.3% high susceptibility; TRI, TPI and distance to rivers most influential.
c3620ff54231bf0610e3a17bd7468870306ed30f.open_work: Transfer the framework to other arid urban areas and validate with formal flood records.
c3620ff54231bf0610e3a17bd7468870306ed30f.issues: Small inventory and no official flood records; road-point proxy is not formal validation.

cc415eee9efac700f2e2e581398287a791d37d94.goal: Jointly forecasts long sequences of electricity load, prices and related meteorological variables for power-system decisions.
cc415eee9efac700f2e2e581398287a791d37d94.architecture: PatchGRU: temporal variance separator, multi-scale patch inputs to a gated recurrent unit (GRU), mean supervision and local-global interaction modules, using only GRU and MLP layers.
cc415eee9efac700f2e2e581398287a791d37d94.data: Electricity load, price and meteorological series from different regions, periods and sampling frequencies; datasets not named.
cc415eee9efac700f2e2e581398287a791d37d94.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art models, including at lead times up to 30 days.
cc415eee9efac700f2e2e581398287a791d37d94.issues: Datasets and metrics not detailed in the abstract; meteorological forecasts produced statistically rather than from NWP.

ac6a9579f0c13a6f5b97d211d321b52d7c3ebd43.goal: Provides process-level flood dynamics data suitable for machine learning-based flood modelling and forecasting.
ac6a9579f0c13a6f5b97d211d321b52d7c3ebd43.architecture: Benchmark dataset produced with a finite-difference hydrodynamic model, plus benchmarking of foundation-style neural flood forecasting models.
ac6a9579f0c13a6f5b97d211d321b52d7c3ebd43.data: Four events (Pakistan 2022, UK 2015, Australia 2022, Mozambique 2019) with topography, land use, rainfall, SAR flood maps and surveyed outlines; 30 m and 300 s resolution.
ac6a9579f0c13a6f5b97d211d321b52d7c3ebd43.result: Provides low- and high-fidelity datasets and shows effectiveness for spatiotemporal, cross-regional and downscaled neural flood forecasting.
ac6a9579f0c13a6f5b97d211d321b52d7c3ebd43.open_work: Add more events and regions and test generalization of neural flood models.
ac6a9579f0c13a6f5b97d211d321b52d7c3ebd43.issues: Simulated targets inherit hydrodynamic model errors; only four events limit diversity.

9ad96cc7542dde688f907a741e627cb7a5a11f77.goal: Reviews feature selection methods used in machine learning prediction of actual evapotranspiration.
9ad96cc7542dde688f907a741e627cb7a5a11f77.architecture: Systematic review of filter, wrapper, embedded, manual and dimensionality-reduction feature selection for ML-based AET models.
9ad96cc7542dde688f907a741e627cb7a5a11f77.data: 62 studies selected from 416 retrieved across seven digital libraries.
9ad96cc7542dde688f907a741e627cb7a5a11f77.result: Filter methods are most used (38.8%), then manual (28.7%), embedded (17.5%), wrapper (11.2%) and PCA-type reduction (3.8%); random forest and ANN are the most common models.
9ad96cc7542dde688f907a741e627cb7a5a11f77.open_work: Hybrid feature selection combining filter, wrapper, embedded and manual approaches.
9ad96cc7542dde688f907a741e627cb7a5a11f77.issues: Review of reported practice rather than controlled comparison of feature selection methods.

47fd0332d2d55246ac04f7e62c620c0541ea2e34.goal: Integrates watershed hydrology and reservoir operations in one model to simulate regulated river systems.
47fd0332d2d55246ac04f7e62c620c0541ea2e34.architecture: Physics-encoded deep learning model embedding hydrological and reservoir operation process structure into neural network components; specific layer type not specified in the available metadata.
47fd0332d2d55246ac04f7e62c620c0541ea2e34.data: Streamflow and reservoir operation data in regulated watersheds; specific basins not reported.
47fd0332d2d55246ac04f7e62c620c0541ea2e34.open_work: Extension to larger multi-reservoir systems and decision-support applications.
47fd0332d2d55246ac04f7e62c620c0541ea2e34.issues: Requires reservoir data rarely available publicly; transferability of learned operation rules uncertain.

6461997e9591909bc56c5c16a126708d144d81ee.goal: Predicts site-specific wheat yield by combining simulated crop traits with satellite reflectance and spectral indices.
6461997e9591909bc56c5c16a126708d144d81ee.architecture: Long short-term memory (LSTM) and random forest models using APSIM-simulated multiple crop traits and spectral features.
6461997e9591909bc56c5c16a126708d144d81ee.data: Geo-tagged wheat field data, APSIM calibrated trait simulations and time-series satellite reflectance and spectral indices.
6461997e9591909bc56c5c16a126708d144d81ee.result: LSTM with integrated inputs achieves RMSE 250.68 kg/ha, MAE 193.76 kg/ha and R² 0.84; random forest reaches R² 0.78.
6461997e9591909bc56c5c16a126708d144d81ee.open_work: Test across regions, seasons and crops.
6461997e9591909bc56c5c16a126708d144d81ee.issues: Depends on crop model calibration; sample and spatial extent limited.

59966ee54e811b324b3a4aa8762b72a1ddd6ba1c.goal: Reconstructs East Asian summer monsoon rainfall since the Last Glacial Maximum to identify tipping points and abrupt shifts.
59966ee54e811b324b3a4aa8762b72a1ddd6ba1c.architecture: Ensemble reconstruction using nine statistical and machine learning methods on multi-proxy records; the individual methods are not specified in the abstract.
59966ee54e811b324b3a4aa8762b72a1ddd6ba1c.data: Multi-proxy records from a maar lake in southern China, plus multi-model simulations and existing records for attribution.
59966ee54e811b324b3a4aa8762b72a1ddd6ba1c.result: Five tipping points identified with median amplitude 387 ± 73 mm (24 ± 5%), attributed to cascades of AMOC and Saharan vegetation shifts.
59966ee54e811b324b3a4aa8762b72a1ddd6ba1c.open_work: Test implications for future monsoon tipping under warming and add more sites.
59966ee54e811b324b3a4aa8762b72a1ddd6ba1c.issues: Single-site proxy reconstruction; transfer functions and dating uncertainties affect results.

3eb624f95693e0e765504085c4e5f8be2fb77614.goal: Models and forecasts urban flooding rapidly, using transfer learning to adapt to new conditions.
3eb624f95693e0e765504085c4e5f8be2fb77614.architecture: Deep neural operator with transfer learning for urban flood modelling.
3eb624f95693e0e765504085c4e5f8be2fb77614.data: Urban flood simulations from hydrodynamic models; specific city and data not reported.
3eb624f95693e0e765504085c4e5f8be2fb77614.open_work: Extend to more cities and real-time forecasting with observed rainfall.
3eb624f95693e0e765504085c4e5f8be2fb77614.issues: Surrogate fidelity limited by training simulations; transfer to very different cities is uncertain.

e5d06252a6358163314e405ca063df9f21c814e5.goal: Improves solar irradiance forecasting using machine learning ensembles with satellite meteorological data.
e5d06252a6358163314e405ca063df9f21c814e5.architecture: Stack-based ensemble with meta neural network (SEFMNN) combining ANN, random forest and SVM, plus XGBoost with squared-error loss and extreme learning machine.
e5d06252a6358163314e405ca063df9f21c814e5.data: Meteorological satellite data for Guangdong, Shandong and Zhejiang (China) and Najran (Saudi Arabia); all-sky and clear-sky shortwave irradiance.
e5d06252a6358163314e405ca063df9f21c814e5.result: SEFMNN and XGB-SE outperform ELM; SEFMNN reaches R² 0.9979, MAE 0.0231 and MSE 0.0020 in Najran.
e5d06252a6358163314e405ca063df9f21c814e5.open_work: Extend to more regions and forecast horizons.
e5d06252a6358163314e405ca063df9f21c814e5.issues: Very high R² suggests possible evaluation leakage or short horizons; normalized metrics hide physical error.

5cc23606f4824cccc37d13b3eb0724586f1063e0.goal: Improves wind speed forecasting with a hybrid ensemble combining wavelet decomposition and deep learning.
5cc23606f4824cccc37d13b3eb0724586f1063e0.architecture: Hybrid ensemble of wavelet transform decomposition and deep learning models; exact network type not specified in the available metadata.
5cc23606f4824cccc37d13b3eb0724586f1063e0.data: Wind speed time series; site not reported.
5cc23606f4824cccc37d13b3eb0724586f1063e0.issues: Decomposition-based hybrids risk information leakage if applied to whole series; evaluation details unavailable.

f2d53d53233b856a59edff911aebd8390a9ebeea.goal: Surveys multimodal learning techniques for time-series forecasting in renewable energy systems.
f2d53d53233b856a59edff911aebd8390a9ebeea.architecture: Review of early, late and hybrid fusion strategies and deep architectures such as co-attention and transformer-based fusion.
f2d53d53233b856a59edff911aebd8390a9ebeea.data: Literature and benchmark datasets combining meteorological forecasts, satellite imagery, sensor streams and grid logs.
f2d53d53233b856a59edff911aebd8390a9ebeea.result: Categorizes fusion techniques, architectures, application scenarios and benchmark datasets, highlighting data alignment, missing modalities and interpretability as challenges.
f2d53d53233b856a59edff911aebd8390a9ebeea.open_work: Self-supervised multimodal learning and adaptive fusion under uncertainty.

f81e74a67938ef17ee8de444ccda5db8bba0fd78.goal: Predicts daily runoff under changing environments with an adaptive rainfall-runoff model.
f81e74a67938ef17ee8de444ccda5db8bba0fd78.architecture: Stream-LSTM, an adaptive long short-term memory model for streaming or non-stationary conditions.
f81e74a67938ef17ee8de444ccda5db8bba0fd78.data: Daily runoff and meteorological data for study catchments; not reported.
f81e74a67938ef17ee8de444ccda5db8bba0fd78.open_work: Test under various non-stationarity types and catchments.
f81e74a67938ef17ee8de444ccda5db8bba0fd78.issues: Evaluation details unavailable; adaptivity mechanism and its robustness uncertain.

db7dc33b4caf537d07684c0269fc6e104e3b0dd2.goal: Projects future methane emissions from global lakes and reservoirs under climate change scenarios.
db7dc33b4caf537d07684c0269fc6e104e3b0dd2.architecture: Data-driven globally gridded modelling of open-water CH4 flux based on in situ-verified predictor relationships; the specific model type is not specified in the abstract.
db7dc33b4caf537d07684c0269fc6e104e3b0dd2.data: Peer-reviewed in situ flux data and predictors; SSP1-2.6 to SSP5-8.5 projections for 2080–2099.
db7dc33b4caf537d07684c0269fc6e104e3b0dd2.result: Emissions increase 24–91% by 2080–2099, dominated by temperature and seasonality changes, with area and nutrient loads important for reservoirs.
db7dc33b4caf537d07684c0269fc6e104e3b0dd2.open_work: Expand in situ flux observations and refine process representation to reduce projection uncertainty.
db7dc33b4caf537d07684c0269fc6e104e3b0dd2.issues: Limited flux observations and empirical relationships extrapolated to future climates.

0d9a0094d08882d123f418c22231ba17588b92f3.goal: Estimates grid-scale soil moisture at multiple soil layers, needed for hydrological and drought applications where in situ profiles are sparse.
0d9a0094d08882d123f418c22231ba17588b92f3.architecture: Spatiotemporal deep learning models with physical constraints added to training; the specific network type is not specified here (abstract unavailable).
0d9a0094d08882d123f418c22231ba17588b92f3.data: Not reported (abstract unavailable); the title indicates gridded multi-layer soil moisture targets.
0d9a0094d08882d123f418c22231ba17588b92f3.open_work: Testing transferability to other regions and depths, and quantifying how much the physical constraints help, follow naturally.
0d9a0094d08882d123f418c22231ba17588b92f3.issues: Without the abstract the data, region and skill cannot be verified; physical constraints may only be soft penalties.

d9fcb4604527d6ace42063d74fe390f3d8a5cd90.goal: Forecasts region-level air quality by modelling time-varying, synchronous spatial and temporal dependencies among monitoring sites or regions.
d9fcb4604527d6ace42063d74fe390f3d8a5cd90.architecture: Dynamic synchronous graph transformer network combining a graph neural network over regions with transformer attention over time.

aeb4158a07f3a7bd0edfbaea8ddffb39d99c3292.goal: Classifies Palmer Drought Severity Index categories in Ethiopia to support drought early warning.
aeb4158a07f3a7bd0edfbaea8ddffb39d99c3292.architecture: Comparison of logistic regression, SVM, KNN, decision tree, random forest, gradient boosting, naive Bayes, AdaBoost and XGBoost with SMOTE resampling and SHAP; ARIMA benchmark.

11c63db04a68b78c42c7d96450eb689accac2f01.goal: Forecasts evapotranspiration, potential evapotranspiration and crop water stress index in Bangladesh under future climate scenarios for irrigation planning.

6764ee62cebdb785e4ece9508fb61737b099e5b5.goal: Tests whether a performance limit exists for rain-snow partitioning from near-surface meteorology.

6764ee62cebdb785e4ece9508fb61737b099e5b5.result: ML improves accuracy by at most 0.6%; all methods fail for mixed and sub-freezing rain events, worst at 1.0–2.5 °C where rain and snow temperatures overlap.

d4b376022628459c5a805696415903bde5bd6698.goal: Explores how to train deep learning models across many stations with static aquifer attributes to simulate groundwater levels regionally.

d4b376022628459c5a805696415903bde5bd6698.data: Groundwater level series in northern France with climatic drivers and static basin characteristics.
d4b376022628459c5a805696415903bde5bd6698.result: Cluster-specific models outperform whole-dataset models; wavelet preprocessing partially compensates for no clustering and, with clustering, strongly improves low-frequency-dominated wells.

d4b376022628459c5a805696415903bde5bd6698.issues: Regional study in northern France; multi-station models can miss local behaviour without clustering.

477e864193ee74eee0cf08b3a0ccae10a6c3a1c7.architecture: Comparison of random forest, XGBoost, feed-forward neural network (MLP), LSTM, support vector regression and Gaussian process regression against a linear regression baseline.
477e864193ee74eee0cf08b3a0ccae10a6c3a1c7.data: Turkey, all 81 provinces; spatially downscaled demographic, economic and climatic variables (heating and cooling degree days) combined with SSP scenarios.
477e864193ee74eee0cf08b3a0ccae10a6c3a1c7.result: Random forest is best (R2 = 0.9359, MAE = 0.04 TWh); demand is projected to rise 78% from 65.5 TWh in 2023 to 116.7 ± 2.9 TWh by 2050, driven mostly by socioeconomic variables.
477e864193ee74eee0cf08b3a0ccae10a6c3a1c7.open_work: Applying the transferable framework to other regionally diverse or data-scarce countries and to other demand sectors.
477e864193ee74eee0cf08b3a0ccae10a6c3a1c7.issues: Tree-based models cannot extrapolate beyond training ranges, a concern for 2050 projections; climate drivers are represented only by degree days; single-country case study.

226149b6b8f1874ca7af780b484a0e9945bb2e04.goal: Produces 1 km maps of column CO2 and CH4 over the Arabian Peninsula to overcome coarse model resolution and gaps in satellite greenhouse gas retrievals.
226149b6b8f1874ca7af780b484a0e9945bb2e04.architecture: XGBoost gradient-boosted trees used to downscale satellite XCO2 and XCH4 from ancillary predictors.
226149b6b8f1874ca7af780b484a0e9945bb2e04.data: OCO-2 XCO2 and Sentinel-5P XCH4 as targets; CarbonTracker, MODIS Terra and ERA5 as inputs; comparison with the EDGAR emission inventory.
226149b6b8f1874ca7af780b484a0e9945bb2e04.result: High skill for XCO2 (R2 = 0.98, RMSE = 0.58 ppm) and moderate for XCH4 (R2 = 0.63, RMSE = 13.26 ppb); summer maxima and urban/industrial hotspots identified.
226149b6b8f1874ca7af780b484a0e9945bb2e04.open_work: The authors suggest integrating ground-based observations to further improve accuracy.
226149b6b8f1874ca7af780b484a0e9945bb2e04.issues: No independent ground-based validation; high XCO2 skill may partly reflect CarbonTracker inputs; XCH4 accuracy is only moderate.

e06e8defbc396f543174e6d39aff060df492e64a.goal: Improves typhoon-induced storm surge prediction in the Bohai Sea, where observed surges are scarce but typhoon activity is changing.
e06e8defbc396f543174e6d39aff060df492e64a.architecture: LSTM, CNN, CNN-LSTM and ConvLSTM models trained to correct residual errors of the FVCOM ocean model (hybrid FVCOM-ML), driven by a hybrid Holland plus reanalysis wind field.
e06e8defbc396f543174e6d39aff060df492e64a.data: Advanced Circulation Model (ADCIRC) storm surge simulations used as training data to compensate for limited in situ observations in the Bohai Sea.
e06e8defbc396f543174e6d39aff060df492e64a.result: FVCOM-ML outperforms standalone FVCOM and standalone ML across single and multiple sites and single and multiple time steps; quantitative gains are not given in the abstract.
e06e8defbc396f543174e6d39aff060df492e64a.open_work: Validation with more observed typhoon events and extension to other semi-enclosed seas.
e06e8defbc396f543174e6d39aff060df492e64a.issues: Training on simulated rather than observed surges means model errors propagate; few real typhoon events are available for testing.

7fe5be4ebc0a8619f7fa57ba53ef48dcde152bf6.goal: Disentangles chemical, aerosol and meteorological drivers of ground-level ozone to inform ozone-climate control strategies in East Asia.
7fe5be4ebc0a8619f7fa57ba53ef48dcde152bf6.architecture: Random forest models interpreted with SHAP values.
7fe5be4ebc0a8619f7fa57ba53ef48dcde152bf6.data: Fine-resolution atmospheric composition measurements (VOCs, NOx, PM2.5) and meteorology at the Tucheng site, New Taipei, northern Taiwan.
7fe5be4ebc0a8619f7fa57ba53ef48dcde152bf6.result: 10-fold cross-validation R2 above 0.867; chemical and aerosol drivers explain 82.4% of SHAP variance in winter and 62.1% in summer; temperature, 1,2,3-trimethylbenzene, NOx, t-2-butene and RH dominate.
7fe5be4ebc0a8619f7fa57ba53ef48dcde152bf6.open_work: Adapting the framework to other sampling sites and linking statistical sensitivities to photochemical mechanisms.
7fe5be4ebc0a8619f7fa57ba53ef48dcde152bf6.issues: Single site; SHAP attributions reflect associations not causation; collinearity among precursors and meteorology may distort importance.

6b880b4bc9c375f9f7078f8fce92227356b9e4d3.goal: Partitions evapotranspiration into evaporation and transpiration and ranks their drivers in a semi-arid ecosystem where process understanding is limited.
6b880b4bc9c375f9f7078f8fce92227356b9e4d3.architecture: Machine learning framework with SHAP explanations; the specific model type is not specified in the abstract.
6b880b4bc9c375f9f7078f8fce92227356b9e4d3.data: 62 hydrometeorological and biomass productivity variables from flux tower data at the Reynolds Creek Critical Zone Observatory, Idaho.
6b880b4bc9c375f9f7078f8fce92227356b9e4d3.result: Soil water content leads evaporation and ET, vapour pressure deficit leads transpiration; combining hydrometeorological and productivity variables improves predictability.
6b880b4bc9c375f9f7078f8fce92227356b9e4d3.open_work: Testing the framework at other semi-arid and contrasting ecosystems and validating partitioning against independent isotope or sap-flow estimates.
6b880b4bc9c375f9f7078f8fce92227356b9e4d3.issues: Single site; ML-based partitioning depends on the reference partition used for training; skill metrics are not reported in the abstract.

b91ee790f2c5978eb8c717fcbc51262500fa320f.goal: Predicts long-term building energy consumption and overheating risk under climate change at the urban scale, as implied by the title.
b91ee790f2c5978eb8c717fcbc51262500fa320f.architecture: Machine learning surrogate combined with urban building energy modeling; the specific model type is not specified in the available metadata.
b91ee790f2c5978eb8c717fcbc51262500fa320f.data: Urban building energy model simulations under future climate scenarios; city, weather files and scenarios are not reported in the available metadata.
b91ee790f2c5978eb8c717fcbc51262500fa320f.result: Not reported; no abstract was available.
b91ee790f2c5978eb8c717fcbc51262500fa320f.open_work: Validation with measured building data and extension to other cities and climate scenarios would be natural next steps.
b91ee790f2c5978eb8c717fcbc51262500fa320f.issues: Card is based on the title only; surrogate accuracy and climate scenario details could not be verified.

c8e742f35ba78b80d6f6f46070a73f2b8b415342.goal: Reviews data-driven deep learning models for forecasting solar and wind energy generation.
c8e742f35ba78b80d6f6f46070a73f2b8b415342.architecture: Review of deep learning forecasting models for solar and wind energy; the specific architectures covered are not specified in the available metadata.
c8e742f35ba78b80d6f6f46070a73f2b8b415342.data: Literature review; corpus and selection criteria are not reported in the available metadata.
c8e742f35ba78b80d6f6f46070a73f2b8b415342.result: Not reported; no abstract was available.
c8e742f35ba78b80d6f6f46070a73f2b8b415342.open_work: Not reported; common open issues in this area include probabilistic forecasting, transferability across sites and use of NWP inputs.
c8e742f35ba78b80d6f6f46070a73f2b8b415342.issues: Card is based on the title only; coverage and conclusions could not be verified.

74740ccac59f9b704c6ca9b1535191e49316b595.goal: Forecasts daily urban air quality in Shenyang, China, with an interpretable high-accuracy model for air quality management.
74740ccac59f9b704c6ca9b1535191e49316b595.architecture: Five gradient-boosted decision tree models combined through a ridge-regularized stacking ensemble, interpreted with SHAP.
74740ccac59f9b704c6ca9b1535191e49316b595.data: Six years (2020–2025) of daily air quality and meteorological measurements in Shenyang.
74740ccac59f9b704c6ca9b1535191e49316b595.result: The stacking ensemble reaches R2 of 94.17% and MAPE of 7.79%, beating individual models; ozone, PM10 and PM2.5 dominate air quality fluctuations.
74740ccac59f9b704c6ca9b1535191e49316b595.open_work: Testing in other cities and at longer forecast horizons, as implied by the claimed global implications.
74740ccac59f9b704c6ca9b1535191e49316b595.issues: Single city; using pollutant concentrations to predict an air quality index built from them makes the task partly tautological; forecast lead time is unclear.

0babf669442db0c030c353dc1fe42392c73f9872.goal: Shows how ensemble construction improves accuracy and uncertainty quantification of ML hydrologic predictions, using stream temperature in unmonitored basins.
0babf669442db0c030c353dc1fe42392c73f9872.architecture: Six ensemble construction techniques applied to LSTM, GRU, temporal convolution network (TCN) and XGBoost models.
0babf669442db0c030c353dc1fe42392c73f9872.data: Stream temperature observations in unmonitored basins across the contiguous United States.
0babf669442db0c030c353dc1fe42392c73f9872.result: Ensembles universally improve accuracy over deterministic models; varying inputs or mixing architectures works best; XGBoost is most accurate but has lower spread than deep learning.
0babf669442db0c030c353dc1fe42392c73f9872.open_work: Determining optimal ensemble size and diversity and extending to other hydrologic variables such as streamflow.
0babf669442db0c030c353dc1fe42392c73f9872.issues: Single target variable; ensemble spread is not necessarily well calibrated; computational cost of large deep learning ensembles.

25a9f12f711e2460b0ba2c55f28bb719aefd1b5b.goal: Quantifies how oceanic mesoscale eddies affect air-sea CO2 uptake, a poorly constrained part of the ocean carbon sink.
25a9f12f711e2460b0ba2c55f28bb719aefd1b5b.architecture: Observation-based machine learning estimation of CO2 fluxes along eddy lifetimes; the specific model type is not specified in the abstract.
25a9f12f711e2460b0ba2c55f28bb719aefd1b5b.data: Observation-based estimates for thousands of tracked eddies in the Kuroshio Extension and Gulf Stream; specific products are not named in the abstract.
25a9f12f711e2460b0ba2c55f28bb719aefd1b5b.result: Anticyclonic eddies enhance and cyclonic eddies slightly reduce uptake, giving net increases of 9.98 ± 2.28% (Kuroshio Extension) and 13.82 ± 9.94% (Gulf Stream), driven by downward DIC pumping.
25a9f12f711e2460b0ba2c55f28bb719aefd1b5b.open_work: The authors call for expanded monitoring in eddy-rich, undersampled regions and better eddy representation in carbon sink estimates.
25a9f12f711e2460b0ba2c55f28bb719aefd1b5b.issues: ML flux estimates inherit sparse pCO2 sampling at eddy scales; large uncertainty in the Gulf Stream; limited to two western boundary current regions.

f957a360a43c2f0b26b74c92062fb2daf3d08137.goal: Improves surface soil moisture prediction by combining process-based and data-driven modeling for weather, agriculture and water management applications.
f957a360a43c2f0b26b74c92062fb2daf3d08137.architecture: Physics-guided deep learning (PGDL) model coupling the Terrestrial Ecosystem Model (TEM) with LSTM networks.
f957a360a43c2f0b26b74c92062fb2daf3d08137.data: Site observations: 7 sites of different vegetation types for single-site tests and 13 sites of one vegetation type for multisite tests.
f957a360a43c2f0b26b74c92062fb2daf3d08137.result: Single-site PGDL RMSE 0.04 and R2 0.66 versus process-based (0.13, −2.32) and pure LSTM (0.06, 0.36); multisite PGDL RMSE 0.06, R2 0.63.
f957a360a43c2f0b26b74c92062fb2daf3d08137.open_work: Scaling to regional or global gridded prediction and across vegetation types.
f957a360a43c2f0b26b74c92062fb2daf3d08137.issues: Small number of sites; multisite tests limited to one vegetation type; generalization to ungauged locations not shown.

725b04e5cf7d79f16aa70191aadb432b436e0a0d.goal: Unifies calibration and regionalization of land/hydrology process model parameters using AI emulators trained across many basins.
725b04e5cf7d79f16aa70191aadb432b436e0a0d.architecture: Large-Sample Emulator (LSE): an AI emulator of the land model trained jointly on many basins, compared with Single-Site Emulators; the network type is not specified in the abstract.
725b04e5cf7d79f16aa70191aadb432b436e0a0d.data: 627 basins in the continental United States simulated with the Community Terrestrial Systems Model (CTSM); runoff evaluation with spatial cross-validation.
725b04e5cf7d79f16aa70191aadb432b436e0a0d.result: LSE improves runoff in all basins and beats single-site emulators in single- and multi-objective calibration; regionalized parameters beat defaults in most unseen basins.
725b04e5cf7d79f16aa70191aadb432b436e0a0d.open_work: Extending to other Earth system model components and global domains.
725b04e5cf7d79f16aa70191aadb432b436e0a0d.issues: Emulator errors can bias calibrated parameters; limited to CONUS runoff; computational cost of generating training ensembles.

8203a5233e238f051afd3e68101255bee0b8a2c0.goal: Provides probabilistic and explainable multi-step groundwater level prediction for water resources management.
8203a5233e238f051afd3e68101255bee0b8a2c0.architecture: Bayesian TimesNet (BTimesNet): a TimesNet convolutional model reshaping 1D series into 2D periodic matrices, with Stein Variational Gradient Descent for uncertainty and SHAP for interpretation.
8203a5233e238f051afd3e68101255bee0b8a2c0.data: Monthly groundwater levels and meteorological predictors from 19 monitoring wells in three US hydroclimatic regions.
8203a5233e238f051afd3e68101255bee0b8a2c0.result: BTimesNet consistently beats LSTM and Autoformer up to 4 months ahead; historical groundwater levels are the most informative features.
8203a5233e238f051afd3e68101255bee0b8a2c0.open_work: Applying to other hydrological and environmental prediction tasks and larger well networks.
8203a5233e238f051afd3e68101255bee0b8a2c0.issues: Only 19 wells and monthly data; reliance on past groundwater levels limits use in unmonitored wells; pumping effects not discussed.

ff9cb356947774c921e3a02c4cc354b2ecba7fb8.goal: Retrieves soil moisture from CYGNSS GNSS reflectometry with improved precision and coverage over the operational product.
ff9cb356947774c921e3a02c4cc354b2ecba7fb8.architecture: Multi-head self-attention-aided vision transformer (MSA-ViT), a modified hierarchical vision transformer, informed by coherent scattering sensitivity analysis.
ff9cb356947774c921e3a02c4cc354b2ecba7fb8.data: CYGNSS reflectivity 2020–2024 aggregated over 3–60 days; evaluation against SMAP, CYGNSS L3 SM V3.2, International Soil Moisture Network in situ data and GPM precipitation.
ff9cb356947774c921e3a02c4cc354b2ecba7fb8.result: Outperforms linear regression, shallow neural networks and other deep learning models, and improves on the CYGNSS L3 product in precision and coverage.
ff9cb356947774c921e3a02c4cc354b2ecba7fb8.open_work: Improving generalization across temporal scales and ecosystem types and extending to higher latitudes beyond CYGNSS coverage.
ff9cb356947774c921e3a02c4cc354b2ecba7fb8.issues: Training against SMAP inherits its errors; quantitative metrics not given in the abstract; CYGNSS spatial coverage limited to the tropics and subtropics.

8cf2bf2c58a4d58afc6693a3535fe09e3eb92b07.goal: Forecasts the Fire Weather Index at 4 km over CONUS up to 14 days ahead to support wildfire risk management.
8cf2bf2c58a4d58afc6693a3535fe09e3eb92b07.architecture: Hybrid graph neural networks combined with temporal convolutional networks (GNN-TCNN), LSTM (GNN-LSTM) and DeepAR (GNN-DeepAR).
8cf2bf2c58a4d58afc6693a3535fe09e3eb92b07.data: gridMET meteorology 2014–2023 used to compute 4 km FWI over CONUS.
8cf2bf2c58a4d58afc6693a3535fe09e3eb92b07.result: GNN-TCNN is best: day-1 IOA 0.95 and RMSE 1.21; 14-day mean IOA 0.885 and RMSE 1.325, ahead of GNN-LSTM and GNN-DeepAR.
8cf2bf2c58a4d58afc6693a3535fe09e3eb92b07.open_work: Incorporating NWP forecast inputs and fuel or ignition data to move from fire weather to fire occurrence prediction.
8cf2bf2c58a4d58afc6693a3535fe09e3eb92b07.issues: Forecasts FWI from past FWI-related data without weather forecasts, so skill at long leads is limited; no comparison with FWI computed from NWP.

1c8f181fa6c9c40d8d4c045e9f50826e6c628ab0.goal: Optimizes fertilization and irrigation to sustain crop yields while reducing agricultural N2O emissions under uncertain climate variability.
1c8f181fa6c9c40d8d4c045e9f50826e6c628ab0.architecture: Reinforcement learning with deep Q-learning and recurrent neural networks in a POMDP, plus a probabilistic deep learning model for N2O emissions.
1c8f181fa6c9c40d8d4c045e9f50826e6c628ab0.data: Simulated farming environment; N2O emission model trained on a limited observational dataset not named in the abstract.
1c8f181fa6c9c40d8d4c045e9f50826e6c628ab0.result: The N2O model achieves PICP of 0.937 for 95% intervals; RL agents reduce N2O emissions without lowering yields under climatic variability.
1c8f181fa6c9c40d8d4c045e9f50826e6c628ab0.open_work: Integrating expanded field datasets or alternative emission models and testing on real farms.
1c8f181fa6c9c40d8d4c045e9f50826e6c628ab0.issues: Emission model generalizability is limited by scarce observations; results come from simulation only.

e76cea7c4efbd6672fa5edc7bfc1c8c8fc1ae687.goal: Provides a standardized global benchmark for in-season sub-national maize and wheat yield forecasting to enable reproducible model comparison.
e76cea7c4efbd6672fa5edc7bfc1c8c8fc1ae687.architecture: Benchmark dataset and evaluation framework (CY-Bench) for data-driven crop yield forecasting models, developed within the AgML initiative.
e76cea7c4efbd6672fa5edc7bfc1c8c8fc1ae687.data: Harmonized sub-national yield statistics with weather, soil and remote sensing predictors for more than 25 countries on six continents; openly released on Zenodo.
e76cea7c4efbd6672fa5edc7bfc1c8c8fc1ae687.result: Delivers a pre-processed, standardized dataset and code for consistent model evaluation; model results are not detailed in the abstract.
e76cea7c4efbd6672fa5edc7bfc1c8c8fc1ae687.open_work: Supports research on time series forecasting, domain adaptation and online learning, and continuous benchmark extension.
e76cea7c4efbd6672fa5edc7bfc1c8c8fc1ae687.issues: Sub-national statistics vary in quality and coverage across countries; limited to maize and wheat.

caacb9964b87b9310c388a159c5588743289bb73.goal: Improves interpretability of urban flood susceptibility mapping while keeping ensemble model accuracy.
caacb9964b87b9310c388a159c5588743289bb73.architecture: Logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost combined with Accumulated Local Effects (ALE) explainable AI.
caacb9964b87b9310c388a159c5588743289bb73.data: Flood conditioning factors such as rainfall, distance to river, elevation, slope and NDVI, with historical flood records; study area not named in the abstract.
caacb9964b87b9310c388a159c5588743289bb73.result: Ensemble models reach 94% accuracy and AUC 0.98, beating logistic regression; ALE reveals rainfall thresholds and nonlinear local effects.
caacb9964b87b9310c388a159c5588743289bb73.open_work: Scaling the framework for urban planning and early warning in other rapidly developing regions.
caacb9964b87b9310c388a159c5588743289bb73.issues: Static susceptibility rather than event forecasting; flood inventory quality and spatial autocorrelation can inflate accuracy.

1d9c4c9317fd467492ef2998e0b970b964470cb3.goal: Reviews machine learning and deep learning approaches as scalable alternatives to hydrodynamic models for flood inundation mapping.
1d9c4c9317fd467492ef2998e0b970b964470cb3.architecture: Review covering random forest, SVM, gradient boosting, CNN, U-Net, LSTM, and hybrid and physics-informed frameworks for flood extent and depth estimation.
1d9c4c9317fd467492ef2998e0b970b964470cb3.data: Literature review of studies using remote sensing, DEMs and hydro-climatic datasets; HEC-RAS and LISFLOOD-FP serve as traditional references.
1d9c4c9317fd467492ef2998e0b970b964470cb3.result: Synthesizes performance and benchmarking practices and identifies challenges in interpretability, data bias, transferability and regulatory acceptance.
1d9c4c9317fd467492ef2998e0b970b964470cb3.open_work: Explainable AI, uncertainty-aware modeling and physics-informed learning as pathways to operational adoption.
1d9c4c9317fd467492ef2998e0b970b964470cb3.issues: Narrative review; heterogeneous metrics across studies limit direct comparison.

f7c4532dbae7a0a05c3fbf2c8497bd5eec79f31d.goal: Describes version 1.1.0 of ECMWF's operational machine-learned forecast model AIFS Single, adding physical constraints and more variables.
f7c4532dbae7a0a05c3fbf2c8497bd5eec79f31d.architecture: Graph neural network encoder-decoder with a transformer processor, extended with a bounding-layer framework enforcing non-negativity and consistency for precipitation and cloud cover.
f7c4532dbae7a0a05c3fbf2c8497bd5eec79f31d.data: Expanded training data of ERA5 reanalysis and ECMWF operational IFS analyses, with an extended set of surface and atmospheric variables.
f7c4532dbae7a0a05c3fbf2c8497bd5eec79f31d.result: Skill improves 4–6% in upper-air and near-surface variables; precipitation improves up to 12% (about 1 day gain); training data expansion drives upper-air gains.
f7c4532dbae7a0a05c3fbf2c8497bd5eec79f31d.open_work: Frequent model updates with expanded data and further physical constraints are highlighted.
f7c4532dbae7a0a05c3fbf2c8497bd5eec79f31d.issues: Deterministic model with MSE-type training still smooths fields; evaluation partly against ECMWF's own analyses.

78a477ce779089679ecc71da12becf61eed5872c.goal: Provides interpretable intra-day solar forecasting using spatiotemporal satellite and numerical weather prediction inputs.
78a477ce779089679ecc71da12becf61eed5872c.architecture: Interpretable transformer-based forecasting model, as stated in the title.
78a477ce779089679ecc71da12becf61eed5872c.data: Satellite imagery and NWP inputs; specific products, sites and periods are not reported in the available metadata.
78a477ce779089679ecc71da12becf61eed5872c.result: Not reported; no abstract was available.
78a477ce779089679ecc71da12becf61eed5872c.open_work: Not reported; testing across climates and sites would be a natural next step.
78a477ce779089679ecc71da12becf61eed5872c.issues: Card is based on the title only; skill and interpretability claims could not be verified.

ab22c0f074e62a94ed190c488f39db52ef432210.goal: Produces probabilistic spatio-temporal wind speed forecasts that capture evolving spatial correlations for wind energy applications.
ab22c0f074e62a94ed190c488f39db52ef432210.architecture: Probabilistic Spatio-Temporal Diffusion Transformer (PSTDT): denoising diffusion probabilistic model with a transformer, dual-spatial attention, dual-phase temporal module and temporal-adaptive layer normalization.
ab22c0f074e62a94ed190c488f39db52ef432210.data: Multiple wind speed datasets; specific datasets are not named in the abstract.
ab22c0f074e62a94ed190c488f39db52ef432210.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art methods, reducing CRPS by 8–20% and MAE by 7–19%.
ab22c0f074e62a94ed190c488f39db52ef432210.open_work: Extending to wind power and longer horizons with NWP inputs.
ab22c0f074e62a94ed190c488f39db52ef432210.issues: Datasets and lead times not specified in the abstract; diffusion sampling cost; reliability of extremes not discussed.

b7abf7e6c27e5a6fd84c2097639d22f093b8f2a9.goal: Bibliometrically reviews satellite remote sensing for crop yield prediction to identify dominant sensors, crops, topics and research gaps.
b7abf7e6c27e5a6fd84c2097639d22f093b8f2a9.architecture: Review and bibliometric analysis of 1174 Web of Science articles from 2000–2025.
b7abf7e6c27e5a6fd84c2097639d22f093b8f2a9.data: Web of Science Core Collection publications; Sentinel-2, Landsat and MODIS are the most used missions, with radar increasingly used.
b7abf7e6c27e5a6fd84c2097639d22f093b8f2a9.result: Publications expand steadily; methods shift from simple regression to machine learning, deep learning and multi-sensor fusion with dense satellite time series.
b7abf7e6c27e5a6fd84c2097639d22f093b8f2a9.open_work: Better fusion of radar and optical data and addressing identified research gaps.
b7abf7e6c27e5a6fd84c2097639d22f093b8f2a9.issues: Bibliometric approach captures trends rather than comparative model performance; limited to Web of Science.

4dbc4b30fa7fefb04194b225590448cc8683e2ce.goal: Reconstructs daily three-dimensional subsurface salinity in the Pacific from satellite observations, beyond prior monthly deep learning reconstructions.
4dbc4b30fa7fefb04194b225590448cc8683e2ce.architecture: Wavelet-enhanced 3-D Mamba state-space model (3-D-WaveMa) with a 3-D selective scanning module and K-means clustering-guided transfer learning.
4dbc4b30fa7fefb04194b225590448cc8683e2ce.data: Multivariate satellite surface observations over the Pacific; EN4 in situ and analysis products as reference.
4dbc4b30fa7fefb04194b225590448cc8683e2ce.result: Beats common deep learning baselines; daily and monthly fields are 4–51% and 19–58% more accurate than mainstream reanalysis and model products; resolves mesoscale eddy structure.
4dbc4b30fa7fefb04194b225590448cc8683e2ce.open_work: Extending to other basins and variables for satellite-based 3-D ocean monitoring.
4dbc4b30fa7fefb04194b225590448cc8683e2ce.issues: EN4 reference is sparse at depth and daily scales; evaluation against reanalyses has its own errors.

6340050f20dd9b336afc11b2cc0c6bb4cc856a87.goal: Reviews advances, challenges and future directions of AI in atmosphere-ocean sciences.
6340050f20dd9b336afc11b2cc0c6bb4cc856a87.architecture: Review of deep learning for weather and climate forecasting, phenomenon detection, data assimilation, reconstruction, bias correction, downscaling, explainable AI and hybrid physics-AI modeling.
6340050f20dd9b336afc11b2cc0c6bb4cc856a87.result: Identifies hybrid physics-AI modeling as the most promising path and calls for an AI model intercomparison framework.

063b6f98dd275402a55ece9ca872148b4c76fb3a.goal: Provides a multi-modal sensor fusion dataset to enable generative modeling for near-real-time remote sensing estimates where satellite coverage is limited.
063b6f98dd275402a55ece9ca872148b4c76fb3a.architecture: Benchmark dataset for generative modeling, with a proof-of-concept U-Net backbone using Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) to inject ground-based sensor data.

66fe930db70cd564d1d5882bfe7ef0cd58e64dd1.goal: Adds explicit runoff routing to LSTM rainfall-runoff models, which otherwise ignore river network connectivity and perform poorly in complex basins.
66fe930db70cd564d1d5882bfe7ef0cd58e64dd1.architecture: LSTM for local runoff generation combined with a graph neural network for routing over the directed river network; compares GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE and ChebNet.
66fe930db70cd564d1d5882bfe7ef0cd58e64dd1.data: LamaH-CE dataset for the Upper Danube River Basin, 1987-2017, partitioned into 530 subbasins.
66fe930db70cd564d1d5882bfe7ef0cd58e64dd1.result: All LSTM-GNN variants beat the baseline LSTM; LSTM-GAT is best (mean NSE 0.61, KGE 0.65, r 0.84, about 35% RMSE reduction), with largest gains at well-connected downstream stations.
66fe930db70cd564d1d5882bfe7ef0cd58e64dd1.open_work: Applying GNN routing to flood forecasting, other large basins and climate adaptation studies.
66fe930db70cd564d1d5882bfe7ef0cd58e64dd1.issues: Single basin tested; mean NSE of 0.61 leaves room for improvement; routing is learned rather than physically constrained.

1a55eab39610fdb8244bd138f11ffc628c9d6b04.goal: Develops probabilistic and interpretable neural network models for flood prediction that provide uncertainty information alongside forecasts.
1a55eab39610fdb8244bd138f11ffc628c9d6b04.architecture: N-HiTS and N-BEATS neural forecasting architectures (MLP-based) trained with a multi-quantile loss, benchmarked against LSTM.
1a55eab39610fdb8244bd138f11ffc628c9d6b04.data: Streamflow and rainfall data from two headwater streams in Georgia and North Carolina, USA; multiple flood events.
1a55eab39610fdb8244bd138f11ffc628c9d6b04.result: N-HiTS and N-BEATS improve accuracy by about 5% on average over LSTM and provide 95% prediction uncertainty bands for flood events.
1a55eab39610fdb8244bd138f11ffc628c9d6b04.open_work: Testing on more basins and longer lead times and further exploiting interpretability of model components.
1a55eab39610fdb8244bd138f11ffc628c9d6b04.issues: Only two headwater streams; modest improvement; quantile-based uncertainty may be poorly calibrated for rare extremes.

6c588e792d6009a14813240234af60e9593bb571.goal: Maps urban flood susceptibility in data-scarce settings using hybridized machine learning models built on historical flood events.
6c588e792d6009a14813240234af60e9593bb571.architecture: Support vector regression hybridized with wavelet transform and metaheuristic optimizers (grey wolf optimizer and bat algorithm): Wavelet-SVR-GWO and Wavelet-SVR-Bat versus standalone SVR.
6c588e792d6009a14813240234af60e9593bb571.data: Historical urban flood inventory and spatial conditioning factors for an urban study area; location not stated in the abstract.
6c588e792d6009a14813240234af60e9593bb571.result: Wavelet-SVR-GWO is best (AUC 0.981, accuracy 0.92, MCC 0.86), followed by Wavelet-SVR-Bat (AUC 0.972), both beating standalone SVR (AUC 0.917).
6c588e792d6009a14813240234af60e9593bb571.open_work: Testing in other cities and with dynamic or climate-change scenarios.
6c588e792d6009a14813240234af60e9593bb571.issues: Susceptibility mapping is static and depends on inventory quality; single study area; high AUCs may reflect spatial autocorrelation between training and test points.

786f1b3ad76c0f1999f8d6741c70b59f6f27531e.goal: Reviews how artificial intelligence addresses data gaps, complex conditions and retrieval limitations in satellite remote sensing of the ocean.
786f1b3ad76c0f1999f8d6741c70b59f6f27531e.architecture: Review of AI in satellite ocean remote sensing covering CNN and transformer retrieval models, deep learning data reconstruction, and detection and segmentation of ocean features.
786f1b3ad76c0f1999f8d6741c70b59f6f27531e.data: Literature review spanning multisource satellite observations of waves, sea surface temperature, salinity, wind, ocean color, sea ice, eddies, internal waves and tropical cyclones.
786f1b3ad76c0f1999f8d6741c70b59f6f27531e.result: AI improves retrieval accuracy under extreme or noisy conditions, reconstructs surface and subsurface fields better than interpolation, and detects ocean features efficiently.
786f1b3ad76c0f1999f8d6741c70b59f6f27531e.open_work: Deeper integration of physical knowledge, multisource fusion and near real-time operational applications.
786f1b3ad76c0f1999f8d6741c70b59f6f27531e.issues: Review-level synthesis; no unified quantitative benchmark across methods; physical consistency and generalization of data-driven retrievals remain open concerns.

53c026087d7093a154c2177dee8c03e11291e2d3.goal: Quantifies how meteorology drives daily surface ozone variability and trends in eastern China to separate meteorological from emission-driven changes.
53c026087d7093a154c2177dee8c03e11291e2d3.architecture: Ensemble of tree-based models (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost, random forest, extra trees) interpreted with SHAP explainable machine learning, plus a SHAP-based de-weathering framework.
53c026087d7093a154c2177dee8c03e11291e2d3.data: Daily surface ozone 2013-2023 in the North China Plain, Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta, with 14 meteorological variables and two temporal indicators.
53c026087d7093a154c2177dee8c03e11291e2d3.result: Before 2019 ozone increases are tied mainly to non-meteorological drivers, after 2019 meteorology dominates; meteorology-induced positive ozone anomalies grow in magnitude but not frequency or duration.
53c026087d7093a154c2177dee8c03e11291e2d3.open_work: Reducing attribution uncertainty from multicollinearity and linking meteorology-induced anomalies to climate change projections.
53c026087d7093a154c2177dee8c03e11291e2d3.issues: SHAP attributions differ across algorithms due to collinear inputs; temporal proxy lumps all non-meteorological influences; statistical attribution rather than chemical transport modeling.
